Title: Assistant Manager, Marketing Communications
Description:
Company Description
HOTEL OVERVIEW
Strategically located in the heart of Singapore’s shopping, dining and entertainment districts and with the City Hall and Esplanade Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) train stations and other major transportation nodes at its doorstep, Fairmont Singapore and Swissôtel The Stamford are the gateway to explore Singapore’s landscapes at your convenience. With a total of 2,030 well-appointed guestrooms, both hotels also offer a distinct collection of 12 lifestyle and dining choices including Michelin-starred fine dining restaurant JAAN by Kirk Westaway, cutting-edge meeting space at Raffles City Convention Centre with 34 meeting rooms and one of Asia’s largest spas, Willow Stream Spa.
ABOUT OUR COMPANY
At Fairmont Singapore and Swissôtel The Stamford, we design career plans and unveil new professional perspectives through our various development programs. We shine when YOU shine. Come and be part of our dynamic team and experience immerse growth and career opportunities with us.
Job Description
The Assistant Marketing Communications Manager develops and leads communications strategies for assigned revenue streams and lifestyle-led portfolios across Fairmont Singapore and Swissôtel The Stamford. This role has a strong focus on campaign management, public relations, media relations, content development, influencer engagement, media planning, partnerships, F&B storytelling, spa and lifestyle campaigns, while supporting broader hotel, brand and corporate initiatives. The role supports the Director of Marketing Communications in managing campaign execution, agency coordination, media hosting and team workflow. This is a leadership position as second in-charge to lead and manage the team.
COMMUNICATIONS & MEDIA PLANNING
Formulate communications and media calendars for assigned portfolios, ensuring timely and accurate execution of initiatives with relevant business units and stakeholders.
Develop Public Relations angles, media materials, influencer briefs and content narratives that generate positive and relevant coverage across local, regional and international channels.
Develop media plan for campaigns and dedicated business units for brand positioning and/or to meet campaign objectives
Review communications materials including press releases, media pitches, social copy, sales decks, in-house collaterals, ad copy and campaign assets to ensure accuracy, tonality and brand alignment.
Lead assigned awards submissions, canvassing of votes or nominations, and post-award amplification with relevant stakeholders.
Identify partnership opportunities with lifestyle, luxury, F&B, wellness, cultural and corporate brands to create differentiated guest experiences.
LIFESTYLE, PUBLIC RELATIONS & PORTFOLIO MANAGEMENT
Lead or support lifestyle and Public Relations -driven portfolios such as selected F&B venues, spa, wellness, partnerships, IP-led collaborations, festive campaigns and hotel stories.
Manage media, blogger, content creator and influencer hosting to drive positive coverage and beneficial commercial outcomes.
Coordinate media familiarisation stays, F&B tastings, chef interviews, partner activations and hosted experiences in line with approved strategy and budgets.
Support restaurant and bar positioning by developing story angles around culinary concepts, chefs, menus, events, awards and collaborations.
Maintain active awareness of hospitality, lifestyle, dining, wellness and media trends to identify relevant opportunities.
CAMPAIGN & EVENT MANAGEMENT
Conceptualise, plan and execute integrated communications campaigns with the Director, internal team, Public relations agencies, digital partners and business unit stakeholders.
Support marketing and promotion of hotel-led events, ensuring strong attendance, media relevance, guest experience and post-event reporting.
Prepare campaign briefs, timelines, content requirements, photography or videography briefs, creative references and partner deliverables.
Coordinate cross-channel launches across website, social media, email, in-house displays, press outreach, partner platforms and advertising placements.
Monitor campaign performance and prepare updates with recommendations for optimisation.
MARKET RESEARCH & ANALYSIS
Conduct market research to identify consumer preferences, competitor activity, hospitality trends and relevant lifestyle or dining developments.
Analyse public relations , campaign, media monitoring, social and stakeholder feedback to develop informed recommendations that support business goals.
Review competitive communications to identify opportunities for differentiation and stronger positioning.
PARTNER, AGENCY & VENDOR ENGAGEMENT
Manage day-to-day agency, partner and vendor coordination for assigned projects, ensuring clear scopes, timelines, deliverables and approvals.
Host partners and industry contacts for ongoing engagement and potential collaborations.
Support negotiation of value-added partner arrangements that enhance brand relevance, reduce costs or improve guest experiences.
BUDGETING & ADMINISTRATION
Manage campaign and assigned business unit budgets and forecast.
Monitor campaign-level budgets, quotations and supplier costs for assigned projects, ensuring forecast accuracy and procurement compliance.
Support annual budget planning by gathering scopes, historical costs and proposed activity requirements.
Work with the Coordinator to ensure agreements, purchase requests, invoices and accruals are submitted accurately and on time.
OTHERS
Comply with hotel and department policies and procedures at all times.
Assist with Sales & Marketing projects and carry out other duties as assigned by Management.
Qualifications
Degree or Diploma in Hospitality, Tourism, Marketing, Communications, Public Relations or a related discipline.
Minimum 3 to 6 years of marketing communications or public relations experience, preferably within hospitality, travel, lifestyle, luxury, F&B or agency environments.
Leadership – experience in leading and managing teams
Excellent spoken and written English. Fluency in a second language is preferred.
AI-enabled marketer, proficient in Claude, ChatGPT, relevant tools for content creation, presentations, project management
Strong knowledge of marketing communications (Branding, Public Relations , Events, Advertising), hospitality trends, media//KOL connections locally/regionally
Excellent writing, editing, media pitching and content planning skills.
Strong stakeholder management with the ability to work across multiple business units and senior stakeholders.
Ability to brief agencies, designers, photographers and vendors with clear objectives and timelines.
Strong analytical skills with comfort using media monitoring, influencer analysis and campaign performance data.
Creative, proactive and commercially minded, with a passion for hospitality and guest experiences.
Collaborative, adaptable and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

Title: Digital Marketing & Branding Lead (FT / Renewable Contract)
Description:
Job Summary
Love great design, beautiful spaces and the thrill of building brands that people genuinely connect with? Do you obsess over conversion rates, live for a good sales milestone and believe that great marketing should always drive real commercial results? You might just be the person we are looking for.
We are on the hunt for a dynamic and commercially savvy Digital Marketing & Branding Lead to take the wheel on marketing and brand-building for our growing portfolio of home and living brands in Singapore. As a multi-brand distributor we represent a curated collection of international labels spanning lifestyle and home essentials and honestly it is a pretty exciting space to be in right now.
This is not a sit-back-and-delegate kind of role. You will be the brand custodian, the campaign architect and the digital marketing engine all rolled into one. From growing brand awareness to driving consumer engagement and commercial performance across every brand in our portfolio you will be the one making it happen. You will work closely with brand principals, retail partners and internal teams to craft and execute integrated marketing campaigns that truly resonate with Singapore's home and living consumers.
If you are someone who gets excited about a beautiful Instagram feed, hitting sales objectives and knows how to tell a compelling brand story across every touchpoint then we would love to hear from you.
Job Responsibilities
Brand Strategy & Management
Be the guardian of each brand's identity, tone of voice and visual standards across every digital and physical touchpoint because consistency is everything
Develop and maintain brand guidelines for each label so that every piece of communication looks and feels unmistakably on-brand
Run regular brand audits to make sure our brands stay fresh, relevant and visually compelling in Singapore's ever-evolving home and living market
Partner closely with brand principals to make sure our localised execution stays true to the bigger brand vision
Digital Marketing Strategy & Planning
Build a digital marketing roadmap that actually moves the needle by translating business goals into sharp integrated strategies with clear KPIs and real measurable outcomes
Get hands-on with all digital channels including SEO, SEM, AIO, GEO and whatever else the ever-changing digital landscape throws at us
Dig into the data, spot the trends and uncover growth opportunities before anyone else does
Allocate the digital marketing budget across all brand
Social Media & Community Management
Take the reins on the social media presence of all our brands across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and beyond
Plan posts, create content, keep the feeds looking good and make sure every account is active, engaging and true to its brand personality
Show up in the comments and DMs because community building is not just a checkbox but a relationship
Scout, manage influencers, livestreamers partnerships, content creators collaborations and brand tie-ups that make sense for the home and living world
E-Commerce & Digital Presence
Roll up your sleeves and get into the weeds of our e-commerce platforms and brand websites covering uploads, listings, visuals and all
Write and edit product listings that are not just accurate but actually make people want to buy
Ensure every touchpoint online delivers a seamless and enjoyable user experience with a sharp eye on UI and UX
Team up with sales and operations on promotions and digital merchandising and constantly find smarter ways to boost conversion and keep customers coming back for more
Key Experience & Skills
Experience & Background
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or related field
At least 3 to 5 years of experience in digital marketing with exposure to brand management ideally within the lifestyle or home and living category
Proven track record of directly managing multi-brand or multi-product digital marketing campaigns
Comfortable leading and executing at the same time in a lean team environment
Confident and comfortable in front of the camera whether it is a quick product reel, a brand story or a live session
Performance Marketing & Analytics
Strong expertise and hands-on experience in performance marketing, analytics tools including Google Analytics, Meta Business Suite, Shopify and apps, as well as any other marketing SaaS implementation and integration
Knowledge in using Canva, video editing software, Microsoft Office tools or other tools
Highly proficient in running campaigns, analysing performance and optimising results
Data-first mindset with a clear focus on commercial impact including pipeline contribution, revenue growth and return on investment
Someone who measures success against real business outcomes and not just pretty numbers on a dashboard
Customer Journey & Digital Funnels
Deep understanding of end-to-end customer journey orchestration and what it takes to keep people engaged at every stage
Experienced in mapping and managing digital funnels that move customers seamlessly from awareness through to conversion and retention
AI Application in Marketing
Advanced hands-on experience applying AI in day-to-day marketing operations including AI-driven campaign optimisation and predictive targeting
Proficient in deploying marketing automation and personalisation at scale
Ability to harness generative AI for content production, creative testing and workflow efficiency to work smarter and faster

Social Media Marketing
SEO / SEM / PPC
Performance & Ecommerce Marketing
Content Marketing
Influencer / Affiliates Marketing
Branding

​Experience: 2–3 years of experience in digital marketing, content creation, social media management, or event execution.
Creative, strategic thinker with strong project management skills
Fast & independent worker with strong organization ability with attention to details.

​Proficient in Adobe Illustrator and Canva for visual graphics design, wix /wordpress for website.
​Proficient in CapCut (or equivalent mobile/desktop editing software) for short-form video creation.
​Platform Expertise: Well-versed with audience trends, algorithms, and best practices on TikTok, Xiaohongshu (XHS), Instagram, and Facebook.
​Influencer Marketing: Proven experience in managing influencer/KOL outreach, campaign execution, and relationship management.
​Event Experience: Prior experience in on-ground event management/coordination is preferred.
​Language & Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Proficiency in Mandarin is a strong advantage (to effectively engage with local stakeholders, merchants, and social media agencies).
​Soft Skills: Creative mindset, strong organizational skills, ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment, and a passion for cultural heritage and precinct promotion.
5.5 day work alternate week and willing to work on weekend during events.

· ​Opportunity to work on iconic heritage projects and major cultural events in Singapore.

· Great opportunity to learn.

Title: Marketing Executive
Description:
ABOUT US
Kiztopia Group is a leading family edutainment and active entertainment business dedicated to creating meaningful experiences through play, exploration and movement.
Our portfolio includes Kiztopia, a recognised family edutainment brand, and Xventure, our next-generation indoor active sports park designed for older children, youths, young adults and families.
As we continue to grow across Singapore and the region, we are looking for energetic, creative and driven individuals who are excited to contribute to our brands and help bring engaging customer experiences to life.
THE ROLE
We are looking for a proactive, creative and hands-on Marketing Executive to support the planning, coordination and execution of integrated marketing initiatives for Kiztopia and Xventure.
This role offers broad exposure across digital marketing, social media, content development, CRM, partnerships, campaigns and events.
You will be responsible for translating marketing plans into effective execution, coordinating with various stakeholders and ensuring campaigns are delivered accurately, efficiently and on schedule.
We are looking for someone who is organised, digitally savvy, resourceful and comfortable taking ownership of day-to-day marketing activities.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Marketing Campaign Execution
Execute integrated marketing campaigns and promotions across online and offline channels.
Coordinate campaign timelines, deliverables, promotional mechanics and marketing assets.
Assist in developing campaign execution plans, including channel schedules, creative requirements and target audiences.
Ensure campaign launches, promotional updates and marketing communications are completed on schedule.
Work closely with Operations, Commercial and relevant internal teams to ensure campaign readiness and alignment.
Monitor campaign progress and proactively flag delays, issues or opportunities for improvement.
2. Digital Marketing & Paid Advertising
Set up, execute and monitor paid digital campaigns across platforms such as Meta, Google and TikTok based on approved marketing plans and budgets.
Assist with audience targeting, creative testing, campaign scheduling and performance optimisation.
Track advertising metrics such as reach, engagement, click-through rates, traffic, conversion and cost efficiency.
Maintain accurate records of campaign spending and results.
Prepare performance reports with key observations and recommendations.
Coordinate campaign landing pages, booking links and tracking requirements where applicable.
3. Social Media & Content Management
Develop and maintain social media content calendars aligned with marketing campaigns and brand direction.
Create, schedule and publish engaging content across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and other relevant platforms.
Develop captions, marketing copy, promotional messages and creative briefs.
Coordinate content production with designers, content creators, agencies and internal teams.
Support the creation of short-form videos, reels, photography and other digital content.
Monitor social media comments, enquiries and engagement, coordinating customer responses or escalations where required.
Keep up with relevant social media trends and propose creative content ideas suitable for each brand.
4. CRM, Customer Engagement & Website Updates
Execute email marketing, eDMs, segmented WhatsApp campaigns and other CRM communications.
Coordinate customer segmentation, promotional content, scheduling and communication accuracy.
Maintain and update website content, promotional details, campaign information and event listings.
Ensure marketing information is accurate and consistent across owned channels and relevant ticketing platforms.
Assist in customer engagement, retention and remarketing initiatives.
Track campaign responses and identify opportunities for improvements.
5. Partnerships, Events & Activations
Coordinate marketing activities with mall partners, influencers, ticketing platforms, schools and community partners.
Support new outlet launches, marketing events, pop-up activations and promotional campaigns.
Assist with influencer coordination, content deliverables, scheduling and campaign follow-up.
Prepare event-related marketing materials, communication schedules and campaign checklists.
Provide on-ground marketing support during key events and activations where required.
6. Reporting, Coordination & Administration
Maintain campaign trackers, content calendars, marketing schedules and deliverable checklists.
Consolidate campaign performance data across digital advertising, social media, CRM and other channels.
Prepare weekly marketing updates covering completed activities, campaign performance, outstanding actions and upcoming priorities.
Coordinate quotations, purchase requests, vendor deliverables and relevant budget records.
Ensure marketing materials, campaigns and promotional information are accurate and approved before release.
Suggest practical improvements to execution efficiency, content performance and campaign effectiveness.
REQUIREMENTS
Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Minimum 2 years of relevant marketing experience, preferably in a consumer-facing business or agency environment.
Good understanding of social media platforms, content marketing, digital advertising and campaign execution.
Hands-on familiarity with platforms such as Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, TikTok or relevant marketing tools.
Ability to coordinate multiple campaigns, stakeholders and deadlines independently.
Good copywriting, communication and organisational skills.
Comfortable working with campaign data, basic performance metrics and reporting tools.
Proactive, resourceful and detail-oriented, with a willingness to learn and take ownership of tasks.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative and hands-on environment.
ADDED ADVANTAGES
Experience in entertainment, attractions, sports, lifestyle, retail, hospitality or leisure industries.
Content creation skills, including photography, social media reels and short-form video production.
Video editing capabilities, using tools such as CapCut, Canva, Adobe Premiere Pro or similar applications.
Experience with CRM systems, email marketing, website CMS or e-commerce platforms.
Experience working with influencers, partners or supporting marketing events and activations.
Familiarity with Google Analytics, campaign tracking or basic marketing reporting.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
Timely and accurate execution of marketing campaigns.
Consistent delivery of engaging social media and digital marketing content.
Effective management of campaign schedules, assets and stakeholder coordination.
Reliable campaign monitoring, performance reporting and follow-up.
Improved execution efficiency and proactive identification of campaign opportunities.
Meaningful contribution to brand awareness, customer engagement and commercial performance.

Gain exposure to two exciting brands in the entertainment and leisure industry.
Build practical experience across integrated campaigns, digital marketing, content, CRM and events.
Be part of new brand launches, marketing activations and ongoing business expansion.
Work in a collaborative environment that encourages initiative, learning and ownership.

Title: Marketing Manager
Description:
ABOUT US
Kiztopia Group is a leading family edutainment and active entertainment business dedicated to creating meaningful, engaging experiences through play, exploration and movement.
With multiple concepts and locations across Singapore and the region, we continue to grow our portfolio through innovation, creativity and a commitment to delivering exceptional guest experiences.
Our established Kiztopia brand brings families together through purposeful play, while Xventure, our next-generation indoor actives ports park, introduces exciting experiences designed for older children, youths, young adults and families.
As we expand, we are looking for passionate and capable individuals to help strengthen our brands, grow our customer base and shape the future of entertainment in Singapore.
THE ROLE
We are seeking a commercially driven, creative and hands-on Marketing Manager to lead the marketing strategy, planning and execution for Kiztopia Group's Singapore businesses, including Kiztopia and Xventure.
You will take ownership of integrated marketing initiatives that strengthen brand positioning, increase customer acquisition, drive visitorship and contribute to business growth.
This role requires someone who can translate business objectives into actionable marketing strategies, balance brand-building with performance marketing, and lead campaigns from concept through execution and performance evaluation.
You will manage marketing budgets, guide team members, coordinate external agencies and work closely with Commercial, Operations and other stakeholders to deliver results.
We are looking for a well-rounded marketing leader who is equally comfortable developing strategy, analysing performance and getting involved in execution.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Marketing Strategy & Business Growth
Develop and lead integrated marketing strategies for Kiztopia and Xventure, aligned with brand positioning, commercial objectives and business priorities.
Translate revenue targets, visitorship goals and customer acquisition objectives into actionable monthly, quarterly and annual marketing plans.
Develop targeted strategies for different customer segments, including families, children, youths, young adults, schools and relevant community groups.
Identify opportunities to drive ticket sales, increase repeat visits, build brand loyalty and strengthen customer lifetime value.
Plan and manage campaigns across business-as-usual operations, seasonal peaks, new outlet launches and special events.
Monitor consumer trends, competitor activities and market opportunities to keep our brands relevant and competitive.
2. Integrated Campaign Management
Lead end-to-end planning and execution of marketing campaigns across paid, owned and earned channels.
Develop clear campaign objectives, audience targeting, promotional mechanics, timelines, budgets and measurable KPIs.
Oversee campaign delivery across social media, digital advertising, CRM, website, partnerships, PR and on-ground activations.
Establish effective customer journeys from awareness and engagement through to ticket purchase and repeat visits.
Ensure campaigns are delivered on time, within budget and aligned with business objectives.
Review campaign effectiveness and refine strategies based on performance data and customer response.
3. Digital Marketing & Performance Management
Lead digital marketing strategies across platforms such as Meta, Google, TikTok and other relevant channels.
Manage advertising budgets and optimise resource allocation based on campaign objectives and performance.
Oversee audience segmentation, retargeting, conversion campaigns and relevant testing initiatives.
Monitor key performance indicators such as reach, engagement, website traffic, acquisition cost, conversions and attributable revenue.
Identify opportunities to improve campaign efficiency, conversion rates and return on marketing investment.
Work with relevant stakeholders to improve website, booking and ticketing conversion journeys.
4. Brand, Social Media & Content Strategy
Own the overall brand marketing direction and ensure consistent positioning across campaigns and communication channels.
Develop differentiated content and communication strategies for Kiztopia and Xventure based on their respective target audiences.
Lead social media planning across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and other relevant platforms.
Guide the development of engaging content, including short-form videos, attraction highlights, promotional campaigns, customer experiences and community-driven content.
Review creative concepts, campaign messaging and marketing assets to ensure brand consistency and audience relevance.
Identify emerging content formats, cultural trends and creative opportunities that can strengthen organic reach and brand visibility.
Work closely with the marketing team, content creators and external agencies to deliver relevant, high-quality content.
5. Customer Engagement, CRM & Retention
Develop CRM and customer engagement strategies to encourage repeat visits, strengthen relationships and drive incremental revenue.
Oversee segmented email marketing, WhatsApp campaigns and other customer communications.
Identify opportunities for cross-promotion between Kiztopia, Xventure and other relevant business concepts.
Develop targeted campaigns around school holidays, birthdays, memberships, special occasions and customer engagement opportunities.
Review customer engagement and campaign data to identify opportunities for improved targeting and retention.
6. Partnerships, Events & Brand Activations
Collaborate with mall partners, ticketing platforms, community groups, schools, influencers and external partners on marketing initiatives.
Work closely with Commercial and Operations teams to support new outlet launches, grand openings, events and promotional activations.
Develop marketing initiatives that build awareness, generate publicity and encourage customer participation.
Identify and evaluate potential partnerships based on audience relevance, commercial value and expected marketing exposure.
Manage external agencies and vendors, ensuring clear deliverables, timelines, quality standards and value for money.
7. Budget, Reporting & Performance Accountability
Develop, manage and monitor marketing budgets across brands, campaigns and channels.
Track campaign performance against marketing KPIs and business objectives.
Prepare weekly marketing performance updates and monthly management reports covering key results, budget utilisation, insights and recommended actions.
Evaluate campaign effectiveness beyond engagement metrics, with emphasis on measurable business outcomes.
Identify underperforming initiatives early and recommend practical corrective actions.
Maintain clear marketing plans, campaign trackers, budgets and reporting frameworks.
8. Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Lead, coach and develop the Singapore marketing team, establishing clear priorities, ownership and performance expectations.
Delegate effectively while remaining hands-on when required by business priorities.
Establish efficient workflows for campaign planning, creative production, approvals, execution and reporting.
Work collaboratively with Operations, Commercial, Partnerships, Sales and regional stakeholders.
Ensure marketing campaigns and promotions are communicated clearly to frontline teams and are operationally executable.
Foster a culture of accountability, creativity, initiative and continuous improvement.
REQUIREMENTS
Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Minimum 5 years of relevant marketing experience, with demonstrated ownership of integrated marketing campaigns and experience leading projects or team members.
Strong understanding of digital marketing, performance advertising, social media, CRM and integrated campaign management.
Proven ability to develop actionable marketing plans and manage campaigns from strategy to execution.
Commercially minded, with the ability to interpret campaign performance and connect marketing activities to business outcomes.
Experience managing marketing budgets, external agencies and multiple concurrent campaigns.
Strong leadership, project management, communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
Proactive, resourceful and comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Creative and analytical, with the ability to balance brand development and performance-driven marketing.
Willingness to take a hands-on approach and support execution where necessary.
ADDED ADVANTAGES
Experience in attractions, entertainment, family-oriented businesses, lifestyle, leisure, retail, hospitality or other consumer-facing industries.
Experience managing multiple brands, business locations or new product launches.
Familiarity with online ticketing platforms, e-commerce conversion and customer acquisition campaigns.
Knowledge of SEO, Google Analytics, marketing automation or relevant CRM tools.
Experience in influencer marketing, community engagement, experiential marketing or event activations.
Hands-on content creation, photography or video editing experience.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
Clear, executable marketing plans aligned with commercial and brand objectives.
Improved brand visibility, customer engagement and qualified traffic.
Measurable contribution to customer acquisition, ticket sales, visitorship and repeat visits.
Effective utilisation of marketing budgets and continuous campaign optimisation.
Consistent delivery of high-quality campaigns across Kiztopia and Xventure.
A well-organised, accountable marketing team capable of executing independently.
WHY JOIN US?
Lead marketing for two exciting entertainment brands with distinct growth opportunities.
Play a meaningful role in new brand development, outlet launches and business expansion.
Take ownership of marketing initiatives with direct visibility into business performance.
Work in a dynamic, entrepreneurial and collaborative environment.
Grow professionally within an expanding regional entertainment group.
If you enjoy building brands, developing creative campaigns and turning marketing ideas into measurable results, we would love to hear from you.

Title: Marketing Manager
Description:
ABOUT STYL SOLUTIONS
Ride on the wave of Industry 4.0! Join STYL Solutions in the forefront of using Fintech and IoT technologies for smart city/nation transformation. Headquartered in Singapore with R&D center in Vietnam, STYL Solutions designs, develops, and supplies hardware, software and integrated solutions for applications in payment, loyalty management, location tracking, self-service operation, telemetry.
Our market segment coverage extends from financial services, retail, mass transit, education to social services markets in Singapore and South Asia Pacific.
Our vision is to use Fintech and IoT to create smart and efficient cities that enhance Quality of Life through convenience and healthier living.
JOB DESCRIPTION
We are looking for an independent and creative Marketing Manager to join us in our growth journey. You will own the full spectrum of STYL Solutions' marketing communications (MarComm) and corporate communications (CorpComm) activities. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role spanning event marketing, content and campaign development, sales collateral, digital and social media, corporate website management, presentation branding, a physical product demo space, and internal communications. You will work closely with the Product, Sales and Management teams and, where required, external vendors and subcontractors, to plan, produce and measure marketing outcomes that support customer acquisition, brand consistency and employee engagement.
RESPONSIBILITIES
A. Marketing Communications (MarComm)
Trade Show & Event Marketing
Plan and coordinate STYL's participation in trade shows and industry events in Singapore and overseas, from booth concept to on-site execution.
Design the booth layout and develop event collateral (backdrop, banners, brochures) and event gifts, including sourcing quotations and managing vendors and job orders.
Develop pre-event promotional eDMs and email signature banners; set up lead-collection methods for the event team.
Consolidate post-event leads, produce a post-event report, coordinate lead nurturing with Sales, and publish post-event social media content.
Content & Inbound Marketing
Work with Product Owners and Sales to plan a campaign calendar (topics, audience, timing) promoting STYL's SaaS solutions.
Maintain and grow the leads database; develop and broadcast eDM campaigns with clear, customer-focused messaging and calls to action.
Track campaign performance (delivery, open and click-through rates, conversions) and hand qualified leads to Sales for follow-up.
Produce blogs, whitepapers, case studies and product videos, and distribute them across the website, social media and sales channels; report on content performance and lead generation.
Product & Solution Pitch Decks and Brochures
Review and refresh existing brochures and Product-team pitch decks for clarity, professionalism and consistent STYL branding.
Simplify technical content into customer-focused messaging and finalise materials for use by Product, Sales and Marketing.
Product Advertising & Campaigns
Plan and execute advertising and marketing campaigns with Product and Sales teams, from objective-setting through channel selection and content creation.
Launch campaigns across selected channels, track reach, engagement and leads, and report results with recommendations for future campaigns.
STYL Marketplace Marketing Support
Support the Marketplace team's campaigns for merchants and the parent/student community, including decal designs, artwork and supporting digital materials.
Ensure all Marketplace marketing materials follow STYL branding and track campaign performance where applicable.
B. Corporate Communications (CorpComm)
Internal Communications
Develop a company-wide internal communications plan covering CEO messages, Town Halls, product updates and newsletters.
Coordinate with Management and other teams to produce and distribute clear, consistent internal content through appropriate channels.
Corporate Website Management
Keep the STYL corporate website accurate, current and optimised for SEO; monitor traffic and page performance.
Publish company news, events and articles, and coordinate with internal teams or the website vendor on content, design and functionality updates.
Social Media Management
Develop and maintain a LinkedIn content calendar; create on-brand posts and visuals covering company activities, products and events.
Schedule and publish approved content, and monitor performance (impressions, engagement, follower growth) to continuously improve STYL's social presence across various platforms (i.e. LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook).
Presentation Templates & Branding
Standardise STYL's corporate PowerPoint templates — layout, fonts, colours and slide types — for consistent, professional use across teams.
Product & Solution Demo Space
Plan a dedicated demo space to showcase STYL's products, including layout, branding, signage and content requirements.
Prepare cost estimates and budget for management approval, and coordinate with vendors and subcontractors on installation, then test and finalise the space for customer visits.
JOB REQUIREMENTS
Here at STYL Solutions, we value proactive ownership and require independence and hands-on involvement in our daily responsibilities. We seek entrepreneurial candidates with the following:
Experience
At least 3 years of relevant experience in marketing communications and/or corporate communications, ideally in a B2B technology, hardware or SaaS environment.
Demonstrated experience planning and executing trade shows or corporate events, from concept to post-event reporting.
Experience running digital and content marketing campaigns (eDM, webinars, social media, SEO) and managing a leads database.
Experience liaising with external vendors, printers, designers or subcontractors, including obtaining quotations and managing budgets, is an advantage.
Prior exposure to internal communications (newsletters, Town Halls, management messaging) is an advantage.
Education & Qualifications
Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Mass Communications, Business Administration or a related field.
Skills
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to translate technical product information into clear, customer-friendly messaging.
Working knowledge of digital marketing tools (eDM platforms, basic SEO, social media scheduling and analytics).
Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Word for presentation and collateral development; working knowledge of design tools (e.g. Canva, Adobe Creative Suite) or the ability to brief designers effectively.
Basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel for tracking campaign metrics, budgets and reporting.
Project and vendor management skills, including budgeting, timeline management and coordination of multiple external suppliers.
Aptitudes & Personal Attributes
Highly organised self-starter, able to independently manage multiple concurrent work streams across events, content, digital and internal communications.
Strong stakeholder management skills, able to work closely with Product, Sales and Management to align marketing output with business needs.
Creative and detail-oriented, with sound judgement on brand consistency and messaging.
Comfortable working hands-on across both strategic planning and operational execution.
Adaptable and resourceful, comfortable operating with a lean or single-person marketing function.
What measures the success of the role
Event Execution & Lead Generation: Successful planning and execution of trade shows and corporate events, resulting in qualified lead collection and timely post-event sales nurturing.
Digital Campaign & Content Performance: Engagement levels, open/click-through rates, and lead conversions from eDM, social media, and website campaigns.
Brand Consistency & Collateral Quality: Delivery of clear, standardized, and customer-focused product pitch decks, marketing collateral, and corporate presentation templates.
Website & Social Media Growth: Up-to-date corporate website and steady growth in follower reach and engagement on the Company’s social media accounts.
Internal & Operational Delivery: On-time execution of internal communication initiatives, demo space setup, and efficient vendor and budget management.

Manage social media content schedules and assist with content creation, posting and basic graphic layouts.

Work closely with the Creative team for shoots and contents, including preparation, coordination and on-site assistance.

Company Overview
We are a fast growing chain-stores retailer of ladies fashion footwear. Established in 2001, PAZZION caters to the modern, sophisticated trend-setter with an uncompromising standard for taste and quality. High-caliber craftsmanship and an unwavering attention to detail mean each pair of shoes is painstakingly designed to bring you the best in style and comfort. PAZZION is available in major retail malls across SINGAPORE with its flagship outlet at Wisma Atria Orchard Road. Greendot Group is a Singapore-based meat-free F&B brand focused on making delicious, accessible and contemporary meat-free food part of everyday dining.

.

6-Month Structured Training Programme (24 Weeks)
Are you a mid-career professional ready to build a career in Digital Marketing?
We are looking for a motivated and committed
Assistant Digital Marketing Manager
to participate in a structured 24-week on-the-job training programme designed to develop practical digital marketing skills, strategic thinking and management capabilities.

To develop a mid-career individual into a competent Digital Marketing Manager who can independently plan, execute, analyse and lead digital marketing initiatives, while contributing to the organisation’s marketing objectives and business growth.

Title: Assistant Manager / Manager – Digital Marketing & Membership Growth
Description:
About the Role
SICCI is seeking a proactive and hands-on Assistant Manager / Manager to lead digital marketing activities, strengthen audience engagement and support membership growth and event participation.
The role combines content creation, campaign management, digital platform management and practical use of AI tools. You will work closely with the CEO, membership and events teams, relevant Board committees and external partners to communicate SICCI’s value to members and the wider business community.
Appointment at Assistant Manager or Manager level will depend on relevant experience and capabilities.
Key Responsibilities
Digital Marketing and Content Creation
Develop and implement digital marketing plans aligned with SICCI’s priorities, membership initiatives and events.
Manage a monthly content calendar across LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, email, the website and other approved channels.
Research, write, edit and publish engaging content, including social media posts, newsletters, website updates and promotional materials.
Create or coordinate visuals, short videos and event content, adapting materials to each platform and target audience.
Maintain consistent branding, messaging and content quality across communications.
Audience Engagement and Campaign Management
Manage social media publishing, community engagement and responses to enquiries, coordinating with relevant colleagues where necessary.
Plan and execute campaigns promoting SICCI membership, events, programmes and business opportunities.
Use audience insights and platform analytics to improve content, targeting and campaign effectiveness.
Develop clear calls to action and support enquiry and registration pathways through landing pages, forms, email campaigns and tracked links.
Membership Growth and Engagement
Collaborate with the membership team on campaigns to attract prospective members and communicate membership benefits.
Support audience segmentation, lead generation, enquiry nurturing and follow-up communications.
Maintain accurate lead records and coordinate the handover of qualified enquiries to the membership team.
Support membership renewal and re-engagement communications.
Event Marketing and Communications
Work with the events team to develop promotional plans and attendee communications.
Coordinate promotional content with speakers, partners and sponsors.
Monitor registration trends and adjust promotional activities where needed.
Support event content capture, publicity and post-event communications.
Provide on-site marketing and communications support for events when required.
Website, App and Performance Reporting
Keep website and SICCI app content, event listings and member information accurate and current.
Coordinate with vendors or technical teams to improve navigation, enquiry capture and registration journeys.
Track and analyse content performance, audience engagement, website traffic, enquiries and registrations.
Prepare regular reports with insights and recommendations to improve marketing activities.
AI Tools and Workflow Improvement
Use AI tools to support research, content development, repurposing, reporting and campaign preparation.
Develop reusable prompts, templates and workflows to improve efficiency and consistency.
Explore suitable automation and AI-assisted processes, subject to SICCI’s approval and review requirements.
Verify information and ensure accuracy, appropriate tone and confidentiality before publication.
Share practical tools and improvements with colleagues.
Job Requirements
Diploma or degree in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
Relevant experience in digital marketing, content creation, communications or growth marketing, with the ability to manage campaigns independently.
Strong English writing, editing and communication skills.
Hands-on experience managing social media platforms and using tools such as Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn analytics and email marketing platforms.
Familiarity with website content management, web analytics such as Google Analytics 4, and CRM systems or lead trackers.
Ability to create or coordinate visual and video content; proficiency in Canva or similar tools is an advantage.
Practical experience using AI tools for professional tasks, with sound judgment in reviewing and verifying outputs.
Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders.
Experience in B2B marketing, membership organisations, business associations, events or engagement with SMEs is an advantage.
SINGAPORE INDIAN CHAMBER OF COMMERCE & INDUSTRY (SICCI)
Singapore Indian Chamber of Commerce is one of the oldest establishments in Singapore. From humble beginnings in 1924, SICCI has emerged as one of Singapore‘s most respected and active commercial organisations today with close to 1000 members.
Offering members a diverse range of services to meet their business needs, SICCI provides a diverse range of services to meet their business needs. Its subsidiaries – SICCI Trade Match, SME Centre@SICCI and SICCI-Institute of Business – combine to actively promote the development of its members and provide the necessary networking opportunities and linkages for its members to grow their businesses and operations locally and globally.
As the body representing the Singapore Indian business community, SICCI serves as the community’s spokesman at various private and public sector platforms sector platforms in Singapore. Apart from its role in the business environment, it plays a leading role in the promotion of social welfare and in Singapore’s nation building.

Based at Mandarin Oriental, Singapore within the Sales & Marketing Department in Singapore, the Assistant Marketing Manager is responsible for supporting the development and implementation of integrated marketing initiatives for the hotel with a strong focus on digital marketing and performance marketing, social media and content execution.
To support the Marketing & Communications team in the day-to-day execution of marketing activities, with a focus on digital marketing (website, EDM, e-commerce), social media, OTA and paid media. - Managing paid digital campaigns, including campaign set-up, creative assets preparation, monitoring and performance reporting.

GFC’s MAS-regulated Financial Consultants provide honest, unbiased advice across savings and investments, insurance, education planning, estate planning, retirement planning, and wealth management. The team supports both local and expatriate professionals with bespoke strategies for income and family protection, pensions, and CPF-related planning. GFC offers a professional environment focused on long-term relationships, high ethical standards, and continuous career development.

We are looking for a commercially driven, creative and proactive
Business Development & Adviser Marketing Executive
to work closely with an allocated Senior Financial Consultant (SFC). This is a hands-on, dual-function role combining prospecting, appointment setting, digital marketing, creative content production and campaign management to support the SFC's business growth.
The successful candidate will enjoy a performance-based remuneration structure comprising a monthly basic salary and commission, with opportunities to grow alongside the business.

Identify, research and develop new business opportunities through online channels, professional networks, referrals, events and other suitable prospecting methods.

Contact prospects and existing clients to arrange appointments, follow up on enquiries and coordinate meetings for the SFC.

Build and nurture relationships with prospective clients, referral partners and relevant professional networks.
Attend networking sessions, industry events and business development activities to identify potential opportunities.
Monitor lead conversion, appointment attendance and follow-up outcomes, and recommend improvements to the prospecting process.
B. Adviser Marketing & Digital Content
Develop and execute marketing strategies and campaigns tailored to the SFC's target audience, business objectives and personal brand.
Ideate, plan, film and edit engaging short-form videos, reels, interviews and other digital content.
Create compelling marketing materials, social media posts, captions, visuals and campaign assets across relevant digital platforms.
Manage and maintain the SFC's approved social media presence and content calendar.
Leverage AI-powered tools to support content ideation, copywriting, editing, repurposing, research and workflow efficiency.
Develop creative campaign concepts to increase brand awareness, audience engagement, inbound enquiries and qualified leads.
Track and analyse campaign performance, including reach, engagement, enquiries, lead quality, appointment conversion and return on marketing spend where measurable.
Prepare regular marketing performance reports and recommend data-driven improvements.
Keep abreast of relevant digital marketing trends, content formats, platform developments and emerging AI tools.

Work closely with the allocated SFC to understand business priorities, target markets, client profiles and growth objectives.
Translate business objectives into actionable prospecting plans and marketing campaigns.
Coordinate with internal marketing, compliance and other relevant stakeholders to ensure marketing materials and activities follow GFC's policies and applicable regulatory requirements.
Maintain accurate records of leads, communications, appointments, campaigns and performance metrics.
Undertake other relevant business development and adviser marketing responsibilities as required.

Title: Business Development & Marketing Manager (Education)
Description:
About SCALA
The Supply Chain And Logistics Academy (SCALA) is the industry level training academy for logistics and supply chain and the only organization that specializes in Experiential Workplace Learning focused on supply chain leadership, technology and sustainability.
We currently serve over 600 corporate clients, many of whom are leading industry icons. Our courses are experiential and designed to make individuals job-ready and future-skilled. Our programs are both place-and-train as well as train-and-place, with redeployment and re-skilling options. We are expanding our offerings to include advanced programs that enable organizations to leverage technology and new business models.
The Business Development Manager (BDM) is responsible for driving SCALA's revenue growth through student enrolment, new programme development, marketing initiatives, business partnerships, and sales channel expansion. The role requires a highly entrepreneurial and results-driven individual who can independently generate leads, convert prospects into enrolled learners, develop new revenue streams, and execute integrated marketing activities to achieve monthly and annual revenue targets.
The successful candidate must possess strong business development and B2C sales capabilities, excellent presentation and networking skills, and hands-on experience in marketing execution, learner recruitment, and programme commercialization.
Key Responsibilities
1. Revenue Growth:
Achieve and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets set by management.
Drive learner enrolment growth through proactive lead generation, consultative selling, and relationship management.
Manage the full sales cycle from lead acquisition, qualification, consultation, follow-up, proposal preparation, and enrolment conversion.
Develop and implement strategies to maximize learner acquisition and retention.
Monitor sales pipeline performance and provide accurate revenue forecasts.
Identify, develop, and establish new sales channels to increase market reach and revenue generation.
Build strategic partnerships with corporate organizations, educational institutions, associations, industry bodies, and referral networks.
Explore new business opportunities and market segments that align with SCALA's growth objectives.
Negotiate and manage partnership agreements to drive sustainable enrolment growth.
2. Marketing & Lead Generation:
Plan and execute marketing campaigns to generate qualified leads and increase market awareness of SCALA's programmes.
Create and manage marketing collateral, promotional materials, sales presentations, brochures, videos, and digital assets.
Work closely with internal or external vendors to manage and continuously improve SCALA's website and digital presence.
Support content creation for social media, email marketing, online advertising, and other lead generation initiatives.
Track and analyse marketing campaign effectiveness and optimize activities based on performance metrics.
3. Programme Development & New Revenue Streams:
Research market trends, learner demands, and industry skill gaps to identify new programme opportunities.
Propose, develop, and launch new training programmes that generate additional revenue streams for SCALA.
Collaborate with trainers, subject matter experts, and stakeholders to design market-relevant learning solutions.
Develop business cases and go-to-market plans for new programmes and services.
4. Events, Seminars & Brand Building:
Represent SCALA professionally at seminars, workshops, exhibitions, education fairs, and networking events.
Deliver engaging presentations to prospective learners, corporate clients, and industry partners.
Organize and manage marketing events, industry networking sessions, and lead generation activities.
Build SCALA's reputation and visibility within the learning and professional development ecosystem.
5. Reporting & Performance Management:
Track KPIs related to sales performance, lead conversion, marketing effectiveness, and programme profitability.
Prepare regular sales and business development reports for management.
Maintain an updated CRM database and ensure effective follow-up on all leads and opportunities.
Recommend continuous improvements to enhance sales productivity and revenue performance.
Qualifications and Experience
Bachelor's Degree in Business Studies, Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or other related disciplines.
Minimum 4 to 5 years of relevant Business Development, Sales, or Marketing experience with demonstrable revenue achievement records.
Proven success in B2C/B2B sales, learner recruitment, student enrolment, training programme sales, education services, or professional development sectors.
Strong track record of consistently meeting or exceeding sales and revenue targets.

- Higher Education
- Lifelong Learning& Adult Education

Strong consultative selling and negotiation skills.

Excellent pipeline management and lead conversion capabilities.
Strong commercial acumen and revenue-focused mindset.

Experience planning and executing digital and offline marketing campaigns.
Ability to create marketing content, promotional materials, and sales collateral.
Familiarity with website management, social media marketing, email campaigns, and lead generation strategies.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong presentation and public speaking abilities.
Confidence in conducting seminars, webinars, and industry presentations.

Continuously optimise content formats, messaging and publishing strategies to improve performance.

Title: Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Specialist
Description:
About the company
At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.
Job description
We are looking for a Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Specialist to be the visionary link between our brand identity & measurable e-commerce performance. You will shape how our health brands communicate across Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & social media.
This role is responsible for developing high-impact creative strategies & producing assets (visual, video, copy) designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok E-Commerce stores. You will work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the expansion of our business. You won't just be creating content; you will be engineering 'Performance Stories' that turn scientific evidence into consumer trust & measurable revenue.
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics & brand strategy in the health supplement industry.
Key Responsibilities
1. Creative & Performance Strategy
Full-Funnel Content: Craft tailored strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific formats (e.g. Meta carousel ads, Meta/TikTok Reels, Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banners & Klaviyo email/whatsapp marketing)
A/B Testing & Data Insights: Develop clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, CTAs, visual styles) & run A/B tests to improve Click-Through Rates (CTR) & Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
Audience Segmentation: Translate target audience data & segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion)
Competitive Intelligence: Identify emerging hooks & messaging trends in the wellness/supplement industry to keep our brands ahead of the curve
2. In-House Content Production & Execution
Performance Creative Development: Lead end-to-end creative production for organic & paid media (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube) with a focus on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing
Video & Static Creation: Rapidly produce & edit native social content, including:
Video: Fast-paced assembly of UGC-style content, product demos & testimonials (CapCut/Premiere)
Static: Adapting product photography into high-performing ad variations & storefront banners
Generative AI Integration: Utilize AI tools & prompt engineering to efficiently generate high-quality video & image assets for rapid testing cycles
Copywriting: Write high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & captions that align with brand voice & regulatory requirements
Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok storefronts
3. E-commerce Growth & Social Account Management
E-Commerce Storefront Custodian (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada, TikTok): Integrate winning creative messages into e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a seamless customer journey for maximum sales conversion
Social Accounts Ownership & Community Manager: Act as the "Brand Guardian" for Miraco’s official accounts on Meta (FB/IG) & TikTok. Ensure all profiles are optimized for conversion, featuring up-to-date bios, Linktree/Shopify integrations & high-lighted stories
Content Programming & Scheduling: Develop & maintain a consistent content calendar that balances "Digital Pearls" (educational), Lifestyle (relatable) & Promotional (sales-driven) posts
Active Social Listening: Use comments & DMs to identify "pain points" to fuel new content hooks
User Generated Content (UGC) Mining: Identify & curate customer testimonials from the community to use as high-converting growth assets
Growth Analytics: Monitor account health metrics (Follower growth, Engagement Rate, Profile Visits) & use these insights to refine the organic reach strategy
Data-Driven Optimization: Work with the Marketing Manager to analyze performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving revenue on Shopify & Marketplaces. Apply insights & analytics to refine content effectiveness continuously
4. Performance Media & Technical Tracking
Paid Media Execution (Meta & Google):
Meta Ads Manager: Build, launch & manage conversion-focused campaigns (Advantage+ Shopping, Catalog Sales & Manual Retargeting) to drive traffic to Shopify & Marketplaces
Google Ads (PMAX & Search): Oversee Performance Max & Search campaigns to capture high-intent health & supplement queries
Precision Tracking & UTM Tagging: Implement a standardized UTM tagging nomenclature across all Digital Pearls, EDMs, WhatsApp blasts & Affiliate links to ensure 100% attribution accuracy in Google Analytics 4 (GA4) & Shopify
Monitor the "customer path" from the first touchpoint (e.g., a Meta post) to the final conversion (e.g. e-commerce purchase, loyalty program subscription, etc.)
Media Optimization: Manage ad spend budgets effectively, focusing on scaling winning creatives & "killing" underperforming ads based on real-time ROAS & CPA data
5. CRM, Loyalty & Lifecycle Marketing (Retention & CLV)
CRM Management, Loyalty & Monetization: Serve as the lead strategist for the CRM loyalty program, designing lifecycle journeys that move customers from "First-Time Buyer" to "Loyal Subscriber"
Develop loyalty-driven content that rewards repeat purchases & encourages long-term brand advocacy to maximize Consumer Lifetime Value (CLV)
Electronic Direct Mailer (EDM) & E-Newsletter Strategy: Develop & execute a high-frequency E-newsletter calendar via Klaviyo. This includes:
Educational Newsletters: Delivering "Digital Pearls" & expert insights from our HCP partners to build brand authority
Promotional EDMs: Creating high-converting seasonal offers & product-launch campaigns
Automated Flow Management: Design & execute end-to-end email & WhatsApp marketing automation (eg. Klaviyo) to nurture leads & re-engage existing customers
Automated Lifecycle Flows: Building "Welcome" series, "Post-Purchase" care, "Win-back" flows & "Replenishment Reminders"
Subscription & Monetization: Craft compelling creative & copy for "Subscribe & Save" programs, focusing on reducing churn & maximizing monthly recurring revenue (MRR)
Optimize the "Subscribe & Save" funnel through targeted email & WhatsApp triggers, focusing on increasing Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) & Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR)
WhatsApp Marketing: Integrate direct-to-consumer WhatsApp communication for personalized health consultations, loyalty rewards & rapid-response promotions
Data-Driven Personalization & Segmented Campaigns: Segment the CRM database based on health concerns, purchase behavior & engagement levels to ensure the right story reaches the right customer at the right time
6. Influencer & Affiliate Strategy (E-Commerce Growth & Acquisition)
Creator Partnerships: Identify & manage relationships with health influencers & HCP advocates via Shopify Collabs, TikTok Creator Marketplace & similar platforms
Affiliate Creative Kits: Develop high-converting "Affiliate Toolkits" (ready-to-use stories, hooks & banners) that empower partners to sell Miraco products effectively
Performance Tracking: Monitor affiliate-driven traffic & conversion data to optimize commission structures & creative briefs for better ROAS
7. Growth-Driven Storytelling
Translating Science to Story: Distilling complex clinical data & health benefits into relatable, high-impact stories that resonate with a consumer’s pain points & emotional aspirations
Narrative Funneling: Crafting story arcs specifically designed for the customer journey, from "educational hooks" that capture attention to "empathy-led consideration" to "urgency-driven conversion"
Growth-Centric CTAs: Developing persuasive, multi-variant Calls-to-Action (CTAs) that don't just ask for a click but provide a compelling reason to engage, directly impacting Click-Through Rates (CTR) & customer acquisition
Performance Iteration: The ability to pivot a brand story based on real-time data insights, identifying which "angle" or "hook" is driving the highest Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
Omnichannel Cohesion: Ensuring a seamless visual & narrative experience across all touchpoints, from high-energy social media (Meta/TikTok) to professional platforms (LinkedIn) & offline trade materials
Compliance & Brand Integrity: Safeguarding brand credibility by ensuring all "Performance Stories" remain factual, align with company values & strictly compliant with regional healthcare advertising standards & product claim guidelines. Partnering with internal teams to audit content for accuracy & compliance prior to regional deployment

Digital Content Creation & Production Support

· Write and edit website copy, blog articles, patient education content, newsletters, captions, and press or announcement content.
· Translate clinical or technical information from healthcare professionals into clear, accurate, patient-friendly content, and obtain sign-off before publishing.
· Maintain a content calendar and a library of reusable templates, brand assets, and approved content.
· Repurpose content across channels (e.g., article → social posts → newsletter → short video) to maximise reach.
· Ensure all creative output adheres to brand guidelines and tone of voice.
Digital Campaigns & Social Media
· Plan, execute and monitor digital campaigns across search, social, email and other online channels, including paid ads (Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads) where applicable.
· Schedule and publish content on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and other relevant platforms.
· Monitor engagement, respond to comments and messages appropriately, and escalate sensitive enquiries or feedback to the relevant team.
· Manage email marketing: build mailing lists, design newsletters, and track open and click-through rates.
· Track and report on campaign and social performance (reach, engagement, leads, conversions, cost per lead) with monthly insights and recommendations.
Event & Outreach Digital Support
· Create digital promotional materials for events, talks, workshops, and outreach activities (e-invites, banners, registration pages, countdown posts).
· Manage online registration forms and event landing pages.
· Provide live social media coverage and post-event content (recaps, photo albums, highlight videos).
Cross-Functional Collaboration
· Work closely with clinicians, nursing, business development, patient liaison and operations teams to gather content and ensure accuracy.
· Coordinate with external vendors, agencies, photographers and videographers as needed.
· Support ad hoc marketing and communications requests.

Title: Events, Marketing & Communications Associate (Contract)
Description:
About QAI Ventures
QAI Ventures AG is a Swiss-headquartered global venture capital firm and ecosystem platform investing in Quantum Tech and Enabling Technologies across the advanced computing value chain. Operating at pre-seed through Series C, QAI uniquely combines a VC fund, accelerator programs (Switzerland, Singapore, Canada), and a corporate innovation offering.
Our Singapore office is a hub for the APAC region, running accelerator cohorts, building early-stage ventures, and engaging the region's deep tech ecosystem. This internship sits at the center of those activities.
The Role
This is a hands-on, high-impact associate role on contract basis for a recent graduate who wants to gain real experience at the intersection of deep tech, startup programs, and strategic communications. You will work directly with the QAI Ventures Singapore team to drive events, marketing, and communications for QAI as a firm and the early-stage ventures we build and support.
You will contribute meaningfully from day one: producing content, coordinating events, shaping brand narratives, and helping portfolio ventures establish their market presence. This role carries genuine responsibility and offers direct exposure to founders, investors, and the regional deep tech ecosystem.
Tasks
Key Responsibilities
EVENTS & COMMUNITY ENGAGEMENT
Plan, coordinate, and execute QAI Ventures Singapore events, including accelerator showcases, investor briefings, ecosystem meetups, and participation in regional conferences.
Manage end-to-end event logistics: venue sourcing, speaker coordination, guest communications, on-site delivery, cost tracking, vendor negotiations, and post-event follow-up.
Support QAI's presence at APAC deep tech and innovation events, including preparation of materials and briefings for the team.
Build and maintain relationships with event partners, venues, and co-organizers across the Singapore and APAC ecosystem.
MARKETING & BRAND
Support the implementation of QAI's marketing strategy for Singapore and the APAC region, in coordination with the Global CMO based in Europe, to ensure consistent QAI branding and communications.
Manage and grow QAI Singapore's social media presence (primarily LinkedIn), including content planning, drafting, scheduling, and performance tracking.
Maintain and update the QAI Singapore website and local marketing materials to ensure alignment with global brand standards.
Coordinate with local agencies and freelancers on design, content, and campaign execution.
Contribute to building marketing infrastructure for portfolio ventures: website content logic, messaging frameworks, and brand foundations.
Help develop positioning and value propositions for early-stage deep tech ventures, translating complex quantum and AI technologies into clear, compelling narratives for customers, partners, and investors.
Create and adapt central marketing and communication materials for ventures and for QAI Singapore.
Track and report on marketing KPIs, generating qualified applications for programs and pipeline for partnerships.
COMMUNICATIONS & CONTENT
Draft and edit external communications including newsletters, program announcements, and ecosystem updates.
Support the development of pitch narratives and investor storylines for portfolio ventures.
Produce compelling content that communicates QAI's investment thesis and portfolio activity across written, digital, and event formats.
Ensure consistent tone, messaging, and brand voice across all QAI Singapore communications.
Assist in generating qualified applications for QAI's accelerator programs through targeted outreach and content campaigns.
Requirements
What We're Looking For
REQUIRED
Recent graduate (BA, MA, MBA, or PhD) in marketing, communications, business, technology management, or a related field.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; you write clearly, precisely, and without clutter.
Ability to translate complex or technical subject matter into accessible, compelling narratives for different audiences.
Demonstrated experience in events coordination, content creation, or marketing, through internships, student projects, or independent work.
Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously.
Proactive, execution-oriented mindset, comfortable taking ownership and delivering without constant direction.
Based in Singapore.
ADVANTAGEOUS
Familiarity with deep tech, quantum technologies, AI, or advanced computing is not required; intellectual curiosity in these areas is essential.
Experience with social media management tools, CMS platforms, or marketing analytics.
Exposure to the Asian startup or innovation ecosystem.
Experience working in or with early-stage startups, accelerators, or venture capital environments.
Graphic design or multimedia content skills (e.g., Canva, Adobe, video editing).
Benefits

You will work alongside founders, venture leads, and investors on some of the most technically ambitious companies being built today. From your first week, you will own deliverables, contribute to strategy, and have direct visibility into how a global deep tech VC operates.
Direct exposure to quantum computing, AI infrastructure, and advanced computing ventures in their earliest, most formative stages.
A seat at the table with QAI's Singapore team, with close collaboration across our global offices in Switzerland and Canada.
Hands-on experience across the full marketing mix, from event production and brand building to venture narrative and growth.
An APAC platform at the frontier of next-generation compute, a field with significant and still-emerging global impact.
Mentorship from experienced venture builders, investors, and operators across QAI's global team.

Title: Executive/Senior Executive, Communications
Description:
Purpose of the Position:
We're building an agency for what's next, and we're looking for a sharp, digitally-fluent Executives who thinks across channels — not just in them.
This is a role for someone who understands that the best communications today don't live in silos. You get how a strong media story amplifies a social campaign. You know that a well-placed press release and a well-timed paid push are more powerful together than either is alone. You're someone who gets genuinely excited about crafting a pitch that lands, building relationships with the right journalists, and then watching that earned credibility flow through to everything else a brand does digitally.
You're curious about where the industry is heading — and excited to help shape what that looks like for the clients we work with.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Own the client experience
- Get under the skin of your clients' businesses — their audiences, pressures, and ambitions.
- You'll support project delivery across PR and digital workstreams, help prepare for client meetings, and develop the instinct for spotting opportunities and challenges before they surface. You bring ideas to the table, not just execution.
Earn your PR stripes
- Get to know the media and influencer landscape across your client sectors — who matters, why they matter, and what they care about.
- Stay on top of news and trends, and start connecting the dots between what's happening and what it means for your clients.
- You'll sharpen your writing across pitches, press releases, and media briefs, support media request coordination, run monitoring and turn what you find into useful insight, and bring real ideas to every brainstorm.
Drive integrated communications
- You'll work across earned media and digital in the same breath — developing social content strategies, managing platforms like Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube, and supporting campaign setup, optimisation, and reporting.
- You'll get comfortable with social listening and analytics tools, and help connect what's happening in the news cycle to what your clients are doing across their channels.
Work smarter with AI
- Use AI tools as a genuine part of how you work — not as a shortcut, but as a craft. Whether it's researching faster, drafting sharper, finding a better angle, or streamlining your workflow, you bring an AI-native mindset to everything you touch.

- A Diploma or Bachelor's in Communications, Marketing, or a related field
- 0–3 years of experience across PR, social media, digital marketing, or advertising — strong fresh graduates are warmly welcomed
- A foundational understanding of both PR/earned media and digital channel ecosystems (social, paid, SEO, analytics)
- Hands-on familiarity with social media platforms and a basic grasp of paid social or SEM is a strong plus
- Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) as part of your everyday workflow — for research, drafting, ideation, and beyond
- Strong written and verbal English — clarity and craft matter here
- A self-starter who manages deadlines well and doesn't need to be chased
- Comfortable working across teams, cultures, and seniority levels in a fast-moving environment
