Title: Manager/Senior Manager, Segment Marketing & Visitor Experience B
Description:
[What the role is]
The Segment Marketing and Visitor Experience Division (SMVE) is a division within Marketing Group that champions target segment strategies to support quality tourism. The division plays an integral role in developing segment insights through research and analysis – including demographics, psychographics, travel motivations and behaviours, decision drivers and spending habits – to formulate effective segment marketing and segment-focused product and experience strategies, and execute segment marketing initiatives that drive arrivals and spend amongst our target segments.
[What you will be working on]
In this role, your main focus would be on the BTMICE segment. You will need to gain in-depth MICE target segment (MICE event organisers and travellers) understanding to identify gaps and opportunities and develop actionable insights that will inform the formulation of a segment-specific marketing strategy and corresponding workplan.
You will be a key member of the team that plans and executes global MICE marketing activities to profile and drive consideration for Singapore as a top MICE destination.
Target segment analysis and understanding
Develop target segment analysis and regularly track and monitor indicators that can inform and guide global marketing strategy, and where relevant, product and experience development. The target segment understanding includes but is not limited to, analysing data sets from a breadth of sources, and/or conducting in-depth consumer research (quantitative and qualitative) on STB’s target MICE event organiser segments, to understand their demographics, psychographics, booking motivations, decision-making, needs and behaviours and the formulation of actionable insights that can inform the BTMICE marketing strategy and plans.
Development and implementation of MICE marketing activities
- Develop and execute Board’s MICE global marketing activities across paid and owned touchpoints, ensuring the activities are grounded on target segment’s insights, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders, external agencies and vendors to ensure timely delivery and quality outcomes. The successful candidate should also be able to demonstrate the ability to conceptualise and craft engaging and effective content across digital platforms (including social media, MICE EDM, landing pages, video and written case studies) and below-the-line formats:
- Content partnerships: Develop and execute strategic media partnerships with key MICE trade and business news media publications to create engaging branded content to drive awareness and consideration as the choice destination among MICE event organisers and attendees. You will be required to work closely with media partners in the conceptualisation and shaping of content angles/structure as well as on the ideal content formats (e.g. web, social, video) for effective delivery of our key messages. Track and analyse the effectiveness of the media partnership plans against the intended objectives and to work with media partners to optimise performance and quality of content.
- VisitSingapore Business Events LinkedIn page management: Lead and manage STB’s MICE global social media account (VisitSingapore Business Events) on LinkedIn including content strategy, calendar planning and execution to meet MICE marketing objectives. The successful candidate will need to collaborate with external agencies as well as in-house creative studio to execute and produce the social content. Analyse paid and organic performance and formulate recommendations to optimise social content to enhance marketing performance.
- MICE EDM marketing campaign: Develop and execute quarterly MICE EDM marketing campaigns targeting MICE event organisers, from conceptualisation to delivery and analysis, with support of an external agency. Formulate engaging and compelling EDM content including copy, appealing visuals and persuasive calls to action. Analyse performance and identify opportunities for EDM campaign optimisation to optimise campaign effectiveness and engagement rates. To also update and maintain the accuracy and hygiene of the MICE email database on a regular cadence, complying with prevailing data protection regulations.
- MICE event case studies (video and web) Lead and develop video content captures of notable MICE events held in Singapore for use for paid and owned marketing, with the support of an appointed video production company. You will be required to manage the appointed production house in the crafting of the video's narrative, storyboarding, selection and liaison with interview profiles (e.g. event organiser, event delegates, conference speakers) across pre-production, during the actual shoot and into post-production to ensure output delivers the intended marketing objectives and messages. For each video case study, there will be an accompanying web case study for STB’s MICE website (VisitSingapore.com/MICE) that you will need to develop with the support of an external agency/in-house creative studio.
- Partner STB’s MICE line units and Regional Offices to support business development efforts through various marketing activities, including collateral and asset creation for owned and paid touchpoints, key MICE travel tradeshows and business development activities.
- You may also be asked to support initiatives that the division may need to take on from time to time.
[What we are looking for]
- At least 3 years of relevant experience in marketing campaign planning, development and execution.
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to analyse data from multiple sources (e.g., in-house data, surveys, third-party research studies) to identify trends, patterns, and derive actionable insights related to target segments and their visitor experience that will result in clear strategies to grow STB's target segments outcomes.
- Strong project management and analytical skills, with the ability to navigate issues, problem solve and work collaboratively with multiple internal and external stakeholders.
- Highly motivated, organised, adaptable and able to perform within tight timelines.
- Experience managing creative, social and PR agencies, production house and other vendors in a multi-stakeholder setting.
- Content marketing experience across videos, short form and long form storytelling.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and strong attention to detail.
- Able to work independently with high initiative and can effectively contribute within a dynamic cross-functional, cross-cultural environment.
“Good to Have” for the job
- Familiarity and past experience with B2B marketing and communications is a plus.
- Experience in applying Generative AI solutions to accelerate content ideation and development and optimise workflows is a plus.
- Proficiency in conducting market research using various methodologies (e.g., surveys, focus groups, in-depth interviews) to understand traveller behaviour, preferences, and needs.
- Prior work experience in consumer research.

Title: Marketing & E-commerce Assistant

Role Overview
The Marketing & E-commerce Assistant supports the day-to-day execution of marketing and e-commerce activities for GLOWN Singapore. The role works closely with the Marketing and E-commerce leads to coordinate campaigns, maintain online sales channels, support content and promotional activities, monitor basic performance, and ensure day-to-day tasks are completed accurately and on time. ● Support offline marketing, events, or activations as needed.

● Help organize and maintain the marketing content and creative asset library.

Title: Marketing & Growth Assistant
Description:
We are looking for a creative and commercially curious Marketing & Growth Assistant to help RhetoriQo grow its brand and business. You'll have creative bandwidth to generate content ideas, produce videos, and track performance — and you'll also get hands-on exposure to business development, from identifying opportunities to supporting outreach.
Who Are We?
RhetoriQo transforms inner voices into outside influence through curated speaking and communication training programmes. Founded by seasoned speaker, lawyer, and coach Zulhafni Zulkeflee, we empower individuals and organisations to excel in their high-stakes settings with public speaking, negotiation, persuasion, and communication skills.
Key Responsibilities
Content Planning & Ideation:
Lead RhetoriQo's online presence by (i) maintaining a clear content calendar for Instagram, TikTok, and other platforms, and (ii) proposing daily post ideas — including videos, images, and captions — that align with our coaching mission, based on research trends and industry topics.

Capture, edit, and polish videos (e.g., Reels, TikToks, stories) optimised for trend relevance, engagement, and credibility-building — with an opportunity to work within the public speaking and communication sector.
Platform Management & Community Engagement:
Lead RhetoriQo's social media growth by managing content across our platforms (e.g., scheduling and publishing according to best posting times), monitoring performance, and refining strategy based on analytics.
Analytics & Strategy:
Experiment with different content formats (e.g., storytelling, teaching snippets, behind-the-scenes) to learn what resonates, by tracking engagement, reach, and other key metrics.
Business Development Support:
Support RhetoriQo's growth by (i) researching potential corporate clients, events, and partnership opportunities, (ii) assisting with outreach tracking and lead lists (e.g., on LinkedIn), and (iii) collaborating on growth ideas — such as relevant industry events to attend, speak at, or pitch to — as you grow into the role.
Qualifications
We value an openness to learn and experiment over experience — if you have the traits below and are up for a new challenge, we would be happy to chat with you:
Proficient in content editing tools (Canva, CapCut, Adobe Premiere, etc.) and general office tools (e.g., Google Docs/Sheets, Excel, Email)
Strong awareness and curiosity of social media trends, particularly on Instagram/TikTok
Excellent written and verbal communication, organisational skills, and attention to detail
Keen to try new things and have an eye for creativity
Commercially curious — you think about not just how to grow an audience, but how that translates into real business opportunities
Self-motivated with the ability to propose ideas and follow through independently
Previous experience in content creation or social media is a plus, but not necessary — if you're new to this, tell us how you'd go about learning and growing in the role

Contract/part-time role: 3–4 hours/day, flexible schedule
SGD $13–15/hour
Remote and/or hybrid (Singapore-based preferred; you may be required to follow along for training programmes or sessions on occasion)

Real ownership from day one — you won't be a pair of hands, you'll have genuine creative and commercial input into how RhetoriQo grows
Work directly with a highly experienced public speaking trainer and coach within the training and coaching industry

Title: Marketing and Administrative Executive
Description:
ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions is part of the ASSA ABLOY Group, who are the global leader in access solutions. Every day, we reimagine how people move through a safer, more open world with ease. If you’ve ever walked through an automatic door, stayed in a hotel, or gone through passport control, you’ve probably used one of our products or services. We have operations in over 70 countries, with over 52,000 colleagues around the world.
Our expertise in customer journey mapping, innovation, and service design leads to the invention of new solutions that create value for our clients and exceptional experiences for their end users. Who We Are?
Originally, the manufacturer of one of the world's first electronic key management systems in 1994 - Traka, an ASSA ABLOY company, is the global leader in intelligent management solutions for keys and equipment. Our solutions help all types of organizations better control their important assets, improving productivity and accountability, and reducing risk in critical processes.
We operate in a wide variety of channel markets such as Data Centres, Government, Ministry of Defence, Police, Prisons & correctional facilities, Airports, Hospitality, Energy & Utilities, Banking, Healthcare, Distribution & logistics Centres, Education and others.
Traka became part of ASSA ABLOY in April 2012, who are a more than eight billion Euro organisation and the global leader in access solutions. Every day we help people feel safe, secure, and experience a more open world. ASSA ABLOY products can be seen and used everywhere you go in your daily life from brands such as Yale, HID and others.

Title: Marketing Executive
Description:
Job Description
We are looking for a Marketing Executive to independently manage and execute day-to-day marketing activities across the Company's brands and business activities.
The role covers digital marketing, social media, events, partnerships, marketing communications and market research. The Marketing Executive will work directly with the Director and is expected to take ownership of assigned marketing projects from planning and coordination through to execution and performance reporting.
The role requires a hands-on and organized individual who can work independently, coordinate with internal teams and external vendors, and manage multiple marketing activities with limited day-to-day supervision.
Job Responsibilities
1. Marketing Planning & Campaign Execution
Plan and execute marketing activities in line with business objectives and direction from the Director.
Develop campaign plans, timelines and required marketing materials.
Coordinate campaign setup, scheduling, content placement and execution to ensure activities are delivered accurately and on time.
Monitor campaign results and prepare reports on key performance indicators.
Review campaign results and recommend practical improvements for future activities.
2. Digital & Social Media Marketing
Plan and manage social media content across platforms such as Facebook, Instagram and TikTok.
Maintain content calendars and coordinate content creation, publishing and scheduling.
Plan and execute digital campaigns, including paid social media advertising where required.
Monitor campaign performance, engagement, leads and other relevant metrics.
Coordinate updates to website content, promotional materials and other digital channels.
Manage EDM campaigns and customer communications where required.
3. Events & Offline Marketing
Plan, coordinate and execute marketing activities including roadshows, travel fairs, workshops, promotions, corporate events and other relevant events.
Coordinate with internal teams, vendors, partners and event organizers on logistics, setup, materials and timelines.
Source and coordinate event requirements, including marketing materials, equipment and manpower support.
Support on-site event operations and ensure activities are delivered according to plan.
Conduct post-event follow-up and prepare basic performance reports.
Support weekend events or marketing activities when required.
4. KOL, Partnership & Promotional Activities
Identify and coordinate suitable KOLs, influencers, media partners and other marketing partners.
Coordinate collaborations, sponsorships, barter arrangements and co-marketing opportunities.
Communicate campaign requirements, deliverables and timelines to partners.
Coordinate content submissions and ensure materials are aligned with the Company's brand and campaign requirements.
Monitor the performance of collaborations and maintain good working relationships with partners.
5. Marketing Content & Creative Coordination
Prepare and coordinate marketing content, promotional materials, notices and social media assets.
Use Canva or other basic design tools to create or amend marketing materials where required.
Coordinate with designers, agencies and external vendors for more specialized creative work.
Coordinate the production of printed materials such as brochures, banners, advertisements and promotional collateral.
Ensure marketing materials are accurate, timely and consistent with the Company's brand guidelines.
6. Vendor & Budget Coordination
Source and compare quotations for marketing activities and recommend suitable vendors.
Coordinate with vendors on pricing, deliverables, timelines and service requirements.
Monitor marketing expenses against approved budgets.
Prepare or coordinate purchase requests, quotations and invoices.
Maintain organized records of vendors, quotations, marketing materials and related documents.
Highlight significant cost differences or discrepancies to the Director for review.
7. Market Research
Conduct market and competitor research to identify customer trends, promotional opportunities and relevant market developments.
Monitor competitor campaigns, promotions and social media activities.
Research potential partnerships, marketing channels and promotional opportunities.
Share relevant market insights and recommendations with the Director.
8. Cross-functional Collaboration
Work closely with sales, operations and other departments to understand business needs and coordinate marketing activities.
Coordinate with external agencies, vendors, partners and other third parties.
Manage assigned marketing projects independently from planning through to execution and follow-up.
Handle ad hoc marketing tasks and special projects as assigned.
Job Requirements
Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related field.
2–3 years of relevant marketing experience, preferably with exposure to digital marketing, social media and events.
Practical experience in planning and executing marketing campaigns and activities.
Experience managing social media platforms and digital marketing campaigns.
Experience coordinating vendors, quotations and marketing expenses.
Basic knowledge of Canva or other design tools.
Good written and spoken English with strong communication skills.
Good organizational and time-management skills with strong attention to detail.
Able to independently plan, priorities and execute marketing activities with limited day-to-day supervision.
Able to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Proactive, hands-on and willing to take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
Willing to support occasional weekend events or marketing activities when required.

Title: Marketing Executive
Description:
Job Description
We are looking for a Marketing Executive to independently manage and execute day-to-day marketing activities across the Company's brands and business activities.
The role covers digital marketing, social media, events, partnerships, marketing communications and market research. The Marketing Executive will work directly with the Director and is expected to take ownership of assigned marketing projects from planning and coordination through to execution and performance reporting.
The role requires a hands-on and organized individual who can work independently, coordinate with internal teams and external vendors, and manage multiple marketing activities with limited day-to-day supervision.
Job Responsibilities
1. Marketing Planning & Campaign Execution
Plan and execute marketing activities in line with business objectives and direction from the Director.
Develop campaign plans, timelines and required marketing materials.
Coordinate campaign setup, scheduling, content placement and execution to ensure activities are delivered accurately and on time.
Monitor campaign results and prepare reports on key performance indicators.
Review campaign results and recommend practical improvements for future activities.
2. Digital & Social Media Marketing
Plan and manage social media content across platforms such as Facebook, Instagram and TikTok.
Maintain content calendars and coordinate content creation, publishing and scheduling.
Plan and execute digital campaigns, including paid social media advertising where required.
Monitor campaign performance, engagement, leads and other relevant metrics.
Coordinate updates to website content, promotional materials and other digital channels.
Manage EDM campaigns and customer communications where required.
3. Events & Offline Marketing
Plan, coordinate and execute marketing activities including roadshows, travel fairs, workshops, promotions, corporate events and other relevant events.
Coordinate with internal teams, vendors, partners and event organizers on logistics, setup, materials and timelines.
Source and coordinate event requirements, including marketing materials, equipment and manpower support.
Support on-site event operations and ensure activities are delivered according to plan.
Conduct post-event follow-up and prepare basic performance reports.
Support weekend events or marketing activities when required.
4. KOL, Partnership & Promotional Activities
Identify and coordinate suitable KOLs, influencers, media partners and other marketing partners.
Coordinate collaborations, sponsorships, barter arrangements and co-marketing opportunities.
Communicate campaign requirements, deliverables and timelines to partners.
Coordinate content submissions and ensure materials are aligned with the Company's brand and campaign requirements.
Monitor the performance of collaborations and maintain good working relationships with partners.
5. Marketing Content & Creative Coordination
Prepare and coordinate marketing content, promotional materials, notices and social media assets.
Use Canva or other basic design tools to create or amend marketing materials where required.
Coordinate with designers, agencies and external vendors for more specialized creative work.
Coordinate the production of printed materials such as brochures, banners, advertisements and promotional collateral.
Ensure marketing materials are accurate, timely and consistent with the Company's brand guidelines.
6. Vendor & Budget Coordination
Source and compare quotations for marketing activities and recommend suitable vendors.
Coordinate with vendors on pricing, deliverables, timelines and service requirements.
Monitor marketing expenses against approved budgets.
Prepare or coordinate purchase requests, quotations and invoices.
Maintain organised records of vendors, quotations, marketing materials and related documents.
Highlight significant cost differences or discrepancies to the Director for review.
7. Market Research
Conduct market and competitor research to identify customer trends, promotional opportunities and relevant market developments.
Monitor competitor campaigns, promotions and social media activities.
Research potential partnerships, marketing channels and promotional opportunities.
Share relevant market insights and recommendations with the Director.
8. Cross-functional Collaboration
Work closely with sales, operations and other departments to understand business needs and coordinate marketing activities.
Coordinate with external agencies, vendors, partners and other third parties.
Manage assigned marketing projects independently from planning through to execution and follow-up.
Handle ad hoc marketing tasks and special projects as assigned.
Job Requirements
Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related field.
2–3 years of relevant marketing experience, preferably with exposure to digital marketing, social media and events.
Practical experience in planning and executing marketing campaigns and activities.
Experience managing social media platforms and digital marketing campaigns.
Experience coordinating vendors, quotations and marketing expenses.
Basic knowledge of Canva or other design tools.
Good written and spoken English with strong communication skills.
Good organizational and time-management skills with strong attention to detail.
Able to independently plan, priorities and execute marketing activities with limited day-to-day supervision.
Able to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Proactive, hands-on and willing to take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
Willing to support occasional weekend events or marketing activities when required.

Title: Marketing Executive (Remote/WFH)
Description:

As a Marketing Executive, you’ll join our new digital marketing and branding service at the ground floor. - Prepare performance reports on traffic, engagement, sign-ups, and conversions

Title: Marketing Executive / Senior Marketing Executive
Description:
ERC Institute, a Private Education Institute (PEI) that was awarded the EduTrust Certification as a mark of providing quality education services to students in Singapore, is looking to recruit dynamic and self-driven individuals who are interested in an exciting career with our fast-growing company.
Position: Marketing Executive / Senior Marketing Executive
Job Summary:
The Marketing Executive / Senior Marketing Executive will be responsible for planning, developing, and executing integrated marketing initiatives to strengthen ERCI’s brand presence, student recruitment efforts, and student engagement activities. This role combines digital marketing, content creation, campaign coordination, event support, branding, and stakeholder coordination to support the ERCI’s strategic objectives and partnerships with universities, agents, and industry stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Digital Marketing & Campaign Management
Manage and optimize digital marketing channels, including LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, Google Ads, email marketing, and website content.
Work closely with appointed marketing agencies and vendors to execute paid advertising campaigns and monitor campaign performance against established KPIs.
Track and manage marketing expenditure within approved budgets and provide regular performance reports and recommendations.
2. Content Creation & Social Media Management
Develop, create, and coordinate engaging content, including photos, videos, testimonials, and marketing campaigns to promote academic programmes, events, student achievements, and institutional initiatives.
Manage content across social media platforms, websites, email marketing, and other communication channels.
Create and update marketing materials, including brochures, eDMs, newsletters, presentations, advertisements, and promotional collateral.
Ensure all marketing communications comply with ERCI branding guidelines and partner university brand requirements.
3. Branding & Creative Development
Coordinate the production of marketing collateral, including posters, banners, flyers, promotional merchandise, and digital assets.
Develop and maintain branded templates, presentations, and visual assets to ensure consistency across the organisation.
4. Student Engagement & Event Marketing
Support the planning, promotion, and execution of student recruitment activities, open houses, education fairs, campus events, and corporate engagements.
Develop promotional materials for academic programmes, special events, and institutional initiatives.
5. Website & Digital Asset Management
Manage and update website content to ensure information remains accurate, relevant, and aligned with marketing objectives.
Work with IT and external vendors on website enhancements, landing pages, SEO initiatives, new functionalities, and user experience improvements.
Support website redevelopment and digital transformation projects through content planning, visual concept development, and digital asset management.
6. Stakeholder, Agent & University Partner Support
Provide marketing support to Business Development Managers and country representatives through the development of market-specific campaigns and promotional materials.
Assist in managing relationships with education agents, marketing partners, and service providers, ensuring proper use of ERCI marketing collateral and brand guidelines.
Support partner universities with marketing requests while ensuring compliance with branding and communication requirements.
Coordinate marketing briefs, campaign materials, and promotional activities with internal stakeholders and external partners.
Requirements:
Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related discipline.
Minimum 1-3 years of relevant marketing experience. Experience in the education sector will be an advantage.
Hands-on experience in social media management, content creation, digital marketing, and campaign execution.
Proficiency in Canva, Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro), CapCut, or equivalent design/video editing tools.
Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, Google Analytics, and email marketing platforms will be an advantage.
Strong copywriting, communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills.
Proficiency in Chinese language will be an advantage to support communications with Chinese-speaking stakeholders and markets.
Candidates with relevant experience and a proven track record may be considered for the Senior Marketing Executive position.

Title: Sales & Marketing Manager / Assistant Manager (Brand & Bakery)
Description:
Job Title
Sales & Marketing Manager / Assistant Manager (Brand & Bakery)
Department
Sales & Marketing
Reports To
General Manager (day-to-day); Chief Executive Officer (brand direction)
Direct Reports
Nil – standalone role
Employment Type
Full-time, permanent
Work Location
70 Bendemeer Road #01-03 (Luzerne) and 44 Jalan Merah Saga #01-42 (Chip Bee Gardens), with travel between outlets and to client / vendor sites
Salary Range
Assistant Manager: S$3,300 – S$3,800 Manager: S$3,800 – S$4,300
(Final offer commensurate with experience and portfolio)
1.
Job Purpose
The Sales & Marketing Manager / Assistant Manager owns the full marketing portfolio of Keong Saik Bakery and is accountable for translating the founder’s vision for the brand into a coherent, commercially effective marketing programme across our retail outlets, e-commerce, and corporate / B2B channels.
This is a standalone role. The successful candidate will be the company’s only dedicated marketing resource, and must therefore be equally comfortable setting direction and executing it personally – from building and maintaining the marketing framework and managing the marketing budget, through to shooting content, briefing printers, and installing collateral at outlet level.
The role suits a self-motivated individual who is energised by building something from the ground up in a small, fast-moving business, and who understands that marketing is ultimately accountable for commercial outcomes and not activity alone.
2.
Key Responsibilities
a. Marketing Framework& Brand Direction
i.
Framework Ownership:
Develop, document, and own the company’s marketing framework, covering brand positioning, target audience, channel strategy, content pillars, campaign calendar, and partnership approach.
ii.
Relevance & Refresh:
Review and refresh the framework at least annually, and on an ad hoc basis where market conditions require, so that it remains relevant to consumer trends, competitor activity, and the company’s commercial priorities.
iii.
Alignment to Brand Vision:
Ensure all marketing direction, tone of voice, and visual identity remain aligned with the founder’s vision for the brand. Where the post-holder wishes to evolve the brand expression, this is to be proposed to and agreed with the Chief Executive Officer and General Manager before execution.
iv.
Campaign Planning:
Translate the framework into a rolling campaign calendar covering seasonal and festive campaigns, product launches, and always-on activity, with sufficient lead time for production and operational readiness.
b. Digital Content Creation
i.
Content Production:
Plan, shoot, and edit all digital content – photography, videography, and short-form video – for social media, website, e-commerce, and third-party delivery platforms.
ii.
Visual Storytelling:
Lead and conduct all product and lifestyle photoshoots, coordinating with the kitchen, outlet teams, and external vendors as required.
iii.
Copywriting:
Write all brand-facing copy, including social captions, EDM content, website and product descriptions, menu copy, and campaign messaging.
iv.
Asset Management:
Maintain an organised content and asset library so that approved images, videos, and copy are readily retrievable by the wider team.
c. Physical Marketing Materials
i.
Design:
Design all physical marketing collateral, including menus, posters, banners, buntings, flyers, table talkers, packaging inserts, and point-of-sale displays.
ii.
Print & Vendor Management:
Source, brief, and manage print and fabrication vendors – obtaining quotations, checking proofs and colour accuracy, and controlling cost and lead times.
iii.
Installation & Upkeep:
Take personal responsibility for the installation, rotation, and upkeep of physical collateral at both outlets, ensuring displays are current, correctly sited, and in good condition. This is a hands-on responsibility and not one that is delegated to outlet teams by default.
iv.
Approvals:
Obtain any landlord, building management, or regulatory approvals required for external signage, displays, or promotional installations.
d. Marketing Budget
i.
Budget Development:
Propose an annual marketing budget, broken down by channel, campaign, and expense category, for approval by the General Manager and Chief Executive Officer.
ii.
Budget Management:
Manage spend against the approved budget, maintain a live spend tracker, and flag anticipated variances in advance rather than in retrospect.
iii.
Return on Spend:
Justify marketing spend against expected commercial return, and reallocate budget away from underperforming activity where the evidence supports doing so.
iv.
Cost Control:
Negotiate rates and terms with vendors, media partners, platforms, and collaborators.
e. Sales Development &Lead Management
i.
Lead Generation:
Identify and pursue corporate, catering, gifting, event-planner, and community sales opportunities through outreach, networking, and partnerships.
ii.
Enquiry Management:
Manage incoming sales and event enquiries end-to-end – response, quotation, follow-up, and conversion – within agreed response timelines.
iii.
Client Relationships:
Build and maintain relationships with prospective and existing corporate clients to support repeat business and long-term accounts.
iv.
Opportunity Tracking:
Maintain an organised lead and opportunity tracker capturing enquiry source, status, value, and conversion outcome, to support forecasting and reporting.
v.
Operational Coordination:
Coordinate with outlet managers and the kitchen to confirm that corporate orders, catering, and event bookings are operationally deliverable before commitments are made to the client.
f. Community &Partnerships
i.
Partnership Development:
Identify and develop brand partnerships, collaborations, and co- marketing opportunities that extend reach without proportional increases in spend.
ii.
Media & Creators
:
Manage relationships with media, food publications, influencers, and content creators, including hosting and briefing.
iii.
Social Media &Community:
Maintain a consistent and timely presence across all company social media accounts, including community management of comments, direct messages, and public reviews.
iv.
On-the-Ground Coordination:
Work with outlet managers and frontline staff to capture authentic in-store content and to ensure campaigns are executed correctly and consistently at store level.
g. Reporting & Performance Measurement
i.
Metrics Design:
Propose, implement, and maintain a set of marketing performance measures that connect marketing activity to sales outcomes, rather than reporting reach and engagement in isolation.
ii.
Fortnightly Updates:
Provide a written fortnightly update to the General Manager and Chief Executive Officer covering campaigns currently in market, campaigns upcoming, spend against budget, results against agreed measures, and any matters requiring a decision.
iii.
Management Reporting:
Present a consolidated marketing and sales performance review at Management Team Meetings.
iv.
Post-Campaign Review:
Conduct a documented review after every major campaign, recording what worked, what did not, and what will be done differently next time.
3.
Working Relationships
– Reports to the General Manager on day-to-day priorities, budget, and performance, and to the Chief Executive Officer on brand direction and major campaign approvals.
– Works closely with outlet managers and operations teams to ensure campaigns, promotions, catering requests, and partnership activations are operationally executable and delivered to brand standard.
– Coordinates with the Head Baker and production team on product launches, seasonal offerings, product photography, and promotional planning, with adequate lead time for production capacity.
– Maintains working relationships with external vendors, photographers, designers, printers, media partners, influencers, and community collaborators.
– Develops and manages relationships with corporate clients, event organisers, and business partners to support revenue growth and brand visibility.
– Collaborates with frontline staff to gather customer insight, identify emerging trends, and capture authentic brand content at store level.
4.
Qualifications & Experience
– Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related discipline. Equivalent practical experience and a strong portfolio will be considered in lieu of formal qualifications.
–
Manager:
Minimum four years of relevant experience, including at least two years independently owning a marketing function, brand, or portfolio.
–
Assistant Manager:
Minimum two years of relevant experience, with demonstrated readiness to take on end-to-end ownership of a marketing portfolio.
– Prior experience in F&B, retail, hospitality, or a consumer lifestyle brand is strongly preferred.
– A portfolio of self-produced work – photography, video, design, and campaign examples– is required at interview.
– Experience managing a marketing budget and reporting on commercial outcomes is a distinct advantage.
5.
Skills Required
– Marketing strategy, framework development, and campaign planning
– Sales development, lead generation, and pipeline management
– Social media management, content scheduling, and community management
– Photography, videography, and content editing (including short-form video)
– Graphic design and production of marketing collateral
– Copywriting and brand communication
– Print production knowledge – file preparation, material selection, and vendor briefing
– Budget planning, spend tracking, and cost negotiation
– Data tracking, reporting, and performance analysis, including familiarity with social platform analytics, website analytics, and POS sales reporting
– Client relationship management and business development
– Event and partnership coordination
– Working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, CapCut, or equivalent creative platforms
– Proficiency in Microsoft Office and presentation tools
– Strong verbal and written communication skills in English
6.
Key Attributes
–
Self-Motivated & Self-Directed:
Sets own priorities, works to self-imposed deadlines, and makes progress without being chased or closely supervised.
–
Comfortable Operating Independently:
Able to function effectively as a department of one, without an in-house team or standing agency support, and to know when to bring in external help.
–
Hands-On:
Willing to do the work personally – including shooting content, carrying and installing collateral, and being present at outlets – rather than working exclusively at a planning level.
–
Creative & Commercial Mindset:
Balances strong creative ideas against practical business and revenue objectives, and can explain why a piece of work is expected to earn its cost.
–
Commercially Numerate:
Comfortable working with budgets, sales figures, and performance data, and able to draw defensible conclusions from them.
��
Receptive to Direction:
Able to work within an established brand vision set by the founder, contributing ideas constructively and raising disagreement through discussion rather than through unilateral action.
–
Relationship Builder & Collaborative:
Comfortable engaging customers, partners, vendors, and internal teams across all levels, and contributes positively to team culture.
–
Organised & Detail-Oriented:
Maintainsstrong attention to detail across campaigns, communications, timelines,quotations, and sales coordination.
–
Adaptable & Resourceful:
Operates effectively where priorities and operational needs shift quickly, problem-solves independently, andremains composed under pressure or tight deadlines.
–
Brand Conscious & Culturally Attuned:
Understands the importance of consistency in branding, customer experience, and public perception, and has genuine feeling for the local heritage and food culture the brand is built on.
–
Results-Oriented:
Driven by measurable outcomes, continual improvement, and business growth.
–
Professionalism & Accountability:
Demonstrates maturity, reliability, discretion, and accountability in representing the company internally and externally.
7.
What Success Looks Like in the First Twelve Months
The following are indicative expectations and will be confirmed with the post-holder on appointment:
1. A documented marketing framework, approved by the Chief Executive Officer and General Manager, in active use as the basis for campaign planning.
2. An approved annual marketing budget supported by a live spend tracker, with spend managed within approved limits.
3. A consistent content cadence maintained across all active channels, with no unplanned gaps in the calendar.
4. A functioning lead and opportunity tracker, with measurable improvement in corporate and catering enquiry conversion.
5. An agreed set of performance measures that credibly links marketing activity to sales outcomes, reported on consistently.
6. Fortnightly reporting established as routine practice, and post-campaign reviews completed for all major campaigns.

Title: Senior Marketing Communications Specialist
Description:
About Us
We are building a new-generation leadership development venture focused on transforming how CEOs and senior executives lead, grow, and create lasting impact.
Through bespoke, evidence-informed solutions, we aim to redefine CEO development by integrating leadership intelligence, human potential, organisational transformation, and technology.
As an early-stage company, we seek an entrepreneurial, resourceful, hands-on marketing professional to build our brand, establish market presence, and create meaningful visibility.
This is an opportunity to work directly with the founder and shape a distinctive brand in the global leadership development market.
Key Responsibilities
1. Brand Development & Market Positioning
- Develop and execute initiatives to establish the company's brand identity, positioning, messaging, and value proposition.
- Build awareness among CEOs, C-suite executives, CHROs, corporate decision-makers, and industry stakeholders.
- Translate the company's vision, intellectual property, frameworks, and programmes into compelling, commercially relevant messaging.
- Maintain consistent brand positioning and visual identity across digital channels and corporate materials.
- Develop marketing collateral that communicates the value and differentiation of our solutions.
2. Digital Marketing & Social Media
- Manage the company's digital presence and social media, particularly LinkedIn.
- Develop a content calendar aligned with brand positioning, business priorities, and founder visibility.
- Create, edit, publish, and repurpose posts, articles, newsletters, videos, interviews, and other content.
- Communicate the founder's expertise, leadership perspectives, and distinctive points of view.
- Monitor reach, engagement, audience growth, and other metrics to improve effectiveness.
- Apply AI-powered tools to enhance content production, efficiency, and workflow automation.
3. Public Relations, Media Relations & Founder Visibility
- Develop and execute a proactive PR and media relations plan to strengthen the company's and founder's visibility and credibility.
- Identify relevant journalists, editors, business publications, podcasts, broadcasters, event organisers, conferences, and industry communities.
- Proactively pitch the founder for interviews, expert commentary, podcasts, panel discussions, speaking engagements, and media features.
- Build and maintain a targeted media contact database and structured pipeline for outreach and follow-ups.
- Identify timely business, leadership, workplace, and organisational topics for the founder to comment on.
- Prepare media pitches, press releases, executive profiles, interview briefs, and talking points.
- Coordinate interview preparation, scheduling, and distribution of published content.
- Build relationships with media professionals and event organisers, tracking outreach, invitations, confirmed engagements, and coverage to refine results.
4. Content Marketing & Thought Leadership

- Produce articles, newsletters, interviews, videos, case studies, and other thought leadership materials.
- Repurpose existing intellectual property, programme insights, research, and interviews for different audiences and platforms.
- Maintain an editorial calendar aligned with marketing priorities and business objectives.
- Explore content collaborations with business communities, professional associations, publications, and industry experts.

- Plan and execute targeted campaigns to build awareness, generate qualified enquiries, and support commercial growth.
- Promote CEO coaching, executive development programmes, leadership workshops, and other offerings.
- Develop tailored materials for corporate clients, strategic partners, and potential investors.
- Support executive roundtables, leadership forums, webinars, and other strategic initiatives.
- Align marketing with target markets, client acquisition priorities, and sales opportunities.
- Identify partnerships, co-marketing initiatives, and channels to expand market reach.
- Monitor campaign performance and improve lead quality, engagement, and commercial outcomes.
6. Website, Marketing Operations & Performance Tracking
- Maintain website content, landing pages, search visibility, and digital brand consistency.
- Coordinate external designers, developers, photographers, videographers, PR providers, and other specialists.
- Establish practical systems for content planning, media outreach, campaign execution, and reporting.
- Manage marketing expenditure responsibly, prioritising strategic impact within available resources.
- Track digital engagement, media outreach, founder visibility, campaign outcomes, qualified enquiries, and business development contribution.
- Review performance and adjust activities based on results, audience feedback, and business priorities.
7. Hands-on Execution & Collaboration
- Own marketing and communications activities from planning through execution.
- Manage multiple projects independently, meeting deadlines and quality standards.
- Coordinate freelancers, agencies, and other external partners when specialist support is needed.
- Deliver effective outcomes with limited resources by establishing efficient processes and reusable marketing assets.
- Work closely with the founder to translate business priorities into actionable plans.
- Identify opportunities, solve problems, and improve effectiveness without waiting for detailed instructions.

- At least 10 years of relevant experience in marketing, brand communications, PR, digital marketing, content marketing, or related disciplines.
- Proven experience executing marketing activities and building brand visibility, preferably in B2B, professional services, consulting, leadership development, technology, or other expertise-driven businesses.
- Practical experience in media relations, PR, executive profiling, thought leadership, or securing speaking and interview opportunities.
- Strong hands-on capabilities in social media management, content development, and digital marketing.
- Excellent English writing, editing, storytelling, and communication skills.
- Ability to translate business objectives and complex ideas into clear, compelling communications.
- Strong project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage priorities independently.
- Commercial awareness and understanding of how marketing supports credibility, lead generation, partnerships, and revenue growth.

- Entrepreneurial and adaptable: Thrives in an early-stage venture with limited resources and evolving priorities.

- Track marketing's contribution to commercial opportunities and refine campaigns accordingly.

Title: Senior Marketing Executive
Description:
Brand strategy and positioning
Define what the brand stands for — its mission, values, personality, and unique selling proposition. This includes identifying the target audience, analyzing competitors, and deciding how the brand should be positioned in the market relative to rivals.
Brand identity management
Oversee the visual and verbal identity: logo usage, color palettes, typography, tone of voice, and messaging guidelines. Ensure every touchpoint (packaging, ads, website, social media) stays consistent with brand guidelines.
Marketing and campaign execution
Plan and run campaigns across channels — digital, social, print, events, influencer partnerships. This involves briefing creative agencies, coordinating with media buyers, and making sure campaigns align with the brand's positioning and business goals.
Market research and consumer insights
Track consumer behavior, preferences, and perceptions through surveys, focus groups, social listening, and sales data. Use these insights to refine strategy and spot opportunities or threats early.
Budget management
Allocate and manage the marketing/brand budget, negotiate with vendors and agencies, and justify spending with measurable returns.
Performance tracking
Monitor KPIs like brand awareness, brand equity, market share, engagement rates, and campaign ROI. Report results to senior management and adjust plans based on what the data shows.
Cross-functional collaboration
Work with product teams, sales, PR, legal, and external agencies to keep everyone aligned on the brand's direction — for example, ensuring new product launches fit the brand story.
Reputation and crisis management
Protect the brand's image by monitoring public sentiment, responding to negative press or social media issues, and having crisis communication plans ready.
Innovation and growth
Identify opportunities for brand extensions, new markets, partnerships, or repositioning as consumer trends shift.
In short: a brand executive is the guardian and growth driver of the brand — keeping it consistent, relevant, and profitable. Want me to tailor this to a specific industry or turn it into a job description?

Title: Senior Marketing Executive / Assistant Manager, Marketing & Communications
Description:
About the Role
OaksPlus Limited is seeking a proactive, creative and results-driven marketing professional to join our Marketing & Communications team as a Senior Marketing Executive or Assistant Manager.
This role will focus primarily on growing the visibility, brand presence and enrolment opportunities of 7oaks Preschool through integrated digital and offline marketing initiatives.
The successful candidate will be responsible for managing digital marketing campaigns and agency relationships, driving social media and content strategies, overseeing website content, developing marketing communications materials and building corporate partnerships.
We are looking for someone who combines creative thinking with strong execution capabilities, is comfortable working with data and can independently drive marketing initiatives from planning through to implementation and performance evaluation.
What We're Looking For
We are looking for someone who is both a strategic thinker and a hands-on executor — someone who can translate marketing plans into well-executed campaigns and measurable outcomes.
You should be comfortable managing agencies and external partners, working with internal stakeholders, analysing campaign results and taking the initiative to improve performance.
Above all, you should have a strong sense of ownership, attention to detail and a genuine interest in building brands that connect meaningfully with families.
Key Responsibilities
1. Digital Marketing & Agency Management
Plan, coordinate and execute integrated digital marketing campaigns across platforms including Google, Meta and other relevant channels to drive brand awareness, enquiries and enrolments.
Manage external digital marketing agencies, including campaign briefs, creative development, budgets, timelines, performance reviews and optimisation.
Monitor campaign performance against agreed KPIs, including website traffic, leads, cost per lead (CPL), lead quality and enrolment conversions.
Work closely with agencies to identify opportunities to improve campaign effectiveness, return on investment and marketing efficiency.
Prepare regular performance reports with actionable insights and recommendations.
2. Social Media & Content Management
Develop and manage social media content plans and calendars across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and other relevant platforms.
Plan and execute engaging content that showcases the preschool's curriculum, learning experiences, educators, community engagement and brand proposition.
Oversee content creation, including copywriting, graphic design, photography and short-form video production.
Coordinate content gathering with preschool centres and internal stakeholders to ensure a consistent flow of relevant and engaging content.
Monitor social media performance, audience engagement and emerging trends to continuously improve content effectiveness.
Maintain consistent brand messaging, visual identity and quality across all social media platforms.
3. Website Management & Digital Presence
Manage and maintain the 7oaks Preschool website using WordPress, ensuring content is accurate, relevant and regularly updated.
Oversee updates to website pages, campaign landing pages, blog articles, promotional content and calls to action.
Coordinate with web developers and external vendors on website enhancements, maintenance and technical issues.
Monitor website performance using tools such as Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console and other relevant analytics platforms.
Work with agencies and vendors to improve search engine visibility, website user experience and lead generation effectiveness.
Support ongoing website enhancement and revamp initiatives where required.
4. Marketing Communications & Brand Management
Plan and execute marketing communications initiatives across digital and offline channels, ensuring alignment with brand positioning and business objectives.
Develop and coordinate marketing collaterals, including brochures, flyers, posters, banners, digital advertisements, out-of-home (OOH) advertising and promotional materials.
Support corporate communications and internal branding requirements, including staff event collaterals, Dinner & Dance materials, annual reports, presentations and internal announcements.
Liaise with creative agencies, printers, media owners and other vendors to ensure timely and cost-effective production of marketing materials.
Maintain brand consistency across all communications touchpoints.
Support public relations, community outreach and other brand-building opportunities as required.
5. Corporate Partnerships & Community Outreach
Identify and develop corporate partnership opportunities to increase brand awareness, generate qualified leads and support preschool enrolment.
Establish and maintain relationships with companies, community organisations and other relevant partners.
Develop partnership proposals, promotional arrangements and joint marketing initiatives.
Coordinate corporate outreach activities, roadshows and partnership activations.
Track partnership activities, leads generated and outcomes to evaluate effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.
6. Campaigns, Events & Performance Reporting
Plan and coordinate marketing support for preschool open houses, Discovery Days, roadshows, enrolment drives and other events.
Work closely with centre leaders and internal stakeholders to ensure marketing initiatives support centre-specific enrolment priorities.
Track marketing performance across channels, including leads, centre visit registrations, visit attendance and enrolment conversions.
Maintain campaign budgets, timelines, marketing calendars and performance reports.
Identify gaps in performance and recommend corrective actions to improve results.
Support other marketing and communications initiatives as assigned.
Requirements
Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Mass Communication, Business, Digital Marketing or a related discipline.
Senior Executive: Preferably 3–5 years of relevant marketing experience.
Assistant Manager: Preferably 5–7 years of relevant marketing experience, with demonstrated ownership of marketing campaigns and agency relationships.
Strong hands-on experience in digital marketing, including paid advertising, campaign coordination, agency management and performance tracking.
Proven experience managing social media channels, content calendars and creative production.
Practical experience managing websites using WordPress or a similar CMS; familiarity with basic SEO and website analytics.
Good understanding of digital marketing metrics, including CPL, conversion rates, website traffic and campaign ROI.
Strong writing and communication skills, with the ability to develop compelling marketing content and coordinate with diverse stakeholders.
Good eye for design and familiarity with Canva, Adobe Creative Suite or similar tools.
Experience in offline marketing, collateral production, vendor coordination and event management.
Strong project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and competing deadlines.
Resourceful, proactive and solutions-oriented, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables.
Experience in the education, preschool or family-oriented services sector will be an advantage.

We do this by offering a wide range of well-designed, functional home furnishing products at prices so low that as many people as possible can afford them. We operate in Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand – and have an ambitious expansion plan to bring a little bit of Sweden to new markets in the region. We are part of the Ikano Group of companies and the only IKEA franchisee owned by the Kamprad family that founded IKEA.
We also develop, own and operate Shopping Centres that are anchored by IKEA and create walkable communities by including residential, office and other types of real estate in our development plans.

Description:

Role: Ad Sales Planner

WE ARE BBC STUDIOS
A globally renowned media company borne of the BBC. We make and distribute the world's most sought-after TV, audio and digital content.
Our ambition is to be the home of the most powerful, entertaining, and inspiring stories for people all around the world.
PURPOSE OF THE ROLE
The Ad Sales Planner is a critical member of the APAC Advertising Sales team, supporting revenue growth across BBC Studios' portfolio of television, digital, audio, sponsorship, branded content and audience solutions. Working closely with sales, clients, agencies and internal stakeholders, the role supports the full advertising sales cycle, from proposal development and campaign planning through to execution, reporting and post-campaign analysis.
The APAC region presents a significant growth opportunity through a dual-pronged strategy of expanding our base of premium television advertisers while accelerating growth across BBC Studios' evolving digital, audience, data and content marketing solutions. As a result, this role plays an important part in helping clients better understand and access BBC Studios' unique audiences, premium content environments and advertising capabilities.
The successful candidate will combine strong commercial acumen, attention to detail and client management skills with a passion for media, content, audience insights and advertising innovation. They will become a trusted partner to the sales team, supporting business growth while ensuring the highest standards of campaign execution and client service.
YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND IMPACT
1. Commercial Sales Planning & Client Solutions (55%)
Support the APAC Advertising Sales team in developing strategic advertising solutions that drive revenue growth across television, digital, audio, sponsorship, branded content and audience-led opportunities.
Develop compelling media plans, presentations and commercial proposals in response to client and agency briefs.
Translate client marketing objectives into integrated advertising solutions leveraging BBC Studios' content, audience and platform capabilities.
Partner with Sales, Insights, StoryWorks and other internal stakeholders to deliver competitive and commercially effective recommendations.
Support proactive pitches and business development initiatives designed to grow revenue and expand advertiser relationships.
Identify opportunities to introduce clients to BBC Studios' growing suite of audience, data, content and digital advertising solutions.
Review inventory availability and recommend effective advertising, sponsorship and content-led opportunities.
Ensure proposals are commercially sound, accurately costed and aligned with sales objectives.
Support programmatic advertising opportunities and act as a point of contact for agency trading desks where required.
Assist in creating best-in-class sales material that positions BBC Studios as a premium advertising partner across APAC.
Act as a trusted commercial partner to the sales team, anticipating client needs and delivering responsive support throughout the sales process.
2. Campaign Management & Client Service Excellence (30%)
Manage the successful implementation, delivery and optimisation of campaigns while providing exceptional support to clients, agencies and internal stakeholders.
Coordinate campaign setup and execution with Ad Operations, StoryWorks, Compliance and other business functions.
Manage campaign bookings, insertion orders, sponsorship documentation and internal approval processes.
Liaise with clients and agencies to ensure all creative materials and campaign assets are received, approved and delivered on schedule.
Monitor campaign performance and identify optimisation opportunities to maximise campaign outcomes.
Provide timely communication and support throughout the campaign lifecycle.
Troubleshoot campaign delivery issues in partnership with operational teams and communicate resolutions to stakeholders.
Prepare campaign performance reports, transmission reports and post-campaign reviews.
Ensure campaigns are delivered in accordance with contractual commitments and client expectations.
Build strong day-to-day relationships with agencies, advertisers and regional sales representatives.
Act as a reliable first point of contact for campaign-related enquiries and operational support.
3. Commercial Reporting, Sales Operations & Business Support (15%)
Provide accurate reporting, financial coordination and operational support to enable effective decision-making and seamless commercial execution.
Prepare and distribute campaign performance reports, post-campaign analyses, transmission reports and revenue tracking updates.
Support the sales team with audience insights, market intelligence and competitor monitoring to strengthen client conversations and commercial outcomes.
Partner closely with Finance to support billing accuracy, invoice reconciliation, revenue recognition processes and client payment enquiries.
Coordinate client onboarding requirements and ensure all necessary commercial documentation, contracts and compliance processes are completed.
Maintain accurate information across CRM, booking, reporting and sales management systems.
Support regional business reporting requirements and sales administration processes.
Ensure consistency with BBC Studios' commercial policies, reporting standards and product messaging across APAC.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational efficiency and sales effectiveness.
Success Measures
The Ad Sales Planner will be successful when they:
Deliver high-quality, strategic media plans that contribute to revenue growth across APAC.
Become a trusted commercial partner to the sales team and a valued contact for clients and agencies.
Contribute to the growth of both premium television advertising and emerging digital, audience and content-led revenue streams.
Maintain high standards of campaign delivery, reporting accuracy and client satisfaction.
Drive operational excellence through efficient processes, accurate forecasting and strong financial coordination.
Provide actionable insights that strengthen BBC Studios' commercial proposition and market position.
Support the achievement of regional revenue targets through outstanding planning, execution, campaign servicing and stakeholder management.
YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
Essential
Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
Experience within a media owner, publisher, agency or advertising environment preferred.
Strong interest in media, advertising, content marketing and audience strategy.
Excellent organisational, administrative and project management skills.
Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Commercially minded with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Numerate and data-driven, with advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Ability to interpret campaign performance data and convert insights into actionable recommendations.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate across multiple teams and markets.
Self-starter with a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset.
Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a collaborative team environment.
Fluent written and spoken English.
Desirable
Experience in digital advertising, broadcast advertising, audio advertising or programmatic media.
Understanding of media planning, campaign management or advertising operations.
Familiarity with audience measurement, analytics and reporting platforms.
Knowledge of branded content, sponsorship and content marketing solutions.
Experience working with CRM, ad-serving, booking or sales management systems.
Additional APAC language capabilities are advantageous.
Passion for media, technology and emerging advertising trends.

The Assistant Manager – Trade Marketing & Commercial Planning will support the
growth of Retail, Food Service and E-commerce channels through trade marketing
initiatives, category development, market intelligence and commercial analysis.
This role works closely with Sales, Marketing, Operations, brand principals and external
partners to translate market and customer insights into effective promotional
programmes, category strategies and commercial opportunities.

• Plan and execute trade marketing activities, promotional campaigns, product
launches and brand activations across Retail, Food Service and E-commerce
channels.

profitability and market share.

brand principals.

spend.

media channels.

using PowerPoint.

management and brand principals.
• Maintain dashboards and reporting tools to track key commercial and business
performance indicators.

Education & Experience
• Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Business, Retail Management, Commercial
Management or a related discipline.
• 3–5 years of relevant experience in Trade Marketing, Category Management,
Commercial Planning, E-commerce or Sales Analytics.

will be advantageous.

experience are encouraged to apply.

data.

market data such as Nielsen.

marketplace operations.

Title: Assistant Manager/Manager, Brand & Content, Singapore Global Network
Description:
[What the role is]
About Singapore Global Network
Singapore Global Network (SGN) is a division under EDB that grows and engages a 220,000-strong international community of overseas Singaporeans and friends of Singapore. Our mission is to grow Singapore’s global networks by fostering meaningful relationships and communities among international talent, entrepreneurs, students and partners worldwide, while strengthening Singapore’s position as the ideal place to work, live and play.

You will be part of SGN’s Brand & Content team, supporting the development and execution of brand and content marketing initiatives that promote SGN as an international networking community among target audience segments, and building a positive experience with members. This includes building the SGN brand experience, growing its digital channel following, promoting its product offerings, generating new members for the network, and engaging audiences through a mix of online and offline initiatives.
You will also help shape global perceptions of Singapore as an ideal city for international talent to live, work and play in. This includes promoting the many aspects of Singapore’s culture, people and environment. Using compelling storytelling techniques, you will creatively convey Singapore value propositions in a way that gets target audiences excited about the prospects and opportunities that Singapore has to offer.
This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys creating, experimenting, and collaborating — from shaping creative campaign ideas to producing inspiring content and supporting delivery across digital channels. You will work closely with internal teams, marketing agencies and brand partners to shape how Singapore is represented to global audiences.
Key Responsibilities
Brand & Campaign Management
- Drive the ideation, development and execution of brand initiatives and marketing campaigns aimed at growing SGN’s digital following, network membership and brand experience.
- Work with marketing agencies to develop and execute campaigns across online and offline channels.

- Identify brand partners for collaboration to enhance SGN’s value offerings to members.
Content Development & Marketing

We are looking for a digital native with a fun personality. Someone who is creative, energetic and with a good sense of humour, to bring out the best that Singapore and SGN has to offer.

- Have 1–3 years of experience (or equivalent internships/projects) in digital marketing, content, communications, or social media. Agency and/or media production house experience is welcome but not mandatory.

Title: Associate Consumer Experience Director, Region APAC
Description:
Your impact begins here
As Associate Consumer Experience Director APAC, you will build two new capabilities that make brand marketing more credible and more measurable across the region. You will define how brands responsibly engage online influencers to earn trust and reference, and you will bring brand, campaign, digital and content-creator activity into one clear performance narrative. Your work will help teams decide where to invest and sharpen how Novo shows up for customers.
What You'll Bring
We're looking for a strong consumer marketer who can build capability from first principles and turn data into decisions.
You'll Need
- A bachelor's degree; an advanced degree (Master's, MBA or equivalent) in Marketing, Data/Commercial or a related field is strongly preferred.
- 12+ years of progressive experience across marketing, digital, media, customer engagement or data/insights, ideally with significant regional or multi-market responsibility.
- Local Singaporean citizens or PR holders are highly preferred.
- Proven experience at a regional/APAC level, translating global strategy into practical approaches across markets with different priorities, regulations and levels of digital maturity.
- Strong modern digital and social marketing expertise, including influencer/Digital Opinion Leaders (DOL) and Key Opinion Influencers (KOI) partnerships, creator collaborations, social amplification and content strategy.
- A track record of designing new capabilities, processes or operating models — playbooks, governance and measurement frameworks — not only running established programmes.
- Deep marketing performance and insight skills: integrating data across brand, media, digital, content and engagement, and translating it into clear recommendations and investment decisions.
- Experience defining KPIs and reporting standards across multiple markets, channels or brands, working with analytics specialists where needed.
- Strong cross-functional leadership and influence without direct authority, partnering with senior marketing, Medical Affairs, Legal/Ethics & Compliance, data teams, agencies and affiliates.
- Comfort operating in a complex, matrixed multinational, balancing regional consistency with local execution realities.
Useful, But Not Essential
- Experience in healthcare, pharmaceuticals or another highly regulated industry is strongly preferred. Candidates from consumer, technology or other sectors will be considered where they bring highly relevant social/influencer and data-driven marketing expertise.
What You'll Do
This is a two-pillar role. In the first, you'll lead how brands engage online influencers; in the second, you'll own how APAC marketing measures and understands its performance. Across both, you'll help shape how Novo shows up across the wider customer experience.
Online Influencer Lead, APAC
- Own the APAC strategy for how brands responsibly leverage online influencers (DOLs and KOIs) to build awareness, trust, credible reference and engagement, and design the process to identify, prioritise and activate opportunities with clear governance, briefing, approval and measurement.
- Partner with Brand, Medical Affairs, Communications, Legal/Ethics & Compliance and affiliates so influencer activity is strategically relevant, medically credible, responsibly executed and compliant — and integrated with broader brand, content, digital and communications plans.
- Work with Communications on content creator engagement, narratives, social amplification, reputation and audience trust, and help shape how brands appear across digital platforms, content environments, NovoCare and emerging discovery experiences such as Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO).
- Define brand- and audience-specific KPIs — awareness, engagement, sentiment, share of voice, trust and reference-building — and connect influencer results to brand health and campaign performance.
- Share best practice, case studies and reusable assets across APAC markets to build capability and reduce duplication.
Marketing Data and Insights Lead, APAC
- Design and own a single, integrated measurement framework across consumer marketing, media, digital, content, influencer and customer experience activity, with consistent KPI definitions, data sources, reporting standards and cadence that replace fragmented channel-level reporting.
- Bring campaign, media, digital, content, influencer and customer experience data into one cohesive performance narrative for APAC marketing leadership, on a regular reporting and insight rhythm that connects investment to impact.
- Translate data into clear insight and recommendations — what is working, why, where to invest next and how to optimise — and use it to inform decisions across markets, channels, campaigns, segments and content formats.
- Partner with Brand, Communications, Medical Affairs, Campaign and affiliate teams during planning cycles to bring an evidence-based view to prioritisation and resource allocation, including practical ways to assess customer experience across key touchpoints.
- Build data and insight capability across affiliate teams through clear tools, playbooks, templates and coaching.
Who You'll Work With
You'll work across markets in International Operations, where colleagues serve people around the world and help improve health at scale. This is a highly cross-functional role, so your ability to build trust and clear ways of working matters. Your closest partners will be Brand, Communications, Medical Affairs, Legal/Ethics & Compliance, Digital, Content and platform owners, along with regional and affiliate marketing teams across APAC. You'll also collaborate with data and analytics specialists and external agencies. These relationships are how influencer programmes stay credible and how a single performance narrative earns the confidence of leadership.
What You Can Expect Here
You'll build two new capabilities from the ground up and see your thinking shape how brands engage customers and how leadership invests across APAC. It's an environment where you're trusted to set direction, challenge established approaches and make your voice heard — and supported to do your best work as you build new skills across markets, functions and channels.
Start now
Your impact begins today. If you're ready to build credible influencer engagement and a clear, decision-useful view of performance across APAC, apply for the Associate Consumer Experience Director role. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
