Title: Brand & Marketing Assistant
Description:
Brand & Marketing Executive
About the Role
We are looking for a self-motivated, creative, and commercially minded Brand & Marketing Executive to support the planning, coordination, and execution of brand, digital, retail, social media, and e-commerce initiatives.
The ideal candidate combines creative thinking with an analytical mindset, keeps up with evolving digital trends, and is enthusiastic about building brands across online and offline channels.
You will work closely with the local and overseas marketing teams, designers, agencies, vendors, and external partners to bring campaigns, promotions, content, and brand experiences to life. This role is well suited to someone who is organised, detail-oriented, and brand-conscious, with the ability to manage timelines, coordinate multiple stakeholders, maintain brand consistency, and support the operational requirements behind successful marketing execution.
Key Responsibilities
Brand Campaigns and Marketing Execution
Support the planning and execution of brand campaigns, seasonal promotions, new product launches, events, and marketing activations.
Develop and maintain campaign timelines, marketing calendars, task lists, and rollout plans.
Coordinate campaign requirements across internal and overseas teams, designers, agencies, vendors, and external partners to ensure timely and effective execution.
Prepare campaign briefs, creative references, key copy points, presentations, and marketing materials.
Ensure campaign messaging and visual assets are aligned with each brand’s tone, personality, positioning, and guidelines.
Monitor project progress, manage follow-ups, and help resolve issues that could affect campaign timelines or deliverables.
Content and Communications
Create and coordinate marketing content across social media, email campaigns, websites, e-commerce platforms, in-store materials, and other promotional channels.
Write and edit social media captions, newsletters, website content, promotional copy, product descriptions, and campaign communications.
Work with designers, agencies, and other creative partners to develop high-quality marketing assets.
Review content and communications to ensure they are clear, accurate, polished, consistent, and on-brand across all customer touchpoints.
Maintain organised records of marketing materials, campaign assets, and brand resources.
Social Media and Digital Marketing
Support the day-to-day management of social media platforms, including Meta and TikTok.
Manage content scheduling, publishing, community engagement, and general account upkeep.
Monitor social media performance and prepare reports covering reach, engagement, follower growth, content performance, and campaign results.
Support influencer and key opinion leader (KOL) campaigns, including research, shortlist preparation, outreach, briefing, coordination, and follow-ups.
Assist with digital marketing initiatives such as boosted posts, campaign tagging, performance monitoring, and basic paid-media coordination.
Track emerging platform features, digital trends, and competitor activity, and recommend relevant opportunities for the brands.
E-commerce
Support the day-to-day management of e-commerce platforms, including Shopify, Shopee, and Lazada.
Ensure that website and marketplace content is accurate, current, user-friendly, and aligned with brand standards.
Maintain product information, pricing, collections, imagery, product attributes, and other digital assets.
Configure and manage promotional campaigns, including discount codes, bundles, vouchers, and gift-with-purchase mechanics.
Support annual and quarterly channel planning, including pricing, promotions, product bundles, inventory alignment, and campaign calendars.
Assist in delivering revenue, conversion, and margin targets through effective campaign execution and ongoing optimisation.
Support go-to-market planning and execution for new product launches and major e-commerce events, including double-digit campaigns.
Coordinate commercial readiness, traffic-acquisition activities, promotional mechanics, product availability, and conversion optimisation.
Track key e-commerce indicators, identify performance trends, and recommend opportunities for improvement.
Role Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, E-commerce, Communications, or a related discipline.
At least two years of relevant experience in brand, digital, retail, social media, or e-commerce marketing.
Experience supporting e-commerce sales and marketplace operations is an advantage.
Strong analytical skills, with experience tracking indicators such as revenue, traffic, engagement, conversion rates, and campaign performance.
Ability to interpret data and translate insights into practical recommendations.
Strong interest in brand building, digital marketing, social media, and e-commerce.
Good understanding of major social media platforms and current digital and consumer trends.
Highly organised, results-oriented, and detail-conscious, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
Able to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional and regional teams.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.
Familiarity with design tools such as Canva, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, or similar platforms is an advantage.
Ability to speak Mandarin and Korean is an advantage.

Title: Brand & Marketing Manager
Description:
Brand & Marketing Manager
About KLARRA
KLARRA is a Singapore-based contemporary fashion and lifestyle brand, known for its modern, refined and timeless approach to style. As we continue to grow our presence across fashion, retail and lifestyle, we are looking for a creative, resourceful and driven Brand & Marketing Manager to join our team.
This role is ideal for someone who has a strong eye for aesthetics, enjoys developing fresh ideas, is confident in building relationships and takes ownership of bringing marketing initiatives to life.
You will play a key role in shaping how KLARRA communicates, engages with its community and builds brand desirability across digital and offline touchpoints.
Key Responsibilities
1. Brand Strategy & Creative Marketing
Develop and execute marketing strategies that strengthen KLARRA's brand positioning, awareness and customer engagement.
Conceptualise fresh and thoughtful marketing ideas aligned with the brand's identity and aesthetic.
Lead the creative direction and storytelling for new collection launches, seasonal campaigns and brand initiatives.
Identify opportunities to create excitement and meaningful conversations around the brand.
Translate ideas into actionable marketing plans with clear timelines, deliverables and objectives.
Maintain consistency in brand messaging, visual identity and tone of voice across all marketing channels.
2. Social Media & Content Strategy
Own and manage the overall social media content calendar, ensuring a consistent and engaging presence.
Independently conceptualise content ideas for Instagram posts, stories, reels and other relevant platforms.
Develop creative briefs, storytelling angles and content direction for the in-house creative marketing team member.
Write compelling and refined copy for social media captions, campaigns, newsletters and other brand communications.
Work closely with the creative marketing team member to plan and coordinate content shoots, including visual references, shot lists and production schedules.
Oversee content scheduling and publishing, ensuring timely delivery and maintaining the brand's visual standards.
Review social media performance and identify opportunities to improve engagement, reach and content effectiveness.
3. Public Relations, KOL & Influencer Marketing
Develop and execute public relations and influencer marketing strategies to strengthen brand awareness and desirability.
Build and maintain relationships with relevant media, editors, stylists, influencers, KOLs and industry partners.
Independently identify, approach and engage suitable KOLs and content creators who align with KLARRA's brand identity.
Conceptualise and manage creative influencer seeding campaigns, gifting initiatives and collaborative content opportunities.
Negotiate partnership terms, deliverables and budgets to ensure meaningful brand exposure and value.
Develop press materials, media pitches and brand announcements for collection launches and key milestones.
Track and evaluate the effectiveness of public relations placements, influencer partnerships and seeding initiatives.
Coordinate with external public relations agencies and partners for selected larger campaigns when required.
4. Brand Partnerships & Collaborations
Proactively identify and develop strategic partnerships with complementary fashion, beauty, lifestyle and hospitality brands.
Conceptualise fresh collaboration opportunities, brand activations and community-building initiatives.
Lead outreach, proposals, discussions and negotiations with potential partners.
Manage partnership execution from initial ideation through to launch, ensuring alignment with the brand's positioning and objectives.
Explore new opportunities to expand KLARRA's reach and introduce the brand to relevant audiences.
5. Campaigns, Events & Brand Activations
Plan and coordinate marketing campaigns for new collections, retail initiatives, KLARRA Cafe and key brand moments.
Conceptualise launch experiences, intimate events, media previews and customer engagement initiatives.
Manage project timelines, budgets, vendor coordination and execution.
Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to ensure smooth campaign delivery.
Identify thoughtful and innovative ways to create excitement and publicity around product launches and special initiatives.
6. CRM, Customer Engagement & Brand Growth
Develop initiatives to strengthen customer loyalty, repeat purchases and long-term brand engagement.
Support the development, launch and ongoing marketing of KLARRA's customer loyalty programme.
Plan customer engagement campaigns, email newsletters and targeted communications.
Identify opportunities to grow the brand's community across existing and potential markets.
Monitor key marketing performance indicators and provide actionable recommendations for improvement.
7. Marketing Planning & Coordination
Develop and maintain a structured monthly and quarterly marketing calendar.
Independently manage priorities, timelines and deliverables across ongoing campaigns and initiatives.
Work closely with the founder, creative marketing team member, design team and retail teams to ensure alignment.
Oversee marketing budgets and manage external vendors where necessary.
Provide regular updates on marketing progress, performance, upcoming initiatives and opportunities.
Take ownership of projects from conceptualisation through to execution, with minimal day-to-day supervision.
Requirements
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in brand marketing, creative marketing, public relations or related fields, preferably within fashion, beauty, lifestyle or premium retail.
Strong creative thinking and the ability to independently develop compelling marketing ideas.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a strong command of English and a flair for refined brand storytelling.
Proven experience in influencer marketing, public relations outreach, partnerships and negotiations.
Strong understanding of social media content strategy, particularly Instagram.
A keen eye for aesthetics, photography, visual storytelling and contemporary fashion.
Experience managing marketing campaigns, timelines and multiple projects independently.
Resourceful, organised, proactive and comfortable taking initiative.
Strong interpersonal skills and the confidence to build and maintain external relationships.
Basic proficiency in Canva or Adobe Creative Suite is an advantage.
Experience with email marketing, CRM and customer loyalty initiatives is an advantage.
Who We're Looking For
We are looking for someone who brings ideas to the table, enjoys creating meaningful brand experiences and has the initiative to turn opportunities into results.
You should be equally comfortable conceptualising a collection launch, developing a social media content plan, approaching potential collaborators and coordinating the details that bring a campaign together.
Above all, we value creativity, good judgement, ownership, attention to detail and a genuine appreciation for KLARRA's brand identity.
How to Apply
If you enjoy building brands, developing creative ideas and creating meaningful connections, we would love to hear from you.

Description:
Overall Job Responsibility
The Deputy Director, Brand & Marketing Communications will lead the development and growth of the SG Enable brand, strengthening public awareness, understanding and trust in the organisation and its role in advancing disability inclusion in Singapore.
As the strategic custodian of the SG Enable brand, you will shape the organisation’s brand positioning and narrative, and lead the development of an integrated marketing communications strategy. You will drive greater impact and effectiveness across media, digital and social channels, while optimizing marketing investments to advance organisational priorities.
You will also champion Marketing Excellence across SG Enable, partnering Business Units to strengthen marketing capabilities, enhance agency and media effectiveness, and ensure that programmes and initiatives collectively reinforce a coherent and compelling SG Enable brand.
Duties and Responsibilities
Brand Strategy & Stewardship
- Lead SG Enable’s brand strategy, positioning, architecture and narrative.
- Strengthen public awareness and understanding of SG Enable and its role in Singapore’s disability ecosystem.
- Establish brand frameworks and guidelines to ensure a consistent and compelling SG Enable brand across programmes, platforms and partnerships.
- Monitor brand health and identify opportunities to strengthen brand relevance and equity.
Integrated Marketing & Audience Growth
- Develop organisation-wide brand and integrated marketing communications strategies.
- Lead major brand-building initiatives and guide Business Units on campaign positioning, audience strategy and marketing effectiveness.
- Strengthen SG Enable’s digital and social presence and grow engagement with key audiences.
- Develop content and storytelling strategies that bring SG Enable’s purpose and impact to life.
Media & Marketing Excellence
- Provide strategic oversight of SG Enable’s media strategy and investments.
- Identify opportunities to consolidate media investments and improve effectiveness and efficiency.
- Lead the evaluation and management of creative, media and digital agencies.
- Establish marketing frameworks, toolkits, measurement standards and best practices across the organisation.
- Build marketing capabilities through coaching, training and knowledge sharing.
Strategic Partnership with Business Units
- Serve as a strategic brand and marketing advisor to Business Units and senior stakeholders.
- Help translate programme objectives into effective audience and marketing strategies.
- Ensure programmes and campaigns appropriately reinforce the SG Enable brand while achieving their respective objectives.
- Facilitate greater collaboration and integration of marketing activities across the organisation.
Insights & Performance
- Establish brand and marketing KPIs and measurement frameworks.
- Use audience research, digital analytics and campaign performance to guide marketing decisions.
- Drive greater accountability and optimisation of marketing and media investments.
Leadership

- Manage agencies, resources and budgets effectively.

Title: Brand Manager (VIVAIA)
Description:
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced, commercially driven General Manager – Singapore to lead VIVAIA’s Singapore business and accelerate sustainable growth.
This is a hands-on leadership role with overall responsibility for the Singapore business, including sales growth, P&L, retail operations, merchandising, marketing, customer experience and business development.
We are looking for someone who does not simply manage the existing business, but can constantly identify why sales are growing or declining, what is driving the change, and what actions should be taken to improve performance.
The successful candidate should have a strong understanding of modern retail, consumer behaviour, digital marketing and store operations, with a proven track record of growing retail businesses.
Responsibilities:
Overall Business & P&L Management
Take overall responsibility for VIVAIA Singapore’s sales, profitability and business performance.
Develop annual and monthly sales, profit and growth plans.
Monitor sales, gross margin, operating expenses, inventory and store profitability.
Identify business opportunities and risks early and take corrective action.
Present regular business reviews and growth plans to regional/global management.
2. Sales Growth
Drive sustainable growth across all Singapore retail stores and relevant online channels.
Monitor daily, weekly and monthly sales performance.
Analyse sales performance by store, product category, SKU, price point and customer segment.
Identify the reasons behind sales growth or decline and translate insights into specific actions.
Improve key retail metrics including traffic, conversion rate, average transaction value and units per transaction.
3. Retail Operations
Lead the Retail Operations team and all store performance.
Set store-level sales targets and performance KPIs.
Work closely with store managers to improve productivity and customer experience.
Identify underperforming stores and develop turnaround plans.
Improve staff selling skills, service standards and sales productivity.
Evaluate new locations and provide recommendations for store openings, relocations or closures.
4. Merchandising & Product
Lead and work closely with the Merchandising/Product team.
Analyse product performance and identify best sellers, slow movers and emerging trends.
Ensure the right products, sizes, colours and inventory are available at the right stores.
Provide market feedback to regional/global product teams.
Develop Singapore-specific product, assortment and pricing recommendations where appropriate.
Improve inventory turnover and reduce unnecessary markdowns.
5. Marketing & Customer Acquisition
Lead the Marketing team in developing effective Singapore marketing strategies.
Build integrated online and offline marketing campaigns.
Evaluate the effectiveness of Meta, Google, TikTok, Xiaohongshu, influencers/KOLs, CRM, affiliates and other digital channels.
Develop campaigns that generate measurable incremental traffic, customers and sales.
Work closely with Retail Operations to convert marketing traffic into store visits and purchases.
Develop customer retention and CRM strategies to increase repeat purchases and customer lifetime value.
6. Customer & Market Insights
Continuously monitor Singapore consumer trends, competitors and market developments.
Track key competitors including international and local fashion, footwear and lifestyle brands.
Understand changing customer preferences, price sensitivity and shopping behaviour.
Use data and customer feedback to improve product, marketing, pricing and store strategies.
7. Commercial & Business Development
Develop partnerships with shopping malls, platforms, strategic partners and relevant organisations.
Negotiate and evaluate commercial opportunities together with relevant internal teams.
Identify opportunities for new stores, pop-ups, events and other channels
Ensure commercial decisions are based on expected sales, profitability and long-term brand value.
8. Team Leadership
Directly manage and develop the key Singapore functions, including:
Head / Manager of Retail Operations
Head / Manager of Merchandising / Product
Head / Manager of Marketing
Build a high-performance culture based on accountability, data and results.
⸻
Key Performance Indicators
The successful candidate will be evaluated primarily on measurable business results, including:
Total Sales Growth
Like-for-Like Sales Growth
Store Sales Productivity
Gross Margin
Store EBITDA / Profitability
Conversion Rate
Average Transaction Value (ATV)
Units Per Transaction (UPT)
Customer Acquisition Cost
Marketing ROI
Repeat Customer Rate
Inventory Turnover
Markdown Rate
New Store Performance

5 years of relevant experience in retail, fashion, footwear, lifestyle, beauty or other consumer brands.
Proven experience managing multi-store retail operations.
Experience managing P&L and business performance.
Strong understanding of merchandising, marketing and retail operations.
Demonstrated track record of growing sales and improving profitability.

Title: Business Development Manager (Digital Marketing)
Description:
*Business Development Manager — Digital Marketing Sales*
*Mustard Seed Digital | Singapore | Full-Time*
*About Mustard Seed Digital*
Mustard Seed Digital is a Singapore-based creative-performance digital marketing agency that helps brands grow through strategy, content, creativity, performance marketing, and marketing technology.
We work with businesses that want more than “just posts” or “just ads”. Our role is to help clients clarify their marketing direction, strengthen their brand presence, generate better leads, improve campaign performance, and build more effective digital marketing systems.
Our services include social media management, content marketing, creative production, performance marketing, paid search, paid social, website design and development, branding, copywriting, CRM, marketing automation, and digital marketing training.
As we continue to grow, we are looking for a *Business Development Manager* who can help us open new doors, build strong B2B relationships, and bring in quality clients who value strategic and measurable digital marketing support.
*About the Role*
This is a *client acquisition and revenue growth role*.
We are looking for a confident B2B hunter who enjoys prospecting, meeting business owners and marketing decision-makers, uncovering client needs, and presenting practical digital marketing solutions.
You should not be someone who only waits for inbound leads. You should be comfortable identifying prospects, initiating conversations, following up consistently, building trust, and moving opportunities from first contact to proposal and closing.
This role is ideal for someone who has experience in B2B sales, digital marketing sales, agency sales, media sales, SaaS sales, marketing consultancy, or professional services business development.
You do not need to be a digital marketing specialist, but you must be able to understand and discuss marketing challenges confidently with clients. You should be able to ask good questions, identify business pain points, and work with our internal team to recommend suitable solutions.
*What You Will Be Responsible For*
*Business Development & Client Acquisition*
* Identify, prospect, and develop new B2B client opportunities in Singapore
* Build your own sales pipeline through outreach, referrals, networking, events, partnerships, and follow-ups
* Engage business owners, SME leaders, marketing managers, corporate decision-makers, and brand teams
* Conduct discovery conversations to understand clients’ business goals, marketing challenges, budget, and decision-making process
* Promote MSD’s digital marketing, creative, content, performance marketing, website, CRM, and marketing automation solutions
* Prepare and present proposals, quotations, pitch decks, and commercial scopes
* Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting to proposal, negotiation, closing, and handover
* Achieve agreed sales, revenue, and gross profit targets
* Maintain strong relationships with prospects and clients to support repeat business and long-term account growth
*Consultative Selling & Solution Development*
* Understand each client’s business situation before recommending a solution
* Help clients see how digital marketing can support brand growth, lead generation, customer engagement, and business performance
* Work with internal teams to shape solutions that are relevant, realistic, and commercially viable
* Present ideas clearly and confidently to clients
* Translate client needs into practical digital marketing scopes and proposals
* Provide market feedback and client insights to help MSD improve its offerings
*Internal Coordination*
* Work closely with the Accounts, Creative, Performance Marketing, and Operations teams
* Ensure proper handover after a deal is closed
* Support smooth client onboarding and expectation-setting
* Monitor client feedback where needed and support service recovery or account growth opportunities
* Keep sales activities, pipeline updates, and client information properly documented
*Who We Are Looking For*
We are looking for someone who is commercially driven, proactive, and comfortable with B2B client acquisition.
*The ideal candidate should have:*
* Proven experience in B2B sales, business development, account acquisition, or client-facing revenue growth
* Experience selling digital marketing, advertising, creative services, media, SaaS, consulting, professional services, or other B2B solutions
* A good understanding of digital marketing services such as social media, content marketing, paid advertising, SEO, websites, branding, CRM, or marketing automation
* Confidence in prospecting and opening new business conversations
* Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills
* Ability to speak with business owners, marketing teams, and senior decision-makers
* Strong commercial sense and the ability to work towards revenue and profitability targets
* Good follow-up discipline and the ability to manage multiple leads at different stages
* Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with internal teams
* A consultative mindset — able to understand client needs instead of simply pushing packages
*We Are Especially Interested In Candidates Who Have*
* Existing B2B sales experience in Singapore
* Experience in a digital agency, creative agency, media agency, marketing consultancy, SaaS company, or related business
* A network of SME owners, marketing decision-makers, corporate contacts, or potential business leads
* Experience preparing proposals, quotations, pitch decks, or commercial scopes
* Experience selling retainers, campaigns, projects, or marketing-related solutions
* Confidence in approaching new clients and creating opportunities from scratch
*This Role May Be a Good Fit If You Are*
* A hunter who enjoys opening new doors and building your own pipeline
* Someone who understands that good sales is about asking the right questions, not just giving a sales pitch
* Comfortable speaking about digital marketing, branding, content, websites, and paid media with clients
* Motivated by revenue growth, client relationships, and business impact
* Looking for a role where your contribution to agency growth is visible and valued
* Able to work in a boutique agency environment where initiative, ownership, and accountability matter
*This Role May Not Be Suitable If You*
* Prefer to handle only inbound enquiries
* Are uncomfortable with prospecting or cold outreach
* Have no interest in digital marketing, content, branding, or performance marketing
* Prefer a highly structured corporate sales environment with fixed scripts and rigid processes
* Are looking for a purely account servicing role without revenue responsibility
*Why Join Mustard Seed Digital?*
At MSD, you will not be selling generic marketing packages. You will be helping businesses think through how digital marketing can support their growth.
*You will have the opportunity to:*
* Sell a broad range of creative, digital, content, performance, and marketing technology solutions
* Work with a team that values strategy, creativity, performance, and purposeful growth
* Shape meaningful client conversations from the first meeting
* Build relationships across different industries and business segments
* Play a direct role in growing the agency’s client base and market presence
* Be part of a boutique agency where your effort, ideas, and results are visible
*Employment Details*
*Employment Type:* Full-time
*Location:* Singapore
*Role Type:* Business Development / Digital Marketing Sales / B2B Client Acquisition

Interested candidates are invited to apply with your resume on the portal and a short note on your business development experience.
In your application, please share:
* The types of clients or industries you have sold to
* The products, services, or solutions you have sold previously
* Any experience you have in digital marketing, media, creative services, SaaS, consulting, or professional services
* Examples of how you have developed new business or built your own sales pipeline

Title: CCP for Digital Advertising and Marketing Professionals
Description:
ABOUT THE ROLE
Tiger Muay Thai Singapore operates combat-sports and fitness outlets serving adults, women, kids and sparring programmes. The company is planning to build a separate brand, Tiger Fitness, and a franchising model in 2027. The Digital Advertising & Marketing Manager will own the digital funnel from awareness to trial sign-up to membership conversion, and will lead digital strategy, budget and results across all outlets.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Plan the annual and quarterly digital marketing strategy, channel mix and campaign calendar for all outlets and programmes
- Plan, launch and optimise paid social advertising on Meta and TikTok, including audiences, creative testing, retargeting and lead-generation campaigns
- Run Google search campaigns and drive local and on-page SEO, including Google Business Profile and review generation
- Plan content pillars and the monthly content calendar, including short-form video, copywriting, community management and influencer/ambassador collaborations
- Build and optimise landing pages and lead forms, and run A/B tests to improve conversion
- Design and run CRM and automation journeys (email, WhatsApp, SMS) for lead follow-up, trial conversion, retention and win-back
- Set up and maintain tracking and analytics (GA4, Tag Manager, UTM conventions, dashboards) and report performance to management monthly
- Manage the monthly advertising budget, reallocating spend based on cost per lead, cost per trial, customer acquisition cost and return on ad spend
- Be accountable, jointly with sales, for trial volume and lead-to-member conversion, and work with outlet teams to improve lead response time
- Brief and manage freelancers, creators, designers and agencies, and set vendor KPIs
- Plan and run marketing activations such as open houses, community events and corporate or ambassador collaborations
- Build marketing foundations for the planned separate brand and franchising model, including positioning, launch plans and replicable campaign playbooks
- Use generative AI and marketing tools to improve productivity, with a documented human review process
- Ensure all marketing complies with PDPA, platform ad policies and brand standards
- Document processes and SOPs for campaigns, tracking, reporting and content approvals
REQUIREMENTS
- Singapore Citizen or Permanent Resident
- Professional, managerial or executive experience in a related field such as sales, customer experience, business consulting, operations, project or vendor management
- Strong customer insight, communication and commercial skills
- Comfortable working with data, spreadsheets and digital tools
- Experience coordinating vendors, freelancers or cross-functional teams
- Prior hands-on experience in digital advertising and marketing is not required. Full training is provided under the on-the-job training plan.
TRAINING AND SUPPORT
- 6-month structured on-the-job training with a designated mentor
- Daily check-ins in the first three months, weekly 1:1 coaching, fortnightly work reviews and monthly competency reviews
- Competency rubric (levels 1 to 4) scored monthly against the training competencies
- Formal mid-point assessment (Month 3) and final assessment (Month 6)
- Training on live campaigns with real budgets, and support to complete industry certifications (e.g. Google Ads, GA4, Meta Blueprint)
EXPECTED OUTCOMES
- By Month 6, independently plans, runs, optimises and reports on multi-channel campaigns
- Owns the advertising budget and manages external resources
- Completes at least 2 industry certifications
- Delivers measurable improvement against Month 1 baselines, with targets agreed with management (e.g. lower cost per trial lead, higher lead-to-trial and trial-to-member conversion, faster lead response)
- Delivers dashboards, SOPs and a brand and franchise-readiness marketing playbook
- Confirmed as a permanent team member after successful completion of the programme

This is a hands-on, highly independent role for someone who can research, strategise, create and execute content across multiple platforms.
You will develop content for two key audiences:
Employers & families — to build trust, brand awareness, organic traffic and enquiries.
Caregivers — to attract qualified job applicants and position Anglo Caregivers as the agency of choice for caregivers seeking employment in Singapore.
What You'll Do
Employer & Brand Content
Create educational 3–7 minute videos/podcasts answering common questions about elderly care and live-in caregiving.
Develop blog articles, FAQs, infographics, carousels and social media content.

Title: Creative Strategist
Description:
About the company
At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.
Job description
We're looking for a Creative Strategist & Content Producer to shape how our health & pharmaceutical brands communicate across both digital & offline channels. You'll craft effective strategies that translate scientific credibility into compelling storytelling & creative assets - helping us engage our diverse audience as we expand our presence regionally. The Creative Strategist & Content Producer will be the visionary link between our brand identity, compelling content creation & drive measurable performance across all key channels. This role is responsible for developing & testing high-impact creative strategies as well as producing content assets (visual, video, copy) internally, specifically designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates, lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee & Lazada stores via social media as well as paid advertising platforms. You'll work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the new channels of the business. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics & brand strategy in the health supplement industry.
Key Responsibilities:
Creative Strategy
- Platform & Channel Strategy: Spearhead tailored creative strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific best practices & formats that align with brand goals & regulatory requirements in each market (e.g., Meta carousel ads, vertical video for TikTok/Reels, static product carousels for Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banner ads)
- Hypothesis Generation & A/B Testing: Develop robust creative testing matrices, formulate clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, calls-to-action, visual styles, copy length) that drive measurable improvements in Click-Through Rate (CTR) & Conversion Rate (CVR)
- Audience Segmentation: Translate target audience data & segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion)
- Competitive Analysis: Continuously keep up to date with competitors & industry trends, identifying new & successful creative formats, hooks & messaging to finetune our strategy
In-House Content Production & Execution
- Performance Creative Development: Lead the end-to-end creative concept development & production for all organic & paid media campaigns (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube, etc.) that align with brand & campaign goals, focusing on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing required for performance marketing
- Hands-on Asset Creation: Directly produce & edit native social content & performance ads using existing assets, stock libraries & internal resources. This includes:
1. Plan platform-specific content calendars: Cover educational, promotional & corporate communications
2. Static/Image Editing: Adapt product photography, create ad variations & design simple graphics & banner ads
3. Video Editing: Fast-paced assembly, cutting, adding text overlays, music & effects for short-form, vertical video (UGC-style, product demos, testimonials)
4. Generative AI Production: Utilize AI tools and prompt engineering to efficiently generate high-quality video and static image assets for rapid content production and testing
- Copywriting: Develop high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & social media captions that align with the creative strategy & brand voice, with a focus on clear value propositions & strong CTAs
- Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across relevant channels (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada store fronts & advertising platforms)
- Testing & Optimization: apply insights & analytics to refine & optimize content effectiveness across platforms
Performance & Reporting
- Data-Driven Insights: Work closely with the Marketing Manager to analyze creative performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving results (or failing) across Shopify, Shopee & Lazada traffic
- Iteration & Optimization:
1. Develop, adapt or review content & formats to improve engagement & performance
2. Use performance data (ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR) to rapidly iterate on existing creative assets & inform future strategy, ensuring a continuous cycle of improvement & optimization
- Storefront Integration: Integrate winning creative messages & visuals onto the respective e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a cohesive customer journey
Multi-Channel Storytelling
- Content cohesion: Ensure content is aligned where possible across digital & print media, including LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, e-commerce platforms, brochures & trade materials
- Tailor content: To achieve relevance & effectiveness across different stages of the audience journey — from brand awareness & education to conversion
- Storytelling & visual consistency: To strengthen brand trust & recognition
Compliance & Brand Integrity
- Uphold regulatory & ethical communication standards across all marketing activities
- Ensure all content complies with regulatory guidelines & marketing requirements in each country we operate in, including product claims, advertising language & digital promotions
- Maintain brand credibility by ensuring all communications are factual & aligned with company values
- Collaborate with internal teams to review materials for accuracy, effectiveness & compliance before publication

- Strong understanding of social media trends & platform best practices (Meta (FB/IG), LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Google, Generative AI).

- Excellent writing, editing & visual storytelling skills — adopt a strategic approach to design that integrates marketing & commercial goals.
- Excellent communication, project management & cross-functional collaboration skills.

Title: Digital Marketing Manager
Description:
Company Overview:
Four Star is the largest Singaporean direct-to-consumer mattress and furnishing brand, dedicated to offering innovative products at value-driven prices. As a rapidly growing organization, we are expanding and seeking dynamic individuals to join our team.
About the Role
We are looking for an exceptionally creative, commercially minded marketer who can uncover new customer segments and create compelling reasons for them to choose Four Star.
You will challenge conventional approaches to mattress and furnishing marketing, develop distinctive campaigns, and build new routes to customers through digital content, creators, partnerships, and e-commerce platforms.
Working closely with the CEO and Head of Digital Marketing, you will play a pivotal role in driving our marketing strategy in Singapore and other Asia markets. Your primary goal will be to enhance brand visibility, drive market share, and foster seamless brand experiences both online and offline.
Key Responsibilities
Strategy Development & New Customer Acquisition
- Lead the development and implementation of comprehensive marketing strategies tailored to Singapore and other Asia markets, ensuring alignment with company’s objectives.
- Define execution strategies for the brand and niche positioning, devising disruptive and innovative strategies to drive the brand into a digital retail powerhouse.
- Develop distinctive campaign concepts that make mattresses and furnishings relevant to customers’ lifestyles, life stages, and purchasing motivations.
- Create and test new messaging, offers, content formats, and customer experiences that attract audiences beyond the brand’s existing customer base.
- Explore opportunities in new customer segments and channels validating their commercial potential through research and testing.
- Establish and monitor KPIs to evaluate campaign effectiveness and ROI, leveraging data-driven insights to continuously improve marketing initiatives.
Digital Transformation & E-commerce Development:
- Drive the digital transformation of the brand in all markets via digital-driven marketing strategies and campaigns planning, including programmatic marketing, analytics, social media, operational marketing, and CRM.
- Identify, evaluate, and develop new customer-acquisition opportunities across marketplaces, social commerce, creator-led commerce, and emerging digital platforms
- Strong knowledge of Social Media platforms (such as Meta, Tik Tok, XHS, etc.).
- Knowledge in online advertising channels.
- Development of E-commerce sales channels.
- Apply SEO, GEO & SEM, content development, distribution, and measurement to effectively tailor content to reach audience personas.
Campaign Management:
- Oversee the planning, execution, and optimization of integrated marketing campaigns across digital and traditional channels, including website, newsletters, social media, and more.
- Develop seasonal/key calendars and campaign flighting, maintaining a communication flow across all global digital/traditional channels.
- Conduct thorough market analysis to identify consumer trends, competitive landscapes, and growth opportunities, translating insights into actionable strategies.
- Translate brand full funnel media plans to optimize channel efficiency, traffic, and conversion tactics based on brand, audience/customer, channel, and campaign strategies.
- Lead the development of compelling creative briefs and guide teams, agencies, and creators from concept through execution.
Brand and Market Presence:
- Lead the team to curate, innovate, and test new ideas to bring about new transformations that rise above unprecedented customer experience, executing offline brand engagement strategies such as pop-up stores, retail partnerships, and collaborations.
- Lead negotiations and relationship-building with key strategic partners.
Team Leadership:
- Manage and inspire a high-performing marketing team, providing guidance and mentorship to drive excellence and innovation.
- Lead daily integrated marketing cross-functional scrum and related stand-up activity to identify and prioritize planning and execution agenda.
Ideal Candidate Profile
- 7+ years of digital marketing experience within consumer electronics, furnishing, technology, or retail industries, with a strong track record in campaign management and team leadership.
- Proven success in marketing partnership, branding, or equivalent roles (e.g., strategic partnership, new traffic acquisition, brand building & awareness).
- Experience developing marketing strategies and monitoring frameworks for different go-to-market channels.
- Evidence of reaching new customer segments or building productive acquisition channels beyond an existing customer base.
- Demonstrated ability to turn creative ideas into measurable improvements in customer acquisition, conversion, or e-commerce sales.
- Strong understanding of platform-specific content, creator partnerships, social commerce, and online purchasing behaviour.
- Demonstrated leadership skills in leading marketing teams and ability to succeed in a fast-paced, startup environment.
- A strategic mindset with the ability to develop and execute innovative marketing strategies that align with business objectives and market dynamics.
- Deep understanding of regional consumer behaviors, market trends, and digital marketing best practices.
- Strong analytical skills with proficiency in interpreting data, measuring performance metrics, and making data-driven decisions.
- Exceptional analytical skills, both quantitative and qualitative, with strong experience in interpreting test results and drawing conclusions.
- Ability to pull data from various resources and translate it into trends, action plans, and reporting templates.
Education:
- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or related fields. MBA/ Advanced degrees or certifications are a plus.
Join Four Star to be part of an innovative, fast-paced environment where your ideas and contributions will directly impact our expansion, growth, and success. We offer competitive compensation packages, opportunities for career advancement, and a vibrant company culture that values creativity and teamwork.
If you are a strategic thinker with a passion for driving impactful marketing initiatives and hands-on experience in a dynamic industry, we invite you to apply and join us on our growing journey

Carchope SG Pte Ltd is a trusted automotive dealership specializing in quality pre-owned vehicles in Singapore. Since our inception, we have been committed to providing customers with a transparent, hassle-free, and enjoyable car ownership journey.

Job Description
Are you creative, tech-savvy, and passionate about social media and AI content creation?
Carchope SG Pte Ltd is looking for a dynamic Digital Marketing Specialist to grow our online presence, create engaging automotive content, and attract potential customers through innovative digital marketing strategies.
If you love cars, enjoy making viral videos, and know how to use AI tools to create eye-catching content, we want you on our team!

Analyse campaign performance and recommend improvements based on data and customer behaviour.

Create attractive car listings, promotional graphics, posters, banners, and marketing materials.
Maintain consistent branding across all digital platforms.
Highlight vehicle features, selling points, promotions, and dealership services through creative content.

Work closely with the sales team to support lead generation and convert online enquiries into potential sales.

This role works with all branding, communications, digital marketing, and event-driven initiatives that strengthen the property’s market positioning and drive revenue across Rooms, F&B, and Events.
The position requires a strategic leader with cross-functional coordination skills and a strong command of digital performance marketing, brand storytelling, and reputation management.
Interested candidates can email jobs.singapore@mamashelter.com.
Key Responsibilities:
Strategic Planning & Leadership
Implement the annual marketing and communications plan, aligning with business and brand objectives.
Assist with tracking the overall marketing budget, forecasting expenditures and ensuring cost efficiency and maximum ROI.

Public Relations, Events & Guest Engagement
Manage press relations, influencer collaborations, and media partnerships to generate strong editorial coverage.

Develop and maintain long-term relationships with journalists, KOLs, and media outlets to build continuous brand advocacy.
Oversee the hosting of media, influencers, and VIP guests, coordinating across departments to ensure seamless brand experience.

Develop and enforce a Crisis Communication SOP, outlining escalation protocols, response templates, and media handling procedures.
Oversee online reputation management across Google, TripAdvisor, and OTA platforms — ensuring timely, brand-aligned responses to guest reviews.

Title: Director, Lifecycle Marketing
Description:
Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.
We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.
From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.
At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll help shape how strategic enterprise customers engage with Singtel’s leadership, innovation ecosystem, thought leadership and technology capabilities.
Make An Impact By
- Managing Consumer Base: Responsible for managing the consumer base, focusing on churn reduction, recontracting, Average revenue per unit (ARPU) improvement, and upsell targets. You will formulate strategic and operational customer lifecycle management strategies- supporting new technology penetration through scientific and data-driven marketing techniques.
- Conceptualizing Lifecycle Marketing Strategies: Lead a team in conceptualizing customer lifecycle marketing strategies and translating them into executable plans. Your focus will be on driving retention, achieving upsell targets, and increasing service holding to achieve revenue and retention objectives. You will also drive recontracting through customer engagement and loyalty initiatives.
- Championing AI-Enabled Marketing Transformation: Lead strategic integration of AI into Singtel’s lifecycle marketing agenda. You will oversee the implementation of hyper-personalization frameworks including content generation capabilities. Your focus will be on embedding AI-enabled segmentation, modelling, and real-time decisioning engines into lifecycle strategies.
- Market Monitoring and Strategy: Stay abreast of market developments and monitor the competitive landscape to position the Consumer Business for new services. You will respond quickly and proactively to market intelligence and competitor feedback, steering marketing strategies to remain market relevant and customer-friendly. Customer insights will be a key focus, allowing you to tailor messaging and distribution channels accordingly.
- Innovative Marketing Campaigns: Spearhead the execution of new approaches in marketing campaigns, such as hyper personalization, contextual targeting, improved automation, and tracking. Collaboration with marketing, sales, and data science teams will be crucial to develop and launch automated flows based on propensity models and behavioral data.
- Customer Base Analysis and Reporting: Responsible for analyzing the customer base, owning customer information, data extraction, and regular tracking of marketing campaign effectiveness. Weekly reporting on key metrics and performance indicators will be part of your responsibilities.
- Team Development: Develop and build a high-performance team through active resource planning, workload balancing, skill and expertise development, talent acquisition, and retention.
- Campaign Strategy and Execution: Partner with various workstreams to manage campaign strategies and executions, including base management, calendar planning, targeting, segmentation, and reporting. You will implement processes to effectively prioritize and streamline user communications.
Skills For Success
- A bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, Accountancy, or related field. A Master of Business Administration (MBA) is desirable.
- Relevant experience working in large corporations or MNCs. Competency and experience in customer management, churn, and lifecycle marketing.
- Strong results orientation and stakeholder management experience.
- Proven marketing strategy and management skills.
- Experience in building customer journeys, including online and social media marketing, customer loyalty program management, web applications, and mobile and home business applications.
- Experience and knowledge in devices, Telco data, customer analytics, and customer experience management (e.g., retail shops, call center, loyalty programs).
- Possess Business acumen, presentation skills (both written and verbal), creativity, resourcefulness, analytical skills, leadership and people management capabilities, stakeholder management, solid budget management, and a challenger mindset.
Rewards That Go Beyond
- Full suite of health and wellness benefits.
- Ongoing training and development programs
- Internal mobility opportunities

Take the leap with Singtel to unlock new opportunities and accelerate your growth. Apply now and start your empowering career!

Title: E-commerce & Social Media Growth Executive (US Market)
Description:
JOB DEFINITION
The E-commerce & Social Media Growth Executive is responsible for building ChoiceRefill’s brand-owned content, social media presence and measurable off-Amazon traffic for the US market.
This is not a traditional customer-service role and does not depend on influencer partnerships. Even if no external creator works with us, employees will continue building ChoiceRefill’s own social media channels, content library and customer-acquisition assets.
ODORSEAL is hiring two employees for this position. Each employee will be assigned individual content projects, social media activities, Amazon Attribution links and measurable results. Both employees will be cross-trained to provide backup coverage when required, while individual project ownership and attributable results remain separately recorded.
ABOUT ODORSEAL AND CHOICEREFILL
ODORSEAL PTE. LTD. is a Singapore-based consumer-products and product-development company.
Our ChoiceRefill brand has been selling round diaper-pail refills to US customers through Amazon since 2017. ChoiceRefill is a practical, repeat-purchase household product that helps families find compatible, easy-to-use and cost-effective refill options.
ChoiceRefill is not a simple trading or standard private-label product. The company has independently developed its production lines, product structure and manufacturing processes.
We continue to improve film performance, production efficiency, product compatibility, packaging structure and the overall user experience. These product-development and manufacturing capabilities create a meaningful technical and operational barrier to entry that many ordinary e-commerce products do not have.
Employees will have the opportunity to understand how a consumer product moves from product development and manufacturing to Amazon sales, customer feedback, product improvement and repeat purchases.
ESTABLISHED AMAZON FOUNDATION
The company founder has many years of practical Amazon e-commerce experience and a clear understanding of product positioning, pricing, traffic, conversion, profitability and repeat purchases.
The founder is responsible for:
• Amazon Listing creation and optimisation
• Product images, selling points and page structure
• Amazon on-platform advertising
• Pricing and promotion strategy
• Product positioning and pack-size strategy
• Purchasing, inventory and core business decisions
• Product compliance and overall brand direction
Employees are not required to build Amazon Listings from the beginning or independently operate Amazon advertising.
Instead, employees will work from an established product, supply-chain, Listing and advertising foundation to build ChoiceRefill’s brand-owned content, social media channels and measurable off-Amazon traffic.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
BUILD BRAND-OWNED CONTENT ASSETS — APPROXIMATELY 35%
Create practical English-language content that answers real customer questions and supports Amazon purchase decisions.
Content may include:
• Compatibility demonstrations for tested round diaper-pail models
• How to identify compatible and incompatible pail structures
• Installation, film-pulling, cutting, tying and refill-replacement instructions
• Troubleshooting for common installation problems
• Guidance on choosing between 3-pack, 4-pack, 6-pack and 8-pack options
• Guidance for existing ChoiceRefill customers moving from older products to the latest version
• Explanations of product length, capacity, value and intended use
• Frequently asked questions based on real customer concerns
Employees do not always need to appear on camera. Clear product demonstrations, hand movements, close-up shots, captions and simple voiceovers are acceptable.
Strong master content should be repurposed into suitable formats for the company website and different social media platforms.
The objective is not to publish content simply to appear busy. The objective is to build an accurate, reusable content library that helps customers understand the product and make the correct purchase decision.
OPERATE BRAND SOCIAL MEDIA AND GENERATE ORGANIC TRAFFIC — APPROXIMATELY 25%
Support and operate ChoiceRefill’s brand-owned social media channels, which may include TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, Pinterest and Facebook.
Responsibilities include:
• Maintaining a practical content calendar
• Publishing approved content consistently
• Adapting content for each platform and audience
• Writing clear English captions, titles and calls to action
• Responding appropriately to relevant public questions and comments
• Participating helpfully in relevant online discussions while respecting community rules
• Directing interested customers to the correct Amazon product page
• Checking that every published Amazon link is accurate and traceable
• Reusing effective content across suitable channels
ChoiceRefill’s social media and off-Amazon growth activities must be able to operate normally without relying on external influencers.
RESEARCH CUSTOMER DEMAND AND IMPROVE CONVERSION — APPROXIMATELY 15%
Actively identify what US customers need to know before making a purchase.
Research sources may include:
• Amazon customer reviews and product questions
• Competitor reviews and recurring complaints
• Customer enquiries received through the ChoiceRefill website
• Social media comments and discussions
• Search suggestions and frequently asked questions
• Feedback from existing ChoiceRefill customers
• Performance data from previously published content
Turn useful findings into:
• New content topics
• FAQ improvements
• Troubleshooting guides
• Website updates
• Product-information recommendations
• Clear suggestions for Amazon Listing improvement for the founder’s consideration
Employees should report “problem + evidence + recommendation,” rather than forwarding screenshots without analysis.
TRACK RESULTS AND RUN GROWTH EXPERIMENTS — APPROXIMATELY 15%
Use Amazon Attribution and internal tracking sheets to measure employee-owned content and traffic sources.
Responsibilities include:
• Using an approved tracking link for each content item
• Recording the platform, content ID, product, publication date and responsible employee
• Monitoring clicks, product-page activity, purchases and attributable sales
• Comparing different topics, formats, openings, captions and calls to action
• Identifying content that attracts clicks but does not result in purchases
• Recommending which content should be repeated, improved or discontinued
• Preparing a short weekly performance summary
• Maintaining accurate content and campaign records
Each employee will receive a separately assigned Amazon Attribution link structure so that individual contributions can be measured.
SUPPORT DAILY E-COMMERCE OPERATIONS — APPROXIMATELY 15%
Support the founder by completing and following up on routine work surrounding the Amazon business.
Responsibilities may include:
• Checking whether key products are available for sale
• Monitoring obvious price, stock, variation, image or link abnormalities
• Tracking approved inventory, inbound-shipment and replenishment matters
• Maintaining product information, packaging files, images and version records
• Organising sales or advertising reports and highlighting meaningful exceptions
• Preparing supporting information for platform cases
• Following up on approved changes and confirming completion
• Escalating urgent issues with evidence and a recommended next step
Employees do not independently change Amazon advertising, Listings, prices, purchasing plans or budgets.
HANDLE LIMITED CUSTOMER ENQUIRIES — UP TO 10%
Customer service is a small, on-demand part of this position.
Most ChoiceRefill customers understand and purchase the product directly through Amazon. The role is not expected to spend most of the working day handling enquiries.
Responsibilities include:
• Checking the company website for customer enquiries
• Answering questions about compatibility, installation and product use
• Following up on unresolved matters
• Classifying recurring customer problems
• Updating approved response templates and FAQ drafts
• Turning repeated questions into useful content or improvement recommendations
When customer-service volume is low, the available time will be redirected to content creation, social media operation, research and growth experiments.
OPTIONAL CREATOR AND INFLUENCER COLLABORATION — 0% TO 10%
Creator partnerships are an additional growth opportunity, not the foundation of this role.
When a genuinely suitable US parenting, household or value-focused creator is identified, employees may:
• Evaluate the creator’s audience and content quality
• Make initial contact
• Explain the product clearly
• Coordinate approved product samples
• Prepare a content brief
• Follow up on agreed timelines
• Record published content and measurable outcomes
Employees are not required to contact creators simply to fill working hours. Creator activity should expand only when it produces useful content, qualified traffic, measurable sales or a valuable long-term relationship.
Time used for creator partnerships will be allocated from the social media and organic-growth portion of the role.
INDIVIDUAL ATTRIBUTION AND SALES INCENTIVES
The fixed basic salary is S$3,400 per month and covers the normal responsibilities of the position.
In addition to the basic salary:
• Employees may receive a monthly performance bonus based on execution quality, accuracy, follow-up discipline, teamwork and backup capability
• Each employee will be assigned a separate Amazon Attribution link structure for employee-owned content
• Eligible individual sales incentives will be calculated using valid, finalised Amazon data
• Refunds, cancellations, self-purchases, abnormal traffic and ineligible activity will not be counted
• Individual attributable-sales incentives do not have a fixed upper limit
• The calculation method will be provided in writing so that employees can understand and verify their results
External Amazon Associates or Amazon Influencers may use their own affiliate links. Such partnerships will be assessed separately and will not replace the employee’s responsibility to build ChoiceRefill’s brand-owned content and traffic.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
A successful employee will not wait for the founder to assign every daily task.
You should be able to:
• Identify useful customer questions independently
• Convert customer questions into content ideas
• Produce or help produce clear product content
• Publish content using the correct tracking link
• Review the resulting performance data
• Decide what should be improved next
• Maintain accurate and complete records
• Follow up until work is completed
• Provide reliable backup coverage when required
• Explain problems using evidence and practical recommendations
Success is not measured only by the number of posts published, messages sent or hours spent.
We value work that is accurate, reusable, commercially useful and capable of producing measurable improvement.
WHAT YOU CAN LEARN
Using real operating data and active commercial projects, the company founder will help employees understand:
• How to identify real customer demand
• How to distinguish views, clicks and purchases
• How to evaluate the commercial value of content
• How to use Amazon Attribution to measure off-Amazon activities
• How pricing, conversion rates, sales, costs and profit are connected
• How customer feedback can lead to content and product improvements
• How to turn one-time tasks into repeatable SOPs
• How product development, manufacturing and supply chains affect a consumer-products business
• How to participate in business decisions using a “problem + evidence + recommendation” approach
This role is suitable for candidates at an early stage of their careers who want to develop long-term commercial judgement, product thinking and independent problem-solving ability.
REQUIREMENTS
• Strong written English, with the ability to communicate clearly with US customers and write natural social media content
• Chinese reading and writing ability, as internal SOPs, training materials, product-development information and reporting templates are currently maintained in Chinese
• Proactive and organised, with the ability to continue work without constant reminders
• Comfortable maintaining accurate records in Excel or Google Sheets
• Able to learn from customer feedback and performance data
• Willing to perform practical content work, including simple filming, editing and publishing
• Comfortable working with a practical household consumable rather than relying only on fashionable or entertainment-focused content
• Able to work with a colleague, review each other’s work and provide backup coverage
• Careful with product facts, compatibility information and customer-facing claims
Fresh graduates and candidates with internship, freelance or personal-project experience are welcome. Prior Amazon experience is not required.
PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
Experience in any of the following areas will be helpful:
• E-commerce operations
• Social media management
• Content creation
• Short-form video production
• Digital marketing
• Customer service
• Community management
• Creator or influencer coordination

主要工作职责
一、建立品牌自有内容资产——约占35%
制作能够回答真实客户问题、帮助客户完成Amazon购买决策的实用英文内容。
内容可能包括：
已完成实测的圆形尿布桶型号兼容演示；
如何辨认兼容和不兼容的尿布桶结构；
安装、抽膜、切袋、打结和更换替换盒的操作说明；
常见安装问题的排查方法；
3盒、4盒、6盒和8盒包装的选择建议；
ChoiceRefill老客户从旧版产品转换到新版产品的说明；
产品长度、容量、价值和适用场景说明；
根据真实客户问题整理的常见问答。
员工不一定需要本人出镜。清楚的产品演示、手部操作、产品特写、字幕和简单配音都可以使用。
优质的母内容应当根据公司官网和不同社媒平台的需要，拆分和改编为相应格式。
我们的目标不是为了显得忙碌而发布内容，而是建立一个准确、可以重复使用，并能帮助客户理解产品和作出正确购买决定的内容资料库。
二、运营品牌社媒并获取自然流量——约占25%
协助运营ChoiceRefill自主拥有的社媒账号，包括但不限于TikTok、Instagram、YouTube Shorts、Pinterest和Facebook。
主要工作包括：
维护清楚实用的内容日历；
按计划持续发布经过批准的内容；
根据不同平台和受众调整内容；
编写清楚自然的英文标题、文案和行动指引；
适当回复相关的公开问题和评论；
在遵守社区规则的前提下，参与相关网络讨论并提供有帮助的答案；
将有购买兴趣的客户引导到正确的Amazon商品页面；
检查每个已发布的Amazon链接是否准确、有效和可追踪；
将已经验证有效的内容合理复用到其他渠道。
ChoiceRefill的社媒和站外增长工作必须能够在不依赖外部红人的情况下正常运行。
三、研究客户需求并改善转化——约占15%
主动寻找美国客户在购买前真正需要了解的信息。
可以参考的信息来源包括：
Amazon客户评价和商品问答；
竞品评价及反复出现的投诉；
ChoiceRefill独立站收到的客户咨询；
社媒评论和相关讨论；
搜索建议和常见问题；
ChoiceRefill现有客户的反馈；
已发布内容的表现数据。
员工需要把有价值的发现转化为：
新的内容选题；
FAQ改进；
故障排查指南；
官网内容更新；
产品信息改善建议；
提供给公司负责人参考的Amazon Listing优化建议。
提交问题时，应采用“问题＋证据＋建议”的方式，而不是只转发截图而不进行分析。
四、跟踪结果并开展增长测试——约占15%
使用Amazon Attribution和公司内部追踪表，衡量员工负责的内容和流量来源。
为每项内容使用经过批准的追踪链接；
记录平台、内容编号、对应产品、发布日期和负责人；
跟踪点击、商品页面活动、购买和可归因销售；
对比不同内容主题、形式、开头、文案和行动指引的表现；
找出有点击但没有产生购买的内容；
建议哪些内容应该继续、修改或停止；
每周提交一份简短的表现总结；
准确维护内容和推广活动记录。
公司将为每名员工分配独立的Amazon Attribution链接体系，以便准确衡量个人贡献。
五、支持日常电商运营——约占15%
通过完成和跟进Amazon业务周边的日常工作，减少公司负责人处理例行事务的时间。

检查公司独立站收到的客户咨询；

跟进尚未解决的问题；

把重复问题转化为有用的内容或改进建议。

Executive (Marketing & Editorial)
This role offers hands-on experience in content creation, digital marketing, and editorial strategies. The ideal candidate is passionate about storytelling, has excellent writing skills, and is eager to learn and contribute to our marketing initiatives. You will support CASE in its consumer education and engagement efforts to raise general consumer rights awareness in Singapore through various initiatives.
Responsibilities may include but not limited to the following:
Marketing and Social Media
- Conceptualise and develop digital marketing and publicity plans, including social media campaigns
- Develop collaterals and publicity materials for social media and marketing collaterals. These include print (letters, brochures, posters, banners, videos, resource packs, and merchandise) and digital (website landing pages, digital assets, eDMs, videos, and powerpoint presentations)
- Propose social media captions, ensuring clarity, consistency, and adherence to brand voice and style guidelines.
- Manage and maintain social media community, handle and respond to incoming queries received through social media accounts
Editorial
- Facilitate the production process of CASE’s in-house publications from research, conceptualisation of content to final delivery in accordance with overall strategic direction/focus
- Liaise with internal/external stakeholders to seek editorial contributions and ensure that contributions are appropriate for publication
- Draft media statements, responses to media queries, answers to media interview requests, speeches and story pitches, including the preparation of relevant statistics and data
Outreach, Events and Special Projects
- Provide support for CASE’s outreach activities/events
- Liaise with vendors on marketing and outreach campaigns and facilitate the process from conceptualisation to production
Other Roles
- Prepare reports for internal reporting
- Collaborate with relevant departments for support as needed, support and participate in CASE projects and initiatives
- Other projects and duties as assigned by Management

- Degree in Marketing, Communications or related fields.
- Excellent presentation and communication skills. Strong command of written and spoken English, and a second language

Title: Executive / Senior Executive, Communications
Description:
Primary Objective(s) of Position
About AWWA
AWWA is a leading social service agency in Singapore, dedicated to empowering people of all ages and abilities to live independently with dignity and purpose. Through our network of service centers, we serve children and youth with additional needs, families, seniors, and persons with disabilities, fostering inclusion and building strong, connected communities.
At the heart of AWWA’s Corporate Services ethos is our dedication to delivering exceptional service marked by care, quality, and professionalism, ensuring a positive and meaningful experience for all who engage with us.
About the Role
As part of AWWA’s Communications team, you will shape and share the organization’s narrative, telling powerful stories of inclusion, empowerment, and impact. You will develop and execute strategic communications plans to strengthen AWWA’s reputation, engage diverse stakeholders, and build public understanding of our mission to support our clients — children, families, seniors, and persons with disabilities.
As an Integrated Communications Executive / Senior Executive, you will support the planning, coordination and execution of integrated communications campaigns and stakeholder-facing platforms across AWWA.
This role covers internal and external communications, media relations, digital and social strategy, design-led content, and brand governance. The ideal candidate must be able to translate complex issues into clear, compelling narratives for diverse audiences (staff, partners (donors/volunteers, media and the public) and brings hands-on executional skills across media, social, design, digital analytics and events.
Responsibilities
Strategic Communications & Narrative Building
- Shape and articulate compelling organizational narratives that highlight AWWA’s mission, programmes, and impact.
- Develop and deliver integrated communications plans aligned to organizational priorities to enhance awareness and engagement across key audiences.
- Collaborate with internal teams to align content across channels and ensure message coherence.
- Work with agency and vendor partners to deliver effective communication campaigns and creative materials.
- Provide strategic counsel to leadership and service center teams on messaging, reputation and stakeholder engagement.
Media Relations & Reputation Management
- Support with proactive media engagement strategies to build AWWA’s visibility and credibility.
- Draft / support the drafting of press releases, media advisories, factsheets, FAQs and campaign toolkits.
- Develop story angles and drive pitching efforts (draft pitch ideas, refine angles with agencies, tailor outreach to target outlets).
- Prepare spokespeople and stakeholders for media outreach, including media lists, invitations, interview logistics and general media servicing.
- Provide on-site communications and media coordination support at events and major platforms.
- Monitor media trends, outlet landscapes and stakeholder sentiment; recommend suitable publications/channels and identify opportunities.
- Cultivate strong relationships with journalists and media outlets across print, broadcast, and digital platforms.
- Liaise with media partners, agencies and stakeholders on publicity-related matters, ensuring timely follow-through.
Digital, Social Media & Content Management
- Develop content for AWWA’s owned channels (social media, website) to build brand visibility and community engagement.
- Integrate storytelling, data insights, and multimedia formats to drive reach and resonance across platforms.
- Use analytics to track campaign performance and refine digital strategies for stronger engagement and conversion.
- Develop visual communications (graphic design, templates, infographics).
Branding
- Maintain brand consistency across channels and materials; review content for brand alignment before publishing.
- Develop engaging, on-brand content and visual concepts to strengthen storytelling (propose visual concepts and messaging approaches).
- Ensure consistent application of brand and corporate identity across all touchpoints.
Internal communications & staff engagement
- Support internal communications strategy and delivery to strengthen culture, alignment and staff engagement (intranet, newsletters, townhalls, campaigns).
- Support internal channels and content (newsletters, internal events) to ensure timely, consistent, and motivating communication
- Develop creative internal storytelling campaigns that highlight staff contributions, organisational values, and impact stories.
The above activities are no means exhaustive and are subjected to amendment whenever is needed.
Job Requirements
- Degree in Communications, Public Relations, Marketing, or a related discipline.
- 5–9 years of relevant experience in corporate, non-profit, or public-sector communications.
- Strong coordination and project management skills, with ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams and deadlines.
- Proven experience in media coordination, publicity support and stakeholder engagement. Strong writing, editing, and storytelling skills across multiple platforms.
- Ability to translate data and insights into actionable strategies.
- A team player with empathy, initiative, and the ability to manage multiple priorities under tight timelines.
- Good command of English and one other vernacular language will be an advantage,
- Good situational judgement and critical thinking skills
- Passion for social impacts and outcomes
