Title: Executive/Senior Executive, Climate and Sustainability Communications
Description:
WWF-Singapore is seeking a dynamic and creative Executive/ Senior Executive, Climate Communications to support communications and engagement activities for the WWF-Singapore's climate and carbon finance programmes.
The role will support the development and delivery of compelling communications that raise awareness, engage stakeholders and showcase WWF's work in advancing climate resilience, sustainable food systems and innovative climate finance solutions across Southeast Asia.
Working closely with programme teams and WWF-Singapore's communications team, the Senior Executive will help translate complex technical topics into accessible and impactful content for diverse audiences.
Key Responsibilities
1. Communications & Content Development
- Develop engaging communications materials, including articles, social media content, newsletters, presentations, infographics and other digital content.
- Translate technical information on climate resilience, sustainable agriculture and carbon finance into clear and compelling narratives for different audiences.
- Support the development of key messages, storytelling and communications materials that showcase WWF's climate programmes.
- Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to source stories, case studies and other content.
2. Communications Campaigns & Outreach
- Support the planning and execution of communications campaigns to raise the visibility of WWF-Singapore's climate initiatives.
- Coordinate content publication across WWF's digital platforms, social media and partner communications channels.
- Support media engagement activities, including drafting press releases, media briefs and other publicity materials.
- Track communications performance and prepare updates on outreach and engagement outcomes.
3. Partner & Coalition Communications
- Support communications and engagement activities for WWF Singapore’s Climate activities including related Coalitions
- Develop partner-facing communications materials, including newsletters, presentations, updates and briefing documents.
- Coordinate with coalition partners on joint communications, announcements and storytelling opportunities.
- Support communications for stakeholder events, workshops, roundtables and regional convenings.
4. Programme & Communications Coordination
- Work closely with WWF's Strategic Communications teams to ensure consistent messaging and alignment with WWF's brand and communications priorities.
- Support the development and implementation of communications plans for climate programmes.
- Coordinate with external vendors, designers and content creators where required.
- Maintain communications calendars, content libraries and relevant reporting materials.
Qualifications & Experience
- Bachelor's degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, Public Relations, Environmental Studies or a related field.
- 2–4 years of relevant experience in communications, content development, digital marketing, public relations or related fields.
- Strong writing, editing and storytelling skills, with the ability to communicate complex topics clearly and engagingly.
- Experience developing content for digital platforms, social media and stakeholder communications.
- Familiarity with climate change, sustainability, agriculture or environmental issues would be advantageous.
- Basic graphic design, video editing or multimedia content creation skills would be an advantage.
- Strong organisational and project coordination skills, with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple assignments.
- Proactive, creative and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively across teams and with external partners.
Why Join Us
Join WWF-Singapore to help tell the stories that inspire action for climate, nature and communities. You will contribute to high-impact regional initiatives, working with diverse partners to raise awareness and accelerate solutions for climate resilience, sustainable food systems and nature-positive development across Southeast Asia.

Title: F&B Brand Executive
Description:
We are looking for a creative, commercially minded, and execution-focused Food Brand Executive to support the development and growth of our food brand. The Food Brand Executive will be responsible for translating the brand strategy into effective marketing campaigns, product launches, promotional activities, content, customer engagement, and in-store execution. The role works closely with Operations, Product Development, Design, Sales, and external partners to ensure the brand remains relevant, consistent, and commercially successful. The ideal candidate combines food industry passion, marketing creativity, strong execution skills, and commercial awareness.
The Food Brand Executive is responsible for turning the food brand's strategy into compelling customer experiences and commercially effective marketing activities. The role sits at the intersection of Brand × Product ×Marketing × Customer × Operations, ensuring that every campaign, product launch, promotion, and customer touchpoint strengthens the brand while contributing to sustainable business growth.
Key Responsibilities
1. Brand Management
Support the development and execution of the brand strategy and annual brand plans.
Ensure consistent brand positioning, identity, tone of voice, and customer experience across all touchpoints.
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, consumer behaviour, and emerging food trends.
Identify opportunities to strengthen brand awareness, customer engagement, and market positioning.
Maintain brand guidelines and ensure all communications and materials are aligned with brand standards.
Support brand health tracking and recommend initiatives to strengthen brand equity.
2. Marketing Campaigns & Promotions
Plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns to drive traffic, sales, and customer engagement.
Develop promotional calendars covering seasonal campaigns, new product launches, festive periods, and key commercial occasions.
Coordinate campaign execution across kiosks, social media, digital platforms, delivery channels, and other customer touchpoints.
Work with Operations to ensure promotions are implemented accurately and consistently at store level.
Monitor campaign performance and recommend improvements based on results.
Coordinate with external agencies, designers, printers, influencers, and other marketing partners where required.
3. Product Launches & Menu Development
Support the development and launch of new food and beverage products.
Work closely with Operations and Product Development teams on product positioning, naming, packaging, pricing, and launch plans.
Develop go-to-market plans for new products and limited-time offerings.
Coordinate product photography, menu boards, promotional materials, and digital content.
Monitor new product performance and gather customer feedback.
Recommend product improvements or promotional strategies based on sales and customer insights.
4. Digital & Social Media
Manage and execute the brand's social media and digital content calendar.
Develop engaging content ideas around products, promotions, brand stories, and customer experiences.
Coordinate photography, videography, graphic design, and other content production.
Monitor social media engagement, customer comments, reviews, and online sentiment.
Support digital campaigns, paid media, and online promotions.
Track digital performance and recommend improvements to increase reach and engagement.
5. Customer & Market Insights
Gather customer feedback and identify changing customer preferences.
Conduct basic market and competitor research.
Monitor competitor pricing, promotions, new product launches, and marketing activities.
Analyse customer behaviour, sales trends, and campaign performance.
Translate insights into practical recommendations for products, promotions, and brand initiatives.
Support customer surveys, focus groups, sampling, and other market research activities where required.
6. In-Store Brand Execution
Ensure brand campaigns and promotional materials are effectively implemented across all kiosks.
Coordinate POSM, menu boards, posters, displays, packaging, and promotional materials.
Conduct store checks to ensure visual and promotional standards are maintained.
Work closely with Operations to ensure campaigns are executed consistently and on time.
Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey and brand experience within the kiosk environment.
7.Commercial & Sales Support
Work closely with Operations and Commercial teams to support sales growth.
Monitor product sales, campaign results, customer traffic, and promotional performance.
Analyse the commercial effectiveness of promotions and marketing activities.
Support pricing and promotional recommendations using market and sales data.
Balance brand-building activities with commercial objectives.
Identify opportunities to improve product visibility, customer conversion, and average transaction value.
8. Brand Partnerships & Activations
Identify and coordinate suitable brand partnerships and collaboration opportunities.
Support sampling events, pop-ups, community activities, and promotional activations.
Coordinate with external partners, landlords, suppliers, and event organisers where required.
Ensure brand activations are aligned with brand positioning and commercial objectives.
Evaluate the effectiveness and ROI of brand activities.
9. Marketing Budget & Administration
Assist in preparing and managing the annual marketing and brand activity budget.

Title: Full-Stack Marketing Manager / Marketing PMM
Description:
About GetBlock
GetBlock launched in 2019 as a two-person company. Seven years later, Coinbase, Trust Wallet, Garanti BBVA, Arkham, Chainalysis, and many more run on GetBlock infrastructure. That infrastructure now spans about 1,000 servers in clusters in New York, Frankfurt, and Singapore, covering 130+ blockchain networks. More than 200,000 customers have signed up, and 60,000 of them were active in the last six months.
On Solana, BNB Smart Chain, and Polygon, GetBlock is the fastest RPC provider in key financial hubs, and the independent benchmarks CompareNodes and OpenChainBench rank it among the top providers in the market.
About GetBlock marketing
A small, senior marketing team built one of the most visible brands in the RPC segment:
getblock.io has ranked #3 in the segment by organic traffic and LLM visibility for many months in a row in 2026
The GetBlock blog was the most visited and most active blog in the entire segment in 2025
150,000 website visits every month
100+ ecosystem partners and 20,000+ builders in the community
Team background includes Forbes, BeInCrypto, and Crypto Briefing
The team under-promises and over-delivers, every time.
About the role
This is a full-stack marketing role.
You will own campaigns across all GetBlock channels, from the first draft to the final report, and decide where the next channel should open. In a single week you might write a launch thread for X and present next quarter's channel strategy to leadership.
GetBlock markets to a few.
The product is technical, and its audience is technical and product decision-makers at Web3 companies, the people who choose which RPC provider their engineers build on. Reach outside that group counts for little, so every campaign you run is judged by whether it lands with them.
Most of the team works around UTC+3. We need solid overlap with those hours, and the exact time zone is flexible.
What you'll do
Plan campaigns across GetBlock's existing channels and measure what each one delivers: social media, community, partnerships, owned media, performance marketing, and SEO/GEO. Owned media takes the biggest share of your time, SEO/GEO the smallest.
Propose new marketing channels, run the first tests, and scale any channel that brings in the right audience.
Own marketing analytics. Find out which campaigns reach technical decision-makers and which burn budget, then shift spend to match.
Run paid traffic together with our performance marketer: suggest hypotheses, design the tests, read the results, and scale what works.
Shape positioning and messaging for product launches with the product team, then carry them into every channel.
Write and edit copy yourself: X threads, LinkedIn posts, blog articles, partner announcements.
Work with GetBlock's 100+ ecosystem partners on joint announcements and co-marketing campaigns.
What you'll bring
Fluent English at C1 or above, spoken and written. This one is a must: English is the only language GetBlock markets in and nearly the only one the team works in.
3+ years in product marketing, including B2B.
Strong writing. You produce a clean first draft without a copywriter and edit other people's copy without flattening their voice.
Marketing taste built on seeing a lot of good and bad work. You can spot a strong launch at a glance and explain what makes it land.
Hands-on experience with X, LinkedIn, Reddit, and Telegram, plus owned media on Medium and Dev.to.
Basic CMS skills. GetBlock's site runs on Prismic.
Confidence with partners: you can run a call with a partner's CMO and walk away with an agreed plan.
How you work with AI
GetBlock marketing already runs on custom skills and agents, and you will add to that setup.
You know when AI helps and when to stop and do the work yourself.
You have built AI workflows that automate 90-100% of a routine end to end, and you keep them running.
You build your own tooling: custom skills, loops, and agents. Lazy prompts and AI slop give you an allergic reaction.
Nice to have
Experience managing a small team.
Vibe-coding experience on products that paying customers use, with a working grasp of GitLab, deployment pipelines, and IDEs.
Mindset and deal-breakers
People who do well at GetBlock are curious and happy to wear many hats. Everyone on the team, this role included, works by two rules:
We are all operators. No task is junior enough to drop.
We are all strategists. No task is senior enough to avoid.
You will probably not enjoy this role if:
Your main strength is managing Jira cards.
Your marketing playbook is mostly KOLs, airdrops, and incentive programs. GetBlock does boring marketing that pays off over years.
You need a translator or heavy editing to work in English.
Why GetBlock
Honest remote. GetBlock is fully remote by design, with no US-only, EU-only, or UK-only restrictions and no hybrid schedule that puts you in an office three days a week.
A running start. GetBlock is an established brand with a busy marketing pipeline and growing metrics, so there is nothing to build from scratch. You join to accelerate what already works.
20 days of annual leave plus 12 personal days in place of a fixed public holiday calendar. Spend them on local celebrations, a loved one's birthday, or a break when you need one. Sick leave is paid on top.
Compensation for coworking space and AI tools.
A personalized development roadmap and performance bonuses tied to your impact.
Well-being programs to help you stay healthy and keep your balance.

Title: Lead Generation & Short-Form Content Copywriter
Description:
*Compensation:* $2,000–$4,000 USD/month
*Location:* Remote
*Employment Type:* Full-time
*Experience Level:* Experienced professionals only
About Kings Media
Kings Media helps founders build their personal brands through strategic content and organic growth.
We're looking for a Lead Generation & Short-Form Content Copywriter who understands how to turn audience insights into compelling content that captures attention, builds trust, starts conversations, and generates business opportunities.
This is not a beginner-level writing position. We want someone with *real, hands-on experience creating short-form content* and a strong understanding of how content supports marketing and lead generation.
You should understand the relationship between:
*Audience → Problem → Hook → Content → CTA → Lead*
You won't just be writing captions or generating ideas. You'll help create content with a clear purpose and contribute to a content strategy designed to drive measurable business results.
What You'll DoShort-Form Content Creation
* Develop content ideas for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and other relevant social platforms.
* Write compelling hooks, opening lines, talking points, and scripts for short-form videos.
* Turn long-form content, interviews, founder insights, and existing ideas into engaging short-form assets.
* Develop Instagram carousels, captions, stories, pinned-post copy, and other written social media content.
* Help structure Instagram profiles, Stories, Highlights, and pinned posts to communicate value and encourage inquiries.
* Create content angles that capture attention, maintain interest, and encourage viewers to take action.
Content Strategy & Copywriting
* Research target audiences, customer pain points, objections, desires, and buying motivations.
* Develop content pillars, messaging angles, and campaigns aligned with business objectives.
* Write educational, authority-building, storytelling, and direct-response content.
* Create compelling headlines, hooks, CTAs, and offer-focused messaging.
* Turn products and services into content that clearly communicates their value.
* Repurpose existing content into multiple formats without losing the original message.
Lead Generation & Optimization
* Create content designed to generate qualified leads, inquiries, and sales conversations.
* Connect each piece of content to a clear objective and call to action.
* Research competitors, successful content formats, and industry trends.
* Test different hooks, messaging angles, and CTAs.
* Review content performance and use available engagement and conversion data to improve future content.
* Collaborate with the marketing team to develop and improve organic lead-generation campaigns.
What We're Looking For
* At least 2 years of professional experience in content writing, copywriting, social media marketing, or a closely related field.
* *Demonstrable hands-on experience creating short-form video content*, particularly Instagram Reels, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts.
* Experience writing scripts, hooks, captions, or content concepts for short-form videos.
* A strong portfolio of published content or relevant work samples.
* Experience creating content for businesses, founders, personal brands, agencies, consultants, or service providers.
* Proven understanding of direct-response copywriting and lead-generation principles.
* Strong storytelling, audience research, and customer psychology skills.
* Ability to write compelling hooks and CTAs that encourage action.
* Excellent written English and the ability to communicate ideas clearly.
* Ability to explain the reasoning behind content decisions.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership, and deliver consistently.
*Important:* We are looking for candidates who have actually worked on short-form content projects—not applicants whose experience is limited to general blog writing, generic captions, or theoretical marketing knowledge.
Bonus Points
* Experience working with founders, creators, agencies, consultants, or B2B businesses.
* Experience developing organic lead-generation campaigns.
* Understanding of short-form video retention, pacing, storytelling, and audience engagement.
* Experience with Instagram Stories, Highlights, and profile conversion strategies.
* Experience with LinkedIn content, email marketing, or SEO content.
* Familiarity with Canva, AI-assisted workflows, and content analytics.
* Examples of content that generated qualified leads, inbound inquiries, or sales opportunities.
What We're NOT Looking For
* Someone who has never worked on short-form video content.
* Someone who only writes generic captions without understanding the strategy behind them.
* Someone who relies entirely on AI to produce content.
* Someone who focuses only on views, likes, or follower growth.
* Someone who cannot provide a portfolio or relevant work samples.
* Someone who cannot explain how their content supports a business objective.
We value creative thinking, but creativity alone is not enough. We want someone who understands how to turn attention into trust and trust into action.
Compensation
*$2,000–$4,000 USD per month*, depending on experience, demonstrated ability, portfolio quality, and the value you can bring to the team.

Title: Market Research Analyst / Senior Market Research Analyst
Description:
JOB SCOPE
Join our dynamic research team to uncover consumer insights and drive strategic decisions for our clients. Depending on experience, you will join as a Research Analyst or Senior Research Analyst, working primarily on quantitative research projects, with opportunities to contribute to qualitative studies and combine findings across both approaches.
The key areas include but are not limited to the following:
Research, Analysis and Insights
- Design and execute end-to-end online and offline quantitative research projects such as brand tracking, campaign/concept tests and customer-centric studies.
- Conduct secondary/desk research to support research hypotheses, questionnaire and discussion guide development, and interpretation of findings.
- Develop survey questionnaires, logic flows, sampling plans, and fieldwork specifications.
- Develop discussion guides for focus group discussions (FGDs) and in-depth interviews (IDIs), with guidance from senior researchers where needed.
- Occasionally moderate or support the moderation of FGDs and IDIs, depending on experience and project needs, including note-taking, probing and capturing key observations.
- Review interview transcripts, recordings and discussion notes to identify key themes and translate qualitative findings into clear, actionable insights.
- Monitor fieldwork progress, conduct data checks, and liaise with vendor partners to ensure sample quality, quota compliance and desired tables.
- Analyse quantitative datasets, including applying statistical techniques such as cross-tabulation, significance testing and correlations.
- Prepare research reports and client presentations, including charting, insight generation and data storytelling.
- Collaborate with senior researchers and clients to ensure methodological robustness, business relevance, and actionable recommendations.
- Where applicable, integrate quantitative findings and qualitative insights to develop a fuller understanding of consumer attitudes, motivations and behaviours.
Project Management
- Manage project timelines and collaborate with cross-functional teams (i.e. programmers, vendors, data science, etc) to ensure timely project completion
- Manage or assist in project setup and fieldwork management
- Support fieldwork audit and quality control efforts
- Check survey link to ensure there are no errors
- Provide regular project or fieldwork updates to clients and other relevant stakeholders.
___________________________________________
JOB EXPECTATIONS & REQUIREMENTS
- Education: Minimum bachelor’s degree in Market Research, Communications, Psychology, Sociology, Business, or a related field.
- Experience at Analyst level: Fresh graduates are welcome but must demonstrate interest in both quantitative and qualitative research. Prior exposure through an internship or similar experience will be an advantage.
- Experience at Senior Analyst level: Minimum 1–2 years of hands-on experience in agency-side market research, primarily in quantitative studies. Experience in qualitative research, including discussion guide development or moderation support, will be an advantage.
- Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and critical thinking abilities, with the ability to interpret numerical data and identify themes from qualitative feedback.
- Communication Skills: Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate clearly, listen actively, ask probing questions and build rapport with clients, colleagues and research participants.
- Project Management: Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and in a highly organised approach, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery. Also able to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
- Attention to detail: High level of accuracy and attention to detail in all aspects of research and reporting.
_____________________________________________

Welcome to the Insights Table. We are a market research agency that see ourselves being able to do better for the industry. On our table, we are proud of our drive, conviction, and authenticity to deliver best-in-class insights and value to our clients. We strive to create a work environment that excites and motivates our people on the table. An environment where individuals can be excited about starting their day, with a purpose, every day.
This is a table where insights are uncovered, curiosity leads to answers, important agenda are discussed, and informed decisions are made. Above all, everyone on the table enjoys coming together.

Title: MARKETING & OPERATIONS EXECUTIVE
Description:
Position Overview
The Marketing & Operations Executive will support the day-to-day marketing, social media, customer engagement, inventory management, booth operations, order fulfilment, and event activities of Yumi Basics.
The role requires someone who is hands-on, organised, proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable supporting both online and offline business operations.
Key Responsibilities
1. Social Media Management
Manage and maintain Yumi Basics' social media platforms.
Plan, create and publish engaging content including posts, Stories, Reels and TikTok videos.
Ensure content is consistent with the brand image and current promotions.
Monitor social media trends and identify opportunities to improve engagement.
Assist with content planning and scheduling.
Capture behind-the-scenes, product, lifestyle and event content when required.
2. Customer Engagement & DM Management
Manage and respond to customer enquiries through Instagram, TikTok and other relevant platforms.
Respond to DMs, comments and enquiries promptly and professionally.
Assist customers with product information, availability, orders and general enquiries.
Follow up with potential customers where required.
Escalate customer issues or complaints to Management when necessary.
3. TikTok Live Administration
Be available to support Yumi Basics' TikTok Live sessions as an Admin when required.
Monitor Live comments and assist with customer enquiries.
Help manage comments, product enquiries and customer engagement during Live sessions.
Support the Live Host with product information and operational matters.
Assist in ensuring each Live session runs smoothly and professionally.
4. Booth & Retail Operations
Assist with setting up and packing down Yumi Basics' booths, pop-ups and events.
Be present and actively assist during booth and event days as required.
Welcome customers and provide product information.
Assist with sales, product display, stock arrangement and customer service.
Ensure the booth is kept clean, organised and presentable throughout the event.
Assist with stock counting before, during and after events.
5. Inventory Management
Maintain accurate records of all Yumi Basics' inventory and stock levels.
Conduct regular stock counts and inventory checks.
Monitor incoming and outgoing stock and update inventory records accordingly.
Receive, check and organise new stock deliveries.
Ensure products are properly labelled, stored and arranged.
Monitor stock levels and highlight low-stock, fast-moving or slow-moving items to Management.
Identify and report missing, damaged, defective or mismatched stock immediately.
Assist with stock reconciliation and investigate inventory discrepancies.
Ensure stock is properly allocated for events, booths, online orders and promotional activities.
Assist Management with inventory planning and stock replenishment.
Maintain an organised stockroom and ensure products can be located easily.
Support stock-taking exercises and periodic inventory audits.
Ensure inventory information is kept accurate and up to date at all times.
6. Order Fulfilment & Packing
Pack customer orders accurately and efficiently.
Prepare parcels for courier collection or delivery.
Check products, quantities and order details before packing.
Ensure products are packed securely and appropriately.
Assist with stock organisation and inventory management.
Monitor and maintain adequate packing materials and supplies.
Report any stock or order discrepancies to Management.
7. Event Planning & Coordination
Assist Management in planning upcoming events, pop-ups, bazaars and promotional activities.
Research potential events, venues and collaboration opportunities.
Assist with event preparation, logistics and scheduling.
Coordinate event requirements such as booth setup, stock, marketing materials and manpower.
Maintain an event calendar and track important deadlines.
Assist during events from setup through to tear-down.
Ensure sufficient stock is prepared and transported for each event.
8. General Marketing & Operations Support
Support promotional campaigns, product launches and sales activities.
Assist with marketing and operational projects assigned by Management.
Identify areas where processes, customer experience and daily operations can be improved.
Work closely with Management and other team members to ensure smooth business operations.
Perform other reasonable duties as assigned based on the Company's business needs.
Requirements
Experience in social media management, content creation, retail, inventory, events or customer service is preferred.
Familiar with Instagram, TikTok and social media trends.
Good communication and customer service skills.
Strong attention to detail, particularly when handling stock and orders.
Organised, responsible and able to manage multiple tasks.
Proactive and willing to take initiative.
Comfortable working at booths, events and outside the usual office/showroom environment.
Able to support TikTok Live sessions and event periods when required.
Able to work independently while also functioning well within a team.
Interest in fashion, beauty, lifestyle or retail is an advantage.
Key Qualities
The ideal candidate should be:
Hands-on and proactive
Organised and detail-oriented
Creative and social-media savvy
Customer-focused
Responsible when handling company stock and products
Comfortable working under pressure
Flexible with event and Live schedules
Willing to support both marketing and operational tasks
Able to multitask and prioritise effectively

This is a hands-on role involving both online and offline responsibilities. The employee may be required to work at the showroom, stockroom, booths, events, pop-ups and other locations depending on business requirements.

Title: Marketing Communication
Description:
JOBDESCRIPTION
Position: Marketing Communications Executive
Department:
Marketing / BusinessDevelopment
Reports To:
Business Development Director / Principal
Employment Type:
Full-Time
1. JobPurpose
The Marketing Communications Executive isresponsible for supporting the planning and execution of the Institute’smarketing and communications activities to strengthen brand awareness, promoteits programmes and services, and support student recruitment objectives.
The role manages marketing content andcommunication channels, including the Institute’s website, social mediaplatforms, digital campaigns, marketing collateral, events and otherpromotional activities.
As the Institute operates as a PrivateEducation Institution (PEI) in Singapore, the Executive is also responsible forensuring that published marketing information is accurate, current andconsistent with approved institutional and course information, and complieswith applicable regulatory requirements and internal policies.
2. KeyResponsibilities
A. Marketing Communications & BrandManagement
Support the development and implementation of the Institute’s marketing and communications plans.
Develop marketing content that communicates the Institute’s programmes, strengths, facilities, student experience and progression opportunities.
Maintain consistent branding, messaging, tone and visual identity across marketing channels.
Prepare and update brochures, flyers, posters, presentations, advertisements, banners and other marketing collateral.
Coordinate with internal departments to ensure that information communicated externally is accurate and up to date.
Maintain organised records of approved marketing materials, artwork and communication assets.
B. Digital Marketing & Social Media
Manage and regularly update the Institute’s social media platforms and other digital communication channels.
Develop and maintain a content calendar for social media and digital campaigns.
Create and publish engaging content, including graphics, photographs, short-form videos, programme highlights, student activities and institutional updates.
Support paid digital advertising campaigns, including campaign setup, content preparation and performance monitoring.
Monitor engagement, enquiries, reach, traffic and other relevant digital marketing indicators.
Recommend improvements to digital campaigns based on performance data and audience response.
Monitor online comments, messages and enquiries and coordinate appropriate responses or escalation.
C. Website & Online Content
Maintain and update marketing-related content on the Institute’s website.
Ensure information relating to programmes, intakes, fees, entry requirements, facilities and institutional information is presented accurately based on approved information.
Coordinate with relevant departments or vendors for website updates and improvements.
Review website content periodically to identify outdated, inaccurate or inconsistent information.
Support search engine optimisation (SEO) and other initiatives to improve the Institute’s online visibility.
D. Marketing Content & Creative Production
Produce written and visual content for marketing campaigns and institutional communications.
Coordinate photography, videography and design work for school activities, events and promotional campaigns.
Develop content featuring student activities, achievements, campus life, academic programmes and institutional developments.
Liaise with external designers, printers, photographers, media agencies and other marketing vendors where required.
Ensure appropriate consent and approval are obtained before using student photographs, videos, testimonials or personal information for marketing purposes.
E. Student Recruitment & BusinessDevelopment Support
Support Business Development and Student Services teams with marketing materials and communication required for student recruitment.
Prepare programme presentations, recruitment materials and promotional content for prospective students, parents, education agents and partners.
Support education fairs, roadshows, open houses, school visits, recruitment events and other promotional activities.
Assist with the preparation of materials for overseas and local recruitment activities.
Support communication campaigns for upcoming intakes, new programmes and institutional initiatives.
Track marketing-generated enquiries and provide relevant reports to management.
F. Events & Institutional Communications
Support the planning, promotion and execution of institutional events such as orientation programmes, graduation ceremonies, open houses, student activities and partner events.
Prepare event publicity materials, invitations, signage, presentation materials and digital communications.
Coordinate photography and content collection during institutional activities and events.
Support internal and external communications relating to significant institutional developments and activities.
G. PEI Marketing Compliance & InformationAccuracy
Ensure marketing and promotional materials are based on approved and current information.
Verify programme names, course duration, fees, entry requirements, awarding bodies, progression pathways, and other key information with relevant departments, ensuring compliance with the CPE Advertising Code for Private Education Institutions prior to publication.
Ensure that marketing communications do not contain misleading, unsubstantiated or unauthorised claims.
Ensure references to regulatory status, certifications, awards, partnerships and institutional achievements are accurately represented and appropriately approved.
Support periodic reviews of published marketing materials, social media content and website information for accuracy and compliance.
Promptly correct, withdraw or escalate marketing information identified as inaccurate, outdated or potentially misleading.
Maintain proper records and versions of approved marketing materials where required for internal review or regulatory purposes.
Observe applicable requirements relating to personal data protection, copyright, intellectual property and the use of student images and testimonials.
H. Marketing Performance & Reporting
Maintain records of marketing activities, campaigns, enquiries and expenditure.
Track agreed marketing KPIs such as reach, engagement, leads, enquiries, conversion indicators and campaign performance.
Prepare regular marketing reports for management.
Analyse the effectiveness of different marketing channels and recommend improvements.
Assist with the preparation and monitoring of the marketing budget.
Coordinate quotations, purchase requests and invoices relating to marketing activities and vendors.
3. OtherResponsibilities
Work collaboratively with Academic, Student Services, Business Development, Quality Assurance and other departments.
Participate in institutional meetings, events and improvement initiatives where required.
Maintain confidentiality of student, staff and institutional information.
Follow the Institute’s policies, procedures and quality assurance requirements.
Perform other reasonable duties assigned by the Principal or Management that are relevant to the position.
4. KeyPerformance Indicators
Performance may be assessed based on:
Timely execution of approved marketing plans and campaigns.
Quality and consistency of marketing content and branding.
Effectiveness of marketing campaigns and recruitment activities.
Accuracy and timeliness of website and marketing information.
Timely completion of marketing materials and projects.
Effectiveness of event and recruitment support.
Achieve the pre-determined number of leads specific to campaigns.
Achieve the pre-determined impression to leads conversion rate.
Achieve the pre-determined number to traffics visiting our website.
Achieve the pre-determined duration which an average visitor will stay on our website.
Achieved the pre-determined number of followers on our social platforms.
5.Requirements
Education
Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Communications, Mass Communication, Digital Marketing, Business or a related discipline.
Experience
Relevant experience in marketing, communications, digital marketing or content creation.
Experience within the education, training or private education sector would be advantageous.
Experience managing social media platforms and digital campaigns is preferred.
Budget planning for all activities.
6. KeyWorking Relationships
Internal:
Principal, Business Development, Student Services, Academic Department, QualityAssurance, Finance and Administration.

- Work with photographers, videographers, designers, creators and event teams to produce high-quality content.
- Develop creative concepts specifically designed for paid advertising, not just organic social.
- Maintain a consistent brand voice and visual identity across channels.
Analytics & Optimisation
- Track and report on content and paid media performance.

Title: Marketing Executive

Job Summary
We are looking for a creative, motivated and results-driven Online Marketing Executive (E-Commerce & Live Streaming) to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing e-commerce platforms, developing digital marketing strategies, creating engaging promotional content and hosting live streaming sessions to promote our products and drive online sales.
The ideal candidate should be familiar with online marketplaces, social media marketing, digital advertising and live streaming. Experience in the food wholesale, distribution or FMCG industry will be an advantage.
Job Responsibilities
1. E-Commerce Management
Manage daily operations of e-commerce platforms such as Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop and other online sales channels.
Create, upload and maintain product listings, including product descriptions, images, pricing and promotions.
Monitor online orders and coordinate with warehouse and logistics teams to ensure timely order fulfilment.
Monitor product availability, inventory levels and online stock information.
Handle customer enquiries, reviews, complaints and feedback professionally.
Plan and execute promotional campaigns to increase online traffic and sales.
Analyse online sales performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
Ensure all online product information and pricing are accurate and up to date.
2. Live Streaming & Online Sales
Plan, organise and host live streaming sessions on TikTok, Facebook, Shopee Live and other relevant platforms.
Introduce, demonstrate and promote company products during live streaming sessions.
Explain product features, pricing, promotions and special offers to viewers.
Engage with live audiences by answering questions and encouraging customer interaction.
Develop creative live streaming concepts, scripts and promotional strategies to attract viewers.
Prepare products, promotional materials and equipment before each live streaming session.
Coordinate with the sales and warehouse teams to ensure sufficient stock availability during promotional campaigns.
Monitor live streaming performance, including viewer engagement, sales conversion and revenue.
Identify ways to improve live streaming content, audience engagement and sales results.
Assist in setting up lighting, cameras, microphones and other live streaming equipment.
3. Digital Marketing & Social Media
Plan and execute digital marketing strategies to increase brand awareness, customer engagement and online sales.
Manage company social media accounts, including Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and other relevant platforms.
Create engaging content such as promotional posts, product photographs, short videos and advertisements.
Develop and maintain a social media content calendar.
Plan online advertising campaigns through Meta Ads, Google Ads and marketplace advertising platforms.
Monitor advertising performance, marketing budgets and campaign effectiveness.
Research market trends, competitors and customer preferences.
Collaborate with internal departments to develop marketing campaigns and product promotions.
Ensure consistent branding and messaging across all digital channels.
4. Content Creation & Product Promotion
Create attractive product visuals, promotional banners, videos and marketing materials.
Produce short-form video content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook and other social media platforms.
Assist with product photography, basic video editing and content production.
Develop creative promotional ideas for festive campaigns, seasonal sales and special events.
Write engaging product descriptions, advertising captions and marketing content.
Ensure marketing materials accurately represent the company's products.

Prepare weekly and monthly reports on e-commerce sales and marketing performance.
Track online orders, sales revenue, customer engagement and conversion rates.
Monitor live streaming sales performance and campaign results.
Analyse customer behaviour and identify opportunities to improve online sales.
Recommend improvements to digital marketing and e-commerce strategies.
Maintain accurate records of marketing activities, promotional campaigns and online sales performance.

Coordinate with sales, warehouse, logistics and other departments to ensure smooth e-commerce operations.
Assist with online customer service and order-related enquiries.
Support company marketing events, promotions and product launches.
Perform other marketing, e-commerce and administrative duties assigned by management.

Title: Marketing Executive(Video Content Production for Social Commerce)
Description:
JOB OVERVIEW
We are seeking a visually driven storyteller to be the creative backbone of our social commerce strategy. While the Social Commerce Executive operates the stores and live streams, you will fuel the entire ecosystem with high-impact, scroll-stopping video content. You are responsible for shooting, directing, and editing all shoppable video assets—from product demos and unboxings to live stream trailers and viral short-form clips—across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and marketplace video feeds.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
A. VIDEO PRODUCTION & SHOOTING
In-House Studio Shoots: Plan, set up, and execute professional product photography and videography shoots using DSLR/mirrorless cameras, smartphone cinematography, gimbals, and professional lighting grids.
Lifestyle & Storytelling Content: Shoot on-location lifestyle videos that showcase products in real-world usage scenarios, aligning with brand identity and campaign themes.
Live Stream Teaser Trailers: Produce high-energy 15–30 second promotional trailers to build anticipation for upcoming live selling sessions.
Product Demonstration Videos: Create clear, compelling "evergreen" demo videos that highlight product features, benefits, usage tutorials, and unboxing experiences—embedded directly into product listings to boost conversion.
Behind-the-Scenes (BTS): Capture raw, authentic BTS footage during live streams and studio operations for use in brand storytelling and employee advocacy content.
On-the-Fly Capture: During live streams, identify and capture highlight reels, customer reaction shots, and memorable moments for immediate post-stream publishing.
B. VIDEO EDITING & POST-PRODUCTION
Editing Software Proficiency: Edit raw footage using CapCut (Desktop/Mobile), Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Adobe After Effects.
Platform Optimization: Adapt videos to platform-specific requirements—9:16 vertical for TikTok/Reels/Shorts, 16:9 for YouTube, and 1:1 or 4:5 for marketplace video feeds.
Trend Integration: Stay on top of trending audio, effects, transitions, and text overlay styles to maximize organic reach and virality.
Sound Design: Clean up audio, sync external mic/voiceover tracks, and add background music/SFX that complements the visual narrative.
Color Grading: Apply consistent color grading and brand filters to maintain a cohesive visual identity across all content.
Thumbnail & Overlay Creation: Design custom thumbnails, product callouts, and price/CTA overlays using Canva, Adobe Photoshop, or After Effects.
C. CONTENT STRATEGY & PIPELINE MANAGEMENT
Editorial Calendar: Work closely with the Social Commerce Executive to align video output with the live stream schedule, product launches, and seasonal campaigns.
Content Batching: Plan and execute efficient batch-shooting sessions to ensure a consistent pipeline of at least X videos per week (e.g., 15–20 short-form videos).
Asset Management: Maintain a centralized, cloud-based media library of all raw footage, edited videos, product shots, and branded assets for easy access by the wider team.
A/B Testing Creatives: Produce multiple variations of the same product video (different hooks, CTAs, audio tracks) to test which performs best in ads and organic feeds.
D. CREATIVE COLLABORATION
Affiliate Toolkit Creation: Produce and distribute videography toolkits (b-roll footage, product shots, script templates, and audio packs) for affiliates and KOLs to ensure brand consistency.
Brief Interpretation: Translate briefs from the marketing/e-commerce team into compelling visual narratives without requiring excessive handholding.
Trend Spotting: Proactively pitch new video concepts, formats, and viral challenges that the brand can capitalize on to drive traffic and sales.
QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS:
Experience:
1–3 years in Content Creation, Videography, Film Production, or Social Media Management.
A strong portfolio demonstrating short-form video work for brands (TikTok, Reels, YouTube Shorts).
Experience in product/commercial videography is a strong advantage.
Technical Skills:
Camera Operation: Proficiency with DSLR/mirrorless cameras (Sony, Canon, Fuji), smartphone cinematography (iPhone/Android), gimbals (DJI, Zhiyun), and lighting setups (softboxes, LED panels, ring lights).
Editing Software: Expert-level proficiency in at least two of the following: CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Adobe After Effects.
Audio: Sound recording and mixing knowledge (lapel mics, shotgun mics, audio sync, noise reduction).
Graphic Design: Working knowledge of Canva or Adobe Photoshop for thumbnails and overlay creation.
Platform Knowledge: Deep understanding of aspect ratios, resolution requirements, file formats, and trending audio/effect libraries for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and marketplaces.
Soft Skills:
Creative Eye: Strong visual storytelling ability—understanding composition, color theory, pacing, and hook creation.
Speed & Agility: Ability to shoot, edit, and publish content within tight turnaround times (same-day edits for trending topics).
Self-Starter: Proactive in pitching ideas; does not wait for briefs to start creating.
Attention to Detail: Meticulous about quality control—no pixelation, bad audio, or typos in text overlays.
WORKING CONDITIONS
Studio & On-Location: Regular work in the studio for product shoots; occasional on-location shoots for lifestyle/brand storytelling.
Flexible Hours: May need to work outside standard hours to capture time-sensitive trends or product launches.
Equipment Responsibility: Responsible for care, maintenance, and inventory of all videography and editing equipment.

Title: Marketing Executive, APAC
Description:
Description
Are you a motivated, creative individual with a passion for marketing?
We have an exciting regional opportunity for you!
We are looking for a passionate marketing professional to drive and coordinate marketing initiatives across the Asia Pacific region.
In this role, you will take ownership of regional marketing projects, serving as the key link between Global Marketing in US and local country stakeholders. You will play an important role in ensuring marketing initiatives are delivered effectively, on time, and in alignment with global strategies, while adapting to the unique needs of local markets.
If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and enjoy bringing creative ideas to life across different markets, we'd love to hear from you!
Working location : International Business Park
What You'll Do...
1. Coordination & Communication:
Serve as the rope holder and key liaison coordinating activities between Global Marketing and country stakeholders.
Translate global marketing strategies into locally relevant campaigns, ensuring consistent execution and alignment across regional and country teams.
Work closely with country stakeholders to brainstorm and collect content ideas tailored to local market needs.
Structure and maintain regional content calendar
Proofread and review marketing materials including email service flyers – validate prior to distribution.
Identify potential roadblocks and proactively follow up with stakeholders to keep projects moving forward.
2. Content Strategy & Development:
Support the localization of global marketing campaigns and content for Asian markets; translate into local language
Consolidate feedback from stakeholders within offices to design local campaigns specific to office and country.
Create long-form articles for local channels, including translation.
Email banner creation for each country’s signature
3. Audio-Visual Content Management:
Act as the regional superuser for video and content production projects.
Guide local teams on best practices for filming interviews, events, and promotional videos and photos.
Support adherence to corporate brand and content standards.
Provide basic training and troubleshooting support for teams creating local video and photo content.
Work with external vendors if necessary to ensure high-quality production.
Record product expert videos (in-person or on Teams)
Translation of subtitles to local language from global materials
Research and help create carousel-friendly regional focus content for Linkedin

Coordinate and facilitate webinars featuring Shipco’s in-house experts.
Assist in planning topics, scheduling, and technical setup for webinars.
Support presenters with slide preparation, webinar tools, and audience engagement.

Monitor campaign performance and participation across regional initiatives.
Track project outcomes and key metrics.
Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and stronger stakeholder engagement.

We’ve received multiple platform awards from major retailers such as Shopee, Watsons, Guardian, and 7-Eleven. Founded by former Grab executives who helped build Grab Financial Group, Stryv is committed to making personal care accessible and aspirational.
Our Vision
We aim to become the Uniqlo of Personal Care—offering well-designed, high-quality personal care electronics like hairdryers, shavers, and electric toothbrushes. Our products are built in tier-1 global factories that manufacture for some of the world’s biggest brands. By selling directly to consumers at accessible prices, we ensure that personal care is inclusive across all income levels.
Backed by Leading Investors
We’re proud to be backed by billion-dollar venture capital funds including East Ventures and GSR. Our supporters also include founders and leaders from some of the region’s most iconic brands: Razer, Carousell, ShopBack, Carro, PRISM+, Grab, Atome, and many more.
The Role
You'll own Stryv's direct marketing engine—building, executing, and optimizing email, SMS, and WhatsApp campaigns that inform, educate, and drive revenue. You'll work across multiple audiences and markets, balancing promotional campaigns with educational content that builds brand trust.
Key Responsibilities:
- Campaign Planning & Execution: Develop and maintain a comprehensive email and direct marketing campaign calendar across all markets. Plan campaigns that drive seasonal promotions, product launches, and customer education initiatives. Coordinate closely with product managers to align on launch timelines and messaging, and work with local marketing teams across Singapore, Malaysia, and Hong Kong to ensure campaigns reflect regional priorities and insights. Effective cross-team communication is essential to align timelines, share customer data, and ensure consistent execution across channels.
- Email & Copy Strategy: Write compelling, culturally relevant copy for email campaigns, SMS, and WhatsApp that converts. Balance promotional messaging with helpful beauty, wellness, and health educational content that connects back to Stryv offerings.
- Product Launches: Lead direct marketing strategy for new product announcements, including segmentation, messaging, and optimization to drive awareness and early adoption.

- Innovation & Testing: Identify and test new engagement channels, messaging formats, and audience segments. Stay current on trends in direct marketing and identify opportunities for Stryv to stand out.
- Cross-Market Execution: Adapt campaigns for Singapore, Malaysia, and Hong Kong audiences, ensuring cultural relevance and local compliance while maintaining brand consistency.
Required Qualifications:
- 3–4+ years of direct marketing experience, with a strong focus on email marketing. Experience with SMS and WhatsApp marketing is a plus.
- Platform expertise: Hands-on experience with Klaviyo, Mailchimp, or similar email/CRM platforms. Ability to build segments, manage flows, and interpret performance data.
- Copywriting & Messaging: Ability to write clear, compelling, and engaging copy across multiple channels. Demonstrated experience writing for regional markets (Southeast Asia preferred) with cultural sensitivity and awareness.
- Language: Fluent English (written and verbal)
- AI & Workflow Optimization: Experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) to improve content creation, campaign planning, and operational efficiency.
- Analytical Mindset: Comfortable reading analytics, A/B testing results, and adjusting strategy based on data.

At GWS Living Art and Vidacity, we believe great marketing goes beyond visibility — it is about creating meaningful experiences that connect people, businesses and communities with sustainability.

You will work across both GWS Living Art and Vidacity, supporting campaigns, events, services and initiatives that reach both B2B and community audiences.

Campaign Management

Collaborate with the marketing team to develop compelling ad creatives, landing pages and supporting offline marketing assets.
Manage and allocate marketing budgets effectively to achieve campaign objectives and optimise return on investment (ROI).
Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to ensure campaigns are delivered effectively and on schedule.
Data Analysis & Reporting
Monitor and analyse key performance metrics across digital and offline channels, including website traffic, social media, advertising campaigns, CTR, CPC, CPA, conversion rates and ROI.
Track campaign performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
Prepare regular performance reports and provide actionable insights to stakeholders.
Use data and customer insights to support marketing and campaign decisions.

Support B2B lead generation initiatives for GWS Living Art and Vidacity, targeting businesses, organisations, partners and other relevant stakeholders.
Track and optimise lead generation funnels to improve conversion rates and customer acquisition.
Work with relevant teams to ensure marketing leads are effectively followed up and nurtured.
Engagement & Conversion
Create and manage campaigns and content that drive engagement across digital platforms.
Monitor engagement and conversion metrics and identify opportunities to improve campaign effectiveness.
Develop strategies to increase traffic, engagement, conversions and customer acquisition.
Strategy Development & Market Research
Develop and implement data-driven strategies to increase brand awareness, traffic, conversions and customer acquisition.
Identify and target key audience segments to maximise campaign effectiveness.
Conduct market research to stay updated on industry trends, competitor activities and customer preferences.
Use market and performance insights to inform and refine marketing strategies.
SEO & SEM
Work with SEO consultants and relevant partners to optimise websites and content for search engines and improve organic search visibility.
Manage and optimise web content and paid search campaigns to increase visibility and drive relevant traffic.
Monitor SEO and SEM performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

Stay updated on digital marketing trends, tools and technologies and explore new approaches to improve campaign performance.
All such further and other duties and responsibilities which the Company may from time to time delegate and designate to the Employee.

*Big Ideas. Good People. Meaningful Growth.*

At BlueTree Education, we believe that great work happens when passionate people come together in a supportive, fun-loving environment.

* Lead parent communications, public relations, media relations, partnerships and crisis communications. Shape how BlueTree is seen by parents, schools and the wider education community.

* Plan and deliver communications to staff across our seven branches, so that teachers and branch teams understand, support and represent our campaigns, brand standards and key messages.
*4. Make Campaigns Happen*
* Plan and execute creative, effective marketing campaigns that attract parents, generate enquiries and drive student enrolments.
*5. Grow Our Digital Presence*
* Manage and optimise Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO and organic content to improve visibility, lead quality and conversions. And manage BlueTree Education's social media channels, including Instagram, TikTok and Facebook.
*6. Build Stronger Parent Connections*
* Develop referral campaigns, engagement initiatives and re-enrolment activities that strengthen relationships with our BlueTree families.
*7. Bring Ideas to Life*
* Work closely with our teachers, centre teams and creative partners to develop engaging content, promotions and brand experiences.
*8. Lead and Grow Together*
* Guide our Marketing Executive, collaborate with external agencies and freelancers, and build a positive, productive marketing team.
*9. Know Your Numbers*
* Track campaign performance, marketing budgets, leads, trials and enrolments. Use insights to make smarter decisions and drive continuous improvement.
*10. Team Leadership*
* Lead and develop the marketing executive, and manage agencies and vendors.
*Who We're Looking For*
We would love to meet someone who:
* Has a proven track record in marketing, particularly in generating leads, sales or enrolments.
* At least 5 years of marketing experience, with a track record of leading campaigns end to end and managing a brand
* Proven experience in branding and in internal and external communications
* Is confident with Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, GA4 and content marketing.
* Understands Singapore parents and ideally has experience in education, enrichment or consumer marketing.
* Is both creative and analytical — someone who loves a great campaign idea but also cares about the results.
* Enjoys taking ownership, solving problems and getting things done.
* Has experience guiding junior team members and managing external partners.
* Brings positive energy, a collaborative spirit and a good sense of humour.
* Is curious about AI and new ways to make marketing more effective.
* Experience leading junior staff and managing agencies or vendors
Experience in multi-brand, multi-branch or referral marketing would be a bonus.
*Why You'll Love Working with Us*
*A Warm, Close-Knit Team*
_We believe work should be enjoyable. Expect friendly colleagues, genuine support, laughter and a workplace where people know one another beyond their job titles._
*Big Ambitions, Real Opportunities*
_We are an established education company with exciting growth plans. You will have the space to contribute ideas, take ownership and grow professionally alongside the business._
*Your Ideas Matter*
_We value initiative over hierarchy. Good ideas can come from anyone, and we encourage people to speak up, experiment and make things better._
*Work That Makes a Difference*
_Behind every campaign is a child learning, a parent finding support and a teacher making an impact. Your work contributes to something meaningful._
*A Culture of Learning and Celebration*
_We believe in developing our people, recognising effort and celebrating milestones — big and small._
*Ready to Grow with Us?*
If you are a marketer who loves a good challenge, enjoys working with good people and wants to be part of a growing education brand, *we would love to hear from you!*

As the studio continues to grow, we are looking for an enthusiastic and organised individual to join the team and support daily operations, student experiences, and programme coordination.
Role Overview
We are looking for a creative, outgoing, and organised
Marketing Operations Executive
to support the studio's marketing activities, social media presence, customer engagement, and daily operations.
You will be involved in creating engaging content, promoting dance programmes, supporting marketing campaigns, and connecting with prospective students and families. You will also help maintain a welcoming studio environment and ensure visitors have a positive experience.

Support promotional activities such as open houses, trial classes, seasonal campaigns, and community outreach.
Assist with coordinating collaborations, partnerships, and other marketing opportunities.
Monitor basic campaign performance, social media engagement, and enquiries to identify areas for improvement.
Customer Engagement & Enrolment Support
Attend to enquiries from prospective students and parents through WhatsApp, phone calls, emails, social media, and in-person interactions.
Introduce the studio's programmes and provide information on classes, schedules, and trial sessions.
Follow up with prospective students and families to encourage trial bookings and enrolments.
Assist with trial class arrangements, registrations, and enrolment administration.
Build positive relationships with students and parents to support customer satisfaction and retention.
Gather customer feedback and share insights with management to improve the studio experience.

Manage the studio's front-of-house area and welcome students, parents, and visitors.
Ensure the studio remains clean, organised, presentable, and ready for daily classes.

Monitor studio supplies and report maintenance or facility-related issues when necessary.

Assist in promoting and coordinating studio events, performances, competitions, workshops, and open houses.
Support event preparations, including promotional materials, registrations, schedules, and logistics.
Capture event highlights and create post-event content for social media.
Engage with students, parents, and the wider dance community to strengthen the studio's brand presence.

Description:

You will work with Private Capital Markets (PCM), Product, Data, Design, Legal and Compliance to deliver campaigns that are compelling and fully compliant with financial services regulations.

Work with PCM, Legal and Compliance to ensure accuracy and consistency
Build and maintain ADDX's investor knowledge base
4. LinkedIn and spokesperson content
Support LinkedIn content for four designated ADDX spokespeople and ADDX's company channels
Ideate posts that build thought leadership, grow followers and expand reach
Align spokesperson content with brand messaging and regulatory guidelines
5. User growth ideas (B2B and B2C)
Generate concepts for investor acquisition: social campaigns, referral programmes and partnership activations
Work cross-functionally to test acquisition ideas from ideation to pilot
6. Events
Coordinate investor events, webinars and client engagement activities, with PCM co-leads where activation-related
Manage logistics, timelines, stakeholders and vendors
Develop event materials, invitations, registration communications and post-event follow-ups
7. PR support
Help prepare press releases and media briefs
Support agency coordination and briefing for campaigns, launches and announcements
Keep PR messaging consistent with investor-facing communications

Title: Pasta & Condiments Southeast Asia Associate Manager
Description:
Sep 25, 2026
Pasta & Condiments Southeast Asia Associate Manager
About Barilla
At Barilla, we believe that every great journey begins with passion and a bold vision. From our humble beginnings in 1877 in a small shop in Parma, Italy, we’ve blossomed into a global leader in the food industry, guided by our commitment to progress and excellence.
Today, Barilla is an international group present in more than 100 countries and we are proud to be recognized as the world’s top food company by reputation. With 22 beloved brands in our portfolio, we are world leader for pasta, the number one choice for ready-made sauces in Europe, leader for bakery products in Italy, and for crispbread across Scandinavia with Wasa.
Our success story is written by a passionate team of almost 9,000 dedicated employees across 30 plants and offices worldwide, all united by a shared mission to nourish the future with purpose and passion.
Are you ready to add your unique flavor to our journey?
Introduction - Organizational Details
Barilla Singapore seeks to recruit the next marketing leader responsible for Southeast Asia Cluster. The individual will directly report to the Pasta & Condiments Director APAC. The position is based in Singapore.
Job Purpose
Lead and implement the 3Y and annual plans (incl. innovation) for both Pasta and Condiments, and ensure congruent executions in the market via collaboration with internal functions (sales, etc.) and distributors and agencies.
Manage operational implementation and tracking of annual plan for the pasta and condiment categories, in order to achieve brand penetration & share growth and profitability within the defined framework set by the guidelines provided.
Be the reference point for the cluster pertaining to external context (e.g. key market trends, consumers’ preference, competitive landscape, etc.) and internal context (Categories’ direction, with Group’s guidelines, policies and procedures, etc.).
This role also requires close collaboration with Barilla’s cross functional colleagues and external partnership management in the development of winning innovations.
Key Accountabilities
- Continuously advocate the Barilla values in the market and with the Business Partner. Champion the bridge of Barilla’s values with core values of the Business Partner and local consumers.
- Lead and collaborate with the distributors in the definition of the marketing strategy and plans which include budget management, pricing, promotion, portfolio and communication strategy. Support the Business Partner in the integration and adaptation of categories marketing plan into a meaningful local plan. Maintain continuous partnership with the Business Partner to optimise plans where necessary.
- Lead new innovation development in collaboration with the region, RDQ and external partners; and roll outs of current innovations. Guarantee full operational support to specific launches & campaign development, in order to maximize the market performance in terms of effectiveness, timeliness, efficiency, and quality, by working closely with internal and external partners to implement the plan (e.g. sales, logistics, service providers, agencies, suppliers, etc.).
- Collaborate with the Business Partner and agency in the definition of the in-store and digital strategy. Digital strategy includes the editorial plan and content creation with agency and chef(s).
- Support Business Partner in the integration of regional digital plan into local plans and optimise plans where necessary.
- Work with Business Partner and Market Research to execute customized market researches in order to assess and understand the key market trends and quality Innovations affecting assigned sub-brands in the short/long-term, and prepare analysis and report to collect the results of the market studies and share them with Superiors, in order to support brand and category strategic planning processes, in compliance with Group’s guidelines, policies and procedures.

We are looking for Product Marketing Manager based in Singapore to join our global Product and Solutions Marketing team, reporting to the Senior Manager, Product Marketing based in Europe. In this role, you will adapt global messaging campaigns, and content for priority APJ markets to support the Go-To-Market execution. You will partner closely with the APJ Sales, Field Marketing and Channel Marketing organizations to localize positioning, develop market-relevant assets and improve adoption of Infoblox’s solutions portfolio across the region. This role is based in Singapore, a key Infoblox hub in APJ, and will require in-office collaboration in line with Infoblox’s hybrid working policy.
You are an excellent verbal and written communicator who combines strong storytelling and practical execution. You understand how regional market needs differ across APJ and can adapt broader product and solutions messaging into content and programs that are relevant for local buyers, partners, and influencers.
Be a Contributor - What You’ll Do
- Adapt and localize global product and solutions marketing messaging, campaigns, assets, and sales play for priority APJ markets
- Develop and maintain regional content pitch decks, sales enablement materials, webinar content, blogs, social posts, and short-form video
- Partner with APJ Sales, Field Marketing, and Channel Marketing to locally support launches, campaigns, sales plays, customer conversations, and events
- Gather input from customers, partner, the field and local market trends to help refine regional positioning and messaging
- Support webinars, field events, and partner programs with relevant messaging and content for target audiences
- Track engagement and feedback on content and campaigns and recommend improvements based on performance and field input
- Work with global Product and Solutions Marketing to ensure regional adaptations stay aligned to core messaging and company priorities
- Contribute regional insights, localization need and buyer feedback into broader team planning
- Support local adoption of go-to-market tools, sales plays, etc. with the APJ team, helping them to activate changes swiftly
- Use AI tools to accelerate content drafting, research synthesis, problem solving, experimentation, and performance analysis while maintaining quality and brand voice
Be Prepared - What You Bring
- Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, communications, or equivalent
- 5+ years of experience in product/solutions marketing, content marketing, or B2B technology marketing
- 5 years of experience adapting messaging and assets for regional or country-level audiences within Asia
- Strong storytelling and content development skills across multiple formats and channels, including creating whitepapers, datasheets, solution notes
- Ability to simplify technical concepts and communicate product value clearly to different audiences
- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with sales, marketing, and product stakeholders
- Working knowledge of APJ market dynamics and an understanding of how buyer needs vary across countries in the region
- Excellent written and verbal English skills and fluent in at least one other language
- Proficiency in at least one additional APJ language (e.g., Mandarin, Korean, Japanese, Thai) strongly preferred, along with experience localizing messaging for local markets
- Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple deliverables with consistent quality and attention to detail
- Hands-on proficiency with AI tools and workflows (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) to boost productivity in research, content creation, problem solving, experimentation, and analytics, with curiosity to keep learning as AI evolves
Be Successful - Your Path
Six Months:
- Understand the Infoblox portfolio and how to position key solutions for APJ audiences
- Build strong working relationships with APJ Sales, Field Marketing, Channel Marketing, and global Product and Solutions Marketing
- Deliver localized messaging and content for priority APJ campaigns, launches, and field needs
- Become a reliable regional partner for adapting global content into market-relevant assets
One Year:
- Own execution of regional product marketing deliverables for priority APJ initiatives under the guidance of the broader Product and Solutions Marketing strategy
- Be a trusted partner to APJ stakeholders for localized positioning, campaign support, and field enablement
- Establish a repeatable approach for capturing regional insights and feeding them back into global messaging and asset planning
- Help improve regional adoption and campaign effectiveness through better market relevance, localization, and content performance
Belong - Your Community
Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward. In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm.
