Title: Public Relations Officer
Description:
Job Summary: We are seeking a skilled and motivated Public Relations Officer to join our team. As a Public Relations Officer, you will be responsible for managing and enhancing the public image and reputation of our organization. You will develop and execute effective communication strategies, build relationships with key stakeholders, and handle media relations. The ideal candidate has exceptional communication skills, a strong understanding of public relations principles, and the ability to adapt to a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
Responsibilities:
Communication Strategy: Develop and implement comprehensive communication strategies that align with the organization's goals and objectives. Create messaging frameworks, key talking points, and press releases to effectively convey the organization's mission, initiatives, and achievements.
Media Relations: Cultivate and maintain relationships with media representatives, journalists, and influencers. Proactively pitch stories and secure media coverage for the organization and its events, campaigns, and milestones. Serve as the primary point of contact for media inquiries and coordinate interviews and press conferences.
Content Creation: Write, edit, and distribute compelling and engaging content for various channels, including press releases, newsletters, articles, blog posts, and social media. Ensure all content is accurate, consistent, and aligned with the organization's brand and messaging.
Crisis Management: Act as the organization's spokesperson during times of crisis or reputation management issues. Develop crisis communication plans, prepare key messaging, and manage media inquiries effectively. Mitigate potential damage to the organization's reputation and maintain transparency and trust with stakeholders.
Stakeholder Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including clients, partners, government agencies, and community organizations. Develop communication materials tailored to specific audiences and collaborate with internal teams to ensure consistent messaging across all touchpoints.
Event Planning and Management: Coordinate and oversee the planning and execution of press conferences, product launches, corporate events, and other public relations initiatives. Work closely with event organizers, vendors, and internal teams to ensure seamless execution and maximum media exposure.
Monitoring and Reporting: Monitor media coverage and public sentiment related to the organization and its industry. Prepare regular reports on media activity, campaign effectiveness, and key performance indicators. Analyze data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
Requirements:
Proven work experience as a Public Relations Officer or in a similar role.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building abilities.
Knowledge of public relations principles, strategies, and best practices.
Experience in media relations, including pitching stories and handling media inquiries.
Ability to effectively manage crisis situations and handle sensitive information.
Familiarity with social media platforms and digital marketing trends.
Exceptional organizational and time management skills.
Proficiency in relevant software and tools.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
We offer a competitive salary, along with benefits and opportunities for professional growth. If you have a passion for public relations, a knack for storytelling, and a desire to shape and protect our organization's reputation, we invite you to apply for the position of Public Relations Officer.

This role will collaborate closely with distributors, system integrators (SIs), and ecosystem partners to drive co-marketing initiatives, demand generation, and account-based marketing (ABM) programs that strengthen AMD's position across the region.

You will be strategic yet hands-on B2B marketer with experience in channel/partner marketing, event execution, demand generation, and content localization. The successful candidate is a confident communicator and relationship-builder who can engage effectively with distributor and partner stakeholders, and a passionate, creative thinker comfortable operating in a fast-paced, multi-country environment.
Key Responsibilities
- Plan and execute integrated regional customer-facing marketing activities, including AMD-led direct marketing programs and co-marketing activities with distributors and ecosystem partners across India and ASEAN.

- Build and strengthen relationships with distributors, SIs, OEMs, and ecosystem partners to unlock co-marketing opportunities and optimize regional resources.

- Working knowledge of digital marketing fundamentals — paid media, promotional strategy, and social media — sufficient to manage and localize digital plans across countries (deep hands-on digital execution is not required).
- Event management experience, including large-scale industry events with on-site ownership.
- Project management experience working directly with cross-functional teams and multiple external partners across geographies.
- Negotiation skills sufficient to structure co-marketing agreements with distributors and partners.
- Prior experience covering India, ASEAN, and/or ANZ markets is highly desirable.

AI is transforming every industry, and Vertical Institute is helping professionals stay ahead through practical, industry-focused training. As Singapore’s AI and technology training provider, we are looking for a Senior Marketing Executive (Integrated & Community) with direct experience in the EdTech, education, or professional training industry to strengthen our brand presence across social media, events, partnerships, and community engagement.
This is a high-ownership role for a marketer who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will own our organic social media presence, lead community and event marketing initiatives, manage our Public Relations (PR) agency relationship, and ensure consistent brand representation across customer touchpoints.
Working closely with the Digital & Growth Marketing Manager, you will take ownership of integrated marketing initiatives and provide day-to-day guidance to a Marketing Executive, ensuring high-quality execution and alignment with broader marketing objectives.

Prepare regular performance reports with clear insights and actionable recommendations.
Track relevant metrics such as reach, engagement, audience growth, registrations, attendance, and campaign effectiveness.
Use audience insights and campaign data to refine messaging, content strategy, and community initiatives.
Identify opportunities to improve marketing processes, campaign execution, and audience engagement.
Team Collaboration & Execution Quality

Collaborate with the Digital & Growth Marketing Manager and wider marketing team to align integrated marketing activities with business objectives.

We are looking for a marketer who combines creativity, strategic thinking, and strong execution discipline. You should understand how to build brand awareness, promote educational programmes, and engage learner communities within the education and training sector.

We are looking for a proactive and results-driven *Social Commerce Executive* to grow our TikTok Shop and Shopee social commerce channels through *affiliate partnerships*, *creator collaborations*, and *livestream operations*.
This is a hands-on role where you'll *recruit and manage affiliates*, *coordinate livestream hosts*, *optimise campaign performance*, and *analyse sales data *to drive growth. Working closely with the founder, you'll have the opportunity to shape strategies that directly impact revenue.
*Key ResponsibilitiesAffiliate & Creator Management*
* Recruit 30–50 affiliates and KOCs each month through TikTok Shop and Shopee Affiliate programmes.
* Manage the end-to-end affiliate lifecycle, including prospecting, outreach, sample seeding, follow-ups, onboarding, and relationship management.
* Negotiate commission structures and collaboration opportunities with high-performing creators.
* Manage TikTok Shop Affiliate Center and Shopee Affiliate backend, including campaign setup, sample requests, and payout tracking.
* Build and maintain an affiliate CRM to track creator performance, GMV, engagement, and communications.
* Draft professional outreach messages, partnership proposals, and creator communications.
*Livestream Operations*
* Build and manage the weekly livestream host roster across Singapore and the Philippines.
* Allocate livestream slots based on host performance, audience behaviour, and business priorities.
* Onboard and train new hosts on products, brand guidelines, and livestream best practices.
* Plan weekly livestream calendars, including featured products, promotional mechanics, vouchers, and campaign themes.
* Support livestream execution through studio preparation, OBS setup, voucher configuration, moderation, and troubleshooting.
* Monitor livestream sessions and resolve operational issues promptly.
* Support major campaigns such as 9.9, 11.11, 12.12, and product launches.
*Performance & Analytics*
* Monitor key metrics including CTR, Add-to-Cart Rate, Conversion Rate, AOV, and GMV.
* Analyse affiliate, creator, and livestream performance to identify opportunities for growth.
* Benchmark competitors using tools such as Kalodata, FastMoss, and TikTok Shop Analytics.
* Prepare weekly reports with actionable insights and recommendations.
*Who We're Looking For*
* 2–4 years of experience in *social commerce, TikTok Shop, Shopee, e-commerce, affiliate marketing, influencer marketing, creator partnerships, or livestream operations*.
* Experience managing affiliate programmes, creators, KOLs, or influencer campaigns.
* Good understanding of TikTok Shop and Shopee seller ecosystems.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and recommend improvements.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Highly organised with excellent attention to detail.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.
* Comfortable appearing on camera occasionally or supporting livestream host onboarding.
* Proficient in Excel or Google Sheets.
* Fluent in English. Conversational Mandarin is an advantage.
* Able to work evenings or weekends during major sales campaigns (time off in lieu provided).
*Nice to Have*
* Existing network of TikTok creators, affiliates, or KOCs.
* Experience with OBS, StreamYard, or TikTok Live Studio.
* Familiarity with Kalodata, FastMoss, Shoplus, or similar analytics tools.
* Basic video editing or content creation skills.
* Experience using AI tools to improve outreach or workflow efficiency.
*What You'll Get*
* Base salary: SGD 4,000–5,000, depending on experience.
* Performance incentives tied to affiliate GMV and livestream sales.
* AWS.
* Annual leave and CPF in accordance with Singapore statutory requirements.
* Direct exposure to the founders with fast decision-making and minimal bureaucracy.
* Ownership of initiatives that directly contribute to business growth.
* Opportunities to build expertise in one of Southeast Asia's fastest-growing e-commerce sectors.

If you're passionate about TikTok Shop, creator partnerships, affiliate marketing, and livestream commerce, we'd love to hear from you.
Click *"Apply Now"* and submit your resume. If you have a portfolio or examples of campaigns you've managed, feel free to include them with your application.

Company Description
A breaker of boundaries, the hotel is ideally placed between the mavericks of Chinatown and the makers of the CBD. Today, Duxton Hill is Singapore’s most up-and-coming neighbourhood, featuring barista cafes, world-class eateries and bars, art galleries and independent boutiques. Now Mondrian arrives at the top of that hill.
Job Description
Job Description & Requirements
Reporting to the Director of Marketing, the Social Media Assistant Manager is a proactive ideator and self-starter who will play a key role in leading the future of luxury hospitality. - A team player who can work effectively with both internal and external partners to meet shared goals and deliver results on time

Title: TikTok Performance Marketing Manage
Description:
We are looking for an experienced, hands-on TikTok Performance Marketing Manager who specialises in selling physical consumer products through TikTok Shop.
Your primary responsibility is to generate profitable sales through TikTok advertising, particularly TikTok Shop GMV Max campaigns.
We are not looking for a traditional social media manager who focuses on followers, engagement or brand awareness. We want someone who understands how to convert advertising expenditure into revenue, identify winning video advertisements and scale campaigns profitably.
You will work closely with our in-house video production, influencer, affiliate and e-commerce teams to grow our skincare products in Singapore and Malaysia.
Key Responsibilities
1. TikTok Ads & GMV Max Management
- Independently set up, launch, monitor and optimise TikTok Shop GMV Max campaigns.
- Manage Product GMV Max campaigns and, where applicable, LIVE GMV Max campaigns.
- Set appropriate ROI targets, campaign budgets and product selections.
- Monitor advertising expenditure, GMV, ROI and cost per order daily.
- Identify underperforming campaigns and implement corrective actions.
- Optimise advertising expenditure according to product margins and profitability.
- Troubleshoot issues involving campaign delivery, insufficient spending, poor conversion rates and declining advertising returns.
- Manage campaigns across Singapore and Malaysia, accounting for differences in consumer behaviour and pricing.
2. Advertising Performance & Profitability
- Take direct responsibility for achieving assigned online sales and advertising profitability targets.
- Calculate product-level break-even ROAS based on selling price, cost of goods, platform fees, affiliate commissions and other variable costs.
- Identify which products generate the highest advertising returns.
- Recommend suitable promotional prices, product bundles and offers to improve conversion rates.
- Monitor customer acquisition costs and contribution margin after advertising.
- Distinguish between sales attributed to advertising and actual incremental sales growth.
- Scale successful campaigns without compromising profitability.
3. Video Advertising & Creative Optimisation
- Work directly with the internal video production team to identify and develop high-converting TikTok advertisements.
- Analyse individual video performance to determine which creatives generate sales.
- Develop creative briefs covering product pain points, selling propositions, hooks, demonstrations and calls to action.
- Recommend new video concepts based on advertising performance data.
- Test different video openings, product demonstrations, offers and messaging.
- Identify creative fatigue and recommend replacement advertisements before campaign performance deteriorates.
- Work with the influencer and affiliate teams to identify high-performing creator content suitable for paid advertising.
- Ensure a consistent pipeline of new advertising creatives for testing.
4. Campaign Testing & Scaling
- Develop structured testing plans for new products, advertisements and promotional offers.
- Establish clear criteria for identifying winning and losing creatives.
- Allocate initial test budgets and determine when campaigns should be scaled, maintained or stopped.
- Conduct controlled testing where feasible to distinguish creative performance from pricing, audience and promotional effects.
- Expand successful advertising strategies across additional products.
- Identify opportunities to increase sales during major TikTok Shop campaigns and promotional periods.
- Manage advertising budgets efficiently during both regular sales periods and major shopping events.
5. Reporting & Performance Analysis
- Maintain accurate daily tracking of advertising expenditure, attributed GMV, ROAS and cost per order.
- Produce weekly reports showing performance by product, campaign and advertising creative.
- Compare actual performance against assigned revenue and profitability targets.
- Identify the three strongest and three weakest advertising creatives each week, explaining their results.
- Provide actionable recommendations for increasing sales and improving advertising returns.
- Coordinate with the e-commerce team to reconcile advertising-attributed sales against actual orders, refunds and net revenue.
- Present clear recommendations for budget allocation and campaign improvements.
Job Requirement:
TikTok Advertising Experience
- Minimum 3 years of hands-on performance marketing experience, including substantial direct experience managing TikTok advertising campaign.
- Demonstrable experience managing TikTok Shop GMV Max campaigns.
- Must have personally managed advertising campaigns rather than solely overseeing external agencies.
- Experience advertising physical consumer products through TikTok Shop.
- Strong understanding of TikTok Shop's advertising ecosystem, campaign optimisation and performance measurement.
Commercial & Analytical Skills
- Proven ability to generate measurable e-commerce revenue through paid advertisements.
- Strong understanding of ROAS, ROI, CPA, CAC, GMV and advertising contribution margin.
- Ability to calculate campaign profitability after product costs, platform charges and affiliate commissions.
- Experience scaling daily advertising budgets while maintaining commercially acceptable returns.
- Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets for advertising performance analysis.
Creative Advertising Skills
- Strong understanding of TikTok video advertisements that drive purchases.
- Ability to identify effective hooks, product demonstrations and sales messaging.
- Experience testing UGC, creator-led advertisements and direct-response advertising creatives.
- Ability to translate campaign performance data into actionable instructions for video creators.
Preferred Experience
- Previous experience marketing skincare, cosmetics, personal care or FMCG products.
- Experience managing TikTok Shop advertising in Singapore and Malaysia.
- Experience working with affiliate creators and content authorisation for paid campaigns.
- Familiarity with Shopee Ads and Meta Ads.
- Experience in promoting products with relatively low selling prices, where advertising efficiency and margins are critical.
Requirements: Must have personally managed advertising campaigns rather than solely overseeing external agencies.

Title: Manager, Corporate Affairs & Communications
Description:
Job Description
At American Express, our culture is built on a long history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities and colleagues. As part of Team Amex, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, learn and grow while helping us define the future of American Express.
The American Express Corporate Affairs & Communications (CA&C) team is a strategic function that works to enhance and protect the continued strength of the American Express brand through public relations, social media and content, colleague communications and community impact initiatives.
We are looking for an experienced communications professional to lead the Corporate Affairs & Communications agenda across Southeast Asia, with primary responsibility for Singapore and Thailand, while supporting communications across other partner card markets in the region. Reporting to the Vice President of CA&C Asia based in India, this role will serve as the senior day-to-day communications partner to business leaders in Southeast Asia, providing strategic counsel and developing integrated communications strategies that advance business priorities, strengthen the company's reputation and build engagement with key internal and external audiences.
The role, as a head of the function, requires a strong combination of strategic thinking and hands-on execution. The successful candidate will be expected to anticipate reputational opportunities and risks, navigate complex issues, build compelling narratives, advise senior leaders and translate business priorities into effective communications.
Responsibilities
- Strategic Communications & Reputation Management
- Develop and execute integrated communications strategies that support business priorities, strengthen corporate reputation and advance key market narratives across Singapore and Thailand and other Southeast Asia markets.
- Identify opportunities to proactively tell the American Express story across media, social and owned channels, as well as via thought leadership, partnerships, research, events and business milestones.
- Lead media relations programs, managing relationships with journalists, influencers and external stakeholders to generate high-quality coverage and visibility.
- Anticipate and manage reputational risks, providing issues management counsel and developing messaging, holding statements and response strategies when needed.
- Act as a member of the crisis response team, ensuring timely, accurate and coordinated communications during issues and incidents.
- Monitor the external environment and identify emerging trends, risks and opportunities relevant to the business and brand.
- Executive & Leadership Communications
- Serve as a trusted adviser to senior leaders and spokespersons, providing communications counsel on business priorities, stakeholder engagement and reputation considerations.
- Develop executive messaging, talking points, speeches, Q&As, briefing documents and communication materials for internal and external audiences.
- Manage executive media interviews, speaking opportunities and stakeholder engagements, including preparation, coaching and message development.
- Partner with senior leaders to strengthen executive visibility and thought leadership through media, owned content and strategic communications opportunities.
- Colleague Communications & Engagement
- Develop and execute internal communications programs that connect colleagues to the company's strategy, priorities, culture and key milestones.
- Create compelling content and storytelling initiatives that engage colleagues and reinforce business objectives.
- Lead and/or support town halls, leadership forums, colleague events and other strategic engagement initiatives.
- Ensure communications align with enterprise policies, governance requirements and disclosure guidelines.
- Stakeholder, Agency & Team Management
- Build strong relationships with a wide range of stakeholders internally and externally; and become a trusted partner and adviser to business unit leaders to deliver coordinated communications outcomes.
- Collaborate with Corporate Affairs & Communications colleagues across Asia and globally to ensure alignment with enterprise priorities while addressing local market needs.
- Lead and develop a communications team member, providing coaching, prioritization and oversight to ensure successful delivery of market communications priorities.
- Foster a collaborative and high-performing team environment while driving strong stakeholder engagement across the organization.
- Manage communications agencies and external partners, ensuring quality execution, strong counsel and effective use of budgets.
- Measure communications outcomes and provide recommendations to strengthen future strategies and programs.
Qualifications
- At least 10 years’ experience working in a similar role with a large organization is a must. Experience with working in communication agency or editorial organization is a plus.
- Demonstrated experience developing and executing strategic, integrated communications programs, with the ability to connect communications activity to business and reputational outcomes.
- Strong editorial mindset, natural storytelling ability and excellent capability to develop compelling narratives and messages
- Strong knowledge and experience across media relations, corporate reputation, issues management and social media. Well established media network and contacts are needed.
- Demonstrated ability to operate as a trusted adviser to senior executives and business leaders, with strong judgment and the ability to influence effectively.
- Excellent written and verbal English communications skills. Proficiency in Mandarin or Thai is a plus. Ability to operate effectively within a global and matrix environment; International experience is a plus
- Creative and strategic problem solver, self-starter and proven track-record to drive tangible communication results backed up with data and analysis.
- Proactive, flexible and collaborative, with excellent interpersonal and relationship management skills. Ability to influence others and be comfortable in communicating at all levels.
- People leadership experience, with the ability to coach, develop and motivate talent.
- Requires ability to handle highly sensitive and in many cases confidential company information as well as managing multiple stakeholders.
- Able to manage and respond quickly to multiple priorities while driving results and delivery against deadlines. Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, matrixed and highly regulated environment.
About Us

Title: Assistant Manager, Integrated Marketing
Description:
At Sephora, beauty is about feeling seen, valued, and empowered, individually and collectively. It is connecting deeply with others, celebrating diversity and inclusivity, unlocking your potential and making a difference every day. Together, we belong to something beautiful.
Sephora SEA’s omni channel business spans over 8 countries (Australia, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore and Thailand) with 100+ stores and boasts some global flagships such as ION and Raffles City in Singapore, F88 in Kuala Lumpur and Pitt Street in Sydney. Sephora SEA is experiencing rapid growth in the region with new store openings and business channels (i.e., Click and collect and marketplace).
Assistant Manager, Integrated Marketing (SEAO)
Our Marketing organization aims to inspire and connect people through meaningful storytelling, always pushing the norms and boundaries, one person, one community at a time.
We are a strategic team of big thinkers and creatives who truly work interdependently to stimulate demand and drive traffic across our network. From developing marketing strategies, designing toolkits connecting consumer insights to our expertise & selection, planning our loyalty program, and building exciting in-store experiences, we are constantly finding ways to remind beauty lovers why Sephora is extraordinary and cement our place as an authentic beauty expert.
Reporting to the Senior Manager, Integrated Marketing (SEAO), you will be directly responsible for planning and strategizing omnichannel marketing campaigns. You will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders and country marketing teams to develop comprehensive toolkits across all Sephora marketing levers and touchpoints, ensuring alignment with business goals.
This role suits a dynamic individual with strong creative instincts, who thrives in strategic discussions as well as detailed execution. You excel in complex, cross-functional environments where no two days are alike, bringing ideas to life across diverse channels.
You Will Shine Here If You Enjoy…
- Executing marketing calendar and campaign strategies.
- Originating creative and innovative marketing ideas and strategies, driving them from concept to launch.
- Working across functions, markets, and all levels of seniority.
- Finding clarity in ambiguity and establishing processes where none exist.
- Drive experiential marketing initiatives by closely monitoring and leveraging industry best practices and pioneering groundbreaking campaign concepts.
What You Will Do
Campaign Planning & Execution
- Lead the strategic and creative ideation and development of omni-channel marketing campaigns activations across SEA ANZ
- Develop integrated campaign frameworks that ensure a clear and consistent consumer journey across digital, retail, social, and PR.
- Translate regional campaign strategy into detailed marketing activation plans, adapting direction for local contexts while maintaining overall campaign integrity.
- Maintain and manage the marketing calendar to optimize activations to sales plan, ensuring alignment with strategic campaign priorities.
- Deliver timely and aligned toolkits and post-mortems for priority campaigns.
- Champion the voice of the customer and Sephora brand codes across all campaign executions.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
- Collaborate with diverse internal teams (e.g., Creative, Paid Media & Analytics, Digital, Retail Execution, Social & PR, Merchandising, Brand Partner Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, and store managers) to align on campaign priorities and execution.
- Drive central campaign leadership, managing interdependencies, resolving blockers, and ensuring seamless project progression and timely signoffs.
- Partner with Merchandising to translate product strategies and commercial priorities into compelling campaign narratives and customer activations.
- Work with regional Retail Excellence and Training teams to implement activation guidance and ensure market teams are briefed and trained on campaign mechanics and in-store executions.
Market Management
- Oversee campaign execution for direct markets (Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Australia, New Zealand) and support franchise markets through toolkit development and adaptation guidance.
- Ensure market-specific nuances are reflected in activation planning without compromising campaign coherence.
- Share insights and data with regional and country teams to optimize market-specific plans.
- Review and ensure final market assets align with campaign direction and brand standards.
Reporting & Performance
- Lead campaign reporting and post-mortems to understand, improve, and elevate execution and performance.
- Track campaign milestones and proactively surface risks to senior leadership.
- Analyze performance data to derive actionable insights, correlating marketing outcomes with commercial targets and formulating strategic recommendations.
What We Are Looking For
- 4-6 years of integrated marketing or campaign management experience, preferably in retail or multi-brand environments.
- Proven experience managing complex, multi-channel campaigns across multiple markets simultaneously.
- Exceptional project management skills, able to lead multiple workstreams, manage timelines, and drive alignment across cross-functional teams.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management, adept at navigating matrixed organizations at local, regional, and global levels.
- High accountability, resilience, and emotional maturity.
- Highly organized, proactive, and skilled at process development in ambiguous situations.
- Ability to operate effectively in high-complexity and ambiguous environments.
- Experience across SEA markets; knowledge of ANZ is a significant plus.
- Passion for beauty, thrive in dynamic, highly matrixed fast paced environment preferred

Title: Integrated Marketing Manager (CFD/Financial Industry)
Description:
About Hytech
Hytech is a leading management consulting firm headquartered in Australia and Singapore, specialising in digital transformation for fintech and financial services organisations. The company delivers end-to-end consulting services and robust middle- and back-office solutions, enabling clients to optimise operations, enhance efficiency, and stay ahead in a fast-evolving digital landscape. Hytech’s client portfolio includes top global trading platforms and leading crypto exchanges.
Hytech applies AI and data-driven approaches to real-world financial use cases, including risk management, process optimization, and decision support, with a focus on delivering practical impact. With more than 2,000 professionals worldwide, Hytech has a strong and growing international presence, with offices across Australia, Singapore, Malaysia, Taiwan, the Philippines, Thailand, Morocco, Cyprus, Dubai, and beyond.
Job Responsibilities
- Formulate and execute integrated marketing strategies:
- Develop the company’s global integrated marketing strategy and annual marketing plan aligned with corporate strategy and business objectives.
- Leverage CFD and financial industry trends, product iteration cycles, and regional market characteristics to integrate multi-channel resources (social media, content, KOLs, events, advertising, PR).
- Deliver differentiated, actionable integrated marketing solutions and take end-to-end ownership of execution performance to drive core KPIs: brand exposure, user acquisition, product conversion, and user retention.
- Team management & delivery of business goals:
- Build, manage, and develop the integrated marketing team.
- Define team objectives, performance metrics, and collaboration frameworks.
- Allocate projects and human resources rationally, track execution progress and deliverable quality, continuously upgrade team capabilities and operational efficiency, and ensure all marketing targets are delivered on schedule.
- Omnichannel marketing orchestration:
- Oversee content operations, social media operations, paid advertising, and related teams.
- Plan marketing content and publishing cadence for social media ecosystems (Twitter/X, Facebook, LinkedIn, Telegram, etc.) and content channels (official website, blogs, industry media, etc.) to guarantee consistent messaging and unified brand identity across touchpoints.
- Continuously optimize paid promotion strategies for Google and social media ads to drive synergistic growth of paid and organic traffic and improve overall marketing ROI.
- Regional & global campaign leadership:
- Lead end-to-end planning and delivery of flagship global marketing initiatives, including new product launches, trading competitions, user incentive programmes, webinars, market analysis livestreams, and financial summit partnerships.
- Own goal-setting, solution breakdown, resource allocation, cross-functional alignment (Product, Tech, Compliance, Design, etc.), execution, and post-campaign reviews.
- Manage project timelines, compliance standards, and communication outcomes to build high-impact industry-level marketing milestones.
- KOL & partnership ecosystem management:
- Manage global CFD and financial industry KOLs, investment thought leaders, industry media, community influencers, and partner resources.
- Establish and sustain long-term cooperative relationships.
- Define KOL and media collaboration strategies to advance media placements, co-created content, and cross-industry partnerships.
- Expand marketing reach, strengthen brand credibility and global footprint, measure partnership performance, refine cooperation frameworks, and control partnership costs.
- Marketing budget & data governance:
- Plan, allocate, and control annual and project-level integrated marketing budgets.
- Build marketing data tracking and performance evaluation mechanisms.
- Monitor key metrics such as impressions, click-through rates, conversion rates, user acquisition volume, CAC, ROI, and user retention.
- Produce regular marketing analysis and review reports for senior management.
- Adjust marketing strategies, channel mix, and resource investment based on data insights and business feedback to lift marketing efficiency continuously.
- Brand & public sentiment management:
- Collaborate with the brand team to articulate core brand values and tone and safeguard the company’s global brand image.
- Monitor financial industry developments and brand-related public sentiment.
- Implement early-warning and contingency protocols for public-opinion risks, identify and mitigate negative exposure proactively.
- Coordinate with leadership and relevant teams to resolve public-opinion incidents and preserve brand reputation and user trust.
- Cross-functional & cross-region collaboration:
- Act as the key owner for integrated marketing work, maintain high-efficiency collaboration with Product, Sales, Operations, Tech, Compliance, Design, and other teams.
- Align marketing requirements and resource allocation across regional markets.
- Enable localised adaptation of headquarters-level strategies in regional markets, and ensure marketing priorities remain aligned with corporate business goals.
Job Requirements
- Education & professional background:
- Bachelor’s degree or above; majors in Marketing, Advertising, Public Relations, International Business, Finance or related fields are preferred.
- 5-8 years of relevant integrated marketing experience; must have CFD or financial industry exposure, plus minimum 3 years of people-management experience.
- Solid understanding of CFD business models, financial product attributes, target audience profiles, and industry go-to-market logic.
- Strategic & professional marketing capabilities:
- Proven track record in integrated marketing strategy formulation, campaign design, execution governance, and post-mortem analysis.
- Capable of building global marketing strategies derived from business objectives, with verifiable end-to-end global campaign delivery experience.
- Deep familiarity with core CFD/financial marketing channels: social media, KOLs, industry media, paid advertising, and partner channels; able to foster multi-channel synergistic growth.
- Team & project management competencies:
- Strong leadership and people-management skills, with hands-on experience in team building, talent development, performance management, and cross-regional team collaboration.
- Robust project orchestration and resource prioritisation skills; capable of running multiple concurrent marketing projects and aligning Product, Sales, Operations, Tech, Compliance, Design stakeholders to ensure smooth roll-out of marketing initiatives.
- Data-driven & commercial acumen:
- Strong capabilities in data analysis, budget planning, cost control, and commercial judgment.
- Evaluate channel and project performance against core marketing metrics, allocate resources rationally, and take accountability for marketing ROI and business outcomes.
- Global mindset & compliance awareness:
- Global perspective with awareness of cross-cultural nuances, local market dynamics, and financial regulatory frameworks across geographies.
- English as a working language with fluent written and verbal communication skills; capable of independently engaging overseas stakeholders and drafting English-language marketing materials.
- High compliance awareness to enforce compliance standards for marketing content and events and mitigate regulatory risks.
- Personal attributes:
- Strong sense of responsibility, goal orientation, decision-making, communication, coordination, and stress tolerance.
- Thrive in the fast-paced, dynamic financial industry environment.
- Demonstrated learning agility, problem-solving skills, and innovative thinking, with genuine passion for CFD and financial sector business.
- Nice-to-have:
- Hands-on experience in overseas-market integrated marketing and localised team management.
- Successful track record of designing and launching CFD/financial industry marketing campaigns.
- Established network of financial sector KOLs, media contacts, and industry partners.
- Multilingual proficiency.

Title: Manager, Integrated Marketing
Description:
Job description:
At Sephora, beauty is about feeling seen, valued, and empowered, individually and collectively. It is connecting deeply with others, celebrating diversity and inclusivity, unlocking your potential and making a difference every day. Together, we belong to something beautiful.
Sephora SEA’s omni channel business spans over 8 countries (Australia, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore and Thailand) with 100+ stores and boasts some global flagships such as ION and Raffles City in Singapore, F88 in Kuala Lumpur and Pitt Street in Sydney. Sephora SEA is experiencing rapid growth in the region with new store openings and business channels (i.e., Click and collect and marketplace).
Manager, Integrated Marketing (SEA ANZ)
Our Marketing organization aims to inspire and connect people through meaningful storytelling, always pushing the norms and boundaries, one person, one community at a time.
We are a strategic team of big thinkers and creatives who truly work interdependently to stimulate demand and drive traffic across our network. From developing marketing strategies, designing toolkits connecting consumer insights to our expertise & selection, planning our loyalty program, and building exciting in-store experiences, we are constantly finding ways to remind beauty lovers why Sephora is extraordinary and cement our place as an authentic beauty expert.
As the Integrated Marketing Manager, reporting to the Senior Manager, Integrated Marketing (SEA ANZ), you will be directly responsible for planning and strategizing omnichannel marketing campaigns. You will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders and country marketing teams to develop comprehensive toolkits across all Sephora marketing levers and touchpoints, ensuring alignment with business goals.
This role suits a dynamic individual with strong creative instincts, who thrives in strategic discussions as well as detailed execution. You excel in complex, cross-functional environments where no two days are alike, bringing ideas to life across diverse channels.
You Will Shine Here If You Enjoy…
- Executing marketing calendar and campaign strategies.
- Originating creative and innovative marketing ideas and strategies, driving them from concept to launch.
- Working across functions, markets, and all levels of seniority.
- Finding clarity in ambiguity and establishing processes where none exist.
- Drive experiential marketing initiatives by closely monitoring and leveraging industry best practices and pioneering groundbreaking campaign concepts.
What You Will Do
Campaign Planning & Execution
- Lead the strategic and creative ideation and development of omni-channel marketing campaigns activations across SEA ANZ
- Develop integrated campaign frameworks that ensure a clear and consistent consumer journey across digital, retail, social, and PR.
- Translate regional campaign strategy into detailed marketing activation plans, adapting direction for local contexts while maintaining overall campaign integrity.
- Maintain and manage the marketing calendar to optimize activations to sales plan, ensuring alignment with strategic campaign priorities.
- Deliver timely and aligned toolkits and post-mortems for priority campaigns.
- Champion the voice of the customer and Sephora brand codes across all campaign executions.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
- Collaborate with diverse internal teams (e.g., Creative, Paid Media & Analytics, Digital, Retail Execution, Social & PR, Merchandising, Brand Partner Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, and store managers) to align on campaign priorities and execution.
- Drive central campaign leadership, managing interdependencies, resolving blockers, and ensuring seamless project progression and timely signoffs.
- Partner with Merchandising to translate product strategies and commercial priorities into compelling campaign narratives and customer activations.
- Work with regional Retail Excellence and Training teams to implement activation guidance and ensure market teams are briefed and trained on campaign mechanics and in-store executions.
Market Management
- Oversee campaign execution for direct markets (Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Australia, New Zealand) and support franchise markets through toolkit development and adaptation guidance.
- Ensure market-specific nuances are reflected in activation planning without compromising campaign coherence.
- Share insights and data with regional and country teams to optimize market-specific plans.
- Review and ensure final market assets align with campaign direction and brand standards.
Reporting & Performance
- Lead campaign reporting and post-mortems to understand, improve, and elevate execution and performance.
- Track campaign milestones and proactively surface risks to senior leadership.
- Analyze performance data to derive actionable insights, correlating marketing outcomes with commercial targets and formulating strategic recommendations.
What We Are Looking For
- 6-8 years of integrated marketing or campaign management experience, preferably in retail or multi-brand environments.
- A visionary who can define strategy, plan programs, and oversee detailed execution.
- Proven experience managing complex, multi-channel campaigns across multiple markets simultaneously.
- Exceptional project management skills, able to lead multiple workstreams, manage timelines, and drive alignment across cross-functional teams.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management, adept at navigating matrixed organizations at local, regional, and global levels.
- High accountability, resilience, and emotional maturity.
- Highly organized, proactive, and skilled at process development in ambiguous situations.
- Ability to operate effectively in high-complexity and ambiguous environments.
- Experience across SEA markets; knowledge of ANZ is a significant plus.
- Passion for beauty, thrive in dynamic, highly matrixed fast paced environment preferred

Title: VP, Marketing, Group Retail Marketing
Description:
Company: 1011 United Overseas Bank Ltd
About UOB
United Overseas Bank Limited (UOB) is a leading bank in ASEAN with a global network in Southeast Asia, Asia Pacific, Europe and North America. Operating through our head office in Singapore and banking subsidiaries in China, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand and Vietnam, we have a global network of about 430 branches and offices in 19 markets. At the heart of UOB is our culture, shaped by the UOB Way and anchored on our four values – Honourable, Enterprising, United and Committed. For more than 90 years, these values have guided how we do right by our customers, collaborate with one another and create long-term value for the communities we operate in. As One Bank, we are committed to helping our colleagues build sustainable careers grounded in purpose, supported by strong values, and enriched with meaningful opportunities to grow.
Job Description
This role is part of UOB’s Group Retail Marketing function which focuses on:
- Rolling out secured loans campaigns and activities to drive revenue growth, loan volumes and awareness for the bank’s mortgage and car loan businesses to drive digital and in-branch take-up.
- Building on the bank’s omnichannel strategy by enhancing the in-person experience / branch proposition for consumers. Curating and governing the showcase of marketing assets across the bank’s wide branch network to increase the branch experience for customers as well as optimising the bank’s owned assets and channels, to drive CVPs and product/solution awareness and take up.
The job holder will be responsible for developing and executing marketing campaigns, as well as communication materials to strengthen the consumer perception of the Bank as well as the Bank’s secured loans business. The job holder will also support acquisition, retention, and portfolio growth initiatives to drive the business.
Roles And Responsibilities
- Lead the development and execution of secured loans (mortgage and auto loans) and branch marketing campaigns to ensure the successful rollout of marketing activities and events. This will also include driving full funnel marketing campaigns, leveraging on both ATL and BTL as well as digital.
- Increase awareness for the branches/products/solutions through strategic media buy to drive awareness, acquisition and engagement.
- Work closely with stakeholders across sales, segment and product teams in the bank to facilitate and execute campaigns to help drive client acquisition, deepen client engagement and promote portfolio quality and penetration.
- Manage and support branch events, including sourcing of partners and gifting/premiums when required.
- Negotiate and work effectively with creative and media agencies as well as other external vendors to ensure quality execution of client programmes and campaigns.
- Monitor and analyse key performance marketing indicators, track and optimise media campaigns as well as deliver a robust and adaptable marketing calendar. Also able to manage and maximise budgets to achieve agreed yearly business priorities.
- Understand the needs of customers, industry trends, and the strategy and tactics of competitors; target key opportunities and communicate core value propositions to establish differentiating plus sustainable advantage and rolling out integrated marketing activities to deliver these to clients.
Requirements
- Degree in Marketing, Communications, Business or Economics.
- At least 8-10 years of Marketing and/or Communications experience in a financial institution (FI), Wealth industry or direct to consumer business model environment e.g. in FMCG, online marketplaces.
- Demonstrate creativity and the ability to express opinions on creative work, with a good sense of consumer trends and insights.
- Ability to apply a customer centric mindset in the implementation of marketing campaigns.
- Good project management skills – able to prioritise and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment while maintaining attention to detail
- Demonstrate competency in integrated marketing communications, including digital and social media marketing.
- Strong communicator (written and spoken) who is personable and collaborative
- Strong analytical skills and data-driven thinking
- Able to work independently and collaboratively in a team, with good stakeholder management ability

Title: (Senior) Marketing Director
Description:
Position Overview
The (Senior) Marketing Director will lead the overall marketing and commercial strategy across all business segments in the Asia Pacific (APAC) region, with responsibility for driving market development, revenue growth, margin improvement, channel effectiveness and commercial performance.
The role will provide strategic leadership across market strategy, pricing, dealer and channel management, promotions, market intelligence and commercial analytics. The Senior Marketing Director will work closely with Sales, Product, Finance, Engineering, Service, regional management and HQ to translate market insights into actionable business strategies and ensure effective execution across APAC.
The role will also be responsible for providing senior management with comprehensive analysis of market size, market share, revenue, margin, pricing, channel performance and other key commercial indicators across all business segments.
Key Responsibilities
1. APAC Marketing Strategy and Regional Leadership
- Lead the development and execution of the overall marketing strategy and marketing activities across all business segments in the APAC region.
- Develop regional marketing strategies, annual plans, priorities and initiatives aligned with business objectives and growth targets.
- Identify market development opportunities, target markets, customer segments and growth areas across APAC.
- Drive the development of segment-specific marketing strategies based on market dynamics, customer requirements, competitive landscape and business priorities.
- Ensure effective alignment between regional marketing strategy, sales strategy, product strategy and overall business objectives.
- Provide strategic market and commercial recommendations to senior management and HQ.
- Monitor the effectiveness of regional marketing activities and adjust strategies based on market performance and business results.
2. Pricing, Dealer and Channel Management
- Take the lead in developing and managing regional pricing strategies across all relevant business segments and markets.
- Analyse market pricing, competitor pricing, product positioning, customer requirements and profitability to support pricing decisions.
- Work closely with Sales, Product, Finance and HQ to establish pricing strategies that balance market competitiveness, revenue growth and margin objectives.
- Lead the development and optimisation of dealer and distribution channel strategies across APAC.
- Establish channel management principles, dealer segmentation, channel coverage, performance monitoring and development plans.
- Evaluate dealer and channel performance and identify opportunities to improve market coverage, sales effectiveness and profitability.
- Develop strategies for dealer appointment, development, performance improvement and channel expansion in collaboration with regional teams.
- Lead the development and execution of regional promotional strategies and programmes, including pricing campaigns, sales promotions, product promotions and market activation initiatives.
- Ensure pricing, dealer/channel strategy and promotional activities are aligned with overall regional business objectives.
3. Market Size, Market Share and Commercial Analytics
- Lead the development of comprehensive market intelligence and commercial analytics across all APAC markets and business segments.
- Establish and maintain analysis of market size, market growth, market share, competitor performance, customer segments, product segments and industry trends.
- Monitor market share performance by country, segment, product and customer category.
- Identify changes in market dynamics, competitor positioning, customer demand and industry trends and translate them into actionable business recommendations.
- Develop market sizing and forecasting models to support business planning, market entry, product planning and resource allocation.
- Analyse sales performance against total addressable market, available market and competitive performance.
- Establish regular dashboards and management reports covering key market and commercial indicators.
- Provide data-driven insights to support strategic decision-making by regional management and HQ.
4. Revenue and Margin Management
- Lead the preparation and analysis of revenue and margin performance across all business segments in APAC.
- Work closely with HQ, Finance, Sales and regional teams to ensure accurate and timely revenue and margin reporting.
- Monitor revenue, gross margin, product mix, pricing, volume and other key commercial performance indicators by country, segment, product and channel.
- Identify key drivers of revenue and margin performance and highlight significant variances against budget, forecast and previous periods.
- Provide management with regular analysis and recommendations to improve revenue quality, profitability and commercial performance.
- Support annual budgeting, business planning, forecasting and strategic target-setting processes through market and commercial analysis.
- Develop standardised regional reporting frameworks to improve visibility and consistency of commercial performance across APAC.
- Work closely with HQ to align regional reporting definitions, methodologies, targets and performance indicators.
5. Sales and Business Development Support
- Act as a strategic business partner to regional Sales and Business Development teams.
- Translate market, customer, pricing, channel and competitive insights into actionable sales and business development strategies.
- Support key account development, new market entry, product launches and strategic business opportunities.
- Identify opportunities to improve customer acquisition, market penetration, product mix and channel effectiveness.
- Provide Sales teams with relevant market intelligence, competitor analysis, pricing insights and commercial recommendations.
- Facilitate close collaboration between Marketing, Sales, Product, Finance, Engineering and Service functions.
6. Product and Market Development
- Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to align product strategies with APAC market requirements.
- Provide market and customer insights to support product planning, product positioning, portfolio optimisation and new product development.
- Identify product gaps and market opportunities across different countries and business segments.
- Support product launches and market introduction strategies across APAC.
- Monitor product performance, competitive positioning, customer acceptance and market development following product launches.
7. Regional Promotion and Marketing Activities
- Lead the development and implementation of regional marketing and promotional programmes across APAC.
- Oversee exhibitions, industry events, customer engagement activities, product launches, digital marketing and other market activation initiatives.
- Develop marketing materials and commercial content to support regional sales and business development activities.
- Ensure marketing activities are focused on measurable business outcomes, including market development, lead generation, customer engagement and sales support.
- Track and evaluate the effectiveness and commercial impact of marketing activities.
8. HQ and Regional Coordination
- Serve as the key regional marketing and commercial interface between APAC markets and HQ.
- Work closely with HQ on revenue, margin, pricing, market size, market share, sales performance and other commercial reporting.
- Ensure timely and accurate submission of regional market and commercial information to HQ.
- Align regional strategies, reporting standards, business targets and performance indicators with HQ requirements.
- Consolidate and communicate market intelligence and commercial insights from individual APAC markets to HQ and senior management.
- Drive regional initiatives and ensure effective implementation across countries and business segments.
9. Team and Stakeholder Leadership
- Lead and develop the regional marketing function, including manpower planning organisational structure, capabilities and performance management.
- Provide strategic direction and guidance to marketing and commercial team members across the region.
- Build capabilities in market intelligence, commercial analytics, pricing, channel management, product marketing and market development.
- Lead relationships with dealers, distributors, external agencies, consultants, event organisers and other strategic partners where applicable.
- Foster strong collaboration across Sales, Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering, Service, HQ and country teams.
Job Requirements
- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Economics, Finance or a related discipline. A Master’s degree or MBA is an advantage.
- Minimum 10 years of relevant experience, with substantial experience in a senior marketing, commercial, business development or regional management role.
- Strong experience in B2B, industrial, automotive, power generation, construction machinery, commercial vehicles, engines or other technical industries is highly preferred.
- Proven experience managing regional marketing strategies across multiple APAC markets and business segments.
- Strong understanding and practical experience in pricing strategy, dealer management, channel management, market development and promotional strategy.
- Strong analytical capabilities, with demonstrated experience in market sizing, market share analysis, forecasting, commercial analytics, revenue analysis and margin analysis.
- Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to understand and analyse revenue, gross margin, pricing, product mix, volume and profitability.
- Experience working with HQ or regional headquarters on business planning, reporting, performance management and commercial analysis.
- Strong understanding of APAC markets, including different market structures, customer behaviours, competitive environments and distribution models.
- Proven leadership experience in managing teams and cross-functional stakeholders across multiple countries.
- Excellent strategic thinking, analytical, communication, presentation, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
- Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with BI, CRM, market intelligence or data analytics platforms is an advantage.
- Ability to work independently in a fast-paced regional environment and manage multiple markets and business priorities.
- English proficiency is required; Mandarin is an advantage for communication with HQ and Chinese-speaking stakeholders.
- Willingness to travel extensively within the APAC region as required.

The Role
As Programme & Strategy Lead, you will lead the strategic direction, client relationship and delivery of the client’s Brand Governance & APAC mid-funnel programme. Mid-funnel is made up of two complementary programmes: an always-on campaign and an influencer campaign, both designed to build brand consideration across priority markets.

Significant senior experience in account leadership, brand strategy, integrated marketing, creative content or a related agency role, ideally across multiple markets.
A strong understanding of how brand strategy, creative work, content, influencers, media and performance connect to build consideration and deliver commercial value
Proven ability to understand a client’s business challenge and translate it into a clear strategic response, inspiring briefs and focused agency action.
A track record of becoming a trusted senior client partner: someone who listens carefully, understands the client’s world, asks the right questions and provides confident, informed counsel.
Strong creative judgement and fluency, with the ability to recognise a good idea, improve it through constructive discussion and guide creative, content and production teams towards high-quality work.
Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to lead senior conversations, facilitate decisions, sell an idea and manage challenge constructively.
A hands-on, solutions-oriented leader who can bring structure to ambiguity, prioritise effectively and lead a small, agile agency team without losing sight of the detail.

Be the senior account lead at the centre of a high-profile APAC programme for a globally recognised hospitality brand.

The Ad Sales Planner is a critical member of the APAC Advertising Sales team, supporting revenue growth across BBC Studios' portfolio of television, digital, audio, sponsorship, branded content and audience solutions. Working closely with sales, clients, agencies and internal stakeholders, the role supports the full advertising sales cycle, from proposal development and campaign planning through to execution, reporting and post-campaign analysis.
The APAC region presents a significant growth opportunity through a dual-pronged strategy of expanding our base of premium television advertisers while accelerating growth across BBC Studios' evolving digital, audience, data and content marketing solutions. As a result, this role plays an important part in helping clients better understand and access BBC Studios' unique audiences, premium content environments and advertising capabilities.
The successful candidate will combine strong commercial acumen, attention to detail and client management skills with a passion for media, content, audience insights and advertising innovation. They will become a trusted partner to the sales team, supporting business growth while ensuring the highest standards of campaign execution and client service.

1. Commercial Sales Planning & Client Solutions (55%)
Support the APAC Advertising Sales team in developing strategic advertising solutions that drive revenue growth across television, digital, audio, sponsorship, branded content and audience-led opportunities.
Develop compelling media plans, presentations and commercial proposals in response to client and agency briefs.
Translate client marketing objectives into integrated advertising solutions leveraging BBC Studios' content, audience and platform capabilities.
Partner with Sales, Insights, StoryWorks and other internal stakeholders to deliver competitive and commercially effective recommendations.

Provide timely communication and support throughout the campaign lifecycle.

Prepare campaign performance reports, transmission reports and post-campaign reviews.

Build strong day-to-day relationships with agencies, advertisers and regional sales representatives.

Support the sales team with audience insights, market intelligence and competitor monitoring to strengthen client conversations and commercial outcomes.

Title: APAC Media Relations Spokesperson
Description:
About The Role
As the APAC Media Relations Spokesperson, you will play a dual role as a spokesperson and a regional coordinator. You will need to display a clear understanding of Shell's strategy and an ability to communicate it in a coherent way across print, broadcast, online and social media, and work to mitigate the reach and impact of inaccurate stories.
You will work closely with country media relations leads within the APAC region, and act as a focal point to help ensure they respond on behalf of Shell consistently, and are proactively communicating company content and messages.
Where you fit in
Reporting to the head of media relations APAC, the APAC media relations spokesperson is a support for heads of media relations in countries in the APAC region and a bridge to the Group External Communications and Campaigns team. Together, the regional and Group media relations teams act as one, managing relationships with major domestic and international print, online, social and broadcast media and driving consistency of Shell message.
Key Responsibilities:
You will be accountable for helping to drive the consistency of media relations in the region, with focus on English language outlets. You will also support with media relations work in Australia as required.
More specifically, your role will include:
- Build and strengthen relationships with senior journalists from international news wires and influential trade publications based in Singapore, to provide trusted insight and context for Shell’s strategy and key activities.
- Engagement with international media on projects, activities and developing/emerging issues (including crisis situations) across APAC and issues above country level.
- Supporting on Australia-specific media relations work as required, including leave cover and support on major projects, announcements, issues and activities.
- Leverage senior leader visits to countries in the region and drive consistency of briefings and alignment with group story, identify opportunities with country Corporate Relations teams to maximise benefit and cut-through of activities such as media briefings, events and site visits within the region.
- Acting on own initiative when representing the Group’s policies and actions to media, and in determining appropriate tone and level of response.
- Filtering incoming requests from international media for interviews/engagement with business leaders across the region and advising the in-country media leads. Drive proactive activity where needed to support Shell’s business strategy.
- Implementing the strategy, policy and standards guidelines process to drive consistency of media relations work across APAC.
- Connect country Corporate Relations teams with Group standards, guidelines, strategy, and best practices to drive consistency in media relations and messaging across APAC, including:
- Acting as a sounding board for media relations advice and coordination across the region.
- Supporting a regional community of practice.
- Disseminating Group messaging and holding statements.
- Acting as the regional approver, where required.
- Coordinate with Group team to monitor and measure cut through of Shell messaging in proactive storytelling and to keep track of momentum with issues, to inform action, including use of data and analytics.
- Disclosure assistance for country leads as needed.
What we need from you :
A hunger for and insight into news is essential. You should have a strong interest in the external media landscape and the interaction of traditional, social and broadcast media outlets. You are someone who integrates and collaborates across boundaries to maximise commercial value for Shell as a whole. When it comes to a fast-paced and constantly changing environment, you are resilient and can thrive in these situations.

- Strong experience working in a corporate communications team, within a complex organisation either in the public or private sector.
- Demonstrate and deploy good judgment and creativity.
- An ability to identify compelling stories and have an external focus.
- Extensive experience working with senior business leaders, providing strategic support and guidance, developing trusted partnerships to support business outcomes.

- Use of data and insights to inform strategy and tactics.

You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.

Title: Assistant Trade Marketing Manager
Description:
Q.B. Food Trading Pte. Ltd. is a wholly owned subsidiary of Johnsonville, LLC—an organization committed to becoming the best company in the world by offering high-quality products through multiple business channels. International growth is a key objective, and this is an excellent opportunity for someone eager to learn and grow with the business.
Position Overview
The Assistant Trade Marketing Manager supports the Retail Sales and Trade Marketing Director in developing and executing trade marketing initiatives across Retail and Food Service channels. The role works closely with Sales, Retail, brand partners, agencies and external vendors to deliver effective campaigns, promotional activities and sales support materials that strengthen brand presence and drive business growth.
Responsibilities
Trade Marketing & Sales Support
- Assist in planning and executing marketing campaigns, trade promotions and brand activations for the company’s core and third-party brands.
- Work closely with Sales teams to develop trade decks, product catalogues, point-of-sale materials, online advertisements and other sales support materials.
- Coordinate with brand partners, agencies and vendors to ensure timely and effective campaign execution.
- Develop and manage promotional and advertising materials across digital, print and social media channels.
- Monitor campaign performance and provide post-campaign analysis and recommendations.
Retail Marketing
- Develop and execute marketing initiatives to drive showroom traffic, customer engagement and sales.
- Coordinate showroom campaigns, events, promotions and product launches.
- Oversee retail merchandising and point-of-sale displays to ensure effective product presentation and brand consistency.
- Work with the Retail and Sales teams to identify opportunities to enhance the customer experience and sales performance.
Digital & Marketing Apps Maintenance
- Assist in managing the marketing budget and track spending against approved plans.
- Coordinate marketing activations, promotional activities and events within agreed timelines and budgets.
- Evaluate the effectiveness and ROI of marketing activities and recommend improvements.
- Coordinate the maintenance and enhancement of company marketing and sales applications, including Food Service CRM, Food Service Ordering App and Merchandiser App.
- Liaise with external agencies on bug fixes, system enhancements, content updates and platform optimisation.
- Gather user feedback and coordinate improvements to enhance functionality and user experience
Education
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related discipline.
Experience
- Minimum 4–6 years of relevant experience in trade marketing, retail marketing, brand marketing or a similar role.
- Experience in FMCG, food, retail or consumer goods is preferred.
- Experience managing agencies, vendors and third-party brand partners.
Skills
- Strong project management, communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Good understanding of trade promotions, retail merchandising and marketing campaigns.
- Strong analytical and organisational skills with good attention to detail.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint and Excel.
- Creative, commercially minded, proactive and hands-on.
- Able to manage multiple projects and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Benefits And Compensation
Why Join Us?
Benefits
At QB Food, we value our employees and are committed to providing a supportive and rewarding work environment. As part of our team, you will enjoy a comprehensive benefits package that includes:
- Competitive salary and performance incentives
- Annual leave and medical benefits
- Group insurance coverage, including medical and dental
- Workmen insurance for added protection on the job
- Staff discounts on a wide selection of quality food products
- Ongoing training and development opportunities to support your growth
- A collaborative and inclusive workplace culture
Join us and be part of a trusted name in food trading with over five decades of excellence.
