Title: Associate Director, Affluent and Wealth Marketing
Description:
Job Summary
As part of the Singapore Marketing team, this role drives the Affluent and Wealth proposition marketing agenda. The individual is responsible for developing and executing strategic initiatives that strengthen Standard Chartered’s wealth brand among affluent clients, while partnering with internal and external stakeholders to deliver impactful programmes that expand the affluent client base and advance key Wealth business priorities.
Key Responsibilities
Campaign Management & Brand Development
- Partner with Affluent Segment and Wealth business stakeholders to strengthen brand preference for Standard Chartered’s wealth solutions and Affluent relationship accounts through strategic marketing campaigns, client engagement events, and consistent brand identity execution.
- Develop and deliver marketing communications and client engagement initiatives that support client acquisition, deepen engagement, and enhance the overall client experience across target segments.
- Lead the end-to-end execution of strategic and tactical marketing campaigns and events across the Affluent and Wealth portfolios, ensuring alignment with business objectives and brand standards.
- Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to deliver campaigns and events effectively, on time, and within budget.
Performance Marketing & Optimisation
- Support the planning and deployment of full-funnel paid marketing campaigns across relevant channels.
- Recommend and manage the optimal media mix to maximise campaign effectiveness and return on investment.
- Monitor, analyse, and optimise campaign performance to drive continuous improvement and achieve targeted business outcomes.
- Translate insights and client feedback into actionable recommendations that improve campaign effectiveness and engagement.
Stakeholder and Agency Management
- Build strong partnerships with the Affluent Segment and Wealth teams, Global Marketing, Product, Corporate Affairs, and Digital Sales to execute campaigns and events that drive client acquisition, deepen engagement, and support portfolio growth.
- Negotiate with and manage creative and media agencies, event management partners, alongside other external vendors, to ensure high-quality delivery of campaigns and events
Motivations
- Creating commercial impact and differentiated client experiences through campaigns and events aligned with Affluent business priorities and desired client outcomes.
- Collaborating with stakeholders and global teams to share best practices and campaign performance insights, improving execution quality and consistency.
Our Ideal Candidate
- Key Experiences:
- 8 + years of relevant experience in a financial institution or an agency managing financial services accounts.
- Experience in campaign and agency management, with a proven ability to shape creative output and media strategy, supported by strong digital and social marketing capabilities.
- Experience delivering excellent client engagement events & proven event management skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage internal and external stakeholders at all levels of seniority.
- Proven analytical, project management, and process management capabilities.
- Strong business acumen and awareness of competitive dynamics and the broader macroeconomic environment.
- Strong understanding of the Affluent and Wealth business.
- Able to work independently and collaboratively in a team
- Bachelor degree in Marketing, Communications, Business or Economics
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite and Outlook, Adobe Analytics
Role Specific Technical Competencies
Must-have Skills
- Customer Engagement
- Campaign Management
- Event & Experience Management
- Stakeholder Management
- Marketing Strategy Execution
Other Skills
- Content Strategy & Communications
- Market Enablement
- Marketing Analytics & Optimisation
- Wealth Product & Proposition Knowledge
About Standard Chartered
We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
Together We
- Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
- Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
- Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term
What We Offer
In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
- Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
- Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
- Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
- Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
- A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
- Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Some of our roles use assessments to help us understand how suitable you are for the role you've applied to. If you are invited to take an assessment, this is great news. It means your application has progressed to an important stage of our recruitment process.

Brand Strategy Ownership

• Own the brand narrative and storytelling, translating strategy into clear, executable plans.
Regional–Global–Local Orchestration
• Act as the primary connector between global, regional, and local teams for Specialty Care/Immunology and assigned brand(s).

About The Role
We’re looking for an Associate Manager / Manager, Brand Growth to join our Global Brand Marketing team and help connect Brand more closely to the products we want to grow, the channels where consumers make decisions, and ultimately business impact.
We’re looking for a left-brain brand marketer — someone who believes in the power of creativity, but is equally comfortable with audience insight, commercial priorities and data.
The role sits at the intersection of brand, product, audience insight and growth, with three core jobs:
Integrate product into Brand
- Work with vertical teams and local markets to identify the products Klook should be talking about, uncover relevant audience insights, and turn them into compelling consumer stories within our larger brand campaigns.
- The job is to go beyond features and find the reason people should notice and care.
Integrate Brand into lower-funnel marketing
- Work across paid media, Kreator, PR, social and local marketing teams to make sure Klook’s brand, values and distinctiveness show up further down the funnel.
- You’ll connect Brand, product, channels and markets around one clear consumer story — so commercial activity builds memory for Klook, not just the immediate transaction.
Measure the impact of Brand

What You’ll Do
- Identify priority products and categories to integrate into Brand activity.
- Gather and synthesise audience and market insights.
- Turn product benefits into compelling consumer propositions and stories.
- Lead integrated marketing campaigns across Brand, paid media, Kreator, PR, social and local markets.
- Bring stronger Brand thinking into lower-funnel and commercial activity.
- Partner with research and analytics teams to measure Brand impact.
- Turn performance and research into actionable recommendations.
- Explore how AI can improve the speed, quality and scale of our work.
What We’re Looking For
- 4–5 years of experience in brand, integrated marketing, product marketing or communications planning.
- A left-brain brand mindset: strong creative judgement, but equally comfortable with data, commercial questions and measurement.
- Strong consumer, audience and value proposition thinking.
- Experience working across regional or global campaigns and multiple channels.
- Good understanding of paid media and lower-funnel marketing.
- Strong stakeholder and project management skills.
- Comfortable working with research, brand metrics and business data.
- Able to simplify messy inputs into a clear point of view.
- AI-curious and proactive about experimenting with better ways of working.
What Success Looks Like
- Klook’s priority products are naturally embedded into Brand campaigns.
- Audience insights actively shape our marketing decisions.
- Lower-funnel campaigns build the Klook brand while driving commercial outcomes.
- Brand, channels and markets work from one connected consumer story.
- We have a clearer view of Brand’s impact across both brand and business metrics.

Title: Associate Manager, CRM Campaign Operations (SEA Pod Lead), Singapore
Description:
About The Role
We are looking for an analytical, execution-driven, and strategic Assistant Manager to lead our newly established South East Asia (SEA) CRM Pod. In this hybrid "Player-Coach" role, you will manage a team of 1-2 Senior Associates/Associates while directly running day-to-day CRM operations for SEA markets.
You will act as the operational backbone for the region - overseeing localised campaign execution, enforcing global governance SLAs, optimising channel efficiency (Push, Email and Localised Messaging Networks i.e. WhatsApp/LINE), and partnering with local commercial heads to drive incremental sales growth.
What You'll Do
Pod Leadership & Governance
- Team Leadership: Manage, mentor, and upskill a team of 1-2 Senior Associates/Associates, overseeing workload distribution, campaign quality assurance, and personal development.
- Operational SLA Enforcement: Serve as the gatekeeper for the SEA CRM pipeline - enforcing brief lead times, standardised intake workflows, channel send caps, and campaign slot allocations across all SEA markets.
- Stakeholder Alignment: Act as the primary point of contact for local SEA Country Managers, Marketing Leads, and other business teams, translating commercial goals into execution roadmaps.
Operational Strategy & Framework Design
- Workflow Automation & SOPs: Architect, implement, and refine scalable operational frameworks and SOPs. Build automated workflows (e.g., auto-populating briefs into master campaign calendars, automated content setup triggers) to minimise manual configuration time and eliminate operational friction.
- SLA & Ingestion Architecture: Design and enforce clear Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Tiered brief lead times, and emergency send cutoffs to protect pod bandwidth and prevent last-minute ad-hoc requests.
- Process Standardisation & Playbooking: Package operational wins, channel guardrails, and intake pilots into standardised regional playbooks that can be easily scaled and replicated across new or long-tail SEA markets.
Hands-on Market Execution
- Market Ownership: Directly own end-to-end CRM campaign planning, audience building, setup, QA, and deployment for designated SEA markets.
- Channel Management: Manage high-velocity multi-channel send rhythms across Push notifications, Email layouts, and regional messaging networks (e.g., WhatsApp/LINE where applicable).
- Localisation & Compliance: Ensure localised copywriting, currency formatting, and asset configurations meet high-quality UX standards and central brand guidelines.
Campaign Optimisation & Performance Analytics
- Experimentation Framework: Design and execute structured A/B tests (copy, send timing, value hooks, mechanics) and mandate 5%-10% holdback control groups to measure clean incremental sales lift.
- Channel Efficiency: Monitor key daily performance metrics (Push OR, Email OR, Email CTOR, Rev/1k messages) to optimise audience segmentation and prevent database fatigue.
- Reporting & Reporting Tools: Work with data analytics to set up automated dashboards, analyse campaign post-mortems, and deliver actionable insights in monthly business reviews.
What You'll Need
- Experience: 3-5+ years of hands-on experience in CRM, Lifecycle Marketing, or Campaign Operations, with at least 1 year of experience managing, mentoring, or leading team members.
- Technical Mastery: Hands-on expertise in enterprise Marketing Automation & CDP platforms (e.g., Iterable, Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Campaign, MoEngage or Segment).
- Data & Analytics Aptitude: Highly comfortable working with performance data, segmentation attributes, and analytics tools. Understanding of Google Analytics, Looker dashboarding, Tableau, and basic SQL is a strong advantage.
- Hybrid Execution Mindset: Comfortable balancing high-level team management and stakeholder negotiation with ground-level technical campaign setup and QA.
- Process & SLA Discipline: Demonstrated ability to build, enforce, and optimise operational workflows, SLA matrices, and intake frameworks.
- Language Skills: Fluency in written and spoken English. Additional SEA regional language skills (e.g., Mandarin, Bahasa Indonesia, Thai, or Vietnamese) are a plus.

Title: Associate Marketing Manager, Singapore
Description:
About SharkNinja
Our mission to positively impact people's lives every day in every home around the world allows our employees to be thinkers and tinkerers, designers and doers, creators and number crunchers, makers of things they love.
SharkNinja APAC is expanding and scaling rapidly. Our two brands, Shark and Ninja, have enjoyed unprecedented growth over the past five years, driven by a very strong innovation pipeline across both brands. Building on that success, SharkNinja APAC has embarked on a bold plan for growth in which Singapore and Malaysia play a critical role. We have taken these markets back from our distributors so that we can run them directly and drive strong growth behind innovation and investment.
Shark and Ninja have exceptional product pipelines and consumers who have not yet been given a strong enough reason to care. This role is where campaigns actually get built and launched — and where our next brand leaders are grown.
Position Summary
The Associate Marketing Manager runs Shark or Ninja marketing activity in Singapore day to day, depending on the category they own: campaign planning and delivery, NPD launch execution, content production, creator and PR activity, and the reporting that tells us whether it worked.
Shark competes in home care, floor care and beauty, and Ninja in kitchen, cooking and food preparation. In both, the product genuinely does something better and the job of marketing is to make people see it. Content, demonstration and credible third-party proof matter more here than message repetition.
This is a hands-on role in a small team. You will write the brief, build the content, brief the creators, manage the agency, check the assets and pull the results together. The plan and the execution both sit with you.
You will also own a defined category or sub-category of Shark or Ninja in Singapore — its plan, its numbers and its results. You work alongside the Marketing Manager, who sets the brand direction, and you are expected to run your area, not simply support theirs.
It is also a development role. We are building the marketing organisation these markets will need, and we want people who will grow into brand ownership. Scope will expand as fast as you can carry it.
Key Responsibilities
- Own a defined category or sub-category of Shark or Ninja in Singapore end to end: set its plan, priorities and targets within the brand plan agreed with the Marketing Manager.
- Be the go-to person for your category — its consumers, competitors, pricing, range and pipeline — and bring a point of view to the Marketing Manager rather than waiting for direction.
- Manage the budget allocated to your category within the brand envelope, and recommend where to invest more or stop.
- Answer for your category's results: demand, conversion and launch performance, reported honestly with learning applied.
- Work as a partner to the Marketing Manager, who sets the brand direction, and not as their support resource.
- Build and execute the Shark or Ninja campaign calendar for Singapore against commercial moments — launches, peak, category occasions and platform campaigns.
- Write clear, insight-led briefs and hold agencies and partners to them.
- Manage delivery end to end: assets, media, channels, timing and go-live, with nothing landing late or incomplete.
- Own campaign budgets and track spend against plan.
- Execute NPD launches
- Deliver every Shark or Ninja launch in your area in Singapore: proposition and message, assets, media, PR, seeding, creators, and online and retail landing.
- Run the launch checklist and chase every dependency — content, stock, pricing, listings, training — rather than assuming others will.
- Secure early reviews and credible demonstration content before day one.
- Report launch performance at 30 and 90 days with learning attached.
- Build content that shows what our products do, grounded in how people actually live, clean, cook and eat here — the small home, the hawker habit, the weekend cook, the health-conscious family.
- Manage creator and influencer activity: selection, briefing, content review and performance measurement.
- Work with the E-Commerce Designer and Social Commerce team so brand and commerce content reinforce each other.
- Work closely with E-Commerce and Sales so campaigns land where the product can actually be bought, with content and availability ready.
- Provide the shopper and in-store material the commercial teams need — claims, demonstration messages and reasons to choose.
- Track what converts and bring that back into the next campaign.
- Bring a point of view to the trading rhythm rather than a report.
- Build campaign and content reporting that is honest about what worked and what did not.
- Test deliberately rather than repeating what was done last year.
- Track competitor activity and flag anything that needs a response.
- Recommend stopping things that are not delivering, including things you built.
Essential
- 4+ years in consumer brand marketing, campaign delivery or product marketing in Singapore.
- Evidence that you build and improve, not just deliver. A campaign, content approach, process or test you initiated yourself — and what changed as a result.
- Hands-on execution capability across content, creators, media and assets. You do the work, not only manage it.
- Genuine Singapore consumer understanding and curiosity about how people actually live and buy.
- Strong project discipline — many moving parts, tight timelines, nothing dropped.
- Commercial awareness: understands that marketing exists to create demand that converts.
- Clear communication and the confidence to brief, challenge and chase.
- Ability to run a defined category or sub-category: set its plan, own its numbers and make the case for investment, with the Marketing Manager as partner rather than director.
- Appetite to grow into brand ownership.
Experience might get you the interview. Mindset is what sets you apart.
YOUR ROLE IN LEADING OUR SUCCESS DRIVERS
- Lead us to be “RARELY SATISFIED”
- Make things better each day; “PROGRESS OVER PERFECTION”
- Use your knowledge of our consumer, understand that “DETAILS MAKE THE DIFFERENCE”
- Deliver something great; “WINNING IS A TEAM SPORT”
- Be clear and honest, “COMMUNICATING FOR IMPACT”

Plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns across email, paid, and organic channels for the South APAC region in collaboration with the Senior Marketing Manager — from strategy to deployment to optimisation.

Title: AVP/VP, Employee Communications
Description:
GIC is one of the world’s largest sovereign wealth funds. With over 2,000 employees across 11 locations around the world, we invest in more than 40 countries globally across asset classes and businesses. Working at GIC gives you exposure to an extraordinary network of the world’s industry leaders. As a leading global long-term investor, we Work at the Point of Impact for Singapore’s financial future, and the communities we invest in worldwide.
Corporate Affairs and Communications
The Corporate Affairs and Communications (CAC) department is responsible for managing corporate affairs, branding and reputation, and all internal and external communications. It includes GIC’s interface with key stakeholders, including the general public and media.
Employee Communications
GIC’s Employee Communications team connects employees across 11 global offices to the organisation’s vision, purpose and strategic direction. The team drives impactful storytelling and engagement through internal communications channels, campaigns, and events — ensuring every GICian understands how their work contributes to GIC’s long-term success.
What impact can you make in this role?
As AVP/VP, Employee Communications, you will help shape how GIC communicates internally — turning complex ideas into clear, engaging stories that inspire and inform employees globally. You’ll strengthen connection and alignment across offices, enhance digital engagement, and use data and technology to elevate how we communicate as one GIC.
What will you do as a AVP/VP, Employee Communications?
Reporting to the Head of Employee Communications, you will be part of the Global Corporate Affairs and Communications team. You will plan and deliver internal communications content and campaigns across multiple channels and events. Your role will include:
- Develop and deliver internal content and campaigns — Plan, draft, and publish high-quality communications across channels such as newsletters, Yammer, and enterprise campaigns. Shape leadership messages, event materials, and storytelling that connect employees to GIC’s mission, values, and strategic priorities.
- Enhance and manage the OneGIC intranet — Partner with the intranet lead to curate engaging content, manage homepage and news updates, design and layout articles on the site, and ensure the platform remains dynamic, user-friendly, and aligned with GIC’s tone and digital content standards.
- Launch and enhance internal communication channels — Work closely with technology teams to improve existing digital platforms and launch new solutions features that strengthen employee engagement globally, streamline content delivery, and enhance the overall user experience.
- Manage the internal communications ecosystem and calendar — Oversee the planning and coordination of content across all internal channels, including the intranet, newsletters, digital screens, physical spaces, and events, ensuring cohesive messaging, consistent cadence, and optimal use of each platform for departments to reach employees effectively.
- Lead enterprise-wide initiatives — Support major internal campaigns and events, from concept development to post-event storytelling.
- Drive global alignment and engagement — Cascade key enterprise messages through toolkits, rollout guides, and briefing materials that enable regional teams to communicate effectively, while driving initiatives and content that strengthen connection, participation, and a unified culture across GIC’s global offices.
- Enhance impact through data and AI — Use channels analytics to uncover insights that drive smarter communication decisions, and apply AI tools to boost efficiency, personalise content, and deepen employee engagement.
- Collaborate across teams — Liaise with internal stakeholders and external agencies to deliver best-in-class content, manage end-to-end workflows, and ensure alignment, quality, and consistency across all internal communications initiatives.
What makes you a successful candidate?
- Minimum of 6–10 years of relevant experience in communications disciplines, with dedicated experience in internal or employee communications.
- Background in financial services preferred.
- Proven experience managing internal communication channels, including intranet and newsletter platforms, with a strong track record of creating engaging, high-impact content.
- Experience working with Content Management Systems and an understanding of UI/UX ideal.
- Ability to think laterally and apply AI and digital tools creatively to solve communication gaps and challenges, enhance processes, and improve technology-driven workflows.
- Strong writing and editorial skills, with expertise in structuring news and storytelling for internal audiences, supported by sound research and critical thinking.
- Keen attention to detail and editorial judgment, capable of reviewing content critically and ensuring alignment with GIC’s tone and standards.
- Ability to connect the dots across enterprise initiatives teams, synthesising information and perspectives to craft cohesive, enterprise-level narratives that reinforce alignment and shared purpose.
- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels.
- Sound stakeholder management and judgment, operating with professionalism, discretion, and collaboration.
- Proactive and solutions-oriented, able to multitask, manage priorities, and take ownership of projects with strong initiative and follow-through.
Work at the Point of Impact
We need to be forward-looking to attract the right people to help us become the Leading Global Long-term Investor. Join our ambitious, agile, and diverse teams - be empowered to push boundaries and pursue innovative ideas, share your views, and be heard. Be anchored on our PRIME Values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence, which guides us in how we make our day-to-day decisions. We strive to inspire. To make an impact.
Flexibility at GIC
At GIC, our offices are vibrant hubs for ideation, professional growth, and interpersonal connection. At the same time, we believe that flexibility allows us to do our best work and be our best selves. Thus, our teams come into the office four days per week to harness the benefits of in-person collaboration, but have the flexibility to choose which days they work from home and adjust this arrangement as situational needs arise.
We are an equal opportunity employer
GIC is an equal opportunity employer, and we value diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.
Please email grphrodtaops@gic.com.sg at any point of the application or interview process if adjustments need to be made due to a disability.
Learn more about our Corporate Affairs & Communication Department here:
https://gic.careers/group/corporate-affairs-communication/
Our PRIME Values
GIC is a values driven organization. GIC’s PRIME Values act as our compass, enabling us to fulfil our fundamental purpose and objectives. It is the foundational bedrock which governs our behaviors, our decision making, and our focus. It informs both our long-term strategy as a firm, and the way we relate to our Client, business partners and employees. PRIME stands for Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence.

Title: B2B Marketing Lead
Description:
The Role
We’re looking for a commercially minded marketing lead to shape and deliver programmes that generate enterprise demand, build pipeline and strengthen Intellect’s presence across priority markets.
You’ll translate business priorities into focused marketing plans and own their execution, bringing together campaigns, events, partner marketing, digital channels, content and prospect lifecycle marketing. Alongside demand generation, you’ll help sharpen how we communicate our solutions, bring offerings to market and improve the effectiveness of our marketing activity.
Working closely with sales, product and content marketing, and local commercial teams, you’ll make decisions about where to focus, coordinate the support needed and carry initiatives through from idea to commercial results. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys combining strategic judgement with execution and building a more effective, repeatable marketing engine.
Your Responsibilities
Marketing Planning & Commercial Priorities
Translate business and market priorities into practical marketing plans, with clear audiences, objectives, budgets and measures of success.
Identify the campaigns, channels and opportunities most likely to generate relevant demand, balancing immediate commercial needs with longer-term market presence.
Own delivery across your marketing programmes, coordinating internal contributors, creative support and external partners.
Review results with commercial stakeholders and recommend where to invest, refine or stop activity.
Integrated Campaigns & Demand Generation
Plan and execute integrated campaigns targeting priority industries, enterprise accounts and decision-makers.
Bring together email, events, webinars, partner channels, content distribution and selective paid activity to generate qualified demand and commercial opportunities.
Own campaign delivery, including audience targeting, briefs, landing pages, email sequences and launch coordination.
Improve digital discovery and conversion across relevant website journeys, search and campaign channels, working with specialist support where needed.
Events & Partner Marketing
Lead the marketing execution of webinars, roundtables, industry conferences and other selected events, from assessing opportunities and shaping the proposition to promotion, delivery and follow-up.
Develop joint marketing programmes with partners, associations and industry communities to extend Intellect’s reach and credibility.
Work with sales to engage relevant prospects before and after events, turning participation into qualified conversations and opportunities.
Evaluate event and partnership performance to guide future activity and investment.
Prospect Lifecycle & Conversion
Build and run prospect nurture programmes across the enterprise buying cycle, including event follow-up, ongoing education and reactivation of dormant leads.
Personally manage audience segmentation, email campaigns and marketing automation workflows to deliver relevant, coordinated communications.
Align with sales on qualification, lead routing, handover and follow-up so marketing engagement translates into timely commercial action.
Use engagement data, funnel performance and sales feedback to improve lead quality and progression.
Market Positioning & Go-to-Market Support
Help translate Intellect’s solutions into clear, compelling messages for different buyers, industries and markets, working with product and content marketing.
Partner with local commercial teams to adapt marketing plans to buyer needs and support market expansion and the launch of relevant offerings.
Shape briefs and contribute to customer stories, campaign content and sales materials, drawing on expertise from clinical, product and commercial teams.
Strengthen Intellect’s visibility and credibility through consistent messaging and the distribution of thought leadership, customer evidence and expert perspectives.
Marketing Performance & Operations
Maintain a clear marketing calendar, reliable campaign tracking and visibility into performance across key programmes.
Assess results through qualified engagement, sales-accepted opportunities, pipeline contribution and conversion, using findings to improve activity and budget allocation.
Work with sales and the relevant CRM or revenue operations owner to strengthen reporting, attribution and shared processes.
Build reusable templates and workflows, using AI and automation thoughtfully to improve execution speed, quality and consistency.
Requirements
An experienced B2B marketer. You have personally owned and delivered marketing programmes for business audiences, ideally involving enterprise buyers and considered purchasing decisions. We value demonstrated scope, judgement and results over a particular title.
Able to shape the plan and deliver it. You can turn commercial objectives into clear priorities, choose an appropriate channel mix and carry work through without needing every step prescribed.
A hands-on owner. You’re comfortable moving between planning, campaign setup, copy and briefs, CRM execution and performance analysis, bringing in support where it adds the most value.
Comfortable across marketing disciplines. You bring practical depth in demand generation, events or webinars, and email nurture, with the ability to connect these to messaging, content and digital channels.
Commercially and analytically minded. You understand enterprise sales cycles and can explain how your work generated relevant demand, improved conversion or contributed to pipeline.
Confident with marketing tools. You can build segments, launch email journeys, configure straightforward automation and use CRM and campaign reporting to guide decisions.
A strong communicator and collaborator. You can develop effective copy and briefs, make complex solutions understandable, and align sales, subject-matter experts and external partners around a clear objective.
Resourceful and organised. You make sensible trade-offs, manage budgets and multiple workstreams reliably, and deliver within a lean environment.
Motivated by the mission. You’re excited to help expand access to mental healthcare and build marketing programmes that support meaningful business growth.
Intellect (
intellect.co
) is a venture-backed digital health company reinventing how mental health is in Asia. Our goal is to make it simple, easy and stigma-free for everyone.
We're building an entirely new way for modern organisations to easily provide support for their employees’ mental health & mental wellbeing, no matter where they are on their journey.
Join us on our mission to eliminate barriers to mental health and to create a wellbeing approach that people love using.

Title: BD & Partnerships Senior Specialist (Partnerships & KOL Collaborations)
Description:
Moomoo Singapore is a holistic wealth-tech platform building an intelligent investing ecosystem across its digital platform, physical experience stores and investor education community. Through the moomoo app, it provides everyday investors and professional clients with access to global markets, diverse investment products, advanced trading tools and AI-powered insights.
Since launching in March 2021, Moomoo Singapore has evolved beyond an investing platform into a popular financial literacy resource and full-spectrum wealth platform, supporting investors from their first trade to managing sophisticated portfolios. It surpassed two million customers in Singapore in June 2026, with users spanning retail investors to private wealth and institutional clients.
Moomoo Financial Singapore Pte. Ltd. is a subsidiary of Nasdaq-listed Futu Holdings Limited (Nasdaq: FUTU). The firm is regulated by the Monetary Authority of Singapore and holds a Capital Markets Services Licence (CMS101000) and Major Payment Institution Licence (PS20200617). It also has exempt financial adviser status and is authorised to provide Digital Payment Token services. Moomoo Trustee (Singapore) Pte. Ltd. is a licensed trust company, while Moomoo Singapore is a DP Clearing Member, SGX-ST Trading Member, and SGX-DT Trading and Clearing Member of Singapore Exchange.
Business Development & Partnerships Manager/Specialist (Partnerships & KOL Collaborations, User Growth)
We are seeking a results-driven, strategically-minded Business Development & Partnerships Manager/Specialist with a genuine passion for stock investing to spearhead user growth in the Singapore market through KOL collaborations and partnerships with financial industry peers and cross-industry brands. This role will be responsible for identifying, negotiating, and managing channel partners to elevate brand awareness, drive user acquisition, and maximize conversion rates. The ideal candidate brings solid stock investment knowledge and hands-on experience, established financial industry resources or cross-industry and investment KOL connections, a strong track record in partnership marketing, and a deep understanding of performance-driven marketing strategies.
Responsibilities
- Identify, develop, and manage partnerships with financial and cross-industry brands, as well as investment and finance KOLs, in alignment with the company's business direction, to drive user growth and business development
- Lead partnership negotiations and develop tailored proposals in alignment with company objectives, ensuring all collaborations deliver on business goals
- Guide partners in producing high-quality co-branded promotional content to maximize reach and engagement
- Plan, execute, and optimize online and offline partnership campaigns, ensuring seamless delivery while tracking and reporting on performance outcomes
- Leverage data analytics to refine partnership strategies, improve customer acquisition efficiency, and maximize ROI
- Stay ahead of industry trends, proactively explore new opportunities, and optimize partnership marketing initiatives. Support cross-functional channel marketing projects to contribute to overall business growth
Requirements

Title: Brand and Marketing Manager, SEA & India – Fenty Beauty
Description:
ABOUT KENDO
Kendo is the small but mighty force behind your favourite beauty products. A play on the words “can do,” Kendo is redefining the beauty industry through next-generation products, visionary campaigns and unforgettable retail presence. Kendo creates original founder brands, partnering with major faces from fashion and entertainment. The house of brands currently includes KVD Vegan Beauty, Fenty Beauty by Rihanna, Fenty Skin, Ole Henriksen, and Lip Lab. We tell their stories to bring to life the dream products you’ve always wanted but have never been able to find.
POSITION SUMMARY
The Brand & Marketing Manager is responsible for orchestrating and executing the brand and marketing strategy for the SEA & India region. Reporting to the Senior Marketing Manager, this role leads the development and implementation of brand positioning, messaging, and consumer engagement across all touchpoints, ensuring a cohesive and impactful brand presence.
The Brand & Marketing Manager drives the planning and execution of comprehensive 360° marketing initiatives, manages the marketing calendar and budget, and collaborates closely with commercial, retail, and education teams to optimize brand performance and market share. Additionally, this role oversees in-store visual merchandising, leads special projects and consumer events, and partners with PR and social media teams to ensure alignment with brand objectives. The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker and hands-on leader with deep experience in brand management and marketing within the beauty industry, a proven track record in the SEA & India markets, and a passion for building strong cross-functional relationships in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Brand Management
- Responsible to strategize, define and implement the brands’ mission, objectives and positioning in the market. Oversees the consistency & timely delivery of brand messaging across all touchpoints and all stakeholders.
- Serves as the brands’ spokesperson, ensuring to maintain a cohesive narrative (brand messaging, brand positions, brand values) across PR, social media, Advertising, Retail & Education.
- Lead all brand meetings and support negotiations to secure optimal support from retail partners.
- Responsible to design and oversee the consumer engagement journey in collaboration with cross functional stakeholders to achieve brands objectives.
- Collaborate with cross functional team to consolidate and share consumer insights to global teams, offering region-specific product enhancement suggestions and championing regional requirements (from brand assets to engagement activities)
- Stay abreast of makeup trends, innovations, and regulatory changes in SEA & India. Analyse market trends, consumer behaviour, and the competitive landscape to identify opportunities and inform marketing plans. Integrate digital and social-first thinking into core brand strategies.
Marketing
- Owns the development and management of Marketing Calendar. Responsible to design milestones to achieve brand strategy & aligned KPI. Responsible to ensure all key stakeholders are consulted, informed and aligned on the identified priority in a timely manner.
- Lead the planning and execution of comprehensive marketing strategies for SEA & India, spanning paid media, partnerships, promotions, CRM, sampling, retail events, and brand-led initiatives, ensuring alignment with overall brand direction.
- Own and manage the brand’s marketing budget, ensuring responsible spending and achievement of ROI targets.
- Collaborate with commercial, retail, and education teams to develop tools and materials that drive sell-through and optimize brand presence with retail partners and distributors.
- May be appointed to lead or participate in special projects (e.g., always-on campaigns, combat plans), ensuring brand cohesiveness, effective execution, and achievement of KPIs.
- Lead and oversees the end-to-end design and execution of consumer events, ensuring consistency with brand guidelines, objectives and delivering a cohesive brand experience.
- Define pricing strategies for new launches and review annual price adjustments. Lead product launch forecasting and collaborate with Planning and Retail teams to maintain optimal stock levels, particularly for key products (eg: Key bets, Top SKUs, Hot off Press etc)
- Lead the delivery of marketing projects and campaigns, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and timely execution.
- Measure and analyze the effectiveness of marketing campaigns and activities. Provide actionable insights and recommendations to the Senior Marketing Manager for continuous improvement.
PR
- Partner with the PR and Social Media team to ensure all PR and social media strategies are aligned with brand objectives and guidelines.
Visual Merchandising
- Oversee the brand’s in-store visual merchandising and gondola displays, ensuring they are updated seasonally to reflect new launches and discontinuations, and are consistent with brand guidelines.
- Work closely with the retail and education teams to ensure timely implementation of marketing mechanics and visual updates at the counter.
General
- Foster strong relationships with internal teams and external partners to secure aligned support and resources for all marketing initiatives.
- Actively contribute to a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and creative team culture in line with Kendo SEA values. Mentor and support team members, promoting a positive and high-performance work environment.
- Identify and implement processes, tools, and procedures to enhance the effectiveness and efficiency of brand and marketing operations.
- Take ownership for achieving key brand KPIs, leveraging insights from the team and reporting progress and recommendations to the Senior Marketing Manager.
REQUIREMENTS
- At least 7 years of experience in a Brand or Marketing role. Beauty Industry a plus.
- Experience in Southeast Asia and India markets is a plus
- Strategic thinker and brand builder.
- Team player that inspires others and collaborates cross functionally.
- The ability to work in a fast-paced environment and juggle multiple priorities.
- Strong organizational, keen attention to detail, follow-up skills, hands-on in getting things done.
- Strong business acumen and analytical skills, results oriented.
- Good interpersonal skills high level of integrity.
- Can do attitude, flexible with an ability to work with a level of ambiguity.
- Ability to deploy ideas effectively and present to Senior Management.
- Proactively collaborate to strengthen the core values and culture of Kendo Brands

Title: Brand Communications Manager
Description:
Be the voice of one of the best-known brands in marketing.
Ahrefs helps marketers get their brands found online, in search, in AI answers and on social. Our tools run on the largest search and AI datasets on the web. We've been bootstrapped and profitable for fifteen years, with no investors and no board, and we have offices in Singapore, Tokyo, Palo Alto and Cambridge (MA).
The product has a big reputation, and we want every word around it to live up to that. Up to now, copy at Ahrefs has been something talented people do alongside their main job. We want someone for whom it is the main job.
The job
You'll be the voice of Ahrefs. You'll decide how we sound and what we say about ourselves, write much of it yourself, and get every team using it. The homepage, a banner ad, a renewal email and a booth wall should all sound like the same company. When someone here wants to know how to say something better, they'll come to you.
What you'll do
The website. Homepage, tool pages, comparison pages, ad landing pages, and the scripts for the explainer videos on them.
Campaigns. Concepts, headlines, banners and video scripts for our advertising.
Customer messages. Product emails and in-app notifications, the kind people read rather than archive.
Print and events. Brochures, flyers, and the copy on our booth walls.
The stage. Shape the message in our team's conference talks, including keynotes at Ahrefs Evolve.
Social. Work with our social media lead so a post and a landing page sound like they came from the same place.
Positioning and messaging. Decide the core story for the company and each product, write it down, and get other teams to adopt it.
You're probably right for this if
Writing copy is what you do best, and most of your career has gone into it: campaigns, websites, product emails, scripts.
You're hands-on. You'd rather write it yourself than brief someone else to. You can turn a banner headline around the same day you're halfway through a homepage rewrite, and you like having both on the go.
You can show us your work. Real, published copy, and you can tell us exactly which parts you wrote.
You know when to be funny and when to get straight to the point.
You pick up technical products quickly, and can explain them to experts without dumbing them down. You don't need to know SEO.
You've owned a brand voice or positioning before, and got teams who didn't report to you to use it.
You'll argue for a word with a CMO, and let go of the ones that don't matter.
Good to have
UX writing or product marketing experience.
Video scripts and speechwriting.
Comfortable enough in Figma or a CMS to fix your own copy in place.
Why Ahrefs?
We believe in giving smart people real ownership and not micromanaging them. You'll own how Ahrefs sounds, everywhere, and shape how millions of marketers see the brand. We value honesty, results and simple solutions over complicated ones, and you'll work with a smart, low-ego team where your words make a real difference.
Ahrefs does not engage with agencies or third-party recruitment providers for the roles we hire for. If we need help, we'll let you know.
Location: Singapore, Tokyo, Palo Alto (CA) or Cambridge (MA). On-site; you'll need the right to work in the office you choose.

Title: Brand Manager
Description:
About Us
Longbridge is a new-generation, AI-driven online brokerage on a mission to make investing smarter, simpler, and more accessible for everyone. Headquartered in Singapore, we are redefining the investment journey by connecting the stages of “Discovery → Learning → Trading.”With our proprietary AI assistant, Longbridge AI, and a cloud-native infrastructure, we provide retail investors with institutional-grade insights and a seamless global trading network. At Longbridge, you won’t just be working for a brokerage; you’ll be building the future of financial infrastructure.
About the role
The Brand Manager leads the brand management mandate for the group: how Longbridge is perceived across markets, and whether every touchpoint, from a paid ad to a flagship event to an in-app card, reflects one consistent, high-quality brand. You own the brand book and its governance, run the review desk that every growth and channel team relies on, and carry brand execution through integrated campaigns, out-of-home and traditional media, co-branded work and events. This is a hands-on role that requires both strategic thinking and strong execution. You will work across Product, User Growth, Design, Corporate Affairs and the Group Content Hub, manage several projects at once, and be the person the organisation turns to when it needs a brand decision made quickly and made well. Based in Hong Kong or Singapore, you cover Hong Kong and Singapore and support the group's other markets as they open.
What you will do
- Brand management and governance — Maintain and evolve the brand identity across all brands, own the brand book, messaging and guidelines, and run the brand governance process so that consistency is built into how teams work rather than checked at the end.
- Review desk and service standard — Run the brand review desk for User Growth and channel teams against established service level standards, so conversion work moves at funnel speed without drifting from the brand.
- Integrated marketing — Plan and execute brand campaigns across owned, earned and paid channels with User Growth, the Content Hub and Corporate Affairs; own out-of-home and traditional media execution end to end, including media planning input, production and vendor management.
- Brand storytelling — Translate AI capabilities, product launches and market insights into brand stories, and adapt messaging for different audiences and regional markets in English and Chinese, working from the product packaging owned by the Product Marketing Manager.
- Co-branded and partner assets — Review and approve co-branded assets with strategic partners, sponsors and distribution partners, so that third parties represent the brand correctly.
- Events and launches — Provide brand production support to Corporate Affairs on flagship events, launches and sponsorship activations: environmental branding, collateral, merchandise and on-site brand execution, working with the Creative & User Experience Designer.
- Agencies and vendors — Manage creative agencies, production vendors and brand research partners day to day: briefs, timelines, quality control, and budget tracking.
- Brand health and measurement — Own brand health reporting: brand tracker, share of voice and sentiment, campaign performance and periodic brand audits; present insights and recommendations that shape upcoming campaigns.
What you bring
- At least 5 years in brand management, integrated marketing or product marketing, with experience in fintech, brokerage, financial services, AI or technology, and campaigns you have led end to end.
- You understand financial markets and investment products, and you know how a regulated category influences brand communication.
- Strong brand and visual judgment, and the confidence to make a call and explain it to a growth team on a deadline.
- Proven experience managing agencies, production vendors and partners, and running out-of-home or traditional media campaigns.
- Excellent English and Chinese communication and copywriting skills; Cantonese is an advantage for the Hong Kong market.
- Organised and detail-oriented, able to run several projects independently with minimal supervision across different teams and markets.
- AI-fluent in practice: you use AI tools in your daily work and have marketed AI or technical products, or are keen to.
- Familiarity with brand tracking, media monitoring or analytics tools is a plus.

Brand Owners, Logistics Service Providers (LSPs), Customs and Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs)
.

Brand Owner and Industry Engagement

Identify stakeholder needs, adoption barriers and opportunities for collaboration.
Develop and manage a qualified pipeline of prospective Brand Owner participants and members.
LSP Engagement and Programme Adoption
Engage logistics providers and supply-chain security stakeholders to drive participation in TAPA APAC’s Brand Protection programme.
Connect Brand Owners with relevant LSPs to support practical adoption and collaborative outcomes.
Own the engagement process from prospecting and needs assessment through to adoption, membership conversion and ongoing relationship management.
Customs and Law Enforcement Collaboration
Develop and sustain relationships with Customs, LEAs and relevant government stakeholders across APAC.
Facilitate lawful information-sharing, industry dialogue, stakeholder briefings and capacity-building activities.
Coordinate public-private collaboration addressing counterfeiting, illicit trade, product diversion and related supply-chain risks.

Maintain clear stakeholder plans, engagement pipelines and follow-up actions.

Maintain structured records of stakeholder feedback, emerging issues and programme improvement opportunities.
Support periodic standards reviews through consultation, user feedback and practical-operability validation.

Represent TAPA APAC at relevant industry conferences and regional stakeholder meetings.

.

TAPA’s vision is an international supply chain where controlled and traceable product can be transported in a cost efficient and secure environment.

Title: Business Development & Brand Executive (Corporate Wellness)
Description:
ABOUT AQUILA MEDICAL CENTER
Aquila Medical Center is a multi-disciplinary MOH clinic in the Singapore CBD with over 8 years of history. Our doctors offer health screening, AI-powered longevity and biological age assessments, hyperbaric oxygen therapy (HBOT), weight management, GP care and teleconsultation, acupuncture, medical aesthetics, hair restoration, plastic surgery and minor surgery under one roof.
We are building our corporate wellness business and our brand, and we're looking for one person to drive both. That means someone who can sit across from an HR manager and close a deal, then head out and film a video for our social media.
THE ROLE
You will report directly to the Medical Director and work across three areas: corporate sales, being the clinic's face on social media, and marketing strategy. You'll get full training on our services and on the MOH rules for healthcare advertising.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Corporate sales & partnerships
Work with our doctors to put together corporate packages from our services, such as annual health screening, longevity assessments, wellness programmes, treatment-credit plans and staff perks
Find prospective corporate clients, reach HR, benefits and management decision-makers, and arrange meetings
Meet clients at their offices across Singapore, present proposals, negotiate and close contracts
Look after clients once they sign, including onboarding, scheduling employee screenings, organising health talks and wellness days, and handling renewals
Build referral partnerships with insurers, employee-benefits brokers, financial advisers and gyms
Track your pipeline and contracts in a CRM and report monthly
Brand, PR & social media
Be the on-camera face of Aquila: plan, script, film and post short-form videos and posts for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and LinkedIn
Grow our following and engagement with a consistent content calendar
Pitch stories to the media and represent the clinic at corporate events, health fairs and networking sessions
Make sure all content follows MOH's healthcare advertising rules
Marketing strategy
Plan campaigns and new-service launches with the Medical Director
Bring what you learn from clients and from content performance back into our offers and messaging
Coordinate with our Google and Meta advertising so that content, ads and sales support each other
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
At least 2 years of sales, business development or client-facing experience. Fresh graduates with a strong drive to sell are welcome to apply
Experience in health screening, employee benefits, insurance, wellness or healthcare is a plus
Motivated by commission and comfortable meeting new people every week
Comfortable and natural on camera, with experience creating social media content (a portfolio or account you're proud of is a plus)
Confident presenter and clear writer in English
Self-driven and organised, since you'll manage your own schedule and travel around Singapore to meet clients
Genuine interest in health, wellness and longevity
Basic video editing skills (CapCut or similar) are useful
WHAT WE OFFER
Base salary of S$3,000 – S$3,600 a month, depending on experience
Commission on the value of every corporate contract you close
Transport claims for client meetings
Direct access to the Medical Director and a real say in how the clinic grows
Office in the CBD at Robinson Road

Apply through MyCareersFuture with your CV.

Innovation Is Everywhere is a learning experience company that helps leaders of global organizations anticipate the future, embrace change, and lead transformation. Support new product launches, trade exhibitions, retail promotions and other business development initiatives.

Prepare regular sales performance reports, dashboards and data-driven insights to support business planning, sales forecasting and Management decision-making.
Monitor sales trends, campaign effectiveness, product performance and channel profitability, where applicable, and recommend improvement strategies.
Coordinate with internal departments to support order fulfilment, inventory planning, customer service and promotional execution.

Promote Motoserv and KlarDetail services and packages to target clients
Follow up on sales leads and close sales opportunities to meet targets
Maintain customer accounts and provide after-sales support to ensure client satisfaction
Collaborate closely with operations and marketing teams to align sales strategies and service delivery

Experience in B2B sales or business development

Low basic salary plus high commission structure
Transport allowance provided

Opportunity for career growth within an expanding automotive group

Multiple locations islandwide under Motoserv & KlarDetail network

Motoserv Automotive Franchise – Grow With Us
Motoserv is a trusted leader in Singapore’s automotive service industry, delivering top-tier car maintenance and repair solutions. With 10 outlets islandwide, we have built a strong reputation for quality, reliability, and innovation.
Today, Motoserv is expanding through a proven franchise model, empowering both independent workshop owners and young entrepreneurs to succeed in the automotive industry.
Vision
Our vision is to be the most trusted and innovative automotive service provider in Singapore. We aim to continuously expand our reach, improve our offerings, and set new industry benchmarks.
Comprehensive Services at Motoserv

Cutting-Edge Facilities

Customer-Centric Approach

Affordability and Transparency

Empowering Independent Workshops

Eco-Friendly Operations: Reducing waste and adopting sustainable materials.
Carbon Cleaning: Helping customers reduce their vehicles’ carbon emissions.
Hybrid and EV Focus: Supporting the transition to cleaner, more sustainable transportation options.
Training and Development
K-tech Auto Academy

*Business Development & Partnerships*
* Identify and develop new business opportunities that support GratiData's growth and monetisation strategy.
* Build relationships with telecommunications companies, advertising partners, content providers, creator/influencer networks, agencies and other strategic partners.
* Conduct outreach to prospective partners and arrange business discussions and presentations.
* Develop partnership proposals, commercial structures and collaboration models.
* Negotiate commercial terms and coordinate agreements through to execution.
* Maintain and develop relationships with existing partners.
*Advertising & Monetisation*
* Identify opportunities to grow advertising revenue and expand GratiData's monetisation partnerships.
* Develop relationships with ad networks, agencies, brands and other advertising partners.
* Work with internal teams and external partners to support the implementation and growth of advertising solutions on the platform.
* Monitor industry developments and identify new monetisation opportunities.
*Creator & Content Partnerships*
* Develop relationships with influencer agencies, creator networks, MCNs and content partners.
* Identify opportunities to onboard creators and content to the GratiData platform.
* Develop commercial arrangements for creator campaigns, content production and promotional collaborations.
* Support influencer and creator acquisition initiatives in GratiData's target markets.
*Market Expansion & Strategy*
* Research potential markets, partners, competitors and industry developments.
* Evaluate new countries and commercial opportunities for regional expansion.
* Prepare market research, competitor analysis and business cases to support management decisions.
* Assist management with financial and commercial analysis of potential partnerships and expansion opportunities.
*Project Coordination & Reporting*
* Coordinate with product, technology, marketing, finance and management teams to ensure partnerships are successfully implemented.
* Track partnership discussions, deliverables, timelines and commercial outcomes.
* Prepare proposals, presentations, reports and other business-development materials.
* Maintain an organised pipeline of prospective partners and opportunities.
* Provide regular updates to management on business development activities and progress.
*Requirements*
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, Economics, Communications or a related discipline.
* Relevant experience in business development, partnerships, sales, account management or a related commercial role.
* Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Strong commercial awareness and ability to understand different business and revenue models.
* Comfortable conducting market research and analysing commercial opportunities.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word.
* Highly organised and able to manage multiple discussions and projects simultaneously.
* Proactive and comfortable approaching and developing relationships with new partners.
* Strong written and spoken English.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with different teams.
*Preferred Experience*
Experience in one or more of the following areas would be an advantage:
* Mobile applications or consumer technology
* Telecommunications
* Digital advertising or ad-tech
* Influencer or creator marketing
* Content platforms or media
* Strategic partnerships
* Regional business development in Southeast Asia
*What We're Looking For*
We are looking for someone who does more than wait for opportunities to arrive. You should be comfortable researching a market, identifying the right company and decision-maker, making the initial approach, developing the commercial proposition, and following the opportunity through to execution.
The ideal candidate combines *strong relationship-building skills with commercial thinking and execution ability*. You should be curious, resourceful and comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where you will have the opportunity to contribute directly to the growth of the business.
*Why Join GratiData?*
You will have the opportunity to work on partnerships across telecommunications, digital advertising, content and the creator economy while helping scale a new consumer technology platform. The role provides significant exposure to senior management and the opportunity to participate directly in GratiData's commercial development and regional expansion.

Title: Communications and CSR Director East Asia
Description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
Could you be the full-time Cluster Communications & CSR Director iEast Asia we’re looking for?
Your future role
Take on a new challenge and apply your strategic communications and corporate social responsibility expertise in a new cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside dynamic, collaborative, and forward-thinking teammates.
You'll play a pivotal role in shaping Alstom’s image and fostering business growth across the country and emerging territories in East Asia. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (HR, project teams, Corporate/Sector publications), build trust with key stakeholders, and drive impactful initiatives that align with Alstom’s values and goals.
You’ll specifically take care of internal and external communications strategies, but also develop CSR programs that engage employees and enhance Alstom’s social impact.
We’ll look to you for:
- Building trust-based relationships with Communications management and Country MD to ensure the meaningful involvement of the Communications Department across projects.
- Developing and implementing employee engagement strategies in collaboration with HR.
- Managing the flow of information to employees using diverse communication tools (Intranet, publications, face-to-face meetings, events).
- Driving media relations, including press releases, press conferences, and social media presence.
- Supporting crisis communications at the country level.
- Organizing and managing internal and external events to enhance Alstom’s visibility and engagement.
- Managing branding and visual identity to align with Alstom’s corporate standards.
- Building CSR and employee volunteering programs and fostering relationships with NGOs.
- Leading a team and managing PR agencies and budgets effectively.
All About You
We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
- Educational background in PR, Marketing, or Communications.
- 15-18 years of experience in communications.
- Experience working with manufacturing or heavy engineering industries with a strong B2G (Business-to-Government) connection is highly desirable.
- Prior experience in journalism or at a PR/Corporate Affairs agency.
- Experience working in matrix organizations is a plus.
- Strong understanding of internal and external communication strategies.
- Proficiency in managing cross-functional teams and budgets.
Things you’ll enjoy Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:
- Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from boring daily routines.
- Work with cutting-edge communication and CSR strategies that drive meaningful impact.
- Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues.
- Contribute to innovative projects that shape the future of mobility.
- Utilise our inclusive and collaborative working environment.
- Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries.
- Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning.
- Progress towards senior leadership positions within Alstom.
- Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension).
You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!
Important to note
As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

Title: Communications Manager
Description:
About SG Her Empowerment (SHE)
SG Her Empowerment (SHE) is an independent non-profit dedicated to empowering women and girls and supporting targets of online harms. Our vision is to create a safe and equitable tomorrow for every person to thrive. Through community engagement, research, strategic partnerships and advocacy, SHE drives lasting, purposeful change.
For more information, visit https://she.org.sg
Our Culture — Who We Are
SHE is a team of deep and creative thinkers who thrive on projects that stretch them. We experiment, run pilots, and explore — because the problems we work on don't have ready-made answers. We value clear communication, shared goals, and a strong spirit of camaraderie. We are not afraid of challenging or being challenged, and we actively seek out different perspectives because we believe that's how everyone grows.
We also take our food very seriously.
If you are someone who wants to do more than a job — someone who invests in the people around them, shows up with curiosity, and brings energy to the room — you will fit right in here.
Who You Are
Beyond your technical skills, we are looking for someone with a specific kind of presence:
You communicate with warmth and directness — you say what you mean and mean what you say, and people feel at ease around you.
You enjoy frank, open conversations and don't shy away from healthy debate — with your manager, your peers, or senior stakeholders.
You build relationships naturally and invest in them deliberately — not because it's in the job description, but because people matter to you.
You are comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders — government partners, board members, external agencies — with confidence and poise.
You bring fun and lightness to the work without losing rigour. You know when to be serious and when to laugh.
You are here to contribute to something meaningful, not just to clock in and out.
About the Role
As Communications Manager, you will be the primary communications professional at SHE, working closely with the Director, Communications & Engagement to execute SHE's brand and media strategy. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role — you will own the day-to-day delivery of SHE's communications across media, content, digital, and campaigns.
You will collaborate horizontally across SHE's Programmes, Research, and SHECARES teams on communications that span events, advocacy, and public education. You will also take over the project management of our corporate website redevelopment — a defined, near-term project with an identified vendor, currently transitioning from our internal project lead.
This is a 1-year contract role with the potential for extension based on organisational needs and performance.
Key Responsibilities
Media Relations
Support media outreach and maintain media contact databases.
Draft press releases, media pitches, fact sheets, key messages, and media responses.
Coordinate media interviews, press events, and media enquiries.

Title: Communications Manager/Senior Communications Executive (6-months maternity cover)
Description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY
The Global Centre for Maritime Decarbonisation (GCMD) was established as an independent, non-profit organisationon 1 August 2021 to help international shipping decarbonise through pilots and trials. Its mission is to support decarbonisation through four pillars: shaping standards, deploying solutions, financing projects, and fostering collaboration across sectors.
GCMD was founded with the support of industry partners, alongside funding from the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (MPA) for qualifying research and development programmes. Since its founding, GCMD has expanded its ecosystem to include more than 130 centre- and project-level partners contributing funds, expertise, and in-kind support to pilot, accelerate the deployment, and scale the adoption of decarbonisation solutions.
GCMD has launched four key initiatives to close technical and operational gaps in: enabling ammonia as a marine fuel, developing an assurance framework for drop-in green fuels, unlocking the carbon value chain through onboard carbon capture and articulating the value chain of captured carbon dioxide, as well as closing the data-financing gap to scale the adoption of energy efficiency technologies.
GCMD is strategically located in Singapore, the world’s largest bunkering hub and busiest transhipment port.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Coordinate communications materials, including press releases, articles, reports, presentations and other corporate collateral.
Support media relations, including coordinating interviews and maintaining media contacts.
Support webinars, conferences and other industry engagements, including speaker coordination, event communications and post-event content.
Maintain communications resources and libraries, including media, photo, video and corporate materials.
Help ensure that communications materials are aligned with GCMD’s branding guidelines.
Update the GCMD website as required.
Help maintain accurate and up-to-date budget records.
Support the team in tracking tasks and deliverables effectively on our project management platform.
Support other communications activities as required during the maternity-cover period.
QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS, EXPERIENCE
At least 4–7 years of experience in communications, PR, media, content or a related field.
Strong writing and editing skills.
Comfortable managing multiple communications activities and deadlines concurrently.
Experience working with media, social media, websites and/or events.
Good stakeholder-management skills and comfortable working with colleagues across different functions and levels.
Organised and detail-oriented, with a disciplined approach to following processes and keeping tasks on track.
Willing and able to learn new digital tools, including AI tools, Adobe InDesign, WordPress and Monday.com.
Experience in maritime, energy, sustainability or another technical/B2B sector would be useful, but is not essential.

Portfolio of self-shot and self-edited vertical videos with at least 3 links, including view/save metrics if available
Proficient written English with a calm, warm, and unhurried tone, avoiding hype and clickbait
Working knowledge of video editing tools such as CapCut, Premiere, Final Cut, or equivalents, and design tools like Canva or Figma
Comfortable with heat and cold immersion and willing to practice sauna rituals weekly
Own a phone and laptop suitable for content creation
Based in Singapore with legal right to undertake an internship
Preferred competencies and qualifications
Comfortable on camera and willing to present to the lens when the shot calls for it
Prior content work for a consumer wellness, fitness, hospitality or F&B venue, where filming happens around live guests
Working knowledge of Meta Business Suite, native TikTok/Instagram scheduling, and reading platform analytics beyond surface reach

Genuine interest in one or more of: Nordic culture, endurance sport, longevity, sleep, or mental wellbeing
