Title: Content Creator(短视频内容创作者)Payes Singapore
Description:
About Payes
Payes 正在打造一个 AI + Community + Marketplace 平台，让全球每个人都可以把闲置资源、技能、任务和数字资产自由交易。我们相信未来不是电商，而是任务市场（Task Marketplace），人与 AI Agent 都可以成为平台的参与者。我们正在新加坡、印度等市场快速扩张，希望寻找热爱内容创作的人，一起把这个故事讲给全世界。
职位名称
Content Creator（全职）
工作地点
新加坡（可接受短期海外出差，如印度、马来西亚、香港、迪拜等）
薪资待遇
SGD 3,000–5,000/月（根据经验调整）+ KPI 奖金 + 年终奖金 + 晋升机会
你的工作
你不是摄影师，也不是剪辑师，而是一个能够持续创造内容的人。
你的核心目标只有一个：每天生产大量高质量、适合 Instagram、TikTok、YouTube Shorts、小红书等平台传播的短视频内容。
你的工作包括：
每天跟随创始人、团队及客户拍摄真实工作场景
策划并拍摄 15–60 秒短视频
采访用户、商家及合作伙伴
拍摄品牌故事、创业故事及团队日常
使用手机完成拍摄（iPhone 优先）
使用 CapCut、Premiere 等工具完成剪辑
使用 ChatGPT、AI 工具辅助脚本、标题、字幕及内容创作
管理公司 Instagram、TikTok、YouTube Shorts 等社交媒体账号
每周分析视频数据，持续优化内容质量
我们希望你具备
热爱拍摄短视频
熟悉 Instagram Reels、TikTok、YouTube Shorts 等平台
熟练使用 CapCut 或 Premiere 剪辑
具备良好的审美和镜头感
愿意出镜或采访他人（不是必须）
会使用 ChatGPT、AI 视频工具者优先
英文沟通能力良好，会中文更佳
有责任心，执行力强，学习能力快
加分项
做过品牌账号运营
做过个人 IP
拍摄过街访、Vlog、商业短视频
会摄影、航拍
会 After Effects、Runway、Veo、Midjourney 等 AI 工具
有金融、科技、Web3、AI 行业经验
我们更看重什么
我们不要求你学历有多高，也不要求你拍过电影。
我们更希望你每天都能持续创作，并且愿意不断学习、不断尝试新的表达方式。你需要关注全球优秀品牌（如 Western Union、Stripe、Airbnb、Notion、Apple、Nike 等）的内容风格，把优秀的创意快速落地，让 Payes 成为一个每天都有新故事发生的品牌。
你的成长机会
你将直接与创始团队合作，参与全球市场品牌建设，接触 AI、金融科技、跨境支付、社区运营等多个领域。未来你不仅是一名 Content Creator，还可以成长为品牌负责人、内容总监，甚至负责全球内容团队的搭建。
应聘方式
请发送以下资料：
个人简历
作品集（Instagram / TikTok / YouTube / 小红书均可）
3–5 个你最满意的短视频作品
简单介绍为什么想加入 Payes
如果你认为自己能够用镜头讲故事，而不仅仅是拍视频，我们期待与你一起打造全球下一代 AI 社区品牌。
About Payes:
Payes is building an AI-driven platform that combines community and a marketplace, enabling people worldwide to freely trade idle resources, skills, tasks, and digital assets. We believe the future lies not in traditional e-commerce, but in a "Task Marketplace" where both humans and AI agents participate as active members. We are rapidly expanding into markets such as Singapore and India, and we are looking for passionate content creators to join us in sharing our story with the world.
Job Title:
Content Creator (Full-time)
Location:
Singapore (Open to short-term overseas business trips to locations such as India, Malaysia, Hong Kong, Dubai, etc.)
Compensation & Benefits:
SGD 3,000–5,000/month (commensurate with experience) + KPI bonuses + Year-end bonus + Promotion opportunities
Your Role:
You are not just a videographer or an editor; you are a dedicated content creator capable of consistent output. Your core objective is singular: to produce a high volume of quality short-form video content daily, optimized for platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Xiaohongshu.
Your responsibilities include:
Capturing authentic behind-the-scenes footage of the founder, team, and clients on a daily basis Planning and filming short videos (15–60 seconds) Interviewing users, merchants, and partners Documenting brand stories, entrepreneurial journeys, and daily team life Shooting content using a smartphone (iPhone preferred) Editing videos using tools like CapCut and Premiere Utilizing ChatGPT and AI tools to assist with scripts, headlines, captions, and content creation Managing company social media accounts (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, etc.) Analyzing video performance data weekly and continuously optimizing content quality.
We are looking for someone who:
Has a passion for creating short-form videos Is familiar with platforms such as Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts Is proficient in video editing using CapCut or Premiere Possesses a good aesthetic sense and an eye for cinematography Is willing to appear on camera or conduct interviews (optional) Has experience with ChatGPT and AI video tools (preferred) Has strong English communication skills; Chinese proficiency is a plus Is responsible, highly execution-oriented, and a quick learner
Bonus Points:
Experience managing brand accounts Experience building a personal brand/IP Experience creating street interviews, vlogs, or commercial short-form videos
Skills in photography and aerial videography (drone)
Proficient in AI tools such as After Effects, Runway, Veo, and Midjourney.
Experience in finance, tech, Web3, or AI
What We Value Most:
We don't require a specific academic background or prior experience in filmmaking.
We value consistent daily creation and a willingness to learn and experiment with new forms of expression. You should keep an eye on the content styles of top global brands (e.g., Western Union, Stripe, Airbnb, Notion, Apple, Nike) and be able to quickly execute great ideas, helping Payes become a brand where new stories unfold every day.
Growth Opportunities:
You will work directly with the founding team, participate in global brand building, and gain exposure to fields such as AI, fintech, cross-border payments, and community management. In the future, you could evolve from a Content Creator into a Brand Lead or Content Director, or even take charge of building a global content team.
How to Apply:
Please submit the following:
Resume/CV Portfolio (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, or Xiaohongshu links are all acceptable)
3–5 of your best short-form video works
A brief introduction explaining why you want to join Payes
If you believe you can tell stories through the lens—rather than just shooting videos—we look forward to building the next generation of global AI community brands with you.

Benefits:
* Parental leave
* Professional development

About the Project
We’re looking for a Creative Director, Brand & Social to become the social-first creative partner within an embedded APAC team for a leading global hospitality brand.
This is not a traditional campaign Creative Director role. You’ll turn cultural signals, audience insight and everyday travel behaviour into visual stories and social-first content that make people stop, feel something and recognise themselves in the brand. You’ll live close to social culture, spotting emerging behaviours, humour and creative references before they become marketing trends. The work should feel boldly human, visually beautiful, culturally sharp and genuinely relatable.
You’ll bring a clear creative point of view, while working collaboratively with the client and Integrated Strategy Director to shape ideas quickly and take them into market. Strong producer instincts matter: there will not always be a large production house behind you. Success means creating a living portfolio of brand content that feels native to social, culturally relevant and premium – with enough craft to build the brand and enough agility to keep it current.
About the Role
Social-First Creative Direction
Turn culture, audience insight and travel behaviour into social-first creative ideas.
Stay close to the most interesting social content, formats and behaviours shaping culture.
Find unexpected ways to place the brand within the story rather than making the brand the story.
Create work that feels premium and distinctive without becoming overly polished, gimmicky or trend-led.
Use humour and relatability with intelligence and restraint.
Storytelling & Content
Build stories around relatable human moments and the emotional side of travel.
Develop social films, short-form video, creator-led storytelling, visual comedy and culturally responsive content.
Create a living portfolio of always-on content, destination storytelling and regional moments
Tell stories visually, not just through messaging.
Ensure content feels native to the platform and market it appears in.
Creator, Influencer & Regional Creative
Shape creative ideas for creator and influencer content while allowing creators to retain their own voice.
Develop ideas that can flex across priority APAC markets without losing the central creative thought.
Bring fresh references from lifestyle, fashion, beauty, sport, entertainment and culture.
Help regional teams translate strong central ideas into locally relevant content.
Hands-on Creative & Production
Take ideas from concept through to market-ready execution.
Work directly with writers, designers, creators, producers and specialist makers.
Move quickly from idea to prototype to production.
Know when an idea needs full production and when it can be made more simply and intelligently.
Maintain strong craft standards while recognising that polish cannot substitute for relevance.
Use AI and emerging creative tools where they improve speed, quality or creative possibility.

You bring 10+ years of experience in creative direction, social-first content strategy, brand storytelling, art direction, copywriting or integrated creative and senior stakeholder upselling experience.
You have a portfolio demonstrating strong ideas and beautifully executed work across multiple formats, most importantly, across social.
You understand the difference between producing content and building a story that creates brand memory and commercial impact.
You have strong experience across social, content, creators/influencers and static/video production.
You can take a strategic direction and translate it into emotionally relatable creative.
You understand how global brand platforms can be regionalised and localised without losing consistency.
You are confident presenting and selling ideas directly to senior clients.
You enjoy working closely with strategists and can move easily between strategy, creative development and production.
Experience within fashion, sport, luxury, beauty, lifestyle, entertainment or premium consumer brands would be particularly interesting.

Description:
This is Adyen

In this role, you will bridge high-level regional growth strategies with hands-on digital execution. This role will lead digital experience across the entire customer lifecycle while focusing heavily on net-new customer acquisition through paid, earned, and owned channel performance across the APAC region.
As a commercial conduit and trusted team leader, you will partner closely with local country marketers, global digital marketing leaders and regional commercial leaders. This is a player-coach role where you will not only coach and grow a high-performing digital marketing function but also be comfortable to roll up your sleeves to get into details and execution.
We are looking for a respected and trusted leader with experience in coaching and developing teams to perform at their best capacity
What you'll do
Regional Strategy & Leadership

- Search & LLM Optimization- Drive search strategy across regional markets, maintaining a forward-looking approach to search trends, user behavior, and modern AI/LLM discovery engines.

Analytics, Budget & ROI
- Budget Allocation- Manage, and continuously optimize quarterly and annual digital marketing spend across APAC markets to ensure maximum return on investment (ROI).
- Performance Analytics- Leverage analytics platforms (e.g., GA4, Salesforce, Marketo, Looker) to track campaign efficacy, model multi-channel attribution, and extract actionable insights for rapid continuous improvement.
Your Background
- Experience- 10+ years of total experience in B2B digital marketing with a deep emphasis on net-new customer acquisition. Fintech or B2B tech experience is strongly preferred
- Leadership- 5+ years of team leadership experience, with a proven track record of developing multi-market, regional teams in APAC (e.g., Australia, SEA, Japan, India)
- Balanced Skillset- Ability to seamlessly balance strategic leadership with hands-on technical execution—from defining high-level commercial objectives to auditing campaign architecture and conversion flows

- Commercial Mindset- Strong business acumen with demonstrated success partnering with Commercial/Sales functions and tracking success against revenue-based goals (SAOs, Pipeline, ROI)
- Experimentation mindset- Evidence of cultivating a test-and-learn culture that balances strategic vision with operational execution
- Agency Leadership- Extensive experience managing regional digital agencies, media budgets, contract negotiations, and external partner performance
- Ability to travel up to 20%+ of the time across APAC.

Title: Digital Media Management Specialist , Entertainment
Description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION
Mediacorp is Singapore's largest content creator and national media network, operating a suite of TV channels, radio stations, and multiple digital platforms. Its mission is to engage, entertain, and enrich audiences by harnessing the power of creativity.
We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace where talent thrives. Our hiring decisions are made based on merit and fit-to-role. If you have a disability or special need which requires accommodation to participate in the recruitment process, please inform us when you submit your online application. We will be happy to support as necessary.
Thank you for your interest and application to this role. Please note that only short-listed candidates will be contacted.
RESPONSIBILITIES
This role has organisation-wide scope across entertainment content, covering the end-to-end management of digital media assets within the Production Asset Management ecosystem.
The role is responsible for metadata governance, AI-assisted tagging accuracy, taxonomy management, and the organisation of content to support efficient ingest, search, retrieval, reuse, localisation, and multiplatform distribution. It ensures that all media assets are consistently classified, rights-aware, and aligned with branding and data governance standards.
Working cross-functionally with Editorial, Production, Programming, Marketing, Digital, Technology, and Data Governance teams, the role supports the integration, adoption, and optimisation of asset management workflows, user practices, and system capabilities.
Candidates appointed to the role will also be cross-trained to support news-related workflows and operational requirements where needed.
While not responsible for content creation decisions, the role plays a critical enabling function by improving content discoverability, supporting compliance and rights visibility, enhancing AI-enabled workflows, and identifying opportunities for content reuse and operational efficiency across platforms.
Responsibilities:
Metadata and AI Tagging Management
Oversee the generation, review, and accuracy of metadata created by AI tools, including facial recognition, speech-to-text transcription, scene detection, object detection, logo recognition, speaker identification, talent identification, and location tagging
Develop and maintain metadata standards, taxonomies, genre classifications, keyword hierarchies, and tagging conventions aligned with entertainment content workflows
Ensure consistent tagging across drama, variety, lifestyle, reality, music, promotional, short-form, and archival assets to support accurate search and retrieval within the Production Asset Management system.
Maintain structured metadata for key entertainment attributes, including programme title, episode number, season, synopsis, cast, hosts, guests, locations, topics, themes, language, subtitles, ratings, rights windows, platform restrictions, embargoes, and promotional usage
Support improved content discoverability for internal users across production, editorial, programming, marketing, digital, social, distribution, and related teams
Workflow Integration and Asset Management
Manage the integration of the Production Asset Management system with entertainment production, post-production, promo, and publishing tools, including systems such as Adobe Premiere
Support efficient ingest, cataloguing, versioning, localisation, retrieval, reuse, archival, and publishing of entertainment media assets
Set up and maintain user roles, access rights, approval workflows, and asset permissions for production, editorial, programming, marketing, promo, digital, and technical teams
Ensure entertainment assets are properly organised for multiplatform use, including digital platforms, social media platforms, partner platforms, and commercial distribution
Work with stakeholders to streamline media handover processes from production, field teams and post-production into archival and publishing workflows
Quality Control, Rights, and Compliance
Perform regular quality checks on ingested video, audio, image, subtitle, caption, transcript, and promotional assets to ensure technical, branding, metadata, and compliance integrity
Oversee copyright management, talent rights, music rights, clip usage, third-party material, platform restrictions, embargoes, sponsorship obligations, and rights usage tracking
Ensure compliance with data privacy policies and content governance frameworks, particularly for facial recognition, audience footage, minors, and rights-managed material
Maintain adherence to archival, retention, backup, and preservation policies to protect the long-term value and integrity of entertainment content
Flag missing, inconsistent, outdated, duplicated, sensitive, embargoed, or incorrectly tagged assets and coordinate resolution with relevant teams
Training and User Support
Conduct training sessions and workshops for producers, promo teams, programming teams, marketers, and digital teams on AI-enabled search, tagging, metadata standards, and media retrieval
Develop user manuals, quick guides, workflow notes, and best practice documents for entertainment metadata management and AI-assisted asset workflows
Act as the primary point of contact for teams on asset-related issues, search and retrieval queries, metadata corrections, rights information, access permissions, and system feedback
Gather user feedback and work with Technology and Data Governance teams to improve system usability, tagging accuracy, workflow efficiency, and adoption across entertainment operations
Content Opportunity and Performance Monitoring
Monitor newly ingested and archived entertainment assets to identify content suitable for social media, promotional campaigns, digital features, highlights, compilations, recaps, or commercial reuse
Alert relevant content, marketing, digital, or social teams when there are strong opportunities to repurpose entertainment clips and assets
Monitor and report on system performance metrics, including tagging accuracy, ingest efficiency, search success rate, asset usage, storage utilisation, and metadata completeness
Propose workflow improvements based on user feedback, operational needs, emerging technologies, and evolving multiplatform content strategies
Support initiatives that improve content discoverability, archive value, entertainment content reuse, multiplatform publishing efficiency, and audience engagement
QUALIFICATIONS
Good understanding of entertainment content formats, including drama, variety, lifestyle, reality, music, short-form video, promos, interviews, and archival programming
Degree or Diploma in Media Management, Broadcast Technology, Mass Communication, Film, Television, Digital Media, Entertainment Management, or a related field
At least 3 years of experience in broadcast, entertainment, digital media, production asset management, post-production, content operations, or media archive management
Familiarity with Production Asset Management or Media Asset Management systems, preferably within a broadcast, entertainment, OTT, or post-production environment
Experience with media-related AI tools such as facial recognition, speech-to-text, scene detection, object detection, automated transcription, speaker identification, or metadata generation will be an advantage
Strong understanding of metadata standards, content taxonomy, SEO basics, digital discoverability, and multiplatform content workflows
Knowledge of rights management, talent rights, music usage, platform restrictions, data governance, and content security practices
Excellent communication and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively with creative, production, technical, programming, marketing, and digital teams
Detail-oriented, organised, and comfortable managing large volumes of media assets and metadata in fast-paced environments
Experience working in entertainment production, post-production, programming, digital content, or media archive environments will be an advantage
Prepared to work irregular shift hours, weekends, and public holidays where operational needs require

Title: Director, Digital Marketing (Paid Search)
Description:
Job Description
Job ID: MJ000389
About The Role
Paid search is Traveloka's largest paid channel and its most measurable one. You'll own it: the operating plan, the budget, the team, and the outcome, measured as incremental growth for the business rather than channel metrics.
We're changing how this function works, and this role leads that change:
- From markets to capabilities. Account structure and bidding run as regional disciplines, not country by country.
- From attributed to incremental. One measure of success that finance and leadership trust.
- From manual to automated. Build in-house capability in bidding and optimisation, and automate the operational work so the team spends its time on decisions.
What You'll Do
- Own the paid search operating plan and a major share of the paid-media budget across our markets, accountable for incremental growth and profit.
- Lead through team leads and senior specialists: set priorities, targets and trade-offs, and hold the bar on how decisions get made.
- Re-architect the function from country-based to capability-based, and own that change end to end, including the people side.
- Set the standard for measurement and budget governance: incrementality testing, clear allocation rules, numbers that hold up under scrutiny.
- Build in-house bidding, optimisation and automation capability, and lead the team's hands-on use of AI to remove manual work.
- Run our most strategic platform relationships: negotiate early access, test scope and commercial terms through conflicting objectives.
- Build the bench: hire, develop, and where needed exit, and leave a leadership pipeline behind you.
- Position paid search for structural change: AI-driven search, privacy, and shifts in how travellers discover and book.
What You Bring
Must have
- 10+ years in performance marketing, growth or an analytically intensive role, including leading a team through managers.
- Owned a large paid-media budget against business outcomes, and can explain what you changed when the numbers told you to.
- Close enough to the data to challenge your own team's numbers. You can interrogate transaction-level data yourself.
- Led a structural change to a team or function as its owner, and saw it through.
- Designed or commissioned incrementality measurement (holdouts, geo tests, MMM) and made budget calls on the result.
- A quantitative degree (engineering, maths, statistics, economics, CS) or equivalent demonstrated depth.
- Strong communication skills with company leadership, and you can defend a recommendation under questioning.
Strong plus
- Paid search leadership at scale.
- Travel, e-commerce or marketplace background.
- Multi-market APAC experience across Southeast Asia, North Asia and Australia.
- Built in-house bidding or automation capability, or brought work back from an agency.
- A consulting or analytics background before marketing.

Title: Event Manager
Description:
Join Access Communications
Access Communications is one of Singapore's leading integrated communications agencies, delivering impactful PR, influencer marketing, social media, events, and strategic communications for renowned lifestyle and luxury brands.
About the role
We're looking for an Event Manager to lead brand experiences in Singapore across several clients at once. You'll take each event from brief to financial close, making sure it runs safely, stays on budget and meets brand standards. You'll also coach the event team and improve how we deliver.
What you'll do
Turn client briefs into event strategies with clear objectives and KPIs, and lead proposals and pitches through to contract award.
Run several projects at a time, managing timelines, budgets, risk registers and stakeholders.
Build event proposals covering timeline, venue, vendors, staffing and budget.
Lead venue selection, site visits and floorplans, and plan capacity and guest flow.

Manage vendors and production, including fabrication, technical, branding, F&B and crew, while protecting quality and margin.
Oversee the run-of-show, rehearsals and show calling, plus celebrity, talent, VIP and media moments.
Internal collaboration working with your PR, creative, production and finance teams, with clear responsibilities and handovers.

It is the central function that coordinates all internal and external communications activities for the company. Lead internal communications across Asia ex-Japan, working with teams in Hong Kong, Singapore, the Chinese Mainland, India, Korea, and Australia.
Partner with Nomura's business divisions — including Investment Banking, Global Markets, International Wealth Management, and Investment Management — to develop and deliver creative internal communications plans.

Develop crisis communications plans and help manage risks to the firm's reputation.
Collaborate closely with global colleagues to deliver projects and content that are broader in scale.
Manage townhalls, fireside chats, podcasts and other regional executive communication activity.
Align global strategy and messaging to ensure consistency in strategy, narrative, and messaging across region while preserving local relevance within a globally coherent framework.
Work with Human Resources and other corporate functions to strengthen company culture and how Nomura is perceived as an employer.
Manage one direct report and collaborate with wider teams to deliver initiatives and maintain consistency with global standards.
Build external networks to stay informed on industry trends and best practices.
Coordinate submissions for industry awards.

Minimum 10 years of professional experience in corporate communications, media relations, content writing, or journalism, with demonstrated focus on the financial services industry
Proven track record of managing communications across multiple geographies and teams simultaneously, demonstrated through regional or multi-market roles

The role helps translates institutional content for online audiences, while providing general support for stakeholder engagement, media relations, marketing or alumni communications when required.
Responsibilities
Content Creation and Digital Communications
- Conceptualise, script, coordinate, produce and edit short-form video and social media content for NIE’s platforms, including reels, event highlights, explainer clips, campaign posts and other digital formats.
- Plan and adapt content for different social media platforms, taking into account audience needs, platform formats, post timing, captions, visual assets, accessibility considerations and performance insights.
- Create, schedule and refine social media content in collaboration with the social media team, ensuring that posts are accurate, timely, engaging and aligned with NIE’s tone and positioning.
- Support NIE departments with content and campaign needs, including coordinating copy, visuals, short-form video, digital assets or other production requirements for institutional communications.
Stakeholder and Event Support
- Provide general coordination support for official visits, institutional events and guest-facing activities, including logistics, liaison, on-site support and follow-up where required.
- Assist with visitor experience touchpoints and other stakeholder engagement activities as required.
- Support institutional events such as graduation ceremonies by assisting with coordination, capturing content opportunities, and supporting related video or social media production needs.
Media Content and Communications Support
- Support the identification of mainstream media coverage, stories or institutional announcements that can be repurposed into social media posts, short-form videos or other digital content.
- Provide general support for media-related activities when required, including coordinating inputs, preparing basic materials, and adapting approved messages for use across NIE’s digital and social channels.
- Monitor media coverage and digital content performance to identify useful story angles, content opportunities and audience insights for NIE’s communications channels.
- Provide communications support for selected alumni programmes and activities, including adapting approved messages or event highlights into suitable digital content where required.
Requirements
- A polytechnic diploma in Communications, Marketing, Digital Media, Film, Media Production, Journalism or a related field.
- Prior experience in content creation, social media management, video production, digital communications, journalism, marketing communications or agency work is advantageous.
- At least two years of work experience.
- Strong writing, editing and visual storytelling skills, with the ability to produce clear captions, short-form scripts, social media posts, video storyboards and simple multimedia content for different audiences.
- Good organisational and project coordination skills, with attention to details.
- Ability to multi-task and work under tight timelines.
- Interest in digital communications, social media trends, video storytelling, institutional branding and public sector or education-related content.
- Proficiency with social media platforms and basic content production tools is essential, including familiarity with short-form video editing, visual design, caption writing and content scheduling tools.

As part of the Marketing & Customer Experience team, you will work alongside experienced marketers across a diverse portfolio of automotive and customer-focused businesses.
Unlike a traditional single-brand role, this position offers exposure to multiple business segments and different areas of marketing. You will gain hands-on experience in integrated campaigns, customer engagement, events, partnerships, marketing operations and brand development while working closely with commercial and cross-functional teams.

- Prepare presentations, reports, business updates and marketing materials for management and internal stakeholders.

- Familiarity with digital marketing channels, customer journeys, content development and campaign-performance metrics.

Title: Executive, Brand Photography Operations, APEC (6 Months Contract)
Description:
Additional Information
Job Number26134805
Job CategoryAdministrative
Location2 Harbourfront Place #06-08, Bank of America, Singapore 098499, Singapore
ScheduleFull Time
Located Remotely?N
Position Type Non-Management
JOB SUMMARY:
The Executive, Brand Photography Operations, will provide project coordination and operational support to the Manager, Brand Photography, for hotel photography projects across Premium, Select, and Midscale brands in APEC.
The role will support the end-to-end photography workflow, from project initiation and pre-production through image-review coordination, final documentation, and asset delivery. The Executive will help ensure that projects progress according to agreed timelines, submissions are complete and accurately recorded, and hotels and photographers receive timely process guidance.
The position will work extensively with Marriott’s photography platform and serve as a day-to-day coordination contact for hotels, Area teams, photographers, and internal stakeholders. Final creative decisions, brand approvals, photographer governance, process strategy, and escalations will remain with the Manager, Brand Photography.
This is a six-month temporary role established to provide operational capacity during a period of significant photography project activity.
SCOPE OF WORK:
Overall Project Management:
Photography project coordination
Create, maintain, and monitor photography projects on the photography platform.
Maintain accurate project trackers, timelines, status updates, and follow-up actions.
Coordinate with hotels and photographers on shot lists, recce submissions, styling decks, post-production files, and final deliverables.
Follow up on overdue actions and flag timeline or submission risks to the Manager.
Schedule preparation calls, webinars, review sessions, and office hours.
Maintain clear records of project decisions, feedback, and approvals.
Pre-production support
Check photography requests, hotel information, shot lists, and project documentation for completeness.
Support introductions and coordination between hotel teams and approved photographers.
Confirm that relevant photography resources and preparation guidance have been shared.
Track recce decks, styling submissions, talent information, and supporting documents.
Consolidate submissions for Manager review and communicate approved feedback.
Image-review workflow support
Organize and prepare photography submissions for Manager review.
Conduct initial checks for completeness, duplication, file naming, and clearly visible inconsistencies against approved checklists.
Record and communicate approved comments to photographers.
Track revised submissions and confirm that comments have been addressed.
Reconcile approved images against the final shot list.
Escalate creative, technical, legal, or brand-interpretation questions to the Manager.
Final assets and compliance documentation
Check that high-resolution images, contact sheets, usage-rights documentation, and applicable talent or model releases have been received.
Organize final asset packages in the appropriate systems and folders.
Prepare documentation required for LOC review and issuance by the Manager.
Support the transfer of approved assets and documentation to relevant hotel and internal teams.
Maintain records of legacy, rendered, limited, or temporary assets and their documented expiry information.
AURA administration and reporting
Monitor platform dashboards, notifications, pending submissions, and project status.
Support hotels and photographers with routine system and process questions.
Maintain data accuracy across project records.
Prepare regular status reports covering open projects, delayed actions, upcoming shoots, and pending reviews.
Identify recurring workflow issues and recommend practical process improvements.
Support testing and documentation for approved platform enhancements.
Vendor and administrative support
Maintain current photographer contact and market-coverage information.
Coordinate collection of quotations and vendor-registration documents.
Check invoices against approved quotations, shot lists, and final delivered assets before routing them for approval.
Maintain organized records of agreements, invoices, approvals, and project documentation.
Provide other photography coordination support assigned by the Manager.
CANDIDATE PROFILE:
Education and Experience:
Diploma or bachelor’s degree in hospitality, marketing, communications, photography, media, project management, or a related discipline preferred.
One to three years of relevant experience in project coordination, hospitality marketing, photography production, creative operations, content management, or brand support.
Experience working with hotels, photographers, creative agencies, or digital-asset workflows would be advantageous.
Direct professional photography experience is not essential, but an interest in visual content and willingness to learn photography standards are important.
Strong written and spoken English is required. Proficiency in an additional Asian language would be advantageous.
Skills and Abilities:
Strong organization and project-tracking skills.
Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and deadlines.
High attention to detail in files, documents, trackers, and asset packages.
Confidence using Microsoft Office, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, and digital workflow platforms.
Ability to follow established photography and brand standards consistently.
Clear and professional communication with hotels, photographers, and internal stakeholders.
Ability to distinguish routine coordination matters from issues requiring escalation.
Basic visual awareness and interest in architectural and lifestyle photography.
Ability to work independently on defined tasks while taking direction on creative and judgment-based matters.
Comfortable operating across multiple APEC markets and stakeholder groups.

Shape the future of places. Shape your future with us.
Real estate is a people business. At Frasers Property, we believe every space should serve a meaningful purpose - shaping how individuals, businesses and communities live, work and connect. Our properties are what the world sees, but our greatest assets are the people who make it all possible.

Guided by our purpose – Inspiring experiences, creating places for good, we take a long-term view and strive to create lasting value for stakeholders.

Every project begins with intention – shaped by local insight, community needs, and a commitment to sustainability and quality outcomes. Digital Marketing & Content
- Develop and coordinate marketing content across social media, websites and other digital platforms.
- Maintain content calendars and update digital platforms, in-mall promotional materials and marketing collaterals.
- Monitor digital campaign performance and improve work efficiency.
Marketing Administration & Reporting
- Prepare marketing reports, track campaign performance and support post-campaign evaluations.
- Monitor project expenditure and assist with budgets, purchase orders and processing of payments.
- Support in other marketing communications, administrative and ad-hoc projects as required.

- Good written, verbal communication and presentation skills.

Collaboration and mutual respect define how we work with each other and with our strong ecosystem of partners. We listen to diverse voices, embrace inclusion, creating environments where people feel they belong.
Join us, and you’ll work alongside passionate professionals who share our vision. Together, we shape environments that strengthen connections and improve quality of life. IDEA → CREATE → PUBLISH → ANALYSE → IMPROVE
Your responsibilities include:
Develop creative content ideas for students and parents
Shoot and edit TikToks, Reels, short-form videos and other social content
Write hooks, scripts, captions and engaging educational content
Turn complex academic concepts into simple, relatable and shareable content
Create content across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Telegram and our website
Identify social media trends and adapt them creatively for education
Work with teachers and the academic team to develop educational content
Monitor and analyse content performance
Identify what works, what doesn't and what we should try next
Engage with students and parents and turn their questions into content ideas
Explore AI and emerging digital tools to improve content creation
Support digital marketing campaigns and Bright Culture's overall brand development
This is a hands-on role. You'll have the opportunity to develop ideas, create the content and see how audiences respond to your work.
Competencies & Values
We're looking for a fresh graduate from a Polytechnic or University who is:
Creative, curious and naturally full of ideas
Passionate about social media and content creation
Genuinely interested in education and interacting with young people
Comfortable with video creation and basic editing
Able to understand trends without simply copying them
A strong communicator and storyteller
Willing to experiment and learn from failure
Comfortable working independently and taking initiative
Interested in both creative ideas and content performance
Open to feedback and constantly looking to improve
Relevant backgrounds include Marketing, Digital Marketing, Mass Communication, Media, Advertising, Design, Creative Media, Business, Education or related fields.
Your academic qualification matters, but your creativity, portfolio, attitude and values matter more.
THIS IS VERY IMPORTANT
We are not looking for someone who simply wants a social media job.
We're looking for someone who genuinely believes in what we're trying to achieve in education.
You should care about making learning:
More engaging.
More relatable.
More memorable.
More human.
We want someone who can look at a boring topic and think:
“How can we make this interesting?”
Look at a difficult concept and think:
“How can we explain this differently?”
See a viral video and think:
“Why did this work, and how could we create our own version?”

Title: Global Assistant Brand Manager - Vaseline
Description:
JOB TITLE: GLOBAL ASSISTANT BRAND MANAGER - VASELINE
LOCATION: SINGAPORE
About Unilever International
Unilever International is Unilever's agile, entrepreneurial route to market for white-space and complementary portfolio opportunities. We bring iconic brands and new formats to consumers across geographies and channels, working with a founder's mindset to serve underserved demand. Our people connect global scale with local opportunity, move decisively across boundaries and build practical solutions that unlock growth.
Job Purpose
This role will help shape and deliver the next phase of growth for Skincare brands across Unilever International. The Assistant Global Brand Manager will translate the Vaseline Skincare Body growth strategy into a focused innovation and market deployment agenda, with end-to-end ownership across new product development, tailored local marketing plans and global innovation roll-outs.
This is a commercially accountable brand-building role for an experienced marketer who can move confidently between strategy and execution. The role will identify growth opportunities across Petroleum Jelly, Body Lotions and emerging formats; build compelling business cases; lead cross-functional innovation; and partner with markets to land launches and campaigns with pace, relevance and excellence.
WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS
Vaseline is one of our priority growth brands within Unilever International, with significant opportunity to strengthen the total Body portfolio. The role provides dedicated leadership to convert global pipelines and local market opportunities into scalable, profitable growth. It will connect Global Brand, Business Group and Business Unit teams with R&D, Supply Chain, Finance, Customer Development, regulatory, agencies and market partners, ensuring that the right innovations and marketing plans reach consumers with strong commercial discipline.
What Will Your Main Responsibilities Be
- Own the Skincare Body growth agenda: Support the development and execution of a clear, multi-year growth strategy across core and emerging body formats, grounded in consumer needs, market whitespace, brand fit and commercial attractiveness.
- Lead end-to-end New Product Development: Translate priority opportunities into robust innovation projects, from insight, concept and proposition through business case, product development, packaging, claims, launch readiness and post-launch review.
- Build an efficient innovation roll-out engine: Work with the Beauty & Wellbeing Innovations Lead and cross-functional partners to improve portfolio deployment, engage the right stakeholders at the right stage and accelerate projects that meet size-of-prize and profitability guardrails.
- Drive global innovation roll-outs: Assess global innovations for Unilever International, define the right market and portfolio fit, adapt the mix where required and lead disciplined deployment across priority markets.
- Create tailored local marketing plans: Partner with Business Unit Brand Leads and Business Development teams to translate global brand platforms into locally relevant plans across key visuals, digital, retail activation, PR, influencer and customer programmes.
- Lead major brand campaigns: Own selected Body campaigns and activation programmes, ensuring that the strategic idea, asset ecosystem and market deployment plan build the total brand and support priority ranges.
- Shape the long-range innovation plan: Build and maintain a three-year innovation roadmap for Body, mapping global pipelines and local whitespace
- Make commercially grounded choices: Develop size-of-prize, pricing, margin and investment cases with Finance and Supply Chain; prioritize the highest-value opportunities; and recommend where to scale, adapt, defer or stop.
- Own performance tracking: Monitor the total Body P&L and launch scorecards, including turnover, incremental turnover, underlying sales growth, gross margin, brand investment and unit economics, translating performance into clear corrective actions.
- Lead cross-functional delivery: Align Brand, R&D, Supply Chain, procurement, Finance, Customer Development, regulatory, legal, artwork, agencies and markets around clear milestones, decisions, risks and accountable owners.
- Influence senior stakeholders: Prepare sharp recommendations and leadership updates, surface risks early and drive timely decisions across a complex global and regional stakeholder network.
- The roles of duties are not exhaustive and may change according to business requirements.
What You Need To Succeed
Essential experience and qualifications
- 3-5 years of relevant brand management, innovation, category or commercial marketing experience, preferably within FMCG, beauty, personal care or consumer healthcare.
- Demonstrated experience owning meaningful brand or innovation workstreams from strategy through execution, with clear evidence of commercial thinking and delivery impact.
- Strong grounding in core marketing fundamentals, including consumer insight, positioning, innovation development, marketing mix creation, communications, go-to-market planning and performance evaluation.
- Experience building business cases and using P&L, market, consumer and customer data to make prioritization decisions.
- Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and external partners across markets and time zones, influencing without formal authority and resolving ambiguity with ownership.
- Strong project leadership, with the discipline to manage milestones, dependencies, risks, budgets and decision forums across multiple concurrent initiatives.
- Excellent written and verbal English, with the confidence to present recommendations, challenge constructively and communicate clearly with senior stakeholders.
- Bachelor degree or equivalent experience in marketing, business, economics, communications or a related discipline.
Preferred Experience
- Experience in global or regional brand management, innovation development, portfolio strategy, localisation or multi-market deployment.
- Experience working on skincare, body care or adjacent beauty and personal care categories.
- Exposure to product, packaging, claims and artwork development, with an understanding of regulatory and production requirements.
- Experience partnering with Customer Development or commercial teams to translate brand strategy into channel and customer activation.
- Flexibility to support occasional early-morning or evening meetings across Asia, Europe and North America when critical business milestones require it.
Core Skills
- Brand strategy and portfolio management
- Consumer and market insight
- End-to-end innovation and NPD leadership
- Integrated marketing and local market activation
- Commercial acumen and P&L understanding
- Business case development and prioritisation
- Cross-functional leadership and senior stakeholder influence
- Structured problem solving and decision quality
- Project and budget management
- Learning agility, resilience and ownership
THE LEADERSHIP WE EXPECT
You operate as a brand owner, not a project coordinator. You can frame the opportunity, make a recommendation, align diverse stakeholders and drive the work through to measurable market impact. You stay close enough to the detail to protect quality while keeping sight of the strategic and commercial objective. You are curious about consumers, decisive with data, comfortable challenging established approaches and motivated by building repeatable growth platforms rather than delivering isolated activities.

Title: Head of APJ Field Marketing
Description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
About The Role
As the Head Field Marketing, APJ , you are the chief marketing architect of our go-to-market engine across the Enterprise and Strategic teams. You will lead a high-performing team of Field Marketing Managers to design, execute, and optimize regional marketing strategies that drive pipeline and revenue.
We are looking for a player-coach who is as comfortable interpreting a dashboard as they are commanding a room during a QBR. If you think business-first, are outcome-obsessed and thrive in high-growth, fast-paced environments, we want to talk.
What You’ll Do
Strategic Leadership & Revenue Growth
- Architect the Theater Strategy: Develop comprehensive marketing plans across regions, segments, and industries to both land and expand in the largest enterprise accounts.
- Deliver theatre growth plans: Build differentiated strategies, scalable programs, and world class events across buying personas and industries, delivering at-scale and account-based tactics. You also won’t be afraid to jump in and execute alongside your team!
- Galvanize Sales Partnerships: Act as a trusted strategic advisor to Sales and Inside Sales Leadership through compelling executive presentations, insights-driven recommendations, and business reviews.
- Outcome Optimization: Track lead flow from initial touchpoint to closed-won revenue. Partner with Sales Ops to refine conversion metrics and maximize ROI.
Team Orchestration & Development
- Lead a Remote Fleet: Manage and mentor a geographically dispersed team. You’ll be responsible for hiring, onboarding, and fostering a culture of high performance and continuous learning.
- Drive cultural excellence: Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, data-driven decision-making, and collaborative execution across geographically distributed teams.
- Develop future leaders: Own talent strategy including succession planning, career pathing, and leadership development to build bench strength for sustained growth.
- Cross-Functional Advocacy: Serve as the "voice of the theater" back to Corporate Marketing to ensure regional needs are met and global initiatives are successfully localized.
Analytics, Insights & Business Acumen
- Establish executive-level reporting: Build comprehensive dashboards and KPI frameworks that track pipeline, program ROI, and business impact.
- Drive data-informed strategy: Leverage analytics to identify growth opportunities, optimize resource allocation, measure program effectiveness, and demonstrate marketing's contribution to revenue.
- Continuously optimize: Develop feedback loops and refinement processes that improve investment efficiency and program performance.
- Budget Ownership: Manage the APAC roll-up budget, ensuring every dollar is allocated toward high-impact activities.
You may be a fit if
- Proven people leader: 10+ years of progressive leadership experience with a track record of building, scaling, and inspiring high-performing marketing teams
- Coaching excellence: Demonstrated ability to develop talent, drive career growth, and create environments where top performers thrive
- Change management prowess: Ability to lead organizational transformation, drive adoption of new processes, and navigate ambiguity in fast-paced, high-growth environments
- The Data Storyteller: You don't just report numbers; you provide insights. You are fluent in the metrics that drive the business
- The Communicator: Exceptional presentation skills. You can build trust with C-suite executives and external partners alike

Description:

About The Role
Lead marketing and communications for CBRE across Singapore and Indonesia, and position the company as the pre-eminent real estate thought leader in both markets. Using earned and owned media, digital and social channels, events and research-led content, you will build share of voice and turn CBRE’s market intelligence into commercial advantage.
Armed with strong media relationships, you will identify opportunities to profile subject matter experts and work closely with them to deliver differentiated points of view on the real estate industry. You will lead a team of five to eight marketing and communications professionals, own the country marketing budget, and act as a trusted adviser to country and business line leadership.
This is a senior, hands-on leadership role in a matrix environment. You will set strategy and stay close enough to the work to deliver it.
What You’ll Do
Strategy and business partnering
‒ Develop and deliver an integrated, ROI-focused marketing and communications strategy across Singapore and Indonesia, covering public relations, digital and social, events, internal communications and brand.
‒ Partner country leadership and business line leaders so that marketing and communications operates as a business enabler rather than a service desk.
‒ Own and manage the country marketing budget, with clear reporting of spend against outcomes.
‒ Set the measurement standard for the function, covering share of voice, campaign performance, event contribution to pipeline and digital engagement, and report against it to leadership each quarter.
‒ Contribute to regional marketing and communications initiatives and project roll-outs across Asia Pacific.
Public relations and media
‒ Act as the key media liaison in Singapore and Indonesia, identifying and pitching stories and securing profiling opportunities for business leaders.
‒ Develop compelling messages, media releases, media responses, byline articles and speeches for senior management.
‒ Build and maintain relationships with tier-one business, property and trade media across both markets.
‒ Manage PR agency partners, including scope, performance, deliverables and budget.
‒ Support regional and global teams on issues and crisis communications, preparing local statements, briefing spokespeople and managing local media response, escalating in line with CBRE protocol.
‒ Maintain spokesperson briefing materials and question-and-answer documents, and arrange media training for senior leaders.
Events and industry engagement
‒ Own the events strategy end to end, from flagship client events and research launches to executive roundtables, industry sponsorships and internal town halls.
‒ Manage event budgets, venue and vendor selection, run of show, speaker preparation and post-event follow-up, with clear measurement of commercial return.
‒ Develop an influencer and industry body engagement strategy, including CBRE’s presence and speaking platforms at key industry events in both markets.
Content, research marketing and digital
‒ Work with CBRE Research to turn market intelligence into campaign-ready content and to build launch moments around flagship reports.
‒ Drive lead generation through social and digital channels, working with regional digital teams on campaign build, targeting, marketing technology and reporting.
‒ Act as brand custodian for both markets, maintaining CBRE brand standards across every piece of external and internal output.
‒ Support business development and pursuit teams with marketing collateral and credentials for major client bids.
Internal communications and employer brand
‒ Drive internal communications for employee engagement, change communications and leadership visibility.
‒ Strengthen CBRE’s employer brand in partnership with the People team, supporting recruitment and retention priorities.
Team leadership
‒ Lead, coach and develop a team of five to eight professionals across PR, digital, events and internal communications.
‒ Set objectives, manage performance and build capability and succession within the team.
‒ Provide direction and quality control across all local marketing initiatives and campaigns.
What You’ll Need
Experience: essential
‒ Degree holder with 12 to 14 years’ experience in marketing and communications.
‒ Within that, a minimum of three to four years leading public relations and events at a senior level, with direct accountability for media strategy and for flagship event delivery.
‒ Experience gained in a multinational or large listed organisation with multiple stakeholders, matrix reporting and regional or global reporting lines. This is a requirement, not a preference.
‒ Proven record of managing PR and event agencies, including briefing, performance management and budget control.
‒ Demonstrated ownership of a marketing budget, with the ability to report return on that spend.
‒ People leadership experience, having managed a team of five or more.
‒ Established media relationships in Singapore, with proven ability to secure tier-one coverage.
Experience: advantageous
‒ Indonesia market exposure, or a demonstrated track record of building media relationships in a new market.
‒ Real estate, professional services, financial services or agency background.
‒ Experience supporting issues or crisis communications within an established corporate protocol.
‒ Bahasa Indonesia or Mandarin in addition to strong written and spoken English in view of the in-country market communications.
Skills and attributes
‒ Proven expertise in social and digital marketing, including campaign measurement and marketing technology platforms.
‒ Credible with senior stakeholders, and comfortable advising and constructively challenging country and business line leadership.
‒ Creative problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a dynamic environment with competing priorities.
‒ A positive, can-do attitude and readiness to roll up the sleeves and get the job done.
‒ Willingness to travel between Singapore and Indonesia as the role requires.
Why CBRE
When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to chart your own course and realize your potential. We welcome all applicants.

OUR VALUES IN HIRING
At CBRE, we are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong. We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and we welcome all applications.

(NYSE: CBRE), a Fortune 500 and S&P 500 company headquartered in Dallas, is the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm and a premier provider of critical infrastructure services. The company has more than 155,000 employees serving clients in more than 100 countries. CBRE serves clients through four business segments: Advisory (leasing, sales, debt origination, mortgage servicing, valuations); Building Operations & Experience (facilities management, property management, flex space & experience, critical infrastructure); Project Management (program management, project management, cost consulting); Real Estate Investments (investment management, development). Head of Trade Marketing and Retail

Strong Trade Marketing and channel development experience.
Experience developing and executing promotional and customer growth strategies.
Demonstrated success in commercial negotiations and account management.

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including financial modeling and data analysis.
Strong PowerPoint presentation and business storytelling skills.
Experience working with SAP ERP systems.
Strong analytical, commercial planning, and business intelligence capabilities.
Ability to build business cases, ROI analyses, channel profitability models, and forecasting tools.

Commercially aggressive with a strong growth mindset.
Highly analytical and data-driven.
Strong decision-making and problem-solving abilities.
Confident communicator with excellent stakeholder management skills.
Results-oriented with a strong execution focus.

Title: Influencer Marketing Specialist
Description:
About the Role
RDIVC PTE LTD is looking for an Influencer Marketing Specialist who understands creators, social media culture and how meaningful influencer partnerships can help grow a brand.
You’ll manage influencer campaigns from creator discovery and outreach through negotiation, content execution, campaign management and performance reporting.
You’ll work closely with RDIVC PTE LTD’s production, marketing and regional teams to develop influencer partnerships that support our brand and marketing objectives.
What You’ll Do
Research and identify suitable influencers and creators.
Build and maintain strong relationships with influencers, creators and talent agencies.
Conduct influencer outreach and manage collaborations from beginning to completion.
Evaluate influencers based on audience, engagement, content quality and brand suitability.
Negotiate rates, deliverables, usage rights and campaign requirements.
Prepare clear influencer campaign briefs.
Coordinate content approvals and publishing schedules.
Ensure influencer content meets RDIVC PTE LTD’s campaign and brand requirements.
Monitor campaign deliverables and deadlines.
Track campaign performance including views, reach, engagement, clicks and conversions.
Prepare campaign reports and recommendations.
Identify emerging influencers, creators and social-media trends.
Maintain an organised database of influencers, previous collaborations, rates and campaign performance.
Work closely with RDIVC PTE LTD’s marketing, production and regional teams on influencer campaigns.
What We’re Looking For
2–4 years of experience in influencer marketing, social media, PR, digital marketing or a related field.
Strong understanding of Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and creator culture.
Strong communication and negotiation skills.
Good relationship-management abilities.
Highly organised and comfortable managing multiple campaigns simultaneously.
Comfortable analysing campaign data and performance metrics.
Good understanding of social-media trends and online culture.
Proactive and able to work independently while collaborating with different teams.
Experience managing regional campaigns, finance, fintech, forex, lifestyle, sports or entertainment.

Manager, Admissions and Financial Aid (Outreach and Marketing)
Posting Start Date: 29/09/2026
Schemes of Service: Corporate

Reporting to the Head of Outreach and Marketing, the incumbent will co-lead the planning and delivery of outreach and marketing initiatives , working closely with team members and internal stakeholders to implement local and international student recruitment activities and support the achievement of recruitment objectives.
The role encompasses both local and international student recruitment, including building relationships with educational institutions, representing SIT at recruitment events and education fairs, and enhancing SIT’s profile among prospective students, parents and educators. Plan and deliver recruitment and engagement activities, including SIT Open House, learning journeys, education fairs, admissions talks and outreach programmes.

Represent SIT professionally at public engagements, presentations and recruitment events, both locally and internationally.

Manage assigned outreach, recruitment and marketing projects from planning through implementation, ensuring timelines, budgets and deliverables are met.
Contribute to team planning, process improvements and the development of new engagement initiatives.
Support cross-functional initiatives across the Admissions and Financial Aid Division.
Guide junior team members or project teams where required.
Undertake additional duties and special projects as assigned.

Title: Manager, Customer Lifecycle Marketing

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

This is an opportunity to combine customer segmentation, CRM, analytics and campaign management to create relevant travel propositions across the customer journey — from awareness and trip planning through purchase, travel and repurchase.

- Develop customer engagement journeys across pre-trip, during-trip and post-trip stages.
- Leverage data analytics to conceptualise, design and evaluate marketing campaigns and messaging.
- Develop upsell and cross-sell initiatives that increase customer engagement, spending and lifetime value.
- Manage marketing campaigns end-to-end to ensure a seamless customer experience.
- Track, report and evaluate campaign performance and translate data insights into actionable strategies and measurable outcomes.
- Define target segments, travel behaviours and campaign triggers.
- Conceptualise and design campaign processes and fulfilment channels across internal and external touchpoints.

- Operate effectively within a new and evolving business environment where historical data and established SOPs may be limited.

- Knowledge and experience within the B2C Travel segment.

Title: Manager, Exhibitor Marketing & Buyer Programmes
Description:
The Manager, Exhibitor Marketing & Buyer Programmes leads exhibitor-facing marketing and high-value buyer programmes across IAPL’s portfolio of shows.
The role supports exhibitor recruitment and retention through year-round marketing campaigns, while also taking ownership of hosted and high-value buyer acquisition, matchmaking and guaranteed meeting programmes that directly contribute to the value delivered to exhibitors.
The position works across InfoComm India and InfoComm Asia, as well as international buyer recruitment for InfoComm China. As a team member working closely with the Sales team, the role connects exhibitor requirements with qualified buyer acquisition and helps demonstrate measurable return on investment to exhibitors.
For InfoComm Asia, the role will work closely with the Senior Marketing Manager, who owns the overall visitor and audience strategy, with this position specifically responsible for the hosted and high-value buyer segment.
*KEY INDUSTRIES*
* Professional audiovisual and integrated experiential communications technology
* Emerging technologies including AI, IoT, 5G, AR/VR/MR, Big Data Analytics, Drones, Robotics, Content Development (Software), Wearables and Cloud Applications
*OVERALL RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES*
*Exhibitor Marketing*
* Lead and execute year-round exhibitor marketing campaigns that support exhibitor recruitment, retention and rebooking across IAPL’s portfolio of shows.
* Achieve agreed sales-accepted lead targets for exhibitor recruitment and provide Sales with a consistent pipeline of qualified prospects.
* Develop exhibitor-facing marketing materials including sector collateral, sales prospectuses, case studies, testimonials and ROI evidence that support the Sales team in converting prospects.
* Own exhibitor communications across the pre-show, onsite and post-show journey, ensuring communications are timely, accurate and relevant.
* Develop campaigns that demonstrate the business value and ROI of participating in IAPL’s exhibitions.
* Develop co-marketing and advocacy programmes with exhibitors to extend buyer reach.
* Support exhibitor retention and rebooking activities through post-show communications, performance reporting and ROI evidence.
* Work closely with Sales to understand exhibitor requirements, market feedback and commercial priorities.
*High-Value & Hosted Buyer Acquisition*
* Own and deliver hosted and high-value buyer acquisition programmes against agreed recruitment, attendance and quality targets.
* Source, identify and qualify senior decision-makers, buyers, specifiers and other high-value attendees relevant to the exhibitor mix.
* Manage the complete buyer journey including sourcing, qualification, invitation, confirmation, communications, attendance and onsite experience.
* Lead overseas hosted and local high-value strategic buyer programmes for InfoComm India and InfoComm Asia.
* Recruit and manage international buyers attending InfoComm China in collaboration with the China marketing team.
* Develop qualification criteria to ensure buyer profiles meet agreed programme requirements and are relevant to participating exhibitors.
* Monitor buyer registration and confirmation pipelines, identify potential shortfalls early and implement corrective actions.
* Manage buyer attendance and no-show rates to maximise programme effectiveness.
*Matchmaking & Guaranteed Meetings*
* Design, manage and deliver exhibitor–buyer matchmaking and guaranteed meeting programmes against commitments sold to exhibitors.
* Work closely with Sales to understand contractual meeting commitments and exhibitor buyer-profile requirements.
* Match qualified buyers with relevant exhibitors based on purchasing requirements, product interests, industry sector and other agreed criteria.
* Track scheduled and completed meetings against targets and contractual commitments.
* Identify potential meeting shortfalls early and work with Sales and relevant teams to implement corrective actions.
* Ensure accurate records are maintained for scheduled, completed, cancelled and no-show meetings.
* Collect feedback from exhibitors and buyers to continuously improve the matchmaking programme.
*Agency, Vendor & Programme Management*
* Manage buyer acquisition agencies, matchmaking platforms and event vendors against agreed scope, budget, timeline and performance targets.
* Establish clear KPIs and deliverables for external agencies and vendors.
* Monitor agency performance including buyer quality, attendance, cost per qualified buyer and delivery against contracted targets.
* Ensure external expenditure remains within approved budgets and flag potential variances in a timely manner.
* Evaluate vendor and agency effectiveness following each show and recommend improvements for future cycles.
*Sponsorship Delivery & Fulfilment*
* Coordinate with Sales, Operations and Marketing to ensure marketing-related sponsorship and exhibitor deliverables are fulfilled as contracted.
* Maintain clear records of relevant exhibitor and sponsorship commitments and monitor delivery status.
* Work with Sales to ensure that buyer and matchmaking commitments sold to exhibitors are understood and appropriately delivered.
* Support onsite delivery of hosted buyer, matchmaking and exhibitor programmes.
* Produce post-show exhibitor ROI reporting jointly with Sales.
* Contribute to exhibitor NPS, satisfaction and rebooking initiatives.
*Data, CRM & Reporting*
* Maintain high-value buyer information within CRM and marketing automation platforms.
* Use CRM data to segment, target and track buyer campaigns.
* Provide timely updates on exhibitor lead generation, buyer recruitment pipeline, confirmed buyers, meeting volumes and overall programme status.
* Track campaign and programme performance against agreed KPIs.
* Analyse buyer profiles, attendance, meeting completion and exhibitor feedback to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Produce post-show analysis covering buyer performance, matchmaking results, exhibitor engagement and programme effectiveness.
* Maintain high standards of data quality and accuracy across buyer databases.
*Collaboration*
* Work closely with Sales on B2B/exhibitor promotion, marketing priorities, buyer requirements, contractual commitments and post-show reporting.
* Work with the Show Marketing Managers across shows to ensure high-value and hosted buyer programmes are aligned with the overall audience strategy.
* Work closely with Operations on onsite buyer and sponsor delivery.
* Contribute to marketing campaigns across IAPL’s three expos and work with counterpart teams across the wider global show portfolio.
* Maintain awareness of industry trends, key market players, buyer requirements and competing regional events.
*EXPERIENCE & ATTRIBUTES*
* 5–8 years of relevant experience in B2B sales/marketing, exhibition marketing, buyer acquisition, event marketing, exhibition sales support or a related field.
* At least 2 years of experience leading campaigns, programmes or projects with measurable targets.
* Experience in hosted buyer, delegate acquisition, audience acquisition or exhibitor–buyer matchmaking programmes is highly preferred.
* Experience within trade exhibitions, conferences, B2B events or related industries would be a strong advantage.
* Demonstrated ability to manage external agencies, vendors and programme partners.
* Commercially aware and comfortable working with targets, budgets and performance data.
* Strong numerical and analytical skills with the ability to monitor buyer pipelines, conversion rates and programme performance.
* Self-motivated and results-oriented, with the ability to achieve and exceed buyer and lead-generation targets.
* Dependable with strong follow-through on commitments made to exhibitors and internal stakeholders.
* Highly organised with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple programmes simultaneously.
* Experienced with marketing automation and CRM platforms such as HubSpot or equivalent, and confident working with database segmentation, data quality and analysis.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and customer service skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills.
* Self-starter, problem solver and collaborative team player.
* Ability to work effectively in a matrix environment and with global teams.
* Able and willing to travel domestically and internationally as required.
*WHAT WE OFFER*
* Remote / work-from-home arrangement
* Health benefits
* Multicultural and international working environment
* Regional exposure across China, India, Malaysia and Southeast Asia
* Opportunity to develop and manage high-value buyer and exhibitor programmes across three major professional audiovisual trade shows
* Collaboration with international teams across a global portfolio of professional audiovisual exhibitions
