Job Summary
The Marketing and Communications Manager is part of an important team that creates and executes property-level communications to our customers. Under the leadership of the Director of Marketing and Communication, this role promotes on-brand messaging to customers through traditional, digital, and social media channels all with the goal of enhancing the image of the hotel. This role helps build direct marketing plans, targeted campaigns, and activated channels to the end of driving consumer awareness and preference, increasing market share, and building broader portfolio and brand awareness. This role focuses on showcasing Food and Beverage promotions, both to hotel guests and to local patrons. As part of the Marketing and Communication team, this role is fully connected into resources in their region; Marketing and Communication Managers liaise and build deep partnerships with their regional eCommerce and Marketing teams to verify all local, social, and digital marketing efforts are effectively integrated with the selling efforts for the organization. This role also gets to do a little bit of everything, from balancing traditional and digital marketing and eCommerce activities to contributing to public relations (PR) activities for the hotel. Success is measured by how well they help drive the sales and revenue strategy of the property, social media engagement and also by how effectively leveraged the resources around them are to create truly compelling marketing and communications campaigns.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education And Experience
Required:
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Marketing, Public Relations, Business Administration or related major and 4 years experience in the sales, marketing, digital or related professional area; hospitality marketing or digital advertising experience preferred
OR
- 4-year bachelor's degree in Marketing, Public Relations, Business, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales, marketing, digital or related professional area; hospitality marketing or digital advertising agency experience preferred.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Hotel Marketing and Advertising
- Executes annual marketing plan to budget, in consultation with the GM, Food and Beverage leader, Operations leaders, Director of Marketing Communications, and cluster marketing and ecommerce teams.
- Partners with Operations, Food & Beverage and Sales teams to execute promotions and campaigns to target in-house guests with promotions that drive incremental revenue to the hotel.
- Acts as the liaison between the marketing department and advertising agency on the tactical advertising campaigns' creative and media plans, particularly for food and beverage promotions.
- Manages F&B media schedules and verifies prompt settlement of accounts.
- Partners with property Revenue Management to verify correct offer loading, verifying advertisement targeting is correctly directed at relevant consumer groups
- Executes email marketing, and display advertising.
- Maintains frequent, active engagement with Cluster eCommerce manager to verify alignment, pull-through, and 2-way communication about the status, performance evaluation, opportunities, and issues related to online programs and initiatives.
- Verifies all advertising for the hotel in digital channels is in alignment with brand voice.
Social Media Content Management
- Facilitates social media engagement and updating content in local digital channels (e.g., hotel website, travel sites).
- Develops and executes promotions campaign in F&B, weddings, spa, rooms and conferences through relevant digital and social media channels.
- Engages in proactive online reputation management by surfacing relevant guest comments (positive or negative) in social media channels and responds accordingly.
Public Relations and Visual Asset Management
- Develops a comprehensive PR plan per quarter along with agency and and executes post sign-off from GM.
- Maintains a comprehensive list of local media contracts, with particular emphasis on food critics and bloggers.
- Manages assigned accounts as per the media account management system.
- Writes and distributes all press releases for property events, promotions, and outlets.
- Manages the execution of hotel sponsored events, community/government relations activities, and press promotional activities.
- Supports pull through of impactful PR strategy & activities to drive quality press coverage through media engagement, in alignment with communications objectives.
- Verifies the news clippings and other online, print, and social media mention report is completed on a monthly basis for property distribution.
- Manages external vendors and media agencies; works with agency partners and continent PR leader to identify strategic media buys for their hotel(s).
- Surfaces and vets PR leads from the continent PR Leader regarding which are the best media to promote the hotel.
- Supports the co-ordination of photography for F&B advertising, collateral and public relations purposes between the hotel, advertising agency and the regional field marketing teams.
- Manages photo shoots for seasonal or festive promotions in partnership with the cluster or area marketing team.
- Acts as central point of contact for regionally approved local photographers for food, amenity, and property imagery; coordinates with area or cluster marketing to verify all photography adheres to brand voice.
Direct Marketing and Collateral Development
- Coordinates and executes Hotel and F&B printed materials.
- Controls quantity and inventory of all Hotel marketing collateral and verifies copies are filed in a comprehensive manner.
- Assists in the production of all property, F&B display, and temporary signage in hotel public areas.
- Promotes collection of competitors collateral and publicity on a monthly basis.
- Manages the execution of F&B direct marketing activities.
- Verifies all collateral is as per brand standard guidelines and in compliance with Brand Standard Audit (BSA).
General
- Assists and manages the development, co-ordination and execution of all communications activities with a strong emphasis on property F&B promotions and campaigns.
- Helps with the publication of hotel’s newsletter(s).
- Supports communications duties and functions as deemed necessary.
- Assists in the liaison and execution of joint F&B promotions.
- Works with eCommerce to verify the Hotel’s website and related websites are updated on a regular basis.
- Partners with Director of Marketing to create marketing plan aligned to hotel sales and revenue strategy.
- Provides training and marketing leadership and act as a marketing subject matter expert for GMs, Sales Leaders and Managers, and Revenue leaders.
- Coordinates with property and above property eCommerce and Revenue Management teams to report success of property marketing and eCommerce performance.
- Keeps abreast of competition and its collateral, advertising, and marketing efforts and constantly evolving digital and marketing trends.

We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our Marketing team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.

The South East Asia marketing team supports business growth and brand awareness for Fidelity International across Singapore and the wider region. The team develops and executes marketing strategies for Intermediary, Institutional, and Private Banking channels, working in close partnership with Distribution, Investments, and broader APAC Marketing teams.
As a lean and collaborative team, we value accountability, adaptability, and partnership. Everyone contributes across different areas of work, ensuring we deliver effectively and consistently together.

This role requires a well-rounded marketer with strong financial product knowledge and experience delivering integrated campaigns across multiple channels and client segments.
The ideal candidate will bring creativity, a hands-on approach, and a growth mindset, combined with strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills. Title: Operations & Marketing Executive

This is a hybrid role combining operations, project coordination, marketing execution, events, customer engagement and management support. You will work closely with the Directors and act as a key bridge between management and the ground team, helping to translate priorities and instructions into clear action and follow-through.
Key Responsibilities
* Coordinate operational matters across centres and support day-to-day business operations.
* Translate management directions into practical action plans, coordinate with relevant teams and follow up on execution.

* Comfortable communicating with management, staff, parents, vendors and external partners.

Title: Performance Marketing Executive - AX26007
Description:
Actxa is a Singapore-rooted smart wearable company on a mission to make better health accessible at scale through technology. Built on years of innovation in connected devices and smart living, Actxa has grown into a trusted companion supporting individuals across the region in taking control of their wellbeing.
Our flagship product, the Actxa Core Smart Ring, features AI Glucose Scan, the world's first clinically studied, non-invasive approach to glucose awareness, delivering a Normal or Elevated reading in just one minute through a ring designed for everyday wear.
We are looking for a Performance Marketing Executive to manage and optimize the performance funnel across paid media and organic discovery, while supporting our channel sales partners with marketing execution. You will run and optimize paid campaigns across Meta, Google and TikTok, drive organic visibility through SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and support distributors and retail partners with the marketing tools they need to sell Actxa effectively. You will also help ensure that the Actxa Core Smart Ring and AI Glucose Scan are represented accurately and prominently wherever customers search, whether through a search engine or AI answer engine.
This is a hands-on, metrics-driven role suited to someone equally comfortable building a Meta Advantage+ campaign, briefing a retail partner's sales team, and investigating a drop in organic traffic following a Google algorithm update.
Paid Media (Meta, Google, TikTok)
- Plan, launch and manage paid campaigns across Meta, Google (Search, Shopping, Performance Max) and TikTok, aligned with revenue and CAC/ROAS targets
- Work within allocated budgets across channels and campaigns, reallocating spend toward the best-performing audiences, creatives and placements
- Build and maintain audience segmentation, retargeting and lookalike strategies across platforms
- Partner with the creative team to brief, test and refine ad creative and copy, running structured A/B tests across hooks, formats and offers
- Monitor pixel and conversion tracking, attribution and campaign health, and troubleshoot tracking issues as platforms evolve, including iOS/privacy changes, Meta CAPI and GA4
SEO & GEO
- Manage on-site and off-site SEO, including keyword strategy, technical SEO health, on-page optimization and content recommendations to improve organic search traffic and rankings
- Develop and execute a Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) approach to help ensure Actxa's products, claims and content are accurately surfaced and cited by AI answer engines such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and Perplexity
- Work with the content team to structure product and educational content, including schema markup, clear claims and FAQ formatting, for both traditional search and AI-driven discovery
- Track organic and AI-referral visibility, keyword rankings and share of voice against competitors in the smart wearable and glucose-monitoring space
Channel Sales & Marketing Support
- Act as the marketing point of contact for distributors, resellers and retail channel partners, supporting their sales efforts with campaigns, assets and promotions
- Develop co-marketing materials, including sell sheets, in-store/POS collateral, digital banners and campaign toolkits, tailored to each channel partner's needs
- Plan and execute joint promotional campaigns and trade activities with channel partners, aligned with regional launch and sales calendars
- Train and brief channel partner sales teams on product positioning, claims and key selling points for the Actxa Core Smart Ring and AI Glucose Scan
- Track channel partner performance and marketing ROI, and share insights to improve ongoing sell-through.
Reporting & Optimization
- Build and maintain performance dashboards across paid and organic channels, reporting weekly and monthly on spend, ROAS, CAC, conversion rate and organic growth
- Translate performance data into clear, actionable recommendations for budget shifts, creative refreshes and campaign improvements
- Stay current on platform updates across Meta, Google and TikTok, including algorithm and policy changes, and adjust execution accordingly.
Requirements
- Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Digital Marketing or a related discipline
- Experience in health tech, wearables, consumer electronics or FMCG is a plus.
- 3-5 years of hands-on experience running paid media across Meta and Google Ads; TikTok Ads experience is strongly preferred
- Working knowledge of SEO fundamentals, including keyword research, technical SEO and on-page optimization, with familiarity with or a strong interest in GEO and AI search optimization
- Proficient in the use of generative AI tools to support campaign planning, content development, customer and market research, performance analysis, SEO/GEO, reporting and day-to-day marketing execution
- Experience supporting channel sales or distributor and retail partners with marketing collateral and campaigns is a strong plus
- Comfortable working with GA4, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, TikTok Ads Manager and marketplace seller dashboards
- Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret performance data, identify trends and turn insights into actions rather than simply reporting numbers
- Excellent attention to detail, particularly when working with product claims and regulatory-sensitive content
- A self-starter who can manage multiple channels and priorities independently in a fast-moving team
Benefits

- A collaborative marketing team with direct exposure to regional growth strategy and channel partnerships
- The opportunity to experiment with emerging channels and AI-driven search and discovery ahead of much of the market

Title: Performance Marketing Lead
Description:
Trust is the first of a new breed of banks in Singapore – digitally native and focused on delivering a delightful customer experience. You will work in a fast-paced and collaborative environment to solve new and interesting challenges each day. Together with our Trust team, you will help shape the future of our bank.
Customer team at Trust is where strategy, design, data, and creative come together. The team drives design and marketing of all new products, brand building, launch campaigns, accelerating acquisitions, and boosting engagement and retention. They turn insights into actions, working across teams to scale what works and experiment with what’s next.
We're looking for a Performance Marketing Lead to join Customer team in Singapore. This hands-on leadership role will own the strategy, execution, and continuous optimisation of Trust’s paid acquisition engine. Your job is to make every dollar of paid media work harder, while amplifying, rather than competing with, the referral and word-of-mouth growth that has carried Trust to a million customers.
The Role Responsibility:
Own performance marketing strategy and results
- Set the strategy, budget allocation and long-term roadmap for paid acquisition across search, paid social, app install (UAC), programmatic and affiliate/partnership channels.
- Own acquisition KPIs end to end - CAC, conversion rate, activation, ROAS and downstream LTV, and report performance and outlook to marketing and business leadership.
- Manage a multi-million-dollar annual media budget, reallocating spend in real time based on channel efficiency and business priorities.
Run and scale the paid media engine
- Plan, launch and optimise always-on and campaign-based activity across Google (Search, UAC, PMax), Meta, TikTok, Apple Search Ads and programmatic/DSP platforms.
- Build a rigorous testing agenda - creative, audience, bidding strategy and landing page experiments to continuously improve efficiency at scale.
- Direct performance-focused creative briefs and work with in-house and agency creative teams to keep a high-velocity content pipeline feeding every channel.
Build the measurement backbone
- Own mobile and web attribution end to end, including MMP configuration (e.g. AppsFlyer/Adjust), SKAN and ATT frameworks, and server-side/first-party tracking as third-party signal degrades.
- Partner with Data and Engineering to build dashboards and incrementality/holdout tests that separate genuinely incremental growth from channel noise.
- Bring a strong point of view on marketing mix modelling and multi-touch attribution to guide budget decisions across paid, referral and on-ground channels.
Integrate paid, referral and on-ground growth
- Work closely with the growth and partnership team to design paid campaigns that reinforce (not cannibalise) Trust's referral programme.
- Identify where performance media can accelerate proven organic and word-of-mouth loops, and where it should step back and let them run.
Lead people and partners
- Manage and develop a small team of performance marketing specialists, plus media, creative and analytics agency partners.
- Act as the performance marketing voice in cross-functional forums with Product, Data Science, Finance, Legal and Compliance, translating regulatory and risk requirements into campaigns that are both effective and fully compliant with MAS advertising guidelines and internal fair-dealing standards.
Our Ideal Candidate:
- 10+ years in performance or growth marketing, including experience leading paid acquisition strategy at a consumer app, e-commerce, fintech, or digital-first brand.
- Deep, hands-on expertise across paid social, paid search and mobile app install campaigns (Google UAC, Meta, TikTok, Apple Search Ads), with a track record of managing meaningful budgets against hard efficiency targets.
- Strong command of mobile measurement partners (AppsFlyer or Adjust), SKAN/ATT, GA4 and attribution methodology in a privacy-constrained environment.
- Comfortable in the data SQL and spreadsheet-level analysis at minimum, and able to turn campaign and cohort data into a clear investment recommendation.
- A builder's mindset: equally comfortable setting quarterly strategy and personally troubleshooting a tracking issue or a stalled campaign.
- Excellent stakeholder management, you can hold your own with Finance on ROI and with Compliance on what a bank can and cannot say in an ad.
- Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, economics, a quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
Good to have:
- Prior performance marketing experience at e-commerce or high-growth fintech.
- Experience designing or scaling referral, loyalty or partnership-driven growth loops alongside paid media.
- Familiarity with Singapore's media landscape and MAS guidelines on financial promotions.
- Working knowledge of Python or scripting for marketing automation and reporting.

Title: Performance Marketing Manager
Description:
Our Journey
The ShopBack Group is Asia-Pacific's leading shopping and rewards platform, trusted by over 20 million active members across 13 markets, including Germany and the United States. Driven by the vision to make every day more rewarding, ShopBack saves members money and time with more ways to earn and more to do with what they earn, and empowers merchants and brand partners to effectively engage its members. Founded in Singapore in 2014, ShopBack now powers over US$5.5 billion in annual sales and half a million transactions a day for more than 20,000 online and in-store partners.
About The Role
As part of the Global Performance Marketing team, you will play a pivotal role in designing and implementing online media strategies to drive growth in acquisition, retention, and branding for the North America market. You will be working closely with local teams and regional stakeholders to foster strong partnerships, ensuring seamless coordination and execution of marketing initiatives across countries. If you are an experienced, self-motivated, and innovative online marketer, who is AI-forward, this could be the role for you.
Note: This role is based in Singapore, with frequent collaboration and timezone overlap with our US team (Texas, Austin)
What You'll Own
- Manage and own the performance of all relevant online marketing channels including but not limited to Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, and programmatic channels.
- Collaborate with local marketing teams to deliver localized strategy: campaign and media planning, and creative development.
- Analyze online paid media campaigns and product data to derive actionable insights for optimization purposes.
- Responsible for budget planning and execution, aimed at maximizing marketing effectiveness. Growth hacking through constant testing to discover new marketing opportunities.
Essentials To Succeed
- 7+ years of hands-on experience in online paid media for APP and Web products.
- Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or relevant experience.
- Proven track record of driving significant growth with marketing efficiency in the North America market.
- Proficient in managing campaigns across the following advertising platforms - Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, and programmatic channels.
- Excellent communication skills and stakeholder management are able to work across multiple markets and cultures, collaborate easily with others, and adapt agilely.
- Proficient in marketing tools, including Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Branch.io/ Appsflyer.
- Excellent analytical skills with a data-driven mindset to interpret and act on data insights.
- Growth hacking mentality and a holistic view of marketing strategy to discover key business opportunities.
- Self-starter with the ability to work independently, owning the problem and developing the solution.
- AI Competency: Demonstrated use of AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude) to develop new or improve workflows, enhance productivity, and drive efficiency at scale.
ShopBacker Traits
- Agency - We take ownership and act, rather than waiting for permission. When something's blocking progress, we find a way through it and follow through until it's done.
- Judgement - We aim for high-impact decisions, not just easy wins, and we put the bigger picture ahead of individual interests. That means moving quickly and confidently, while staying thoughtful about when a call really matters.
- Learning Velocity - We pick up new skills fast and let go of old habits just as quickly when something better comes along. We benchmark ourselves against the best and keep raising our own bar.
- Tenacity - We stay in it when things get hard, keeping a level head under pressure. We debate openly before deciding, then commit fully — and support each other along the way.

- Candid, open, and collaborative culture where feedback is valued.

Title: PILATES STUDIO MANAGER
Description:
STUDIO MANAGER
Position Overview
The
Studio Manager
is responsible for the continued growth, performance and culture of FS8, with a strong focus on creating a
community-led, high-performing and welcoming studio environment
.
This is a hands-on leadership role combining
studio operations, team leadership, client management, business development, training, community engagement, marketing and partnerships
.
The Manager will oversee the day-to-day running of the studio, lead and develop the trainer and front-of-house team, deliver exceptional client experiences, drive membership and revenue growth, and ensure the studio is maintained to the highest operational and presentation standards.
A key component of the role is being visible on the studio floor and building genuine relationships with clients. The Manager will deliver approximately
12 hours of client-facing training per week
, using this time to support client development, understand member needs, build relationships and strengthen the overall studio experience.
The successful candidate will be creative, energetic, organised and commercially minded, with a genuine passion for fitness and community. They will be expected to identify opportunities, develop new initiatives and help establish FS8 as a
community studio — not simply a place where people come to take a class.
Formal FS8 brand and methodology training will be provided.
Key Responsibilities
1. Studio & Operational Management
Take overall responsibility for the smooth and efficient day-to-day operation of the studio.
Manage studio opening and closing procedures, class set-up and pack-down, reception and front-of-house standards.
Oversee trainer schedules, cover requirements and studio timetable requirements.
Ensure all classes are adequately staffed and delivered to FS8 standards.
Maintain a clean, organised, safe and welcoming studio environment at all times.
Conduct regular checks of reformers, equipment, furniture and studio facilities.
Identify maintenance requirements and coordinate repairs or servicing where required.
Ensure equipment is appropriately maintained and reported when issues arise.
Manage studio supplies, stock and operational requirements.
Develop and maintain effective operational procedures and checklists.
Ensure all studio policies, procedures and brand standards are followed.
Monitor studio KPIs and use data to identify opportunities to improve performance.
2. Team Leadership & Staff Development
Lead, support and develop the studio team.
Work closely with trainers to ensure consistent delivery of the FS8 experience and methodology.
Support trainer onboarding, training and development.
Provide regular feedback and coaching to team members.
Assist with trainer scheduling, cover and performance management.
Create a positive, collaborative and accountable team culture.
Identify opportunities to improve team performance and client experience.
Encourage trainers to actively participate in studio community initiatives and events.
Work with senior FS8 leadership on trainer development and ongoing education.
3. Client Training & Experience
The Manager will remain an active part of the studio floor and will deliver approximately
12 hours of client-facing training per week
.
Responsibilities include:
Deliver high-quality FS8 classes in accordance with FS8 methodology and standards.
Build strong relationships with clients through regular interaction and coaching.
Understand individual client goals, motivations and challenges.
Provide appropriate guidance and recommendations to support client progression.
Identify opportunities to improve the client journey and overall studio experience.
Welcome new clients and help them feel comfortable and connected to the studio.
Recognise regular clients and create a personalised experience.
Proactively identify clients who may need additional support, encouragement or follow-up.
Encourage consistency, progression and long-term engagement.
Gather client feedback and turn it into actionable improvements.
4. Client Management & Communication
The Manager will take ownership of the client relationship beyond the studio floor.
Respond promptly and professionally to client enquiries across all communication channels.
Manage client communication through
Mindbody, Loyalsnap, WhatsApp, email and other relevant platforms
.
This includes weekly emails, promotion development and our corporate engagement.
Ensure leads and enquiries are followed up consistently and professionally.
Maintain accurate client records and notes within the client management system.
Monitor client attendance, engagement and purchasing behaviour.
Identify clients at risk of becoming inactive and implement appropriate re-engagement strategies.
Manage membership renewals, upgrades and conversions.
Communicate promotions, programs, events and studio initiatives.
Develop personalised client outreach where appropriate.
Ensure clients receive a high level of communication before, during and after their studio journey.
5. Mindbody & Client Management Systems
Take responsibility for the effective use and administration of
Mindbody
and associated client management systems.
This includes:
Managing client profiles and ensuring information is accurate.
Monitoring bookings, attendance, cancellations and no-shows.
Managing memberships, class packs and relevant client accounts.
Tracking leads and enquiries.
Monitoring client purchasing behaviour.
Supporting reporting and KPI tracking.
Identifying opportunities through client data.
Ensuring the team is appropriately trained in system use.
Maintaining consistent and accurate client records.
Using data to support retention, sales and community-building initiatives.
6. Business Development & Sales
The Manager will play a key role in driving the commercial performance and continued growth of the studio.
Responsibilities include:
Respond promptly and professionally to all enquiries.
Track and manage leads from initial enquiry through to conversion.
Implement systems to maximise enquiry-to-client conversion.
Promote and sell memberships, class packs, programs and studio services.
Meet and exceed agreed membership and sales targets.
Develop member sign-up, retention and renewal strategies.
Identify opportunities to increase client frequency and lifetime value.
Promote studio programs and initiatives consistently.
Develop strategies to increase class utilisation.
Monitor sales performance and identify areas for improvement.
Work with senior management on pricing, promotions and commercial initiatives.
Identify new revenue opportunities for the studio.
7. Community Development
A core objective of this role is to
build FS8 into a community studio
.
The Manager will be responsible for creating an environment where clients know the team, feel recognised and want to spend time at the studio.
This includes:
Developing a strong sense of community among members.
Creating opportunities for clients to connect with one another.
Developing regular studio celebrations and community events.
Celebrating client milestones, achievements and birthdays.
Creating member challenges and participation initiatives.
Developing social and wellness activities outside regular classes.
Encouraging trainers to actively engage with the studio community.
Creating initiatives that make clients feel recognised and valued.
Building relationships with local businesses and the wider MBFC community.
Identifying opportunities to make FS8 a destination within the local corporate and fitness community.
The goal is to create a studio where clients don't simply attend classes — they feel that they belong.
8. Studio Events, Celebrations & Initiatives
The Manager will be responsible for developing and executing initiatives that drive engagement and create memorable studio experiences.
Examples may include:
Member appreciation events.
Studio anniversary celebrations.
Birthday and milestone celebrations.
Fitness challenges.
Community workouts.
Wellness events.
Guest trainer sessions.
Corporate fitness initiatives.
Member competitions and incentives.
New program launches.
Seasonal campaigns.
Charity and community initiatives.
The Manager should continuously look for
new and creative ways to bring people into the studio and give existing clients a reason to remain engaged.
9. Partnerships & Collaborations
Develop and maintain relationships with relevant brands, businesses and organisations.
Responsibilities include:
Identify potential collaboration opportunities.
Develop partnerships with complementary fitness, health, wellness, beauty, food and lifestyle brands.
Build relationships with businesses within the MBFC and CBD community.
Develop corporate wellness opportunities.
Coordinate collaborative events and activations.
Negotiate and manage mutually beneficial partnership arrangements.
Ensure partnerships add genuine value to the FS8 client experience.
Track the performance and effectiveness of collaborations.
10. Marketing & Social Media
The Manager will work closely with the marketing team while taking an active role in the studio's local marketing and digital engagement.
Responsibilities include:
Support the development and execution of local marketing campaigns.
Create and identify opportunities for social media content.
Encourage trainers and clients to participate in content creation.
Promote studio events, offers, challenges and initiatives.
Engage with clients and the local community through social media.
Support Instagram and other digital channels with timely studio updates.
Identify local marketing opportunities within MBFC and Marina Bay.
Work with collaborative brands on joint marketing initiatives.
Ensure the studio's online presence reflects the energy and culture of the physical studio.
11. Training & Development
The Manager will receive formal FS8 brand and methodology training and will be expected to continually develop their own knowledge and skills.
Responsibilities include:
Complete all required FS8 training and education.
Maintain current knowledge of FS8 programming and methodology.
Participate in ongoing trainer development.
Support the development of the wider studio team.
Keep up to date with developments in the fitness and wellness industry.
Bring new ideas and best practices into the studio where appropriate.
Encourage a culture of continuous learning and development.
12. Cleaning, Maintenance & Studio Standards
The Manager is responsible for ensuring the studio consistently meets FS8 standards of cleanliness, presentation and safety.
This includes:
Ensuring reformers and equipment are cleaned and maintained regularly.
Ensuring the studio floor, mats, mirrors and communal areas are clean.
Maintaining reception, changing areas and client facilities.
Monitoring cleaning standards throughout the day.
Managing cleaning schedules and external cleaning providers where applicable.
Reporting and following up on maintenance issues.
Conducting regular equipment and facility checks.
Ensuring the studio is presented to a high standard before, during and after operating hours.
Creating a studio environment that feels professional, welcoming and premium.
13. Reporting & Performance
Monitor studio KPIs including membership growth, sales, retention, attendance and utilisation.
Provide regular performance updates to senior management.
Analyse client and business data to identify trends and opportunities.
Monitor promotional and campaign performance.
Track lead conversion and client retention.
Identify operational issues and propose solutions.
Set and work towards agreed studio targets.
Take ownership of results and proactively communicate challenges and opportunities.

Title: Post Creative Strategist
Description:
About Vaynerx
VaynerX (https://vaynerx.com) is the most contemporary family of companies, working together to build and grow brands. Subsidiaries include VaynerMedia, Eva Nosidam Productions, The Sasha Group, Gallery Media Group, Tingley Lane Trading, VaynerSpeakers, and VaynerCommerce.
About Vaynermedia
VaynerMedia is a global integrated creative and media agency, built for today's consumers. As the Modern Agency of Record, it understands the nuances of today's attention landscape, empowering brands to win attention, drive relevance, and deliver business results. Founded in 2009, by Gary Vaynerchuk, the independently owned agency operates in 15 offices worldwide, including Amsterdam, Bangkok, Chicago, New Delhi, Kuala Lumpur, London, Los Angeles, Mexico City, Miami, New York, Tokyo, Toronto, Singapore, and Sydney. VaynerMedia is part of the VaynerX family of companies.
Culture is our key and Empathy is how we build it. VaynerMediaAPAC is strong with a world-class combination of diverse backgrounds collaborating to put forward innovative, creative and strategic solutions to the one advantage that stands the test of time --- PEOPLE. Day in and day out, we propel some of the biggest brands in the world to the intersection of attention and culture. In APAC, we are proudly +300, servicing a diverse client all around the region.
The PITCH
Well, now we’re looking for someone who lives and breathes social media even more than us. Do you know all of the latest trends? Memes? And TikToks? Maybe you’ve dabbled in the world of influencers? Believe in the power of social media and community management to change hearts, minds, and drive sales? Love the hustle of fast-paced, hyper-growth agency life? Thrive in a role where you can bring ideas to life on billions of screens? Cool. Then let’s talk.
This exciting opportunity of a full-time role based in the Singapore will allow you to collaborate with the local team as well learn from the experts globally. You will manage and drive our strategy expertise and someone who is familiar with the Sinapore landscape.
Are you based in Singapore? Do you wanna geek out on the world of media and creative advertising agency? Oh well, we could be meant to be -----so keep reading!
Here’s where you come in.
Volume, ideation and listening are the building blocks to being an exceptional Post Creative Strategist. We believe everyone's got brilliant ideas. But what sets YOU apart from the rest? It’s about forming several strategies to win with different groups of demographics.
You have a solid understanding of what works in the industry but at the same time, constantly determining what can make your strategies better. Possessing an undying passion to continuously make magic happen regardless of the adversities thrown in your way.
Our Post Creative Strategists do more than just providing insights and research to the Creative team, they provide continuous recommendations based on daily evolving conversations. This position represents the community’s voice in every aspect of the brand and maneuvers way through multiple channels. The ideal candidate synergises well with the Creative team and is deeply rooted in the purpose of ‘customer first’.
The Brief
- Knowledge and implementation of end-to-end customer experience strategies, including customer research, strategy, vision & design
- A keen sense of developing strategy solutions, from brand strategy, down to tactical social, content and influencer strategies
- An out of the box perspective on data and research to find interesting consumer insights that we can leverage on
- Strong understanding of marketing fundamentals
- Able to craft content calendars, caption banks, and trendjacking posts with ease.
- An understanding of community management and social listening to deeply understand people
- Ability to read and internalise social media comments and differentiate people’s behaviours on different social platforms
- Brings the consumer’s world to life for creative teams and clients using qualitative and cultural mining and insightful synthesis of quantitative research to inform a strategic approach.
- Articulate effective strategic rationale and logic flow that will help form a compelling story.
- Deck crafter - someone that can detail out ideas and insights that are clear and can sell!
What You Should Know About VaynerMedia
Think “lab” and not “agency”. We get excited about solving business problems, not creating advertising for the sake of making advertising. Our entrepreneurship DNA runs deep. We’re willing to break rules, try new things, and test hypotheses if it means better understanding our craft. It’s fun!
Our environment (and pace) feels much more like a start-up than most agencies you might be used to. Hopefully that, and the opportunity to collaborate with the talented and enthusiastic crew, work with big brands excites you, as it does us. We can’t wait to meet you.
P.S Portfolio would be nice :)

Title: PR Director, APAC
Description:
Who are we?
Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.
We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.
We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.
We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!
Role Overview
Cohere has a strong AI narrative, the most deployable product, and a CEO who co-authored the foundational paper of modern AI. The company is positioned to become the transatlantic leader in sovereign AI for enterprise and government, and needs a storytelling engine to deliver that story at scale. This role sits within the team that is building that engine.
In this cross functional role, you will stand up our PR and Communications function in the APAC region. You'll partner with the global Corporate Communications team to create regional communications plans that fuel our growth among governments and enterprises in the most highly-regulated industries. You’ll nurture how we talk to customers, partners, and employees, ensuring that the corporate message resonates culturally for each region and audience.
This is a rare opportunity to build a comprehensive APAC communications function at a fast-growing company in the most dynamic space in technology. This is a role for someone who likes to take big swings – and have fun doing it – where no job is too big or too small.
Key Responsibilities
- Build a PR and Communications function from the ground up, including hiring PR Managers and agencies in key territories including Korea, Singapore, Japan, India, Australia.
- Implement PR & Corporate Communications strategies that align with organizational goals, values, and brand positioning across internal and external audiences at the local and regional level
- Partner with PR, marketing, sales, and external stakeholders to craft clear, compelling messaging and materials that support business priorities, organisational changes, and market positioning
- Develop and execute rapid response muscle in each region
- Oversee high-impact communications forums including executive speaking engagements, industry conferences, customer events, and internal leadership gatherings
- Adopt AI integration for the communications team to enhance content ideation, creation, and scaling
- Oversee and optimize the APAC communications channel ecosystem—including earned media, owned channels, executive communications, and employee engagement tools—while innovating with emerging formats and technologies
- Lead cross-functional APAC storytelling initiatives that connect daily work to Cohere's mission, amplify customer success stories, and elevate executive thought leadership in the marketplace
- Leverage data-driven insights and audience research to inform communications strategies that resonate with employees, customers, partners, investors, and industry influencers
- Partner with Corporate Communications on crisis and issues communications preparedness and response across all stakeholder groups, coordinating with legal, executive leadership, and functional teams to protect corporate reputation and stakeholder trust
- Serve as the central communications hub, ensuring seamless integration and consistency between internal communications, external PR, marketing narratives, and executive messaging across all touchpoints
Qualifications
- Have 12-15 years of experience in-house corporate communications, ideally within a fast-paced, high-growth tech or AI environment
- 5+ years of experience in people management
- Are scrappy. You thrive in thinking “outside the box” and find joy in marrying a problem to its solution
- Are experienced at hiring, onboarding, and managing PR agencies
- Are adept in pre-IPO communications
- Have experience and/or heavy interest in policy and regulatory communications
- Are an exceptional writer with a talent for distilling complex, cross-functional topics into simple, compelling narratives
- Have experience serving as a communications business partner or trusted advisor to senior leaders, executives, and people/human resources teams
- Are highly organised and process-driven, with strong project management skills and a bias for action
- Bring high levels of creativity to communications – in format, channel, and storytelling
- Are comfortable navigating organisational dynamics and building strong relationships across all levels
- Thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and know how to prioritise ruthlessly

Title: Program Origination & Marketing Manager
Description:
Company Overview
The Singapore Mint, established in 1968, has evolved into a leading innovative mint producing high-quality coins, medallions, and collectibles. It combines advanced technology with skilled craftsmanship and serves both local and international markets.
Job Summary
The Manager, Programme Origination leads the team to develop and execute commemorative coin and collectible product programmes, owning strategy, marketing, delivery, and P&L to achieve commercial and performance targets.
Responsibilities
Lead and manage the Programme Origination team to deliver product programmes that meet yearly margin targets and enhance team capabilities in a dynamic environment
Plan, execute, and review programmes managing scope, schedule, budget, quality, launch readiness, risks, and post-launch performance
Conduct market research to identify trends and originate differentiated product concepts that enhance brand equity
Oversee marketing and communications plans, including product storytelling, campaign briefs, sales enablement materials, and channel support across retail, e-commerce, corporate sales, and digital platforms
Coordinate internal teams across programme origination, marketing, sales, design, production, and operations to ensure aligned delivery and accountability
Manage external contractors, agencies, vendors, and partners to deliver quality, cost, timelines, messaging, and brand standards
Monitor programme KPIs and P&L, track sales, margin, and engagement targets, and implement timely corrective actions
Provide accurate programme reporting, documentation, and management updates
Recommend programme concepts, timelines, budget allocations, go-to-market requirements, and risk mitigation or performance improvement actions
Influence cross-functional delivery across marketing, production, operations, sales, and external partners to ensure cohesive execution
The Singapore Mint was established in 1968 to mint circulation coins for the newly-independent nation. Over the years, The Singapore Mint has evolved from a basic minting facility to a fully integrated business operation, comprising programme concept, product design, marketing, sales and distribution with after sales service. Focusing on quality system and standards, The Singapore Mint is a certified ISO 9001 and 14001 organisation. Today, it has grown to become one of the leading innovative mints in the industry, capable of producing coins and medallions of the highest quality.
Leveraging on technology, The Singapore Mint has developed hybrid techniques to create high security and innovative features on circulation and commemorative coins and collectables. Fusing advanced minting technologies with authentic crafting methods, The Singapore Mint is one of the few mints in the world that still maintains a team of highly skilled craftsmen, adding intricate elements that can only be meticulously achieved by the human touch.
As a testament of its high quality crafting techniques, The Singapore Mint has won multiple international awards and its rising stature has garnered much interest internationally. The mint has been appointed by issuing authorities around the world for the production of their coins.
Other than producing coins and medallions, The Singapore Mint has also expanded to provide quality currency-related gifts and collectibles, lifestyle products and services to both local and international markets. We continue to pledge our unwavering commitment to our customers, business associates and partners to offer the best in quality, value and service.
The Singapore Mint (Singapore Precision Industries Pte Ltd) is a fully owned subsidiary of Sembcorp Industries.

Title: Project Coordinator/Manager: Business Development & Market Research
Description:
Are you interested in international trade and cross-border innovation?
Do you want to help international entrepreneurs bring their ideas to life with some of the largest brands in Asia, and play a role in helping Asian corporations to digitalise and decarbonise their operations?
Or maybe you’re interested in cross-border investment and want to play a role in enabling Singaporean corporations to expand overseas?
If that’s yes to all three, you may be who we are looking for to join our team.
You’ll work alongside a diverse group of 180+ business development consultants with a deep specialism in Asia. Over 35 years in the business, we’ve supported over 2,000 clients across startups and scaleups, SMEs, corporates and government bodies – generating upwards of $20 billion in revenues and investment for our clients across 40+ international markets.
We’re growing our team in Singapore. So, if you think you’re up for the challenge, read on – and apply.
What you'll be doing
You’ll be working with our international clients from both the private and public sector, with a concentration on high-growth sectors such as medtech, renewables, automotive, industrial robotics, consumer electronics, semiconductors and agritech; in addition to F&B, agriculture, consumer goods, among others.
For your private sector clients, you’ll be the on-the-ground extension of your clients’ business development team, with a goal of developing their route to market, plus securing partners and customers in Singapore. In your day-to-day, you’ll be identifying, meeting, pitching to and gathering crucial feedback from your clients’ potential customers, distributors and partners in the market.
For some projects, you’ll be doing the groundwork: conducting the desk research and market intelligence that underpins every client engagement. That means sizing the market opportunity, mapping competitors and distribution structures, screening and qualifying potential partners and customers, and checking regulatory or certification requirements – then turning your findings into clear, client-ready market-entry reports.
You might also work with our government agency clients from overseas. You’ll be the on-the-ground representative of your client’s export promotion team, supporting trade missions, delivering B2B meetings and organizing trade events.
You’ll be working closely with your clients and providing them with key progress indicators in the form of meeting notes, reports, and sync calls.
And when the time is right, you will arrange for your clients to visit Singapore. You’ll be their local expert – taking them to key customer meetings, interpreting and providing the incredibly important cultural context to business conversations.
Through all this, you’ll deepen your consulting knowledge and gain first-hand experience in making international business happen.
What you'll be getting
- Competitive salary and vacation, plus flexible working arrangements
- International office environment and work culture
- Opportunities for growth and advancement within the company
- On-the-job experience across multiple industries, often working with cutting-edge tech
- A chance to sharpen your sales, consultancy, research and business development skills by learning from best-in-class consultants and business builders
- An opportunity to make a difference by enabling green transformation and digital transition through international collaboration
What you'll need
- Full professional proficiency in spoken and written English
- Minimum of four years’ experience working in sales, business development, market research, consultancy, economic development or export promotion
- Ideally, relevant experience in our B2B fields (industrial, medtech, automotive, semiconductor, energy, software, engineering, life sciences, medtech, F&B, agri, etc.)
- Regional experience across Southeast Asian markets is a plus
- Demonstrated research and analytical skills, with the ability to build evidence-based target lists, market insights market-entry recommendations
- Comfort with data sources and research tools – trade and industry statistics, company registries, LinkedIn/Sales Navigator, industry databases
- Strong analytical writing skills: with the ability to synthesise raw findings into structured reports, briefs and meeting notes on which your clients can act
- A firm understanding of Singaporean business culture and the ability to proactively guide international clients through local nuances
- The ability to quickly grasp new concepts and communicate that knowledge to stakeholders
- A keen interest in international trade and overseas business development
- A degree in business/marketing/law/engineering/science, or in a related field

Title: Regional Marketing Manager, APAC
Description:
The Regional Marketing Manager, APAC is responsible for driving customer acquisition, engagement, retention, and advocacy across the APAC region. Through customer insights, analytics, digital marketing, content, and customer experience initiatives, this role supports business growth while enhancing the overall customer experience.
This role requires a strong combination of customer experience expertise, digital marketing capabilities, analytical skills, and re-gional stakeholder management. Working closely with local market teams, the successful candidate will understand diverse cus-tomer needs across APAC markets, identify customer experience gaps and opportunities, and lead initiatives that improve customer journeys, strengthen customer loyalty, and deliver measurable business outcomes.
Key Responsibilities
- Customer Experience Strategy & Execution (Customer-Centric Mindset)
- CX Strategy & Customer Journeys: Lead the design, mapping, and improvement of end-to-end customer journeys across APAC to enhance customer satisfaction, loyalty, and overall experience. Ensure journeys reflect the needs of different cus-tomer segments, market conditions, and customer expectations across the region.
- CX Measurement & ROI: Establish and track key customer experience metrics, including Net Promoter Score (NPS), cus-tomer retention, engagement, and CX ROI, to measure programme effectiveness and business impact.
- Regional Initiative Management: Lead the implementation of regional and global customer experience initiatives across APAC, ensuring programmes are adapted to local customer needs, market conditions, and business priorities. Research market trends and best practices to continuously improve programme effectiveness and customer experience.
- Customer Analytics, Feedback & Insights (Analytical & Growth Mindset)
- Customer Insights & Analytics: Manage customer analytics programmes, including NPS, customer feedback, competitor analysis, market sizing, complaints analysis, and CRM reporting to generate actionable insights and support business deci-sions.
- Customer Segmentation & Growth Insights: Analyse customer profiles, behaviours, and engagement trends across mar-kets to identify opportunities for customer acquisition, retention, and business growth.
- Complaint & Feedback Management: Review customer complaints and feedback, identify root causes, and recommend improvements to improve customer satisfaction and experience.
- Brand, Content & Digital Engagement (Digital & Innovative Mindset)
- Customer Engagement & Digital Marketing: Develop and execute customer engagement programmes across digital channels, using marketing automation and digital tools to improve communication, engagement, retention, and customer experience.
- Content & Brand Development: Create and manage customer-focused content, thought leadership, customer communi-cations, campaigns, and digital assets to strengthen brand awareness, customer engagement, and loyalty.
- Events & Experience Programmes: Plan and deliver webinars, customer events, roundtables, and regional marketing programmes that support customer acquisition, engagement, retention, advocacy and overall customer experience.
- Stakeholder Management & Regional Coordination (Resilient & Collaborative Mindset)
- Regional CX Leadership: Lead and coordinate customer experience programmes across APAC markets, ensuring con-sistent execution while balancing local customer needs and business priorities.
- Cross-Functional & Local Market Collaboration: Work closely with local teams and key stakeholders to identify cus-tomer experience gaps, align priorities, and implement improvement initiatives across the region.
- CX Governance & Reporting: Provide regular reporting and recommendations on NPS, customer retention, customer feedback, customer journey performance, key customer trends, and improvement opportunities to stakeholders.
Job Requirements
- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Finance, Data Analytics or a related field
- More than 7 years of proven experience in customer experience, marketing, analytics, customer engage-ment, or related roles, preferably within financial services, insurance, or B2B environments
- Proven experience managing regional programmes and working across multiple APAC markets within a matrix organisation
- Experience managing customer experience programmes, NPS initiatives, customer retention strategies, customer feedback programmes, and customer engagement initiatives
- Proficiency in Marketing Automation platforms (e.g. Marketo) and CRM systems (e.g. Salesforce), including customer en-gagement, reporting, and campaign tracking
- Knowledge of customer journey mapping, customer lifecycle management, customer segmentation, and customer en-gagement strategies
- Strong understanding of customer experience measurement, including NPS, customer retention, customer feedback, complaint management, and CX ROI
- Ability to manage digital content, customer communications, webinars, events, and multi-channel marketing campaigns
- Advanced Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, Lookups, dashboards, data analysis, reporting, and trend identification
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and business recom-mendations
- Familiarity with reporting and visualisation tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms
- Excellent presentation, communication and stakeholder communication skills
Behavioral Traits
- Resilient & Results-Oriented: You are motivated by delivering meaningful business and customer outcomes. You remain driven through complex projects, multiple stakeholders, and changing business priorities while maintaining a strong focus on results.
- Entrepreneurial, Innovative & Proactive: You are a self-starter who takes ownership, identifies opportunities, explores new ideas, and continuously seeks better ways to improve customer experience, engagement, and business performance.
- Customer-Centric & Analytical: You are passionate about understanding customer needs and behaviours. You are comfortable working with data, customer insights, and feedback, translating them into practical recommendations that im-prove customer satisfaction, loyalty, retention, and business outcomes.

Description:
Position Summary
The Marketing Manager for Air Conditioning Products plays a vital role in driving the success of Samsung Air Conditioner business in Southeast Asia and Oceania (SEAO) region. In collaboration with key stakeholders from subsidiaries and Suwon office (in South Korea), this individual is responsible for developing and implementing effective marketing strategies tailored for both B2B and B2C markets.
This individual will primarily focus on leading marketing initiatives across SEAO to enhance brand awareness and preference while generating effective sales and marketing materials to support both Sales & Technical teams.
Role And Responsibilities
- Work closely with business leaders and product managers to develop regional marketing strategy that aligns with global marketing directions and brand guidelines

- Lead planning and execution for regional partner conferences and industry events

- Stay updated on competitors’ marketing activities and conduct regular analysis and reviewing brand, competition and trends to enhance brand equity

- Continuously explore new marketing techniques and technologies to stay ahead in the competitive B2C & B2B landscape

- Bachelor degree in Marketing, Business Administration or a related field
- Minimum 8 years’ experience in marketing in either B2C or B2B markets. Experience in both is a plus
- Experienced in performance marketing, including paid digital campaigns, social media advertising and marketplace/e-commerce optimisation

This role manages the regional activation of PR and Media priorities across SEAO, aligning with global Communications strategy and regional objectives. - Act as a key liaison between HQ and markets to consolidate communication calendars, priorities and requirements.
- Translate global direction into actionable regional plans supporting markets for high-quality execution.
- Manage and track budgets for related regional projects, agency and vendor expenses, ensuring financial accountability and optimal utilization.

Description:
Medline - Together, Advancing Healthcare
Medline is a healthcare company–a manufacturer, distributor and so much more, doing business in more than 125 countries and territories around the world. We provide the quality medical products and solutions our customers need to deliver their best care to every person in every care setting.
Medline is committed to reducing our carbon footprint, developing responsible products, supporting our employees and local communities, and promoting high ethical standards internally and among our supplier partners. Job Summary
The Regional Product Manager – Operating Room & Peri-Operative Solutions is responsible for driving the regional product management agenda and leading the strategic management of a portfolio of products and solutions supporting the Operating Room (OR) and peri-operative care environment across Southeast Asia.
The role focuses on identifying market opportunities, generating actionable insights, and translating them into effective portfolio and go-to-market strategies that enhance customer value and support sustainable business growth. The incumbent will develop a deep understanding of surgical workflows, patient pathways, customer needs, market dynamics, and competitive landscapes to ensure the portfolio remains relevant and differentiated across diverse healthcare systems.
Acting as a critical link between Global Product Divisions, regional teams, distributors, and in-market stakeholders, the incumbent will drive product readiness, launch excellence, portfolio optimisation, and commercial execution across Southeast Asia.
Success in this role requires strong strategic thinking, commercial acumen, stakeholder influence, and the ability to operate effectively in a matrix organisation. Title: Research Assistant/Associate (AI Specialist)
Description:
Job Title: Research Assistant/Associate (AI Specialist)
University-Level Unit: Yong Loo Lin School of Medicine
Faculty/Department-Level Unit: Biochemistry
Employee Category: Research Staff
Location_ONB: Kent Ridge Campus
Posting Start Date: 20/05/2026
Job Description
About the Program:
The MSc in Precision Health and Medicine x Artificial Intelligence (MScPHMxAI) programme at the National University of Singapore is a forward-looking graduate programme designed to train the next generation of healthcare, biomedical, and data-driven professionals in precision health and medicine.
The programme integrates emerging approaches in multi-omics, biomedical data science, artificial intelligence, machine learning, computational biology, digital health, and translational medicine. A key objective of the programme is to develop innovative, research-informed approaches to teaching, learning, student support, capstone training, industry engagement, and AI-enabled programme delivery.
We are seeking a motivated and capable Research Assistant (s) (at least 1) to support research and innovation activities within the MScPHM programme, with a particular focus on AI-enabled education, precision health learning support, programme analytics, computational infrastructure, and capstone research coordination.
Position Summary:
The Research Assistant(s) will work closely with the Programme Directors, faculty members, students, and relevant academic and industry partners to support applied research and innovation in the MSc in Precision Health and Medicine programme.
The role will focus on developing, implementing, and evaluating AI-enabled approaches to enhance learning, research training, student support, programme operations, and capstone project development. The successful candidate will contribute to research on the effective and ethical use of AI in graduate education, learning analytics, precision health training, student progression, outreach strategy, industry alignment, and computational learning support.
This is a research-facing role with programme implementation responsibilities. The Research Assistant will support the generation of research outputs, reports, dashboards, workflows, educational resources, and evidence-based recommendations to improve the MScPHM programme and strengthen its role in precision health and medicine education.
Key Responsibilities
1. Applied Research in AI for Precision Health and Medicine Education
The Research Assistant(s) will contribute to research and innovation projects related to AI-enabled learning, programme development, and precision health education. Responsibilities include:
Assist in research on the use of AI, machine learning, and data-driven methods to support learning in precision health and medicine.
Support research into ethical, effective, and responsible approaches for using AI in graduate education, including how AI can enhance learning without compromising deep understanding, academic integrity, or independent thinking.
Contribute to the design, implementation, and evaluation of AI-assisted learning workflows for MScPHM students.
Assist in developing research frameworks to evaluate student learning needs, progression, engagement, and performance across the programme.
Support the preparation of research reports, presentations, manuscripts, grant materials, and internal programme evaluation documents.
Conduct literature reviews and benchmarking studies on AI in education, precision health training, biomedical data science education, and graduate programme innovation.
2. Capstone Research Support and Student Research Development
The Research Assistant(s) will support the research training component of the MScPHM programme, particularly capstone and project-based learning activities. Responsibilities include:
Assist Programme Directors and faculty members in guiding students undertaking capstone projects involving AI, data science, multi-omics, bioinformatics, or precision health applications.
Provide research and technical support to students working on computational or AI-related capstone projects.
Help monitor capstone project progress and identify students who may require additional research or technical support.
Support the development of capstone project resources, templates, research guidance materials, and computational learning aids.
Assist in identifying suitable academic, clinical, research, and industry partners who may host or co-supervise capstone projects.
Maintain and improve structured systems for tracking capstone topics, mentors, student progress, outputs, and project outcomes.
Contribute to research on how capstone training can be better aligned with industry, healthcare, research, and workforce needs in precision health and medicine.
Key Responsibilities
3. Programme Analytics, Student Progress Research, and Learning Support
The Research Assistant(s) will support data-driven approaches to student learning, engagement, and progression. Responsibilities include:
Assist in collecting, organising, analysing, and interpreting programme-related data, including student engagement, academic progression, assessment outcomes, capstone outcomes, and feedback.
Develop dashboards, reports, and analytical summaries to help the programme team identify student needs and improve learning support.
Support research-informed strategies to help students with varied computational backgrounds succeed in modules involving AI, data science, statistics, bioinformatics, or programming.
Assist in organising research-informed computational support sessions, workshops, or clinics for students requiring additional help with programming, Linux, R, Python, AI/ML tools, or data analysis workflows.
Support the development of learning materials for computational and AI-related components of the programme.
Assist in evaluating the effectiveness of active learning tools, digital platforms, and AI-enabled learning interventions.
Support academic integrity initiatives by helping evaluate tools and workflows related to assessment design, online learning, and responsible AI use.
4. AI-Enabled Workflow Development and Research Operations
The Research Assistant(s) will help design and implement AI-enabled workflows to improve the efficiency, quality, and evidence base of programme-related research and operations. Responsibilities include:
Identify opportunities to streamline research, learning support, student monitoring, capstone coordination, outreach tracking, and programme evaluation workflows.
Design, implement, or recommend AI-assisted solutions, scripts, dashboards, forms, databases, and automation workflows to reduce repetitive manual work.
Develop and maintain structured datasets related to student progression, capstone projects, mentor networks, industry engagement, outreach outcomes, and programme evaluation.
Assist in building reproducible workflows for reporting, data cleaning, analysis, and visualisation.
Support responsible use of AI tools in programme processes, including documentation, data privacy awareness, and quality control.
Stay updated on emerging AI, automation, and educational technology tools relevant to graduate education and precision health training.
Key Responsibilities
5. Computational and Technical Research Support
The Research Assistant(s) will support the technical and computational infrastructure required for AI-enabled learning and research activities. Responsibilities include:
Support the maintenance and management of programme-related computing environments, including Linux-based servers, user accounts, permissions, and relevant software environments.
Assist students and faculty with basic troubleshooting of computational workflows used in teaching, learning, and capstone research.
Support the use of high-performance computing, cluster, cloud, or server-based workflows where relevant.
Help prepare technical documentation, guides, and reproducible examples for students using R, Python, Bash, Linux, bioinformatics tools, data analysis workflows, or AI/ML platforms.
Assist in ensuring that computing environments are reliable, secure, and suitable for student learning and research activities.
Work with relevant IT or institutional teams where needed to support programme-related technical requirements.
6. Research on Programme Positioning, Outreach, and Industry Alignment
The Research Assistant(s) will contribute to research and evidence-gathering activities that strengthen the MScPHM programme’s positioning and relevance. Responsibilities include:
Assist in research to identify the profiles, motivations, and needs of prospective students who are best suited for the MScPHM programme.
Support analysis of admissions trends, applicant backgrounds, recruitment channels, and outreach effectiveness.
Help evaluate how the programme can better attract high-quality, best-fit applicants.
Assist in identifying relevant research groups, clinical partners, companies, industry sectors, and organisations in precision health and medicine that may support capstone projects, internships, employment pathways, or collaborations.
Maintain structured records of potential academic, clinical, and industry partners.
Support the development of evidence-based outreach materials, digital content, programme summaries, and impact reports.
Assist in analysing the impact of website updates, social media activities, information sessions, and other outreach initiatives.
7. Programme Implementation Support
As part of supporting research and innovation within the programme, the Research Assistant(s) will also assist with selected implementation activities necessary for the smooth running and evaluation of MScPHM initiatives. These may include:
Supporting the preparation of learning materials, digital resources, workshops, and programme documentation.
Assisting with coordination of research-related student activities, capstone briefings, workshops, seminars, and industry engagement sessions.
Liaising with students, faculty, mentors, and partners on matters related to research activities, capstone coordination, technical support, and learning resources.
Supporting the accurate organisation of programme-related data, records, reports, and documentation.
Assisting with website and digital content updates related to programme research activities, capstone highlights, student achievements, and outreach initiatives.
Assisting in organizing activities for the MScPHM students
Qualifications
Essential Requirements
A good Honours Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in computational biology, bioinformatics, data science, biomedical informatics, computer science, biomedical sciences, precision health, or a closely related field.
Strong interest in AI, machine learning, data analytics, biomedical data science, or precision health and medicine.

Sales & Accounts Management cum Marketing Executive
