Title: Sales & Marketing Executive
Description:
We are looking for a proactive and creative Sales & Marketing Executive to manage the company’s sales and marketing activities.
The successful candidate must be comfortable speaking to customers, conducting presentations, developing marketing materials, managing social media platforms, creating EDM campaigns and following up on sales opportunities.
This is a hands-on role suitable for someone who can combine sales ability with digital marketing, content development and customer engagement.
Key Responsibilities
Sales and Business Development
Identify and develop new business opportunities from existing and prospective customers.
Promote Hypercom’s solutions, including Unified Communications, PBX systems, cloud communication services, CCTV, video conferencing, networking, AI-powered solutions and maintenance services.
Contact prospective customers through telephone calls, emails, social media, referrals, events and other lead-generation activities.
Understand customers’ business and technical requirements before recommending suitable solutions.
Prepare sales presentations, proposals, quotations and supporting materials.
Conduct face-to-face and online presentations to customers, business partners and management teams.
Follow up on quotations, proposals, enquiries and sales leads until closure.
Maintain good relationships with customers, technology partners, distributors and vendors.
Work with technical and project teams to ensure that proposed solutions meet customer requirements.
Maintain accurate records of leads, opportunities, quotations and sales activities.
Achieve agreed individual and company sales targets.
Provide regular sales forecasts, pipeline updates and activity reports to management.
Support customer contract renewals, technology refresh opportunities and cross-selling of additional solutions.
Attend customer meetings, exhibitions, seminars, partner events and networking activities when required.
Marketing and Digital Content
Plan and manage Hypercom’s overall marketing calendar.
Manage and regularly update the company’s social media platforms, including LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram and other relevant channels.
Develop suitable content for social media posts, product announcements, customer success stories, promotions and company updates.
Create and distribute EDM campaigns for products, services, events, promotions and customer engagement.
Maintain and organise customer and prospect mailing lists.
Monitor EDM campaign results, including delivery, open, click and response rates.
Prepare marketing presentations, brochures, flyers, product comparisons, event materials and digital advertisements.
Coordinate with vendors, principals and business partners on joint marketing campaigns.
Update the company website with relevant products, services, events and promotional content.
Support search engine, online advertising and lead-generation activities where applicable.
Assist in organising customer seminars, product demonstrations, webinars and corporate events.
Take suitable photographs and short videos during company activities and events for marketing use.
Ensure that all published content is accurate, professional and consistent with Hypercom’s brand identity.
Monitor competitors, industry developments and emerging technology trends.
Submit regular reports on marketing activities, campaign performance and generated leads.
Presentation Requirements
The candidate must be able to:
Prepare clear and professional PowerPoint presentations.
Present technology solutions confidently to customers and business partners.
Explain technical products in simple business language.
Conduct product introductions, demonstrations and proposal presentations.
Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
Represent Hypercom professionally during meetings, exhibitions and events.
Requirements
At least two years of relevant experience in sales, business development, digital marketing or a similar customer-facing role is preferred.
Experience in the information technology, telecommunications, Unified Communications, CCTV, networking or system integration industry will be an advantage.
Strong spoken and written English.
Confident in conducting presentations and communicating with customers.
Able to prepare sales proposals, quotations, presentation materials and marketing content.
Familiar with social media management and EDM campaign tools.
Proficient in Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, Excel and common digital marketing applications.
Basic graphic design and video-editing ability using tools such as Canva or similar applications will be an advantage.
Self-motivated, organised and able to work independently.
Able to manage multiple sales opportunities and marketing campaigns concurrently.
Results-oriented and comfortable working towards sales targets.
Willing to learn about new technology products and solutions.
Able to work closely with sales, technical, project and administrative teams.
Possession of a valid Singapore driving licence will be an advantage but is not compulsory.
Remuneration and Benefits
Competitive monthly basic salary based on experience and ability.
Performance-based sales commission or incentive.
Incentives based on individual sales performance, qualified leads, successful campaigns or achievement of agreed targets.
Annual performance review.
Product, sales and technical training.
Opportunities to attend vendor training, seminars and industry events.
Career development opportunities within sales, marketing, account management and business development.
Mobile phone or transport reimbursement may be provided for approved business expenses in accordance with company policy.
Staff welfare activities and company events.
Key Performance Indicators
The employee’s performance may be assessed based on:
Sales revenue and gross profit achieved.
Number and quality of new sales opportunities generated.
Conversion of leads and quotations into confirmed orders.
Growth and management of the sales pipeline.
Customer follow-up and response time.
EDM campaign delivery, engagement and lead generation.
Contribution to customer retention, renewals and cross-selling opportunities.
Suitable Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate is commercially driven, confident in front of customers and capable of independently carrying out both sales and marketing work. The person should be able to convert technical information into clear customer benefits, create professional marketing content and consistently follow up on opportunities to achieve results.

Title: Salesforce Campaign Strategist
Description:
We are seeking a Salesforce Campaign Strategist who will be responsible for designing, planning, and optimizing data-driven marketing campaigns leveraging the Salesforce ecosystem. This role combines marketing strategy, customer insights, campaign automation, and performance analytics to drive lead generation, customer engagement, pipeline growth, and revenue outcomes.
The ideal candidate possesses strong expertise in marketing technology, customer journey mapping, and campaign optimization, with the ability to translate business goals into impactful multi-channel marketing strategies.
Responsibilities
- Develop data-driven campaign strategies aligned with business and marketing objectives, focusing on customer acquisition, engagement, retention and conversion.
- Define campaign approach and planning, including objectives, audience strategy, customer journeys, content, channels, measurement framework and KPIs.
- Leverage customer and performance insights to recommend segmentation, targeting, personalisation and lifecycle engagement strategies.
- Design and optimise customer journeys, nurture programmes and lifecycle initiatives to improve customer engagement and conversion.
- Analyse campaign performance across markets, divisions, audiences and channels, identifying trends, opportunities and areas for improvement. Drive continuous optimisation through A/B testing, experimentation, attribution and performance analysis to improve campaign effectiveness and ROI.
- Lead quarterly performance reviews, translating cross-campaign learnings and best practices into actionable recommendations and future optimisation priorities.
- Collaborate with Campaign Managers, SFMC Architect and business stakeholders to ensure strategic recommendations are practical, technically feasible and incorporated into future campaign planning.
Profile
- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Information Technology, Communications, or a related field.
- 4-8 years of experience in campaign strategy, CRM marketing, demand generation, marketing operations, or related functions.
- Strong experience in customer lifecycle management, lead generation, marketing automation, and B2B/B2C marketing strategies.

Title: Senior Analyst, Campaign Management Analytics
Description:
Job Description
We are seeking a seasoned Senior Campaign Analyst to help shape the bank's transition towards AI-enabled, journey-led customer engagement. With 7-10 years of experience in campaign analytics, CRM or customer engagement, you will design and optimise multi-channel campaigns and always-on customer journeys that drive customer growth, product adoption and long-term value. The role combines audience intelligence, MarTech platform capabilities, experimentation and performance measurement to deliver personalised, data-driven experiences at scale. Partnering with Product, Marketing, Digital, Data and Technology teams, you will transform customer insights into actionable engagement strategies while ensuring strong governance, compliance and measurable business outcomes.
Job Responsibilities
Campaign Strategy & Execution
- Develop and manage end-to-end marketing campaigns across email, SMS, push notifications, telesales, direct mailer and paid media.
- Design journey based campaigns, segment customers based on lifecycle stages and behaviors, and map out touchpoints & triggers.
- Conduct A/B testing and multivariate analysis to optimize campaign performance.
MarTech Adoption & Continuous Improvement
- Act as a power user and business subject-matter expert for the evolving MarTech stack, including CDP, journey orchestration, personalisation, experimentation and analytics capabilities.
- Support platform implementation, data and channel onboarding, user acceptance testing, operating-model design and migration from legacy campaign processes.
- Identify opportunities to use predictive, generative and agentic AI safely for audience discovery, journey design, insight generation and operational productivity.
- Create playbooks, reusable templates and training materials; coach analysts and business users in journey-led campaign practices.
Customer Segmentation
- Partner with data science and analytics teams to leverage advanced analytics and predictive models in targeting customers.
- Refine customer segments and personalize outreach based on behavioral trends and product take-up.
Campaign Measurement & Fulfilment
- Prepare detailed reports and dashboards for campaign tracking, fulfilment and executive review.
- Analyze campaign performance using tools like SAS, or Power BI.
- Generate actionable insights to improve targeting, conversion, and ROI.

- Analysis
- SAS
- Python
Job Requirements
- Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science or a related discipline.
- 7-10 years of experience in campaign analytics, CRM, digital analytics or customer engagement, preferably in banking or financial services.
- Hands-on proficiency in SQL and at least one analytical environment such as SAS, Python or R; experience with Power BI, Tableau or equivalent visualisation tools.
- Practical experience with CRM, marketing automation, CDP or journey orchestration platforms. Exposure to platforms such as Adobe Experience Platform / Journey Optimizer, Salesforce Marketing Cloud or equivalent is advantageous.
- Working knowledge of audience segmentation, experimentation, customer lifecycle analytics, campaign measurement and data quality controls.
- Strong stakeholder management, structured problem solving, documentation and presentation skills.

Title: Senior Campaign Analyst
Description:
We are seeking a seasoned Senior Campaign Analyst to help shape the bank's transition towards AI-enabled, journey-led customer engagement. The Senior Communications and Partnerships Manager leads HOME’s public communications and external engagement. Comfortable working in a small, mission-driven organisation.
Commitment to HOME’s mission and to treating migrant workers with dignity and respect.

Title: Senior Director - Performance Marketing (Remote)
Description:
Own the paid media engine for a $1Billion+ brand. Decide what to launch and where the budget goes.
Total Annual Package: Up to USD $240,000 + comprehensive benefits (Base salary + monthly performance bonus of up to 20% of base)
Location: Remote (Global)
Growth path from here is fluid: all paid channels, including the ones you select, moving toward scope at the intersection of capital allocation, creative strategy, and P&L ownership. What takes 4-5 years elsewhere happens in 1-2 here.
We've been AI-first since December 2023: Every proposal that reaches the CEO ships with an LLM validation link. Your first spend case gets stress-tested by an advanced model to eliminate blind spots.
Role Overview:
Puffy, a market-leading, nine-figure D2C brand and Top 5 US mattress brand with over $1 billion in sales, is hiring a Senior Director of Performance Marketing to own a multi-million-dollar monthly paid media engine across Google and Meta with full authority over systems, measurement, creative testing, capital allocation, and team, reporting directly to the CEO.
This role exists to convert a multi-million-dollar paid budget into maximum contribution margin, building the decision systems, measurement infrastructure, and team that let the revenue engine run and scale without day-to-day executive involvement.
The Problems You'll Own:
- Primary: Decide what to launch and where the budget goes: A multi-million-dollar monthly budget runs across Google and Meta, and every standard campaign type is already live and optimized: brand and non-brand search, PMax, Meta prospecting and retargeting, Shopping and feed. Growth now has to come from what isn't running: new campaign structures, new creative, a different mix of spend.
- Secondary: Build the system that runs the scaling decisions: Design and document the rules that govern spend, when to pause, when to increase budget, when to pull back, and the measurement each decision depends on. The system should run the scaling without day-to-day executive oversight.
The Career Accelerator:
This is not a role where you manage dashboards and present decks.
- The scope is scarce: very few Senior Directors of Performance Marketing get simultaneous authority over multi-million-dollar monthly budgets on both major platforms, full ownership of measurement and creative systems, org design power, and a direct line to the CEO with no layers in between.
- Your first 12 months: build pause/hold/scale logic, budget guardrails, and escalation protocols from scratch. Deploy incrementality testing and reconcile platform attribution against backend reality. Architect the creative engine as a system: concept pipeline, testing taxonomy, briefs, hook/hold analytics, UGC, and whitelisting. Design capital allocation on marginal return rather than platform-reported averages. Design promo architecture across the retail calendar: pulse strategy, financing offers, funnel alignment. Identify, evaluate, and pilot paid channels beyond Google and Meta. Structure the performance marketing function itself. Shape the future of performance marketing at Puffy, where paid media is the primary growth lever.
What Is In It For You:
This isn't just another performance marketing role. This is your chance to become a true industry architect.
1. Own the Paid Engine End to End, With No Layers Above You
You set the strategy, build the systems, and own the outcomes.
- You allocate multi-million-dollar monthly budgets across Google and Meta on marginal return rather than platform-reported averages, design the pause/hold/scale logic and budget guardrails that govern all paid spend, and serve as the single source of truth on paid media performance. Creative runs as a system you architect: concept pipeline, testing taxonomy, briefs, hook/hold analytics, UGC, whitelisting.
- You hold profitability to a contribution-margin standard after returns and financing costs, not ROAS in isolation. You lead, assess, and structure the performance marketing function with org design authority and CEO sign-off, reporting directly to the CEO.
2. Join a High-Performance Organization and Partner with the 1%:
- 🏆 Puffy: Top 5 Mattress Brand in US with Over $1 Billion USD in Sales
- 🌍 Great Place to Work Certified
- 💡 Work directly with Forbes Council Member CEO. Your vision is the company's vision.
Gain firsthand exposure to strategic decisions and high-velocity execution that drives a global brand
3. Embrace Radical Flexibility
Work from anywhere in the world with meaningful time zone overlap. Structure your environment around your best thinking, whether that's a home office, a co-working space, (OR) our Dubai headquarters (with full relocation, visa support, and 0% income tax if you choose). Your output is your credential, not your location.
4. Become the Operator Other Brands Try to Hire
In most companies, performance marketing leaders inherit a system somebody else built and spend the next three years defending its numbers in meetings. Here you build it. When the CEO decides how much capital goes into growth next quarter, your model is the input to that decision, not a report on it afterwards. You'll leave with a paid media system you designed end to end, and the proof that it held contribution margin at scale, which is the part almost nobody in this function can actually show. Puffy has been AI-First since December 2023, so you'll build it with an AI-native toolbox behind you rather than an agency deck in front of you.
What You'll Need:
- 7+ years in performance marketing with sustained ownership of $1M+/month on both Google and Meta (concurrently or across roles). "Ownership" means authority over strategy, structure, and budget, not just execution.
- Google depth at PMax-era: campaign structure, feed management, brand/non-brand economics.
- High-AOV considered-purchase experience ($1,000+ order values): sparse-conversion, long-decision-cycle categories.
- Personally built, not inherited, bid, budget, and pause decision systems at scale. You'll be asked to present a playbook you authored.
- Statistical decision literacy: volume gating, false-kill vs. wasted-spend trade-offs, threshold derivation, incrementality test design.
- Creative testing systems at scale in a post-ATT environment: concept-vs-variation discipline, creative analytics.
- Team leadership including senior direct reports. Experience building or restructuring a performance marketing function.
- Structured approach to new channel evaluation: selection frameworks, pilot design, budget allocation, and kill criteria.
Good-to-Have:

- Mixed agency + in-house background.
- Experience with emerging paid channels (e.g., TikTok, Connected TV, affiliate/partnerships, etc.).

The Puffy DNA:
We're restless, perpetually hungry, and fast-paced, driven by an unwavering belief that we can outperform any competitor, regardless of their size.

- Execute with Urgency: We thrive in high-stakes environments by making thoughtful decisions quickly and acting decisively.

Annual salary review every January

Description:
Job Description
The Senior Director, Regional Marketing & eCommerce – Asia Pacific (APACx) is the regional business strategist for Marketing and eCommerce performance across Hilton’s Asia Pacific markets outside Greater China. This leader sets the discipline strategy, operating model, growth priorities and performance standards that help markets, hotels and ownership groups capture demand, grow direct and digital revenue, and improve the return on marketing investment.
You will be the voice of the business, the region and the customer—turning consumer insight, market context and business performance into clear priorities across multiple markets. In partnership with Marketing, Loyalty and other regional teams, you will ensure local needs and market nuances inform integrated, omnichannel strategies that strengthen demand, revenue, market share, customer engagement and loyalty. You will connect the right audiences to the right channels and experiences, while enabling markets to make faster, more effective and commercially accountable decisions.
As the primary regional marketing and digital performance expert, you will build trusted relationships across Operations, Commercial, Brand Support, Development and other enterprise functions. You will represent the discipline with senior stakeholders, strengthen collaboration across markets and establish a culture of accountability, learning and continuous improvement—ultimately driving stronger revenue and channel performance across the region.
Responsibilities
HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT
Your role is important, and below are some of the fundamental job duties that make your work unique.
What Your Day-to-day Will Be Like
- Own the APACx Marketing and eCommerce performance strategy, translating enterprise and area priorities into market-level growth plans, targets, investment choices and clear accountability.
- Lead regional performance management across direct, digital and other demand-capture channels, using revenue, conversion, acquisition, cost, contribution and channel-shift metrics to identify opportunities and remove barriers to growth.
- Build multi-year capability and operating-model roadmaps covering planning, measurement, consulting, media effectiveness, channel optimization, test-and-learn practices, automation and market enablement.
- Set the regional approach to scenario planning, budget phasing and business cases, balancing near-term commercial delivery with sustainable customer and channel growth.
- Engage regularly with Regional Commercial, Revenue Management, Distribution and on-property commercial leaders to review performance, identify demand and conversion opportunities, align marketing investments to business needs, and translate insights into measurable revenue, channel and share outcomes.
- Lead, coach and develop a distributed team of regional Marketing and eCommerce strategists and consultants, creating a culture of commercial ownership, curiosity, pace and high-quality decision-making.
How You Will Collaborate With Others
- Partner with APAC Commercial, Revenue Management, Distribution, Loyalty, Operations, Finance and Development leaders to align channel strategy with hotel, portfolio and market business priorities.
- Work with Global Marketing, eCommerce, Media, CRM, Analytics, Technology and Product teams to translate global platforms, playbooks and capabilities into practical regional adoption; provide performance requirements and feedback without owning product roadmaps.
- Build trusted relationships with market leaders, hotel executive committees, owners, management companies, agencies, media partners and commerce platforms, including regular business reviews and performance escalations.

- The APACx Marketing and eCommerce discipline strategy, annual operating plan and multi-year capability roadmap, including priorities, service levels, governance and investment recommendations.
- A regional performance-management system with scorecards, forecasts, channel and market diagnostics, test-and-learn readouts, quarterly business reviews and clear actions for markets and enterprise partners.
- Scalable consulting tools, playbooks, training and automation that raise the performance maturity of markets, hotels and ownership groups and improve the speed and consistency of execution.

WHY YOU’LL BE A GREAT FIT

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Economics, Analytics or a related field.
- 12+ years of progressive experience in regional, international or global marketing, digital commerce, eCommerce, revenue growth or a closely related commercial discipline.
- At least 5 years leading multi-market teams, cross-functional teams or complex regional programs in a matrixed multinational organization.
- Proven experience setting strategy and improving business performance across multiple markets, brands, channels or customer segments.

Career in the Hospital
Join our incredible team at the National University Hospital (NUH), where we believe that a hospital is more than just a workplace. Every day, we witness the remarkable impact that our healthcare professionals can have on individuals, families, and entire communities.

Our strong ties with the medical school have shaped us into a unique institution, allowing us to seamlessly integrate clinical care with teaching and research. • Provide strategic communications counsel including branding and editorial oversight and support to internal stakeholders
• Develop crisis communications plans and participate in emergency preparedness exercises

• Bachelor in mass communications, public relations, marketing, journalism or a related field

Title: Senior Executive, Public Relations
Description:
The Senior Executive, Public Relations supports NTUC Club’s external communications, corporate reputation and earned-media efforts across its B2B and B2C portfolio of brands. The role develops accurate, newsworthy and audience-relevant publicity materials; supports key messaging for corporate announcements, campaigns and strategic initiatives; builds relationships with media, influencers and PR partners; coordinates media engagement; and monitors coverage, public sentiment and emerging issues. The Senior Executive is expected to work closely with internal stakeholders to understand business priorities, secure factual and management clearances, protect NTUC Club’s reputation and strengthen sustained brand visibility.
Key Responsibilities:
PR planning and story development
Support the development and delivery of integrated PR plans that strengthen NTUC Club’s corporate reputation across its B2B and B2C portfolios. Identify newsworthy angles, shape story narratives and key messages for corporate announcements, campaigns and strategic initiatives, and maintain a forward publicity pipeline aligned with organisational and business priorities.
Media materials and editorial
Draft, edit and proofread media releases, advisories, interview pitches, media invitations, fact sheets, FAQs, holding statements, speeches, talking points and briefing notes. Ensure materials are clear, accurate, aligned with NTUC Club’s house style and tone of voice, and ready for the intended audience and channel.
Media pitching, relations and engagement
Develop and proactively pitch tailored story angles to relevant journalists, editors and producers to secure earned-media opportunities. Build and maintain strong working relationships with media contacts, PR partners and relevant stakeholders; disseminate approved materials; manage follow-ups; and respond promptly and professionally to media enquiries and requests to drive coverage, publicity and brand visibility.
Interviews and spokesperson support
Coordinate interview opportunities, media briefings and on-site coverage. Prepare spokesperson briefs, anticipated questions and approved messages; manage logistics and ensure relevant internal stakeholders are aligned before engagement.
Media events, drops and influencer engagement
Plan and execute media previews, invitations, media drops and relevant influencer engagements. Manage guest lists, RSVPs, materials, gifting and on-site requirements while ensuring appropriate approvals, records and follow-up.
Media monitoring and reporting
Monitor media coverage, public sentiment and relevant conversations; maintain accurate clipping records; and prepare PR reports post-campaign. Assess results against agreed indicators, highlight sentiment and emerging issues, recommend actions where necessary, and capture learnings and recommendations for future outreach.
Issues and crisis communications support
Monitor for potential reputational issues, escalate concerns promptly and support crisis communications planning and response across external channels in accordance with the approved Incident and Media Management SOP. Assist with fact gathering, holding lines, stakeholder coordination, media monitoring and post-incident documentation.
Stakeholder and clearance management
Work with business units, corporate stakeholders, Customer Experience, PR partners and other relevant teams to obtain complete information, visuals and factual confirmation, and to address reputational issues and opportunities. Maintain clear review and approval trails, and ensure materials are not disseminated before the required departmental, management and business unit clearances are secured.
PR platforms, databases and records
Maintain the media database, campaign media lists, PR WIP, coverage folders, templates, approved materials and decision history in SharePoint. Support the effective use and administration of media-monitoring and PR tools.
Budget, vendor and governance support
Track approved PR spend, quotations and commitments; brief and coordinate vendors; and maintain supporting procurement, reconciliation, evaluation and audit documentation in accordance with internal requirements.
Requirements:
Degree or diploma in Mass Communications, Public Relations, Media Studies, Journalism or a related field.
At least 3–5 years of relevant experience in public relations, media relations, corporate communications or a related communications role.
Proven experience in media pitching, developing newsworthy story angles and securing earned media opportunities.
Exceptional writing, copywriting, editing and proofreading skills, with strong news judgement and critical-thinking ability.
Strong project management and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate internal teams, media contacts, agencies and vendors.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment while supporting both B2B and B2C portfolios.
Ability to multitask, manage competing priorities and deadlines, and respond calmly and promptly to emerging media or reputational issues.
Note: This scope of work is not limited to the above and may include additional responsibilities under the Group Marketing, Communications and Brand department, as required by business needs.

Title: Senior Performance Marketing Executive
Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a strategic, data-driven and performance-focused Senior Performance Marketing Executive to drive digital demand generation and customer acquisition.
You will take ownership of end-to-end performance marketing campaigns that generate qualified leads, support pipeline growth and contribute to measurable business growth.
Working closely with Product Marketing, Brand, Sales, Business Units, media agencies and platform partners, you will use data, customer insights and experimentation to continuously improve campaign performance and maximise marketing ROI
How you’ll contribute to MyRepublic’s success:
- Develop and execute integrated performance marketing strategies to drive qualified leads, pipeline growth and customer acquisition.
- Plan, manage and optimise paid media campaigns across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn, Meta, Yahoo Native, display and remarketing.
- Manage media budgets and investments to optimise ROI, CPL and overall campaign efficiency.
- Drive continuous optimisation through A/B testing, audience segmentation, bid strategies, creative testing and landing page improvements.
- Monitor campaign performance and develop dashboards covering lead quality, attribution, conversion rates and key marketing KPIs.
- Work with media agencies and platform partners to ensure campaigns are delivered on schedule and meet performance objectives.
- Collaborate with Product Marketing, Brand, Sales and Business Units to translate business priorities into measurable digital initiatives.
- Drive website conversion optimisation across landing pages, lead forms, user journeys and CTAs.
- Support SEO and SEM initiatives to improve organic visibility and website traffic.
- Manage marketing tracking and measurement, including GA4, Adobe Analytics, Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking, UTM governance and attribution.
- Analyse customer behaviour and audience insights to identify growth opportunities and improve targeting strategies.
- Drive first-party data activation, audience segmentation, remarketing and lookalike audience strategies.
- Explore emerging digital platforms, AI-powered marketing tools and automation opportunities to improve marketing efficiency.
We think you’ll fit in great with us if you:
- Experience in performance marketing, digital marketing or growth marketing.
- Experience in B2B technology, telecommunications, ICT, SaaS or related industries is preferred.
- Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta Ads Manager and native advertising platforms.
- Proficiency in GA4, Adobe Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio and other digital analytics platforms.
- Strong understanding of SEO, SEM, CRO, marketing automation and attribution modelling.
- Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, Zoho or similar.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable marketing insights.
- Strong project and stakeholder management skills, including experience coordinating agencies and cross-functional teams.
- Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to present campaign performance and strategic recommendations to senior stakeholders.
- Self-motivated, commercially driven and comfortable working in a fast-paced, performance-oriented environment.
Why Join Us?
At MyRepublic, we believe in creating a workplace that values your well-being, growth, and happiness — both in and out of work. Here’s what you can look forward to when you join our team:
- Wellness Day - Enjoy 1 wellness day every quarter to rest, recharge, or do something that makes you feel great.
- Industry Leading Family Care Benefits– Time off to care for your loved ones when they need you most.
- Birthday Leave – Celebrate you! Take a day off on your special day.
- Work From Anywhere (WFA) Leave – Up to 20 days a year to work from wherever inspires you.
- Hybrid Work Arrangement – Enjoy flexibility with a mix of office collaboration and remote work.
- Plenty of Fun Events! – From team bonding activities to festive celebrations, there’s always something happening to keep the energy high and connections strong.
From being the first to launch 1Gbps broadband plans and the first network optimised broadband service for gaming in Singapore, to crafting workplace practices that put wellbeing at its core, our values guide us in everything we do at MyRepublic. It’s the secret sauce that makes us tick. If you espouse the following, we know you would fit in great with us!

Job Description
NIQ CMI’s Customer Success Team focus on delivering world class insights and reports to the clients and striving for very high level of Customer Satisfaction and advocacy.
Customer Success is NIQ's key department which is instrumental for the company’s success.
So where do you fit here?
A successful candidate for this role will be someone who can establish strong relationships with both our clients and our colleagues. You will quickly become a trusted partner, working with many of our clients’ teams, including marketing, sales, category, and many more.
You will be expected to understand our clients’ needs and then create and present solutions that help achieve their strategic and tactical goals.

- Be responsible for identifying opportunities through day-to-day engagements with our clients, handing off opportunities to Account Development to pursue
- Have a strong working knowledge of the client business priorities and the role we can play in supporting these goals
- Be a confident and capable crafter of compelling insights, deliver clear and actionable recommendations to our clients helping them grow their business.

Title: Senior Strategist
Description:
Company Description
AKA is an integrated communications agency based in Singapore, supporting our clients locally, regionally and globally by conceptualising and bringing to life compelling creative campaigns. Part of our offering is design and production support - from creating on-point infographics for an infant formula brand, through to shooting stylish cinema ads for a travel destination. Everyone at AKA is forward-thinking, collaborative, and passionate about delivering great work for our clients (plus we're a friendly bunch). We enjoy a flat hierarchy and expect everyone - no matter what level - to bring ideas to work every day, speak their mind, and positively contribute to the culture. We're proud to work with some of the world's leading brands - the likes of Durex, Meta, Jetstar Asia, Tourism New Zealand, and Levi's to name just a few.
Overview
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior / Strategist with a strong focus on social-first storytelling and digital culture to join our talented team. If you are a passionate cultural translator with a proven track record of developing insights that drive impactful, platform-native campaigns, we encourage you to apply.
Responsibilities
As a Senior / Strategist at AKA Asia, you will sit at the heart of our Strategy & Studio teams, playing a pivotal role in shaping client narratives and developing forward-thinking communication strategies. You will be responsible for translating complex business objectives into actionable consumer insights, crafting inspiring creative briefs, and providing strategic counsel to clients across diverse industries. Because of our growing focus on social-first scopes, this role requires a deep, intuitive understanding of the digital and social landscape, emerging cultural trends, and platform behaviors. You will collaborate intimately with our Social & Content and Integrated Creative hubs to ensure strategies are seamlessly brought to life in ways that resonate deeply with modern audiences.
- Strategic Counsel & Vision: Provide high-level strategic counsel to clients, deeply understanding their business challenges and developing tailored, future-proofed communication strategies to achieve their goals.
- Social-First Strategy: Lead the development of social-first campaigns. Demonstrate a deep understanding of platform nuances (TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, etc.), creator culture, and digital community behaviors to build strategies that are native to the platforms they live on.
- Research & Cultural Insights: Conduct qualitative and quantitative research to uncover human truths, cultural shifts, and audience behaviors. Utilize social listening tools and market analysis to identify untapped opportunities for clients.
- Creative Collaboration & Briefing: Distill complex research into clear, compelling, and inspiring creative briefs. Act as a strategic partner to the creative, social, and earned comms teams throughout the creative process to ensure the work stays on strategy and delivers maximum impact.
- Client & Pitch Management: Play a lead role in new business pitches, shaping the strategic narrative from the ground up. Manage the strategic components of day-to-day client accounts and participate in critical client presentations.
- Measurement & Effectiveness: Define campaign KPIs and collaborate with data/analytics counterparts to track and measure the effectiveness of social and integrated campaigns. Use data to refine ongoing strategies and demonstrate clear ROI.
- Thought Leadership & Mentorship: Elevate the agency's strategic output by keeping the broader team up-to-date on industry trends, platform algorithm changes, and competitor activities. Mentor junior team members and contribute to a collaborative, intellectually curious agency culture.
Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Communications, Marketing, Advertising, Sociology, or a related field.
- Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in strategic planning, with a heavy emphasis on social media, digital strategy, or integrated communications.
- Proven track record of developing and executing successful, award-worthy social-first and integrated campaigns.
- Deep expertise in social media platforms, digital culture, and creator-led ecosystems.
- Proficiency with social listening, audience insight, and analytics tools (e.g., Brandwatch, Meltwater, GWI, native platform analytics).
- Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to turn data into compelling narratives.
- Excellent writing, briefing, and presentation skills, with the ability to command a room and influence senior client stakeholders.
- Ability to work independently, manage multiple moving parts, and thrive in a fast-paced agency environment.

Title: Senior Wellness Livestreamer & Social Content Creator
Description:
About Fei Fah Medical Manufacturing
For over 75 years,
Fei Fah
has helped people live healthier lives through trusted wellness solutions — from the Electric Medibalm born in our original Chinatown drugstore in 1950, to modern innovations like our 1000-day fermented True Zen Sleep Enzyme. Today, we're building on that heritage by blending timeless values with digital innovation, growing our brands across eCommerce, social, and new markets.
We’re looking for a proven on-camera talent to become the lead face and voice of a beloved Singaporean brand as it finds its modern voice on camera.
The Role
This is a new, exploratory role, and you’ll help build it from the ground up.
Your main job is to
lead and host livestreams
that build awareness of our products and consistently turn viewers into customers. Your second job is to
create social media content
that does the same. You’ll bring your own playbook, test and refine it, and help us define what a winning livestream and content approach looks like for Fei Fah, including high-visibility sessions as we expand into new channels.
This is a hands-on role for someone with a track record of hosting and selling live, who takes ownership of results and sets the standard for the people around them.
Key Responsibilities
Livestreaming
(primary focus)
• Host and lead livestream selling sessions on TikTok Shop, Shopee, Lazada, Instagram, Facebook and other emerging platforms
• Present our wellness products with confidence, credibility and conversion in mind
• Engage viewers in real time, handle questions and objections, and drive sales through vouchers, bundles and flash deals
• Plan the livestream schedule, themes, formats and run-sheets, aligned with mega-sale events (e.g. 9.9, 11.11, 12.12)
• Take ownership of livestream performance targets (viewers, engagement, conversion, sales) and report with concise insights and recommendations
• Experiment with new formats, timings, platforms and co-host or guest-host arrangements
• Coordinate with operations and the marketing team so stock, pricing, promotions and equipment are ready before going live
• Coach and support junior hosts and co-hosts where needed
Social Media Content
(secondary focus)
• Create and star in short-form videos, Reels and other content for TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Rednote and other channels that build awareness and drive sales
• Develop content ideas and series that turn attention into store traffic and sales
• Repurpose livestream highlights into clips and content
• Use AI tools wherever they help you ideate, produce and edit faster
• Work closely with our designer and content team, giving clear briefs and constructive feedback
Compliance
• Ensure everything you say and show, on live and in content, complies with platform policies and applicable local health product regulations (we’ll train you on what you can and can’t claim)
Who We’re Looking For
• 2-3+ years of experience in livestream hosting, live selling, or on-camera content with a track record of driving engagement or sales
• Strong on-camera presence: confident, expressive and natural, able to carry long sessions
• Ability to think quickly and handle live comments, objections and the unexpected with ease
• Experience with TikTok Shop, Shopee, Lazada or similar live selling platforms
• Comfortable with data, and confident turning numbers into actions
• Good sense of social media trends, and curious about AI tools
• Organised, accountable and able to work independently
• Experience in FMCG, health or wellness is an advantage
• Proficient in English and Mandarin to effectively communicate with English and Mandarin-speaking clients.
Essential Qualities
• Accountable and results-driven
• Passionate difference maker
• Proactive and loves to learn
• Experimental, with a test-and-learn mindset
• Attention to detail
What We Offer
•
An attractive compensation package which could be structured on base pay plus lucrative commission on sales
, depending on experience and the arrangement that suits you
•
Flexible engagement:
permanent, freelance, full-time or part-time, including evening and night sessions
•
Flexible location:
livestream from our office, from your own home, or from another suitable place you’d like
• Full product training
• Opportunity to be the lead on-screen personality of a heritage Singaporean wellness brand
•
Opportunity to go on board Genting Cruise
for livestreaming with us
• Room to shape our livestream playbook and grow into a team lead as operations expand
How to Apply
Send us your resume together with your TikTok or Instagram profile and
links to previous livestream replays or on-camera work
, ideally with any results you can share (viewers, engagement, sales).

With growing capabilities in formulation development, quality systems, and production, Fei Fah supports the development and manufacture of innovative health and beauty products for regional markets.

Title: Senior/ Specialist, E-Commerce Marketing (Amazon Campaigns & Promotions)
Description:
Company Overview: Truegenics Pte Ltd is a leading ecommerce company based in Singapore with a track record of over US$218M in online product sales. We specialise in e-retailing our own brand of health supplements to a global audience. We strive to create value and make a positive difference in the world, one life at a time. We believe that even the smallest action can define one’s destiny, and are committed to the creation of products that enhance the lives of our consumers.
Mission of the role: This role is responsible for driving our revenue growth through expert campaign and promotion planning across all four brands (Simple Promise, 5th & Glow, N-Labs, and 7th Manna). The Specialist will focus on optimizing conversions through data-driven insights, developing and executing robust promotional strategies, and working closely with our Operations and PPC teams to ensure flawless high and low-level execution. This person will act as the analytical engine for our campaigns, processing complex data to discern winning strategies from underperforming ones, and guiding the brands toward sustainable, high-impact growth.
Key Responsibilities:
Promotions & Campaigns
Promotions Planning & Execution: Take full ownership of developing and executing promotional strategies and campaigns. Coordinate seamlessly with the Operations and PPC teams to ensure all promo strategies and executions are carried out accurately and on time.
Data-Driven Insights & Analytics: Process and analyze campaign data and key e-commerce metrics (e.g., ROAS, ACOS, TACoS). Exercise strong analytical judgment to discern "what is good and what is bad" in campaign performance, providing actionable insights to optimize overall spend and ROI.
Merchandising & Content Execution
Content Optimization: Optimize and update keywords (KWs), product descriptions, image assets, and A+ content to maximize organic ranking and conversions.
Listings Management: Create fully optimized new listings for new product launches and update existing listings where needed.
Inventory Management & Transparency Program: Manage inventory replenishment, ensuring stock levels are optimal, discrepancies are resolved, and oversee Amazon's Transparency Program to prevent unauthorized sellers.
Competitor Benchmarking: Continuously track competitor content (ads, videos, images, etc.) and benchmark competitor SKU prices to maintain our competitive edge.
Collaboration & Trend Identification: Identify current trends in e-commerce content. Work closely with the Affiliates team to identify winning external content and mirror those strategies onto our Amazon listings.
Cross-Functional & Strategic Support
Cross-Team Collaboration: Act as the central hub between Marketing, Operations, and PPC teams. Align stakeholders on campaign strategies, improve cross-departmental execution processes, and ensure all teams are synchronized for major promotions across all brands.
Reporting & Analytics: Maintain, generate, and present detailed reports on promotional and campaign performance metrics to stakeholders, driving strategic decision-making.
Key Skills / Experience Required:
Education: Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (preferred but not mandatory).
Experience: At least 3 years in eCommerce or Digital Marketing, with a strong focus on the Amazon marketplace.
Campaign & Promotion Management: Proven ability to plan, launch, and manage e-commerce promotional campaigns, coordinating with various teams to ensure successful execution.
Analytical & Strategic Insight: Exceptional analytical skills. Must be highly capable of processing raw data, identifying trends, and discerning successful tactics from underperforming ones to drive future strategy.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Experience collaborating with operations, advertising (PPC), and creative teams to bring campaigns to life.
Tools Proficiency: Familiarity with Amazon Seller Central, advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, VLOOKUP), and data analysis tools like Helium 10 or ScaleInsight.
Self-Starter: Ability to work independently, take absolute ownership of promotional calendars, and lead initiatives from start to finish.

Title: Social Commerce Content Specialist
Description:
About Us
Dyson is a global technology enterprise. We solve the problems others choose to ignore, with surprising new inventions that defy convention and simply work better. We’re growing fast and our ambition is huge – more categories, more locations, and more people.
From its beginnings in cyclonic vacuums, Dyson’s portfolio has grown to include five main areas of technology: Cord-free and corded vacuum cleaners, hand dryers, lighting, environmental control machines (purifying fans, heating and cooling fans and humidifiers) and hair styling tools, which are sold in more than 82 countries across the world. We are on a mission to improve our customer’s lives: whether that be by making the the air they breathe safe and clean, or connecting them to high performing machines, which keep their homes clean.
About The Role
Role Overview
The Social Commerce Content Specialist supports the execution and optimization of Dyson Singapore's social commerce content across TikTok Shop and other platforms. The role plans, creates, publishes and optimizes social commerce-native content that supports discovery, engagement, qualified traffic and commerce contribution, while exploring AI-enabled workflows to improve creative speed and production efficiency.
Key Responsibilities About You
- Always-On Content Planning
- Support the development of weekly content plans and publishing schedules based on commercial priorities and campaign requirements.
- Recommend content themes, product focus areas and campaign support ideas for Dyson's owned social commerce channel.
- Maintain a strong base bank of planned content while protecting capacity for reactive trends and timely cultural moments.
- Balance product education, demonstration, problem-solution, creator-led, entertainment and conversion-oriented formats.
- Plan sufficient content depth to support multiple daily posts during launches and key commercial periods without compromising quality or accuracy.
- End-to-End Content Creation
- Spot relevant social trends, behaviors, sounds, formats and hooks; translate them into ideas appropriate for a premium technology brand.
- Develop concepts, hooks, scripts and shot lists for organic and commerce content, with guidance from the wider team where required.
- Shoot and edit content using mobile-first workflows and collaborate with internal stakeholders; create platform-native cuts, captions, graphics and sound treatments.
- Publish content accurately and on time, with correct product naming, claims, links, tags and social commerce Shop product anchors.
- Explore AI-enabled tools to improve ideation, scripting, editing, localization and content versioning.
- Content Re-Purposing and Capture
- Rework suitable global and regional assets into local, social-native edits.
- Identify and repurpose high-performing material from affiliates, owned livestreams, experts, stylists, launches and events, subject to usage rights.
- Create content briefs and capture plans for colleagues, creators, and talent, so usable footage is generated efficiently.
- Maintain an organized content library with clear status, usage rights, product, format, and tags.
- Trend-Jacking and Reactive Execution
- Identify reactive opportunities that are relevant to Dyson products, audiences and brand standards.
- Performance Optimization
- Track views, watch time, completion, engagement, shares, saves, profile visits, product clicks and video-attributed GMV.
- Identify winning hooks, formats, products and creators; create follow-up variations and retire approaches that are consistently weak.
- Provide a concise weekly content readout with insights, next tests and recommended changes, not only a list of posts published.
- Work with the Social Commerce Lead and Marketing to identify high-performing organic content suitable for paid boosting.
- Brand and Content Governance
- Ensure all content meets brand, legal, product-claim, music-rights and platform-compliance requirements.
- Maintain Dyson's premium positioning while creating content that feels current and native to TikTok.
- Key Performance Indicators
- Output and Consistency: Agreed owned-channel publishing cadence delivered; planned base content and reactive content produced on time.
- Speed: Time from trend identification or commercial brief to approved publication.
- Attention Quality: Average watch time, completion rate, shares, saves and engagement versus benchmarks.
- Commerce Contribution: Product clicks, click-through rate, video-attributed GMV and qualified content passed for boosting.
- Learning Velocity : Number and quality of structured tests, repeatable winning formats and performance-led iterations.
- 1-2 years' experience in short-form video, social content, creative production or creator-led marketing.
- Demonstrable social media-native portfolio with strong hooks, pacing, storytelling, product demonstration and editing judgement.
- Able to concept, script, shoot and edit independently using tools such as CapCut, Premiere Pro or equivalent.
- Fast and resourceful, with strong trend judgement and discipline to protect premium brand standards.
- Curious and hands-on with AI content tools, with the ability to test new workflows responsibly and turn successful experiments into repeatable production processes.
- Strong attention to detail in product claims, captions, tagging, links, file management and publishing accuracy.
- Able to work with employees, creators, experts and stylists to capture natural, useful content efficiently.

Title: Social Media Executive
Description:
ABOUT US
The Hey Co Group is a homegrown Singapore F&B group founded in 2016. Over nine years we have built and scaled a portfolio of brands across quick-service, casual dining, cafe, restaurant and bar. We are not a chain. Each brand has its own identity, its own audience, and its own reason to exist — and we obsess over quality and consistency across every touchpoint, including the ones on people's screens.
Social media is where most people meet our brands for the first time. A single Reel can fill a restaurant on a quiet Tuesday. That is why this role sits at the heart of how we grow.
THE ROLE
We are looking for a creative Social Media Executive to support our Branding & Marketing Manager in bringing six distinct brands to life.
You will be the hands-on engine of our social channels — creating content and caring for our communities. You bring the ideas and the execution. The Branding & Marketing Manager brings the strategy and brand direction. Together you will make sure each brand shows up consistently, on time, and looking its best, every single week.
We are a team that embraces AI, and we want someone who uses it to create faster and think bigger — from ideation through to editing.
This is a great role for a creative, platform-native person who wants to do the work, learn fast, and see their content reach thousands of guests.
A DAY IN THE LIFE
No two days look the same. A typical week might involve shooting a new menu launch at one of our cafes in the morning, editing a batch of Reels and Stories over lunch, scheduling the week's posts, replying to a wave of comments and DMs, checking how last week's content performed, and syncing with the Branding & Marketing Manager on an upcoming campaign.
Some days are quiet and edit-heavy. Others are fast, on-location and full of energy.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
Create content — shoot, edit, schedule and publish posts, Reels and Stories across our brands, following the direction and calendar set with the Branding & Marketing Manager
Shoot and edit — capture short-form video and photography in-store and on-location, quickly, with a phone and light kit
Community — reply to comments and DMs across assigned brand accounts, engage followers, and keep each brand's tone right. Escalate service issues and complaints to the relevant outlet manager promptly
Support campaigns — support the launches, seasonal menus, promotions and collaborations that the Branding & Marketing Manager plans
Paid social support — set up and boost posts across Meta and TikTok under the Branding & Marketing Manager's direction. Monitor spend and basic performance, and flag what is and is not working
Local SEO support — keep our Google Business Profiles current across outlets (hours, photos, menus, review responses) and apply keyword and caption basics so our content is easier to find
KOL coordination — coordinate influencer and food creator visits: scheduling, logistics and hosting on the day
Use AI — use AI tools to work faster and smarter: drafting captions and ideas, generating and editing images and video, researching trends, and streamlining your day to day
Report — track reach, engagement, saves and follower growth by brand, and share a simple monthly update on what is working and what is not
Consistency and ideas — keep each brand's tone, look and quality distinct and consistent, and bring fresh, on-trend ideas to the table
WHAT YOU WILL BRING
Essential:
One to three years in social media and content — F&B, hospitality, lifestyle or agency
A portfolio, showreel, or links to two or three accounts you have personally run. Applications without work samples will not be reviewed
A creative, ideas-driven eye for aesthetics, storytelling, and food that looks irresistible
Strong hands-on skills across Instagram, TikTok and Facebook, plus shooting and editing short-form video and photography
Working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager at boosting and basic campaign level
Basic understanding of local SEO — keywords, captions, hashtags, and Google Business Profile management
Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Canva AI, CapCut, image and video generators) to create, ideate and work efficiently
Able to juggle several brands and deadlines without dropping quality, and to hold distinct brand voices apart rather than blending them into one
Comfortable working in live restaurant environments, including occasional evenings and weekends for shoots
A genuine love for food, hospitality, culture and people
Based in Singapore and able to travel between our outlets
Advantageous:
Basic design ability (Canva, Figma or Adobe)
Familiarity with Xiaohongshu
Written Mandarin
Experience with a multi-outlet or multi-brand group
Familiarity with the Singapore F&B and dining scene

Send the following to HR@theheyco.com:
Your CV
A short note on why this excites you
Links to content you have created — a portfolio, a showreel, or two to three accounts you have run, with a line on what you were responsible for

Planning and executing integrated, multi-channel campaigns across digital platforms, social media, webinars, podcasts, customer events, and other relevant customer touchpoints.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working across local, Zone, and global teams in a matrix and multicultural environment.

Title: 2027 Analytics & Sales Early Professional Programme, Singapore (May class, Thai Speaker)
Description:
The Analytics & Sales Program offers a unique opportunity to build expertise in financial markets, Bloomberg technology, and client engagement while developing a foundation for a long-term career within Bloomberg's Financial Solutions business.
You will begin your career in Analytics, where you'll work directly with Bloomberg Professional Services clients across the global financial community. In our Analytics business, you will provide 24/7 support to Bloomberg users around the world and across multiple industries. Through Instant Bloomberg (IB) chat, you'll answer client questions, solve complex workflow challenges, and help clients maximize the value of Bloomberg's products and solutions.
On any given day, our teams respond to tens of thousands of client inquiries in over 15 languages. From helping portfolio managers analyze risk to supporting traders as they uncover new sources of market liquidity, you'll gain exposure to a wide range of financial workflows while developing deep product, market, and client expertise.
As Bloomberg continues to innovate, you'll partner with clients to introduce new products, deliver training, support onboarding and product rollouts, and help organizations utilize technology more effectively. You'll also collaborate closely with Sales teams on strategic client initiatives, building the skills and relationship management capabilities that prepare you for future opportunities across Financial Solutions.
As your expertise grows, you'll have the opportunity to progress into Sales, the most common career path within the program. In Sales, you'll become a trusted advisor to clients, building long-term relationships, understanding business goals and workflows, and identifying opportunities to deliver Bloomberg solutions while driving business growth.
What's In It for You?
Industry-Leading Training
From day one, you'll participate in one of the industry's most comprehensive training programs, building a foundation in financial markets, asset classes, Bloomberg technology, and client workflows.
Client Exposure from Day One
After training, you'll join one of our Analytics teams, where you'll continue learning through hands-on client exposure, mentorship, and specialized asset class and workflow training. Every client interaction is an opportunity to deepen your expertise, develop your problem-solving skills, and build confidence as a trusted advisor.
Long-Term Career Growth
The Analytics & Sales Program is designed to accelerate your professional development. As your knowledge and experience grow, so do your opportunities. Most participants progress into Sales, where they build long-term client relationships and drive business growth, while others pursue specialist client-facing, product or leadership roles across Bloomberg's Financial Solutions business.
Who You Are
You are intellectually curious, client-focused, and energized by financial markets. You enjoy solving problems, learning new technologies, and understanding the drivers behind market-moving events. A strong communicator and relationship builder, you thrive in fast-paced environments, are passionate about delivering exceptional client experiences, and are motivated to build a long-term career helping clients solve challenges and achieve their business goals.
You’ll need to have:
Bachelor's degree (or above) and the ability to start a full-time role in 2027 (Candidates graduating by July 2027 are welcome to apply)
Up to 3 years of work experience
Professional fluency in English and Thai (written and spoken), as the role requires regular communication and support business activities conducted in Thai
Demonstrated academic coursework or work experience in financial markets, economics or fintech
Experience in customer service roles (interacting with both internal and external clients)
Experience with client interaction in sales or account management capacity
Strong multitasking, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to learn quickly and adapt in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Interest in innovative technologies and their potential to enhance workflows and efficiencies.
Flexibility to occasionally work weekends or on bank/public/federal holiday (weekday off in lieu).
We’d love to see:
Demonstrated practical exposure to Python or other coding languages preferably.
Beginner to intermediate experience with Excel and/or Visual Basic for Applications (VBA)
With 1-3 years of full-time work experience in the financial market or financial services industry, or in client-facing/relationship management/sales/consulting role

Title: Account Executive, Scale (Thai Speaking)
Description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.
We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.
To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.
Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.
If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
The ideal candidate will have at least 5 years experience selling, renewing and expanding SaaS solutions to clients in a variety of different verticals in the mid-market, commercial or enterprise segment. Ideally, this experience will include collaboration with Customer Success, Business Development, and Marketing teams’ into the lead generation process.
You will work with Braze’s high growth potential clients to ensure they are maximizing value from technology and services in order to develop and grow the relationship. This is an opportunity to bring your skills as a consultant, business analyst, project manager and sales professional to work with leading brands and expand your knowledge of cross-channel consumer engagement, mobile marketing automation, APIs, analytics and AI Decisioning.
This is a field sales role that routinely requires travel for onsite customer engagement, resulting in a majority of time spent out of the office meeting with and selling to existing customers. Your focus market (although not limited to) will be the Thailand and Vietnam market.
WHO YOU ARE
- 5+ years of experience in a relevant closing role
- Background in SaaS sales for Mobile and/or Marketing Technology
- Up-to-date on digital trends, especially in the AI, mobile, web and Customer Engagement space
- Intimate knowledge of the Thailand and Vietnam technology landscape and network
- Outstanding verbal, written and stand-up presentation skills, with experience of presenting value propositions to executive teams and at customer/prospect/partner events
- Proven ability to prospect into target accounts
- The ability to handle multiple competing priorities
- A hunter mentality
- Drive, determination and accountability
- Excellent organizational skills and time management abilities
- Proven success navigating organizations and the ability to quickly identify decision makers and the decision-making process for organizations
- Prior experience with salesforce.com CRM, or other CRM used to manage sales pipeline
- Intermediate to advanced knowledge of Google Workspace suite of productivity tools and Claude/Gemini
- Proven ability to quickly get up to speed on new cloud apps and tools
CORE OBJECTIVES
- Achieve quarterly net new and retention revenue targets
- Consistently generate robust pipeline in support of these targets
- Develop commercial relationships in order to increase Braze utilization and value
- Effectively communicate customer feedback to the Braze product and leadership team.
- Cross-department collaboration, including but not limited to Business Development, Success, Sales, RevOps, Product, Legal and Marketing
- Coordinate resources to drive feature adoption
- Excellent Product knowledge
- Pro-actively analyze customer product usage and identify growth opportunities
- Work with Success & Onboarding managers and other technical partners to seamlessly transition clients from pre-sales, through onboarding and into ongoing Service usage
WHAT WE OFFER
Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country here. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.
From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we’ve got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:
- Competitive compensation that may include equity
- Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans
- Flexible paid time off
- Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
- Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave
- Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend
- A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
- Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching
- Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze
- Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®
ABOUT BRAZE
Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™. Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.
The company has been consistently recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was named a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2026. Title: Business Development Manager, South Asia
Description:
Company Overview:
Verathon is a global medical device company focused on supporting customers by being their trusted partner, delivering high-quality products that endure over time and ensure clinical and economic utility. Two areas where Verathon has significantly impacted patient care, and become the market leader in each, are bladder volume measurement and airway management. The company’s BladderScan portable ultrasound and GlideScope video laryngoscopy & bronchoscopy systems effectively address unmet needs for healthcare providers and meaningfully raise the standard of care for patients. Verathon, a subsidiary of Roper Technologies, is headquartered in Bothell, Washington, USA and has international subsidiaries in Canada, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit www.verathon.com.
Overview:
This is a commercial execution role — a genuine product expert with sharp market knowledge who can hold their own in a distributor sales meeting, a hospital tender review, or a pricing negotiation. The BDM owns the performance of Verathon's distributor network across Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, and the Philippines — markets significantly underpenetrated relative to Verathon's global footprint, with substantial room to grow.
The VP of Asia retains final contract ownership; this role drives the day-to-day commercial work, measured on three things:
Finding the right partners — identifying and recommending distributors who can perform in-market
Educating and influencing them — building partner sales teams' clinical and commercial capability
Holding them accountable — to forecasting, pricing, and revenue targets, including compliant conduct in government and tender dealings
Best suited to someone who has managed distributor performance before and drives outcomes through product credibility and follow-through rather than a direct reporting line.
Responsibilities:
Partner Identification & Selection (~10%)
Identify, evaluate, and recommend distributor partners across all five markets based on market reach, capability, and strategic fit
Lead due diligence before onboarding; ensure new distributors are approved by Verathon's Quality organization per regulatory requirements
Continuously assess the distributor network and evolve the partner mix as the business grows
Distributor Negotiation & Commercial Terms (~15%)
Negotiate distributor pricing and discounts within Verathon's GDLP framework and delegated authority; escalate requests outside standard parameters to the VP of Asia
Manage agreements using Verathon's standard contract templates; recommend non-standard terms for the VP of Asia's review — the VP of Asia retains contract ownership and sign-off
Ensure all pricing and contracting activity aligns with Pricing Committee governance
Partner Education & Influence (~25%)
Design and deliver training on Verathon's Airway and Urology portfolio for distributor sales and clinical teams; partner with Marketing on product launches so teams are trained and equipped ahead of time
Build referral networks and a repeatable onboarding/certification framework to accelerate adoption and ramp new reps quickly
Provide direct clinical/technical support during evaluations and case reviews; develop "local champions" who can carry product advocacy independently
Partner Accountability & Performance Management (~20%)
Hold partners accountable to forecasting discipline, pricing execution, and revenue targets through structured business reviews; drive corrective action when targets or contractual commitments are missed
Address underperformance proactively and constructively, escalating to the VP of Asia when more significant partnership changes are warranted
Monitor partners on an ongoing basis for competitive conflicts of interest and for compliance with anti-corruption/anti-bribery requirements in government and tender dealings; escalate immediately if issues arise
Own forecast input and pipeline visibility (Salesforce/CRM); drive revenue growth and margin discipline together, not one at the expense of the other
Tender & Public Bid Management (~10%)
Own end-to-end tender/RFP strategy for public and institutional healthcare bids across all five markets, from opportunity identification through submission
Build TCO models and health economic value dossiers to justify premium pricing in cost-constrained, GPO-driven public healthcare systems
Coordinate with distributor teams, Legal, and Regulatory on bid compliance; develop competitive bid positioning with Commercial Ops and Pricing
Track win/loss outcomes and tender pipeline as a standing input to quarterly business reviews
Stakeholder Relationships & Market Intelligence (~15%)
Build relationships with KOLs, reference sites, healthcare institutions, government health agencies, regulatory bodies, and professional societies relevant to market access and tender success
Represent Verathon at regional conferences and industry events
Monitor competitive activity (e.g., Ambu, Olympus) and market dynamics; champion digital/AI tools to improve territory planning, forecasting, and distributor productivity
Deliver structured quarterly business reviews to the VP of Asia — what's working, what isn't, and what needs escalation
Cross-Functional Operational Support (~5%)
Coordinate with Customer Care, Technical Service, Finance, and Marketing to keep distributor operations running smoothly — order flow, service issues, credit terms, and product end-of-life transitions

Demonstrated ability to navigate healthcare regulatory, tender/RFP, and pricing/contract processes across multiple SE Asia markets, including building health economic/TCO value propositions for GPO and tender wins
