Title: Named Account Executive, Thailand
Description:
About Us
At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
Available Locations
- Singapore
About The Role
The Cloudflare APAC sales organisation operates as one integrated revenue system. Account Executives, Customer Engineers, Partner Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Customer Experience Managers, Professional Services and Revenue Operations work as a continuous engine - winning, deploying, adopting, expanding, and scaling platform commitments across the full customer lifecycle.
The system is supported by an AI-embedded operating model. The work itself, however, remains human. The role of every seller at Cloudflare is to bring critical thinking, judgment, and trust to customer relationships and outcomes.
In this role, you will be responsible for driving significant growth by landing and expanding a portfolio of assigned customers in Enterprise accounts of the Thailand market. The ideal candidate possesses a strong blend of sales acumen and technical understanding, enabling them to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical buyers. As an Account Executive, you will drive revenue velocity by utilizing foundational sales data layers for accurate forecasting, proactive pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets.
You are the kind of operator who uses AI as a force multiplier every day, cares more about customer outcomes than job boundaries, and demonstrates curiosity, judgment, and high agency.
Responsibilities
- Own and execute a comprehensive territory plan to consistently achieve and exceed sales and revenue targets.
- Cultivate long-term strategic relationships with key accounts and partners. Lead executive-level transformation narratives that earn the right to be in the architecture conversation.
- Leverage top partners as an extension of the sales team to co-sell alongside where they bring customer relationships, services capability, or procurement leverage. Drive regular forecast & pipeline cadences with top partners.
- Understand customer network architectures, the problems that Cloudflare can solve and effectively translate Cloudflare’s solutions to drive successful platform sales, ensuring clients can secure and scale their own AI-driven workloads.
- Manage contract negotiations and structure platform-level commercial commitments (multi-year, multi-product, outcome-anchored) rather than point-product deals.
- Stay engaged through onboarding, adoption, and the first renewal. Partner with Customer Engineers, Professional Services on a deployment plan with milestones tied to measurable outcomes.
- Proactively build and manage a robust sales pipeline by leveraging internal tools, AI-assisted research and pipeline sources (BDR, Channel, Marketing).
- Maintain high standards in pipeline discipline, CRM hygiene and forecasting accuracy.
Desirable Skills, Knowledge, And Experience
- Bachelor's degree required.
- Experience selling technology solutions in high-growth technology firms.
- Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting and exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.
- Proficient in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and multi-threaded land and expand strategies.
- Strong understanding of computer networking, cloud security technology, and how enterprise infrastructure adapts to automated data workflows.
- Exceptional interpersonal communication skills and value selling skills.
- Proficiency in modern sales software, customer data environments, and core systems (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite).
- Thinks critically rather than reacting, exercises judgment under uncertainty, names risks honestly, shows genuine empathy for customers as people, can point to relationships built over time on trust, and demonstrates visible curiosity in how they prepare, sell, and learn.
- Willingness to actively engage with AI tools and experiment.
- Ability to travel as required.
- The portfolio for this role consists of customers based in Thailand. Proficiency in Thai to communicate with these customers would be required.
What Makes Cloudflare Special?
We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.
Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.
Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.
1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.
Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

This role is based remotely in APJ timezone, and requires native-level Thai language fluency to serve our Thai customers, prospects, and AWS field teams.
Who We Are
DoiT is a global technology company empowering cloud-driven organizations to achieve business growth and innovation through strategic cloud utilization. We blend data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state, from initial planning to full-scale production.
With extensive experience across various cloud environments, we possess deep specializations in Cloud Data Platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, and BigQuery, as well as FinOps expertise. As a trusted and award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we proudly support over 4,000 customers worldwide.
Our flagship offering is DoiT Cloud Intelligence (DCI), which uniquely combines advanced technology with human insight, enabling us to solve complex multicloud challenges and drive significant efficiency for our clients.
The DoiT Cloud Intelligence platform:
- Provides deep visibility into cloud cost, usage, performance, and optimization opportunities across complex multi-cloud environments, enabling organizations to make data-driven infrastructure decisions.
- Combines automation, analytics, and expert guidance to identify savings opportunities, improve resource efficiency, and continuously optimize cloud investments at scale.
- Powers Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Systems Integrators (SIs), and Private Equity (PE) operating teams with portfolio-level insights, benchmarking, and operational tooling to manage multiple cloud environments effectively.
- Goes beyond reporting by delivering prescriptive recommendations and automated workflows that help engineering, finance, and platform teams turn cloud intelligence into measurable operational and financial outcomes.
The Opportunity
As a Solutions Engineer supporting DoiT Cloud Intelligence in Thailand, you will be the hands-on technical face of DoiT in the local market. Partnering with Account Executives, Customer Success, and the AWS field team, you will help Thai enterprises, digital natives, MSPs, and Systems Integrators unlock actionable insights across their AWS and multi-cloud environments — driving cost efficiency, operational visibility, and smarter cloud decision-making through DCI.
This is a growth-oriented Field Engineering role. You are chartered to drive DCI and product adoption through high-impact technical sales plays, measurable revenue growth, partner-led pipeline, new logo acquisition, and upsell/cross-sell motions. You will sit at the intersection of customers, cloud platforms, and our product — an embedded technical partner inside the account team rather than a reactive support resource.
Responsibilities
Technical Qualification & Discovery: Collaborate with the Account Executive to thoroughly understand the prospect’s cloud environment, FinOps maturity, cost management challenges, and operational goals through in-depth technical discovery sessions across engineering, finance, and platform teams.
Technical Validation & POV Leadership: Own and drive technical validation and Proof of Value (POV) exercises for DoiT Cloud Intelligence, including POV preparation, proactive management, and ensuring successful technical outcomes that demonstrate clear value and alignment with prospect requirements.
Platform Demonstrations: Develop and deliver compelling, tailored demonstrations of DCI in Thai and English, showcasing cloud cost visibility, optimization insights, and operational intelligence across complex multi-cloud environments.
Business Case & ROI Development: Leverage your understanding of cloud economics and FinOps to build business cases and ROI analyses that clearly articulate the financial and operational impact of adopting DCI, for both engineering and executive audiences.
AWS Partner-Led Growth: Work with AWS field teams and local partners on co-sell motions, partner-sourced pipeline, and accelerator programs — including GenAI, Migration Acceleration Program (MAP), and Well-Architected Framework Review (WAFR) engagements. Support GTM initiatives that convert partner relationships into qualified opportunities.
Hands-On Cloud Engineering: Act as a trusted cloud engineer who designs and helps implement improvements in cost efficiency, resilience, security posture, and operational automation. Lead structured technical engagements such as optimization sessions, reliability and security reviews, architecture deep dives, migration assessments, and Well-Architected style assessments.
DCI Power User & Expertise: Become the go-to expert for DoiT Cloud Intelligence in the region: build analytics and cost allocation views, surface cost and risk opportunities, write Composer queries, create CloudFlow automations, and embed DCI into customer observability, governance, and CI/CD workflows.
Partner & Portfolio Motion Support (MSP, PE, SI): Support technical engagements with MSPs, PE firms, and SIs by demonstrating how DCI enables portfolio-level visibility, operational insight across multiple cloud environments, and scalable optimization strategies.
Technical Win Ownership: Take full ownership of the technical win for DCI engagements — guiding prospects through evaluation, addressing technical requirements, and building confidence in the platform’s ability to drive cloud efficiency and operational insight.
Reusable Assets & Enablement. Convert field work into reusable assets: playbooks, Terraform modules, automations, architecture diagrams, internal tooling, and documented patterns. Create external-facing technical content such as webinars, workshops, and customer enablement sessions in Thai.
Event & Conference Presentations. Represent DoiT and DCI at local and regional events, AWS events, webinars, and industry conferences, delivering engaging presentations and demonstrations.
Product Feedback & Customer Advocacy. Translate customer pain points, partner requirements, and feature gaps into structured, technically credible input for Product and Engineering, helping shape the evolution of the Cloud Intelligence platform. Represent the voice of the Thai and APAC technical customer in roadmap discussions.
Accurate, Timely Documentation. Ensure timely entry of data into internal business support systems and contribute to the tools and metrics that highlight business performance and effectiveness.
About You
You are an accomplished Solutions Engineer or hands-on cloud architect with customer-facing experience, ideally in a B2B SaaS or cloud consulting environment. You are a native Thai speaker who can move fluidly between a Thai-language executive conversation and an English-language technical deep dive with a global product team.
You are excited about enabling companies to transform themselves using the public cloud, and you hold yourself accountable for the success of any initiative you are involved in. You want to be part of a high-performance, growth-focused organization and you enjoy winning against the competition. - 5+ years of hands-on experience designing, deploying, and operating production workloads on AWS (experience with GCP or Azure is a strong plus), with the ability to reason across compute, storage, networking, IAM, and observability.
- Experience in a customer-facing technical role — Solutions Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Pre-Sales Engineering, or Field/Forward Deployed Engineering — selling or delivering into enterprise and mid-market accounts.

Title: TikTok LIVE - AI Data Operation Specialist (Thai Speaking)
Description:
Responsibilities
About the Team
The livestream industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become the next growth driver for TikTok global business. It also brings great joy to users globally and it creates a new channel for our creators to show themselves.
We are seeking an AI Data Operation Specialist to join our team to lead quality initiatives in content moderation—leveraging both human labeling and machine learning models, including Large Language Models (LLMs). This role plays a critical part in upholding content quality across TikTok LIVE platform. The ideal candidate will be deeply involved in training AI models, analyzing moderation data to extract actionable insights, resolving complex content scenarios, and working closely with partner teams to ensure effective issue resolution. Success in this role requires strong analytical thinking, high ownership, and the ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams. A keen eye for detail and a proactive mindset toward challenging existing processes and driving continuous improvement are essential.
Detailed responsibilities include:
1. Ensure high-quality content benchmarking across BPO teams, support the setup, onboarding, and training of new BPO teams. Manage policy clarifications, calibrations, and arbitration processes. Analyze BPO team performance to identify knowledge gaps and systemic issues.
2. Handle content labeling for specific queues based on cross-functional business requirements, analyze labeled content to identify trends and provide insights to project teams and independently manage quality evaluation initiatives, delivering actionable analytical insights.
3. Train models using large datasets of labeled content to improve decision-making accuracy. Enhance model capabilities through iterative training and reinforcement learning, assist in data preparation, cleaning, and structuring for training purposes. Improve model accuracy by testing and fine-tuning, highlight the algorithm team with supporting examples for any potential gaps in LLM decision making draft, revise, and quality-check content to explore and enhance the synergy between human input and data in LLM training.
4. Analyze moderation and labeling data from multiple queues to derive a process or market specific trend/correlation. Arrange supporting data points for impact analysis and solution planning.
5. Custodian of all quality specific artifacts for the content moderation scope, generating creative solutions, including the use of technology and tools, to enhance the quality of both individual and team outputs.
Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, Communications, or a related field
- 3+ years of experience in AI data operation, leveraging AI and ML for content quality management, product operations, or a related analytics role.
- Proficiency in data analysis and visualization tools such as Excel, Tableau, Power BI, or similar
- Basic understanding of machine learning concepts and Large Language Models (LLMs)
- Strong ability to analyze complex datasets, identify patterns, and generate actionable insights
- Fluency in both written and spoken English is essential as it will be utilized as the primary language for daily work. In addition, to better understand live streaming content in specific regions and better monitor and improve the ecosystem health of the Thai markets, proficiency in Thai is also necessary.

Title: Commercial and CX Graduate Associate - CHR 805
Description:
About the Role:
Grade Level (for internal use):
09
S&P Global Energy Commercial and CX Graduate Program
Role: Associate, Commercial and CX Graduate
The Location: Singapore
The S&P Global Energy Commercial and CX Graduate Program journey begins with an intensive 5-week onboarding in our London office.
The 3-months thereafter will be part of the EMEA Customer Success Team, focusing on building a foundational knowledge of the commodity markets, developing essential business-related skills while learning about various S&P Global Energy data, research and analytical products. With Customer Success, you would be a primary contact for clients, providing solutions to their requests in a timely, professional and courteous manner and providing training on S&P Global Energy products through virtual and onsite visits.
The program will consist of rotations to customer success, sales, channel management and marketing functions. This will enable each graduate to gain a holistic perspective of the business. Combined with on-the-job learning, graduates must complete and pass certification milestones along with a rigorous evaluation process that will test and stretch their skills and capabilities. As you progress though the program, you will have the opportunity to support the sales team and ultimately generate additional revenue that helps to grow our business
You will be offered the opportunity to assist S&P Global Energy in achieving its mission of being one of the leading providers of the highest quality price assessments and analytical information to the world’s financial and commodity markets. Our real-time news, pricing and analytical services help markets operate with transparency and efficiency worldwide. As the principal provider of commodity price assessment and information to more than 10,000 customers in 150 countries and with 20 offices spanning five continents, you will form part of a truly globally diverse workforce. You will be part of a rapidly growing organization with an exceptional corporate culture. Our data, analytics, and research help our customers make informed, smarter business decisions and investments.
We are looking for high achievers from a diverse pool of current undergraduates or recent graduates who are passionate about the energy and commodities markets and want to develop their career in a dynamic, high performing and multicultural commercial team. You will be someone who can quickly work out how to make things happen through intellectual curiosity, creativity, exceptional learning agility and problem solving skills as well as effective networking and collaboration skills. Additionally, proficiency in Generative AI technologies and the ability to leverage these tools for innovative solutions will be highly valued.
What’s in it for you:
You will join as a member of a cohort of Commercial and CX Associates. Here, you will be introduced to world-class experts in various commodities including former chief economists, traders and risk managers. They will give presentations about how commodity markets work and provide insightful perspectives on global economic, political, technological and legal issues linked to their specializations. You will also be enrolled in an e-learning curriculum, providing foundational knowledge about the technical aspects of various commodities and market.
Within weeks you will have the opportunity to present topics to senior management and to get constructive feedback on your progress. Throughout the program you will learn how to use tools including S&P Global Energy-Platts, CERA and HORIZON products, Excel add-ins and CRM systems.
You will be challenged on a daily basis with a steep learning curve. You will get the opportunity to work with a broad range of clients including governments, investment banks, commodity trading houses, major oil and gas companies, hedge funds and industry and get to be part of a large energetic and international team with fantastic opportunities for growth.
Career paths after the 18-month initial phase of the program include:
Regional Sales
Specialist Sales
Customer Success
Responsibilities:
Help clients understand how to navigate and extract useful data from the S&P Global Energy product range.
Liaise with the content, commercial and technical teams to address any client queries and ensure our data is maintained to the highest standards.
Proactively reaching out to clients for face-to-face/virtual training (this will apply towards the later stages of development once fully fluent and certified on the product range).
Conduct research about important issues at the forefront of energy and commodity markets and present this to colleagues.
Support sales teams with research and proposals.
Build account overviews and plans to support strategic sales teams.
Design data-driven models and templates for clients.
Create marketing materials for commercial culture initiatives and future graduate cohorts.
Getting involved in special project initiatives where determined necessary by management.
Requirements:
Ability to join a class of new hires in late February 2027
BSc or BA degree, or equivalent.
All applicants must have the right to work in Singapore
Fluent command of English is a prerequisite. Proficiency in additional ASEAN (Mandarin/Vietnamese/Thai) languages is highly desirable.
Strong presentation and communication skills. You must have good telephone manners and be comfortable presenting to large groups both in person and remotely.
Strong understanding and command of AI Capabilities.
Familiarity with or strong interest in learning about financial and commodity markets.
Good PC skills including the Microsoft Office product range.
Well versed in Excel
Ability to effectively multi-task and work independently.
Willingness to learn and take on a wide variety of tasks.

The company built on breakthroughs.

The enterprise network product group consists primarily of optical-based communication networks sold to businesses, governments and individuals for their own use.
Note: This role can be based in either Singapore or Bangkok, Thailand.
Purpose of Position:
To provide comprehensive local support for application engineering and implementation of Corning solutions to key hyperscale customers in Thailand. To build deep local relationships with key project stakeholders which include telecom design consultants, network installers, multi-tenant data center (MTDC) operators, main contractors and channel distribution partners.
Key Responsibilities:
Solution Design & Implementation
Support design and implementation of Corning solutions for AI-ready data center infrastructure, including high-density optical connectivity for compute, network, and interconnect environments.
Drive early engagement with hyperscale customers to secure Corning specifications in AI data center designs and implementation standards.
Translate customer technical requirements into scalable, repeatable deployment solutions for hyperscale AI programs.
Technical Support & Engineering
Act as Subject Matter Expert (SME) for assigned Hyperscale DC sites. Provide technical & engineering support to global / regional account teams to ensure that all technical requirements are fulfilled
Facilitate field trials and define criteria for successful trials. Track and forecast customer timing for acquisition and deployment.
Provide technical & engineering support to customers during implementation and deployment phases
Sales & Pre-Sales Support
Develop and maintain collaborative relationships with customers, network installers, telecom consultants, and integrators to deliver project success
Provide recommendations for passive optical connectivity design and new innovations tailored to meet specific customer needs in dealing with complex technical challenges across various data center networking applications
Assist with the review of technical specifications and compliance, BOM development for bids and tenders
Market Analysis & Strategy
Stay up-to-date on the latest trends and requirements for AI data center networking in APAC market
Conduct market research to identify potential opportunities to build network infrastructure at scale
Contribute to the development of the strategies to expand Corning’s demand position (CDP) in APAC market
Collaboration & Training
Train Corning network preferred installers (NPIs) on network design, installation, and deployment practices, in accordance to the hyperscale customer requirements.
Share implementation best practices, lessons learned, and troubleshooting knowledge across global / regional support and sales teams.
Travel Required:
Up to 30% travel within APAC.
Required Education:
Bachelor’s degree in an engineering or science field
Required Years and Area of Expertise:
3–5 years of experience in data center infrastructure, application engineering, systems engineering, technical sales, project delivery, or deployment support
Experience supporting hyperscale, cloud, or AI data center environments preferred
Experience with optical connectivity, structured cabling, high-density network infrastructure, or data center deployment projects preferred
Required Skills:
Understanding of hyperscale and AI data center network architecture
Knowledge of high-density fiber infrastructure and deployment practices
Ability to support implementation, rollout, and issue resolution in fast-paced customer environments
Strong capability to work across customer, sales, engineering, operations, and manufacturing teams
Familiarity with GPU / AI cluster connectivity environments preferred
Soft Skills:
Effective time management, organization, and reporting skills
Ability to prioritize and effectively manage competing requirements
Effective written and verbal communication skills

Title: Business Development Lead (VN/TH) & Head of Sales (Maternity Cover)
Description:
MiQ is seeking a commercially driven Business Development Lead to grow new business across Vietnam and Thailand while providing leadership continuity as Head of Sales maternity cover. You’ll lead market growth plans, build pipeline, coach Sales Managers, and drive revenue in partnership with key teams—using MiQ’s data, analytics, and programmatic expertise to deliver for clients.
Start date: 1 November 2026
Maternity cover period: 22 February – 21 July 2027
Role purpose
Own new-business growth across Vietnam and Thailand while providing maternity cover for the Head of Sales during the stated period. The role combines market development, sales leadership, and continuity of the broader sales agenda.
Core mandate
- Generate new-business revenue per market from Vietnam and Thailand
- Lead the Sales Managers in Vietnam and Thailand to build qualified demand and convert opportunities.
- Provide leadership continuity for the Head of Sales during the maternity-cover period.
- After the cover period, continue the Business Development remit and report to the Head of Sales.
Key responsibilities
Business development
- Build and execute the Vietnam and Thailand growth plans.
- Create a pipeline through target-account planning, partnerships, referrals, events, and other relevant channels.
- Own senior stakeholder engagement for priority prospects and opportunities.
- Maintain accurate forecasting, pipeline hygiene, and regular reporting against market targets.
Sales leadership
- Set priorities and operating cadence for the Sales Managers in both markets.
- Coach managers on demand generation, opportunity progression, deal strategy, and forecast accuracy.
- Align with Marketing, Client Services, Operations, and Finance to support revenue conversion and delivery readiness.
Head of Sales maternity cover
- Maintain continuity of sales leadership, decision-making, and performance management from 22 February to 21 July 2027.
- Lead the agreed sales rhythm, including pipeline reviews, forecasting, business reviews, and escalation management.
- Ensure a structured handover before and after the cover period, with clear ownership of active opportunities, risks, and decisions.
Success measures
- Revenue: new-business revenue achieved in each market by December 2027.
- Pipeline: Sufficient qualified pipeline coverage and progression to support the market targets.
- Leadership: Sales Managers in both markets have clear plans, weekly operating cadence, and visible accountability.

Title: Business Development Representative
Description:
About Us:
Vortexa was founded to solve the immense information gap that exists in the energy industry. By using massive amounts of new satellite data and pioneering work in artificial intelligence, Vortexa creates an unprecedented view of global seaborne energy flows in real-time, bringing transparency and efficiency to the energy markets.
With offices in London, New York, Houston, Singapore, Geneva and the UAE, we are building the definitive platform for energy and freight analytics globally - backed by leading investors including Morgan Stanley & Notion Capital.
The Role:
We are seeking a motivated and results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our BDR Pipeline Generation team, based in our Singapore office and focused on the APAC region. You will play a crucial role in driving the growth of our business, helping to generate new opportunities across our core APAC customer segments.
You’ll be responsible for identifying and engaging high-potential prospects across APAC — including Singapore and Southeast Asia (e.g. Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand and Vietnam), Japan, South Korea, Australia, India and Greater China — through both marketing-generated leads and proactive outbound efforts ensuring our Sales team is set up to succeed. You'll work closely with Sales, Marketing, and RevOps to drive pipeline generation through inbound lead discovery and qualification, proactive and energetic outbounding, and driving attendance at key APAC industry events.
It’s an ideal opportunity for someone eager to develop their SaaS career in a high-performing, global team, while learning about one of the world’s most impactful and complex industries.
In this role you will:
Drive qualified pipeline through personalised, multichannel outreach (email, LinkedIn, phone, event follow-up, and local channels such as WeChat, LINE and KakaoTalk where appropriate)
Conduct Discovery calls and qualify leads before handover to Sales, mapping the buying group and approval process (often consensus-driven in markets such as Japan and Korea)
Research and map high-potential accounts across APAC’s core segments — national oil companies and refiners, Japanese trading houses and utilities, Singapore-based trading firms, shipowners and brokers, bunkering, and banks and commodity funds
Collaborate with the Marketing team to promote and drive registrations for Vortexa-hosted and APAC industry events (e.g. Singapore International Energy Week, APPEC, Singapore Maritime Week, Asia Pacific Maritime, and LNG and freight conferences in Japan, Korea and Australia)
Collaborate with the RevOps, Sales, and Marketing teams to evolve scalable playbooks and processes
Ensure accurate tracking and maintenance of data within the BDR tech stack (Salesforce, Salesloft, Gong, Marketo etc.)
Run outreach in line with regional data-privacy and anti-spam rules (e.g. Singapore PDPA, China PIPL, Japan APPI, India DPDP Act, Australia Spam Act)
Maintain core working hours aligned to Singapore time, with flexibility to engage prospects across APAC time zones (from India to Japan and Australia), plus occasional regional travel for key events and customer meetings (10-20%)
Consistently meet or exceed quarterly targets for revenue contribution (e.g. qualified demos booked with AEs, pipeline created, and pipeline closed won)
Requirements
You will have:
At least 2 years of experience in a SaaS BDR, SDR, or commercial associate role
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to craft compelling outreach and hold engaging conversations with senior stakeholders to engage prospects and nurture leads
Cultural fluency in APAC business norms, including relationship-led selling and hierarchy-aware engagement with senior stakeholders
Genuine interest in the energy, freight, or commodities space; (experience in the sector is a plus)
A proactive and curious attitude, with an eagerness to grow within a high-performing team
A proven track record of exceeding commercial OKRs
Experience with Salesforce, Salesloft, Gong, ZoomInfo, etc. or similar tools, plus the resourcefulness to research accounts manually where database coverage is thin (common in North and Southeast Asia)
Professional working proficiency English and additional local languages (bonus)
Sound judgement when engaging prospects in sanctions-sensitive or politically sensitive trade flows
The ability to work independently, take initiative, and meet deadlines

Prior exposure to APAC commercial, trading or maritime environments.
Benefits
Stock-options in a fast-growing, high-potential business
An open, collaborative, and supportive working culture built on merit, which celebrates creative thinking and “getting things done.”
The opportunity to work with AI-driven technology in a scale-up environment with commodity trading experts
Private Health Insurance offered via AXA

Title: E-Commerce Lead
Description:
Aire is a Singapore-born senior care brand on a mission to redefine ageing and incontinence. We make adult diapers, pull-up pants and leak pads that are softer, more absorbent and sized for Asian bodies, so older adults can enjoy carefree days and restful nights.
The Role
We're hiring a hands-on, data-driven E-Commerce Lead to own Aire's online business across Shopee, Amazon and TikTok Shop, plus our D2C site. You'll own the full funnel: traffic, conversion, retention and channel P&L. You'll also build our livestream and social commerce engine from the ground up.
This is a fully remote role. We're a small, lean team, so you'll set the strategy and do the work yourself. A big part of the job is coaching our existing team members and growing their e-commerce skills as we scale.
Responsibilities
Marketplaces and social commerce
- Own e-commerce revenue and profitability targets (GMV, ROAS, CAC, LTV, repeat rate) across Shopee, Amazon, TikTok Shop and the D2C site
- Run day-to-day marketplace operations: listings, pricing, promotions, mega-sale calendars (9.9, 11.11, 12.12), stock planning and platform account-manager relationships
- Lead livestream and social commerce on TikTok Shop and Shopee Live: strategy around our hosts, scripts, run-of-show, KOL and affiliate partnerships - leading team here
- Manage marketplace ads (Shopee Ads, Amazon Sponsored Ads, TikTok GMV Max) and allocate budget based on performance
D2C, performance and organic growth
- Grow the D2C site (shop-aire.com) as a profitable channel
- Build and scale performance marketing, including paid social, paid search (Google) and affiliate
- Drive organic growth through SEO, content and community, for both the D2C site and marketplace search
- Design and run CRO experiments across the D2C site and marketplace storefronts (product pages, bundles, vouchers)
- Build retention and lifecycle programs (email, SMS, WhatsApp, subscription and repeat purchase). Incontinence care is a recurring need, so retention is core to the business.
Data, planning and partners
- Manage the e-commerce budget and report weekly on channel performance, unit economics and forecasts
- Build market-specific playbooks as we expand into Malaysia, Indonesia and Thailand
- Manage agencies and e-enabler partners, and hold them to clear targets
- Work with product, design and supply chain on launches, packaging and inventory
Team development
- Train and coach our small team in marketplace operations, ads, livestreaming and analytics
- Document processes and playbooks so the team can run channels independently
- Help hire and grow the e-commerce team as the business scales
Requirements
Must have
- 6–8+ years in e-commerce, marketplace or growth marketing, ideally in FMCG, personal care, health or wellness
- Proven experience running livestream and social commerce, with measurable results on TikTok Shop and/or Shopee Live
- Hands-on experience managing Shopee, Amazon and TikTok Shop stores, including ads, campaigns and operations
- A track record of scaling paid acquisition profitably across channels (marketplace ads, paid social, paid search)
- Working knowledge of SEO and D2C site growth (Shopify or similar), including CRO and lifecycle marketing
- Strong data skills: comfortable in seller centers, GA4, dashboards and spreadsheets, and able to make budget calls from cohort, LTV and margin data
- Experience coaching or managing others, and patience to train a team that is still learning
- Self-directed and comfortable working remotely in a lean team, doing both strategy and execution
Preferred
- Experience at an e-commerce enabler or marketplace (e.g. aCommerce, Synagie, Shopee, Lazada, Amazon, TikTok), managing multiple brands or categories
- Experience across multiple Southeast Asian markets and their regulatory environments
- Background in senior care, adult incontinence, healthcare or other regulated consumer health categories
Why Join Aire
- Build a category that serves Asia's ageing population with dignity
- Real ownership of the e-commerce channel and its P&L, working directly with the founder
- Fully remote, flexible working
- Shape and grow a team from the early stage as we expand across Southeast Asia
Read more about Aire
- After being laid off from Meta, this S'porean invested 6 figures to start an adult diaper biz (Vulcan Post, Nov 2024)
- Why We Doubled Down On Our Partnership With Aire (DSG Consumer Partners, Jun 2025)
- Why We Partnered with Aire: Championing the Silver Economy in Southeast Asia (DSG Consumer Partners, May 2024)

Send your CV and a short note on a livestream or marketplace campaign you're proud of (with results) to nivedita@shop-aire.com.

Title: Field Marketing Manager, ASIA
Description:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.
Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.
Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.
The Role In a Nutshell
As the Field Marketing Manager for Asia, you will play a key role in driving regional growth across Southeast Asia (ASEAN) markets. You will own and execute the regional field marketing strategy, partnering closely with Regional Directors, Sales, BDRs, Partnerships, SEs, and the wider APJ Marketing team to build pipeline, accelerate deal velocity, and strengthen Chainguard's market presence.
This role combines strategic planning with hands-on execution and offers strong opportunities for growth and registered leadership as the business scales.
What You'll Do
Own Regional Demand & Pipeline Growth
- Develop and execute integrated quarterly marketing plans aligned to Asia pipeline across key markets including Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam
- Drive full-funnel demand generation across priority accounts and key market segments
- Align marketing initiatives closely with regional sales priorities and account strategies
Execute High-Impact Programs

- Localize and amplify global campaigns to resonate with regional audiences including security leaders, platform engineers, and DevOps teams
- Leverage digital marketing and ABM strategies to increase engagement and pipeline impact
Drive Strategic Account Engagement
- Partner with Sales teams to identify and activate Tier 1 and strategic accounts
- Build targeted, multi-touch campaigns that support complex enterprise buying journeys
- Create personalised engagement strategies that help accelerate opportunities through the funnel
Strengthen Sales & Marketing Alignment
- Act as a trusted marketing partner to Regional Director, Sales teams, and BDRs
- Align on GTM priorities, territory planning, and campaign execution
- Support Sales with messaging, programs, and tools that improve conversion and pipeline velocity
Expand Partner Marketing
- Collaborate with cloud, channel, and technology partners to co-create and execute joint campaigns
- Work closely with Partner Sales to build scalable GTM partnership opportunities across Asia
- Increase regional reach through strategic alliances and ecosystem engagement
Contribute to APJ Strategy
- Support pan-APJ campaigns, events, and strategic initiatives
- Share regional insights and market feedback to help refine messaging, positioning, and campaign effectiveness across APJ
Measure, Optimize & Scale
- Track and analyse pipeline contribution, engagement, and ROI metrics

- Build scalable processes and frameworks to support regional growth

Title: Head of Digital and Media
Description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.
Our nutrition business develops science-based nutrition products for people of all ages, from helping babies and children grow, to keeping adult bodies strong and active. Millions of people around the world count on our leading brands – including Similac®, PediaSure®, Pedialyte®, Ensure® and Glucerna® – to help get the nutrients they need to live their healthiest life.
Working at Abbott
At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You will have access to:
Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.
The Opportunity
As the Head of Media and Digital, Abbott Nutrition International, a division of Abbott Laboratories Ltd., is a leading player in Nutrition market in Asia Pacific. The person in this role will lead the regional media and digital agenda across 13 APAC markets (Vietnam, Philippines, Malaysia, India, Indonesia, Singapore, Taiwan, Australia, New Zealand, Cambodia, Thailand, Myanmar, Japan) to accelerate profitable growth through brand building, direct-to-consumer (DTC) strategies including execution of eCommerce and social commerce programs. The role owns the regional vision, partner ecosystem, ways of working, data & measurement frameworks, and capability uplift to accelerate New User (NU) acquisition and lifetime value.
What You’ll Do
Define APAC media & digital vision and operating blueprint for brand building and profitable growth with New User acquisition.
Build and govern the regional agency and platform ecosystem; run agency reviews/appointments and set performance scorecards.
Negotiate and manage Joint Business Plans (JBPs) with major platforms (Google, Meta, TikTok, Amazon, Lazada, Shopee, etc.) securing innovation, data access and commercial value.
Architect measurement, data & analytics frameworks: KPIs, attribution strategy (MMM/MTA), dashboard standardization, and data governance.

Set APAC content & creative effectiveness strategy; drive AI-enabled creative testing and analytics.
Own annual investment strategy and budget allocation using scenario planning and portfolio optimization across markets and brands.
Drive innovation and future readiness via pilots in AI/automation, predictive modeling, commerce media; scale wins regionally.
Run Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs): track funnel KPIs (reach → engagement → leads → New User → repeat/LTV) and reallocate spend based on ROI trends.
Publish a monthly competitor and category intelligence brief with implications and recommended actions.
Diagnose priority market gaps and co-create corrective action plans (audience strategy, creative performance, conversion pathways, CRM sequencing).
Lead monthly data quality & measurement check-ins; enforce reporting integrity and governance standards.
Curate and manage an innovation pipeline: design-controlled pilots and A/B tests; publish learnings and playbooks for scale.

Evaluate agency and vendor performance versus scorecards; agree on improvement plans.
Strengthen DTC operational readiness: content calendars, segmentation improvements, marketing automation enhancements with CRM/MarTech teams.
Ensure agencies deliver Everyday Great Execution: pacing, targeting accuracy, bid strategies, budget flighting, creative rotations, and hygiene.
Monitor real-time data and social listening dashboards to detect trends, sentiment shifts, platform algorithm changes, and campaign anomalies.
Activate rapid-response protocols for misinformation, negative chatter, platform incidents, or ad-safety risks.
Sustain tight daily alignment across affiliates and partners to implement tactical course corrections quickly.
Provide on-demand strategic support for urgent market needs (competitive spikes, PR incidents, sudden performance drops

Title: Head, Strategic Partnerships & Alliances
Description:
Your Impact:
The Head, Strategic Partnerships & Alliances serves as a primary dealmaker and strategic partner to the Commercial Vice President of Target Geographies. This role is responsible for driving growth through the origination, evaluation, structuring, and execution of strategic partnerships and business development transactions (in-licensing, acquisitions, and out-licensing) across key geographies (Philippines, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam).
Operating within a matrix structure, the incumbent leads and guides in-country resources to scout opportunities, conduct rigorous due diligence, build business cases, and negotiate complex contracts to successful execution.
What You’ll Work On:
- Opportunity Origination & Market Scouting: Proactively generate and cultivate a robust pipeline of deal opportunities through industry networks, partnering conferences, market intelligence, and local market engagement across target geographies (PH, VN, TH, ID).
- Evaluation & Business Case Development: Lead end-to-end cross-functional assessments—incorporating clinical, regulatory, commercial, scientific, and market access viability—to build comprehensive business models and strategic valuations.
- Due Diligence Management: Direct cross-functional diligence teams (internal stakeholders and external advisors) to validate commercial assumptions, uncover structural risks, and develop actionable risk mitigation strategies.
- Deal Structuring & Term Sheets: Formulate non-binding offers, term sheets, and creative transaction structures that provide a competitive advantage in deal bids while maximizing long-term enterprise value and ensures commercial terms are aligned with key stakeholders for best business outcomes.
- Negotiation & Contract Execution: Lead or co-lead contract negotiations and final execution in close alignment with internal legal, finance, commercial, and Asia Pacific BD leadership.
- In-Country Leadership & Capability Building: Directly lead, guide, and leverage local country resources to elevate market intelligence, opportunity screening, and overall deal-execution readiness across target territories.
What You Bring:
- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Sciences, Life Sciences, or a related field required. Master’s degree or MBA strongly preferred.
- Experience: Minimum 10 years in the biopharmaceutical industry, with a proven track record in Business Development, Corporate Strategy, Portfolio Management, Strategic Marketing, or Commercial Analytics.
- Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in networking, deal structuring, financial modeling/ valuation, and assessing clinical/ regulatory risks and opportunities.
- Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated ability to navigate complex matrix organizations and build trusted relationships with local, regional, and global leaders.
- Languages: Fluent in English; proficiency in one or more Asian languages is desirable.
- Mindset: Driven, highly adaptable professional with strong business acumen and an execution-focused work ethic.
Location: Singapore, Philippines, Indonesia, Thailand or Vietnam
About Menarini Asia Pacific
We are a global, family-owned healthcare company where our people are our priority. Present across 13 markets in Asia-Pacific, here’s why you should join us:
- Local Market Expertise, Global Footprint: As a global family-owned company, we value local knowledge and expertise to invigorate the lives of patients, people and partners

- Empowered to be Entrepreneurial: We operate in a dynamic, low-bureaucracy environment where swift decision-making allows us to make a real impact
- Sustainability and Care: Be part of a company that cares. Together, commit to sustainable workplaces
Join us and invigorate lives! For more information about Menarini Asia-Pacific, please visit www.menariniapac.com

Title: Senior APAC Marketing Manager
Description:
About the Company
GMI Cloud is a fast-growing, AI-native infrastructure company delivering high-performance GPU compute, inference services, and infrastructure for AI agents.
From large-scale compute to optimized inference and agentic workloads, GMI Cloud gives AI teams the infrastructure they need to build, deploy, and scale on one unified cloud.
One cloud for compute, inference, and agents.
About the Role
GMI Cloud is looking for a Senior APAC Marketing Manager to lead marketing strategy and execution across the region (excluding mainland China). APAC isn't one market — Singapore, Taiwan, Malaysia, Thailand, and other sub-markets each have distinct channel ecosystems, buyer journeys, and content preferences. This role isn't about running one playbook everywhere; it's about designing a set of differentiated but coordinated approaches that reinforce each other.
What You'll Do
1. Regional Market Strategy & Approach
- Design differentiated, market-specific playbooks across GMI's APAC footprint (Singapore, Taiwan, Malaysia, Thailand, and other priority markets) — channel priority, content tone, and campaign cadence should reflect each market, not a single template
- Continuously evaluate and refine channel strategy across mainstream regional platforms (e.g., LinkedIn, local trade media, regional tech publications) to keep investment aligned with actual conversion by market
- Rationalize the events calendar, consolidating budget and team bandwidth around high-value moments (e.g., major AI/tech conferences, regional trade shows) rather than spreading thin across low-yield events
- Build out enterprise GTM content and event strategy for priority markets across Southeast Asia (e.g., AgentBox and Prime Inference-focused enterprise events and webinars), and assess where that model can extend further
2. Brand Narrative, Content & Product-Led Growth
- Translate GMI's core brand narrative (five-pillar content strategy, Inference/Compute weighting) into content that fits each market's context — genuine localization, not direct translation
- Bring a product-led growth lens to brand execution — design and run public product launches that use the product itself as the primary growth and conversion mechanism, not just an announcement wrapped in marketing
- Use product launches as a wedge into specific industry verticals — mapping launch messaging, positioning, and follow-through content to the verticals most likely to convert
- Coordinate regional adaptation of social, web, and event content, keeping the global narrative framework consistent without feeling forced
- Build a content calendar and cadence that maps market activity, product launches, and industry events into one unified schedule
How We'll Measure This Role
- Channel performance by market — lead and pipeline generation across LinkedIn, regional trade media, and event channels in each priority market
- Product launch impact — activation and conversion driven directly through launch mechanics, and vertical-specific pickup following a launch
- Content cadence and consistency — steady output aligned with the brand narrative framework
- Event ROI — whether consolidated investment in core events produces measurable pipeline or brand impact
- Cross-functional alignment — how well marketing execution tracks with product launches, partnership timing, and sales targets
What We're Looking For
- 10+ years of marketing experience, including hands-on ownership across multiple APAC sub-markets (Singapore, Taiwan, Southeast Asia, or similar)
- A track record spanning multiple marketing functions — brand, content, demand gen, product marketing — rather than depth in a single lane
- Direct experience with product-led growth: running public product launches where the product itself drives adoption and conversion, and translating launch momentum into vertical-specific pipeline
- Experience designing regional market strategy from scratch, not just executing an existing plan
- Familiarity with mainstream regional channels — LinkedIn, local trade press, industry events, regional tech media — and the ability to design channel and content strategy accordingly by market
- Proven experience localizing brand narrative into region-specific content — understanding the balance between global consistency and local relevance
- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, able to align with Product, Sales, and Partnerships on priorities
- Fluent in English, with additional regional language ability (Mandarin or Southeast Asian languages) a plus
- Working understanding of, or strong interest in, AI infrastructure, GPU cloud computing, or inference services
Bonus Points
- B2B SaaS or cloud/AI infrastructure marketing experience
- Experience marketing into Southeast Asian tech ecosystems (Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Vietnam)
- Experience organizing large industry trade shows or regional AI conferences
- Experience managing content teams or working alongside Developer Advocate / community functions

Title: Snr Specialist Analytics SA – ASEAN, WWSO Data APJC
Description:
DESCRIPTION
In this role, as a Specialist Solutions Architect, you will be the analytics expert for customers across Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, the Philippines, and Vietnam. You will help them build and operate analytics, search, and streaming workloads, and partner with them to design **agent-ready data platforms**: open, governed foundations that let AI agents search, process, and analyse data to support decision-making. The work spans the full range of modernisation, from moving on-premises Hadoop and legacy data warehouses to an open lakehouse on Apache Iceberg and S3 Tables, through to semantic search, natural language data exploration, and RAG-based insight generation.
ASEAN is one of the fastest-growing data markets in the world, and many customers are still deciding where their data platform will live. You will work with banks, telcos, retailers, public sector agencies, and digital natives as they make that decision, often in head-to-head evaluations against Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Fabric, and GCP BigQuery. Grounded in deep analytics expertise, you will bring a broad perspective that spans databases, ML, and security, and you will advise on governance and access control as much as on performance and cost.
You will build reference architectures, demos, and workshops with your own hands and scale them across six countries through account teams and partners. Partners deliver much of the analytics work in ASEAN, so enabling them to land complex platforms such as SageMaker Unified Studio is a core part of the role. You will also carry the voice of ASEAN customers back to the AWS analytics, search, streaming, and generative AI service teams to shape their roadmaps.
Data is the context layer that turns generic AI into personalised, differentiated customer experiences. Every AI conversation is a data conversation, and this role sits at the centre of it for ASEAN. If you see that shift as an opportunity and want to co-create new value with customers across the region, come join us and build the future together!
Key job responsibilities
- Provide deep technical expertise in analytics, search, streaming, and governance (Redshift, Athena, EMR, Glue, Kinesis, MSK, OpenSearch, Lake Formation, DataZone, SageMaker Unified Studio, S3 Tables, QuickSight) across ASEAN's enterprise, public sector, and digital-native customers
- Design agent-ready data platforms on open lakehouse, Iceberg, zero-ETL, RAG, and semantic search
- Lead architecture reviews, immersion days, proofs of concept, and migrations (MAP) off Hadoop, legacy warehouses, and third-party platforms
- Win competitive evaluations against Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Fabric, and GCP BigQuery
- Enable partners and build repeatable assets that scale across six countries
- Carry customer feedback and competitive signals back to service teams to shape the roadmap
A day in the life
Your customers span Financial Services, Telecommunications, Retail, Public Sector, and Digital-Native companies. One morning you run an open data platform workshop in Singapore; by lunch you are designing governed data access for a Manila bank's first production agents. In the afternoon you build a RAG proof of concept with OpenSearch and Bedrock for a Jakarta retailer, then help a partner unblock a SageMaker Unified Studio rollout, before sending field feedback to the Redshift service team. You travel regularly across a region where the decisions customers make today will set their data platform for the next decade.
About the team
The WWSO Data & AI team helps customers adopt our newest and most advantageous technologies. This role sits on the APJC Data team alongside Analytics, Database, and Storage Specialist SAs and GTM Specialists across five geos. In ASEAN, you work closely with the Analytics GTM Specialist, the Database and Storage Specialist SAs, the partner team, and account teams in each country to deliver holistic data outcomes. If you thrive on going deep on technology, love building for customers, and measure success by the architectures you've shaped, this is the role for you.
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
- 7+ years of data warehouse technical architectures, data modeling, infrastructure components, ETL/ ELT and reporting/analytic tools and environments, data structures and hands-on SQL coding experience
- Experience defining data center system-level architecture, documenting performance and equipment requirements, creating and communicating conceptual designs, and creating and maintaining project documentation
- Experience working with technical and business stakeholders from global cross-functional teams
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent experience
- Deep hands-on experience with analytics technologies, including data warehousing (e.g. Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery, Teradata), data lakes, ETL/ELT pipelines, streaming (Kafka, Kinesis, Flink), search (Elasticsearch/OpenSearch), and data governance.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Experience and demonstrated industry leadership in the fields of database or data warehousing, data sciences and big data processing
- AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification, or Bachelor's degree
- Experience designing agent-ready data platforms (open lakehouse, Iceberg, zero-ETL, RAG, semantic search)
- Experience across multiple Southeast Asian markets and building reusable assets at scale
- Fluency in English required; a Southeast Asian language (e.g. Bahasa Indonesia, Thai, Vietnamese) is a plus

As One Bank, we are committed to helping our colleagues build sustainable careers grounded in purpose, supported by strong values, and enriched with meaningful opportunities to grow.
Job Description
We are seeking an experienced Strategic Communications professional to manage communications for our Wholesale Banking and Global Markets businesses.
This role is responsible for shaping and executing integrated communications strategies that strengthen the bank's reputation, support business objectives, and position the organisation as a trusted partner to corporate, institutional and investor clients.
The successful candidate will work closely with senior business leaders across Wholesale Banking, Corporate Banking, Transaction Banking, Treasury, Global Markets, Investment Banking and related functions to develop compelling narratives around market developments, client solutions, industry trends and the bank's strategic priorities.

- Develop and execute strategic communications programmes that support Wholesale Banking and Global Markets business objectives.
- Craft clear and compelling narratives that enhance the bank's thought leadership and market position.
- Advise senior executives on communications strategy, stakeholder engagement and reputation management.
- Translate complex financial, economic and market developments into impactful content for external and internal audiences.

- Develop and maintain strong relationships with financial, business and trade media.
- Identify proactive opportunities to position senior executives as industry thought leaders.
- Manage media enquiries and interview opportunities related to wholesale banking, treasury, capital markets and economic developments.
- Prepare media materials including press releases, media pitches, briefing notes, Q&As and spokesperson talking points.
Executive Communications
- Develop speeches, keynote addresses, opinion articles, LinkedIn content and executive messaging for senior leaders.
- Support executive participation in conferences, industry forums, client events and media interviews.
- Ensure messaging consistency across markets and business units.
Internal Communications
- Support internal communications initiatives that strengthen employee engagement and understanding of business priorities.
- Communicate key business achievements, transactions, client successes and strategic milestones.
- Partner with HR and leadership teams on change management and transformation communications where required.

Typically 2-5+ years pre-sales/ sales experience.

Title: Account Manager - Stakeholder Advisory and Engagement Agency
Description:
Overview
This is a fantastic opportunity to join one of our client communications teams and deliver high calibre, multi-channel communications solutions for our blue-chip client base. This can include annual reports and reviews, sustainability reports, investor relations and employee communications, online reporting centres and wider website content and communications initiatives.
Attracting and retaining the right people for our team is an absolute priority for us and we take their career development seriously from day one. You will have access to a full programme of training and plenty of autonomy to develop new skills and contribute ideas. We take every aspect of the work we deliver for clients seriously and we work to maintain the highest possible standards in everything we do for them and for the company. But as well as being passionate about our work, we are supportive, collaborative and positive, always looking to make what we do enjoyable and rewarding.
Why this job?
You will be instrumental in helping clients shape their communications strategies to positively influence and impact their key stakeholder audiences.
It’s a genuine opportunity to work in a fast-moving environment across a range of channels and audiences.
You will be involved in a diverse client base, providing an opportunity to learn across a range of sectors.
It’s a fantastic chance to grow and expand your responsibilities as part of a career development plan.
Overview of the role
Our client communication teams are looking for a highly motivated and ambitious individual, who is looking to deliver high calibre, multi-channel communications solutions for our blue-chip client base, including annual reports and reviews, sustainability reports, investor relations and employee communications, online reporting centres, website maintenance and social media campaigns.
In the Account Management teams, you will engage with senior stakeholders and provide you with the opportunity to develop an intimate understanding of your client’s strategy and business model as well as a deep knowledge of best practice and market trends in financial and non-financial reporting. In time you will have the opportunities and platform to develop your career within this growing and highly ambitious organisation.
The successful candidate must be comfortable communicating with clients and internal teams, have a keen eye for detail, strong communication and interpersonal skills, creative flair and want to participate in building one of the largest and most successful professional service companies of its kind.
Responsibilities:
Account management
Successfully manage the delivery of assigned mixed-media projects, taking responsibility for all deliverables
Develop an intrinsic understanding of your clients’ business model and strategy
Effectively manage each project stage
Accurately prepare all project documentation
Demonstrate real strength in identifying and managing account and project problems independently and provide effective solutions
Client relationship management
Proactively build strong client relationships with your day-to-day client contacts
Always deliver exemplary client services helping to ensure we maintain the current high levels of client satisfaction and continually seek ways to exceed our clients’ expectations
Commercial responsibility
Work closely with your team leader to develop your commercial awareness of Black Sun’s job costing and fee structures
Effectively manage project budgets by implementing all Black Sun’s quality assurance and financial processes
Where necessary, work with your team leader to develop strategies for auditing and managing overrun costs from clients
New business and client development
Work closely with team leaders to successfully identify new business opportunities from your existing clients, writing client proposals and effectively presenting concepts and delivery presentations
Support the new business process by assisting with the delivery of new business proposals
Research and strategic development
Support internal teams with Black Sun’s research into best practice corporate communications by conducting research
Continually drive your understanding of our clients’ businesses, the industries they operate in, and trends in best practice corporate communications
Qualifications, experience & skills:
Minimum 2.5 years agency or client-side experience, ideally within corporate marketing and communications.
Excellent writing, editing, proof reading skills are essential.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills are essential.
Exceptional attention to detail; and
Be fully conversant with Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Your personal qualities:
Strong interpersonal and communications skills necessary to build trust and respect both externally and internally.
High-quality service ethic and committed to customer service excellence.
Ability to manage many urgent and often conflicting priorities.
Strong ‘can do’ attitude with an innate ambition to take initiative and work by yourself as well as in a team.
Flexibility and team focussed approach with a ‘roll up your sleeves’ attitude to getting the job done; and
A great sense of humour and fun!
Reporting Relationships
Reporting to: Account Director
Work closely with: Creative and Production teams, as well as Digital, Research & Strategy and Finance teams.
Interview process
Phone screening with office manager
1st Interview (teams) with hiring manager
2nd interview (f2f) with hiring director and hiring manager, presentation of task
What we offer
In addition to a competitive salary based on skills and experience, as an employee at Black Sun, you will have access to a range of great benefits and perks, including:
Extraordinary Workplace: : Our office is in a 1920s heritage building right in the heart of Chinatown, surrounded by Michelin-rated eats and city buzz. We’ve even got a rooftop garden home to over 70 species of bees and butterflies. It’s certainly not your average workspace!
Hybrid Working : We ask for three days a week in the office to keep our collaborative energy strong, but you can also work fully remotely for up to two 2-week periods a year (within a 2-hour time difference)
In addition to 22 days’ annual leave and bank holidays, we offer 14 fully paid medical leave and childcare leave, in accordance with MOM’s regulations.
Designated medical service via MinMed and have access to our wellbeing support via our international EAP Service ComPsych Guidance Resources, offering confidential emotional, legal, financial, and life support. This is available 24/7 to you and your immediate family with a digital App to easily access all these resources from your own device.
Bonus Scheme : we offer a discretionary annual bonus to recognise great work and team success.
Training & Development We’re big believers in potential. Our new digital learning platform, Viva Learning makes it easier than ever to build skills, explore content, and take ownership of your development. With access to thousands of videos, articles, and Microsoft 365 courses you can learn at your own pace, when and where it suits you.
Have Your Say: We’re a place where ideas are welcome and voices are heard. Our open-door culture means managers are approachable, and your input can genuinely shape how we work and grow.
Team Socials : We take our celebrations seriously. From social activities, festivity luncheons to company get-togethers, there’s always something to look forward to.
About Us :
Black Sun Global
Black Sun Global is a stakeholder advisory and engagement agency that’s been driving transformation and positive change for ambitious brands for more than 20 years. With deep expertise in disclosure and reporting, ESG, sustainability, and digital engagement, we reshape how organisations connect with customers, investors, employees, and the wider world.
We are trusted partners to some of the most influential global organisations, sparking innovation and sustainable performance through our strategic insights, partnerships, and proprietary technologies.
As founders of the Positive Change Group, we are on a mission to create a new kind of stakeholder relations partner. Our world-class specialists work closely with executive leadership teams to protect reputations, inspire trust, and promote responsible business practices - building resilience and long-term value in a rapidly changing world.
The Positive Change Group
Positive Change Group is a global stakeholder engagement business. Our specialist agencies work as one, bringing together reporting, culture, communications and sustainability through a connected model that helps organisations close the gap between what they say and what people see, so they can present a clear and consistent story across every stakeholder group.
When that alignment is in place, organisations move faster, make better decisions and build confidence in their direction.
Headquartered in London, with an international network across Europe, Asia Pacific, the Middle East and South Africa, Positive Change Group supports over 100 multinational organisations at C-suite and board level.
Join the people driving positive change
At Positive Change Group, we bring together bold thinkers, challengers and collaborators from across disciplines, sectors and geographies - connected by a shared mission and a drive to make a real difference.
We're guided by The Changemaker Way: five shared values that define how we work, lead and grow - with each other, our clients and the communities we serve.
