Title: Ad Product Marketing & Creative Lead
Description:
About Cosmose AI
We make smartphones smarter. Cosmose is integrated by eight phone makers, capturing first-screen real estate and first-party data to drive over 2 billion daily user interactions in 60+ countries.
Why Join Cosmose AI?
Global Scale: Build a product natively integrated across eight major OEMs with access to first-party data from millions of phones in over 60 countries.
Elite Talent Density: Work alongside IOI and ACM-ICPC champions.
High Autonomy, Fast Velocity: Take complete ownership with rapid deployment cycles and a flat org chart.
Real Ownership: Earn stock options that directly tie your upside to our global growth and success.
We are looking for a hands-on Ad Product Marketing & Creative Lead to translate our KaiKai lock screen surface into a compelling, high-impact narrative that advertisers want to buy into.
This is a dual-impact role: you will own our go-to-market strategy, sales enablement, and corporate positioning from scratch, while staying deep in creative execution—setting the quality bar, building agency guidelines, and collaborating directly on client campaigns.
Who we think this person is
Most likely you are sitting in a strategy job at a creative agency, or in brand marketing, business marketing, or platform partnerships at a media house. If you already do ad product marketing at a platform, you will recognise this job instantly, and we want to hear from you, but we wrote this for the first two.
What you'll do
Go-to-market and product marketing
Own commercialisation for new ad formats, from first-client pilot through pilot programme to general availability
Define target advertiser segments and the problem each format solves for them
Write positioning, messaging and proof points, and keep sales speaking with one voice
Package formats into sellable offerings together with the CBO, who owns the rate card and pricing logic
Set and report success metrics for each launch: adoption, advertiser performance, revenue impact
Act as voice of the advertiser to product, and voice of product to sales
Sales-facing material and enablement
Own the full sales kit: decks, one-pagers, case studies, creative spec guides, objection handling
Every case study anchored to a measurable outcome, not a description of what ran
Train the sales team on new formats and refresh that training at each launch
Direct external design and production partners, and own those relationships and their briefs
Creative
Run brand collaborations end to end: concept, pitch, execution with the client's agency, sign-off
Work with the Creative Team
Set and hold the quality bar on everything that runs on the KaiKai surface
Build creative guidelines and a reference library agencies can work to without hand-holding
Put creative testing in place so format and execution decisions are evidenced rather than argued
Market
Track competing platforms: what they offer, how they package it, what they charge
Represent the product as subject matter expert in client and agency meetings, with the sales team
Co-build the annual product moment with the CBO (not the first year)
Cosmose corporate marketing and communication
Clean up corporate positioning and the public-facing basics: website, LinkedIn, company boilerplate
Keep a regular communication rhythm so client outreach lands on a company that looks alive
Owns the work.
KaiKai consumer brand
With the CBO, positioning of the consumer app and the case for voluntary download
What we're looking for
Six years or more; the title on your CV doesn't matter. Strategy, planning, brand marketing, business marketing, product marketing. What matters is what you have made, not what the role was called.
You can take something technical and turn it into a reason a marketer cares. This is the whole job in one line. We have a surface, a set of capabilities, and no story. You build the story, then you have to defend it to someone who buys media for a living.
You know how a brand buys media from the inside. What actually goes into an RFP. Who signs. What brand lift is and why measurement decides whether a budget grows or stays a test. If you have been on the buying side, this is your advantage, and it is the one we value most.
You have a view on creativity, and you can give a brand feedback they will accept. Not taste for its own sake. You can tell the difference between creative that will work on a specific surface and creative that was resized from a banner, and you can say so to a client without losing the client.
You can write about a company, not only about a product. Part of this job is making Cosmose look like a company a media buyer would take seriously. Website, LinkedIn, the basics. You do not need to have done corporate communications as a job. You need to be able to look at what we have today and say what a planner would think of it.
Your Polish and English are good enough to run meetings with internal teams and a global client. The team is spread across Warsaw, Singapore, the SEA market, and Brazil.
You are fine without a process. There is no playbook here yet, and you will be writing most of it.
What you do not need
You do not need to have worked at a platform. Most of the people we are talking to have not. We can teach you pricing, ad load, measurement partners, and how OEM deals work.
No adtech background and no technical knowledge of programmatic.
No sales experience. There is no quota, and you will not own accounts.
Not performance marketing. This is not a media buying or user acquisition role.
What you would be learning in the first six months
How this inventory is priced and why. How measurement works in OEM inventory, and why it is the thing that unlocks budgets. How an OEM partnership actually operates. If none of that sounds interesting, this is the wrong job, because it is where the first year goes.
We’re building something big—and we’re just getting started.
If you’re excited about shaping the future of AI-powered mobile content, we’d love to meet you.
Be part of the Cosmose story. Apply now!

creative

Support learners in developing confidence in digital incident handling.

Responsibilities
About the Team The ModLab AIGC (Artificial Intelligence Generated Content) Team is part of the Monetization Integrity Operations organization within Trust & Safety. Our team specializes in reviewing, labeling, and evaluating content that powers the next generation of AI moderation systems. By producing high-quality datasets and identifying emerging content trends, we help improve machine learning models, strengthen moderation accuracy, refine policies, and support safer advertising experiences across TikTok's products. We work closely with cross-functional partners including Product, Engineering, Data Science, Policy, Quality, and Machine Learning teams to ensure AI systems continue to evolve responsibly while balancing user safety and business growth. About the Role As an AIGC Model Labeling Specialist, you will review and label text, images, videos, advertisements, and content to improve TikTok's AI-powered moderation systems. Your work will directly contribute to the development of machine learning models that detect policy-violating content, improve moderation accuracy, and support product innovation across multiple business lines. You'll also help identify emerging trends, provide operational insights, and contribute to improving moderation policies and AI model performance. This role requires strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to make consistent decisions in a fast-paced environment. What You'll Be Doing - Label and categorize content (text, images, video, multimedia) according to established taxonomy standards and moderation policies. - Produce accurate annotations and datasets that help train, evaluate, and improve AI and machine learning models. - Perform quality reviews to ensure labeling consistency and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. - Escalate ambiguous or complex cases appropriately and participate in discussions to improve policy clarity. - Participate in calibration sessions to maintain consistency across reviewers. - Identify emerging content trends and provide structured feedback to improve moderation guidelines, workflows, and AI models. - Work closely with cross-functional teams including Product, Engineering, Policy, Quality Assurance, Data Science, and Operations to improve moderation effectiveness. - Stay updated with evolving moderation policies and ensure consistent application across all assigned work. - Meet productivity, quality, and turnaround time expectations while maintaining high standards.
Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications - Strong written and spoken English. - Excellent analytical thinking and attention to detail. - Strong decision-making and problem-solving skills. - Good computer literacy and comfortable with learning new internal tools and systems. - Comfortable reviewing sensitive or graphic content. - Able to work rotating shifts, including weekends and public holidays. - Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. Preferred Qualifications - 2+ years of experience in content moderation, Trust & Safety, content review, or data labeling operations within a technology company (e.g. social media, AI, e-commerce, search, or online platforms). - Experience reviewing content (AIGC), including text, images, videos, or synthetic media. - Experience in quality assurance, auditing, or content quality review. - Familiarity with interpreting and applying content moderation or advertising policies. - Experience participating in calibration sessions or maintaining annotation quality and consistency.

You will be responsible for driving accurate and timely service commercial forecasting, revenue planning, and sales performance management across Service Commercial in AKA (ASEAN, Korea, Australia & New Zealand) region. You will have visibility of critical service sales KPIs, sets annual sales targets, and oversees pipeline health, funnel conversion, and backlog execution to achieve operational plan outcomes. Title: Analyst/Associate - Customer Success & Client Acquisitions
Description:
Role Purpose
This role sits at the intersection of performance marketing and client acquisitions operations. You will work with both the Marketing and Commercial teams to execute how Keenai generates, converts, and onboards clients, from campaign and event-led lead generation through to funnel conversion and compliant onboarding, while ensuring the Sales team adheres to the relevant regulatory and compliance requirements across jurisdictions.
You will support a data-driven client acquisition engine: helping set channel and campaign strategy, tracking performance against acquisition metrics, and partnering closely with the Marketing and Commercial teams, RMs, Legal, and Compliance to generate, convert, and onboard clients into active, well-onboarded accounts.
Key Responsibilities
Acquisition Strategy & Performance Marketing: Support the end-to-end client acquisition funnel strategy. Help define and prioritise channels (campaigns, events, partnerships, referrals) based on CAC, conversion rate, and pipeline quality. Track targets and report on acquisition performance to leadership.
Campaign & Event-Led Lead Generation: Plan, coordinate, and measure client-facing events, roadshows, and acquisition campaigns as strategic lead-generation channels. Manage logistics, guest and vendor management, and post-event follow-up, and track ROI and lead-to-client conversion for each initiative.
Funnel & Conversion Analytics: Build and maintain reporting on the acquisition funnel from lead to onboarded client. Identify drop-off points and friction, and recommend process or channel changes that improve conversion and time-to-onboard.
Client On-boarding: Conduct thorough customer due diligence, analyse customer activities, and keep the company's KYC records current per internal standards and regulatory guidelines, ensuring onboarding operations keep pace with acquisition volume.
Document Analysis: Assess customer identity documents, source of wealth documentation, adverse screening, company registries, business structures, beneficial ownership, and other sources and collaterals needed to make the assessment.
RM Enablement: Support RMs' acquisition efforts by coordinating prospect documentation, expediting onboarding turnaround, and removing friction that could delay a lead from converting into an active client. Liaise with RMs to collect, verify, and follow up on required client documents; flag gaps or discrepancies before submission.
Risk & Compliance Oversight: Ensure adherence to internal SOPs, regulatory requirements, and audit standards throughout the onboarding lifecycle. Conduct periodic reviews of client transaction history and account usage, and escalate activities exceeding internal risk tolerance or regulatory guidelines to Keenai's relevant teams.
Records Keeping: Ensure customer records are accurate, organised, and updated as required, in compliance with data privacy regulations and internal data security protocols.
Client Communication: Communicate with clients and prospects clearly and professionally through Keenai's approved communication channels, across both marketing and onboarding touchpoints.
Stakeholder Management: Coordinate with Marketing, Compliance, Risk, and Operations teams to align campaign activity with onboarding capacity, and to resolve queries and expedite approvals.
Relevant Experience
Experience in performance marketing, growth, or acquisitions roles, ideally with ownership of funnel metrics (CAC, conversion rate, ROI).
Experience planning or coordinating client events, roadshows, or acquisition campaigns.
Experience in partnerships, business development, or value engineering roles.
Familiarity with AI or conversational AI technologies.
Prior 0-1 startup or fast-paced high-growth environment experience.
Success Metrics
Client acquisition cost (CAC) and lead-to-client conversion rate
Number and ROI of events/campaigns run
Time to on-board client account
% of onboarding cases resolved within target timeframe
Number of timely account / portfolio reviews
Number of aged/escalated cases
On-boarding TAT:
TAT from Operations for key client topics
Average time from document receipt to account activation, measured against SLA targets.
Qualifications
Proficiency in verbal and written English.
2 to 4 years of relevant experience; based in Singapore, full-time, 5 days a week in office.
Domain knowledge in Wealth Management is a plus.
Experience with performance marketing tools and analytics (e.g., GA4, Meta/Google Ads, CRM reporting) is a plus.
Working knowledge of KYC/AML regulations and onboarding documentation requirements.
Proficiency with CRM and onboarding/workflow systems (e.g., Salesforce, proprietary onboarding platforms), with hands-on experience running campaigns on MoEngage (or similar marketing automation/CRM platforms).
Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; comfortable managing multiple campaigns and cases simultaneously.
Ability to do process gap identification and support with process streamlining.
Lighthouse Canton is an independent asset manager to institutional investors and private clients, with headquarters in Singapore. Establish and uphold stringent project standards and governance models to ensure predictable, high-quality execution across all workstreams.
Facilitate steering committees and provide clear, trusted updates to executive sponsors.
Work with teams from both Infinite Lambda and the client to deliver projects, earning their trust and getting 360-degree feedback on feasibility and plans.

Proactively identify risks and remove roadblocks, helping the team find the pathway to excellence that earns the admiration and respect of your clients.
Track progress and communicate updates to stakeholders regularly through reports and presentations. Conduct project reviews and identify areas for improvement.
Deliver structured, clear, and professional communication, tailoring your style to best suit each client's environment — this is pivotal to how our clients perceive Infinite Lambda.

Title: APAC | Project Manager (B2B Contractor)
Description:
About the role
As a Project Manager at Infinite Lambda, you'll be a pivotal force behind the successful delivery of large-scale, complex client projects for our most important clients. You will be at the forefront of business transformation, holding ultimate accountability for project execution and owning the entire project lifecycle. You will ensure all projects and workstreams deliver tangible, measurable business value, on time and within budget, helping clients innovate and compete.
You are a key partner in our client relationships, working with our Account Managers to nurture long-term partnerships and spot new opportunities, contributing to the growth of our client accounts. You will use your positive and collaborative attitude to foster a culture of excellence, self-organisation, and high accountability across delivery streams. Your empathy and problem-solving skills will be essential as you guide your team to become more self-organised and accountable, celebrating successes along the way.
Anticipated start date: ASAP
Location: APAC
Contract duration: 3 months with very likely extension for 6+ months
Daily Requirement: 8 hours per day, Monday to Friday
Responsibilities
Lead the end-to-end delivery of client projects using Agile or Waterfall methodologies (depending on the best fit with the client), expertly tailoring your approach to the specific needs and phase of each project.
Develop and maintain clear scope and timelines, ensuring you can protect projects against scope creep and provide alternative solutions to recover as needed.
Gather, analyse, and document business requirements, working closely with clients and internal teams to translate business needs into clear, actionable specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
Facilitate stakeholder interviews and discovery sessions to elicit needs and uncover pain points, constraints, and opportunities.
Develop and execute comprehensive test strategies, including test planning, UAT coordination, and defect triage, ensuring delivered solutions meet agreed acceptance criteria.
Conduct data analysis and profiling to validate requirements, support migration activities, and inform data model and reporting design.
Act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, clarifying scope, managing ambiguity, and communicating trade offs.
Proactively develop and champion creative, non-standard solutions to execution challenges, ensuring optimal recovery and continuous improvement in delivery standards.
Establish and uphold stringent project standards and governance models to ensure predictable, high-quality execution across all workstreams.
Facilitate steering committees and provide clear, trusted updates to executive sponsors.
Work with teams from both Infinite Lambda and the client to deliver projects, earning their trust and getting 360-degree feedback on feasibility and plans.
Leverage your technical understanding to constructively challenge assumptions, guide recovery plans, and facilitate trade-off decisions between engineering quality and delivery speed, ensuring alignment with overall project goals.
Create and maintain essential documentation (such as RAID Logs, RACI matrices, business requirement documents, and Gantt charts) and lead ceremonies like standups, retrospectives, and client presentations.
Proactively identify risks and remove roadblocks, helping the team find the pathway to excellence that earns the admiration and respect of your clients.
Track progress and communicate updates to stakeholders regularly through reports and presentations. Conduct project reviews and identify areas for improvement.
Deliver structured, clear, and professional communication, tailoring your style to best suit each client's environment — this is pivotal to how our clients perceive Infinite Lambda.
Maintain a safe and congenial working environment for your team.
Support with client prospects - meetings, follow up and relationship management.
Liaise with our staffing team to ensure visibility on what will be needed to deliver projects.
Work with Account Manager(s) to provide constant and stable visibility on accounts.
Provide active coaching and mentorship to delivery teams, helping them adopt best practices, adhere to project standards, and elevate their own delivery capabilities.

Title: APJ Partner Category Lead - DevOps and Observability, APJ Partner Category
Description:
Description
As the APJ DevOps and Observability Partner Category Lead, you will own and drive the end-to-end DevOps and Observability technology partner strategy across the Asia-Pacific and Japan region. You will be responsible for understanding customer and market signals, accelerating customer adoption of DevOps and Observability solutions, growing top-line Marketplace revenue across all market segments and across all countries in APJ.
This is a high-visibility, high-impact role that sits at the intersection of AWS's most strategic DevOps and Observability partnerships and the rapidly converging Observability-Security-Data landscape. You will serve as the single-threaded owner (STO) for the DevOps and Observability partnership category in APJ, orchestrating executive governance, field enablement, and go-to-market execution.
The ideal candidate will have direct sales and/or ISV/Technology Partner experience, as well as deep familiarity with the Observability and DevOps technology landscape (infrastructure monitoring, log analytics, AIOps, cloud-native observability), cloud platform economics, and enterprise partner development. The candidate will have strong business acumen and problem-solving skills, as well as the ability to manage multiple customer personas and successfully align executive stakeholders with differing goals. A strong executive presence and the ability to successfully manage ambiguous, fast-moving situations autonomously and deliver results is required.
Key job responsibilities
- Define and execute the APJ DevOps & Observability category partnership strategy, goals, and metrics. Break down the overall goals and metrics into country/area outcomes
- Set up partner governance and executive engagement. Establish and run the partnership operating model for DevOps & Observability partners, serving as AWS's primary relationship holder with partners' APJ leadership
- Work with cross-functional stakeholders (Area Partner Leaders, Security Category Lead, Data/AI Category Lead, SI Partners, and Sales Leaders) to deliver integrated programs and customer engagements
- Enable Area/Country Partner teams to serve as local representatives for DevOps & Observability partnerships
- Work back from market signals to identify customer needs and mitigate partnership risks with proactive remediation plans
- Track and communicate key metrics. Maintain pipeline visibility and identify and share insights.
A day in the life
Your day might start with a pipeline review call with Japan's Area Partner team to unblock a strategic enterprise deal, followed by a bi-weekly sync with APJ partner leadership to align on upcoming product launches. Mid-morning you're reviewing market signals and customer feedback. After lunch you're enabling a group of sellers on a new co-sell play, and in the afternoon you're leading an executive monthly business review presenting APJ progress to world wide leadership.
About The Team
The APJ Partner Category Team is responsible for AWS's most strategic technology partnerships across Asia-Pacific and Japan. We operate as category leaders - each owning an end-to-end partnership strategy that spans revenue, GTM, enablement, and executive governance. We work at the intersection of AWS's fastest-growing services and our partners' go-to-market ambitions to drive customer outcomes at scale.
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Basic Qualifications
- 3+ years of business development, partnership management, or sourcing new business experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- 5+ years of communicating with and presenting to executive and senior audiences experience
- Experience working with Observability, DevOps, Monitoring, or Cloud Operations related technologies, including but not limited to log analytics, infrastructure monitoring, and AIOps
- Track record of building operating models, governance mechanisms, and field enablement at scale across multiple geographies
Preferred Qualifications
- 5+ years of experience in technology partner development, ISV alliances, or strategic business development in the cloud/DevOps ecosystem
- Direct experience managing Observability or DevOps technology partnerships (APM, cloud monitoring, log management, or infrastructure observability platforms)
- Understanding of Observability technology economics (consumption-based pricing, platform convergence across observability-security-data, and cloud-native architectures)

Job Description:
At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.
Cloudera empowers the world’s largest enterprises to turn complex data into clear, actionable insight. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, Cloudera is the preferred data partner across industries, running on-premises, in public cloud, and in hybrid architectures. Powered by open-source innovation, the platform is the foundation for digital transformation at global scale.
This role sits on the team that resells a Cloudera-supported OEM version of Mistral along with Cloudera Anywhere Cloud. You will sell enterprise AI on top of the data estates Cloudera already runs — models, deployment, and support delivered as a supported offering inside the customer’s existing Cloudera footprint, and net new customers who need Sovereign AI Models for their data.
As an Applied AI Sales Executive, you own end-to-end enterprise deals for the Cloudera-supported OEM of Mistral: from the first conversation through proof of concept, negotiation, close, and expansion. You are the commercial owner for external stakeholders and the internal quarterback across customer engineering, product, legal, implementation, and executive sponsors, working in harmony with Cloudera's existing account executives who oversee the overall client relationship. Success means growing new and expansion subscription revenue while making AI a durable part of the customer’s data strategy.
Account coordination and revenue
In alignment with the primary account executives from Cloudera and Mistral's partner sales team, develop and manage pipeline, forecast accurately, and exceed quarterly and annual goals for new and expansion software subscriptions, renewals, and related services for Cloudera's offering of Mistral and Cloudera's Anywhere Cloud.
Introduce and grow designated enterprise accounts and strategic prospects, aligning plans with company objectives and customer priorities in data, analytics, and AI.
Lead large, multi-threaded transactions and keep commercial control of the deal while coordinating specialists.
Development and qualification
Run strategic outbound and convert qualified inbound where a standard motion can become a broader, multi-year agreement.
Use warm introductions, installed-base relationships, and partner paths to reach heads of data, AI, innovation, and the C-suite.
•Develop account and opportunity plans that map the Mistral offering to the customer’s technology footprint, growth plans, and competitive landscape.
Value validation and technical selling
Lead customers through proof of concept with the implementation and technical teams, so evaluation is structured, time-boxed, and tied to a commercial outcome.
Turn successful POCs into long-term contracts by linking model performance, deployment model (on-prem, cloud, hybrid), governance, and support to the customer’s operating reality on Cloudera.
Articulate how the OEM Mistral offering fits the Cloudera platform—data under management, security, hybrid operations—and work side by side with specialists so technical questions are answered without losing account ownership.
Deal management and executive engagement
Align customer engineering, product, commercial, and legal stakeholders on both sides, including at executive level.
Negotiate agreements end-to-end with legal and implementation support.
Build consensus across executive sponsors, influencers, and decision-makers. Position the offering inside strategic AI and data initiatives, not as a one-off tool purchase.
Market and internal enablement
Bring back field intelligence on use cases, objections, competitive moves, and deployment constraints to shape roadmap priorities and sales plays.
Introduce domain and technical specialists while retaining overall account responsibility and customer-success ownership.

8+ years of enterprise software sales, with a record of exceeding quota on complex, consultative deals.
Comfortable with senior C-level engagement, discussions and negotiations.
Experience selling highly technical products, ideally in data management, data platforms, analytics, or AI infrastructure.

Title: Assistant Brand Manager
Description:
About Urgo Medical
Urgo Medical is the advanced wound care division of the French family-owned Urgo Group.
Our mission: healing people
As wounds are a source of suffering around the world, our mission, as the Healing Company, is to support healthcare professionals heal people with evidence-based treatments and innovative services so that life can start again for patients.
Our mission is based on three pillars:
- Putting patients at the heart – Listening to patients to understand their needs and adapt our solutions accordingly.
- Caring for caregivers – Working closely with healthcare professionals and scientific bodies to develop innovative solutions and education programs.
- Leading with science – Continuously investing in R&D and generating robust clinical evidence to support evidence-based treatments.
We are 1,600 colleagues across Europe, Asia (Australia, China, India, Singapore & Vietnam), and the Americas — united by one passion: making a difference for patients.
Our Company Culture in APAC:
Across Asia-Pacific, Urgo Medical has built a strong, people-centered culture recognized through Great Place to Work® certification in all affiliates.
At Urgo Medical, we know our mission starts with our people. Our culture is shaped by three key pillars:
- Winning Mindset – Striving for excellence, leading with boldness, and believing that anything is possible.
- Learning Organization – Encouraging continuous growth through transparency, feedback, and opportunities for development.
- Engaging Teams – Promoting teamwork, collaboration, and open communication built on empathy and inclusiveness, where every voice is heard and valued.
As a family-owned business, we combine autonomy and agility with the global reach of a leading healthcare company. We are committed to developing our people and creating real opportunities for advancement — from rapid career progression to international mobility.
Why Join Urgo Medical Singapore?
This is an opportunity to join a focused and agile Singapore team and play a meaningful role in the continued growth of Urgo Medical’s Advanced Wound Care business.
As Assistant Brand Manager, you will have broad exposure across the business and work closely with the General Manager, Sales team, Regional Marketing and other cross-functional partners. In a lean team environment, the role offers the opportunity to see the impact of your work directly and to contribute across the full marketing cycle — from market insights and brand planning through to product launches, customer engagement and commercial execution.
The role offers:
- Meaningful ownership of brands and marketing initiatives within the Singapore market.
- Reporting directly to the General Manager, with close collaboration across Sales and other key functions.
- The opportunity to contribute to upcoming product launches and the continued development of Urgo Medical’s Advanced Wound Care portfolio.
- A strong connection to the market through regular engagement with Sales, healthcare professionals and customers.
- Exposure to APAC Regional and Global Marketing teams, while retaining the flexibility to adapt initiatives to the needs of the Singapore market.
- A hands-on and entrepreneurial environment where initiative, agility and new ideas are encouraged.
- Opportunities to learn and develop through close collaboration with experienced local, regional and global colleagues.
- A people-focused culture reflected in Urgo Medical Singapore’s Great Place to Work® certification.
As a smaller local organisation within an international group, Urgo Medical Singapore offers the opportunity to combine local ownership and visibility with regional and global exposure.
Position Summary
The Assistant Brand Manager – Advanced Wound Care is responsible for supporting the development and execution of strategies that drive brand growth, market adoption and commercial performance across the wound care portfolio.
The role involves understanding patient and healthcare professional needs, translating clinical evidence and market insights into effective brand activities, and supporting the positioning of products within a competitive healthcare environment.
Key responsibilities include brand and portfolio management, market analysis, customer engagement, campaign development, sales enablement, stakeholder engagement and collaboration with Sales, Medical/Clinical, Regulatory and Regional Marketing teams.
The Assistant Brand Manager will also monitor market trends, competitor activity and customer feedback to identify opportunities, while ensuring brand activities remain aligned with clinical evidence, regulatory requirements and overall business objectives.
Key Responsibilities:
Brand Strategy & Portfolio Management
- Support the development and execution of brand strategies and annual marketing plans aligned with business objectives, customer needs and market opportunities.
- Support product lifecycle management, positioning, value proposition development, product launches and portfolio optimisation.
- Monitor market trends, competitor activity, clinical developments and emerging wound-care technologies to identify growth opportunities.
- Work with Regional and Global Marketing teams to adapt brand strategies, materials and initiatives for the Singapore market where relevant.
Market Insights & Commercial Growth
- Develop a strong understanding of customer and patient journeys, healthcare needs, treatment pathways and market dynamics.
- Gather market and customer insights through research, field visits, customer engagement and close collaboration with the Sales team.
- Support initiatives that drive sales, revenue, market share and product adoption.
- Partner with Sales to develop account-specific strategies, sales tools, product messaging and customer engagement programmes.
- Analyse sales and market performance and recommend actions to address gaps and maximise opportunities.
- Monitor customer behaviour, competitor activity and market trends and adapt marketing activities where appropriate.
Marketing, Digital & Customer Engagement
- Develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns, product launches, promotional activities, workshops, conferences, exhibitions and educational programmes.
- Support digital marketing activities, including content development, campaign coordination and performance tracking across relevant channels.
- Manage the end-to-end planning and administration of brand events, including timelines, vendors, logistics, materials, registrations, approvals and post-event evaluation.
- Manage marketing and event budgets, including budget planning, purchase orders, invoices, expense tracking and reconciliation.
- Evaluate the effectiveness and ROI of marketing and event activities and recommend improvements for future initiatives.
Clinical & Professional Engagement
- Work with Medical/Clinical teams to translate clinical evidence and product benefits into clear, compelling and compliant brand messaging.
- Support clinical education, product training, workshops and professional engagement activities.
- Build and maintain relationships with healthcare professionals, wound-care specialists, Key Opinion Leaders and professional organisations.
- Gather customer and clinical insights to strengthen brand activities and product adoption.
- Ensure brand activities reflect current wound-care practices, clinical guidelines and customer needs.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution
- Work closely with Sales, Medical/Clinical, Regulatory, Finance, Supply Chain, Customer Service and other relevant teams.
- Collaborate with APAC Regional Marketing and Global teams to leverage brand assets, expertise, tools and best practices.
- Ensure timely execution of brand plans, product launches, campaigns, events and commercial initiatives.
- Support Sales capability through product training, brand updates, sales materials and competitive insights.
- Maintain a strong connection to the field through regular customer and Sales engagement.
Performance, Administration & Compliance
- Monitor and report brand performance, including sales, market share, campaign effectiveness, event outcomes and budget utilisation.
- Maintain accurate documentation, forecasts, marketing plans, CRM records, contracts, purchase orders, samples and other administrative requirements.
- Coordinate vendors, agencies and external partners and ensure deliverables are completed according to agreed timelines and budgets.
- Track key marketing KPIs and use performance data to support continuous improvement.
- Ensure all marketing, promotional, educational and event activities comply with company policies, healthcare regulations, industry codes and applicable compliance requirements.
Qualifications & Experience:
- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biomedical Science or a related discipline.
- Approximately 2–4 years of professional experience, ideally in brand, product or healthcare marketing.
- Experience in medical devices, pharmaceuticals, healthcare or life sciences is preferred.
- Experience in Advanced Wound Care, surgical care or related specialties would be advantageous.
- Previous exposure to Sales, clinical applications or other customer-facing roles is advantageous.
- Exposure to digital marketing, product launches, events or healthcare professional engagement would be beneficial.
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:
- Good understanding of healthcare markets, customer needs and market dynamics.
- Good knowledge of brand management, marketing strategy and campaign development.
- Ability to translate market and customer insights into effective marketing initiatives.
- Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills.
- Strong analytical and commercial acumen, with the ability to use data and insights to support business decisions.
- Strong project-management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage campaigns, events, budgets and multiple priorities.
- Ability to develop clear, compelling and evidence-based product messaging and marketing materials.
- Proactive, adaptable and comfortable working in a lean and dynamic environment.
- Strong learning agility, collaborative mindset and willingness to take ownership.
- Strong ethics, integrity and commitment to compliance.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office; familiarity with CRM and digital marketing tools is advantageous.
Working Conditions:
- Field & Office-Based Work: Primarily office-based, with regular field engagement alongside Sales and healthcare professionals.
- Travel & Customer Engagement: Local travel may be required to support customer meetings, field visits, product demonstrations, clinical education, conferences and exhibitions.
- Flexible Working Hours: Occasional evening or weekend work may be required to support professional events, conferences and collaboration with Regional or Global teams.
- Regional Collaboration: Occasional overseas travel within APAC may be required.

Title: Assistant Manager, Lifecycle Marketing & Campaign Delivery
Description:
Help turn a new Changi Account member’s first interaction into a lasting relationship with Changi. As part of Market Experimentation & Personalization (MXP) team, you will design and deliver customer journeys that encourage first and repeat purchases, strengthen loyalty and bring inactive customers back across Changi’s F&B, retail, travel and digital experiences.
You will own assigned lifecycle programs and campaigns from initial idea to launch and ongoing improvement. Working with marketers, platform specialists and data analysts, you will translate customer insights into relevant communications across email, app push, in-app messaging and other owned digital channels. The role combines customer journey design with hands-on campaign building and experimentation.
What You Will Do
Design customer journeys
- Plan and design lifecycle programs that welcome new members and encourage their first purchase, drive repeat purchases, re-engage inactive customers and invite eligible customers to renew their marketing consent. Define clear customer needs, business objectives and success measures.
- Turn customer behavior and insights into audience segments and journey plans, defining who enters and exits each journey, what they receive, and when and through which channels they are engaged.
- Partner with marketers to develop relevant messages, benefits and offers that encourage member engagement. Recommend and test incentives where they can improve customer and business outcomes.
Build & deliver campaigns
- Manage lifecycle and tactical marketing campaigns from brief to launch, coordinating content, assets, approvals and timelines with marketing teams and creative agencies.
- Build and maintain automated journeys and campaigns in Braze, using customer behavior, event triggers, segmentation and personalized content to coordinate engagement across channels.
- Check targeting, consent, exclusions, contact frequency, journey logic, content and links before launch. Monitor live campaigns and work with relevant specialists to resolve issues.
- Work with MXP Tech and data colleagues to define the customer attributes and events needed for journeys, and test that campaigns respond correctly to customer actions.
Test learn and improve
- Plan and run A/B tests with clear hypotheses, success measures and appropriate comparison or control groups. Test messages, offers, timing, channels and journey design.
- Incorporate lifecycle communications with relevant web and app experiences and activate through experiments using Adobe Target or similar tools.
- Use campaign and customer data to evaluate activation, repeat purchase, retention and incremental impact where measurable. Share findings and recommend improvements to journeys and campaigns.
- Make delivery more efficient and reliable through reusable journey components, templates, documentation and quality checks.
What You Will Bring
- 3–5 years of relevant experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, loyalty engagement or marketing automation. We welcome candidates with a different length of experience who can demonstrate the capabilities below.
- Practical experience designing and delivering automated customer journeys, such as onboarding, activation, retention or win-back. You can explain the audience, journey logic, your contribution and what you learned from the results.
- Hands-on experience with a customer engagement platform such as Braze is preferred; strong experience with a comparable platform is welcome.
- A good understanding of segmentation, behavioral triggers and personalization, with the ability to translate a marketing objective into a working campaign or journey.
- Experience running A/B tests, interpreting campaign data and turning findings into practical recommendations.
- Confidence working with technology and data: understanding targeting and automation logic, investigating campaign setup issues and explaining requirements to technical colleagues.
- Strong attention to detail, sound judgement and clear communication. You can take ownership of delivery, manage competing timelines and work constructively with stakeholders.
- A degree in Marketing, Business, Information Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant practical experience.
Why Join MXP?
You will help shape how customers experience Changi across their lifecycle, with the opportunity to develop your skills in journey design, marketing automation and experimentation. Working within a team that brings together campaign delivery, customer data and platform expertise, you will see your ideas through from design to live delivery and measurable learning.
Why consider this: Marketing aligns with the MSc and BBA in Marketing and current Marketing and PR Specialist role.

Title: Assistant Marketing Manager, Events
Description:
Goldheart Jewelry is evolving how a heritage brand speaks to a new generation of romantics, achievers and self-gifters through meaningful experiences and cultural moments. As Assistant Marketing Manager, Events, you will play a key role in bringing the brand to life through well-executed marketing activations and events. This includes planning and executing boutique and atrium activations, corporate staff sales, campaign launches and PR-related events that drive brand visibility and retail engagement.
You will lead the planning and execution of events that translate our brand story into impactful moments for customers, media and partners. Working closely with the Marketing, Creative, Retail Operations, Merchandising teams and external partners, you will translate campaign strategies into on-ground experiences while also supporting tactical marketing needs such as boutique promotional collaterals and activation materials.
What you’ll own
Event & Activation Planning
- Plan and execute a calendar of marketing events and activations aligned with key campaigns, product launches and seasonal retail moments which includes:
- Boutique events and in-store activations
- Mall atrium events
- Corporate office staff sales
- PR and media events in collaboration with the Marketing team
- Oversee end-to-end event execution including concept development, budgeting and timeline planning to vendor coordination, programme flow, gifting, RSVP coordination, event logistics, on-ground execution and post-event evaluation.
- Translate brand events into experiential moments, working closely with Marketing to ensure key product stories, seasonal campaigns and brand narratives come to life through immersive activations.
- Take a hands-on role in planning and executing consumer and branding events, while also guiding and coordinating external partners - including agencies, production vendors, stylists, and PR collaborators - to ensure quality brand experiences aligned with brand guidelines.
- Collaborate with Marketing to maximise amplification of events and PR moments across digital channels, ensuring strong storytelling before, during and after key activations.
Retail & Campaign Activations
- Work closely with the Marketing team to translate campaign narratives and product stories into engaging retail and experiential activations.
- Ensure event concepts and setups reflect the brand’s positioning while supporting commercial objectives such as traffic generation, sales conversion and customer engagement.
Boutique Marketing & Promotional Collaterals
- Support the development of marketing collaterals for tactical activations including:
- Preparing artwork briefs for Creative team
- Coordinating production of in-store POSM, event signages, promotional materials and activation visuals with Creative team
- Ensuring brand consistency across boutique marketing materials
PR Event Support
- Support the Marketing team in the planning and execution of PR and media-related events, including:
- Media previews and product showcases
- Influencer or stylist engagements
- Campaign launch events
- Assist with coordination of guest management, event logistics, gifting and on-site event operations to ensure smooth execution.
Vendor & Partner Coordination
- Manage relationships with event vendors, production partners, venues and mall management teams.
- Coordinate with agencies, suppliers and VM team on event setup, fabrication, logistics and installation to ensure timely and high-quality execution.
- Identify and pursue partnership opportunities with lifestyle brands/venues that extend brand reach and relevance.
Event Performance Tracking
- Support post-event reporting by tracking key outcomes such as:
- RSVP sign-ups, event attendance and engagement
- Gift redemptions
- Retail traffic or sales performance during activations
- Provide insights to improve future activations and event strategies.
Competencies Required
• STRATEGIC THINKING – Applies an understanding of the organization’s mission, vision and strategic priorities to design events initiatives that support brand growth and business objectives.
• INFLUENCE – Builds strong relationships with internal stakeholders and partners to amplify brand narratives and drive successful collaborations.
• PROJECT MANAGEMENT & LEADERSHIP – Demonstrates initiative, accountability and a hands-on approach in managing projects and partners, while contributing positively to team performance and outcomes. Able to anticipate operational challenges and respond quickly in fast-paced event environments.
• INNOVATION – Brings fresh ideas to brand activations, partnerships and product storytelling, contributing to a culture that embraces creative thinking and continuous improvement.
• BUSINESS AWARENESS - Understands how retail activations and marketing events contribute to brand visibility, customer engagement and sales performance.
The portfolio you’ll build here
- A portfolio of brand experiences and events that bring Goldheart’s campaigns and collections to life — from media previews and product launches to retail activations, collaborations and brand partnerships.
- End-to-end event ownership, including concept proposals, event briefs, guest strategies, programme flow, vendor coordination and post-event reports that demonstrate both creative thinking and operational excellence.
- Experience developing experiential frameworks and event playbooks (event formats, guest journeys, media engagement approaches, partnership structures) that can be replicated and scaled across campaigns and retail initiatives.
- Case studies of brand activations and PR initiatives that generated measurable impact — such as media coverage, influencer reach, brand buzz, customer engagement or retail traffic uplift.
- Cross-functional collaboration experience, working closely with brand marketing, content, social, retail operations, merchandising and external partners to ensure campaigns translate seamlessly into impactful real-world experiences.

- Proven experience planning and executing brand events, launches or experiential activations with strong attention to detail and operational execution.
- Strong project management and vendor coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple timelines, partners and deliverables simultaneously.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, comfortable working with media, influencers, agencies, venues and internal stakeholders.
- Highly organised, proactive and resourceful, with the ability to troubleshoot quickly and stay calm in fast-paced event environments.
- Highly proactive, resourceful and comfortable working in dynamic event environments.

Title: Assistant PR Manager
Description:
Join the Bacha Coffee team
Great ideas start with coffee, Bacha Coffee starts with you. We are headquartered in Singapore with coffee rooms and boutiques in Europe and Asia currently. We are expanding aggressively to achieve a worldwide presence in the upcoming months...
Bacha Coffee specialises in 100% Arabica coffees and provides customers with a unique opportunity to travel the world through their cup by exploring harvests from over 30 of the most well-reputed coffee producing countries. Even our distinctive fine blended, fine-flavoured and naturally decaffeinated coffees are produced using only 100% Arabica beans to give coffee lovers the widest choice, without ever sacrificing quality or flavour.
The qualities that have made Bacha Coffee a legendary brand around the world also make us a great place to work: innovation, creativity, passion, and excellence.
Job Summary
Responsible for planning and implementing Bacha Coffee’s global public relations strategies and activities while ensuring consistency in brand messaging across relevant markets. This role is responsible for the development and implementation of support materials and management of PR agencies internationally, as well as coordinating strategically with the other departments and stakeholders within the company and the brand.
Primary Relationships
The position reports directly to the Public Relations Manager.
Within the organisation, this position has primary working relationships with the other members of the Corporate Communication Department, other HQ Departments and overseas partners.
Outside the organization, the position coordinates primarily with PR agencies, business partners and the media.
Responsibilities
Create and execute global Public Relations strategy that align with the brand developments, priorities and announcements
Familiarising with the brand DNA, heritage and offerings, while embodying the brand ethos. Support other departments, partners and stakeholders in ensuring that all external-facing communication is on-brand and Bacha Coffee’s desired image and positioning is consistently and accurately articulated
Support Public Relations Manager to guide overseas partners (both subsidiaries and franchises) for the management of their local media relations and vet their suggested press releases, PR campaigns, etc. across all markets globally
Write and proofread communication materials i.e., press releases, responses for media queries and interviews, boilerplates, management biographies, fact sheets, media kits, etc.
Elevating brand presence and positioning the brand accurately in local and global media sphere through media related activities such as media liaison, gifting, events and hostings, overseas media trips, etc.
Coordinating internally with other departments on all Public Relations matters including the creation of Public Relations materials and assets
Working with Bacha Coffee subsidiaries, franchises and distributors to ensure implementation of brand and editorial guidelines and directives
Effectively manage issues and crises in collaboration with Public Relations teams and Public Relations agencies in Singapore and overseas
Ensuring that proper archives of global media clippings are maintained and regularly updating Public Relations reporting standards
Regularly monitoring trends and informing management of developments in luxury, retail and F&B industries
Maintaining Bacha Coffee media databases and periodically revising and refreshing media outreach to constantly remain current
Qualifications
Required:
Minimum of 5 years’ experience in communications or public relations with demonstrated success, preferably in the luxury retail sector
Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications, marketing, or public relations preferred
Past experience working in a Public Relations agency or managing international Public Relations agencies preferred
Past experience practising Public Relations for a luxury brand preferred
Past experience dealing with international markets/stakeholders and media being responsible for a global or regional scope
Applicants must be fluent in written and spoken English and have excellent writing and proofreading skills.
A second or third language would be an advantage, as it would support effective communication with our diverse franchise partners
Other:
Strong creative, strategic, analytical, organizational and personal skills
Demonstrated successful experience writing press releases, pitching and hosting media
Computer literacy in word processing, data base management and page layout
Commitment to working in cross-functional teams
Very strong oral and written communication skills
Ability to manage multiple projects at a time
Out-of-town, overnight travel might be required from time to time (less than 10%)

Title: Assistant Vice President, Business Development (Partnership Distribution)
Description:
Singlife is a leading homegrown financial services company, offering consumers a better way to financial freedom. Through innovative, technology-enabled solutions and a wide range of products and services, Singlife provides consumers control over their financial wellbeing at every stage of their lives.
In addition to a comprehensive suite of insurance plans, employee benefits, partnerships with financial adviser channels and bancassurance, Singlife offers investment and advisory solutions through its GROW with Singlife platform. At Temasek, talent is at the heart of our future. We are seeking an experienced Talent Acquisition professional to lead Temasek’s global campus recruitment efforts, while also driving selected experienced hire mandates across the business. About us
At Fenergo, we’re not just building software—we’re transforming how the world’s leading financial institutions fight financial crime. Headquartered in Dublin and trusted by over 100 of the world’s top financial institutions, we’re on a mission to change the game.
We’re more than a global leader in AI-powered client lifecycle management—we’re reimagining how financial institutions tackle compliance. From Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) to rapidly evolving regulations, we turn complexity into clarity. Our FinCrime Operating System, powered by agentic AI and intelligent automation, helps financial institutions move faster, act smarter, and stay safer across 120+ countries.
But we don’t stop there.
At Fenergo, we believe in a world where financial institutions aren’t just compliant—they’re confident. Where technology doesn’t just meet regulations—it stays ahead of them. Our mission is to empower financial institutions to stop financial crime and create a safer world.
Every product we build, every innovation we deliver, and every partnership we forge is shaped by that belief. We’re tackling some of the toughest challenges in financial technology. From speeding up onboarding to uncovering hidden risks, our work empowers banks to serve their customers with speed, integrity, and peace of mind.
Join us, and be part of a team that’s building smart solutions, solving real problems, and shaping the future—together.
About the role
Fenergo is committed to hiring the best people. From small beginnings, we have assembled an excellent team of business and technical staff who have enabled our company to grow rapidly on the international Financial Services stage. Over the last number of years, we have become the market leader in the Client Lifecycle Management and Regulatory Compliance arena.
We thrive on the challenge of building our product and continuously improving our people, processes and knowledge to meet the needs of our growing customer base. We are a young company, excited by the future, and we are looking for people who will share this journey with us. We have a number of opportunities that allow for rapid personal and career development for the right candidate.
The Client Solutions team works closely with our Global Sales Teams, who identify potential opportunities, and we then provide detailed business and technical support throughout the sales cycle. We also work closely with our Product team, identifying gaps and opportunities and contributing directly to the product roadmap and our future success.
This is a client-facing role. You will build relationships and act as the first point of contact with the client's stakeholders and subject matter experts. The role requires absolute professionalism in advising clients and guiding them through a multi-faceted change process, so that they see early and continuous value in their organisations.
Core Responsibilities
For each prospect engagement, you will work alongside the sales team and other internal stakeholders, including the regulatory team, professional services and a technical team, to guide the client through the following key tasks:
Ensure that the Fenergo application is presented in the best light with new and existing customers.
Deliver product demos that show how Fenergo can help clients achieve meaningful and rapid improvements in their organisation. This includes demo preparation, delivery and follow-up on outstanding questions.
Understand client challenges and develop the solutions necessary to win new business.
Lead and conduct onsite engagements to understand customer processes and requirements, and to facilitate architecture and solution discussions.
Work with prospective clients to align their tactical and strategic challenges with the implementation of the Fenergo product across their organisation.
Proactively scope the functional and technical requirements needed to address customer requirements, assess customers' met and unmet needs, and recommend solutions that optimise value for both the customer and Fenergo.
Maintain and expand your working knowledge of the Fenergo product, and provide feedback to the Product organisation on enhancements.
Work with Sales Ops Support to complete RFx documents on behalf of the company.
Use knowledge of competitive solutions to help the sales organisation propose the optimal solution for the customer.
Ensure that the sales and professional services organisations are properly aligned to achieve client and sales objectives.
Build strong relationships within the project team, client teams and the internal Product Management team.
Keep abreast of product, regulatory and industry changes.

Excellent client-facing skills, with the ability to 'own the room'. Soft skills include communication, co-ordination and negotiation.

Title: Associate Director, Sales Operations – APAC
Description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients— that is what Vantive aspires to deliver.
We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don’t settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients’ lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Sales Strategy Execution & Commercial Planning
Translate APAC commercial strategy into prioritized regional execution plans with clear accountabilities, milestones, and measures of success. Establish and lead the APAC Sales Operations operating model, defining regional standards, governance, decision rights, and performance expectations while enabling effective execution by country and cluster teams.
Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Commercial Excellence teams to develop annual sales plans and go-to-market strategies.
Drive sales planning processes including targeting, segmentation, account prioritization, and resource allocation.
Lead the sales operations contribution to business reviews by converting performance data into actionable insights, recommendations, and clearly assigned interventions.
Establish sales operating rhythms, governance processes, and performance management frameworks.
Sales Force Effectiveness
Lead the design and implementation of sales force effectiveness initiatives.
Monitor and improve sales productivity, customer coverage, call effectiveness, and pipeline conversion.
Establish a consistent APAC sales performance framework, including common definitions, KPIs, scorecards, and review standards.
Identify opportunities to improve execution efficiency across the sales organization.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance commercial performance.
Territory & Quota Management
Govern territory design, alignment, optimization, and deployment to improve customer coverage, workload balance, and resource productivity.
Establish quota-setting methodologies that align with business objectives.
Assess territory workload, customer potential, and resource allocation.
Evaluate and recommend organisational changes to improve market coverage and growth opportunities.
Sales Incentive Design & Governance
Lead the design and governance of sales incentive compensation programmes, with Finance and HR partnership and clearly defined approval accountabilities.
Ensure incentive plans drive desired commercial behaviors and strategic priorities.
Manage incentive calculations, governance, reporting, and annual plan reviews.
Evaluate effectiveness of incentive programmes and recommend enhancements
Partner with Finance and HR to ensure compliance and governance standards.
CRM & Commercial Systems Excellence
Own regional CRM adoption, governance, commercial data quality, and user effectiveness, while defining the respective accountabilities of APAC, country, Digital, and IT teams.
Partner with Digital and IT teams to optimize sales technology platforms.
Implement tools that improve sales execution, forecasting accuracy, and customer engagement.
Drive standardization of commercial processes within CRM platforms.
Develop and lead change management plans for major sales operations initiatives, including stakeholder engagement, communications, capability building, adoption measurement, and reinforcement.
Sales Pipeline Management & Forecasting
Analyze pipeline health, conversion trends, risks, and opportunities.
Establish disciplined sales forecasting methodologies and governance.
Drive monthly, quarterly, and annual sales forecasting processes.
Provide leadership with a transparent commercial outlook, documented assumptions, performance risks, opportunities, and recommended corrective actions.
Identify early warning indicators and corrective actions.
Commercial Analytics & Performance Insights
Establish a consistent APAC commercial performance framework with common data definitions, KPIs, dashboards, and review standards.
Translate commercial and customer data into clear insights, recommendations, and prioritized actions for regional and country leadership.
Identify performance drivers, market opportunities, execution gaps, and emerging risks, and monitor agreed interventions through to closure.
Partner with Finance, Digital, IT, and Data Analytics to improve data accessibility, quality, and confidence across APAC.
undefined
Cross-Functional Leadership
Collaborate closely with Marketing, Finance, HR, Customer Experience, Supply Chain, IT, and Data Analytics teams.
Lead commercial transformation and operational excellence initiatives.
Ensure alignment between strategic objectives and operational execution.
Act as the primary liaison between sales leadership and supporting functions.
Team Leadership & Capability Development·
Build and develop a high-performing APAC Sales Operations organization, including direct reports and the wider country and cluster functional network.
Coach and mentor team members while strengthening operational capabilities.
Promote a data-driven and customer-focused culture.
Drive succession planning, talent development, and employee engagement.

Bachelor's degree in business, Commerce, Finance, Economics, Analytics, Healthcare, or related discipline.
MBA or advanced business qualification preferred.

Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in sales operations, commercial excellence, commercial analytics, or related commercial leadership roles, including significant experience operating across multiple APAC markets.
Demonstrated experience in Sales Operations, Sales Force Effectiveness, Territory and Quota Design, Sales Incentive Compensation, CRM & Commercial Systems, Commercial Analytics, Forecasting & Pipeline Management, Business Planning·
Experience leading regional and cross-functional teams.
Demonstrated experience leading regional transformation, building new operating capabilities, and influencing senior stakeholders in a complex matrix environment.
Healthcare, MedTech, Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical, or B2B commercial environment preferred.

Title: Associate Director, Senior Risk Analyst
Description:
City: Singapore
Division: Investments COO
Why work for us?
A career at Janus Henderson is more than a job, it’s about investing in a brighter future together.
Our Mission at Janus Henderson is to help clients define and achieve superior financial outcomes through differentiated insights, disciplined investments, and world-class service. We will do this by protecting and growing our core business, amplifying our strengths and diversifying where we have the right.
Our Values are key to driving our success, and are at the heart of everything we do:
Clients Come First - Always | Execution Supersedes Intention | Together We Win | Diversity Improves Results | Truth Builds Trust
If our mission, values, and purpose align with your own, we would love to hear from you!
Your opportunity
Act as a risk partner, embedded within the investment process, supporting Portfolio Managers in enhancing portfolio construction, risk positioning, and return outcomes.
Deliver timely, decision-relevant risk insights to inform active investment decisions and challenge assumptions where appropriate
Partner with Portfolio Managers on a day-to-day basis to integrate risk considerations into portfolio construction and investment decisions.
Generate and interpret analytics across factor exposures, active risk, performance attribution, and market conditions, translating outputs into clear, actionable insights.
Provide constructive challenge and alternative perspectives to support more robust investment decisions.
Proactively identify risk concentrations, unintended exposures, and emerging vulnerabilities, and recommend mitigation strategies.
Monitor financial markets and assess implications for portfolios, escalating material risks and opportunities with clear, actionable recommendations.
Contribute to risk budgeting, scenario analysis, and sensitivity analysis, supporting portfolio positioning under different market environments.
Respond to client and internal stakeholder queries, articulating portfolio risk and performance drivers in a clear and investment-relevant manner.
Build trusted relationships across Investment, Product, and Technology teams to ensure effective risk integration across the investment lifecycle.
Drive automation and efficiency improvements, enhancing scalability and consistency of risk analytics and reporting.
Work closely with Technology and Data teams to ensure accuracy, integrity, and usability of risk data and models.
Carry out other duties as assigned.

A consultative and partnership-driven approach to working with Portfolio Managers, focused on diagnosing underlying risk drivers and co-developing actionable solutions

Financial markets, equity fundamentals, and drivers of investment returns.
Proven experience working within investment or risk analysis, in either buy or sell side.
Portfolio construction in bottom-up, discretionary investment processes and risk-return trade-offs.
Factor risk modelling (style, sector, macro) and active risk decomposition.
Scenario analysis and stress testing, including forward-looking risk identification.
Performance attribution (Brinson and factor-based) and linking performance outcomes back to positioning decisions.
Skills in:
Analysis of portfolios and risk using systems such as FactSet, Barra, Aladdin.
Quantitative mindset.
Excel, Snowflake & Python.
Effective communication and people skills.
Integrity and autonomy.
Motivations towards:
Equity markets and investment.
Providing actionable investment risk and quantitative intelligence for the betterment of investment processes and outcomes.
Nice to have skills
Buy side experience.
Strong FactSet and Alladin skills.
Working toward CFA or other professional qualification is useful but not required.
A strong understanding of strategy risks and risk modelling.
Understanding of the risk and return characteristics of different asset classes beneficial.

Has responsibility for supporting risk managers and portfolio managers in the equity asset class.

No

Leadership development programs
Regular training
Career development services

Description:
Job Description:
About Us
ATR is the world's number one aircraft manufacturer in regional aviation providing a new generation of turboprops. We are a joint venture between two European aeronautical heavyweights, Airbus and Leonardo.
From the world’s largest cities, to our planet’s most remote regions, our purpose is to deliver air travel to people, communities and businesses in an innovative, sustainable and modern way.
If you strive for excellence, are driven by ambition, trust and respect as we are, then get your career off to a flighting start with ATR!
Our leadership profile:
People Centric - Entrepreneurial - Inspiring - Exemplary - Innovative - Humble
At ATR you will work with passionate colleagues to make a difference in a human size company with attractive advantages!
Customer Marketing and Business Development Manager
A unique opportunity to join the ATR Commercial Directorate as a Customer Marketing & Business Development Manager in the dynamic APAC region. The team, made up of people based over 3 continents, is looking for it’s newest member to come onboard.
Your mission:
- Influence and convince airline and lessor decision-makers of the competitive advantage of ATR products and their contribution to airline profitability, both in the context of sales campaigns and business development.
- Play a critical role in setting the sales strategy and approach with the regional sales directors.
- Manage all marketing and business development activities on specific accounts and campaigns in the APAC region:
- Identify targets and prospects with regional sales directors and contribute to the definition and implementation of regional strategies.
- Prepare and present analyses on aircraft performance and technical aspects, airline economics as well as network and fleet planning at all phases of sales campaigns.
- Build strong pitches for sales campaigns and ensure that value-added arguments are effectively communicated, understood by the customer and used to develop a business offer when appropriate.
- Find and engage with possible future prospects in the region, including but not limited to VIP prospects, oil and gas prospects and future airline prospects.
- Develop a thorough understanding of all aspects of an airline’s requirements, global and regional aviation market trends, airline business drivers, evolving fleet and network requirements, revenue and profit generation models, and the markets competitive environment.
- Build relationships with customer counterparts.
- Proactively drive business development analyses and presentations to fuel new market opportunities and influence the market by promoting the superiority of ATR products and their latest developments.
- Contribute to the product policy by providing feedback on the market needs expressed during sales campaigns.
- Strengthen the impact of customer-facing messages in close collaboration with the Product Marketing, Market Development and Communications teams.
About You
- Ideally 3-5 years of relevant work experience, with at least one experience within an airline or in a customer-facing role. A strong technical (performance and operations) and commercial understanding of regional air transport, the cost structure of airlines, the product landscape and influencing factors.
- Excellent presentation skills: Experience in delivering presentations to large audiences and the ability to communicate with different sources and users of information.
- Analysis: Strong analytical skills and ability to turn findings from technical or digital analysis into compelling marketing arguments.
- Customer Focus: ability to work to satisfy internal and/or external customers by managing time and quality expectations.

- Innovation: The ability to take a creative approach to developing new marketing strategies, solving problems, and achieving goals.
- Team spirit and collaboration
- Strong interpersonal skills

- Understanding of the key players, stakeholders, trends, and drivers of the aviation market.

- Understanding of the macro-economic environment.
- Aircraft financing landscape.
- Fleet and network planning, revenue management.
- Product knowledge: performance, aircraft systems, engines, cabin, etc.
- Marketing and communication: messages, presentations.
Language skills
