Title: ATR - Customer Marketing & Business Development Manager
Description:
Job Description:
About us
ATR is the world's number one aircraft manufacturer in regional aviation providing a new generation of turboprops. We are a joint venture between two European aeronautical heavyweights, Airbus and Leonardo.
From the world’s largest cities, to our planet’s most remote regions , our purpose is to deliver air travel to people, communities and businesses in an innovative, sustainable and modern way.
If you strive for excellence, are driven by ambition , trust and respect as we are, then get your career off to a flighting start with ATR!
Our leadership profile:
People Centric – Entrepreneurial – Inspiring - Exemplary – Innovative - Humble
At ATR you will work with passionate colleagues to make a difference in a human size company with attractive advantages!
Customer Marketing and Business Development Manager
A unique opportunity to join the ATR Commercial Directorate as a Customer Marketing & Business Development Manager in the dynamic APAC region. The team, made up of people based over 3 continents, is looking for it’s newest member to come onboard.
Your mission:
Influence and convince airline and lessor decision-makers of the competitive advantage of ATR products and their contribution to airline profitability, both in the context of sales campaigns and business development.
Play a critical role in setting the sales strategy and approach with the regional sales directors.
Manage all marketing and business development activities on specific accounts and campaigns in the APAC region:
Identify targets and prospects with regional sales directors and contribute to the definition and implementation of regional strategies.
Prepare and present analyses on aircraft performance and technical aspects, airline economics as well as network and fleet planning at all phases of sales campaigns.
Build strong pitches for sales campaigns and ensure that value-added arguments are effectively communicated, understood by the customer and used to develop a business offer when appropriate.
Find and engage with possible future prospects in the region, including but not limited to VIP prospects, oil and gas prospects and future airline prospects.
Develop a thorough understanding of all aspects of an airline’s requirements, global and regional aviation market trends, airline business drivers, evolving fleet and network requirements, revenue and profit generation models, and the markets competitive environment.
Build relationships with customer counterparts.
Proactively drive business development analyses and presentations to fuel new market opportunities and influence the market by promoting the superiority of ATR products and their latest developments.
Contribute to the product policy by providing feedback on the market needs expressed during sales campaigns.
Strengthen the impact of customer-facing messages in close collaboration with the Product Marketing, Market Development and Communications teams.

Title: AVP/VP, Brand and Marketing (Creative)
Description:
GIC is one of the world’s largest sovereign wealth funds. With over 2,000 employees across 11 locations around the world, we invest in more than 40 countries globally across asset classes and businesses. Working at GIC gives you exposure to an extraordinary network of the world’s industry leaders. As a leading global long-term investor, we Work at the Point of Impact for Singapore’s financial future, and the communities we invest in worldwide.
Corporate Affairs and Communications
The Corporate Affairs & Communications team is responsible for managing corporate affairs, branding and reputation, and all internal and external communications. It is GIC’s interface with key stakeholders, including the general public, media, and employees.
Brand and Marketing
We develop narratives that underpin the GIC brand and protect GIC’s reputation and share these narratives with a range of audiences – our client, partners, the public, media, and our employees – through both internal and external communications. Our team includes Brand and Marketing, Corporate Communications, Employee Engagement, and Impact and Partnerships.
What impact can you make in this role?
We are looking for a suitable candidate to join our team as AVP/VP – Brand and Marketing, reporting to the Head of Brand and Marketing. This is a pivotal hire — the creative conscience of our team, setting the standard for how GIC looks, feels, and communicates across every touchpoint. In this hands-on strategic role, the successful candidate will work alongside the team to shape and deliver creative output across the platforms.
What will you do as a AVP/VP in Brand and Marketing?
Brand Ownership
- Brand Custodian - Own and evolve GIC's visual identity, brand guidelines, and creative standards across all touchpoints globally
- Ensure brand consistency across platforms and materials
Agency Partnership & Creative Direction
- Serve as GIC's primary creative authority with external agencies — setting briefs, reviewing output, and holding work to an institutional standard.
- Build a clear briefing framework and a deep understanding of what 'right' looks like for GIC, elevating first-draft quality and reducing iterations.
- Manage agency relationships actively — Defined deliverables, honest feedback — and know when to commission, push back, or deliver in-house.
Design & Creative Execution
- Produce key assets directly where needed.
- Apply user-centric design principles to digital platforms, contributing to UI/UX projects.
- Comfortable working in Adobe Creative Suite; not only direct and able to prototype and deliver finished assets.
Team & Strategic Contribution
- Build and maintain the brand toolkit so the team can produce on-brand work independently
- Be the creative partner to teams across the department, raising the design quality of the content produced
- Contribute to the department strategy a creative lens, bringing an external perspective on how peer institutions are evolving their brand presence.
- Collaborate with team members and cross-functional departments to align creative direction with strategic goals
What makes you a successful candidate?
Experience
- 8–10 years in brand, creative, or design roles — in-house or senior agency side
- Background in financial services, professional services, or institutional organisations strongly preferred — you understand how to brief and direct work that feels right in a regulated, high-trust environment
- Proven track record as a sophisticated creative client — experience managing multiple relationships and projects effectively in a fast-paced environment.
- Experience operating as a trusted creative advisor to senior stakeholders – diagnosing needs, shaping direction and bringing an outside-in view of how leading institutions are evolving their brand.
- Hands-on experience producing a range of collateral and creative outputs – brand identity, events creative, publication, video/ motion content and multi-formal institutional design
- History of raising agency output quality through better briefing, sharper creative standards, and informed, constructive feedback
Skills & Attributes
- Strong design software skills — fluent in Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Familiarity with Figma or Sketch and basic HTML/CSS knowledge, Understanding of UX/UI design and accessibility best practices and comfortable as both strategist and maker: you can write the brief and produce the asset.
- Strategic, consultative mindset — sets the creative standard, exercises independent judgment on what 'right' looks like for GIC, and influences rather than simply executes.
- Strong stakeholder and project management skills — able to run multiple workstreams concurrently, manage agency and internal timelines across time zones, and land creative ideas in a conservative institutional context without diluting them.
- A genuine team player — generous with time and knowledge, supportive of colleagues, and invested in the team's collective success, not just individual output.
- Builds strong relationships across a wide range of stakeholders, raising the quality and confidence of everyone they work with.
- Strong problem-solver — anticipates, initiates, and resolves issues, and able to pivot in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment.
- Highly organised — delivers to a high standard under competing deadlines, with a positive, continuous-learning attitude.
Work at the Point of Impact
We need to be forward-looking to attract the right people to help us become the Leading Global Long-term Investor. Join our ambitious, agile, and diverse teams - be empowered to push boundaries and pursue innovative ideas, share your views, and be heard. Be anchored on our PRIME Values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence, which guides us in how we make our day-to-day decisions. We strive to inspire. To make an impact.
Flexibility at GIC
At GIC, our offices are vibrant hubs for ideation, professional growth, and interpersonal connection. At the same time, we believe that flexibility allows us to do our best work and be our best selves. Thus, our teams come into the office four days per week to harness the benefits of in-person collaboration, but have the flexibility to choose which days they work from home and adjust this arrangement as situational needs arise.
We are an equal opportunity employer
GIC is an equal opportunity employer, and we value diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.
Please email grphrodtaops@gic.com.sg at any point of the application or interview process if adjustments need to be made due to a disability.
Learn more about our Corporate Affairs & Communication Department here:
https://gic.careers/group/corporate-affairs-communication/
Our PRIME Values
GIC is a values driven organization. GIC’s PRIME Values act as our compass, enabling us to fulfil our fundamental purpose and objectives. It is the foundational bedrock which governs our behaviors, our decision making, and our focus. It informs both our long-term strategy as a firm, and the way we relate to our Client, business partners and employees. PRIME stands for Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence.

Title: B2B Growth Marketing Lead - APAC
Description:
We're looking for a B2B Growth Marketing Lead to accelerate the growth of Wise Business across APAC.
This is a senior, hands-on role for an exceptional B2B growth marketer. You'll identify the markets, customer segments and opportunities with the greatest growth potential, then turn those choices into locally relevant campaigns that acquire valuable business customers.
You'll own the regional B2B growth strategy and bring it to life across both self-serve and sales-assisted acquisition. You'll move comfortably between market prioritisation, customer insight, campaign strategy, proposition development, detailed execution and performance optimisation.
You won't be starting with a large dedicated team or a finished regional playbook. You'll work through specialist teams across content, events, paid search and other channels, partner closely with Sales, and make the evidence-based case for additional regional investment when an opportunity requires it.
You'll be based in Singapore and work closely with our APAC Regional Marketing Lead and market teams. Singapore is your operating base, but you'll use evidence to determine where Wise Business has the strongest growth opportunities across APAC.
Your mission
Make APAC a major contributor to Wise Business growth by building a repeatable engine that identifies the region's best opportunities and turns them into locally relevant, commercially effective campaigns.
Help more micro and small businesses discover and choose Wise for their international money needs, while growing within our customer-value and payback requirements.
What you'll be doing
Own the B2B growth strategy for APAC, using customer, market, product and commercial evidence to prioritise the most attractive opportunities.
Develop and execute locally relevant, integrated campaigns that acquire valuable business customers across self-serve and sales-assisted journeys.
Translate customer problems into clear growth hypotheses, propositions, campaign briefs, channel plans and measurement approaches.
Work hands-on with specialists across content, events, paid search and other channels to take campaigns from idea to market without losing strategic quality or pace.
Partner closely with Product Marketing and Sales on the Go-To-Market Plan and our ideal customer profiles delivering crucial market feedback.
Connect campaign performance to new business profiles, customer quality, downstream value and payback - not just impressions, clicks or lead volume.
Build credible business cases for regional investment outside established marketing activity, defining the opportunity, expected return, resources required and how the activity will be tested.
Use performance and customer evidence to decide what to scale, improve, stop or redirect, creating a consistent pipeline of activity rather than isolated launches.
Build a strong operating rhythm with the APAC Regional Marketing Lead and regional stakeholders, combining local context with the wider Wise Business growth strategy.
Identify and propose issues or improvements to Wise Business from a regional product perspective to help strengthen the offering.
Qualifications
You have deep B2B growth marketing experience and can demonstrate meaningful commercial outcomes that you personally helped create.
You're an exceptional, hands-on growth marketer. You can set the strategy, write the brief, shape the proposition, work through funnel problems and stay close to execution and performance.
You have built growth across multiple markets and understand that APAC is not one homogeneous audience. You know how to adapt a strategy to different customer needs, channels and competitive conditions.
You can identify and prioritise valuable B2B audiences, uncover the customer problem that matters and turn that insight into a focused acquisition proposition.
You understand both self-serve and sales-assisted acquisition and know how Marketing and Sales can operate as one connected growth system.
You make commercially grounded decisions using acquisition cost, conversion, customer quality, payback and lifetime-value considerations.
You're comfortable defining success before launch, working with imperfect data and making clear scale, stop or change decisions from the evidence.
You can bring together specialist and cross-functional teams without formal authority, maintaining clarity, quality and momentum.
You're comfortable operating independently in an ambiguous environment and move quickly from uncertainty to a sensible test.
You're motivated by Wise's mission and the opportunity to help small businesses operate and grow internationally.
Nice to haves
Most of your career has been spent in B2B SaaS marketing.
Experience in B2B fintech, payments, financial services or a comparable technology platform with a multi-stage customer journey.
Direct experience growing a business in Singapore, Southeast Asia or other APAC markets.
Experience marketing to freelancers, micro-businesses, small businesses, agencies, consultancies or startups.
Experience with cross-border, multi-currency or international-expansion products.
Experience entering or scaling an early-stage regional market.
Familiarity with partner-, community- or event-led B2B acquisition alongside digital channels.
Who we are
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move money around the world. With the Wise account people and businesses can hold over 40 currencies, move money between countries and spend money abroad. Large companies and banks use Wise technology too; an entirely new cross-border payments network that will one day power money without borders for everyone, everywhere. However you use the platform, Wise is on a mission to make your life easier and save you money.
Co-founded by Kristo Käärmann and Taavet Hinrikus, Wise launched in 2011 under its original name TransferWise. It is one of the world’s fastest growing, profitable technology companies and is listed on the London Stock Exchange under the ticker, WISE.
16 million people and businesses use Wise. In fiscal year 2023, Wise processed approximately £105 billion in cross-border transactions, saving customers around £1.5 billion.
What it’s really like to work here
At Wise, we do things a bit differently. There’s no corporate nonsense, and no old-fashioned hierarchy. Instead, we work in dozens of self-sufficient, autonomous teams. Think of them like start-ups within a start-up that learn from each other.
Each team picks the problems they want to solve. So there’s no micro-management. No hiding behind fancy job titles. And no one telling you what to do. You are your own boss. But you’ll get tons of guidance and plenty of support from talented, super-smart colleagues from all over Wise.
We’re going to be upfront — the way we work doesn’t suit everyone. But if freedom, autonomy, and life-affirming, head-scratching professional challenges rock your world, we could be a match made in heaven.

Title: B2B Marketing Sales Account Manager (Remote)
Description:
Job Description
About Us
We help interior design and renovation firms in Singapore grow — through lead generation, branding, and marketing programmes that bring them qualified homeowners and stronger market positioning. Our clients don't just buy a service from us once; they grow with us across tiers as their firms scale. That only works when someone closes the right clients — and then owns the relationship after the first close.
That someone is you.
About the Role
This is a fully remote role.
You'll work from wherever you work best — no daily commute, no office face-time. What matters is that your clients feel looked after and your accounts grow. You'll meet clients over video calls (with the occasional in-person session if a key relationship calls for it), and stay connected to the team through our daily rhythms online.
This is a closing role first, a relationship role always.
You'll start by building your own book of business: running sales conversations with interior design firms, diagnosing where their business is stuck, and closing them into the right programme. Every deal you close becomes an account you own — and from there, your job is to make each relationship deeper, longer, and more valuable over time.
The more you close early on, the bigger the portfolio you manage — and the more your recurring income compounds through renewals, tier upgrades, and referrals. You are the person our clients trust from the very first call, the one who checks in before they have to ask, and the reason they sign, renew, upgrade, and refer.
What You'll Do
Run discovery and sales calls with interior design and renovation firms — diagnosing their growth bottlenecks and closing them into the programme that fits
Manage your own sales pipeline end to end: qualification, follow-ups, objection handling, and closing, with clear monthly targets
Own every account you close as their primary point of contact and trusted advisor
Run regular check-ins and performance reviews with clients — walking them through their results, diagnosing bottlenecks, and recommending next steps
Drive renewals by ensuring clients see and understand the value they're getting throughout the programme, not just at renewal time
Identify and develop expansion opportunities — helping clients climb to higher programme tiers when their business is ready for it
Generate referrals naturally by building the kind of relationship people recommend to their peers
Work with our internal teams to resolve client issues quickly and keep promises made during the sales process
Maintain accurate account records, follow-up rhythms, and relationship health tracking in our CRM
Who You Are
2+ years in B2B sales, account management, or client success — with a track record of hitting sales targets and closing deals
A closer who thinks long-term: you know how to drive a deal to a decision, but you close clients you can grow, not just deals you can win
A natural relationship builder — the close is the start of the relationship, not the end of it
Consistent with follow-through: you do what you say, on time, every time
A clear communicator who can explain performance data and business concepts simply, in person and in writing
Commercially sharp — you can spot an upsell or referral opportunity without making the client feel sold to
Organised and self-directed: you manage your own portfolio, pipeline of renewals, and follow-up cadence
Proven ability to work independently in a remote setup — you stay responsive, structured, and visible without anyone looking over your shoulder
Bonus: experience in or exposure to the interior design, renovation, real estate, or home services industry
Why Join Us
100% remote
— you're measured on client outcomes, not hours at a desk
Base salary + commissions on every deal you close, plus recurring incentives on retention, renewals, and account growth — your income compounds as your portfolio grows
Build your own book of business from day one, backed by proven sales scripts, frameworks, and playbooks — you close it, you keep it, you grow it
Clear frameworks, playbooks, and training on how we sell, manage, and grow accounts
A front-row seat to how design and renovation businesses in Singapore scale

Title: Brand Manager
Description:
About the role
We're looking for a Brand Manager who can own the Bells brand system end to end — across all three sub-brands — and who is equally comfortable managing a website launch and standing on-site at a training centre reviewing a kiosk installation. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role at the centre of the Bells brand rollout — spanning digital brand execution (websites, programme pages), physical brand experience (centre branding, kiosks, experiential walls), and the ongoing marketing engine (testimonials, collateral, campaigns) that keeps each brand alive day to day.
You'll work directly with senior brand and marketing leadership, coordinating designers, developers, print vendors, and centre teams to bring a locked brand system to life consistently — online and in person — across every touchpoint a learner encounters, whichever Bells sub-brand they meet first.
Key responsibilities
Own end-to-end execution of Bells websites and programme pages — homepage, About Us, Contact Us, and all course/programme pages — across Bells School of AI, Bells School of Finance, and Bells Academy, coordinating information gathering, content, Figma design, dev handover, staging, and go-live against a live project tracker.
Ensure every page reflects locked, approved copy and the correct brand system for its sub-brand exactly — verbatim accuracy on approved lines is non-negotiable.
Coordinate with content, design, and tech stakeholders to keep multiple programme pages moving through the pipeline in parallel across all three brands without missing deadlines.
Drive the physical rollout of Bells brand guidelines across all training centres — managing video recce, floor plans, design concepts, approvals, print production, and installation end to end — tailored to whichever sub-brand a centre or zone represents.
Own the Centre Branding Playbook and ensure it is replicated consistently across centres, each on its own rollout timeline.
Lead kiosk branding standardisation — from pilot through to uniform rollout across all centres.
Build out the Testimonials Playbook into a repeatable, business-as-usual process across all Bells sub-brands — covering collection (video and static, via structured intake forms), consent tracking, and editing.
Own the On-Ground Collateral / BTL Playbook — flyers, notice boards, hiring and recruitment posters, and event materials — for both marketing and centre/ground-sales needs, across all three sub-brands.
Act as the day-to-day guardian of the Bells brand system — the master brand and each of its three sub-brands — ensuring consistent, correctly-differentiated application across every digital and physical touchpoint.
Maintain and report against the brand ops tracker, proactively surfacing blockers, delays, and dependencies.
About you
4–6 years of experience in brand management, brand marketing, or brand operations, with exposure to both digital execution (websites, content, campaigns) and physical/experiential branding (retail, centre, event, or environmental branding).
Degree holders (preferably in Marketing)
Background in education or edtech is a plus, but not essential.
Experience managing more than one brand or sub-brand at a time is a strong plus.
Strong project management instincts: comfortable owning a tracker with 15–20+ concurrent workstreams, each at a different stage, without letting anything slip.
Working knowledge of how signage, kiosks, and print production actually get made — from concept and design through to approval and installation.
Comfortable reviewing and giving feedback on website and programme page content, with an eye for consistency, tone, and brand fit.
Fluent with AI tools for everyday content, design, and editing work — drafting and refining copy, generating and iterating on visual concepts, and speeding up edits.
Excellent stakeholder management — able to work confidently with founders and leadership as well as designers, vendors, and ground teams.

Based in Singapore, with willingness to travel regularly across Bells training centres for on-site branding rollouts.
About us
Bells Institute of Higher Learning is one of Singapore's most established education providers, with 150,000 learners impacted, 7 training centres, and 40+ courses. Bells is an SSG-appointed programme partner, aligned to SkillsFuture and NTUC e2i, with corporate partners including JP Morgan, DBS Bank, Samsung, Singtel, Meta, and BDO.
The Bells brand structure is being rebuilt around three sub-brands: Bells School of AI, our flagship digital-first anchor brand; Bells School of Finance, built in partnership with Imarticus Learning — a leader in professional education with 1M+ learners impacted globally — bringing AI-embedded finance education to Singapore; and Bells Academy, home to our specialised courses spanning 3D printing, project management, craft skills, and more.

Title: Brand Partnerships & Growth Specialist
Description:
Crimson Education is the world’s leading college admissions consulting firm, with over 1,490 Ivy League offers and 2,410 to the US Top 15. We help ambitious students gain admission to the world’s top universities through expert-led guidance and proven, data-driven strategies. Crimson students are 7x more likely to get into the Ivy League than their peers. We were recently featured on the front page of the Wall Street Journal.
Crimson is the only college admissions consultancy that brings together:
Former Ivy League and Top 20 admissions officers to rigorously review and refine applications
Professors and PhD teaching fellows from leading universities to guide students through original, independent research — with pathways to selective peer-reviewed publication or conference presentation
Past ISEF winners and judges who coach students to compete for state, national, and international science fair awards
Capstone project mentors who help students design and scale leadership initiatives with real-world impact, measurable outcomes, and credible external validation
We’re backed by leading VC firms, including Tiger Global, Heal Partners, IceHouse Ventures, and Movac, and recently closed a USD $40M Series D funding round at a USD $640M valuation. We now operate across 21 markets worldwide, including the US, Canada, UK, Singapore, Japan, Hong Kong, Australia, and New Zealand.
Beyond college admissions consulting, Crimson offers a wide range of Enrichment programs designed to help students discover their interests, develop new skills, and achieve meaningful academic and extracurricular accomplishments. As we continue expanding our reach internationally, we're looking for a part-time Brand Partnerships & Growth Specialist to help introduce these programs to new audiences and strengthen their presence in key markets.
The role will initially focus on Indigo Research and Crimson Rise, two of our key Enrichment products. You’ll find creative ways to get them in front of the right students and families — whether through partnerships with leading schools and organizations, media and podcasts, creators, conferences, community placements, events, pop-ups, or other brand activations.
You’ll work closely with our marketing and leadership teams to identify opportunities others might miss and turn them into action. We’re looking for someone with strong existing networks who can open doors, generate ideas independently, and think commercially about how greater visibility can translate into audience growth, leads, and ultimately revenue.
Responsibilities include
Brand Growth & Opportunity Development
Identify creative ways to get Indigo and Rise in front of the right audiences – from media, podcasts, and creators to conferences, school and community placements, pop-ups, activations, and other unconventional opportunities.
Strengthen Indigo and Rise’s positioning across international markets, adapting ideas and messaging to local audiences while maintaining a consistent global brand.
Turn student, mentor, leadership, and company stories into compelling campaigns, content, PR, thought leadership, and other brand-building opportunities.
Develop and test creative market-specific ideas that build awareness and credibility, while considering how visibility can translate into audience growth, qualified leads, demand, and revenue.
Track results, identify what works, and recommend which channels, ideas, and initiatives we should scale.
Partnerships, Networks & Execution
Use your existing network – and continuously expand it – to open doors with journalists, creators, schools, education organizations, event organizers, companies, communities, and other influential partners.
Develop creative collaborations such as events, content partnerships, creator campaigns, webinars, competitions, community initiatives, and brand activations.
Proactively secure high-value media coverage, podcast appearances, speaking opportunities, conference placements, partnerships, and other forms of brand exposure.
Own opportunities end-to-end, from identifying the idea and making the introduction through pitching, execution, follow-up, and measuring impact.
What skills and experience you’ll need
5+ years of experience across brand marketing, partnerships, PR, growth, events, communications, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience building brands and creating growth opportunities across international markets.
An established, active network in at least one of our priority markets – the US, India, Singapore/Southeast Asia, or the Middle East – with relationships you can genuinely activate to open doors. This could include journalists, media outlets, schools, education organizations, event organizers, creators, influencers, community leaders, or other relevant partners.
A track record of independently spotting and creating opportunities – from partnerships and PR to events, creator collaborations, activations, and other forms of meaningful brand exposure.
A commercial mindset: not every brand activity needs to generate leads immediately, but you naturally think about how awareness and credibility can ultimately contribute to audience growth, demand, leads, and revenue.
Excellent written and spoken English, with strong pitching, storytelling, and communication skills.
Strong relationship-building skills and confidence approaching journalists, creators, organizations, partners, and senior external stakeholders.
Highly proactive, resourceful, and organized – you can take a broad objective, identify the right opportunity and people, and independently drive it from idea through execution.
What success looks like
Indigo and Rise become meaningfully more visible, relevant, and credible in the markets you own.
You consistently uncover opportunities we would not have found without you – new partners, creators, media, events, communities, placements, and creative ways to reach our target audiences.
Your existing network opens doors quickly, while the network you build becomes an increasingly valuable asset for Indigo and Rise.
Your initiatives generate measurable outcomes across brand awareness, audience growth, qualified leads, strategic relationships, and ultimately revenue.
You develop a clear understanding of what works in each market, learn quickly from what doesn’t, and scale the strongest ideas.
Why join us
Part-time, fully remote role with flexible working hours.
Help shape two education brands across multiple international markets.
High ownership and the freedom to turn good ideas into real campaigns, partnerships, and events.
Work with a global team of ambitious, curious people.

Title: Business Development (Export Sales)
Description:
Job Level
: Executive / Assistant Manager /Manager, depending on experience and competencies
Salary
: Commensurate with experience and the level of appointment
Work Location
: Singapore, with frequent overseas business travel and assignments
About the Role
We are seeking a commercially driven and proactive Business Development professional to expand the Company's export business and strengthen its presence in overseas markets. The role focuses on developing new international markets, building customer relationships, driving export sales and identifying sustainable business growth opportunities.
The successful candidate must be comfortable with frequent overseas travel, including overseas assignments of at least two weeks at a time, to visit customers, develop new markets and participate in trade exhibitions. Candidates with a culinary background or knowledge of food products will have an added advantage.
Key Responsibilities
1.Overseas Business Development & Market Expansion
Identify, evaluate and develop new overseas markets, customers and distribution channels to expand the Company's export business.
Develop market entry strategies and business plans to drive sales growth and strengthen the Company's international market presence.
Conduct overseas market research, competitor analysis and customer assessments to identify business opportunities.
Establish and maintain relationships with overseas distributors, importers, retailers, food service operators and other strategic partners.
2.Export Sales & Customer Relationship Management
Drive export sales activities, develop new customer accounts and grow existing overseas business.
Conduct regular overseas customer visits, product presentations, business negotiations and follow-ups to secure sales opportunities.
Understand customers' product requirements, market preferences and commercial needs, and coordinate suitable product solutions with internal teams.
Prepare quotations, sales proposals, forecasts and business reports to support export sales development.
3.Overseas Exhibitions & Business Engagement
Participate in international trade exhibitions, food fairs and industry events to promote the Company's products and generate new business leads.
Coordinate exhibition preparations, product displays, promotional materials, customer meetings and post-exhibition follow-ups.
Represent the Company professionally at overseas exhibitions, customer meetings and other business engagements.
4.Overseas Assignments & Cross-Department Coordination
Undertake frequent overseas business travel, including assignments of at least two weeks per trip, depending on business requirements, to develop markets and engage customers directly.
Coordinate with internal departments, including Operations, Procurement, Logistics, Impex and Food Safety, to support export orders, product availability, documentation and delivery arrangements.
Monitor export sales performance, market developments and customer feedback, and provide recommendations to Management.
Perform other relevant duties as assigned by Management.
Requirements
Diploma or Degree in Business, International Trade, Marketing, Food Science, Culinary Arts or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may also be considered.
Relevant experience in export sales, international business development, overseas market expansion or a related commercial role.
Strong business development, sales negotiation, customer relationship management and market research skills.
Willingness and ability to undertake frequent overseas travel, including assignments of at least two weeks at a time.
Experience in the food industry, FMCG, food service or food distribution will be an advantage.
A culinary background or knowledge of food products, food preparation or food applications will be an added advantage.
Good communication, presentation, negotiation and cross-cultural interpersonal skills.
Self-motivated, results-oriented and able to work independently in a dynamic international business environment.

Title: Business Development Director
Description:
We are an early-stage Singapore company in the health, wellness, and digital health sector preparing to establish our commercial presence overseas.
Candidate Profile
We are seeking an experienced
Business Development Director
to lead our in-market business development activities and establish the commercial foundations in our overseas target market.
This is a hands-on role suited to an experienced commercial professional who is comfortable operating and working independently in an entrepreneurial, early-stage small environment, building markets, relationships and opportunities from the ground up.
The Business Development Director will be responsible for developing the company’s local commercial presence, identifying and engaging prospective customers and strategic partners, generating qualified leads and business opportunities, and building a structured pipeline for future revenue growth.
A commercially minded and resilient professional who is comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy and integrity.
The successful candidate should be willing to work in an environment where processes, systems, customer relationships and market presence are still being built. This role requires someone who can move comfortably between strategic thinking and hands-on execution.
Key Responsibilities
Lead and execute the company’s business development and market-entry activities.
Conduct market research and assess local market opportunities, customer segments, competitors, commercial channels and market-entry considerations.
Identify, qualify and engage prospective customers, strategic partners, distributors, channel partners and other relevant commercial stakeholders.
Generate qualified leads and build a structured business development pipeline.
Arrange and conduct in-person business meetings with prospective customers, partners and other stakeholders.
Develop and strengthen local partnerships relevant to the company’s growth strategy.
Progress commercial opportunities from initial engagement through follow-up, proposal development, pilot discussions and potential agreements.
Represent the company professionally in external meetings, market-development activities and relevant industry engagements.
Gather market intelligence and customer feedback to support refinement of the company’s commercial and market-entry strategy.
Prepare commercial proposals, presentations and business cases in collaboration with the Singapore management team.
Execute appropriate in-market business development and marketing activities to support brand awareness and lead generation.
Maintain accurate records of prospects, meetings, opportunities, follow-up actions and commercial outcomes.
Track and report key business development metrics, including leads generated, meetings conducted, partnership opportunities progressed and measurable milestones achieved.
Prepare regular progress reports and provide management with practical recommendations on market opportunities, risks and next steps.
Support the development of the company’s longer-term overseas expansion strategy based on commercial validation.
Job Requirements
The ideal candidate should have:
Significant track record and professional experience in business development, partnerships, sales, commercial strategy and international market entry.
Relevant experience in pharmaceuticals, healthcare, health and wellness, digital health or a similar related sector.
Strong understanding of the commercial dynamics, stakeholders and partnership models relevant to the industry.
Demonstrated ability to identify opportunities, generate leads and develop commercial relationships.
Strong experience in stakeholder engagement, partnership development and external business representation.
Ability to operate independently in the target market.
Strong commercial judgement, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to interact confidently with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data analysis, reporting and commercial tracking.
Excellent time-management and organisational skills.
Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
Ability to remain focused while managing multiple priorities.
Self-motivated, proactive and independent.
Positive, solutions-oriented and adaptable working style.
Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
Ability to work effectively with a small team while operating independently.
Willingness and ability to be physically based in the target market for the required assignment period.
The candidate should be comfortable:
building commercial relationships from an early stage;
working without an established local team or mature sales infrastructure;
adapting quickly to changing priorities;
managing multiple workstreams independently;
taking ownership from initial market engagement through to commercial follow-up; and
contributing practically to the company’s market-entry strategy.
Working Environment

Title: Business Development Executive
Description:
*About NuSpace*
NuSpace is a Singapore-headquartered company building satellite IoT connectivity and CubeSat hardware. Our mission is to connect every sensor, asset, and machine on Earth, including the places terrestrial networks never reach. Our NuLink connectivity service and CubeSat bus platform serve customers who need reliable data from remote and demanding environments. We are a small, engineering-led team entering a commercial growth phase, and we are hiring our first dedicated business development associate.
*About the Role*
You will work directly with our Chief Executive Officer to turn our technology into customer relationships. This is a commercial role, not a research role. You will spend most of your time on market research, outreach, and proposal support, and you will learn how a deep-tech company actually wins business. Sales cycles in this industry are long, so expect early wins to be small: a qualified lead, a well-received proposal, an insight that changes how we position a product.
What you will do:
* *Research markets:* Analyse where satellite IoT and CubeSat hardware create the most value (for example agriculture, logistics, maritime, energy, and government) and recommend where we should focus.
* *Qualify leads:* Handle inbound inquiries and outbound outreach, working out who the decision-maker is, what the customer needs, and whether it is a real opportunity.
* *Support proposals and bids:* Help draft proposals, capability documents, and grant or tender submissions, working with our engineers to translate technical specs into customer language.
* *Maintain the pipeline:* Keep our prospective customer lists accurate and give leadership a clear weekly view of opportunities and risks.
* *Feed customer insight back:* Bring what customers say to our product and engineering team. Your notes will be used in roadmap discussions.
*What your first 12 months look like*
* *Months 1 to 3:* Learn our products and customers, shadow leadership on calls and meetings, and create your own lead tracker and market research pack.

Title: Business Development Executive (Consumer (FMCG))
Description:
ROLEOVERVIEW
The Business Development Executive will be responsible for expanding market share, developing new distribution channels and growing the company's consumer goods business.
The role focuses on identifying business opportunities, establishing and managing retail, wholesale and e-commerce partnerships, and improving sales performance across existing customer accounts.
The position may cover consumer goods categories such as fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG), consumer electronics, apparel, cosmetics, fashion and related products, depending on the company's business requirements.
KEYRESPONSIBILITIES
1.Business Development and Channel Expansion
+ Identify, develop and secure new business opportunities across retail, wholesale, distribution and other relevant sales channels.
+ Establish and maintain professional relationships with distributors, retailers, supermarkets, wholesalers and traditional trade partners.
+ Evaluate potential business partners and distribution opportunities based on market potential, commercial viability and business objectives.
+ Develop and implement business development plans to increase market coverage, sales revenue and distribution reach.
2.E-commerce and Digital Channel Development
+ Identify and develop partnerships with online marketplaces, e-commerce platforms, quick-commerce providers and other relevant digital sales channels.
+ Support the development and implementation of channel-specific sales strategies and promotional initiatives.
+ Monitor online sales performance and recommend improvements to product visibility, customer engagement and conversion.
3. Key Account Management
+ Build and maintain professional relationships with existing and prospective customers, including distributors, retail buyers, category managers and commercial partners.
+ Negotiate commercial terms, product listings, promotional arrangements and other business agreements within the company's approved policies and authority limits.
+ Monitor account performance, identify opportunities for account growth and address customer concerns in collaboration with relevant internal teams.
4.Sales and Marketing Coordination
+ Work with marketing and other relevant teams to plan and execute trade promotions, merchandising initiatives, product launches and in-store activities.
+ Coordinate promotional calendars, product displays and channel-specific marketing activities with business partners.
+ Review campaign results and recommend improvements based on sales performance and commercial objectives.
5.Sales Forecasting and Performance Analysis
+ Monitor sales performance, customer orders, inventory levels and product movement to support demand forecasting and inventory planning.
+ Analyze relevant sales data, market developments and consumer purchasing trends to identify business opportunities and potential risks.
+ Prepare sales forecasts, pipeline updates and regular performance reports.
+ Recommend appropriate actions to improve sales growth, product availability and inventory turnover.
6.Market Research and Business Development Planning
+ Monitor industry developments, competitor activities, distribution trends and changing consumer demand.
+ Identify potential customer segments, product categories and distribution channels for business expansion.
+ Provide market insights and recommendations to support commercial planning and decision-making.
QUALIFICATION, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
Relevant Experience
+ Experience in sales, business development, account management, channel development or a related commercial role.
+ Experience in FMCG, consumer goods, consumer electronics, apparel, cosmetics, fashion, wholesale distribution, retail or e-commerce would be relevant to the role.
+ Candidates with transferable experience in related industries may also be considered based on the relevance of their skills, knowledge and achievements.
Market and Commercial Knowledge
+ Understanding of retail or wholesale distribution channels, customer account management, sales processes and commercial negotiations.
+ Familiarity with trade promotions, product listings, distribution arrangements and sales performance analysis would be advantageous.
+ Knowledge of consumer purchasing trends and market dynamics relevant to the products and channels managed.
Negotiation and Relationship Management
+ Ability to develop business relationships, identify customer needs and negotiate commercial arrangements.
+ Ability to communicate effectively with customers, distributors and internal stakeholders.
+ Strong commercial awareness, problem-solving skills and customer relationship management capabilities.
Analytical and Organizational Skills
+ Ability to interpret sales data, monitor business performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
+ Good planning, coordination and organizational skills.
+ Proficiency in relevant sales reporting tools, spreadsheets or customer relationship management systems would be advantageous.
Education
+ A bachelor's degree or equivalent professional qualification in Business, Marketing, Sales or a related discipline.
+ Candidates with other relevant qualifications and demonstrable experience may also be considered based on their ability to perform the role.

This role will suit an outgoing person who is customer-focused, energized by commercial interactions, enjoys solving problems, is comfortable cold-calling and enjoys extensive traveling within Asia / the Middle East.
The ideal candidate is a subject matter expert on commodity pricing and fertilizer markets to raise Argus’ profile, develop and nurture relationships with key stakeholders in the fertilizer industry and promote the use of Argus price benchmarks. This strategic industry-facing role requires frequent engagement with industry participants to promote Argus fertilizer services and to provide intelligence to drive product development and inform strategic decisions for the business.
You will represent Argus at industry events and establish relationships with industry decision-makers across Asia and the Middle East. As part of engaging with the market, there will be a significant focus on making relevant connections, then successfully securing meetings and relationship building to discuss customer pain points. The aim will be to identify opportunities to better support customers’ commercial activities and decision-making using Argus services.
Key areas of focus will be fertilizer raw materials markets, including sulphur, sulphuric acid and ammonia, as well as finished fertilizers such as urea, processed phosphates, potash, and NPKs.
What You Will Be Doing
- Develop and execute regional strategies across Asia and the Middle East to increase usage of Argus price assessments and grow the regional subscription business in fertilizer market reports and analytics services.
- Support strategic sector objectives. One of the key objectives will be to support Argus; relationship with brokers and exchanges and develop existing and upcoming Argus-based fertilizer derivatives.
- Build strong business relationships with fertilizer industry executives through proactive engagement.
- Work with subject matter experts and editors of fertilizer market reports to develop price assessments and methodologies and new products that solve real problems clients and prospects face.
- Understand client requirements for fundamentals data and fertilizer price forecasts.
- Monitor the competitive environment for Argus fertilizer services in Asia and the Middle East and propose strategies to maintain or achieve market leadership.
- Support account managers to grow their accounts by identifying commercial opportunities and joining meetings where appropriate to demonstrate the value of Argus services.
- Represent Argus at industry conferences and business gatherings, including regular speaking engagements.
- Coordinate regional fertilizer strategy with SVP Fertilizers and the fertilizer sector leadership team. Regularly communicate opportunities and challenges faced in the region with this group.
- Contribute (as needed) to white papers, presentations, analyses, and marketing materials.
To learn more about the report this role covers you can click here: https://www.argusmedia.com/en/fertilizer
What We’re Looking For In You
- Experience promoting price indexation, business intelligence or market analytics services in energy or fertilizer-related industries.
- 7+ years of experience in price reporting, supply, trading, and/or analysis in fertilizer markets, including deep understanding of industry economics and logistics.
- Strong negotiation and persuasion skills with the ability to build long-lasting, positive relationships with a wide range of stakeholders, including but not limited to senior executives, corporate entities, as well as government and non-government organisations.
- Ability to uncover customers’ problems and align them back to our value proposition.
- Cross-cultural management track record, with focus on APAC, South Asia, Middle East.
- Demonstrated ability to deliver successful outcomes in a complex matrix management environment and build effective working relationships with colleagues in all business functions.
- Suitable professional qualifications, such as undergraduate or master’s degree in a relevant field.
- Proactive and able to work independently.
Travel
- 20-25% of extensive travel within Asia / the Middle East
What’s In It For You
- Work within a highly motivated team at an industry-leading and rapidly growing global company.
- Competitive salary and commission scheme.
- A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork.
- Excellent location at Raffles Place in central Singapore – close to public transport and amenities.
- Hybrid working model - Work from Home available upon completion of probation.
- Comprehensive benefits package including medical (GP and specialist), dental and hospitalisation.
- 20 vacation days your first year, up to a maximum of 25 days.
- Extensive internal and external training.
- Employee Welfare & Employee Assistance Programme.
Argus is the leading independent provider of market intelligence to the global energy and commodity markets. We offer essential price assessments, news, analytics, consulting services, data science tools and industry conferences to illuminate complex and opaque commodity markets.
Headquartered in London with 1,500 staff, Argus is an independent media organisation with 32 offices in the world’s principal commodity trading hubs.
Companies, trading firms and governments in 160 countries around the world trust Argus data to make decisions, analyse situations, manage risk, facilitate trading and for long-term planning. Argus prices are used as trusted benchmarks around the world for pricing transportation, commodities and energy.
Founded in 1970, Argus remains a privately held UK-registered company owned by employee shareholders and global growth equity firm General Atlantic.

Our leading SaaS-based Global Employment Platform™ enables clients to expand into over 180 countries quickly and efficiently, without the complexities of establishing local entities. Actively participate in team meetings, share insights, and contribute ideas to enhance sales and lead generation processes.

Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field is preferred.
2+ years sales or lead generation experience
Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to effectively engage with prospects and build rapport.
Excellent phone etiquette and the ability to handle objections and rejection professionally and persistently.
Self-motivated and results-oriented with a proactive approach to identifying and pursuing opportunities.
Familiarity with CRM software and proficiency in using sales tools and technologies.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment, supporting sales initiatives and goals.

Title: Business Development Specialist
Description:
Business Development Specialist
Location: Singapore
Employment Type: Full-Time
We are looking for a confident, motivated and relationship-driven Business Development Specialist to support the growth of our client base, develop new business opportunities and build long-term professional relationships.
This role is well suited to individuals who enjoy meeting people, understanding client needs and creating opportunities through networking, referrals and consultative conversations.
Key Responsibilities
* Identify and develop new business opportunities through referrals, networking, events, partnerships and direct outreach.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with prospective and existing clients.
* Conduct initial client meetings to understand objectives, priorities and areas where professional advice may be required.
* Introduce relevant financial, wealth-planning and advisory solutions based on client needs.
* Support senior consultants in preparing proposals, presentations and client recommendations.
* Follow up consistently with prospects and maintain an active pipeline of opportunities.
* Develop strategic relationships with business owners, professionals, corporate contacts and potential referral partners.
* Organise and participate in client engagement activities, seminars, networking sessions and business events.
* Conduct market research to identify new segments, partnership opportunities and potential areas for business growth.
* Maintain accurate records of client interactions, leads, opportunities and follow-up activities.
* Support business development campaigns and client acquisition initiatives.
* Work closely with consultants and management to convert opportunities into long-term client relationships.
* Maintain a high standard of professionalism, confidentiality and client service.
* Attend relevant training and professional development programmes.
* Ensure all activities are conducted in accordance with internal procedures and applicable regulatory requirements.
What We Are Looking For
* Minimum Diploma in any discipline.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Confident in meeting and speaking with new people.
* Comfortable with networking and developing relationships from the ground up.
* Strong follow-up and relationship-management abilities.
* Self-motivated, disciplined and goal-oriented.
* Commercially minded with a strong interest in business development and client advisory work.
* Able to understand client needs and communicate ideas clearly.
* Good organisational and time-management skills.
* Able to work independently while contributing effectively within a team.
* Comfortable working in a performance-driven environment.
* Experience in business development, sales, banking, finance, consulting, recruitment, customer service or other client-facing roles will be an advantage.
* Fresh graduates with the right attitude and willingness to learn are welcome to apply.

You are someone who enjoys building relationships, creating opportunities and connecting with people.
You are comfortable starting conversations, developing trust and understanding what clients are trying to achieve before introducing suitable solutions.
You understand that business development is not simply about making a sale. It is about building a professional network, maintaining relationships and creating long-term value for both the client and the business.
The ideal candidate is personable, ambitious, persistent and capable of turning conversations into meaningful business opportunities.

* Structured training and professional development
* Mentorship from experienced professionals
* Opportunity to build a strong professional network
* Exposure to client advisory, financial planning and wealth-management concepts
* Career progression based on performance and professional development
* Flexible and entrepreneurial working environment
* Opportunities to develop leadership and management capabilities

Nestly Technologies Pte. Ltd. is a Singapore-based technology company focused on developing innovative digital solutions that empower businesses through artificial intelligence (AI), data analytics, and digital transformation.
Our flagship platform,
Peekaa
, is an integrated business management solution combining customer relationship management (CRM), loyalty programmes, marketing, and appointment scheduling. We aim to help businesses streamline operations, improve customer engagement, and make smarter, data-driven decisions.
Our goal is to build smarter technology, empower businesses, and shape the future of intelligent business solutions.
The Opportunity
We are looking for ambitious, entrepreneurial, and self-driven individuals to join us as
Business Growth & AI Solutions Consultants
.
This is more than a traditional sales role. You will work closely with business owners to understand their challenges, identify opportunities for improvement, and introduce digital solutions that help them operate more efficiently and grow sustainably.
You will take ownership of the
entire client journey, from business acquisition and onboarding to ongoing relationship management, customer success, and retention
.
As you grow your portfolio of clients, you will have the opportunity to build a sustainable recurring income stream through commissions from customers who continue subscribing to our services.
With flexible working hours, attractive commission opportunities, and strong career growth potential, this role is ideal for individuals who want to take ownership of their success while building a meaningful career in the technology industry.
Key Responsibilities
1. Business Development & Client Acquisition
Proactively identify and engage business owners to introduce Peekaa's digital solutions.
Build a pipeline of prospective business clients through networking, referrals, outreach, and other business development activities.
Conduct product demonstrations and consultations to understand business needs.
Present tailored solutions, handle client enquiries, and convert prospective clients into paying subscribers.

Identify inefficiencies and recommend practical solutions to improve productivity, customer retention, and operational performance.
Help business owners understand how digital tools, data analytics, and emerging AI capabilities can support business decisions.
Position yourself as a trusted business partner by providing practical, value-driven recommendations.

Manage the complete onboarding process to ensure new clients successfully adopt Peekaa.
Guide business owners and their teams in understanding and using the platform effectively.
Maintain ongoing relationships with clients through regular follow-ups, consultations, and support.
Monitor client satisfaction, address concerns, and work towards long-term retention and subscription renewals.
Identify opportunities to help existing clients maximise the value of the platform.
4. Portfolio Growth & Customer Success
Develop and manage your own portfolio of business clients.
Build long-term customer relationships that support continued subscriptions and recurring commission opportunities.
Gather customer feedback and collaborate with internal teams to improve our products and services.
Work towards individual acquisition, retention, and business growth objectives.

Entrepreneurial, self-motivated individuals who enjoy meeting people and building relationships.
Strong communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.
Passionate about business development, technology, and helping businesses grow.
Comfortable engaging business owners, understanding their challenges, and recommending solutions.

Attractive Commission & Recurring Income Opportunities

Opportunities to earn recurring commissions from eligible customers who continue their paid subscriptions.
Build your own client portfolio and develop long-term earning potential through acquisition and retention.
Performance-driven earning opportunities that reward individual contributions and results.

Enjoy flexible working hours and greater autonomy over your daily schedule.
Plan your own client appointments, business development activities, and follow-ups.
Take ownership of your performance while maintaining flexibility in how you manage your work.
Strong Career Growth Opportunities
Be part of a growing technology company with opportunities for professional development.
Gain valuable experience in business consulting, sales, AI, data analytics, and digital solutions.
Opportunities to progress into senior consulting, business development management, and leadership roles as the company expands.
Grow alongside the business and play a meaningful role in its development.
Be Part of the Future of Technology
Gain exposure to emerging AI technologies and data-driven business solutions.
Work directly with business owners across different industries.
Make a real difference by helping businesses improve efficiency, strengthen customer loyalty, and achieve sustainable growth.
Build Your Career With Us
At Nestly Technologies, we believe your growth should reflect your ambition, effort, and contributions.
If you are driven by success, enjoy building meaningful business relationships, and want to be part of a growing technology company, we would love to hear from you.
Build your client portfolio. Grow your recurring income. Shape the future of business technology with us.

The team is responsible for identifying and developing inorganic growth opportunities, unlocking new routes to market, and fostering a diverse partner ecosystem that amplifies our reach while making it easier for customers to buy and deploy Chainalysis.
The Channel Partnerships Manager, APAC will own the day-to-day management of channel partners across the region, with a focus on activating, enabling, and growing a defined set of channel partners. This role is focused on regional execution and will be responsible for helping partners and internal field teams work together more effectively to drive pipeline, revenue, and market coverage in APAC.
In This Role, You’ll
- Build strong working relationships with key partners in-region, including resellers, distributors, MSPs, and SI partners, and serve as the primary point of contact for partner engagement within the geo.
- Drive partner enablement so partners can effectively position Chainalysis, qualify opportunities, navigate sales plays, and work within our channel processes and requirements.
- Develop and execute joint plans with priority partners in APAC to increase partner-sourced pipeline, improve partner engagement, and expand partner contribution to regional growth.
- Work closely with regional sales leaders, AEs, RevOps, Marketing, and Partnerships to align partners to the right accounts, opportunities, and go-to-market motions in-region.
- Identify high-potential regional partners to prioritize, grow existing partner performance, and help recruit new partners where there is clear market opportunity or coverage need.
- Support internal field enablement in APAC so sellers understand when and how to engage partners, the relevant program guidelines, and how to work effectively with indirect routes to market.
- Run a consistent operating cadence with top partners, including business reviews, pipeline check-ins, account mapping, and escalation management where needed.
- Track partner activity and outcomes in partnership with RevOps and sales, including partner-sourced pipeline, training progress, and overall partner performance in the region.
- Coordinate closely with the broader Partnerships team to ensure regional execution is aligned to the overall program while remaining focused on in-market partner activation and revenue growth.
We’re Looking For Candidates Who Have
- Proven experience managing channel, reseller, distributor, MSP, VAR, and SI relationships at a B2B technology company.
- Demonstrated ability to enable partners effectively, including training on value proposition, sales plays, qualification, and how to work opportunities with internal sales teams.
- Experience driving measurable business outcomes through partners, including partner-sourced pipeline
- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working closely with sales, marketing, RevOps, and other internal stakeholders to execute partner plans.
- Strong commercial judgment and execution skills, including the ability to prioritize partners, manage competing opportunities, and navigate ambiguity in a fast-moving environment.
- Experience working in APAC or in a multi-country region with different market dynamics, sales motions, and partner maturity levels.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build credibility internally and externally.
- Knowledge of the crypto and blockchain ecosystem, and the ability to ramp quickly on Chainalysis products, use cases, and customer needs in order to enable partners effectively.
- Background in crypto, financial services, public sector, fintech, cybersecurity, or risk/compliance software.
Nice To Have Experience
- Experience with PRM tools, deal registration processes, account mapping, and partner performance tracking.
- Experience building channels in an environment where direct sales and indirect routes to market must coexist and be carefully governed.
- Comfort working across time zones and in a highly matrixed global organization.
AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.
AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.
About Chainalysis
Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.
You belong here.
At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.
We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

About PwC
Job Description & Summary
We believe that challenges are better solved together. That's why you'll join a diverse, global community of solvers - an unexpected mix of people that come together to build trust in society and solve important problems. With us, you are encouraged to lead with your heart and values, and where your unique skills are developed and put to work in unexpected and exciting ways, superpowered by technology.
Firmwide Corporate Services
Our Firmwide Corporate Services unite to help build our competitive advantage with first class support internally. Spanning Administration, Business Development, Chairman’s Office, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Learning and Development, Legal, Marketing and Communications, Operations and Change Management, and Technology, we power our lines of services to make sure all of us have the right sources, services and technology to be the best we can be.
Not all of us work directly with external clients. Some of our most talented people choose to harness their skills, experience, expertise and service excellence within PwC. The possibilities are endless and our business landscape is changing everyday.
Responsibilities
- This role sits within the client events and digital experience specialist team which is part of the wider marketing and communications function. As part of this specialist team, you will be expected to plan, organise, and execute events (physical, hybrid, and virtual), including conferences, webinars, seminars, and trade shows, involving government and industry leaders.
- You will be expected to build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders, both internal and external, ensuring event objectives align with business goals.
- Demonstrate excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with team members and stakeholders, ensuring clarity and alignment throughout all project phases.
- Efficiently manage time to prioritise tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced work environment.
- Manage event budgets and negotiate contracts with vendors whilst ensuring high-quality experiences, under the supervision of the Events lead.
- Coordinate event setup, including venue selection, catering, and AV support for events and webinars.
- Plan, develop and manage and execute event-led marketing and client engagement campaigns and marcom activities with the objectives of encouraging event registration/sign ups, post-event publicity/visibility, and to support the key stakeholders’ relationship building.
- The role includes developing integrated client engagement and events marketing communications materials (such as social media posts, videos and photo-taking) for distribution across multiple channels, audience segments and stakeholder groups, from conceptualisation/angling to audience planning, messaging, content development and post-event communications materials across the event lifecycle
- Use CRM, marketing automation and event technology platforms to manage campaign delivery, track performance and support reporting
- Monitor campaign, attendance and client feedback data to evaluate performance, support post-event follow-up and identify opportunities for improvement
- Perform any other duties as assigned
Requirements
Core experience
- Degree in business administration, marketing or communications
- Minimum of 5 years of experience in B2B marketing, with strong exposure to event-planning and event-led marketing, client engagement campaigns and stakeholder management, preferably within professional services
- Experience using CRM, marketing automation and event technology platforms such as Cvent and GlobalMeet, Microsoft Teams, Salesforce or Marketing Cloud to deliver events and track performance
- Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to craft clear, compelling and audience-relevant marketing and client engagement communications.
Skills And Capabilities
- Strong project and event management capability, with the ability to plan, coordinate and manage multiple workstreams across event planning, execution, reporting and campaign delivery
- Strong marketing and campaign delivery experience, with the ability to support the development and execution of effective campaigns and client engagement activities aligned to business priorities and audience needs
- A keen interest in business, market and client issues and the ability to translate insight into relevant marketing activity
- Effective communications capability across multiple channels (such as website, social media and newsletters) and audience segments, with the ability to tailor messaging, tone and format to different stakeholder groups and objectives
- Sound analytical skills, with the ability to use campaign, digital and client feedback data to evaluate performance and identify opportunities for improvement
- Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, collaborate and build trusted relationships across teams
- Flexible approach to handle fluctuating work volumes and the ability to work under pressure.
- Creative, collaborative and outcome-driven, with strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach
- Comfortable using AI-enabled and digital tools to improve marketing productivity and workflow efficiency
- Able to work independently and also as a team player.
