Title: Client Manager
Description:
Description
01 Meet the studio.
MSQ Asia & Elmwood Singapore is our hybrid hub for Southeast Asia, where brand distinctiveness meets joined-up activation for greater impact.
MSQ is the world's most AI-enabled challenger group, with AI-powered human creativity at the heart of everything we do. We fuse the right mix of capabilities to unlock momentum for brands, connecting creative performance to business outcomes in real time. We have global specialists across creative, social and influencer, media and commerce, strategy & insights, CX & creative, tech, sports & entertainment, and AI products & data. This is MSQ's Joined-Up Thinking: the scale of a holding company with the agility of an independent.
Elmwood is our global brand and design capability, with almost 50 years of experience as one of the world's most effective brand and design agencies. With studios in London, New York, Singapore and Shanghai, we create brands that are more meaningful, more memorable and built to move faster than the market. Our work covers brand strategy and identity, packaging and experience design for clients across global personal care, food and beverage, financial services and technology. Elmwood is proud of its long track record at the DBA Design Effectiveness Awards, the longest-running awards for design that delivers measurable business results.
Requirements
02 Why this role matters.
The Account Manager is responsible for managing day-to-day client relationships and projects, translating client needs into clear briefs, and ensuring work is delivered on time, on budget and to an excellent standard, directly impacting client satisfaction, retention and account growth.
03 What you will be doing.
People & Team accountabilities:
Collaborate closely with Account Executives, aiding in their development while also managing smaller-scale projects or specific workstreams independently.
Encourage collaboration, knowledge sharing and feedback within project teams to build capability and improve how we work together.
Implement studio and network-wide strategies within your account teams, ensuring ways of working align with the one Elmwood vision and goals.
Manage team dynamics on your projects, holding people (including yourself) accountable for agreed actions, quality standards and timelines.
Work/offer accountabilities:
Oversee the daily delivery of client projects, making sure tasks are completed on time, meet requirements, and stay within budget.
Lead internal briefings, manage timelines, and coordinate estimates and contact reports, ensuring clarity for internal teams.
Work in partnership with cross-functional teams such as creative, strategy and production to monitor progress and manage deliverables throughout the project lifecycle.
Collaborate with creative and operations teams, as well as external partners, to ensure all work aligns with strategy and achieves the desired creative outcomes.
Track and evaluate project effectiveness with senior team members, helping to define success metrics and feeding learnings back into future work.
Advocate for internal systems, processes, and financial tools, ensuring we stick to budgets and timelines and support accurate reporting.
Document project insights and outcomes through post-project reviews (“washups”) to drive continuous improvement.
Client accountabilities:
Foster trust with client contacts through clear, professional communication, consistent follow-up, and well-managed expectations.
Act as a dependable point of contact for daily updates and issues on your accounts, with support from your senior team members where needed.
Assist in preparing for meetings, presentations and proposal writing, helping to shape compelling, on-brand responses.
Keep detailed records of client feedback, approvals and change requests to ensure alignment and avoid scope creep.
Manage key client relationships and day-to-day interactions, demonstrating a measurable impact on their business and identifying opportunities to grow and deepen the relationship.
Business accountabilities
Engage in weekly planning, resource and forecasting meetings to maintain transparency, accountability and visibility of pipeline and capacity.
Manage and meet specific business targets for your accounts in line with the studio business plan and Strategic Account Plans.
Build and manage the client revenue pipeline for your accounts, ensuring accurate forecasting, visibility and strong recoverability.
Support value-based pricing and project costing, using financial tools and data to manage scope, protect margins and escalate risks early.
Contribute to award entries, case studies and marketing initiatives that build Elmwood’s fame and reputation in the region.
04 What you know and bring.
The knowledge you'll need:
3–5 years of experience in a design, branding, or marketing agency in client servicing and/or project management roles.
Relevant experience in advertising agencies is a plus.
A background in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a similar field is preferred.
Solid understanding of brand and design processes, from briefing and strategy through to creative development and production.
Good commercial acumen, including familiarity with scopes of work, pricing models, budgets, forecasting and profitability drivers.
Proficient in project management, collaboration and file-sharing tools such as ClickUp, Pitch, LucidLink or similar. platforms.
AI fluency: confident using AI tools day to day to work smarter across briefing, planning, reporting and client communication. You're curious about how AI is changing agency workflows and keen to bring new ideas to the team.
The skills that'll set you apart
Proven ability to manage multiple projects and cross-functional teams simultaneously, balancing priorities and deadlines.
Keen attention to detail and accuracy across timings, budgets, documentation and deliverables.
Outstanding organisational and time management abilities, with a proactive, solutions-focused mindset.
Professional writing tone, style, and email etiquette, with the ability to communicate clearly and persuasively with clients and colleagues.
Strong eagerness to listen, learn, and grow in a dynamic, occasionally unstructured environment, bringing a genuine passion for creativity, innovation, and delivering exceptional work.
High sense of responsibility and commitment to the role, taking ownership of outcomes for your clients, projects and team.
Benefits
05 What we offer.
The work
The opportunity to work with leading global and regional brands across categories, shaping strategies and design that get seen and felt in the real world.
The people & culture
A fun studio environment working alongside great and talented individuals, with a collaborative, down-to-earth culture where craft, curiosity and generosity are valued.
Annual festivities and various social events throughout the year that bring the team together.
Growth & development
Access to learning, feedback and stretch opportunities across studios and disciplines, with support to shape a career that works for you.

Title: Client Manager
Description:
01 Meet the studio.
MSQ Asia & Elmwood Singapore is our hybrid hub for Southeast Asia, where brand distinctiveness meets joined-up activation for greater impact.
MSQ is the world's most AI-enabled challenger group, with AI-powered human creativity at the heart of everything we do. We fuse the right mix of capabilities to unlock momentum for brands, connecting creative performance to business outcomes in real time. We have global specialists across creative, social and influencer, media and commerce, strategy & insights, CX & creative, tech, sports & entertainment, and AI products & data. This is MSQ's Joined-Up Thinking: the scale of a holding company with the agility of an independent.
Elmwood is our global brand and design capability, with almost 50 years of experience as one of the world's most effective brand and design agencies. With studios in London, New York, Singapore and Shanghai, we create brands that are more meaningful, more memorable and built to move faster than the market. Our work covers brand strategy and identity, packaging and experience design for clients across global personal care, food and beverage, financial services and technology. Elmwood is proud of its long track record at the DBA Design Effectiveness Awards, the longest-running awards for design that delivers measurable business results.
Requirements
02 Why this role matters.
The Account Manager is responsible for managing day-to-day client relationships and projects, translating client needs into clear briefs, and ensuring work is delivered on time, on budget and to an excellent standard, directly impacting client satisfaction, retention and account growth.
03 What you will be doing.
People & Team accountabilities:
Collaborate closely with Account Executives, aiding in their development while also managing smaller-scale projects or specific workstreams independently.
Encourage collaboration, knowledge sharing and feedback within project teams to build capability and improve how we work together.
Implement studio and network-wide strategies within your account teams, ensuring ways of working align with the one Elmwood vision and goals.
Manage team dynamics on your projects, holding people (including yourself) accountable for agreed actions, quality standards and timelines.
Work/offer accountabilities:
Oversee the daily delivery of client projects, making sure tasks are completed on time, meet requirements, and stay within budget.
Lead internal briefings, manage timelines, and coordinate estimates and contact reports, ensuring clarity for internal teams.
Work in partnership with cross-functional teams such as creative, strategy and production to monitor progress and manage deliverables throughout the project lifecycle.
Collaborate with creative and operations teams, as well as external partners, to ensure all work aligns with strategy and achieves the desired creative outcomes.
Track and evaluate project effectiveness with senior team members, helping to define success metrics and feeding learnings back into future work.
Advocate for internal systems, processes, and financial tools, ensuring we stick to budgets and timelines and support accurate reporting.
Document project insights and outcomes through post-project reviews (“washups”) to drive continuous improvement.
Client accountabilities:
Foster trust with client contacts through clear, professional communication, consistent follow-up, and well-managed expectations.
Act as a dependable point of contact for daily updates and issues on your accounts, with support from your senior team members where needed.
Assist in preparing for meetings, presentations and proposal writing, helping to shape compelling, on-brand responses.
Keep detailed records of client feedback, approvals and change requests to ensure alignment and avoid scope creep.
Manage key client relationships and day-to-day interactions, demonstrating a measurable impact on their business and identifying opportunities to grow and deepen the relationship.
Business accountabilities
Engage in weekly planning, resource and forecasting meetings to maintain transparency, accountability and visibility of pipeline and capacity.
Manage and meet specific business targets for your accounts in line with the studio business plan and Strategic Account Plans.
Build and manage the client revenue pipeline for your accounts, ensuring accurate forecasting, visibility and strong recoverability.
Support value-based pricing and project costing, using financial tools and data to manage scope, protect margins and escalate risks early.
Contribute to award entries, case studies and marketing initiatives that build Elmwood’s fame and reputation in the region.
04 What you know and bring.
The knowledge you'll need:
3–5 years of experience in a design, branding, or marketing agency in client servicing and/or project management roles.
Relevant experience in advertising agencies is a plus.
A background in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a similar field is preferred.
Solid understanding of brand and design processes, from briefing and strategy through to creative development and production.
Good commercial acumen, including familiarity with scopes of work, pricing models, budgets, forecasting and profitability drivers.
Proficient in project management, collaboration and file-sharing tools such as ClickUp, Pitch, LucidLink or similar. platforms.
AI fluency: confident using AI tools day to day to work smarter across briefing, planning, reporting and client communication. You're curious about how AI is changing agency workflows and keen to bring new ideas to the team.
The skills that'll set you apart
Proven ability to manage multiple projects and cross-functional teams simultaneously, balancing priorities and deadlines.
Keen attention to detail and accuracy across timings, budgets, documentation and deliverables.
Outstanding organisational and time management abilities, with a proactive, solutions-focused mindset.
Professional writing tone, style, and email etiquette, with the ability to communicate clearly and persuasively with clients and colleagues.
Strong eagerness to listen, learn, and grow in a dynamic, occasionally unstructured environment, bringing a genuine passion for creativity, innovation, and delivering exceptional work.
High sense of responsibility and commitment to the role, taking ownership of outcomes for your clients, projects and team.
Benefits
05 What we offer.
The work
The opportunity to work with leading global and regional brands across categories, shaping strategies and design that get seen and felt in the real world.
The people & culture
A fun studio environment working alongside great and talented individuals, with a collaborative, down-to-earth culture where craft, curiosity and generosity are valued.
Annual festivities and various social events throughout the year that bring the team together.
Growth & development
Access to learning, feedback and stretch opportunities across studios and disciplines, with support to shape a career that works for you.

Company: BANQUE PICTET & CIE SA SINGAPORE BRANCH
Title: Client Relationship Officer
Description:
Your team
The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 4600 people. Pictet has been present in Singapore for more than 30 years where it employs over 200 people.
Pictet Asset Services provides custody, fund services and trading solutions for external asset managers, fund managers and institutional clients. We manage every aspect of the asset servicing value chain and our range of bespoke solutions include value-adding analytics, trading strategy support and digital front-end interfaces designed to provide an unrivalled customer experience.
Your role
This role support and develop Pictet Asset Services B2B client relationships in Asia by combining front-facing relationship management with strong operational and servicing capabilities, acting as a shadow Client Relationship Manager (CRM) while ensuring best-in-class day-to-day support. For the candidate with the appropriate credential and ambition, this position offers a potential pathway to a full CRM role in the future.
Key Responsibilities:
Client Relationship Officer
Lead with complex account opening/closing, static data changes and onboarding of new services, ensuring completeness and accuracy of documentation.
Provide daily operational support including but not limited to: processing and monitoring of payments, cash movements, securities orders, fund subscriptions/redemptions, and asset transfers.
Handle client queries and incidents, ensuring timely resolution, proper escalation and clear communication to clients and internal teams.
Verify the accuracy of transactions and data input in core banking and PAS tools; maintain up-to-date client files and internal records.
Contribute to client satisfaction and retention through proactive, solution-oriented servicing and regular contact (calls, emails, meetings).
Assist in coordinating internal stakeholders (Operations, Legal, Compliance, Credit, Trading, other PAS locations) to deliver a seamless client experience. Promote collaboration and alignment of processes between Singapore and other PAS hubs (Geneva/Luxembourg).
Contribute to keeping operating memoranda, procedures and checklists accurate and up to date as processes evolve.
Commercial Support / Relationship Management (Shadow CRM)
Support senior MH/ CRMs in managing and developing relationships with existing Institutional clients including preparation for meetings and follow-ups. Help build a comprehensive understanding of clients’ business models, objectives, challenges and decision-making processes.
Support commercial initiatives (pricing analyses, fee schedules, KPIs, simple profitability views) and preparation of pitch or review materials for existing and prospective clients.
Identify and flag opportunities for cross-sell / up-sell and process improvements to the CRM and Market Head.
Your profile
Education & Experience
University degree or equivalent in Finance, Economics, Business or related field.
5–7 years’ experience in a Client Relationship Officer / Client Service / middle-office role in asset servicing, custody, or private banking; strong exposure to B2B clients (Asset Managers, Institutional clients, EAMs/GIs).
Good understanding of banking and asset-servicing products, operational flows and securities / funds processing; knowledge of Avaloq or similar core banking system is an advantage.
CMFAS / CACS certifications are an advantage.
Technical & Professional Skills
Solid knowledge of asset-servicing operations: payments, cash sweeping, settlements, corporate actions, account opening and documentation.
Strong client-facing skills with the ability to explain operational topics clearly and manage sensitive situations diplomatically.
Good business mindset: able to understand revenue drivers, pricing considerations and commercial priorities.
High proficiency with MS Office; comfortable working with internal banking systems and reporting tools.
Excellent command of English; additional Asian language(s) a plus for regional client coverage.
Personal Competencies
Enthusiastic, proactive and eager to learn, with a genuine interest in progressing towards a CRM role while still embracing hands-on CRO tasks.
Strong team player able to work closely with colleagues across locations, while also operating independently when required.
Well-organised, meticulous and able to manage multiple priorities under time pressure, with strong attention to detail and risk awareness.
Service-oriented, solutions-driven and resilient, with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Diversity & Inclusion
Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

Company: STATE STREET FUND SERVICES (SINGAPORE) PTE. LIMITED
Title: Client Service - Hedge/FOF, Officer
Description:
Who we are looking for
This is a senior level management role within the
Hedge Funds Services Business Unit
of the State Street Alternative Investment Solutions Group. The
position interacts with all levels of professionals both internally and externally and with senior level executives of State Street.
Therefore, exceptional interpersonal and communication skills are required. Candidates must demonstrate strong initiative, be able to perform well under pressure and be capable of managing multiple and diverse assignments. Theposition is responsible for managing departments experiencing significant growth. (PE FA background are also welcomed).
What you will be responsible for
Provide overall direction to team of staff to assure synchronized teamwork that accomplishes yearly and quarterly financial and operations goals and objectives.
Responsible for development and execution of overall business plans both internally and in partnership with clients.
Manage relationships with clients at appropriate levels to ensure continued confidence in State Street.
Manage relationships with key client contacts ensuring expectations are met and client satisfaction with the level of service received.
Ensure process and procedures are adequate to meet quality standards and are consistently applied and regularly reviewed within department.
Responsible for the direction and training of subordinate managers and staff. Address employee concerns and sensitivities.
Review and approve NAV files in accordance with established policies and procedures.
Provide support for and effectively communicate broad overall company initiatives and goals to staff within span of control.
Responsible for developing department budget and staffing projections. Completes staffing proposals for newly awarded business.
Monitors and approves department expenses.
Assess operational effectiveness and make suggestions to streamline functions.
Develop ideas for new products and services to expand business opportunities and better meet client needs.
Participates in new business process including review of proposals, prospect presentations, staffing allocations, etc.
Represent the organization internally and externally as a senior level executive of State Street.
Meet all requirements for the performance planning process including goal setting, regular and immediate feedback and submission of formalized performance appraisals.
Allocates and coordinates resources including staff allocation, space and procurement of necessary equipment.
Spearhead special projects and serve on committees and task force assignments.
Provide leadership in areas outside of the division
Education & Preferred Qualifications
Candidate must have a university degree (business, mathematics, finance or economics preferred, accounting concentration a plus) and
at least 7 years of accounting experience

Title: Commercial Analyst
Description:
The Commercial Analyst transforms commercial, distributor, retail, inventory, market and promotional data into actionable business insights that drive sustainable growth and improve commercial decision-making across Asia Pacific.
The role provides Management, Sales and Trade Marketing teams with a fact-based understanding of business performance by answering four critical questions:
What happened? Why did it happen? What is the commercial impact? What should we do next?
A key focus of the role is evaluating performance across multiple APAC distributor markets by connecting sell-in shipments, distributor IMS (sell-out), inventory levels, stock cover, distribution, retail performance and commercial activities to identify opportunities and risks. The Commercial Analyst proactively challenges assumptions and forecasts, identifies root causes behind business performance, and recommends actions that improve commercial execution and business outcomes.
Working closely with Sales and Trade Marketing teams, the Commercial Analyst drives fact-based decision-making through commercial analysis, forecasting support and strategic business insights. While reporting, dashboards and analytics tools are important enablers, the primary purpose of the role is to generate actionable recommendations that support business growth.
This position reports to the Chief Commercial Officer, Emerging Markets - Haribo Asia Pacific
Key Responsibilities
1. Sales Performance & Business Analysis
- Analyze sales performance by customer, channel, market, SKU, category and period.
- Track actual performance against Budget, Forecast and Latest Business Estimate (LBE).
- Identify drivers of growth, decline and market share changes.
- Conduct SKU-level analysis covering volume, value, velocity, mix and contribution to growth.
- Evaluate customer, channel and category performance trends.
- Perform deep-dive analyses on significant commercial opportunities and business risks.
- Monitor performance against key commercial KPIs and strategic priorities.
2. APAC Distributor, Sell-In, Sell-Out & Inventory Analytics
- Analyze performance across multiple APAC distributor markets using shipment, IMS, inventory and retail data.
- Reconcile company sell-in performance against distributor sell-out (IMS) and retailer consumption trends.
- Monitor distributor inventory levels, stock cover, stock aging and inventory health across markets.
- Identify abnormal stock build-up, pipeline loading, forward-buying and destocking activities.
- Distinguish genuine consumer demand trends from inventory-related fluctuations.
- Assess distributor inventory holdings against shipment trends and forecast assumptions.
- Proactively challenge distributor forecasts based on IMS run rates, inventory positions, stock cover, distribution trends and historical performance.
- Highlight markets at risk of overstocking, understocking or supply disruptions.
- Identify opportunities to improve inventory health, stock productivity and forecast accuracy.
- Support commercial discussions with distributor partners through fact-based insights and recommendations.
3. Forecasting & Commercial Planning
- Review and challenge Forecast, LBE and Budget assumptions using commercial and market data.
- Assess forecast realism by evaluating:
- IMS (sell-out) performance
- Distributor inventory and stock cover
- Distribution trends
- Velocity and rate of sale
- Planned commercial activities
- Historical performance and seasonality
- Monitor forecast accuracy and identify recurring forecasting gaps.
- Proactively identify risks and opportunities that may impact achievement of Budget and Forecast commitments.
- Support monthly forecasting, S&OP and business review processes through analytical insights.
- Develop forward-looking scenario analyses and business projections.
- Provide early warning indicators and recommend corrective actions where required.
4. Distribution & Route-to-Market Analytics
- Monitor numeric and weighted distribution across customers, channels and SKUs.
- Identify distribution gaps and quantify incremental revenue opportunities.
- Analyze relationships between distribution, sales velocity and overall performance.
- Assess customer and outlet universe opportunities to support expansion plans.
- Support route-to-market effectiveness evaluations and sales force prioritization.
5. Retail & Shopper Analytics
- Analyze retailer scan/POS data to identify category, segment and brand performance trends.
- Generate actionable insights from NielsenIQ, Kantar, Circana and retailer-provided data sources.
- Identify category growth opportunities and customer-specific assortment recommendations.
- Analyze shopper, category and retailer performance drivers.
- Support customer category reviews and Joint Business Planning (JBP) discussions with fact-based recommendations.
- Assess customer assortments and identify opportunities for expansion, optimization or rationalization.
- Benchmark customer performance against category growth and market trends.
- Translate retail and shopper insights into practical commercial actions.
6. Promotion & Trade Investment Analytics
- Analyze promotional uplift, incremental volume and value generated by trade activities.
- Measure the effectiveness of promotions, displays, secondary placements, checkout executions and price reductions.
- Conduct pre-, during- and post-promotion analysis to assess commercial impact.
- Analyze promotional cannibalization, pantry-loading effects and post-promotion retention where data permits.
- Evaluate promotional mechanics by customer, retailer and channel.
- Compare ROI across promotional activities and trade investments.
- Identify optimal discount depth, promotional frequency and activation strategies.
- Support annual trade spend allocation through historical effectiveness and ROI analysis.
- Recommend which trade activities should be scaled, optimized or discontinued.
- Partner with Trade Marketing and Sales teams to improve planning, execution and post-event evaluation.
7. Marketing & Campaign Effectiveness
- Assess the impact of marketing campaigns, product launches and brand initiatives on sales performance.
- Evaluate campaign impact on sell-out, market share, distribution and category performance.
- Connect marketing investments with commercial outcomes.
- Provide post-campaign evaluations and recommendations to improve effectiveness.
8. SKU, Assortment & Portfolio Analytics
- Evaluate SKU productivity using sales, distribution, velocity and profitability metrics.
- Identify high-performing and underperforming SKUs.
- Assess assortment effectiveness by customer and channel.
- Identify cannibalization risks and incremental contributions of new SKUs.
- Support fact-based assortment, rationalization and portfolio prioritization decisions.
- Recommend customer-specific assortment improvements.
9. Market, Category & Competitive Intelligence
- Analyze syndicated and retailer data sources such as NielsenIQ, Kantar and Circana.
- Monitor category performance, market share and competitive developments.
- Track competitor pricing, promotions, assortment and distribution activities.
- Identify emerging consumer, category and customer trends.
- Integrate external market intelligence with internal data to explain performance and identify opportunities.
10. Dashboards, Data Quality & Commercial Reporting
- Develop and maintain automated Power BI and Excel dashboards that support commercial decision-making.
- Create an integrated view of performance across customers, channels, categories and markets.
- Improve reporting efficiency through automation and process enhancements.
- Ensure data integrity, consistency and governance across reporting sources.
- Support development of standardized commercial KPI reporting.
- Enable self-service reporting capabilities for commercial stakeholders.
11. Commercial Insights, Strategic Analysis & Business Partnering
- Convert complex datasets into concise, actionable recommendations.
- Clearly articulate: What happened? Why it happened? Business impact Recommended actions
- Identify root causes behind performance changes rather than simply reporting outcomes.
- Challenge assumptions, forecasts and commercial plans using fact-based analysis.
- Proactively identify growth opportunities, distribution gaps, customer opportunities and business risks before they become business issues.
- Support Sales and Trade Marketing teams with actionable recommendations that improve business performance.
- Prepare management presentations, business reviews and strategic analyses.
- Act as a trusted commercial business partner to the Chief Commercial Officer and leadership team.
Key Competencies and Qualifications
- Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, Finance, Business Analytics, Data Analytics or related discipline.
Experience
- 3-5 years of experience in Commercial Analytics, Sales Analytics, Trade Marketing Analytics, Category Management Analytics, Business Insights or Commercial Excellence.
- FMCG or Consumer Goods experience is strongly preferred.
- Experience working with distributors, modern trade customers and retailer POS data.
- Experience supporting category reviews, Joint Business Planning and customer decision-making is highly desirable.
- Exposure to regional or multi-market business environments is advantageous.
Commercial & Analytical Capabilities
- Strong FMCG commercial understanding with the ability to connect shipments, IMS, inventory, distribution, retail performance and promotional activities into a coherent business story.
- Demonstrated ability to explain not only what happened, but also why it happened and what actions should be taken next.
- Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capability.
- Commercially curious and comfortable challenging assumptions with data.
- Ability to identify root causes, risks and opportunities across complex datasets.
- Strong business partnering, stakeholder management and influencing skills.
- Excellent communication and presentation capabilities.
- Ability to simplify complex analysis into practical business recommendations.
- Proactive, collaborative and capable of working effectively across functions and markets.

Title: Commercial Executive - Strategic Repertoire
Description:
At Warner Music Group, We’re a Global Collective Of Music Makers And Music Lovers, Tech Innovators And Inspired Entrepreneurs, Game-changing Creatives And Passionate Team Members. Here, We Turn Dreams Into Stardom And Audiences Into Fans. We Are Guided By Three Core Values That Underpin Everything We Do Across All Our Diverse Businesses
- Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future.
- Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.
- Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.
WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.
Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
Job Title: Commercial Executive - Strategic Repertoire
A Little Bit About Our Team
At Warner Music Group, our Commercial team works at the dynamic intersection of music, data, and fan culture to maximise the reach and impact of our world class catalogue. As part of the Streaming and Strategic Repertoire team focusing on South East Asia, we bring timeless tracks to new generations of listeners while unlocking commercial opportunities for legendary music. In this role, you will work directly alongside our Regional Senior Manager, Streaming and Strategic Repertoire (SEA), collaborating with internal marketing, creative, ecommerce, and playlist teams to drive real audience growth across the region.
Your Role
As the Commercial Executive - Strategic Repertoire, you will play a key role in executing catalogue campaigns and audience engagement strategies across South East Asia. This role balances hands on creative execution, from digital campaign management to creative asset coordination, with essential daily project workflows and administration. One hour you will be analysing campaign metrics and tracking budgets, and the next you will be collaborating on DSP playlist initiatives with our Topsify team or supporting creator marketing initiatives. It is an energetic, detail driven role where your work directly shapes how fans discover and rediscover WMG catalogue.
Here You’ll Get To
- You will partner with the Regional Senior Manager to develop and execute catalogue marketing strategies that boost consumption across South East Asia.
- You will lead mid-weight projects end-to-end, taking charge of campaign delivery, asset sourcing, workflow compliance, and stakeholder updates.
- You will create, launch, and track digital marketing campaigns for catalogue artists, compilation themes, and regional growth projects.
- You will track and analyse campaign performance against KPIs while keeping project budgets and cost administration organised.
- You will collaborate on creative asset development, ensuring seamless usage, manipulation, and distribution across external channels.
- You will build strong working relationships with internal departments, artist managers, repertoire owners, and external business partners.
- You will coordinate with our Owned & Operated Topsify team to drive high-impact DSP playlist campaigns.
- You will support catalogue digitisation and partner with the E-Commerce team to promote exclusive physical and D2C products.
About You
- You have minimum 3+ years of marketing experience within a record label, music company, or entertainment environment ideally within SEA.
- You have a proven track record assisting with digital marketing campaigns across paid media, social, content, and promotional activations.
- You are passionate about music across diverse genres and eras, bringing active user knowledge of current streaming platforms and social media trends.
- You enjoy a data-informed approach to work, bringing strong analytical skills and creative problem-solving to every campaign.
- You are highly organised and detail orientated, with strong project coordination skills and a continuous learning mindset.
- You possess strong relationship management skills and business-level English communication skills, thriving as a collaborative team player.
We’d Love It If You Also Had
- Experience working on regional campaigns across South East Asian music markets.
- Hands-on familiarity with basic image editing tools and asset management platforms.
- Prior exposure to playlist marketing, creator marketing or direct-to-consumer (D2C) e-commerce strategy.
As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.
Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Title: Commercial Operations Analyst (Americas)
Description:
General Description
Commercially-minded Commercial Operations Analyst to support business development, shipping operations and commercial decision-making from our Singapore office.
The role combines shipping market analysis, operational and fixture-related data, client intelligence and business analytics to identify opportunities, monitor performance and support client-facing teams across Asia and the Americas. The position is collaborative and client-facing, requiring strong interpersonal skills, sound judgement and the ability to engage effectively across cultures and seniority levels.
Given the Americas focus, the role requires regular overlap with Americas business hours, flexibility outside standard Singapore office hours, and periodic travel. Fluency in English and Spanish is required, with Spanish supporting commercial engagement across Latin America and the wider Americas.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Key Responsibilities
Commercial & Shipping Analytics
Analyse vessel, fleet and market data to identify commercial opportunities and trends.
Monitor shipowners, managers, operators, charterers, newbuildings, S&P activity and fleet movements.
Analyze client portfolios, flag composition, registration opportunities, pipelines and fleet performance.
Support client acquisition, fleet expansion and retention through market-share and competitor analysis.
Develop forecasts, KPIs and management reporting.
Analyze regulatory, inspection and Port State Control data where commercially relevant.
Operations, Fixtures &Post-Fixture
Support analysis of vessel employment, fixtures and operational performance.
Track voyages, vessel activity, cargo movements and client fleets.
Assist with post-fixture analysis, including performance, costs, documentation and commercial follow-up.
Monitor vessel and trade activity across Asia, North America, the US Gulf, Caribbean and Latin America.
Prepare vessel, fleet and client briefs for commercial discussions.
Data Analytics &Business Intelligence
Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, Excel models and commercial reporting tools.
Clean, combine and validate data from internal systems and external maritime databases.
Automate recurring reports and analytical processes where practical.
Use Salesforce or similar CRM platforms for pipeline analysis, segmentation and commercial prioritization.
Present analytical findings clearly to management and commercial stakeholders.
Market Intelligence &Client Support
Monitor shipping activity across Asia and the Americas.
Research shipowners, managers, operators, charterers and other industry participants.
Track newbuildings, ownership and management changes and other events that may create commercial opportunities.
Analyze fleet developments and trading patterns across the Americas.
Support engagement with US and Latin American maritime stakeholders.
Prepare client profiles, fleet analyses, presentations and commercial proposals.
Visit client offices, vessels and other operational premises as required to support commercial relationships and gain direct insight into client operations.
Travel periodically within Asia and to the Americas for client meetings and industry events.
General Qualification Guidelines
Bachelor's degree or equivalent.
Approximately 1–3 years of relevant experience in shipping, maritime services, commercial analytics or vessel operations.
Strong proficiency in Excel and Power BI and experience with complex datasets.
Familiarity with Salesforce and maritime data sources such as S&P Global/IHS, Waypoint, Clarksons or AIS platforms is advantageous.
Understanding of shipping operations, vessel terminology and fixture/post-fixture processes.
Knowledge of the Americas shipping market, including fleet developments and key maritime stakeholders, is highly desirable.
Familiarity with US and Latin American maritime regulatory and commercial environments is advantageous.
Experience with forecasting, automation or APIs is beneficial.
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
Strong analytical and commercial judgement.
Ability to translate data into clear, actionable insights.
Strong interpersonal skills and emotional intelligence, with the ability to build rapport and read situations effectively.
Confidence engaging with stakeholders across cultures and seniority levels.
Strong attention to detail, communication and presentation skills.
Ability to work independently and take ownership.
Comfortable working across commercial, operational and technical teams.
Flexibility to maintain regular overlap with business hours in the Americas and travel internationally as required.
The role requires regular working-hour overlap with North and Latin American time zones, including early-morning and/or evening hours in Singapore where required. Periodic travel to the Americas and within Asia, including visits to client premises, vessels and industry events, will form part of the role.

Description:
Global Operations
Commercial Partnership Solutions Project Manager, APAC - Global Monetization Product and Technology
Location :
Singapore
Employment Type :
Regular
Job Code :
A133589
Responsibilities
The TikTok Ads Creative and Ecosystem team develops the technology behind ad creative production, interpretation, and optimization, so advertisers, creators, and partners can deliver experiences users actually want to watch. We work on scaling creative production, understanding diverse content, and optimizing ad performance, while preserving the authentic sense of discovery that makes TikTok distinctive. The quality of those solutions directly influences user engagement, advertiser success, and the growth of the creative ecosystem. You will shape the future of AI-powered advertising creativity, on work with impact at global scale. About the Team The Commercial Partnership Solutions (CPS) Project Management team turns sold partnership packages into high-quality delivery. We work across Sales, Creative, Product, Operations, Creator, Measurement, agencies, and production partners to execute integrated packages that may include TikTok advertising, offline activations, creator collaborations, and out-of-home advertising. As the Project Manager based in Singapore and supporting APAC, you will take ownership after the commercial handoff and remain accountable until every package entitlement has been delivered and the project has been closed. You will translate the signed scope into an executable plan, coordinate all resource owners, manage client communication, resolve delivery risks, and consolidate results for the final report. Responsibilities - Own the end-to-end execution of CPS projects, from post-sale handoff through launch, delivery, and project closeout. - Translate sold CPS packages into structured execution plans, with clear scope, timelines, deliverables, owners, and dependencies. - Drive the delivery of all package components, including TikTok Ads, Offline Activations, Creator Collaborations, and OOH Advertising. - Partner closely with internal teams, agencies, vendors, media owners, and clients to ensure timely, high-quality execution across all workstreams. - Proactively manage project risks, approvals, scope changes, and operational issues to keep delivery on track and within agreed commitments. - Consolidate delivery outcomes, performance inputs, and key learnings into post-campaign reporting, while identifying opportunities to improve future CPS execution across APAC.
Qualifications
Minimum Qualification(s) - Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. - Minimum 3 years of experience in project management, integrated marketing, campaign operations, client services, experiential marketing, media, production, or partnerships. - Experience owning complex, client-facing projects with multiple deliverables, external partners, and overlapping timelines. - Working knowledge of digital advertising and integrated campaign execution, with experience across online and offline channels. - Strong project planning, prioritization, problem-solving, and attention to detail. - Clear written and verbal communication, with confidence leading client, agency, vendor, and senior stakeholder conversations. Ability to work independently in a fast-moving environment, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and stay grounded during high-visibility delivery moments. - Professional fluency in English, required for client communication and regional collaboration. Based in Singapore, with flexibility to support projects across APAC, including regional stakeholder collaboration, occasional travel, onsite activations, and work outside standard office hours when project delivery requires it. Preferred Qualifications - Experience in a digital, creative, media, experiential, or production agency, or in a client-side integrated marketing role. - Hands-on experience with at least two of the following: paid social advertising, creator campaigns, offline events, sponsorships, or OOH advertising. - Familiarity with advertising, media, agency, creator, and production ecosystems across APAC, with strong knowledge of the Singapore market. - Experience managing vendors, statements of work, budgets, delivery evidence, or commercial scope changes. - Comfort working with campaign data and turning results into client-facing insights and recommendations. - Knowledge of TikTok advertising products, platform behavior, creator ecosystems, and content formats.

The Flexi Group operates premium flexible workspace brands—including Common Ground, the Hive, and The Cluster—spanning 11 major cities across the Asia-Pacific region and Australia. We create beautifully crafted, productivity-driven environments designed to help teams excel.
Each brand offers a distinct community and tailored experience, functioning as a vibrant hub where businesses can connect, collaborate, and expand their professional networks.

Title: Construction Program Manager (Digital Delivery & Governance), APJC Construction Program Team - APJC Construction
Description:
DESCRIPTION
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.Our Construction Managers are on the forefront of creating and delivering the most innovative products to our customers; and are known for changing the face of cloud computing.
AWS Data Center APJC Construction Program team is seeking a highly enthusiastic, motivated, and customer-facing Construction Program Manager – Digital Delivery & Governance to govern the quality of all digital deliverables across the lifecycle across our hyperscale data-center construction portfolio. They innovate, develop, manage AI-powered design release quality gate process (scoring packages for document completeness, BIM compliance, clash detection). They setup the AWS BIM requirements, train and oversee GC BIM coordination during construction (federated models, weekly clash resolution, BIM Execution Plan Enforcement). As CPM-Digital Delivery & Governance, you will work with a multi-disciplinary team of BIM specialists with a detailed knowledge design, BIM engineering and construction principals. You are responsible of governing the BIM deliveries in both design and construction stages consistently achieve industry leading standards and AWS requirements on technologies across the portfolio. You will track the document changes, stored and reported and enable the final as-built meeting the customer requirements, assuring as-built model quality at PFHO. This Construction Program Manager will develop and maintain construction-specific BIM standards, governance workflow and adapt EIR for APJC. This role also scale AI-powered construction technology tools (CDMS, Akuma, ScheduleIQ) across the portfolio.
This is an individual contributor role reporting to the APJC Construction Program Lead. You will support Construction Managers delivering data center capacity across the APJC region. This position is based in Singapore, Sydney, Mumbai, or Tokyo and involves regular travel (up to 20% of the time) to project sites and other locations in the region.
This Construction Program Manager will be ultimately responsible for ensuring the Construction team adopts consistent and scalable AI-enabled approaches, processes, and digital delivery standards (ISO 19650) in APJC Construction. You will lead the integration of BIM information management, and construction technology platforms including Procore, BIM 360, and custom AI applications. The Construction Program team will provide centralized support and metrics tracking functions to Construction Managers on preconstruction services, AI-enhanced project controls (time, cost, quality and safety), administration tasks, systems, programs, processes, SOPs, templates and intelligent dashboards. This role will focus on BIM Governance throughout Design and Construction, and develop strategies to drive efficiency and smart BIM related solutions for project control.
Key job responsibilities
Construction Project Control & BIM Management
• Own end-to-end BIM information management for AWS's hyperscale data center program across APJC portfolio, ensuring compliance with ISO 19650 standards and AWS Exchange Information Requirements (EIR)
• Manage BIM professionals across consultant and contractor firms, establishing standardized quality frameworks that reduce design coordination clashes through earlier cross-discipline conflict detection and AI-enhanced clash detection workflows
• Lead comprehensive project controls across all construction phases, gathering data across clusters to support reporting on scope, schedule, budget, resources, quality and risk management, with AI-enhanced metric development and tracking
• Develop and maintain construction project control dashboards that provide leading indicators for time and cost performance, integrating traditional project management metrics with AI-generated predictive analytics
• Implement reality capture and digital twin technologies to improve design accuracy, construction verification, and as-built documentation quality
• Establish and maintain BIM standards, processes, and workflows as well as Educating and training internal teams and GC in BIM software and procedure.
• Lead discussions in engineering/ construction best practices supporting the wider team by sharing knowledge with a view to establishing new standards
Digital Delivery Governance
• Operate the Design Release quality gate (scoring packages for document completeness, BIM compliance, clash detection)
• Train and oversee GC BIM coordination during construction (federated models, weekly clash resolution, BIM Execution Plan enforcement)
• Assure as-built model quality at PFHO
• Develop and maintain construction-specific BIM standards and adapting EIR for APJC
• Scaling AI-powered construction technology tools (CDMS, AKuma, ScheduleIQ) across the portfolio
• Track document changes, storage, and reporting to ensure final as-builts meet customer requirements
• Lead the integration of BIM information management and construction technology platforms including Procore, BIM 360, and custom AI applications
• Architect agentic workflows that automate repetitive construction quality and compliance processes, freeing Construction Managers to focus on high-value strategic work
Success Metrics: Design Release package scores, clash resolution rates, as-built delivery rates (target 86%+), and cost avoidance ($100k+ per project through early interception).
A day in the life
You will use data, AI-generated insights, and anecdotes to tactically drive internal customers to manage project risks (time, cost, quality and safety). You will apply your knowledge and experience in both construction project controls and AI/ML engineering to identify and develop intelligent dashboard reporting and automated decision-support systems that provide visibility to peers and leadership to drive better business outcomes. You need to have the backbone to use the data to tell the business "this is what the data is telling us, and this is how it should be done" that enable our Construction Managers to enforce effective project control with their General Contractors and vendors.
You will architect agentic workflows that automate repetitive construction quality and compliance processes, freeing Construction Managers to focus on high-value strategic work. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams including Data Engineers, Construction Managers, BIM professionals, and AWS AI/ML specialists to continuously improve and scale AI solutions across the APJC portfolio.
You must be an effective communicator, sending clear, concise and consistent messages verbally, in written form, and/or in public speaking forums. You must have diplomacy, patience, and tact to earn trust in relationships to effectively advise, instruct, and challenge internal and external partner teams on AI strategies, construction processes, and digital delivery methodologies.
About the team
You will be integrated with a global network of Construction professionals including Construction Managers, Program Managers, Regional Managers, and Regional Project Engineers in operational teams, as well as the Data Engineers.
Our Data Center Construction Program team owns and drives the process and dashboard reporting from constructability of design, procurement strategies, proposal development, bid analysis, award, to managing the onsite construction work.
About AWS
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our department, Data Center Planning and Delivery (DCPD), sponsors leadership programs that support the growth and development of builders across the organization. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events build stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation draws on the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Title: Content & Growth Marketing Specialist
Description:
About Us:
Hotel101 Global, listed on Nasdaq (HBNB), is a pioneering hospitality brand fueling global growth with its compelling “condotel” investment model. We integrate tech-driven operations with our HappyRoom standard to deliver consistent, comfortable, great value guest experiences worldwide, ensuring exceptional efficiency and scalability.
Our story began with a simple, yet revolutionary idea: a “one room” global hotel brand—a promise of consistency, comfort, and irresistible value, wherever in the world our guests may be. Our vision knows no borders: to build 1 million hotel rooms and be present in 100 countries.
Our unique condotel approach allows investors to own income-generating units within a professionally managed hotel, blending real estate investment with the stability of a global hospitality brand. Infused with Filipino-inspired warmth, Hotel101 Global is redefining the industry, creating exceptional value for investors through sustainable growth, predictable returns, and a presence in key international markets.
Join us to invest in a brand that’s shaping the future of global hospitality. For more information, visit www.hotel101global.com.
Job Summary
Would you rather do a bit of everything than specialise in one channel?
We are looking for a marketer who is comfortable across content and campaigns. Someone who can put a piece of content together, get a campaign live, and then look at how it performed and work out what to do next.
You will be part of the global marketing team, where ideas are planned together and support is provided.
Hotel101 is opening in new markets and every launch needs content, campaigns and collateral. A big part of this role is helping us build something repeatable, so we are not starting from scratch each time.
What We Offer
Variety. Brand, content, campaigns, e-commerce and CRM, rather than one channel for the next three years.
Travel, and the chance to make content in the markets we are opening.
We are always exploring new tools and better ways of working, AI included, and we welcome anyone who enjoys doing the same.
Room to grow as we grow. We are continuing to expand into new countries.
Key Responsibilities
Brand & Campaigns
Help us plan and run campaigns across social, search, e-commerce, media and offline. You will be involved from the first idea through to the results.
Look after our brand. That means keeping our guidelines and asset library in good shape, and helping local teams out when they are putting something together.
Work on our promotions, from festive campaigns to opening offers. You will sort out the details and make sure everything is ready to go on time.
Help bring new hotels to market. When a property opens, you will help pull together the content, the campaign and the collateral it needs.
Ensure that content, campaigns, promotions and partnerships comply with applicable legal, regulatory, platform, brand and internal approval requirements, including required disclosures and disclaimers.
Content & Creative
Take the lead on content at our properties and in market. You will come up with the idea, brief it, and work with photographers and videographers on the day.
Take ownership of asset creation, producing work in-house wherever it makes sense: social posts, EDMs, campaign visuals and decks. We will talk through the direction together before you dive in.
Write and edit our copy, from captions and scripts to EDMs and the occasional landing page.
Look after our social channels and keep a content calendar that works for every market.
Secure and maintain the necessary licences, consents, releases, approvals and usage rights for third-party content, images, footage and other creative assets.
Digital & Performance
Run our paid campaigns on search and social, for both unit sales enquiries and room bookings.
Help us show up better in search, on our own site, and across the booking platforms and listing sites where guests find us.
Keep an eye on conversion, from landing pages and forms through to the booking flow and enquiry follow-up. Growing direct bookings is something we care a lot about.
Keep the website and app up to date, so promotions, links and pages are accurate and live when they should be.
Help with CRM and marketing automation, so buyers and guests hear from us at the right moment.
Look back at how campaigns performed and tell us what you think we should change next time.
Handle buyer and guest data, CRM communications and marketing preferences in accordance with applicable data-protection and direct-marketing requirements.
Events & Partnerships
Help us get ready for exhibitions, roadshows and networking events: collateral, booth materials, presentations and the follow-up afterwards.
Work with our agencies, KOLs and media partners in each market.
Working With the Team
Work closely with the wider marketing team. We share what we are working on, and there is always someone to talk an idea through with.
Team up with local sales, hotel operations and revenue colleagues so campaigns and launches land properly in each market.
Keep everyone in the loop as campaigns and launches progress, so nothing catches anyone by surprise.
Qualifications
All-rounder mindset. You would rather pick something new up than pass it to someone else.
3 to 5 years in marketing, with hands-on experience in content and campaigns.
You can put content together yourself, including editing video and turning raw footage and assets into something we can publish.
Design skills. You will be making real assets, so we are after someone who can do the work, not only brief it.
Comfortable with numbers. You can work out what performance data is telling you and what to do about it.
Some commercial sense. You have worked to a target before and you understand how promotions work.
Experience with SEO, CMS platforms and analytics tools.
Organised, and happy juggling a few campaigns and deadlines at once.
Open to travel, including longer trips when we are opening a new market.
Comfortable working with stakeholders across markets and seniority levels.
A degree in marketing, communications, business or a related field.
Good to Have
• Experience keeping a brand consistent across several markets.
• PR experience, or having worked alongside PR agencies.
• UI design experience, or having worked on website or app design.
• Working knowledge of CRM and marketing automation.
• A background in hospitality, travel or the real estate industry.
• Agency experience. Having handled a few brands or accounts at once tends to translate well to a role like this.

Title: Creator & User Excellence Specialist, Customer Support
Description:
Global Operations
Creator & User Excellence Specialist, Customer Support
Location :
Singapore
Employment Type :
Regular
Job Code :
A08497
Responsibilities
TikTok's Customer Support team's vision is to deliver industry-leading support for our users and creators to inspire creativity and bring joy. We are looking for an experienced results-oriented individual to join the team that is at the forefront of this mission. As a Creator & User Excellence Specialist within the Customer Support team, you will be part of a team that drives cross-functional service governance and continuous improvement for user and creator support. You will consolidate voice-of-customer insights from Customer Support and XFN stakeholders, translate them into prioritized problem statements, and partner with Product, Program Management, Operations, Policy, Communications, and other teams to drive structured triage, alignment, and action. This shared intelligence enables faster issue detection, better resource prioritization, and more effective decision-making across teams. You will also be responsible for leading root-cause analyses (RCAs), shaping prioritization frameworks, and driving end-to-end remediation from problem definition through implementation. This includes strengthening operational health, supporting incident response and post-incident follow-through, and improving Customer Support north star metrics through structured program management. You will establish tools, governance mechanisms, and scalable processes to manage top-priority issues, while identifying opportunities to streamline workflows and increase intelligent automation across support operations. You are passionate about elevating the user and creator support experience and enjoy turning complex operational pain points into scalable solutions. You combine analytical rigor with strong execution, and you are comfortable moving between investigations, stakeholder alignment, program delivery, and process design. Your background is grounded in problem solving, program or project management, operational excellence, and cross-functional collaboration, with a strong appreciation for customer support and user safety. Responsibilities - Feedback Loop Operations and Optimization: - Support feedback loop operations, ensuring smooth day-to-day operational functionality including the intake, triage and prioritisation flows, leveraging analytical skills to enrich feedback and quantify priorities based on business impact - Support ongoing iteration of the feedback loop—identify bottlenecks and pain points, and recommend improvements to boost efficiency and impact - Collaborate with XFN partners (Product, Policy, Security, T&S) to design new workflows that close discovered gaps / pain points or increase the comprehensiveness of feedback received - RCA, prioritization and remediation execution: - Root Cause Analysis: Conduct deep dives into recurring or high-severity issues, identify root causes across people, process, policy, and platform dimensions, and define data-driven recommendations to prevent future occurrences. - Prioritization & Impact Assessment: Quantify user, creator, and business impact to prioritize the most important pain points, using data and structured judgment to inform sequencing and resource allocation. - Cross-Functional Solutioning & Service Governance: Facilitate solution design sessions, define mid- and long-term fixes, and influence Executive stakeholders to secure buy-in, clarify ownership, and prioritize implementation across Customer Support and XFNs. - Remediation Program Delivery: Build and execute remediation plans in partnership with relevant XFNs (content, process/policy, product management, data analytics, operations, other support teams, and engineering) to address recurring escalations and systemic gaps. Plan, pilot, iterate, and drive implementation of approved solutions, including hypercare support, while monitoring key metrics to validate impact and detect unintended consequences. - Operational Health, Incident Readiness & Data-Driven Decision Making: Monitor key metrics, analyze trends, support structured responses to high-impact incidents, and use insights to influence process enhancements and operational strategies. - User-Centric Advocacy, Automation & Scalability: Act as a voice for users and creators, ensuring their concerns are understood and addressed in support services and product improvements, while identifying opportunities to streamline workflows, standardize practices, and scale support through automation.
Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications: - 5+ years of experience in customer support, trust & safety, operations, program management, product operations, or similar functions in online platforms. - Experience in understanding operational workflows across intake, prioritization, resolution, and service readiness. - Track record of solving complex problems using formal RCA methodologies, challenging the status quo, and turning findings into executable remediation plans. - Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and program/project management skills, with the ability to align multiple teams, manage risks, clarify ownership, and drive delivery to completion. - Proven ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment, operate with ambiguity, and maintain a strong bias for execution in fast-moving environments. - Strong analytical mindset with experience in prioritizing ambiguous problem spaces, quantifying business impact, conducting RCA, and translating insights into actionable recommendations. - Passion for improving user and creator experiences on digital platforms, with a customer-centric mindset and strong ownership of outcomes. Preferred Qualifications: - Strong data analysis skills and data-driven mindset. - Exposure to customer support workflows and cross-functional service governance is a strong plus. - Background in Trust & Safety, online platform operations, risk management, service operations, or incident management. - Experience with process automation, workflow tooling, or technology-driven operational improvement is a plus. - Self-starter who can manage multiple priorities autonomously and drive projects from inception through implementation, with an eye for process design, scalability, and automation.

Title: Credit Asset & Liability Management Lead - Treasury - Global Payment - Singapore
Description:
Responsibilities
Team Introduction
The Global Payment Treasury team provides the payment solutions behind ByteDance platforms including TikTok: payment acquiring, disbursements, transaction monitoring, payment method management, foreign exchange conversion, accounting, and reconciliations.
We solve complex treasury and payment challenges across global markets, managing liquidity, FX, reconciliation, and payment operations while balancing regulatory requirements, cost efficiency, and business needs.
You will keep payments smooth, secure, and reliable at scale, for users across ByteDance's platforms.
This role owns the asset and liability management framework for the company’s consumer and merchant lending businesses. It connects business growth, loan cash flows, funding requirements, liquidity, cost of funds, and balance-sheet returns. The role partners closely with the Funding Management team and works across business, finance, credit risk, legal, tax, compliance, product, technology, and data.
Responsibilities:
- Funding Planning & Allocation: Develop daily, weekly, and rolling 12-month funding forecasts; define funding allocation across countries, products, and channels; run liquidity stress tests; and translate funding requirements into financing constraints.
- Liquidity Management: Build cash-flow forecasting and monitoring mechanisms to support loan disbursement, collections, and debt service; optimise idle cash; reduce all-in cost of funds; and establish market-specific Liquidity Contingency Plans.
- Asset-Liability Risk Management: Build an ALM framework covering duration matching, maturity mismatch, and refinancing risk; manage interest-rate and cross-border FX exposures; establish funding diversification and concentration limits; and monitor the impact of asset quality on liability structure.
- Asset Routing & Yield Management: Build dynamic asset routing strategies across instruments, channels, and asset pools based on yield, risk, and funding cost; develop asset segmentation and funding-channel models to improve capital efficiency; and establish asset-pool performance and cost-of-funds analytics.
- Systems & Data: Develop liquidity policies and process controls; drive system capabilities for asset tagging, channel rules, and routing strategies; and establish management reporting and risk alerts to ensure key ALM metrics are traceable, explainable, and reviewable.
This role will be based onsite at our office and will require a 5-day onsite work arrangement.
Qualifications
Minimum Qualification(s):
- 5+ years of experience in treasury, ALM, liquidity management, or a related field, preferably with experience in consumer finance or credit-asset treasury.
- Deep understanding of consumer lending models, the loan asset lifecycle, and asset-quality metrics.
- Ability to independently build loan cash-flow, funding requirement, liquidity forecasting, and stress-testing models.
- Strong understanding of how vintage, delinquency, loss, and prepayment affect cash flows, liquidity, and financing structures.
- Strong balance-sheet and financial-statement analysis skills, with the ability to connect business growth, funding needs, cost of funds, liquidity, and ROE.
- Experience managing interest-rate risk, FX risk, maturity mismatch, refinancing risk, and counterparty concentration.
- Strong cross-functional leadership, senior stakeholder management, team management, and proficient in both written and spoken English.
Preferred Qualification(s):
- Experience in Southeast Asian and Latin American financial markets is preferred, together with knowledge of local regulatory and capital-control constraints.

Title: Credit Funding Lead - Treasury - Global Payment - Singapore
Description:
Responsibilities
Team Introduction
The Global Payment Treasury team provides the payment solutions behind ByteDance platforms including TikTok: payment acquiring, disbursements, transaction monitoring, payment method management, foreign exchange conversion, accounting, and reconciliations.
We solve complex treasury and payment challenges across global markets, managing liquidity, FX, reconciliation, and payment operations while balancing regulatory requirements, cost efficiency, and business needs.
You will keep payments smooth, secure, and reliable at scale, for users across ByteDance's platforms.
This role owns internal and external financing for the company’s consumer and merchant lending businesses, covering financing planning, funding-partner origination, structuring, negotiation, documentation, closing, and post-closing management. The role partners with the Asset & Liability Management team to define financing size, tenor, currency, and cost parameters and works across business, finance, credit risk, legal, tax, compliance, product, technology, data, and institutional business development.
Responsibilities:
- Funding Strategy & Planning: Own the medium- to long-term funding strategy and execution roadmap; develop short-, medium-, and long-term financing plans; design the financing mix across countries, products, and providers to diversify sources and control concentration; establish financing reserves and refinancing plans based on capacity, market conditions, and stress tests.
- Funding Channels & Institutional Relationships: Originate and maintain relationships with banks, funds, and institutional investors; partner with business development teams on asset issuances and pitches; lead funding-partner onboarding, commercial negotiation, and solution design across size, cost, tenor, and covenant requirements.
- Structured Finance & Transaction Execution: Independently lead financing transactions end-to-end from origination and structuring through due diligence, negotiation, documentation, and closing; collaborate with finance, tax, legal, compliance, and credit risk teams; convert financing structures into repeatable, scalable models; and assess the impact of asset quality and prepayment on financing terms and credit enhancement.
- Asset Pool & Post-Closing Management: Establish asset eligibility, pool onboarding, ongoing management, amortization, and performance analysis mechanisms; manage drawdowns, repayments, data reporting, and covenant monitoring; track facility utilization and refinancing risks; and partner with the ALM team to match assets to funding channels.
- Funding Operations & Systems: Build funding operating policies and process controls across the transaction lifecycle; drive systems to centrally manage facilities, drawdowns, repayments, covenants, asset pools, and institutional relationships; and establish analytics for cost of funds, channel performance, and execution efficiency to improve funding strategy.
This role will be based onsite at our office and will require a 5-day onsite work arrangement.
Qualifications
Minimum Qualification(s):
- 5+ years of experience in funding, structured finance, treasury, or a related field, preferably with experience in credit-asset or consumer-finance funding.
- Hands-on experience independently leading structured financing transactions, with clear ownership across origination, structuring, negotiation, documentation, and closing.

Job Summary
We are seeking a proactive, agile and data-driven CRM and Growth Assistant Manager / Manager to join our marketing team. Balancing luxury brand flair with commercial growth principles, you will play a central role in driving customer activation, lifecycle engagement and retention across omnichannel touchpoints.

Job Responsibilities
CRM and Lifecycle Marketing
- Plan, build and deploy targeted eDM, SMS and offline clienteling/direct mail communications with meticulous accuracy, high deliverability and strong brand alignment.

- Partner with retail and merchandising teams to equip them with customer insights and outreach lists for a seamless online-to-offline experience.
