Digital Growth and Conversion
- Build and optimize high-converting landing pages, lead-capture forms and sign-up mechanisms across omnichannel touchpoints.
- Design, implement and analyze continuous A/B and multivariate experiments across email messaging, landing page layouts, CTAs and onboarding flows to increase conversion rates and revenue per recipient.
- Explore and pilot emerging owned and paid channels suited to our customer base.
- Align CRM journeys with social, affiliate and paid media campaigns for consistent full-funnel messaging.

Stakeholder Collaboration
- Work closely with internal stakeholders including loyalty, merchandising and e-commerce teams to translate promotional calendars and events into automated lead-capture and growth workflows.
- Monitor luxury retail market trends, MarTech developments and competitor retention strategies to identify emerging automation and growth opportunities.

Description:
Informa is a leading academic publishing, business intelligence, knowledge and events business, creating unique content and connectivity for customers all over the world. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is a member of the FTSE 100.
Taylor & Francis is one of the world’s largest publishers of high-quality, peer reviewed scholarly journals, books, e-books and reference works. We empower learners, thinkers and doers with trusted knowledge that advances research and enriches lives. We bring together diverse people, ideas and opinions to validate and publish the experts, theories and truths that matter. And we’ve been doing this in an unbroken arc since 1798.
Our purpose is to foster human progress through knowledge. We strongly believe that this requires us to encourage and examine different ideas and voices, so that any work that meets our exacting levels of quality deserves to be included in our publications. This requires open minds, the opportunity for robust debate, and the courage to defend perspectives that stand up to scrutiny, even if they conflict with our personal beliefs or values. Because that’s the only way to find the best obtainable version of the truth and, ultimately, foster human progress. If you agree, then we’d love to hear from you.
Job Description
This role focuses on developing and testing new commercial models for the APAC market, specifically targeting customer segments not currently served by existing commercial models. The position is accountable for systematically developing, testing, and planning the scale-up of propositions that will drive sustainable revenue and profit growth from APAC customers.
Additionally, this role will lead special projects that support editorial excellence and strengthen academic partnerships within the publishing industry, ensuring T&F maintains its position as a trusted partner to the academic community across the APAC region.
Reporting directly to the SVP Asia Pacific, with a dotted line to the VP Academic Partnerships, and based in Singapore, this role will blend strategic, commercial, financial, technology, and marketing insight with direct customer engagement to understand regional needs and drive revenue growth across the Asia Pacific addressable market.
Closing Date: Applications will close on 31st October 2026
Applications are shortlisted on a rolling basis, and we will be interviewing alongside advertising. We therefore encourage you to apply at the earliest opportunity.
What you will be doing:
Market Analysis & Customer Insight
- Systematically review B2B customer groups in the APAC region not currently served well by existing commercial models
- Prioritize customer segments for investigation in conjunction with the SVP Asia Pacific, VP Academic Partnerships and regional leadership teams
- Engage directly with representative samples of prioritized groups to understand their perception of value, impact, willingness to pay, and view of T&F's products and services
- Combine customer insight with APAC market research to provide comprehensive views of regional opportunities
Proposition Development
- Work with regional Commercial, Marketing, Editorial and Central Finance teams, as well as the Technology team where relevant, to design specific propositions for APAC customers
- Ensure propositions meet customer needs in a profitable and scalable way for the region
- Develop business cases that demonstrate potential for sustainable revenue streams in our Asia Pacific market
Implementation & Testing
- Deploy propositions to pilot groups within APAC, then to wider beta testing groups, and subsequently to all customers in the segment
- Work with regional Commercial and Marketing teams, and with outsourced resources like telesales/telemarketing teams or commercial partnerships
- Manage and deliver agreed outcomes and regional targets
APAC Special Projects
- Support the development of regional content strategies that align with academic priorities and emerging research trends in APAC
- Facilitate knowledge exchange programs, workshops, and events that position T&F as a thought leader and trusted partner in the academic community
- Identify opportunities for collaborative publishing initiatives, open access models, and innovative content formats that serve the evolving needs of APAC researchers and institutions
- Work with editorial teams to pilot new workflows, technologies, or processes that improve efficiency and author/editor experience
Stakeholder Management
- Ensure the SVP Asia Pacific, VP Academic Partnerships and relevant leadership teams remain informed and aligned with prioritization and outcomes
- Enable successful revenue streams to transition to teams that will permanently be responsible for the revenue as they scale up
- Collaborate across APAC regions and functions to drive proposition success
- Build and maintain strong relationships with key academic stakeholders, including university leadership, research administrators, and scholarly society representatives
Qualifications
What we're looking for:
- Knowledge of customer and market segments that a publishing company can provide value to, with specific understanding of APAC market dynamics
- Background in sales, marketing, strategy, or proposition development
- Strong communication skills, both influencing and listening, with ability to work directly with customers
- Solid commercial awareness, particularly around revenue and profit dynamics
- Strong project management and planning skills
- Willingness to innovate, work across APAC regions and functions, and take calculated risks
- Experience working in the APAC academic publishing or education sector
- Understanding of regional cultural and business nuances across APAC markets
- Experience with commercial partnerships and outsourced sales models in Asia
- Knowledge of editorial processes, peer review systems, and academic publishing workflows
- Established network within the APAC academic and research community

Title: Digital Marketing Executive (Paid Ads & Social Media) – Hybrid/Flexi
Description:
Job Description
About Handshake
Handshake is a Singapore-based escrow payment platform built for the renovation industry. We hold homeowners' renovation payments securely and release funds only when each stage of work is approved, so homeowners are protected from incomplete work and payment disputes, and interior designers get assurance that funds are secured and ready to be paid out.
Renovation disputes and scams are a real and growing problem in Singapore, but most homeowners don't think it will happen to them. Our job is to change that mindset and make escrow protection the standard way smart homeowners renovate. We work with partners including Renonation and leading industry brands, and we're now building out our direct-to-homeowner marketing engine.
The Role
We're looking for a hands-on marketer to run Handshake's paid ads and social media. You'll get Handshake in front of homeowners planning a renovation, build trust in a new brand, and turn that awareness into homeowners who ask their interior designer to use Handshake.
This is a hybrid role with flexible hours. We care about results, not face time. You'll work directly with the founders, get real ownership of campaigns and budget, and grow quickly in a lean startup environment.
Key Responsibilities
Run paid ad campaigns across Meta (Facebook and Instagram), Google and TikTok, targeting homeowners at key renovation moments such as BTO key collection, resale purchase and renovation planning
Launch, test and optimise campaigns across the funnel, from awareness to lead generation and conversion
Track ad spend and report on performance (CPL, CAC, conversion rates) with clear recommendations
Create static and short-form video ad creatives, and brief designers or freelancers where needed
Manage Handshake's organic social channels (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn), including the content calendar, posting and community management
Turn our value proposition (payment protection, peace of mind, homeowner control over payments) into clear, trust-building messaging for homeowners

Guide executive/s to manage day to day executions and train them on media and client servicing fundamentals.

Ability to perform effectively under pressure to meet deadlines without sacrificing professional standards

Leader/manager of a project, with end-to-end responsibility for the delivery as well as achievement of objectives and measurable results.

Key Accountabilities
- Own Eastspring's regional product positioning, value proposition and competitive differentiation across asset classes, investment capabilities and strategic growth priorities.
- Develop go-to-market strategies and narratives for product launches, strategic campaigns and investment themes, articulating a compelling "Why Buy, Why Eastspring, Why Now" proposition.
- Act as the strategic link between Investments, Product, Distribution and Marketing, ensuring propositions are client-centric, differentiated and commercially aligned.
- Partner with Distribution, Channel Marketing and Digital Marketing to activate propositions through the most effective channels, driving engagement, sales effectiveness, shelf visibility, asset growth and retention.
- Drive regional product content priorities, ensuring alignment with go-to-market plans, client needs and business objectives.
- Manage the creation, governance and optimisation of compliant product content, with clear measurement of engagement, effectiveness and commercial impact.
- Leverage client, market and competitor insights to refine positioning, identify growth opportunities and strengthen Eastspring's competitive advantage.
- Establish clear success metrics to measure commercial impact, ensuring product marketing is focused on business outcomes rather than content output alone.
Experience / Qualifications
- 10-12+ years' experience in product marketing, investment marketing, proposition development or commercial strategy within asset management or financial services.
- Proven track record in product positioning, go-to-market strategy and commercialisation, delivering measurable business growth and fundraising outcomes.
- Strong understanding of asset classes, investment strategies and market dynamics, with the credibility to engage senior investment professionals.

Title: Director of Field Marketing - Asia Pacific / Middle East (R5943)
Description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn , X , Instagram , and YouTube .
Shield AI is expanding rapidly across global defense markets, working with governments, militaries, defense organizations, and strategic partners to deliver next-generation autonomous capabilities. As we scale internationally, we are building a world-class go-to-market organization capable of engaging customers and partners across some of the most strategically important defense markets in the world.
The Director of Field Marketing, Asia Pacific / Middle East will lead and scale Shield AI’s largest regional field marketing organization, spanning the Middle East, India, and Asia Pacific. Based in Singapore and reporting to the VP, Global Field Marketing Units, this leader will develop the strategy, team, programs, and operating discipline required to support Shield AI’s growth across a diverse and rapidly evolving set of aerospace and defense markets.
This role will partner closely with Sales, Business Development, Capture, Growth, Product Marketing, and executive leadership to translate regional business priorities into high-impact field marketing programs that strengthen strategic relationships, accelerate opportunities, support capture efforts, and generate measurable pipeline impact.
The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of international defense and aerospace markets and is comfortable navigating complex government, military, acquisition, and industry stakeholder environments. This is a player-coach role for a strategic leader who can build and lead a high-performing regional team while remaining hands-on in the development and execution of critical programs.
The role requires significant international travel, approximately 25-50% of the time, across the Middle East, India, and Asia Pacific.
What You'll Do
- Lead and scale Field Marketing across the Middle East, India, and Asia Pacific, establishing a unified regional strategy aligned with Shield AI’s global Go-to-Market priorities.
- Lead the company’s largest regional field marketing team, developing organizational structure, talent, processes, and operating rhythms that enable the team to scale effectively across multiple markets.
- Build and institutionalize field marketing as a disciplined, revenue-aligned function within a fast-growing aerospace and defense organization.
- Develop and execute account-based marketing strategies for priority government, military, defense, aerospace, and strategic industry accounts, mapping stakeholders and orchestrating multi-touch engagement across events, executive briefings, targeted campaigns, and other high-value experiences.
- Develop a deep understanding of the defense and aerospace ecosystems across the Middle East, India, Japan, Korea, Australia, Southeast Asia, and other priority APAC markets, including key military, government, acquisition, industry, and technology stakeholders.
- Partner with Sales, Business Development, and Capture teams to identify strategic accounts and opportunities and develop marketing programs that support relationship development, pipeline creation, opportunity progression, and capture objectives.
- Own strategy and execution for major aerospace and defense events across the region, prioritizing strategic account engagement, executive meetings, customer relationships, and opportunity acceleration over brand presence alone.
- Create and execute high-impact ABM programs, executive engagements, customer experiences, roundtables, and regional campaigns designed to generate new pipeline and accelerate existing opportunities.
- Develop regional marketing strategies that account for differences in defense procurement processes, government structures, military organizations, acquisition timelines, budgets, and business cultures across individual markets.
- Build strong relationships with regional Sales, Business Development, Capture, and Growth leaders to ensure field marketing investments are directly connected to business priorities and revenue opportunities.
- Establish KPIs that reflect international defense sales realities, including strategic account penetration, stakeholder engagement depth, executive engagement, opportunity creation, pipeline contribution, and deal acceleration.
- Lead regional agencies, vendors, event partners, and other external resources, ensuring high-quality execution and disciplined management of marketing investments.
- Bring creativity, structure, cultural awareness, and adaptability to a rapidly evolving environment where new markets, capabilities, and customer opportunities are developing in real time.
- Represent Shield AI and Field Marketing with senior internal and external stakeholders, demonstrating the credibility, judgment, and executive presence required to operate in complex aerospace and defense environments.
Required Qualifications:
- 10 to 15+ years of experience in field marketing, demand generation, integrated marketing, or related marketing leadership roles.
- Demonstrated experience marketing into international government, military, aerospace, defense, or other highly complex B2G environments.
- Strong understanding of aerospace and defense markets across the Middle East and/or Asia Pacific, with the ability to operate effectively across multiple countries and cultures.
- Experience working with defense ministries, military services, government agencies, acquisition organizations, defense primes, or other strategic aerospace and defense stakeholders.
- Proven experience building and executing account-based marketing strategies within complex, multi-stakeholder organizations.
- Demonstrated ability to develop marketing strategies that support long-cycle sales, government procurement, defense acquisition, capture, and strategic account development.
- Experience leading and scaling regional teams across multiple countries or geographies.
- Strong executive presence and credibility engaging senior military, government, defense industry, and business leaders.
- Experience operating as a hands-on builder and operator in a high-growth or rapidly evolving organization.
- Strong cross-functional partnership skills with Sales, Business Development, Capture, Growth, Product Marketing, and executive leadership.
- Ability to travel internationally 25-50% of the time.

Title: Director of Marketing
Description:
About the role
As the Director of Marketing, APAC, you'll drive full funnel marketing initiatives, brand awareness and commercial impact.
In this role, you’ll own the marketing strategy and execution across our growing Asia-Pacific portfolio — spanning existing markets and new launches across the region.
You will work closely with global leaders, senior APAC leadership, regional General Managers and Sales. You will lead a small, on-the-ground APAC marketing team and serve as the senior marketing authority for the region. This role demands a rare combination: a performance-oriented digital marketer who can drive measurable revenue impact and a hands-on brand leader who thrives in the operational complexity of launching and growing physical, experiential locations.
You are the critical connective tissue between APAC market realities and global marketing strategy — translating local intelligence into decisions that move the needle on leads, occupancy, and brand awareness.
You will report directly to the Vice President of Marketing (US-based) and dotted-line reporting to the Managing Director, APAC.
What you’ll do
Digital Performance & Revenue Marketing

- Bring deep fluency in digital performance metrics: you know what good looks like, ask the right questions, and hold the team accountable to APAC-specific outcomes.
- Build and maintain tight feedback loops between marketing, sales, and unit operations to ensure demand generation directly supports occupancy goals and revenue targets.
- Report regularly to the Central Corporate Marketing and senior regional stakeholders on marketing performance, pipeline contribution, and ROI.
Overall Marketing Strategy (incl Content, Partnerships, Events)

- Develop strategic partnerships (e.g. Chambers of Commerce, industry associations, brokers, local businesses) to grow visibility
- Lead activations and events to drive brand awareness, engagement, and qualified demand
- Support Sales leadership on broker marketing and enterprise outreach using global content adapted for local relevance
Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership
- Develop and manage a lean APAC marketing team, acting as both a strategic coach and a hands-on contributor when needed.
- Build deeply collaborative relationships with regional Sales Leads, General Managers, and Unit Operations teams — functioning as an integrated partner, not a siloed function.
- Guide local teams in developing high-value strategic partnerships (Chambers of Commerce, industry associations, broker networks, local businesses) that drive visibility and qualified prospect traffic.
- Partner with regional Sales leadership to support broker marketing and enterprise outreach, leveraging globally produced content with local customization.
Brand, PR & Agency Oversight
- Manage local agencies and freelancers (PR, creative, translation, events) as needed to fill capacity gaps and ensure excellence in execution.
- Coordinate with the US Corporate Brand team on high-visibility PR announcements, creative asset requests, and brand campaigns, ensuring global quality standards are maintained across all APAC markets.
- Serve as a senior brand ambassador for Industrious in the region — capable of representing the company's vision clearly and compellingly to media, partners, and prospects.
Go-to-Market Leadership for Regional Launches
- Own and evolve the GTM marketing playbook for new market and location launches across APAC, adapting global frameworks for local relevance across varied markets and languages.
Who you are
Requirements
- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field; advanced degree a plus
- 8+ years of progressive marketing experience, with at least 3 years in a senior or leadership role
- Background in experiential real estate (flexible office, hospitality, gyms, or related industries) preferred
- Digital performance marketing expertise (paid search, paid social, SEO, lead generation) with demonstrated impact on revenue and pipeline
- Experience across APAC markets
- Proven experience leading regional marketing teams within a global organization
- Experience partnering with sales teams to drive demand, pipeline, and measurable business outcomes
- Experience managing GTM launches for physical locations
- Proven ability to hire, coach, and scale regional, distributed marketing teams
- Willingness to travel 2–3 times per quarter within APAC and periodically to the US

- Strong strategic thinking with a hands-on, execution-focused mindset
- Ability to balance global standards with local market nuances
- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills (especially with sales, ops, and creative teams)
- High level of operational rigor and ability to manage complex, multi-market initiatives

- Effective leadership in multicultural, distributed team environments

Title: Director of Sales & Marketing / EAM - Sales & Marketing
Description:
Summary
COME, EXPRESS YOUR ANDAZ
Join Andaz Singapore, the first Andaz hotel in Southeast Asia.
Occupying Levels 25 to 39 of the DUO Tower, Andaz Singapore is a lifestyle hotel brand by Hyatt Hotels Corporation that inspires fresh perspectives. The first Andaz property in Southeast Asia offers well-appointed guestrooms and suites, four event venues, and five dining and drinking concepts. Situated at the crossroads of the Kampong Glam, Little India and Bras Basah Bugis cultural districts—with their intimate shophouse-filled alleyways and atmospheric colours, textures and flavours— Andaz Singapore aims to spark discovery of the rich culture of Singapore and inspire guests to experience the city from new angles.
Global in scale while local in perspective, the Andaz brand empowers self-expression and stimulates guests’ curiosity through imaginative travel for a distinctively local experience. Through thoughtful, unscripted service tailored for travelers, Andaz hotels enable guests to go beyond the familiar to discover and define their personal essence while immersing themselves in the spirit of the eclectic culture around them.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
At Andaz Singapore, we believe in creating inspiring experiences through genuine connections, thoughtful leadership and a culture where colleagues can be their best selves.
We are seeking an experienced and commercially driven Director of Sales & Marketing / Executive Assistant Manager-Sales & Marketing to join our Leadership Committee. Reporting to the General Manager, this role provides strategic leadership across Sales, Events, Weddings, Revenue Management coordination, Marketing Communications and Digital Marketing. The position translates the hotel’s strategy, brand direction and financial priorities into integrated commercial plans that drive revenue, market share, customer preference and long-term brand value.
This is an exciting opportunity for an accomplished commercial leader who combines strong business acumen with a passion for developing people, building meaningful customer relationships and delivering measurable results.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
· Develop and execute an integrated Sales & Marketing business plan covering key market segments, accounts, channels, events, weddings and communications.
· Lead commercial strategies that drive room, event and wedding revenue, market share, demand generation and conversion.
· Set the hotel’s sales deployment, key-account development, prospecting, customer engagement and market coverage priorities.

· Lead the commercial performance of Events and Weddings, including pipeline conversion, space utilisation, client engagement, revenue delivery and cross-functional handovers.
· Oversee integrated marketing, public relations, digital, advertising, partnership and content initiatives, ensuring measurable returns and consistency with Andaz brand standards.
· Maintain accurate commercial forecasts, pipeline information, competitive intelligence, campaign analysis and executive performance reporting.
· Manage the department’s budget, productivity, promotional investment, contracts, purchasing and financial controls.
· Recruit, coach and develop a high-performing and inclusive commercial team, while strengthening succession planning and leadership capability.
· Ensure that commercial activities, contracts, records, data controls and departmental procedures comply with Hyatt policies and applicable requirements.

· Substantial senior leadership experience in luxury hospitality Sales & Marketing.
· Broad commercial exposure across sales, events, revenue collaboration, marketing communications and digital channels.
· A demonstrated ability to develop complex commercial plans, interpret market and financial performance, and deliver measurable business outcomes.
· Strong understanding of lifestyle positioning, customer expectations, brand standards and long-term brand equity.
· Executive presence, sound judgement, discretion and the ability to contribute constructively to hotel-wide decisions.
· Strong communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to engage senior leaders, owners, corporate partners, customers and colleagues.
· A bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Hospitality, Communications or a related discipline, or equivalent executive experience. You will use financial, digital, CRM, business intelligence and revenue data to identify opportunities, manage risks and improve performance.

You will build strong customer and industry relationships, communicate with clarity, and create an environment where colleagues are empowered to experiment, improve and grow.

Title: Director, AI Consulting
Description:
Position Overview
The
Director of AI Consulting
will lead and build the organization’s end-to-end AI consulting function, with overall responsibility for AI consulting strategy, client engagement, solution development, delivery excellence, and team leadership.
This role serves as the bridge between
business strategy, AI technology, data, and implementation
. The Director will work closely with senior business stakeholders to identify high-value AI opportunities, translate business challenges into actionable AI strategies and solutions, and lead multidisciplinary teams from initial discovery and use-case definition through solution design, implementation, adoption, and value realization.
The successful candidate will combine strong
management consulting capabilities, AI expertise, commercial acumen, and organizational leadership
, with the ability to engage executive stakeholders while also providing direction to technical and delivery teams.
Key Responsibilities
1. AI Consulting Strategy & Practice Leadership
Define and lead the overall strategy, operating model, methodologies, and service portfolio for the AI Consulting function.
Build an end-to-end AI consulting capability covering
AI strategy, opportunity assessment, use-case prioritization, solution design, implementation, adoption, and value realization
.
Establish standardized consulting frameworks, methodologies, playbooks, governance models, and reusable assets.
Develop the AI consulting roadmap in alignment with broader business and digital transformation priorities.
Continuously assess developments across Generative AI, AI agents, machine learning, automation, data platforms, and emerging AI technologies to identify new business opportunities.
Establish clear KPIs for the AI Consulting organization and drive continuous improvement in quality, productivity, client satisfaction, and business impact.
2. Executive & Client Advisory
Serve as a trusted AI advisor to senior executives and business leaders.
Lead executive-level discussions to understand strategic priorities, operational challenges, and transformation objectives.
Advise stakeholders on AI strategy, AI operating models, investment priorities, capability development, and transformation roadmaps.
Translate complex AI technologies into clear business implications, opportunities, risks, and investment decisions.
Facilitate executive workshops, AI strategy sessions, ideation workshops, and use-case prioritization exercises.
3. AI Opportunity Identification & Use-Case Development
Lead structured assessments to identify business processes and functions where AI can create measurable value.
Develop and maintain enterprise or business-unit AI use-case portfolios.
Evaluate opportunities based on strategic value, feasibility, data readiness, implementation complexity, risk, and expected ROI.
Build business cases and value hypotheses for AI initiatives.
Define prioritized AI transformation roadmaps covering short-term opportunities and longer-term strategic capabilities.
4. Solution Strategy & Design
Translate business requirements into AI solution concepts and implementation strategies.
Partner with AI engineers, data scientists, architects, product teams, IT, and business SMEs to develop practical and scalable solutions.
Guide solution decisions across areas such as:
Generative AI and Large Language Models
AI agents and agentic workflows
Machine learning and predictive analytics
Intelligent automation
Knowledge management and enterprise search
AI-enabled business process transformation
Data and AI platforms
Ensure proposed solutions balance business value, technical feasibility, scalability, security, compliance, user experience, and cost.
5. End-to-End AI Program Delivery
Provide leadership and governance across the full AI consulting lifecycle:
Discover → Assess → Prioritize → Design → Prototype → Implement → Deploy → Adopt → Scale → Measure Value
Oversee multiple AI consulting engagements and transformation programs simultaneously.
Establish appropriate program governance, milestones, quality standards, risk management, and executive reporting.
Resolve strategic, organizational, and delivery challenges that could impact program outcomes.
Ensure AI initiatives move beyond proof-of-concept and deliver sustainable business impact at scale.
Establish mechanisms for measuring realized business value, adoption, productivity improvement, revenue impact, cost reduction, or other agreed outcomes.
6. AI Governance & Responsible AI
Incorporate Responsible AI principles throughout consulting methodologies and solution development.
Partner with Legal, Privacy, Security, Compliance, IT, and other relevant stakeholders to establish appropriate AI governance.
Ensure AI solutions appropriately address data privacy, security, model risk, intellectual property, regulatory requirements, explainability, and human oversight.
Help business stakeholders understand and manage the risks associated with enterprise AI adoption.
7. AI Adoption & Business Transformation
Drive organizational adoption of AI solutions, not simply technical implementation.
Work with business leaders to redesign workflows and operating models around new AI capabilities.
Develop change-management, communication, training, and capability-building strategies.
Identify barriers to adoption and establish plans to increase utilization and realized value.
Promote an AI-enabled culture and improve AI literacy across the organization.
8. Team & Capability Building
Build, lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing AI Consulting organization.
Define team structure, roles, competencies, career paths, and resource requirements.
Recruit and develop talent across AI strategy, business consulting, solution consulting, program management, and related disciplines.
Develop consulting capabilities in structured problem solving, executive communication, business case development, AI solution design, and transformation delivery.
Foster strong collaboration between consulting, engineering, data science, product, IT, and business teams.
Create a culture of client focus, innovation, accountability, continuous learning, and measurable impact.
9. Commercial & Partnership Management
Support development of AI consulting propositions, statements of work, engagement models, resource plans, and commercial proposals where applicable.
Develop strategic relationships with technology providers, AI platforms, implementation partners, and external consulting organizations.
Evaluate build-versus-buy-versus-partner decisions for AI initiatives.
Manage external partners to ensure quality, knowledge transfer, delivery performance, and commercial effectiveness.

Description:

Role Summary
The Solutions Lead – APAC sits within the Value Capture & Integration Office, as part of Strategic Commercial Initiatives, and is responsible for driving Market Intelligence's (MI) commercial growth agenda across the APAC region.
This role adapts and executes integration-led growth initiatives — converting product, data, and platform integration into measurable commercial value for APAC markets — partnering with regional Sales, Account Management, Product, Technology, and the Enterprise Data Organization. The Solutions Lead – APAC builds the technical and commercial case for integration-led growth within the region, from opportunity identification through deal execution and value tracking, and serves as a trusted advisor to regional revenue teams and customer stakeholders on strategic, complex opportunities.
Primary Focus
Execute the Value Capture & Integration Office's commercial growth agenda across APAC, identifying where integration of products, data, and platforms creates monetizable value in regional markets.
Architect end-to-end solutions that translate integration and synergy opportunities into GTM-ready offerings for APAC clients, partnering with regional Sales and Account Management to embed them into deal strategy.
Track the business case and value-capture outcomes for strategic commercial initiatives in the region, reporting impact on deal velocity, deal size, win rate, and retention.
Drive the shift from siloed, feature-led selling to integrated, solution-led selling across the APAC revenue organization.
Act as the regional feedback loop between APAC revenue teams and global product/engineering and technology teams, surfacing local integration readiness and requirements.
Enable the APAC revenue organization to engage confidently on integrated solution narratives in client discussions.
Apply solution architecture best practices within the region, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, and differentiated — adapted to local regulatory and market context.
Value Capture & Commercial Growth Strategies
The Solutions Lead – APAC partners with regional Sales and Account teams on strategic opportunities, renewals, expansions, and complex deals — building the deal strategy that enables stakeholders to confidently buy and deploy.
Unlock stalled regional pipeline by resolving integration, security, deployment, and operating -model concerns early in the cycle.
Support executive-level customer engagements across APAC markets to demonstrate the value of integrated MI capabilities and position S&P Global as a strategic partner.
Identify recurring value-capture opportunities within the region and feed successful local integrations back into the Office's global library of reusable solution modules.
Customer & Commercial Problem Solving
The Solutions Lead – APAC develops a deep understanding of regional customer business models, workflows, and decision drivers, translating them into solution designs that articulate value while balancing customer needs with commercial viability.
Map current-state and target-state workflows for regional clients to define where integrated data, analytics, and automation capabilities should be embedded for maximum commercial impact.
Translate integration opportunities into clear solution designs that articulate why, how, and the value delivered, adapted to local market and regulatory context.
Resolve technical and commercial objections by aligning integration approach to customer constraints such as governance, risk, and time-to-value across APAC jurisdictions .
Maintain credibility by proactively addressing objections and protecting client trust from pre-sale through adoption.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategy Influence
Collaborate with regional and global Product, Engineering, Technology, and Enterprise Data Organization contacts to refine offerings based on APAC integration insights.
Feed customer feedback, implementation realities, and regional commercial potential into the Office's product and technology roadmap discussions.
Lead cross-functional initiatives within APAC that bridge field execution with the Office's integration agenda.
Mentor regional teams on value-capture and solution architecture best practices.
Engage with APAC stakeholders at key technology partner firms where integration involves third parties.
Commercial Growth Acceleration & Optimization
Maintain a regional library of solution playbooks and reference architectures, and feed successful local patterns back to the global Office.
Guide prototypes and proofs of concept for priority APAC integration pursuits, validating workflow fit, technical feasibility, and measurable outcomes.
Train and support the APAC revenue team on the Office's commercial initiatives and repeatable solutions to scale adoption across the region.
Required Experience & Expertise
10+ years in commercial strategy, pre-sales/solution architecture, GTM, or integration and value-capture roles, with regional or APAC market experience.
Proven track record supporting commercial growth through integration-led value capture and solution-led deal strategy.
Demonstrated success supporting strategic commercial initiatives and engaging senior stakeholders on complex opportunities across APAC markets.
Technical fluency in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), hyperscalers , and modern data integration and orchestration approaches.
Working fluency in AI/automation concepts, including agentic frameworks and orchestration tools, with the ability to translate capabilities into deployable client solutions.
Excellent stakeholder management skills across matrixed organizations and diverse APAC markets.

Title: Director, Asia Procurement
Description:
Barnes Aerospace, is an international manufacturer of precision-machined and fabricated components and assemblies for original equipment manufacturer (OEM) turbine engine, airframe and industrial gas turbine builders throughout the world, and for the military. Barnes Aerospace also provides jet engine component overhaul and repair (MRO) services for many of the world's major turbine engine manufacturers, commercial airlines and the military. Additionally, we manufacture aerospace aftermarket spare parts and provide repair services for aerospace engine components. Barnes Aerospace provides a total solutions package to our customers that leverages the synergies between our OEM and MRO businesses to address complex aerospace customer needs and support products through the entire lifecycle.
Barnes Aerospace Singapore, with legal entity name - Windsor Airmotive Asia Pte Ltd in the Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA), is a leading provider of Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) services and spare parts for many of the world's major turbine engine manufacturers, airline operators, and third-party providers. The Barnes Aerospace Singapore OEM Division is a world-class provider for Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM), specializing in precision stamped assemblies and tight tolerance machining, serving a robust global customer base throughout the aerospace industry. To learn more about Barnes Aerospace, please visit www.barnesaero.com (http://www.onebarnes.com/).
Barnes Aerospace is seeking an expert Director, ASIA Procurement, to join its team and be responsible for the procurement of raw materials, goods, and services for our manufactured goods and services. This includes the planning, scheduling, and monitoring of the movement of materials through the production cycle; utilizing production schedules to maintain inventory at planned levels; ensuring materials standards are met; and managing outside vendors through the processes of qualifying, obtaining quotes, examining bids, and making award decisions for the company. The Director, ASIA Procurement is the procurement and escalation focal point for raw materials, outside service processes, indirect and CAPEX purchasing, supplier selections, rating of supplier performance and maintaining supplier relationships.
Core Responsibilities:
P2R Governance – Design, document, and roll out standard work for requisition, PO placement, supplier acknowledgment, manage ASL (Approved Supplier List), goods/invoice receipt, and GR/IR resolution; align ERPs and related master-data rules including Coupa implementation transition.
Material Availability & Expediting – Lead daily shortage management and tiered escalation; resolve constraints rapidly while transitioning sites from reactive expediting to disciplined planning.
PO Execution Excellence – Drive 100 % PO accuracy, secure supplier confirmations within 48 hours, and achieve best-in-class on-time delivery through disciplined processes, supplier development, and inventory-buffer strategies (kanban, & VMI).
Performance Management & Analytics – Build real-time dashboards for OTD, inventory turns, PPV, GR/IR aging, and P2P cycle time; facilitate weekly site huddles and monthly executive reviews.
Continuous Improvement – Champion Lean/Six-Sigma kaizens to compress P2P cycle time and release working capital; cleanse MRP parameters (min/max, safety stock, MOQ) to align inventory with demand variability.
People & Change Leadership – Lead tactical buyers/expediters through regional managers; coach talent pipelines and cultivate a culture of data-driven decision-making and operational rigor.
Participate in supplier selections and onboarding of new sources for indirect commodity spend and supplier consolidation.
Maintain current knowledge of market conditions that affect overall cost, lead time, and availability of critical commodities.
Continuously improve supplier performance by understanding business requirements and aligning suppliers with business needs.
Participate in supplier quarterly reviews and communicate expectations.
Work closely with Procurement Managers and Commodity Managers to negotiate favorable contracts and long-term agreements.
Must meet or exceed Key Performance Indicators on cost, quality, delivery and cash flow.

Title: Director, Global Materials Portfolio & Supply Strategy
Description:
ABOUT YOUR ROLE:
The Director, Material Portfolio and Supply Strategy is a senior enterprise leadership role responsible for shaping VF’s material portfolio strategy, establishing supply strategy frameworks, and enabling Material Experience Centers in Singapore and key regions. The role connects brand needs, category strategy, supplier capability, sustainability, cost/value opportunities, and material storytelling to create a focused, scalable, and commercially impactful material ecosystem.
The incumbent will establish portfolio governance, preferred material platforms, supply strategy frameworks, and center activation models, while partnering with Material Sourcing leads and cross-functional teams to support execution, unlock enterprise leverage, inspire innovation, and improve material decision-making.
KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
MATERIAL PORTFOLIO STRATEGY, CURATION & VALUE CREATION
• Own the enterprise material portfolio strategy across categories, linking brand needs, product requirements, commercial priorities, sustainability, and supply capabilities.
• Identify cross-brand and cross-category opportunities to increase scale, reduce duplication, improve value, and strengthen strategic supplier partnerships.
• Define portfolio architecture, decision criteria, and governance for preferred, core, strategic, innovative, and emerging materials.
• Lead portfolio reviews to assess relevance, duplication, adoption, performance, and opportunities to scale, refresh, or sunset materials.
SUPPLY STRATEGY FRAMEWORK, SUPPLIER ECOSYSTEM & MATERIAL PLATFORMS
• Establish supply strategy frameworks for strategic material platforms, including supplier segmentation, capability mapping, capacity readiness, cost positioning, regional considerations, and scalability requirements.
• Define the operating model for supply strategy alignment across material categories, brand priorities, sourcing regions, and supplier networks, in partnership with Material Sourcing leads who own execution.
• Enable cross-brand leverage by creating visibility to demand, volume, fragmentation, and supplier opportunities for Material Sourcing leads to execute.
MATERIAL EXPERIENCE CENTER, INNOVATION & MARKET INTELLIGENCE
• Establish and maintain the Singapore Material Experience Center and enable regional centers as spaces for material inspiration, supplier storytelling, innovation, and strategic portfolio engagement.
• Curate material stories, displays, supplier showcases, and experience journeys that spark idea creation and accelerate material exploration across brands.
• Own the multi-year material portfolio roadmap across categories, aligned with brand strategies, product needs, value creation priorities, sustainability goals, and evolving supply-market capabilities.
• Build a structured market intelligence and scouting approach covering material technologies, supplier capabilities, cost drivers, sustainability, regulatory shifts, and consumer expectations.
• Shape strategic supplier engagement for portfolio priorities, preferred platforms, capability development, supply resilience, innovation themes, and enterprise value creation with category sourcing and development leaders.
• Connect supplier capabilities with cross-brand needs to unlock differentiated solutions, faster commercialization, and scalable value.
DIGITAL GOVERNANCE, DATA & ENTERPRISE LEADERSHIP
• Partner with technology and data teams to strengthen the digital material ecosystem and create simple, scalable user experiences.
• Establish dashboards and operating rhythms to track portfolio health, platform adoption, value creation, supply risk, scouting progress, and center engagement.
• Create decision rights, standards, and governance connecting portfolio strategy, supply frameworks, brand needs, regional execution, and supplier partnership processes.
• Lead and develop a high-performing, inclusive team with expertise in material portfolio strategy, supply strategy, category insights, supplier capability, analytics, governance, and operations.
• Build trusted relationships across brands, categories, regions, and functions to align priorities, resolve trade-offs, and deliver enterprise outcomes.
• Influence senior leaders through clear insights, compelling material storytelling, fact-based recommendations, and transparent measures of value.
WHAT WE WILL BE LOOKING FOR IN YOU:
• Deep expertise across material categories, with the ability to connect technical knowledge, portfolio strategy, commercial value, sustainability, and supply considerations.
• Proven experience shaping enterprise material, category, portfolio, innovation, or supplier strategies in a complex global organization.
• Strong commercial and analytical acumen, with demonstrated success converting leverage opportunities into measurable value.
• Demonstrated capability in portfolio governance, supply strategy frameworks, market intelligence, supplier scouting, Material Experience Center activation, and innovation-to-scale processes.
• Ability to translate complex market and technical signals into clear choices, priorities, stories, and actions.
• Experienced people leader and enterprise connector with excellent executive communication, facilitation, and storytelling skills.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
• A clear enterprise material portfolio strategy is established, governed, and adopted across brands, categories, and key functional partners.
• Material choices are more focused, commercially grounded, supply-ready, and aligned to brand, consumer, performance, sustainability, and value needs.
• Cross-brand and cross-category leverage opportunities are visible, governed, adopted, and converted into measurable enterprise value.
• A clear material portfolio roadmap and repeatable market intelligence and scouting engine inform brand strategies, supply strategy frameworks, innovation pipelines, and category plans.
• Material Experience Centers in Singapore and key regions are actively used to inspire ideas, showcase strategic materials, engage partners, and convert exploration into pilots or innovation opportunities.
• Material portfolio duplication is reduced, adoption of strategic platforms increases, and teams make faster, better-informed decisions.
• A connected internal and external material ecosystem expands VF’s access to relevant capabilities and future opportunities.
WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:
• A purpose-driven opportunity to transform how material portfolios are built, governed, sourced, shared, and scaled across iconic global brands.
• A platform to lead cross-brand and cross-category impact in a collaborative, forward-thinking environment.
• A best-in-class work environment, well-being policies, and workplace flexibility designed to help you show up and lean into life with your whole self - emotionally, physically, and socially.

If you are a Director, APAC Marketing professional looking for an opportunity to grow your career, Emerson has an exciting opportunity for you. In this strategic leadership role, you will lead regional marketing strategy, execution, and business performance across Asia-Pacific, excluding China. As a key member of both the Global Marketing Leadership Team and Regional Marketing Leadership Team, you will connect enterprise growth priorities with regional market needs, helping drive customer engagement, demand generation, brand awareness, pipeline growth, and sustainable business results. This position offers the opportunity to influence global strategy, partner with senior leaders across the organization, and lead a talented, geographically diverse team across some of the world's most dynamic markets.

Title: Director, Public Safety Marketing - JAPAC
Description:
Acute Care Technology
At ZOLL, we're passionate about improving patient outcomes and helping save lives. We provide innovative technologies that make a meaningful difference in people's lives. Our medical devices, software and related services are used worldwide to diagnose and treat patients suffering from serious cardiopulmonary and respiratory conditions.
The Acute Care Technology division of ZOLL Medical Corporation develops and delivers innovative lifesaving products and software solutions to EMS, hospital, public safety, and military customers globally. Products include AEDs, trauma kits, ventilators, temperature management solutions, and more. Our dedicated employees take pride in their commitment to improving patient outcomes while delivering world-class customer service.
At ZOLL, you won’t just have a job. You'll have a career—and a purpose.
Join our team. It’s a great time to be a part of ZOLL!
Work Location : Singapore / Malaysia
Job Summary
The Director/Senior Manager, Public Safety Marketing - JAPAC is responsible for driving the market positioning and strategy in the APAC markets to ensure continued growth and competitive penetration. This position will focus on the implementation of marketing strategies and campaigns to promote the business within the region, whilst also working closely with the US based Marketing leaders to execute on global strategies within APAC.
Within the APAC region, analyse customer insights, consumer trends, market share data, and competitor initiatives, and translate the implications into actionable plans.
Produce an annual marketing plan for all market segments and manage a budget that aligns strategies and initiatives with those defined in the mid-term plan, whilst also contributing to the annual mid-term planning activities.
Essential Functions
Marketing Plan
- Develop and recommend marketing plans to achieve optimum sales and profitability within the company guidelines.
- Develop and implement marketing plans which include sales/ profit objectives, strategies, tactics, sales, and promotion budgets.
- Determine price and volume discount policies in conjunction with the Director of Asia Pacific.
- Revise marketing objectives to reflect changes in the business and report quarterly to the Director of Asia Pacific.
- Support the marketing managers to organise promotional campaigns and co-ordinate all aspects of product promotions. Maintaining mailing lists for effective product mailings and promotions.
- Ensure the company’s attendance at conferences achieve maximum market exposure within the constraints of the promotion budget.
New Product Opportunities
- Identify and communicate new product opportunities to management.
- Develop and recommend new product opportunities for consideration.
- Develop at the request of management, a marketing proposal and/ or plans for new products, providing market forecasts of volume, price, cost, including product launch.
- Search, identify and implement continuously, product line consolidation/ discontinuance programs
Product Knowledge
- Develop and maintain product knowledge.
- In conjunction with the Sales Excellence team, develop and implement product training programs to ensure that staff are fully conversant with selling features and benefits of assigned products.
- Recognise and understand competitors’ products strengths and weaknesses with specific relevance to the company’s products within which training is being given.
Liaison/ Communication
- Develop and maintain effective working relationships with others.
- Maintain productive working relationships with key contacts in relevant key accounts.
- Develop and maintain a close working relationship with Regional Sales Leaders to attain group and company sales goals.
- Maintain productive relationships within the company at a Global level.
Tenders and Contracts

Title: E-Commerce Marketing Executive
Description:
Sony Electronics Singapore is seeking a commercially minded E-Commerce Executive to drive sales and profitability across our four online channels: Sony Store Online (SSO), Shopee, Lazada and TikTok Shop.
The role owns channel performance, platform content and marketing, and campaign pricing execution, working closely with Product Managers, Operations and the Customer Marketing (CMK) team.
As platform costs continue to rise, the role is expected to grow revenue profitably, making informed trade-offs on where to invest, what to promote and how each channel contributes to Sony's direct-to-consumer strategy.
What you will be doing
Sales & Channel Profitability
- Own sales targets for SSO, Shopee, Lazada and TikTok Shop, tracking performance against monthly and campaign targets
- Monitor channel P&L, including platform commission, fees, vouchers co-funding, logistics and ad spend, to manage cost to serve per channel
- Recommend where to grow, hold or pull back by channel, category and SKU, based on profitability and Sony's direct-first channel strategy
- Analyse why performance moved (traffic, conversion, pricing, assortment, competition) and propose corrective actions, not just report results
- Prepare channel performance reports and post-campaign reviews for department and management meetings
Marketing & Content
Across all channels
- Work with Operations team to manage product listings, content and storefronts across all four platforms, ensuring accuracy, brand consistency and compliance with approved product claims
- Work with Digital Marketing to drive qualified traffic to SSO and marketplace stores, aligning paid media with channel priorities
Brand Store (SSO)
- Plan and execute customer-centric campaigns that focus on engagement, not just conversion: driving web traffic, clicks and longer browsing time
- Run seasonal campaigns and gamification activities that give customers reasons to visit, interact and return
- Drive new customer acquisition and repeat purchase on SSO with the CMK team, using CRM, loyalty and member-exclusive mechanics
- Track engagement metrics (sessions, CTR, time on site, active customers, etc) alongside sales to measure what each campaign delivers
Marketplaces (Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop)
- Plan and execute platform marketing calendars around key mega sales (e.g. 9.9, 11.11, 12.12), product launches and Sony campaigns
- Manage on-platform marketing tools: vouchers, flash deals, bundles, sponsored ads and livestream or affiliate activity (TikTok Shop)
- Manage marketplace partner relationships (KAMs) to secure campaign slots, visibility and commercial support
- Partner with the CMK team to grow product registration from marketplace buyers, bringing them into My Sony Rewards
Campaign Pricing & Operations
- Liaise with Product Managers to align campaign prices across platforms and campaign periods, protecting price consistency and channel harmony
- Flag pricing conflicts, margin risks and overlapping promotions before campaigns go live
- Consolidate pricing, promotion and listing details into clear, accurate briefs for the Operations team to execute and upload on time
- Validate live prices, promotions and listings after upload, and resolve discrepancies quickly
Success Measures
- Achievement of sales targets by channel
- Channel profitability and cost-to-serve within agreed thresholds
- SSO new and returning customer sales growth
- Product registration volume from marketplace purchases
- Pricing and listing accuracy; on-time campaign execution
- Quality of performance insights and recommendations
What you should have
- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Digital Commerce or a related discipline
- 3+ years of hands-on e-commerce experience, managing brand stores on Shopee, Lazada and/or TikTok Shop
- Experience with a brand-owned web store (e.g. Shopify) is a strong advantage
- Track record of growing marketplace sales while managing margin, platform fees and promotional costs
- Strong analytical skills; advanced Excel required, Power BI or similar is a plus
- Consumer electronics, retail, FMCG or other brand-led DTC environments preferred
What will help you succeed
Commercial Ownership
- Treats each channel as a business with its own P&L, not just a sales outlet
- Balances short-term campaign wins with long-term channel health and pricing integrity
- Knows when a sale is not worth chasing because cost to serve outweighs the return
Functional Knowledge
- Solid understanding of marketplace mechanics: commission structures, platform-funded vs brand-funded vouchers, ad tools and campaign participation requirements
- Working knowledge of e-commerce metrics (traffic, CVR, AOV, ROAS) and how they drive revenue
- Familiarity with DTC, CRM and loyalty levers that bring marketplace buyers into a direct relationship with Sony
Ways of Working
- Coordinates confidently across Product Managers, Operations, Digital Marketing, CMK and platform partners
- Writes clear, accurate briefs so others can execute without back-and-forth
- Detail-oriented on prices, promotions and listings; checks before things go live
Mindset
- Takes ownership of channel results and explains the why behind the numbers
- Spots problems early and comes with a proposed solution
- Adapts quickly as platforms change their rules, fees and features
Benefits you will have
- Flexible work arrangement (because we understand Life happens)
- Comprehensive medical benefits (including physical health screenings and term life insurance benefits)
- AWS and variable bonus
- Special staff purchase rates
- Flexible benefits (so you can claim for that staycay or gym membership you’ve been eyeing)
- Corporate social responsibility time off for 1 day each year to volunteer for a charity of your choice
- Milestone gifts (such as long service award and marriage gift because we want to celebrate both your professional and personal milestones)
- Wellness activities to promote healthy lifestyles
- Curated training programmes to encourage continuous professional development
At Sony, we strive to create a place for you to realise your potential and inspire you to make positive impact through innovation, smart collaboration and boundless curiosity. We are looking for people who believe that they can enrich lives and help us achieve our purpose – fill the world with emotion, through the power of creativity and technology.

Description:
COME, EXPRESS YOUR ANDAZ
Join Andaz Singapore, the first Andaz hotel in Southeast Asia.
Occupying Levels 25 to 39 of the DUO Tower, Andaz Singapore is a lifestyle hotel brand by Hyatt Hotels Corporation that inspires fresh perspectives.The first Andaz property in Southeast Asia offers well-appointed guestrooms and suites, four event venues, and five dining and drinking concepts. Situated at the crossroads of the Kampong Glam, Little India and Bras Basah Bugis cultural districts—with their intimate shophouse-filled alleyways and atmospheric colours, textures and flavours— Andaz Singapore aims to spark discovery of the rich culture of Singapore, and inspire guests to experience the city from new angles.
Global in scale while local in perspective, the Andaz brand empowers self-expression and stimulates guests’ curiosity through imaginative travel for a distinctively local experience. Through thoughtful, unscripted service tailored for travelers, Andaz hotels enable guests to go beyond the familiar to discover and define their personal essence while immersing themselves in the spirit of the eclectic culture around them.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
At Andaz Singapore, we believe in creating inspiring experiences through genuine connections, thoughtful leadership and a culture where colleagues can be their best selves.
We are seeking an experienced and commercially driven Director of Sales & Marketing / Executive Assistant Manager-Sales & Marketing to join our Leadership Committee. Reporting to the General Manager, this role provides strategic leadership across Sales, Events, Weddings, Revenue Management coordination, Marketing Communications and Digital Marketing. The position translates the hotel’s strategy, brand direction and financial priorities into integrated commercial plans that drive revenue, market share, customer preference and long-term brand value.
This is an exciting opportunity for an accomplished commercial leader who combines strong business acumen with a passion for developing people, building meaningful customer relationships and delivering measurable results.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Develop and execute an integrated Sales & Marketing business plan covering key market segments, accounts, channels, events, weddings and communications.
- Lead commercial strategies that drive room, event and wedding revenue, market share, demand generation and conversion.
- Set the hotel’s sales deployment, key-account development, prospecting, customer engagement and market coverage priorities.
- Guide the Revenue Management function in evaluating business pace, demand patterns, competitive conditions, displacement and need periods, while developing well-supported pricing and revenue recommendations.
- Lead the commercial performance of Events and Weddings, including pipeline conversion, space utilisation, client engagement, revenue delivery and cross-functional handovers.
- Oversee integrated marketing, public relations, digital, advertising, partnership and content initiatives, ensuring measurable returns and consistency with Andaz brand standards.
- Maintain accurate commercial forecasts, pipeline information, competitive intelligence, campaign analysis and executive performance reporting.
- Manage the department’s budget, productivity, promotional investment, contracts, purchasing and financial controls.
- Recruit, coach and develop a high-performing and inclusive commercial team, while strengthening succession planning and leadership capability.
- Ensure that commercial activities, contracts, records, data controls and departmental procedures comply with Hyatt policies and applicable requirements.
WHAT YOU HAVE
- Substantial senior leadership experience in luxury hospitality Sales & Marketing.
- Broad commercial exposure across sales, events, revenue collaboration, marketing communications and digital channels.
- A demonstrated ability to develop complex commercial plans, interpret market and financial performance, and deliver measurable business outcomes.
- Strong understanding of lifestyle positioning, customer expectations, brand standards and long-term brand equity.
- Executive presence, sound judgement, discretion and the ability to contribute constructively to hotel-wide decisions.
- Strong communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to engage senior leaders, owners, corporate partners, customers and colleagues.
- A bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Hospitality, Communications or a related discipline, or equivalent executive experience. You will be expected to connect market intelligence, customer demand, pricing, channel performance and hotel operating capacity to clear commercial action. You will use financial, digital, CRM, business intelligence and revenue data to identify opportunities, manage risks and improve performance.
You will work collaboratively with the General Manager, hotel leadership, operating divisions, Finance, Human Resources and Hyatt partners to create shared accountability and deliver sustainable results. You will build strong customer and industry relationships, communicate with clarity, and create an environment where colleagues are empowered to experiment, improve and grow.

Title: Emerging Southeast Asia Sales, Wealth Business
Description:
The Southeast Asia region presents a significant wealth management opportunity for asset managers due to a variety of factors, including a growing middle class, economic expansion, increased financial sophistication, and rapid technological advancements.
The Southeast Asia Wealth team is responsible for understanding market trends and client needs across Southeast Asia’s diverse Wealth markets and then translating these into commercial opportunities for our business. The team works with onshore asset managers, private / consumer banks, insurers, and wealth platforms to offer the full range of BlackRock active funds, ETFs and alternatives products.
We partner with clients to build bespoke solutions for specific client needs, while offering model portfolios and discretionary investment offerings backed by our market-leading in-house technology and risk analytics. The team is based in Singapore and works closely with colleagues around the globe to deliver the best of BlackRock to APAC Wealth investors.
Job Purpose/Background:
BlackRock's Southeast Asia Wealth business is looking for a Vice President to lead and engage with main Wealth clients in the Philippines and Emerging Southeast Asia markets. The primary responsibility is to enhance commercial engagement with clients, contribute to Wealth distribution strategy, and deliver business results through high-quality business development and client engagement. The role requires collaboration with multiple teams across product and business groups in APAC, EMEA, and the US to deliver the firm's capabilities to clients.
You will be responsible for execution and management of key client accounts and will work closely with the product teams to contribute to product development and new product ideas. Success would mean delivering our value proposition, investment capabilities and commercial expertise with clients as well as help their end-investors achieve financial goals and investment objectives.
Reporting to the Head of Emerging Southeast Asia Wealth, the successful candidate should have demonstrated knowledge of the Wealth segment and distributors in the Philippines including private and retail banks, insurance, advisory, and platforms. A proficient understanding of investment strategies, investment management, capital markets, sustainable investing and alternative strategies would be advantageous. A keen interest to learn and be a "Student of the Market" will be a strong contributor to this success for this role. Additionally outstanding social skills, relationship management, and the ability to connect effectively across a matrix and sophisticated organization are critical for success.
Key Responsibilities:
· Based in Singapore, the role works with the broader Emerging Southeast Asia Wealth team to develop and execute a detailed sales strategy, with a focus on promoting the benefits and extending the usage of BlackRock solutions.
· Proactively position and differentiate BlackRock and our investment products against competitor firms and products to Financial Advisers.
· Exhibit in-depth knowledge of all investment products, including the demonstration of a high level of comfort in communicating this information to Advisers in the context of portfolio construction
· Expand existing client base by uncovering investment needs and presenting solutions.
Exhibit high-level market knowledge and ability to converse with financial advisers on investment solutions and current economic and market conditions
· Embrace the firm’s commitment to the client experience and exceed client contact expectations
· Partner with colleagues across the organization to improve the BlackRock/Client relationship.
· Follow a team-based approach and leverage the Firm’s resources at appropriate times in the sales cycle, in order to broaden and deepen the usage of BlackRock solutions.
· Diligent use of client relationship management tools to record client activity/interaction.
· Administrative tasks: prepare client materials and reports for management.
· Responsible to ensure that all regulatory and legal requirements and standards are met.
Experience/Qualifications:
· 8+ years of proven experience in a similar industry with established network of wealth industry relationships, and their key stakeholders.
· Established track record in relationship management and growing a mutual fund business.
· Strong analytical skills and ability to synthesize data to draw conclusions, informing business strategies and client recommendations.
· Relevant industry and investment knowledge. Strong proficiency across a wide range of traditional, alternative Investment products and ETFs. Clear awareness of key issues affecting Wealth clients.
· Strong presentation and communication skills, both written and verbal, to effectively convey complex information to clients and internal teams.
· Strong team player, who is able to collaborate credibly internally in order to leverage the Firm's resources locally as well as globally
· Self-motivated individual, with a commitment to excellence.
· Proficiency in Tagalog will be a plus to support the Filipino clientele base in the Philippines
· BA/BS degree in related field.
BlackRock’s purpose is to help more and more people experience financial well-being. As a global investment manager and a leading provider of financial technology, our clients—from grandparents, doctors, and teachers to large institutions—turn to us for the solutions they need when planning for their most important goals. At BlackRock, you will have an opportunity to do meaningful work with diverse colleagues across the globe, all with the support of a company that’s committed to your well-being and invested in your success. Discover how you can have a career at BlackRock that’s exciting, rewarding and full of possibilities.

Title: Entertainment Director
Description:
Who are we?
Mondrian is built on a team of visionaries at the forefront of hospitality, cuisine, design, and entertainment. Our lifestyle moments are forged with highly-curated and passionate service. We are committed to authenticity, sophistication, mastery and innovation. Our mission has been to make food and beverage the heart and soul of our hotels. Our stage is the world. Our time is now. We are an equal opportunity employer.
What do we expect of you?
Reporting into the Director of Food & Beverages, you ensure that Mondrian guests have exceptional entertainment experiences. You are responsible for the day-to-day management of performers, musicians, and other entertainers and works closely with these artists to ensure that they are well prepared for their performances and appearances.
The Entertainment Director is also required to be involved in negotiating contracts and other legal matters related to their clients’ careers. In addition to managing individual artists, the entertainment managers is required to manage entire groups or bands.
How your day looks:
Managing and overseeing all aspects of an event, from start to finish
Negotiating contracts with talent, production companies, and other industry professionals to secure performers for events
Coordinating with vendors to ensure that all services are provided as agreed upon and within budget
Making sure that all operations run smoothly, including scheduling rehearsals and performances and making sure that all technical elements are working properly
Overseeing marketing efforts such as creating advertisements or organizing promotional events
Coordinating with marketing departments to develop and implement marketing strategies that reach target audiences through all channels,including print and digital advertising, social media campaigns, live events, and public relations campaigns
Managing the budget and working with event planners, designers, and other professionals to create an event that is within the budget guidelines
Evaluating the success of an event based on factors such as ticket sales, attendance levels, and customer satisfaction levels
Handling tasks related to event planning, such as selecting a venue, hiring performers, coordinating catering services with caterers, and selecting decorations and other event elements
How do you deliver this?
Tell It Like It Is
- Be authentic, honest, direct, sincere & professional.
Build Rapport
– Be engaging, reliable, thoughtful, helpful, energetic & empathetic.
Gain Trust
- Be dependable, deliver on promises, take ownership & follow through.
Play To Win
– Be original, bold, cutting edge and decisive.
Right Here, Right Now
– Be attentive, meticulous, determined & impressive.

Description:
The Enterprise Workforce Transformation Package Programme (EWTPP) is a strategic initiative supported by Workforce Singapore Agency (WSG) and administered by the Singapore Business Federation (SBF) as the anchor programme partner. It aims to support companies in their workforce transformation efforts.
The Senior Executive (Marketing & Engagement) supports the effective implementation of marketing, communications, and engagement activities for the EWTP Programme. This role provides operational and administrative support to the programme team, assists in outreach and reporting, manages programme communications channels, and contributes to resource development. The Beverage Container Return Scheme (BCRS) was recommended by a Citizens’ Workgroup in 2019 as part of efforts to protect the environment, conserve finite resources, and increase recycling rates in Singapore.
The Scheme is designed to spark behavioural change by encouraging more sustainable consumption habits and enabling the transition towards a circular economy.
Under the Scheme:
Beverage producers and retailers are responsible for ensuring that beverage containers are properly collected and treated at end-of-life, and
Consumers are encouraged to return empty containers for recycling in exchange for a deposit refund.
The Scheme contributes to a more sustainable Singapore by:
Increasing the recycling rate of beverage containers and reducing waste sent for disposal;
Encouraging consistent recycling habits among Singaporeans; and
Aggregating a clean, high-quality stream of recyclable materials.
The impact of BCRS will be significant. The Scheme will cover more than one billion beverage containers used each year, allowing us to recover over 16,000 tonnes of material annually. This means less waste sent for incineration, lower carbon emissions, and a more circular economy.
BCRS is Singapore’s second Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) scheme, following the introduction of the e-waste EPR framework in 2021. EPR schemes place responsibility on producers for the collection and end-of-life management of the products they put on the market. Over time they will make changes to their supply chains, processes and materials used, knowing that they have some responsibility for recycling the container after it is sold.
As a producer-led scheme, BCRS is designed and operated by the industry, for the industry. This approach allows producers to determine the most practical and cost-effective way to recover used beverage containers, while maintaining efficiency and service standards. Producer-led return schemes have been shown to be effective in countries such as Norway, Denmark and Lithuania.
Successful implementation requires the support, understanding, and shared commitment from all stakeholders involved: producers, retailers, recyclers, and consumers. There will be teething issues and adjustments along the way, but we can address them with everyone’s support. Launching the Scheme in April is the first step and adjustments will need to be made along the way, in order for the scheme to be effective and impactful.
