Check against your experience: BCRS is Singapore’s second Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) scheme, following the introduction of the e-waste EPR framework in 2021. EPR schemes place responsibility on producers for the collection and end-of-life management of the products they put on the market. Over time they will make changes to their supply chains, processes and materials used, knowing that they have some responsibility for recycling the container after it is sold.
Check against your experience: As a producer-led scheme, BCRS is designed and operated by the industry, for the industry. This approach allows producers to determine the most practical and cost-effective way to recover used beverage containers, while maintaining efficiency and service standards. Producer-led return schemes have been shown to be effective in countries such as Norway, Denmark and Lithuania.
Check against your experience: Successful implementation requires the support, understanding, and shared commitment from all stakeholders involved: producers, retailers, recyclers, and consumers. There will be teething issues and adjustments along the way, but we can address them with everyone’s support. Launching the Scheme in April is the first step and adjustments will need to be made along the way, in order for the scheme to be effective and impactful.

Title: Field Marketing Manager, APAC
Description:
About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About The Role
We're looking for our founding APAC Field Marketing Leader, someone strategy-strong who can autonomously own a regional function end to end — set the strategy, build the operating system, carry the number, and represent marketing credibly to regional sales leadership and to global marketing leadership at the same time. Not a program manager who executes a plan set elsewhere.
The essential tension to screen for: this person needs the seniority and judgment to lead an org, and the willingness to be a team of one for a while. Regional expansion is planned but the timing isn't fixed, which means for some meaningful period they are writing the doc, running the roundtable, and negotiating with the agency themselves. Scrappy, low-ego, and hands-on — but senior enough to see the whole picture without the support systems a mature regional marketing org would provide.
Regional judgment matters more here than in most field marketing roles. One person cannot serve five sub-regions equally, so the job is fundamentally about sequencing: which markets get real first-party investment, which get partner-led coverage, and which wait. They need to make those calls, defend them to sales leaders in each market, and revisit them as signal comes in.
Partner fluency is not a nice-to-have in this region — it's the primary distribution mechanism. Someone who has only run first-party programs will find the leverage model unfamiliar.
What a successful candidate looks like: a leader who landed in a new region with nothing, picked the right two markets to prove out, used partner and agency capacity to punch well above their headcount, and can point to the pipeline, the operating system, and the team plan they left behind.
Ideal Profiles
- The first-in-region builder who then scaled it. Was the founding field or regional marketing hire for APAC at an enterprise software company and grew it into a team. Brings direct experience with both halves of this job. Pressure-test whether they built a durable function or just ran events, and whether they're still willing to be hands-on at the start.
- The partner-led regional leader. Led co-marketing and demand programs through cloud providers, resellers, and distributors across APAC markets. Strongest on leverage and ecosystem motion. Pressure-test whether they can also build direct enterprise ABM and own a pipeline number independent of partners.
- The multi-market APAC field marketing leader. Owned field marketing across several APAC sub-regions at a scaled tech company. Brings market fluency, local vendor and event relationships, and cultural range. Pressure-test appetite for building infrastructure from scratch rather than operating within an existing system, and for the period before they have a team.
Key responsibilities
- Build and lead the APAC field marketing function, establishing scalable frameworks and processes from scratch in the region
- Drive field marketing initiatives across enterprise while building scaled programs for startups, adapting strategy for diverse international markets and buying behaviors
- Create and run field marketing programs including executive roundtables, customer events, industry conferences, partner programs, and ABM activations
- Partner closely with APAC sales leadership to align programs to territory and account-specific pipeline and revenue goals
- Establish measurement frameworks including lead scoring, attribution models, and ROI reporting to demonstrate marketing's impact on revenue
- Evaluate and select premium third-party events that align with business goals, and build high-impact activation strategies around them
- Collaborate with Global Field Marketing and other central marketing teams so APAC programs align with company-wide strategy while meeting local market needs
- Coordinate with APAC Solutions Marketing and Product Marketing for consistent messaging and positioning across regional programs
- Manage regional resources including relationships with key partners, vendors, and industry organizations across APAC
- Build and manage the regional field marketing budget with strong financial discipline and ROI focus
- Define the regional team plan and hire and lead the function as expansion headcount lands
- Drive continuous improvement through post-program analysis, stakeholder feedback, and data-driven optimization
Minimum Qualifications
- 14+ years B2B enterprise marketing with blended expertise in field marketing, ABM, and demand generation in APAC markets
- Deep understanding of enterprise sales cycles and buying processes; software company experience is required
- Track record building and scaling field marketing and demand generation programs from the ground up
- Strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to program optimization and attribution
- Demonstrated contribution to significant revenue goals through integrated marketing initiatives
- International marketing experience and understanding of regional market dynamics across Asia Pacific
- Proven self-starter who has run sophisticated programs with small teams in fast-paced startup environments
- Strong project management across complex, multi-country programs simultaneously
- Exceptional budgeting and financial management with experience managing substantial field marketing budgets
- Cultural awareness and ability to adapt strategy for diverse APAC markets
- Excellent cross-functional collaboration, particularly with sales teams and executive stakeholders
- Comfort with ambiguity and a bias for thoughtful action
- Existing right to work in Singapore is required for this role.
Strong candidates may also have
- Experience marketing AI/ML or complex technical products to enterprise customers
- Experience building and leading demand generation teams in APAC
- Knowledge of account-based marketing strategies and execution
- Background at high-growth technology companies such as Okta, Splunk, Snowflake, or Workday
- Previous experience as a first field marketing hire in a new region
- Fluency in multiple Asia Pacific languages
- Understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements for marketing activities
- Experience evaluating and activating at premium third-party events strategically, including hospitality management at high-end venues and cultural
Logistics

And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

You will be responsible for gathering sales performance data from various source systems, evaluating and deploying optimal database tools, and constructing a centralized single source of truth for commission calculations and commercial reporting.

Title: Fundraising and Partnership Manager
Description:
About the Role
4S is building a dedicated fundraising function for the first time, following the launch of our first integrated fundraising campaign, Adopt-A-Wish, in February 2026. This role will lead that build —establishing the donor pipeline, partnership base, systems and stewardship practices 4S does not yet have, with a particular focus on Community-based Centres (4S Active Ageing Centre and 4S Eldercare Centre @ Eunos Crescent). The role will also contribute to 4S’s overall financial sustainability and support fundraising, partnership and sponsorship opportunities across its facilities.
This is a founding role in a function 4S is investing in as a strategic priority under its 2024–2028 Roadmap. You will have real latitude to shape how 4S fundraises, working closely with the CEO, HQ’s Community Engagement and Corporate Communications & Marketing staff.
Responsibilities
Fundraising Foundations
Design and stand up 4S’ core fundraising approach — a donor pipeline and a repeatable calendar of campaigns/appeals.
Support the procurement and implementation of 4S’ Donor and Volunteer Management System (DVMS), then manage its donation-related functions, including donor records and donation tracking, to support donor engagement and regular giving across the organization.
Develop and implement plans to meet agreed year-one and year-two fundraising targets and grant KPIs, with an initial focus on the Community-based Centres’ funding needs. Track progress and propose higher targets for agreement with the CEO where feasible.
Partnership Development
Build 4S's first structured base of corporate, foundation and community partnerships — moving beyond one-off donations toward small numbers of well-managed, renewable relationships.
Prepare partnership proposals and manage the resulting agreements/MoUs. Coordinate sponsorships and donations (cash/in-kind) with the relevant facilities, including donor follow-up.
Donor Stewardship
Establish a simple, consistent stewardship cadence (acknowledgement, updates, impact reporting) for 4S's existing and new donors.
Use what Adopt-A-Wish surfaced about donor behavior to refine the next campaign.
Governance
Keep accurate fundraising records and ensure activities comply with the Charities Act, Commissioner of Charities and NCSS requirements.
Provide the CEO, Board and relevant Management Committees with straightforward updates on pipeline, funds raised and donor retention at agreed intervals, attending meetings as required. Prepare progress and outcome reports in line with grant requirements.
What you’ll partner on not own:
Digital fundraising platforms, campaign content and social media: partner with the HQ’s Community Engagement and Corporate Communications & Marketing staff on campaign delivery, content, publicity and brand alignment.
Requirements
Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications or related field.
5 years' relevant experience in fundraising, partnerships or business development, including experience helping build or scale a fundraising function (not only operating within an established one) — this is a build role, not a maintenance role.
A proven track record in donor or partnership acquisition, ideally including hands-on campaign delivery rather than only strategy.
Strong proposal writing, communication and relationship-building skills; comfortable working with limited existing infrastructure.
Working knowledge of Singapore charity governance and compliance (Charities Act, IPC requirements).
Genuine interest in eldercare / community-based social service work.
Working Arrangements
Reports to Chief Executive Officer
44 hours per week, 5-day work week
Availability to attend meetings or work on weekends when required
Willingness to work five days per week at Eunos Crescent, Singapore

a secular and non-ethnic based organisation registered with the: Commissioner of Charities on 25 April 1996 (Registration Number: 01172)

Description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

The Role
We are looking for people who bring something unique to Suntory Global Spirits - themselves. We value differences, and we appreciate what each of us can contribute. We inspire each other, and challenge ourselves to innovate, improve, advance new ideas and try new things. We create endless opportunities to Unleash Your Spirit every day in a culture that is charged, creative, challenging and fun.
Position Overview
The General Manager– Singapore is a key member of the Southeast Asia leadership team and is responsible for brand building, commercial and Trade Marketing leadership, and delivery of the full end-to-end ownership of the market P&L in own RTM - Singapore. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role with accountability for developing and executing commercial and trade marketing strategy, optimizing the route to market, building premium brands, and leading the local team ensuring sustainable profitable growth.
Singapore is a strategically important market within Southeast Asia and operates in own route-to-market environment. The General Manager will be responsible for driving performance through strong internal leadership, close partnership with customers, wholesalers, on-trade and e-commerce accounts, and effective alignment with regional and global stakeholders.
Mission of the Role
To lead the Singapore business with full P&L ownership, clear commercial and brand agenda, delivering NSV, market share and brand equity growth through strong market leadership, effective route-to-market management, disciplined execution, a high-performing team culture and cross-functional collaboration.
Role Responsibilities
People Leadership
Lead the Singapore country organization with solid-line responsibility for Commercial, Trade Marketing and in‑market Brand Marketing roles.
Ensure the organization design, roles and ways of working support the GM‑led model and SEA growth ambition from 50M to 100M NSV.
Build and sustain a strong, inclusive, and high-performing team culture aligned to the values and ambitions of Suntory Global Spirits.
Inspire, coach, and develop the local team to deliver against business objectives and create a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
Foster a One Team culture that encourages collaboration, curiosity, and outperformance.
Provide clear direction, support, and constructive feedback to team members and ensure the organization is structured effectively to deliver the market plan.
Support talent development and succession planning within the Singapore organization and across key market-facing roles.
Commercial Leadership
Develop and execute the strategic direction for Singapore, including the market plan, commercial plan, brand plans, budget, and forecast.
Own the delivery of the market P&L and financial performance, including NSV growth, profitability, A&P deployment and operating expenses within agreed SEA guardrails.
Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual business performance reviews, with strong understanding of the key drivers of market performance, including depletions, stock levels, activation plans, promotions, pricing, and competitor dynamics.
Build and align annual brand and commercial plans, setting clear KPIs across distribution, market share, rate of sale, pricing, promotional activity, and execution standards.
Drive the innovation agenda in close partnership with regional and global brand teams.
Own pricing and profitability decisions within regional guardrails
Ensure route-to-market effectiveness and build strong, trust-based relationships with wholesalers, customers, and other key external partners.
Establish and maintain strong working relationships with enabling functions including Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Legal, Human Resources, and Marketing.
Champion compliance, professionalism, and good governance, ensuring the market operates in line with all legal, regulatory, and policy requirements.
Lead confidently through change, ensuring business priorities remain clear and the organization remains agile and responsive.
Market and Stakeholder Leadership
Represent the Singapore market effectively within the Southeast Asia and broader APAC leadership forums.
Lead in‑market Brand Managers and Marketing activation, ensuring local execution is on strategy, premium, and consistent with SEA campaign platforms and brand guardrails.
Lead in‑market Trade Marketing and activation planning, ensuring alignment to SEA TM standards, playbooks and ways of working. Partner with regional and global stakeholders to ensure Singapore’s needs are understood and reflected in business planning.
Build effective external relationships with customers, wholesalers, trade partners, and relevant industry stakeholders.

Work closely with regional and global marketing teams to strengthen innovation agenda

Strong general management mindset, able to balance growth, margin, brand equity and culture in one coherent plan.
Comfortable with end‑to‑end accountability and making clear investment trade‑offs across brands, channels and customers.
Ability to create an environment where people can perform at their best.

Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills in a matrixed organization.

Help safeguard the financial system at global scale. In Global Screening Operations, you will review client and transaction screening alerts, apply sanctions and Know Your Customer requirements, and help prevent financial crime. You will build strong risk and analytics skills, work with teams across regions, and contribute to process and technology improvements that raise quality and speed. This role suits someone who is detail-focused, analytical, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, risk-intensive environment.
As a Payment Lifecycle Analyst in Global Screening Operations within Payments Operations, you will ensure client and transaction activity complies with global and local regulatory requirements. You will investigate alerts from screening systems and validate potential sanctions and politically exposed person matches, documenting decisions with clear evidence. You will work with Asia-based clients and stakeholders, and the role requires you to read and interpret Japanese and Chinese documents as part of case investigation and resolution. You will also support improvements to controls, metrics, and technology to strengthen outcomes and consistency.

Review and investigate transaction and client screening alerts using screening platforms and research tools.
Apply sanctions and Know Your Customer requirements, including Office of Foreign Assets Control and other sanctions regimes.
Validate potential sanctions and politically exposed person matches and escalate cases where required.
Read and interpret Japanese and Chinese documents to support investigations, evidence gathering, and case closure.
Document decisions clearly, ensuring analysis is evidence-based and audit-ready.
Manage shared mailboxes, perform manual screening where needed, and conduct inquiries to close information gaps.
Meet service-level agreements and performance targets while maintaining high quality and confidentiality.
Analyze trends and metrics and prepare management reporting.
Identify process gaps and deliver improvements that increase efficiency, quality, and consistency.
Support technology enhancements, including requirements gathering and user acceptance testing.
Stay current on policy, control, and procedure changes and help embed updates into daily work.
Collaborate with global partners to resolve complex cases and share best practices to maintain consistent standards.

Bachelor's degree.
Ability to read and speak Japanese (min JLPT N3 level or higher) and Mandarin as the role requires you to read and interpret documents in Japanese and Mandarin as part of case investigation and resolution.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with sound, timely decision-making.
Strong attention to detail, including disciplined documentation and evidence retention.
Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and meet deadlines in a regulatory environment.
Proven ability to manage multiple tasks and adapt to change.
Familiarity with service-level agreements and performance measures such as key performance indicators and key risk indicators.
Commitment to confidentiality and quality in a risk-intensive environment.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and Outlook.

Experience in high-volume processing, risk operations, or screening work in financial services.
Experience with payments screening or financial crime prevention.
Knowledge of banking systems across lines of business.

Title: Guest Experience & Business Development Manager (CCP PMET)
Description:
About the Role
BMG treats guest experience as both a service and a revenue function. The Guest Experience & Business Development Manager will build relationships, community programmes, local partnerships and customer pipelines that generate hotel stays, restaurant diners, groups, events, repeat customers and referrals.
This is not primarily a complaint-handling or front-office role.
Key Responsibilities
Develop relationships with nearby companies, networking groups, local organisations, attractions, communities and complementary businesses.
Generate new hotel, F&B, group, corporate and event business.
Engage hotel and restaurant guests and convert appropriate interactions into permission-based CRM relationships.
Maintain a structured CRM and segment customers by behaviour, relationship, commercial potential and future needs.
Use approved AI tools to personalise follow-ups, proposals, local recommendations and customer journeys.
Develop neighbourhood partnerships and placemaking programmes.
Design community programmes and BMG social activities.
Work with operations and digital resources to create campaigns, offers, events and experiences.
Measure which partnerships and programmes generate bookings, diners, referrals and attributable revenue.
Analyse repeat visits, conversion, customer behaviour and pipeline progress.
Feed customer intelligence into management, pricing, programming and service decisions.
CCP Growth Skills
Consumer Intelligence Analysis
Placemaking for Hospitality
Service Innovation
Digital Marketing
Structured Career Conversion
The selected employee may undergo up to 24 weeks of OJT to develop hospitality-specific customer intelligence, CRM, placemaking, business development, AI-enabled relationship management and service-innovation capabilities.
Suitable Background
Potential backgrounds include community development, events, customer success, corporate relations, sales, marketing, account management, tourism, retail, service industries and partnership development. Candidates do not need to come from a traditional hotel Guest Relations department.
BMG Hospitality Pte. Ltd. is a Singapore-based hospitality and lifestyle company building a technology-enabled ecosystem across accommodation, food & beverage, talent, education, community, digital marketing and media.
Our core hospitality concept, Capsule Modern, focuses on modern, well-designed and affordable accommodation for the next generation of travellers. We aim to combine efficient hotel operations, strong guest experiences, social interaction and technology to create a scalable hospitality platform. Our target guests include independent travellers, digital natives and younger international visitors seeking convenient locations, quality facilities, value and community experiences.
Alongside our hotels, BMG Hospitality is developing Gabriel Restaurants to support both hotel guests and external customers. The restaurant platform is designed to complement hotel operations through breakfast services, food and beverage offerings and social experiences while developing its own standalone revenue streams.
BMG operates with an asset-light approach, focusing primarily on leasing and converting suitable properties rather than purchasing real estate. Standardised operating procedures, technology, centralised management and disciplined project execution are intended to allow new properties to be developed and launched efficiently.
Technology and artificial intelligence form an important part of BMG's operating philosophy. We are building a cloud-based management environment covering hotel operations, revenue management, reservations, customer relationship management, finance, HR, recruitment, project management, marketing, social media, reporting and management dashboards. Our managers are expected to use AI as a practical working tool to improve productivity, decision-making, communication and reporting.
Beyond hotels and restaurants, BMG is developing an ecosystem that includes talent recruitment and development, BMG Academy, affiliate marketing, community programmes and digital media. These businesses are intended to support the hospitality platform by developing employees, creating additional distribution channels, building customer communities and creating new sources of revenue.
BMG's organisational culture is built around entrepreneurship, accountability, continuous learning and measurable performance. We believe technology should empower employees rather than replace the human relationships that remain fundamental to hospitality. Team members are encouraged to understand the commercial impact of their roles, develop leadership capabilities and continuously improve the systems they manage.
The company is currently focused on establishing and scaling its Singapore operations, with longer-term opportunities across selected Asian markets. As BMG grows, we are building a management team capable of creating repeatable operating systems that can support multiple hotels, restaurants and related businesses across different locations.
Our objective is to build more than a collection of hotels. We aim to develop an integrated hospitality ecosystem where accommodation, food, technology, talent, education, community and digital distribution work together to create stronger customer experiences, operational efficiency and sustainable long-term growth.

Description:

Description
As the SCPM Geo Leader for APJ, you will serve as the "Single Threaded Leader” (STL) for AWS marketing in your geography, informing and influencing the full marketing investment across digital, events, partner and ABM to maximize impact in your region. You work backwards to drive key marketing outputs (e.g., perception, Marketing Engaged Framework metrics) from brand to demand across channels. You are an advocate and “voice of the customer” representing the sale leadership and more importantly the growth targets of the Geo. You represent marketing outcomes that deliver revenue to the sales leader on behalf of WW Marketing; you directly own Account Based Marketing and influence the digital; event marketing, partner marketing and other Marketing program/ investments on behalf of your region. You will drive the regional ABM strategy while serving as the single point of accountability for representing your Geo back to all marketing teams.
Key job responsibilities
- Ensure the marketing investments across functions (IDC, Events, Partner Marketing, ABM CoE, Industries, Developer, product marketing, andBrand) is aligned with the marketing growth by customer segment that is needed in your Geo.
- Lead and scale the Account Based Marketing program for your geography, including account selection, coverage strategy, and resource deployment decisions, adapting global ABM playbooks to local market context and building regional ABM capability through hiring, coaching, and upskilling.
- Represent marketing as a unified growth partner to regional sales leadership by participating in business reviews, annual planning, and governance forums, and by owning the investment framework that categorizes country-level marketing spend using a standardized, data-driven model.
- Serve as the region's marketing intelligence expert, translating local customer insights, market dynamics, and cultural moments into actionable briefs for product marketing, industry marketing, public relations, public policy, and analyst relations teams.
- Build and lead an inclusive marketing community across all functions operating in your geography — coaching and developing marketers regardless of reporting line, championing talent progression, and creating collaboration forums that connect global teams to the regional mission.

You open the morning reviewing regional demand metrics, spotting a gap in pipeline coverage for an emerging customer segment. We connect worldwide marketing strategy to local execution, ensuring every investment — from large-scale summits to targeted ABM campaigns — is grounded in real customer and market insights. Proven experience translating business and brand strategies into high-quality experiential programs spanning experience design, curation, production and content amplification.
Experience building and evolving recurring experiential platforms or signature programs, rather than solely delivering one-off events.
Ability to design experiences for different customer segments and life stages, including affluent, high-net-worth and intergenerational families.
Strong experience in content and social amplification, agency management and luxury, hospitality, lifestyle and experiential ecosystem.
Excellent senior stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to operate effectively in a complex, matrixed organization where program ownership sits with the business.
Polished and credible, with the presence to engage senior stakeholders and clients across all segments, including affluent, high-net-worth and next-generation clients.

BW Group is a leading global energy and maritime company involved in shipping, deepwater oil & gas production, renewable energy and digital infrastructure. BW controls a fleet of over 400 vessels transporting oil, gas and dry commodities. In the infrastructure space, the group operates in wind, batteries, water, subsea cable networks and data centres.
BW is proud to be listed among Forbes World's Best Employers and Financial Times Best Employers Asia-Pacific 2025.
Are you ready to make an impact?
What drives us is our mission to deliver energy for the world today, and to find solutions for tomorrow. If you want to make lives better around the world by providing access to energy, while working on sustainability and decarbonisation, we'd like to hear from you. Working at BW you will feel the pulse of the world each day. If something happens in the world, we feel it, and you can play your part by anticipating and responding to it. Our high-performing teams are drawn to BW by the global nature of our work and the satisfaction of working with collaborative people who inspire each other to deliver exceptional results.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Role Overview
Based in Singapore and reporting to the Chief People Officer, BW Group, the Head of Communications & Brand leads communications and corporate brand activities across BW Group whilst also supporting BW LNG.
This is a highly visible role partnering closely with the Chairman, senior executives and Communications leaders across our affiliate companies to strengthen BW's reputation, shape its corporate narrative and foster greater collaboration across the Group.
Success requires far more than exceptional communications capability. You will be a commercially minded strategic thinker who anticipates issues, shapes narratives and influences outcomes through sound judgement, trusted relationships and collaboration in a federated organisation where credibility matters more than hierarchy.
Working with a lean team and external partners, you will combine strategic thinking with a hands-on approach, helping shape executive communications, protect and enhance the BW brand, support organisational transformation and drive communications excellence across the Group.
Key Accountabilities
Corporate Communications
Develop and deliver BW Group's corporate communications strategy aligned with the Group's long-term vision and priorities.
Shape compelling narratives that strengthen understanding of BW's purpose, strategy and portfolio of businesses.
Advise leaders on communications strategy, executive messaging and stakeholder engagement.
Lead communications for strategic initiatives, organisational change, major announcements and corporate events.
Oversee BW Group's digital communications, including LinkedIn and other channels, delivering engaging content that strengthens the brand and supports strategic objectives.
Executive
Communications
Partner closely with the Chairman and senior executives on speeches, presentations, thought leadership and executive communications.
Develop executive communications that reflect BW's values and high editorial standards.
Lead the production of flagship Group communications, including World Horizon, the Annual Report, Sustainability Report, corporate website and key leadership updates.
Support senior executives at conferences, media engagements, investor events and industry forums through end-to-end communications planning and delivery.
Serve as a trusted communications adviser to the Chairman and senior leadership, providing sound judgement on messaging, stakeholder considerations and reputational matters.
Employee
Communications
Lead Group-wide employee communications across digital channels.
Deliver engaging communications that connect shore-based and seafaring employees through platforms such as BW Connect.
Foster a culture of openness, pride and engagement across the Group.
Brand & Reputation
Act as steward of the BW corporate brand, ensuring consistency whilst respecting the autonomy of our affiliate businesses.
Evolve BW's corporate identity and positioning to strengthen the Group's reputation and create value across the portfolio.
Protect and enhance BW's reputation with employees, customers, investors, regulators, partners and the wider maritime and energy community.
Lead crisis and issues communications, partnering with senior management and external advisers as required for ongoing incidents and with post-communications.
BW LNG Communications & Marketing
Partner with the BW LNG leadership team to develop communications and marketing initiatives that strengthen the company's commercial positioning and reputation.
Lead communications supporting commercial initiatives, including vessel launches, technology innovations, customer campaigns and industry events.
Develop marketing content and digital campaigns that showcase BW LNG's capabilities, innovation and market leadership.
Ensure alignment between BW LNG's communications and the wider BW corporate brand.
Leadership & Influence
Lead BW's Communications Community of Practice, fostering collaboration, sharing best practice and identifying opportunities for greater alignment across affiliate companies.
Build trusted relationships with affiliate CEOs and Communications leaders, influencing through credibility rather than authority.
Foster collaboration across the Group whilst respecting the entrepreneurial culture and autonomy of individual businesses.
Digital Communications & AI
Harness AI and emerging technologies to improve the quality, consistency, efficiency and reach of communications.
Identify and implement new tools, channels and approaches that enhance engagement and communications effectiveness.
Measure communications impact using meaningful qualitative and quantitative insights.
Team Leadership
Lead, coach and develop a small, high-performing communications team.
Manage external agencies and specialist partners to maximise quality, capability and value.
QUALIFICATIONS
Experience
We're looking for someone who combines strategic communications leadership with exceptional judgement and the ability to influence senior stakeholders. You'll ideally bring:
Significant experience leading corporate communications within a global organisation or consultancy.
Experience advising CEOs and senior executives on communications strategy and reputation management.
Strong understanding of corporate branding, stakeholder engagement and executive communications.
Experience leading communications during periods of organisational change, transformation or significant corporate activity.
Experience working across complex, matrixed or federated organisations would be advantageous.
Experience within the maritime or energy sectors would be beneficial, although not essential.
What Will Make You Successful
You'll be someone who naturally earns trust and credibility. You'll demonstrate:
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Excellent judgement and discretion.
The ability to simplify complex issues into clear, compelling messages.
Exceptional relationship-building and influencing skills.
Strong commercial awareness.
High levels of curiosity and strategic thinking.
Comfort working directly with senior executives and Board-level stakeholders.
A collaborative style with low ego and high integrity.
The ability to balance strategic thinking with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and deliver.
Demonstrates sound judgement in knowing when to follow established processes and when a pragmatic, flexible approach will deliver a better outcome.
A passion for continuous improvement, innovation and practical application of AI.
This role is unlikely to suit someone who prefers highly structured environments, relies on formal authority to get things done, or wants to specialise in a single area of communications. Success requires sound judgement, adaptability, collaboration and a willingness to operate across a broad range of strategic and hands-on responsibilities.
OTHER INFORMATION
Why BW?
This is a unique opportunity to help shape the voice and reputation of one of the world's most respected maritime and energy groups.
You'll work closely with visionary leaders who value integrity, long-term thinking and collaboration, while helping tell the story of a business investing in both today's energy needs and tomorrow's energy transition.
The role offers exceptional breadth, combining strategy, executive partnership, brand leadership, organisational change, employee engagement and external communications in an entrepreneurial international environment.

Title: Head of Communications & Creative
Description:
Reimagine access. Reimagine ownership. Build the future with Cinch.
Cinch is Southeast Asia's leading circular tech subscription company, redefining how people and businesses access technology. Instead of adding to the growing e-waste crisis, we enable affordable, sustainable access to devices through subscriptions that maximize reuse and extend their lifecycle.
We operate across B2C, B2B, and B2B2C channels, including major partnerships with global leaders like Samsung. Our model sits at the intersection of powerful mega trends—sustainability, embedded finance, and the shift from ownership to access—creating a massive opportunity to reshape the future of tech consumption.
At Cinch, we are builders with high standards, a bias for action, and a shared mission to create a generational company that outlasts us. Freshly funded by leading institutional investors and growing rapidly, we're creating an environment where ambitious people can do the best work of their careers—and where the work has real, lasting impact.
About The Role
We're looking for a Head of Communications & Creative to lead Cinch's brand voice, creative output, and communications strategy across both B2C and B2B. This is a senior leadership role for someone who sets direction and raises the bar — building out the brand framework, messaging architecture, and tone of voice, and ensuring everything we put out reflects a consistent, high standard.
You'll lead a small in-house team and work alongside external creative partners to deliver at pace and scale. The role requires someone equally at home shaping strategy and reviewing final creative — someone who can lead a team as effectively as they can write a brief.
This is a high-visibility role with direct exposure to senior leadership across B2C and B2B, including major regional and global partnerships.
What You'll Do
Communications Leadership
- Own Cinch's communications strategy across B2C and B2B — defining what we say, how we say it, and to whom
- Develop and refine messaging pillars, tone of voice, and narrative frameworks that hold consistently across all channels and audiences
- Lead Cinch's media and PR presence; manage relationships with communications agencies and press contacts
- Partner with Product, CX, and Commercial teams to translate business milestones into timely, high-impact communications
Creative Direction
- Set and maintain the creative vision for Cinch across all brand touchpoints — digital, print, video, events, and presentations
- Lead the in-house team and external creative partners to deliver work that meets a consistently high standard
- Provide clear creative direction on all major briefs, ensuring quality and on-brand execution regardless of who produces the work
- Ensure visual and verbal consistency across everything Cinch produces
Brand Strategy
- Strengthen and evolve Cinch's brand identity — including visual language, brand guidelines, and messaging architecture
- Act as the internal brand custodian, setting the framework and maintaining final sign-off on creative output
- Build brand equity through consistent, well-executed communications — not just campaign moments
B2B Communications
- Drive communications for high-stakes B2B partnerships and commercial relationships, including fast-turnaround deliverables for regional and global partners
- Oversee business-facing materials: pitch decks, co-marketing assets, partner announcements, and thought leadership content
- Balance speed and quality in a high-pressure B2B environment where timelines are tight and stakes are high
Team Leadership & Operations
- Lead, develop, and grow a small in-house communications and creative team
- Bring in and manage external agencies and freelancers to supplement in-house capacity where needed
- Establish clear briefing processes, creative workflows, and quality standards across all output
- Manage the communications and creative budget effectively
What We're Looking For
Must-haves
- 8–12 years in communications, brand, or creative leadership — with meaningful experience on both strategy and execution
- A track record of elevating brand and communications in a high-growth environment (tech, fintech, marketplace, or consumer brand)
- Experience leading in-house teams while managing external agencies and freelancers in parallel
- Strong command of both B2C and B2B communications; comfortable shifting between consumer campaigns and business-critical partner materials
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills — you can produce a compelling brief, a polished announcement, and a persuasive pitch in the same week
- High creative judgment — you know what good looks like and can communicate it clearly enough that your team consistently delivers it
Nice-to-haves
- Experience strengthening or refreshing a brand identity, in-house or with an external agency
- Familiarity with the SEA media landscape and regional creative ecosystem
- Background in fintech, payments, or a related regulated industry
- Hands-on comfort with design tools (Figma, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite) — not required, but appreciated

Title: Head of Communications and PR, APAC
Description:
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About The Opportunity
We are seeking an exceptional, entrepreneurial Head of Communications for APAC. This person is a senior leader who will own and drive our regional communications strategy and execution while playing a pivotal role in global and regional PR initiatives. This is a high-impact role for someone who combines deep regional media relationships with an interest in and passion for the digital asset space.
We're looking for a builder: someone who's comfortable operating with autonomy, thrives in fast-moving environments, and knows how to convert communications strategy into measurable results.
Candidates based in Hong Kong, Singapore, and Australia are encouraged to apply. We operate with regional flexibility and a results-first culture. We care about impact, not where you sit.
What You’ll Be Doing
- Lead the development and execution of OKX's APAC communications strategy — setting direction, driving alignment, and delivering results across the region.
- Serve as the senior communications voice for APAC, partnering closely with marketing, product, legal, compliance, and local market leads.
- Build and lead a high-performing communications function, including managing PR agency relationships across the region.
- Leverage your deep network of media contacts across Australia, Singapore, and broader APAC — including tier-one business, broadcast, financial, and crypto media — to drive high-impact coverage.
- Cultivate and own relationships with editors, journalists, and influential industry voices across key APAC markets.
- Place compelling stories in top-tier general media and leading crypto publications, driving consistent coverage volume and quality.
- Act as an integral member of the global comms/PR team, contributing to worldwide initiatives and helping amplify global campaigns across APAC.
- Activate PR opportunities through OKX's global partnerships, including McLaren F1 Team and Manchester City Football Club, generating visibility across media and potential users.
- Write and oversee PR plans, press materials, executive messaging, and content for key announcements and initiatives.
- Ensure brand consistency and messaging discipline across all regional communications efforts.
- Track, report on, and actively influence media coverage to align with business objectives.
What We Look For In You
- 12–15 years of experience in PR and communications, with a strong background in financial services, fintech, or technology, crypto experience is preferred.
- Superior stakeholder management and presentation skills.
- Established media connections across APAC relationships across business, broadcast, financial, and crypto media.
- Proven track record running regional and global PR campaigns that generate significant, high-quality media coverage.
- Experience with investment and financial communications.
- An entrepreneurial mindset, you set ambitious targets, hold yourself accountable, and know how to get results in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
- Team management experience and the ability to lead, mentor, and inspire.
- Bachelor's degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, or a related field.
- Fluent in English; proficiency in other languages is an advantage.
Perks & Benefits
- Competitive total compensation package
- L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
- Various team building programs and company events
- Wellness and meal allowances
- Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
- More that we love to tell you along the process!
Notice
All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.
Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

Title: Head of Futures
Description:
Synthesis x Head of Futures
At Synthesis, we push the boundaries of what’s possible with Open Source Intelligence. It’s a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment vibrant with collaboration and creativity, at the intersection of data science, cultural analysis & brand consultancy (we call this HCDS: Human Centred Data Science!).
We are looking for people who are culturally curious and passionate about data storytelling.
We work with famous brands including Netflix, Nike, PepsiCo, 2K Games, Amazon Music, Pernod Ricard, Brown-Forman and Tetra Pak. Our team is nimble, diverse, and adaptable. Together we represent a variety of experiences – from computer science, digital anthropology, engineering, advertising, to gaming and law.
We will have a great working relationship if you...
Are comfortable with open-ended challenges, working collaboratively to find creative solutions
Are innately curious, interested in macro, consumer, cultural and category shifts
Have the drive to learn and innovate new technologies and methodologies
Have strong written and communication skills
The Head of Futures at Synthesis develops strategies, innovations and scenarios for the sharpest insights and marketing professionals in the world.
Your core focus:
Leading a business unit.
Working closely with the leadership team. You will have the freedom to guide and coach a multidisciplinary team of data scientists and strategists. This includes leading decisions on recruitment and financial planning. You will oversee multiple projects, ensuring efficient resourcing and high-quality output.
Business development:
Working together with the leadership team, you will play a crucial role in establishing and growing client partnerships with existing and new clients. This means writing proposals, pitching, helping design approaches for new and existing clients and brainstorming cross-sell ideas to grow clients across the business.
Commercial foresight storytelling:
You will craft persuasive, memorable data-driven narratives and scenarios around how people will live, work and play, and how businesses will operate and grow in the next 5-10 years, including translating words into experiences to bring the future to life, presenting confidently and persuasively to influence the next steps of senior stakeholders.
Trusted advisor for world-leading clients:
You will be the day-to-day lead and decision-maker. Your role will require you to deeply understand our client’s business, run projects end-to-end and have a ‘nose’ for what’s next through forward-looking insights and innovations that will be most useful and inspiring for their growth strategy.
You’ll need:
10+ years' experience working in trends and foresight, strategy and planning, management consultancy, or a related role. Foresight experience is an advantage.
Strong analytical skills: an ability to translate client requirements into data briefings with the data science team, confidently digest complex datasets, and process and layer different data outputs to build a complete picture of people, categories and themes in the next 5-10 years
Strong creativity and communication skills: extraordinary writing, visual storytelling, experience design and presentation skills to bring ideas to life
Strong interpersonal skills: a flexible thinker who thrives in positive, collaborative environments and can work under pressure. Naturally adopts a ‘plussing’ approach– pushes, questions and stretches thinking by adding, not criticising without suggestions
Openness and enjoyment of iteratively developing your ideas, drawing on the value of the diverse perspectives of those around you. You recognise the value of having an array of approaches at your disposal rather than focusing solely on one methodology or model.
Advantageous, but not required:
Experience working with Google Scholar and Google Patents as well as census, search, social, advertising & e-commerce data
Knowledge of quantitative, statistical and qualitative research techniques and analysis
About Working Here
We are a diverse team; we value creativity, a ‘plussing’ mindset and collaboration. To help create this, we offer flexible working and a supportive environment. This includes the following benefits:
Twice yearly, uncapped profit-share bonus scheme—so everyone is collectively rewarded for business success.
20 days paid holidays per annum + Public holidays + Whole company paid ‘reading week’ between Christmas and New Year.
10:00-15:00 core working hours for meetings, otherwise flexible working.
No meetings on Fridays, wherever possible, to secure Friday as a focus working day.
Opportunity to work remotely for up to 4 weeks per calendar year.
Performance Program to support continuous learning, including an annual conference or language-learning budget, time allocated for learning, and mentorship.
AIA health insurance and an extra SGD $1000 per annum for health and wellbeing.
Paid maternity and paternity leave
Synthesis is a data science-fuelled brand consultancy
We do Human Centred Data Science. The rigorous exploration of data underpinned by a strategic understanding of people, category and context
We use human understanding to ask better questions of the numbers. Our proprietary frameworks and algorithms are designed and tested by category experts to ensure we deliver fresh, smart and actionable output
Our team has experience across sectors, from beauty, to travel, FMCG and new media. We work globally and our tools work with all major languages, but we have special focus on Asia
We work on:
- Brand Equity & Positioning
- M&A and Portfolio Strategy
- Market & Target Understanding
- Advocacy & Influencer Strategy
- Early Trend Identification
- Service Experience Evolution
- Communications Strategy

Title: Head of Intermediary Marketing, HK & SEA
Description:
Job Description
Who we’re looking for
We are looking for a strategic, experienced and highly collaborative senior marketing leader to lead intermediary marketing across Hong Kong and South East Asia, with people management responsibilities across Hong Kong and Singapore. Based in Singapore and reporting to the Head of Marketing, Asia, this role will represent the broader Singapore marketing community and act as a key marketing contact for the Singapore entity.

Standard Chartered is uplifting the financial markets technology estate to a modern architecture to provide solid foundations for its business growth. The “Head of S2BX Engineering” is accountable for defining and delivering the end-to-end technology strategy, platforms and services that support Standard Chartered’s Straight2Bank Exchange (S2BX) - SCB's multi-asset electronic trading platform. This role is at Band 4 level (equivalent to Executive Director). The role leads the critical technology estate that delivers pricing, market connectivity and analytics for FX, NDF, MM, Precious metals & Digital Assets to external clients and Internal Sales & Trading across the SCB footprint.
The role provides senior technology, engineering and organisational leadership across a globally distributed S2BX Engineering organisation, partnering closely with Markets business, Product, Operations, Risk, Finance, Infrastructure and control functions to ensure that platform continues to lead low-latency pricing, execution, algorithmic trading capabilities and market making operations.
As a member of the ‘Markets Pricing, Connectivity & Analytics’ Engineering Team, the role balances strategic transformation with platform stability and service resilience, while driving simplification, modernisation, control uplift, cost discipline and execution excellence across the S2BX estate.
Key Responsibilities
Strategy
• Set and own the end-to-end technology strategy for S2BX Engineering, covering multi-asset trading, real-time pricing, execution algorithms, market making technology and client connectivity, ensuring platforms are ultra-low latency, highly scalable, well-controlled and aligned to Markets business priorities and regulatory obligations.
• Define and maintain a coherent S2BX technology roadmap, translating enterprise, Markets and client objectives into prioritised investments that balance platform modernisation, regulatory commitments, performance optimisation, service resilience and business growth.
• S2BX Core Platform – Responsible for the strategy, design, delivery and resilience of end-to-end technology capabilities across the trading platform estate, ensuring ultra-low latency execution, real-time risk management, strong data integrity, effective risk mitigation and scalable platforms that support global market making operations.
• Drive platform simplification, architectural consistency and reuse across the S2BX estate to reduce fragmentation, strengthen controls, improve performance and enhance long-term maintainability.
• Provide decisive leadership on material strategy, delivery or performance issues across S2BX platforms, making timely trade-offs and escalation decisions to protect trading continuity, client experience and execution quality
• Maintain a forward-looking modernisation roadmap that reduces technology obsolescence, improves execution performance, enhances algorithmic capabilities and ensures long-term supportability of mission-critical S2BX platforms.
• Drive a performance, control and resilience agenda across the software development lifecycle, reducing latency, improving execution integrity and delivering measurable improvements in trading performance and client outcomes.
AI & Innovation
• Provide senior leadership for AI engineering across S2BX platform, acting as an SME for AI-enabled software delivery across pricing, trading and automated risk management, ensuring consistent adoption of approved patterns, standards and secure delivery practices.
• Support innovation in algorithmic trading, client execution optimization and automated market making through advanced analytics, machine learning and AI-driven trading strategies
• Deliver tangible AI-enabled productivity gains and enhanced trading capabilities, translating innovation into measurable execution performance, client experience and operational outcomes
• Support business teams in understanding the 'art of the possible' for AI in electronic trading, supporting the design and delivery of coherent, scalable solutions that enable trading innovation and client differentiation.
Business
• Acts as a senior technology partner to Markets and client-facing leadership, shaping platform strategy, priorities and investment decisions in line with trading performance, client outcomes and competitive positioning.
• Promote a platform-led operating model across S2BX Engineering, building reusable and well-governed capabilities that support multi-asset trading, algorithmic execution and market making while reducing fragmentation and operational dependency.
• Lead investment planning, prioritisation and resource allocation for the S2BX estate, balancing strategic enhancement, performance optimization, platform health and service performance against agreed business and client priorities.
• Influence and challenge senior stakeholders across Business, Sales, Trading and Client Management to translate strategic and client requirements into high-performance platform outcomes.
• Oversee strategic vendor and third-party relationships across the S2BX estate to secure sustainable commercial, service, performance and risk outcomes across critical trading platforms and market data services.
Processes
• Ensure S2BX platforms operate with the highest standards of performance, availability and operational readiness, supporting time-critical trading, real-time pricing, algorithmic execution and market making workflows.
• Embed disciplined engineering, Agile and DevOps practices across the organisation, with particular focus on low-latency development, performance testing, controlled releases, real-time monitoring and operational resilience.
• Ensure compliance with defined engineering, testing and release disciplines, using automation and tooling to support efficient, repeatable and well-controlled execution of S2BX deliveries without impacting trading performance.
• Define and enforce engineering standards covering ultra-low latency development, real-time data processing, execution integrity, performance monitoring, disaster recovery and end-to-end controls across critical S2BX processes.
• Ensure S2BX platforms support regulatory compliance and supervisory expectations, including strong controls for trade reporting accuracy, best execution, client protection and data governance.
• Drive automation and industrialisation across S2BX processes to reduce manual intervention, improve execution efficiency and enhance trading performance at scale.
Risk Management
• Seek regular assurance that S2BX Engineering is operating to acceptable risk, control and performance standards, taking prompt action to address weaknesses and ensuring timely remediation of any trading or client impact
• Operational Resilience Capability - Strengthen service resilience, disaster recovery and operational integrity for time-critical, high-volume S2BX platforms through disciplined engineering and continuous performance improvement.
• Act quickly and decisively when performance, risk or control weaknesses become apparent, ensuring root-cause resolution, clear accountability and appropriate escalation through relevant governance forums.
• Balance business delivery, performance optimization and transformation objectives with risk and control requirements to ensure platform decisions remain within the Group's risk appetite while maintaining competitive execution quality.
People and Talent
• Set direction and drive high performance by translating strategy into clear direction, aligning individual goals to team outcomes and providing regular, constructive feedback.
• Develop talent and capability through coaching and career conversations that build critical skills, stretch potential and prepare individuals for future opportunities.
• Lead by example by role-modelling the Bank’s valued behaviours, upholding strong risk and conduct standards, exercising sound judgment, and creating an inclusive team culture that supports wellbeing, values diverse perspectives, and drives accountability.
• • Provides executive leadership for a large, globally distributed S2BX Engineering organisation, setting direction, standards and expectations across low-latency engineering, algorithmic development and mission-critical platform operations.
• Attract, retain and develop high-calibre engineering talent with expertise in C++14/17, Java, python, low-latency systems, network programming, distributed architectures and financial markets technology.
• Build and maintain strong leadership and engineering depth through effective talent development, succession planning and capability building across critical S2BX platforms and trading technologies.
• Build a diverse and inclusive organisation through inclusive hiring practices, objective talent decisions and an environment where different perspectives drive innovation in trading technology.
• Lead through example, setting the tone for a culture of engineering excellence, performance optimization, collaboration and constructive partnership with trading and client-facing teams.
• Ensure ongoing development of technical and domain capabilities across the organisation, including low-latency programming, algorithmic trading, market microstructure, DevOps, cloud and engineering excellence.
Qualifications
Key Experiences
• Extensive senior leadership experience within Global Markets Technology, with deep expertise in areas such as FX, Electronic Trading, Market Pricing, Connectivity, Execution Platforms, Market Data, and Analytics.
• Proven track record of leading large, globally distributed engineering organisations, driving strategic transformation initiatives, and delivering mission-critical, control-sensitive technology services that operate at scale.
• Demonstrated ability to shape and execute technology strategy, platform modernisation, and engineering excellence agendas, balancing innovation, resilience, regulatory requirements, and business growth objectives.
• Strong domain expertise in building and operating high-performance, low-latency trading platforms, with experience across pricing, execution, risk management, market connectivity, and client-facing trading capabilities.
• Recognised leader in driving modern engineering practices, cloud adoption, AI-enabled development, platform simplification, automation, and operational resilience across complex enterprise environments.
C ertifications / Qualifications

Title: Head, Brand
Description:
Overview
The Head of Brand is a senior role sitting at the heart of The Kallang Group’s Brand, Marketing, Communications and Digital team. You will work closely and directly with the Group Head of Brand, Marketing, Communications and Digital, as the brand guardian and custodian of The Kallang Group.
We are looking for a visionary, high-energy Head of Brand to lead the evolution of The Kallang as the "excitement epicentre." Following our rebrand from the Singapore Sports Hub, this role sits at the heart of our shift into a world-class curator of the global experience economy.
As the Head of Brand, you will be the Brand Guardian for The Kallang. You will own the long-term brand strategy, define our brand architecture, and drive initiatives that build deep brand love and long-term equity.
Leading a team of passionate marketers, you will translate consumer insights into high-impact campaigns, cultivate strategic marketing partnerships, and manage agency ecosystems to deliver world-class brand experiences. You will ensure absolute consistency across all touchpoints while collaborating cross-functionally to drive commercial growth and brand loyalty.
Key Responsibilities:
Brand stewardship and architecture
- Brand Guardian: Custodian of the brand identity, ensuring all visual assets, tone of voice, and messaging remain consistent across all physical and digital touchpoints.
- Brand Strategy and Architecture: Define, evolve, and execute a comprehensive brand strategy and architecture.
- Brand love and equity Building: Design and scale long-term positioning frameworks that elevate brand affinity, driving The Kallang from a physical destination to an iconic, emotionally resonant brand.
Brand health and consumer insights measurement
- Brand health tracking: Work with agencies to measure and identify approach on growing brand health.
- User Insights Understanding: Partner with data and research teams to analyse consumer behaviours, market trends, and audience sentiment to unearth actionable insights that feed into creative briefs.
Campaign execution
- Campaign and Activation Management: Concept and oversee end-to-end multi-channel branding campaigns, experiential activations, and cultural events that maximize earned media and drive foot traffic.
Partnerships and ecosystem management
- Marketing Partnerships: Working hand in hand with commercial partnerships team to identify, negotiate, and execute strategic, co-branded partnerships with global brands, local community leaders, and government stakeholders to amplify brand reach.
- Agency Management: Appoint, evaluate, and manage creative and experiential agencies, fostering an environment of collaborative excellence and ensuring top-tier deliverable standards.
Operations and leadership
- Budget Management: Own and optimize the brand marketing budget, ensuring maximum ROI, cost efficiency, and strategic resource allocation across all campaigns.
- Cross-Team Collaboration: Foster close collaboration with Commercial, Operations, PR, Digital, Marketing and Events teams to align the brand's narrative with broader business objectives.
- Team Leadership: Mentor and develop a high-performing brand marketing team, nurturing internal talent and promoting a culture of creativity, accountability, and bold thinking.
Leadership Expectations
- Strong ability to influence, able to align teams, agencies, and senior stakeholders through credibility and clarity rather than hierarchy.
- Manages up and across effectively, comfortable engaging C-suite stakeholders and navigating organisational dynamics with maturity and discretion.
- Communicates with precision, translates complexity into clear recommendations, whether in a deck, a brief, or a room.
- Brings calm to ambiguity, takes unclear or fast-moving situations and creates structure, momentum, and direction.
- Earns trust quickly, builds strong working relationships across functions and levels, and is relied upon to deliver.
Requirements:
- Minimum 12 years of marketing experience, with a track record in both strategy, planning and execution.
- Relevant experience and expertise across brand, customer insights, social and CRM. Performance marketing knowledge is a plus but not critical to the role.
- Strong commercial mindset; understands how marketing connects to revenue, audience growth, and long-term brand equity.
- Sharp problem-solving instincts, moves quickly from diagnosis to recommendation to action.
- Experience in live entertainment, sports, hospitality, or experience-economy sectors is an advantage.

Description
As an Insight Consultant, you are determined to activate change for great brands through a passion for data and consumer insights. You are project driven and can manage your time and workload independently, but equally you love to collaborate in teams to reach the best result.
Initially, your focus is on data analysis and reporting, but you are eager to learn and develop expertise in quantitative and/or qualitative research methods across full projects in Southeast Asia.
Key Responsibilities
Project Management
- You assist in the planning, setting up and management of online research projects, either supporting or being supported by more senior colleagues.
- You have a good enough understanding of the research process at Human8 to manage a simple project.
- You collaborate well with and act as a liaison for PST.
Activity Design
- You attend activity design meetings and brainstorms.
Fieldwork
- You grow your moderating experience on 1on1 interviews and group discussions ( both synchronous and asynchronous).
- You can brief external moderators
- You can check the status of survey fieldwork and communicate it internally.
Analysis And Reporting (primary Focus In This Role)
- You can analyse, interpret and report on the findings of most research projects (except for very complex projects)
- You can provide draft conclusions and recommendations for review by a more senior consultant.
- You can interpret an analysis plan and use it as a base to collaborate with others (e.g. PST, external moderator, etc.) when relevant.
- You listen with an open mind to colleague's feedback on your work.
Presenting
- You grow experience by presenting internally (e.g. team meetings)
- You attend client presentations and can answer questions that relate to your analyses.
Account Management
- You gain experience and exposure to clients by supporting more senior consultants with project related tasks and communications.
Commercial Management
- You follow our marketing content for own interest and to develop your knowledge about our offering.
- You are building your social professional profile and becoming an active networker.
- You can pitch your role naturally and what impact it has on your clients, to a friend/family member.
- You are aware of the commercial objectives and targets of your team.
- You are aware and understand the budget build-up of projects where you have an active role.
Skills, Knowledge & Expertise
- A bachelor's degree in relevant field (e.g., social sciences, psychology, business, or economics).
- Curiosity and Eagerness: A desire to learn and explore.
- Attention to Detail: Carefully handle data and research materials.

Title: Integrated Marketing Operation Manager - Global Payment
Description:
Responsibilities
Team Introduction
The Global Payment team of Bytedance provides payment solutions - including payment acquisitions, disbursements, transaction monitoring, payment method management, foreign exchange conversion, accounting, reconciliations, and so on to ensure that our users have a smooth and secure payment experience on ByteDance platforms including TikTok.
In line with the globalization strategy and vision of the company, the Global Payment team builds a platform to provide cross-border payment solutions for all ByteDance's products and services, that are growing rapidly worldwide. This is an exciting opportunity to make an impact on global scale across all ByteDance's business use cases.
Responsibilities
1. Based on industry/market/user insights and considering the characteristics of global e-commerce, analyze and develop long-term campaign plans, including key milestones, hotspots, major promotions, etc. Design integrated marketing strategies and approaches for international credit payment services (BNPL) to enhance core metrics such as BNPL's GMV.
2. Build an operational system that serves the lifecycle of user segments for BNPL, including user acquisition and user engagement, tailored to specific scenarios. Drive the establishment of touchpoints, marketing tools, and marketing benefits repository to improve business conversion efficiency.
3. Monitor and attribute the progress and effectiveness of existing traffic touchpoints and daily operational activities. Expand collaboration opportunities with internal and external partners to acquire additional traffic sources. Collaborate with marketing teams to implement new growth strategies and initiatives.
This role will be based onsite at our office and will require a 5-day onsite work arrangement.
Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
1. Bachelor's degree or above, with 3 years and above work experience in user growth operations or integrated marketing operations in the BNPL payment or e-commerce industry.
2. Clear logical thinking, strong business acumen, self-driven with a goal-oriented mindset, team player with the ability to actively drive business collaborations.
3. Ability to independently manage projects, strong skills in program design and data sensitivity, excellent resource integration capabilities.
4. Excellent communication and negotiation skills, ability to collaborate across departments, passionate, creative, and responsible, with personal insights and experience in marketing strategies.
5. Proficiency in data analysis, ability to identify and solve problems through the analysis and synthesis of various operational data.
Preferred Qualification
- Over 1 year of relevant experience in managing a team.
About Us
Founded in 2012, ByteDance's mission is to inspire creativity and enrich life. With a suite of more than a dozen products, including TikTok, Lemon8, CapCut and Pico as well as platforms specific to the China market, including Toutiao, Douyin, and Xigua, ByteDance has made it easier and more fun for people to connect with, consume, and create content.​
Why Join ByteDance
Inspiring creativity is at the core of ByteDance's mission. Our innovative products are built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and enrich life - a mission we work towards every day.​
As ByteDancers, we strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our Company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
Diversity & Inclusion​
ByteDance is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At ByteDance, our mission is to inspire creativity and enrich life. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​
