Title: International Graduate Program (IGP) - Automotive Marketing Engineer
Description:
As an Automotive Marketing Engineer IGP, you will be responsible for automotive applications and product lines.
Are you ready to accelerate your career with a global leader in the tech industry? As a pioneer in semiconductor solutions, Infineon invites you to join us enabling the shift towards a carbon-neutral world, empowering a connected and sustainable future. The International Graduate Program (IGP) at Infineon is a unique opportunity to fast-track your development and become a future expert in your field. Over 18 months, you'll embark on a journey that takes you to at least three different assignments at three different departments, including one abroad. As a global company with a local presence, Infineon offers a unique blend of international collaboration and regional expertise which you’ll become part of. This program is designed to give you a deep understanding of our company, its operations, and yourself as well, given you’ll become aware of what are your strengths and weaknesses by working on different departments.
Your Role
Key responsibilities in your new role
- Product Management: Be responsible for automotive applications and product lines
- Market Strategy: Understand automotive application requirements in Asia Pacific in order to align with Infineon's global Go-To-Market (G2M) strategy and drive it regionally
- Stakeholder Management: Be responsible for communicating and aligning with different functions, product lines
- Market Intelligence: Learn and understand current and future automotive market trends
- Pricing Strategy: Develop and evaluate pricing strategies and structures for Asia Pacific region
- Brand Management: Design, develop and implement communication programs to advertise Infineon products/brand/services using media (e.g. print, broadcast, digital, events, and sales promotions)
Your program consists of the following elements (to be confirmed):
- Automotive Marketing - Singapore
- Strategy Merger & Acquisitions - Singapore
- Product Marketing - Munich
Your Profile
Qualifications And Skills To Help You Succeed
- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronic Engineering
- Technical Background: Less than 3 years work experience, entry level candidates with interest in Engineering are welcome to apply
- Analytical Thinking: Strong data skills to apply them to create overall Regional Strategy
- Communication: Clear and concise communicator to guide and enable Field Application Engineer and Account Manager with product based G2M collaterals
- Positive Attitude: Proactive, self-motivated and eager to learn
- Adaptability: Thrive in an agile working environment, adapt to changing priorities
- Team Collaboration: Work closely together and contribute effectively within a team environment
- Language: Speak and write fluent English

Title: International PR & Content | Marketing (Senior) Manager
Description:
Location: Hong Kong / Singapore / Remote (International / Global)
About the Role
We are seeking an energetic, strategically minded Marketing Business Partner (Manager / Senior Manager grade) to drive OSL’s brand awareness, PR presence, and content-led pipeline expansion across international and developed markets (Europe, North America, and key global hubs). Operating as OSL’s primary content storyteller and brand catalyst internationally, you will translate complex PayFi and cross-border payment innovations into high-impact market messaging.
In this role, you will lead our English-first content strategy, direct international PR agency partners, and leverage high-profile media collaborations to build enterprise domain authority. While your core focus is high-impact written content, PR, and brand messaging, you will also support field marketing initiatives and offline event execution—including owned flagship events at major global gatherings.
Currently structured as a hands-on Individual Contributor role, this position offers immediate strategic ownership with long-term growth potential. As our international operations expand, the role is positioned to evolve to include people management responsibilities and driving cross-functional output through central shared service centers and matrixed contributors.
Key Responsibilities
- International Content Strategy & Execution: Plan, write, and publish high-caliber English B2B content—including whitepapers, deep-dive articles, enterprise case studies, and executive thought leadership—tailored to international corporate decision-makers and financial institutions.
- PR Agency & Tier-1 Media Management: Manage external international PR agencies across target regions to amplify brand reach cost-effectively. Drive tier-1 media placements, executive interview opportunities (e.g., CNBC), and strategic content distribution via partners like The Block.
- Executive Presence & Conference Strategy: Coordinate high-impact speaking slots and panel opportunities for OSL leadership at major global summits to establish the firm as a premier PayFi and regulated digital asset partner.
- Pipeline Foundation & Budget Scaling: Establish the client pipeline and content foundation in Q4 to prepare for strategic budget scaling and campaign deployment in Q1. Ensure content and PR directly feed top-of-funnel enterprise lead generation.
- Field Marketing & Flagship Event Support: Provide field marketing support for global roadshows, webinars, and partner salons. Co-lead the planning and execution of OSL’s owned flagship side-event during Hong Kong Fintech Week next year.
- Ecosystem Partnerships & Co-Marketing: Collaborate with key industry platforms, media channels, and ecosystem partners to negotiate co-marketing initiatives, build platform-level endorsements, and expand brand authority.
- Competitive Benchmarking & Positioning: Continuously benchmark OSL’s value proposition against traditional and emerging international payment and crypto infrastructure providers to refine brand narrative and positioning.
Requirements & Qualifications
- 5+ years of B2B content marketing, PR, or brand marketing experience targeting international/developed markets. Background in Web3/Crypto, Fintech, Enterprise SaaS, or Payments is preferred.
- Native or near-native English copywriting and editing skills, with a proven portfolio of B2B technical narratives, thought leadership, and PR copy for executive audiences.
- Proven experience managing international PR agencies and securing placements or executive interviews in tier-1 financial and tech media outlets.
- A self-starter capable of taking full ownership from high-level campaign conceptualization through execution as a high-impact IC, with the capability to scale into people management or lead shared-service resources in the future.
- Experience supporting offline industry events, webinars, or commercial roadshows.
- Self-motivated and comfortable collaborating across global time zones.
- Fluent/Native English is required. Mandarin is a plus (good to have), but not required.
- Deep payment experience is a plus (good to have), but not mandatory—ability to quickly master cross-border payment mechanics, stablecoins, and PayFi is required.
About OSL
- OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.

With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Description:
Investment Research & Portfolio Management
Conduct fundamental research and valuation across equities, fixed income, credit and ETFs, including companies, sectors, macro and external funds.
Prepare investment proposals and Investment Committee papers
Support portfolio construction, asset allocation and position sizing and coordinate trade execution with brokers.

Investor Engagement
Support fund-raising and investor meetings, presenting portfolio positioning, performance and market views.
Prepare investor presentations, commentaries and due-diligence questionnaires responses using approved information.
Work with Investor Relations on capital-raising; refer advice, suitability and complaints to authorised personnel.

Apply data analytics, automation and AI-enabled research tools, with source verification, data security and human review.

Governance & Decision-Making
Make investment recommendations; decisions are approved by the Head of Portfolio Management and/or Investment Committee
Coordinate fund operations without authority to approve NAVs, valuations of recommended positions, payments or onboarding — these sit with independent authorised signatories.
Comply with compliance, personal-account dealing, conflicts-of-interest and confidentiality policies; use AI only within approved governance policies.

Title: Investment Performance Analysis, Senior Associate
Description:
Who we are looking for
We are looking for an exceptional individual to become our Client Manager within the AOPM (Asset Owner Private Market) business unit of State Street servicing our APAC client. The Client Manager interacts with all levels of professionals both internally & externally. Therefore, exceptional interpersonal and communication skills are required. Candidates must demonstrate initiative, be able to perform well under pressure and simultaneously handle multiple assignments. AOPM business provides document management, cash management, valuation, look through and transparency services, as well as performance & analytics reporting in addition to day-to-day accounting and administration service, in alternative investments space. Experience in any or all of the above areas is preferred.
Why this role is important to us
The team you will be joining is a part of Specialized Services and Investment Analytics (SSIA). Our offering is a recognized industry-leading provider of analytics, portfolio valuation, fund administration and risk services on private equity portfolio. These services are fully integrated to provide complete end-to-end solutions that span the front-, middle- and back-office requirements of institutional investors.
Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.
What you will be responsible for
As a Client Service Manager (AOPM) , you'll be:
Primary client touch point for State Street Private Market Solution on the assigned client
Manage client expectations with both designated client contacts and their vendors.
Manage internal workflow to ensure our client request and service level agreement are met, and play a governance role on client deliverables.
Review and/or prepare of various client related correspondence.
Maintain working relationship with all client contacts, including investment professionals, investors, auditors, lawyers and banking personnel.
Participate in special client or internal projects as required.
Lead and represent business area as a domain expert to provide sales support (e.g. client presentation) , client discussion and prospect client matters.
Education & Preferred Qualifications
Candidate must have a college degree (business, mathematics, finance or economics preferred, accounting concentration a plus) and at least 3-5 years of experience, including 1 to 3 years of independent accounting / P&A / financial reporting experience is required.
Client service experience with institutional clients is preferable.
Experience in the private equity/real estate industry is preferable.
Strong interpersonal skills, positive, can-do attitude, meticulous are essential.
Strong computer skills are required, especially Microsoft Office, particularly MS Excel.
About State Street
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

An international team (French, British, German, Polish, Canadian, US, Japanese) with complementary backgrounds across investment, medical, scientific, strategic and operational disciplines.
Alumni of INSEAD, Berkeley, Georgetown, Bocconi, HEC Paris, École des Ponts ParisTech, ESSEC, Imperial College and Dartmouth, among others.

Reporting to the Head of Investor Relations, the Director of Investor Relations will play a leadership role in the strategic direction and execution of ARCHIMED's global capital formation and LP engagement efforts. Oversee the operation of the firm's IR program, including quarterly and annual fund and co-investment reporting in partnership with Finance, Impact and Investment Teams.

Lead the planning and delivery of the Investor AGM and other flagship LP events in close coordination with the Communications team.
Mentor and develop junior IR team members and contribute to the build-out of the function as the platform grows.
CO-INVESTMENTS, GP-LED SECONDARIES AND STRATEGIC VEHICLES
Drive the firm's co-investment program with existing LPs and the broader institutional community, working alongside deal teams to syndicate opportunities efficiently and on favorable terms.
Contribute to the strategic evolution of ARCHIMED's fund platform by structuring and leading GP-led secondaries, continuation vehicles and other bespoke capital solutions where appropriate.

Strong financial acumen. Fluency with fund structuring, LPA terms, performance metrics (gross and net IRR, TVPI, DPI, PME), portfolio analytics and the quantitative diligence expected by sophisticated LPs.

A strong production mindset — the ability to work under pressure, adapt quickly, troubleshoot problems, and work effectively with other departments — is essential.

Title: Junior Content Creator, We. Studio
Description:
Purpose of the Position:
You sit in We. Studio but spend most of your time with the Brand Content & Commerce team, working our consumer growth portfolio. Think travel, tourism, hospitality. Brands that live and die on social. You make thumb-stopping content that gets people to stop, watch, and act.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Make content that connects
You concept, produce, and post-produce. Static or video, you take an idea from a scribble to something live on feed. You're fluent in CapCut, TikTok Symphony, and platform-native editing tools. You can write the copy too, because a great video with a flat caption is a wasted post. Editing, motion graphics, colour grading, and audio mixing (After Effects, Premiere, DaVinci, or similar) are a real plus.
Turn ideas into content people share
You're in the room when ideas start. You take a brief, a trend, or a random spark and turn it into something worth making. You think in formats and hooks, not just visuals. You know the difference between content that's fine and content people actually send to their friends.
Run the community, not just the calendar
You post, schedule, and stay close to the comments. You reply, you jump on the right moments, and you know when to hijack a trend versus when to sit one out. You treat the community like a live thing, because it is.
Live on-platform
You already know what's working this week because you're on the apps for fun, not just for work. You bring that instinct into the room. New tools, new formats, new ways of doing things. You help build the kind of portfolio that makes people ask how we did it.
Co-create with AI
You use AI as part of how you make things, not as an afterthought. Higgsfield or similar for video generation, Midjourney, Gemini, Google Stitch or ChatGPT for image. You experiment, you find what's usable, and you fold the good stuff into your workflow. You're not precious about trying something new and binning it if it doesn't land.
QUALIFICATIONS:
- A Diploma or Bachelor's in Film, Media Production, Digital Arts, Communications, Marketing, or a related field. Or a portfolio strong enough.
- 0–2 years in content creation, social, or video. Strong fresh graduates are warmly welcomed.
- Comfortable with CapCut, TikTok Symphony, and platform-native editing. Working knowledge of Premiere Pro or After Effects is a plus, not a must.
- A portfolio or set of live socials that shows you can make content people actually watch and share. Early stage is fine; we care about instinct.
- You can write. Social copy, captions, hooks. You know words carry the post as much as the visuals.
- You live on the platforms. You know what's trending, what's dying, and when to jump on a moment.
- Some exposure to motion graphics, colour grading, or sound design is a bonus.
- Curious about AI creative tools (Higgsfield, Midjourney, ChatGPT and the like) and keen to build them into how you work.
- Sharp attention to detail and able to juggle multiple projects without dropping any.
- A collaborative spirit and clear communication. You'll be client-facing, so this matters.
- Comfortable in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.

You sit right at the heart of our commercial engine. You are an encouraging leader who is excited to step up and develop talent, as well as a relentless advocate for the F&B industry. You genuinely love food, understand the hustle of running a kitchen, and thrive on walking into a restaurant, sitting down with owners, chefs, and decision-makers, and building lasting, trust-based partnerships that unlock sustainable mutual growth.
Team Vision
Champion Restaurant Success & Food Culture: Act as the voice of our restaurant partners. We don’t just manage accounts; we partner with culinary visionaries, local favorites, and household brands to help their businesses flourish.
Empower & Elevate People: Build a collaborative, high-energy coaching culture where Account Managers are mentored to reach their peak potential and take pride in their craft.

People Leadership & Team Enablement
Lead and Mentor: Guide, coach, and support a team of Account Managers, fostering a culture of ownership, curiosity, and high performance.

Talent Development: Conduct regular 1-on-1s, support individual career growth paths, resolve day-to-day escalations, and participate in hiring and onboarding future team members.
Relationship Building & Partner Advocacy

Commercial Dialogues & Escalations: Step in on key partner discussions, including joint brand promotions, POS integrations, commission frameworks, and contract renewals.
Partner Voice: Advocate fiercely for merchant needs internally, collaborating cross-functionally with Product, Operations, Marketing, and Logistics to resolve operational pain points.

Business Reviews & Planning: Guide the execution of Joint Business Plans (JBPs) and Business Reviews with key partners to forecast revenue, set growth milestones, and align promotional calendars.
Growth Campaigns & Deals: Support your team in co-creating high-performing commercial campaigns, exclusive offerings, and curated vendor deals that delight foodies and maximize vendor profitability.
Data-Driven Advisory: Translate platform analytics into clear commercial narratives, consulting partners on order trends, basket sizes, pricing architecture, and customer retention.
Operational Agility & Process Optimization
Streamline Best Practices: Standardize AM workflows, SOPs, and reporting routines to minimize administrative friction and free up time for strategic partner touchpoints.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with commercial ops, legal, and finance to ensure smooth contract management, incentive payouts, and billing processes.

Title: Loyalty Lead
Description:
Job Purpose:
The Loyalty Lead owns the Guardian membership proposition in Singapore and is accountable for growing the identified customer base, member sales penetration and the commercial value the programme returns to the business across Guardian stores, the Guardian app, online and brand-specific programmes such as GNC Rewards.
Reporting to the Marketing Director, the role owns the loyalty proposition end to end — from member strategy, value proposition, pricing, rewards and lifecycle engagement through to programme economics, personalisation, platform capability to and in-store execution. The role holds an agreed annual target for member penetration, member sales and net programme contribution.
The role will build the capabilities, customer data and operating model required for Guardian loyalty programme. This includes translating customer insight and commercial priorities into a differentiated member proposition that drives frequency, retention, customer value and profitable growth.
Leading a team spanning programme strategy, CRM and campaign operations, analytics and partnerships, and works closely with Commercial, Retail Media, Digital, Technology, Finance and Store Operations to turn first-party customer data into relevant member value, supplier-funded income and incremental sales and margin.
Main Duties and Responsibilities:
Loyalty Strategy and Digital Growth
- Own the Guardian Singapore loyalty strategy and multi-year roadmap, aligned with the overall business and customer growth strategy.
- Deliver annual targets for member acquisition, active members, member sales penetration, transaction penetration, frequency, retention and customer value.
- Own the acquisition engine across every touchpoint — point of sale, app, online, services and brand programmes — and hold identification rate as a tracked operating metric.
- Build the activation, retention, reactivation and win-back agenda for different customer value segments.
- Develop customer segmentation and value frameworks to identify priority customer groups, growth opportunities and differentiated engagement strategies.
- Benchmark competing health & beauty, and other high-frequency cross category loyalty programmes and translate relevant learnings into a prioritised design and investment list.
Member Proposition & Lifecycle Engagement
- Design the member benefits, including member pricing tiers, points and voucher mechanics, birthday and milestone rewards, and wellness benefits.
- Own the lifecycle journey framework - welcome, onboarding, replenishment, cross-category engagement, birthday, lapsed and win-back
- Own the calendar of member-exclusive campaigns and activations
- Set reward and redemption rules, validity, exclusions and reversal logic, ensuring mechanics are scalable and configurable.
- Own member communications across app, email, SMS and relevant in-store touchpoints, ensuring relevance, frequency discipline and consistent brand experience.
- Establish a structured test and learn programme across mechanics, offers and creative, refining them against sales and margin data.
Programme Economics & Commercial Performance
- Own the loyalty P&L, balancing issuance cost, redemption rate, reward and voucher funding, platform and operating cost against member sales and margin delivered.
- Maintain the programme economics model, including reward cost, redemption, breakage, points liability, funded value ceilings and programme contribution.
- Set clear return thresholds for loyalty investment and reallocate reward investment away from activities that does not pay back.
- Secure supplier funding for member offers and pricing in partnership with Commercial, and track funding claimed and received.
- Prepare business cases, budget submissions and investment approvals for loyalty capabilities and campaigns, with clear assumptions and measurable expected returns
Data, Personalisation & Monetisation
- Provide thought leadership on digital trends, tools, and emerging technologies relevant to retail and omnichannel marketing
- Own the member data agenda with H&B Format and Group Technology Team
- Drive segmentation, RFM and lifetime value models and next-best-offer logic.
- Drive personalised offers and recommendations at scale, and report the incremental sales and margin attributable to it.
- Enrich the customer view with wellness services, pharmacy and digital behaviour data, within consent and privacy requirements.

The Voyage Global Leadership Development Program
Voyage: Training tomorrow’s leaders today
Marriott International welcomes recent university graduates to experience the career development adventure of a lifetime and a world of leadership opportunities. Voyage is a full-time, paid development program. As an associate and trainee, you’ll build upon the skills you developed in school by participating in real world assignments.
About the journey
Voyage is an elite, award-winning program that provides a combination of hands-on, discipline-specific training and a leadership-focused curriculum. The program takes place at a Marriott International managed hotel, not a classroom, and is offered in 50+ countries. Voyage is available in the following disciplines:
Accounting & Finance

Engineering

Event Planning
Food & Beverage Operations
Human Resources
Revenue Management
Rooms Operations
Sales & Marketing
Information Technology
Residences
When you join Voyage, you gain access to Marriott’s senior leaders and coaches and have many opportunities to stand out. You’ll participate in mini-rotations across the disciplines to learn firsthand how to manage various hotel functions and to connect with current and former Voyage participants through our social collaboration tools. Voyage is a 18 months full-time program. You’ll immediately be immersed in our rich culture and portfolio of global brands to learn how Marriott sets the standard of industry excellence.

Voyage participants learn by doing! You’ll be fully immersed in the day-to-day operations of a hotel. If accepted into this elite program, you will:
Cultivate customer relationships

Take on special projects that will draw upon all your training

You will also have an opportunity to provide feedback on your curriculum and have an impact on future Voyage hires’ experiences. with architects/tech leads, ensuring work is decomposed, estimable, and appropriately staged (MVP, phased rollout).

to ensure test strategies, quality gates, and non-functional requirements (performance, security, reliability) are embedded in plans.
Support DevOps enablement
by aligning delivery plans with CI/CD, environment provisioning, feature flagging, and deployment automation needs.
Promote operational excellence practices
(observability readiness, incident learnings, SLO/SLA alignment) for production-bound changes.

Description:
Our Purpose

Title and Summary
Manager, Business Development & Cloud Partnerships Enablement APAC
Overview:
Mastercard Services is building a cloud channel to distribute its ISV and SaaS products through the hyperscalers. AWS is the priority, followed by Microsoft Azure, Alibaba Cloud, and others across Asia Pacific. The priority products are in MarTech (Dynamic Yield personalisation) and cybersecurity (Recorded Future threat intelligence).
As Partner Enablement Manager, reporting to Director, Cloud Partnerships APAC, you will make sure hyperscaler sellers understand what Mastercard brings and why it matters to their customers. You will also make sure Mastercard's own sellers know how to work with the hyperscalers instead of around them. Everything you build should lead to registered opportunities, co-sell activity and revenue through cloud channels.
Role/Responsibilities:
• Hyperscaler Enablement: Getting Cloud Partners Ready to Sell Mastercard
o Design and deliver enablement programs for hyperscaler field teams (account managers, partner managers, solutions architects and marketplace specialists) on Mastercard Services products.
o Build role-based content that gives partner sellers a reason to bring Mastercard into their accounts: value propositions, customer use cases, discovery questions, joint sales plays and objection handling.
o Work with hyperscaler partner teams to plug Mastercard content into their own internal enablement channels and seller programs.
o Support marketplace readiness, including listing content, private offer mechanics and collateral that explains how customers can buy Mastercard solutions through the marketplace and their cloud commitments.
o Localise enablement for APAC markets (e.g. Japan, Australia, Singapore, Southeast Asia), adjusting for language, regulation and how local field teams operate.
o Assist in field marketing activities (e.g. staff a trade show booth, deliver sales presentations, etc.)
• Internal Enablement: Helping Mastercard's Field Win with Hyperscalers
o Equip Mastercard sellers, solution specialists and account teams to co-sell with the hyperscalers confidently.
o Build "How to Win with Cloud Partners" resources covering account mapping, opportunity registration, co-sell programs (e.g. AWS ACE and ISV Accelerate) and marketplace transactions.
o Develop and run the account mapping process between Mastercard and hyperscaler sales teams, from preparation and joint prioritisation through to follow-through. This includes working with Legal and Compliance on what can be shared and when.
o Run regular internal sessions on partner engagement models, deal registration, co-marketing funds and how marketplace deals affect revenue and attribution.
o Act as the go-between for the Mastercard field and the cloud partnerships team, making sure sellers know who to call and when.
• Programs, Content and Operations
o Own the cloud partner enablement library: co-sell decks, battlecards, sales plays, case studies and FAQs, kept current and easy to find.
o Work with Product Marketing and product teams to turn launches and messaging into partner-ready materials quickly.
o Coordinate partner-facing events, workshops and seller enablement days with hyperscaler field teams, including using MDF where it's available.
o Track and manage enablement deliverables across products and markets, and keep stakeholders informed without burying them in status reports.
• Measuring Impact
o Track enablement KPIs and connect them to commercial outcomes: sellers enabled, opportunities registered, co-sell engagement, marketplace transactions and partner-sourced pipeline.
o Use pipeline data, win/loss insights and field feedback to find gaps and improve programs.
o Feed partner and market insights back to Sales, Product and Marketing.
Experience:
• 3+ years in partner enablement, channel enablement or partner programs at a SaaS, cloud or technology company.
• A track record of building scalable partner and internal sales enablement programs tied to pipeline and revenue, not just content production.
• Experience building or supporting account mapping and joint pipeline processes between a vendor's field team and partner sales organisations.
• Strong programme and project management skills, with several workstreams across markets running at once.
• A data-driven approach: you measure what you do and drop what doesn't work.
• Highly Preferred: Hands-on experience with at least one major hyperscaler partner program (AWS strongly preferred), including co-sell mechanics, opportunity registration and marketplace listings.

• You're comfortable with ambiguity and like building things as you go.
• You can explain a complex product simply enough that a busy hyperscaler seller will remember it on a customer call.
• You build credibility quickly with external partners and internal field teams, and you influence people without having authority over them.

Description:
Job Title
Manager, Market Enablement, Protection, India (24 months contract in Singapore)
Job Description
The Role
This role is crucial in supporting our India Market Client Solutions Sales team by producing high-quality materials and effectively managing internal processes. This role directly contributes to our ability to win new business, strengthen relationships with existing clients and deliver on our wider Protection strategy.
While the position doesn’t direct client ownership, it is instrumental in ensuring we execute our client strategies successfully and may be required to engage with client reinsurance owners to support delivery of agreed quotations.
The person in this role will work closely with colleagues across the India Market and Global Client Solutions teams, helping to align efforts and maintain momentum across initiatives. The ability to work cross-functionally and build strong internal relationships will be key to delivering meaningful outcomes.
This is a collaborative and hands-on role that provides the opportunity to contribute to proposition innovation, collaborate across functions and support the delivery of strategic priorities across the region.
Duties
1. Close collaboration with the India Market Client Solutions Sales team to create assets which empower them to build a strong deal pipeline and achieve growth targets. Produce engaging, informative and compelling assets which showcase the value of our services and partnership and position our brand effectively
Creating best-in-class client communication that meet client requirements and demonstrate our capabilities. For example, developing visually appealing, creative solution decks that highlight our USPs and effectively communicate our value proposition and plans to clients – collaborating with the Marketing team on look and feel if appropriate.
Assisting in preparing for client meetings and presentations, ensuring all materials are tailored to the specific needs and preferences of the audience.
2. Strategic Analytics representatives, to ensure alignment and timely client delivery of new business and in-force initiatives.
Overall deal management for new business tenders, in-force business, and other projects required by the business. Initially, this will primarily involve managing internal stakeholders and will include client-facing components.
Supporting delivery of client plans and deliverables, including developing solutions, tracking and following up actions. [For example, in-force management for clients would include working on reinstatement requests, product changes, and ad hoc client requests.]
Ownership for the delivery of internal deliverables or projects.
3. Coordinating the completion of non-standard client-related tasks, as appropriate (e.g. risk assessments, governance requirements etc).
Proactive stakeholder engagement and management. Ensuring there is a high degree of collaboration and accountability within deal teams.
Producing draft treaty and addenda, taking this through to execution in a timely manner, and ensuring all governance is followed
4. Own Client Solutions for the India Market delivery of internal processes and reporting related to new business
Supporting quarterly new business reporting by working closely with DBS.
Generating ad hoc MI, as required, to review performance of pipeline and new business growth opportunities.
Updating internal documents/tools regularly, such as Partnership Management Framework (PMF) and quote tracker.
Essential Qualifications & Experience
Knowledge
Strong and relevant technical experience in life (re)insurance
Preferably a qualified actuary with relevant post qualified experience
Good understanding of the life insurance market
Highly analytical and a creative problem solver, with strong interpersonal and organisational skills
Leadership Skills
Highly collaborative individual who is comfortable with holding cross-functional or deal team members accountable
Strong communication (written and verbal) skills
Ability to quickly cut through detail and focus on what is important, being decisive and accountable.
Commercial Judgement
Organised, driven, and deadline focused with an attention to detail
Ability to manage competing demands and deal with non-standard and unstructured requests, at short notice
Motivated to take ownership of work and to seek further responsibility
Desirable Experience
Previous experience working in a life and disability reinsurance environment is preferred
Proficiency extracting, manipulating, analysing and drawing conclusions from data.
Risk Management Responsibilities
The role holder is responsible for ensuring a strong risk culture exists within the global client solutions team. The key risk management responsibilities include:
Demonstrating awareness and understanding of risk policies, key risks and associated controls;
Translating risk management principles and objectives into priorities, processes and activities that make sense to team members;
Fostering a culture of risk management in the team through training and performance management.
Taking a pro-active approach to identifying, fixing and learning from control failures.
Where relevant, report and effectively manage issues and/or loss events as they arise.

Every person in our global team is valued for the unique qualities they bring to our business and we seek to build their expertise and support their individual ambitions at every step. Title: Manager, Marketing & Events, Singapore Global Hub
Description:
About Endeavor:
Endeavor is the leading global community of High-Impact Entrepreneurs in emerging markets. Present in 45+ markets around the world, our 3,100+ entrepreneurs rely on Endeavor’s unparalleled network of peers and mentors to solve their toughest challenges. Portfolio companies in Singapore include Carousell, Shopback, Nium, Advance.ai, Kredivo, Glints, Tymebank and more.
Endeavor’s core belief is that entrepreneurs are the single best way to transform economies around the world: with the right community, mentorship, and investment, these individuals form the building blocks for thriving, dynamic economies in emerging markets around the world.
Read more about how we support Endeavor Entrepreneurs around the world - from Nairobi to Kuala Lumpur, Mexico City to Dubai.
About our values
About how we plan to advance the Multiplier Effect by helping entrepreneurs grow faster, think bigger, and give back to their communities as they inspire, mentor, and invest in others.
And about our rules-based, co-investment venture capital fund with $540M+ AUM across four funds, Endeavor Catalyst.
About the Role:
Endeavor is launching its newest Global Hub in Singapore this coming July 2026. The team currently comprises the Managing Director of the hub and Head of Asia for Endeavor Catalyst. Several others roles will be hired this year including the Manager, Marketing & Events.
This role will support Endeavor's brand-building efforts in Singapore and build a strong community through online and offline activities.
Be part of the founding team responsible for establishing and growing our presence in this country and developing partnerships with key stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities:
Work closely with the hub director and the team on defining the marketing strategy and program implementation for the Global Hub in Singapore for 2026 and beyond based on Endeavor's Vision 2035.
Support on all the Endeavor Hub Events and Activities from coordination on logistics and program to coordinating the partnership and marketing efforts on the Ground.
Coordinate with the local partners on all communication and marketing materials by also respecting our Global Marketing Guidelines.
Support the Global Marketing Team on reporting and coordination.
Coordinate event materials, assist with event preparation, and research creative elements for each of the Events.
Vendor research and assist with relationship management.
Manage and maintain partners database.
Assist with revenue tracking and outreach efforts.
Coordinate the event registration process and maintain accurate attendee lists using our event ticketing platform, WordPress, Google Sheets and Zapier integrations.
Provide administrative support to the events team, including data entry, updating new information, research, and project management.
Ensure event prep by ensuring all event-related materials are produced and available on time and resolving any last-minute challenges.
Launch Singapore-specific website and social media presence.
Manage all design and delivery of marketing material.
Coordinate post-event tasks such as thank-you notes, feedback surveys, and event reports.
Research and compile a list of potential invitees for all events happening in the region.
Actively participate in relevant strategic initiatives to improve team operational efficiency and effectiveness (e.g., onboarding processes, new service offering concepts, onboarding mentors and partners).
Who you are:
Preferably minimum of 3 years of relevant work experience.
Project Management Guru: You must be a capable project manager who can think through timelines, dependencies and budgets for programs.
Collaborator: You will work with, and rely on, numerous internal stakeholders. We expect you to have close relationships with the Global Marketing, Programs, and Operations team.
Comfort with ambiguity: You thrive on making order out of chaos. You can identify priorities proactively without being frazzled with last minute changes.
Deep local market understanding: You will primarily be building our brand presence in Singapore. You must be able to know where and how to reach our target markets and deliver content and activities that resonate with them . Knowing suitable vendors and venues are also important in the delivery of our activities.

Title: Manager, Media Planning
Description:
About WPP Media
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.
WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.
For more information, visit wppmedia.com.
Role Summary and Impact
We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Senior Manager to join WPP Media Singapore Clients Team. You will be responsible for leading a portfolio of strategic client relationships. Acting as a trusted strategic advisor and central hub integrator across specialists and local market teams, this role oversees the complete campaign lifecycle, from integrated cross-channel media strategy and planning to execution, optimization, and financial governance.
You will bridge client business goals with innovative and effective media solutions across all digital biddable and non-biddable/traditional channels, ensuring high client satisfaction, account profitability, and operational excellence while mentoring junior talent.
Experience working with Singapore and regional premium lifestyle and luxury publishers, with established media relationships and a good understanding of the publisher landscape, will be a strong advantage.
Client Partnership & Strategic Leadership
Client Champion & Trusted Advisor: Build and nurture strong, long-lasting relationships with senior client stakeholders based on trust, transparency, and proactive communication. Act as the primary point of contact and escalate/resolve challenges with confidence.
Business & Category Insight: Deeply understand client business models, market dynamics, competitive landscapes, and growth priorities across diverse sectors (luxury, financial services, FMCG, wine & spirits).
Strategic Roadmap Development: Lead annual strategy sessions, quarterly business reviews (QBRs), and campaign roadmaps, translating overarching business targets into actionable, high-impact marketing and media strategies.
Account Growth & Scope Management: Proactively identify portfolio expansion opportunities, unlock new revenue streams, and champion client satisfaction to drive long-term retention.
Integrated Media Strategy & Campaign Planning
Cross-Channel Planning: Develop end-to-end, integrated media strategies combining digital channels (Search, Social, Programmatic) and traditional/non-biddable channels (TV, Print, Radio, OOH/DOOH, Cinema, Digital IOs).
Goal-Oriented Media Design: Define clear, measurable performance benchmarks and KPIs, ensuring media allocations align with client investment strategies and brand priorities.
Innovative Integration: Partner with internal specialists (Planning, Investment, Activation, Content, Analytics) to deliver cohesive, data-led communications solutions.
Campaign Execution, Operations & Governance
Seamless Implementation: Oversee end-to-end execution, launch accuracy, and quality control across all media channels, maintaining robust documentation, approvals, and audit readiness.
Regional & Local Governance: Coordinate across regional hubs, local markets, and external partners to ensure consistency of delivery, process optimization, and compliance with agency standards.
Issue & Workflow Resolution: Act as the operational escalation point to resolve delivery, billing, technology, and implementation challenges across internal and external stakeholders.
Commercial Management & Financial Stewardship
Account Profitability & Revenue Ownership: Manage account P&L, accurate revenue forecasting, scope control, and commercial compliance against contractual targets.
Meticulous Budget Management: Oversee client media investments, managing budget allocations, spend tracking, reconciliations, invoicing, credit notes, and accruals with full client transparency.
Financial Risk Mitigation: Partner with Finance and Operations teams to ensure timely billing, revenue recognition, and proactive resolution of financial discrepancies.
Data Analytics, Optimization & Reporting
Performance Monitoring & Insights: Analyze campaign performance using tools such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, PowerBI, Clear Decisions, and Evogenious (TV) to derive actionable strategic insights beyond surface-level metrics.
A/B Testing & Continuous Improvement: Design and lead A/B testing and experimentation initiatives to continuously optimize conversions, engagement, and ROI across campaigns.
Executive Reporting: Deliver clear, tailored performance reports and forward-looking strategic recommendations that articulate value to senior client leadership.
People Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Team Mentorship & Coaching: Support the growth and capability development of junior team members through day-to-day guidance, skill-building, and knowledge sharing.
Cross-Functional Synergy: Facilitate smooth collaboration between media owners, technology partners, creative agencies, procurement teams, and internal practice specialists.
Culture Champion: Drive a high-performing, inclusive, and collaborative team culture grounded in accountability and continuous learning.
What You Will Need (Qualifications & Experience)
Experience: At least 6-7 years of experience in media planning and client servicing in integrated advertising, with a proven track record of managing end-to-end campaigns in the Singapore market and regional hubs.
Cross-Channel Knowledge: Good understanding of biddable channels, as well as strong working knowledge on non-biddable media particularly premium lifestyle and luxury category.
Tool & Analytics Proficiency: Hands-on experience with industry analytics, research, and reporting tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, PowerBI, Excel, Clear Decisions, Evogenious).
Commercial Acumen: Strong fluency in media math, financial stewardship (reconciliations, billing, accruals), contract management, and account profitability.
Communication & Stakeholder Management: Exceptional presentation, negotiation, and written/verbal communication skills, with experience managing executive-level clients.
Leadership Qualities: Self-driven ownership with demonstrated ability to guide, mentor, and elevate junior team members in a fast-paced environment.
Core Competencies
Client Leadership & Advisory: Strategic relationship building, consultative problem solving, executive stakeholder engagement.
Integrated Media Mastery: Dynamic cross-channel planning, including performance media, direct publishers and traditional media.
Commercial Acumen: Financial discipline, budget governance, scope management, profitability tracking.
Operational Excellence: Process rigor, quality control, multi-stakeholder orchestration in the Singapore and regional markets.
People & Team Leadership: Talent coaching, cross-functional collaboration, team alignment.
Success Measures
Client Satisfaction & Retention: High Net Promoter Scores (NPS) and successful contract renewals across assigned portfolio.
Commercial Health: Achievement of revenue targets, forecast accuracy, and healthy account margin performance.
Operational Accuracy: Zero major financial/billing discrepancies and 100% adherence to governance and audit standards.
Campaign Effectiveness: Exceeding client campaign KPIs through continuous testing and data-driven optimization.
Team Growth: Positive engagement, skill progression, and capability development among junior direct reports/mentees.
Life at WPP Media & Benefits
Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we're just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.
WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. Description:
Make an Impact
As Manager, Rewards & Well Being, you will play a key role in shaping and delivering competitive, equitable and sustainable Rewards & Well Being programmes across Singtel Singapore and overseas entities.
You will independently manage key reward portfolios and annual processes, providing specialist advice and data-driven recommendations to People & Culture, Business and Finance stakeholders. Working within Group Rewards frameworks and with oversight from the Director, Rewards & Well Being, you will balance market competitiveness, internal equity, affordability and employee experience to develop practical reward solutions.
What You'll Do
Lead end-to-end annual reward processes, including salary review, performance bonus and promotions, covering planning, guidelines, modelling, governance, stakeholder alignment and management reporting.
Lead market benchmarking and compensation analysis including salary ranges, market positioning, compa-ratios and internal relativities, translating market data into clear recommendations.
Conduct job evaluation and job sizing for new and changed roles, assessing scope, complexity, accountability and organisational impact while ensuring consistency with approved methodology and internal relativities.
Lead and contribute to reviews of salary structures, reward frameworks and targeted reward solutions, developing options and business cases that balance competitiveness, equity, affordability and implementation considerations.

Manage relationships with insurers, brokers and well-being providers, including service performance, cost management, issue resolution and programme improvements.
Develop advanced analytics, scenario modelling and management insights, identifying trends, risks and workforce implications and translating complex data into actionable recommendations.
Partner People & Culture, Business Leaders, Finance and Group Rewards on reward budgets, forecasts, policies and implementation, influencing decisions through sound judgement and evidence-based advice.
Strengthen reward governance and controls, and lead simplification, standardisation, automation and digitalisation of reward processes and ways of working.
What You'll Bring
Degree in HR, Business, Finance or a related discipline; professional Compensation & Benefits / Total Rewards certification and IHRP certification would be advantageous.
7–10 years of relevant HR experience, with substantial Compensation & Benefits / Total Rewards experience and demonstrated ownership of complex reward processes or projects.

Description:
About Klook
We are a leading pan-regional experiences platform in Asia Pacific, purpose built to digitalize experiences and make them accessible to every traveler.

Do you share our belief in the wonders of travel? Global citizens ourselves, Klookers are not only curating memorable experiences for others but co-creating our world of joy within Klook.
We work hard and play hard, upkeeping our high-performing culture as we are guided daily by our 6 core values:
- Customer First
- Push Boundaries
- Critical Thinking
- Build for Scale
- Less is More
- Win as One
We never settle, and together, we believe in achieving greater heights and realizing endless possibilities ahead of us in the dynamic new era of travel. Care to be a part of this revolution? Join us!
We're looking for a Manager, Strategic Partnerships to join our SIM/WiFi team and grow our eSIM business through partnerships. This is an owner's role: you will define the partnership strategy for Klook eSIM — where we play, with whom, and on what terms — and then personally execute it, building and closing the pipeline that turns that strategy into new-user growth.
The ideal candidate moves fluently between the two halves of the job: structured strategic thinking to set direction and prioritise, and hands-on deal-making to open doors, negotiate and get agreements signed — with the rigour to turn signed partners into acquisition volume rather than logos on a slide.
Key Responsibilities
Set the strategy
- Develop the strategic partnerships strategy for Klook eSIM: the partner archetypes and channels that can deliver new users at scale, the value proposition for each, and the commercial models to pursue.
- Translate it into an annual and quarterly plan with prioritised targets, sequencing and resourcing — using market data, competitive analysis and partner economics to decide where to concentrate effort and what to deprioritise.
- Refresh the strategy as the eSIM distribution landscape shifts, and report progress to senior leadership on a regular cadence.
Build pipeline and close deals
- Own the eSIM partnership pipeline end to end: map the landscape and identify high-potential partners across tech platforms, travel and OTA players, telcos, device and app ecosystems, fintech, loyalty programmes and offline travel channels.
- Generate qualified opportunities through outbound prospecting, industry networks, events and inbound inquiries, and maintain a disciplined pipeline with clear stages and next steps.
- Lead deals from first conversation to signature: pitch, commercial modelling, negotiation, and alignment with Legal, Finance and Product on structure and risk.
- Build the internal business case for each deal — expected new users, economics, resourcing — and secure senior stakeholder buy-in.
Scale partners into user growth
- Own launch and ramp-up: coordinate Product, Tech, Supply and Operations to get integrations live on time and performing.
- Manage live partners as a growth portfolio — review performance, pull levers to increase conversion and volume, expand where partners are working and exit where they are not.
- Design and land partner co-marketing and joint go-to-market activity, working with our marketing teams on execution to drive new customer acquisition.
- Act as the primary commercial relationship owner for key partners, and use performance data to sharpen targeting, deal structure and partner management.
Flex across broader growth channels
- Support other external growth and awareness channels that can drive eSIM acquisition — such as affiliates, social and creator-led channels — and work with internal marketing teams to launch campaigns with Klook's platform-level strategic partners.
What You'll Need
- 6+ years in strategic partnerships, business development or commercial strategy, with a proven track record of independently sourcing, negotiating and closing partnerships that delivered measurable user or revenue growth. OTA, ecommerce, travel, telco or tech startup experience is a plus.
- Experience owning a partnership or growth strategy end to end — building the thesis, target list and plan, then delivering it, rather than executing someone else's.
- Demonstrated ability to build pipeline from scratch: comfortable with cold outreach, working a network, and creating opportunities where none existed.
- Strong commercial and negotiation skills, with the judgement to structure deals that are both closeable and good for the business.
- Strong analytical skills — able to size markets, model partner economics, and use data to prioritise and make the case internally.
- Ability to drive cross-functional projects, getting Product, Tech, Legal, Finance and Marketing aligned behind a strategy, a deal and its launch.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with credibility in front of senior external and internal stakeholders.
- Fluent in English and Chinese; additional languages a plus. Globally minded and comfortable working across cultures and time zones.
- A start-up attitude — entrepreneurial, roll-up-your-sleeves, and able to work independently when required.
- Exposure to affiliates, social or influencer marketing, or knowledge of the telecommunications / eSIM space, is a plus but not required.

Our high-performing Exos team delivers service and operational excellence across a holistic wellbeing program to support the physical and social health of employees from our large global client.

This role will enable the marketing function in the areas with our greatest density, leading the collaboration with internal stakeholders and managing expectations with client stakeholders. Ownership over APAC client and internal stakeholder relationships, responsible for developing, growing and maintaining strategic partnerships that deliver on regional goals, demonstrate value, and aim toward larger org-wide priorities
Manage marketing and communications requests from partners and stakeholders, determining the most strategic response in accordance with our annual strategic plan
Coordinate with cross-functional teams to implement consistent communications across organizations, visually and tonally
Collaborate on the development and implementation of all consumer-focused communications and production of those assets
Own and manage all marketing services offered by this internal team, including toolkit development and optimization, development of SOPs and guidelines, website maintenance, newsletter content development, asset requests, regional promotional campaigns, email engagement campaigns, documentation creation to educate and enable internal teams to find and properly leverage the best marketing assets. Continually explore how to elevate and refine marketing tactics and channels
Contribute to and provide strategic input and/or executional support towards global marketing initiatives and campaign development
Align regional campaigns with our global marketing initiatives
Clearly and effectively storytell to multiple audiences (internal, users, stakeholders), embodying and evolving the brand tone
Contribute to strategic planning, development and delivery of an integrated marketing strategy and communications plan
Ideate, improve, and rollout processes to drive efficiencies across teams and more effective collaboration
Take initiative to plan, organize, coordinate and perform work in situations where numerous and diverse demands are involved

- Work from home most of the week, with one day together in the office.
- Flexible hours built around your output, not the clock.
- Work directly with the founders, with real ownership from day one.
- Grow with us as we scale from Singapore into the US.

Competitive base salary plus a performance-linked bonus tied to what you create, the partnerships you land, and the sales you help drive. Real responsibility from day one.

Description:
Job Description
About Us
We help interior design and renovation firms in Singapore grow — through lead generation, branding, and marketing programmes that bring them qualified homeowners and stronger market positioning. Our clients don't just buy a service from us once; they grow with us across tiers as their firms scale. That only works when someone closes the right clients — and then owns the relationship after the first close.
That someone is you.
About the Role
This is a fully remote role.
You'll work from wherever you work best — no daily commute, no office face-time. What matters is that your clients feel looked after and your accounts grow. You'll meet clients over video calls (with the occasional in-person session if a key relationship calls for it), and stay connected to the team through our daily rhythms online.
This is a closing role first, a relationship role always.
You'll start by building your own book of business: running sales conversations with interior design firms, diagnosing where their business is stuck, and closing them into the right programme. Every deal you close becomes an account you own — and from there, your job is to make each relationship deeper, longer, and more valuable over time.
The more you close early on, the bigger the portfolio you manage — and the more your recurring income compounds through renewals, tier upgrades, and referrals. You are the person our clients trust from the very first call, the one who checks in before they have to ask, and the reason they sign, renew, upgrade, and refer.
What You'll Do
Run discovery and sales calls with interior design and renovation firms — diagnosing their growth bottlenecks and closing them into the programme that fits
Manage your own sales pipeline end to end: qualification, follow-ups, objection handling, and closing, with clear monthly targets
Own every account you close as their primary point of contact and trusted advisor
Run regular check-ins and performance reviews with clients — walking them through their results, diagnosing bottlenecks, and recommending next steps
Drive renewals by ensuring clients see and understand the value they're getting throughout the programme, not just at renewal time
Identify and develop expansion opportunities — helping clients climb to higher programme tiers when their business is ready for it
Generate referrals naturally by building the kind of relationship people recommend to their peers
Work with our internal teams to resolve client issues quickly and keep promises made during the sales process
Maintain accurate account records, follow-up rhythms, and relationship health tracking in our CRM
Who You Are
2+ years in B2B sales, account management, or client success — with a track record of hitting sales targets and closing deals
A closer who thinks long-term: you know how to drive a deal to a decision, but you close clients you can grow, not just deals you can win
A natural relationship builder — the close is the start of the relationship, not the end of it
Consistent with follow-through: you do what you say, on time, every time
A clear communicator who can explain performance data and business concepts simply, in person and in writing
Commercially sharp — you can spot an upsell or referral opportunity without making the client feel sold to
Organised and self-directed: you manage your own portfolio, pipeline of renewals, and follow-up cadence
Proven ability to work independently in a remote setup — you stay responsive, structured, and visible without anyone looking over your shoulder
Bonus: experience in or exposure to the interior design, renovation, real estate, or home services industry
Why Join Us
100% remote
— you're measured on client outcomes, not hours at a desk
Base salary + commissions on every deal you close, plus recurring incentives on retention, renewals, and account growth — your income compounds as your portfolio grows
Build your own book of business from day one, backed by proven sales scripts, frameworks, and playbooks — you close it, you keep it, you grow it

You will collaborate closely with Branding, Content, Creative, Retail Operations, eCommerce and Events teams to ensure campaigns are executed consistently and effectively.

- Assist in translating brand strategies into actionable marketing initiatives that drive both brand awareness and commercial performance.
Retail Activations & Customer Engagement
- Plan and execute retail marketing initiatives that bring campaigns and product stories to life within boutiques and retail environments.
- Collaborate with Retail Operations and Visual Merchandising teams to ensure boutiques are campaign-ready and aligned with brand standards.
- Support the development and execution of tactical retail initiatives, customer engagement activities and promotional campaigns to drive traffic, conversion and sales.
- Monitor execution standards across boutiques and identify opportunities to enhance customer experience and campaign effectiveness.

- Boutique events
- VIP customer events
- Mall atrium activations
- Corporate staff sales
- Campaign launches and promotional roadshows
- Coordinate event logistics, vendor management, guest experience and on-site operations to ensure seamless execution.
- Work closely with the Events and PR team to bring marketing campaigns to life through engaging customer experiences.
Partnerships & Collaborations
- Identify and support opportunities for brand partnerships, mall collaborations and cross-promotional campaigns that enhance brand visibility and customer acquisition.
- Coordinate partnership deliverables and ensure alignment with campaign objectives and brand positioning.
- Build and maintain relationships with external partners, landlords, vendors and agencies.

- Manage campaign calendars, project timelines and cross-functional deliverables.

- Liaise with agencies, vendors and suppliers to ensure timely execution of marketing initiatives.
- Ensure all campaigns and activations are delivered accurately, efficiently and within budget.

- Track campaign and activation performance across marketing channels and retail touchpoints.
- Prepare post-campaign and post-event reports including customer engagement, traffic, sales and ROI metrics.
- Identify key learnings and recommendations to optimise future campaigns and activations.

- Understands how branding, retail marketing, customer engagement, events and partnerships work together to drive business results.
- Event & Activation Management
- Strong ability to translate marketing campaigns into engaging retail activations and customer experiences that strengthen brand affinity and support sales objectives.
- Project & Operational Excellence
- Demonstrates strong organisation and project management capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple timelines, stakeholders and operational requirements simultaneously.
- Stakeholder Collaboration
- Builds strong relationships with internal teams, agencies, vendors, mall partners and external stakeholders to deliver successful campaigns and activations.
- Initiative & Ownership
- Proactive, resourceful and comfortable taking ownership of projects from planning through execution while supporting broader marketing objectives.
The portfolio you’ll build here
- End-to-end ownership of integrated marketing campaigns across multiple channels.
- Exposure to branding, retail marketing, customer engagement, partnerships and events.
- Experience working on major jewellery launches, seasonal campaigns and VIP initiatives.
- Cross-functional collaboration across Content, Creative, Retail Operations, eCommerce and Events teams.
- Development into a future Senior Marketing Executive with broad 360° marketing exposure.
About you
- 1–2 years of marketing experience, preferably within retail, fashion, beauty, lifestyle or luxury sectors.
- Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Events Management or a related field.
- Proven experience in marketing campaigns, executing brand events, retail activations or campaign launches.

Title: Marketing Executive, Shiseido
Description:
MAIN PURPOSE
This role is responsible for driving commercial performance across channels through the planning and execution of retail marketing campaigns, trade promotions, and activation programs that support brand and business objectives. The Marketing Executive translates brand and marketing plans into integrated retail activation strategies, ensuring strong omnichannel execution tailored by retailer and channel.
The role also supports product marketing initiatives and is responsible for delivering elevated in-store brand experiences through effective visual merchandising, retail excellence, and consumer-centric activations. This position plays a key role in maximizing visibility, conversion, and shopper engagement across all retail touchpoints.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Retail and Trade Marketing
- Develop and execute retail marketing plans, promotions, and campaigns across all retail channels
- Translate brand objectives into retailer-specific activation plans that drive traffic, conversion, and sell-out performance
- Support the planning and execution of promotional calendars, retailer exclusives, seasonal campaigns, and key commercial moments
- Collaborate closely with sales team and retailers to identify growth opportunities and maximize business performance
- Monitor retail performance and campaign results, providing insights and recommendations to optimize effectiveness
Omnichannel Activation and Execution
- Support the development and implementation of integrated omnichannel activation plans across retail, EC, social, CRM, and digital touchpoints
- Ensure seamless execution and consistency of brand campaigns across all consumer-facing channels
- Coordinate marketing assets, POSM, merchandising materials, and campaign deployment to support launches and promotional activities
- Work closely with internal stakeholders, retailers and agencies to ensure timely delivery and execution excellence
Visual Merchandising (VM) and Retail Experience
- Support the development and implementation of visual merchandising guidelines and in-store communication materials
- Ensure brand standards and visual consistency are maintained across all retail locations and counters
- Coordinate VM installations, campaign updates, product displays, and seasonal merchandising refreshes
- Conduct regular retail audits and identify opportunities to enhance in-store visibility, shopper experience, and conversion
- Partner with retailers and vendors to ensure timely installation and execution of VM initiatives
Product Marketing Support
- Support the planning and execution of product launches and hero campaigns across retail channels
- Coordinate launch materials, non-saleable products, product information and retail merchandising requirements
- Track launch performance and gather retail feedback to identity opportunities for improvement
Retail Marketing Operation
- Plan and recommend GWP offerings from HQ assets and local sourcing opportunities, ensuring alignment with campaign objectives, consumer needs, and budget allocation across all channels
- Track and manage promotional investments, including rebates, vouchers, and marketing support by channel and retailer, ensuring spending remains within approved budgets
- Support POSM forecasting, allocation, and utilization to maximize impact while maintaining cost efficiency and minimizing wastage
- Monitor and analyse retail campaign performance, promotional effectiveness and ROI
- Track competitor activities, market trends and retail best practices
- Prepare post-campaign report and provide recommendations to improve future activations
QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE
- Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Retail Management or related field
- Minimum 1 year of relevant experience; retail marketing, trade marketing, brand marketing
- Experience in beauty, luxury, FMCG, retail, or consumer industries preferred
- Exposure to product launches, retail activations, promotions, and visual merchandising execution
- Experience working with retailers, external agencies, and cross-functional stakeholders
- Familiarity with omnichannel marketing and retail operations is advantageous
- Commercially driven with a strong understanding of retail dynamics
- Highly organized with excellent execution capabilities
- Collaborative team player who works effectively across functions and retail partners
- Proactive and solution-oriented with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment

Title: Marketing Manager, APAC Operating Unit, Caltrate
Description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.
About the role: Marketing Manager, APAC Operating Unit, Caltrate
This is an opportunity to help shape the next phase of growth for Caltrate across APAC markets.
Working across strategy, innovation, communications, and activation, you will help identify growth opportunities, shape innovation priorities, and define the brand and communication agenda that enables Caltrate to win across APAC markets outside China. You will partner with local markets to translate regional strategy into relevant portfolio choices, consumer propositions, claims, and content.
Partnering closely with cross-functional and market teams, you will bring together consumer insight, trusted science, and commercial thinking to strengthen Caltrate’s relevance, competitiveness, and sustainable growth across the region.
Role Responsibilities
- Drive APAC Growth Strategy & Innovation for Caltrate Outside China
- Identify emerging consumer needs, category shifts, and growth opportunities for total mobility across APAC markets.
- Serve as the regional business lead for non-China APAC markets, partnering with local teams on growth priorities, portfolio strategy, innovation, communications, and business performance.
- Define strategic priorities and innovation opportunities that strengthen Caltrate’s competitiveness and accelerate sustainable brand growth.
- Partner with cross-functional and market teams to translate consumer needs into relevant products, claims, formats, packs, and experiences.
- Lead innovation development from opportunity identification through business case, commercialization, launch, and scaling across priority markets.
- Build the APAC Communication & Activation Growth Model for Caltrate
- Define Caltrate’s communication and activation agenda across APAC markets outside China, aligned with regional growth priorities and local market needs.
- Develop compelling consumer propositions, claims, content territories, and communication toolkits that can be adapted by markets.
- Identify how Caltrate can drive growth through digital commerce, retail media, creators, healthcare professional influence, partnerships, and emerging commerce ecosystems.
- Build scalable activation frameworks, best practices, and capabilities that help markets improve execution quality and drive stronger consumer engagement.
Why This Role?
- Lead key growth, innovation, communications, and activation initiatives for Caltrate across APAC markets outside China.
- Shape regional strategy while partnering closely with local markets to enable relevant execution and business impact.
- Influence how one of Haleon’s leading mobility brands grows across the region.
- Build regional experience across brand strategy, innovation, communications, commercial activation, and market partnership.
Your areas of knowledge and expertise that matter most for this role
- 7+ years of experience in brand marketing, portfolio management, innovation, and/or commercial leadership, preferably in consumer health, nutrition, wellness, or OTC categories.
- Experience translating consumer, customer, and category insights into regional strategy, effective communications, and sustainable brand growth.
- Experience leading innovation pipelines, large-scale launches, and market adoption through cross-functional collaboration in a matrix organization.
- Strong commercial and financial acumen, including business case development, budget management, and performance tracking to drive profitable growth.
- Experience working across diverse APAC markets and adapting regional strategy into locally relevant activation plans is a plus.

It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people.
