About Us
At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
Available Locations
- Singapore
About The Role
The Cloudflare APAC sales organisation operates as one integrated revenue system. Account Executives, Customer Engineers, Partner Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Customer Experience Managers, Professional Services and Revenue Operations work as a continuous engine — winning, deploying, adopting, expanding, and scaling platform commitments across the full customer lifecycle.
The system is supported by an AI-embedded operating model. The work itself, however, remains human. The role of every seller at Cloudflare is to bring critical thinking, judgment, and trust to customer relationships and outcomes.
In this role, you will be responsible for driving significant growth by landing and expanding a portfolio of assigned customers in your assigned territory. The ideal candidate possesses a strong blend of sales acumen and technical understanding, enabling them to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical buyers. As an Account Executive, you will drive revenue velocity by utilizing foundational sales data layers for accurate forecasting, proactive pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets.
You are the kind of operator who uses AI as a force multiplier every day, cares more about customer outcomes than job boundaries, and demonstrates curiosity, judgment, and high agency.
Responsibilities
- Own and execute a comprehensive territory plan to consistently achieve and exceed sales and revenue targets.
- Cultivate long-term strategic relationships with key accounts and partners. Lead executive-level transformation narratives that earn the right to be in the architecture conversation.
- Leverage top partners as an extension of the sales team to co-sell alongside where they bring customer relationships, services capability, or procurement leverage. Drive regular forecast & pipeline cadences with top partners.
- Understand customer network architectures, the problems that Cloudflare can solve and effectively translate Cloudflare’s solutions to drive successful platform sales, ensuring clients can secure and scale their own AI-driven workloads.
- Manage contract negotiations and structure platform-level commercial commitments (multi-year, multi-product, outcome-anchored) rather than point-product deals.
- Stay engaged through onboarding, adoption, and the first renewal. Partner with Customer Engineers, Professional Services on a deployment plan with milestones tied to measurable outcomes.

- Maintain high standards in pipeline discipline, CRM hygiene and forecasting accuracy.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
- At least 5 years experience selling technology solutions in the BFSI sector.
- Experience selling technology solutions in Financial Services Industry in Hong Kong.
- Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting and exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.
- Proficient in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and multi-threaded land and expand strategies.
- Strong understanding of computer networking, cloud security technology, and how enterprise infrastructure adapts to automated data workflows.
- Exceptional interpersonal communication skills and value selling skills.
- Proficiency in modern sales software, customer data environments, and core systems (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite).
- Thinks critically rather than reacting, exercises judgment under uncertainty, names risks honestly, shows genuine empathy for customers as people, can point to relationships built over time on trust, and demonstrates visible curiosity in how they prepare, sell, and learn.

Manage and maintain new joiner onboarding materials, ensuring resources, process guidance, contact information and training content remain current, accessible and aligned with account ways of working.
Coordinate end-to-end access and onboarding for Publicis internal platforms and relevant media platforms, working with internal teams and partners to ensure new joiners receive the required permissions, tools and training in a timely manner.
Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, standardise ways of working and strengthen operational controls across the APEC network.

Own and develop relationships with priority regional and global media partners, including Google, Meta, TikTok, Netflix and Amazon, alongside other relevant publishers, platforms and technology partners.
Establish a structured partner engagement plan covering regular business reviews, capability updates, training, thought leadership and access to alpha, beta and new-product opportunities.
Maintain a clear view of partner roadmaps and emerging capabilities, assessing their relevance to client’s business objectives, audiences, markets and upcoming campaigns.
Co-manage the agency test-and-learn roadmap, including opportunity identification, prioritisation, ownership, timelines, measurement approach, results and next-step recommendations.
Work closely with pillar leads, planners, activation teams and analytics specialists to ensure suitable alphas, betas and new products are considered and incorporated into upcoming campaign plans.
Build a reliable pipeline from partner opportunity to campaign activation, removing barriers, clarifying requirements and tracking progress through to learning and potential scale-up.
Partner with local markets to maintain an up-to-date view of key local media relationships, platforms, products and market developments.
Coordinate regular market sharing sessions with the Singapore Hub, with particular focus on Japan, Korea, India and Australia, to strengthen local market knowledge and surface transferable opportunities.
Create and maintain a central repository of partner updates, local market intelligence, case studies, test results and best practices that can inform future planning.

Description:
Job Title
Network Sales Admin Support
Occupation
Sales & Business Development Support
About Super Sistem Group
Super Sistem is a
licensed telecommunications infrastructure operator and builder
, holding a
Facilities-Based Operator (FBO) licence in Singapore
and a
Jartup (Jaringan Telekomunikasi Tertutup) licence in Indonesia
.
These licences enable Super Sistem to develop, operate and manage telecommunications infrastructure across
Singapore and Indonesia
, including submarine cable and terrestrial fibre infrastructure.
We specialize in developing and operating
submarine cable and terrestrial fibre infrastructure
, connecting key digital, data centre and telecommunications hubs across Singapore and Indonesia.
As a rapidly growing cross-border network operator, Super Sistem combines
engineering expertise, regulatory knowledge and commercial capabilities
to develop reliable, scalable and future-ready digital connectivity infrastructure.
We are now seeking a
Network Sales Admin Support
to join our Singapore team and work closely with our
Chief Marketing Officer (CMO)
in developing Super Sistem's regional wholesale connectivity business.
About the Role
The
Network Sales Admin Support
will work closely with the CMO to support the day-to-day execution of Super Sistem's
sales, business development and customer engagement activities
across Singapore and the region.
This is more than a traditional administrative support position. The successful candidate will be exposed to the
full commercial sales cycle
— from identifying prospects and preparing sales materials, to customer meetings, quotations, negotiations, contracting and ultimately closing business.
The role is designed for a
high-potential, commercially minded individual who wants to build a long-term career in telecommunications infrastructure sales
.
The successful candidate will initially provide strong administrative, coordination and sales support to the CMO. As the candidate develops product knowledge, commercial understanding and customer relationships, the role will progressively expand to include
direct customer engagement, account management, business development and ownership of sales opportunities
.
Our objective is to develop the successful candidate towards taking on
greater responsibility and independently leading sales activities within approximately three years
, subject to performance, capability and business requirements.
Prior telecommunications or submarine cable experience is
not essential
. We are particularly interested in candidates who are
fast learners, commercially driven, confident in dealing with people and have a proven track record in sales or customer-facing business development
.
Key Responsibilities
1. Sales & Business Development Support
Work closely with the CMO to support
sales and business development activities
across Singapore and the region.
Assist in identifying and researching
potential customers, partners and business opportunities

Maintain and update the company's
sales pipeline, customer database and opportunity tracking
.

Prepare sales quotations, proposals, presentations, capability statements and other customer-facing materials.

quotation, negotiation, contract and service delivery

Ensure timely follow-up on outstanding customer enquiries, proposals and commercial matters.
Support the CMO in maintaining strong relationships with existing customers and business partners.
2. Sales Administration & Coordination

Prepare meeting agendas, minutes, action items and follow-up reports.
Maintain accurate records of
customer contacts, opportunities, quotations, contracts and sales activities
.
Coordinate internally with technical, project, operations, finance and management teams to respond to customer requirements.
Assist in preparing internal sales reports, pipeline updates and management presentations.
Coordinate travel arrangements, customer meetings and regional business activities when required.
3. Customer & Market Research
Conduct research on
telecommunications operators, ISPs, data centres, cloud providers, hyperscalers, content providers and other potential customers
.
Monitor market developments, new infrastructure projects, submarine cable systems, data centre developments and regional connectivity opportunities.
Identify potential new customers and business opportunities for Super Sistem's network infrastructure and connectivity services.
Assist in developing customer and market intelligence to support the CMO's business development strategy.
4. Commercial & Product Development
Develop a strong understanding of Super Sistem's products and services, including
submarine fibre capacity, dark fibre, wavelength, cable landing station and data centre connectivity solutions
.
Work with the technical team to understand customer requirements and translate them into appropriate connectivity solutions.
Assist in preparing commercial models, pricing comparisons and customer proposals.
Develop an understanding of the commercial considerations surrounding
capacity, fibre pairs, IRUs, connectivity services and infrastructure projects
.
Support the CMO in evaluating new commercial opportunities and partnerships.
5. Progressive Sales Responsibility
As the candidate develops experience and demonstrates capability:
Participate directly in
customer meetings and commercial negotiations
.
Take ownership of selected customer accounts and sales opportunities.
Develop and maintain relationships with customers and industry partners.
Independently manage defined sales opportunities from prospecting through to closure.
Develop and maintain an individual sales pipeline and sales targets.
Represent Super Sistem at selected
industry conferences, exhibitions and customer events
.
Progressively take on responsibility for
regional sales and business development activities
.
The long-term objective is for the successful candidate to develop from a sales support role into a
commercially independent sales and business development professional
capable of leading customer relationships and sales opportunities.
Qualifications & Experience
Essential
Diploma or Bachelor's Degree
in Business, Marketing, Sales, Communications, Information Technology or a related discipline.
A
Diploma is sufficient
for this position; academic qualifications are less important than demonstrated commercial ability and attitude.
Proven sales or business development track record
, preferably with measurable sales achievements or customer acquisition results.
Strong interest in developing a career in
sales and business development
.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
Confident and comfortable communicating with customers, partners and senior stakeholders.
Strong organisational skills with attention to detail.
Good written and spoken
English
.
Strong Microsoft Office / Google Workspace skills.
Fast learner with the ability to understand new products, technologies and commercial concepts quickly.
Self-motivated, proactive and able to work independently.
Willingness to travel regionally when required, particularly to
Indonesia and other Southeast Asian markets

• Contribute ideas that help the organisation adopt AI safely, responsibly and effectively.
Data, Reporting and Insights

• Support the development and maintenance of trackers, dashboards and status reports.
• Analyse basic data to identify trends, outstanding actions, common risks and improvement opportunities.
• Help translate research and analysis into concise, practical and audience-appropriate insights.
• Perform quality checks to improve the accuracy, consistency and completeness of governance records and reports.
Stakeholder Engagement and Project Coordination
• Collaborate with technology, information security, legal, compliance, risk, data and business teams.
• Support meeting preparation, agenda development, note taking, action tracking and follow-up activities.
• Coordinate inputs from stakeholders for governance reviews, risk assessments, presentations and reports.
• Contribute to communication materials that promote awareness and responsible adoption of AI.
• Assist with the coordination of governance, innovation and change-management activities.
• Communicate progress, issues, dependencies and support needs clearly and professionally.
• Handle business and governance information with appropriate care and confidentiality.

Title: OUTREACH & ADMISSIONS SENIOR EXECUTIVE
Description:

Role Type:
Part-Time / Contract for Service
Position Level:
Senior Executive
Location:

SGD$4,000 – $5,500 / month
(commensurate with experience)
About the Organization
The organization is Singapore’s pioneer secular, co-educational weekday residential program. We provide comprehensive academic, developmental, and holistic support to promising youth from low-income households. Our mission is to empower scholars to break through systemic constraints and realize their full potential in an inclusive, high-support living-learning environment.
Why Join There?
Direct Social Impact:
Play a pivotal role in transforming the educational and life trajectories of deserving youth by expanding access to life-changing scholarship opportunities.
Pioneering Residential Model:
Be an essential voice in building partnerships and community trust for Singapore’s first residential tertiary scholarship ecosystem.
Strategic & Operational Influence:
Lead end-to-end recruitment strategies—from designing innovative talent-spotting initiatives to build lasting community relationships.
Collaborative & Value-Driven Culture:
Work alongside a dedicated, passionate team of social service, youth development, and education professionals in a purpose-driven environment.
Position Summary
We are seeking a proactive, strategic, and relationship-focused Outreach & Admissions Senior Executive. In this role, you will lead outreach strategies, build pipeline partnerships with educational and community organizations, and oversee the end-to-end scholar admissions and onboarding journey.
If you are a creative strategist with a background in student recruitment, business development, or community engagement—and possess a deep commitment to youth empowerment—we invite you to join our mission.
Key Responsibilities
1. Strategic Outreach & Pipeline Development
Partner Engagement:
Build and nurture sustainable partnerships with primary/secondary schools, social service agencies, and community organizations to secure a consistent pipeline of prospective scholars.
Outreach Campaign Execution:
Curate and deliver admissions-focused outreach initiatives, including campus tours, school visits, speaking engagements, and community workshops.
Channel Innovation:
Design and implement structured recruitment initiatives (e.g., talent-spotter networks) to broaden reach across underrepresented communities.
Volunteer Leadership:
Mobilize, train, and manage volunteer teams to support ground outreach and event operations.
2. Admissions Management & Scholar Conversion
Brand Ambassadorship:
Serve as a primary representative of our client's organization, articulating our value proposition effectively to prospective scholars, parents, and community partners.
Admissions Oversight:
Process inquiries and applications, conduct eligibility assessments, coordinate candidate interviews, and manage admissions documentation.
Advisory & Guidance:
Guide applicants and families through admissions criteria, residency requirements, program details, and financial support options.
Scholars Onboarding:
Act as the primary liaison for newly admitted scholars and their families throughout the initial transition and induction period.
3. Data Codification & Reporting
Process Optimization:
Standardize and codify admissions procedures to ensure seamless data management across applicants, school partners, and community networks.
Data Analytics & Reporting:
Track key outreach metrics, analyze recruitment funnel performance, and prepare regular strategic reports for executive management.
Qualifications & Experience
Education:
Diploma or Degree in Business, Communications, Social Sciences, Marketing, Education, or a related field.
Professional Experience
:
Minimum 4 years of proven experience
in business development, student recruitment, community outreach, or marketing.
Key Competencies:
-Exceptional interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills; adept at engaging diverse audiences, families, and community partners.
-Proven track record in project management—able to balance high-level strategy with hands-on event execution.
-Self-driven, resilient, and collaborative mindset with strong problem-solving capabilities.

Description:
Packaging Optimization Lead
Zuellig Pharma
is a leading healthcare solutions company in Asia, and our purpose is tomake healthcare more accessible to the communities we serve. We provideworld-class distribution, digital, and commercial services to support thegrowing healthcare needs in this region.
The company was started a hundred years ago and hasgrown to become a multibillion-dollar business covering 17 markets with over12,000 employees. Our people serve more than 200,000 medical facilities andwork with over 450 clients, including the top 20 pharmaceutical companies inthe world.
Purpose of the Role:
The Packaging Optimization Lead is a dedicated specialist hire — thegroup’s subject-matter expert across all packaging formats, solutions, andtechnologies — created to bring that spend, and the operations behind it, undercoherent technical ownership.
This is a lean, high-impact role designed to act as a force multiplieracross multiple business units and markets. The Lead develops solutionproposals, defines specifications, and evaluates vendors, enabling GroupProcurement to execute from a position of technical expertise.
The mandate spans standardization, packaging automation,distribution-centre (DC) space recovery, freight (dimensional weight)efficiency, and forward-looking regulatory and sustainability readiness.
What You’ll Do:
· Standards & specification
o Developand maintain a Group Packaging Standards Framework adopted across all markets.
o Definepackaging specifications across formats and drive carton-range rationalizationto reduce the active size range.
o Establishand own KPI baselines — cost per pack, void fill, DIM weight, damage rates, andstorage footprint.
· Automation &optimization
o Identify,scope, and lead evaluation of automated packaging solutions at priority DCs —carton right-sizing and auto-erect, on-demand box cutting, automatedtape & seal, strapping and bundling, and print-and-applylabelling.
o Facilitatecompletion full SKU analysis incorporating order & bundling profiles todevelop engineered optimized packaging solutions with a focus on productquality; 100% recyclability of materials used; returnable packaging and closedloop material handling unit opportunities, cubic utilization / minimisation andoverall packaging costs reductions.
o Drivevoid-fill elimination through fitted inserts and no-void formats, usingright-sizing as the primary lever.
o Buildindividual capex business cases for automation, validated before deploymentthrough existing capital and procurement governance.
· DC space &inventory
o Quantifythe packaging storage footprint and lead initiatives to reclaim DC floor spacefor client inventory and cold-chain capacity.
o Collaboratewith procurement on just-in-time (JIT) delivery and supplier-managed inventory(VMI) to reduce on-site packaging stock.
· Freight &dimensional weight
o ImplementDIM-weight optimization on outbound freight, prioritising air and expresscold-chain lanes for immediate cost reduction.
· Supplier &commercial enablement
o Developsolution proposals, specifications, and vendor evaluations that enable GroupProcurement to consolidate volume and negotiate from technical strength.
o Supportpreferred-supplier agreements that deliver measurable unit-cost reduction andworking-capital improvement.
· Compliance,sustainability & foresight
o Establisha regulatory-foresight function covering EPR tracking, labelling requirements,plastic-levy monitoring, and recycled-content mandates.
o SupportESG reporting and circular-economy targets in partnership with theSustainability function.
· Data, analytics& reporting
o Buildthe baseline data infrastructure to track packaging performance in a singleview, progressing toward analytics, AI-assisted design and material selection,and digital-twin simulation.
o ReportROI and savings against baseline to Finance and the Group Head of Distribution.
What will make you successful:
Must-Have:
· Degree in packaging engineering, mechanical /industrial engineering, supply chain, or a related discipline — or equivalentpractical experience.
· Familiarity with packaging-related regulation(EPR, labelling, recycled-content mandates) and sustainability reporting is anadvantage
· Substantial experience (typically 8+ years)in packaging engineering, logistics engineering, or supply-chain operations,ideally within pharmaceutical, healthcare, or other regulated or high-volumedistribution environments.
· Demonstrated track record deploying packagingautomation — e.g. carton right-sizing / auto-erect, on-demand box cutting,automated case sealing, or print-and-apply labelling.
· Hands-on knowledge of packaging materials andformats: corrugate, void fill, tape and seals, pallet wrap, and cold-chainpackaging.
· Experience developing specifications andevaluating vendors, and building capex / ROI business cases for operationalinvestment.
· Multi-market experience across Asia-Pacificand comfort operating in a matrixed, multi-stakeholder organisation.
Advantage to Have:

· Analytical rigour — sets baselines,quantifies opportunity, and validates impact with data.
· Commercial acumen — connects technicaldecisions to material, freight, working-capital, and space-related value.

Process Discipline - Commitment to standards

University or Bachelor's degree preferred, or equivalent experience.

Experience developing positive relationships and solving customer problems.

Handles accounts with low to mid-levels of annual revenue.
Primary focus for partner sales on SMB segment.
Typically assigned average size quota.

Local and Country accounts.
Focus on partners with low to mid-levels of HPE specialization and commitment.

If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you.
Who We Are
The Trade Desk is changing the way global brands and their agencies advertise to audiences around the world. How? With a media-buying platform that empowers marketers to deliver a more insightful and relevant ad experience for consumers — and sets a new standard for global reach, accuracy, and transparency.
The public relations and communications team at The Trade Desk plays a vital role in elevating the company’s profile through compelling storytelling, high-impact media engagement, and strategic external events that resonate with key audiences. As a link between the organization and external audiences, the team partners collaboratively across the business to build strong relationships and advocacy across stakeholders.
What You’ll Do
The Trade Desk is seeking an experienced strategic communications leader who will be responsible for setting the PR strategy in Australia, India, Southeast Asia and elevating the company’s profile through impactful programs that amplify compelling narratives and drive media and external engagement.
This role requires proven experience within B2B communications – ideally within technology or digital media – with a proven track record of developing strategic communications programs, strong media relations strategy, strong relationship management skills and an ability to grasp complex issues in a technical environment.
The candidate should possess exceptional hunting ability to proactively drive stories, strong attention to detail, paired with the ability to craft compelling narratives that engage the media and clearly connect PR efforts to business impact. This person should be a self-starter who thrives in fast-moving environments and can collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders across different regions and time zones.
In this role, you will:
- Lead and develop strategic PR plans across Australia, India and Southeast Asia, building awareness of The Trade Desk and articulating the vision and value of the company
- Drive proactive media coverage in support of The Trade Desk, including major trade publications and national business press, leveraging existing relationships and building new ones
- Prepare and support executives for media interviews, external speaking engagements and opportunities for thought leadership
- Manage external PR agencies to ensure alignment on strategic, high-priority initiatives and an effective press calendar
- Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to manage executive communications and key events end-to-end
- Support business and marketing leaders on the creation, development and execution of media and partner marketing strategies
- Coordinate with local, regional and global marketing and global communications colleagues to ensure alignment on messaging, news releases, product launches, key events, and press interviews
Who You Are
- 12+ years of PR and Communications experience
- We are looking for a strategic thinker, sharp writer and seasoned media relations professional within B2B communications, ideally within technology or digital media
- Experienced in shaping and leading complex, multi-market communications programs at scale particularly across Australia, India and Southeast Asia
- Demonstrated success in media strategy and relations, cultivating strong journalist relationships and driving high-impact coverage across business and trade press
- Strong executive-presence skills, with the ability to advise, brief and influence senior stakeholders with confidence and clarity
- Highly organized and detail-oriented with the ability to connect tactical execution to broader strategic goals
- Demonstrated critical thinking skills, including data analysis, problem solving and attention to detail
- A collaborative, solutions-oriented approach, particularly in fast-moving or ambiguous environments, across markets and diverse stakeholder groups

Responsibilities and Competencies:
Policy-Operations-Technology Integration

• Operational Policy Development: Formulate and review operational policies to support programme implementation and grants management, translating policy directives into operational guides
• Continuous Improvement Management: Implement systematic refinements to enhance operational effectiveness while maintaining compliance and quality standards.
User Experience and Customer Service Mindset
• Customer Journey Design: Develop comprehensive end-to-end customer interaction points (offline and online); identifying service gaps and value-creation opportunities.
• Process Streamlining and Appeals Management: Streamline customer management processes and appeal processes; manage escalated enquiries and audit queries on post training activities, grant administration and disbursement process.
• Service Standards Implementation: Implement robust service standards and monitor performance of the process to ensure alignment with service framework.
Partnership and Vendor Management

• System Development Coordination: Coordinate with internal divisions and service providers to manage system development, change requests, problem resolution, including validating requirements and testing.
• Vendor Performance Management: Develop workflows and work instructions for outsourced providers to implement the programmes; monitors service provider performance in operational delivery and customer service.
Performance Monitoring and Reporting
• Performance Analytics and Reporting: Monitor, track and report programme performance including Service Level Agreements indicators and Key Performance indicators, translating metrics into actionable insights for management.
• Risk Assessment and Mitigation: Identify areas of risks, devise mitigating measures, and establishes control measures to ensure operations align with intended policy parameters.

• Nurtures and provide guidance to team members and develops their leadership and functional capabilities through mentoring and coaching.

You are passionate about solving customer issues, detail-oriented with key strengths in operations management and work processes. You are a people person and is committed to nurture, develop and give guidance to your team members.

Title: Principal Product Manager (Lead)
Description:
Company Description
NCS is a leading AI Tech Services company. With a 15,000-strong team across the Asia Pacific, NCS scales its platforms and capabilities to provide clients with greater agility and AI expertise across a range of Industries. Embracing a strong ecosystem of global partners, NCS transforms technology services delivery combining AI with digital resilience to drive real business impact. NCS is a subsidiary of the Singtel Group.
Job Description
The ideal candidate is a senior product leader who can operate confidently at both strategic and execution levels. They are comfortable influencing senior stakeholders, making prioritisation decisions across competing demands, and creating structure without slowing delivery. They bring credibility through deep product management experience, consulting discipline, and strong pre-sales and solutioning expertise, with the ability to shape client problem statements, develop compelling solution approaches, and connect business goals with practical delivery outcomes. They also have the maturity to work across public and private sector contexts, where governance, risk, value, and stakeholder complexity may differ.
The role holder is responsible for leading a portfolio of products or strategic product initiatives to deliver measurable business value, strong client outcomes, and scalable product practices across teams. This role combines product leadership, portfolio prioritisation, operating model design, governance, analytics, and executive engagement. They are also expected to bring thought leadership, mentor teams, and contribute to organisation-wide product management best practices.
What will you do:
1. Lead portfolio delivery and maximise impact
Lead a portfolio of products, product streams, or strategic initiatives from planning through delivery and value realisation.
Ensure product teams are focused on solving the highest-value problems for users, clients, and the business.
Translate strategic priorities into clear product outcomes, roadmaps, and delivery plans across multiple squads.
Drive alignment between business objectives, user needs, delivery capacity, and technical feasibility.
Monitor whether delivered initiatives achieve intended outcomes, and intervene when priorities, scope, or execution need adjustment.
Balance short-term delivery commitments with long-term product sustainability, platform health, and strategic growth.
Guide teams to move beyond feature delivery and maintain focus on measurable impact, adoption, and product performance.
2. Establish product operating model and governance across squads; scale product discovery and measurement
Define, implement, and continuously improve the product operating model across squads to ensure consistency, clarity, and accountability.
Establish clear governance mechanisms for product planning, decision-making, prioritisation, dependency management, and escalation.
Clarify roles, responsibilities, and decision rights across product, engineering, design, delivery, architecture, and business stakeholders.
Standardise core product management practices such as discovery, roadmap planning, backlog management, experimentation, and outcome tracking.
Scale effective product discovery practices so squads consistently validate user needs, business value, and solution assumptions before delivery.
Ensure squads use suitable measures of success, including discovery metrics, delivery indicators, adoption measures, and value outcomes.
Promote disciplined yet practical governance that enables speed, transparency, and quality decision-making rather than unnecessary process.
3. Shape investment and prioritisation across a portfolio; influence executive stakeholders
Lead portfolio-level prioritisation by assessing strategic fit, value potential, cost, risk, dependency, and execution readiness.
Develop structured business cases, investment proposals, and prioritisation recommendations for senior leadership review.
Work with executives and cross-functional leaders to align investment decisions with enterprise goals, client priorities, regulatory considerations, and delivery realities.
Support trade-off discussions where funding, resources, timelines, or business priorities are constrained.
Communicate portfolio choices, sequencing logic, and expected outcomes in a clear and credible manner to senior stakeholders.
Influence decision-making through evidence, market insight, user understanding, and commercial judgement.
4. Define product analytics strategy and value realisation system
Establish a product analytics approach that supports decision-making at squad, product, and portfolio levels.
Define and implement value realisation frameworks using OKRs, product health metrics, adoption measures, customer outcomes, operational indicators, and commercial impact metrics where relevant.
Ensure product teams have clear baselines, targets, and review cadences to track whether products are delivering intended value.
Partner with data, engineering, and business teams to improve access to quality data and strengthen product insight capability.
Use analytics to identify opportunities, underperformance, risks, and improvement actions across the portfolio.
Create regular reporting and review mechanisms for leadership to assess progress, product health, and return on investment.
Promote a culture of evidence-based decision-making and continuous learning.
5. Provide thought leadership and shape organisational best practice
Act as a senior product leader who brings strong point of view, practical experience, and market-informed thinking to improve product management maturity across the organisation.
Contribute to development of product frameworks, standards, governance models, and playbooks.
Coach and mentor product managers and cross-functional teams to strengthen product capability and consistency of practice.
Share lessons learned, emerging trends, and proven approaches to improve how teams deliver product outcomes.
Support leadership in building a stronger product culture and embedding best practice across business and delivery teams.
Qualifications
The ideal candidate should possess:
More than 15 years of experience across product management and consulting, including leadership responsibility for complex products, portfolios, or transformation initiatives.
Demonstrated experience leading product strategy, delivery, and value realisation across multiple squads or business domains.
Proven experience in project and product delivery in both government and commercial environments.
Strong experience in portfolio prioritisation, business case development, investment shaping, and executive stakeholder management.
Experience designing or improving product operating models, governance structures, and scalable product practices.
Hands-on experience in product discovery, roadmap management, experimentation, and outcome measurement.
Strong track record in defining and using OKRs, product health metrics, and analytics to drive product decisions and business outcomes.
Experience working with cross-functional teams including engineering, design, architecture, data, operations, and senior business stakeholders.
Proven experience in pre-sales and solutioning, including shaping client problem statements, developing product and delivery approaches, contributing to proposals and business cases, and presenting solution recommendations to senior stakeholders
Relevant Certifications:
Product management certification is required. Examples may include recognised certifications in product management, product ownership, or digital product leadership.
Agile, Scrum, Lean, or related delivery certifications are advantageous.

Title: Principal Treasury Officer, Head of Treasury Strategic Planning and Middle Office(Based in Beijing)
Description:
The Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB) is a multilateral development bank whose mission is financing Infrastructure for Tomorrow in Asia and beyond – infrastructure with sustainability at its core. We began operations in Beijing in 2016 and have since grown to 111 approved members worldwide. We are capitalized at USD100 billion and AAA-rated by the major international credit rating agencies. Collaborating with partners, AIIB meets clients' needs by unlocking new capital and investing in infrastructure that is green, technology-enabled, and promotes regional connectivity.
The Principal Treasury Officer, Head of Treasury Strategic Planning and Middle Office, is a senior leadership role within the Office of the Treasurer (TRE) at AIIB. The position serves as a strategic integrator across asset liability management (ALM), funding strategy, risk oversight, financial control, and treasury operations, directly supporting the delivery of AIIB's financial and balance sheet strategy.
Operating with a high degree of independence and decision authority, the role will lead a multifunctional team responsible for balance sheet management, long-term financial projections, performance analytics, first-line risk oversight, portfolio valuation, and treasury IT infrastructure. The position will provide core decision support to the treasurer, asset liability committee (ALCO), Chief Financial Officer (CFO), and senior governance committees, and will serve as a key interface with credit rating agencies, shareholders, and external counterparties.
Responsibilities:
- Lead the development and execution of AIIB's balance sheet strategy within the ALM policy framework, driving cross-departmental collaboration across treasury, finance, and risk.
- Direct medium- and long-term cash flow forecasting (contractual and behavioral), including modeling, analysis, projection, and stress testing, to ensure compliance with liquidity policies and limits.
- Own and maintain the Bank's long-term financial projections (LTFP) model, providing strategic decision support for business planning, capital allocation, and budgeting.
- Shape ALM strategies and guidelines, exercising independent judgment on interest rate risk, refinancing risk, currency risk, and liquidity risk positioning.
- Provide strategic advice on hedging, pricing, and structuring for client operations, including flexible financing products, local currency lending, structured finance, and loan syndications.
- Lead treasury's first-line risk oversight function, ensuring compliance of all treasury portfolios to credit, market, and liquidity risk limits.
- Direct the treasury valuation and collateral management functions, including modeling and pricing of the Bank's financial instruments, and monitoring of collateral activity.
- Ensure Credit Support Annex terms are met, and directly manage collateral posted as independent amount. Lead treasury in CSA negotiations with counterparties.
- Monitor and report on the performance of all assets in the treasury management system at the portfolio level.
- Maintain valuation integrity across all treasury positions, coordinating with risk management on model validation.
- Provide core decision support to the Treasurer, ALCO, CFO, and senior committees on balance sheet optimization, capital allocation, risk appetite calibration, and financial sustainability.
- Lead the Bank's relationship with credit rating agencies, including facilitation of ratings reviews, meeting information requirements, and advising on strategies to maintain AIIB's AAA ratings.
- Represent treasury in relevant internal committees, working groups, and cross-functional initiatives.
- Represent AIIB at external conferences, peer group fora, and MDB knowledge exchange platforms, contributing to institutional visibility and thought leadership.
- Lead treasury in contracting with rating agencies and negotiating CSAs with counterparties.
- Lead a multi-functional team spanning ALM and ratings analytics, valuation, and reporting and analytics, with full accountability for team performance, development, and succession planning.
- Drive continuous improvement of treasury effectiveness and efficiency by leveraging technology, driving automation, and defining best-in-class processes and procedures.
- Develop, maintain, and oversee (as system administrator) treasury's IT infrastructure, including core treasury management system and asset liability management system.
- Maintain and enhance all procedures for the treasury middle office function, identifying and implementing process improvements.
- Regularly report on objectives, results, and compliance with internal and external regulations and controls.
Requirements:
- Minimum 20 years of progressive experience in treasury management, ALM, risk management, or financial markets within an international financial institution, multilateral development bank, or comparable environment.
- Master's degree in finance, economics, quantitative discipline, or equivalent. CFA, FRM, or CTP certification preferred.
- Demonstrated track record of strategic leadership at a senior level, including balance sheet management, financial planning, and governance engagement.
- Deep expertise in ALM, cash flow modeling, financial projections, and stress testing methodologies.
- Strong knowledge of derivatives pricing, valuation frameworks, and collateral management.
- Proven ability to lead cross-functional projects and drive organizational change in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.
- Strategic thinker, able to shape direction and priorities in VUCA (volatility, uncertainty, complexity, ambiguity) environments.
- High degree of independence and sound judgment in analytical, strategic, and governance domains.
- Exceptional stakeholder management skills, including experience engaging with senior management, Board members, credit rating agencies, and external counterparties.
- Strong organizational, critical thinking, and communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information for executive audiences.
- Demonstrated ability to build, mentor, and lead high-performing teams across multiple disciplines.
- Familiarity with a broad range of treasury management systems and data analytics platforms.
- Excellent command of English, written and oral. Knowledge of additional languages is an asset.

We believe our strength comes from having a team with the right diverse skills, experiences, and abilities selected through a merit-based competitive process. Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Programmes & Events Executive with a background in Mass Communication to provide maternity cover for the Assistant Manager (Prevention & Restoration) role. The incumbent will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing key programmes, outreach campaigns, and events that align with our mission to promote community awareness, empowerment, and support services. This role requires a balance of hands-on event management, stakeholder engagement, and communication strategy, ensuring programme continuity and visibility during the cover period.
Key Responsibilities
Programme & Event Coordination
- Plan, organize, and execute community programmes, workshops, and outreach events under the Prevention & Restoration pillars.

- Implement robust systems for data collection and analysis to ensure accurate reporting and inform ongoing programme adjustments
Innovation & Improvement

- Propose new approaches for digital storytelling and awareness campaigns leveraging your Mass Communication background.

Consolidate performance of all spaces and share insights across transversal teams

Monitor investment allocation, spend efficiency and performance against plans.
Monitor and evaluate market, brand, campaign and activation performance, identifying key drivers, risks and opportunities.
Develop actionable recommendations based on performance trends, consumer insights and market dynamics to enhance brand growth.
Support preparation for performance reviews, QBRs, AOP cycles and planning sessions, ensuring robust analysis and clear business recommendations.
Manage external agencies and partners to deliver high-quality creative development, production and execution in line with brand standards.
Lead the development and deployment of scalable toolkits, assets and operating frameworks that strengthen execution quality, marketing effectiveness and brand consistency across local markets.
Work closely with global, regional and local teams to ensure alignment across brand plans and execution
Partner with commercial, finance, insights, communications, education and private client teams.

Marketing experience, preferably in brand management, regional marketing, consumer marketing, luxury goods, wines & spirits, hospitality, beauty, lifestyle or premium consumer categories.

Strong project management capability, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, timelines, stakeholders and agency partners.

Title: Regional Director, Research Sales - SEA & ANZ
Description:
Regional Director, Research Sales - SEA & ANZ
About our Team
Our Academic & Government team helps our communities accelerate knowledge for a better world by helping to establish, discover and advance knowledge. We do this by turning scientific discoveries into peer reviewed knowledge, hosting the world’s richest corpus of knowledge, allowing users to unlock insights from content and by measuring the quality and impact of research - turning insights into outcomes.
About the role
The Regional Director, Research Sales leads a sales team of Account Managers and is responsible for driving revenue growth across their region. Regional Directors will manage their team to focus on growing Elsevier’s journals and books business through new sales and maintenance / growth of the existing base (renewals and upsell/cross-sell). In addition, the Regional Director will be accountable for driving renewal/ sales of new offerings (e.g. Leapspace). The role will encompass sales strategic planning and execution, coaching and professional development and delivery of sales results.
The Regional Director is accountable for current and long-term revenue growth across the region, leading sales execution within a complex matrix of teams and products.
Responsibilities
Pre-sales: Develop regional sales plans, identify growth opportunities and risks, guide account planning, and engage key influencers.
Sales: Coach Account Managers on customer needs, negotiations and deal execution to achieve bookings and revenue targets.
Post-sales: Leverage customer insights to identify sales opportunities, support pricing discussions, ensure effective AM/CSM handovers, and participate in business reviews.
Renewals: Ensure timely, effective renewals while identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
Own regional new business, renewals and revenue growth across Journals and Books, including key consortium negotiations.
Build, coach and retain a high-performing sales team and embed global sales initiatives, tools and best practices.
Represent Elsevier with key customers, decision-makers, influencers and partners across the region.
Lead and support large, complex commercial negotiations.
Ensure accurate forecasting, pipeline management, reporting and Salesforce adoption.
Collaborate across sales, pricing, finance, product, marketing and senior management to support long-term business growth.
Requirements
Proven senior sales leadership experience, with a strong track record of achieving revenue growth, new business and renewal targets across a regional or multi-country territory.
Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, develop and retain high-performing sales teams, including driving accountability and implementing organisational change.
Strong experience in strategic sales planning, account management and execution, including identifying growth opportunities, managing commercial risks and developing key account strategies.
Extensive experience managing complex, high-value commercial negotiations, including enterprise customers, strategic accounts and/or consortium agreements.
Strong capability in renewal management, upselling and cross-selling, with a focus on customer needs, retention and long-term revenue growth.
Proven ability to develop and maintain senior-level relationships with key decision-makers, influencers, customers and strategic partners across the region.
Strong sales forecasting and pipeline management capabilities, with experience using CRM and sales enablement tools such as Salesforce, Clari, Challenger or equivalent platforms.
Demonstrated ability to operate effectively within a complex matrix organisation, collaborating across sales, customer success, product, marketing, finance, pricing and senior management.
Strong commercial acumen, analytical and decision-making skills, with the ability to balance current-year performance with the long-term interests of the business.
Excellent leadership, communication, influencing and stakeholder-management skills, with the credibility to represent the organisation at a senior level across Southeast Asia, Australia and New Zealand.
Work in a way that works for you

Flexible working arrangements
Access to learning and development resources

Elsevier is a global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world’s grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world.

Title: Regional Legal Counsel
Description:
Company Description
The ASPAC Legal Department of LVMH’s Beauty Division is looking to hire a Legal Counsel (7- PQE) to be based in Singapore. If you are a diligent, capable and articulate common-law and private practice-trained lawyer with strong legal fundamentals, intellectual curiosity and exceptional drafting skills, looking for a role where law, data, business and luxury gracefully intertwine, this opportunity is for you – your lawyering prowess, diplomacy and keen eye for detail will directly contribute to the smooth functioning of a fast-paced and dynamic Legal Department in the ASPAC region.
This is an incredible opportunity to work with our iconic houses in the Beauty Division: Parfums Christian Dior, Guerlain, Givenchy, Benefit Cosmetics, Make Up For Ever, Fresh, Acqua di Parma, Maison Francis Kurkdjian, Kendo Brands and Kenzo Parfums.
Job Description
Provide day-to-day legal advice and support to the LVMH Beauty portfolio in both its local market and travel retail businesses and across all operational verticals, including real estate/ leasing, retail, digital, supply chain, marketing and visual merchandising, for the following brands: Parfums Christian Dior, Guerlain, Givenchy, Benefit Cosmetics, Make Up For Ever, Fresh, Acqua di Parma, Maison Francis Kurkdjian, Kendo Brands, Fenty and Kenzo Parfums.
Draft, review and advise on a broad range of commercial, corporate, real estate and regulatory matters relevant to the Beauty Division, including agency, retail, e-commerce, marketing, influencer and talent engagement, events, licensing, supply chain, warehousing, logistics, procurement, services, confidentiality, and other business partnership arrangements.
Spearhead and support data privacy, data governance and legal compliance projects and workstreams, including advising on personal data protection laws, marketing consent frameworks, customer data use, cross-border transfers, vendor compliance and the implementation of internal privacy policies and processes.
Track and interpret developments in ASPAC’s data protection laws and regulatory frameworks, reviewing new legislation to assess its practical implications for the Beauty Division’s operations; provide compliance support in advising Maison stakeholders on data privacy compliance matters arising from the division’s business activities, identifying and recommending best practices where relevant.
Support the conduct of regular privacy and consumer law risk assessments, coordinate data audits, and help maintain accurate and compliant privacy documentation and records.
Assist in managing privacy-related user complaints and data breach incidents, supporting timely investigation, escalation, and resolution in line with regulatory requirements.
Partner with regional and global legal colleagues to develop, roll out and embed legal best practices and legal risk management initiatives across the Beauty Division.
Prepare and update contract templates to maintain an up-to-date repository of contracts for key stakeholders, and provide regular training to stakeholders across the business, including training on the use of contract templates and key legal issues relevant to their roles within the business.
Support legal, privacy and special projects as tasked by the Beauty Division – Regional Legal Director (General Counsel) from time to time.
Qualifications
Holder of a valid legal practitioner qualification in a developed Common Law jurisdiction, preferably Singapore.
7+ years of post-qualification experience in a reputable law firm – our preference is to hire candidates currently working in private practice.
Demonstrated substantial hands-on experience in drafting and reviewing a broad range of commercial, licensing, eCommerce and marketing terms & conditions, as well as preparing articulated legal advice & memoranda. (Strong drafting and communication skills are fundamental requirements for the role and will be assessed as part of the recruitment process through a written test.)
Experience dealing with privacy, data protection and cybersecurity matters arising in the context of general corporate and commercial transactions. Whilst we are not seeking a specialist data privacy counsel - candidates should however be comfortable in reviewing regulations, identifying and addressing mandatory requirements, spotting issues, and undertaking data/ risk mapping exercises as part of the assigned broader commercial legal work.
Demonstrated experience in coordinating and managing legal projects on selected marketing, advertising and eCommerce projects, including working cross-functionally and driving matters through implementation.
Ability to work independently – once the successful candidate is assimilated into the role, he/she will not be under daily supervision for BAU (‘business as usual’) matters.
Highly agile with the ability to adapt quickly to changing circumstances and continuously recalibrate priorities in response to evolving business, legal and organizational needs.
Excellent command of the English language is essential. Proficiency in Mandarin and Bahasa Indonesia/Malay would be an advantage, as the role involves liaising with stakeholders across our Southeast Asia and Greater China operations.
Warm, yet polished, firm and well-spoken, with outstanding interpersonal skills and a proven ability to communicate effectively and diplomatically across diverse cultures and seniority levels.

Title: Regional Operations Director
Description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
Regional Operations Director
Job Summary/Goals
Lead integrated facilities management operations across the APAC (including GC exc. West Asia) portfolio for a major multi-service corporate client, ensuring operational excellence, financial performance, risk compliance, and exceptional employee experience delivery across a portfolio exceeding 1.5 million square feet.
As the primary regional operational lead across 10+ countries, the role partners closely with the Regional Account Executive and cross-functional service line leaders to deliver contractual commitments, operational transformation, technology-enabled improvements, and strategic business outcomes while leading a regional team of 80 employees. The role reports to Regional Account Executive.
What Your Day-to-Day Will Look Like
• Own the operational heartbeat of the account: You'll oversee integrated FM service delivery across 1.5M+ sq. ft. spanning 10+ countries in APAC (including GC exc. West Asia), ensuring KPIs, Joint Business Plans, and compliance targets are consistently met.
• Be the trusted partner to senior client stakeholders: From day-to-day engagement to executive business reviews, you'll act as a strategic advisor, communicating performance, managing risks, and strengthening client partnership at every level.
• Lead and develop a regional team of 80: You'll coach, develop, and inspire a geographically dispersed, multicultural team, building capability, managing succession, and creating a high-performance culture across borders.
• Drive digital transformation and innovation: You'll champion the adoption of AI tools, smart building technologies, automation, and data analytics, leading change management to embed new ways of working across teams and vendors.
• Manage financial and commercial performance: From budgeting and forecasting to vendor governance and supply chain spending, you'll support financial targets and identify savings opportunities that deliver value for the client.
• Lead on risk, compliance, and governance: You'll own Health & Safety, engineering risk programmes, audit readiness, and incident reporting — fostering a risk-aware culture across all sites and service lines.
• Shape and execute the regional strategy: Working closely with the Regional Account Executive, you'll translate client priorities into operational action, driving consistency, best practice, and continuous improvement across the entire APAC (including GC exc. West Asia).
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Client & Operational Leadership
• Partner with the Regional Account Executive to maintain strong engagement with client stakeholders and ensure alignment between operational delivery and client business priorities.
• Lead the execution of the regional operational strategy and service delivery across the APAC (including GC exc. West Asia) portfolio.
• Drive a culture of service excellence, continuous improvement, and accountability across all sites and teams.
• Ensure delivery of contractual obligations, including achievement of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), Joint Business Plan priorities, and Partnership Incentive Fund (PIF) objectives.
• Partner with Workplace Experience, Projects, Real Estate, Engineering, Risk, and other service line teams to ensure integrated and seamless service delivery.
• Oversee operational governance, reporting, systems, and data integrity to ensure compliance, consistency, and effective decision-making across the portfolio.
• Partner with Workplace Experience, Projects, Engineering, Real Estate, Risk & Compliance, and other service lines to deliver integrated workplace solutions and positive employee experience outcomes.
• Monitor Planned Preventive Maintenance (PPM) programs to ensure compliance with local regulations, client standards, and JLL operational requirements.
• Ensuring robust business continuity, crisis management, and emergency response procedures are implemented, maintained, and regularly communicated across all sites.
• Accountable for the regional success of the "autonomous operations" model (EPIC), including delivery, performance, and outcomes.
Digital and Innovation Leadership
• Drive operational innovation and digital transformation initiatives across the portfolio, leveraging technology, automation, AI-enabled tools, smart building solutions, and data-driven insights to improve operational efficiency, service quality, scalability, reporting, and employee experience.
• Partner with account leadership, technology teams, and service line leaders to strengthen digital adoption, operational analytics, and technology-enabled decision-making across the portfolio.
• Lead adoption and change management initiatives related to operational technologies, digital workflows, analytics platforms, and AI-enabled capabilities across regional teams and vendors.
Financial & Commercial Management
• Support the Regional Account Executive in achieving financial targets, operational efficiencies, savings initiatives, and commercial objectives across the portfolio.
• Oversee regional budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, and operational expenditure management.
• Provide governance oversight of vendor performance, supply chain expenditure, and commercial compliance activities, including contract changes and service performance management.
People Leadership & Talent Development
• Lead, Inspire and develop a regional team of 80 employees across geographically dispersed and multicultural sites, fostering a high-performance, inclusive, and accountable culture.
• Directly manage the professional development of all direct reports, providing regular coaching, feedback and career growth opportunities aligned to JLL’s talent framework. Ensure team members have clear objectives, professional development plans and participate in training and continuous learning activities.
• Prepare and maintain a robust Succession Plan for the account, identifying and developing high-potential talent to ensure business continuity and pipeline readiness in partnership with HR.
• Champion employee engagement and wellbeing across the regional team, modelling JLL behaviours for the team.
• Manage team resourcing and workload allocation to support effective and sustainable operations.
• Participate in remuneration and talent review processes as required.
Risk, Compliance & Governance
• Promote a strong risk-aware culture across the account and ensure compliance with client, local regulatory, and JLL Health, Safety, Environment, and Risk Management standards.
• Be accountable for regional Health & Safety and Engineering/Design/Risk program and its deliverables.
• Ensure all incidents are reported and managed in accordance with client and JLL procedures.
• Oversee operational risk mitigation activities and ensure appropriate escalation processes are in place across the region.
• Support audit readiness and ensure operational compliance documentation is maintained and accessible.
• Partner with internal risk, compliance, and safety teams to continuously strengthen governance standards and operational resilience.
Leadership & Stakeholder Management
• Act as a trusted advisor and operational partner to senior client stakeholders and internal leadership teams.
• Promote open, constructive, and collaborative relationships across client teams, JLL functions, and external vendors.
• Communicate operational priorities, performance outcomes, risks, and improvement initiatives clearly and effectively.
• Lead by example in demonstrating JLL values, ethical standards, professionalism, and inclusive leadership behaviours.
• Drive operational transformation and innovation initiatives that improve workplace experience, sustainability outcomes, and service efficiency across the portfolio.
Key Performance Measures
Performance will be measured through achievement of:
• Contractual KPIs
• Client satisfaction and employee experience outcomes
• Financial performance, budget management, and savings targets
• Operational consistency and service quality
• Compliance, audit, and safety performance
• Adoption and successful implementation of operational technology and innovation initiatives
• Improvement in operational efficiency, automation, reporting quality, or digital maturity outcomes
• Sustainability and operational efficiency objectives
• Timely and accurate operational and financial reporting
• Team engagement, capability development, and retention
Key Stakeholders
• Regional Account Executive
• Client Regional Leadership and Governance Teams
• Country internal Workplace Experience Teams and client-side leadership
• Engineering Operations and EOS Teams
• Projects and Real Estate Teams
• Finance, Procurement, HR, and Risk Functions
• External Vendors and Service Providers
Skills & Experience
• Strong leadership capability with experience managing geographically dispersed and multicultural teams across APAC & Greater China.
• Strong operational, commercial, and financial management skills.
• Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and clients.
• Experience leading or supporting digital transformation, operational technology adoption, automation initiatives, or data-driven operational improvement programs within facilities management, workplace operations, or corporate real estate environments.
• Demonstrated ability to leverage data, analytics, and technology insights to support operational decision-making, performance optimization, and continuous improvement.
• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving capability.
• Strong communication and presentation skills, with fluency in English required.
• Additional APAC regional language capability is advantageous.
• Demonstrated ability to lead change, continuous improvement, and operational transformation initiatives.
• Resilient and adaptable in fast-paced and evolving operational environments.
• Strong digital, systems, and data literacy, including workplace technologies, operational reporting platforms, and analytics tools.
• Ability to balance strategic priorities with operational execution.
Competencies
• Leadership: Sets clear objectives and measurable outcomes for teams and stakeholders. Motivates and develops teams to achieve operational excellence and client outcomes. Demonstrates ethical leadership and accountability consistent with JLL values and standards.
• Decision Making: Applies sound judgment and data-driven thinking to resolve complex operational and commercial challenges.
•Communication: Builds trusted relationships and communicates effectively with stakeholders across all organizational levels.
• Strategic Thinking: Leverages data, technology, and commercial insight to improve operational outcomes and support transformation initiatives.

Title: Regional Partnerships Manager
Description:

We are seeking a proactive and commercially minded Regional Partnerships Manager to drive business development, F&B product sales, food concept innovation and strategic partnership growth within the Food & Beverage (F&B) industry.
The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, developing and refreshing food concepts, expanding product sales channels and establishing strategic commercial partnerships across regional markets.
A key focus of this role is managing and strengthening relationships with the company's key strategic partners based in the Philippines, while exploring additional business opportunities and partnerships in Indonesia and other relevant markets.
Key Responsibilities
1. Business Development & Opportunity Exploration
Identify, evaluate and develop new business opportunities within the F&B industry, including new markets, sales channels and potential business ventures.
Conduct market research to identify emerging food trends, customer preferences, competitor activities and growth opportunities.
Develop business proposals, commercial plans and strategies to support market expansion and revenue growth.
Evaluate potential business models, distribution opportunities and commercial collaborations to improve business performance.
Explore opportunities to expand the company's F&B business through new products, services, concepts and strategic commercial initiatives.
2. Food Concept Development & Innovation
Explore, develop and update food concepts in response to changing consumer preferences, market trends and business opportunities.
Propose new F&B product offerings, menu concepts, food formats and product combinations to enhance market appeal.
Review existing food concepts and recommend improvements to product offerings, menu presentation, pricing and customer experience.
Work with relevant internal teams, suppliers and business partners to evaluate product feasibility, cost considerations and commercial viability.
Coordinate concept trials, product launches and promotional initiatives to assess market response and support successful implementation.
3. Strategic Partnerships & Regional Expansion
Establish, develop and maintain long-term relationships with strategic partners, distributors, suppliers, food operators and corporate customers.
Manage and strengthen working relationships with the company's key strategic partners based in the Philippines.
Coordinate regular business discussions, partnership meetings, commercial negotiations and follow-up activities with strategic partners.
Identify and pursue partnership opportunities that support new food concepts, product distribution, sales growth and regional business expansion.
Explore opportunities for joint ventures, co-branding, product collaborations and other mutually beneficial commercial arrangements where appropriate.
Develop partnership proposals and coordinate implementation plans to achieve agreed business objectives.
Explore additional business opportunities and establish new strategic relationships in Indonesia and other relevant regional markets.
4. F&B Product Sales & Marketing
Promote and sell F&B products, food items and related offerings to business customers and strategic partners.
Identify prospective customers, generate sales leads and convert business opportunities into commercial orders.
Develop product presentations, quotations, sales proposals and commercial plans tailored to customer requirements.
Explore new sales channels, distribution networks and customer segments to increase product reach and revenue.
Coordinate product launches, promotional campaigns and sales initiatives to improve product awareness and market penetration.
Monitor sales performance, customer feedback, market demand and competitor activities to identify opportunities for improvement.
Support the development of pricing strategies and commercial proposals in line with business objectives.

Support business development and commercial activities across the Philippines, Indonesia and other relevant regional markets.
Maintain effective communication with business partners and customers to understand local market requirements and resolve business-related issues.
Coordinate with internal teams on product development, pricing, availability, order fulfilment and partner requirements.
Prepare regular reports on market opportunities, sales performance, partnership progress and business development activities.
Conduct market research and business visits to identify potential customers, evaluate commercial opportunities and strengthen partner relationships.
Travel regionally when required for business meetings, market research, customer visits and partnership development.
