Title: Regional Trade Marketing Manager, SEA
Description:
The Opportunity
We are partnering with a fast-growing global FMCG organisation to appoint a Regional Trade Marketing Manager to strengthen its commercial and trade marketing capabilities across the region, with Southeast Asia (SEA) as the key priority market.
Operating within a regional matrix structure, this role will be responsible for translating brand and commercial strategies into impactful channel and shopper activation plans. You will work closely with regional and local Sales, Marketing, Trade Marketing teams and distributor partners to accelerate brand penetration, strengthen in-store execution, and drive sustainable sales growth across priority SEA markets.
This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced trade marketing professional who combines regional strategic thinking with strong hands-on execution across diverse and distributor-led markets.
About the Company
Our client is a rapidly expanding global food and consumer goods organisation with an established portfolio of well-recognised brands. With ambitious international growth plans, the organisation continues to invest in strengthening its commercial capabilities, distribution footprint, and consumer relevance across Southeast Asia.
Key Responsibilities
Regional Channel Strategy & Planning
Develop and execute regional trade and channel marketing strategies, with SEA as the primary market focus, across Modern Trade (MT) and General Trade (GT).
Translate brand strategies and campaigns into locally relevant channel execution plans across priority SEA markets.
Develop channel and customer segmentation strategies to identify and prioritise commercial growth opportunities.
Partner with local Sales teams and distributors on joint business planning and market execution.
Shopper Marketing & In-Store Excellence
Develop shopper marketing programmes that drive brand trial, conversion, basket size, and sales growth.
Create scalable regional execution toolkits covering POSM, planograms, promotional mechanics, and in-store visibility.
Partner with SEA markets to adapt regional initiatives based on local shopper missions, channel dynamics, and cultural relevance.
Champion best-in-class in-store execution and consistency across priority brands and channels.
Trade Promotion & Commercial Effectiveness
Develop and optimise trade promotion strategies across channels, seasons, and key commercial campaigns.
Evaluate promotional mechanics, bundling strategies, and trade investments to identify opportunities for improvement.
Monitor promotional effectiveness and ROI, translating performance insights into actionable recommendations.
Shopper Insights & Category Execution
Leverage shopper, market, and sales insights to understand behavioural differences across SEA markets and channels.
Translate insights into actionable trade marketing and channel strategies.
Champion execution standards across assortment, merchandising, pricing, promotion, and shelf (AMPPS).
Ensure consistent brand execution while enabling appropriate localisation across individual markets.
Stakeholder & Capability Development
Collaborate closely with regional and local Sales, Marketing, Trade Marketing, Insights, and distributor teams.
Lead complex cross-market projects involving multiple stakeholders across SEA.
Coach and develop trade marketing capabilities across regional and local teams.
Drive continuous improvement in trade marketing processes, tools, and ways of working.
Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Business, Commerce, or a related discipline.
Approximately 10–12+ years of experience in Trade Marketing, Shopper Marketing, Channel Marketing, Customer Marketing, or related commercial roles within FMCG or consumer goods.
Strong regional experience across Southeast Asia is highly preferred, ideally gained within an FMCG regional or APAC headquarters environment.
Strong understanding of SEA's diverse Modern Trade, General Trade, and distributor-led market dynamics.
Proven ability to translate brand strategies into effective channel and shopper activation plans.
Strong analytical and commercial capabilities with experience interpreting sales, shopper, market, and promotional performance data.
Excellent project management and stakeholder influencing skills with the ability to operate effectively across a matrix organisation.
Strong leadership and coaching capabilities with experience developing trade marketing talent and organisational capabilities.
Fluent written and spoken English; proficiency in relevant local languages is advantageous for effective communication with market, distributor and commercial stakeholders across the assigned SEA markets.
Entrepreneurial, agile, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

Strong exposure to commercial strategy, shopper marketing, and distributor-led market development.

Description:
Regulatory Affairs/Quality Assurance APAC
Location:
Singapore, SG, 068902
Travel activity: 0-5%
Employment Type: Permanent
Your challenge
We are looking for a Regulatory Affairs / Quality Assurance professional to join Greiner Bio-One Singapore and support regulatory and quality activities across the Asia-Pacific (APAC) region.
In this regional role, you will work closely with local subsidiaries, distributors, and global Regulatory Affairs and Quality Management teams to support regulatory compliance, product registrations and quality-related activities across APAC markets. You will serve as an important link between regional markets and Greiner Bio-One's global functions, helping to ensure that products are compliant with applicable regulatory requirements and maintained to the company's quality standards.
Core Responsibilities:
Manage the application, renewal and maintenance of GBO-APAC local countries’ product registration and licenses; coordinate and work closely with GBO-APAC market authorized holders and GBO headquarters
Regularly coordinate and liaise with internal stakeholders, GBO-APAC business partners, and local authorities/regulators
Act as the Medical Devices Regulatory and Compliance Subject Matter Expert in APAC; be aware of and monitor global and local regulations and standards changes and provide advice on local and regional requirements
Maintain regulatory documentation and ensure the registration database is updated
Support and assist internal/external audits; participate in regulatory inspections by the external authorities/regulators
Support, assist and provide advice of product design changes and control processes
Support, process and manage product incidence reports, post-market
Ensures complaints are processed and documented according to regulatory requirements
Ensures complaints are investigated in due time and work cross-functionally with HQ on prioritization
Assist in implementing and maintaining the local QMS, training system and related procedures.
Support and coordinate monitoring and review of issues, customer dissatisfaction, and complaints received for APAC
Your Profile
Bachelor’s Degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biomedical Engineering, or a related scientific discipline.
Minimum 3-5 years of experience in medical device or IVD product registration is preferred.
Familiarity with national health authority registration frameworks across APAC (e.g., HSA in Singapore, TGA in Australia, NMPA in China, PMDA in Japan, TFDA Taiwan, ASEAN Medical Device Regulatory Framework).
Familiarity with the MDSAP Audit programme.
Strong analytical, organisational and documentation skills with excellent attention to detail.
Good communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across different cultures and countries.
Ability to manage multiple projects and regulatory timelines independently.
Proficiency in English; additional Asian languages would be an advantage.
Our Offer
Company Overview:
Greiner Bio-One Singapore Pte. Ltd. is part of Greiner Bio-One, a globally active medical technology company for the in-vitro diagnostics, biotechnology, diagnostic and pharmaceutical industries. The broad portfolio is sold in more than 100 countries worldwide. By using state-of-the-art technologies, Greiner Bio-One creates the basis for top performance in pre-analytics, diagnostics, basic research and pharmaceutical drug discovery. The company operates in the market via the two business units Preanalytics and BioScience and has more than 2300 employees and 28 subsidiaries.
Established in Singapore in 2022, Greiner Bio-One Singapore serves as a regional hub supporting market development and customers across the Asia and Pacific regions. Greiner Bio-One Singapore is located at 112 Robinson Road, Singapore, and works closely with colleagues, customers, distributors and regional stakeholders across the APAC market.
Why join Greiner Bio-One Singapore?
You will have the opportunity to work in a regional APAC role within a global medical technology organisation, collaborating with colleagues across different markets and functions. The position provides exposure to regulatory and quality requirements across Asia-Pacific while contributing to products and solutions that support healthcare professionals, laboratories and patient safety.

is a Singapore-based fintech company offering a MAS-regulated multi-currency wallet, foreign exchange, card and international remittance services.
Through the
iChange
app, customers can access competitive foreign exchange rates, manage multiple currencies, make payments globally using the iChange Mastercard, send money overseas and access other cross-border payment services.
As we expand our customer acquisition and partnership activities in Singapore, we are looking for an energetic and commercially driven individual to help grow
iChange
through strategic partnerships, field activations and targeted marketing initiatives.

Sales & Marketing Specialist – Partnerships & Customer Acquisition
to support the growth of
iChange
in Singapore.
This is a hands-on role combining business development, partnerships, field marketing and customer acquisition. The successful candidate will work closely with the CEO and management team to identify and develop new acquisition channels and execute campaigns that generate measurable customer growth.
A key part of the role will be building relationships with travel agencies, moneychangers, merchants and other relevant distribution partners to promote
iChange
’s foreign exchange, card and remittance propositions.
The candidate should be comfortable being hands-on. This is not purely a desk-based marketing position. Some activations may take place on weekends, particularly Sundays, depending on the target customer segment and location, with appropriate time-off arrangements.
The role will also work with our digital marketing and creative partners to ensure that online campaigns, partnership activities and physical activations are coordinated effectively.
Key Responsibilities:
· Develop partnerships with travel agencies, money changers, merchants and other potential customer-acquisition channels.
· Identify, approach and onboard new distribution and promotional partners.
· Plan and manage roadshows, pop-up booths and other customer-acquisition activities across Singapore.
· Coordinate promoters and other external resources required for field campaigns.
· Conduct product presentations, demonstrations and partner training.
· Develop promotional concepts and campaigns together with internal teams and external marketing agencies.
· Track leads, customers sign-ups, activation rates, campaign costs and conversion performance.
· Identify new locations, communities and customer segments where iChange can acquire customers efficiently.
· Gather market intelligence and competitor insights from the travel, payments, FX and remittance sectors.
· Take ownership of initiatives from planning through execution and post-campaign analysis.
· Maintaining the sales / partnership pipeline in CRM, including follow-ups and conversion tracking.
Job Requirements:
· Strong sales, business development and relationship-management skills.
·
3 – 5
years of relevant experience, preferably in fintech, payments, travel, foreign exchange, remittance, cards or consumer financial services.
· Experience developing partnerships with travel agencies, money changers, merchants or retail/distribution networks would be particularly relevant.
· Experience with roadshows, events, field marketing, merchant acquisition or customer activation campaign is preferred.

Job Summary
Our client, a leading provider of life science and scientific research solutions, is seeking a driven and customer-focused Sales Account Manager to grow its flow cytometry product portfolio in Singapore.
The successful candidate will be responsible for developing new business opportunities, managing existing customer accounts, and promoting flow cytometry solutions to research laboratories, academic institutions, hospitals, biotechnology companies and pharmaceutical organisations.

LG-Singapore is a Singapore-based environmental technologycompany specializing in innovative organic waste management solutions. Ourproprietary technology transforms organic waste into high-quality organicfertilizer, helping businesses reduce waste while supporting the circulareconomy. As we expand our organic fertilizer business locally andinternationally, we are looking for an ambitious sales professional to bringour product to growers, distributors and end users.
Job Overview
We are seeking a results-driven Sales Executive/Manager tolead the sales of our organic fertilizer product. You will build a customerbase across agriculture, horticulture, landscaping and distribution channels, local and overseas,and convert qualified leads into repeat business from first contact throughcontract signing and ongoing account management.
This role suits someone proactive and persistent infollow-ups, comfortable explaining the technical benefits of an organic productto farmers, buyers and partners, and capable of managing multiple opportunitiesand accounts at the same time.
The successful candidate will play a key role in growing ourorganic fertilizer sales in Singapore and overseas markets, and in developinglasting relationships with customers and channel partners across multipleindustries.

• Own the full sales cycle for the organic fertilizer product, from lead generation and initial enquiry through negotiation, contract execution, delivery coordination and repeat orders
• Identify and develop target customer segments, such as farms and agri-businesses, vertical and urban farms, nurseries, landscaping and turf companies, golf courses, town councils and facility managers,distributors, retailers and overseas importers
• Build and manage a sales pipeline; follow upconsistently with prospects and maintain strong engagement throughout theirdecision-making process
• Present the product's benefits to customers, including nutrient composition, soil health improvement, application methods, and the sustainability and circular-economy value of fertilizer made from recycle dorganic waste
• Arrange product samples, field trials and demonstrations, and gather results and testimonials to support sales
• Prepare quotations, proposals, price lists and sales presentations for customers and distribution partners
• Develop and manage distributor, reseller and agentrelationships locally and in overseas markets
• Collaborate with the Legal team on supply agreements,distribution agreements and other commercial contracts, ensuring terms align with business objectives and company policies
• Work with Operations and Technical teams on production planning, stock availability, packaging, delivery schedules and product quality, so customer commitments are met
• Support product registration, labelling and regulatory documentation requirements for fertilizer sales in target markets, togetherwith the relevant teams
• Maintain accurate CRM and sales records, and provideregular sales forecasts and progress updates to management and investors
• Conduct market research on industry trends, pricing,customer needs and competitor products
• Represent the company at meetings, trade shows,exhibitions, conferences and networking events
• Keep management informed of customer feedback, product performance, risks and opportunities requiring attention
• Follow up after sale on customer satisfaction, payment collection and repeat purchase opportunities
Qualifications
• Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing,Agriculture, Horticulture, Environmental Science, Biology, Chemistry,Biotechnology, Engineering or a related discipline
• 3-5 years of experience in B2B sales, account management or business development; experience selling fertilizers, agri-inputs, horticultural products or other products to farms, nurseries or landscaping customers is an advantage
• Knowledge of organic fertilizers, soil science, plant nutrition, urban farming, waste management, sustainability or ESG-relatedbusiness is strongly preferred
• Early-career professionals with strong technical aptitude, excellent communication and follow-up skills, and a genuine interest in agriculture and environmental technology are encouraged to apply
• Proven track record of securing and closing deals
Skills
• Excellent follow-up and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple leads and accounts simultaneously

• Self-motivated, resourceful and able to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams
• Ability to understand customer requirements and recommend suitable products and application approaches
• Good negotiation skills and commercial awareness,including pricing, margins and payment terms
• Proficient in Microsoft Office applications; experience with CRM software is an added advantage
• Willingness to travel locally and overseas, includingsite and farm visits, as required
• Additional languages (such as Mandarin, Malay, Bahasa Indonesia or Thai) are an advantage for regional markets
• Demonstrates humility, professionalism and a collaborative working style with both external and internal stakeholders
• Strong listening skills, with the ability to understand customer and management requirements before responding

This role acts as the primary point of contact for all matters related to the account, building and maintaining strong, long-lasting customer relationships backed by competence, knowledge, and experience. Strategic Leadership Management:
Act as the primary point of contact for all matters specific and related to the account, serving as a strategic partner to the client.
Create and execute annual site business plans aligned with client growth and JLL growth plans and initiatives that support account expansion and win: win outcomes.
Drive and track cost-saving initiatives and innovative solutions (including technology, process, and sustainability improvements) to deliver measurable value and support account profitability and growth.
Build and maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships, ensuring deep understanding of client business and strategic objectives.
Ensure seamless and efficient delivery, improving cost optimization, mitigating risk, and fostering sustainable practices, including the development of the team and cross-skilling.
Client Relationship Management
Conduct regular client engagements, including weekly operations meetings, monthly management review meetings, and quarterly business reviews (QBRs).
Demonstrate strong attention to detail and proactive communication of updates, issues, risk mitigation solutions, and delays.
Proactively engage stakeholders to ensure that on-site client expectations are met.
Build and develop effective client/stakeholder relationships across multiple levels of the organizations (JLL and Client).
Serve as on-site key point of contact for Facilities in the client's premises.
Maintain close liaison with the client on-site representatives to address problems and/or enhance working environment performance.
Operational Excellence & Site Operations Management
Manage all building-related technical and service contracts, develop and implement procedures and performance measures to ensure efficiency, accuracy, reliability, and safety of work methods and systems.
Ensure compliance with contract requirements and manage risk, acting as the ultimate compliance authority for the account.
Manage internal reporting such as development tracker, opex and capex pipeline, compliance, risk, and issues.
Recommend continuous quality improvement practices and implement industry best practice operations.
Implement building procedures and performance measures and ensure they are maintained at all times.
Ensure all Critical Environment (CEM) requirements are met, including compliance with ISO, BCA and HSE standards.
Review existing operations regularly to reduce costs and improve operational standards.
Provide 24/7 emergency call support and site attendance as required.
Coordinate critical out-of-hours issues and participate as a key team member in investigations and responses to emergency situations.
Ensure uninterrupted site operations and be present at major events, incidents, and shutdowns.
Business Development & Growth
Develop new business and identify new and innovative business opportunities, expanding the share of wallet by solving client pain points.
Initiate and participate in contract negotiations and agreements.
Work collaboratively with facilities team colleagues both within the client location and in the wider Jones Lang LaSalle network.
Act as a strategic partner to the client, identifying and supporting account growth opportunities, expanding service scope, and ensuring mutually beneficial outcomes.
Team Leadership & People Management
Build and lead empowered, technically capable account teams whose competencies align with the client's industry and business.
Foster talent development and conduct quality career development conversations, including robust succession planning and cross-training initiatives.
Manage diverse teams across the portfolio.
Manage and coach team members, developing and sustaining a high-quality, well-motivated team.
Ensure high staff morale, trust, and work ethics.
Build and maintain an environment that supports teamwork, cooperation, and performance excellence within the team.
Mentor and enable training and development of team members to ensure staff development to anticipate/meet client requirements and growth.
Demonstrate flexibility and adaptability to support evolving client requirements, new technologies, and changes in the business environment.

Manage IFM service delivery models (self-performed and sub-contracted) covering facility management, workplace services, site services, ground maintenance, engineering services, employee services, utilities and energy, and specialty services.
Ensure governance and account management structures are in place.
Sponsor the Asset Management Program and Audit program, allocating resources and ensuring delivery execution.
Leverage technology and data analytics (e.g., CMMS, ServiceNow, analytics platforms) to drive operational efficiency, transparency, and continuous improvement in service delivery and asset management.
Procurement & Vendor Management
Manage all 3rd party/subcontractor performance, ensuring vendors are well-managed, deliver services on time and within budget, and minimize JLL’s risk exposure.
Ensure that vendor procurement processes comply with agreed client procurement guidelines as well as Jones Lang LaSalle best practice.
Ensure vendors are selected based on their familiarity with the local market situation, enabling them to offer timely and effective responses to service requests.
Consolidate contracts and suppliers to leverage volume purchasing power and streamline vendor relationships.
Contracts Management

Ensure expiry of contracts are well-monitored and re-procurement is initiated and all compliance needs are met including licensing and insurance coverage.
Ensure contracts are continually assessed to deliver best value to the client.
Financial Management
Actively work to ensure that the site's financial operations are meeting or exceeding targets and control requirements, including the Jones Lang LaSalle Code of Ethics.
Ensure financial processes are followed at all times with no non-compliance outcomes.
Develop and accurately oversee the forecast and budget management for the account, including opex and capex.
Track and report on cost savings achieved, ensuring alignment with client and JLL targets.
Health, Safety, Security & Environment (HSSE) Management
Champion a culture of compliance and safety, ensuring all operations, financial processes, and service delivery meet or exceed JLL and client standards, statutory regulations, and audit requirements.
Ensure the provision of a safe working environment and compliance with statutory regulations on fire, health, and safety standards.

Lead the development, implementation, and regular testing of integrated risk management and business continuity frameworks, proactively identifying and mitigating operational, financial, and reputational risks.

Ensure disaster recovery and business continuity plans are implemented and maintained.
Ensure escalation procedures and incident reporting procedures are implemented and in place.
Assist in the development of guidelines and strategies to ensure compliance with Jones Lang LaSalle's business conduct.
Act as the first escalation point for issues that require resolution and/or support.

Attain client KPIs.
Ensure continual service improvements.
Maintain client satisfaction survey (Client Voice) at the highest level (e.g., >8 Survey Score).
Leverage technology and data analytics to drive operational efficiency, transparency, and continuous improvement in service delivery and asset management.

Based in Singapore reporting to the EVP APAC, the Senior Business Development Manager will be responsible for identifying repeat and new sales opportunities within the region, growing strategic relationships, and utilizing commercial acumen to define and maximize opportunities. · Developing our existing accounts, and inside wallets, from our regional and Global client base, working alongside our other product and services Business Development colleagues.

· Delivering compelling sales presentations to prospects, highlighting the benefits and features of our various solutions.
· Developing our accreditation and regulatory channels for learning solutions.
· Leveraging industry contacts to drive business development initiatives and enhance the company’s presence in APAC.
· Evaluating competition, analysing the market, and thinking laterally to target opportunities for growth in APAC whilst staying informed about industry trends, competitors and market conditions.

Title: Senior Client Executive
Description:
Description
01 Meet the studio.
MSQ Asia & Elmwood Singapore is our hybrid hub for Southeast Asia, where brand distinctiveness meets joined-up activation for greater impact.
MSQ is the world's most AI-enabled challenger group, with AI-powered human creativity at the heart of everything we do. We fuse the right mix of capabilities to unlock momentum for brands, connecting creative performance to business outcomes in real time. We have global specialists across creative, social and influencer, media and commerce, strategy & insights, CX & creative, tech, sports & entertainment, and AI products & data. This is MSQ's Joined-Up Thinking: the scale of a holding company with the agility of an independent.
Elmwood is our global brand and design capability, with almost 50 years of experience as one of the world's most effective brand and design agencies. With studios in London, New York, Singapore and Shanghai, we create brands that are more meaningful, more memorable and built to move faster than the market. Our work covers brand strategy and identity, packaging and experience design for clients across global personal care, food and beverage, financial services and technology. Elmwood is proud of its long track record at the DBA Design Effectiveness Awards, the longest-running awards for design that delivers measurable business results.
Requirements
02 Why this role matters.
The Senior Account Executive sits between the Account Executive and Account Manager levels — and it is one of the most important developmental roles in the client services team. You will step up to own day-to-day client relationships on key workstreams, manage projects end to end, coordinate internal and external teams, and ensure work is delivered on brief, on time and on budget. You will be a trusted partner to clients and an organised, proactive driver of project excellence within the studio.
03 What you will be doing.
People & Team accountabilities:
Begin to coach and support more junior team members, sharing your knowledge and applying developing coaching techniques to help them grow.
Contribute actively to knowledge-sharing initiatives and encourage team interaction — helping to build a collaborative, high-energy team environment.
Begin to understand and connect your work to the wider agency strategy and business goals, and help your team do the same.
Assist in managing small-scale project or team changes, helping to maintain momentum and morale when things shift.
Work/offer accountabilities:
Manage day-to-day delivery of assigned client projects, from brief through to final implementation, ensuring timelines, budgets and quality standards are met.
Support in writing and refining clear, actionable creative, design execution and production briefs for internal teams and suppliers.
Coordinate closely with design, strategy and provocation teams to ensure creative work aligns with client objectives and brand strategy.
Prepare proposals, cost estimates, project timelines, contact reports and maintain up-to-date project documentation and folders.
Liaise with third-party suppliers and production partners to manage implementation phases and ensure delivery excellence.
Begin to manage resources more effectively — tracking your own time, supporting workflow management and contributing to team capacity planning.
Client accountabilities:
Handle day-to-day client communications, proactively managing expectations, sharing status updates and ensuring a consistently high standard of service.
Play a more active and independent role in maintaining and nurturing client relationships, taking ownership of your assigned workstreams with growing confidence.
Identify and suggest new areas for client development — recognising opportunities for additional briefs and up-selling relevant services.
Assist in preparing proposals, credentials and pitch materials, beginning to take active management of smaller pitch responses.
Develop a more detailed understanding of specific client industry segments — leading in gathering and analysing client and competitor data.
Business accountabilities
Monitor project financials, including tracking hours, costs and billing information, flagging risks early and supporting revenue and profitability targets.
Assist in managing parts of the client revenue pipeline and support accurate forecasting and reporting.
Support new business efforts with research, credentials collation, case study preparation and pitch support when required.
Identify and begin to act on growth opportunities within your client accounts, flagging potential new projects or service extensions to your senior team.
Participate in negotiation processes as an active contributor, building your commercial awareness and confidence in client conversations.
Develop your industry knowledge — researching trends and consumer behaviours and sharing findings with the broader team.
Contribute to award submissions, case study development and agency reputation initiatives.
04 What you know and bring.
The knowledge you'll need:
3–4 years of account management experience in a branding, packaging, design or marketing agency, with exposure to FMCG or consumer brands preferred.
Experience working with packaging design across 2D graphics; 3D structural design experience is strongly preferred.
Growing understanding of brand and design processes, from briefing through to creative development, production and delivery.
Strong commercial awareness, with experience working to budgets, timelines and financial targets.
A background in Business, Marketing, Communications or a related field is preferred.
Experience in project management, collaboration and file-sharing tools such as ClickUp, Pitch, LucidLink or similar. platforms.
AI fluency: confident using AI tools day to day to work smarter across briefing, planning, reporting and client communication. You're curious about how AI is changing agency workflows and keen to bring new ideas to the team.
The skills that'll set you apart
Clear, concise communicator with excellent written, verbal and presentation skills.
Proven ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects, coordinating cross-functional teams efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
Highly organised, detail-oriented and rigorous, with strong time management skills and a proactive, solution-focused mindset.
Confident working directly with clients, building trust and contributing to strategic conversations with senior team support.
Developing storytelling skills — able to enhance project presentations and communicate ideas with growing clarity and impact.
A strong eagerness to listen, learn and grow within a dynamic, sometimes unstructured environment.
A genuine passion for creativity, innovation and delivering outstanding work, with a growing appreciation for what makes a brand truly great.
High sense of responsibility and commitment — you take pride in the quality and accuracy of everything you deliver.
Benefits
05 What we offer.
The work
The opportunity to learn your craft on real, high-impact brand and design projects for some of the world's most exciting companies — from day one.
The people & culture
A fun studio environment working alongside great and talented individuals, with a collaborative, down-to-earth culture where craft, curiosity and generosity are valued.
Annual festivities and various social events throughout the year that bring the team together.
Growth & development
Access to learning, feedback and stretch opportunities across studios and disciplines, with support to shape a career that works for you.

At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
Skills and Competencies
12+ years of experience in banking, financial services, or enterprise technology, with at least 5 years in strategic account management, customer success leadership, or senior client-facing roles
Proven track record of managing and growing complex, high-value enterprise accounts ($5M+ ARR)
Deep understanding of the banking industry including regulation, origination, risk management, and lending practices
Demonstrated ability to build and sustain C-level and senior executive relationships across client organizations
Experience developing and executing multi-year strategic account plans with measurable growth outcomes
Strong executive presence with excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills
Ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence without direct authority in a matrixed organization
Willingness to travel approximately 30–40% within the APAC for client and executive meetings
Deep expertise in artificial intelligence, with a track record of implementing advanced AI solutions to drive strategic transformation and operational efficiency. Strong experience using AI tools to lead innovation initiatives. Demonstrated leadership in managing AI-related risks, ensuring ethical governance, and fostering a culture of responsible AI adoption across the organization
Education
Bachelor's degree required
MBA or advanced degree in Finance, Business, or a related field preferred
Responsibilities
The Senior Director, Customer Success Management serves as a senior strategic leader responsible for owning Moody's most critical banking client relationships and driving long-term account growth across a portfolio of high-value strategic accounts.
Serve as the primary executive sponsor and strategic point of contact for a portfolio of Moody's highest-value banking clients

CapitaLand Group ( CapitaLand ) is one of Asia’s largest diversified real estate groups. Headquartered in Singapore, CapitaLand’s portfolio focuses on real estate investment management and real estate development, and spans across 270 cities in 45 countries.
Job Description
Catapult by CapitaLand is Singapore's premier executive education and leadership development campus. More than a venue, Catapult brings together corporates, learning providers, industry partners and business leaders through executive programmes, leadership offsites, conferences, corporate events and networking experiences. Located within Rochester Commons, Catapult provides a purpose-built environment designed to support collaboration, innovation, learning and business transformation.
We are looking for a hands-on and execution-focused marketing professional to support the growth of Catapult's enterprise learning solutions and programmes portfolio. This role combines programme marketing, event execution, lead generation, partnership coordination and proposal development.
The Role
Reporting to the Director, Marketing & Partnerships ( Catapult ), the Senior Executive, Marketing & Partnerships ( Learning Solutions & Programmes ), plays a key role in supporting the growth and delivery of Catapult's learning solutions, programmes and events to enterprises and organizations in Singapore.
Working closely with knowledge partners, facilitators, corporate clients and internal stakeholders, the role is responsible for developing customized proposals for learning solutions, driving event marketing initiatives, and coordinating the successful execution of programme marketing campaigns.
This is a highly hands-on and execution-focused role suited for someone who enjoys partnering with stakeholders, managing multiple projects concurrently, translating client requirements into learning solutions, and supporting business development efforts through effective marketing, programme coordination, and sales enablement.
The successful candidate will play an important role in helping Catapult create impactful learning experiences while contributing to the conversion of learning opportunities into tangible business outcomes.
Key Responsibilities
- Client Proposal Development for Learning Solutions and Programmes
- Assist in the preparation of customised learning proposals, pitch decks and client presentations
- Gather programme information, pricing and learning solutions from knowledge partners
- Support responses to RFPs, corporate training enquiries and partnership opportunities
- Coordinate inputs from internal stakeholders to ensure timely submission of proposals
- Knowledge Partner Coordination
- Serve as the primary coordinator for assigned knowledge partners and programmes
- Work with partners to obtain and update programme information, speaker profiles, marketing assets and schedules in a timely manner
- Support the onboarding and launch of new programmes and learning initiatives
- Coordinate joint marketing activities and promotional campaigns with partners
- Maintain and update database of knowledge partners, where required
- Programme Marketing & Events
- Coordinate the end-to-end planning and execution of Catapult’s Masterclasses with knowledge partners, executive roundtables, networking sessions and signature learning events.
- Coordinate invitation campaigns for Masterclasses, executive events and thought leadership sessions.
- Liaise with speakers, facilitators, knowledge partners and internal teams on the curation of learning events, programme logistics and requirements.
- Manage participant registration, communications, attendance tracking and post-event surveys.
- Prepare event briefs, run sheets, attendee materials and presentation decks.
- Support outreach initiatives to prospective clients, including HR, L&D and business leaders.
- Support onsite event execution and ensure a positive participant experience.
- Maintain and update prospect and attendee databases within CRM systems for the Sales team to follow-up, where required
- Track enquiries and support reporting on lead generation performance where needed.
- Administrative & Reporting Support
- Maintain programme schedules, marketing trackers and learning event budgets
- Track programme registrations, attendance and participant feedback
- Prepare post-event reports and campaign performance summaries where necessary
- Support procurement, vendor coordination and administrative processes where required
Requirements
- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Human Resources or a related discipline.
- 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in marketing for corporate training providers, executive education institutions, learning and development companies, leadership development consultancies, teambuilding providers, business events and conference organisations.
- Experience in a client-facing, account management, programme management, marketing or business development role is preferred.
- Experience preparing proposals, presentations and client-facing materials will be advantageous.
- Strong project coordination and stakeholder management skills.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
- Proficient in PowerPoint, Excel, CRM and email marketing tools.
- Comfortable engaging knowledge partners, facilitators and corporate clients.
- Able to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
To succeed in this role, you will ideally:
- Have experience on the commercial side ( “sell-side” ) of L&D, corporate training, executive education or teambuilding industry, with a strong understanding of client needs and buying processes
- Be familiar with developing and customising learning solutions, leadership development programmes and corporate training proposals for diverse client audiences
- Have a proven track record of executing event marketing campaigns and driving registrations for workshops, conferences, executive programmes or learning events
- Be comfortable preparing customized proposals, presentations and pitch materials in partnership with Sales and Business Development teams
- Demonstrate strong project management and stakeholder coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and programmes concurrently
- Thrive in a hands-on, execution-focused environment, taking ownership of campaign delivery, programme coordination, event execution and follow-through
- Be highly organised, detail-oriented and responsive, with a commitment to delivering high-quality work within tight timelines
- Enjoy engaging with internal and external stakeholders and contributing to the conversion of learning opportunities into meaningful business outcomes

Title: Senior Executive, PR & External Communications
Description:
ORGANISATION / DIVISION INFORMATION
As the holding company of Singapore’s public healthcare institutions, we are always looking for qualified, passionate individuals who are keen to make a valuable contribution to public healthcare. At MOH Holdings, we believe our employees are our greatest asset and we are dedicated in helping them achieve their full potential through professional development and by providing an environment to develop their leadership skills and competencies.
As MOHH's brand custodian, the Strategic Communications and Marketing Division oversees all aspects of corporate branding and communications to grow and strengthen MOHH's identity as well as to drive effective reputation management for the company. We also helm national public education campaigns to support and advance MOH's healthcare agenda for Singapore.
Join us and be part of a team - a uniquely MOHH spirit that propels us forward through every circumstance we face.
- Acting Today for Tomorrow: We work pragmatically with the realities of the present, with a mindset that is geared to the needs of the future.
- Starting Where You Can: We take a can-do approach to problem-solving, even if it means starting small, because every contribution counts.
- Leaving No Job Undone: We take pride in seeing things through. Our high standards means it’s not just about getting the job done, but getting it done well.
- Moving Together as One: Care for all starts within, with us as an organisation. We look out for one another, leaving no on behind as we grow.
SUMMARY OF THE ROLE
We are seeking a capable and driven communications professional to join MOHH’s Strategic Communications and Marketing Division.
Operating within a high-visibility public healthcare environment, this role supports media relations, corporate reputation, and issues communications across internal divisions. The successful candidate will contribute to sensitive and time-critical matters, leadership communications, and strategic positioning work in a complex stakeholder landscape.
At the Executive/Senior Executive level, the role focuses on strong execution — drafting media materials, coordinating stakeholder inputs, and supporting issues management under guidance.
Level and scope will be commensurate with experience and demonstrated capability.
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES
Media & Public Communications
- Draft press releases, media statements, Q&As, and responses to media queries with accuracy and clarity
- Coordinate cross-functional inputs to ensure timely and aligned public responses
- Monitor media coverage and flag emerging reputational risks
Issues & Sensitive Matters
- Support the management of issues and time-sensitive matters across internal divisions
- Draft holding statements, key messages, and stakeholder updates under tight timelines
Strategic Positioning
- Partner internal divisions to frame sensitive matters appropriately
- Contribute to narrative development for corporate initiatives and policy-related announcements
- Ensure consistency and message discipline across communications outputs
Leadership Communications
- Develop speeches, briefing notes, talking points, and engagement materials for senior leadership
JOB REQUIREMENTS
- Degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism or related field
- 2–5 years of experience in corporate communications, public relations, or in-house communications environments
- Strong writing capability, with experience drafting press releases, media responses, Q&As, or stakeholder communications
- Exposure to issues management, sensitive stakeholder environments, or high-visibility communications scenarios
- Strong attention to detail, with the ability to ensure factual accuracy, message consistency, and alignment across multiple inputs and stakeholders
- Ability to operate calmly under pressure, manage competing priorities, and deliver high-quality outputs within tight timelines
- Structured thinking and analytical capability, with the ability to distill complex matters into clear and coherent narratives
- Effective stakeholder management skills, including the confidence to engage internal divisions constructively and align on communications positioning
- Level and responsibilities will be commensurate with experience.

Title: Senior Executive/ Asst Manager, Key Account Management (E-Commerce)
Description:
At YCH, our mission is to be one partner – every channel for our clients. We are looking for a charismatic lead that is able to forge innovative eComm supply chain solutions for our partners, while bringing great teams and people together.
As the Key Accounts Lead at YCH, you will be at the centre of controlling business and technical requirements. We are looking for a charismatic individual with a strong track record in translating big-picture strategy into feasible, repeatable, and scalable project plans and processes. This role is high-impact and has high-exposure role to senior leadership. Strong internal/external stakeholder management is non-negotiable.
Primary Duties and Responsibilities
Key Accounts Management
Develop and execute a hybrid creative solutioning and operational strategy to drive account growth, expand the merchant ecosystem, increase GMV, and enhance customer engagement with online and offline initiatives.
Lead communications across internal and external stakeholders, reviewing content for quality and brand consistency, to create a clear brand strategy and value statement.
Monitor performance targets and other KPIs (GMV, revenue, margins) and support efforts to optimize cost structures and improve operational efficiencies.
Analyse operations and marketplace performance, market trends, and user data to identify improvement opportunities and growth areas.
Build, onboard, and maintain strong relationships with merchants and partners, ensuring active participation in campaigns and platform initiatives.
Manage and optimize internal workflows across Business Development, Product Development, and Customer Success teams while ensuring seamless cross-functional collaboration with operations, finance and tech teams to support effective project execution.
Identify and recommend new service scopes, tools, technologies, and processes to enhance account operations and support business scalability.
Develop and execute strategic roadmaps for the various system products and apps within the ecosystem.
Ensure compliance with relevant laws, industry standards, and internal policies, including Terms of Use and Seller Terms, data protection, etc.
Support commercial team and Legal Counsel for reviewing contracts, agreements, and other legal documents.
Lead or support strategic projects as required by senior management and business requirements.
Business Development
Support Head of Business Development in charting growth strategies for the Digital Commerce BU and YSG.
Contribute to regional strategies, intercompany synergies, expansion into adjacent industries, and high-growth market opportunities.
Drive revenue growth, cost efficiency, and operational excellence in line with BU objectives.
Represent the company in exhibitions, fairs, and similar forums to generate leads and consolidate industry best practices.
Contribute to a high-performance, collaborative, and values-driven workplace culture.
Strategic Projects
Lead or Support key projects that relate to account success and capability growth
Ability to learn and synthesize solutions to large range of projects: Operations, tech, AI, supply chain, etc.
Strong understanding of the ‘customer voice’ andquality service. Teamwork is the only way forward.
Build relationships at multiple levels, including the executive sponsor, the day-to-day users, and procurement, so the projects are adopted successfully.
Quickly identify risks, technical issues, and other blockers that create delays or quality issues in projects or solutions.

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business, Marketing, Operations, or a related discipline.
5+ years in project management, e-commerce or digital platforms with track record in e-commerce marketplaces, live-streaming or dot.com operations, logistics and supply chain.
Proven ability to work regionally on APAC-level businesses. Track record of interfacing with senior management and leadership.
Strong presentation and communications skills. Track record in negotiations preferred.
Strong data processing and visualization skills.
Strong business acumen with a proven track record of driving account success KPIs, stakeholder management, project management, revenue and cost optimisation.
Strong project management skills. Experience in driving continuous improvement projects preferred.

About NUS Business School
Founded in the same year that Singapore gained independence, NUS Business School stands today among the world’s leading business schools. It is distinctive for offering the best of global business knowledge with deep Asian insights, preparing students to lead Asian businesses to international success and to help global businesses succeed in Asia.
For more than 50 years, NUS Business School has offered a rigorous, relevant and rewarding business education to outstanding students from across the world. That would not have been possible without a group of dedicated professionals who are passionate about building a positive environment to grow and groom future business leaders. And we are looking to add to our BIZ family!
To learn more about the NUS Business School, please visit https://bschool.nus.edu.sg/
Job Description
As part of the MSc Student Life team supporting our Masters programmes, this role will play a pivotal role in cultivating a positive, transformational, inclusive, and holistic student experience, outside of the classroom. The role will collaborate closely with student leaders, faculty, alumni, and internal partners to build a vibrant, supportive, and globally diverse learning community that inspires leadership growth, personal development, and lifelong networks.
Student Life, Community Building and Student Club
Design, implement, and support student life initiatives that foster interaction, belonging, and a strong sense of community across diverse student cohorts.
Work closely with, collaborate with, and provide day-to-day guidance to student leaders in the student club, inspiring and supporting them in their leadership journey.
Serve as a motivator, mentor, and facilitator and empower student leaders to develop their potential, lead confidently, and contribute meaningfully to the student body.
Collaborate with student clubs and student leaders to conceptualise, plan, and execute engaging programmes, events, and community-building initiatives.
Promote diversity, inclusion, and intercultural appreciation, building a community that celebrates differences and nurtures lifelong networks.
Provide pastoral care, general counselling, and well-being support to students.
Cross-Programme Collaboration, Innovation and Engagement
Develop and lead cross-MSc programmes initiatives, activities, and signature events to strengthen cohesion and collaboration across Masters programmes.
Work collaboratively with other MSc Programme teams to develop aligned student life initiatives and a unified student experience.
Take a proactive role in innovating and creating new ideas for student life programmes, ensuring activities remain relevant, meaningful, and engaging.
Events and Signature Experiences
Lead in the planning and execution of office-led events including Orientation programmes, Commencement programmes, end-of-semester celebrations.
Guide student leaders and actively support event management, ensuring smooth execution while fostering learning opportunities for student organisers.
Conduct administrative briefings, onboarding sessions, and student club information sessions for students.
Partner with internal and external stakeholders to deliver impactful student engagement opportunities.
Stakeholder Engagement, Communications and Service Excellence
Build strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
Deliver exceptional service excellence and uphold high standards of professionalism, responsiveness, and student-centric support.
Contribute to social media outreach to enhance visibility and engagement among current students, prospective students, and alumni.
Operations, Governance and Financial Management
Guide student leaders on funding guidelines, work planning, budget planning, and responsible financial management for student events and activities.
Maintain, refine and automate operational processes, including SOP documentation and workflow improvements.
Support resource planning, budget tracking, and reporting for events and student life initiatives.
Carry out any additional duties assigned by the Director and Senior Associate Director to support the goals of the MSc Programmes office.
Qualifications
A Bachelor degree from a reputable institution.
Years of Experience
At least 3 years of experience working directly with student leaders or youth development is highly preferred.
Student Development and Engagement
Good understanding of student leadership development, co-curricular engagement, and experiential learning principles.
Experience mentoring, guiding, or supporting student leaders and student clubs, with the ability to inspire and empower young adults.
Stakeholder Management and Collaboration
Effective stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across multiple internal departments and external partners.
Ability to navigate diverse viewpoints, coordinate across teams, and drive cross-MSc initiatives.
Event Planning and Project Management
Proven experience in event management, including planning, execution, logistics coordination, and post-event evaluation.
Ability to lead student teams in event execution while ensuring quality, safety, and learning outcomes.
Meticulous and strong organisational skills with the capacity to manage multiple projects, timelines, and deliverables simultaneously.
Communication and Interpersonal Skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence in conducting briefings, presentations, and engagement sessions.
Ability to communicate effectively with a diverse, international student population.
Strong interpersonal skills with a warm, empathetic, and approachable manner.
Efficient problem-solving skills with the ability to manage unexpected student issues, plan contingencies, and respond calmly to challenges.
Digital Skills
Proficiency in MS Office, online graphic design and collaborative tools.
Comfortable learning new platforms and systems used in student services and event management.
Training or certification in student development, coaching, counselling, facilitation, or leadership development is a plus.

Description:
At JurongHealth Campus, we believe that our patients are the focus of our work and we render the best care and service to them. We are changing the face of public healthcare and carving out new paths to improve our processes and services. We value our team’s contributions and ensure that our staff are competitively rewarded and supported.
Join us, where we place the value of every staff member and the care of every patient at the centre of all we do.
The Opportunity:
We are looking for Senior Executive/Assistant Manager, HR People Experience to join us.
Job Description:
The incumbent will play a key role in fostering an engaged, connected, and inclusive workplace culture.
Reporting to the People Experience Lead, this role is part of the HR People Experience team and is responsible for driving and implementing a range of Group HR and Institutional HR strategies and initiatives. Key areas of focus include employee recognition, staff engagement, culture building, health and well-being programmes, and HR communications.
Employee Recognition & Awards
Coordinate award cycles from planning to completion, including timelines, nomination forms, eligibility checks, submission tracking, review coordination, approvals, event arrangements and record keeping.
Partner stakeholders to identify and articulate impactful employee contributions. Review nominations critically, identify gaps and advise stakeholders on the evidence, examples or elaboration needed to strengthen the write-up and demonstrate alignment with award criteria.
Develop communications and recognition stories that showcase award recipients and reinforce the organisation’s core values.
Analyse nomination trends, participation, feedback and award outcomes to recommend improvements that strengthen the quality, reach and impact of JurongHealth Campus (JHC) recognition programmes and culture of appreciation.
Employee Engagement & Pulse Survey
Coordinate survey planning and implementation, including data mapping, user testing, timelines and communications.
Partner with Employee Engagement Champions and relevant stakeholders across JHC to support survey participation and address implementation matters.
Analyse quantitative and qualitative survey findings at hospital, division and department levels to identify key trends, strengths, root causes, emerging concerns and priority areas for action.
Translate survey insights into practical, evidence-based recommendations and interventions to enhance employee engagement, workplace culture, staff well-being and employee experience.
Partner the People Engagement Lead, Employee Engagement Champions and relevant stakeholders to develop, implement, monitor and evaluate action plans and organisation-wide interventions arising from survey findings.
Prepare clear reports, presentations and engagement insights to support leadership discussions, decision-making and follow-through on agreed priorities.
Internal Events and Staff Experiences
Design and lead events, campaigns and staff experiences that promote diversity, inclusion, team spirit and a positive employee experience, and reinforce organisational values and desired culture.
Manage event delivery from planning to completion, including timelines, budgets, logistics, stakeholder engagement and vendor coordination.
Leverage participation data, employee feedback and engagement insights to evaluate programme effectiveness and recommend improvements that strengthen the impact of future initiatives.
People Experience, Culture & Strategic Initiatives
Support the People Experience Lead to conceptualise, develop, implement and evaluate organisation-wide employee engagement, people culture and staff experience initiatives.
Conduct research, environmental scans and benchmarking on emerging employee experience and workplace culture practices and translate relevant insights into proposals and practical initiatives for JHC.
Develop proposals, business cases, presentations and communication materials to support leadership discussions and decision-making on people culture initiatives and projects.
Partner stakeholders across departments to drive implementation, monitor progress and evaluate the outcomes of key people experience and culture initiatives.
Represent JHC in relevant NUHS committees and workgroups, contribute an institutional perspective, and coordinate input and follow-through with internal stakeholders.
Undertake strategic projects and workgroups relating to employee engagement, organisational culture, staff well-being, recognition and employee experience as assigned.
Job Requirements:
Minimum 4 to 5 years of relevant experience in employee engagement, employee experience, organisational culture, internal communications, HR programme management, organisational development, event management, or related disciplines.
Demonstrated project management skills, with the ability to independently manage multiple workstreams, stakeholders, timelines, budgets, and end-to-end programme execution.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively convey ideas, insights, recommendations, and proposals in a clear and impactful manner.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, including experience in interpreting employee surveys and feedback, identifying key trends and root causes, and translating findings into actionable recommendations and improvement plans.
Proven ability to engage, advise, and influence stakeholders at all levels while fostering strong collaborative partnerships across teams and functions.
Self-driven and results-oriented, with the initiative, resourcefulness, and sound judgement to manage challenges, navigate ambiguity, and deliver quality outcomes.
Able to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment, with a growth mindset, learning agility, and a continuous improvement approach to programmes and processes.
Possesses strong emotional intelligence, resilience, and professional maturity to effectively manage organisational dynamics, competing priorities, and change.
Proficient in Microsoft Office applications and comfortable leveraging AI solutions, digital platforms, social media channels, and design or video-editing tools to enhance employee engagement and communication outcomes.

Title: Senior IT Project Manager - #1662
Description:
As a Senior Project Manager, you will be working on:
• Lead the end-to-end delivery of complex digital products or ICT initiatives, aligning user needs, business outcomes, delivery priorities, technical constraints and operational readiness.
• Lead project governance across predictive, agile or hybrid delivery models, including sprint and release governance, critical-path management, key dependencies and timely management decisions.
• Establish and maintain integrated project plans, consolidated RAID and dependency views, recovery actions and outcome measures, and intervene where delivery performance is at risk.
• Provide release assurance for major implementations by overseeing system, user and security testing, defect-risk decisions, cutover readiness, operational handover and post-release stabilisation.
• Shape user-adoption and stakeholder-engagement approaches for significant releases and direct the resolution of material product or operational issues with product and engineering leads.
• Lead the management of significant maintenance and service contracts, including performance, service levels, commercial obligations, renewal or extension options, service credits and supplier accountability.
• Advise on procurement and contracting approaches and lead the preparation or review of tender specifications, Approval of Requirements, evaluation recommendations, contract variations and direct contracting justifications.
• Participate in significant vendor negotiations and provide evidence-based recommendations on contract scope, commercial exposure and approval risks.
• Establish forward-looking licence, subscription and technology-lifecycle plans covering renewal, end of support, upgrade sequencing, dependency risk and continuity of support.
• Oversee vulnerability remediation, security patching and follow-up of security findings, and escalate material delays or residual risks to the appropriate governance forum.
• Oversee project and annual budget planning, commitments, forecasts, actual expenditure, OOE funding drawdowns and funding sufficiency, and recommend corrective or reprioritisation options where required.
• Provide robust review and challenge of vendor proposals, contract variations, rate-card application and service-request man-day estimates, including identification of duplication, unsupported contingency or inefficient role mix.
• Prioritise and govern major service requests and changes for assigned systems against business value, operational risk, dependencies, capacity and available funding.
• Lead or support steering and senior governance forums as required, present clear options and recommendations to management, and facilitate resolution of cross-functional or supplier disputes.
• Mentor less-experienced project managers where required, contribute reusable project and contract controls, and support lessons learned and continuous improvement.
What we are looking for:
• At least 7 years of experience relevant to the Project Manager job role.
• A proven track record leading complex ICT projects, digital products or major maintenance workstreams from planning and procurement through implementation, transition and operations.
• Demonstrated delivery of effective products and project outcomes under material resource, schedule
or operational constraints.
• End-to-end leadership experience across product, engineering, operations, cybersecurity, procurement, finance and service-provider teams.
• Experience establishing integrated plans, project governance, management reporting and recovery actions across multiple interdependent workstreams.
• Strong experience managing public-sector or comparable regulated procurement and contract activities, including requirements, evaluations, AOR, contract variations, direct contracting and commercial discussions.
• Strong commercial judgment in contract interpretation, vendor performance, service credits, invoice validation, rate-card application, change control and man-day governance.
• Experience managing project or annual budget planning, expenditure forecasting, funding sufficiency and financial recommendations to management.
• Experience establishing licence and technology-lifecycle plans and overseeing end-of-support upgrades, vulnerability remediation and security patch compliance.
• Ability to critically review vendor scope, assumptions and effort estimates and recommend sound commercial and delivery positions.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including management papers, technical writing, governance presentations and engagement with senior stakeholders.
• A highly meticulous, resilient and outcomes-focused approach, with the ability to lead under pressure, resolve ambiguity and drive complex matters to closure.
• Demonstrated ability to tailor predictive, agile and hybrid project-management practices to project risk and governance needs.
Preferred requirements:
• Current PMP or PRINCE2 Practitioner certification; PMI-ACP or an advanced agile credential is advantageous where the candidate has applied it on complex or hybrid ICT initiatives.
• Proven experience leading complex ICT projects or high-impact maintenance workstreams involving multiple vendors, contracts or interdependent technical and business workstreams.
• Experience presenting delivery, financial, contractual and risk recommendations to senior management, steering committees or equivalent governance forums.
• Experience leading substantial Singapore Government or comparable public-sector procurement activities, including evaluation recommendations, AOR, contract variations or direct contracting submissions.
• Experience handling significant vendor-performance and commercial discussions involving contract scope, service levels, rate cards, cost optimisation or remedial actions.
• Experience establishing integrated governance controls such as consolidated schedules, RAID and dependency management, budget forecasting and management dashboards across complex
workstreams.
• Experience overseeing annual project budgets, funding sufficiency and expenditure reprioritisation, with the ability to provide clear financial recommendations to management.
• Experience leading major licence-renewal, end-of-support, platform-upgrade, cloud-migration or technology-modernisation planning across business, technical, security and vendor teams.
• Experience mentoring project managers, improving project or contract-management practices and contributing reusable templates, controls or lessons learned.
• Strong proficiency with
Microsoft Project or equivalent scheduling tools, Jira and Confluence or Azure DevOps, SharePoint, Excel and Power BI for integrated planning and senior-management reporting.
• ITIL 4 certification or relevant cloud, security or governance credentials is advantageous where supported by practical service-management or technology-risk experience.

Title: Senior Legal Counsel
Description:
Requisition Number: 64493
Job Location: Singapore, SGP
Global Grade: Band 7
Work Type: Office Working
Employment Type: Permanent
Posting Start Date: 16/10/2026
Posting End Date: 30/10/2026
:
Job Summary :
• This role is a Short-term assignment (STA) for 6 months (Jan -June 2027).
• Provide proactive strategic legal advice and support on key technology and operations legal issues and legal matters across the Bank’s client businesses). Engage, build and maintain relationships with relevant stakeholders across the Bank’s client businesses.
• Reviewing, advising, drafting and negotiating global and multi-country technology and operations transactions, including system and software integrations, software licenses, managed services, technology outsourcing and other technology and e-commerce arrangements.
• Provide legal support and expertise in relation to technology and operations developments which support the key digitisation initiatives of the Bank (including for example such as innovation initiatives, and working with FinTech companies and start-ups, electronic contracting, data and analytics projects, and other emerging technologies such as virtual banks, proofs of concept and pilots, and partnerships and collaborations, trading platforms, and blockchain initiatives).
• Provide legal support and advice for ongoing vendor and contract management issues including management of pre-litigation contract disputes and for specialist technology legal advisory support (including advising on topics such as technology, IP, liability, data privacy, confidentiality, service levels, exit management and supply chain governance issues) supported by the Enterprise Legal team and broader legal teams as required.
• Work with the Bank’s various Risk owners such as Compliance, Regional and Country legal, information security and cloud governance teams, among others, to ensure that technology and operations projects and initiatives have the necessary legal and regulatory clearances, and comply with the Group’s standards
Key Responsibilities
• Provide relevant stakeholders with accurate and timely information regarding the status of technology and operations matters. Drive best practices and lessons learned across the Bank network and create and provide training on legal issues in the sourcing and technology areas to legal teams, Technology and Operations (T&O) teams and group functions including supply chain management.
• Anticipating, identifying, mitigating, monitoring and reporting legal risks in relation to technology and operations projects and initiatives as required by the group’s risk management framework.
• Support the Head, Legal, Business Technology in developing effective processes (including training, advice and support) to ensure that policies, procedures and standards to address legal risk are effectively implemented. Support the development and roll-out of training programs on managing legal risk associated with third party provider contracts within the scope of the Business Technology Legal team.
• Support the API and Open Banking initiatives of the Bank.
• Support the Standard Chartered Bank Centre of Excellence for Legal initiative.
• Ensure close coordination with Vendor Management and other Legal teams, for example the client business Legal teams.
• Where external counsel/ legal support is appointed, liaise with external counsel/ legal support and ensure the scope of work is defined and appropriate, oversee the quality of work and manage external legal costs and ensure appropriate overall matter management.
Regulatory & Business Conduct
• Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
• Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
• Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters
Key Stakeholders
• Head, Legal - Business Technology
• Client business leadership, management and project teams.
• T&O leadership, management and project teams.
• Supply Chain Management teams
• Vendor Management Teams
• Group functions management and project teams.
• Enterprise Legal team.
• Group Commercial Legal team
• Legal and Compliance teams – group, regional, business and country. .
Our Ideal Candidate
• Must be a qualified lawyer (solicitor, attorney or barrister) with 5+ years’ post qualification experience.
• A good knowledge and understanding of technology legal matters including experience in current technology and operations trends (preferably in the financial industry) such as API, blockchain, digital platforms, virtual and digital banking and other FinTech initiatives as well experience in traditional technology procurement topics such as IP, Cloud, e-commerce, data privacy, information security and outsourcing.
• Experience in the banking industry (whether through in-house or private practice) is preferred but not mandatory.
• Experience in leading, structuring, and executing a wide variety of technology and operations transactions with a strong emphasis on internal and external stakeholder management.
• Experience working at a regional and / or global capacity is beneficial.
• Understanding of risk management techniques.
• Exemplary integrity, ethics, independence and resilience.
• Be collaborative, and a strong team player.
• Personal authority with proven ability to establish relationships and provide strong direction at senior levels.
• Taking responsibility over matter management, including following up with relevant stakeholders and decision-makers regularly.
Role Specific Technical Competencies
Commercial Law
Intellectual Property Law
Legal Analysis
Legal Function
Legislative Analysis
Litigation

A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.
