Title: Senior Manager / Assistant Director, Communications & Branding (Frasers Property Singapore)
Description:
Shape the future of places. Shape your future with us.
Real estate is a people business. At Frasers Property, we believe every space should serve a meaningful purpose - shaping how individuals, businesses and communities live, work and connect. Our properties are what the world sees, but our greatest assets are the people who make it all possible.
Who We Are
We are a diversified, multinational real estate group on a journey of evolution – strengthening our reputation as an integrated investor, developer, and operator across geographies and asset classes, including industrial & logistics, retail, commercial & business parks, residential and hospitality. Guided by our purpose – Inspiring experiences, creating places for good, we take a long-term view and strive to create lasting value for stakeholders.
How We Work
Every project begins with intention – shaped by local insight, community needs, and a commitment to sustainability and quality outcomes. Across the Group, we bring together diverse talents, perspectives, cultures, and strengths – from strategy, investment and operations to customer experience, technology and beyond. When we do, we create outcomes greater than the sum of our parts: vibrant places that connect, inspire, and uplift.
About The Role
The role plays a pivotal role in shaping and strengthening the reputation, brand equity and stakeholder engagement efforts of Frasers Property Singapore across its retail, commercial, residential and mixed-use portfolio.
Reporting to the Deputy Director, Communications & Branding, the role will lead the development and execution of integrated communications, branding and engagement strategies that support business objectives, enhance stakeholder trust and reinforce the company's positioning as a leading real estate owner, developer and placemaker.
As a strategic advisor to management and business stakeholders, the role will champion enterprise-wide branding initiatives, oversee high-impact communications programmes, drive visual storytelling through photography and videography, and ensure the consistent expression of the FPS brand across customer, employee and community touchpoints.
The role will also lead employee engagement and community investment initiatives, while partnering closely with business teams to develop compelling narratives, enhance brand experiences and elevate FPS' visibility among key audiences.
How You’ll Make An Impact
- Manage the development and implementation of integrated communications and branding strategies to strengthen the positioning, reputation and visibility of Frasers Property Singapore across its retail, commercial, residential and corporate portfolios.
- Develop and oversee compelling corporate, brand and thought leadership content across channels, ensuring consistency in messaging and brand storytelling.
- Support issues and crisis communications planning and response, including the development of stakeholder communications, key messages and engagement strategies.
- Manage employee communications and engagement initiatives that strengthen organisational culture, foster employee advocacy and reinforce the company's purpose and values. Engage key stakeholders including the People & Culture team to reinforce the company’s purpose and core value across Frasers Property Singapore.
- Partner with business units to develop brand strategies and narratives, leveraging compelling visual and multimedia content to enhance brand affinity, reputation and commercial outcomes.
- Manage community investment initiatives in Singapore through strategic partnerships, employee volunteerism, philanthropic programmes, sponsorships and thought leadership opportunities, strengthening social impact and corporate reputation.
- Oversee external agencies, vendors and consultants to ensure the effective delivery of branding, communications and engagement programmes.
What You’ll Bring
- Degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, or a related discipline.
- Preferably 10-15 years of experience in corporate communications, marketing communications and/or branding.
- Proven track record in developing, building and managing brands at an enterprise level.

Title: Senior Manager, AP VAS Issuing Solutions
Description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
Job Description
Team Summary
The AP VAS Issuing Solutions team is responsible for driving the growth and expansion of Visa's next-generation issuing capabilities across Asia Pacific. Leveraging Pismo's cloud-native banking and issuer processing platform, the team works closely with regional and global stakeholders to bring innovative issuing, core banking, lending, and digital account solutions to market.
Operating at the intersection of product strategy, go-to-market execution, and client engagement, the team partners across Issuing Solutions Sales, Sales Engineering, Product, Pismo, and market teams to identify new growth opportunities, shape product roadmaps, and accelerate adoption across AP markets.
What a Senior Manager, AP VAS Issuing Solutions does at Visa
As a Senior Manager, AP VAS Issuing Solutions, you will play a key role in shaping and executing the regional growth strategy for Pismo and Visa's Issuing Solutions portfolio across Asia Pacific.
You will evaluate market opportunities, define go-to-market strategies, support commercial expansion initiatives, and help ensure product readiness for launch across priority markets. Working closely with clients, partners, and internal stakeholders, you will help drive adoption of Pismo's issuer processing, core banking, lending, and digital account capabilities while influencing product enhancements based on market needs.
This role requires a combination of strategic thinking, product management expertise, commercial acumen, and strong cross-functional leadership to support Visa's continued expansion in the issuer processing and banking technology space.
Why this is important to Visa
Pismo represents a strategic pillar of Visa's growth strategy in issuer processing, digital banking, and next-generation financial infrastructure. As Visa continues to expand its Issuing Solutions capabilities across Asia Pacific, this role will help identify new market opportunities, accelerate commercialization efforts, and ensure successful market deployment of innovative banking and payments solutions.
The role directly contributes to revenue growth, client acquisition, market expansion, and Visa's long-term vision of enabling modern, cloud-native financial services across the region.
Projects you will be a part of
You will contribute to a range of strategic initiatives, including:
Defining expansion strategies and go-to-market plans for Pismo across priority Asia Pacific markets.
Evaluating new business opportunities for issuer processing, core banking, lending, and digital account solutions.
Supporting market entry and launch readiness activities, including product localization and regulatory alignment.
Developing commercial business cases, growth plans, and multi-year product roadmaps.
Identifying partnership opportunities, including collaborations with system integrators, technology providers, and ecosystem partners.
Driving product enhancements and capability development based on client needs, industry trends, and competitive insights.
Enabling regional and in-market teams through training, knowledge sharing, and sales readiness programs.
Key Responsibilities
Contribute to implementing a regional strategy, ensuring alignment with global and enterprise objectives over a multiyear period.
Prioritize and execute commercial goals for Pismo during the AP expansion in collaboration with essential stakeholders locally and globally.
Identify and execute upgrades to Pismo to address evolving client needs, local market conditions, and foster innovations beneficial to both clients and Visa.
Motivate, challenge, and mentor the team to enhance their problem-solving and product management abilities.
Support competitive analysis, customer insights, and market studies with market-facing teams to aid the development of new features and capabilities.
Play a significant role in assessing new market opportunities and potential partnerships, including alternative sales models (e.g. through System Integrators)
Influence budget and financial planning by offering insights into potential revenue opportunities and associated costs.
Develop and execute continuous training programs and provisioning of information materials to help market teams effectively sell and deploy Pismo and supporting VAS products.
Prepare and deliver presentations and documentation for both internal and external audiences through working groups, webinars, and other formats regarding product ownership.
Promote PISMO by building extensive internal partnerships within Visa across various functions regionally.
Effectively collaborate with a diverse set of Visa teams, including but not limited to Visa Consulting and Analytics, Marketing, Legal, Corporate Communications, Finance, Client Services and others to achieve company goals.
Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

10+ years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree, or 8+ years with an Advanced Degree (e.g., Masters, MBA).
Experience in the payments industry, preferably in product management or strategy at an Issuer, Issuer Processor, or Core banking platform provider.
Understanding of Issuer Core Banking & Processing, related regulations, and market competitiveness across AP.
Proven leadership in driving solution delivery and creating commercial & revenue opportunities based on market and client demand.
Expertise in scaling and distributing products/services within a technology company, with a focus on overcoming commercial, technical, industry, and internal challenges.
Exceptional business acumen, analytical skills, and deep understanding of new technology, processing business models, and profitability drivers.

Title: Senior Manager, Brand
Description:
About DayOne Data Centers
DayOne Data Centers is a Singapore-headquartered global digital infrastructure platform that develops and operates next-generation data centers across Asia Pacific and Europe. Trusted by leading hyperscalers and businesses, the company engineers, builds, and operates high-capacity, AI-ready campuses with speed, scale, and reliability.
This is a strategic role responsible for defining the brand vision, ensuring consistent execution across markets, and overseeing the creative quality of DayOne’s global presence — from corporate identity and digital experiences to flagship events and thought leadership exposure. You will own the strategy, direction, and quality, guiding teams and external agencies to deliver a premium, globally consistent brand.
Role Summary
As The Brand Lead, You Will
- Define and evolve DayOne’s brand strategy and identity
- Lead creative direction across all visual and experiential assets
- Shape the brand expression for global events and key milestones
- Drive brand visibility through strategic sponsorships and industry presence
- Govern brand consistency across regions, platforms, and content
- Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure brand alignment
- Manage creative agencies, production partners, and internal resources
Your mandate is to elevate DayOne into a globally recognisable, trusted, and differentiated brand in the digital infrastructure ecosystem.
- Brand Strategy & Identity
- Develop and refine DayOne’s brand strategy, positioning, and architecture.
- Lead the evolution of the visual identity system, tone of voice, and brand guidelines.
- Define how the brand expresses itself across markets, customer segments, and product categories.
- Ensure brand clarity, differentiation, and relevance in the global digital infrastructure, cloud and AI ecosystem.
- Creative & Design Leadership
- Set the creative direction for all key brand assets, including corporate visual systems, digital interfaces, and experiential branding.
- Lead the creative review and approval of major deliverables (visuals, design systems, imagery, digital concepts).
- Collaborate with external agencies, production houses, and internal teams to uphold high standards.

- Define the brand look, feel, and thematic experience for flagship events, launches, and strategic announcements.
- Create event-level brand frameworks that align with corporate positioning and regional priorities.
- Ensure branded experiences are premium, consistent, and reflective of DayOne’s values.
- Sponsorships, Visibility & Thought Leadership Exposure
- Develop a strategic calendar of sponsorships, partnerships, and industry engagements that enhance DayOne’s brand equity.
- Evaluate speaking opportunities and thought-leadership platforms that align with brand positioning.
- Work with Communications and Product Marketing to ensure narrative consistency across appearances.
- Digital & Website Brand Governance
- Provide creative direction for DayOne’s website, digital brand systems, and new visual concepts.
- Guide the integration of multimedia assets (e.g., photography, video, animations, 3D) into digital experiences.
- Brand Governance & Quality Control
- Establish a global brand governance framework to ensure consistency across all markets.
- Maintain a brand library with templates, standards, and creative resources.
- Conduct brand audits and implement improvements based on insights.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration
- Partner with Corporate Communications, Marketing, and Corporate Affairs to ensure brand-aligned messaging and visuals.

- Define and track brand KPIs such as visibility, consistency, recognition, and engagement across key audiences.
- Ensure sponsorships and brand activation initiatives have measurable outcomes.

- 8–12 years in brand strategy, brand management, or creative direction, preferably in:
- technology / cloud / enterprise B2B
- Digital infrastructure / telecommunications
- industrial or professional services
- Proven experience leading brand identity development at a regional or global level.
- Strong ability to set creative direction and review high-quality visual work.
- Experience managing branding for major corporate events or product launches.
- Demonstrated success in managing agencies, production partners, and creative teams.
- Excellent ability to translate business strategy into brand expression.
- Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills.
- Experience in branding for multi-country or multi-site infrastructure businesses.
- Familiarity with digital brand systems, UI/UX design principles, or experiential design.
- Exposure to fast-growth or transformation-stage organisations.

Title: Senior Manager, Capability & Learning
Description:
About Sembcorp
Sembcorp is a leading energy and urban solutions provider headquartered in Singapore. Led by its purpose to drive energy transition, Sembcorp delivers sustainable energy solutions and urban developments by leveraging its sector expertise and global track record.
Purpose and Scope
The Senior Manager, Capability & Learning partners closely with business leaders, HR Business Partners (HRBPs) and Centres of Excellence (COEs) to build the organisational capabilities required for current and future business success.
Reporting to the Head, Capability & Learning, this role serves as a capability development subject matter expert, translating business strategy, workforce challenges and skills insights into practical capability-building solutions. The incumbent co-creates and executes interventions that strengthen technical, functional, leadership, digital and AI capabilities across the organisation.
Key Responsibilities
1.Capability Consulting & Solution Design
Partner business leaders, HRBPs, COEs and SMEs to diagnose capability gaps, workforce challenges and development needs.
Act as an internal subject matter expert on capability development, advising stakeholders on effective workforce and learning solutions.
Design solutions that strengthen technical, functional, commercial, leadership, digital and AI capabilities.
2.Capability Development & Delivery
Design, curate and deliver data-driven learning and capability-building interventions based on business and workforce needs.
Develop capability pathways, learning resources and development interventions that support employee growth and career progression.
Continuously evaluate programme effectiveness and incorporate feedback to enhance learning outcomes and business impact.
3. Capability Insights & Skills Analytics
Maintain and analyse capability, skills and learning data to identify trends and capability gaps.
Track learning effectiveness, capability development outcomes, workforce readiness and return on capability investments using dashboards, reports and management insights.
Develop and deliver learning solutions using the insights identified.
4.Capability Operations and Governance
Manage capability and learning operations to ensure efficient execution, governance and continuous improvement.
Manage key external partnerships, grants, accreditation requirements and industry collaborations that support capability development objectives.
Requirements
Degree in Human Resources, Organisational Development, Organisational Psychology, Business, Learning & Development or related disciplines.
At least 8-12 years of relevant experience in capability development, learning, organisational development, talent development, consulting or related fields.
Proven experience partnering business leaders to diagnose workforce and capability challenges and design practical solutions.
Experience designing and facilitating capability-building interventions across technical, functional, digital, leadership and/or workforce transformation domains.
Familiarity with AI and digital technologies, and their implications on workforce capability, productivity and job redesign.
Demonstrate a collaborative approach, with the ability to influence stakeholders and co-delivery solutions that improve workforce capability and business performance.

At Sembcorp, our culture is shaped by a strong set of shared behaviours that guide the way we work and uphold our commitment to driving the energy transition.

Collaboration is at the heart of what we do, as we work seamlessly across markets, businesses, and functions to achieve our goals together. Accountability is a core principle, ensuring that we take ownership of our commitments and deliver on them with integrity and excellence. These values define who we are and create a workplace where our people can thrive while making a meaningful impact on driving energy transition.

Title: Senior Manager, CRM Marketing, Asia
Description:
About Crunchyroll
Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.
Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!
About The Role
We’re looking for a passionate and data-driven Lifecycle Marketing Senior Manager to join our Regional Engagement team, based in Singapore. In this role, you’ll lead localized lifecycle strategies across Asia, designing and implementing campaigns that engage, retain, and win back Anime fans. You’ll combine deep knowledge of local market dynamics with a global fan-first vision, ensuring Crunchyroll connects authentically with our community across every stage of the customer journey.
What You’ll Do
- Lifecycle Strategy & Execution: Help to develop and implement lifecycle marketing strategies tailored to audiences across Asia covering acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, and winback working closely with our Lifecycle Marketing team. Ensure best practices in personalization, segmentation, and lifecycle orchestration.
- Regional Expertise: Serve as the regional expert for customer lifecycle nuances, shaping best practices, and advising on culturally & market-specific approaches, and fan engagement opportunities.
- Go-to-Market Campaigns: Collaborate with regional marketing, programming, and curation teams to design localized go-to-market moments for major content launches, seasonal events, and fan activations.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with regional marketing, content programming, and curation teams to develop go-to-market strategies and localized moments that drive subscriber growth and fandom engagement.
- Marketing Technology Leadership: Own and optimize our Braze instance in the region, leveraging its full capabilities (email, push, SMS, MMS, WhatsApp, in-app, and notification center) to design seamless and personalized user journeys.
- Fan-First Campaigns: Create impactful communications that celebrate anime fandom and strengthen Crunchyroll’s emotional connection with fans in Asia.
- Data-Driven Growth: Partner with Product, Content, Data Science, and Growth teams to measure performance, analyze insights, and continuously optimize lifecycle initiatives.
- Innovation & Experimentation: Stay on top of Asia-specific marketing trends (e.g.mobile-first experiences, digital payments, WhatsApp-first engagement) and adapt lifecycle strategies to meet fans where they are.
In this role, you will report to the Director, Growth - Asia + MENA.
We are considering applicants for the location of Singapore.
About You
- 8+ years of experience in CRM, lifecycle, or retention marketing is required, ideally in the streaming, entertainment, or digital subscription services industry.
- Extensive experience with Braze (or comparable orchestration platforms), including journey design, real-time triggers, and channel execution.
- Experience in Asian markets and cultural nuances, digital marketing platforms, and messaging ecosystems with experience tailoring campaigns for diverse local audiences.
- Analytical skills to interpret performance data, identify trends, and optimize campaigns.
- Collaborative spirit—comfortable working across regional and global teams in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.
- Creative acumen is essential to conceptualize and drive dynamic, fan-first engagement campaigns that captivate our growing Southeast Asian audience.
- A genuine passion for anime, fandom culture, or entertainment brands!
- Additional proficiency in relevant regional languages.
About The Team
Our Lifecycle Marketing team designs personalized journeys that drive fan connection, engagement, and loyalty. Through data-driven insights and creativity, we activate the right experiences at the right time across channels—helping anime fans feel seen, understood, and inspired by Crunchyroll.
About Our Values
We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value
- Courage. We believe that when we overcome fear, we enable our best selves.
- Curiosity. We are curious, which is the gateway to empathy, inclusion, and understanding.
- Kaizen. We have a growth mindset committed to constant forward progress.
- Service. We serve our community with humility, enabling joy and belonging for others.

Our mission of helping people belong reflects our commitment to diversity & inclusion. It's just the way we do business.

Description:
FIND YOUR 'BETTER' AT AIA
We don’t simply believe in being ‘The Best’. We believe in better - because there’s no limit to how far ‘better’ can take us.
We believe in empowering every one of our people to find their 'better' - in the work they do, the career they build, the life they live and the difference they make. So that together we can support even more people - including our own - to live Healthier, Longer, Better Lives.
If you believe in better, we’d love to hear from you.
About The Role
Join us as Senior Manager, Investment Marketing at AIA Investment Management!
We are seeking for a Senior Manager to be part of our Investment Marketing team to drive the growth and success of AIA’s investment-linked, funds, and pension business across 18 markets by leading product innovation, marketing, business development, and capability-building initiatives. Leveraging AIA Group’s resources and strategic partnerships with leading global institutional investment managers, the incumbent will enhance product adoption, elevate investment competencies, and support sustainable growth in assets under management through innovative strategies, impactful marketing programs, and best-in-class training and sales enablement.
Responsibilities
- Grow AUM of unit linked funds, pension and collective investment schemes (“Investment Products”) across all AIA markets.
- Develop and drive Investment Products innovation, marketing and training initiatives across all AIA markets.
- Ensure the marketing and training needs of local business units in relation to Investment Products are adequately met.
- Centralize and coordinate the development and management of sales, marketing and training infrastructure as well as collaterals to ensure consistency of messaging across AIA markets including:
- Tools and client interfaces for Investment Product marketing, reporting and training,
- Manage fund factsheet production,
- Create pitchbooks/marketing decks,
- Materials for agency and investor education, investment training and market updates
- Participate and present in investment trainings, events and seminars
- Have a firm understanding and grasp of local business units’ requirements and constraints.
- Keep abreast of the competition and industry developments. Evaluate and provide regular reports on competitors' activities and industry developments.
Requirements
- At least 8 years or more relevant experience in the asset management industry, with frontline experience in financial markets, investment advisory, sales, marketing and training.
- Energetic and excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to build relationships across the business, operations and internal and external stakeholders at all levels.
- Demonstrates strategic foresight and a forward-looking mindset, partnering business units to create sustainable impact and drive long-term success.
- Experience in working across teams and functions to identify, solve and implement solutions.
- In depth knowledge of global macro markets, mutual fund products and working knowledge of regulatory environment in Asia.
- Degree in Business / Finance / Economics, ideally with relevant professional qualifications such as CFA.
- Proficient with MS Powerpoint, MS Word, MS Excel, Bloomberg, media tools
- A strong and effective communicator with ability to present impactfully to large audiences.

Title: Senior Manager, Media Sales & Operations
Description:
We are committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.
About Infront
Building the big moments - we deliver unforgettable sporting events
Infront is all about sports. Active in more than 25 sports, we cover all aspects of a successful sporting event from the distribution of media rights, sponsorship, media production, event operations through to digital solutions. If you share our passion for sport, we may just be the right fit for you.
Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for a passionate individual who is eager to make an impact in the sports industry and thrive in a dynamic team environment as a Senior Manager, Media Sales & Operations.
If you’re seeking a new challenge in an engaged team and collaborative environment filled with enthusiasm and energy, and you possess a strong sense of teamwork and culture, then this position may be the right opportunity for you!
Your main tasks
Responsible for sales and/or sales support of the Badminton World Federation (BWF) media rights portfolio across selected territories, including the management of existing broadcast partners and development of new commercial opportunity
Support the overall management of BWF properties, working closely with relevant Infront departments to ensure the property is delivered to the highest standard across sales, rights delivery, media operations, technology, production, digital, sponsorship, marketing and client servicing
Coordinate with the Global Media Sales Team to support the creation and implementation of BWF sales strategies, including market-by-market planning, commercial positioning, pricing recommendations and broadcaster engagement
Support or lead, as required, the management of key client relationships, including client servicing, contracting, fulfilment of contracted rights, rights delivery, operational coordination and further development of long-term broadcaster partnerships
Manage and support the commercialization of broadcast sponsorship opportunities with BWF broadcast clients, ensuring all activations, proposals and deliverables are aligned with BWF guidelines, rights parameters and approval processes
Support the Director of Media Rights in developing and implementing strategic plans for BWF dark markets, with the objective of identifying future growth opportunities, new distribution models and long-term revenue potential
Explore and develop new ways to commercialise the BWF property beyond traditional broadcast rights sales, including digital distribution, social content, highlights, FAST channels, betting data/audio-visual opportunities, branded content, sponsorship integration and other emerging media models
Support the development and implementation of annual budgets, revenue forecasts and strategic planning for BWF media projects in coordination with relevant internal stakeholders and the Infront Media Sales team
Prepare regular reporting for BWF and internal stakeholders, including sales updates, market feedback, broadcaster performance, rights delivery status, commercial opportunities, dark market development and key risks
Conduct market research across relevant territories, including broadcaster landscape analysis, competitor monitoring, benchmark studies, pricing assessment and identification of emerging platforms or alternative buyers
Support media-related rights-in activities, including regular reporting, client management, event servicing, onsite presence where required and ensuring seamless delivery of BWF events to broadcast partners
Contribute knowledge, experience and market insights to the continued development of the Media, Betting & Technology Team, including proposing improvements to processes, sales materials, commercial models and client servicing approaches
Support the further growth of Infront’s portfolio by contributing to pitches for new rights, responses to tenders and business development initiatives in close coordination with relevant rights-in and business development teams
Your profile
3-6 years of experience in a similar function or related fields
Degree preferred but not mandatory; professional education with additional qualifications also considered
Analysis of new problems, assessment of technical information and other sources, development of new solutions
Strong understanding of the global sports industry, with specific relevance to badminton, including media rights, broadcast partnerships, sponsorship commercialisation, rights delivery, stakeholder management and event servicing
Demonstrable knowledge of the badminton media landscape in selected territories, including broadcasters, digital platforms, agencies, national associations, confederations and other key stakeholders within the badminton ecosystem
Good understanding of the BWF property portfolio, including Major Events, the World Tour, World Tour Finals and other BWF-sanctioned events, as well as the commercial value and broadcast appeal of these properties
Familiarity with drafting, reviewing and navigating media rights contracts, including badminton-specific rights packages, broadcast obligations, territorial rights, digital rights, sponsorship restrictions, approval processes and rights delivery requirements
Proven working relationships and an established network across broadcasters, agencies, rights holders, sponsors, sports governing bodies and/or badminton stakeholders would be highly advantageous
Experience in supporting or delivering international sporting events from a media standpoint, preferably badminton events, including broadcaster servicing, onsite coordination, rights delivery, production support and stakeholder communication
Understanding the international badminton landscape, including the BWF ecosystem, major events, leading athletes, member associations, commercial partners, fan engagement trends and market dynamics, would be a strong plus
Previous experience with a broadcaster, rights holder, agency, federation, national association or sports organisation involved in badminton or Olympic sports would be preferred
Ability to analyse badminton market trends, conduct territory-specific benchmark studies, identify new commercial opportunities and support the development of growth strategies across established, developing and dark markets
Strong communication, coordination and relationship management skills, with the ability to work effectively across internal departments, BWF, broadcasters, agencies, sponsors and other badminton stakeholders
Strong attitude towards quality, excellence in delivery and ‘client-first’ thinking
Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines
Excellent time management and capacity to handle multiple concurrent projects and responsibilities
What we offer
Hybrid work arrangements to support work-life balance
A supportive and team-oriented culture that encourages innovation and idea sharing
Continuous learning opportunities through training programs, workshops and external events
Competitive compensation package with performance bonuses and benefits
Comprehensive employee benefits, including medical insurance, annual leave and loyalty bonus
Are you ready to actively shape and elevate every aspect of the sports industry? Combine your passion for sports with a fulfilling career in our team of talented, motivated, and dedicated team members.
We look forward to receiving your online application and exploring the possibility of you joining our team.
Infront is an equal opportunities employer.

Title: Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships, Business Development & Subsea Network Investments
Description:
Job Description
We are looking for a Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships, Business Development & Subsea Network Investments with proven experience, strong sense of ownership and passion for defining and driving large cross-functional programs in the infrastructure and networking space.
The candidate should be self-driven, can learn quickly and influence decision-making across organizations.
In this position, you will work closely with various Keppel business divisions to gather, refine, and drive program goals to deliver various projects.
At Keppel, we set a high bar, so expect to be challenged on the scope and scale of the problems we tackle. We are moving fast, using the latest technologies, and transforming the way we leverage telecommunication services. If you're looking for a place to make a huge difference, this is it.
Job Description
- Business Development/ Strategic Partnerships/ Investments
- Team leader to lead in new business opportunities in the subsea arena with potential strategic partners and customers.
- Develop budgets and financial models for international submarine cable systems and domestic terrestrial networks, for the entire project lifecycle from seed funding to development to operational phase
- The team is to work closely with tax advisors, create tax efficient holding structures for the investment
- The team is to work closely with Corporate Legal and External Legal Teams to negotiate MOUs, Binding Term Sheets and Definitive Agreements
- Ability to review agreements and contracts and be able to negotiate with partners and customers
- To manage and engage third party consultants for the relevant areas of work requirements
- Ability to data process with information on emerging markets and feasibility studies done on key markets
- Clear and objective analysis and recommendations for the investment
- Business cases and approvals from internal stakeholders including KCL, KTT, KAIF and KDC
- Manage market research for new projects
- Partnership Management
- Provide inputs to sales team in developing compelling business propositions to potential customers who may be partners in the branch landings.
- Working closely with Corporate Legal and External Legal Teams to negotiate MOUs, Binding Term Sheets and Definitive Agreements (IRU)
- Ability to review agreements and contracts and be able to negotiate with partners and customers
- Internal Stakeholder Engagement
- Coordinate monthly/quarterly reporting to KCL, KTT and KAIF and all other BU units
- Work closely with GRC on Red Team engagement and GCC on SGX/Press releases
- Assist Keppel Capital, KAIF, etc.… in their fund-raising activities, approval process, due diligence, and lenders documentation
- Engage, coordinate and to cooperate with Corporate Finance in their debt raising activities
- To support Business Operations in facilitating internal audit processes pertaining to your area and to work the team process as well for audit purposes

Duties and Responsibilities
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced marketing and outreach professional to lead initiatives that strengthen the School's engagement with prospective students, industry partners, alumni, government agencies, and the wider community.
The successful candidate will play a key role in conceptualising and delivering impactful outreach programmes and major internal and external events that enhance the School's profile and support its strategic objectives.

Plan and execute marketing campaigns across digital and offline channels to promote programmes, events, and key initiatives.

Monitor campaign performance and engagement metrics to evaluate effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.

Build and maintain strong relationships with schools, industry partners, government agencies, community organisations, alumni, and other external stakeholders.

Undertake other duties as assigned.

Title: Senior Marketing & Communications Specialist
Description:
Overview
ENGIE is a global energy company, a leading provider of electricity, natural gas, and energy services. With 100 000 employees in more than 70 countries worldwide, ENGIE achieved revenue of €95 billion in 2023. ENGIE is committed to being a leader in the energy transition. We are looking for talented and motivated people to create the future of energy. Join a rewarding and flexible work environment that encourages innovation and creativity, and help us meet the energy challenges of today and tomorrow.
The Supply & Energy Management (S&EM) Global Business Unit covers trading and risk management activities as well as B2B and B2C supply activities across a large and highly diversified energy portfolio, including electricity, natural gas, biomass, LNG and other fuels, CO2 and environmental products
Within the S&EM Business Unit, Business Platform APAC is developing ENGIE’s trading and risk management activities across the APAC region, Middle East and India, around 4 main pillars: risk management and market access, asset management, green solutions and energy supply businesses.
Purpose
The Senior Marketing & Communications Specialist supports the development and delivery of integrated marketing and communications activities that strengthen ENGIE’s Supply & Energy Management positioning and business growth across Asia.The role serves as a regional principal Marketing and Communications focal point of contact for S&EM activities across markets in the region, including Singapore and Japan, working closely ensuring consistency of S&EM’s positioning and coordinating with the relevant Country, GBU and Group Communications teams to ensure consistent messaging, brand alignment and effective execution in accordance with the ENGIE Communications operating model. Communications accountability in individual markets remains with the respective Country Communications teams.
The role contributes to positioning ENGIE as a credible partner in energy supply, renewable energy solutions, corporate PPAs, environmental products, energy management and decarbonisation. Working with commercial, trading and business development teams, the role supports market-facing campaigns, thought leadership, customer engagement initiatives and communications materials that build visibility and enable business development.
Key Responsibilities
Business marketing and commercial support: Support the planning and execution of marketing and communications activities aligned with S&EM growth objectives; work with commercial and business development teams to develop customer-facing materials; and prepare sales-enablement content, presentations, business profiles and solution collateral.
Thought leadership and market positioning: Support and in the development of markets relevant to S&EM’s regional activities and client coverage market insights, executive viewpoints, case studies, industry articles and customer success stories; work with subject matter experts to translate complex market and trading topics into clear, engaging content for customers and internal stakeholders.
External communications and reputation: Support proactive communications activities linked to S&EM business priorities; draft and coordinate media materials, press releases, industry submissions and external messaging; monitor relevant industry developments and support issues management preparation when required.
Digital marketing and content: Manage and produce content for websites, LinkedIn and other relevant channels; maintain an S&EM editorial calendar aligned to commercial priorities; develop campaign assets, newsletters, infographics, videos and presentations; and track engagement and campaign performance indicators.
Events and customer engagement: Coordinate communications and marketing support for industry conferences, customer forums, webinars, roundtables and trade exhibitions; prepare event content, key messages and engagement materials; and support regional customer engagement initiatives.
Internal communications: Prepare internal communications materials that build awareness of S&EM’s activities, products and capabilities across ENGIE; support leadership communications, employee engagement content and regional announcements.
Brand and governance: Ensure communications and marketing materials follow ENGIE brand standards; coordinate with ENGIE Group and regional communications teams; and apply established communications review and approval processes.
Qualifications, skills and experience
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Public Relations, Journalism or a related discipline.
Professional communications, digital marketing or brand-related certification would be advantageous.
Technical Skills & Experience
4 years’ experience in B2B marketing, communications, corporate affairs, digital marketing or a related field.
Exposure to power, utilities, energy trading, renewable energy, sustainability, infrastructure or related sectors would be advantageous.
Good understanding of commercial marketing, customer engagement and business development support.
Experience assisting with thought leadership content, digital campaigns, customer-facing communications materials and executive presentations.
Strong writing, editing, messaging and storytelling capability, with the ability to simplify technical energy and market topics for different audiences.
Ability to coordinate with stakeholders across commercial, trading, leadership, communications and regional teams.
Competencies
Clear communication and business partnering mindset.
Commercial awareness and ability to connect marketing activities to business priorities.
Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
Creativity, curiosity and ability to develop compelling market-facing narratives.
High attention to detail, brand discipline and governance mindset.
Ability to work independently while seeking alignment in a regional, matrixed environment.
ENGIE Energy Marketing Singapore Pte Ltd
ENGIE Energy Marketing Singapore Pte Ltd is the LNG trading platform at the heart of ENGIE, a global energy player in the three businesses of gas, power and energy services, and a comprehensive presence throughout the energy value chain.
Combining in-depth industry experience and financial-market know-how, we serve with LNG solutions all ENGIE business activities worldwide and trade LNG with third parties, from upstream producers to downstream utilities.
ENGIE Energy Marketing Singapore Pte Ltd also has a local presence in Europe (Paris, London, and Madrid).
Unequivocally client-focused, we bring the best of both worlds – energy and trading – to our business partners, be they within the Group or external customers.

Title: SENIOR MARKETING MANAGER
Description:
ABOUT
We are a new international school in Singapore committed to delivering excellence in education and nurturing a generation of culturally diverse students. Our mission is to create a community that fosters curiosity, creativity, and a lifelong passion for learning.
ROLE
The Senior Marketing Manager manages the operational delivery of the school’s marketing activities in support of enrolment, brand awareness and community engagement. The role translates agreed marketing priorities into campaigns, events and projects; coordinates internal teams and external partners; and tracks delivery and results. Strategic direction and priorities are set with the school’s leadership and marketing lead.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Campaigns and Promotions
Coordinate and deliver integrated marketing campaigns across digital, print, events and partner channels, based on agreed objectives and audience segments.
Manage campaign timelines, briefs, creative assets, approvals, landing pages and calls to action.
Work with Admissions to align campaign activity with enquiry generation, open houses and other recruitment priorities.
Track campaign activity and results, identify delivery issues and share recommendations for optimization.
Search and Digital Marketing
Manage the appointed agency’s delivery of Search Engine Marketing (SEM), including paid search campaigns on platforms such as Google Ads. Coordinate campaign briefs, keywords, ad copy, budgets and landing pages; review results such as impressions, clicks, cost per click, conversions and enquiry quality.
Coordinate Search Engine Optimization (SEO) activity to improve the school’s visibility in unpaid search results. This may include keyword and content recommendations, page titles and descriptions, website content updates, internal linking and monitoring organic traffic and search performance.
Coordinate paid social and other digital campaigns with agencies or platform partners, ensuring assets, targeting, tracking and reporting are in place.
Coordinate website and landing page updates through the relevant content management system (CMS), keeping information accurate and the enquiry journey clear.
Liaise with Admissions and CRM users to support campaign tracking and follow-up of marketing-generated enquiries.
Events and Community Activity
Plan and deliver marketing support for open houses, school events, exhibitions, webinars and community initiatives.
Coordinate event promotion, registration communications, collateral, suppliers, logistics and post-event follow-up.
Work with Admissions and relevant school teams to ensure event activity supports family engagement and enrolment objectives.
Marketing Projects and Content
Coordinate marketing projects from brief to completion, maintaining schedules, deliverables, approvals and stakeholder updates.
Work with internal teams and external creatives to develop and update digital and print materials, including photography, video, banners, brochures and campaign assets.
Coordinate EDMs and other audience communications, including copy, design, audience lists, approvals and deployment.
Ensure materials follow the school’s agreed brand and messaging guidelines, escalating content or positioning decisions to the marketing lead.
Agency, Media and Partner Liaison
Manage day-to-day relationships with digital agencies, media contacts, vendors and third-party partners.
Prepare clear briefs, coordinate approvals and assets, monitor timelines and follow up on agreed deliverables.
Coordinate media placements, listings, sponsorships and promotional opportunities with relevant external organizations.
Budget and Performance Reporting
Track campaign and event spend against approved budgets and coordinate quotations, purchase requests and supplier invoices.
Maintain a marketing calendar and records of campaign, event and partner activity.
Compile regular reports on campaign delivery and performance, including lead generation, website and search activity, event registrations and spend.
Use results and feedback to suggest practical improvements to future activity.
REQUIREMENTS
Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Marketing, Public Relations, or related field is preferred.
At least 7 years of experience in similar role, with at least 3 years in a leadership role. Experience in the education sector is desirable.
Proven track record of developing and implementing successful marketing strategies.
Strong leadership skills and the ability to manage cross-functional teams.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proficiency in English.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Strong analytical skills and some experience with CRM and CMS systems.
Knowledge of the Singapore and International education market is a plus.

Title: Senior Producer
Description:
The Senior Producer is responsible for leading the end-to-end development and execution of video productions across corporate, government, broadcast, digital and social media platforms. The role oversees the full production lifecycle — from conceptualisation and pre-production planning to on-ground execution and post-production delivery — ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget and to a high creative and technical standard.
The role requires strong storytelling instincts, production leadership, stakeholder management and the ability to manage multiple fast-turnaround projects in a dynamic agency environment. The Senior Producer is also expected to mentor junior producers and production crew, uphold production SOPs, and contribute towards strengthening organisational capabilities in emerging production technologies and workflows.
Key Responsibilities
Production Management & Execution
Lead and manage the full video production process from ideation to final delivery.
Develop creative concepts, treatments, production approaches and storytelling strategies aligned with client objectives.
Oversee production schedules, manpower deployment, logistics, budgeting and vendor coordination.
Manage shoots across studio, field, overseas and live-event environments.
Ensure production quality, technical standards and visual consistency across all deliverables.
Troubleshoot production challenges and provide practical on-ground solutions during shoots
Creative Development
Work closely with creative, editorial and account servicing teams to conceptualise compelling content and campaign narratives.
Translate client briefs into engaging visual storytelling formats suitable for digital, broadcast and social platforms.
Provide creative direction on filming style, pacing, interview approaches, graphics integration and overall narrative flow.
Review scripts, storyboards and edits to ensure alignment with campaign objectives and brand guidelines.
Stakeholder & Client Management
Serve as the main production point-of-contact for clients, talents, agencies and partners during projects.
Present production concepts, filming approaches and creative recommendations confidently to stakeholders.
Manage client expectations, timelines and feedback throughout the production process.
Build strong working relationships with Government stakeholders, agencies and production partners.
Team Leadership & Mentorship
Supervise and guide producers, videographers, editors and freelancers on assigned projects.
Ensure adherence to production SOPs, equipment protocols and operational workflows.
Conduct pre-production briefings and post-project reviews to strengthen team performance and operational standards.
Mentor junior staff and support capability development within the production team.
Production Operations & Resource Planning
Coordinate equipment bookings, crew deployment, filming permits and production logistics.
Ensure productions are executed efficiently while maintaining prudent cost management.
Monitor production timelines and resource utilisation to support operational efficiency.
Support the implementation of improved workflows and production systems.
Post-Production Oversight
Oversee editing workflows, review rough cuts and ensure quality control before delivery.
Work with editors, motion graphics artists and sound designers to ensure creative consistency.
Ensure final deliverables meet platform specifications, broadcast standards and client requirements.
Innovation & Capability Development
Keep abreast of emerging production trends, AI-assisted workflows, virtual production and evolving digital content formats.
Explore new production technologies and methodologies to improve efficiency and creative output.
Contribute ideas to strengthen the organisation’s production capabilities and creative offerings.

Title: Senior Social Engineering Threat Analyst
Description:
Work Location :
Singapore, Singapore
Hours:
40
Line of Business:
Technology Solutions
Pay Details:
We’re committed to providing fair and equitable compensation to all our colleagues. As a candidate, we encourage you to have an open dialogue with a member of our HR Team and ask compensation related questions, including pay details for this role.
Job Description:
Job Summary
The Senior Social Engineering Threat Analyst defines, develops, and implements Technology Controls and Information Security-related policies, programs, capabilities, and tools that protect TD customers, colleagues, brand reputation, and digital channels from social engineering threats.
This role provides specialized expertise in assessing cyber risk, identifying control gaps, investigating malicious activity, and recommending risk-based solutions across customer protection and employee phishing operations. The threat scope includes phishing, smishing, vishing, spoofing, impersonation, social media and brand abuse, malicious domains and websites, and email-delivered malware.
The role participates in projects of moderate to high complexity and delivers complex reporting, analysis, and assessments at the functional, business line, or enterprise level. The individual serves as a subject matter expert and works across Cyber Security, Fraud, Digital, Telecommunications, Legal, Brand Protection, Operations, and external industry partners to reduce exposure and strengthen organizational resilience.
Key Responsibilities
Assess, investigate, and respond to social engineering threats targeting TD customers, colleagues, brand, and digital assets, including phishing, smishing, vishing, spoofing, impersonation, social media abuse, and other malicious campaigns.
Investigate and scope confirmed malicious email activity, analyze campaign behavior, identify affected users and assets, and support timely containment, remediation, and escalation in accordance with established procedures.
Perform malware triage for email-delivered threats, document findings, and coordinate escalation or incident support when broader risk is identified.
Lead digital risk protection activities by identifying, analyzing, and supporting the disruption of malicious domains, phishing infrastructure, fraudulent websites, social media abuse, and brand impersonation.
Monitor emerging threat activity and threat actor tactics, techniques, and trends; translate findings into actionable intelligence and risk-based recommendations for preventative and detective control improvements.
Identify control gaps across customer-facing and employee-facing threat operations and recommend solutions that improve detection coverage, response effectiveness, and resilience.
Develop, maintain, and continuously improve policies, procedures, standards, playbooks, case-management practices, and operational controls for social engineering threat operations.
Identify and advance automation opportunities that improve the consistency, scalability, and efficiency of triage, investigation, response, disruption, and reporting activities.
Produce complex reporting, threat assessments, trend analysis, and strategic insights for leadership, stakeholders, and partner teams to support informed risk management and decision-making.
Collaborate with Cyber Security, Fraud, Digital, Telecommunications, Legal, Brand Protection, Operations, and external industry partners to coordinate investigations, mitigation, threat disruption, and control enhancements.
Participate in cross-functional initiatives and projects of moderate to high complexity involving technology controls, information security risk, customer protection strategy, employee phishing defense, and operational transformation.
Provide specialized guidance, share knowledge, and contribute to consistent investigative and analytical practices across the Social Engineering Threat Operations team.
Core Competencies
Demonstrated experience in at least one of the following:
Malware triage and incident support
Digital risk protection and threat disruption
Social media or brand-abuse investigations
Operational playbook development or enhancement
Case-management or operational process improvement
Threat reporting or automation solutions
Providing specialized guidance and promoting consistent investigative practices
Strategic thinking, sound judgment, and continuous improvement
Who We Are
TD Securities is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores. Every day, we strive to make every interaction, product, and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple for over 27 million households and businesses in Canada, the United States and around the world. More than 95,000 TD colleagues bring their skills, talent, and creativity to foster deeper relationships, ensure disciplined execution, and build a simpler, faster banking experience. TD is deeply committed to being a leader in client experience, that is why we believe that all colleagues, no matter where they work, are client facing. Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.
Our Total Rewards Package
Our Total Rewards package reflects the investment we make in our colleagues to help them, and their families achieve their well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, including medical coverage, paid time off, career development, and reward and recognition programs.
Additional Information:
We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.
Colleague Development
If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities.
If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.
We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.

We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.
Interview Process

About Us
At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
Available Location: Singapore
About The Department
Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.
About This Role
This role within the mid-market segment focuses on both the acquisition of prospective customers, in addition to the expansion of existing customer accounts. Within this mid-market segment, you will work a set of target accounts in the Digital Natives and or the Commercial sub-segments. This position targets companies with up to 2,500 employees or $1 billion in revenue. The ideal candidate will possess both a sales and technical background that enables them to drive engagement from administrative through executive levels within network operations, development and technical infrastructure teams.
Key Responsibilities:
- Develop and execute a comprehensive plan to achieve aggressive quarterly revenue targets in ASEAN iGaming market.
- Focus heavily on acquiring new logos and maximizing upsell/cross-sell across our full portfolio (e.g., Cloudflare One).
- Act as a trusted advisor, understanding complex customer use cases (node security, dApp delivery) and communicating compelling technical value propositions to C-level executives and technical teams.
- Build a robust pipeline, manage complex contract negotiations, and accurately forecast commercial outcomes with a disciplined approach.
- Effectively scale the territory through collaboration with regional service providers and consulting partners.

- Proven experience selling technical solutions into iGaming platforms, or highly-regulated financial technology environments.

- Possess experience selling technical, cloud-based products or services.
- Solid understanding of computer networking and Internet functioning.
- Strong interpersonal communication skills (both verbal and written) and organizational skills
- Self-motivated with an entrepreneurial spirit.
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced dynamic environment.
- Willingness to travel frequently to visit customers and prospects

The CRM, Loyalty and Customer Engagement Manager owns EYSS’s customer engagement strategy, Eu Rewards loyalty programme and CRM technology ecosystem. The role drives customer acquisition, engagement, retention, repeat purchase and customer lifetime value by translating business objectives into data-led lifecycle strategies, loyalty propositions and automated customer journeys across retail, e-commerce and digital channels.

- Use segmentation, contact strategy and omnichannel journey design to improve repeat purchase, member engagement, customer lifetime value and churn reduction.
- Collaborate with Retail and E-Commerce teams to ensure consistent customer experiences across store, online and digital touchpoints.

- Own the Eu Rewards loyalty programme, including programme proposition, tier structure, rewards, member engagement mechanics, bonus point campaigns and performance monitoring.
- Ensure programme governance, operational controls, data integrity and loyalty liability coordination with Finance are properly managed.

- Manage business requirements, enhancement requests, solution design input, UAT, deployment readiness, defect assessment, platform optimisation and operational governance.

- Plan, implement and optimise Salesforce Marketing Cloud customer journeys across lifecycle automation, segmentation, triggered communications, email, SMS and personalised engagement.
- Use Journey Builder, Contact Builder, Data Extensions, Automation Studio and campaign performance insights to improve marketing relevance, operational efficiency and customer engagement effectiveness.
- Establish automation frameworks that support onboarding, nurture, retention, reactivation, replenishment and other customer lifecycle use cases.

- Monitor customer, loyalty and campaign performance to identify growth opportunities and recommend data-driven initiatives.
- Track and interpret key customer metrics across membership growth, active member rate, retention, repeat purchase, CLV, churn, segmentation, cohort, RFM, loyalty participation and campaign effectiveness.
- Prepare insights and recommendations that support strategic decision-making, customer growth and continuous improvement.

- Develop and manage CRM partnership marketing initiatives that strengthen member acquisition, customer value propositions and engagement.
- Coordinate external partner campaigns, loyalty collaborations, joint promotions and ROI evaluation.
- Manage CRM, loyalty and martech vendors, including Salesforce partners, agencies, consultants and system implementors.
- Facilitate requirements prioritisation, review solution approaches, support issue resolution and RCA, and ensure contracted outcomes are delivered.

Title: Social Media Account Manager
Description:
Social Media Account ManagerThe Role Brief
We're Network, a Singapore media company that only does interior design marketing. 120+ ID firms on our books. We have a full creative team, a production team and consultants handling the commercial side, so you're not designing, editing or filming. You own the account. What gets made, what gets written, when it gets shot, and whether it grew. Every account you hold is judged on the organic result, not on how full the calendar looked.
Starting Salary: SGD 2,380 to 2,690 a month, Singapore based.
(Why the range? We pay based on skill. This is STARTING SALARY, and there are incentives to grow it.)
* Write the briefs. Complete enough that the creative team never comes back with questions.
* Schedule the shoots. Client and production team aligned so shoot days actually happen.
* Own the client groupchat. Fast replies, no dropped threads.
* Own the organic result. Reach, page growth, enquiries.
* Write the captions and hooks. In the client's voice, not a house voice.
* Platforms: IG, FB, TikTok, YT.
Language
You need to speak conversational Mandarin. A lot of our ID clients are more comfortable in Mandarin, and you'll be on calls and in groupchats with them.
All written content is in English. Captions, hooks, briefs, everything that goes out. You don't need to write in Mandarin, but your English writing needs to be good.
Working arrangement
Mainly remote. (90% of time)
Occasionally you'll have meetings with clients, and sometimes with celebrities or talent attached to a shoot, to align on what we're making. Some of those are over Google Meet, some are in person.
70/30
Every account has a consultant attached to it. The split is 70/30. You carry 70, which is why the title says Account Manager. They carry 30 on the commercial side.
They own the client relationship and the money conversation. You own the delivery and the result. When a client asks for something that won't work, you say so and give the consultant an alternative to take back.
What you get to work with
You'll have a full stack creative team behind you:
* Full stack UI/UX and backend developers
* Video editors
* Graphic designers
* Content strategists
* Performance marketers and lead gen media buyers
Plus team training, which is the part that matters most if you're serious about this.
Why this role, specifically
We're not looking for a competent account manager. We're looking for someone we can train.
You'll be taught organic and direct response marketing by people who do it every day, at volume, across 120+ accounts in one vertical. The goal is that you can execute and generate real ROI for a client, not just keep their feed looking busy. That skill is worth more than this salary, and it compounds.
Our delivery is our pride. Our fulfilment is our pride. If you want to take pride in your own work, this is the team to be around.

Description:
Social Media Content Producer
Role Overview
The Social Media Content Producer is responsible for developing, producing and delivering engaging social media content across multiple platforms and formats. Social Media Content Development
Conceptualise and develop creative content ideas based on client briefs, communications objectives, target audiences and platform requirements.

Produce content with an understanding of the need for speed, relevance and turnaround, particularly for time-sensitive or event-based communications.
Repurpose and optimise existing assets into suitable content formats for different platforms.
Project & Client Management
Manage assigned content projects from brief through to final delivery, ensuring timelines, deliverables and quality standards are met.
Work directly with clients and internal stakeholders to understand requirements, clarify briefs and provide recommendations on content execution.
Coordinate production schedules, talent, locations, equipment and other resources required for shoots.
Manage feedback and revisions efficiently while maintaining the creative intent and communications objectives of the project.
Support multiple concurrent projects and prioritise deliverables according to deadlines and operational requirements.
Content Strategy & Performance
Contribute ideas to social media content plans, campaigns and always-on content strategies.
Apply an understanding of platform algorithms, audience behaviour and content performance when developing content.
Review content performance and identify learnings that can improve future creative execution.
Work with account, strategy and creative teams to ensure content is aligned with the broader campaign and communications strategy.

Explore and apply AI-enabled tools to support content ideation, scripting, visualisation, editing, asset generation and production workflows.

Job Description
About Us
We help interior design and renovation firms in Singapore grow — through lead generation, branding, and marketing programmes that bring them qualified homeowners and stronger market positioning. Our clients don't just buy a service from us once; they grow with us across tiers as their firms scale. That only works when someone closes the right clients — and then owns the relationship after the first close.
That someone is you.
About the Role
This is a fully remote role.
You'll work from wherever you work best — no daily commute, no office face-time. What matters is that your clients feel looked after and your accounts grow. You'll meet clients over video calls (with the occasional in-person session if a key relationship calls for it), and stay connected to the team through our daily rhythms online.
This is a closing role first, a relationship role always.
You'll start by building your own book of business: running sales conversations with interior design firms, diagnosing where their business is stuck, and closing them into the right programme. Every deal you close becomes an account you own — and from there, your job is to make each relationship deeper, longer, and more valuable over time.
The more you close early on, the bigger the portfolio you manage — and the more your recurring income compounds through renewals, tier upgrades, and referrals. You are the person our clients trust from the very first call, the one who checks in before they have to ask, and the reason they sign, renew, upgrade, and refer.

Title: Social Media Videographer (Organic Content Shooter)
Description:
Organic Content Shooter | Singapore, on-site, freelance | SGD 150 per 2-hour shoot + transport covered
Network runs marketing for 120+ interior design firms in Singapore. We make home tours and organic content for their social pages: completed homes, designers on camera, before-and-afters, the real work behind a renovation.
The rest of the team is already in place. Strategists plan the content, copywriters write it, editors cut it and the graphic team designs around it. What we need is the person on site.
Your job is simple. Show up, follow the brief and come back with the content the strategy needs.
What you'll do
Prep:
Read the brief and shot list before you arrive. Know what the strategist wants from this home.
On site:
Handle the designer and homeowner. Direct them on camera, keep the shoot moving and get every shot on the list.
Shooting:
2 hours, vertical first. Home tour walkthroughs, the designer talking to camera, before-and-afters, details and one trend video.
Handover:
Shoot in Apple Log, then upload the raws the same day. No editing. Our team takes it from there.
Volume:
Up to 2 shoots a day across Singapore.
Pay
SGD 150 per 2-hour shoot. Transport there and back covered.
Requirements
A portfolio of short-form content you shot. IG or TikTok links are fine.
Your own gear: iPhone 15 Pro, 16 Pro, 17 Pro or 18 Pro (Pro or Pro Max), 256GB recommended, with a gimbal. Must shoot Apple Log in HEVC using the Blackmagic Camera app.Or a DJI Osmo Pocket 3 or newer, shooting D-Log M or D-Log. Bring the wide-angle add-on for small rooms.A wireless mic either way.
Comfortable directing people who aren't used to being on camera.
You know what works on Reels and TikTok, and you shoot for it.
Reliable. On time, raws uploaded the same day.
Don't apply if
You want to edit or put your own style on the content. The strategy is set before you arrive.
You need a crew and an hour of setup per shot.
You go quiet on site and wait to be told what to do.
