Title: Social Work Associate at C'SAY CREST-Youth @ North
Description:
The Social Work Associate (SWA) supports youth experiencing mental health distress and/or mild to moderate mental health conditions. He/she works collaboratively with youth, families, and community partners to provide holistic support and facilitate the achievement of identified goals.
The Social Work Associate also contributes to raising awareness of youth mental health, promoting early identification, providing follow-up support, and linking youth and families to appropriate resources to facilitate early intervention. In addition, he/she supports the team in ensuring that service delivery is aligned with the intended programme objectives and care model.
Job Responsibilities
A). Outreach
Promote youth mental health awareness through social media engagement, talks, workshops, roadshows and campaigns.
Customise and design suitable outreach events based on the needs of the youth and partners.
Create social media posts to reach out to youth in the community and bring awareness about CREST-Youth services.
Coordinate between different internal and external stakeholders to ensure smooth running of events such as volunteers, youth mentees, partners, SAMH youth centres and HQ.
Develop long-term partnership with organisations with common interest in supporting youth mental wellness, especially those residing in our region.
B). Case Management Support
Attend to phone enquiries from stakeholders or caregivers on referral process and criteria.
Support in intake interviews, triage and co-triage with team when deemed necessary.
Conduct regular check-ins, and emotional support to clients and caregivers to monitor progress and wellbeing.
Identify presenting/underlying issues to formulate a care plan to enhance or maintain and promote psychosocial functioning of clients.
Help coordinate case conferences and multi-disciplinary meetings.
C). Administrative and Documentation Tasks
Maintain accurate and timely documentation and data in accordance with case management protocols.
Support reporting officer in collating data and other statistics needed for programme.
Adhere to Programme’s key performance indicator (KPI).
D). Group Activities for In-Centre Youth
Design, plan and facilitate group activities for in-centre youth.
Work closely with volunteers and interns to conduct workshops for youth.
Collaborate with other youth centres to organise events for youth.
Accompany youth and their caregivers for external events to ensure their safety and well-being when needed.
Inform supervisor and reporting officer of any critical situations involving conflict, violence and other emergencies to seek support promptly.
E). Professional Development
Attend Individual and group supervisions, team meetings and training sessions to deepen knowledge in youth mental health.
Stay updated on best practices and resources relevant to adolescent development and mental wellbeing.
F).
Other Duties
To assist Service Head and Team Lead to organise recreational activities for the Team when necessary.
To assist ad-hoc SAMH projects, community outreach programmes and events, ie World Mental Health Day, YOUth Alive!, etc. assigned by Head.
Any other duties as assigned only by Deputy Headand not any other staff.
Uphold SAMH professional standards and ethical guidelines.
Demonstrate a high level of trustworthiness, commitment to the organization and team’s mission and empowerment in daily tasks.
G. Operations at C’SAY CREST-Youth @North Centre
Ownership of centre space.
Maintenance of premises.
Qualifications & Experience
Minimum Diploma in Social Work, Counselling, Psychology or related discipline.
2 to 3 years of relevant work experience in Healthcare or Community Care is preferred.
Strong organisational and time management skills, with attention to detail.
Strong communication skills.
Must be proficient in MS Word, Excel and Powerpoint.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Proactive, resourceful and able to multi-task.

Title: Specialist - Finance Business Partnering
Description:
Company Description
Anglo American's Shipping Division is the Group's exclusive 'in-house' ocean freight service provider, offering a comprehensive range of shipping services to our business units around the world. Using global scale and strength, we aim to optimise our marine activities and provide safe, reliable, compliant and competitive freight to our commodity businesses and their customers in today's dynamic marketplace.
Job Description
The Finance Business Partner uses commercial acumen, analytical skill and storytelling to provide decision support and challenge that ensures the business takes decisions that maximise value.
The Specialist – Finance Business Partnering is a key member of the team acts as the trusted Finance advisor to commodity results and projects, as well as driving change and meeting the specific needs of the business as a respected and trusted business partner.
In addition to being accountable in providing analysis and insight, the Specialist – Finance Business Partnering optimizes existing business models or acting as ‘intrapreneur’ and designing new ones. With end-to-end visibility, understanding of the entire business and technical knowledge, the the Specialist – Finance Business Partnering engages strongly with stakeholders owning and challenging the issues, working jointly with other teams on strategy & planning, innovation, market research and business model change. They piece together information from different sources to develop a truly informed picture of how value is created and put at risk across the organization, recognising inherent trade-offs as businesses deploy different capitals. Translate analytical findings into clear compelling story, conveyed through ad hoc and regular reporting in both written and verbal form.
Business advisory
Proactively engage with the front / mid-office teams to frame business questions that shape analytical agenda.
Originate data from a variety of internal and external sources and in a variety of fields, including operational, financial and accounting.
Use Business Intelligence tools to prepare and analyse data, surfacing insights on key performance drivers to support decision making.
Communicate the insights and recommend strategic and tactical action, suggesting opportunities for improvement and value delivery.
Be key finance advisor to Marketing Exco.
Financial planning
Develop and implement models to forecast financial results and position, enabling informed working capital and cash decisions and supporting regular outlook and budget processes.
Embed delivery of a standardized financial forecasting process across Marketing - prepare and process data/information required for actual, forecast, budget, interim and year end reporting to support the reporting of results for the commodity.
Continuously evolve and refine forecasting processes to improve forecast accuracy and strengthen quality of decision making
Performance management
Design and prepare regular and ad hoc performance reports, including analysis and supporting information to meet internal requirements and deadlines for Marketing and Group.
Drive a collaborative process that provides visibility across the value chain performance and enables improvement in performance management.
Conduct analysis and provide insight into performance trends and results to identify value/improvement opportunities.
Collaborate within the finance team to access data and understand information from all relevant sources and develop on-demand information for users.
Work with Group Finance and Investor Relations to improve internal and external understanding of performance and the Marketing Narrative for your particular commodity, leveraging deep knowledge and understanding of the technical and commercial aspects of the business matched with financial acumen.
Project management and support
Support cross-disciplinary teams in ideating, designing and implementing ad hoc projects, including establishing new corporate or financing structures, executing M&A deals or securing approval for new lines of business.
Support the delivery of material cross commodity and functional projects which impact the broader Finance function.
Ensure changes are embedded into business as usual process
Learning and development
Drive a culture of continuous improvement, big data thinking and collaborative ‘smart team’ working
Stay up-to-date with technology and leverage latest software tools in analysis and reporting.
Support the implementation of new technologies to deliver next generation

Strong academic credentials: in Finance, with CA, CFA CPA qualification.
Commercial acumen: ability to identify how the business generates value. Experience within commodities industry, with marketing, trading and logistics experience preferred.
Financial planning and analysis: applies a broad range of data analytical techniques to draw conclusions and optimize financial performance. Capacity to analyse and find insight in large datasets.
Investment Appraisal: compiles investment proposals and challenges investment assumptions/ provides specialist expertise
Governance and Compliance: applies Governance and Compliance knowledge within the business to mitigate risk and identifies new ways to assess adherence
Project management: applies project management techniques to manage large and complex projects and ensures changes are embedded into business as usual process

Financial regulatory environment: understanding and application of relevant accounting principles, IFRS, policies and processes - Financial Controlling / local statutory accounting standard, IFRS, and local tax law
Technology: understands the fundamental principles of effective financial and accounting systems and is aware of how technology can be deployed to deliver efficiency, effectiveness and control to meet the defined business requirements. Working knowledge of SAP and Hyperion preferred.

Title: Specialist, Data Analytics, Digital & eCommerce, CoA APAC
Description:
Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Lifestyle
We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. As a member of HARMAN Lifestyle, you connect consumers with the power of superior sound.
- Contribute your talents to high-end, esteemed brands like JBL, Mark Levinson and Revel
- Unite your passion for audio innovation with high-tech product development
- Create pitch-perfect, cutting-edge technology that elevates the listening experience.
About The Role
In this role, you will be a core member of a small but effective integrated regional team that will help HARMAN build and grow APAC’s digital ecosystem.
You will be in charge of collecting, analysing, and interpreting complex data sets to provide insights that drive business decisions. The ideal candidate will have a strong passion for data mining, analysis and data visualisation. You will also be able to work independently and as part of a team to deliver high-quality results with the goal of bringing best in class experiences to life for our consumer. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities for digital business growth.
You will report directly to the Senior Manager, Digital & E-Commerce, and this is an independent contributor role managing JBL and Harman Kardon across APAC. You will also be working collaboratively with our distribution partners, digital, ecommerce leads and regional business development managers to drive strategic thinking and KPI measurements.
What You Will Do
Data Collation and Analysis:
- Design and implement data collection methodologies and process to collate relevant data from multiple sources and ensure sanity check.
- Conduct detailed data analysis using data techniques, mining and visualisation to extract insights and identify trends.
Reporting and Visualisation:
- Create dashboards, reports and visualisations that effectively communicate data-driven insights to various stakeholders.
- Present findings and recommendations to internal teams, stakeholders and senior management in an accurate and concise manner.
- Continuously refine reporting processes to improve accuracy, efficiency and effectiveness of data.
Business Insights and Strategy:
- Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to understand their analytical needs.
- Analyse data, work with stakeholders to understand their needs and translate data into actionable insights and recommendations.
- Develop data visualisation to communicate findings.
- Stay updated with industry trends and best practices in data analytics.
- Collaborate with the wider product and marketing team to plan and create digital driven marketing plans (includes paid media), content, creatives, KPIs & reporting.
- Work in hand with the global insights team to manage and deliver an annual brand health insights report across key APAC countries.
- This role will also require you to manage agency relationships, to ensure data and reports are delivered on time.
What You Need To Be Successful
- Bachelor’s Degree in eCommerce/Digital analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science or related field.
- 2 or more years working experience in data analytics.
- Strong understanding of data mining, analysis and data visualisation.
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen attention to detail.
- Strong communication and presentation skills to convey complex info to non-technical audiences.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
- Familiar with eCommerce operating platforms, web analytics, UX-UI tools (Google Analytics, Mouseflow or similar), Proficient in Excel, Power BI or similar tools.
Bonus Points if You Have
- Prior experience in Consumer Electronics or FMCG industry with APAC experience.
- Ability to juggle between the details and big picture, manage multiple and competing projects and priorities.
- Passion for and genuine curiosity for innovation in the Digital / e-Commerce space and a passion for data analysis.
- Data/Insight-driven, strong sense of accountability and solution-oriented are key. Ability to draw insights from multiple data sources and formulate recommendations for improvements.
- Adaptable to ambiguity, changes and be at the forefront to lead change in both actions and behaviour.
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a culturally-diverse team environment, and understanding what it means to achieve success with others and through others.
- Excellent communicator and able to perform well in a matrixed organization.
- Proven experience in managing and influencing a network of local senior managers and managers in a cross functional team.
What Makes You Eligible
- Full working rights in Singapore.
What We Offer
- A hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with in-person collaboration, with most office-based roles onsite three days a week.
- Access to employee discounts on HARMAN and Samsung products (including JBL, Harman / Kardon, AKG, and others)
- Learning and development opportunities through our award-winning HARMAN University programs
- An inclusive and diverse work environment that supports both your professional and personal development
You Belong Here
HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want.
About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next-Level Technology
Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.
Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other.
If you’re ready to innovate and do work that makes a lasting impact, join our talent community today!

Please be aware that HARMAN recruiters will always communicate with you from an '@harman.com', ‘@careers.harman.com’ or ‘harmanglobal.avature.net’ email address. If you are asked for such information or receive communication from an email address not ending in one of the above email domains about a job with HARMAN, please cease communication immediately and report the incident to us through: harmancareers@harman.com.

Title: Sr. Field Application Scientist, Cell Culture Automation
Description:
Bring more to life.
Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?
At Molecular Devices, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.
You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.
Join Molecular Devices and help drive scientific discovery for life science customers in academia, biotech, pharma, and government. Our automated and AI-enabled technology empowers researchers to tackle complex questions and gain deep insights, accelerating the development of safer, more effective therapeutics. As part of our team—rooted in collaboration, authenticity, and innovation—you’ll ultimately contribute to groundbreaking science that enhances lives globally and shapes a healthier future for all.
Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.
The Sr. Field Application Scientist, Cell Culture Automation is responsible for serving as the primary scientific and technical expert for cell culture automation across JAPAC. The role accelerates customer success, scientific adoption and commercial growth by translating complex cell biology workflows into reliable automated solutions, leading proof-of-concept work and supporting customers from evaluation through long-term adoption.
This position reports on an interim basis to the Interim General Manager, JAPAC and is part of the Commercial Applications / Scientific Affairs organization, located in Singapore and working remotely to cover Japan and Asia Pacific (JAPAC).
In this role, you will have the opportunity to:
Serve as the regional scientific and technical expert for cell culture automation, supporting customer discovery, workflow assessment, solution design, evaluation, implementation and sustained adoption across JAPAC.
Design and execute product demonstrations, feasibility studies and proof-of-concept projects for advanced cell models, including induced pluripotent stem cells, organoids, spheroids, immuno-oncology and translational disease models.
Translate cell culture protocols and acceptance criteria into reliable automated workflows, including liquid handling, labware configuration, imaging, monitoring, feeding, seeding, passaging, compound addition and endpoint assays.
Guide customers in AI-enabled image analysis, phenotype classification, segmentation, feature extraction, quantitative analysis, data interpretation and image-guided automated decision making.
Partner with commercial and cross-functional teams to advance opportunities, lead onboarding and training, optimize applications, coordinate technical escalations, and develop strategic reference sites and scientific collaborations.
The essential requirements of the job include:
PhD in Cell Biology, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Biomedical Sciences, Bioengineering, Pharmacology, Computational Biology or a related discipline; or a Master’s degree in a related discipline with substantial relevant industry experience.
Multiple years of customer-facing scientific applications experience in a field applications, application scientist, product specialist, scientific consulting or comparable technical-commercial role.
Demonstrated experience with automated cell culture, liquid handling, laboratory robotics or workflow automation, together with relevant cell-based applications such as stem cells, induced pluripotent stem cells, organoids or spheroids.
Demonstrated experience with live-cell imaging, high-content screening, automated microscopy, cell-based assay development or AI-assisted image analysis, including data interpretation and workflow optimization.
Fluent English communication and presentation capability, with experience supporting customers and cross-functional stakeholders across multiple countries and cultures.
Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:
Ability to travel internationally approximately 40-60%, including overnight travel, to support customers and commercial teams across JAPAC.
Ability to work in customer laboratory environments and comply with applicable site safety, access and training requirements.
It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:
Cell culture automation, ImageXpress systems, MetaXpress, IN Carta, high-content screening platforms, automated cell culture platforms or comparable technologies.
Drug discovery, biopharmaceutical, contract research organization, academic research institute, stem cell center or imaging core-facility environments.
Launching emerging scientific technologies, developing strategic reference sites or driving adoption across Asia Pacific.

Title: Supply Chain Lead, APM
Description:
Campari Group today is a major player in the global branded spirits industry, with a portfolio of over 50 premium and super premium brands, marketed and distributed in over 190 markets around the world, with leading positions in Europe and the Americas.
Headquartered in Milan, Italy, Campari Group owns 25 plants worldwide and has its own distribution network in 26 countries, and employs approximately 4,700 people.
Shares of the parent company Davide Campari - Milano N.V. are listed on the Italian Stock Exchange since 2001. Campari Group is today the sixth-largest player worldwide in the premium spirits industry.
Role Purpose
The Supply Chain Lead is the recognised face of Supply Chain to the Market and the voice of the Market within Supply Chain. The role owns and orchestrates end-to-end APM (Asia Distributors markets + Singapore IMC) Supply Chain performance across service levels, demand quality, S&OP outcomes, cost to serve, customer service, logistics execution and inventory-related trade-offs. The incumbent partners closely with the APM Managing Director and commercial leadership, translating business priorities into disciplined Supply Chain choices while leveraging local, regional and global resources to deliver sustainable service, growth and cost performance.
Key Accountabilities
Supply Chain Business Partnering & Market Leadership
Act as the single, responsive point of contact for Supply Chain for the APM Leadership Team and commercial organisation.
Partner with the APM Managing Director to anticipate business constraints, understand customer and channel needs, and translate market priorities into Supply Chain actions.
Influence cross-functional decisions beyond Supply Chain by bringing fact-based trade-off recommendations on service, cost, inventory, availability and demand quality.
Communicate Supply Chain priorities, risks, opportunities and project impacts clearly to market stakeholders, ensuring strong alignment and follow-through.
S&OP, Demand Planning & Commercial Collaboration
Lead the local S&OP / Demand Planning process, enabling consensus meetings, challenging assumptions and tracking risks and opportunities.
Improve the level of maturity of the existing S&OP process in APM, ensure standardization to Campari One plan model
Own forecast quality at market level, including bias, forecast value-add, data integrity and appropriate aggregation for regional and local decision-making.
Drive one-plan discipline and readiness for IBP / digital planning capabilities, ensuring local teams adopt standard planning cycles and ways of working.
Customer Service, Logistics & Cost to Serve
Be responsible for customer service and logistics operations in APM, including order-to-delivery performance, service recovery, delivery reliability and distribution performance, from Singapore warehouse.
Be responsible for the implementation and the logistics operation of the future Logistics Asia Hub, coordinating supply of defined Asia markets from all sources
Own cost-to-serve visibility and improvement plans, identifying logistics levers and productivity opportunities while protecting service and growth.
Manage and develop strategic relationships with third-party logistics providers, transportation partners, warehouses and key external service providers.
Partner with the commercial organisation on distributor relationships, collaborative planning, service alignment and issue resolution.
End-to-End Supply Chain Performance & Continuous Improvement
Connect demand, supply, inventory, materials, customer service and logistics into a coherent end-to-end market view.
Identify business and operational opportunities, define action plans and drive execution to enhance service delivery, availability and working capital outcomes.
Build robust performance management routines based on clear KPIs for service, forecast accuracy, cost, inventory and operational productivity.
Lead local Supply Chain transformation initiatives and continuous improvement projects, including logistics network optimisation, customer service transformation and route-to-market related change.
People Leadership, Matrix Collaboration & Operating Model Catalyst
Coordinate local functional Supply Chain efforts and foster collaboration across Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Customer Service, Logistics, Finance and Commercial teams.
Engage regional and global Supply Chain counterparts proactively to answer local business needs, escalating trade-offs and priorities with clear recommendations.
Develop team capability and succession pipeline across demand planning, customer service and logistics roles where direct or functional leadership is in scope.
Role model Campari values, GSC behaviours and mindsets, creating an engaged, accountable and performance-oriented Supply Chain climate.
Key Relationships
Internal: APM Leadership Team: Managing Director, Sales and Marketing, Finance / FP&A, HR - Regional Supply Chain: Supply Planning, S&OP and Demand Planning, Procurement and CoMan, Quality and R&D – Global Supply Chain functions: Innovation, MDM, CS&L and Planning.
External: Third-party logistics providers, distributors, key customers, freight forwarders, service partners where relevant.
Experience, Education & Success Profile
Required Experience & Education
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business or a related discipline.
Approximately 10+ years of Supply Chain experience, ideally including APM/Singapore exposure in S&OP, Demand Planning, Customer Service, Logistics or Commercial Planning.
Proven experience in FMCG or F&B industry
Experience operating in a matrix organisation and influencing senior commercial stakeholders without relying only on formal authority.
People management or functional leadership experience, including capability building and performance management, is strongly recommended.
Experience leading continuous improvement projects in logistics, customer service, planning, network optimisation or route-to-market change.
Strong digital and data literacy; SAP S/4HANA, SAP IBP or advanced planning system exposure is an advantage.
Fluent English required; other Asian language and cross-cultural APAC experience are strong advantages.
Leadership Traits & Behaviours
Business partner and influencer: credible with commercial leaders and able to build consensus around difficult trade-offs.
Decision-oriented: turns data, KPIs and market signals into clear choices and action plans.
Commercial-first and service-obsessed: protects growth and customer experience while balancing cost and inventory.
Pragmatic and resilient: able to work through ambiguity, prioritise effectively and sustain momentum in transformation.
People developer: builds internal capability, coaches team members and reinforces accountability.
Matrix leader: connects local, regional and global teams into one coherent operating model.
Differentiating Success Factors
P&L fluency and ability to explain the financial implications of service, stock, cost-to-serve and route-to-market decisions.
Distributor / customer collaboration experience, including joint planning and service-level alignment.
Scenario planning capability and comfort leading trade-off discussions across demand, supply, cost and inventory.
Multi-country or APAC regional experience, with the cultural agility to navigate diverse stakeholder environments.
Transformation mindset: able to upgrade ways of working and embed future-ready planning and service operations.

Title: SUPPLY CHAIN OPERATIONS MANAGER, SEA & JP
Description:
Role Overview
Supply Chain Operations Manager, SEA & JP leads CPFR(Collaborative Planning, Forecasting and Replenishment) process with distributor partners across South-East Asia and Japan cluster. The role focuses on establishing reliable distributor data flows and actionable performance metrics, and ensuring demand visibility, product availability, inventory health and supply reliability by connecting distributor plans with General Mills commercial and supply chain processes.
The role partners closely with General Mills teams(Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Customer Service & Logistics, Supply Planning, Commercial, Finance, Marketing, COE and Global Business Support) and distributor supply chain and commercial teams. The CPFR Manager establishes a consistent operating rhythm, recurring planning and review routines, ensures high quality collaborative plans with distributors, improves alignment between General Mills and distributors on IMS, shipment, inventory and replenishment plans along with KPI’s and drives timely action on risks and opportunities.
Job Description
1. Distributor Collaboration and CPFR Governance
Own the CPFR process and operating model for the assigned distributor markets & cluster
Establish clear ways of working, meeting cadence, roles, decision rights, inputs, outputs and escalation paths
Build trusted working relationships with distributor supply chain, commercial, customer service and logistics counterparts
Lead regular joint planning reviews and ensure required inputs, decisions and actions are clear and timely
Support distributor partners and planning teams on CPFR principles, forecast quality, inventory management including data requirements, ways of working, GMI processes and order placement timelines and performance tracking
Build distributor planning maturity through standardized routines, data, performance management and joint accountability
Ensure the distributor forecast collection, challenge and consensus process at the appropriate market, brand, SKU and time-horizon level
Ensure distributor demand signals are mapped with commercial plans, promotions, launches, seasonality, market intelligence and historical consumption. Ensure commercial events, launches, portfolio changes and market risks are reflected in the planning cycle
Drive distributor adherence to agreed order placement timelines per brands/plants
Monitor distributor inventory (on hand and in transit), stock cover, open orders, and projected availability and ensure they are rightfully reflected in all relevant GMI tools
Monitor actual sales, stock, shipments, orders, and forecast changes to identify risks and opportunities early
Define and maintain replenishment parameters in partnership with distributors and internal planning teams
Provide clear inputs to market or cluster S&OP forums and other business decision forums
2. Business Outlook, Service, Inventory and Supply Risks Management
Ensure a high quality 12-month rolling IMS outlook to be built with the distributors with identified and actioned risks and opportunities
Collaborate with demand planning team to identify and improve forecast gaps, demand volatility, supply-demand imbalances and projected service risks
Coordinate recovery plans for stock-outs, excess inventory, slow-moving or aged stock, supply constraints, expedites and order changes
Escalate risks with the business impact, recommended action, decision owner and timing
Ensure order stability and reduce avoidable expedites, delays, cancellations, stock-outs and inventory build-up
Support scenario planning and quantify the implications of key assumptions, risks and decisions
3. Performance Management, Analytics and Continuous Improvement
Define and maintain dashboards covering forecast accuracy, forecast bias, primary and secondary service levels, stock-outs, stock cover, inventory health, order adherence and action closure
Establish performance baselines and targets for each distributor
Analyse trends and root causes of forecast error, service failures, inventory imbalances and planning instability and lead corrective actions with the appropriate internal and external stakeholders
Improve and standardize data quality, master data discipline, reporting automation and planning transparency
Measure the impact of improvements on service, inventory, cost, planning stability and distributor collaboration
4. Cross-Functional Leadership and Business Integration
Influence internal and external stakeholders without relying solely on direct authority
Lead through influence across a matrix of distributors and General Mills stakeholders
Share best practices across markets and contribute to capability building within the distributor-market supply chain organization
Demonstrate General Mills leadership behaviours by acting with pace, prioritizing what matters, winning as one team and doing the right thing, all the time
Key Performance Indicators
Distributors forecast accuracy and forecast bias (M-3)
Case-fill rate, primary and secondary service level, availability and stock-out rate
Inventory coverage by distributor and category
Order adherence, order stability and schedule change frequency
CPFR action closure and process compliance
CPFR maturity rating per distributor
Qualifications, Skills & Experience
1. Education
Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, Economics or a related field
Master’s degree or APICS/IBF certification is a plus
2. Experience
3-5 years of experience in demand planning, supply planning, customer collaboration, replenishment, logistics or end-to-end supply chain
Proven experience working with distributor-led markets or distributors managing CPFR or planning processes across multiple geographies
Practical experience with CPFR, S&OP / IBP, forecasting, inventory management and exception-based planning
Experience leading cross-functional projects and influencing stakeholders without direct authority
Experience in fast-moving consumer goods or a similarly demand-volatile, multi-SKU environment is preferred
3. Skills
Define and maintain dashboards covering forecast accuracy, forecast bias, primary and secondary service levels, stock-outs, stock cover, inventory health, order adherence and action closure.
Strong analytical and numerical ability, proficiency in Excel and planning tools (SAP APO/IBP, OMP)
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across functions and regions with effective negotiation skills
A proven “doer” who acts with speed and agility to deliver results
Deep understanding of forecasting methodologies, in market, shipment and inventory dynamics and S&OP processes
Attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and ability to work in a dynamic environment
Fluency in English

Title: Technical Sales Lead, Singapore (SG)
Description:
Location: Singapore, SG
Corporate Title: Vice President
Division: CSH-Public Sector Solutions (50008266)
Department: CSHA-PSS Market Units (50008267)
Purpose
Our dedicated Public Sector Solutions (PSS) team specialises in serving Public Sector clients and brokers, addressing the unique challenges of this client segment with trusted risk insights, data analytics, and risk transfer solutions. By connecting public sector brokers and clients to the full capabilities of the Swiss Re Group, we turn their needs into outcomes. Together, we navigate an increasingly complex world, building resilience for governments and beyond.
Our PSS team is focused on, for Swiss Re Group, public sector institutions with non-standard buying behaviour, influences and/or needs driven by unique political or budgetary considerations, motivations, gestation periods and/or procurement processes impacting decision-making, solution design and/or execution. This includes:
Governments at central, state, and municipal levels
State-backed risk pools, captives and international sovereign risk pools
Publicly owned Export Credit Agencies
World Bank, UN Agencies and IMF, and other Supranational & Development Finance Institutions; and
Non-governmental organizations (NGOs)
About the Role
You will be responsible for enabling business origination by utilizing deep technical subject matter expertise of designing insurance solutions to actively promote and eventually execute effective risk transfer strategies. The role has a specific focus to promote and facilitate new sales opportunities by offering innovative insurance solutions in line with Swiss Re risk appetite and underwriting standards for Natural Catastrophe (Nat Cat) and climate risks. The end goal is to deliver opportunities for Swiss Re Group including, but not limited to Reinsurance, Corporate Solutions, Alternative Capital Partners, and Risk Data Solutions (the tool and consulting arm of Swiss Re Group) aligned with their growth priorities and target liability portfolios. You will work in close coordination with the Business Units (BUs) where the underwriting and P&L authority sits, to deliver business success in a collaborative ecosystem. There is also close collaboration with other Group Functions such as Regulatory Affairs, Risk Management, and Swiss Re Institute.
Your key responsibilities are:
Enable business origination by providing subject matter expertise to develop and provide technical solutions and eliminating technical hurdles often experienced by public sector clients, primarily in property and Nat Cat areas.
As a member of a team with local presence but global reach, you ensure flexible and effective product- and know-how transfer and deploy your expertise in a manner that maximizes cost-benefit for local origination efforts while at the same time building a consistent common global knowledge base.
Transform data driven risk "challenges" into applicable, sellable risk transfer solutions for external stakeholders (clients, brokers, risk and finance managers, etc).
Make product demonstrations and accelerate the sales process by presenting potentially complex products in an easy-to-understand but data-backed way.
Strong collaboration with relevant 3rd party vendors such as but not limited to ICEYE, REASK, Floodbase, Planet, JBA, RMS, Verisk, etc.
Develop, maintain and utilize technical networks internally and externally to stay abreast of market developments, competitor activities and technical best practices, with a particular focus on supporting Swiss Re BUs.
Contribute technical and public entity thought leadership at high profile industry events, through media outreach and at speaking engagements.
Establish yourself as part of BU property network, including but not limited to Alternative Capital Partners (ACP), Parametric Centre of Excellence (CoE), Alternative Risk Transfer (ART), etc. – notably scientific, engineering, and structured insurance solution experts across the company.
Guide placement of bespoke solutions jointly with structuring, underwriting, and client management in compliance with legal and regulatory requirements, as well as in accordance with internal risk management and performance guidelines.
Work closely with PSS CM team to ensure maximum sales effectiveness, while providing regular updates and helping manage deal flow.
For your supported transactions maintain oversight of production numbers against defined plan figures.
About You
Master's degree preferred in natural science, computer, engineering, mathematics, finance or actuarial sciences.
7+ years of experience working in property insurance market in underwriting, risk management or insurance/Insurtech sales/marketing complemented by practical experience in structuring and executing structured insurance solutions, ideally but not limited to parametric natural catastrophe products that yield strong economic profit for the company.
Strong knowledge of traditional and structured insurance products and markets.
Strong financial acumen with deep capital and financial management proficiency as well as analytical and modelling capabilities.
Good command of systems and tools (geospatial, computing - e.g., Excel, R, Python), risk analysis and willingness to learn proprietary Swiss Re tools.
High attention to details and ability to meet tight deadlines.
Ability to work both independently and as part of a cross-functional team to achieve financial targets.
Ability to triage effectively and to stop low return on investment propositions early and decisively.
Above average presentation skills and personal gravitas to interact with an external client base with ease and under pressure.
Effective communicator in English and flexibility to adapt to audience at different seniority levels.
Chinese (Mandarin) a strong asset.
Willingness to travel extensively in the APAC region.
Local/ Specific Role Requirements
Full proficiency in English. Chinese (Mandarin) a strong asset
Driving technical development (IT, coding, programming)
Structuring Expert tailored cases, including but not limited to parametric (Property mostly)
Climate or Geoscience Expert
Co-owning regional account management responsibility with local senior lead of ROW APAC market (except ANZ)

Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.
Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. We offer innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations from our approximately 50 locations worldwide. Title: TikTok Ads Specialist
Description:
About Us
We provide travel eSIM solutions that help international travellers stay connected abroad. Customers can browse and purchase mobile data plans through our website and app. We are looking for an experienced TikTok advertising specialist to grow customer acquisition and sales across international markets.
About the Role
You will manage TikTok paid advertising, with a particular focus on using short-form video to attract relevant audiences, communicate product value and convert interest into purchases.
This role combines hands-on media buying, strong creative judgement and rigorous data analysis. You should be able to explain why a video attracts attention, whether that attention leads to sales, and how to improve both creative performance and acquisition efficiency through continuous testing.
Appointment at Specialist or Senior Specialist level will depend on your experience, capabilities and track record.
Key Responsibilities
Plan, launch and optimise TikTok Ads campaigns to drive customer acquisition and purchases through our website and app.
Develop a structured short-form video testing programme across travel scenarios, customer pain points, product demonstrations, offers and creator styles.
Prepare actionable creative briefs covering opening hooks, scripts, pacing, product benefits and calls to action.
Work with creative teams and content creators to produce and iterate video ads and UGC suited to TikTok.
Analyse video viewing and engagement metrics alongside click-through rates, purchase conversion, acquisition costs and returns.
Identify where performance breaks down between attracting attention, generating clicks and converting visitors into paying customers.
Maintain a consistent pipeline of new creative concepts and variations, using test results to guide subsequent production.
Monitor creative fatigue and scale successful ads while controlling acquisition costs and returns.
Manage campaign structures, targeting, bidding and budget allocation across international markets.
Work with product and technical teams to validate conversion tracking and website or app attribution.
Compare platform-reported results with actual sales and acquisition costs, and present clear findings and recommended actions.
Requirements
At least 3 years of hands-on TikTok Ads experience, including independently managing campaigns and budgets. Candidates with 5 or more years of relevant paid advertising experience and substantial TikTok Ads experience are encouraged to apply.
Strong ability to evaluate short-form video creatives and turn performance data into specific recommendations for hooks, scripts, pacing, product messaging and calls to action.
Strong data analysis and logical reasoning skills, with the ability to develop hypotheses, run structured tests and explain the results.
Proven success in paid campaigns that generated purchases or paying customers, supported by measurable acquisition costs and returns.
Experience testing multiple creative concepts and scaling successful campaigns while monitoring performance as budgets increase.
Strong working knowledge of TikTok Ads Manager, campaign optimisation and conversion tracking.
Ability to assess data quality, understand attribution limitations and distinguish meaningful improvements from short-term fluctuations.
Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets and familiarity with relevant website or app analytics tools.
Clear written and spoken English, strong attention to detail and the ability to collaborate effectively with creative and technical teams.
Preferred Experience
International or multi-market TikTok advertising campaigns.
eSIM, telecommunications, travel technology, e-commerce or consumer apps.
Website purchase campaigns, app acquisition and app attribution tools.
UGC advertising, creator-led paid campaigns or short-form video production.
Relevant industry experience is an advantage. Experience with Google Ads or Meta Ads is welcome but is not required.

Please submit your CV and one or two TikTok paid advertising campaigns you have personally managed. Include the objective, market, approximate budget, timeframe, your responsibilities, creative testing approach, optimisation decisions and measurable results.

Description:

Job Family Group:

Job Description:
Trading & Shipping, Asia Pacific, and Middle East (T&S APME) is the supply and trading arm of BP in the East is our face to the traded markets for oil, gas, power, refinery and chemical feedstock and currencies. Employing on our unique expertise and insights, we are leading buyer and seller of spot cargoes, with a focus on responsiveness and the introduction of new products to keep the world’s energy moving. T&S APME supports other BP businesses by providing a competitive supply and trading function that covers Oil, Chemicals, Power, and Gas as well as a suite of risk management tools. Our trading business delivers gross margin through our entrepreneurial trading activities and the optimization of blending and shipping operations. T&S APME’s vision is to grow the Eastern Hemisphere supply and trading business into an industry-leading organization that is not only profitable and safe but also one that respects the environment and communities that we operate in. T&S APME is a dynamic environment as it is market driven and at the forefront of BP's commercial activities
We are seeking an applicant to fill the position of Trading Operations, based in Singapore. The successful candidate will be part of a larger Trading Operations team and will report to the Team Lead of the Petchem, Naphtha and LPG team. The business aims to extract maximum value through effective stock inventory management and timely scheduling of deliveries to end receivers, as well as optimizing cargo matching and tanker berthing/delivery schedule. The activities will also include administrative work to ensure updates in the relevant systems. These operational objectives are aligned with our BP “Who we are” framework, which are to be achieved with no compromise to BP’s operating standards.
What you will deliver
The successful candidate’s primary focus will be managing operations in support of the Naphtha and/or PetChem business and marine activities. The successful candidate will work closely with all stakeholders across Asia Pacific and Middle East, where applicable and will be responsible for
Ensuring all operations activities are conducted in compliance with relevant HSSE and operating standards.
Working closely with BP Shipping to ensure that the business aligns with Group Marine Policy.
Collaborating with Finance teams to provide assurance on trading processes and procedures.
Scheduling the movements and efficiently coordinate and optimise operations.
Maintaining timely and accurate records in the relevant systems
Working with the traders, originators, and marketers to implement new trading/marketing strategies and enhance the value of existing strategies.
Working with the regional offices on operational decisions & resolution of issues
Supporting ancillary invoice and payment processing to shipowners, service providers and surveyors
Proactive management and recovery of demurrage and oil loss costs
Developing, maintaining, and enhancing the relationships with third parties and associates, including terminals, shipping companies, surveyors, and marketing businesses
Providing market intelligence to support analytics, marketer and traders’ understanding of market activity.
Supporting local or group initiatives and projects, as required, that enhance value
What you will need to be successful
Meaningful operational experience with a proven track record of delivering commercial value.
Ability to implement the compliance & HSSE requirements relating to operations.
Supply and logistics knowledge with experience in handling tank storage, pipeline scheduling and truck deliveries.
Strong knowledge of international and domestic processes and documentation
Strong Interpersonal skills and able to build and maintain successful relationships.
Strong Communication skills
Strong teammate, proactive and assertive
Strong analytical skills and commercial awareness
Key Technical Competencies
Knowledge of energy trading industry
A university degree or diploma holder preferred, but specific educational profile is less important than behaviours and a strong track record of high performance and contribution.

Title: Vice President - Business Analysis and Transformation Service - Operations
Description:
Company Overview:
Nomura is a Global financial services group with an integrated global network spanning over 30 countries. By connecting markets East & West, Nomura services the needs of individuals, institutions, corporates and governments through its four business divisions: Retail, Asset Management, Wholesale (Global Markets and Investment Banking) and Merchant Banking. Founded in 1925, the firm is built on a tradition of disciplined entrepreneurship, serving clients with creative solutions and considered thought leadership. For further information about Nomura, visit www.nomura.com.
Department Overview:
The Operations division provides the support and control infrastructure that enables the Firm to develop and deliver financial products throughout the world. Working with the Sales, Trading and Information Technology Divisions, Operations professionals are responsible for the management and execution of transactions in a manner which maximizes profitability and minimizes risk. Our division is responsible for the management and execution of millions of securities transactions on a daily basis. Our responsibilities include trade processing, confirmation, settlement, fails management, margin, asset servicing, risk management, reference data management and various other client services. In partnership with sales, trading, prime services, information technology and other teams from across the bank, we apply a continual focus on improving productivity and efficiency, while seeking new and innovative ways to support our clients' changing needs.
Business Overview:
Strategic, Analytics, and Business Re-engineering (SABRE) aims to align our capabilities to deliver end-to-end solutions that create tangible value for the business. The Business Analysis and Transformation Service within SABRE focuses on driving small and large transformation objectives from ideation to delivery for Operations acting in as Business Analyst, Project Manager and Program manager.
Lead business analysis, transformation initiatives across Operations, driving strategic change programs while managing a high-performing team of business analysts. This role combines deep business analysis expertise with project management capabilities to deliver end-to-end solutions across complex collateral management and middle office processes within the global investment banking environment.
Role Description:
Lead projects across a range of Operations initiatives, working with related participants (Global Markets business, International Wealth Management business, Transformation Office, Technology, Operations etc)
Apply advanced business analysis techniques and deep domain knowledge in Operations processes - in particular within our Wealth Management team, to drive transformation initiatives
Drive the execution of process changes and ensure proper impact assessment, change management & service integration.
Understand, document, and validate complex business requirements, translating stakeholder needs into clear, actionable specifications for technology and operations teams
Analyse current end-to-end operations process flows, producing comprehensive documentation including current state assessments, gap analysis, and future state designs
Collaborate with technology teams to design and document strategic system/process flows, ensuring alignment between business requirements and technical solutions
Leverage AI and automation tools to accelerate business analysis processes, including requirements generation, documentation, user story creation, and test scenario development, driving significant efficiency gains across the team
Establish governance frameworks, metrics, and controls to manage programs effectively, including risk and issue management with proactive corrective measures
Lead agile delivery through JIRA, Confluence, and other tools, ensuring transparency and continuous improvement
Drive project proposal development by leveraging relationships with senior stakeholders and C-level executives
Provide strategic input into engagement decisions including work planning, timeline management, resource allocation, and team career development
Develop comprehensive program strategies encompassing stakeholder assessment, leadership alignment, organizational transition, change readiness, capability transfer, and end-user training
Track and coordinate BoW related issues, improvements and actions till closure.
Champion the adoption of emerging AI technologies within the team to enhance analytical capabilities, reduce manual effort, and improve delivery quality
Skills, experience, qualifications, and knowledge required:
Domain
Minimum 8 years of Project Manager experience running successful change the bank projects for Operations
Proven experience in Banking operations, including Wealth Management activities. Proven experience of Middle Office and Bank Office functions.
Demonstrated business analysis skills including requirements elicitation, process modelling, gap analysis, user story creation, acceptance criteria definition, and UAT coordination.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills at senior levels.
Excellent communication, leadership, and organizational skills with proven experience in conflict management and issue resolution
Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams under tight deadlines.
Demonstrated ability to understand, evaluate, and apply AI tools (such as generative AI, process mining, intelligent automation) to streamline business analysis workflows, accelerate documentation, and enhance requirements quality
Understanding of business performance metrics (cost efficiency, productivity, operational risk).
Technical
Strong proficiency in executive storytelling, PowerPoint, and data visualization.
Strong working knowledge of Agile methodologies with hands-on experience using JIRA, Confluence, and other agile project management tools throughout the full delivery lifecycle
Analytical mindset with proficiency in Excel, Power BI, or other visualization tools.
Familiarity with data visualization best practices and executive narrative design principles.
Certification in Project Management (PMP/Prince2) or Business Analysis is a plus.
Nomura Competencies
Explore Insights & Vision
Identify the underlying causes of problems faced by you or your team and define a clear vision and direction for the future.
Making Strategic Decisions
Evaluate all the options for resolving the problems and effectively prioritize actions or recommendations.

Inspire team members through effective communication of ideas and motivate them to actively enhance productivity.

By connecting markets East & West, we service the needs of individuals, institutions, corporates and governments through our four business divisions: Wealth Management, Investment Management, Wholesale (Global Markets and Investment Banking) and Banking.
Driven by the insights of some 28,000 people worldwide, we put our clients at the center of everything we do, delivering unparalleled access to, from and within Asia. For further information about Nomura, visit www.nomura.com
Divisional Overview
The Chief Transformation Office function oversees group-wide transformation on mission critical projects for the firm. We’re aligned to our key businesses across the group and operate to global standards and governance across our programs. Our purpose is to support Nomura’s business strategy and deliver consistent group-wide services based on common operating principles.
Job Overview
The Vice President, Transformation Specialist is a high-impact, execution-focused role tasked with defining and delivering strategic transformation initiatives across Nomura. This position bridges strategic vision and operational execution, requiring a change-driven leader who can translate ambiguous objectives into structured, measurable outcomes while engaging senior stakeholders globally.
The ideal candidate is a go-getter with strong technical rigor (financial modeling, AI/Excel) and exceptional leadership (influencing without authority, driving cross-functional alignment). While domain expertise in financial services is advantageous, the role prioritizes technical adaptability, change leadership, and execution excellence.
The VP will lead cross-functional teams and engage senior stakeholders across functions and regions. The portfolio will span structural reform, location strategy, AI-enabled transformation, outsourcing and strategic vendor partnerships, with a focus on measurable outcomes and effective execution.
Responsibilities
Strategy, Business Cases and Workstream Definition
Translate strategic priorities into well-defined initiatives, problem statements, options and target outcomes.
Develop rigorous business cases, including baseline analysis, financial models, benefits, costs, dependencies, implementation options and delivery risks.
Scope workstreams, define deliverables and milestones, establish governance, and create practical mobilisation and execution plans.
Apply strong numerical judgement to challenge assumptions, test scenarios and support evidence-based investment decisions.
Transformation Delivery and Value Realisation
Own initiatives from definition through mobilisation and delivery, maintaining clear plans, decision points, dependencies, risks and outcomes.
Lead multidisciplinary project teams through influence, setting direction and holding contributors accountable without relying on formal line-management authority.
Create transparent reporting for senior governance forums and ensure agreed benefits are measurable, tracked and realised.
Balance strategic ambition, execution feasibility, control requirements and sustainable organisational capability.
Strong AI-Adoption into the role
Identify, articulate and prioritise practical AI prompts and use cases that improve productivity, decision-making and business outcomes within the role.
Use Microsoft Copilot effectively for administration, analysis, document production and presentations; bring familiarity with the broader enterprise AI landscape.
Senior Stakeholder Engagement and Project Leadership
Build trusted relationships with Business Managers and senior stakeholders across functions and regions, including at VP, Executive Director and Managing Director level.
Structure complex issues into concise, decision-ready materials and communicate recommendations with clarity and credibility.
Facilitate workshops, challenge constructively, resolve ambiguity and build alignment across stakeholders with differing priorities.
Coordinate global project teams across Asia, the UK and the US, ensuring clear ownership, timely decisions and consistent execution.
What Success Looks Like
Strategic priorities are converted quickly into credible, decision-ready business cases and clearly scoped workstreams.
Financial and operational assumptions are transparent, evidence-based and sufficiently robust to support senior investment decisions.
Projects mobilise effectively, maintain senior stakeholder alignment and deliver agreed milestones, benefits and control outcomes.
AI use cases and prompts move beyond ideas into practical adoption, with measurable productivity or business value.
Project and business solution recommendations balance value, capability, resilience, governance and regulatory requirements.
The VP is recognized as a trusted, self-directed transformation partner who can lead project teams and influence effectively across functions, cultures and time zones.

Minimum 10 years’ experience in business transformation function with a focus on strategy, change delivery, and business analysis within investment banking or the wider financial services sector.

Experience in defining strategic initiatives, preparing compelling business cases with financials and converting ambiguous objectives into structured, executable workstreams.
Advanced Microsoft 365 user skills, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, with practical experience using Microsoft Copilot for administration, analysis, document creation and presentations.
Demonstrated experience writing and progressing AI prompts and/or use cases that improve productivity or deliver measurable outcomes; knowledge of Anthropic or similar AI models would be advantageous.
Track record of successful end-to-end project delivery, including planning, governance, risk and dependency management, senior reporting and benefits realisation.

Ability to lead cross-functional project teams through influence and accountability in an individual-contributor role.

Title: Vice President Global Marketing
Description:
Global VP Marketing
Our client is a fast-growing technology business with an established presence across multiple international markets. As the company enters its next phase of growth, they are looking for a Global VP Marketing to build and lead the marketing function.
This is a genuine build-and-scale mandate. You'll define the global marketing strategy, build the team, establish the right systems and processes, and create a measurable marketing engine that directly contributes to commercial growth.
What you'll own:
- Develop and execute the global marketing strategy across brand, growth, demand generation and customer acquisition
- Build a measurable marketing funnel from initial engagement through to conversion and revenue
- Identify and develop new channels, markets and growth opportunities
- Lead a multidisciplinary marketing team spanning acquisition, demand generation, content, brand, digital and events
- Establish robust marketing operations, CRM, automation, attribution and reporting
- Own marketing performance metrics, budgets and commercial KPIs
- Strengthen the company's international brand presence through content, thought leadership, partnerships and events
- Build and develop a high-performing marketing organisation, establishing clear ownership, accountability and ways of working
- Work closely with commercial and executive leadership to align marketing activity with broader company objectives
What you'll bring
- 7+ years' experience in marketing, with strong depth across growth, demand generation, brand, digital or integrated marketing
- Proven experience leading marketing teams or a significant marketing function
- A strong commercial track record, with the ability to demonstrate marketing's impact on leads, pipeline and revenue
- Experience within a high-growth technology or scaling business
- Exposure to both B2B and B2C environments would be highly advantageous
- Strong understanding of digital acquisition, content, social, paid media, events and lifecycle marketing
- Experience with CRM, marketing automation and modern martech platforms
- A data-driven approach, with strong analytical and commercial judgement
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
- Comfortable operating at both strategic and executional levels
- Entrepreneurial mindset with the energy and resilience required to build something from the ground up
Why this role?
This is an opportunity to join a high-growth technology business at an important stage of its evolution and build the global marketing function from the ground up.
You'll have significant ownership over strategy, team, budget, systems and execution, with the opportunity to shape how marketing contributes to the company's next phase of growth.
Why consider this: Marketing aligns with the MSc and BBA in Marketing and current Marketing and PR Specialist role.

Title: Vice President, ASEAN FX Strategist (Job ID:10079919)
Description:
An exceptional opportunity has arisen for an experienced Vice President Senior Currency Analyst to join a highly respected global financial institution in Singapore. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on producing insightful research reports focused on ASEAN economies and foreign exchange rates, particularly with expertise in INR, VND, and PHP. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the organisation’s visibility across international markets by conducting independent research and contributing to team’s regular publications that provide actionable insights to both internal stakeholders and a diverse global client base. The position offers a unique blend of analytical rigour, stakeholder engagement, and the chance to work closely with colleagues across Tokyo, London, New York, and Asia. With a supportive team environment, this is your chance to make a significant impact while developing your career within a collaborative and inclusive culture.
Deliver high-impact research on ASEAN economies and FX rates, enhancing the organisation’s reputation across global markets through regular publications and thematic studies.
Engage directly with clients and internal teams via seminars, webinars, conference calls, and company visits to share insights and foster strong professional relationships.
Benefit from flexible working opportunities within a knowledgeable team that values collaboration, ongoing learning, and personal growth.
What you'll do:
As a Vice President Senior Currency Analyst based in Singapore, you will be at the forefront of delivering high-quality economic research that shapes strategic decisions for both internal stakeholders and external clients worldwide. Your day-to-day responsibilities will involve producing detailed analyses of ASEAN economies—especially focusing on India (INR), Vietnam (VND), and the Philippines (PHP)—and generating regular publications that keep clients informed about market developments. You will collaborate closely with colleagues across multiple regions to contribute to global research pipelines while also engaging directly with customers through various channels such as seminars or webinars. Success in this role requires not only technical expertise but also excellent communication skills for presenting complex information clearly. Your ability to build strong relationships internally and externally will be crucial as you help drive customer satisfaction through insightful analysis.
Produce comprehensive research reports on ASEAN economic trends and foreign exchange rates with a particular focus on INR, VND, and PHP currencies.
Contribute regularly to daily FX updates, weekly market reviews, and quarterly outlooks as part of the Asia Global Market Research team.
Develop in-depth thematic studies and ad-hoc commentary on economic data releases, policy changes, market events, and currency movements relevant to Southeast Asia.
Create and maintain robust quantitative models for economic indicators and foreign exchange forecasting to support research outputs.
Participate actively in regional and global research initiatives by collaborating with colleagues in Tokyo, London, New York, and other key locations.
Engage with clients through conference calls, seminars, webinars, company visits, and business trips to present research findings and address queries.
Build effective partnerships with sales teams, traders, relationship managers, and other stakeholders to ensure timely responses to market-related questions.
Support junior team members by providing coaching, guidance, and sharing best practices within the Asia GMR team.
Ensure all activities comply with relevant regulations, internal policies, risk controls, and dual-entity guidelines as required by the functional arrangement.
Assist in managing the department’s risk profile by adhering strictly to compliance standards and supporting operational excellence.
What you bring:
To excel as a Vice President Senior Currency Analyst in Singapore you will bring substantial experience from previous roles where you have delivered high-quality economic or FX research within major financial institutions or consultancies. Your background should include advanced academic training—ideally at postgraduate level—in economics or finance coupled with hands-on expertise in both qualitative assessment techniques (such as policy analysis) and quantitative methods (including econometric modelling). You are adept at distilling complex macroeconomic trends into actionable insights for diverse audiences ranging from senior executives to institutional investors. Strong interpersonal skills; you thrive when collaborating across functions or mentoring less experienced colleagues. A deep understanding of compliance requirements—particularly those associated with multi-entity operations—is essential given the dual-hat nature of this role. Above all else your commitment to accuracy integrity teamwork continuous learning sets you apart as an invaluable member of any high-performing research function.
Minimum 10 years of experience in Global markets working in Singapore or any other regional market.
Demonstrated experience of at least eight years in economic or foreign exchange research within financial services or related sectors is essential for this position.
Proven experience building robust models for economic indicators or FX forecasting supports data-driven decision-making within the team
A bachelor’s degree or higher qualification in economics, finance or another relevant discipline provides the necessary academic foundation for success.
Proven ability to conduct both qualitative assessments and quantitative analyses when tackling complex economic issues is vital for producing impactful research outputs.
Strong presentation abilities enable you to communicate findings effectively during seminars, webinars or client meetings across different regions.
A collaborative approach is important as you will work closely with colleagues from various departments such as sales or trading as well as mentor junior staff members.
Familiarity with regulatory frameworks governing financial institutions ensures compliance with all relevant laws including those specific to dual-entity arrangements.
Excellent stakeholder management skills allow you to develop productive relationships both internally within the organisation and externally with global corporate clients.
What sets this company apart:
This organisation stands out as one of the world’s most established financial institutions renowned for its commitment to excellence integrity innovation within global markets. Employees benefit from being part of an inclusive workplace culture that prioritises knowledge-sharing professional development mutual respect among colleagues at every level. The company offers flexible working opportunities designed to support work-life balance alongside access to extensive training resources that empower individuals at all stages of their careers. Collaboration is deeply embedded in everyday practice ensuring everyone feels valued supported able contribute meaningfully towards shared goals whether working locally in Singapore or connecting virtually with peers around the globe. By joining this team you become part of a network dedicated not only delivering outstanding results but also nurturing talent fostering long-term growth leadership within financial services sector.
What's next:
If you are ready to take your career in economic research to new heights we encourage you to explore this exciting opportunity further!
