Title: Vice President, Business Development
Description:
Saviynt's AI-powered identity platform manages and governs human and non-human access to all of an organization's applications, data, and business processes. Customers trust Saviynt to safeguard their digital assets, drive operational efficiency, and reduce compliance costs. Built for the AI age, Saviynt is today helping organizations safely accelerate their deployment and usage of AI. Saviynt is recognized as the leader in identity security, with solutions that protect and empower the world’s leading brands, Fortune 500 companies and government institutions. For more information, please visit www.saviynt.com.
Reporting to the SVP Global Partners & Channel Chief, the VP of APJ Partnerships and Channels will serve as the leader for the APJ Partner organization and represent Saviynt with key partner/alliance relationships across APJ. This role will be responsible for driving the strategy and execution of the APJ partner business and initiatives and will ensure short and long-term expansion, including setting the strategic direction to meet revenue goals, while identifying and pursuing new partner streams and routes to market in conjunction with the APJ Sales Leadership Team. Saviynt has a partner-first culture and views our partner community as an extension of the company. The growth and advancement of our partner organization is a key driver to the success of the company. This role needs a strong, experienced leader that will take our APJ partner organization to the next level.
The next generation of Identity Security requires partners that can deliver on the transformation necessary to improve a customers Identity security posture across many different identity types and integrations. Driving Saviynt’s growth strategy through these partners is a critical element of this role.
WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING
-
- Lead the APJ Partner organization to drive growth with identified top-tier partner alliances. This will include the nurturing and development of new alliance partners into the core network
- Lead by the numbers in a purposeful way. Assess and improve upon current engagement processes, methodologies, structure, and associated discipline
- Create and execute short- and long-term partner plans, including strategies, programs, goals, quotas, tracking mechanisms, and analytics. The ultimate goal is to build a highly metric-driven and predictable team
- Propose & implement necessary adjustments to optimize performance and build/refine the infrastructure to facilitate ambitious & exciting growth
- Manage a team across multiple geographies including team structure, hiring, performance assessment, coaching and feedback, team succession planning, and training
- Work closely with Executive Leaders, Sales, Marketing, Enablement and the Product Organizations to create a strong and collaborative partnership that will ensure success in competitive positioning, market awareness, and execution
- Assess and improve upon current engagement processes, methodologies, structure, and associated discipline. Create and execute short and long-term partner plans, including strategies, programs, goals, quotas, tracking mechanisms, and analytics
- Drive partner director alignment in the regional APJ sales teams. Participate in the sales opportunity reviews and reach out and collaborate with the Partner Directors, Regional Sales VPs and Account Executives
- Use experience and creativity to create, analyze and execute lead-generation programs across all partner types
WHAT YOU BRING
-
- Minimum 15 years of Enterprise Sales experience with a compelling and verifiable track record of success managing and building/scaling a critical partner organization. Previous experience as SVP, GM, or VP for a high-growth enterprise SaaS software company
- Highly instrumented and analytic executive for the enterprise in multiple verticals
- Process-driven with the ability to use a quantitative approach to apply business insights to partner sales
- A dynamic executive with the ability to strategically build innovative models combined with the tactical ability to execute. Has seen a growth journey but has the ability to scale down. A strong leader & motivator with proven success in building a world-class sales team with proven, repeatable methodologies
- Ability to lead and serve in a hands-on capacity on projects as well as serve as the connective tissue between Revenue Org, marketing, and customer success
- Strong knowledge of the partner landscape by region/country with special emphasis on Japan, ASEAN, and India
- Exceptional interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills
- Willingness and ability to travel, both domestically and internationally
- Inspirational leadership, strong executive presence. Successful leadership track record in overachieving business goals and quota attainment success
- Ability to envision, develop, document and execute partner plans through a geographically dispersed partner and sales team. Demonstrated ability to build, lead and coach an APJ partner sales team
- Experience negotiating complex commercial deals, including services, reseller, and co-sell agreements
- The ability to collect information and identify fundamental patterns/trends in data. This includes the ability to gather, integrate, and interpret information from several sources
- The ability to build trusting, collaborative relationships and rapport with different types of people and businesses. This includes delivering on commitments and maintaining confidential information, as well as being approachable, showing interest in the other person, and relating well to people regardless of personality or background
- Ability to assess the current network of Partners and evaluate net-new relationships, make recommendations and execute against those recommendations

Description:
Some careers have more impact than others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
In International Wealth and Premier Banking, we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking, Insurance, and Chief Operating Office.
We are currently seeking a high calibre professional to join our team as a Vice President, Marketing, South Asia, HSBC Private Bank.
In this role you will need:
Lead the development and delivery of Private Bank marketing activity across South Asia, with a strong focus on premium client events and experiences that differentiate by segment.
Own the strategy and annual event calendar across South Asia, including regular travel to markets to plan and deliver on-the-ground execution.
Manage end-to-end event delivery: concept development, programme/content design, stakeholder alignment, vendor sourcing, production, run-of-show, guest management and post-event follow-up.
Embed strong tracking discipline for every event: define objectives and KPIs upfront, manage registration/attendance/engagement tracking, capture client feedback, and deliver timely post-event reporting with ROI/impact analysis.
Develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns across offline and digital channels to drive awareness, engagement and client activity.
Drive martech-enabled campaign execution (audiences/targeting, journeys, workflows and channel deployment) to improve relevance, speed-to-market and measurement.
Manage performance across owned and paid channels, including social and paid media, with clear KPI tracking, optimisation and reporting.
Provide budget ownership and marketing governance oversight, ensuring compliant approvals, audit-ready documentation, brand stewardship, and effective agency/supplier management.
To be successful you will need:
Degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration or a related field (or equivalent experience).
10+ years’ progressive marketing experience, including end-to-end events/experiential management; ideally within private banking/wealth management, financial services, or premium/luxury sectors.
Demonstrated track record delivering multi-market/regional programmes and succeeding in complex, matrix organisations.
Strategic and strong execution capability across concepting, budgeting, delivery and post-activity ROI/performance analysis for events, sponsorships and thought-leadership forums.
Knowledge of marketing governance in regulated environments, including conduct considerations, data privacy and regional guidelines for client communications and digital advertising.
Excellent stakeholder engagement and executive presence; fluent English required, Mandarin preferred; willingness to travel regularly across South Asia.
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Description:
Job Title
VP, Pricing, Protection, India (24 months contract in Singapore)
Job Description
The Role
The VP, Pricing, Protection, India is one of the leaders of Pacific Life Re’s India Protection business and a member of the India Protection Market Leadership Committee (PMLC) that sets our strategic and tactical objectives and plays a key role in the overall success of the India business, including how we can leverage our core capabilities to shape and achieve our market strategy and delivering an aligned functional strategy.
Specific local pricing responsibilities are for the performance of the India pricing function, incorporating all aspects of the pricing process including setting of bases, development of pricing terms and management of the pricing pipeline.
The role is a core member of the global Protection Pricing Functional Leadership Team (FLT), with shared accountability for executing global pricing strategy, shaping functional priorities, and driving consistent execution and capability uplift across regions. The incumbent is expected to operate as a peer leader within the global Pricing FLT, constructively challenging ideas, influencing outcomes beyond their home market, and representing regional perspectives while acting in the best interests of the global Protection Pricing function.
The incumbent will have a deep understanding of client requirements and play a key role in developing solutions that appropriately balance the needs of Pacific Life Re and the client. The incumbent will also support the AVP, Client Solutions, Protection, India in building and maintaining relationships with clients and partners in India.
The individual will lead the India Pricing team and work closely with other functions including Client Solutions, R&D, Underwriting & Claims Solutions and Services, and Corporate Actuarial areas.
The incumbent will be responsible for overseeing risk management processes, ensuring that all quotes comply with Pricing standards and that appropriate processes and documentation standards are in place.
In addition, they will also be expected to collaborate with the Divisional Pricing team (supported by the Global Pricing team) which is responsible for the oversight and support of pricing across Pacific Life Re. This will include collaboration in areas such as prioritisation and co-ordination of global projects (e.g. actuarial model changes), co-ordination of information for quotes needing to be approved within Pacific Life and development of various aspects of the underlying bases such as non-decrement terms of trade.
Finally, the incumbent will be a part of the broader Pacific Life Re Leadership Team.

*SE Active* is the exclusive partner for *Technogym* in Singapore & Malaysia, managing everything from equipment sales to after-sales services and warranty protection. SE Active aims to be the market leader in offering total wellness solutions in both countries, with a customer-first approach to meet fitness and wellness needs. The company's focus is on growing the brand's presence and anchoring market dominance while providing the Technogym experience by embodying its core values.
*About Technogym*
For more than 40 years, we at *Technogym* have been helping people live healthier and happier lives. If 50 million people in the world train on our equipment every day, it’s not just a matter of chance. We are the global experts of wellness, be it for fitness, health, or sports. Reaching over 100 countries in the world, Technogym has brought wellness through movement to thousands of locations around the world. Technogym produces top-notch fitness equipment found in luxury property gyms and has been the Official Supplier of the Olympic Games for ten consecutive editions, from Sydney 2000 to Milano Cortina 2026, supporting Olympic athletes in their quest for excellence.
*Job Overview:*
As an Education & Customer Success Specialist, you will play a key role in elevating Technogym’s brand experience through impactful education, customer engagement, training excellence, and relationship management. You will work closely with internal teams, partners, trainers, and customers to drive product adoption, customer satisfaction, and long-term engagement with Technogym’s wellness ecosystem.
This role combines elements of wellness education, customer success, account support, coaching, community engagement, and event coordination. You will empower internal teams, B2B partners, and end consumers with in-depth product knowledge and training support, while also building strong customer relationships and a network of certified personal trainers and wellness advocates.
You will serve as a key point of contact in ensuring customers receive a seamless experience throughout their journey — from onboarding and training to ongoing engagement and retention. Through proactive support, product education, and community activation initiatives, you will help customers maximize the value of Technogym solutions while strengthening brand loyalty and advocacy.
The ideal candidate is passionate about fitness, wellness, and customer experience, with strong communication and interpersonal skills. You are a confident trainer and relationship builder who thrives in dynamic environments, enjoys engaging with diverse audiences, and is committed to delivering exceptional education and customer experiences across markets.
*Responsibilities:*
*1. Internal Product Education & Sales Enablement*
* Lead ongoing product education and training initiatives for the sales team throughout the year.
* Ensure all sales team members complete Technogym’s product storytelling assessments and maintain a minimum performance score across all products.
* Identify underperforming team members and conduct targeted coaching and training sessions to strengthen product knowledge and storytelling capabilities.
* Maintain a minimum personal product knowledge rating, as assessed by the Regional Education & Training Manager, to qualify for delivering storytelling assessments.
* Develop and update training materials, user guides, and educational resources to support internal product learning and customer engagement.
*2. Customer Onboarding, Training & Success Management*
* Support the onboarding of new customers by guiding them through product setup, training, and adoption to ensure a smooth customer experience.
* Conduct quarterly product refresher trainings and ongoing educational sessions for key account clients in collaboration with their internal training managers.
* Coordinate and deliver on-site product training during new equipment installations, ensuring all facility staff receive relevant training materials via the Technogym Trainer Portal.
* Facilitate post-delivery product education sessions for home customers. Where required, coordinate with certified freelance personal trainers from the Technogym training network to deliver training sessions.
* Create and implement customer success plans that outline customer goals, milestones, adoption strategies, and engagement initiatives.
* Educate customers on product features, capabilities, and best practices to maximize product utilization and long-term value.
*3. Customer Relationship Management & Retention*
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers to understand their operational needs, business goals, and challenges.
* Proactively engage customers through various communication channels to monitor satisfaction, gather feedback, and support ongoing success.
* Monitor customer usage and adoption trends to identify at-risk accounts and implement retention strategies.
* Support account management activities, including license renewals to drive customer retention and long-term account success.
* Address customer concerns, issues, and escalations promptly while coordinating with internal stakeholders to ensure effective resolution.
* Identify and develop customer advocates for testimonials, referrals, case studies, and community engagement opportunities.
*4. Trainer Network Development*
* Expand and manage the Technogym-certified personal trainer network through onboarding, certification, and ongoing engagement initiatives.
* Ensure certified trainers remain up to date with the latest Technogym products, training methodologies, and wellness solutions.
* Maintain the quality and consistency of training standards through regular assessments, refresher programs, and recertification initiatives.
*5. Community Engagement & Wellness Events*
* Collaborate with frontline managers and the marketing team to identify and engage relevant fitness and wellness communities.
* Establish partnerships with coaches, medical professionals, wellness experts, influencers, and other industry stakeholders to support wellness initiatives and community outreach.
* Plan and execute community-focused events, workshops, clinics, and wellness activations with clearly defined KPIs to measure engagement and impact.
* Represent Technogym as a wellness and product ambassador during events, training sessions, and customer engagements.
*6. Reporting, Analytics & Continuous Improvement*
* Track and report key performance indicators (KPIs) related to customer satisfaction, training effectiveness, customer retention, engagement, and revenue growth.
* Collect and analyze customer feedback to identify trends, areas for improvement, and opportunities to enhance the customer experience.
* Work closely with sales, marketing, after-sales, and regional teams to ensure a seamless and consistent customer journey.
* Stay updated on industry trends, customer success best practices, and Technogym product developments to continuously improve training delivery and customer engagement strategies.
*Requirements:*
* *Bachelor’s degree* in Sports Science, Exercise Physiology, or a related field.
* *5–7 years of experience *in fitness education, personal training, customer success, business development, consultancy, or a similar client-facing role.
* *Strong presentation and training delivery skills* — able to engage, educate, and inspire diverse audiences including sales teams, fitness professionals, and customers.
* Proven experience in *conducting workshops, seminars, or product training sessions* in a professional setting.
* Ability to *build rapport and credibility* quickly with internal stakeholders (e.g., sales team) and external clients.
* *Confident and polished communicator* with excellent interpersonal skills and professional presence.
* Comfortable working *independently and cross-functionally*, with strong organizational and time management skills.
* Tech-savvy with the ability to *navigate digital platforms* for training, communication, and certification delivery.
* Passionate about *fitness, wellness, and the Technogym philosophy* of lifestyle transformation through movement.
* Certification as a *personal trainer or fitness instructor* (e.g., ACE, NASM, NSCA) is a strong advantage.
* Prior experience in a *premium brand environment* or wellness tech company is a plus.
* Proven ability in *customer success*, account management, consultancy, business development, or pre-sales support roles preferred.
* Strong *customer-centric mindset* with a focus on onboarding, engagement, retention, and long-term relationship building preferred.

What we are attempting is hard and means we need great people working together to build great technology.

We have raised more than £500m in funding and our investors include Molten Ventures, Eurazeo, Intesa Sanpaolo, Temasek, Nyca Partners, JPMorgan Chase Strategic Investments, Standard Chartered Ventures, and more.

We're regularly cited as having a fantastic workplace culture and have been recognised by Sifted magazine as having one of the highest Glassdoor ratings for a UK fintech company and the industry's most generous employee share package. Named one of the world's most innovative fintechs by Global Finance Magazine, we were also recognised by the Financial Times as one of Europe's fastest-growing companies for two consecutive years—and a UK Best Employer for 2026.
The Client Success Director (CSD) is accountable for ensuring Clients successfully adopt and scale our platform to achieve their contracted outcomes. The primary measure of success for this role is enabling clients to reach their contracted volume of live accounts within agreed milestone dates and budget, while maintaining high client satisfaction and long-term commercial value.
This is a senior, client-facing role requiring deep experience in core banking transformation programmes, strong commercial acumen, and the ability to orchestrate delivery, support, and sales teams across complex, multi-year engagements.
Duties
Client Outcomes & Delivery
- Own the end-to-end client success plan from sales support, to implementation through to scale and steady state.
- Ensure clients achieve their contracted account volumes within agreed milestones, timelines, and budgets.
- Act as the primary point of accountability for delivery outcomes across implementation, upgrades, and ongoing services within the scope of the MSA.
- Proactively identify risks to delivery, adoption, or timelines and drive mitigation plans across internal and client teams.
- Monitor and analyse client product usage, forecasting key account metrics.
Client Engagement & Governance
- Following the Vault Delivery Framework, establish and run robust account governance, including steering committees, operational forums, and executive engagement.
- Own CSAT, including measurement, action planning, and continuous improvement.
- As part of the governance model and ensuring compliance with Thought Machine Support requirements, define the Target Operating Model for support as early on in the engagement as possible.
- As part of being accountable for the client success plan, lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), demonstrating progress against milestones, value delivered, and forward roadmap.
- Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders across business, technology, and operations.
- Ensure Client production readiness is complete and signed off by all stakeholders for all go live events including upgrades, particularly the issue of SPM’s (Service Procedure Manuals) and the acceptance into support by the Thought Machine Support organisation.
Support & Platform Stability
- Act as the escalation point for support issues, ensuring the support organisation resolves defects and incidents in a timely and transparent manner.
- Work with the assigned client support lead to track and communicate bug resolution, root cause analysis, and preventative actions to clients.
- Work with the assigned client support lead to ensure platform stability and service quality meet contractual and regulatory expectations.
Commercial & Financial Ownership
- Own the P&L for all paid services delivered to the client, ensuring services are delivered profitably or within the understood company investment envelope for a specified outcome to assure client success.
- Maintain overall services profitability for the client, balancing issue remediation and client satisfaction, delivery quality, cost control, and long-term account value.
- Oversee commercials related to professional services, managed services, upgrades, and Statements of Work (SOWs).
- Work closely with the CCO office and Finance to forecast revenue, margin, and delivery costs.
Growth & Sales Collaboration
- Partner with the Account Director who is accountable for growing the account and expanding white space.
- Support sales cycles by articulating and presenting the client journey — from onboarding to scale — tailoring the level of engagement to be as “hands-on” as the client desires depending on the nature of the engagement (client maturity, partner involvement etc.).
- Identify expansion opportunities across modules, services, upgrades, and additional volumes to get the client to the contracted volume on the platform.
- Contribute to renewals and contract extensions through demonstrated value and strong relationships.
Upgrades & Roadmap Management
- Oversee planning and execution of platform upgrades, ensuring minimal disruption and clear client communication.
- Being the voice of the client to ensure alignment of client roadmaps and their required regulatory change with product evolution.
- Ensure upgrades are delivered on time, within scope, and are commercially aligned.

Benefits

About the job
As a Generative AI (GenAI) Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Google Cloud, you will be an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier Artificial Intelligence (AI) products and production-grade reality within customers. You will function as an innovator-builder, moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions directly within the customer’s environment. You will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management challenges that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. You will serve dual purpose, providing white glove deployment of complex AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.
Responsibilities
Serve as a developer for complex AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, MCP servers) that drive measurable Return on Investment (ROI).
Architect and code the connective tissue between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including Application Programming Interface (APIs), legacy data silos, and security perimeters as part of an expert team.
Build high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet rigorous requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.
Identify repeatable field patterns and friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or formal product feature requests for engineering teams. Be able to co-build with customer engineering teams to instill Google-grade development best practices, ensuring long-term project success and high end-user adoption.
Translate technical concepts to non-technical executive and Thai-speaking audiences.

gTech Ads is responsible for all support and media and technical services for customers big and small across our entire Ad products stack. We help our customers get the most out of our Ad and Publisher products and guide them when they need help. We provide a range of services from enabling better self help and in-product support, to providing better support through interactions, setting up accounts and implementing ad campaigns, and providing media solutions for customers business and marketing needs and providing complex technical and measurement solutions along with consultative support for our large customers. These solutions range from bespoke and customized ones for our customers to scalable support for millions of customers worldwide. Based on the evolving needs of our ads customers, we partner with Sales, Product and Engineering teams within Google to develop better solutions, tools, and services to improve our products and enhance our client experience. As a cross-functional and global team, we ensure our customers get the best return on investment with Google and we remain a trusted partner.
As a Product Deployment Engineer, you will be a key advisor to Google’s customers and serve as the definitive regional service authority for a specific product area. You are the strategic bridge between “what a customer wants” and “what gTech Ads has to offer” within a specific product area, whether via the standing Menu of Service (MoS) or our gTech Ads engineering capabilities.
Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.

Title: Relationship Manager
Description:
About the Role:
Grade Level (for internal use):
12
The Role: Relationship Manager
Relationship Manager (RM) is a senior level position who leverages knowledge of the commodity markets and energy industry to grow our bank of business in the region. RM's role is to develop relationships with our strategic clients who are key industry influencers, big energy conglomerates, financial institutions, ministries, and government agencies think thanks, policy makers etc.
The RM will leverage his/her understanding of the Client’s core business spanning upstream, midstream and downstream to help later realize bottom line benefits from the use of S&P Global Energy’s (SPE) products.
A good understanding of the client workflows and trusted relationships in place, the RM will be the guardian of this relationship, orchestrating the deployment of corporate-wide resources (including internal personnel who have specialized skills sets) to provide value to these key accounts. RM is accountable for enhancing our net promoter score and for channelizing the voice of the customer internally.
work closely with individual account managers to not only retain the current bank but also develop whitespace opportunities. This opening is for a RM role in our Singapore office wherein the RM will be responsible for managing relationships with our strategic Thai customers in Thailand and Singapore. As it will involve working with multiple clients in the industry and with multiple account managers, the RM will work closely with the Senior Commercial Director of the Region to map out a growth strategy for the region that includes a SWOT analysis and acquiring new logo opportunities.
As the customer advocate, RM must also provide actionable customer feedback that will enhance SPE’s products and service to earn client trust and business.
Responsibilities:
Managing Key Account Relationship and Service Level Agreement (SLA)
Main point of contact/liaison - accountable for the experience the customer has with SPE,
Considers both the big picture as well as the day-to-day when managing the account,
Develops and builds meaningful and lasting relationships with key and influential contacts,
Effectively navigates around client organizations and leverages internal cross functional resources to create value,
Continuous investigative and collaborative contact with customers to gather strategic information about their business, understands their issues, uncovers unrecognized problems providing solutions to them,
As owner of the SLA, co-ordinates with all other functions and third parties to help ensure service levels and value add offerings are attained and customer needs are met,
Acts as a broker of capabilities or services for client, advocates internally and facilitates the involvement of various SPGE’s functions (sales, content, client services, products, commodity specialists and marketing) to achieve common goals for the client and for SPGE,
Understands the client usage of product/services and help define potential use cases or enhancements of new products to benefit client,
Monitors and reports on the health of SPGE’s relationship with the Client.
Lead Generation - Driving Increased Usage and Adoption of New Services
Plays an instrumental role in the sales cycle by researching customer business, identifying and qualifying leads, involving sales to negotiate and close opportunities,
Promote non-benchmark services and identifies new product development needs by working across functions within the customer organization to understand their needs,
Contribute relevant input to product launch, SPE's forums, conferences and marketing plans,
Seeks out cross and up selling opportunities
Drives interest in trials and demonstrations, participating in their presentation and drive customer buy in for product discussions or testing,
Responds to incremental sales and incoming orders, processed via the sales administrator
Retention
Close collaboration with the sales managers and internal stakeholders,
Prevents cancellations and mitigates risk by ensuring existing clients continue to derive value from SPE's services,
Devise value-add plan for clients with enterprise-wide licenses by working closely with the sales managers, client services, commodity specialists, marketing and content team to drive increased usage and broader adoption.
Reporting
Communicates potential client and/or market shifts, changes or reactions, as well as client needs back to appropriate levels,
Monitors and reports on use of SPGE's services and usage levels,
Contributes to account Plan and participates in plan implementation,
Works with RMs within the region to drive a uniform customer experience and across regional boundaries to ensure the customer account plan is developed and executed consistently and effectively,
Provides status risk and opportunity, competition know how and product development needs,
Updates salesforce,
Monthly activity reporting.
Requirements:
Degree with minimum 10 years of successful experience managing client relations within major or complex accounts, preferably in a trading, consulting, marketing and/or business development role,
Good understanding of SPGE's business and previous user of SPGE's services is a bonus,
Good understanding of S&P Global’s other businesses is a bonus
Excellent business communication and presentation (verbal/ written) skills in Thai and English,
Right to work in Thailand will be a plus
Can distill, summarize, interpret and communicate information to facilitate its usefulness
Proven leadership in managing multi-national global and/or strategic accounts, multi-cultural awareness and regional experience is preferred
Superior customer relationship management skills, proven ability to develop multiple level of relationships within an account of a strategic nature
Competency in creating and identifying needs using consultative sales techniques is a must
Very strong planning and organizational skills, able to prioritize
Competent with systems (Salesforce CRM, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
Frequent travelling required around the region at least once or twice a month

Title: Senior Solutions Architect
Description:
We are looking for passionate technologists to join our Pre-Sales organization to ensure that our growth is grounded and guided by strong technical alignment with our platform and the needs of our customers.
MongoDB Pre-Sales Solution Architects are responsible for guiding our customers and users to design and build reliable, scalable systems using our data platform. Our team is made up of seasoned technical sales professionals, software architects, entrepreneurs, and developers who take direct responsibility for customer success, including the design of their software, deployment, and operations. You'll work closely with our sales executives, helping customers solve business problems by leveraging our solutions, playing a key role in winning deals and driving the business forward. You'll be a trusted advisor to a wide range of users from startups to the world's largest enterprise IT organizations.
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Singapore for our hybrid working model with business fluency in English and Thai.
As an ideal candidate, you will have:
Ideally 8 - 11 years of related experience in a customer facing role, minimum 3 years of experience in pre-sales with enterprise software
Minimum of 3 years experience with modern scripting languages (e.g. Python, Node.js, SQL) and/or popular programming languages (e.g. C/C++, Java, C#) in a professional capacity
Experience designing with scalable and highly available distributed systems in the cloud and on-prem
Demonstrated ability to work with customers to review complex architecture of existing applications, providing guidance on how to improve by leveraging technology
Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical and business concepts in a clear and compelling manner to technology and business leadership
Ability to strategize with sales teams and provide recommendations on how to drive a multi-threaded account strategy, aligning other MongoDB and ecosystem resources to move towards a mutually beneficial account plan
The ability to communicate in Thai language, with business level proficiency
The ability to travel up to 50%
A Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience
You may also have:
Experience selling databases and/or deploying applications with any of the major cloud providers
Experience with database programming and data models
Experience in data engineering or AI/ML projects
Experience in transforming legacy systems and platforms into modern, scalable, and efficient technology stacks
Understanding of popular sales methodologies/ frameworks such as MEDDPICC/ Command of the Message
A MongoDB Certification
A Cloud Provider Certification
What you do at MongoDB:
In this role, you will work on complex opportunities where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of various factors. You will:
Design and Architect: Design scalable and performant applications, systems and infrastructure for large software projects leveraging MongoDB.
Customer Advising and Value Articulation: Guide customers on architecture patterns and optimisation strategies for MongoDB, while clearly communicating its business value to the relevant stakeholders.
Sales Partnership: Collaborate with the sales team to drive account success through account planning, opportunity prioritization/qualification and pipeline generation strategy, while taking ownership of the technical aspects (including but not limited to technical discovery, demos, proof of value, presentations, sizing and documentation)
Demand Generation: Proactively generate demand within the sales territory through self-driven technical initiatives, participation in events such as industry trade shows and account-based marketing events
Customer Success: Foster strong customer relationships, build champions and ensure customer success and satisfaction
Innovation and Improvement: Continuously seek opportunities to innovate and improve MongoDB solutions and processes (e.g. by relaying field feedback to the product team), as well as proactively mentor other Solutions Consulting team members
Personal Training and Development: Engage in ongoing training and professional development to stay abreast of MongoDB product suite as well as industry trends
What you will learn:
MongoDB Product Suite Mastery:
Core Database Server: Master the fundamentals and advanced features of MongoDB's core database
Atlas and Advanced Services: Gain expertise in Atlas (fully managed cloud database service), Atlas Stream Processing, Atlas Data Lake, Atlas Full-Text Search, Atlas Vector Search, and Charts
Relational Migrator: Learn to migrate from relational databases seamlessly
Market-Relevant Technologies:
Hyperscaler Ecosystem: Gain expertise in designing complex systems utilizing cloud services on hyperscaler platforms
Complementary Technologies: Enhance your skills with partner and complementary technologies such as Apache Kafka and Kubernetes
Modern Architecture Design:
Design Patterns and Methodologies: Embrace best practices in microservices, DevOps, cloud, and security.
Cutting Edge RAG and AI Architectures: Help customers on their generative AI journeys and working with industry leading partners in the space
Sales Techniques and Soft Skills:
Effective Communication: Master presentations, demonstrations, and whiteboarding
Client Interaction: Develop strategies for discovery and objection handling
Industry Insights:
Diverse Market Verticals: Gain exposure to a broad spectrum of interesting use cases across various industries

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

Title: Vice President, Thailand Wealth Business (Singapore-based)
Description:
Location: Singapore, Singapore Team: Sales & Relationship Mgmt Job Requisition #: R264183 Date posted: Oct. 06, 2026
Job description
About this role
Thailand represents a strategic growth market for wealth management, supported by increasing affluence, evolving investor sophistication, expanding private wealth pools, and growing adoption of diversified investment solutions. The Thailand Wealth team is responsible for understanding market dynamics and client needs across Thailand’s wealth landscape and translating these into commercial opportunities for the business. The team partners with private banks, consumer banks, securities firms, insurance companies, digital wealth platforms, and asset management partners to deliver the breadth of BlackRock’s investment capabilities across active, index, ETFs, and alternatives.
Working closely with clients, the team develops tailored investment solutions that address evolving investor objectives while leveraging BlackRock's global investment platform, portfolio construction expertise, and technology capabilities. The role also partners extensively with regional and global colleagues to bring the full breadth of BlackRock's platform and insights to Thailand's wealth investors.
Job Purpose / Background
BlackRock⁠’s Thailand Wealth business is seeking a Vice President to lead and deepen relationships with key wealth clients in Thailand. The primary responsibility is to drive commercial engagement with clients, contribute to local wealth distribution strategy, and deliver business growth through high-quality client coverage, strategic partnership development, and investment solution positioning.
The role requires close collaboration across regional and global teams including product specialists, portfolio management, marketing, and client business functions across APAC, EMEA, and the US to deliver the firm’s capabilities to Thai wealth investors. You will be responsible for managing and growing strategic client relationships across private banks, retail banks, securities firms, insurance channels, and wealth platforms in Thailand. The role also involves identifying market trends, client needs, and commercial opportunities to support product development initiatives and broader business priorities. Success in this role requires delivering BlackRock’s value proposition and investment capabilities effectively to clients, while helping partners achieve their business objectives and better outcomes for end-investors.
Reporting to the Head of Thailand Client Business (or SEA Wealth leadership), the successful candidate should possess strong knowledge of Thailand’s wealth landscape, including key distributors and evolving investor trends. A solid understanding of investment products across mutual funds, ETFs, alternatives, and portfolio solutions is important, while familiarity with sustainable investing and private markets would be advantageous. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong commercial acumen, relationship management skills, and the ability to operate effectively within a highly matrixed, global organization. Intellectual curiosity, a growth mindset, and the ability to influence stakeholders internally and externally are critical for success in this role.
Key Responsibilities
Partner with the Thailand Client Business and broader APAC Wealth team to develop and execute the Thailand sales and client engagement strategy, with a focus on growing adoption of BlackRock⁠ investment solutions across wealth distribution channels. Build and deepen strategic relationships with key clients including private banks, retail banks, securities firms, insurance partners, and wealth platforms in Thailand.
Position and differentiate BlackRock’s investment capabilities, thought leadership, and product offerings against competitors in the Thai wealth market.
Demonstrate strong knowledge across investment solutions including mutual funds, ETFs, model portfolios, alternatives, and portfolio construction frameworks, and communicate these effectively to clients and internal stakeholders.
Identify new business opportunities by understanding evolving client needs, market trends, and regulatory developments within Thailand’s wealth industry.
Drive commercial outcomes through proactive client coverage, strategic account planning, and effective pipeline management.
Maintain a high level of market awareness and engage clients on investment themes, macroeconomic developments, and portfolio positioning ideas.
Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders across investments, product, marketing, operations, and risk functions to deliver seamless client outcomes and strengthen client relationships.
Leverage the firm’s global platform and resources to broaden and deepen client engagement across priority accounts.
Maintain disciplined use of CRM systems and ensure timely documentation of client activities, opportunities, and engagement plans.
Ensure all client activities are conducted in compliance with applicable regulatory, legal, and internal risk management standards.
Support preparation of client presentations, business updates, strategic initiatives, and management reporting as required.
Experience / Qualifications
Minimum 6 years of experience in asset management, wealth management, private banking, or financial services, with a strong network across Thailand's wealth ecosystem.
Proven success in relationship management, business development, and driving investment solution adoption across wealth distribution channels.
Strong understanding of investment markets and products, including mutual funds, ETFs, discretionary solutions, and alternatives.
Commercially driven, with the ability to identify opportunities, generate market insights, and deliver client-focused solutions.
Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify complex investment concepts for diverse audiences.
Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with experience working across local, regional, and global teams.
Entrepreneurial, self-motivated, and results-oriented, with a commitment to delivering outstanding client outcomes.
Familiarity with Thailand's regulatory environment, fund industry, and distribution landscape preferred.
Fluency in Thai and English is required given the client-facing nature of the role and coverage of the Thailand market.
Bachelor's degree required; CFA and/or advanced degree preferred.
Our benefits
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
Our hybrid work model
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
Guidance on AI use for candidates
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance (opens in new window) on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
About BlackRock
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com (opens in new window). We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn (opens in new window), Instagram (opens in new window), YouTube (opens in new window), X (opens in new window), and TikTok (opens in new window).
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

Title: Group Procurement Director
Description:
Group Procurement Director
Oatside · Singapore (Group HQ) · Full-time
About Oatside
Oatside is Asia's #1 oat milk brand, headquartered in Singapore and sold across 19 markets. We own and operate our manufacturing in Chonburi, Thailand and in Indonesia, with further capacity expansion underway. We are a fast-scaling, founder-led business moving toward institutional-grade governance, and procurement is one of the biggest levers we have on margin, supply security and quality.
The role
The Group Procurement Director owns all third-party spend across the group — direct materials, packaging, indirect and capex — and leads our procurement teams in Indonesia and Thailand from Singapore. You will take a centre-led procurement model that has been designed and make it real: consistent category strategies, one supplier base managed to group standards, hard savings that show up in the P&L, and supply continuity for a business that cannot afford a line to stop.
This is a hands-on leadership role. You will personally lead the largest categories and the most important supplier relationships while building the capability of the local teams.
Reports to: CEO
Direct reports: Country procurement leads procurement teams across Indonesia and Thailand covering all direct and indirect spends and procurement operations.
Location: Singapore, with regular travel to Thailand and Indonesia (~30–40%)
What you'll do
Strategy and governance
Own the group procurement strategy, operating model and annual plan; run the centre-led model with clear splits between group categories and local buying.
Own the spend taxonomy, procurement policy, delegation of authority and sourcing governance — fit for a company preparing for public-market scrutiny.
Report procurement performance (savings, cost avoidance, supplier OTIF, quality, working capital) to the leadership team monthly.
Category and supplier management

Title: Partner Sales Manager Singapore (South East Asia)
Description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.
We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.
To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.
Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.
If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.
The Partner Sales Manager | South East Asia (SEA) works with our Braze Go-To-Market (GTM) team, Delivery and Tech partners to drive mutually beneficial commercial outcomes for all parties. They build and maintain strong relationships with our Tech Alloy Partner Leads and their GTM teams to foster a thriving Partner Community. Braze teams benefit from pipe generation, deal support and retention. Partners benefit from new opportunities and deal support. Customers and Prospects benefit from the delivery of best-in-class composable solutions.WHAT YOU'LL DO
- Work closely with our GTM teams across SEA - Account Executives (AE), Account Managers (AM) and Business Development Representatives (BDRs) to uncover opportunities for partner engagement, drive pipeline growth, and accelerate deal closures.
- Work with our Customer teams - AM and Customer Success Managers (CSM) - to identify opportunities for partners to help drive utilization, growth and reduce churn risk on existing Braze customers. Connecting partners to ensure our customers are fully leveraging Braze and our composable solution
- Develop mutually agreed-upon, win-win Joint Business Plans (JBPs) with partners, outlining shared objectives, success measures, stakeholders, methods, and review cadences.
- Incorporate Growth Plans, Partner Marketing, Awareness & Enablement, Partner-Led Opportunities (PLO) and Customer Success objectives into JBPs where relevant.
- Work closely with marketing to develop an annual Partner Marketing Calendar - and engage partners to participate and sponsor Braze-owned events, Braze x Partner specific events, Industry events and sponsor Partner events.
- Travel frequently to build in-person relationships and a presence in your allocated markets across SEA.
- Develop and implement a Strategic Partner plan for all of your Countries for each Half.
- Possess a strong understanding of team territory, including existing customers, Target A & B accounts, and overlapping tech/services integrations via Crossbeam.
- Serves as a trusted advisor to their Sales Director on the Braze ecosystem within their territory.
- Coach AEs on Partner Engagement Best Practices, including where partners are incumbent in their prospects and which partners to engage for co-seller and co-delivery.
- Effectively engage senior stakeholders within our partner ecosystem, aligning with their priorities and the value partnering with Braze offers.
- Identify gaps and opportunities within our Partner Ecosystem to continue to grow and build our Partner Network
- Build strong, trusted relationships with our Partner Leads and contacts.
- Run account mapping, enablement and QBR sessions to understand where we have overlap with both Technology and Agency PartnersWHO YOU ARE
- You are passionate about Customer Engagement and want to work with the leading technology in this space.
- You have deep experience and a point of view to engage senior stakeholders across various organisations about martech architecture, solutions and the benefits of a composable approach.
- You love working with people and genuinely believe in the power of genuine relationships built on trust and mutually beneficial outcomes.
- You enjoy traveling and are willing to spend a significant amount of time on the ground in your allocated markets
- You are a self-starter driven by success and make the most of every minute.
- You are highly organised and manage your time effectively.
- You can influence and ensure our GTM teams are staying on top of their accounts and following up.
- You have strong relationship-building skills and can bring an existing network within the space
- You have 5 or more years of experience working for a technology vendor in either a partner, vendor, agency or customer role
- Bonus points for professional fluency in Cantonese or Thai, which will help you build strong relationships with our clients in Hong Kong and Thailand.
WHAT WE OFFER
Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.
From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:
- Competitive compensation that may include equity
- Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans
- Flexible paid time off
- Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
- Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave
- Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend
- A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
- Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching
- Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze
- Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®
ABOUT BRAZE
Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.
The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025.
Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore.
The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.

Title: Senior Channel Sales Manager
Description:
Channel Sales Lead (ROA)
About Us:
At Sitecore, our mission is to simplify how brands reach, engage, and serve people by delivering intelligent, personalised digital experiences that connect the world. We empower the world’s most iconic brands to build lifelong relationships with their customers—seamlessly, smartly, and at scale.
As the leading provider of agentic digital experience software, Sitecore brings together content, commerce, and data into one composable platform that enables brands to deliver millions of meaningful, adaptive experiences every day. Trusted by global leaders such as American Express, Porsche, Starbucks, and L’Oréal, Sitecore helps brands transform engagement through experiences that are not only personalised but predictive and dynamic.
Our foundation is our people—a diverse, passionate, and collaborative global team spanning over 25 countries. We believe that every experience matters, and that belief starts with how we work together. Our values guide how we lead, innovate, and connect. They are the behaviours that bring our mission and vision to life, every day, in every interaction.
As we continue to evolve, we are actively cultivating AI skills across our teams to unlock new levels of creativity, efficiency, and insight. From engineering to customer experience, AI capabilities are becoming integral to how we design, build, and deliver the next generation of digital experiences.
Learn more at Sitecore.com.
About the role:
We are looking for a Channel Sales Lead to drive revenue growth through Sitecore’s reseller ecosystem across Rest of Asia (ROA), with a primary focus on Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Hong Kong and Korea.
This role is responsible for building, enabling, and scaling high-performing reseller relationships, driving pipeline generation, and ensuring successful execution of joint go-to-market initiatives. The ideal candidate combines strong channel sales execution with a solid understanding of SaaS enterprise software and, ideally, Digital Experience (DXP) solutions.
This is a hands-on role that sits at the intersection of partner management, deal execution, and regional market development. This role requires 25–50% travel across ROA and works closely with Direct Sales, SDRs, and Partner Business Managers, reporting into Global VP, Growth Markets in Dubai.
What You will do:
Channel & Reseller Management
Own and grow revenue through assigned Sitecore resellers across ROA
Manage a mix of top‑tier (Premium & Elite) and broader reseller tiers, including mid‑tier and long‑tail resellers, depending on market needs.
Act as the primary point of contact for reseller sales leadership and key stakeholders
Drive reseller alignment with Sitecore’s go-to-market strategy, portfolio, and commercial models
Support onboarding, enablement, and ongoing reseller performance management
Pipeline & Revenue Growth
Build, manage, and forecast reseller-sourced pipeline
Support resellers through the full sales lifecycle: opportunity qualification, deal structuring, pricing, and close
Ensure accurate forecasting and reporting in collaboration with internal sales leadership
Drive focus on net-new customer acquisition and expansion within existing accounts
Go-To-Market & Enablement
Develop and execute joint business plans with key resellers
Support reseller-led marketing activities, campaigns, and events
Enable resellers on Sitecore’s SaaS, AI, and Digital Experience offerings
Act as a bridge between resellers and internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Solution Consulting, Customer Success)
Market & Ecosystem Development
Develop strong understanding of local market dynamics, competitors, and customer needs
Identify opportunities to expand Sitecore’s footprint through new or deeper reseller engagements
Provide feedback into regional and global channel strategy based on market insights
What You Need to Succeed:
Core Requirements
Experience in SaaS software sales, channel sales, or reseller-led sales models
Proven ability to work with resellers, distributors, or system integrators
Experience managing pipeline, forecasting, and closing enterprise or mid-market deals
Strong commercial acumen and deal execution skills
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities
Additional Skills That Could Set You Apart (Highly Desirable):
Experience with Digital Experience Platforms (DXP), CMS, MarTech, or enterprise software ecosystems
Familiarity with enterprise buying cycles and multi-stakeholder sales processes
Experience working with Microsoft-centric ecosystems (Azure, enterprise SaaS environments) is a plus
Language Requirements
Fluent English (required)
Proficiency in Thai, Vietnamese, or Korean is a strong advantage
Personal Attributes
Self-starter with a high degree of ownership and accountability
Comfortable operating across cultures and geographies
Structured, data-driven, and outcome-oriented
Able to balance strategic reseller development with hands-on deal execution
Why This Role
Opportunity to play a key role in scaling Sitecore’s presence across high-growth Asian markets
High visibility role working closely with regional and global leadership
Exposure to Sitecore’s AI-first, SaaS-driven Digital Experience platform strategy
Ability to shape and influence how Sitecore grows through resellers in ROA

Title: Business Analyst
Description:
SimplifyNext is a Singapore-headquartered digital engineering firm, with offices in Thailand and Malaysia, working across three converged areas: agentic AI, AI-enabled application modernisation, and intelligent automation.
We bring strong business process consulting together with deep technology skills and modern delivery practices – product-centric, agile and AI-assisted. We build bespoke applications and AI systems, and we go deep on the platforms our clients run on, including Microsoft, AWS, ServiceNow, Databricks and UiPath. That combination of engineering depth and platform depth is what our clients come to us for.
We build and modernise the systems people depend on daily. Our 300+ practitioners are multi-disciplinary by design – business consultants, software engineers, architects, AI engineers and designers working on the same delivery, not handing off between silos. We focus on delivering outcomes for clients, building strong careers for our people, and staying ahead of the technology curve. We hire because we are growing.
Role Purpose
The Business Analyst is the bridge between business intent and delivered technology. You will lead discovery, shape requirements into a workable backlog, and stay with the solution through build, test and adoption–making sure what gets delivered actually solves the problem and gets used. This is a client-facing consulting role on live digital and AI-enabled transformation programmes, largely for Singapore Public Sector and large enterprise clients.
What You'll Own
As a Senior Business Analyst, you will play a client-facing consulting role driving business transformation on SaaS and digital platforms.You will:
1. Discovery & Transformation Opportunities
Lead discovery workshops to identify pain points, mapuser journeys, and define transformation opportunities.
2. Requirements & Agile Backlog
Shape requirements into clear Agile user stories andproduct backlogs, working closely with Product Owners, Architects, andDevelopers.
3. AI & Automation-Led Process Reimagination
Leverage Generative AI and automation to reimagineprocesses, accelerate delivery, and create smarter digital workflows.
4. Full Lifecycle Delivery
Drive projects through the full lifecycle: Discovery,Design, Build, Test, Implementation, and Adoption.
5. Business & Technology Bridge
Act as the bridge between business and technology,ensuring solutions deliver measurable business value.
Contribute to business process re-engineering andoperating model redesign as part of SaaS- and AI-enabled transformations.
AI-Assisted Delivery
We deliver with an in-house AI workbench that pairspractitioners and AI across the lifecycle. As a BA you'll use it to:
Refine stories and pressure-test acceptance criteria,surfacing gaps, ambiguities and dependencies early.
Accelerate process documentation, journey maps andrequirement traceability.
Support risk-based test design and coverage analysisalongside QA.
AI accelerates the work; you own the judgement, the clientrelationship and the outcome.
What You'll Bring
Must-Have
4 – 10 years of business analysis or consulting experience delivering enterprise application, SaaS or digital transformation projects.
Proven track record across the full delivery lifecycle – discovery, design, build, test, implementation and adoption.
Strong Agile delivery experience (Scrum, SAFe or hybrid): writing user stories, defining acceptance criteria, and supporting backlog prioritisation.
Excellent facilitation and communication skills – able to run workshops with senior stakeholders and frontline users alike.
Solid consulting toolkit: stakeholder management, problem structuring, business process re-engineering, and business case development.
Comfortable working with AI-assisted delivery tooling to accelerate analysis, documentation and quality review.
Experience delivering for Singapore Public Sector or large enterprise clients.
Good-to-Have
Hands-on exposure to one or more of ServiceNow, Microsoft Power Platform, OutSystems, UiPath, AWS or Databricks.
Experience shaping requirements for agentic AI, RAG or intelligent automation solutions.
Background in service design, journey mapping, or operating model redesign.
Certification in Agile / Scrum (e.g. CSM, PSPO, PMI-ACP) or business analysis (e.g. CBAP).
Familiarity with Jira, Confluence and Azure DevOps.
Not for You If
This role is not a fit if:
You prefer writing requirements documents over sitting with users and engineers to work problems out.
You see AI tooling as a threat to the craft rather than part of how analysis gets done.
You want a pure documentation role without accountability for whether the solution lands.
You are uncomfortable being client-facing or leading workshops with senior stakeholders.
Why SimplifyNext
One Team, Not Siloed Offerings
Apps, automation, and AI aren't separate teams here - you'll work across all three as one connected practice, not get boxed into a single lane.
AI in Our DNA, Not Bolted On
Regardless of platform, every specialist here is AI-enabled by design, powered by our own in-house AI workbench that pairs humans and AI from discovery to testing.
Future-Proof Your Career
Tech trends come and go - today's hot platform is tomorrow's afterthought. We multi-skill our people across platforms and AI so your career keeps growing no matter where the market moves.
APAC's Biggest AI-Integrated Practice
Across every platform we work in, our AI-integrated practice is the largest in the region, with work good enough to be cited at Google's own AI event.
Grow With Us Across ASEAN
We're one of Singapore's 100 Fastest Growing Companies, expanding fast across Thailand and Malaysia - plenty of room to grow with us.

Title: Business Development Senior Manager, APAC
Description:
At Spotify, we’re passionate about delivering the right audio experience for every moment. We’ve connected hundreds of millions of people to the content they love and built the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service. We operate in more than 180 markets and continue to scale rapidly across APAC.
We’re building a world-class business development team and are looking for a multi-talented self-starter with ambition and drive who will help grow Spotify’s Premium distribution partnerships in the APAC region. You will own, negotiate, and scale strategic agreements with partners who can accelerate subscriber and engagement growth. This role will be based in either Singapore or Seoul and you will report to the APAC Director of Business Development. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences audio.
What You'll Do

- You have a minimum of 5+ years of significant business development or strategic partnerships experience within APAC—ideally across telcos, OEMs, payments, entertainment, or digital platforms.
- Fluency in English and Korean is required for the role; other additional APAC languages a plus.
- You have a proven track record of structuring and closing complex deals with large enterprises and scaling partnerships with measurable commercial impact.
- You understand the nuances of APAC markets and bring relevant local insights; deep experience in Korea, Thailand or Indonesia is especially valuable.
- You think strategically about complex business issues, yet you’re equally strong in operational execution and relationship ownership.
- You excel in multicultural, fast‑moving environments and collaborate effectively across distributed teams.
- You have strong experience negotiating contracts, understanding legal frameworks, and partnering effectively with attorneys.
- You are comfortable working with product, engineering, and design teams and translate technical concepts to non‑technical team members with ease.

• SLA Target: Complete all patching tasks within 24 hours of request initiation • Quality Metric: Maintain a 100% accuracy rate in patching, ensuring no cross- connections occur
➢ Rebooting/Reseating of Equipment:
• SLA Target: Execute equipment reboots/reseating within 1 hours of request during business support hours or as stipulated with stakeholder

• Quality Metric: Achieve a minimum satisfaction rating of 85% from internal stakeholders regarding the quality of work performed.
➢ Reporting Back to Customer’s Stakeholders:
• SLA Target: Provide status updates to Customer stakeholders within 1 hour of task completion.
• Quality Metric: Ensure that all reports are clear, concise, and accurately reflect the work performed
➢ General Support as Requested by Customer:
• SLA Target: Respond to general support requests within 1 hour during business hours
• Quality Metric: Maintain a resolution rate of 90% for support requests within the same business day for lower priority requests.

• Quality Metric: 100% of tickets are acknowledged, recorded, and categorized correctly upon submission.

• Quality Metric: Maintain an accuracy rate of 95% in categorizing and prioritizing tickets, ensuring that critical issues receive immediate attention.

About Us
We are an events team that puts our people first. The events industry is fast-paced and demanding, and we won't pretend otherwise: there are late nights, tight timelines and days when everything happens at once. But every event we deliver is the result of our team's hard work and dedication, and the moments we create together are what make it worthwhile. We work hard, we play hard, and we celebrate every success as one team.
Our colleagues are based across Singapore, Thailand,Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, India and the Philippines, and we collaborate closely across borders to bring each project to life. We're looking for a sincere, passionate sales professional who wants to grow with us for the long term.
The Role
As our Events Sales Executive, you will bring in new business, customise event solutions that reflect each client's goals, and stay involved from the first enquiry through to show day and beyond. You will be the client's trusted point of contact, working hand in hand with our operations and creative teams to deliver experiences that keep clients coming back.

Respond promptly to sales enquiries and follow up with tailored event proposals.

ClientSolutions and Service
Understand each client's objectives and recommend event solutions that align with their goals and brand vision.
Deliver a high standard of customer service, offering relevant advice and recommendations based on client requirements.
EventDelivery
Collaborate closely with our event operations and creative teams to ensure seamless planning and execution.
Be present onsite to check that the event setup is properly executed by our operations team, and walk clients through the setup to confirm everything is in place.

Follow up with clients after each event to gather feedback and maintain the relationship.

A strong relationship builder with a client-focused, service-oriented approach.
A team player who enjoys working with colleagues across departments and countries.
