Function: Finance
Location: Singapore
Reporting to: FP&A Manager (SAT Cluster)
Role: Permanent
Financial Planning & Analysis Analyst
The incumbent will provide financial planning and analysis support to the FP&A Manager across the Cluster markets (Australia, Thailand, and Singapore), playing a key role in the overall budgeting and planning cycle, alongside forecasting, performance reporting, and business analysis.
The position supports the preparation and consolidation of budgets across the markets, working with relevant stakeholders to ensure planning inputs and submissions are accurate, aligned, and timely. The role also provides variance analysis and contributes to practical improvements that enhance the efficiency, consistency, and data quality of budgeting processes.
Working closely with local business stakeholders, Entity Finance Controlling, Supply Planning, and other cross-functional teams, the incumbent will help collect and validate planning inputs, maintain accurate working files, and ensure timely and reliable submissions in line with Cluster, Regional, and Corporate requirements.
With demonstrated performance, growing business knowledge, and the required capabilities, the incumbent may progressively assume broader FP&A coordination and business-partnering responsibilities for a designated market within the Cluster.
As the FP&A Analyst, you will be responsible for:
Planning & Budgeting
- Support and coordinate annual budgeting, forecasting, and A&SP planning activities across the Cluster markets.
- Prepare and consolidate planning templates and working files, and coordinate with budget owners to collect and validate inputs.
- Maintain planning assumptions and supporting schedules, highlighting gaps or inconsistencies.
- Support TM1 / IBP / GPM uploads and timely submissions to Cluster, Regional, and Corporate FP&A.
- Contribute practical ideas and support the implementation of improvements to budgeting templates, workflows, and controls to enhance efficiency, consistency, and data quality.
Performance Reporting & Variance Analysis
- Prepare management reports and track actual performance against budget and forecast.
- Analyze key P&L variances, including OPEX and Marketing & Sales performance, and summarize business drivers for management review.
- Help identify performance gaps and track follow-up actions with relevant stakeholders.
- Assist with financial models and scenario analyses, including pricing and commercial simulations.
Business Partnering & Market Analysis
- Work with budget owners and cross-functional stakeholders to support budget reviews and provide relevant financial analysis.
- Develop an understanding of market performance and key business drivers to support business discussions and decision-making.
- As business knowledge, capability, and performance develop, progressively take on a broader scope of market-level analysis, stakeholder coordination, and business-partnering activities.
Closing & Financial Data Quality
- Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end activities in coordination with Entity Finance Controlling, Accounting, GBS, and business partners.
- Perform checks and reconciliations on management P&L data and investigate discrepancies.
- Help ensure accurate, complete, and timely reporting in relevant finance systems.
Systems, Master Data & Ad-hoc Analysis
- Coordinate with GBS on finance master-data requests, including product cost, profit and cost centers, transfer pricing, and PIR setup.
- Support cross-functional and global initiatives through ad-hoc analysis, simulations, and structured financial models.
- Perform other related tasks and projects as requested by the manager.
Requirements:
University degree or equivalent in Finance, Business, or Accounting
2 years experience in Financial Planning & Analysis or related position, preferably in international or FMCG environment is an advantage.
Fluency in English is required
Functional Skills:
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel; working knowledge of SAP or similar ERP systems is preferred.
Foundational understanding of budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, and variance analysis.
Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to organize financial data and communicate clear findings.
Ability to manage deadlines, learn business drivers, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders.
Demonstrates ownership, adaptability, curiosity, and a growth mindset.

Title: Government Relations and Public Policy Manager
Description:
We’re looking for an experienced Government Relations Manager to advance our policy and regulatory objectives in South East Asia and help us get closer to to help us get closer to achieving our mission of low cost and high speed international payments. You will be expected to represent the company with gravitas and be influential in doing so.
This job requires active external advocacy, public campaigning and engagement with policymakers and policy influencers to prosecute our interests for direct access to payment systems and transparent pricing of foreign exchange.
You will have responsibility for our engagement with the respective government but with potential for further responsibilities in other markets as we grow and expand into different locales.
We lead the way in calling for the full implementation of the G20 Cross Border Payments Roadmap through our annual G20 Scorecard Reports, with a heavy focus on driving direct access and price transparency.
What you’ll experience
You will be based in our Singapore office and work closely with our Product, Banking, Compliance, Public Relations and Legal teams across South East Asian markets - particularly Singapore, Malaysia, the Philippines and Thailand but with potential for responsibility for other markets as we grow and expand into different locales. You will be expected to travel frequently to other markets, particularly Thailand, Indonesia, Malaysia and the Philippines in order to advance our mission.
Wise is an ‘in person’ company, so you will be based in our full stack office in Singapore and report to the APAC Government Relations Lead (also based in Singapore); you will have a high degree of autonomy in how you work to achieve our mission goals.
You will also be expected to play an integral part supporting our APAC and global leadership team in their external facing meetings with governments, regulators and trade associations as well as assist in Environmental, Social and Governance compliance processes.
You will be part of the global Government Relations team. It is a small but effective group of professionals who prioritise active advocacy to achieve our mission.
Qualifications
Be a natural self-starter who can work productively and efficiently without regular direct supervision. You must be capable of identifying problems, developing a plan to solve those issues and then delivering your plan to fulfill our mission.
Be willing to advocate proactively and robustly for Wise’s interests with government stakeholders to the exclusion of all other interests.
Have an ability to constructively challenge, with evidence, those in positions of authority who do not want to see change.
Be capable of identifying potential issues, developing a plan to solve those problems and then delivering on your plan to fulfill our mission.
Have a minimum of 7 years’ of relevant experience in government, politics or public policy roles.
Understand our mission in respect to international payments.
Have an ability to constructively challenge those in positions of authority who do not want to see change.
Be fluent in written and spoken English and preferably in another language.
Have experience operating in at least one South East Asian Market with an established network and an understanding of government structures, regulatory systems and political institutions.
Proficiency in financial services, payments and consumer protection policy is considered a plus.
Be a persuasive advocate and skilled communicator both in speaking and writing - your written work will be both for internal and public consumption and your advocacy may be used in the media.
Be tenacious, inquisitive and have an appetite to learn about new areas of policy and their application to our business.
Have an ability to work across teams and cultures in a dynamic and diverse workplace with respect for and curiosity about other cultures and systems.

Title: Indirect Sales Manager
Description:
As an Indirect Sales Manager, you will be responsible for driving net-new customer acquisition across a large Growth territory spanning Singapore,Thailand, Philippines and Vietnam (accounts and geographies not allocated to Focused Account Managers), based out of Singapore. You will also lead a set of existing customers and therefore drive adoption, as well as generate new revenue through upsell and cross-sell motions.
You will work both directly with prospective customers and through channel partners to identify and qualify new logos, map key stakeholders and buying groups, uncover business and IT pains, position the right BMC Helix solutions, and convert opportunities into long-term Helix customers.
Given the scale of the territory, this role requires strong business acumen and disciplined territory planning to identify the right verticals, prioritize the right accounts, and run a repeatable pipeline-generation engine—while partnering closely with internal specialists and the partner ecosystem through long, consultative enterprise sales cycles.
Key Responsibilities
Territory Ownership& Growth Strategy
Own end-to-end responsibility for the Growth territory across Singapore,Thailand, Philippines and Vietnam (accounts not allocated to Focused Account Managers), including territory strategy, pipeline creation,forecasting, and revenue delivery for both net-new logo acquisition as well as net-new business from existing customers.
Develop annual territory plans and a prioritized target account list—selecting the right verticals and accounts to focus on, mapping key stakeholders,understanding strategic initiatives, and defining pursuit plans to land new enterprise customers.
Build account intelligence and pipeline through proactive prospecting,partner-sourced leads, and market mapping to identify new logo opportunities for ITSM, ITOM, AIOps, Automation, Observability, and Security Operations.
Prospect & Stakeholder Engagement
Own relationships with existing / prospective enterprise customers, working closely with Solution Engineering, Value Engineering, Partner Teams, Legal,and Product to progress opportunities from discovery to close.
Build strong multi-level relationships across CXO, CIO/CTO/CISO organisations, IT Operations, Service Management, Security, and procurement—creating a clear map of the buying group and decision process.
Lead discovery and executive conversations focused on pain points, business outcomes, ROI, resilience, and operational efficiency—connecting customer priorities to the right Helix capabilities.
Drive a structured pursuit motion that converts qualified prospects into Helix customers and establishes BMC Helix as a trusted transformation partner.
Solution Positioning & Value Selling
Deliver high-impact product presentations, executive briefings, and whiteboarding sessions tailored to enterprise use cases.
Translate complex technical capabilities into clear business value propositions aligned to enterprise priorities.
Support customers through evaluation, proof-of-value, and decision-making processes.
Partner with Value Engineering to build compelling business cases and ROI models.
Deal Strategy & Execution
Build and maintain a robust enterprise pipeline using structured qualification frameworks such as MEDDIC / MEDDPICC.
Own deal strategy from discovery through closure, including pricing, commercial structuring, negotiations, and approvals.
Navigate complex enterprise procurement processes, legal reviews, and multi-stakeholder approvals.
Ensure accurate forecasting, CRM hygiene, and disciplined pipeline management.
Channel &Ecosystem Collaboration
Work closely with system integrators, consulting partners, and regional channel partners to create and progress partner-sourced and co-sell new opportunities across Singapore, Thailand, Philippines and Vietnam.
Enable partner-led pursuits by ensuring strong qualification, clear positioning and differentiation, mutual action plans, and tight execution governance through the sales cycle.
Collaborate with marketing on territory programs (events, CXO roundtables, partner campaigns, ABM) to generate demand and accelerate pipeline creation.
Cross-Functional Leadership
Act as the voice of the customer internally, providing insights to Product Management, Leadership, and Global Teams.
Collaborate with global BMC Helix teams to leverage best practices, customer success stories, and product roadmaps.
What You Need to Bring
Experience & Background
10–12+ years of experience in enterprise software sales with a strong track record in net-new logo acquisition across ASEAN (enterprise/upper-mid market).
Proven track record of consistently achieving or exceeding sales targets in large enterprise environments.
Experience selling enterprise platforms such as ITSM, ITOM, AIOps, Automation, Cloud, Observability, or Infrastructure Management.
Enterprise Sales Expertise
Strong understanding of enterprise buying processes, long sales cycles, and multi-stakeholder decision-making.
Experience engaging with CIO, CTO, CISO, Head of IT Operations, and Digital Transformation leaders.
Ability to manage large deal values, multi-year contracts, and strategic renewals.
Sales Execution & Discipline
Expertise in account planning, pipeline management, forecasting, and QBRs.
Proficiency with SFDC or equivalent CRM tools.
Strong negotiation, pricing, and commercial structuring skills.
Relationship & Influence
Established relationships and credibility within large enterprises and the partner ecosystem across ASEAN, with the ability to open doors and build executive sponsorship in target accounts.
Ability to influence technical, operational, commercial, and executive stakeholders.
Strong collaboration skills with partners, internal teams, and leadership.
Personal Attributes
High ownership mindset with strong customer focus.
Excellent communication skills and executive presence.
Strategic, consultative, and value-led selling approach.
Self-driven, coachable, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, matrixed organization.

As an UHNW Client Advisor, Executive Director in the SEA Market team at JP Morgan, you will be responsible for supporting and managing all aspects of client relationships across the team. You will operate in both banker and investor capacity, handle and coordinate with various teams on account inquiries and investment-related aspects, and deliver strategic messages to your portfolio. Collaborate with the other integrated team members to provide a high quality of client service.

Work together with other teams in meeting all compliance, regulatory, risk management, operational, and due diligence requirements and compliance with internal policies.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent in any discipline
Minimum 10 years' experience in wealth management space, along with strong client and stakeholder management skills is required.

Strong knowledge of Wealth Management business with deep understanding on Compliance, Risk and Regulatory frameworks.
As the role is an important contributor to the strategy of JP Morgan, comfort and experience working with and reporting to senior management is required.
Experience in managing relationships both with clients and internal partners across multiple countries and regions to drive our sales agenda.

Title: Manager / Senior Manager, Client Servicing & Onboarding
Description:
Job purpose
This role, based in Singapore, is responsible for leading the local Client Servicing Know-Your-Client ("CS KYC") team and ensuring the timely, accurate, and high-quality delivery of client onboarding, KYC reviews, and client file maintenance for institutional and distribution clients across Asia.
The role combines team management, operational oversight, governance, and regional coordination, working closely with headquarter in Paris and other Asian entities to ensure alignment with Group standards, internal policies, control requirements, and local regulatory obligations.
The position is hierarchically attached to the local Client Servicing organization in Singapore and functionally attached to the management of the Global Client Servicing and Onboarding ("CSO") Business Line.
Job description
Team Leadership and Management:
Lead, manage, and develop the Singapore-based CS KYC team, including workload allocation, prioritization, coaching, training, and day-to-day supervision. Ensure strong collaboration, accountability, and service quality across the team.
KYC Onboarding and Due Diligence Oversight:
Oversee the end-to-end onboarding of institutional and distribution clients in line with KYC/AML procedures, internal policies, and regulatory requirements. Review client profiles, identify documentation requirements, and ensure files are complete and ready for validation.
Validation, Escalation, and Follow-up:
Coordinate KYC validation with Compliance and other control functions. Manage follow-up actions, queries, remediation points, and escalations to ensure timely resolution and appropriate communication to stakeholders.
Periodic Review and File Maintenance:
Oversee the update of KYC records through periodic reviews, event-driven updates, and remediation exercises. Ensure client documentation remains accurate, complete, compliant, and properly recorded in internal systems.
Governance and Regional Coordination:
Ensure proper implementation of Group policies, KYC/AML standards, internal procedures, and control requirements across the team. Work closely with HQ Paris and other Asian entities on governance, policy alignment, process consistency, and escalation matters.
Client Categorization and Data Oversight:
Oversee client categorization, suitability, eligibility documentation, and the accurate capture of client and KYC data in internal systems. Promote strong data quality and consistency throughout the onboarding and review lifecycle.
Stakeholder Coordination:
Maintain effective communication with the Global CSO Business Line, Paris teams, and internal stakeholders including Sales, Client Servicing, Compliance, Legal, Operations, and Middle Office, as well as external parties where required.
Functional Alignment with CSO Business Line
: Ensure that local team organization, priorities, governance practices, escalation handling, and service delivery remain aligned with the direction, standards, and expectations of the CSO Business Line, while operating within the local CS reporting line in Singapore.
Control Environment and Continuous Improvement:
Ensure the team operates within a robust control framework, with appropriate documentation, audit trail, and escalation discipline. Contribute to projects and process improvements related to onboarding, regulatory change, governance, and efficiency.
Profile
7 to 10 years of relevant experience in asset management or financial services, with strong exposure to Client Servicing, KYC/AML, client onboarding, Compliance, or a related support/control function.
Proven experience in the onboarding, review, and maintenance of institutional and/or distribution client files.
Proven experience in a team management or senior team lead role, including supervision, coaching, workload allocation, performance follow-up, and escalation management.
Strong understanding of KYC/AML requirements, due diligence standards, client categorization, eligibility documentation, onboarding governance requirements, and control expectations in a regulated environment.
Good understanding of governance frameworks, policy implementation, and the importance of consistency of practices across regional teams and jurisdictions.
Exposure to regional KYC requirements across Asian markets, particularly Singapore, Hong Kong, Malaysia, Thailand, South Korea, China, and Taiwan, would be an advantage.
Experience in working with HQ/global teams on governance, policy alignment, or regional oversight would be an advantage.
Familiarity with KYC tools, client data systems, workflow monitoring processes, and management reporting.
Strong coordination, leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders across functions and locations.
Strong attention to detail, analytical capability, sound judgment, and control mindset.
Well-organized, proactive, reliable, adaptable, and able to work within tight deadlines.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Amundi Singapore is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Amundi Group. It was established in 1989 as a business hub for Amundi Group’s operations in South East Asia. It is also one of Amundi Group’s key investment centers. Having been in Asia for 35 years, we have a good understanding of the investment and service requirements of the region’s investors.
We have local offices in the region including Amundi Malaysia and Amundi Thailand to reach and broaden our client base as well as to deepen our penetration in the respective markets. Our presence and growing footprint in Asia demonstrate our long term commitment to our investors in the region, which is one of the fastest growing regions in the world. We leverage on our local presence and work in close partnership with our clients providing a dedicated local sales and service infrastructure. Our global capabilities are delivered through the local teams to ensure best-in-class service.

Title: Regional Sales Manager - Banking Software Solutions Asia
Description:
ANKH Executive is supporting a globally established, Swiss-headquartered banking technology provider in appointing two Senior Sales Executives for the Asia region. The organisation has key operations, solution expertise and pre-sales support managed from Luxembourg.
This Singapore-based role is focused on enterprise sales of banking software solutions into financial institutions. Private banking and wealth management remain important target environments, but the mandate is now also open to senior sales professionals from core banking, transaction banking and adjacent enterprise banking technology backgrounds.
The successful candidates will cover selected Asia markets, with priority relevance across Hong Kong, Thailand, Singapore and Vietnam. The role includes existing account development, active pipeline conversion, new-logo acquisition, client presentations and demos, RFI/RFP ownership and complex software contract closure.
The position offers a high level of autonomy, senior reporting access and Luxembourg-based pre-sales support. The Sales Executive will own the A-to-Z sales process, while technical preparation and RFI/RFP groundwork will be supported by specialist teams.
CORE RESPONSIBILITIES
- Develop and execute territory and strategic sales plans across selected Asia markets
- Identify, qualify and pursue new business opportunities with banks, wealth managers and regulated financial institutions
- Manage existing accounts and active regional pipeline while developing new prospects and new-logo opportunities
- Own the full sales cycle from prospecting through negotiation and signature
- Lead client presentations, demonstrations and workshops with Luxembourg pre-sales support
- Own and sign off RFI/RFP responses, with preparation and technical input from internal specialists
- Prepare commercial proposals and lead contract negotiations
- Build executive-level relationships and identify C-level sponsors within key opportunities
- Maintain CRM discipline, accurate forecasting and weekly sales reporting
- Represent the organisation at banking, wealth management, fintech and financial technology industry events
REQUIRED PROFILE
- Minimum 8 years of enterprise sales experience, preferably in banking software, financial technology, core banking, transaction banking, private banking technology, wealth management technology or financial services software
- Software/platform sales exposure into banks, wealth managers, private banks, universal banks or regulated financial institutions
- Strong sales track record in Asia, ideally including Hong Kong, Thailand, Singapore or Vietnam
- Private banking / wealth management software experience is valuable; core banking, transaction banking and adjacent banking technology sales backgrounds will also be considered
- Relevant knowledge of banking technology environments including core banking, transaction banking, payments, cash management, treasury, trade finance, digital banking, private banking or wealth management platforms
- Track record managing complex sales cycles, RFI/RFP processes, demos, commercial proposals and contract negotiation
- Ability to engage senior stakeholders across business, technology, operations and executive leadership
- Strong CRM discipline, forecasting accuracy and account planning capability
- English mandatory; Mandarin, Cantonese, Thai, Vietnamese or other relevant regional language capability is a strong advantage; French is nice to have
- Singapore-based candidates preferred; candidates with prior Singapore experience or clear ability to be based in Singapore may be considered

Apply with your CV and a summary of relevant enterprise software sales achievements to apply@ankhexecutive.com.

Title: Senior Account Manager
Description:
Who We Are
Formerra is a preeminent distributor of engineered materials, connecting the world's leading polymer producers with thousands of OEMs and brand owners across healthcare, consumer, industrial, and mobility markets. Powered by technical and commercial expertise, it brings a distinctive combination of portfolio depth, supply chain strength, industry knowledge, service, leading ecommerce capabilities, and ingenuity. The experienced Formerra team helps customers across multiple industries to design, select, process, and develop products in new and better ways – driving improved performance, productivity, reliability, and sustainability. To learn more, visit www.formerra.com.
Formerra leads in the market with the following key capabilities:
Problem-solving mindset, based on ingenuity and backed by a skilled and experienced commercial team that brings differentiated insights across markets including healthcare, consumer, industrial and mobility
Expansive material portfolio, including engineering thermoplastics and traditional polymers across leading material brands
Integrated, long-standing relationships with leading, global suppliers
Unparalleled and highly specialized technical, processing, and design support
Regulatory-compliant material support and expertise
Position Overview
This position is responsible for sales of Formerra distributed products in Singapore to drive sustainable and profitable growth. Duties include forecasting and achieving annual objectives for sales, margins and volume growth, pipeline opportunities building up for future years. Position is focused on developing new business in Singapore and securing business from prospective and existing accounts in an effort to meet sales objectives. Accountability will center on margin and relationship building but will include prospecting, forecasting, achievement of sales objectives and directing activities across functional groups in support of account goals. Expectations include the ability to sell at all levels of management and building relationships that ensure Formerra will continue to get the first and last look. Ability to function independently, being skilled at customer centric selling approaches and effectively selling the value of our products and services are also keys to success. This individual must have the ability to assist customers in problem solving on product issues. We are looking for candidates that bring energy, enthusiasm and professionalism to their daily routines. The preferred candidate will possess strong product knowledge and sales skills in plastics distribution/trading business, especially with the experience in Healthcare/Medical/Consumer/Electric/Packaging and Electronics/Transportation markets.
Location Requirement: This role is remote; however, applicants must be located within the territory (Singapore).
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
Establish and execute formal account plans
Develop contact matrix and establish strong High-Wide-Deep relationships with key decision makers and project facilitators.
Establish, track and close new business targets consistently with both short and long term growth objectives at designated accounts within the territory.
Prospecting and cold calling
Market development activities (OEM/Application selling where designated).
Develop, execute and manage sales plans, sales budgets, and expense budgets.
Negotiate pricing and contracts as needed.
Deliver the planned results (AOP – Annual Operating Plan).
Routine utilization of sales tools (Opportunity Scorecards, Sales Funnel, Account Plans, Visit Plan and Reports, Business Reviews, etc.).
Key Account management, teamwork with global contacts
Manage and grow relationships with local suppliers as well as develop new suppliers in assigned regions
Adopting and executing Customer Centric Selling Skills
Key Competency Requirements:
Accountable - Acts in the best interests of the company; demonstrates behavior aligned with the Formerra Code of Conducts; values and respects others; is reliable, consistent and a good role model.
Pro-activeness - Demonstrates high levels of initiative and a sense of urgency and responsiveness; consistently achieves measurable results; takes accountability for actions.
Adaptability - Reacts positively to change; demonstrates flexibility and adaptability; proactively pursues continual learning and improvement.
Interpersonal Skills - Communicates effectively both verbally and in writing; listens effectively and clarifies information as needed; works well with others in a team environment across the organization knowing who to engage to achieve results.
Problem Solving Skills - Effectively identifies problems by framing issues, leveraging data and ultimately developing and implementing solutions.
Continuous Improvement & Process Focus - Actively engages in continually identifying ways to improve one's self as well as the business and utilizes tools and processes to ensure consistent, reliable, high quality results.
Qualifications:
Education Requirements:
Bachelor's degree or above in polymer science or business trading or related areas.
Experience Requirements:
Strong selling skills supported upon 10+ years of demonstrated accomplishments
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
Proficiency in job-related software products and an enterprise management data system
Excellent verbal skills – ability to speak clearly, confidently, and professionally both on the telephone and in-person.
Writing skills – ability to write clearly and succinctly, to adapt writing style to match the audience, and develop proposals.
Negotiation skills – ability to effectively manage conflicts, negotiate scope, timeline, pricing, and deliverables with customer to generate the sale and to ensure profitability
Language fluency in English, Chinese language skill is preferred.
Must be self-motivated, ambitious, team player with a persuasive and energetic personality
Work Environment:
Physical & Social Setting:
Hybrid: A mix of office and remote work.
Work Conditions:
Travel requirements (60% of travel required) mainly in Singapore, and occasionally in Malaysia and Thailand when needed.

Title: Senior Legal Counsel
Description:
At Sephora, beauty is about feeling seen, valued, and empowered, individually and collectively. It is connecting deeply with others, celebrating diversity and inclusivity, unlocking your potential and making a difference every day. Together, we belong to something beautiful.
Sephora SEA’s omni channel business spans over 8 countries (Australia, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore and Thailand) with 100+ stores and boasts some global flagships such as ION and Raffles City in Singapore, F88 in Kuala Lumpur and Pitt Street in Sydney. Sephora SEA is experiencing rapid growth in the region with new store openings and business channels (i.e., Click and collect and marketplace).
Senior Legal Counsel, SEAO
Sephora, the world’s leading prestige beauty retailer and part of the LVMH Group, is seeking a commercially minded and highly collaborative Senior Legal Counsel to join our Legal team in Singapore. Sephora Southeast Asia and Oceania serves customers across a diverse and fast-growing region through a compelling omni-channel beauty experience, combining retail, digital, technology, and expert service.
Reporting to the Head of Legal, the Senior Legal Counsel will act as a trusted legal advisor and strategic business partner to Sephora’s SEAO business. The role will provide practical, risk-balanced, and commercially focused legal advice across a broad spectrum of matters, including commercial contracting, compliance, privacy, digital and technology, retail operations, consumer protection, marketing, intellectual property, and disputes. While the role spans the full legal function, particular emphasis will be placed on technology contracting and data protection/privacy.
This is a broad regional role suited to a self-driven legal professional who combines strong technical legal expertise with sound business judgment, stakeholder influence, and a commercially pragmatic approach to problem solving. The successful candidate will work closely with senior leaders and cross-functional teams to enable business growth, protect Sephora’s interests, and strengthen a culture of compliance across the region.
You will shine here if you enjoy...
Strategic Business Partnership & Legal Advisory
Act as a trusted legal advisor to business leaders across Southeast Asia and Oceania, providing pragmatic and commercially sound legal guidance.
Partner closely with Retail, Digital, E-Commerce, Marketing, Merchandising, Supply Chain, Finance, HR, Technology, and Franchise teams to support business initiatives and strategic priorities.
Identify legal and regulatory risks and provide practical recommendations that balance business objectives with appropriate risk management.
Support business growth, expansion initiatives, new operating models, partnerships, and strategic projects across the region.
Translate complex legal concepts into clear, actionable advice for stakeholders at all levels.
Commercial Contracting & Business Transactions
Draft, review, negotiate, and advise on a broad range of commercial agreements, including technology, software, SaaS, cloud and digital services agreements, e-commerce or platform-related agreements, logistics and supply chain agreements, marketing and advertising agreements, and professional services and consulting agreements. This includes acting as the primary point of contact for technology-related contract negotiations region-wide.
Review marketing campaigns, promotions, and advertising content for regulatory compliance across SEAO markets
Develop and maintain legal templates, playbooks, and guidance materials to improve contracting efficiency, consistency, and stakeholder experience.
Support contract lifecycle management processes and continuous improvements in legal service delivery.
Compliance, Privacy & Regulatory Governance
Serve as a key legal advisor on data privacy and protection matters, including negotiating data processing agreements and providing guidance on marketing, CRM and other customer-facing initiatives
Provide guidance on regulations relating to consumer protection, marketing and advertising, intellectual property and general corporate or commercial matters across multiple jurisdictions within Southeast Asia and Oceania
Support the development, review, and implementation of policies, procedures, governance frameworks, workflows, and legal guidance materials.
Design and deliver practical legal and compliance training programs to increase awareness and strengthen a culture of compliance.
Monitor emerging legal and regulatory developments and proactively advise business stakeholders on potential impacts.
Disputes, Investigations & Risk Management
Manage and advise on contentious matters, including customer complaints, product liability matters, commercial disputes, regulatory inquiries, investigations, and enforcement matters.
Partner with business leaders to assess exposure and implement practical mitigation strategies.
Support crisis management and business continuity activities requiring legal input.
Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external counsel to achieve timely and commercially appropriate resolutions.
External Counsel Management & Legal Operations
Manage relationships with external legal counsel across the region, ensuring high-quality advice, practical outcomes, and cost-effective support.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives across legal operations, including legal technology adoption, contract automation, knowledge management, process simplification, and service delivery enhancements.
Contribute to the ongoing development of the legal function through best-practice sharing, guidance, mentoring, and coaching where appropriate.

Qualified lawyer in Singapore or another common law jurisdiction, with 7–10 years of post-qualification experience.
Experience in a top-tier law firm and in-house legal role within a multinational organization.
Strong regional experience across Southeast Asia, APAC, or other multi-jurisdictional markets.
Experience in consumer, retail, FMCG, e-commerce, technology, or digital industries is preferred.

Strong expertise in technology contracting, data privacy, commercial contracts, and negotiations.
Good knowledge of consumer protection, e-commerce, marketing regulations, and intellectual property.
Ability to translate legal and regulatory requirements into practical business advice.
Leadership & Personal Attributes
Strong commercial acumen, judgment, and stakeholder management skills.
Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Able to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and thrive in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.
High integrity, professionalism, and discretion. Additional Asian language skills are an advantage.

APAC's Biggest AI-Integrated Practice

We're one of Singapore's 100 Fastest Growing Companies, expanding fast across Thailand and Malaysia - plenty of room to grow with us.

Title: Senior R&D Formulator
Description:
About Hysses
Hysses (乡术 — “arts from the village”) is Singapore’s leading aromatherapy and natural wellness brand, with a retail footprint of essential oil-based skincare, haircare, body care, and home scent products across Singapore, Malaysia, and beyond. All formulation, research, and development is done in-house at the Hysses Singapore HQ.
Hysses formulates with natural botanicals and bioactive ingredients, sourced from farmers and native communities worldwide, and is committed to genuine efficacy over ingredient trends — avoiding synthetic silicones, parabens, paraffin, artificial colours, synthetic fragrances, and unrefined petroleum-derived ingredients. The brand’s growth has been driven by a small, hands-on R&D team responsible for everything from raw material sourcing to finished product launch.
Role Summary
The Senior R&D Formulator will lead the development of new products and reformulation of existing ones across Hysses’ skincare, haircare, body care, and home fragrance/essential oil ranges. This is a senior, hands-on technical role for an experienced formulator who can independently own projects from concept to commercial launch — balancing natural/clean-beauty ingredient philosophy, sensory and olfactory quality, regulatory compliance, cost, and manufacturability.
The role also carries a mentorship component, guiding junior formulators and coordinating closely with sourcing, QA, regulatory, marketing, and manufacturing partners.
Key Responsibilities
Formulation & Product Development
Independently develop, trial, and optimise formulations for skincare, haircare, body care, and home/car scent products using natural botanical actives, essential oils, and bioactive ingredients.
Lead formulation projects end-to-end: concept briefs, bench trials, stability testing, pilot batches, scale-up, and handover to production.
Reformulate existing SKUs to improve efficacy, sensory experience, stability, cost, or compliance with Hysses’ clean-formulation standards (free from synthetic silicones, parabens, paraffin, artificial colours, synthetic fragrances, and unrefined petroleum derivatives).
Design and refine essential oil blends and fragrance accords for both leave-on/rinse-off body products and ambient home scent
formats (diffuser oils, room mists, candles).
Technical & Quality Ownership
Conduct and oversee stability testing (accelerated & real-time), compatibility testing, challenge testing, and preservative efficacy studies in coordination with QA/QC and external labs.
Troubleshoot formulation issues arising in pilot or full-scale production runs (viscosity, separation, discolouration, scent drift, microbial stability, etc.).
Maintain rigorous documentation: formulation records, batch trial data, INCI listings, safety data, and version control for all formulas.
Ensure all formulations meet applicable regulatory requirements across Hysses’ markets (e.g., Singapore HSA cosmetic notification,
ASEAN Cosmetic Directive, and relevant requirements in export markets).
Ingredient & Supplier Management
Source, vet, and qualify new natural and bioactive raw materials, essential oils, and botanical extracts, working directly with farmers, growers, and ingredient suppliers.
Evaluate raw materials for purity, sustainability, traceability, and consistency with Hysses’ natural-ingredient philosophy.
Maintain up-to-date knowledge of the aromatherapy and natural ingredient landscape, including emerging actives, extraction techniques, and sustainable sourcing practices.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner with Marketing and Product teams to translate brand and consumer briefs into technically sound, launch-ready formulations.
Work with Manufacturing/Operations to ensure formulas are scalable, cost-effective, and manufacturable within existing production capabilities.
Liaise with Regulatory/QA on labelling, claims substantiation, and safety documentation.
Support packaging compatibility testing in coordination with the packaging development team.
Leadership & Process
Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior formulators and R&D associates.
Help establish and improve R&D processes, documentation standards, and lab protocols as the team and product range scale.
Contribute to long-term R&D roadmap and innovation pipeline planning.
Requirements
Education & Experience
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Cosmetic Science, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field.
Hands-on formulation experience in cosmetics/personal care, with demonstrated ownership of products from concept through commercial launch.
Proven experience formulating with natural, naturally-derived, and/or essential oil-based ingredient systems is strongly preferred; aromatherapy or fragrance formulation experience is a strong plus.
Experience across multiple product categories (skincare, haircare, body care, and/or home fragrance) preferred.
Technical Skills
Strong working knowledge of cosmetic chemistry: emulsions, surfactant systems, natural preservation/preservative-boosting strategies, rheology, and natural emulsifiers/thickeners.
Familiarity with essential oil chemistry, blending, and safe usage levels (IFRA guidelines knowledge a plus).
Working knowledge of ASEAN Cosmetic Directive and/or Singapore HSA cosmetic product notification requirements; familiarity with international regulatory frameworks (EU, US, China) is an advantage.
Comfortable with stability protocol design, analytical/QC basics, and reading INCI/safety documentation.
Proficient with formulation costing and understanding manufacturing/scale-up constraints.

Strong sensory evaluation skills (texture, scent, colour, performance) and genuine passion for natural/botanical ingredients.
Detail-oriented with excellent documentation discipline.
Able to work independently and take ownership of multiple concurrent projects in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
Strong cross-functional communicator, comfortable working closely with sourcing, marketing, and operations teams.

Trade Finance Senior Officer
in the Trade Finance Department. This is a back-office function that handles end-to-end processing, document checking, settlement, compliance, and record-keeping for all trade products—strictly following regulatory compliance related to AML/CFT and bank policies and procedures.
Transaction Processing

Prepare, verify, and authorize SWIFT messages; input transactions into core banking systems

Customer & Stakeholder Support

The successful candidate will continuously develop new show concepts, audience experiences, robotics demonstrations and event packages that differentiate our offering and create business.
You will lead a small technical operations team of up to 2 team members, working closely with robotics engineers, vendors and clients to deliver safe, reliable and engaging live experiences.
Key Responsibilities
1. Event Concept
Develop innovative concepts for humanoid robotics shows, demonstrations, corporate events, exhibitions, and public experiences.
Develop repeatable show packages and customised experiences based on client requirements.
Work with technology and robotics teams to translate emerging capabilities into compelling event experiences.
Research robotics and event trends to continuously refresh the company's show portfolio.

Coordinate venue requirements including space, flooring, power, connectivity, access, storage and operating conditions.
Conduct site surveys and technical walkthroughs to identify operational constraints early.
Coordinate rehearsals, demonstrations, stage movements, audience interaction and show cues.
Manage event setup, live operations and teardown.
3. Resource Planning
Prepare event quotations, budgets and cost models covering:
Robot and technical resources
Manpower
Venue, connectivity requirements, Logistics and transportation
Insurance and permits
Customisation and content development
Setup and stand down

Ensure pre-event testing, rehearsal and technical readiness.
Establish operational checklists and contingency plans for robot or technology failures.
Coordinate technical troubleshooting during live events and ensure appropriate escalation.
Maintain equipment inventory, readiness schedules and deployment records.

Incorporate robotics-specific safety requirements into every event plan.
Establish robot operating zones, crowd separation, emergency stop procedures and safe operating protocols.
Conduct event risk assessments and ensure appropriate mitigation measures are in place.
Coordinate relevant venue requirements, permits, insurance and safety documentation.
Develop contingency plans for robot failure, network failure, power issues, venue changes and other show disruptions.

Act as the primary client contact from initial enquiry through event completion.
Understand client objectives and translate them into practical robotics experiences.
Manage expectations around robot capabilities, limitations, operating conditions and show requirements.

We are looking for a hands-on Robotics Experience & Events Coordinator to build and operate a new business around humanoid robotics shows, demonstrations and technology experiences.
This role will own the end-to-end event lifecycle — from event concept, client engagement through to costing, planning, logistics, technical coordination and on-site execution.
The successful candidate will continuously develop new show concepts, audience experiences, robotics demonstrations and event packages that differentiate our offering and create business.
You will lead a small technical operations team of up to 2 team members, working closely with robotics engineers, vendors and clients to deliver safe, reliable and engaging live experiences.
Key Responsibilities
1. Event Concept
Develop innovative concepts for humanoid robotics shows, demonstrations, corporate events, exhibitions, and public experiences.
Develop repeatable show packages and customised experiences based on client requirements.
Work with technology and robotics teams to translate emerging capabilities into compelling event experiences.
Research robotics and event trends to continuously refresh the company's show portfolio.
2. Event Planning
Own the end-to-end planning and execution of events from initial brief to post-event review.
Coordinate venue requirements including space, flooring, power, connectivity, access, storage and operating conditions.
Conduct site surveys and technical walkthroughs to identify operational constraints early.
Coordinate rehearsals, demonstrations, stage movements, audience interaction and show cues.
Manage event setup, live operations and teardown.
3. Resource Planning
Prepare event quotations, budgets and cost models covering:
Robot and technical resources
Manpower
Venue, connectivity requirements, Logistics and transportation
Insurance and permits
Customisation and content development
Setup and stand down
Build reusable costing templates and event packages to improve work efficiency.
4. Robotics & Technical Operations
Coordinate with robotics engineers and operators to ensure robots are event-ready.
Plan robot deployment, transportation, charging, batteries, controllers, networking and supporting equipment.
Ensure pre-event testing, rehearsal and technical readiness.
Establish operational checklists and contingency plans for robot or technology failures.
Coordinate technical troubleshooting during live events and ensure appropriate escalation.
Maintain equipment inventory, readiness schedules and deployment records.
5. Safety & Risk Management
Incorporate robotics-specific safety requirements into every event plan.
Establish robot operating zones, crowd separation, emergency stop procedures and safe operating protocols.
Conduct event risk assessments and ensure appropriate mitigation measures are in place.
Coordinate relevant venue requirements, permits, insurance and safety documentation.
Develop contingency plans for robot failure, network failure, power issues, venue changes and other show disruptions.
6. Point of Contact
Act as the primary client contact from initial enquiry through event completion.
Understand client objectives and translate them into practical robotics experiences.
Manage expectations around robot capabilities, limitations, operating conditions and show requirements.

Title: (Refinery) Operations Event Coordinator
Description:
Are you looking for a career in an inspiring, global environment where your expertise makes a difference? At Neste, you will be working for the world’s leading producer of renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel, which enable our customers to reduce their greenhouse gas emissions.
We are looking for you,
Operations Event Coordinator
to our Operations Event Team in our Refinery in Tuas .
You will focusing on planning & preparing our Refinery for a Safe Turnaround. In this job you will work closely not only with the different stakeholders within Neste but also together with our external partners. You must be a highly self-motivated individual, able to embrace changes, process a strong ability to work independently and live the values of Neste.
Together with you and your expertise, we can make an impact today and keep our promises for tomorrow.
Reasons to join
We operate in an inspiring and evolving business environment as a global leader in renewable fuels. We contribute to Neste’s success by living our values every day: we care, we have courage, we cooperate.
We prioritize safety at all times and in every location. We strive to create a positive and impactful work environment.
Transformation brings new possibilities and fosters our courage and curiosity. As a global company, we support personal development with versatile learning and career opportunities. Collaboration is key, and we believe in flexible, smart ways of working. We work at the office at least three days a week to ensure seamless teamwork and a sense of belonging.
More about the job
Your role in our team / in creating a sustainable future
● Responsible to plan, prepare and execution of events related to Operations including operations resource planning for designated unit(s). Events are defined as:
-Turn-arounds (TA)
- Unit shut-downs (SD)
- Major maintenance activities i.e. Tank-inspections, absorbent changes etc.
- (Pre)Commissioning and initial start-up of capital investment projects
● Back-up Event team member in Turn-arounds and Unit Shut-downs
● Responsible and monitoring TA/SD execution and instruct shift teams accordingly and reporting progress
● Liaison of Operations to 3rd parties/suppliers related to operations support for preparing and execution of Turn-arounds and Shut-downs assigned by Operations Event Lead
●Responsible (within Operations) for optimizing the Shut-down, Start-up and Clearing work instructions for designated area
● Responsible for correcting, reviewing and improving assigned Operations NMS Work Procedures
● Responsible for review of Shift Team Operations Shut Down Instruction to ensure all the scope are covered in the instructions
● Responsible to communicate and train shift teams related to events
● Work closely with all Internal & External stakeholders.
Keys to success in this role / The best combination to succeed in this role
-
Diploma in Chemical Engineering or similar
-
Minimum Polytechnic Diploma with 3 years of supervisory experience OR Higher NITEC with 5 years of supervisory experience OR GCE ‘O’ level with 8 years of supervisory experience in a Petrochemical /Refinery Environment
Let’s get you started
We look forward to receiving your CV and application.
To ensure security and confidentiality, please submit your application through our recruitment system, as we are unable to consider applications sent via email.
We will do our best to contact you after the application time has ended. The recruitment process will include interviews and a potential aptitude assessment.
Depending on the location and the requirements of the position, the process may include a health examination and/or a security clearance.
Neste in brief
Neste (NESTE, Nasdaq Helsinki) is the world's leading producer of renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel (SAF), with production on three continents. The company’s renewables production capacity is expected to reach 6.8 million tons annually in 2027. Neste also produces high-quality oil products at its Porvoo refinery in Finland. The company has a network of nearly 1,000 fuel stations with expanding service offering, such as EV charging, in Finland and in the Baltics.

Title: 2027 Deutsche Bank Graduate Programme - Corporate Bank - Singapore
Description:
Job Description
About the programme:
The Deutsche Bank Graduate Programme is a year-long comprehensive programme designed to provide you with exposure to a range of fascinating projects and ongoing professional and technical training to develop the skills you need to grow your career. You’ll feel supported by a network of peers and mentors and benefit from our global wellbeing programme.
About the division:
The Corporate Bank is a market leader in cash management, lending, trade finance, trust and agency services, securities services and risk management for FX and Rates. We have deep client relationships and our client solutions relate directly to the real economy.
Products
Cash Management: Delivers a wide range of innovative payment and cash management related products to corporates and non-bank financial institutions.
Coverage: Our Coverage team manages the Corporate Bank’s key client relationships across the full suite of Corporate and Investment Bank products.
Institutional Cash Management: Delivers a wide range of innovative payment and cash management related products to financial institutions.
Trade Finance & Lending: Covers the full range of corporate lending solutions and provides solutions related to imports, exports or domestic trade transactions.
Relationship & Transaction Management: Incorporates our client relationship management with service and implementation across all Corporate Bank products. It is the largest team within Corporate Bank division and at the forefront of change management.
Within each area you will have the opportunity to perform multiple roles such as Sales, Product Management, Client Service & Delivery or Business Management
About the role:
Your training starts with an invaluable Global induction that will give you a broad understanding of our business. Our senior leadership will share their vision for Deutsche Bank with you.
After that you will participate in our Divisional Technical Training and Professional Skills Training followed by a 12 month comprehensive continuous learning journey, with opportunities for networking throughout and a supportive wellbeing programme.
Then you'll work alongside, and learn from, exceptionally talented colleagues in a friendly, supportive culture where people are open and approachable. Working on our day-to-day business as well as on special projects, you will contribute to the innovation of new ideas to help our clients achieve their financial goals. There’s a range of a work and clients that will enable you to make an early impact on what we do best – generating inventive, effective solutions for our clients.
Our people are innovative problem solvers, driven by intellectual curiosity and a commitment to excellence.
We are recruiting for a junior analyst within the Corporate Banking Coverage team. Our Regional Corporate Coverage team provides our clients with holistic solutions to meet their strategic objectives – with full access across the Corporate Bank’s product suite as well as the expertise of the Investment Bank across the Asia Pacific Region. In this role, you will support the Team with their main responsibilities:
Coverage and originator to identify opportunities and structure solutions in coordination with product partners across the corporate bank product suite.
Close coordination with global and local country relationship bankers to ensure integrated and seamless coverage for our clients Regional Treasury Centre / Fintech platform and digital economy sector clients.
Client centricity, deepen relationships and wallet share with existing clients as well as actively developing new client relationships.
Advise clients, provide insights into the latest macroeconomic, geopolitical issue and regulatory trends in Asia impacting our clients and the industry they operate in.
Keep abreast of developments in the client business and the industry ecosystem, and manage risks within the portfolio
Our people are innovative problem solvers, driven by intellectual curiosity and a commitment to excellence.
Responsibilities of the role include:
Participating in daily banking activities to maximise our client’s engagement across multiple products
Building relationship with our clients at all levels through new products and expanding into new markets
Ensuring we provide our clients with holistic solutions to meet their strategic objectives
We are recruiting for a junior analyst within the Merchant Solutions team. This team works towards connecting and powering an inclusive digital economy that benefits our clients and partners everywhere by making transactions simple, safe, smart and accessible using secure data and trusted networks, partnerships. We combine the best of traditional bank treasury solutions with global payment service provider capabilities. Deutsche Bank offers a full spectrum of integrated payment solutions around payment acceptance and payment issuing, marketplace, FX and financing. Our products range from card acceptance and alternative payment methods to the card issuance and wallets, as well as integrated FX and lending workflow solutions for eCommerce and ePOS.
Responsibilities of the role include:
Product management, develop a world-class product vision, strategy and roadmap
Manage end-to-end product development
Inspire a customer-centric and data-driven product culture
What we look for:
We recruit students and graduates who are intelligent and adaptable with excellent communication skills; proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimize workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs. They have degrees in many different disciplines. Even though good levels of numeracy are important for some roles, you won’t necessarily need a formal mathematical or financial background. Our comprehensive training programmes will give you all the technical knowledge you’ll need to build a career with us.
To be eligible for the 2027 Graduate Programme you must:
• Complete your studies (all final exams, coursework and have no outstanding requirements for graduation) between 1st January 2026 and 31st July 2027.
• Be able to start full time work in July 2027, subject to local working legislation and visa requirements.
• Possess no more than 12 months full-time, relevant work experience.
Roles requirements for Regional Corporate Banking Coverage team
Ability to think quickly and efficiently deal with clients and other counterparties
A strong intellectual curiosity
A keen interest in macroeconomics and global financial markets / the Fintech platform and digital economy sector
A driven, ambitious mindset
Demonstrate problem solving skills
Strong communication, organizational and interpersonal skills
Role requirements for Merchant Solutions team
Bachelor degree in business administration, business management, computer science, information systems or similar courses
Technical / software / product background
Basic understanding of payment acceptance
Excellent communication skills with outspoken / proactive personality, good networker internally and towards external parties

Feeling healthy, engaged and well-supported, enables us to do our best work and get the most out of life outside of the office. That’s why Deutsche Bank is committed to providing benefits and programmes centered around wellbeing. Benefits & Wellbeing – Deutsche Bank Careers (db.com)

Our values define the working environment we strive to create – where our people have a sense of belonging and everyone feels welcomed, respected and can contribute and grow. We know that high-performing teams have different skills, backgrounds, and experiences. We collaborate, encourage and enable open dialogue and diversity of views. Title: Academy Executive (Partnerships)
Description:
Job Description
Join us as Academy Executive (Partnerships)!
Are you looking for a fulfilling job that provides opportunities for you to make a real difference to the community and youth through meaningful work? Are you looking for a place of work that promotes a culture of growth and development, while having fun? We are looking for an Academy Executive (Partnerships) to join our growing full-time team.
Halogen aims to inspire and influence a generation of young people to lead themselves and others well, and we take that mission seriously with our staff as well. Being a youth development organisation, we work with the youthful vibrancy of our stakeholders and students, ensuring that while we do the social good of building young leaders and entrepreneurs, we also do the personal good of building a staff team that is enabled to do their best work. As an Academy Executive, you will play an important role in partnering multiple stakeholders, both local and in the ASEAN region to drive our youth programmes. You will be in charge of managing the partners who engage with us, and work closely with stakeholders to find opportunities to collaborate.
Responsibilities
Lead and facilitate training workshops/ learning sessions, helping youth we work with to build character, mindsets and skill sets. Facilitate group sizes up to 45 participants confidently.
Programme management - lead, organise and execute Halogen programmes and events.
Manage our youth community within our fellowship and accelerator programmes, supporting youth in their development, while continually improving and enhancing the infrastructure of the programmes.
Support the organisation in our work within ASEAN, engaging different stakeholders to open opportunities for collaboration.
Manage partnerships directly with corporates, social impact organisations, and educational institutions to ensure successful implementation of programmes through effective communication.
•Support outreach efforts to widen our net of partners to expand Halogen’s scope ofwork.

Working with a range partners from corporates, to social impact organisations and institutions, managing conversations, and finding avenues to align objectives of our partners to Halogen’s long term growth plan.
Leading on key events and programmes organised by Halogen.
Working alongside youths and stakeholders to ensure the successful design of our youth accelerator programme.
Team meetings that cover programme planning, outreach to stakeholders, and managing progress of partnerships.
Work alongside the Fundraising department to secure funds and resources for programmes.

At least 2 years of experience managing partnerships, events and programmes. Experiences working on programmes regionally in ASEAN would be considered favourably.

Description:
Company Description:
Publicis Groupe is not just a company you work for; it’s a platform for you to take your talent to the world.
If you want to help change the world, ideas alone are not enough. Real impact can only come from having meaningful access to a world of knowledge, people and resources. At Publicis Groupe, you are connected to our global network, intelligence, tools, clients, brands and 80,000 brilliant minds with expertise in data, technology, media, strategy, creativity and business transformation, all literally at your fingertips.
Go ahead, the world is waiting.
Publicis Groupe is the largest communications group in the world. Founded in Paris in 1926, we are present in more than 100 countries as leaders in marketing, communication, and digital business transformation. Two of its biggest solution hubs in Singapore - Publicis Communications and Publicis Media & Digital.
Publicis Communications, the creative communications hub of the Publicis Groupe, is a collective of the most passionate, purposeful, and progressive creative agencies in Singapore. They are Publicis Worldwide, Leo Burnett, Saatchi & Saatchi, Prodigious, and MSL.
Publicis Media & Digital, which is comprised of global media agency brands Starcom, Zenith, Spark Foundry, and Performics, is powered by digital-first, data-driven global practices that together, help our clients navigate the modern media landscape.
Our two other solution hubs, Publicis Sapient and Publicis Commerce, empower businesses to embrace digital transformation and equip them with a total commerce experience.
Overview:
We are looking for an experienced Account Director - Senior Account Director who can act as a senior communications specialist and strategic client lead across a portfolio of high-profile corporate and consumer brands. The role will lead accounts such as Science Centre Singapore, TWG Tea and PropertyGuru, with responsibility for communications strategy, senior client counsel, earned media and reputation, integrated campaign development, team leadership and account growth.
The successful candidate must bring deep PR and communications expertise and be able to independently shape narratives, distil and unpack briefs, identify reputational and earned opportunities, counsel senior clients and spokespeople, and lead teams to deliver communications programmes that create meaningful public and media impact. At Senior Account Director level, the role will also be expected to operate as part of the agency’s senior leadership bench, with broader responsibility for people development, business growth and the quality of the agency’s communications thinking.
Responsibilities:
Strategic client counsel & account leadership
Lead senior client relationships and act as a trusted point of counsel on communications strategy, reputation, positioning and campaign direction.
Critically analyse briefs and business challenges, identify the real communications problem to solve, and recommend the right approach rather than simply executing a prescribed scope.
Lead strategic planning across assigned accounts, ensuring programmes have clear objectives, audiences, narratives, KPIs and a strong earned rationale.
Anticipate client needs, issues and opportunities, and proactively course-correct accounts where required.
Orchestrate account teams end-to-end, setting priorities, maintaining momentum and ensuring clients receive consistently senior, high-quality counsel.
PR strategy, earned media & reputation
Own the earned communications strategy across accounts, including corporate profiling, consumer storytelling, thought leadership, media engagement and issues preparedness.
Bring strong news judgement and a sophisticated understanding of the Singapore media environment, including how different newsrooms, verticals and stakeholders assess relevance and credibility.
Develop strong media narratives and story architecture that connect client business priorities with wider cultural, consumer, industry or societal conversations.
Build and leverage senior relationships with editors, journalists, creators, influencers and other relevant opinion-formers and stakeholders.
Provide senior counsel on reactive communications, sensitive issues and reputational considerations, including when to engage, how to position and when not to pursue publicity.
Lead senior spokesperson preparation for interviews, announcements and high-stakes external engagements.
Content, messaging & integrated communications
Counsel teams and clients on communications strategy, messaging and narrative development across corporate and consumer audiences.
Guide the development of high-quality communications materials including strategic plans, key messages, press materials, speeches, briefing documents, thought-leadership content and executive communications.
Provide senior editorial judgement and ensure work is persuasive, audience-led and strategically sharp, not simply factually correct.
Partner with Creative, Social, Influence and other specialist teams to develop integrated ideas with a strong communications backbone and clear potential to earn attention.
Ensure channel choices support the communications objective, bringing together earned, owned, social, creator and paid activity where appropriate rather than defaulting to a single discipline.
Stakeholder, campaign & event leadership
Lead the agency approach to stakeholder engagement across media, influencers, partners, industry bodies, communities and other relevant audiences.
Oversee major launches, media programmes, experiential activations, briefings and events, ensuring the communications story is clear and the experience delivers against strategic objectives.
Represent clients and the agency confidently in senior stakeholder engagements, meetings, interviews and external forums.
Think ahead on potential risks, sensitivities and opportunities, and ensure teams are prepared to troubleshoot effectively.
Team leadership & capability building
Lead, coach and develop Account Managers, Executives and junior team members through both formal and day-to-day guidance.
Set the strategic and quality bar for teams, helping them move beyond task delivery into stronger judgement, counsel and communications thinking.
Resource accounts effectively, bringing in the right specialists and senior support when needed while maintaining commercial discipline.
Create confident, motivated teams and provide clear direction during complex or high-pressure periods.
Contribute to the agency’s communications capability through training, mentoring, best-practice development and active championing of agency culture and standards.
Commercial leadership, account growth & new business
Own the commercial health of assigned accounts, including scope, resourcing, budget management, profitability and contract considerations.
Identify and convert opportunities to deepen existing client relationships and grow accounts organically through relevant communications counsel and new initiatives.
Lead or play a senior role in new business development, from strategic response and proposition development through pitch narrative and presentation.
Build strong chemistry with prospective clients and bring a clear senior point of view that demonstrates the agency’s communications expertise.
At Senior Account Director level, contribute to broader agency growth priorities, capability development and senior management discussions.
Qualifications:
Approximately 10+ years of relevant PR and communications experience, ideally within an agency environment, with a proven track record leading significant client relationships and teams.
Essential: deep, hands-on PR and earned communications expertise. Candidates must have personally led communications strategy, media narratives, senior media engagement and client counsel — not only managed integrated campaign delivery.
Strong strategic judgement and the ability to connect business objectives, audience insight, reputation and earned opportunity into a clear communications recommendation.
Established understanding of the Singapore media and stakeholder landscape, with credible senior media relationships and the confidence to advise clients on what will and will not earn attention.
Excellent writing, messaging and editorial judgement, with the ability to simplify complex information and sharpen the work of others.
Confidence counselling senior clients and spokespeople, including challenging assumptions constructively and navigating sensitive or ambiguous communications situations.
Proven ability to lead multiple accounts and teams, manage resourcing and commercial considerations, and maintain quality across a demanding portfolio.
Experience across corporate and consumer communications is strongly preferred. Exposure to public-sector/institutional, luxury/lifestyle, property/technology or similarly complex categories would be advantageous.

Title: Account Executive
Description:
Job Description
Posting Start Date: 15/10/2026
Brand: MCI
Country/Region: Singapore
Work Location: Singapore
Workplace Type: Hybrid
Contract type: Permanent
Job Function: Account Management
Information at a Glance
We are a global engagement marketing agency that creates human-centric touchpoints that unleash the power of people to deliver innovation and growth. Firm believers in the power of building community since 1987, we are helping brands, associations and not-for-profit organisations solve their key people challenges through our core expertise: Live & virtual events, Strategic & digital communications and Consulting & community solutions. We are an independently owned agency, headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, with a global presence of 60 offices in 31 countries.
THE OPPORTUNITY
At MCI, we believe great experiences start with great people, bold ideas, and strong collaboration. As an Account Executive, you will be an integral part of the team, working closely with Account Managers and colleagues to bring exciting brand experiences, events, and marketing campaigns to life.
From supporting new business pitches and developing creative ideas to sourcing suppliers, preparing costings, and servicing client accounts, you will be involved in the action from day one. This is an opportunity to learn, contribute, and grow while playing a meaningful role in delivering impactful experiences for our clients.
THE WORK
1. Support Pitches & New Business Development
Work closely with Account Managers and the wider team to develop compelling pitch proposals and presentations.
Contribute ideas, research trends, explore creative concepts, and help turn client briefs into engaging event and marketing experiences.
Research venues, suppliers, entertainment, activities, and other event elements to support creative recommendations.
Source quotations, develop cost estimates, compare supplier options, and support budget preparation to ensure ideas are both exciting and commercially viable.
Assist in preparing pitch decks, proposals, and supporting materials that bring our ideas to life and help us win new business.
2. Support Account Servicing & Client Relationships
Work alongside Account Managers to support the day-to-day servicing of client accounts, ensuring projects and requests are managed efficiently.
Assist in understanding client briefs, coordinating internal teams, and following up on project deliverables.
Prepare meeting materials, project updates, reports, timelines, and other account documentation.
Build positive working relationships with clients, suppliers, and internal stakeholders through clear communication and a collaborative approach.
Stay curious about our clients’ businesses, brands, and objectives, and look for opportunities to contribute ideas that add value.
THE CONNECTION
Reports To
Account Manager (for daily activities)
Works Closely With
Sales Team (Local and Regional), Operation Team / Project Managers, Sales Support and other Product Practices within MCI.
THE MUST HAVE
This role is suitable for well-rounded individuals with business, hospitality, or a marketing degree.
1 – 3 years of experience in the meetings and events and/or hotel and hospitality industry would be an advantage.
1 – 3 years of experience in the account management or account servicing role would be an advantage.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Office and presentation development, are essential.
Great customer mindset, proactive disposition with strong negotiation and problem-solving skills.
Result driven personality with energy, commitment and a strong drive to succeed.
THE GOOD TO HAVE
Adaptable and solution oriented, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
Strong sense of ownership, responsibility, and attention to detail
Willingness to travel and support onsite delivery when required
ADDITIONAL LOCAL BENEFITS
Birthday Leave
Employer-paid Business Travel Insurance, unlimited Whitecoat tele consults, Dental & Vision reimbursements
Employer-paid Group Hospital & Surgical, Outpatient Clinical, Outpatient Specialist & Personal Accident Insurance
Comprehensive internal Learning & Development portal and opportunities for external courses
MCI is where you can bring your true self to work and be proud of what you do. Join us and make a difference!
