We're on the lookout for talented individuals like yourself to join our dynamic team and lead the charge in seizing new business opportunities within mid-market segment. As an Account Executive in the ever-evolving world of SaaS, you'll be at the forefront of our sales efforts, reporting directly to the Sales Director.
Joining Meltwater means immersing yourself in a culture of continuous growth and development. Our environment is tailored to nurture your leadership skills, encourage collaboration, and uphold principles of inclusive leadership. Collaborate with seasoned professionals and influential leaders who are committed to guiding you towards success.
Partner with us, and you'll integrate into a vibrant community that recognizes and celebrates your contributions, empowering you to make a meaningful impact. Let's embark on this journey together as we redefine the landscape of sales management and drive impactful change!
What You'll Do:
Proactively generate and develop your own pipeline within the dynamic mid-market segment through outbound prospecting, cold calling, email outreach, networking, and other targeted business development activities.
Captivate potential clients with engaging product demonstrations and persuasive sales presentations that showcase the value of Meltwater's solutions.
Tailor carefully crafted proposals that not only address client needs but also exceed expectations, setting the stage for lasting partnerships.
Serve as a trusted advisor throughout the purchasing journey, guiding prospects with confidence and clarity through solution exploration and pricing considerations.
Champion win-win outcomes through skilled negotiation of contract terms and pricing, ensuring alignment and satisfaction on all fronts.
Seize every opportunity for growth by identifying upselling opportunities and nurturing relationships beyond the initial sale, fostering loyalty and trust.
Thrive in a results-driven environment by consistently surpassing sales targets and securing deals at competitive price points.
Foster seamless integration and ongoing success by collaborating closely with internal teams, leveraging collective expertise to deliver unparalleled customer experiences.
What You'll Bring:
A Bachelor's degree or higher, showcasing your academic excellence and providing a solid foundation for success in this role.
A minimum of 3-5 years of experience in business-to-business sales is required, with a strong track record of success.
Strong negotiation skills and the ability to effectively communicate complex value propositions, ensuring clarity and alignment with clients.
Proven results-oriented mindset, with a track record of consistently achieving and surpassing sales targets.
Ability to identify upsell opportunities and maintain ownership of accounts, driving continued growth and satisfaction.
Proactivity in conducting targeted outreach and lead generation activities, demonstrating initiative and resourcefulness.
Excellent organizational skills, including adept management of the customer purchase process and proficient negotiation of contract terms.
Collaborative mindset, capable of coordinating seamlessly with internal teams for successful implementation and client satisfaction.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Willingness to embrace the best of both worlds with our hybrid work schedule. This role requires you to be in the office 3 days a week.
The ability to legally work in the country of hire is required for this position.
What We Offer:
Enjoy flexible paid time off options for enhanced work-life balance.
Comprehensive health insurance tailored for you, complete with an annual health check.
Special discount on selected restaurants/shops through our food delivery partner.
Employee assistance programs cover mental health, legal, financial, wellness, and behaviour areas to ensure your overall well-being.
Complimentary CalmApp subscription for you and your loved ones, because mental wellness matters.
Energetic work environment with a hybrid work style, providing the balance you need.
Benefit from our family leave program, which grows with your tenure at Meltwater.
Thrive within our inclusive community and seize ongoing professional development opportunities to elevate your career.
Where You'll Work: 60 Anson Rd, #18-03 Mapletree Anson, Singapore 079914
When You'll Join: January 2027

At Meltwater, we believe that when you have the right people in the right environment, great things happen.
Our best-in-class technology empowers our 27,000 customers around the world to make better business decisions through data. But we can’t do that without our global team of developers, innovators, problem-solvers, and high-performers who embrace challenges and find new solutions for our customers.

We are innovators at the core who see the potential in people, ideas and technologies. Together, we challenge ourselves to go big, be bold, and build best-in-class solutions for our customers.
We’re proud of our diverse team of 2,200+ employees in 50 locations across 25 countries around the world. No matter where you are, you’ll work with people who care about your success and get the support you need to unlock new heights in your career.
We are Meltwater. Inspired by innovation, powered by people.

Title: Account Executive, SG
Description:
About HitPay
HitPay is a Singapore-headquartered payments company, founded in 2016, that helps small and medium-sized businesses accept payments online and in person across Southeast Asia and beyond. We give our partners one platform for cards, real-time bank payments, e-wallets, BNPL, cross-border payment methods, POS and terminals — with no setup fees and no monthly fees. In Singapore, we hold a MAS Major Payment Institution licence. In 2026, HitPay was named to CNBC's World's Top Fintech Companies list (top 500 globally, produced with Statista) and recognised as one of the top 27 startups in Singapore by Tech in Asia.
The role
You'll own new business for HitPay's core acceptance products in Singapore — winning SMB and mid-market businesses that want to take payments more simply and more cheaply, across online and in-store channels. This is a full-cycle, quota-carrying role: you'll prospect, run demos, handle commercials and objections, get partners live, and set them up for long-term growth on HitPay.
You'll sell into a busy, competitive market where businesses already have a bank terminal, a global gateway or both. Winning means understanding how each business actually takes money today, and showing them a better setup.
What you'll sell
- Online payments: payment gateway, plugins for platforms like Shopify, WooCommerce and Wix, payment links, invoicing and recurring billing
- In-person payments: POS app, card terminals, Tap to Pay on iPhone and Android, static QR and soundbox
- Payment methods: cards, PayNow, GrabPay, ShopeePay, BNPL, plus cross-border and tourist payment methods (e.g. Alipay+, WeChat Pay, UPI)
What you'll do
- Build and manage your own pipeline through outbound prospecting, inbound leads, events, and referral and platform partners
- Run discovery and product demos tailored to verticals such as F&B, retail, e-commerce, education, fitness and travel
- Design the right acceptance setup for each partner — channels, payment methods, hardware and integrations — and build the commercial case versus their current provider
- Negotiate pricing within guidelines and close deals; work with Onboarding and Risk to get partners through KYB and live quickly
- Drive early activation and volume in the first 90 days, then hand over cleanly to Account Management, or keep growing the account where agreed
- Keep CRM data accurate and forecast reliably every week
- Feed what you hear in the market back to Product and Marketing — competitor moves, missing features, pricing pressure
- Spot partners who would benefit from CFO Stack products and bring in the CFO Stack team
What you'll bring
- [2–5] years of closing experience in B2B sales, ideally in payments, fintech or SaaS selling to SMBs
- A track record of hitting or beating quota in a high-velocity, full-cycle sales role
- Comfort prospecting: cold calls, walk-ins, LinkedIn, events — you create your own pipeline
- Enough technical understanding to talk through integrations, checkout flows and terminal setups with business owners and their developers
- Familiarity with Singapore's payments landscape (PayNow, card schemes, merchant acquiring, BNPL) and its SMB ecosystem
- Clear, confident communication in English; [Mandarin, Malay or another regional language] is a plus
- Self-driven and organised, with a strong sense of ownership
How we'll measure success
- New partners signed and gone live against monthly and quarterly targets
- Processing volume (TPV) and net revenue from new partners in their first 90 days
- Time from signed to first transaction
- Pipeline coverage and forecast accuracy

You will be in tune with the local restaurant industry and will proactively engage with our restaurant customers. You will be innovative in overcoming customer obstacles, and provide constructive perspectives to challenge current thinking. In This Role, You Will
Work closely with customers to increase product and feature adoption, improve their online availability and ultimately grow their business through our partnership.

Proactively incorporate company strategies into your work and constantly be on the lookout for opportunities to increase your impact with customers.

Stay current with organisational changes, initiatives, and vision.
Work collaboratively with colleagues and key internal stakeholders.

You are passionate about hospitality and technology. Restaurant management and/or sales experience in the food and beverage industry is preferred but not essential.
You are curious, humble and have an eagerness to learn.
You are able to effectively influence and use data to guide your decisions.
You're self-motivated and have the grit necessary to thrive against ambitious expectations.
You naturally communicate well, and can establish trust with people genuinely and quickly.

Sembcorp is a leading energy and urban solutions provider headquartered in Singapore. Led by its purpose to drive energy transition, Sembcorp delivers sustainable energy solutions and urban developments by leveraging its sector expertise and global track record.
Join us in shaping a sustainable energy future
Drive Asia’s energy transition with us! Our Gas & Related Services segment is a key growth engine, delivering reliable and efficient energy to industries and communities across multiple countries. We support Asia’s growing energy needs while advancing the shift to a lower-carbon future.
Purpose and Scope
We are looking for a commercially minded professional to support the origination, negotiation and execution of electricity supply agreements for commercial and industrial customers across different sectors. The role will cover thermal, renewable and low-carbon electricity solutions.

Relevant experience in commercial sales, business development, customer account management, deal support or contract management, preferably in power, utilities, energy, sustainability or related sectors. Title: Admin & Client Servicing Executive (Events & Media)
Description:
RS Photography is a Singapore photography and video production company. Since 2013 we have delivered over 2,600 assignments for 693 clients, and we run 150 to 160 shoots a month for government agencies, associations and corporate clients: conferences, award ceremonies, exhibitions, national events and corporate portraits.
We are hiring an Admin Executive. Our job title is Admin & Client Servicing Executive (Events & Media). You will be the person our clients deal with day to day, and the person who keeps our bookings, quotations and invoicing running cleanly. It is a single, defined seat reporting directly to the Director. The work is yours to own, not to assist with.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Run day-to-day office and admin matters independently
- Be the first reply to client enquiries by email and phone, and stay the named contact through to delivery
- Prepare quotations from our standard rate cards for the Director's approval, and follow up on the ones that go quiet
- Work our daily sales queue: review outreach drafts to event organisers and exhibitors, send the approved batches, and log every reply the same day
- Turn replies into bookings: confirm dates, booth numbers and hours, and prepare quotations from our standard rate cards for approval
- Book and brief our freelance photographers and videographers for busy show weeks, so every confirmed booth has a named crew member
- Raise invoices, submit e-invoices online, and track payment, including government purchase orders and their reference numbers
- Turn confirmed jobs into calendar bookings with complete details: contact person, venue, reporting time, shoot requirements, billing notes
- Prepare the weekly shoot schedule and coordinate between clients and our photographers and videographers
- Assist with tender and quotation submissions on government procurement portals
- Handle HR paperwork: employment letters, work pass applications and renewals
- Keep company documents and vendor registrations current
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
- At least 2 years in an admin, client servicing, coordination or account support role
- Confident written English. You will be writing to clients directly, often to government officers
- Comfortable writing and sending a high volume of professional emails, and keeping a simple tracker up to date
- Comfortable with numbers: quotations, invoices, purchase orders, simple reconciliation
- Organised under volume. We run 150 to 160 jobs a month; the details are the job
- Working knowledge of Google Workspace or Microsoft Office
- You can use AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to draft, summarise and organise work, and you check the output before it goes to a client. You will show us at the interview
- Someone who follows up without being chased
NICE TO HAVE, NOT REQUIRED
- Experience in events, media, production, an agency, or another service business with many small jobs
- Exposure to government procurement: GeBIZ, Vendors@Gov, InvoiceNow, purchase orders
- Experience with work pass applications or HR administration
- Invoicing or bookkeeping software experience
WHAT WE OFFER
- S$2,800 to S$3,000 per month, all fixed, depending on experience
- A 5-day work week, Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm with a one-hour lunch break
- A defined seat reporting to the Director, with real ownership
- A team of 10 where your work is visible and matters
- Training on our booking, quotation and invoicing process in your first weeks
- CPF, annual leave and public holidays in accordance with the Employment Act
LOCATION
Midview City, 22 Sin Ming Lane #06-82, Singapore 573969, in the Sin Ming and Bishan area. This role is based in our Singapore office and we are not able to sponsor employment passes.
HOW TO APPLY
Apply through Indeed with your CV. Please tell us your earliest available start date. We are hiring now, and candidates who can start sooner will be prioritised.

Title: ADMISSIONS SPECIALIST
Description:
ADMISSIONS SPECIALIST
ABOUT
RD American School partners exclusively with Riverdale Country School - one of America's top-ranked private schools. We are more than an educational institution - we are an accelerator of learning. Our approach is grounded in cognitive science and modern pedagogy, empowering students to thrive in a complex, fast-changing world.
ROLE
The Admissions Specialist is responsible for driving student enrollment growth by managing the full admissions lifecycle, from lead generation and relationship building through application processing and enrollment conversion. Acting as both an admissions advisor and business development professional, the role proactively identifies and nurtures prospective families while ensuring an exceptional admissions experience.
The successful candidate will be a relationship-focused professional who is comfortable engaging with prospective parents, developing community partnerships, conducting school tours, managing a sales pipeline, and achieving enrollment targets.
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES
Student Recruitment
Proactively identify, engage, and cultivate prospective families to generate new student enrollment opportunities.
Manage the admissions pipeline from initial inquiry through successful enrollment.
Build and maintain relationships with corporate partners, relocation agencies, embassies, education consultants, community groups, and referral networks.
Conduct outreach activities, networking initiatives, and recruitment campaigns to increase market awareness and generate qualified leads.
Re-engage dormant inquiries and prospective families to maximise enrollment opportunities.
Support parent referral and ambassador programmes to strengthen word-of-mouth recruitment.
Represent the school at education fairs, community events, corporate engagements, and recruitment activities.
Contribute towards achieving annual enrollment and retention targets.
Admissions& Family Engagement
Serve as a primary point of contact for prospective families throughout the admissions journey.
Provide accurate and timely information regarding academic programmes, admissions requirements, school culture, and tuition fees.
Conduct professional campus tours, information sessions, and admissions presentations.
Build strong relationships with prospective families and guide them through the decision-making process.
Maintain regular follow-up communications to support conversion from inquiry to enrollment.
Deliver a consistently high standard of customer service and parent experience.
Application & Enrollment Management
Process student applications and ensure all supporting documentation is complete and compliant.
Coordinate assessments, interviews, and placement evaluations with academic teams.
Prepare admissions offers, enrollment agreements, and associated documentation.
Monitor application progress and proactively manage timelines to ensure efficient processing.
Support onboarding and transition activities for newly enrolled students and families.
Maintain waiting lists and assist with enrollment forecasting activities.
CRM, Reporting & Administration
Maintain accurate and up-to-date records within the school's CRM and Student Information Systems.
Track and manage inquiries, applications, enrollments, withdrawals, and conversion metrics.
Generate admissions activity reports and enrollment pipeline updates.
Monitor individual performance against enrollment and conversion targets.
Ensure compliance with PDPA requirements and school policies relating to student data and confidentiality.
Internal Collaboration
Work closely with the Admissions Manager to achieve student recruitment and enrollment objectives.
Collaborate with the Marketing team on lead generation campaigns and admissions communications.
Coordinate with Academic staff regarding assessments and student placements.
Liaise with Finance and Operations teams on enrollment documentation, onboarding, and student commencement processes.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the admissions function.
REQUIREMENTS
Education & Experience
Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Education, Hospitality, or a related field.
2-5 years of experience in admissions, student recruitment, business development, customer service, hospitality, education, or consultative sales.
Experience within an international school or education environment is advantageous.
Familiarity with CRM systems, customer relationship management, or sales pipeline management preferred.
Skills & Experience
Strong business development, networking, and relationship management capabilities.
Proven ability to build and nurture prospects through a sales or admissions pipeline.
Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills.
Strong customer service and stakeholder engagement skills.
Ability to influence and guide families through complex decision-making processes.
Highly organised with strong attention to detail and follow-through.
Ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines and enrollment targets.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM systems.
Personal Attributes
Professional, confident, and personable communicator.
Results-driven and motivated by achieving targets.
Proactive and solutions-oriented.
Adaptable and resilient in a fast-paced environment.
Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and integrity.
Culturally sensitive with the ability to engage families from diverse backgrounds.
At RD American School, you’ll be part of a forward-thinking team shaping the future of education. You’ll have the opportunity to innovate, lead, and make a meaningful impact on learners and families across the region.

Title: Aftermarket Product Sales Manager
Description:
If you desire to be part of something special, to be part of a winning team, to be part of a fun team – winning is fun. We are looking forward to an Aftermarket Product Sales Manager in Eaton’s Aerospace business, based in Singapore. In Eaton, making our work exciting, engaging, meaningful; ensuring safety, health, wellness; and being a model of inclusion & diversity are already embedded in who we are - it’s in our values, part of our vision, and our clearly defined aspirational goals.
What you’ll do:
Leads the business launch, market development, and profitable growth of aftermarket repair, overhaul, retrofit, modification, and upgrade solutions supported by Eaton Aerospace Component Services Asia (EAS) across the Asia Pacific region.
The Aftermarket Product Sales Manager serves as the commercial business owner for the assigned product lines and aftermarket programs. The position identifies and evaluates market opportunities, develops business and customer capture strategies, establishes pricing approaches, coordinates cross-functional business launch activities, and drives opportunities through execution to achieve order intake, sales, profitability, and market share objectives.
The position works closely with the APAC Sales team, EAS, FMC team, Product Management, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Customer Service, and other global stakeholders to translate customer and market requirements into commercially viable aftermarket solutions.
Following the establishment of EAS and the initial deployment of MRO capabilities, the role focuses primarily on launching and sustaining new business, developing the regional opportunity pipeline, expanding customer and product coverage, supporting new repair capability introduction, and ensuring that commercial commitments are converted into sustainable business performance and customer satisfaction.
• Market Development & Opportunity Identification - Identify and prioritize aftermarket repair, upgrade, and service opportunities through market, customer, and competitive analysis to drive profitable growth across APAC.
• Business Development & Customer Capture - Develop customer engagement and capture strategies in partnership with Sales and product teams to convert opportunities into bookings and revenue.
• Opportunity Pipeline Management - Manage the regional opportunity pipeline and drive execution to improve opportunity conversion, forecast accuracy, and business growth.
• Business Launch & Commercial Execution - Lead commercial activities for new business launches, ensuring customer requirements and market opportunities are successfully translated into executable growth plans.
• Capability Expansion & Business Cases - upport new repair capability and service expansion initiatives through market assessments, business case development, and revenue projections.
• Pricing & Commercial Strategy - Develop pricing strategies and commercial proposals that support competitiveness, profitability, and long-term business growth.
• Market Intelligence - Monitor market trends, fleet developments, customer needs, and competitor activities to support strategic decision-making and growth initiatives.
• Forecasting & Business Planning - Prepare forecasts and business analyses that support Profit Plan, SIOP, business reviews, and strategic planning activities.
• Cross-Functional Coordination - Coordinate commercial, operational, and technical stakeholders to support successful business launches and opportunity execution.
• Business Performance Management - Monitor sales, pipeline, pricing, and profitability performance and recommend actions to improve business results and customer satisfaction.
• Customer & Partner Engagement - Support customer engagement and build effective relationships with airlines, MROs, distributors, and strategic partners to expand aftermarket business opportunities.
• Sales Enablement & Knowledge Sharing - Develop sales tools, customer presentations, and training materials to improve commercial effectiveness and organizational capability.
Qualifications:
• Requires a bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Marketing, Aviation, or a related discipline. An MBA or advanced degree is preferred.
• Requires a minimum of five years of relevant experience in sales, product management, business development, marketing, program management, or a related commercial role.
• Requires strong business acumen and the ability to understand customer requirements, market trends, competitive dynamics, business case financials, pricing considerations, and the commercial implications of operational decisions.
• Requires knowledge of the aerospace industry. Experience in aerospace aftermarket, airline maintenance, MRO, component repair, product support, or related service businesses is preferred.
• Requires the ability to conduct market assessments, customer analysis, competitive analysis, opportunity qualification, and business case development.
• Requires the ability to translate market and customer information into practical growth strategies, value propositions, commercial plans, and cross-functional execution actions.
• Requires an understanding of aftermarket business models, including repair and overhaul services, retrofit, modification and upgrade programs, long-term agreements, PBH arrangements, and service capability development.
• Requires demonstrated capability in opportunity pipeline management, sales forecasting, commercial planning, pricing strategy, and performance analysis.
• Requires effective program and project management skills to coordinate business launches, capability expansion activities, customer commitments, and cross-functional deliverables.
• Requires the ability to operate effectively within a global and highly matrixed organization, influence stakeholders without direct authority, and drive alignment across commercial and operational functions.
• Requires strong customer interface skills and the ability to uncover customer needs, frame business problems, develop differentiated solutions, and contribute to winning capture strategies.
• Requires the ability to develop and maintain effective working relationships with customers, Sales teams, business leaders, product divisions, operational sites, and strategic partners.
• Requires strong analytical skills and proficiency in interpreting sales, forecast, customer, product, fleet, and financial information.
• Requires strong written and verbal communication, presentation, facilitation, and negotiation skills.
• Requires the ability to manage multiple priorities, make recommendations with incomplete information, and maintain execution discipline in a changing business environment.
• Requires proficiency in standard business systems and tools used for customer relationship management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, reporting, presentation development, and data analysis.
• Prefers experience supporting new capability deployment, MRO business launch, commercial integration, or regional expansion initiatives.

Title: AI Model Trainer
Description:
About ChronoAI
ChronoAI is a Singapore-headquartered AI technology company building infrastructure for the next generation of AI agents.
Our mission is to make persistent, always-on AI agents as easy to deploy as cloud services. We are building an Agent-as-a-Service ecosystem covering connectivity, runtime and skills.
Our products include NyxID, which connects AI agents to services and applications; Aevatar, infrastructure for persistent cloud-based agents; Ornn, a plug-and-play skill marketplace for AI agents; and Automath, an AI engine for mathematical discovery and formal verification.
At ChronoAI, we believe AI should handle more execution while humans focus on judgment, creativity and decision-making. We value people who are curious, move fast, take ownership and constantly look for smarter ways to solve problems.
About the Role
We are looking for an AI Model Trainer to improve model capabilities through better data, training methods and evaluation.
This is a hands-on, experimental role. You will turn complex knowledge and reasoning processes into structured training examples, investigate where models fail, and design experiments to determine what actually improves performance. You will work with domain experts, AI/ML engineers and leadership, but you should be comfortable forming your own hypotheses and taking ownership of the work from dataset design through to evaluation.
We care about more than a higher benchmark score. The right person can tell whether a model has learned a capability, identify when an apparent improvement is caused by data leakage or a weak evaluation, and explain the trade-offs behind the next experiment.
What You'll Do
Develop, curate and validate high-quality datasets for model training and fine-tuning.
Translate abstract concepts, domain expertise and multi-step reasoning into clear, machine-trainable examples.
Run training, fine-tuning and iterative optimisation experiments.
Design evaluation criteria, test cases and benchmarks that measure the capabilities we actually need.
Analyse model outputs for accuracy, reasoning quality, consistency and completeness.
Identify hallucinations, reasoning errors, knowledge gaps and recurring failure patterns; investigate their likely causes.
Experiment with prompting, synthetic data, training approaches and model selection, using results to decide what to try next.
Put quality controls around data generation and evaluation so errors are not amplified at scale.
Document datasets, methods, experiment results and decisions clearly enough for the team to reproduce and build on them.
Use AI tools and automation to accelerate repetitive work while maintaining rigorous human judgment over data quality and conclusions.
What We're Looking For
A degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Physics or a related discipline.
A strong understanding of machine learning and modern language models, with hands-on experience or solid practical knowledge of training, fine-tuning, data preparation or evaluation.
Python proficiency and familiarity with common AI/ML frameworks and workflows.
Strong analytical and logical reasoning skills, including the ability to structure complex or abstract knowledge.
The ability to examine individual failures, not just aggregate metrics, and turn observations into testable hypotheses.
Care with experimental design, data quality, documentation and reproducibility.
Curiosity about new AI methods, comfort with ambiguity and the self-direction to make progress in a fast-moving environment.
Nice to Have
Experience training, fine-tuning or evaluating language and reasoning models.
Familiarity with PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, LoRA/QLoRA, PEFT or similar tools.
Exposure to SFT, reinforcement learning, synthetic data generation or reasoning-model training.
Experience with domain-specific models, formal reasoning or quantitative research.
Research or engineering work you can share that shows how you identified a model limitation and improved it.

Our technology features advanced natural language processing for contextual understanding, personalized AI that adapts to individual communication styles and needs, real-time analysis of complex human situations and relationships, and privacy-focused architecture ensuring secure personal data handling.

Title: AI Support Engineer (Weekend Shift)
Description:
About the Team
OpenAI’s User Operations team shepherds our customers’ adoption of AI and ensures that our customers' product experience is nothing short of exceptional. We are building the very first post-AGI support team. We resolve complex issues, provide technical guidance, and support customers in maximizing value and adoption from deploying our products. We work closely with Sales, Technical Success, Product, Engineering and others, to deliver the best possible experience to our customers at scale. OpenAI's customers represent a range of diverse backgrounds and maturity, from early-stage startups to established global enterprises.
About the Role
We’re looking for dedicated, experienced, and deeply curious individuals to help solve some of the most complex challenges faced by our customers while building the future of post-AGI support alongside us. In this role, you’ll work directly with customers through support tickets and live calls, troubleshooting high-impact issues and resolving novel, often ambiguous technical problems in one of the fastest-moving environments in technology. As AI adoption rapidly accelerates, the work you do will directly support mission-critical systems being built on OpenAI’s platform, serving as a critical line of defense for customers operating at massive scale.
Beyond resolving technical issues, you’ll help define what world-class support looks like in an AGI-driven future. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Operations to improve systems, reduce bugs, and elevate the customer experience, while leveraging automation, agents, and our own AI technology to transform how support operates at scale.
This role is based in Singapore. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. To succeed in this position you must be fully fluent in English (spoken and written). Please note that your resume must be submitted in English, and the interview process will be conducted in English.
Note: Each person in this role will be expected to work a standard 5x8 work week, with 1 of the days covering weekend shifts each week (e.g., work weeks covering Tuesday - Saturday or Sunday - Thursday)
You’ll be responsible for:
Working directly with customers to troubleshoot and resolve their most complex technical issues, including API failures, integration challenges, authentication errors, and production incidents.

Your Opportunity Starts Here.
Job Description
CARM is an operational risk management team under OCBC Consumer Financial Services (CFS) Singapore business unit. The team actively works in partnership with CFS Business Risk Management Team (BRMT) and CFS AML & Sanctions Advisory Team to manage CFS AML Risk in a highly demanding and fast paced environment, with opportunities and exposure in the area of proactive AML risk management for aspiring AML expertise individuals.
Key Responsibilities
1. Analysing new and existing customers’ profiles and transactions in the relevant sanctions, money laundering (ML) and terrorism financing (TF);
2. Providing relevant sanctions/ML/TF risk assessments of customers’ profiles and transactions, highlighting any key risk area(s) for attention;
3. Recommending effective risk mitigating strategies for senior management consideration; and
4. Implementing approved risk mitigating strategies by ensuring thorough and consistent execution
Key Learnings & Duties
Key learnings and duties include 1 or more of the following AML/CFT control and risk mitigation activities:
1. Processing of escalated name screening alerts and/or transaction activities alerts;
2. Processing of priority requests from compliance or local authorities;
3. Reviewing and/or filing of internal Suspicious Transaction Reports (UTR) to assess if further escalation to Group Regulatory Compliance Unit for STR filing is required;
4. Conducting Standard or Enhanced Customer Due Diligence reviews;
5. Managing customers and internal stakeholders’ request for information and documents;
6. Exiting and closure of customer banking relationships;
7. Tracking of activities progress through MIS update and reporting;
8. Providing AML advisory support to internal stakeholders where required; and 9. Participating in on demand risk management projects and activities, including optimisation, RPA and AI RegTech initiatives.
Academic Requirement
Diploma or Degree holders aspiring to develop a career in AML risk management
Experience
Added advantage for individual with:
1. Minimum 2 years of Sanctions/AML/CFT operational experience and/or
2. Certification in Sanctions / AML / CFT
Technical Skills
Technical knowledge and understanding of Singapore’s regulatory requirements relating to sanctions, money laundering and terrorism financing
Personal Traits
1. Passionate in developing a career in AML risk management
2. Independent self-starter with a strong positive mindset and self-motivation ability
3. Meticulous, committed and focused
4. Possesses an inquisitive mind and raises critical challenges to augment current work processes
5. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
6. Has a good sense of risk acumen
7. Ability to influence and collaborate well with stakeholders and team members 8. Good written and oral communication skills and ability to interact effectively with people at different levels
9. Forward looking and embraces technology to drive efficient and effective AML risk management.
What we offer:
Competitive base salary. A suite of holistic, flexible benefits to suit every lifestyle. Community initiatives. Industry-leading learning and professional development opportunities. Your wellbeing, growth and aspirations are every bit as cared for as the needs of our customers.

Revantage Asia Pacific (with offices in Singapore and Sydney) is among three Revantage regions that also include Revantage North America and Revantage Europe.

The successful candidate will proactively manage office services, coordinate facilities maintenance, oversee vendors, support workplace logistics, and ensure the office environment operates seamlessly.

Title: Analyst / Senior Analyst - Fund Management
Description:
Overview:
When you join Hines, you will embark on a career journey fueled by vision and guided by leaders who set the standards of our industry. Our legacy is rooted in innovation and excellence, earning us a spot on Fast Company’s esteemed annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies, as well as recognition as one of U.S. News & World Report’s Best Companies to Work For in 2024. Discover endless opportunities to grow and make your mark at Hines.
Responsibilities:
As an Analyst / Senior Analyst - Fund Management with Hines, you will work primarily across various fund management responsibilities, with a particular focus on financial modelling, performance analysis, valuation, liquidity and reporting, together with selective exposure to acquisitions, investor due diligence and capital raising. The role is designed to develop from analytical execution into increasing ownership of portfolio-management workstreams.
Hines is looking to hire an Analyst / Senior Analyst into the Investment Management team, primarily to work on Hines Asia Property Partners (HAPP), Hines' flagship institutional Asia-Pacific core-plus fund. Launched in 2021, HAPP is an open-ended, diversified vehicle investing across developed Asia markets, including Japan, Australia, South Korea, Singapore and New Zealand.
Based in Singapore, this is an opportunity to join a high-performing investment team and contribute to the continued growth of HAPP while working at the centre of Hines' Asia-Pacific investment platform. The role will work closely with senior Investment Management leadership, as well as Hines' acquisition, asset management, research, financing, development and sustainable value creation teams across the region. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, participating in:
Portfolio Management
Development, maintenance and review of HAPP's asset- and fund-level financial models, including portfolio performance, return forecasting, liquidity, valuation, cash flow, performance attribution and scenario analysis, with a focus on identifying the key drivers of fund and investment performance.
HAPP's recurring fund-management cycle, including quarterly business planning, valuation, asset-model roll-up, liquidity forecasting, performance and return analysis, and portfolio and investor reporting, working with country teams and relevant functional specialists to review inputs, analyse actual performance against budget and prior periods, and ensure accurate and timely outputs.
Process improvement, automation and technology initiatives across portfolio modelling, reporting and data workflows to improve scalability, controls and efficiency.
Investment & Asset Management
Asset management of the Fund's investments, including analysis of business plans, monitoring of portfolio performance and identification of value-enhancing initiatives in collaboration with country teams. More experienced candidates will progressively own selected portfolio and asset-management workstreams with senior oversight.
Selected acquisitions and strategic opportunities across Asia-Pacific, including underwriting, portfolio-fit and fund-level impact analysis, transaction execution, and investment strategy / portfolio construction, working with Hines' local country teams, Hines Research and relevant functional specialists.
Investor Relations & Capital Raising
Investor relationships with current and prospective institutional investors, including investor due diligence, DDQ / RFP responses, portfolio analysis and selected investor meetings, working with the broader Fund team, Capital Markets and other stakeholders across Hines.
Preparation and coordination of analysis and investment content for investors and internal stakeholders, including fund updates, investor meeting materials, portfolio reviews and other capital-raising materials.
Qualifications:
Minimum Requirements include:
Typically 2-5 years of relevant experience in real estate private equity, investment management, investment banking, real estate investment or a related field. Candidates somewhat below or above this range may also be considered where capabilities and experience are strongly aligned. Direct Asia-Pacific experience is desirable but not essential.
Bachelor degree from a high-calibre institution, preferably in a subject area demanding high analytical aptitude.
Highly numerate with strong analytical and financial modelling capability. Demonstrated ability to build, audit and interpret financial models, identify key performance and return drivers, and explain conclusions clearly. Experience analysing real estate investments, portfolios or operating companies is desirable.
Ability to distil complex analysis into clear conclusions and present ideas effectively in written, verbal and graphical form, including in Word and PowerPoint.
Excellent communication skills with confident fluency in written and spoken English. Additional Asian language capability would be advantageous given the regional remit of the role.
Ability to relate well to other people at all levels, internally and externally. Culturally sensitive and comfortable working across multiple Asia-Pacific markets and stakeholder groups. Display passion and energy, creating a positive working environment.
Proactive, self-motivated and able to take ownership, use initiative and escalate appropriately.
Confidence, independence and strong interest in working in an entrepreneurial, growth-oriented investment environment.
Strong attention to detail, particularly in financial models, recurring reporting and data quality.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and recurring reporting / modelling deadlines, working quickly and accurately to a high standard under pressure.
Positive energy and contribution to team spirit.
Ambition and willingness to learn, with a clear desire to develop from analytical execution into investment and portfolio-management ownership. Lead how cash operations runs across Asia. You will drive regional improvements, strengthen controls, and ensure consistent regulatory compliance across locations. Lead regional projects across branches to drive efficiency, automation, and standardisation.

Ensure procedures and controls meet local and global legal, regulatory, and industry requirements across locations.
Implement best practices across branches, including documentation standards, governance routines, and consistent execution.
Drive the risk and controls agenda, including error tracking, issue management, and remediation governance.
Lead incident response coordination and communications for events impacting cash operations across the region.
Maintain incident and resiliency documentation and readiness routines, ensuring requirements are completed on time and to standard.
Build strong partnerships with branch leads and stakeholders across business, product, service, technology, risk, compliance, and audit teams.
Provide clear updates to senior leadership on performance, risks, priorities, and delivery progress.

Bachelor Degree
Minimum 10 years of experience in cash operations and/or cash products within financial services, including leadership or matrix leadership responsibilities.
Strong understanding of payments and treasury services operations and technology strategy.
Working knowledge of payments, deposits, and liquidity products and operating flows.
Proven ability to deliver outcomes through influence across multiple locations and teams without direct reporting lines.
Strong risk and controls mindset, with experience meeting regulatory expectations and driving remediation to closure.
Strong execution discipline, with the ability to prioritise, manage competing demands, and deliver to deadlines.
Strong stakeholder management and networking skills, including the ability to align teams and manage conflict constructively.
Strong communication skills, with confidence engaging senior stakeholders.
Demonstrated people leadership capability, including coaching and developing others in a matrixed environment.
Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills
Experience leading regional operating model changes, including centralising work in hubs or shifting work across sites.
Experience delivering cross-branch transformation involving process redesign or technology enablement.
Demonstrated ability to identify opportunities for automation and artificial intelligence in operational workflows, including evaluating, implementing, or governing solutions to deliver scalable improvements.

About the Role
GreenLight is recruiting a Singapore-based Event Manager for a full-time, twelve-month contract supporting OpenAI’s strategy and execution across a wide portfolio of events. Working under the guidance of the APAC Events lead, this role will partner closely with local and global cross-functional teams to deliver sophisticated, high-impact experiences for an innovative global technology organization.
The role will support projects across the wider APAC region with flexibility to travel and work in other markets based on business and event requirements.
The ideal candidate brings strong regional expertise, operational excellence, cultural fluency, and a passion for creating original, meaningful experiences, particularly within technology and thought leadership contexts. The role owns event operations, regional vendor coordination, guest experience, and post-event reporting.
This position is based in Singapore and requires working from the office at least three days per week, alongside travel across APAC and internationally as project needs require.

Own the full event lifecycle for programs, including concept development, planning, workstreams, budgeting, logistics, catering, and on-site production.
Partner with local teams to translate regional priorities and OpenAI’s complex AI technology into locally relevant, globally consistent programming, clear event objectives, timelines, and measurable outcomes.

Title: APAC Service Delivery Manager
Description:
Company Description
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
Join us to put AI to work for people.
Job Description
The Role
The Service Delivery Manager (SDM) is responsible for overseeing the performance, quality, and operational health of partner-delivered services in APAC. Acting as the primary governance point between ServiceNow and delivery partner(s), the SDM ensures partner engagements are delivered in accordance with agreed service levels, quality standards, contractual commitments, and customer outcome expectations.
The SDM monitors partner delivery performance, identifies risks, drives corrective actions, manages escalations, and provides ongoing visibility into delivery health for ServiceNow leadership. The role serves as the accountability layer that makes partner performance predictable, scalable, and aligned to ServiceNow standards, regardless of whether the partner is delivering managed services, outsourced operations, subcontracted services, or project-based engagements.
Responsibilities
Serve as the primary ServiceNow point of contact for the partner's aligned Delivery Manager(s), maintaining day-to-day oversight of partner service performance against contracted KPIs and SLAs.
Review delivery quality trends, audit findings, and operational metrics to identify systemic issues, root causes, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
Monitor delivery unit economics and cost-per-outcome performance, ensuring the contracted commercial model (unit-based, outcome-based, or hybrid) tracks to delivered value.
Manage the ongoing evolution of the Partner’s service so that new capabilities can be planned and deployed with the appropriate stakeholder alignment, scalable processes and measurable outcomes to drive results
Manage the operational governance cadence, including weekly performance check-ins, monthly reviews, and quarterly business review preparation.
Lead delivery escalations across ServiceNow and partner teams, driving timely issue resolution and ensuring accountability for remediation plans and service recovery activities.
Own tracking and acceptance of transition and mobilization milestones during partner onboarding or service transitions, including staffing ramp against plan, capability/certification readiness, and transition exit criteria.
Own capacity and demand management processes, including utilization tracking, variance planning, and periodic reconciliation against contracted volumes.
Manage the change control process for operational or initiative requests that have contractual implications, engaging Commercial Management as needed.
Flag discrepancies between service delivery status and invoicing or milestone payment triggers to Commercial and Finance stakeholders.
Produce and maintain performance reporting, providing regular updates to internal leadership and ensure effective coverage and handoff models across distributed, multi-shift delivery teams
Identify and implement process improvements in response to changes in tooling, operating model, or service delivery requirements.
Coordinate with Service Delivery Managers in other geographies on initiative design, sequencing, and rollout to ensure global consistency.
Maintain a regular interlock with the Global Partnerships and Channels (GPC) team and the emerging global partner organization, ensuring partner performance insights, escalations, and capability needs are shared and jointly actioned.
Partner with account teams, customer success teams, and delivery stakeholders to protect customer outcomes and address service delivery risks impacting customer health.
Drive consistency in delivery execution, governance processes, and operational standards across partner-delivered services within the geography.
Qualifications
Demonstrated experience in service delivery management, vendor governance, or partner performance management within a complex, matrixed organisation – particularly within India-based organizations.
Experience managing partner, vendor, or supplier performance through structured governance frameworks, scorecards, and business reviews.
Proven ability to manage third-party performance against defined SLAs and KPIs, including escalation and corrective action processes.
Experience managing partners related to Customer Success and Professional Services context
Experience designing and maintaining operational documentation, including playbooks and standard operating procedures.
Strong project and programme management capability, with a track record of delivering cross-functional initiatives to agreed timelines.
Ensure effective coverage and handoff models across distributed, multi-shift delivery teams
Experience monitoring and tracking partner resource ongoing development of skills and certifications in line with service demands
Demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate across functions and levels of seniority without direct line authority.
Proficiency in performance data analysis and reporting, with the ability to draw actionable conclusions from KPI and operational metrics.
Familiarity with Customer Success and Professional Service metrics and post-sales operating models, including NPS, utilization, rate cards, and product adoption measures.
Knowledge of, or ability to rapidly develop proficiency in, ServiceNow’s platform and products.
Ability to balance customer outcomes, business objectives, and partner performance requirements in a complex operating environment.
5+ years of experience in service delivery, partner governance, or a related operational role within a global technology or SaaS environment.
Track record of driving continuous improvement and service efficiencies.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working within or alongside a Partner or managed service delivery model, particularly in a vendor governance or service integration capacity.
Familiarity with scaled SaaS operating models, AI Native environments, and partner-delivered service motions.
Experience operating within an organisational transformation programme in a post-sales or customer success context.
Certifications in project management, service management, supplier management, or customer success disciplines (e.g., PMP, ITIL, CSM, COPC).
Exposure to AI-enabled or agentic workflow tooling within an operational team environment.
Experience operating in global teams servicing multiple geographies, including AMS, EMEA, and APAC.

Description:
At Apple, we work every day to create products that enrich people’s lives. We want to help people in every part of their lives that we can, including making the world’s best content easily and beautifully available to the hundreds of millions of people around the globe who use Apple products. Our Advertising Platforms organization enables a thriving ecosystem for content creators, publishers, and developers by helping them monetize their work while enabling users to discover high-quality content seamlessly across Apple devices. With the continued growth of Apple Ads within the App Store where a significant majority of app downloads originate from search this platform has become a critical channel for app discovery and performance marketing for iOS developers globally.
In this role, you will grow, lead and develop a team that is responsible for revenue generation and customer happiness across your assigned market or region. You’ll use your knowledge of developers, advertisers and agencies to create and maintain positive and productive relationships with marketers of all size and type. You’ll quickly gain the respect and support of both management and other employees by achieving business goals and demonstrating good judgment, business insight, balance, objectivity, collaboration, quiet confidence, and trustworthiness. You will also have direct management responsibility for a team of Client Partners (our client facing sales team) and the Platform Specialists and is expected to lead and develop the team in managing strategic client relationships and delivering measurable business outcomes across Korea.
Description
The CPM, Korea will lead the sales organization across Korea, with direct responsibility for both Client Partners and Platform Specialists.
- This role requires a strong player-coach leader who can effectively develop and inspire the team while remaining hands-on in managing and expanding relationships with our most strategic customers.
- This role will be accountable for building, managing, and expanding relationships with leading advertisers and app developers across the Korea market.
- Sales Leadership: Lead, inspire, and develop a high-performing Korea team, fostering a strong culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
- Revenue Growth & Strategy: Own and deliver against revenue targets, driving sustainable growth through strategic account planning, business development, and expansion of existing partnerships.
- Client & Partner Engagement: Cultivate senior-level relationships with key clients and developers across Korea, positioning Apple’s Advertising Platforms as a strategic growth partner.
- Operational Excellence: Ensure strong sales discipline through accurate forecasting, pipeline management, and consistent use of CRM and internal tools (e.g., Salesforce), aligned with global standards.
- Performance Optimization: Oversee the Platform Specialist function to ensure best-in-class campaign execution, optimization, and performance outcomes across key metrics such as CPT, CPA, and customer satisfaction indices.
- Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Marketing, Product, and other global teams to provide Korea market insights, influence product roadmap, and ensure local market needs are effectively represented.
- Market Expertise: Maintain deep knowledge of the Korea digital advertising ecosystem, including attribution models, measurement frameworks, privacy considerations, and competitive dynamics.
Preferred Qualifications
A hands-on player-coach leadership style, with the ability to both lead strategically and actively engage in key client relationships and sales opportunities.
Excellent communication skills, be able to listen effectively, socialize ideas across functions and articulate the business visions both internally and externally
Established network across advertisers, agencies, and developers within Korea.
Demonstrated ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels, including C-suite executives and senior marketing leaders.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate strategic perspectives clearly and effectively.
Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and drive alignment across regional and global teams.
Adaptability and resilience in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, with a proactive and solutions-oriented mindset.
Experience in gaming app category preferred.
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelors degree educated, MBA a plus.
English fluency required.
Deep understanding of the mobile app economy and evolving digital marketing landscape in Korea.
Extensive experience in digital, online, or performance marketing, ideally within the mobile app ecosystem and data-driven marketing environments.
Strong expertise in performance marketing, including campaign optimization, attribution, and measurement frameworks.
Proven track record of building and leading high-performing sales teams, with demonstrated success in attracting, developing, and retaining top talent.

Title: Asia Business Development Associate
Description:
*The role of Asia Business Development Associate*
GLAS is an international provider of institutional debt administration services, serving lenders, borrowers, issuers, and advisers offering a global platform across Loan Agency and related services, Capital Markets and Restructuring.
GLAS’ vision is to be recognised as the best-in-class independent, non-creditor, conflict-free provider of institutional debt administration services, enabling global clients and counterparties to achieve successful outcomes on their transactions.
The business currently comprises c.500 employees who deliver a solution-based, innovative service, ensuring GLAS is the preferred global partner of choice. GLAS has a blue-chip customer base developed over many years; select clients include Apollo, Blackstone, CVC, Deutsche Bank and Goldman Sachs. GLAS has been recognised as the premier independent provider of loan agency and bond trustee services with a portfolio of over $800 billion assets across its global platform. The company is headquartered in London with offices in Paris, Frankfurt, Madrid, New York, New Jersey, Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Singapore, Dubai, Hong Kong, Milan and Rome.
We are seeking a commercially focused Asia Business Development Associate to support the growth of GLAS across Singapore, Hong Kong and wider Asian markets. This is a mid-level sales role focused on originating and converting new business across GLAS’ specialist and core product offering.
Working closely with the Head of Business Development, Asia, and broader APAC Sales team, the successful candidate will build market coverage, develop high-quality opportunities and strengthen relationships with priority clients and intermediaries. The role will contribute across GLAS’ debt administration services (including Loan Agency, Capital Markets and Restructuring, Escrow and Custody products) as well as Investment + Private Capital infrastructure services, fund accounting and entity management services.
The position requires a proactive business development professional with financial services experience, strong relationship-building skills and the ability to manage opportunities from initial engagement through proposal, mandate award and handover to delivery teams.
*Key Responsibilities*
*New Business Growth and Origination*
* Identify, develop and convert new business opportunities across Singapore and wider Asian markets.
* Support the execution of the Asia business development plan in alignment with APAC and global growth priorities.
* Build and maintain a disciplined pipeline across GLAS’ service offerings.
* Undertake targeted prospecting and market outreach across agreed client segments and service lines.
* Support client meetings, pitches, presentations, RFP responses, fee proposals and commercial discussions.
* Maintain momentum across opportunities from initial engagement through mandate award and successful handover.
* Identify cross-selling opportunities across existing relationships and introduce relevant GLAS services.
*Market Coverage and Relationship Development*
* Build and maintain relationships with banks, private credit funds, financial sponsors, law firms, borrowers, issuers, advisers, fund managers, family offices and other relevant market participants.
* Develop relationship maps and account plans for priority prospects, clients and market influencers.
* Represent GLAS at client meetings, industry conferences, networking events and market forums, as appropriate.
* Increase awareness of GLAS’ independent, conflict-free service proposition across target markets.
* Support the Head of Business Development, Asia in deepening senior relationships and expanding GLAS’ market presence.
* Product coverage across debt administration services (including Loan Agency, Capital Markets and Restructuring, Escrow and Custody products), Investment and Private Capital infrastructure services, fund accounting and entity management services
* Develop a working knowledge of GLAS’ core products across Loan Agency, Capital Markets and Restructuring services.
* Develop and promote GLAS’ specialist offering for funds, fund managers, family offices, investment trusts, corporate services and other relevant client groups.
* Work with product and operational specialists to understand client needs, shape solutions and communicate GLAS’ value proposition clearly.
* Identify opportunities to connect specialist and core capabilities into coordinated client solutions.
* Keep current on product developments, service capabilities and relevant transaction experience across GLAS’ global platform.
*Pipeline, CRM and Commercial Management*
* Maintain accurate and timely prospect, activity, opportunity and deal information within CRM systems.
* Prepare pipeline updates, forecasts and business development reporting for the Head of Business Development, Asia.
* Track agreed activity, progression, conversion and revenue measures and highlight risks or gaps early.
* Support opportunity qualification, pricing, proposal development and sales governance processes.
* Use sales data, client feedback and market intelligence to prioritise activity and improve conversion.
*Market Intelligence*
* Monitor market activity, competitor developments, regulatory trends and emerging client needs across Asia.
* Research priority sectors, client segments and market participants to support targeted origination.
* Share relevant market intelligence and commercial insights with Asia, APAC and global colleagues.
* Use market insights to identify new product, sector and geographical opportunities for growth.
*Cross-Functional Collaboration*
* Work closely with Client Relationship Management, Transaction Management, Operations, Product and Marketing teams to deliver a coordinated client experience.
* Partner with the APAC Business Development Lead and regional BD colleagues to support cross-border opportunities and consistent market coverage.
* Coordinate the successful handover and onboarding of new mandates to operational teams.
* Collaborate with global colleagues to pursue international opportunities and deliver consistent pitches and proposals across jurisdictions.
* Support marketing initiatives, thought leadership and campaigns relevant to the Australian market.
*Experience & Qualifications*
* Relevant business development, sales, relationship management or origination experience within financial services, professional services or a related commercial environment.
* Demonstrated experience developing prospects, supporting pitches and progressing opportunities through a sales pipeline.
* An understanding of syndicated loans, private credit, debt capital markets, restructuring, trustee services, funds or related financial products is preferred.
* Experience engaging with banks, funds, financial sponsors, law firms, advisers, borrowers, issuers or institutional clients.
* Strong presentation, written communication and interpersonal skills, with confidence engaging senior stakeholders.
* Experience using CRM systems and maintaining accurate commercial data and reporting.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Law or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Fluency in English is required; additional Asian language capability is advantageous.
*Skills & Competencies*
* Commercially minded and growth-oriented, with a strong interest in new business generation.
* Proactive and confident in prospecting, networking and building new relationships.
* Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills.
* Able to understand client needs and communicate complex services in a clear, compelling way.
* Disciplined in pipeline management, follow-up, CRM administration and reporting.
* Highly organised, self-motivated and able to manage multiple priorities.
* Collaborative and able to work effectively across regional and global teams.
* Adaptable and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, growing international organisation.
* Professional, credible and able to represent GLAS to a high standard.
Success Measures
* Growth in new business revenue and mandates across Asia.
* A strong, qualified pipeline aligned to agreed target markets, client segments and service lines.
* Achievement of agreed activity, conversion and revenue targets.
* Expansion of GLAS’ Asia market coverage, prospect relationships and brand presence.
* Accuracy of pipeline data, forecasting and management reporting.
* Successful execution of pitches, proposals and commercial negotiations.
* Effective onboarding and handover of new mandates.
* Strong collaboration with APAC and global commercial and operational teams
*Benefits*
* Competitive base salary plus discretionary annual bonus
* Paid annual leave plus Singapore public holidays
* Long service award
* Career development and study support available
* Private medical insurance
