Title: AVP, Compliance Manager, International Oversight
Description:
WHO WE ARE:
As Singapore’s longest established bank, we have been dedicated to enabling individuals and businesses to achieve their aspirations since 1932. How? By taking the time to truly understand people. From there, we provide support, services, solutions, and career paths that meet their individual needs and desires.
Today, we’re on a journey of transformation. Leveraging technology and creativity to become a future-ready learning organisation. But for all that change, our strategic ambition is consistently clear and bold, which is to be Asia’s leading financial services partner for a sustainable future.
We invite you to build the bank of the future. Innovate the way we deliver financial services. Work in friendly, supportive teams. Build lasting value in your community. Help people grow their assets, business, and investments. Take your learning as far as you can. Or simply enjoy a vibrant, future-ready career.
Your Opportunity Starts Here.
Why join
Step into a pivotal role where your expertise contributes directly to strengthening the Group's financial crime risk management framework across our international network. As the Group Oversight Specialist, supporting oversight of the Bank of Singapore (BOS) Branches, Affiliates, Representative Offices and Subsidiaries (BAROS), you will navigate complex regulatory environments while partnering with diverse stakeholders across Group OCBC. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain broad regional exposure, deepen your financial crime compliance expertise, and contribute to the consistent application of Group standards, helping to safeguard the Bank's reputation as a trusted and compliant financial institution.
How you succeed
You will excel in this role if you are able to work effectively across multiple markets, build strong partnerships and provide clear, practical compliance advice. Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and a solid understanding of financial crime risks are essential. By staying abreast of regulatory developments and emerging threats, you will help identify and mitigate risks, address audit and regulatory findings, and collaborate with stakeholders to strengthen the Bank’s financial crime control framework and compliance culture.
What you do
Maintain compliance governance and oversight on BOS Branches, Affiliates, Representative Offices and Subsidiaries (“BAROS”).
Implement BOS Group policies and procedures to BAROS.
Provide FCC advisory to BOS BAROS.
Plan and execute strategies to manage emerging risks and/or areas of emerging concerns.
Review and provide guidance to BOS BAROS to formulate Management Action Plans in response to findings arising from audits and/or regulatory inspections.
Assess oversight effectiveness outcomes semi-annually.
Conduct risk culture assessment of BOS BAROS Front Office.
Supervise and advise key business initiatives involving BOS BAROS.
Guide the formulation of compliance training and share best practices across BOS BAROS.
Drive and manage initiatives to enhance the AML/CFT framework and program.
Review senior management reporting.
Support any ad-hoc tasks/work as assigned by the manager.
Who you are
Degree Holder with minimum 6 years of experience in FCC-related roles, preferably within private banking.
Able to drive change and seize opportunities to improve FCC control environment in a fast-paced environment.
Able to articulate thought process clearly.
Possess a strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills.
Proficient in MS Office applications.
Team player, self-motivated and resourceful.

Title: Bid Manager Talent Community
Description:
About the role:
The role of Bid Manager is exceptionally rewarding, and you will work across a broad range of interesting client sectors and internal CBRE stakeholders. The role is suited for someone who is passionate about quality, creativity, written word and seeing end results. You will have attention to detail and a flair for understanding and articulating solutions to client needs and challenges. A blend of strategic, organizational, written and interpersonal skills is crucial for success.
The Bid Manager plays a vital role in driving the success of our organization by working in partnership with the Sales Director and Country/Division sales team to oversee the project management and governance of the sales process, particularly at the Request for Information (RFI) and Request for Proposal (RFP) stages. You may also be required to own and lead top pursuits.
You have exceptional writing skills and may already have bid management experience or are looking to take the next step in your bid management career. Using your natural leadership skills to foster a strong team culture, you will drive up standards up by working closely with Business Development Managers (BDM) and Business Unit Sales Coordinators (BUSC) to ensure differentiated, innovative and client focused proposals are delivered on time and to an exceptional standard.
A key responsibility of this role is to train and develop BUSC’s, sharing your knowledge and skills to help them grow and succeed.
What you’ll do:
Attracting clients
Guide and encourage BDM and BUSC client research activity to support client cultivation
Assist with preparation of materials for prospective client meetings and presentations
Lead (or support) the coordination of Country/Divisional events by inputting into content, themes and materials
Work with the Strategic Development Lead to support BDMs and BUSC’s develop vertical markets.
RFI and RFP process
Ensure request for information (RFI) questionnaires are submitted to a high standard
Work closely with the sales team to manage proposals from initiation to submission, this will include:
Ensure bid tracker/responsibility matrix is created for every opportunity and team remains organized
Response planning and structuring
Work with BDMs and BUSCs to develop win themes aligned to client needs
Write bespoke bid responses and work closely with the BDM to produce compelling executive summaries
Check and challenge BUSC and BDM content, and contributions from others to ensure written responses clearly articulate differentiation and win themes
Ensure final documents are of the highest quality through design, editing and proof reading
Ensure the team are on track for post proposal activities, helping plan and prepare site visit, presentation and workshop materials.
BUSC community
Build and foster a BUSC community to create a team of high performing sales support, this includes holding weekly BUSC catch ups and workload prioritisation meetings
Help BUSCs build confidence by coaching and development through writing and proposal training, and personal development planning
Support BUSC recruitment, onboarding and succession planning.
Knowledge and process
Work in partnership with the Sales Director and Strategic Development Lead to embed and improve process and knowledge across the Country/Division
Work closely with the team to ensure content library is continuously up to date with professional profiles, account profiles and case studies. Share content with the wider business
Proactively stay up to date with CBRE, industry knowledge and innovations, sharing this information with your team and allowing this knowledge to filter in to bid responses
Maintain a consistent process with BDMS and BUSCs to ensure accurate Salesforce reporting.
Networking and collaboration
Build an internal network across the Bid Manager community to enhance knowledge, share best practice, and collectively benefit from shared insights
Build relationships with operational leaders and support functions.
What you will need:
Degree in Business Studies, Engineering or Economics
Minimum 5 years relevant working experiences
Experience working in a bid management and/or sales environment
Experience writing and managing proposals
Experience of meeting tight deadlines
Experience motivating, training and leading teams
Experience of dealing with and co-operating with a wide range of people.
Must possess excellent Microsoft 360 skills – primarily Microsoft Word and PowerPoint. SharePoint, InDesign, SmartSheet and Salesforce are beneficial.

Description:
Job Description
Responsible for compiling tender information to identify key activities and confirm that tender requirements are within the capability of the Company.

Coordination of all internal stakeholders to support tender requirements.
Manage tendering process lifecycle from attending bid meetings, addressing technical and commercial clarifications, extension of submission deadline etc.

Coordinate with the estimating teams during prequalification, request-for-information, request-for-quotation, and tender stages.
Review tender requirements and ensure the proposed commercial and technical strategy aligns with client expectations.
Support the development of competitive execution plans covering engineering, procurement, fabrication, assembly, integration, commissioning, load-out, transportation, and offshore hook-up support.

Title: Business Analyst - Temenos T24 & TAP
Description:
Project description
This role will be part of the Platform and Integration Office team, supporting the Group Wealth Platform (GWP) regional rollout programme for Private Banking. GWP is the Group's integrated wealth
management platform built on Temenos Transact (T24) as the core banking and wealth back-office system and Temenos Triple'A Plus (TAP) as the front- and middle-office portfolio management system,
covering client investment account opening, order management and pre-trade checks, wealth product processing, portfolio management, assisted and self-service channels, and downstream data and reporting.
The GWP – Business Analyst, Temenos T24 & TAP Subject Matter Expert (SME) will be the programme's go-to functional expert on the Temenos wealth product suite. The role bridges business requirements
and the Temenos solution, ensuring that business needs are met through standard product capability and model bank configuration wherever possible, and that gaps, customisations and workarounds
are clearly understood, justified and governed.
The ideal candidate will bring deep hands-on knowledge of T24 and TAP, gained through one or more end-to-end Temenos implementations for private banks or wealth managers in the Asia Pacific
(APAC) market. He/she will apply this experience to fit-gap analysis, solution design review, T24–TAP integration, data migration, testing and go-live readiness across markets at different stages of rollout,
while also advising on APAC market practices and local regulatory needs.
The candidate is expected to demonstrate strong discipline in business analysis and documentation, and to be able to work well within a team and yet take initiative and ownership over his/her own area of work assignments or projects.
Responsibilities
Act as the functional SME for Temenos T24 and TAP across the programme, advising business and project teams on standard product capability, model bank configuration and industry best practice for private banking and wealth management.
Lead requirement workshops and fit-gap analysis against T24 and TAP, and translate business needs into Business Requirement Documents (BRD), process flows and business rules that are aligned with Temenos capability; recommend configuration-first solutions and challenge unnecessary customisation.

Title: Business Consultant for Construction Firms (Ideally Experienced)
Description:
Job Description
About Us
We help interior design and renovation firms in Singapore grow — through lead generation, branding, and marketing programmes that bring them qualified homeowners and stronger market positioning. Our clients don't just buy a service from us once; they grow with us across tiers as their firms scale. That only works when someone closes the right clients — and then owns the relationship after the first close.
That someone is you.
About the Role
This is a fully remote role.
You'll work from wherever you work best — no daily commute, no office face-time. What matters is that your clients feel looked after and your accounts grow. You'll meet clients over video calls (with the occasional in-person session if a key relationship calls for it), and stay connected to the team through our daily rhythms online.
This is a closing role first, a relationship role always.
You'll start by building your own book of business: running sales conversations with interior design firms, diagnosing where their business is stuck, and closing them into the right programme. Every deal you close becomes an account you own — and from there, your job is to make each relationship deeper, longer, and more valuable over time.
The more you close early on, the bigger the portfolio you manage — and the more your recurring income compounds through renewals, tier upgrades, and referrals. You are the person our clients trust from the very first call, the one who checks in before they have to ask, and the reason they sign, renew, upgrade, and refer.
What You'll Do
Run discovery and sales calls with interior design and renovation firms — diagnosing their growth bottlenecks and closing them into the programme that fits
Manage your own sales pipeline end to end: qualification, follow-ups, objection handling, and closing, with clear monthly targets
Own every account you close as their primary point of contact and trusted advisor
Run regular check-ins and performance reviews with clients — walking them through their results, diagnosing bottlenecks, and recommending next steps
Drive renewals by ensuring clients see and understand the value they're getting throughout the programme, not just at renewal time
Identify and develop expansion opportunities — helping clients climb to higher programme tiers when their business is ready for it
Generate referrals naturally by building the kind of relationship people recommend to their peers
Work with our internal teams to resolve client issues quickly and keep promises made during the sales process
Maintain accurate account records, follow-up rhythms, and relationship health tracking in our CRM
Who You Are
2+ years in B2B sales, account management, or client success — with a track record of hitting sales targets and closing deals
A closer who thinks long-term: you know how to drive a deal to a decision, but you close clients you can grow, not just deals you can win
A natural relationship builder — the close is the start of the relationship, not the end of it
Consistent with follow-through: you do what you say, on time, every time
A clear communicator who can explain performance data and business concepts simply, in person and in writing
Commercially sharp — you can spot an upsell or referral opportunity without making the client feel sold to
Organised and self-directed: you manage your own portfolio, pipeline of renewals, and follow-up cadence
Proven ability to work independently in a remote setup — you stay responsive, structured, and visible without anyone looking over your shoulder
Bonus: experience in or exposure to the interior design, renovation, real estate, or home services industry
Why Join Us
100% remote
— you're measured on client outcomes, not hours at a desk
Base salary + commissions on every deal you close, plus recurring incentives on retention, renewals, and account growth — your income compounds as your portfolio grows
Build your own book of business from day one, backed by proven sales scripts, frameworks, and playbooks — you close it, you keep it, you grow it
Clear frameworks, playbooks, and training on how we sell, manage, and grow accounts
A front-row seat to how design and renovation businesses in Singapore scale

WhatsApp: +65 9061 4389

Title: Business Controller, Asia Pacific (D2C & HUB)
Description:
CLARINS
Date: Oct 19, 2026
Singapore, SG, 239519
Ready to bring passion into your career?
A global leading skincare and make-up company, Clarins Group is the embodiment of a committed family history, with a fierce passion for innovation and spirit of independence. Its raison d’être is "making life more beautiful, passing on a more beautiful planet".
Operating in more than 150 countries, we are now the number one skincare company in Europe and are accelerating our development on all other continents, particularly in Asia and the Americas.
Because our 8,000 talents are unique, we are committed to promoting diversity in all its forms.
Do you want to help write the next chapter of our story?
We are looking for a Business Controller, Asia Pacific, based in Singapore.
Mission 1: Finance Business Partner - Direct-to-customer (DTC) Channels
In this capacity, the role supports both Ecommerce and Retail channels across the APAC region and is responsible for the following:
Serve as Finance Business Partner to the Regional Ecommerce and Retail teams, supporting KPI tracking through the preparation, consolidation, and analysis of performance reports.
Maintain and oversee the regional Retail financial database, ensuring data integrity and accuracy. Monitor new boutique openings and renovation projects by reviewing business plans for robustness and conducting ongoing performance follow-up.
Prepare and deliver dedicated quarterly Retail and Ecommerce performance reports for the APAC region, providing clear insights into operational and financial results.
Consolidate monthly APAC Ecommerce and Retail P&L statements, analyzing significant variances against budget and reforecasts, and highlighting key discrepancies and risks.
Act as the primary point of contact for Headquarters Controlling on all Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) financial matters, ensuring alignment and timely communication.
Communicate and implement Group DTC guidelines and requirements across APAC markets, ensuring consistent and rigorous application.
Mission 2: Finance Business Partner – Regional Supply Chain
Within this scope, the Business Controller, APAC is responsible for the following:
Act as Finance Business Partner to the Regional Supply Chain function and serve as the key point of contact for Headquarters Logistics Controlling, in coordination with the RFPAD.
Oversee and review market reporting submissions relating to Inventories and Purchases, ensuring timely, accurate, and complete submissions for both actuals and budget cycles. Serve as the primary contact for APAC markets on related reporting matters.
Prepare consolidated APAC inventory reporting for regional management, covering resale and POP inventories, including provisions and destructions, and provide detailed variance analysis.
Develop and monitor the monthly APAC year-end stock landing forecast, investigating and documenting any deviations versus budget to ensure inventory levels remain aligned with plan.
Analyze stock equations for the Regional Hub and each APAC subsidiary during budget and reforecast cycles, challenging underlying assumptions to ensure completeness and accuracy of purchase projections and cost of goods sold forecasts.
Prepare and review monthly HFM/DMP reporting analyses, identifying significant variances and obtaining appropriate explanations from markets.
Support APAC markets in meeting Supply Chain data and reporting requirements, and deliver training and guidance to markets as required to strengthen reporting accuracy, consistency, and compliance.
Mission 3: Controller of the Intercompany P&L – Singapore Hub
Assume full ownership of the intercompany Profit & Loss related to sales transactions between the Hub and APAC markets, with responsibilities including:
Monitor and oversee intercompany transactions between the France-based factory and APAC markets (Hub activity), in close collaboration with the Regional Supply Chain team.
Lead the preparation of the Hub’s Budget and reforecasts, including related reporting to Group, covering intercompany P&L, inventories, and purchases. Ensure alignment with Regional Supply Chain assumptions and reconciliation with consolidated forecasts submitted by APAC subsidiaries.
Partner with Supply Chain to prepare and monitor inventory provisions for Singapore Hub in accordance with Group policies and accounting standards.
Actively contribute to the monthly closing process by ensuring all required journal entries are properly prepared, documented, and communicated to Accounting, particularly regarding provisions, inventory variances, and destructions.
Perform monthly monitoring of intercompany P&L, purchases, and inventory landing versus budget and reforecasts; investigate and analyze deviations, and report findings to the RFPAD.
Allocate and communicate the APAC markets’ share of IAS 38 allocation related to POP at the Singapore Hub.
Manage Singapore Hub intercompany transfer prices within the Group Supply Chain ERP (M3) for Intercompany Sales, including:
Oversee and maintain the pricing structure within the system, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and alignment with Group policies.
Implement and update price lists and billing prices within the commercial system for annual pricing updates, ensuring correct and timely application.
Act as the primary point of contact for subsidiaries on intercompany pricing matters, including follow-up on missing prices required for forecast valuation.
Mission 4: Drive Process Automation & Continuous Improvement
Within the scope of D2C and Hub topics, the Business Controller, APAC is responsible for:
Identifying and driving opportunities for process improvement to reduce manual work, improve data accuracy, and streamline recurring finance processes.
Partnering with Finance, Data, and Technology teams to design streamlined workflows, and implement automation solutions that strengthen data quality and controls. They will translate business requirements into practical improvements, standardize reporting and planning processes, and promote adoption of modern tools and best practices to enable more timely, insight-driven decision-making.
Other responsibilities may be added to the above, which are consistent with the title Business Controller, Asia Pacific, including involvement in additional projects to lead the change in our Clarins organization.
You Have:
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting or a related discipline, with strong numerical aptitude and business acumen.
Minimum 5 years of FP&A or related experience in a sizeable organisation, preferably within the beauty, retail or FMCG industry and APAC region.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to simplify financial concepts for non-finance stakeholders.
Proactive, adaptable and independent, with strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate across diverse teams and cultures.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with Workday, HFM, IBM Cognos (BIA), M3 or Power BI is an advantage.
We have:
Over 72 years of expertise in beauty and spa, with the Clarins and myBlend brands
Unique products and innovative services
A commitment to Social & Environmental Responsibility embedded in our raison d’être
A caring and inclusive corporate culture
Development and training opportunities
Attractive compensation and benefits
A flexible work environment, with up to 1 day of remote working per week
If you have a curious mind, a thirst to go further, and the drive to boldly take on new challenges, join us.
About Clarins Group
A B-Corp certified global leading skincare and make-up company, Clarins group is the embodiment of a committed family history, with a fierce passion for innovation and spirit of independence. Our purpose "making life more beautiful, passing on a more beautiful planet," is a core commitment outlined in our by-laws.
Operating in more than 150 countries thanks to our 8,000 employees worldwide, we are now the number one skincare company in Europe and are accelerating our development on all other continents, particularly in Asia and the Americas.
In line with our dual CSR mission of ‘Caring for people, caring for the planet’ we take pride in offering a rewarding yet challenging work environment where everyone can thrive.
This culture allowed us to achieve the certification of Forbes' World’s Best Employers 2024, Forbes' World’s Best Employers 2024 for Women.
To learn more about our group and our commitments to people, visit www.groupeclarins.com.

Inclusion and diversity are firmly grounded in our core values. We strive to achieve inclusiveness, and we foster an equal-opportunity culture where everyone can reach their full potential and do their best
work.

Title: Business Development
Description:
Senior Business Development Manager – Pharma
About The Role
We are looking for a Senior Business Development Manager to join a growing pharmaceutical business and play a key role in expanding its portfolio across the ASEAN region.
This is a highly commercial and externally-facing role, focused on identifying and securing in-licensing opportunities, strategic partnerships and multi-country deals across ASEAN. You will work closely with pharmaceutical and biotech companies to identify the right assets, understand their commercial potential and ultimately position the business as the right partner to bring these products successfully to market.
This is not simply a licensing role. We are looking for someone who can build relationships, originate opportunities and sell the broader value proposition of the organisation — including its ability to commercialise, launch and scale pharmaceutical products across multiple ASEAN markets.
Key Responsibilities
- Identify, source and evaluate in-licensing opportunities across pharmaceutical and biotech companies, with a particular focus on assets with potential across ASEAN.
- Build and maintain relationships with pharma, biotech and asset owners, acting as a senior external representative of the business.
- Lead the end-to-end BD process from opportunity identification and partner engagement through to negotiation, deal structuring and execution.
- Develop and negotiate multi-country licensing, distribution, co-promotion and strategic partnership agreements.
- Clearly articulate the company's commercialisation capabilities, market access, regulatory expertise, local market infrastructure and route-to-market strategy across ASEAN.
- Engage potential partners at senior levels and effectively communicate why the company is the right commercial partner for their assets.
- Work closely with Commercial, Medical, Regulatory, Market Access and Finance teams to assess the feasibility and commercial attractiveness of new opportunities.
- Develop business cases covering market potential, competitive landscape, pricing, investment requirements, revenue opportunity and commercial strategy.
- Lead commercial due diligence and support internal investment and portfolio decisions.
- Monitor emerging pharmaceutical trends, competitor activity and portfolio gaps to identify new partnership opportunities.
What We're Looking For
- Strong experience in Business Development, Licensing, Alliance Management or Corporate Development within the pharmaceutical industry.
- Demonstrated experience in in-licensing pharmaceutical products/assets, ideally across multiple therapeutic areas.
- Proven experience managing or negotiating regional or multi-country deals, rather than purely single-market transactions.
- Strong network and relationships across pharma and biotech companies, particularly within Asia and/or internationally.
- Commercially minded and comfortable engaging externally with senior stakeholders, including BD, Licensing, Commercial and C-suite executives.
- Able to sell a compelling story around what the organisation can do for a partner and how it can successfully commercialise an asset across ASEAN.
- Strong understanding of pharmaceutical commercialisation, including market access, regulatory considerations, pricing, distribution and launch strategy.
- Comfortable managing complex, cross-functional deal processes and translating market opportunity into a compelling business case.
- Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to represent the company in external meetings and industry discussions.
- Excellent communication skills in English; additional ASEAN or Asian language capabilities would be advantageous.
The Opportunity
This is an opportunity to take a highly visible regional BD role within a growing pharmaceutical organisation, with significant scope to shape the company's external partnerships and future product portfolio across ASEAN.
You will have the opportunity to originate deals, build senior-level relationships and play a direct role in bringing new pharmaceutical products into the region, while helping shape the company's broader commercialisation strategy.

Responsibilities

Convert qualified prospects into active purchasing accounts and meet new customer acquisition targets.

Document and obtain approval for all confirmed orders, prices, and terms according to company procedures.

Build relationships with decision-makers such as shop owners and purchasing managers to support channel growth.

Comply with company policies on pricing, discounts, credit, order approvals, and sales documentation.
Observe product safety, labeling, and regulatory requirements when promoting and supplying electronic products.
Handle customer and company pricing information confidentially.
Represent the company professionally during customer meetings, business visits, exhibitions, and sales activities.
Communicate effectively in English to engage with customers and internal teams; additional languages relevant to the customer base are advantageous.
Travel locally as needed to conduct customer visits and business development activities.

Previous experience in sales, business development, or B2B customer management.
Experience in consumer electronics, mobile accessories, IT products, retail distribution, or wholesale trading.
Ability to quickly learn and understand electronic accessories product specifications.
Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
Proactive, independent, and target-driven with capability to conduct field sales activities.
Good organizational skills to manage multiple customers and sales opportunities.
Proficiency in basic computer applications, spreadsheets, and sales reporting systems.
Valid driving licence and own transport are advantageous for field sales.

Title: Business Development & Sales Manager
Description:
We are looking for an ambitious, commercially driven Business Development & Sales Manager – Commodities Inspection to strengthen our presence in Singapore and expand our business across existing and new markets.
This is a hands-on, new-business-focused sales role for someone who enjoys identifying opportunities, opening doors, building relationships, and converting prospects into long-term business.
You will be responsible for developing new client relationships, identifying commercial opportunities, and promoting Control Union’s broad portfolio of services, including Inspection, Certification, Collateral Services, and other related solutions.
While Singapore will be your primary market, you will work closely with our international network of technical specialists, commercial teams, and operational colleagues to develop solutions for clients with both local and regional requirements.
We are looking for someone who is proactive, independent, and commercially minded — someone who does not wait for opportunities to appear but actively creates them.
Key Responsibilities
Business Development & New Client Acquisition
Proactively identify, target, and engage potential clients through cold calling, LinkedIn, networking, referrals, industry events, conferences, and direct outreach.
Build and maintain a strong pipeline of new business opportunities across Singapore.
Identify and develop opportunities within our established agricultural and commodity sectors while exploring new industries and markets where Control Union’s services can add value.
Establish relationships with key decisionmakers, industry stakeholders, and potential referral partners.
Arrange and lead client meetings to understand business requirements, identify commercial potential and develop appropriate solutions.
Independently explore emerging markets, services, and business opportunities to expand Control Union’s commercial reach.
Sales Management & Commercial Execution
Manage the complete sales cycle, from initial prospecting and qualification through proposal development, quotation, negotiation, and deal closure.
Work closely with technical, commodity and international colleagues to develop commercially competitive solutions that meet client requirements.
Prepare and follow up on commercial proposals and quotations, ensuring timely progression of opportunities.
Negotiate commercial terms within agreed authority while maintaining a strong focus on profitability and sustainable business growth.
Identify cross-selling opportunities across Control Union’s international service portfolio.
Develop selected existing-client relationships while maintaining a strong emphasis on new business acquisition.
Coordinate the successful handover of secured business to the relevant operational and account-management teams.
Market Development & Commercial Performance
Represent Control Union as a key local commercial contact in Singapore, strengthening our visibility and relationships within the market.
Monitor industry trends, competitor activities, and emerging commercial opportunities.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date sales activities, opportunities, follow-ups, and pipeline information in HubSpot CRM.
Actively manage sales opportunities through each stage of the commercial process, ensuring consistent follow-up and progression.
Contribute ideas and initiatives to improve sales effectiveness, market positioning, and business development processes.
Participate in relevant industry events, client meetings and regional business activities were commercially beneficial.
Requirements & Qualifications
Professional Experience
Minimum 5 years of proven experience in B2B sales, business development, or new business acquisition.
Experience in Testing, Inspection & Certification (TIC), commodity inspection, logistics, supply chain services or other complex B2B service industries is preferred.
Demonstrated ability to independently generate leads, establish new client relationships, and successfully close business opportunities.
Strong commercial understanding, including opportunity qualification, proposal development, negotiation, and margin awareness.
Experience working with regional or international clients and coordinating with cross-functional teams is advantageous.
Familiarity with CRM systems, preferably HubSpot, and a disciplined approach to pipeline management.
Skills & Personal Attributes
A genuine business hunter: Highly proactive in prospecting, comfortable with cold outreach and motivated by winning new business.
Results-oriented: Able to translate sales activities and client meetings into qualified opportunities, revenue, and profitable business.
Independent and self-driven: Capable of developing new markets and managing priorities with minimal supervision.
Commercially astute: Able to identify client needs, communicate value, negotiate effectively and progress opportunities towards closure.
Curious and adaptable: Willing to explore unfamiliar industries, learn new services and challenge conventional approaches.
Resilient and persistent: Comfortable handling rejection, overcoming objections and maintaining momentum throughout the sales cycle.
Collaborative: Able to work effectively with technical specialists, operational teams and colleagues across different countries and cultures.
Strong communicator: Excellent written and spoken English, with the confidence to engage senior decisionmakers and build professional relationships.
Mandarin language proficiency is a strong advantage, particularly for engagement with Chinese-speaking clients and regional stakeholders.
Existing industry connections in Singapore, Shanghai or Hong Kong would be advantageous but are not essential.
Willingness to travel regionally when required.
What We Offer
An opportunity to play a key role in expanding Control Union’s business presence in Singapore.
Exposure to a broad portfolio of services, industries, and international markets.
Access to Control Union’s global network of technical experts, commercial specialists, and operational teams.
A structured onboarding programme to build familiarity with our services, internal network, and commercial processes.
Guidance and commercial support during the initial development phase, with increasing autonomy as you establish yourself in the role.
The opportunity to contribute ideas, develop new markets and make a measurable impact on business growth.
A dynamic, internationally connected working environment that values initiative, independent thinking, and collaboration.
What Success Looks Like
Success in this role is not measured simply by the number of contacts made or meetings attended.
We are looking for someone who can consistently create new opportunities, build a qualified sales pipeline, progress negotiations and convert prospects into profitable business.
You will initially focus on developing a strong network of prospects and generating qualified opportunities, with increasing responsibility for delivering new clients, revenue and gross margin as the business pipeline matures.
Ready to Take on the Challenge?
If you are a motivated B2B sales professional who thrives on building new business, enjoys opening doors and wants to make a meaningful commercial impact within an international organisation, we would like to hear from you.
Apply now and become part of Control Union’s continued growth in Singapore and the wider Asia Pacific region.
Our Company
From our roots in agricultural inspections, Control Union have been operating for over 100 years and by now are engaged in many fields including inspections, certifications, logistics, collateral management and risk management etc. Our in-depth knowledge and experience covers all aspects of the supply chain in many industries including agriculture, textile, energy, forestry and sustainability etc.

Description:
SINBOR
was established over 55 years ago. We are looking for a few Sales & Business Development Executives.
ROLE
Sinbor is seeking motivated sales professionals to grow our customer base and promote our range of high-quality marble and other building materials in Singapore. We welcome applications from both junior candidates with strong relationship-building potential and experienced senior professionals with established industry connections and product expertise. The level of appointment and responsibilities will be aligned with the successful candidate’s experience.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
1. NEW BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT
• Identify and develop new business opportunities within Singapore's marble, natural stone, interior design and construction sectors.
• Proactively approach and build relationships with interior designers, architects, property developers, contractors, quantity surveyors, contract managers, project managers and other relevant decision-makers.
• Identify upcoming and existing residential, commercial, hospitality and other projects where marble and other building materials may be required.
• Develop relationships with project stakeholders and increase awareness and consideration of the company's marble and other building material products.
• Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective customers and projects.
• Arrange client meetings, presentations, showroom visits and site visits where appropriate.
• Convert new prospects into active customers and develop opportunities for repeat business and referrals.
2. PROJECT & PRODUCT SALES
• Understand customer and project requirements and recommend suitable products from the company's existing product range.
• Promote and sell high quality marble and building materials for residential, commercial and other project applications.
• Manage sales opportunities from initial enquiry through quotation, negotiation, closing and order coordination.
• Prepare accurate quotations using the company's established pricing structure for marble and other building materials and fabrication and dry-lay services.
• Ensure quotations accurately reflect required materials, dimensions, fabrication requirements and other relevant project specifications.
• Follow up consistently on quotations and outstanding opportunities.
• Negotiate with customers within established company pricing guidelines.
• Maintain accurate records of leads, quotations, opportunities and confirmed orders.
3. NON-STANDARD MATERIAL REQUIREMENTS
Where a customer requests a material or specification outside the company's standard product range, the Sales Manager will work with the Purchaser to identify an appropriate solution.
• Identify when a customer's requested marble, colour, pattern, size or specification is outside the standard product range.
• Clearly communicate the customer's material requirements and specifications to the Purchaser.
• Work with the Purchaser to understand available alternatives, costs and lead times.
• Use information provided by the Purchaser to prepare an appropriate customer quotation.
• Maintain ownership of the customer relationship and sales opportunity throughout the process.
4. ORDER & DELIVERY COORDINATION
• Coordinate confirmed orders with relevant internal teams.
• Ensure customer requirements are accurately communicated to teams responsible for dry-lay, fabrication and fulfilment.
• Monitor order progress and delivery schedules.
• Keep customers informed of relevant updates.
• Identify and escalate potential issues that could affect delivery or customer satisfaction.
• Follow up after delivery to support customer satisfaction and identify opportunities for repeat business.

• Proven experience in sales, business development or project sales, preferably within marble, natural stone, building materials, interior finishes or a related industry.
• Strong track record of generating new business rather than relying solely on inbound enquiries or existing accounts.
• Established network within Singapore's interior design, architecture, property development, construction or related industries is highly advantageous.

• Strong commercial and negotiation skills with the ability to convert opportunities into confirmed sales.
• Excellent communication, relationship-building and presentation skills.
• Strong follow-up, organization and pipeline-management abilities.
• Ability to work independently, take ownership of opportunities and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

• Comfortable working with established pricing guidelines and fabrication costs.

Job Description – Business Development Executive WAREHOUSE123
About the job
Most sales roles begin with a product list. This role begins with a customer’s warehouse problem.
We are building WAREHOUSE123 (https://youtu.be/_rMZWsB-NaY?si=qs-2_Yd0lTHtho70) around a simple goal: when a business thinks, “We need this for our warehouse,” WAREHOUSE123 should be the name they think of.
That means going beyond individual products. We want to understand how customers store, move, handle and protect goods, then connect them with practical solutions across racking, shelving, material handling, warehouse equipment and related operational needs.
We are looking for someone who wants to grow into this mission with us — someone prepared to speak with customers, attend sites, work through incomplete RFQs, ask good questions and take responsibility for moving an enquiry towards a workable solution.
What you will do
Attend to customer enquiries promptly, professionally & with clear follow-through.
Speak with customer to understand what they are trying to achieve, what information is missing & what should happen next.
Join customer site visits & progressively learn to conduct site surveys, take measurements, document observations & identify operational constraints.
Review storage needs, product dimensions & loads, material-handling equipment, aisle requirements, workflow & site conditions before recommending a solution.
Coordinate internally & with suppliers to develop recommendations, quotation inputs, product options & follow-up actions.
Track each enquiry carefully so commitments, unanswered questions & next steps are not forgotten.
Look beyond the immediate request to identify related warehouse needs that may improve safety, efficiency, storage capacity or daily operations.
Who we are looking for
You take ownership of work & follow through without needing to be chased repeatedly.
You are curious & willing to learn products, technical details & warehouse operations that may initially be unfamiliar.
You are comfortable meeting customers & working in both office & site environments.
You ask questions when information is unclear instead of guessing or passing the problem to someone else.
You remain constructive when a task becomes difficult, changes direction or requires extra investigation.
You communicate clearly and respectfully in spoken and written English.
You are organized enough to manage several enquiries, follow-ups & open items at the same time.
You are comfortable with basic measurements, numbers & common office or digital tools.
Background
Early-career applicants & career-switchers are welcome. Experience in sales, customer service, logistics, warehouse operations, engineering, project coordination, material handling or industrial products would be useful, but it is not essential. We are more interested in evidence of responsibility, learning ability & practical problem-solving than in a perfect job title.
Whatyou can build here
Real experience in customer discovery, RFQ handling, site surveys & solution development.
Working knowledge across storage systems, warehouse equipment, lift truck, material handling products & related product categories.
The opportunity to influence which products & solutions WAREHOUSE123 develops next.
Progressively greater responsibility as your product knowledge, judgement &customer-handling ability grow.
A role where good work can contribute directly to a long-term Singapore warehouse-solutions brand.
Our working approach
We do not expect a new team member to know every answer on day one. We do expect honesty, effort, disciplined follow-up & the willingness to keep learning. When a customer gives us an incomplete request, our job is not to dismiss it or guess. Our job is to clarify the need, inspect the situation where necessary and work towards the most practical solution we can responsibly provide.
Application process
Shortlisted applicants will be invited to discuss a simple, realistic customer scenario. This is not a test of memorized warehouse knowledge. It helps us understand how you ask questions, organize incomplete information and approach a practical problem.
If this sounds like the kind of responsibility & learning opportunity you have been looking for, submit your resume to sunny@yktoh.com& and tell us briefly why this role interests you.
We assess applicants using job-related skills, experience, potential & ability to perform the role.
Singapore Locals and Singapore Permanent Residents Preferred.

Title: Business Development Executive (Corporate Wellness)
Description:
ABOUT US
Bewell Chiropractic is an established Gonstead chiropractic group with three clinics in Malaysia's Klang Valley. Our Singapore clinic in Novena is its first outside Malaysia. We keep things simple and transparent: published prices, no long prepaid packages, and no pressure selling.
THE ROLE
You will build our corporate wellness partnerships, working closely with our founder, who leads corporate business development. Your job is to open doors with HR, people and workplace-wellness teams at companies, government agencies and building owners around Novena and across Singapore, and turn those conversations into ongoing programmes: workplace talks, on-site posture check sessions, and employee-benefit arrangements.
This is a relationship role, not a sales-floor job. Success means programmes that actually run and partners who come back, not signatures alone.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Research and build a target list of companies, agencies and buildings (HR, L&D, workplace wellness and facilities contacts), using AI tools to speed up research and qualification
Reach out by email, LinkedIn, phone and in person; book introductory meetings
Organise and attend workplace talks and on-site posture check days with our chiropractors
Prepare simple proposals and partnership agreements using our approved templates and price list
Help employers explain how staff can use flexible benefits or wellness allowances with us
Use AI assistants (such as Claude or ChatGPT) daily to draft outreach, proposals and follow-ups, then check and personalise every message before it goes out
Keep a clean CRM record of every contact, meeting and follow-up
Report monthly on activity: contacts made, meetings held, talks booked and partnerships signed
Represent Bewell at networking events, HR forums and community events

2+ years of experience personally sourcing and opening B2B accounts through outbound outreach (corporate wellness, healthcare, fitness, insurance or HR benefits is a plus)
Diploma or degree in any discipline, or equivalent practical experience
Able to write proposals and conduct corporate meetings in English, the working language used with our target clients
Organised and self-driven: you plan your own week and follow up without being chased
Hands-on experience using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT in your daily work (research, writing, planning). Tell us how you use them
Comfortable with Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 and a CRM
Honest by default. You never over-promise what a service can do
IMPORTANT: HOW WE TALK ABOUT OUR SERVICES
Chiropractic in Singapore is subject to strict advertising rules. You must describe only what we deliver (a screening, a talk, a session, a written report) and never promise health outcomes or name medical conditions. We will train you on this from day one and ask you to follow our communications guidelines in writing. If that sounds reasonable to you, we'd like to hear from you.

S$3,500 to S$4,000 per month fixed salary, full-time, 5 days per week
No commission; performance reviewed against agreed partnership-development milestones
CPF, annual leave, sick leave and public holidays
13th-month AWS, written into your contract
A clear path to Senior Business Development Executive as the corporate programme grows
Work directly with the founder in a small team where your work shapes a new clinic's growth
A modern, AI-first way of working, with tools provided
HOW TO APPLY
Apply through Indeed with your CV and a short note describing one account you personally sourced: who the decision-maker was, how you approached them, how long it took to agree, the result, and your own contribution. Also tell us, in one or two lines, how you use AI tools in your work. Please anonymise confidential details.

Description:
Top performers in this role don't wait for opportunities—they create them.
At Qashier, we're building the leading all-in-one commerce platform for SMEs across Southeast Asia. We're looking for competitive, resilient sales hunters who love winning new business, thrive in the field, and are motivated by uncapped earnings.
This is a true new business acquisition role.
There are no warm leads to inherit. Success comes from building your own pipeline, creating opportunities every day, and consistently closing merchants through disciplined outbound execution.
If you're someone who enjoys hearing "yes" because you've earned it—not because the lead was handed to you—this role is for you.
What You'll Own
You will own the entire sales cycle—from prospecting to signed merchant.
Specifically, you will:
Build and manage your own pipeline through cold calls, walk-ins, Google Maps prospecting, referrals, networking, and creative outbound outreach.
Consistently execute high outbound activity (40+ quality prospecting touches daily) to generate new business opportunities.
Meet SME owners face-to-face, understand how they operate, identify business challenges, and recommend the right Qashier solution.
Sell a complete commerce platform combining POS, integrated payments, QR payments, loyalty, e-invoicing, and merchant solutions that help businesses operate more efficiently.
Own your sales metrics including pipeline health, activity levels, conversion rates, revenue, and forecast accuracy.
Conduct compelling product demonstrations, negotiate commercial terms, and confidently close new merchant partnerships.
Partner closely with our Operations and Account Management teams to ensure a seamless merchant onboarding experience.
Continuously improve your sales process, messaging, and prospecting strategy to consistently outperform your targets.
What Makes Someone Successful Here
Our highest performers consistently demonstrate the following:
Hunter mentality — You enjoy winning new business and take pride in opening doors that others cannot.
Bias for action — When pipeline is low, your instinct is to increase activity, not wait for better leads.
Commercial judgment — You know where your time creates the greatest return and prioritize opportunities that matter.
Resilience — Rejection fuels you. Every "no" simply gets you closer to the next "yes."
Consultative selling — You ask thoughtful questions, understand each merchant's business, and tailor solutions rather than relying on generic pitches.
Coachability — You actively seek feedback, adapt quickly, and continuously improve.
Ownership mindset — You treat your territory like your own business and take accountability for your results.
Strong communication — You communicate with confidence, clarity, and credibility across merchants from different industries.
What We're Looking For
2–5 years of experience in B2B field sales, merchant acquisition, business development, or outbound sales.
Consistent track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets.
Comfortable spending most of your time in the field meeting merchants.
Proven ability to build your own pipeline through outbound prospecting.
Experience selling to SMEs is highly preferred.

HUD's product sells itself to the right person. Your challenge is finding and selling to them at scale.

Use AI tools aggressively to 10x your output (e.g., vibe code scrapers, automate workflows, build internal tools)
Develop and iterate on messaging that resonates with technical buyers, including ML engineers, AI researchers, and engineering leaders
Quickly learn new prospect businesses / industries and understand their pain points, workflows, and why HUD matters to them
Track pipeline metrics and optimize conversion at every stage
Work closely with founders to develop and refine our GTM playbook as we scale
Experience

Demonstrated ability to build and run a GTM motion with real, measurable results
A strong track record of closing deals
A CS or engineering background, or you vibe-code extensively on the side
Deep familiarity with GTM tooling
Strong written communication that technical people actually respond to
Early-stage startup experience with ability to work independently in fast-paced environments

Experience selling developer tools, infrastructure, or ML/AI products
History of building outbound systems using tools like Clay, Apollo, or custom automation
Familiarity with RL, e.g., you know what environments, evals, and benchmarks are

Title: Business Development Manager – Retail Expansion, Site Acquisition & Leasing
Description:
We are looking for an experienced and well-connected Business Development Manager to support the Group’s expansion across its beverage, bakery and retail brands.
This role will be responsible for identifying and securing suitable retail locations across Singapore, with a strong focus on shopping malls, retail developments and high-traffic commercial locations.
The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of Singapore’s retail and shopping mall landscape, including mall positioning, tenant mix, rental rates, footfall, customer demographics and available retail spaces.
You should also have an established network and strong working relationships with major shopping mall landlords, developers, leasing teams and property representatives, with the ability to identify opportunities and negotiate favourable commercial terms for the Group.
This is a hands-on role covering the full process from site identification and evaluation to lease negotiation, store expansion and lease renewal.
Responsibilities:
1. Retail Site Identification & Expansion
Identify and source suitable retail locations for the Group’s beverage, bakery and retail brands across Singapore.
Proactively monitor upcoming vacancies, new developments, mall repositioning projects and potential retail opportunities.
Build and maintain a pipeline of potential locations suitable for different brand concepts and store formats.
Evaluate locations based on mall positioning, footfall, customer demographics, tenant mix, accessibility, visibility, unit size and commercial potential.
Recommend suitable locations based on each brand’s target customers, business model and expansion strategy.
2. Shopping Mall & Landlord Relationships

Title: Business Development Manager — Hunter
Description:
About SeedRock
SeedRock Asia Pte. Ltd. is a Monetary Authority of Singapore regulated multi-family office and licensed fund manager (CMS100959), serving ultra-high-net-worth families and institutional clients across two practice pillars: Private Wealth and Family Governance, and Institutional Mandates.
Our positioning is deliberate: Institutional Sovereignty — the corporate office for your family. We exist to give UHNW principals the governance discipline, investment rigour, and institutional infrastructure ordinarily reserved for sovereign wealth funds and the largest endowments, applied at the scale of a single family or a small group of families.
SeedRock is independent. We hold no proprietary product, carry no distribution agenda, and answer only to the families and institutions that retain us. As the firm scales, origination is becoming a discipline in its own right — distinct from relationship management — and we are building a dedicated hunting function to support it.
The Role
We are looking for a connected, credible originator to join SeedRock as a Business Development Manager, focused purely on opening doors: introducing ultra-high-net-worth principals and family office decision-makers to SeedRock, and converting those introductions into qualified client relationships for our Private Asset Management team to take forward.
This is a deliberately distinct role from SeedRock's Relationship Manager track. A Hunter does not hold or manage a client book — your job is to find the relationship, make the introduction, and bring SeedRock's proposition to people who would genuinely benefit from it. Once a client is onboarded, the relationship is handed to an RM for ongoing management; you move on to the next introduction.
If you have a genuine network among UHNW individuals, family offices, or the professionals who serve them — and you would rather be rewarded for opening doors than for managing what comes through them — this role is built for you.
Key Responsibilities
• Originate and qualify new UHNW client introductions and family office leads, building a consistent pipeline of warm prospects for SeedRock's Private Asset Management team
• Leverage and actively expand an existing network across UHNW individuals, family offices, and the accountants, lawyers, and other professionals who serve them
• Run an initial qualification process on each introduction — establishing fit, scale, and intent before handing the relationship to an RM for full onboarding
• Meet quarterly origination targets, measured against qualified AUM or deal value introduced to the platform
• Represent SeedRock's institutional positioning credibly in first conversations — clients should leave the first meeting with a clear sense of what makes SeedRock different from a private bank
• Work closely with the Executive Director, Private Asset Management, to ensure a clean and well-briefed handover of every qualified introduction
• Maintain a disciplined personal pipeline log, providing visibility on origination activity and conversion at all times
Candidate Profile
• A genuine, active network among ultra-high-net-worth individuals or family offices — this is the single non-negotiable requirement for the role
• We are deliberately open to non-traditional origination talent: relationship-rich professionals (accountants, lawyers, corporate bankers with UHNW relationships), returning Singaporean diaspora from overseas finance careers, and business owners' right hands (CFOs or chiefs of staff to UHNW families) are all strong fits, alongside conventional private banking backgrounds
• Comfortable being measured purely on origination outcomes, without the security or upside of managing a long-term client book
• Polished, credible, and able to represent an institutional brand convincingly in a first meeting with a sophisticated principal
• Self-directed and resilient — origination is a long-cycle activity and this role rewards consistency over time, not single big wins
• Unblemished regulatory record and clean professional history, verifiable through standard background and reference checks
Compensation
This role is structured to reward consistent, credible origination rather than book management. Compensation is salary-led, with a directed annual bonus tied to origination performance against quarterly targets.
• Fixed base salary of SGD 7,000 to 9,000 per month, calibrated to network strength and origination track record
• Quarterly targets set against AUM or deal value originated and successfully onboarded
• Directed annual bonus, assessed against cumulative origination performance across the year
• This compensation reflects an expectation of an active, existing UHNW or family office network from day one — it is priced for a credible operator, not for a network still being built
Why SeedRock
• A genuinely open-architecture platform — no proprietary product agenda, no balance-sheet conflicts to navigate in the introduction conversation
• A clean, focused mandate: origination only, with no expectation to manage or service a book afterwards
• Direct line of sight to SeedRock's Executive Director on every qualified introduction, ensuring credit for origination is never lost in handover
• An institutional brand built specifically for the UHNW family office segment, genuinely differentiated from a retail-down private bank pitch
To Apply
Please submit your CV in confidence. All applications are handled with strict discretion; no contact will be made with current employers at any stage of the process.
Founded in 2018 as a family office and External Asset Manager, we have rapidly evolved into a prominent player in Singapore’s financial landscape. Our mission is to assist high net-worth individuals and families navigate the ever-changing macro-economic landscape. In the dynamic and complex world of finance, we are our client’s partner in safeguarding and growing our client wealth.
We are thrilled to announce our transformation from a Multi-Family Office into a Full-Fledged Fund Management Company. This transition underscores our commitment to providing comprehensive, sophisticated, and tailored investment solutions to our clients. With a strong track record of success, a seasoned team of experts, and a deep understanding of the global financial markets, we are our client go-to partner for managing and growing our client’s wealth.

Title: Business Development Representative
Description:
Who are we?
Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries.
People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden.
Job Description
Working for the Howden Employee Benefits division, this is a fantastic and exciting new role in our Business Development Team, working as a Business Development Representative.
Working on our intuitive CRM system, proactively responding to email and web enquiries, making outbound calls to prospective and existing clients to arrange meetings for our Consultants & following up on a pipeline of activities to generate new business and nurture relationships.
You’ll also be working closely with our marketing team, supporting them with campaigns and delivery of great content and advice for our clients and prospects.
Who are we looking for?
We’re looking for enthusiastic, driven telesales professionals who can deliver against targets and generate opportunities for new business. Who are able to demonstrate success in telesales, telemarketing or tele-research roles including setting appointments for field sales consultants.
Who can manage their own workload and pipeline of activities and opportunities and see them through to completion. We’re looking for somebody with commercial awareness and the ability to understand the changing needs of businesses priorities, and the people who work for our clients and prospects so that we can help them provide for their people.
Highly literate with keen attention to detail and competent with Microsoft Office applications. Someone with a sense of responsibility and ownership who can work with minimum supervision
Key responsibilities
The role supports Howden’s plans for business growth and expansion through building a genuine pipeline of prospective clients and accurate data. The job holder will focus on contacting prospects and managing the Customer Relationship Management database. The job holder will ensure that all activities are consistent with Company/Group policies.
Planning and Reporting:
Manages own work priorities and activities in line with agreed business plans to ensure the achievement of personal and team objectives.
Manages assigned projects and contributes to other project as required
Provides relevant management information to the senior manager, as required
Technical:
Works with data to create an accurate and valid new business pipeline, often linked to specific or targeted campaigns by telephone and/or e mail,
Manage diaries and schedule meetings for Consultants
Builds, checks and expands the client database and key contact information
Undertakes research on behalf of their manager as required
Policy, Process and Procedures:
Ensures prompt and accurate processing of data/information on relevant systems
Maintains appropriate client files, and provides marketing information when requested by the client

Actively develops contacts and builds relationships in the market in order to secure new business and identify opportunities for the future.
Builds and maintains strong relationships with internal stakeholders e.g. marketing, broking teams
Attends external seminars, forums and events where necessary, to positively represent the company and increase own knowledge and understanding of client priorities, changing needs and market trends. Provides support and assistance to senior colleagues and/or their clients on request.
Responds to the clients(both internal and external) requirements as appropriate
Behaves with all clients (both internal and external) fairly and ethically
Shares information that could be beneficial to the Operating Entity/Group

Actively undertakes personal development to ensure up to date knowledge and understanding of best practice

The Board of each Operating Entity requires the highest standards of corporate governance, operational excellence and financial reporting throughout the Group from all its employees. Specific responsibilities are listed below.

Completes all relevant regulatory training
Ensures competence of self and direct reports (if any)

Experience in a B2B telesales / telemarketing role
Experience of working within an insurance and client facing environment
Previous experience of working in a sales or marketing environment is desirable
Awareness of the regulatory environment and requirements including e.g. FCA rules, data protection, money laundering, specific standards of insureds’ professional bodies
Knowledge of the market within which the company operates including an awareness of competitors, specific territory knowledge, cultural awareness
SKILLS/BEHAVIOURS
Is confident and has good communication
Strong negotiating skills; able to influence and persuade others
Professional and personable
Computer literate
Able to work independently and use initiative – a self-starter who has drive and enthusiasm
Highly organised, with good planning/time management skills. Is proactive.
Resilient and calm under pressure
Strong attention to detail

GCSE Maths and English (or equivalent)
A levels minimum or tertiary level qualification is desirable

Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new

Description:
CBRE Data Centre Solutions (DCS) is seeking a highly motivated and versatile Business Unit & Sales Coordinator to join our growing team across Southeast Asia and India.
This dynamic role will be instrumental in driving sales governance and supporting operational excellence within our Data Centre Solutions business. The successful candidate will be a proactive, people-oriented individual with a strong ability to manage multiple tasks and foster a collaborative culture across diverse stakeholder teams in the region. This role offers an excellent opportunity for an individual keen to grow their career within the exciting Data Centre space, specifically within sales and operations.
Key Responsibilities:
Sales Governance & Proposal Management (approx. 60%):
Proposal Development: Lead and support the end-to-end proposal writing process, crafting compelling and accurate proposals, presentations, and other sales collateral. This includes gathering necessary information quickly and efficiently to meet submission deadlines.
· Sales Process & Governance: Act as a central point of contact for sales governance, ensuring adherence to CBRE's established processes, policies, and best practices. This will involve understanding the sales lifecycle with minimal handholding and proactively identifying areas for improvement.
Sales Process Administration: Support the Business Development Manager to streamline sales operations by managing pre-qualification questionnaires (PQQs) and Requests for Information (RFIs), conducting thorough research to build comprehensive information packs, and maintaining precise client and sales data for the Business Unit. This includes tracking sales activities, assisting with pitch preparations, coordinating client communications during the bid process, and obtaining quotes from subcontractors for proposals.
Information Gathering: Rapidly assimilate and consolidate information from various internal and external sources to support proposal development and sales strategies.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with sales teams, subject matter experts, and regional leadership to ensure alignment and effective communication throughout the sales cycle.
Document Creation & Pricing Support: Utilise Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint and Excel, to create bespoke, simple proposal templates while maintaining CBRE’s branding. To support Business Development Manager / Director in inputting pricing elements into client-facing documents.
Operations Support (approx. 40% of time):
Support the implementation and continuous improvement of operational processes within Data Centre Solutions, focusing on efficiency, risk mitigation, and service delivery.
The BUSC will manage schedules and coordinate internal and external meetings, acting as a key point of contact for the BU. This also includes diligently taking meeting minutes, ensuring the timely execution of follow-up actions, and contributing to clear communication by writing the Business Unit newsletter and other announcements to maintain operational efficiency.
The BUSC will be responsible for managing and maintaining the Executive Director’s calendar & meetings, and travel arrangements where necessary.
Collaborate with various internal teams to ensure seamless service delivery.
Coordinate and manage tasks and initiatives across different stakeholder teams and within the Southeast Asia and India regions.
Proactively identify and address operational challenges, contributing to solutions that enhance overall business performance.
Desired Skills and Experience:
Proposal Writing Expertise: Proven experience in writing clear, concise, and persuasive proposals and other client-facing documents.
Advanced skills in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel are essential for creating professional presentations, templates, and managing pricing data.
A solid understanding of sales methodologies and governance principles, with the ability to quickly grasp and apply new processes.
Demonstrated ability to gather, analyse, and refine complex information into actionable insights.
Basic knowledge of data centre operations, infrastructure, or related technologies is a plus. A keen willingness to learn and develop expertise in this area is essential, with a desire to grow within the Data Centre sales and operations domain.
A "people person" who can build strong relationships, foster a positive team culture, and effectively communicate with diverse stakeholders at all levels.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and bids simultaneously, delivering high-quality results within established deadlines.
Act as a champion of CBRE's RISE values (Respect, Integrity, Service, and Excellence) within the business unit, fostering a collaborative and inclusive environment across diverse teams and stakeholders within the region.
A highly motivated individual who takes initiative and requires minimal supervision.
