Title: CATERING MANAGER
Description:
Job Title:
Catering Manager
Industry:
Food & Beverage / Catering Services
Employment Type:
Full-Time
Minimum Education:
Recognised Bachelor's Degree (Compulsory)
Minimum Experience:
5 Years of Relevant Experience
Work Location:
Singapore
1. Job Summary
We are seeking a qualified and experienced Catering Manager to oversee the company's catering operations, including menu planning, food production coordination, event catering, manpower management, procurement, quality control, financial planning, and customer relationship management.
The successful candidate will be responsible for planning and coordinating catering services for corporate functions, private events, institutional clients, and other catering requirements. The role involves managing food preparation schedules, delivery logistics, service personnel, supplier relationships, budgets, and operational performance to ensure consistent food quality, timely service, customer satisfaction, and profitability.
The candidate must possess a recognised bachelor's degree and at least five years of relevant experience in catering management, food service operations, or the food and beverage industry.
2. Key Responsibilities
A. Catering Operations Management
Plan, organise, direct, and supervise the company's daily catering operations.
Develop operational schedules for food preparation, packing, transportation, delivery, setup, and service.
Coordinate catering orders according to client requirements, event schedules, guest numbers, and service specifications.
Establish and implement standard operating procedures for catering production, dispatch, delivery, and on-site service.
Monitor operational efficiency and ensure catering assignments are completed accurately and on time.
Coordinate with kitchen teams, service staff, drivers, logistics personnel, and external service providers.
Review operational processes and recommend improvements to increase productivity and service quality.
B. Menu Planning and Food Quality Control
Develop and review catering menus based on customer requirements, event types, budgets, and market demand.
Coordinate with chefs on menu preparation, recipe standardisation, portion sizes, food presentation, and production quantities.
Oversee food production planning for Indian cuisine, international menus, buffet catering, packed meals, and other catering services, where applicable.
Ensure food quality, taste, freshness, consistency, and presentation meet company standards.
Monitor ingredient requirements and implement measures to minimise food wastage.
Review customer feedback and introduce appropriate menu and service improvements.
C. Food Safety and Regulatory Compliance
Ensure catering operations comply with applicable Singapore Food Agency (SFA) requirements and relevant food safety regulations.
Implement proper food handling, temperature monitoring, storage, transportation, sanitation, and cleaning procedures.
Ensure food is prepared, packed, transported, and served under appropriate hygienic conditions.
Conduct regular inspections of kitchens, food preparation areas, storage facilities, catering equipment, and delivery arrangements.
Maintain food safety records, cleaning schedules, inspection reports, and corrective action documentation.
Identify food safety risks and implement preventive and corrective measures.
D. Event Planning and Client Coordination
Liaise with corporate clients, event organisers, private customers, and other business partners to understand catering requirements.
Prepare catering proposals, menus, quotations, service schedules, and event plans.
Coordinate guest counts, dietary requirements, special requests, event layouts, buffet arrangements, and service equipment.
Supervise catering setup, food presentation, service delivery, and breakdown at event venues.
Monitor service standards during events and resolve operational issues promptly.
Develop long-term client relationships and identify opportunities to secure repeat catering contracts.
E. Staff Recruitment and Manpower Management
Determine manpower requirements according to catering orders, production volumes, event schedules, and delivery commitments.
Recruit, train, supervise, and evaluate catering supervisors, kitchen personnel, service staff, and other operational employees.
Prepare staff rosters and allocate responsibilities for food preparation, packing, transportation, setup, and event service.
Monitor attendance, working hours, overtime records, and payroll-related documentation.
Establish performance standards and provide training to improve employee productivity, service quality, and workplace safety.
Maintain effective communication between kitchen, logistics, sales, and event service teams.
F. Financial Management and Cost Control
Prepare operating budgets, catering cost estimates, revenue forecasts, and financial performance reports.
Monitor sales revenue, food costs, labour expenses, transportation costs, equipment rental, and event-related expenditure.
Calculate catering costs and assess profitability for individual orders, events, and corporate contracts.
Review profit-and-loss statements and implement measures to improve margins and operational efficiency.
Control food wastage, excessive purchasing, overtime expenditure, and unnecessary operating costs.
Prepare management reports on sales performance, expenses, gross margins, and business profitability.
G. Inventory, Procurement and Supplier Management
Forecast ingredient and supply requirements based on confirmed orders, expected demand, and catering schedules.
Manage purchasing and inventory of food ingredients, beverages, packaging materials, disposable items, and catering equipment.
Coordinate with suppliers regarding pricing, product specifications, delivery schedules, and quality standards.
Monitor stock levels, expiry dates, storage conditions, stock rotation, and inventory discrepancies.
Evaluate supplier performance and recommend improvements to procurement arrangements.
Ensure sufficient ingredients, equipment, packaging, and operational resources are available for scheduled catering assignments.
H. Logistics and Delivery Coordination
Plan delivery schedules, vehicle allocation, delivery routes, and loading arrangements.
Coordinate with drivers and logistics personnel to ensure food and equipment arrive at the correct venues on time.
Ensure appropriate handling and temperature control during food transportation.
Monitor delivery accuracy, order quantities, packaging standards, and equipment collection.
Resolve delivery delays, missing items, and other logistical issues.
Review transportation efficiency and recommend measures to reduce delivery costs.
I. Business Development and Performance Management
Identify new catering opportunities among corporate clients, event organisers, institutions, and private customers.
Develop strategies to increase catering sales, improve customer retention, and expand the company's customer base.
Review market trends, customer requirements, competitor offerings, and catering service demand.
Coordinate promotional initiatives and recommend new catering packages and service offerings.
Monitor key performance indicators, including sales growth, customer satisfaction, food costs, labour productivity, and order fulfilment.
Prepare periodic reports and recommendations for management on business growth and operational improvement.
3. Job Requirements
Educational Qualification:
A recognised bachelor's degree is compulsory. Applicants must provide documentary evidence of their qualifications.
Work Experience:
Minimum of five (5) years of relevant experience in catering management, catering operations, food service management, or a related food and beverage management role.
Catering Expertise:
Demonstrated experience in managing catering orders, food production schedules, event logistics, and service delivery.
Management Skills:
Ability to supervise kitchen, catering, service, and logistics personnel.
Financial Competency:
Experience in budgeting, catering cost calculations, financial reporting, inventory control, and profitability analysis.
Food Safety Knowledge:
Familiarity with food hygiene, safe food handling, storage, transportation, and applicable Singapore regulatory requirements.
Planning and Coordination:
Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple catering assignments and deadlines.
Communication Skills:
Strong client management, negotiation, leadership, and problem-solving abilities.
Analytical Ability:
Ability to assess operational performance, identify cost-saving opportunities, and implement service improvements.
Work Flexibility:
Willingness to work according to catering schedules, including weekends and public holidays when required.
4. Application Requirements
Interested applicants should submit a detailed resume outlining their educational qualifications, employment history, catering management experience, and relevant operational responsibilities.
Applicants may be required to provide copies of their educational certificates, employment records, and other supporting documents during the selection process.
Only candidates who meet the essential educational and experience requirements will be considered.
Requirements:
The candidate must possess a recognised bachelor's degree and at least five years of relevant experience in catering management, food service operations, or the food and beverage industry.
A recognised bachelor's degree is compulsory. Applicants must provide documentary evidence of their qualifications.

- Design and implement regional go-to-market plans with key partners to drive adoption and sales of Jabra’s video collaboration solutions.
- Align GTM strategies with corporate objectives and regional market dynamics.
Partner Engagement & Enablement:
- Build strong relationships with key regional partners, distributors, and resellers to drive joint business growth.
- Conduct business planning sessions with partners to align sales goals and marketing initiatives.
- Enable partners through training, certification programs, and co-marketing initiatives.
Revenue Growth & Business Development:
- Identify and develop new business opportunities to increase video revenue across APAC.
- Collaborate with global account teams to drive video solutions adoption within multinational corporations.
- Work closely with regional sales teams to develop and execute account-based strategies.
Onboarding & Development of AV SI Partners:
- Identify, onboard, and nurture new regional AV Systems Integrators (SI) to expand Jabra’s video collaboration ecosystem.
- Develop customized training and enablement programs to accelerate the success of AV SI partners.
- Establish business plans with AV SI partners to drive joint revenue growth and market expansion.
Sales Support & Regional Engagement:
- Provide additional sales support and strategic guidance to APAC regional sales teams to drive video business growth.
- Travel across APAC to engage with partners, provide sales assistance, and support local teams in executing business plans.
- Work closely with regional sales leaders to drive revenue, achieve targets, and ensure consistent execution of sales strategies.
Market Insights & Competitive Analysis:
- Monitor market trends, customer needs, and competitive landscape to inform GTM strategies.
- Provide insights to internal stakeholders on APAC market dynamics and business opportunities.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
- Discuss, brainstorm, and collaborate with the sub-regions video sales team, Solutions Engineers, and global alliance team to develop new go-to-market bundles to sell more Jabra video solutions.
- Work closely with marketing, sales, and product teams to ensure successful execution of partner programs and initiatives.
- Act as a bridge between APAC partners and global HQ to align regional needs with global strategy.
To perform well in the role, we imagine that you:
- Have at least 5+ years of experience in business development, channel sales, or strategic partnerships within the video conferencing, UC, or IT industry.
- Proven track record in developing and executing go-to-market strategies in APAC.
- Strong experience working with regional distributors, partners, and global accounts.
- Experience in onboarding and managing AV Systems Integrators (SI) is a plus.
- Excellent communication and negotiation skills with a strategic mindset.
- Ability to work in a fast-paced, cross-functional, and global environment.
- Willingness to travel across the APAC region as needed.
What you Bring:
- Driven and dedicated – Always striving for excellence and results.
- Execution-focused – Turning ideas into impactful actions.
- Collaborative mindset – Works seamlessly across teams and stakeholders.
- Skilled relationship builder – Great at networking and fostering partnerships.
- Goal-oriented – Motivated to achieve and exceed business targets.
- Adaptable and resilient – Thrives in a fast-changing environment.
- Willing to travel – Ready to connect with partners across APAC.
If you're excited about making an impact and being part of a growth-focused team, we’d love to hear from you!

Title: Channels & Partnerships Manager
Description:
About us:
Founded in 2014, Tiger Brokers is a leading global online brokerage firm that leverages next-generation technology to deliver high-quality financial products and services to retail, institutional, and corporate clients worldwide.
Initial focus: API Partners, and Institutes of Higher Learning & Financial Literacy
The Manager – Channels & Partnerships is responsible for originating, building and maintaining profitable, long-term B2B relationships between Tiger Brokers and its partners. The role develops strategic partner plans, identifies growth opportunities, negotiates agreements and manages ongoing relationships with existing and new partners, so that each partnership delivers distribution, brand value and client acquisition for Tiger Brokers Singapore.
At the outset, the role will concentrate on two partner segments: API partners, and Institutes of Higher Learning (IHLs) and financial literacy. The Partnerships team works as one unit – team members cover for one another and rotate across partner segments (including exchanges, product issuers, media, lifestyle and institutional partners) as priorities evolve – so the successful candidate should expect this focus to broaden over time.
Initial Focus Areas:
1. API Partners
- Originate, onboard and grow partners who integrate Tiger Brokers’ trading and market-data capabilities through our API, such as fintech apps, wealth and advisory platforms, and quantitative or algorithmic trading communities.
- Own the partner journey from commercial discussion to go-live: scope use cases, coordinate with Product and Engineering on integration and testing, and secure Compliance and Legal sign-off on onboarding, client-ownership and distribution terms.
- Conduct partner due diligence before onboarding and ongoing monitoring after launch, covering regulatory standing, brand fit and conduct.
- Track partner performance after launch (activation, funded accounts, trading activity and integration issues) and run regular business reviews to grow each account.
2. Partnership – Institutes of Higher Learning & Financial Literacy
- Develop partnerships with universities, polytechnics and other IHLs – including faculties, career offices and student investment clubs – to co-create financial-literacy programmes such as workshops, talks, case competitions and investment challenges.
- Work with Marketing to deliver the firm’s investor-education content and programmes, keeping all material educational rather than promotional and appropriate to the audience, with Compliance review before release.
- Keep all IHL and financial-literacy programmes education-led: they carry no account-opening incentives, referral mechanics or sign-up promotions.
- Explore talent-pipeline opportunities with IHLs, such as internships and industry projects, in coordination with HR.

The primary measure of success for this role is enabling clients to reach their contracted volume of live accounts within agreed milestone dates and budget, while maintaining high client satisfaction and long-term commercial value.

Client Outcomes & Delivery
Own the end-to-end client success plan from sales support, to implementation through to scale and steady state.
Ensure clients achieve their contracted account volumes within agreed milestones, timelines, and budgets.
Act as the primary point of accountability for delivery outcomes across implementation, upgrades, and ongoing services within the scope of the MSA.
Proactively identify risks to delivery, adoption, or timelines and drive mitigation plans across internal and client teams.
Monitor and analyse client product usage, forecasting key account metrics.
Client Engagement & Governance

Oversee commercials related to professional services, managed services, upgrades, and Statements of Work (SOWs).
Work closely with the CCO office and Finance to forecast revenue, margin, and delivery costs.

Support sales cycles by articulating and presenting the client journey — from onboarding to scale — tailoring the level of engagement to be as “hands-on” as the client desires depending on the nature of the engagement (client maturity, partner involvement etc.).
Identify expansion opportunities across modules, services, upgrades, and additional volumes to get the client to the contracted volume on the platform.
Contribute to renewals and contract extensions through demonstrated value and strong relationships.

Description:
DESCRIPTION
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. Amazon's technology business has a history and tradition of leading the world in Web-related technologies and services. Now with Amazon Web Services (AWS) you have the chance to help individuals and businesses take their computing infrastructures and applications into "the Cloud".
AWS Managed Services is designed to accelerate cloud adoption. It simplifies deployment, migration, and management using automation and machine learning backed up by a dedicated team of Amazon employees. AWS Managed Services provides ongoing management and operations of the AWS infrastructure. It automates common activities such as change requests, monitoring, patch management, security, and backup services and provides full-lifecycle services to provision run and support your infrastructure.
We are seeking a professional that is able to operate at the forefront of transformational technology assisting enterprise customers to take advantage of a growing set of AWS services and features to run their applications.
As an AMS Cloud Architect you will be the technical resource to help our largest customers navigate the operational challenges of cloud computing. You will be an adviser supporting the customers' effort to identify good candidate workloads from their application pipeline and offer AMS specific advice on their architecture to ensure they are getting the full value of the AMS feature set. You will be the person people seek out as a resource to solve difficult problems. You possess customer facing skills that enable you to represent AWS well within a customer's environment and drive discussions with senior personnel regarding incidents, trade-offs, best practices, and risk management. You will constantly seek out new ideas and technologies that you can use to deliver a higher quality service.
You will be accountable for providing our customers with an exceptional AMS Operations experience. You will possess excellent customer facing communication skills. You will represent AMS within the customers' environment and drive discussions at multiple levels within the customer organization to Senior Leaders at the C level technical personnel and management regarding incident management, trade-offs, best practices, and risk management.
You will be surrounded by people who are smart passionate about cloud computing and believe that world class operations is critical to customer success. Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:
· Ensure customer business objectives are achieved with strong partnership and infrastructure solutions that meet customer's needs.
· Drive customer transformation activities and manage the engagement via governance to ensure successful delivery of solutions.
· Guide customers to ensure success in building and migrating applications software and services following the principles of the AWS Well-Architected Framework.

· You will engage directly with AMS and AWS service teams to be the voice of the customer and work with internal AWS resources to drive innovation, feature requests, and resolution to customer impacting bugs and/or issues.
· Capture and share best-practice knowledge among the AMS Cloud Architecture community.
· Assist in building AMS Operational service offerings and processes that demonstrate the value of well-operated infrastructure in the cloud.
· Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as blogs and whitepapers.

• Work with AWS field sales presales training and support team to help customers and partners on key engagements in technical cloud computing using AWS. Develop and deliver proof-of-concept projects and technical workshops. Support implementation projects and assist customers with cloud computing & processing capabilities. Help partners and customers utilize AWS services which include understanding customer requirements, proposing and delivering packaged offerings, and delivering custom solution engagements. We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Title: Coffee Category Development Specialist, Singapore
Description:
About SharkNinja
Our mission to positively impact people's lives every day in every home around the world allows our employees to be thinkers and tinkerers, designers and doers, creators and number crunchers, makers of things they love.
SharkNinja APAC is expanding and scaling rapidly. Our two brands, Shark and Ninja, have enjoyed unprecedented growth over the past five years, driven by a very strong innovation pipeline across both brands. Building on that success, SharkNinja APAC has embarked on a bold plan for growth in which Singapore and Malaysia play a critical role. We have taken these markets back from our distributors so that we can run them directly and drive strong growth behind innovation and investment.
Position Summary
The Coffee Category Development Specialist builds SharkNinja's credibility and commercial position in coffee in Singapore. This is a category where consumers are knowledgeable, opinionated and unforgiving — they can tell within one cup whether a brand understands coffee or is simply selling a machine.
Your job is to make sure we understand coffee, and that everyone who represents us does too. You will build the category expertise inside the business, the education programme for promoters and retail floor staff, and the in-store and event experiences that let consumers taste the difference rather than read about it.
This is a hybrid role and deliberately so. It requires genuine coffee craft — you should be able to dial in a grinder, pull a decent shot and hold your own with a specialty roaster — combined with commercial capability: range input, pricing and mechanics, distribution targets and accountability for what the category delivers.
You will also be our voice in the coffee community in Singapore: roasters, cafés, baristas, competitions and enthusiasts. Credibility here cannot be bought with media spend; it is earned person by person.
Key Responsibilities
- Build the Singapore coffee category plan: where we play, against whom, at what price points and with what proposition.
- Own the commercial development of the range in market — distribution targets, listings, pricing input and promotional mechanics.
- Provide structured range, feature and proposition feedback to Product and Marketing based on what the market and the community actually say.
- Track category performance, competitor activity and consumer trends, and bring a monthly point of view rather than a report.
- Build the coffee education and certification programme for promoters, retail floor staff and our own team — beans, grind, extraction, milk, maintenance and how our machines deliver.
- Train to competence, not to attendance. Certify people and re-certify them.
- Create the demonstration standard for coffee specifically: what a great in-store coffee demonstration looks like, start to finish.
- Build the materials — guides, videos, cheat sheets — that let someone perform well without you in the room.
- Design how coffee is demonstrated and sampled in our doors: equipment, consumables, hygiene, workflow and the actual quality of what goes in the cup.
- Work with Retail Excellence to build coffee experience into the perfect-store standard.
- Ensure demonstration machines are maintained, calibrated and genuinely capable of producing good coffee. A bad demonstration cup does more damage than no demonstration.
- Manage the consumables and equipment supply chain that keeps this running.
- Build genuine relationships with specialty roasters, cafés, baristas and the Singapore coffee community.
- Develop partnerships — bean partnerships, café collaborations, competition presence, training tie-ups — that earn us credibility rather than buy us exposure.
- Represent SharkNinja at coffee events, roadshows and trade moments as a credible practitioner.
- Be an honest channel back into the business about how we are really perceived by people who know coffee.
- Own the coffee category revenue and distribution targets for Singapore.
- Drive attachment of consumables, accessories and care products — the recurring revenue that makes this category valuable.
- Support launches: readiness, training, demonstration capability and early reviews.
- Prove the return on coffee education and experience investment so we know whether to scale it.
Essential
- 5+ years across coffee and commercial roles — for example specialty coffee, coffee equipment sales, category development or trade training, with genuine hands-on coffee craft.
- Real coffee credibility. You can dial in a grinder, pull and assess a shot, texture milk and hold a technical conversation with a specialty roaster. This is not a category where theory is enough.
- Evidence of building an education or category programme. Training you designed and delivered, or a category you developed from a weak position — with a before and after.
- Commercial capability — comfortable carrying a revenue and distribution number, not just a training calendar.
- Existing relationships in the Singapore coffee community, or the credibility to build them quickly.
- Strong communication and teaching ability. You will train people who are not naturally interested in coffee.
- Practical, hands-on temperament — you will maintain and calibrate equipment yourself when needed.
Experience might get you the interview. Mindset is what sets you apart.
YOUR ROLE IN LEADING OUR SUCCESS DRIVERS
- Lead us to be “RARELY SATISFIED”
- Make things better each day; “PROGRESS OVER PERFECTION”
- Use your knowledge of our consumer, understand that “DETAILS MAKE THE DIFFERENCE”
- Deliver something great; “WINNING IS A TEAM SPORT”
- Be clear and honest, “COMMUNICATING FOR IMPACT”

Coffee Beans | Coffee Machines | B2B Sales
Job Description
Cowpresso Coffee Roasters is looking for a
proactive, driven and outgoing Sales Executive
who takes pride in their work, responsibility and ownership of results.
This is a
hands-on business development role
. We are looking for someone who is comfortable actively going out to find new customers rather than waiting for enquiries to come in.
You will be responsible for prospecting, cold calling, cold outreach, visiting cafés and businesses, attending exhibitions, following up on leads and converting prospects into long-term customers.
The ideal candidate is confident speaking to new people, persistent with follow-ups and motivated by achieving sales targets.
Key Responsibilities
1. New Business Development & Prospecting
Actively identify and acquire new B2B customers for Cowpresso's coffee beans, coffee machines and related products.
Conduct
cold calls, cold emails, WhatsApp outreach and other forms of direct prospecting
to generate new leads.
Conduct
physical sales visits and walk-ins
to cafés, restaurants, offices, hotels and other potential customers.
Research and build lists of potential customers and decision-makers.
Approach prospective customers at exhibitions, trade shows, events and external venues.
Generate your own leads in addition to following up on leads provided by the company.
Arrange meetings, product demonstrations, coffee tastings and sales presentations with prospective customers.
Consistently follow up with prospects until a clear sales outcome is reached.
2. Sales & Account Conversion
Understand each customer's requirements and recommend suitable coffee beans, machines, equipment or solutions.
Prepare quotations and proposals and conduct sales presentations.
Negotiate commercial terms within company guidelines and work towards closing deals.
Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets and KPIs.
Identify opportunities to upsell and cross-sell additional products to existing customers.
Build long-term relationships with customers to encourage repeat business.
3. Field Sales
This is
not purely a desk-based sales position
.
The Sales Executive is expected to regularly be in the market meeting potential customers, including:
Walking into cafés, restaurants and other F&B businesses to introduce Cowpresso.
Visiting offices and commercial businesses to introduce coffee machine and coffee supply solutions.
Attending exhibitions, trade shows and networking opportunities.
Conducting scheduled customer meetings, tastings and demonstrations.
Following up personally with high-potential prospects.
4. Customer Relationship Management
Serve as a key point of contact for assigned customers.
Maintain strong relationships with new and existing accounts.
Understand customer feedback and communicate useful market information to management.
Work closely with the operations, coffee and technical teams to ensure customers receive appropriate support.
Follow up on customer enquiries, quotations, samples and outstanding opportunities promptly.
5. Sales Reporting & Administration
Maintain an organised and updated sales pipeline.
Record leads, meetings, follow-ups, quotations and sales progress accurately.
Provide regular sales reports and updates to management.
Monitor prospect feedback, competitor activities and market opportunities.
Handle sales-related administrative duties where required.
Requirements
Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing, Hospitality or a related field is preferred.
Previous experience in
B2B sales, business development, F&B, coffee, equipment sales or field sales
is advantageous.
Fresh graduates with a strong sales personality and willingness to learn may also apply.
Confident communicating with new people both over the phone and face-to-face.
Comfortable with
cold calling, cold outreach and walking into businesses to prospect for new customers
.
Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
Self-motivated and able to work independently without requiring constant supervision.
Persistent and disciplined in following up with potential customers.
Organised and able to manage multiple leads and opportunities simultaneously.
Comfortable travelling around Singapore for customer visits and sales prospecting.
Good command of written and spoken English.

We are looking for someone who is a passionate coffee sales person.
You should enjoy meeting people, finding opportunities and turning a cold prospect into a customer. You should be comfortable picking up the phone, introducing yourself to a new business, walking into a café to speak with the owner or manager, and following up consistently.
You should have a strong sense of ownership over your sales pipeline and be motivated by achieving measurable results.

Company: ASTER CHEMICALS AND ENERGY PTE. LTD.
Title: Commercial Manager
Description:
About Aster
Aster is a leading provider of energy, chemical, and infrastructure solutions in Southeast Asia, supplying products and services to various manufacturing industries in both domestic and international markets. It is a Chandra Asri-led joint venture with Glencore.
Since Chandra Asri Group's establishment in 1992, the Group has grown from strength to strength to build its reputation as a reliable growth partner, with strategically well positioned assets in Indonesia and Singapore.
The Group's total asset base includes a refinery with a capacity of more than 300,000 barrels per day with ongoing asset rejuvenation, alongside a 1.1 million metric ton naphtha cracker on Bukom Island, 2.5 million metric tons of downstream chemical assets on Jurong Island, and a 0.9 million metric ton naphtha cracker in Cilegon.
The company's business is supported by core infrastructure assets, including energy, electricity, water, jetty, and tank farm facilities.
For more information, visit www.aster.com.sg.
About The Role
This position will define, lead and execute strategies to deliver sustainable commercial value to the organization. You will own a range of categories and be responsible for managing the spend and contracts underlying these categories, from planning, sourcing, and negotiating to fulfilment. Beyond traditional category and contract management, you are also expected to unlock new business opportunities and manage the end-to-end process from origination to delivery. This role will work for you only if you have an unconstrained view of the world while still remaining grounded enough to get the job done.
Our organization is growing at an accelerated pace, both organically and through partnerships and acquisitions. This role will include portfolios which require you to manage key partnerships/accounts to align interests, negotiate win-win positions, monitor and manage performance, and develop continuous improvement and other business opportunities to solidify our partnerships.
Success in this role requires close collaboration with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Marketing, Engineering, Production, Finance, and Legal. The ability to influence stakeholders and navigate complex interdependencies will be critical to achieving business objectives.
Key Responsibilities
Manage key external business partners, alliances, and supplier relationships to deliver business outcomes
Develop and lead execution of business strategies with strong focus on improving business performance
Develop and lead negotiation and commercial deal making strategies/tactics to deliver best commercial outcomes
Demonstrate innovation, agility, and ability to think and work “outside the box” while adhering to our business values and principles
Coach, develop, and inspire a team members and foster a culture of performance, accountability, and growth.
Capably manage internal stakeholders and over time masterfully navigate and steer team through internal decision making processes
Actively Monitor market trends and shifts and connect how these market shifts may potentially create risks or opportunities to our business strategies; Develop and execute risk management strategies
Understand and demonstrate leadership in terms compliance with our business controls, standards, policies as well as external legal/regulatory frameworks.
Advocate, champion or in some areas, sponsor use of digital tools and data-driven decision-making to optimize processes and reporting.
Promote synergy across business units within our group of companies, enabling standardization and best practice sharing.
Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Supply Chain or related discipline. Postgraduate qualifications will be an added advantage.
Min. 10-12 years of working experiences in commercial, business development, supply chain, procurement or category management roles; Breadth of experience gained through exposure to diverse roles and responsibilities is a plus.
Excellent deal making, negotiation and business partnering skills; experience managing key strategic accounts is a must have.
Demonstrated experience managing complex stakeholder relationships across diverse internal and external groups, including multicultural and cross-functional environments.
Strong financial, commercial, analytical skills specifically ability to understand what drives business and financial performance, analyze levers to improve business results to improve shareholder returns.
We are a dynamic, fast pace organization with strong focus on results and outcomes. You must be comfortable working in an environment where you are constantly challenged by new ideas, strategies and learning new skills.
Strong verbal and written communication in English.

Title: Commercial Sales Director (RF/ Wireless connectivity)
Description:
Our client is an established company specialising in wireless connectivity products, radio frequency solutions and embedded hardware. With established engineering and product development capabilities, the business serves customers across international markets through customised technology solutions and long-term commercial partnerships.
The organisation is seeking a commercially astute and technically conversant sales leader to spearhead its next phase of growth. This is a senior management opportunity for a hands-on business builder who can develop new markets, deepen strategic customer relationships, strengthen the commercial organisation and take ownership of business performance.
Key Responsibilities
• Develop and execute the commercial growth strategy, identifying new markets, customer segments and business opportunities across wireless connectivity, RF solutions, embedded boards and related technologies.
• Lead proactive business development and new customer acquisition, personally driving strategic sales opportunities from prospecting and technical engagement through negotiation, design-in and commercial closure.
• Build and expand strategic relationships with OEMs, ODMs, system integrators, technology partners and distribution channels across international markets.
• Work closely with engineering, product development and operations teams to translate customer requirements into commercially viable solutions, customised products and long-term business opportunities.
• Take ownership of sales performance and P&L outcomes, including revenue growth, gross margins, pricing strategy, sales forecasting, resource allocation and commercial profitability.
• Develop and implement go-to-market strategies, market positioning and account plans to strengthen the company's competitive position and unlock new revenue streams.
• Build, lead and develop a high-performing commercial team, establishing clear sales objectives, accountability, customer coverage and performance management practices.
• Work closely with senior management and the Board on business growth priorities, market opportunities, strategic partnerships and the development of the company's commercial capabilities.
Requirements
• Degree in Engineering, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Business or a related discipline. Candidates with relevant technical sales experience and a strong commercial track record will also be considered.
• Significant experience in B2B technology sales, business development or commercial leadership within wireless communications, RF technologies, Wi-Fi connectivity, embedded systems, electronic hardware or related industries.
• Proven success in winning new customers, developing strategic accounts and delivering sustainable revenue growth in technically complex product environments.
• Strong technical and commercial acumen, with the ability to engage engineering stakeholders while translating product capabilities into customer value and profitable business opportunities.
• Demonstrated experience in P&L management, commercial strategy, pricing, margin optimisation and business performance management.
• Experience building or developing sales teams within a lean, entrepreneurial or SME environment, with the ability to balance strategic leadership with direct customer engagement.
• Strong leadership, negotiation and stakeholder management skills, coupled with a hands-on, entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to operate effectively in a Singapore-headquartered business covering international markets.

Title: Consultant, Red Team
Description:
We are seeking a skilled and adaptable Red Team Consultant to deliver Red Team and Purple Team engagements for our customers. The consultant will simulate realistic threats, identify weaknesses across people, processes, and technology, and collaborate with defensive teams to improve security detection and response capabilities.
This is a dynamic, customer-facing role involving assignments that may vary in scope, duration, location, and delivery approach. Consultants should be comfortable adapting to different customer environments and evolving project requirements.
Red Team Engagements
- Plan and conduct authorised Red Team engagements, adversarial simulations, and objective-based security assessments.
- Translate relevant threats and customer risks into realistic attack scenarios.
- Perform reconnaissance, initial-access testing, social engineering, privilege escalation, lateral movement, persistence, and data-access simulations where authorised.
- Assess security controls across networks, endpoints, applications, cloud platforms, identity systems, and operational processes.
- Identify and demonstrate attack paths that could expose critical systems or business assets.
- Develop or adapt tools, scripts, payloads, and supporting infrastructure to achieve engagement objectives.
- Maintain operational security and minimise the risk of unintended disruption throughout each engagement.
Purple Team Engagements
- Collaborate with Blue Teams, Security Operations Centres, incident response teams, and other defensive stakeholders.
- Design and execute controlled attack scenarios to validate preventive, detective, and responsive security controls.
- Map simulated adversary behaviours to recognised frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.
- Evaluate security alerts, telemetry, logging coverage, investigation workflows, and response procedures.
- Help defensive teams develop and refine detection rules, use cases, playbooks, and response processes.
- Facilitate knowledge-sharing sessions to explain attacker techniques and strengthen defensive capabilities.
- Conduct validation and retesting to confirm that identified security gaps have been addressed.
- Document improvements and remaining areas of security exposure.
Engagement Planning and Governance
- Define engagement objectives, scope, assumptions, success criteria, and rules of engagement with relevant stakeholders.
- Ensure all activities are conducted within approved legal, ethical, safety, and customer-defined boundaries.
- Follow applicable change-control, data-handling, access-control, and escalation procedures.
- Maintain accurate records of actions, evidence, findings, and attack paths.
- Communicate critical findings, operational concerns, and potential business risks promptly.
- Coordinate with project managers, internal teams, and customer stakeholders throughout the engagement lifecycle.
Reporting and Stakeholder Communication
- Produce clear technical reports, executive summaries, attack narratives, and prioritised remediation recommendations.
- Explain technical findings in terms of their operational and business impact.
- Present engagement outcomes to technical teams, senior management, and executive stakeholders.
- Deliver engagement debriefs and remediation workshops where required.
- Support remediation planning, validation, and retesting.
Capability Development
- Contribute to the improvement of Red Team and Purple Team methodologies, tools, procedures, and knowledge bases.
- Research emerging threats, vulnerabilities, attack techniques, defensive approaches, and security technologies.
- Share technical knowledge, lessons learned, and good practices with team members.
- Support the development of reusable attack scenarios and detection-validation content.
Customer Engagement and Adaptability
- Deliver assignments of varying scope, complexity, and duration based on customer and business needs.
- Work at customer premises when required.
- Adapt to different industries, technologies, operating environments, and levels of security maturity.
- Remain flexible in supporting planned and ad-hoc project requirements.
- Communicate effectively with internal teams and customer stakeholders throughout each assignment.
- Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP) is required.
- Advanced or specialist certifications, such as OSEP, OSED, OSWE, CRTO, CRTE, CREST CRT/CCT, GPEN, GXPN, would be advantageous.
- Demonstrated experience in Red Teaming, Purple Teaming, adversarial simulation, penetration testing, or a related offensive security role.
- Strong knowledge of adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures, including the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
- Hands-on experience with network, Active Directory, Windows, Linux, web application, cloud, and identity-based attack techniques.
- Experience collaborating with defensive security teams to validate and improve security controls.
- Understanding of defensive technologies and processes, including SIEM, endpoint detection and response, network monitoring, security logging, threat hunting, and incident response.
- Proficiency with relevant commercial or open-source offensive security tools and frameworks.
- Ability to develop or modify tools and scripts using languages such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, C#, or another relevant programming language.
- Ability to analyse complex attack paths and translate technical findings into clear business risks and actionable recommendations.
- Strong report-writing, presentation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
- Sound professional judgement and a strong commitment to ethics, confidentiality, operational security, and authorised testing boundaries.
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams.
- Willingness and ability to undertake customer-facing assignments of varying duration, including working at customer premises when required.
- Flexibility to support ad-hoc assignments and changing project requirements.
- Eligibility to obtain any security clearance or customer-specific access approval required for assigned engagements.
- A degree or diploma in cybersecurity, computer science, information technology, or a related discipline is preferred; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.

Title: Content Head
Description:
About Feel Fresh
Two founders, a Singapore oral-care brand, and nobody between us and the customer. We make a peroxide-free whitening kit, a stain remover mouthwash, ultrasonic and UV cleaners for retainers and aligners, water flossers and toothbrush sterilisers. We sell on our own site and on TikTok Shop, Shopee and Lazada, and Malaysia is next.
The Straits Times, CNA and Mothership wrote about us without being pitched. Dentists started recommending the products because patients brought them into appointments. All of it was built on content we made ourselves.
We are a multi-million-dollar brand that still runs on content: a script, a phone, a shoot, an ad that works. We are looking for the person who runs all of it.
The job, honestly
You run content at Feel Fresh. The editors, the filmers, the content interns and the livestream hosts look to you for what we make next, and the founders look to you for whether it worked.
You set the direction, you write the scripts that matter, and you step in front of the camera when the brand needs a face. Then you build the team and the system so the output keeps getting better, not just bigger.
You will work shoulder to shoulder with the two founders. Ideas get decided in a conversation, not in a deck. Pitch something on Monday and it can be filmed on Wednesday and live on Friday.
In a typical month you might
- Set the content direction and the monthly plan across TikTok, Instagram, Meta ads and our TikTok Shop livestreams.
- Run the editing and filming team: briefs, reviews, deadlines and the quality bar.
- Write the key scripts yourself and appear on camera for founder-style pieces, explainers and lives when needed.
- Run 2 to 4 shoot days: street interviews, founder pieces, product demos.
- Own the numbers with our performance marketer: which content drove sales, what we stop, what we double down on.
- Hire and train as we grow, including for the Malaysia launch.
You would be right for this if
- You have 3 or more years of content, social or video work behind you, with some of it leading people or projects, and a portfolio you are proud of.
- You write strong scripts and can tell within three seconds why a video will work, and say why.
- You are comfortable on camera.
- You are genuinely into marketing. You study ads for fun.
- You can run a team calendar and still ship on time.
The deal
- S$4,000 to S$6,000 a month to start, with pay that grows as the company and your results grow.
- A direct line to the founders and to the numbers behind the work.
- A brand with real reach: national press, dentist-recommended products, four marketplaces and a Malaysia launch.
- The chance to build the content function and the team under it from where it is today.
Singapore-based, in office, with regular shoot days on location.

Company Description
Astro Health Ventures is a Singapore healthcare company re-shaping how traditional medical services are delivered. We build and run specialised digital clinics, pairing licensed doctors with technology we build ourselves. Our first venture, Trimly (trimly.sg), is an MOH-licensed clinic providing medically supervised weight management in Singapore. We are founder-led with seven-figure monthly revenue, and short-form video is the biggest creative lever in our growth.
This is a Singapore-based role with regular on-site shoot days. We will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore and do not require visa sponsorship.
Role Description
We are hiring a fresh diploma or degree graduate who loves making short-form video and wants to do it full-time, at volume, for a brand where the numbers show what works.
What You'll Do
- Come up with short-form video concepts for TikTok, Instagram Reels and paid ads
- Write hooks, scripts, captions and simple storyboards
- Film content with our doctors, team members, creators and actors when needed
- Create UGC-style videos that feel real, not like ads
- Turn what we know about our patients (constant hunger, years of dieting, busy schedules, hormonal challenges) into stories people recognise themselves in
- Edit quickly in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or Final Cut
- Make multiple versions of hooks, intros, captions and formats for testing
- Study ad and content performance with the marketing team and improve based on what works
- Build a swipe file of strong ideas from health, wellness, beauty and consumer brands
- Keep a steady pipeline of new creative assets coming every week
What We're Looking For
- A diploma or degree in any field. Media, film, communications or marketing helps, but your portfolio matters more than your course
- You genuinely enjoy making content and understand short-form video culture
- You have a portfolio, TikTok or Instagram account, or past content you can show us. School, personal and freelance projects all count
- You understand hooks, pacing, captions and framing, and why people keep watching
- You can write simple, emotionally clear scripts
- You can film and edit on your own
- You would rather test many ideas than spend a week on one "perfect" video
- You take feedback well and turn revisions around quickly
- You are based in Singapore and can film locally

- Experience working with creators, influencers or non-actors on camera

- Comfortable with AI image and video tools

- Comfortable appearing on camera, though this is not required
What Success Looks Like
Success means we are consistently launching new content that helps us learn what our audience responds to. You don't need every video to be a winner. You do need to help us produce, test, learn and improve quickly.
We care about:
- Number of usable video concepts produced each week
- Speed of filming and editing
- Quality of hooks and storytelling
- Ability to find different angles for the same pain point
- Improvement in ad and content performance over time
What We Offer
- S$3,000 to S$4,500 a month depending on portfolio, plus 13th month bonus
- Direct mentorship from the founder who leads growth
- Hybrid working: in Singapore for shoot days, flexible otherwise
- Apply with your CV and links to 3 to 5 videos you filmed and edited yourself. Applications without links won't be reviewed. We read every application and reply either way.

Best Talent

Foster high employee engagement through recognition & reward of team members and celebrating success.

Develop environmental health and safety procedures for sites. These procedures include emergency action plans, disaster recovery, business continuity, and other related procedures.

Build a culture of innovation, delivering ideas, innovation and thought-leadership to the customer.
Engage with team, supply chain and subject matter experts for idea generation and process improvement, providing a diverse offering of solutions to the customer.
Collaborate, connect and share best practice on new ways of working with peer group and external network.
Growth & Retention
Drive sustainable organic growth on the account – maximizing opportunities for additional scope, extra works and projects. Price additional services and extra works, and/or work with the BU Project team.

Asia Properties is seeking a Manager, Corporate Development (M&A) to support the origination, evaluation, and execution of real estate acquisitions, joint ventures, and strategic investments across the region. The ideal candidate combines strong financial and analytical rigour with a genuine interest in real estate markets, and is comfortable managing multiple live transactions in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
JobDescription
Deal Origination &Market Intelligence

Track market trends, transaction comparables, competitor activity and regulatory/policy changes affecting real estate investment across target markets
Financial Analysis &Valuation

Prepare feasibility studies covering market positioning, highest-and-best-use analysis, development cost estimates and revenue assumptions

Due Diligence &Transaction Execution

Prepare investment committee and board presentations, clearly articulating deal rationale, risks and returns
Stakeholder &Relationship Management
Build and maintain relationships with brokers, agents, joint venture partners, government agencies, financial institutions and other market participants
Liaise with internal stakeholders across finance, legal, development, asset management and operations to align on deal terms and execution requirements
Support negotiations with counterparties, sellers and JV partners under the guidance of senior corporate development leadership
Post-Deal Support
Support integration planning and handover to asset management/development teams following completion
Track post-acquisition performance against underwriting assumptions and flag variances

Familiarity with real estate asset classes (residential, commercial, retail, industrial/logistics, hospitality)and REIT/fund investment structures is highly valued

Solid understanding of real estate fundamentals, market cycles and development economics

Strong negotiation andrelationship-management skills
Close attention to detail and strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple deals concurrently under tight timelines

Activités

Title: Corporate Sales & Business Development Executive
Description:
Corporate Sales & Business Development Executive
The Gift Expert is a leading corporate gifting and merchandising company that helps businesses strengthen relationships through thoughtfully curated gifts, branded merchandise, promotional products, employee appreciation programmes, and customised gift solutions. As we continue to expand, we are looking for 3 to 4 ambitious, driven, and relationship-focused individuals to join our growing Corporate Sales & Business Development team.
This role is ideal for candidates who enjoy meeting people, building relationships, presenting ideas, and helping clients find creative gifting solutions. Whether you have previous sales experience or are looking to build a career in B2B sales, we provide the training and support needed to develop your skills in corporate sales, business development, and account management.
As a Corporate Sales & Business Development Executive, you will play a key role in driving business growth by identifying and engaging potential corporate clients across various industries. Your responsibilities will include prospecting new business opportunities, conducting cold calls and client outreach, introducing our corporate gifting and merchandise solutions, understanding clients' branding and campaign objectives, preparing quotations and proposals, following up on enquiries, negotiating opportunities, and converting leads into long-term business relationships.
You will also support The Gift Expert's expansion into retail merchandising by working with theme parks, tourist attractions, museums, hotels, resorts, lifestyle brands, and destination retailers to develop customised souvenir collections, retail-ready merchandise, and exclusive gift products.
Working closely with our internal teams and supplier network, you will coordinate product recommendations, sourcing, sampling, artwork approvals, pricing, production schedules, and delivery timelines to ensure every project is delivered smoothly and exceeds client expectations.
Candidates with backgrounds in sales, events management, event organising, hospitality, tourism, retail, marketing, client servicing, project coordination, or customer relationship management will have an advantage, as these experiences translate well into understanding client expectations, managing multiple projects, coordinating timelines, and delivering outstanding customer experiences. Experience in organising corporate events, exhibitions, roadshows, conferences, or marketing activations is an added bonus, as many corporate gifting projects are closely aligned with events, product launches, employee engagement initiatives, and client appreciation programmes.
We are looking for individuals who are energetic, proactive, confident communicators, and eager to learn. Success in this role comes from having a positive attitude, resilience, strong interpersonal skills, and a genuine interest in helping businesses create memorable gifting experiences. We welcome motivated individuals who are prepared to take ownership of their work and grow within a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
The Gift Expert offers comprehensive training in corporate sales, cold calling, business development, client relationship management, solution selling, and merchandising. In addition to a competitive basic salary, this role includes an attractive commission structure that rewards strong performance and provides significant earning potential as you build and expand your client portfolio.
If you enjoy meeting clients, developing creative solutions, and building long-term business relationships, this is an excellent opportunity to establish a rewarding career in the corporate gifting and merchandising industry with The Gift Expert.

The Singapore Mint was established in 1968 to mint circulation coins for the newly-independent nation. Over the years, The Singapore Mint has evolved from a basic minting facility to a fully integrated business operation, comprising programme concept, product design, marketing, sales and distribution with after sales service. Focusing on quality system and standards, The Singapore Mint is a certified ISO 9001 and 14001 organisation. Today, it has grown to become one of the leading innovative mints in the industry, capable of producing coins and medallions of the highest quality.
Leveraging on technology, The Singapore Mint has developed hybrid techniques to create high security and innovative features on circulation and commemorative coins and collectables. Fusing advanced minting technologies with authentic crafting methods, The Singapore Mint is one of the few mints in the world that still maintains a team of highly skilled craftsmen, adding intricate elements that can only be meticulously achieved by the human touch.
As a testament of its high quality crafting techniques, The Singapore Mint has won multiple international awards and its rising stature has garnered much interest internationally. The mint has been appointed by issuing authorities around the world for the production of their coins.
Other than producing coins and medallions, The Singapore Mint has also expanded to provide quality currency-related gifts and collectibles, lifestyle products and services to both local and international markets. We continue to pledge our unwavering commitment to our customers, business associates and partners to offer the best in quality, value and service.

Pay: Commission-only, no fixed base salary. Paid in SGD or USD. There is no hourly or fixed fee; all pay is commission.
Angle: You've made your profits from Bali — or you missed that wave. Lombok is the next chance.
Compensation: commission-only (freelance/independent). Highly attractive, uncapped commission on every closed sale, plus overrides on deals closed by partners you activated. Details are shared in the interview.
About Baraca
Baraca Capital is a RERA-licensed real estate advisory and investment firm helping investors build portfolios across Dubai, Bali and Lombok. Through Baraca Development we design, permit, build and manage projects under our own name. Flagship: Tampah Beach Villas and a South Lombok pipeline. We also advise investors on Dubai property.
The role
Own Singapore. Build the market for Baraca from the ground up, so investors in Singapore can access Lombok developments and Dubai advisory through you and through partners they already trust.
You will
- Map, sign and activate local brokers, wealth advisers, private bankers, family-office contacts and other partners (e.g. property agencies, private banks, independent wealth managers)
- Train partners on the Lombok thesis, the product, the buying process and compliance basics. Run activation playbooks with them.
- Generate investor leads, qualify them and close them yourself
- Host investor events, seminars and webinars in Singapore. Organise site visits to Lombok.
- Represent Baraca locally at industry events, in the media and with partners
- Track your pipeline and report on active partners, qualified leads and reservations/sales

You bring
- A proven track record selling international or high-ticket real estate or investment products to high-net-worth (HNW) clients
- An existing network of HNW investors, brokers, advisers or partners in Singapore that you can activate now, not only a claim on your CV
- Fluent spoken and written English. Mandarin or other regional languages are a plus.
- Comfort working commission-only and independently. You run your own diary and own a new market.
- Bonus: Indonesia, Bali or Dubai property experience. Experience with developer channel partnerships, or in private banking or wealth management.
Success looks like
- A live roster of activated partners selling Baraca in Singapore
- A steady flow of introductions, reservations and closed sales
- Baraca seen as the go-to name in Singapore for Lombok and Dubai property investment
How to apply
Apply with your CV/LinkedIn and a short note: which partners or networks you can open in your first 90 days, and whether your Bali story is "I rode it" or "I missed it."

Title: Creative Copy Writer
Description:
What you will do
You own the words and help shape the idea behind them, from the first brainstorm to the final caption.
Concepts and campaign messaging
Work with the Creative Lead and strategy head to develop campaign ideas, creative territories and messaging frameworks.
Turn client briefs, product features and brand positioning into clear, memorable narratives.
Present and sell your concepts in internal reviews and client pitches.
Copy across channels
Write campaign headlines, taglines, body copy and calls to action for key visuals, print and digital ads.
Write platform-native social copy for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and LinkedIn: hooks, captions, carousels and short-form video scripts.
Write websites, landing pages, EDMs, brochures and the occasional long-form piece.
Name things: campaigns, products, programmes and brand properties.
Brand voice
Learn each client's tone, personality and audience, and keep the voice consistent across markets and touchpoints.
Build and maintain voice guidelines and messaging playbooks for assigned accounts.
Proofread and edit your own work and others' to a publish-ready standard.
Collaboration
Work side by side with designers and video editors so copy and visuals are developed together.
Join client meetings with client servicing to take briefs and present work.
Revise copy based on client feedback and on engagement and performance data.
Use AI tools to speed up research and first drafts, while keeping the judgement and the final line your own.
Your first 90 days
By the end of month three you are writing publish-ready copy for your accounts with light supervision.
Days 1–30: learn how we work.
Get to know our briefing, review and approval process, and how copy, design and strategy hand off to each other. Read into the tone, audience and goals of each account you are assigned.
Days 31–60: contribute.
Deliver on-brand copy across social, digital and print. Join brainstorms and pitch angles, hooks and formats. Turn briefs into clear concepts.
Days 61–90: own it.
Lead the copy on at least one campaign from concept to delivery. Start a voice guide and hook library for your accounts, and flag content opportunities to the team.
What you bring
Must have
1–3 years as a creative, conceptual or brand copywriter, in an agency or in-house.
A portfolio that shows conceptual thinking, strong campaign headlines, social copy and integrated campaign work.
Excellent written English and a sharp eye for grammar, rhythm and detail.
The ability to picture an idea and explain it clearly to designers, clients and other non-writers.
Range in tone: from polished and premium for a luxury hotel to playful and punchy for a beauty brand, without jargon or filler.
Awareness of digital culture, platform formats and what audiences are responding to now.
Self-discipline to manage your own time and deadlines in a WFH-first team.
Comfort with tight turnarounds and with taking feedback and revising quickly.
Good to have
Experience in hospitality, travel, beauty, lifestyle or healthcare brands.
Scriptwriting for Reels, TikTok or short films.
Working knowledge of SEO and performance copy.
A second language used in our markets, such as Mandarin.
How you work
Curious and resourceful
Clear communicator
Organised and dependable
Strategic problem-solver
Takes initiative and ownership
Why join Agape
Real creative ownership.
You help shape campaigns and brand voices from the concept up, not fill in text boxes on templates.
Brands people know.
You write for established regional and global names in hospitality, beauty and lifestyle.
A small team with no layers.
You work directly with the team leads and the founder, pitch ideas freely and see them made quickly.
Since our inception in 1998, Agape Communications’ core philosophy has led us into the new decade as a strategy-led creative brand agency that aims to bridge the gap between consulting and creating, while keeping our focus on our clients’ growth in the post-COVID landscape.
Creatives never stop thinking, and good ideas never stay still.
Strategic Thinking
We think, a lot. Our strategy is focused on deriving insights, data analysis and knowledge inquiry so that we can make farsighted decisions and effective executions.
Boldness
We keep up with the times. Our swift responses and daring approach to new ideas and contexts mean we are not afraid to take risks and express ourselves.
Perspective & Insight
We are multifaceted. Every individual in Agape brings fresh and unique perspectives to the table every day, so that there is never a moment where any of us sees the same idea in the same way.

Title: Creative Manager / Creative Director
Description:
The Creative Manager / Creative Director will be responsible for leading the creative direction and visual communication of the company across its brand, marketing, retail, events, and corporate initiatives.
This is a hands-on creative role for someone with strong experience across different areas of design, including branding, retail, events, print, environmental graphics, promotional materials, and corporate communications.
The ideal candidate should be able to take a project from an initial idea through to final artwork and production, while working closely with management, internal teams, suppliers, and external partners to ensure the final outcome is creative, practical, and aligned with the company’s brand.
Experience & Skills
Minimum 7 to 10 years of experience in graphic design, including at least 4 years in a creative or design leadership role.
Significant experience within MICE, events, exhibitions, experiential marketing or a closely related creative agency environment.
Proven experience delivering creative work for major or international brands.
A strong portfolio demonstrating outstanding graphic design, visual storytelling, branding and campaign development across both physical and digital applications.
Strong conceptual ability with the confidence to originate ideas and creative concepts from a blank page.
Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring and inspiring a creative/design team in a fast-paced agency or project-driven environment.
Expert-level proficiency in CorelDraw, Autocad, Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign.
Strong understanding of brand identity, typography, layout and design systems.
Solid technical knowledge of artwork preparation and production across print and digital applications, including large-format graphics, signage, fabrication, event screen graphics, presentations and digital assets.
Excellent organisational and project management capabilities, with the ability to manage competing priorities across multiple concurrent projects.
A polished and confident communicator who can present, articulate and defend creative ideas to clients and senior stakeholders.
Strong understanding of both digital and physical design applications.
Experience taking projects from concept and design through artwork preparation and final production.
Good understanding of print production, materials, finishing, fabrication, and installation.
Experience working with printers, fabricators, production houses, suppliers, and other creative partners.
Strong portfolio demonstrating a variety of creative and commercial design work.
Ability to understand a brief, develop concepts, present ideas, and turn them into practical final solutions.
Strong knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.
Good understanding of typography, layout, colour, composition, branding, and visual hierarchy.
Able to work independently and manage multiple projects with different deadlines.
Strong communication and coordination skills.
Key Responsibilities
Creative Direction & Brand Development
Develop creative concepts and visual directions for company campaigns, events, retail activities, marketing initiatives, and corporate communications.
Maintain consistency and quality across all brand touchpoints.
Translate business objectives and ideas into clear, engaging visual concepts.
Provide creative direction and recommendations to management and internal teams.
Develop new creative approaches that help strengthen the company’s overall brand presence.
Design & Visual Communication
Lead and execute a wide range of design projects from concept to final artwork.
Develop key visuals, campaign materials, presentations, advertisements, brochures, posters, signage, displays, and promotional materials.
Create artwork for both digital and physical applications.
Adapt creative concepts across different formats, sizes, locations, and media.
Ensure artwork is technically suitable for production and installation.
Retail, Events & Environmental Design
Develop creative solutions for retail displays, point-of-sale materials, roadshows, exhibitions, events, and promotional spaces.
Work on event graphics, backdrops, banners, stage visuals, booth graphics, directional signage, wall graphics, and other environmental applications.
Understand the practical requirements of producing and installing creative materials in physical spaces.
Work with production teams, printers, fabricators, installers, and vendors to ensure creative concepts are delivered accurately.
Print & Production
Prepare and manage artwork for various print and production requirements.
Have a good understanding of printing processes, materials, finishing, fabrication, and installation.
Review proofs, samples, colours, materials, and finished products where required.
Work closely with suppliers and production partners to resolve technical or production-related issues.
Ensure final deliverables meet the expected creative and production standards.
Preferred Experience
Experience in the following areas would be advantageous:
Retail and point-of-sale design
Events and exhibitions
Roadshows and promotional campaigns
Corporate branding and communications
Large-format printing and signage
Environmental graphics and spatial branding
Packaging and promotional materials
Display and merchandising
Print production and fabrication
Campaign key visuals and adaptations
Vendor and production coordination
Personal Attributes
Creative, practical, and commercially minded.
Able to balance creativity with real-world production requirements.
Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger picture.
Comfortable taking ownership of projects from beginning to completion.
Able to communicate ideas clearly to both creative and non-creative teams.
Proactive in finding solutions rather than simply identifying problems.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.
Collaborative and able to work effectively with management, colleagues, clients, suppliers, and production teams.
