Overview
The Director, Retail – Singapore and Malaysia is responsible for leading the retail business across both markets, driving commercial performance, operational excellence, and exceptional consumer experiences across all company-owned stores. This role provides strategic leadership for retail growth, ensuring the successful execution of business, brand, and operational priorities while delivering sustainable financial results.
As a commercially driven and people-focused leader, the Director will develop and execute market growth strategies, optimize retail operations, and build a high-performing organization. Working closely with cross-functional partners, the incumbent will champion innovation, drive change, and strengthen organizational capability to support the long-term success and profitability of the Singapore and Malaysia retail business.
The role can be based either in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia or Singapore.
What You'll Do
Lead Singapore and Malaysia Retail Strategy: Develop and execute the long-term retail strategy for Singapore and Malaysia, driving sustainable revenue growth, market expansion, brand equity, consumer engagement, and operational excellence while ensuring alignment with regional and global business priorities.
Own P&L and Business Performance: Assume full accountability for retail sales, profitability, productivity, and key performance indicators. Leverage data-driven insights to identify growth opportunities, mitigate risks, and implement strategic actions that deliver consistent business results.
Drive Retail Excellence and Consumer Experience: Lead the delivery of best-in-class consumer experiences and operational standards across all retail locations. Partner with Area Managers, Retail Operations, Training, and Visual Merchandising teams to ensure execution excellence, brand consistency, and customer satisfaction.
Shape Merchandise and Inventory Strategies: Collaborate closely with Merchandising and Planning teams to optimize assortment, inventory productivity, allocation strategies, and product availability, maximizing sell-through, profitability, and consumer demand fulfillment.
Lead Commercial Activation: Partner cross-functionally to develop and execute in-store marketing, promotional, and brand activation initiatives that drive traffic, conversion, and revenue growth.
Drive Store Portfolio and Expansion Strategy: Identify and execute retail expansion opportunities, including new store openings, relocations, remodels, pop-up concepts, and portfolio optimization initiatives to strengthen market presence, enhance consumer accessibility, and improve financial returns.
Build Organizational Capability: Lead, coach, and develop retail talent across stores and the support organization, fostering leadership capability, succession strength, and a high-performance culture.
Champion Operational Governance and Compliance Ensure adherence to company policies, operational controls, compliance requirements, and risk management practices, safeguarding the business while maintaining a productive and engaging store environment.
What You'll Bring to the Table
Bachelor's degree in Business, Retail Management, Marketing, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
12+ years of progressive retail leadership experience, including multi-store, district, or national retail responsibility within a consumer-facing brand.
Proven track record of leading large, geographically dispersed retail teams and delivering sustainable sales, profit, and operational KPI improvements.
Strong commercial and financial acumen, with experience managing retail P&L performance, productivity, inventory, and store portfolio optimization.
Demonstrated ability to develop high-performing teams, build leadership capability, and drive succession planning within a retail organization.
Strategic thinker with the ability to translate market insights and business priorities into executable retail growth strategies.
Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills, with a proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally across Merchandising, Planning, Marketing, Finance, HR, and Operations.
Strong communication, change leadership, and decision-making capabilities.

Title: Director, Solutions Growth & Enablement
Description:
Our Purpose
Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.
Title and Summary
Director, Solutions Growth & Enablement
Overview
The Director, Solutions Growth & Enablement plays a critical role in accelerating the growth of Mastercard's Consumer Acquisition & Engagement business across Asia Pacific.
Leading a Kuala Lumpur-based team, the role is responsible for driving commercialization, sales enablement, strategic partnerships, and market development activities that help regional and divisional teams grow pipeline, win new business, and deepen client relationships.
The role serves as a key bridge between Product, Sales, Marketing Services, and market teams, ensuring Mastercard's capabilities are translated into compelling client solutions, commercial opportunities, and measurable business outcomes.
________________________________________
The Role
Growth Strategy & Commercialization
 Drive commercialization and growth initiatives for Consumer Acquisition & Engagement solutions across Asia Pacific.
 Identify revenue opportunities, emerging client needs, and market trends that can be translated into scalable growth strategies.
 Develop value propositions, solution narratives, and sales plays that help position Mastercard's capabilities in a differentiated and commercially compelling manner.
 Partner closely with product and market teams to bring new capabilities to market and accelerate client adoption.
Strategic Partnerships
 Lead strategic partnerships across Mastercard including Marketing & Communications, Core Product, Optimization, and other Core teams.
 Identify opportunities to integrate CA&E capabilities into broader Mastercard conversations and develop joint go-to-market initiatives that expand reach and revenue potential.
 Facilitate cross-functional collaboration to unlock multi-product opportunities and deliver more holistic solutions for clients.
Sales Enablement & Opportunity Development
 Equip Sales, Client Services, and Account Management teams with the tools, content, training, and support needed to drive growth.
 Develop sales materials, client presentations, case studies, proof points, and commercial narratives that simplify complex capabilities and demonstrate business value.
 Support high-priority client pursuits through solution shaping, business case development, pitch support, pricing discussions, and executive storytelling.
 Partner with market teams to identify and convert cross-sell and upsell opportunities across the CA&E portfolio.
Market Growth Leadership
 Act as the primary commercialization and growth partner for West Southeast Asia, South Asia, and Australasia.
 Support divisional teams in pipeline development, strategic account planning, and client engagement activities.
 Identify growth opportunities across industries and markets and help teams activate solutions that address client acquisition, engagement, loyalty, and growth objectives.
 Provide hands-on support for strategic opportunities, helping accelerate deal progression and improve conversion outcomes
External Engagement & Thought Leadership
 Partner with Services B2B Marketing and regional stakeholders to develop thought leadership, client engagement programs, and market-facing initiatives that elevate Mastercard's profile in customer acquisition, engagement, and loyalty.
 Represent CA&E at industry forums, client events, and internal leadership engagements as a subject matter expert and growth advocate.
All About You
You are a strategic and commercially driven leader with expertise in marketing, loyalty, and platforms commercialization. You combine strategic clarity with hands-on collaboration and have a proven ability to turn complex products into actionable market opportunities.
 Experience in commercialization, business development, marketing, consulting, or sales enablement across multiple markets.
 Skilled at translating capabilities into compelling client opportunities, value propositions, and growth strategies.
 Strong stakeholder manager who builds relationships across Product, Sales, Marketing, and Delivery teams to drive results.
 Analytical, collaborative, and action-oriented, with a track record of helping teams win and grow business.
 Passionate about enabling markets, supporting strategic opportunities, and accelerating growth across Asia Pacific.

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Title: Director, Strategic Alliances & Partnerships - APAC
Description:
Role Description:
Working as Director, Strategic Alliances & Partnerships (APAC) for Jumio, you will be responsible for generating new business via the partner ecosystem with a special focus in the APAC region. You will demonstrate a proven sales acumen with the experience of solution selling and a track record of successfully selling into Fintech, Crypto, Payment, e-Wallet vertical.
The Manager, Strategic Alliances & Partnerships is responsible for the design, development, execution and growth of the partner strategy in the APAC marketplace, in close coordination with global counterparts.
They will be expected to quickly embrace the Jumio business, understand the complex market ecosystem and quickly build and execute an effective GTM and revenue acceleration plan for the various partner channels identified (i.e. OEM/ISV, reseller, system integrators) with the expressed purpose to make an immediate impact to our indirect sales strategy and drive incremental sales with and through our most critical business partners.
The ideal candidate will possess the business acumen to identify business opportunities, build loyal partner relationships with strong negotiation, communication skill sets and a patient disposition.
This role is to help to grow the Jumio business via partners; reaching customers that Jumio may not be able to reach on its own.
Example Responsibilities:
- Understanding the overall Jumio partner ecosystem and how to manage channel conflicts with the purpose to aim for an amicable outcome.
- Identify and recruit the right partners to jointly identify and prospect opportunities with the successful management and completion of the deal.
- Maximize closing of deals that can result in the taking of market share from competitors.
- Develop and build partner relationships through calls, emails, meetings and conferences.
- Maintain accurate records of all partner activities for the purposes of identifying, nurturing and closing the Company’s sales pipeline.
- Ensure Jumio direct sales teams and partner sales teams are completely aligned and proactively pursue joint opportunities with a prioritized list of top performing partnerships.
- Drive the collaboration of marketing, customers success and product teams to deliver a compelling partner engagement.
- Have a complete understanding of the Company’s offerings and competitive products, pricing and proposal models.
- Self-sufficient and comfortable to travel sometimes or as needed.
Experience and Qualifications:
- Significant experience and track record of performance within indirect / channel partner / strategic alliances selling roles, ideally in a regional and/or global strategic alliance / partner sales leadership capacity.
- Experience with reseller / independent software vendor / system integration channels in the APAC in fraud & identity verification / cyber security solutions / identity access management solutions is critical.
- Proven strategic leader with a strong track record of driving partner-led revenue growth and GTM success. Recognized for delivering high-impact outcomes through ecosystem alignment, scalable co-sell strategies, and a results-driven mindset. A true rock star in accelerating revenue through partner collaboration and execution excellence.
- Excellent presentation, communication and negotiation skills.
- Positive attitude, team oriented and self-starter who can work alone and in a collaborative manner to achieve the goals set for the organization.
- Closing skills, financial planning and strategy skills, proven ability to achieve sales quotas, willingness to travel, and team player.
- Proficiency in Channel Management, CRM, Sales Automation and Social Selling tools, with demonstrable experience with Salesforce, Highspot, LinkedIn, etc. a plus.
@Work:
Jumio Singapore office is located at Centennial Tower. It is the APAC headquarters comprising a small team of energetic, motivated staff members across sales, consulting, marketing functions. It is a friendly, social culture where everyone comes together to celebrate each other’s success and provide support in resolving challenges.
Jumio Values:
IDEAL: Integrity, Diversity, Empowerment, Accountability, Leading Innovation
Equal Opportunities:
Jumio is a collaboration of people with different ideas, strengths, interests and cultures. We welcome applications and colleagues from all backgrounds and of all statuses.
About Jumio:
Jumio is a B2B technology company dedicated to eradicating online identity fraud, money laundering and other financial crimes to help make the internet safer. We leverage AI, biometrics, machine learning, liveness detection and automation to create solutions that are trusted by leading brands worldwide and respected by industry thought leaders.
Jumio is the leading provider of online identity verification, eKYC and AML solutions. With a global footprint, we’re expanding the team to meet strong client demand across a range of industries including Financial Services, Travel, Sharing Economy, Fintech, Gaming, and others.
Applicant Data Privacy
We will only use your personal information in connection with Jumio’s application, recruitment, and hiring processes, as described in Jumio’s Applicant Privacy Notice. If you have any questions or comments, please send an email to privacy@jumio.com.

Title: Director, Strategic Partnerships and Commercialisation, Neurovascular (KISA)
Description:
Position Summary
The Director, Strategic Partnerships & Commercialisation is responsible for shaping the customer, market, and technology adoption agenda across Korea, India, SSP, and ASEAN (KISA).
This role leads regional customer excellence, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) engagement, Voice of Customer (VOC), and commercialization initiatives that support adoption of priority technologies and sustainable business growth. Working closely with customers, healthcare leaders, country leadership teams, APAC Marketing, and Business Excellence stakeholders, the Director translates customer insights and market intelligence into actions that influence regional priorities, investment decisions, and growth strategies.
As a Director-level individual contributor, the role operates through influence and strategic leadership rather than direct authority, serving as a trusted advisor and advocate for the KISA customer and market perspective.
Key Responsibilities
- Lead the KISA customer excellence strategy, including customer engagement programs, advocacy initiatives, and VOC capabilities.
- Develop and govern regional KOL, Centre of Excellence, and customer advocacy networks aligned to growth priorities.
- Drive commercialization and technology adoption strategies that improve launch readiness, adoption, and utilization of priority technologies.
- Translate customer insights and market intelligence into actionable recommendations that influence business priorities and market development initiatives.
- Establish regional frameworks, engagement platforms, and best practices that enable countries to strengthen customer engagement and adoption activities.
- Build trusted relationships with physicians, healthcare leaders, KOLs, and strategic customers across the region.
- Partner with Country Leadership, APAC Marketing, Business Excellence, and regional stakeholders to align priorities and accelerate growth opportunities.
Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate combines strong commercial acumen with experience in customer engagement, market development, commercialization, strategic partnerships, or technology adoption within healthcare or medical technology environments.
They demonstrate:
- Strategic thinking and business acumen
- Executive presence and influencing skills
- Strong customer-centricity
- Experience working across multiple countries and cultures
- Ability to translate customer insights into business outcomes
- Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership capabilities
Success Measures
Success in this role will be demonstrated through:
- Strength and effectiveness of customer, KOL, and advocacy networks
- Impact of customer insights on business decisions and priorities
- Commercialization effectiveness and technology adoption outcomes
- Influence on regional strategy, investment, and growth initiatives
- Contribution to KISA, APAC, and broader Neurovascular business objectives
Role Impact
This role plays a critical part in connecting customer insight, strategic partnerships, commercialization, and technology adoption to business growth. By strengthening customer advocacy, accelerating adoption of innovative technologies, and ensuring customer perspectives are represented in regional decision-making, the Director helps shape the long-term growth and market development agenda across KISA.
Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

Title: Ecommerce onboarding specialist
Description:
uParcel is a Singapore-based e-commerce fulfilment and last-mile delivery 3PL. We combine in-house warehousing with our own fleet of same-day delivery drivers, giving online sellers on Shopee, Lazada and TikTok Shop one integrated partner from inbound stock to the customer’s doorstep.
As our E-commerce Onboarding Specialist, you are the first face clients see after they sign with us and the person who sets them up to succeed. You will guide each new client from kick-off to a smooth first live order, coach their teams on our system until they are confident using it independently, and remain their go-to contact for support questions. Your work directly shapes client satisfaction, retention and long-term growth.
1. Client onboarding
• Run kick-off calls with new clients to understand their products, order volumes, sales channels and fulfilment requirements.
• Own the onboarding plan for each client, with clear milestones, owners and timelines from sign-up to go-live.
• Collect and validate client information such as SKU masters, inbound stock details and channel integrations (Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop).
• Configure client accounts in the system and coordinate with warehouse and delivery teams so inbound, storage, picking and delivery are ready before go-live.
• Test the end-to-end flow with each client, from order sync through to delivery, and resolve issues before the first live order.
2. System coaching and training
• Coach client teams on how to use the system, including order management, inventory visibility, inbound bookings, reporting and tracking.
• Deliver live walkthroughs and workshops, and tailor training to each client’s size and level of e-commerce experience.
• Create and maintain easy-to-follow guides, SOPs, FAQs and short how-to videos that clients can refer to on their own.
• Check in after go-live to confirm clients are using the system correctly and getting full value from it.
3. Customer support
• Be the first point of contact for client questions on system use, orders, inventory, inbound and delivery status.
• Respond promptly and clearly through email, chat and phone, and meet agreed response-time standards.
• Investigate issues with the warehouse, delivery and tech teams, and follow each case through to resolution.
• Log and categorise support cases and identify recurring questions, so they can be fixed at the root through training material or product improvements.
4. Customer success
• Build strong, trusted relationships with clients takeholders, from founders and sellers to operations staff.
• Monitor early client health indicators such as adoption, order accuracy and support volume, and act early when something looks off.
• Spot opportunities where additional uParcel services could help a client grow, and pass these to the sales team.
• Feed client insights and feature requests back to Operations and Product to improve the onboarding experience and the system.
Requirements
• Diploma or degree in Business, Supply Chain, Information Systems or a related field (or equivalent experience).
• 1 to 3 years of experience in client onboarding, customer success, account support or implementation, ideally in e-commerce, logistics or SaaS.
• Working knowledge of how online selling works on Shopee, Lazada and TikTok Shop, including order flow and seller operations.
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain system features in simple, practical terms.
• Patient, empathetic and confident coaching clients with different levels of technical skill.
• Strong organisation and follow-through, able to manage several onboardings and support cases at once.
• Comfortable learning new software quickly and with Excel or Google Sheets for data checks and reporting.
• Fluent in English; additional languages such as Mandarin or Malay are a plus.
Goodto Have
• Experience with warehouse management systems, order management systems or delivery management platforms.
• Experience with helpdesk or CRM tools.
• Experience creating training content such as guides, SOPs or video tutorials.
• Familiarity with 3PL, fulfilment or last-mile delivery operations.

Title: Enablement Delivery Specialist
Description:
The Enablement Delivery Specialist is a pivotal execution-focused role within the GTM Enablement organization, responsible for the end-to-end orchestration of world-class training experiences. Reporting to the Manager of Delivery, this role ensures that every training event, from foundational bootcamps to advanced skill-building workshops, is delivered with the logistical precision and professional excellence required to drive field performance.
You will act as the "Producer" and "Emcee" for our regular and ad-hoc in-person and virtual events, serving as the connective tissue between strategic program design and field-facing execution.
Based in our Dublin International Headquarters, you will thrive in a high-growth environment that values intellectual honesty, radical accountability, and a "team first" mindset.
Success in this role means moving beyond simple event planning and facilitation to become a trusted partner who enhances the learner experience and provides critical insights for continuous enablement improvement.
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Singapore for our hybrid working model.
Responsibilities
Training Event Orchestration and Logistics
- End-to-End Management: Own the full logistical lifecycle for in-person training events, including venue selection, meeting room configuration, catering, and on-site technology
- Operational Precision: Ensure flawless accuracy in scheduling, invitations, reminders, and learner communications across all assigned sessions
- Execution Reliability: Execute assigned tasks within scope and on time using project management tools, maintaining high delivery reliability
- Stakeholder Coordination: Partner with Workplace and TRO teams to orchestrate seamless delivery, owning handoffs and vendor coordination with "radical follow-through
- Data Integrity: Maintain accurate program data (attendance, survey results) with zero critical errors, ensuring visibility for stakeholders
Event Production and Emceeing
- Producer Role: Serve as the event "Producer" and "Emcee," ensuring smooth delivery and strong participant engagement throughout every session
- Platform Mastery: Operate core delivery platforms (Zoom, LMS, virtual classroom tools) with full proficiency, eliminating technical disruptions
- Content Delivery: Follow facilitation guides and scripts to deliver established content with consistent professional quality and tone
- Live Engagement: Manage live interactions, including polls, Q&A, and breakouts, while reading the audience and adjusting pacing based on real-time signals
- Facilitator Support: Act as the primary point of contact for facilitators and SMEs, ensuring they are set up for success and the environment is optimized for learning
Feedback and Continuous Improvement
- Insight Gathering: Gather structured feedback from attendees after every session to measure program effectiveness and learner confidence
- Actionable Synthesis: Synthesize learner sentiment into actionable insights, providing content designers with specific observations on confusion or engagement drops
- Quality Cycle: Identify content improvement opportunities based on learner reactions and escalate them with specific proposed fixes
- Knowledge Management: Document delivery processes and issue resolutions in the team knowledge base to ensure work is person-independent
The Ideal Candidate
- Experience: Minimum 2 years of experience in event management, ideally within a corporate or high-growth technology environment
- Training Background: Ideally 1 year of experience in training management or enablement delivery. Foundational knowledge of adult learning principles is a plus
- Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to communicate with precision and build trusted partnerships. You are known for professional poise and the ability to manage conflicting priorities
- Technical Proficiency: Full proficiency in operating delivery platforms (Zoom, LMS) and project management tools. Experience with Mac and Google Suite is preferred
- Organizational Rigor: Immaculate attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams without sacrificing quality
- Communication: Strong presentation and facilitation skills with the confidence to emcee for large groups of enterprise sales and services professionals

Title: Enterprise Account Executive
Description:
As vCluster Labs’ Enterprise Account Executive, you aren’t just selling software; we are defining a category. In this role, you will be the CEO of your territory, tasked with identifying, navigating, and closing large-scale agreements with the world's leading organizations. You will be selling a technical platform that solves critical problems for Engineering, DevOps, Security, and Data leaders.
As an Enterprise Account Executive, your role will include:
Strategic Territory Management: Own a dedicated patch of Enterprise accounts. Build a comprehensive territory plan to uncover new opportunities and expand existing footprints.
Full-Cycle Execution: Manage the entire sales lifecycle from prospecting and discovery to negotiation and close. You are a "Hunter" who enjoys the thrill of the chase but executes with the precision of a consultant.
Multi-Threaded Selling: Navigate complex organizations to build consensus across technical champions (Dev/Ops/Security practitioners) and executive economic buyers (CTO, CIO, CISO, CFO).
Value Engineering: Move beyond feature/function selling. articulate a clear "Business Value Assessment" (BVA) that ties our technical capabilities to the customer's top-line revenue or bottom-line efficiency.
Methodical Forecasting: Maintain hygiene in Salesforce/CRM. Utilize MEDDPICC or Command of the Message methodologies to provide accurate weekly, monthly, and quarterly forecasts.
This role could be a fit for you if you bring:
Experience: 7+ years of quota-carrying field sales experience, with at least 3+ years selling specifically to the Enterprise ($200k - $1M+ ACV).
Technical Aptitude: You don’t need to code, but you must be "technically fluent." You can hold your ground in a conversation with a VP of Engineering or a Chief Architect about their tech stack, workflow, and pain points.
Methodology Master: You live and breathe sales methodology. You can clearly explain how you use MEDDPICC/MEDDIC to qualify deals and de-risk your pipeline.
Consistency: A documented history of performing in the top 10-20% of your cohort. We want to see President’s Club awards and consistent quota over-achievement.
Start-Up Grit: Experience working in a high-growth environment (Series B to IPO phase). You are comfortable with ambiguity and are willing to build the playbook, not just read it.
Bonus points for:
Domain Expertise: A proven track record of selling complex SaaS/PaaS solutions. Experience in DevOps, Infrastructure, Data, Observability, or Cybersecurity is highly preferred.
Startup Experience: You have been at an early-stage organization where you control your own desk. You function autonomously and strive towards building something great.
Partnership Experience: Successful track record of building equitable relationships with new partners.
About vCluster Labs
We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.
We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.
We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.
Benefits
We offer the following benefits:
Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.
Premium Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).
Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.
Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.
Culture & Values
At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for:
Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.
Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.
Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.
Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.
Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

Title: Enterprise Account Executive
Description:
Industry leader? Well, how about an industry creator?!
WalkMe, an SAP company, pioneered the world's leading Digital Adoption Platform, helping organizations navigate change across any application or system. Today it is the platform that drives AI adoption across the enterprise. Enterprise work stays fragmented across applications, and that fragmentation compounds as AI advances. Traditional training and vendor-provided help leave organizations managing change one application at a time. WalkMe guides people through change, brings AI into the flow of work, automates tasks and shows executives how workflows perform. Global leaders including IBM, Nestlé, Thermo Fisher Scientific, and the U.S. federal government trust WalkMe. WalkMe turns AI potential into AI performance.
So, if you’re an expert in your field, and looking for an opportunity to work, collaborate, and innovate with some of the most talented people out there, WalkMe is the place for you!
As an Enterprise Account Executive for the Southeast Asia market, you will act as a strategic hunter focused on net new logo acquisition. You will own the complete, end-to-end sales cycle - navigating complex enterprise environments, partnering with global SAP teams and positioning WalkMe’s high-value solutions to C-suite decision-makers.
What You'll Own
Drive Net New Business: Own the full end-to-end sales cycle for the APAC region, from initial pipeline generation, discovery, and tailored demos/POCs, to complex contract negotiations and closing.
Master Value-Based Selling: Partner closely with internal Solution Consultants and Customer Success Managers to build and present ROI-driven business cases for enterprise prospects.
Navigate the C-Suite: Establish trusted relationships with senior executives and stakeholders across all levels of Fortune 1000 and major target organizations.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Align internally with cross-functional teams—including corporate counsel, senior management, and Renewal Managers—to efficiently push enterprise agreements across the finish line.
Forecast & Pipeline Management: Maintain high data integrity in Salesforce, accurately managing monthly/quarterly revenue forecasting while consistently meeting or exceeding quarterly quotas.
Inbound & Outbound Strategy: Actively hunt for new enterprise opportunities through outbound prospecting while strategically managing high-value inbound lead requests.
What You'll Need to Succeed
Enterprise SaaS Expertise: Proven success in Enterprise Software Sales (SaaS) or Strategic Business Consulting, consistently hitting or exceeding seven-figure quotas.
Strategic Hunter Mindset: A track record of closing net-new enterprise logos using structured, value-based sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC, Challenger, Command of the Message).
APAC Market Knowledge: Deep familiarity with the business landscape, cultural nuances, and executive networks within the APAC region, with experience in the financial services industry in South East Asia preferred.
Technical Curiosity: Experience selling sophisticated, high-tech platform solutions with the ability to comfortably bridge the gap between business value and technical execution.
Collaborative Spirit: A proven ability to quarterback complex deals by leveraging internal teams (SEs, CSMs, Partners) and working with the SAP ecosystems
Communication: Fluent English required, additional proficiency in SE Asian language is a bonus

Title: Enterprise Account Executive, Asia
Description:
Intellect is the global leader in hyper localised mental health benefits, trusted by the world’s most forward-thinking employers, insurers, and governments to deliver care that is local, personalised, and effective at scale. Today, we serve over 4 million people across 100 countries and 100+ languages, making mental health support truly accessible across borders and cultures.
Our platform powers the mental wellbeing of workforces at hundreds of Fortune 500 and global multinational companies, enabling them to support their people with the highest standards of clinical quality, cultural relevance, and on-demand accessibility.
Driven by our mission to build the world’s most trusted mental health benefits platform, Intellect combines a best-in-class digital platform with a world-leading global provider network to deliver unmatched client outcomes, and transformative care experiences.
We are backed by top global investors including Tiger Global, Y Combinator, Insignia Ventures Partners, HOF Capital, K3 Ventures, JAFCO, Headline, East Ventures, IHH Healthcare, MS&AD Ventures, and more, alongside an extensive coalition of notable family offices, big tech executives, and leading angel investors.
The Role
We are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive, Asia to drive new business across mid-market and enterprise customers in the region.
This is a high-ownership, full-cycle sales role for someone who wants to build, not simply inherit a mature territory and run an established sales playbook.
You will have strong support from marketing, partnerships, leadership, product, clinical, customer success, and other teams across Intellect. At the same time, we expect you to be highly proactive in creating momentum yourself: opening doors, developing opportunities, shaping propositions, building compelling pitches, navigating complex buying processes, and doing what is needed to move important deals forward.
We are looking for someone commercially sharp, resourceful, persistent, and comfortable operating with pace and ambiguity.
A builder, not a passenger.
What You Will Do
Build & Win New Business
Own the end-to-end sales cycle across mid-market and enterprise customers in Asia, from first conversation through to contract signature.
Develop a deep understanding of target accounts, their priorities, decision-makers, buying dynamics, and where Intellect can create meaningful value.
Run high-quality discovery with senior stakeholders and translate customer needs into compelling commercial solutions.
Build strong, multi-threaded relationships across organisations and navigate complex regional or enterprise buying processes.
Create & Develop Pipeline
Work closely with marketing and the broader commercial team on inbound opportunities, campaigns, events, account-based initiatives, and other sources of demand.
At the same time, take ownership of creating opportunities yourself through targeted outreach, referrals, networking, events, partnerships, and thoughtful account development.
You should be comfortable working both sides of the equation: converting strong inbound demand and creating new opportunities from scratch.
Shape Complex Enterprise Deals
Develop account strategies and determine the best path to win each opportunity.
Create and customise presentations, proposals, business cases, and commercial narratives around the needs of each customer rather than relying only on standard materials.
Bring the right internal stakeholders into the process - across leadership, product, clinical, customer success, legal, security, and operations - and orchestrate them effectively.
Navigate procurement, legal, security, commercial negotiations, and other enterprise requirements with sound judgement and persistence.
Identify blockers early, create clear next steps, and maintain momentum throughout the sales cycle.
Represent Intellect Across Asia
Build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers across the region.
Represent Intellect at customer meetings, industry events, conferences, roundtables, and other commercial opportunities.
Be willing to engage directly in events, lead generation, and market-building activities rather than seeing them as someone else’s responsibility.
Develop a strong understanding of the evolving mental health, employee benefits, HR, healthcare, and workforce landscape across Asia, and bring relevant market insights back into the company.
What Success Looks Like
You consistently build and convert a healthy pipeline of high-quality opportunities.
You win meaningful new mid-market and enterprise customers across Asia.
You create opportunities independently as well as convert marketing-generated demand.
You build credibility with senior stakeholders and develop relationships across multiple decision-makers within an account.
You navigate complex sales cycles with strong commercial judgement and clear ownership.
You create compelling, customer-specific pitches and proposals that move opportunities forward.
You maintain strong discipline around pipeline management, forecasting, follow-ups, and next steps.
You become a credible and trusted representative of Intellect in the market.
You operate effectively without needing a large or highly prescriptive sales machine around you.
Requirements
5-10 years of B2B sales experience, with meaningful exposure to mid-market or enterprise customers.
We care less about a specific industry background than we do about seeing evidence that you can create and win business.
You are likely to be someone who:
Has a strong track record of winning new mid-market or enterprise customers.
Has owned a meaningful portion of the full sales cycle, from opportunity creation through to negotiation and close.
Is commercially hungry and proactive about generating business rather than relying entirely on inbound demand.
Can sell consultatively and understand the underlying business problem rather than simply presenting product features.
Is comfortable navigating complex organisations with multiple stakeholders and decision-makers.
Can communicate credibly with senior executives and adapt your approach across different audiences and markets.
Is comfortable creating or adapting your own decks, proposals, business cases, and sales narratives when needed.
Is highly resourceful and persistent when an opportunity becomes difficult or stalls.

Works effectively across functions and knows how to bring the right people into an opportunity.
Is ambitious, resilient, and motivated by ownership and outcomes.

Title: Enterprise Account Executive, Singapore
Description:
Get to Know Us
Horizon3.ai is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organisations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organisations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.
We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.
What You’ll Do
The Enterprise Account Executive is a key role responsible for driving sales growth and expanding the customer base in the cybersecurity technology sector. The focus is on acquiring new accounts, building strong customer relationships, and ensuring customer satisfaction and retention. The successful candidate will have a proven track record in selling cybersecurity technologies, introducing disruptive cyber software solutions, and exceeding sales quotas consistently. They will also be adept at establishing and nurturing Channel Partner relationships, with pre-existing connections with key resellers in the region being a crucial requirement.
- Sales Experience: Minimum of 5 years of successful sales experience in the cybersecurity technology industry, with a strong track record of achieving sales growth
- Introduction of New Solutions: Demonstrated success in introducing and selling new disruptive cyber software solutions
- Quota Achievement: Proven ability to exceed sales quotas consistently quarter over quarter.
- Channel Partner Management: Experience in establishing and monetising strong Channel Partner relationships, with existing relationships in the region being essential.
- Sales Process Management: Proficiency in managing all aspects of the sales process, including qualification, proof of value, forecasting, negotiation, and deal closure.
- Post-Sales Management: Ability to manage and drive the post-proof of value ROI process.
- CRM and Pipeline Management: Experience in accurately tracking and managing customer information in company-provided CRM, and maintaining an accurate pipeline and forecasting in Salesforce (SFDC).
- Product Presentation and Demo: Capability to present and demonstrate Horizon3AI solutions effectively in both virtual and in-person meetings.
- Independent and Team Player: Demonstrated ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with distributed sales, support, and success teams.
- Sales Methodology: Familiarity with Challenger Question-Based Selling type sales methodologies.
- Sales and Marketing Tools: Familiarity with sales enablement tools like Salesforce, CRM, Outreach.io, Linked-In Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, and Slack.
What You’ll Bring
- Sales Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience working in a Sales role in cybersecurity
- Industry Experience: Minimum of 3 years of experience working in the INFOSEC or SaaS space
- Education: A university degree or equivalent work experience required
Travel Required
We are a fully remote company, and this job may require up to 40% of travel within the assigned territory to be successful. Job-related travel expenses are reviewed and must be approved by your manager.
Perks of Horizon3.ai
- Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.
- Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.
- Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.
- Remote Work: We are a 100% remote company. Enjoy the flexibility to work in the way that supports you and brings out your best.
- Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.
Compensation And Values
At Horizon3.ai, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.
You Belong Here
Horizon3.ai is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.
Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3.ai, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.
We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3.ai, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Title: Enterprise Account Manager
Description:
As the Enterprise Account Manager, you will establish, develop, and expand key accounts that generate significant revenue for the organization. You will research and pursue new business opportunities and create connections with influencers, executives, and decision-makers. You will provide excellent service and support to ensure client satisfaction that leads to long-term accounts. You will serve as a liaison between the client and other internal departments to expedite any assistance that may be needed.
Responsibilities:
Implements and develops strategic plans to drive profitability and achieve company objectives.
Engages with internal and external stakeholders at all levels to effectively to implement and develop customer account plans.
Drives new business development within named accounts. Will research, qualify, contact, present and close new clients based on an assigned territory or market segment.
Manages, develops, and identifies sales strategies to improve sales productivity.
Continuously develops relationships with priority customer stakeholders, understands their key business issues, and recommends ways to deliver value.
Liaison between the field and Global Accounts teams as it relates to pursuing new agreements, Value-Add/Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) commitments, and increasing customer wallet-share.
Communicates customer activity, opportunity status, renewal status, and strategic plan progress to management.
Leads solution development efforts that best address customer needs.
Engages supplier sales resources to enlist their support and create solutions.
Expert in strategic selling and takes the lead in high level sales engagements. Provides pre/post-call coaching to branch sales team.
Qualifications:
High School Degree or Equivalent required; Bachelor’s Degree preferred
5+ years proven sales experience as an Account Manager of large account portfolios.
Experience managing multiple stakeholders and projects.
History of success maintaining and developing key relationships.
Success in strategic planning, resource allocation, leadership techniques, production methods and coordination of people and resources.
Ability to understand where potential exists in assigned accounts and can recognize and create opportunities.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with an aptitude for building strong client relationships.
Strong negotiation and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency with CRM software and Microsoft Office.
Self-starter and able to work efficiently under pressure.

Title: Enterprise Partnership Manager
Description:
Role Summary
The Client develops innovative enterprise partnerships that drive incremental profitability across the organisation through integrated commercial relationships spanning multiple Lines of Business.
The Manager, Enterprise Partnerships (Financial Services) will lead the origination, development, structuring and commercial negotiation of new Strategic Financial Services Partnership opportunities across Asia Pacific.
The role will develop integrated propositions spanning the Client’s Entertainment, Cruise Line, Experiences, Consumer Products, Publishing, Interactive/Gaming and future enterprise businesses. This includes expanding existing financial services relationships through new campaigns, sponsorships, products, markets and cross-Line of Business initiatives.
Working closely with the Manager, Account Management, APAC business teams and the US Global Card Services team, the Manager will be responsible for securing new commercial value while ensuring that proposed partnerships align with the Client’s enterprise strategy, brand standards and global Financial Services objectives.
Main Responsibilities
- Enterprise Business Development
- Originate and develop new Strategic Financial Services Partnership opportunities across APAC.
- Lead the expansion of existing partner relationships through new commercial initiatives, sponsorships, products, markets and participating Lines of Business.
- Develop integrated propositions across Entertainment, Cruise Line, Experiences, Consumer Products, Publishing, Interactive/Gaming and future enterprise businesses.
- Identify opportunities involving the entertainment app, Studios, theatrical releases, premieres, live events, sponsorship platforms, Cruise Line Adventure and other strategic initiatives.
- Build and maintain a strong pipeline of new partnership opportunities.
- Assess partner needs, market trends and business priorities to identify areas of mutual strategic value.
- Co-branded Card Business Development
- Identify and develop new co-branded card opportunities, consumer propositions and market expansion initiatives in partnership with the CA APAC and US Global Card Services team and Strategic Financial Services Partners.
- Structure and negotiate new Cardholder Value Propositions (CVPs), programme launches and strategic enhancements that extend existing partnerships into new markets, products or participating Lines of Business.
- Collaborate with the Manager, Account Management to transition newly launched co-branded programmes into ongoing account management, governance and optimisation following execution.
- Commercial Strategy and Deal Structuring
- Structure enterprise-wide sponsorships, marketing programmes, consumer propositions and commercial partnerships.
- Lead commercial negotiations for new agreements, programme extensions and material expansions of existing partnerships.
- Develop commercial models, fee structures, rights packages and marketing commitments.
- Prepare business cases, revenue projections, financial models and cost-benefit analyses to support investment decisions.
- Partner with Legal, Finance, Tax and relevant business teams to progress opportunities from proposal through execution.
- Ensure new propositions balance partner objectives with the Client’s commercial, operational, brand and guest-experience requirements.
- Cross-Line of Business Partnership Development
- Lead cross-Line of Business planning for new enterprise partnership initiatives.
- Align participating business teams on commercial objectives, rights, benefits, responsibilities and implementation requirements.
- Facilitate internal decision-making and resolve differences across stakeholders where required.
- Ensure proposed partnership structures maximise enterprise value rather than operating as isolated Line of Business initiatives.
- Establish clear governance and implementation plans before agreements are executed.
- Partner and Executive Stakeholder Management
- Serve as the strategic commercial lead for new Financial Services partnership opportunities across APAC.
- Build relationships with senior partner stakeholders and decision-makers.
- Develop and present strategic proposals to internal leadership and external partners.
- Partner closely with Entertainment, Cruise Line, Experiences, Consumer Products, Publishing, Interactive/Gaming, Corporate Strategy and regional leadership.
- Collaborate with the US Global Card Services team to align APAC opportunities with global Financial Services partnership priorities.
- Maintain close coordination with the Manager, Account Management to ensure a consistent Client/brand interface to partners.
- Partnership Transition and Implementation
- Develop implementation frameworks for newly executed programmes.
- Coordinate with participating business teams to confirm roles, timelines, deliverables and governance requirements.
- Partner with the Manager, Account Management to transition newly signed partnerships and programmes into ongoing account stewardship.
- Provide continued commercial support during launch and initial implementation where required.
- Retain ownership of material expansion opportunities and new commercial negotiations arising after launch.
- Innovation and Market Development
- Develop new partnership models, consumer propositions and integrated commercial solutions.
- Identify emerging trends in payments, financial services, loyalty, co-branded cards, digital commerce and consumer engagement.
- Assess opportunities in new APAC markets and across future Client businesses.
- Benchmark relevant partnership models and recommend new sources of enterprise value.
- Performance and Reporting
- Monitor the value, progression and probability of the enterprise partnership pipeline.
- Track new commercial opportunities against revenue and growth targets.
- Prepare executive business updates, investment proposals and strategic recommendations.
- Maintain accurate records of proposals, negotiations, approvals and key commercial assumptions.
- Evaluate the performance of newly launched initiatives and identify opportunities for further expansion.
Qualifications & Experience
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications or a related discipline.
- MBA or postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
- Eight to ten years of experience in account management, strategic partnerships, sponsorship, financial services or commercial relationship management.
- Demonstrated success managing complex enterprise accounts and long-term strategic partnerships.
- Strong commercial acumen, with experience managing contractual obligations, renewals and commercial negotiations.
- Experience coordinating programmes across multiple business units, markets and stakeholder groups.
- Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior internal and external partners without direct authority.
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail when managing contractual rights, deliverables and approvals.
- Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills, including experience communicating with executive stakeholders.
- Experience within financial services, entertainment, hospitality, tourism or consumer-facing businesses is highly desirable.
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel and Word.
- Willingness to travel across APAC as required.

Build the future of industrial operations with AI.
Hubble is building the AI Agentic Operations Platform for industrial enterprises. Backed by a successful Series B, we're entering an exciting phase of growth as we expand beyond our leadership in the Built Environment into new industrial sectors across Asia.
We're looking for an experienced Business Development Executive/Manager who thrives on winning new business, navigating complex enterprise sales cycles, and helping customers solve mission-critical operational challenges. This is a consultative, solution-led role where you'll engage senior decision-makers, shape digital transformation initiatives, and demonstrate how AI can deliver measurable business outcomes.
If you enjoy opening doors, building executive relationships, and closing high-value enterprise deals, we'd love to speak with you.
You’ll:
Drive sales engagements to exceed activity, pipeline, and revenue goals every quarter.
Build a sales plan to maximize revenue and customer satisfaction within your accounts/territory.
Analyse sales/metrics data from your accounts/territory to help evolve your strategy & execution.
Become the resident expert on the Hubble platform, articulating how our agentic AI capabilities drive measurable operational impact for industrial enterprises.
Educate customers by demonstrating Hubble’s platform and prescribe relevant use cases that deliver strong business impact.
Demonstrate value to key stakeholders - confidently engage different stakeholders, negotiate win-win agreements and close large deals.
Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, including engagements with government agencies and statutory boards (e.g. BCA, LTA, HDB).
Align with internal stakeholders, including Customer Success, Marketing and Product Management, to ensure a seamless customer journey.
Develop long-term strategic relationships with key accounts, positioning Hubble as a trusted partner in their operational transformation.
What we need from you:
Minimum 5 years in B2B software sales, selling SaaS, AI or enterprise technology solutions.
Proven track record of consistent sales/territory growth and quota achievement in a hunting role
Demonstrated success in new logo acquisition and expansion within existing accounts using solution-selling techniques.
Ability to engage C-suite executives and multiple stakeholders across business and technical functions.
Demonstrated ability to navigate complex multiple-stakeholder deal environment and track record of successful selling to companies in Singapore.
Strong strategic account planning and execution skills, with comfort using sales management tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar.
Skilled in both virtual & in-person presentations with the ability to create strong impact through product demonstrations and construct compelling, ROI-driven business cases.
About Hubble:
Hubble is building the AI Agentic Operations Platform for industrial enterprises.

Title: EOI: Facilities Coordinator
Description:
About CBRE
CBRE is the world’s leading and largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, servicing more than 90% of the Fortune 100. Through our Global Workplace Solutions (GWS) business, we deliver integrated facilities and workplace services that create exceptional outcomes for our clients and people.
About the Role
As a Facilities Coordinator (Events) you will play a highly visible, hands-on role in shaping the day-to-day workplace experience. Your core focus will be supporting soft services operations and workplace coordination to ensure the office runs smoothly and efficiently.
In addition, you will provide events coordination support on an as-needed basis, assisting with corporate events and conferences when required. This is not a full-time events role, but an add-on responsibility that supports business needs as they arise.
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys being on the move, working closely with people, solving problems in real time, and taking pride in delivering consistently high service standards. Your presence, attention to detail, and proactive mindset will directly impact user satisfaction and how the workplace is experienced every day.
What You’ll Do
Generate, track, and maintain reports related to meeting rooms, events, and calls as required.
Manage general administrative and soft services operations such as janitorial services and other assigned services.
Conduct daily office inspections to ensure facilities, front office, lobby areas, and office equipment are fully operational and well maintained.
Ensure day-to-day operational excellence for sites under your coordination, meeting agreed SLAs and KPIs for self-service requests and helpdesk support.
Support asset and inventory management, ensuring critical items are tracked, available, and properly documented.
Provide day-to-day operational management of vendors, ensuring timely response within SLA, no downtime for critical services, and effective handling of escalated customer complaints.
Ensure all facilities-related documentation is properly filed, maintained, and inventoried at site.
Coordinate and oversee pantry supplies, stationery, and first aid items replenishment, working with housekeeping to ensure pantry and vending machines are consistently stocked.
Ensure employee services are delivered in line with customer expectations and within SLAs and KPIs, obtaining necessary approvals for any ad-hoc or special requests prior to implementation.
Support finance-related activities by verifying vendor invoices, goods receipts (GR), and payment documentation, and assisting with the issuance of purchase orders for ad-hoc requirements.
Assist in the preparation of reports and operational analysis as needed.
Follow all department policies, procedures, and service standards.
Actively participate in annual and site-wide activities such as fire drills, building power shutdowns, and other operational events.
Remain mobile across the workplace, performing daily check-ins around the front office and lobby, identifying issues early, resolving disruptions quickly, and contributing ideas to continuously improve workplace performance and user satisfaction.
Provide ad-hoc coordination support for conferences and large group events when required, assisting across the event lifecycle from initial request through execution and post-event activities.
Liaise with requestors and users to understand event objectives, requirements, and logistical needs, ensuring expectations are clearly defined and supported.
Support meeting room and event space utilisation by assisting with room reservations and space management processes, resolving scheduling conflicts, and coordinating space requirements with stakeholders as needed.
Support day-of event execution when required by coordinating with internal teams and vendors, assisting with last-minute logistics, setup, and smooth delivery.
Build and maintain strong working relationships with vendors, internal teams, and key stakeholders through open communication, collaboration, and engagement.
Perform post-event support tasks when applicable, including expense processing, basic event reporting, and assisting with the collection of feedback from requestors.
What You’ll Need
Diploma or Degree in Facilities Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.
Experience in facilities operations or soft services roles within an office or corporate environment; exposure to corporate events coordination is an advantage.
Strong coordination and communication skills with the ability to work effectively with users, vendors, and internal teams.
Hands-on, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, onsite role.
Ability to prioritise tasks, respond quickly to issues, and manage multiple activities at the same time.
Basic understanding of SLAs, KPIs, vendor coordination, and invoice processing.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and workplace or facilities management systems.
Physically mobile and comfortable performing regular walkthroughs of office spaces and common areas.
A proactive, service-driven mindset with a natural ability to spot issues and suggest practical solutions.
Why CBRE
At CBRE, we create workplaces where people and businesses thrive. You will be part of a collaborative, professional team that values service excellence, integrity, and continuous improvement. This role offers hands-on experience within a global organisation and the opportunity to contribute directly to workplace performance and employee experience.

Title: ETD Compliance Advisory – Senior Manager
Description:
The TP ICAP Group is a world leading provider of market infrastructure.
Our purpose is to provide clients with access to global financial and commodities markets, improving price discovery, liquidity, and distribution of data, through responsible and innovative solutions.
Through our people and technology, we connect clients to superior liquidity and data solutions.
The Group is home to a stable of premium brands. Collectively, TP ICAP is the largest interdealer broker in the world by revenue, the number one Energy & Commodities broker in the world, the world’s leading provider of OTC data, and an award winning all-to-all trading platform.
Founded in London in 1866, the Group operates from more than 60 offices in 27 countries. We are 5,200 people strong. We work as one to achieve our vision of being the world’s most trusted, innovative, liquidity and data solutions specialist.
Role Overview
Compliance Advisory plays a critical role in supporting and constructively challenging the business to achieve the highest standards of regulatory compliance, market integrity and conduct. The function is structured across regional advisory teams and complemented by three Global Heads of Product
Advisory responsible for:
• Securities & Venues
• Derivatives (Rates, FX, Money Markets and Government Bonds)
• Exchange Traded Derivatives (ETD) & Commodities
This role is to support the Global Head of ETD Advisory, with responsibility for providing specialist advisory coverage across Exchange Traded Derivatives and physical commodities markets globally. The team provides strategic regulatory oversight and subject matter expertise across Exchange Traded Derivatives and physical commodities related activities, supporting both TP ICAP's Global Broking and Energy & Commodities divisions.
Operating with a strong global coordination mandate, the team ensures the consistent application of regulatory standards, conduct expectations and risk management practices across all jurisdictions in which TP ICAP operates.
The team works in close partnership with regional Compliance Advisory teams, Legal, Risk and business leadership, providing specialist input to support strategic initiatives, regulatory change, investigations, training programmes and governance activities.
The successful candidate will play a key role in shaping the firm's regulatory strategy, supporting the continued evolution of global Exchange Traded Derivatives and Energy & Commodities businesses, and strengthening the firm's culture of compliance worldwide.
Role Responsibilities
· Be part of ETD Compliance Advisory team driving high standards of delivery, and providing expert product advisory support across the global businesses.
· Engage closely with Business Heads to provide regulatory guidance and challenge on business strategy and growth initiatives from a regulatory and conduct perspective.
· Act as a trusted adviser to Front Office leadership, delivering clear, risk-based, and commercially
practical regulatory advice.
· Help to design and deliver global thematic training programmes to enhance regulatory awareness and promote a strong compliance culture.
· Provide compliance guidance and advice on change initiatives, including new product approvals, new broking models, expansion into new jurisdictions, execution workflows, and market structure developments, ensuring alignment with applicable regulatory and exchange requirements.
· Work on global strategic initiatives, including potential acquisitions, and provide Compliance input into due diligence and implementation planning.
· Represent Compliance at senior business and governance forums, influencing decision-making and ensuring appropriate risk management.
· Partner with regional Compliance and Regulatory teams to assess and coordinate the global impact of upcoming exchange and/or regulatory developments.
· Act as the escalation point for complex, sensitive, or high-risk compliance matters relating to Exchange Traded Derivatives and commodities activities globally.
Experience / Competences
Essential
· Significant compliance advisory experience within wholesale financial markets, particularly Exchange Traded Derivatives and Commodities, gained within a global financial services organisation or through a closely related regulatory, legal, risk, exchange, or market oversight role.
· Comprehensive knowledge of global regulatory requirements applicable to Exchange Traded Derivatives, exchanges, and related market structure and market conduct.
· Strong understanding of interdealer brokerage models, exchange-traded markets, clearing frameworks, and associated market infrastructure.
· Proven ability to assess complex regulatory issues and deliver pragmatic, risk-based solutions that support commercial objectives while maintaining regulatory compliance.
· Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders across Front Office, Compliance, Legal, Risk, and Operations functions.
· Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively across seniority levels, functions, and geographic regions.
· Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex regulatory requirements clearly and concisely.
· Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across regional and global teams to deliver consistent regulatory outcomes.
Desirable
· Experience providing compliance advice on new products, business initiatives, trading workflows, and regulatory change initiatives.
· Knowledge of transaction reporting requirements and related regulatory frameworks, including MiFIR and REMIT.
· Experience operating within a complex global financial services organisation with multiple regulatory obligations and stakeholder groups.
· Experience supporting global regulatory change, remediation or transformation activities.
· Experience engaging with regulators, exchanges, clearing houses, or industry bodies.
· Professional Compliance qualification or relevant industry accreditation.
· Strong understanding of evolving market structure developments, electronic execution models, clearing frameworks, and emerging regulatory developments impacting global Exchange Traded Derivatives and commodities markets.
· Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality outcomes against tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Strategy & growth

People & leadership

– Set clear goals, give honest feedback, and create an environmentwhere people grow and do their best work.

– Direct the marketing and product development plans that drivevisitor and exhibitor numbers.
Network & collaboration
– Work within a matrix structure, coordinating with teams anddepartments across the global Messe München network.
– Share and adopt best practice in data, marketing and commercialinfrastructure across the portfolio.

Get Out! Events is dedicated to creating unforgettable events that inspire and connect. Specialising in corporate events, summits and conferences, we deliver tailored experiences with creativity, precision and seamless execution to leave a lasting impact.

- Help troubleshoot on-ground issues calmly and escalate matters to the Event Manager when needed.

We are looking for someone who is dependable, humble, hands-on, and eager to grow. You should be comfortable taking ownership of assigned event components while learning to handle larger responsibilities over time.

This role offers exposure to a wide range of corporate and government events and a clear pathway to take on larger event responsibilities as you build confidence, consistency, and execution ability.
Working Style
This is a hands-on events role. You will support both office-based planning and on-site event execution. Some events may require early mornings, evenings, weekends, or physical setup work.

- Salary range: SGD 2,500 to SGD 3,300 per month
- Working hours: weekdays, 10am to 6pm
- Occasional evening and weekend work during events

Title: Event Operations & Client Experience Executive
Description:
We’re looking for an *Event Operations & Client Experience Executive* to join The Arcade People, where we bring games, entertainment and experiences to events across Singapore.
This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys *people, problem-solving and a little bit of controlled chaos*.
You’ll work closely with our clients, sales team and operations crew to make sure events run smoothly, from the first client conversation to the final machine packed away.
No two days are quite the same. One day you may be coordinating an event setup, the next you could be helping a client work out the best game selection, and another day you might be on-site solving an unexpected problem that definitely wasn't in the original plan.
What You'll Be Doing
*Client & Event Coordination*
* Communicate with clients to understand their event requirements and expectations
* Coordinate event details, timelines, logistics and on-site requirements
* Assist with client enquiries and provide practical recommendations
* Coordinate with venues, event organisers, suppliers and internal teams
* Build positive relationships with clients and ensure a smooth experience
*Event Operations*
* Coordinate and support event setups, teardowns and on-site operations
* Work closely with our logistics and operations teams to ensure equipment is ready and delivered correctly
* Attend events when required and ensure operations run smoothly
* Make sure our games, attractions and equipment are presented and operated properly
*Problem Solving & Troubleshooting*
* Handle unexpected situations and last-minute changes calmly and efficiently
* Think on your feet and find practical solutions when things don't go according to plan
* Troubleshoot basic equipment or operational issues and coordinate with the relevant team when technical support is required
* Take ownership of problems rather than simply passing them along
*General Operations*
* Assist with quotations, event documentation and internal coordination
* Support day-to-day office and operations activities
* Learn our wide range of arcade games, carnival games, inflatables, F&B stations and other event attractions
* Take on additional projects and responsibilities as you grow into the role
What We're Looking For
