Title: FOOD SERVICES OPERATIONS DIRECTOR
Description:
Job Description
We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Food Services Operations Director to provide strategic leadership and oversee the overall management, operational performance and business development of our restaurant and food catering operations.
The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing business strategies, managing financial performance, directing food service operations, leading management teams and ensuring sustainable business growth.
The position requires strong leadership capabilities, extensive experience in food service operations, strategic planning, financial management and a comprehensive understanding of the restaurant and catering industry.
Job Scope & Responsibilities
Provide strategic leadership and overall direction for the company's restaurant and food catering operations.
Develop and implement short-term and long-term business strategies to achieve organisational objectives, revenue growth and profitability.
Direct and oversee restaurant operations, catering services, food production, procurement and customer service functions.
Establish operational policies, management procedures and performance standards to ensure efficient business operations.
Develop annual business plans, operational budgets, financial forecasts and strategic expansion plans.
Monitor company revenue, operating expenditure, food costs, labour costs and overall financial performance.
Lead and supervise departmental managers, restaurant managers, kitchen management teams and catering operations personnel.
Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and evaluate departmental productivity, operational efficiency and financial results.
Develop strategic plans for business expansion, new restaurant outlets, catering contracts and additional revenue opportunities.
Identify potential corporate clients, business partnerships and strategic commercial opportunities within the food service industry.
Oversee menu development strategies, food pricing policies, product positioning and operational profitability.
Direct procurement strategies, supplier negotiations, inventory management and supply chain optimisation.
Ensure effective coordination between restaurant operations, kitchen production, catering logistics and administrative departments.
Implement quality management systems to maintain consistent food standards, customer satisfaction and operational excellence.
Ensure compliance with Singapore Food Agency (SFA) regulations, food hygiene requirements, employment regulations and applicable workplace safety standards.
Develop and oversee manpower planning, management recruitment, staff development and organisational performance improvement strategies.
Review operational risks, establish internal controls and implement business continuity and risk management procedures.
Analyse market trends, customer demand, industry competition and commercial opportunities to support strategic business decisions.
Direct sales and marketing strategies to strengthen brand positioning, customer acquisition and business development.
Oversee negotiations for major catering contracts, supplier agreements and commercial partnerships.
Implement technology-driven improvements, including POS systems, inventory management systems and operational reporting processes.
Monitor food production efficiency, wastage control and resource utilisation to optimise operational costs.
Establish customer experience standards and oversee the resolution of significant customer service issues.
Coordinate with finance and administration teams to ensure effective financial reporting, budgeting and operational accountability.
Evaluate investment requirements for kitchen equipment, operational infrastructure and future business expansion.
Conduct regular management meetings to review business performance, operational challenges and strategic priorities.
Develop leadership capabilities among departmental managers and establish succession planning initiatives.
Ensure effective communication and coordination between management, employees, suppliers and business partners.
Prepare and present business performance reports, financial analysis and strategic recommendations to the Board of Directors or senior management.
Take overall responsibility for achieving approved operational targets, maintaining service excellence and supporting long-term business sustainability.
Job Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Hospitality Management, Food Service Management, Business Administration, Operations Management or a related discipline preferred.
Minimum 8–10 years of relevant experience in restaurant, hospitality, food service or catering operations, including substantial senior management experience.
Proven experience in strategic business planning, operational leadership and financial performance management.
Strong understanding of restaurant operations, catering services, food production management and supply chain coordination.
Demonstrated ability to manage departmental managers and cross-functional operational teams.
Extensive knowledge of budgeting, financial forecasting, cost control and business profitability.
Experience developing business expansion strategies and commercial partnerships.
Good understanding of Singapore's food safety, hygiene and relevant regulatory requirements.
Excellent leadership, strategic decision-making and organisational management capabilities.
Strong analytical, negotiation, communication and problem-solving skills.
Ability to establish operational KPIs, evaluate performance and implement continuous improvement strategies.
Experience in developing and implementing standard operating procedures and management policies.
Proficiency in business reporting, Microsoft Office and operational management systems.
Ability to manage competing business priorities and make independent strategic decisions.
Willingness to attend operational meetings and oversee business activities outside standard office hours when necessary.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Revenue growth and business profitability.
Achievement of approved operational budgets.
Restaurant and catering service performance.
Food cost and operational expenditure control.
Customer satisfaction and service quality.
Business development and corporate catering growth.
Workforce productivity and management effectiveness.
Compliance with applicable food safety and regulatory requirements.

Description:
As the Franchise Manager, you will play a pivotal role in driving Crystal Jade’s franchise and business partnership initiatives across existing and new markets.
Your responsibilities include:
Franchise & Strategic Partner Acquisition
Identify and onboard high-potential franchisees and strategic partners who align with Crystal Jade’s brand ethos.
Conduct thorough due diligence (financial, operational, cultural) to ensure partner suitability and long-term success.
Maintain a robust pipeline of potential partners and foster strong relationships throughout the acquisition process.
Contract negotiating and deal structuring.
Managing Intellectual Properties of the brand globally and developing sustainable strategies in terms of trademark, licensing and copyrights application.Managing Intellectual Properties of the brand globally and developing sustainable strategies in terms of trademark, licensing and copyrights application.
Market Expansion & Localization
Maintain continual communication & positive working relationship with franchise markets.
Lead end-to-end market entry strategies, from initial research to execution, ensuring seamless localization of menus, branding, and operations.
Collaborate with Culinary & Operations to adapt offerings to local tastes, preferences, and regulatory requirements.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to create tailored marketing campaigns that resonate with regional audiences.
Research F&B and franchise trends and identify potential expansion opportunities across the region.
Franchise Management
Conduct regular audits and training sessions to ensure consistent adherence to Crystal Jade’s standards.
Provide ongoing operational guidance, training and support to franchisees to drive operational excellence and customer satisfaction.
Maintain franchisee resource of training aids & marketing materials
Monitor franchisee performance, sales and profitability, and work with franchisees to drive business growth.
Manage franchisee relationships and resolve operational issues or disputes where required.
Review franchise performance reports and provide regular updates and recommendations to management.
Travel overseas for franchise development, site visits and operational support when required.
Manage trademark registration and franchise agreements.
Data Analysis
Work closely with Finance to ensure timely billings and collections from franchisees.
Updating & maintenance of existing franchisee data and databases.
Reporting of sales data and analysis of P&L, product mix and compliance.
Developing Franchise model, structure, fees and compliance per industry trends and updates.
Stakeholder Collaboration & Brand Marketing
Collaborate closely with internal teams (Marketing, Operations, Procurement) and franchisees to facilitate successful franchise rollouts.
Develop go-to-market strategies that amplify brand visibility and establish a strong presence in new regions.
Function as the primary liaison between franchisees, corporate leadership, and other key stakeholders.
Strategic Alignment with the Chief Executive Officer (CEO)
Partner with the CEO to align franchise initiatives with Crystal Jade’s broader growth objectives and business models.
Deliver regular performance updates, market insights, and actionable recommendations to inform strategic decision-making.
Support senior management on department’s annual store expansion KPI and budget.
Otherad hoc duties as assigned
Experience & Requirement
Bachelor’s degree in business, Management, International Business, or a related field.
5 – 8 years of experience in franchise development, F&B, retail, or related fields.
Demonstrated success in launching franchises or expanding operations into new markets.
Competent in Microsoft Office Suite.
Exceptional negotiation, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
Strong analytical abilities, with a knack for interpreting market data and tailoring strategies to local contexts.
Entrepreneurial spirit with a passion for growing local F&B brands on the global stage.
Detail-oriented yet strategic, with the ability to balance day-to-day execution with long-term vision.
A collaborative team player who thrives in cross-functional settings.
Thank you for your interest in joining our team. We appreciate all applications; however, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
Founded in 1991, Crystal Jade is a Singapore-based culinary brand with MICHELIN one star (Singapore) and multiple MICHELIN Bib Gourmand awards (Hong Kong & Shanghai).

Title: Gas Analyst - Chinese Markets
Description:
Department: Gas
Location: Singapore
Description
Energy Aspects is seeking a Gas Quant Analyst to join our growing research team, based in Singapore. This is an excellent opportunity for a talented analyst to develop expertise in Gas across Chinese markets.
The gas analyst will support the development of our LNG and/or gas market views, working closely with the rest of the team to produce timely, high-quality analysis. You will work in an environment that mirrors the responsiveness and commercial sharpness of a trading desk: staying close to the market, responding quickly to new information, and in constant dialogue with industry and trading contacts. The role requires intellectual rigour, commercially awareness, and the ability to translate fast-moving developments into clear, actionable insights for clients.
A core focus of the role is contributing to LNG and EU gas research output that is timely, relevant, and decision-useful. This means producing short, well-researched analysis of market-moving events, with speed of delivery a key priority. Our reports, presentations, and client interactions should help market participants identify the most important developments, understand their implications, and spot the most compelling market opportunities. You will develop short-term supply-demand balances, work collaboratively with senior colleagues to refine your analytical approach, and build robust, defensible market views.
This is an opportunity to grow your career in an entrepreneurial business operating in fast-evolving global energy markets. You will learn to spot emerging opportunities, contribute ideas for analytical development, and work collaboratively across teams. Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential, as is the ability to interact professionally with clients and market participants. In return, we offer competitive remuneration, the opportunity to work alongside highly experienced energy market specialists, and the chance to develop your expertise within one of the industry's most respected energy intelligence businesses.
Key Responsibilities
· Support the development of robust and defensible LNG import and export forecasts, gas balances, and market views.
· Gather market intelligence through dialogue with traders, industry participants, and market contacts to support team analysis.
· Translate fundamental analysis, market intelligence, and proprietary data into clear, actionable views for clients.
· Conduct timely analysis of market-moving events, producing short, high-conviction views for clients at speed.
· Write both scheduled and ad hoc reports on the LNG and Gas market, with a focus on supply-demand fundamentals, policy developments, pricing dynamics, and other key market drivers.
· Present Energy Aspects’ LNG and EU gas views to clients through presentations, conferences, webinars, and direct written responses.
Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
· Prior experience analysing gas markets, with a strong ability to translate fundamental analysis into clear and defensible market and price views.
· Proven ability to operate effectively in fast-moving markets and respond quickly to market-moving developments.
· Strong technical skills (Excel, Python) and experience developing, running, and refining supply-demand balances, forecasting frameworks, and quantitative models.
· Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to express complex views clearly, concisely, and with conviction.
Benefits
Welcome to our unique workplace where a passion for our industry-leading product sits at the heart of who we are.
Life at EA is completely eclectic, fostered through the global nature of the business and a real appreciation of the many cultures of our diverse team. We unite as a single, cohesive team through an array of social clubs that cater to a spectrum of interests, from running and yoga to football and culinary adventures. These groups create a collegial and dynamic atmosphere that extends beyond work, promoting a healthy and balanced lifestyle for our team.
Our strategically located offices are all set in prestigious buildings, offering you the convenience of nearby gyms, retail therapy, diverse dining options, and accessible public transport.
Our office spaces are thoughtfully equipped to enhance your day-to-day experience whether working independently or collaborating with teammates. Enjoy the simple pleasures of a freshly brewed coffee, healthy snacks, and a social space for celebratory moments. One of the unique traits of life at Energy Aspects is the way our international colleagues often delight us with treats from around the globe. It’s safe to say you’ll never go hungry in our offices!
We recognize your contribution with a competitive compensation package that includes annual bonuses, comprehensive private health insurance, and substantial pension contributions. Additionally, we offer company share options, subsidized gym memberships, and a generous holiday policy to support your financial and personal well-being.
Join a company that values your professional growth and personal fulfilment, all within a supportive and engaging environment.

This leader will be expected to operate with clarity, pace and discipline while leading a sizeable, multi-disciplinary operations platform through continued growth, transformation and change.
Why this role is important to us
This is a critical senior leadership appointment within State Street’s AIS organization, accountable for unifying delivery across Singapore and Hong Kong, strengthening end-to-end ownership and positioning the platform for sustainable growth. The role will provide clear executive accountability for service quality, operational resilience, risk and control discipline, productivity, talent development and the delivery of consistent, high-quality outcomes for clients and stakeholders across both locations – supporting the integrated APAC operating model owned by the Alternative APAC COO.
What you will be responsible for
Critical business priorities:
Provide senior leadership for the Alts operations teams across Singapore and Hong Kong, covering both Hedge Fund and Private Markets servicing across Fund Accounting, Alternatives Middle Office and Investor Services.
Shape and execute a more integrated operating model across the two locations that strengthens end-to-end accountability, simplifies governance and supports scalable growth, aligned to the broader APAC operating model.
Collaborate with regional business and product leadership to advance strategic growth initiatives, support complex commercial opportunities and ensure operational capabilities effectively enable client acquisition, retention and sustainable revenue growth.
Lead strategic transformation across technology, process, data, controls and organizational design, with a clear focus on service excellence and long-term platform efficiency.
Own the delivery of complex daily operations – including NAV production, middle-office trade lifecycle and investor servicing – with robust oversight of vendor-supported activities, critical processes and client-impacting services.
Act as the senior escalation point for Singapore and Hong Kong on operational matters, strategic client priorities, service performance and new business readiness.
Strengthen the risk and control environment while driving productivity, operational discipline, simplification and continuous improvement, meeting regulatory expectations.
Build trusted partnerships across business, product, client service, technology, risk, finance and regional leadership teams – including State Street’s global operations hubs – to deliver shared priorities.
Maintain senior accountability for client experience, service governance, relationship engagement and timely resolution of client-impacting issues.
Apply strong APAC market and cultural awareness to lead effectively across both locations and promote an inclusive, collaborative and high-accountability environment.
Develop a deep, diverse and resilient leadership bench through deliberate talent development, succession planning and disciplined performance management.
As a Managing Director you will:
Champion differentiated client outcomes by aligning stakeholders, resolving complex issues and ensuring service delivery supports broader commercial and relationship priorities.
Ensure timely, accurate and well-controlled delivery of NAV calculations, financial reporting and investor reporting across relevant platforms and client mandates, spanning both Hedge and Private Markets.
Convert performance insights, client feedback and risk indicators into practical action plans with clear ownership, measurable outcomes and disciplined follow-through.
Maintain strong accountability for regulatory compliance, operational risk management, issue remediation and adherence to applicable policies, standards and control expectations.
Engage and influence senior global and regional stakeholders to align priorities, share best practices and advance a consistent, scalable and resilient operating model.
Lead business continuity planning and execution, ensuring operational resilience, governance discipline and readiness across both locations and critical services.
Identify and deliver transformation, automation, standardization and capacity-creation opportunities that improve productivity, control, transparency and client experience.
Lead a multi-location team through clear direction, strong communication, effective delegation, leadership development, employee engagement and succession planning.
What we value
The Managing Director will be expected to operate as a senior enterprise leader within AIS, bringing strategic judgment, commercial awareness, operational excellence, strong control discipline and a deep commitment to people leadership. We value leaders who can:
Navigate a large global organization with confidence, build trusted senior relationships and create an effective stakeholder network across business lines and functions.
Lead effectively in a matrixed environment by aligning stakeholders, managing competing priorities and resolving areas of complexity or contention with sound judgment.
Build, develop and inspire high-performing operations teams with a clear focus on accountability, engagement, inclusion and execution excellence.
Communicate with clarity and executive presence across clients, third parties, senior leaders, peers and large regional teams.
Lead and sponsor change management, transformation and operating model programs in complex, regulated and multi-location environments.
Execute with pace and discipline under challenging circumstances, maintaining focus on risk, quality, client outcomes and delivery commitments.
Coach, influence and collaborate across locations, including virtual teams, to drive shared ownership and enterprise-wide outcomes.
Demonstrate strong cultural intelligence and the ability to lead across the Singapore and Hong Kong markets with respect, openness and consistency.
Role-model inclusion, flexibility, integrity and respect when working with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and locations.
Education & Preferred Qualifications

Title: Head of APAC GTM Operations - MendixRapidMiner (MXRM)
Description:
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.
The Opportunity
Head of APAC GTM Operations - MendixRapidMiner (MXRM) is the operational backbone of the MXRM Specialized Sales organization in Asia-Pacific. This role exists to protect and accelerate the APAC Zone Sales Leader's ability to execute: by running the forecasting rhythm, building the pipeline visibility the zone needs, and translating GTM performance into Finance-ready P&L narratives.
This is not a generalist ops role. MXRM operates on a distinct GTM motion — high-velocity lead funnel, Land-to-Expand post-sale engine, ARR and NRR as primary value metrics.
The role operates within the two-layer GTM Ops model: global strategy and tooling is set by the VP GTM Ops (Global); zone-level execution and insights are owned by this role for APAC. The role reports solid-line to the VP GTM Ops (Global), with dotted lines to the APAC Zone Sales Leader. Geographic scope covers Asia-Pacific — ANZ, Japan, SEA, India, Korea, and Greater China — with Singapore preferred.
Key Responsibilities:
Own and drive the APAC zone Management Operating Rhythm (MOR): weekly pipeline reviews, opportunity scrubs, Sales Manager syncs, and forecast calls. Ensure the APAC zone operates with the same cadence and rigour as AMS and EMEA, consistent with the global Franchise Model. Manage time zone complexity across sub-regions (Japan/Korea, SEA, ANZ, India) and flag deviations from MOR standards to the VP GTM Ops and APAC Zone Sales Leader.
Lead the APAC end to end forecasting process. Manage the weekly forecast call with the APAC Zone Sales Leader and Sales Managers. Own SRC (Sales Review Cadence) preparation for the APAC zone — ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and full alignment with the global GSCS rhythm. Maintain rolling forecast visibility that enables the Zone Sales Leader to call the number with confidence.
Leverage APAC-specific dashboards and reporting with a Specialized Sales lens. Core metrics include New Logo vs. Expansion split, ARR and NRR performance, GRR, pipeline coverage by motion, and time-to-value indicators. Provide sub-regional breakdowns (ANZ, Japan, SEA, India, Korea, Greater China) and define and defend MXRM-specific metric definitions where they differ from GSCS corporate defaults.
Translate APAC GTM performance into Finance-ready outputs — revenue gap analysis, attainment bridges against plan, ARR/ACV variance reporting, and scenario modelling inputs for the APAC P&L. Act as the primary operational interface between the APAC Zone Sales Leader and Finance, handling multi-currency complexity across APAC markets (JPY, AUD, SGD, INR, KRW, CNY).
Ensure Salesforce (SFDC) data quality, opportunity management standards, and CPQ/quoting accuracy across the APAC sales team. Identify and resolve operational friction points — process gaps, tooling issues, or data inconsistencies — that slow pipeline velocity or distort reporting. Partner with the Global GTM Ops team to implement tooling improvements in the APAC zone.
Manage 1–2 GTM Ops Analysts / Coordinators dedicated to the APAC zone. Set clear priorities, build operational capacity, and coach the team to deliver high-quality insights and execution support as the zone scales. Contribute to a high-performance GTM Ops culture globally. This also means this is a hands-on leader role.
Serve as the APAC GTM Ops point of contact for larger Siemens org, Finance, Growth/Marketing, and Global GTM Ops. Ensure APAC-specific insights and operational learnings flow into global conversations and navigate partner-heavy GTM motions in markets where indirect channel is dominant (Japan, Korea, SEA). Translate global directives — process changes, new tooling, updated definitions — into effective APAC implementation.
Continuously refine APAC GTM processes, operational cadences, and reporting practices in line with the global GTM Ops framework. Feed validated improvements and playbook learnings back to the VP GTM Ops as inputs to the global replication framework.

7–10 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM Operations in a SaaS or enterprise software environment.
Minimum 3 years in a regional or zone-level operations role, covering APAC (multi-country at minimum).
Proven track record of owning forecasting cadences and pipeline reporting for a substantial revenue organization ($50M+ ARR or equivalent).
Demonstrated experience bridging Sales and Finance — translating pipeline data and attainment into P&L-relevant narratives for senior leadership.
Proficient in Salesforce (SFDC) — opportunity management, pipeline reporting, and data hygiene at scale.
Advanced Excel and/or Google Sheets skills — financial modelling, scenario analysis, and variance reporting.
Working knowledge of CPQ or quoting tools in a SaaS sales context.
Strong communicator — able to present operational insights clearly and concisely to Zone Sales Leaders, Finance partners, and global GTM leadership.
Player-coach mentality: comfortable being hands-on on analysis and execution while developing and mentoring junior analyst talent.
Comfortable working across multiple timezones and culturally diverse teams spanning ANZ, Japan, SEA, India, and Korea.
Experience operating within a matrixed organisation with multiple reporting lines and cross-functional stakeholders.
Familiarity with Specialized Sales or horizontal GTM motions (Mid-Market, SMB, product-led or free trial funnels).
Exposure to ARR, NRR, and GRR metric frameworks in a land-and-expand commercial model.

Title: Head of Channels & Alliances
Description:
The Head of Channels & Alliances leads the Secure Power channel and alliance business across Singapore and Brunei, delivering profitable growth, market expansion and partner-led customer engagement across IT, data centers, edge, AI infrastructure and critical power. Own the country channel strategy, distributor and partner ecosystem, alliances, channel marketing and go-to-market execution for the T&E portfolio. Work across sales, segments, marketing, services and offer teams to scale growth beyond direct-sales capacity.
What will you do?
Channel Strategy & Growth
- Define and execute the cluster channel and alliance strategy, annual business plan and growth roadmap aligned with country and regional priorities.
- Deliver channel orders, revenue, gross margin and market-share objectives across data center, AI infrastructure, edge, enterprise, and commercial and industrial segments.
- Identify market trends and new partner-led growth opportunities; establish coverage models that expand reach and improve sales productivity.
Partner Ecosystem Development
- Develop and optimize the ecosystem across distributors, value-added distributors, IT solution providers, system integrators, data-center specialists, managed service providers, EcoXpert partners and emerging AI-infrastructure partners.
- Recruit, onboard, segment and develop strategic partners through clear growth plans, scalable programs and managed and unmanaged coverage models.
- Increase partner capability, loyalty, productivity and wallet share across solutions, software, services and sustainability offerings.
Strategic Alliances & Go-to-Market
- Lead executive relationships with server OEMs, infrastructure providers, cloud providers and AI ecosystem players.
- Create joint go-to-market plans, co-sell motions, bundled offers and differentiated solution value propositions.
- Drive account mapping, opportunity sharing, executive sponsorship and partner participation in AI-ready data-center and next-generation infrastructure opportunities.
Distributor & Partner Performance
- Lead joint business planning and quarterly business reviews with distributors and key partners, supported by clear performance measures and accountability.
- Drive sales-out growth, partner profitability and inventory health; ensure effective execution of commercial programs and channel policies.
- Resolve channel conflicts and maintain transparent rules of engagement across direct and indirect sales motions.
Partner Enablement & Capability Building
- Build partner competencies in Secure Power solutions, software, lifecycle services, sustainability, data centers, EcoXpert and AI infrastructure.
- Accelerate certification, specialization and program participation, enabling partners to move from product selling to solution selling and adopt new offers and sales plays.
Cross-Functional Leadership & Governance
- Align enterprise sales, segment teams, marketing, services, offer management, finance and operations around cluster growth priorities and coordinated execution.
- Support major opportunities through joint customer engagement and partner-led solution development.
- Own channel forecasting, pipeline governance and structured performance reviews; provide accurate business insights and recommendations to leadership
What qualifications will make you successful?
- 10+ years of experience in channel sales, alliances, business development or partner management, with leadership exposure in IT, data centers, critical power, infrastructure or technology.
- Proven success managing distributors, strategic partners and executive stakeholders within indirect-sales and ecosystem-led growth models.
- Knowledge of Secure Power market dynamics, data-center and AI-infrastructure ecosystems, channel economics, partner programs, go-to-market strategy and enterprise solution selling would be advantageous
- Strategic thinking, commercial acumen, business planning and data-driven decision making.
- Executive stakeholder management, negotiation, influencing and alliance development.
- Leadership, coaching, collaboration, accountability and customer centricity.
- Act as the cluster leader for Secure Power channels and alliances, building a high-performing ecosystem that scales profitable growth.
- Strengthen executive relationships across distributors, partners and technology alliances, and accelerate growth in AI, data centers, edge, software and services.
- Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, customer focus and continuous improvement.

Title: Head of Partners, APAC
Description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.
So, what's the role all about?
This is a senior leadership role for a commercially sharp, relationship-first partnerships executive who is ready to own APAC partner growth for NiCE. You will report directly into the VP Partner Sales, International, and lead a team of 8-10 partner managers across a region spanning India, Middle East, ANZ, Japan and South-East Asia.
APAC is at an inflection point for NiCE. Partner-led revenue is growing quickly, and this role exists to accelerate that momentum by building deeper strategic relationships, raising the execution quality of the team, and aligning the partner ecosystem to the AI-first CX transformation story that NiCE and Cognigy represent together.
How will you make an impact?
Partner strategy and ecosystem development
- Own and execute the APAC partner strategy, aligned to NiCE's international commercial objectives and partner-led revenue targets.
- Build and grow a high-performing partner ecosystem across GSIs, hyperscalers, regional system integrators, BPOs, and value-added resellers in India, Middle East, ANZ, Japan, and South-East Asia.
- Establish and deepen executive-level relationships with partner leadership across the region, leveraging your existing APAC network from day one.
- Work with hyperscaler partners AWS and Microsoft to develop co-sell, marketplace, and joint go-to-market motions that accelerate pipeline and deal velocity.
- Identify, qualify, and onboard new strategic partners where gaps exist in current ecosystem coverage.
Revenue and pipeline ownership
- Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline to meet or exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets across APAC.
- Maintain full pipeline visibility through disciplined use of Salesforce and NiCE's partner operating cadence QBRs, MBRs, and weekly deal reviews.
- Build joint business plans with Tier 1 and Platinum partners, including clear revenue commitments, enablement milestones, and executive alignment.
- Work cross-functionally with APAC sales leadership, marketing, and pre-sales to ensure partner opportunities convert and partners are fully equipped to close.
Team leadership and performance
- Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 8-10 Partner Managers across APAC, setting clear performance standards and a high-execution culture.
- Build a team environment anchored on accountability, coaching, and continuous enablement with a focus on producing partner managers who can operate independently in market.
- Hire, onboard, and retain talent in line with APAC headcount plans as the function scales.
- Bring the energy and operating discipline to run a high-performing regional function, with a consistent rhythm of field engagement, pipeline reviews, and executive stakeholder management.
AI-first partner enablement
- Champion NiCE's AI-first CX narrative CXone and Cognigy across the APAC partner ecosystem, ensuring partners can confidently position agentic AI to their customers.
- Drive structured enablement programmes across the region, including certifications, AI readiness training, and joint presales capability.
- Identify and develop partner-led reference customers and lighthouse accounts across India, ANZ, and Japan that demonstrate the NiCE and Cognigy value proposition.
Executive presence and market representation
- Represent NiCE at major APAC industry events, partner summits, and customer forums across India, Australia, and Japan.
- Build and maintain senior relationships with partner C-suite and alliance leadership, acting as the face of NiCE's partner business in the region.
- Provide regular reporting and insight to the VP Partner Sales International on partner performance, pipeline health, market trends, and competitive intelligence.
Have you got what it takes?
Experience
- 12+ years of experience in partner sales, alliances, channel, or business development within a B2B SaaS or AI/CX business with significant tenure in APAC markets.
- A proven track record of building and scaling partner-led revenue across at least two of the three key markets: India, ANZ, and Japan.
- Hands-on experience leading and growing a team of 8+ partner managers in a complex, multi-country regional role.
- Deep working knowledge of GSI and hyperscaler operating models, with existing C-level and VP-level relationships across the APAC ecosystem.
- Demonstrable success in delivering against partner-sourced revenue targets in a fast-paced, commercially competitive environment.
Skills And Capabilities
- Strong commercial instincts you understand how to structure partner programmes, protect deal economics, and align partner incentives to mutual growth.
- Credible AI and CX fluency you can speak with conviction about agentic AI, contact centre transformation, cloud platforms, and the practical outcomes NiCE delivers for enterprise customers.
- Exceptional executive presence and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust at C-suite and senior partner leadership level across diverse APAC cultures.
- High proficiency in pipeline management, sales cadence, and partner governance frameworks you run a clean, disciplined operating model.
- Cross-functional collaboration skills you work naturally with sales, marketing, product, and finance to align on shared outcomes.
- Ability to communicate and influence in English to board level; additional APAC language proficiency (Mandarin, Japanese) is a significant advantage.
Background
- Experience in CCaaS, contact centre AI, unified communications, CX platforms, or enterprise SaaS strongly preferred.
- Familiarity with partner programme design, deal registration, MDF allocation, and partner performance management.
- Experience working within a global matrix organisation, managing upward to international leadership and laterally with regional sales teams.
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, or a related field. MBA or equivalent executive programme is advantageous.

Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions.

, and building a high-performing sales organization.

Identify market opportunities, emerging trends, and competitive threats to strengthen i-PRO’s leadership position across the region.

Drive disciplined forecasting, budgeting, and performance review processes.
Deliver data-driven insights and recommendations to the APAC leadership team.

Title: Head of Sales, Asia
Description:
About Intellect
Intellect is the global leader in mental health benefits, trusted by the world’s most forward-thinking employers, insurers, and governments to deliver care that is local, personalised, and effective at scale. Today, we serve over 4 million people across 100 countries and languages, making mental health support truly accessible across borders and cultures.
Our platform powers the mental wellbeing of workforces at hundreds of Fortune 500 and major companies, enabling them to support their people with the highest standards of clinical quality, cultural relevance, and on-demand accessibility.
Driven by our mission to build the world’s most trusted mental health benefits platform, Intellect combines a best-in-class digital platform with a world-leading global provider network to deliver unmatched client outcomes and transformative care experiences.
We are backed by top global investors including Tiger Global, Y Combinator, Insignia Ventures Partners, HOF Capital, K3 Ventures, JAFCO, Headline, East Ventures, IHH Healthcare, MS&AD Ventures, and more, alongside an extensive coalition of notable family offices, big tech executives, and leading angel investors.
The Role
The Director of Sales, Asia will drive Intellect’s enterprise sales growth across our core Asian markets through direct sales and strategic alliances.
This is a hands-on leadership role with accountability for regional sales performance and an individual new business revenue target. You will lead and develop a team of Account Executives and SDRs while personally originating, owning and closing a focused portfolio of strategic enterprise opportunities.
We are looking for a strong enterprise seller and people leader who understands how to win complex deals, lead competitive RFPs and build trusted relationships with C-suite decision-makers. You should be equally comfortable setting market priorities, coaching a salesperson, leading an executive presentation and negotiating a contract.
You will work closely with Marketing, Revenue Operations and Partnerships to shape our sales go-to-market strategy, strengthen commercial discipline and build repeatable routes to growth. You will also partner with Clinical, Operations, Product and Finance to ensure our proposals deliver value for customers and are commercially sustainable.
Your Responsibilities
1. Revenue Ownership & Enterprise Selling
Own regional new business sales performance, translating revenue targets into clear market priorities, account plans and execution.
Carry an individual new business revenue target and personally own a focused portfolio of strategic deals through the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to negotiation, contracting and close.
Build qualified pipeline through targeted outreach, executive networks, referrals and partner channels, alongside Marketing and SDR-led activity.
Navigate complex buying groups, uncover customer priorities, develop compelling business cases and secure access to economic buyers and executive sponsors.
Build and deepen relationships with CHROs, Chief People Officers, Total Rewards and Benefits leaders, and other senior stakeholders involved in enterprise buying decisions.
2. Sales Team Leadership & Development
Lead, coach and develop Account Executives and SDRs, setting clear expectations for pipeline creation, opportunity progression and revenue delivery.
Run effective pipeline reviews, deal reviews and individual coaching, identifying performance gaps early and taking action to address them.
Develop the team’s capabilities in discovery, stakeholder mapping, multithreading, value articulation, executive engagement and negotiation.
Establish clear account and territory ownership; help shape hiring, team structure and incentives as the business scales.
Build a culture of accountability, collaboration and high performance through direct feedback, recognition and timely performance management.
3. RFP Leadership & Complex Deal Strategy
Lead priority enterprise RFPs and tenders end to end, including bid qualification, go/no-go decisions, win strategy, proposal development, presentations and commercial negotiations.
Build each bid strategy around the customer’s priorities, evaluation criteria, competitive landscape and Intellect’s differentiated value.
Coordinate solution specialists and cross-functional contributors to deliver accurate, compelling proposals on time, with clear ownership of deliverables.
Lead customer engagement throughout the process, navigating procurement requirements and aligning stakeholders around the proposed solution.
Use win/loss reviews to improve bid selection, sales execution, proposals and competitive positioning.
4. Go-to-Market Strategy & Marketing Collaboration
Shape and execute the sales go-to-market strategy across Asia, prioritising markets, industries, customer segments and direct versus partner-led routes.
Partner with Marketing on target account selection, account-based campaigns, events and demand generation, with shared focus on qualified pipeline and revenue outcomes.
Establish clear lead handovers and follow-up standards, using conversion data and sales feedback to improve lead quality and campaign effectiveness.
Work with Marketing and Product to sharpen enterprise positioning, value propositions and sales narratives based on customer insights and competitive intelligence.
Translate market feedback into practical recommendations on offerings, packaging and growth opportunities.
5. Alliances & Ecosystem-Led Growth
Work with the Partnerships team to turn broker, insurer and other strategic relationships into qualified enterprise pipeline and revenue.
Develop joint account plans and sales initiatives that improve access to priority customers and markets.
Lead sales execution for agreed alliance-led opportunities, coordinating partner introductions, joint pitches and negotiations.
Establish clear opportunity ownership and handovers with Partnerships, aligning direct and partner-led activity to avoid channel conflict.
Evaluate alliance-led sales activity through pipeline quality, conversion and revenue contribution.
6. Revenue Operations & Commercial Discipline
Partner with Revenue Operations to strengthen the foundations for scale: CRM standards, pipeline stages, qualification criteria, forecasting, account planning and performance reporting.
Own adoption of these standards within Sales, maintaining accurate opportunity data, realistic forecasts and clear next steps.
Use pipeline coverage, conversion, sales cycle and productivity data to identify bottlenecks and improve performance; build repeatable playbooks across priority segments.
Help shape pricing, packaging and deal structures with Finance and relevant teams, balancing customer value, competitiveness, delivery requirements and sustainable margins.
Lead deal negotiations within agreed approval frameworks and ensure effective handovers to Client Success and Operations, with clear customer commitments and ownership of follow-on opportunities.
Requirements
Proven Enterprise Sales Leader
You have a track record of delivering B2B new business growth and leading sales teams against clear revenue targets. You have personally originated and closed complex enterprise deals and can explain your contribution to those wins.
Hands-On Player-Coach
You enjoy leading a team while continuing to own and close your own opportunities. You can balance personal selling with coaching, delegate effectively and step into team deals without creating confusion over ownership.
Experienced RFP Leader
You have led and won competitive enterprise RFPs or tenders. You bring sound judgment on which bids to pursue, how to differentiate a proposal and how to coordinate teams through demanding timelines and commercial negotiations.
Strong Enterprise Seller & Executive Relationship Builder
You understand long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, from discovery and business case development through procurement, legal review and contracting. You can engage credibly with C-suite leaders, develop executive sponsors and build new relationships through outreach, networks and partner introductions.
Disciplined Sales Operator
You understand pipeline generation, qualification, forecasting, territory planning, sales methodologies and performance management. You use data to improve decisions and execution, supported by sound judgment and a close understanding of your customers.
Commercially Strategic & Collaborative
You bring strong judgment on market priorities, pricing, positioning and deal economics. You work effectively with Marketing, Revenue Operations, Partnerships and delivery teams, aligning different perspectives around clear commercial outcomes.
Experienced Across Asian Markets
You have meaningful experience in Asian enterprise markets and understand differences in buying behaviour, procurement practices and market maturity. Experience across Singapore and other major Asian markets is strongly preferred.
Experience in enterprise SaaS, HR technology, employee benefits, healthcare, insurance, professional services or another complex B2B category is advantageous. Direct mental healthcare experience is not required.
Builder Mindset & Mission Alignment
You are comfortable in a growing business where processes continue to evolve. You bring structure, take ownership and adapt as you learn. You are motivated by expanding access to quality mental healthcare while building a commercially sustainable business.
What Success Looks Like
Delivery against regional and individual new business revenue targets.
A healthy enterprise pipeline, stronger conversion and reliable forecasting.
Strategic enterprise and RFP wins on commercially sound terms.
A capable, accountable sales team with improving productivity and performance.
Measurable pipeline and revenue from alliance-led sales.
Repeatable sales practices and effective collaboration across the teams supporting growth.
Benefits
Why You’ll Love Working With Us:
Global company – work in a diverse environment with people from nearly 20 countries
Generous leave policy – time off to rest and recharge
Christmas week off – company-wide break during Christmas, separate from annual leave
Birthday leave – enjoy a day off on your birthday
Quarterly mental health days – one day off every quarter to focus on your wellbeing
Flexible work arrangements – work in a way that suits your lifestyle and goals
Work-life balance – a culture that values personal time and long-term wellness
Medical coverage – comprehensive insurance for peace of mind
Performance bonus – high performance is recognised and rewarded
Development budget - annual allowance to support your professional development
Mental health support – premium coaching access to our mental health app and resources & dedicated budget for clinical and psychiatric care
Socials and communities – regular non-work events/activities to connect and have fun together

Title: Head of Sales, Public Sector
Description:
Job Brief
About us
SPTel is a Business Class Digital Services provider that promises:
Fully digitalized processes, enabling on demand provisioning of services such as Bandwidth and cyber security
Business Grade connectivity standards that include <1ms ultra low latency performance and clean-pipe connectivity as a default
True network diversity for improved reliability with unique fibre pathways and facilities that are physically separate from incumbent telcos
Innovative services such as IoT-a-a-S and Edge Cloud computing
We are well recognized in the industry clinching numerous awards for our cutting-edge telco services and have doubled our customer base annually in the last 3 years. We were also featured in the CNA documentary “Home-Grown with a Digital Edge”.
These accolades and achievements are the result of us meticulously grooming a team of talents and specialists to be part of our exciting journey and we are looking to grow our team. If you are a skilled and driven individual, do join us as co-creators of the future of SPTel.
Role Purpose
The Head of Sales, Public Sector is responsible for driving SPTEL’s revenue growth and market penetration across government and public-sector customers.
The role will lead the Public Sector Sales team, deepen strategic customer relationships, expand SPTEL’s presence across new agencies and accounts, and position SPTEL as a trusted digital infrastructure and connectivity partner to the public sector.
Responsibilities
Public Sector Sales & Growth
Own public-sector revenue, order intake, pipeline and new customer acquisition
Develop and execute account and sales strategies across existing and prospective public-sector customers.
Grow strategic accounts through deeper engagement, increased share of wallet and cross-selling of SPTEL solutions.
Drive new-logo acquisition, expanding SPTEL’s footprint across government agencies and public-sector organizations.
Lead major tenders, complex opportunities and commercial negotiations, providing executive sponsorship for strategic deals.
Strategic Account & Market Development
Build strong relationships with senior decisionmakers and key stakeholders across the public sector mainly Ministries, Statutory boards, GovTech, Healthcare clusters, Institutes of Higher Learning, Research Institutes and critical information infrastructure customers
Identify emerging customer needs and translate them into new sales opportunities.
Develop priority public-sector segments and verticals where SPTEL can establish strong, differentiated market positions.
Work with Product and Solutions teams to develop relevant propositions and repeatable sales plays for target customer segments.
Ecosystem & Partnerships
Build relationships with system integrators, technology companies and ecosystem partners to strengthen SPTEL’s public-sector propositions.
Identify joint go-to-market opportunities and partnerships that enable SPTEL to participate in larger and more complex transformation programs.
Leverage partners to extend SPTEL’s capabilities and market reach.
Sales Leadership & Execution
Build, lead and develop a high-performing, customer-focused and growth-oriented sales team.

Title: Head/Manager of Training and Programs
Description:
Are you passionate about empowering young women, building strong communities, and creating impactful partnerships?
Girl Guides Singapore (GGS) is seeking a
Head/Manager of Training& Programs
to lead our Training, Program & Unit Development (TPUD) team. This leadership role will shape and drive strategic initiatives towards the development of Programmes, team management, relationship and partnership development and process improvement in workflow & processes for the team.
What You’ll Do
•
Lead& Develop the Training, Program & Unit Development Team –
Serve as the Reporting Officer for the TPUD team, providing day-to-day leadership, guidance and supervision, building a collaborative, accountable and supportive team culture.
•
Improve Team Processes –
Review and streamline TPUD workflows, systems and processes to improve efficiency, consistency and the quality of support to members and volunteers.
•
Oversee Programmes
– Provide leadership and oversight for the design, management and delivery of impactful programs and events that support member growth, development and empowerment.
•
Shape Training & Development
– Lead the creation and implementation of robust indoor and outdoor training frameworks that build leadership skills, resilience and confidence in girl members and adult leaders.
•
Drive & Support Unit Growth
– Equip Unit leaders with strategies, resources, and best practices to enhance Unit performance, sustainability and engagement across diverse communities
•
Lead Strategic Partnerships
– Develop and drive a long-term partnership strategy, build strong relationships with external partners, collaborators, and community organisations and international Guiding bodies to advance GGS’s mission and impact locally and globally.
•
Expand International Engagement -
Foster and strengthen relationships with the global Guiding movement by initiating collaborations, exchange opportunities andcross-cultural programs that enrich GGS members’ experiences
•
Champion Community Engagement
– Strengthen the Guiding community by engaging volunteers, members, and stakeholders to actively contribute, participate andco-create initiatives.
•
Manage Budgets &Resources
– Oversee program and training budgets, ensuring effective resource allocation, vendor management, and operational efficiency.
•
Work with the Management Team
– Provide strategic direction and align the TPUD team’s goals with organisational priorities, fostering collaboration across departments.
What We’re Looking For
• 5–7 years of experience in partnerships, program development or community engagement, including at least 3 years of direct people management (e.g. as a Reporting Officer responsible for supervising, appraising and developing staff), with a track record of driving organisational impact. Candidates with less experience may be considered for the role at Manager level.
• A people leader who can motivate, coach and develop a team, manage performance fairly and consistently, and handle difficult conversations with care
• Ability to set strategic direction and drive execution with clear outcomes
• Experienced in managing stakeholders at all levels, fostering influence, alignment, and lasting partnerships
• Strong leadership and management capabilities, including oversight of teams, budgets, and complexmulti-stakeholder initiatives
• Relevant sector experience in training, youth development, volunteer-based, or membership organizations (highly desirable)
• Organized, adaptable, and results-oriented, with a passion for empowering young women and communities
• Knowledge of the Guiding movement, outdoor skills will be an advantage
Working Hours
• Working hours are Tuesday to Saturday,8:30 AM – 5:30 PM
• Flexibility is required for occasional evening or weekend events/trainings, with time off provided in lieu
Why Join Us?
For over 100 years, GGS has been providing unparalleled opportunities for girls and women to discover and develop their strengths, their skills and their fullest potential, to become responsible citizens of the world. Today, GGS is the largest volunteer organization for girls and women in Singapore. Asa member of the World Association of Girl Guides and Girl Scouts (WAGGGS), we are connected to over 10 million members in 153 countries.
At GGS, you’ll have the opportunity to shape programs that inspire the next generation of young women leaders. You’ll be part of a supportive team dedicated to creating lasting impact in the community.
We empower girls and women through fun and challenging programs, and unique experiences, adventures and activities. We offer opportunities for girls to get involved in local and international communities, equipping them to make a lasting positive impact by helping others. Our girls develop a deep sense of confidence and self-assurance, along with vital leadership and life skills –all while learning through fun adventures and making lifelong friendships!
To find out more about GGS and the girl-led programs we run, please visit our website at www.girlguides.org.sg
We are a social service organisation which aims to develop girls and young women to the fullest of their potential. Today, we provide opportunities for some 9,000 girl members to build character and resilience, develop future-ready skills, and help them grow into next-generation women leaders for the community and beyond.

Title: Health Insurance Specialist
Description:
Job Description:
Health Insurance Specialist
Location: Singapore
Permanent
Full time
Hybrid working
Job Purpose:
The Health Insurance Specialist is responsible for working closely with Standard Chartered Bank (SCB) Singapore Relationship Managers and Insurance Specialists to generate qualified customer referrals and deliver sales of the Bupa Global SCB international private medical insurance product to eligible Priority Private and high-net-worth customers.
The role provides needs-based product advice, manages customers through the end-to-end sales and application journey, and delivers regular product and sales training to Standard Chartered Relationship Managers and Insurance Specialists. The role is accountable for achieving assigned sales targets while delivering suitable customer outcomes and complying with Bupa, Standard Chartered and applicable Singapore regulatory requirements.
How you'll help us make health happen:
Build strong working relationships with Standard Chartered Bank Singapore Relationship Managers and Insurance Specialists across the relevant Priority Private and private banking segments.
Develop a consistent pipeline of qualified referrals through regular engagement, branch or banking-centre visits, joint customer activity and structured follow-up.
Deliver regular training to SCB Relationship Managers and Insurance Specialists on the Bupa Global SCB IPMI proposition, customer eligibility, referral processes, sales positioning and approved customer communications.
Support SCB Relationship Managers and Insurance Specialists in identifying customers for whom international private medical insurance may be relevant.
Conduct needs-based customer discussions and recommend a suitable Bupa Global SCB IPMI product in accordance with approved sales, suitability and compliance processes.
Achieve assigned sales, conversion, referral and activity targets.
Manage the full customer journey, including referral follow-up, fact-finding, quotation, application, documentation, underwriting coordination, payment and policy issuance.
Conduct initial eligibility and application-completeness checks and refer medical disclosures or complex cases to Bupa Underwriting.
Maintain an accurate sales pipeline and provide regular reporting on referrals, appointments, conversion, issued business and forecast performance.
Use pipeline data to identify referral or conversion gaps and agree improvement actions with SCB stakeholders and the Senior Health Insurance Specialist.
Work with Bupa Underwriting, Operations, Sales Support, Marketing and Compliance teams to progress cases and resolve issues.
Maintain complete and accurate customer and sales records and comply with applicable data privacy, conduct and regulatory requirements.
Gather feedback from customers and SCB stakeholders to improve training, referral quality, the sales process and customer experience.
Key Skills/Qualifications needed for this role:
Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience in business, finance, insurance or a related field is preferred.
Holds, or is able to obtain before appointment, all qualifications, licences and approvals required to conduct the role in Singapore.
Commitment to ongoing professional development and completion of all required regulatory and product training.
Fluency in English is essential. Additional language capability relevant to Standard Chartered Singapore's customer base, including Mandarin, would be advantageous.
Proven record of achieving individual sales targets in health insurance, life insurance, wealth protection or another regulated financial-services environment.
Experience in bank distribution, bancassurance, wealth management or a high-net-worth customer environment.
Strong stakeholder-management skills and the ability to influence Relationship Managers and Insurance Specialists without direct authority.
Demonstrated ability to generate and manage referrals, maintain a disciplined sales pipeline and improve conversion.
Experience delivering product training, sales coaching or presentations to distribution partners.
Strong consultative-selling, presentation, negotiation and objection-handling skills.
Knowledge of IPMI or medical insurance products, customer suitability and underwriting processes.
Confidence engaging with affluent, Priority Private and high-net-worth customers in person and through digital channels.
Strong CRM, pipeline reporting and digital-sales-tool capability.
Why Bupa?
Bupa Global is the international health insurance division of Bupa. We provide customers who want premium international coverage with products and services to access the healthcare they need anytime, around the world, whether at home or when studying, living, travelling or working abroad.
Bupa Global has offices around the world including London and Brighton (UK), Dublin (Europe), Miami (USA), Dubai (UAE, in partnership with Sukoon), Egypt and Hong Kong (China) as well as regional offices in mainland Singapore, the Dominican Republic, Bolivia, Panama, Guatemala and Ecuador.

Title: HR Executive / Senior HR Executive
Description:
HR Executive / Senior HR Executive
AMICI Events & Catering Pte Ltd
About the Role
We are seeking a proactive, organised and process-driven HR Executive / Senior HR Executive to oversee our human resource operations and support the continued growth of our business.
Operating across events, catering and ready-to-eat (RTE) food production, our workforce comprises corporate employees, kitchen and production personnel, and part-time or casual event crew.
The successful candidate will be responsible for managing day-to-day HR operations, strengthening HR policies and procedures, improving workforce management systems, and supporting organisational development.
This role reports directly to the Chief Financial Officer.
Key Responsibilities
1. HR Operations & Process Improvement
Review, develop and implement HR policies, standard operating procedures (SOPs) and employee lifecycle processes.
Standardise recruitment, onboarding, attendance, leave administration, payroll coordination and offboarding procedures.
Identify opportunities to improve HR efficiency, documentation and internal controls.
Support management in reviewing organisational structures, reporting lines, job responsibilities and career progression frameworks.
2. Workforce Management & Payroll
Administer and optimise StaffAny for employee scheduling, attendance tracking and timesheet management.
Monitor employee attendance, working hours, overtime, rest days and shift arrangements.
Consolidate and verify attendance records for monthly payroll processing.
Manage payroll-related variables, including overtime, night shifts and part-time or casual labour payments.
Ensure accurate and timely maintenance of workforce and payroll records.
3. Recruitment & Talent Management
Manage the full recruitment lifecycle, including job advertisements, candidate screening, interview coordination, onboarding and employee documentation.
Coordinate recruitment for corporate, kitchen, production, operations and event-related positions.
Develop and maintain a pool of part-time, freelance and casual event personnel to support operational requirements.
Work closely with department heads on manpower planning and recruitment needs.
4. HR Compliance & Employee Administration
Ensure HR practices comply with applicable Singapore employment legislation and statutory requirements, including MOM regulations, the Employment Act and CPF obligations.
Maintain accurate employee records, employment documentation and HR databases.
Administer employee leave, insurance, medical claims and other employment-related matters.
Monitor applicable employee training, medical checks and food hygiene certification requirements.
Support HR reporting, recordkeeping and compliance documentation.
5. Employee Relations & Performance Management
Handle employee enquiries, grievances and workplace matters professionally and confidentially.
Support department heads in managing employee performance, disciplinary processes and employee development.
Promote consistent HR practices and effective communication between management and employees.
Requirements
Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Human Resource Management, Business Administration or a related discipline.
3–7 years of relevant HR generalist experience.
Experience in F&B, hospitality, catering, events or food manufacturing will be an advantage.
Good working knowledge of Singapore employment legislation, MOM regulations and CPF requirements.
Experience using StaffAny or similar workforce management systems is preferred.
Familiarity with payroll processing, attendance management, recruitment and HR administration.
Experience developing HR policies, SOPs or employee handbooks will be advantageous.
Strong communication, organisational, problem-solving and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities and coordinate with different departments.
Comfortable supporting a workforce comprising full-time, part-time and casual employees.
What We Are Looking For
We value candidates who are hands-on, detail-oriented and capable of improving existing processes while managing everyday HR responsibilities.
The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in a dynamic operational environment and collaborating with both frontline employees and senior management.

Description:
About Us
Our leading SaaS-based Global Employment Platform™ enables clients to expand into over 180 countries quickly and efficiently, without the complexities of establishing local entities. At G-P, we're dedicated to breaking down barriers to global business and creating opportunities for everyone, everywhere.
Our diverse, remote-first teams are essential to our success. We empower our Dream Team members with flexibility and resources, fostering an environment where innovation thrives and every contribution is valued and celebrated.
The work you do here will positively impact lives around the world. We stand by our promise: Opportunity Made Possible. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, we invite you to join us in expanding your skills and helping to reshape the future of work.
At G-P, we assist organizations in building exceptional global teams in days, not months—streamlining the hiring, onboarding, and management process to unlock growth potential for all.
About the role:
As our customer base evolves to serve large global enterprises, we are shifting from fragmented, regional ops handoffs to a dedicated, high-touch delivery model.
The Forward Deployed Operations Manager (FD-OM) acts as the single operational point of contact for our enterprise clients and internal Customer Success teams. In this role, you will lead complex, multi-country onboarding implementations end-to-end. You will sit at the intersection of enterprise project management, global employment compliance, customer activation, and operational delivery—ensuring seamless global expansions and long-term customer satisfaction.
What you will do:
Enterprise Implementation & Project Management
End-to-End Onboarding: Own and project manage end-to-end, multi-country EOR onboarding programs from HR Operations' perspective for enterprise clients, managing timelines, risk registers, and critical path milestones.
Single Point of Contact: Serve as the primary operational partner for enterprise Customer POCs, ensuring a coordinated and unified HR operations service delivery experience during project implementation,.
Internal Alignment: Coordinate within internal HR Ops regional teams in close partnership with Customer Success, Sales teams to align resources and streamline program execution
Global Compliance & Operational Delivery
Compliance Oversight: Navigate complex international labor laws, visa/immigration requirements, benefits administration, and localized employment contract - acting as a consultant to our Customers to deliver on value across multiple workstreams and tailor our offering to Customer's needs
Local Ops Integration: Translate complex in-country operational nuances into clear action plans for the customer while maintaining strict adherence to local regulations.
Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify and resolve operational blockers, regulatory risks, and payroll setup delays across multiple jurisdictions.
Customer Relationship & Activation
Customer Success Partnership: Partner closely with assigned Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to bridge operational delivery with long-term strategic account growth.
Adoption & Happiness: Drive client activation and platform adoption, ensuring a white-glove onboarding experience for both enterprise admins and international employees.
Escalations & Problem-Solving: Act as the direct escalation point for complex operational inquiries, resolving issues with high speed and precision.
Operational Scaling & Process Improvement
Playbook Development: Document and refine implementation playbooks, scalable workflows, and enterprise delivery standards to continuously decrease time-to-first-payroll.
Voice of Customer: Partner with Product and Engineering teams to feed enterprise client requirements back into the platform roadmap.
What we're looking for:
Minimum requirements
Relevant Experience: 4+ years in Enterprise Implementation, Customer Onboarding, Technical Project Management, or Operations Delivery—ideally within the EOR, Payroll, Global HR Tech, or SaaS space.
Domain Knowledge: Direct exposure to global employment mechanics (Employer of Record, global payroll, employment law basics, or HR operations).
Enterprise Project Management: Proven track record of managing multi-stakeholder, multi-country projects using formal frameworks (PMP, Agile, or equivalent experience).
Client-Facing Presence: Excellent communication and consultative leadership skills; comfortable steering calls with VP/C-suite stakeholders at Fortune 500 or high-growth enterprise companies.
Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to thrive in ambiguous environments and translate complex regulatory/operational realities into simple, actionable steps for clients.
Preferred requirements
Experience handling complex, high-volume employee transfers (TUPE, M&A transitions, or enterprise-wide migrations).
International work experience across EMEA, LATAM, or APAC regions.
Core Competencies & KPIs
Core Competencies
Stakeholder Orchestration: Keeping clients, local ops, and CSMs aligned on timeline and scope.
Operational Agility: Unblocking localized compliance hurdles quickly without compromising governance.
Empathy & Drive: Delivering high customer satisfaction during high-stakes corporate expansions.
Success Metrics (KPIs)
Time-to-Activation / Speed-to-Onboard: Minimizing the cycle time from contract signing to employee active state.
Customer Satisfaction (CSAT / NPS): High satisfaction scores during the onboarding and implementation phase.
Implementation Accuracy: Zero compliance or payroll setup errors during the first pay run.
Account Retention & Expansion Readiness: Smooth handoff to CSMs with fully activated platform usage.

AstaGuru, Mumbai’s Premier Online Auction House, seamlessly blends sophistication with expertise, defining its identity through a profound commitment to artistic preservation. Title: Inside Sales Officer/Marine (Fresh Grads Welcome)
Description:
Inside Sales Officer (Fresh Grads Welcome)
With opportunities to develop into outside sales
About the Company
Our client provides marine safety and detection solutions to customers in the maritime industry. Its products and services support safe vessel operations, including gas detection equipment, calibration gases and related testing solutions.
About the Role
We are seeking a proactive, customer-focused Inside Sales Officer to manage sales enquiries, prepare quotations, follow up on opportunities and build customer relationships.
The role will initially focus on inside sales, offering the opportunity to develop product knowledge and understand the maritime customer base. As your capabilities grow, the scope is expected to expand into outside sales, including customer visits, business development and direct account management.
Key Responsibilities
Inside Sales and Customer Management
Handle incoming sales enquiries by phone and email, providing timely and professional responses.
Understand customer requirements and work with the technical team to recommend suitable products and solutions.
Prepare quotations and proposals, follow up with customers and convert opportunities into confirmed orders.
Proactively contact existing and prospective customers to identify new sales opportunities.
Build relationships with purchasing teams, shipowners, ship managers and other relevant customer contacts.
Identify opportunities for repeat orders, equipment replacement, cross-selling and additional services.
Coordinate with technical, operations and logistics teams on product availability, order processing and delivery schedules.
Maintain accurate customer records, sales activities and opportunity updates in the CRM system.
Support sales reporting and contribute towards agreed sales targets.
Development into Outside Sales
Progressively participate in customer meetings, site visits and product presentations.
Support prospecting and business development within assigned accounts or markets.
Develop the ability to manage customer accounts through the full sales cycle, from initial contact to negotiation and closing.
Represent the company at relevant customer events and industry exhibitions as required.
Take on greater responsibility for customer acquisition and account growth as product knowledge and sales capabilities develop.
Requirements
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with confidence engaging customers by phone, email and in person.
A proactive approach to following up on quotations, developing leads and securing business.
Good organisational skills and attention to detail when handling quotations, orders and customer information.
Willingness to learn technical products and explain their practical benefits to customers.
Comfortable using Microsoft Office and CRM or sales order management systems.
Able to work independently and collaborate effectively across teams.
A clear interest in developing into outside sales, with willingness to undertake customer visits and travel as the role evolves.
Ideal Candidate
You enjoy building customer relationships and take ownership of sales opportunities. You are comfortable starting with office-based sales responsibilities and are motivated to grow into a role involving face-to-face selling, business development and account management.

- Mentor and support junior team members, fostering professional development and excellence in client servicing.

Title: Integrated Strategy Director
Description:
Location: APAC / Remote
Engagement: 12-month fixed-term contract
Format: Remote/Hybrid
Travel: Regional travel required
About the Project
We’re looking for a Integrated Strategy Director to become an embedded strategic partner to a global hospitality brand growing in APAC.
This is the first and most important hire within a broader new creative and content capability. You’ll sit close to the client’s leadership team, deeply understand the business, and help turn commercial priorities, audience insight and cultural signals into a clear strategic direction for the brand’s mid-funnel programme.
The ambition is bigger than campaign planning. The opportunity spans brand strategy, creative development, always-on content, influencers, production and brand governance, with a significant opportunity to unlock more commercial value from the content already being created.
You’ll be expected to bring the perspective of an excellent agency strategist while operating with the closeness, context and accountability of an in-house partner.
About the Role
