Description:
Job Title: International B2B Sales & Export Executive – Electronics
*Company:* JK IMPORT AND EXPORT PTE LTD
*Job Type:* Full-time
*Industry:* International Trading, Electronics, Import & Export
*Experience Required:* 3–5 years or more in international B2B sales and export operations
About Our Company
JK IMPORT AND EXPORT PTE LTD is an international trading and export company specialising in sourcing, supplying, and exporting electronics, electrical products, consumer goods, and other products to international markets.
We work with manufacturers, suppliers, distributors, wholesalers, and corporate buyers across multiple international markets.
We are looking for an experienced and proactive professional who has worked in an export house, international trading company, or export-oriented manufacturing company and can independently manage international B2B sales alongside export operations and shipment coordination.
Job Responsibilities
*1. International B2B Sales & Business Development*
* Develop new international customers, distributors, wholesalers, importers, and corporate buyers for electronics and electrical products.
* Identify new business opportunities in international markets, including Africa, the Middle East, Asia, and other export markets.
* Generate leads, contact potential customers, follow up on enquiries, and convert enquiries into confirmed orders.
* Prepare quotations, proforma invoices, commercial offers, and sales proposals.
* Negotiate prices, payment terms, delivery schedules, and other commercial conditions with international customers.
* Maintain strong relationships with existing customers and develop long-term business opportunities.
* Coordinate with manufacturers and suppliers to obtain product specifications, pricing, samples, and delivery timelines.
*2. Export Documentation & Shipment Management*
* Independently manage the export process from order confirmation until shipment dispatch and document submission.
* Coordinate with freight forwarders, shipping lines, transporters, customs brokers, and other logistics service providers.
* Arrange sea freight, air freight, and other international shipping requirements.
* Obtain and compare freight quotations and negotiate competitive shipping rates.
* Coordinate shipment bookings, container loading, cargo collection, and shipment schedules.
* Prepare and verify commercial invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin, shipping instructions, and other applicable export documents.
* Coordinate with customs brokers and relevant parties for export declarations and customs clearance.
* Track shipments and keep customers informed about dispatch dates, estimated arrival times, and shipment status.
* Follow up on bills of lading, airway bills, and other shipping documents as applicable.
*3. Third-Party Inspection & Quality Control Coordination*
* Coordinate third-party inspections with inspection agencies such as SGS, Bureau Veritas, Intertek, or other approved inspection companies, as required by the customer or contract.
* Arrange pre-shipment inspections and factory inspections where applicable.
* Coordinate inspection schedules with manufacturers, suppliers, and inspection agencies.
* Ensure products are ready for inspection according to customer specifications, purchase orders, and agreed quality requirements.
* Follow up on inspection reports, test reports, quality certificates, and other required documents.
* Coordinate corrective actions with suppliers in case of inspection failures, discrepancies, or quality issues.
* Ensure shipments meet the applicable contractual and destination-market requirements before dispatch.
*4. Supplier & Order Coordination*
* Liaise with electronics manufacturers, factories, and suppliers to confirm order details, production schedules, quantities, and delivery dates.
* Monitor order progress and ensure goods are ready for inspection and shipment on time.
* Coordinate product specifications, labelling, packaging, carton markings, and shipping requirements.
* Resolve supplier delays, shipment discrepancies, documentation errors, and other export-related issues.
* Maintain proper records of purchase orders, sales orders, supplier quotations, inspection reports, and shipping documents.
*5. Customer Service & Sales Reporting*
* Maintain regular communication with international customers regarding quotations, orders, inspections, and shipments.
* Follow up on outstanding quotations and pending orders.
* Maintain accurate customer, supplier, and shipment records.
* Prepare regular reports on sales enquiries, confirmed orders, shipment status, and new business opportunities.
* Work towards achieving sales targets and improving export business performance.
Requirements
* Minimum 3–5 years of relevant experience in international B2B sales, export operations, or international trading.
* Previous experience working in an export house, international trading company, export-oriented manufacturing company, or electronics export business is strongly preferred.
* Practical knowledge of export procedures, international shipping, freight forwarding, and export documentation.
* Experience coordinating third-party inspections and pre-shipment inspections.
* Working knowledge of shipping lines, freight forwarders, customs brokers, container shipments, and shipment bookings.
* Understanding of Incoterms, including EXW, FOB, CFR, CIF, and other applicable trade terms.
* Good understanding of commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading, certificates of origin, and other relevant export documents.
* Experience dealing with international customers, overseas suppliers, and logistics service providers.
* Strong negotiation, communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple customer orders and shipments simultaneously.
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel, email communication, and basic reporting.
* Self-motivated, organised, responsible, and capable of working independently.
Preferred Qualifications

* Experience coordinating with manufacturers in China.
* Experience handling container shipments, consolidated cargo, and international freight arrangements.

Title: International Trade Operations Hub Lead
Description:
Role Purpose
The ITO Hub Lead is the regional functional and people leader for an assigned business portfolio within the Asia Pacific Control Tower. The role owns end-to-end ITO governance for the assigned portfolio, leads ITO Specialists, governs complex and systemic escalations, drives carrier/LSP performance, RCI/CAPA effectiveness, risk management and continuous improvement, and consolidates Hub performance for management reporting. The Hub Lead retains full ITO Specialist capability and may directly perform specialist activities when required by business criticality, complexity, workload or continuity needs.
Reports to :
APAC Control Tower Manager
Direct reports :
ITO Specialists assigned to the respective business portfolio
Coverage :
Asia Pacific; assigned business portfolio
Role orientation :
Full ITO functional capability, people leadership, regional governance, systemic escalation, provider performance and continuous improvement
Key Responsibilities
• Own end-to-end ITO governance for the assigned business portfolio, including transportation priorities, critical lanes, service requirements, risks and performance.
• Lead, coach and develop ITO Specialists; allocate priorities, balance workload, maintain backup coverage and ensure consistent quality of specialist outputs.
• Retain full ITO Specialist capability and personally lead or perform specialist work for complex, critical, high-impact or resource-sensitive situations.
• Act as senior transportation SME across ocean, ISO tank, air and other applicable international transportation modes and provide direction on non-standard cases.
• Govern aged, repeated, high-impact, cross-country and cross-provider escalations; challenge recovery plans and ensure timely escalation to the correct stakeholder.
• Lead regional carrier and logistics service provider performance governance, covering booking/service performance, lead-time commitment versus actual, reliability, rollovers, space/equipment, drayage and recurring provider failures.
• Govern capacity, routing and allocation risks and escalate structural or commercial provider issues to the appropriate procurement / commercial owner.
• Lead governance of significant logistics incidents, root-cause investigations and corrective/preventive actions; challenge weak RCA / CAPA and validate effectiveness.
Consolidate assigned-portfolio performance, risks, escalations, provider trends, RCI/CAPA and improvement priorities for direct reporting to the APAC Control Tower Manager.
• Maintain visibility of import-governance themes including broker/customs performance, clearance lead time, backlog, regulatory exceptions and cost exposure.
• Own the portfolio improvement pipeline and convert recurring failures into standardization, automation, productivity, cost-avoidance, service-quality and risk-reduction initiatives.
• Lead or support implementation of new providers, processes, systems, regulatory changes and regional/global initiatives, including training and stabilization.
• Provide performance, risk and improvement inputs for management and strategic customer-governance reviews in partnership with account and Control Tower leadership.
Leadership & Operating Model
• The Hub Lead is a hands-on functional leader, not solely a people manager. The role can perform the complete ITO Specialist scope while carrying broader portfolio accountability and leadership authority.
• Country Operations remains accountable for routine shipment execution, local operational provider management and first-level exception resolution.
• ITO Specialists perform assigned governance and specialist activities; the Hub Lead owns consolidated portfolio outcomes, prioritization, senior escalation and Specialist performance.
• The APAC Control Tower Manager retains overall Control Tower service governance and receives consolidated Hub performance and risk reporting.
Governance Cadence
• Daily / as required: critical escalation, service recovery, risk intervention and Specialist support.
• Weekly: portfolio ITO performance, exception aging, provider issues, RCI/CAPA, risk and improvement priority review.
• Monthly: regional ITO/LSP performance governance covering KPI/SLA, lead time, reliability, recurring failures, CAPA and improvement.
• Quarterly: strategic provider and management-governance support covering systemic trends, capability, risk and improvement roadmap.
• Annual: operating-model, capability/resource, service-strategy and improvement-roadmap planning.
Candidate Profile
• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, International Trade, Business or a related discipline.
• Typically 7-10+ years of relevant international logistics, freight forwarding, transportation, supply chain or trade experience, with strong ocean and regional/multi-country exposure.
• People or team leadership experience together with hands-on functional expertise in provider management, escalation, performance governance, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement.
• Chemical, industrial, 3PL/4PL, LLP or Control Tower experience is advantageous.
• Strong executive communication, stakeholder management and ability to influence across operational, commercial and functional teams without relying solely on direct authority.
• Strong analytical judgment with the ability to convert performance data and recurring failures into practical, measurable actions.
Success in the Role
• Strong and improving transportation service performance for the assigned portfolio.
• Effective leadership and capability development of ITO Specialists with robust continuity and backup
coverage.
• Reduction in aged, repeated and systemic service failures.
• Improved carrier/LSP performance and sustainable corrective-action effectiveness.
• High-quality RCI/CAPA governance with lower repeat root causes.
• Timely, accurate Hub performance and risk reporting to Control Tower leadership.
• Measurable continuous-improvement, productivity, cost, service-quality and risk-reduction outcomes.

Overview
Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 7,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. Our organization is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized innovative solutions powered by Microsoft Technologies.We are seeking an Industry Solutions Delivery Area/Organizational Unit Partner Commercial Lead. You will work across sales and delivery motions, with partners and stakeholders to ensure Microsoft engages the right partners, structures the right commercials, and drives strong delivery performance at scale, positively impacting the ISD Area/OU key business metrics.Your role is pivotal in marrying Microsoft’s delivery capabilities with an empowered partner network to accelerate cloud consumption and customer success . You will bring deep experience in partner management within a consulting services environment, commercial deal structuring, and performance governance within a complex services or technology environment. By expertly managing partner collaborations – from initial contract through steady-state delivery – the Partner Commercial Lead ensures that ISD’s engagements with partners are strategic, efficient, and ultimately drive significant business impact for Microsoft.Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Responsibilities
Execute Partner Strategy
- Lead execution of the ISD global partner strategy within a specific Area or OU by aligning partner engagement to business priorities, embedding the strategy into operating rhythms, and driving adoption across sales and delivery teams
- Track progress through defined milestones, governance forums, and data-driven insights to ensure timely course correction and measurable results

Title: Junior Events Manager
Description:
Roles & Responsibilities
Company Overview
Get Out! Events is dedicated to creating unforgettable events that inspire and connect. Specialising in corporate events, summits and conferences, we deliver tailored experiences with creativity, precision and seamless execution to leave a lasting impact.
We are an AI-native events agency. We believe in equipping every team member with AI tools and agents, so our people spend less time on repetitive admin and more time on clients, creativity and great events.
Job Summary
Get Out! Events seeks a Junior Events Manager with 2 to 3 years' experience to lead corporate events from planning to execution, coordinating teams, clients and vendors to deliver seamless event experiences.
Why Join Us

- Track and manage budgets, quotations and administrative documentation accurately to maintain financial and operational control
- Manage multiple concurrent event projects efficiently in a fast-paced environment, prioritising tasks to meet deadlines
Requirements
- 2 to 3 years of relevant experience in an events agency or corporate events environment
- Strong project coordination skills, demonstrated by managing event logistics and timelines to successful completion
- Effective communication skills for liaising with clients, vendors and cross-functional teams
- Organised and detail-oriented approach to managing event components and following through on timelines
- Open to new ways of working, including AI tools
Other Information
- Full-time position based in Singapore
- Salary range: SGD 3,800 to SGD 4,200 per month
- Working hours: weekdays, 10am to 6pm
- Occasional evening and weekend work during events
- 3 openings available

Title: Key Account Manager - Wholesale & Franchise
Description:
About us
Love, Bonito is Southeast Asia’s leading womenswear brand, built with a mission to empower women to find confidence through style. Incorporated in 2010 in Singapore, we’ve since grown from a humble online startup into a multi-channel business with over 20 stores and counting across Asia and a thriving online presence.
For the next decade, we are looking to expand through new categories, markets, wholesale partnerships, and brand acquisitions. We are evolving into a next-generation regional consumer group — one that blends heart with performance, and creativity with technology.
At our core, we’re a team of builders, dreamers, and doers who believe culture is more than words on a wall — it’s how we show up every day. We move fast, stay curious, and take bold bets on ideas and people we believe in. Here, you’ll find a community that challenges you to grow, trusts you to lead, and celebrates you for being you. Together, we’re shaping the future of Asian brands — from right here in Southeast Asia, to the world.
Why join us?
At Love, Bonito, you’ll do more than just a job — you’ll help build a movement. We’re creating an organization that’s lean, bold, and full of heart — where every person has the space to make an impact. Here’s what you can expect:
Purpose with performance: We’re building a world-class Asian brand that competes globally. We hold ourselves to high standards and operate with purpose, integrity, grit and excellence. Join us if you take customer service excellence seriously and are passionate about creating real impact!
Growth that’s real: We are known to be incredibly dynamic and fast-paced. You’ll be expected to learn fast, stretch beyond your comfort zone, and work alongside people who challenge and support you in equal measure. Don’t join us if you’re looking for a comfortable, fully structured setup, but do join us if you’re excited to build, shape, and make an impact together!
Culture at our core: If you’re looking for a no-corporate-BS environment, you’ll fit right in. We lead with empathy, celebrate individuality, and believe that great work comes from trust, not titles. We believe in teamwork and effective collaboration - because when we run together, we go further. If this speaks to your values, come join us and be part of #TeamLB!
Join us as we redefine what it means to build an enduring global consumer group.
About the role
As the Key Account Manager - Wholesale & Franchise, you will own the operational and merchandising engine behind Love, Bonito's franchise and wholesale business — from full day-to-day ownership of partner accounts to quarterly buying, onboarding, SOPs, and performance reporting. Reporting to the VP of Business Development, you'll bring strong retail/merchandising judgment to partner buying sessions, coordinate closely with Marketing to ensure campaigns and activations land on the ground, and build the scalable systems that let the business expand across markets. This role is built for someone who leads with operational and merchandising expertise first, and who wants to grow into broader strategic ownership as the franchise network scales
Main responsibilities
1. Partner Relationship & Enablement and Operational Support
Act as day-to-day point of contact for partners: order queries, operations, marketing

Description:
Who We Are
lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth-focused environment for our people.
Job Summary
The Key Leader role is an essential part of the store leadership team, impacting salesfloor team members and guest (i.e., customer) experience every day. Key Leaders are responsible for leading by example and providing support to Educators, facilitating an outstanding guest experience in the store, and overseeing all operations of the retail floor. Key Leaders leverage key performance indicators and metrics to prioritize responsibilities while adapting to day-to-day business adjustments and challenges.
Core Responsibilities of the Job
Leadership and People Management
* Support ongoing learning and development of team members by providing direct feedback, coaching, mentoring, and career path guidance, and addressing performance concerns.
* Provide team members recognition, gap assessment, and overall performance documentation to support and reinforce career and personal growth.
* Develop, maintain, and disseminate product and general company knowledge through appropriate communication channels.
Guest (i.e., Customer) Experience
* Support team members (e.g., leading by example or coaching) with ensuring a great guest experience that values guests' time, including assessing guest needs, providing technical product educations, and supporting in-store transactions and omnichannel programs.
* Interact with and assess guests' unique needs to provide customized, effective purchase and return solutions and support.
* Provide technical product education by articulating the value and benefit of the product.
* Resolve guest feedback and address guest concerns or escalations to make it "right" for guests.
* Dynamically provide coverage on the floor to assess and fulfill the needs of the business, team, and guests.
* Inform guests of local community programs. Plan and execute local, regional, and area driven Community projects and initiatives (e.g., local run club, international day of yoga).
Working with Others
* Contribute to a respectful and inclusive team environment by welcoming and celebrating differences to ensure a supportive and engaging experience for all team members and guests.
* Establish supportive and productive relationships with all team members.
* Collaborate with team members to ensure optimal guest experience and support store operations.
Operations
* Provide salesfloor leadership to team members, including planning salesfloor coverage and making decisions to maintain efficiency and effectiveness of salesfloor operations.
* Review business data and metrics to evaluate progress toward goals and determine if adjustments are warranted.
* Open and close the store in accordance with the opening and closing checklists.
* Manage product presentation tasks (e.g., put items back in place, restock or add depleted items to the floor from inventory, destock or relocate items) according to company standards.
* Assign Educators cleaning tasks as needed throughout the shift to maintain the luxury environment of the store.
* Ensure team uses in-store technology to support store operations and provide positive guest experiences.
* Understand and adhere to people safety policies and procedures to maintain a safe work environment.
* Perform work in accordance with applicable policies, procedures, and laws or regulations.
People Management
* Team lead role indirectly responsible for subset of store employees on the floor or as delegated by Store Manager
What We Look For
* Inclusion & Diversity: Creates/supports an inclusive environment that values/celebrates differences
* Integrity/Honesty: Behaves in an honest, fair, and ethical manner
* Guest Experience: Enjoys working and connecting with, understanding, and helping guests
* Collaboration and Teamwork: Works productively with and supports others to achieve goals; seeks partnerships and diverse perspectives
* Leadership: Is able and desires to lead, influence, and inspire others; motivates, empowers, develops, and directs people as they work
* Candid Communication: Is willing to openly/constructively share concerns (i.e., straight talk)
* Decision Making: Uses logic and reasoning to evaluate alternatives and make effective, timely decisions

who are we
lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth-focused environment for our people.
about this team
The Retail Brand Experience (RBE) team brings lululemon's brand and product stories to life through exceptional in-store experiences. Visual Merchandising is a critical component of the guest journey, ensuring our stores consistently deliver inspiring, engaging, and commercially effective experiences.
The APAC Retail Brand Experience team partners cross-functionally with regional and market teams to develop and execute visual merchandising strategies that drive brand awareness, product storytelling, and business performance. We balance global direction with local market relevance, ensuring our stores remain authentic to the lululemon brand while meeting the unique needs of our diverse markets.
core responsibilities
Reporting to the Manager, Retail Brand Experience in market, the Key Market Visual Merchandiser (Lead) is responsible for leading visual merchandising strategy and execution across designated APAC key market(s). This role serves as a strategic partner to regional retail teams, driving consistency, capability building, and excellence in visual presentation while adapting global and regional initiatives to local market needs.
Visual Merchandising Strategy & Execution:
* Lead the execution of visual merchandising strategies across the market ensuring alignment with regional brand and RBE direction.
* Translate and adapt product storytelling, campaign activations, window displays, styling standards, and product placement strategies to meet market-specific needs.
* Drive excellence in weekly, monthly, and quarterly in-store visual merchandising execution to enhance guest experience and support commercial performance.
* Ensure consistent execution of brand standards, visual presentation guidelines, and retail storytelling across all stores.
* Collaborate with cross-functional partners to bring seasonal campaigns, product launches, and key business initiatives to life in retail environments.
* Partner with local vendors to brief campaign creatives and to ensure product quality and execution standards are met, on time and within budget
Market Leadership & Partnership:
* Serve as the key Visual Merchandising partner for assigned market(s), building strong relationships with retail leadership teams and SSC stakeholders.
* Act as the bridge between SSC functions and retail teams, ensuring effective communication, feedback loops, and alignment on priorities.
* Lead market-specific visual merchandising initiatives and Centre of Excellence (COE) projects that elevate the guest experience and drive business impact.
* Provide recommendations and insights based on market observations, store visits, and performance trends.
Capability Building & Coaching:
* Lead the development of visual merchandising capabilities across retail teams through coaching, training, and mentorship.
* Design and facilitate training programs, workshops, and learning materials to support store teams.
* Deliver ongoing feedback and guidance to stores to drive continuous improvement in visual execution and brand presentation.
* Identify capability gaps and partner with leaders to develop plans that strengthen visual merchandising excellence across the market.
New Store Openings & Optimization:
* Lead visual merchandising planning and execution for new store openings, renovations, relocations, and store optimization projects.
* Partner with Opening & Optimization teams to develop and implement optimal store layouts, merchandising maps, and visual strategies.
* Ensure all new stores and renovation projects meet lululemon visual standards and deliver a seamless guest experience.
* Facilitate pre-opening training, visual merchandising setup, enrollment activities, and post-opening support.
* Manage visual merchandising project timelines, communications, and stakeholder alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
Program & Process Development:
* Drive the continuous improvement of visual merchandising tools, processes, and resources with APAC VMS.
* Support the development and evolution of programs and other visual merchandising initiatives.
* Maintain and manage visual merchandising resources, databases, and operating procedures.
* Lead project planning, communication strategies, and execution follow-up to ensure successful implementation of key market initiatives.
qualifications
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Merchandising, Visual Communications, Design, or a related field.
* 5-8 years of experience in Visual Merchandising, Retail Brand Experience, Visual Merchandising or related retail functions.
* Demonstrated experience leading large-scale visual merchandising execution across multiple locations or markets.
* Strong understanding of retail environments, product presentation, guest experience, and commercial drivers.
* Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong coaching and facilitation capabilities with experience developing retail team capabilities.

Job Brief
About us
SPTel is a Business Class Digital Services provider that promises:
Fully digitalised processes, enabling on demand provisioning of services such as Bandwidth and cyber security
Business Grade connectivity standards that include <1ms ultra low latency performance and clean-pipe connectivity as a default
True network diversity for improved reliability with unique fibre pathways and facilities that are physically separate from incumbent telcos
Innovative services such as IoT-a-a-S and Edge Cloud computing
We are well recognised in the industry clinching numerous awards for our cutting-edge telco services and have doubled our customer base annually in the last 3 years. We were also featured in the CNA documentary “Home-Grown with a Digital Edge”.
These accolades and achievements are the result of us meticulously grooming a team of talents and specialists to be part of our exciting journey and we are looking to grow our team. If you are a skilled and driven individual, do join us as co-creators of the future of SPTel.

Protect & Grow Key Accounts
Deepen strategic customer relationships, increase share of wallet and grow recurring revenue.
Acquire & Scale Mid-Tier Enterprise
Significantly expand SPTEL’s customer base through focused new-logo acquisition and repeatable sales motions.
Build Strategic Verticals
Identify and develop priority industry sectors where SPTEL can establish differentiated propositions, ecosystem relationships and sustainable market leadership.
Extend Reach through Channels
Build a scalable partner ecosystem to penetrate emerging markets and customer segments.

Lead the Key Account team responsible for SPTEL’s largest and most strategic enterprise customers mainly commercial enterprises, financial services, logistics, manufacturing, healthcare, retail and energy & utilities
Drive revenue growth, retention and increased share of wallet.
Build senior executive relationships and position SPTEL as a strategic digital infrastructure partner.
Lead major opportunities, complex bids and strategic commercial negotiations.
Drive disciplined account planning and cross-selling across SPTEL’s portfolio.
Mid-Tier Enterprise Growth
Develop and execute a focused strategy to materially expand SPTEL’s mid-tier enterprise customer base.
Build a strong new-logo acquisition engine targeting high-potential mid-sized enterprises.
Establish systematic prospecting, pipeline development and conversion disciplines.
Develop repeatable sales plays and propositions that improve sales velocity and scalability.
Drive both customer-count growth and recurring revenue from the mid-tier segment.

Identify and prioritize strategic industry verticals with strong growth potential and alignment to SPTEL’s capabilities.
Develop vertical-specific growth strategies, propositions and go-to-market plans.
Build deep understanding of each sector’s customer needs, technology trends, buying behaviors and competitive landscape.
Establish SPTEL’s credibility and market presence within selected verticals through anchor customers, strategic partnerships and ecosystem relationships.
Develop industry-specific sales plays that can be replicated across customers within each vertical.
Work closely with Product, Solutions and Marketing to shape differentiated propositions addressing sector-specific requirements.
Build strategic relationships with industry leaders, technology partners and relevant ecosystem players.
Develop the sales organization’s industry domain expertise and capability.
Create measurable vertical growth plans covering pipeline, customer acquisition, revenue and market penetration.
Emerging Markets & Channels
Lead the Channel team responsible for extending SPTEL’s reach into emerging customer segments and markets.
Develop and execute the partner and channel go-to-market strategy.
Recruit and develop strategic channel, technology and ecosystem partners.
Establish clear partner segmentation, commercial models, targets and performance management.
Build repeatable partner propositions that enable SPTEL to scale efficiently into new markets.
Sales Leadership & Execution
Own enterprise revenue, order intake, customer acquisition and pipeline targets.
Establish a high-performance, growth-oriented sales culture with clear accountability.
Drive rigorous pipeline management, forecasting and sales governance.
Improve sales productivity, conversion rates and speed to revenue.
Build and develop strong Key Account, Mid-Tier Enterprise and Channel sales teams.
Personally sponsor strategic customers, major new-business opportunities and priority vertical initiatives.
Collaborate across Product, Solutions, Marketing, Operations and Finance to turn market opportunities into scalable commercial propositions.

12+ years of B2B enterprise sales experience, preferably across telecommunications, ICT, digital infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity or managed services.
Proven track record of delivering enterprise revenue growth and building high-performance sales organisations.
Strong experience managing strategic/key accounts together with new-business acquisition.
Demonstrated ability to develop new industry verticals and translate sector opportunities into scalable sales propositions.
Experience rapidly expanding a mid-market or mid-tier enterprise customer base.

Description:
Global Operations
Law Enforcement Response Team Specialist (APAC)
Location :
Singapore
Employment Type :
Regular
Job Code :
A156301B
Responsibilities
About the Team The Law Enforcement Response Team (LERT) is part of the Trust & Safety team. As a LERT Specialist, you will be responsible for analysing and responding to time-sensitive user data requests, preservation requests and inquiries from law enforcement across Asia-Pacific, Middle-East and Africa. You will work in a global and cross-functional team to ensure user safety on the platform and mitigate legal risk. You take great pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in our platform and ensuring the highest levels of user safety. Responsibilities - Reviewing and responding to an increasing number of user data and preservation requests from law enforcement agencies while protecting user privacy. - Ensuring that all law enforcement requests are analysed and processed in compliance with applicable laws, internal Standard Operating Procedures, and our law enforcement guidelines, with a strong focus on evolving legal frameworks across Asia-Pacific, Middle-East and Africa. - Collaborating with cross‑functional internal teams such as legal and external partners to deal with issues concerning user safety, data privacy and data disclosure. - Ensuring operational excellence while upholding high quality, speed, and accuracy in your work. - Gathering and analysing data on law enforcement requests to improve internal processes and consistently communicating with both internal and external stakeholders. - Drafting internal documentation, workflows and procedures concerning user safety, data privacy and data disclosure. - Keeping accurate internal records and clearly articulating operational decisions.
Qualifications
Minimum qualifications: - Bachelor's degree and/or equivalent experience and a minimum of 3 years experience preferably in a Law Enforcement Response specialist role or legal field. - Fluency in English and advanced English writing skills. - Proven ability to analyse and accurately process data with exceptional attention to detail in a fast-moving environment; requires strong analytical, organisational, and time-management skills to work independently and prioritise effectively under tight deadlines. - Understanding of the legal mechanisms for law enforcement data access, including Mutual Legal Assistance Treaties (MLAT), and court orders. - Experience in navigating and complying with complex, strict regulatory environments, preferably with direct experience related to data privacy and disclosure rules in the technology sector. - Be a team player who is willing to tackle challenging issues in a collaborative manner with your teammates in a fast-paced multi-cultural environment. Preferred Qualifications: - Bachelor's degree in law, criminal justice or similar. - Experience in developing or refining operational policies and procedures in response to new legal or regulatory requirements.

Title: Lead Content Strategist
Description:
About Feel Fresh
Two founders, a Singapore oral-care brand, and nobody between us and the customer. We make a peroxide-free whitening kit, a stain remover mouthwash, ultrasonic and UV cleaners for retainers and aligners, water flossers and toothbrush sterilisers. We sell on our own site and on TikTok Shop, Shopee and Lazada, and Malaysia is next.
The Straits Times, CNA and Mothership wrote about us without being pitched. Dentists started recommending the products because patients brought them into appointments. All of it was built on content we made ourselves.
We are a multi-million-dollar brand that still runs on content: a script, a phone, a shoot, an ad that works. We are looking for the person who decides what that content should be.
The job, honestly
You decide what Feel Fresh puts out and why. You set the content plan across TikTok, Instagram, our Meta ads and our TikTok Shop livestreams, you write and brief the scripts, and you read the numbers afterwards to see which ideas actually made people buy. Then you plan the next round on what you learned.
You will work shoulder to shoulder with the two founders and our performance marketer. Ideas get decided in a conversation, not in a deck. Pitch something on Monday and it can be filmed on Wednesday and live on Friday.
In a typical month you might
- Build the monthly content plan: which products, which angles, which formats, and what each channel gets.
- Write and brief 15 to 25 short-form scripts, and pick the ones worth shooting.
- Plan the content around launches and sale moments like 11.11, Payday and the Malaysia rollout.
- Sit with the ad account and the organic numbers, work out why the winner won, and turn that into next month's briefs.
- Brief and give feedback to our editors, filmers and content interns.
- Find the next format before everyone else copies the current one.
You would be right for this if
- You have 2 to 4 years of content, social or creative strategy work behind you, ideally for a consumer brand or an agency, and a portfolio you can walk us through.
- You can explain why a video worked with numbers, not just taste.
- You write well: hooks, scripts, captions, briefs.
- You would rather own one brand properly than juggle six accounts.
- You want to be measured on results, not on effort.
The deal
- S$3,500 to S$5,500 a month, depending on what you bring.
- A direct line to the founders and to the numbers behind the work.
- A brand with real reach: national press, dentist-recommended products, four marketplaces and a Malaysia launch.
- Room to grow into leading the content function as we grow.
Singapore-based, in office, with regular shoot days on location.

Title: Leasing Manager (Retail Expansion)
Description:
We are looking for an experienced and well-connected Business Development Manager to support the Group’s expansion across its beverage, bakery and retail brands.
This role will be responsible for identifying and securing suitable retail locations across Singapore, with a strong focus on shopping malls, retail developments and high-traffic commercial locations.
The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of Singapore’s retail and shopping mall landscape, including mall positioning, tenant mix, rental rates, footfall, customer demographics and available retail spaces.
You should also have an established network and strong working relationships with major shopping mall landlords, developers, leasing teams and property representatives, with the ability to identify opportunities and negotiate favourable commercial terms for the Group.
This is a hands-on role covering the full process from site identification and evaluation to lease negotiation, store expansion and lease renewal.
Responsibilities:
1. Retail Site Identification & Expansion
Identify and source suitable retail locations for the Group’s beverage, bakery and retail brands across Singapore.
Proactively monitor upcoming vacancies, new developments, mall repositioning projects and potential retail opportunities.
Build and maintain a pipeline of potential locations suitable for different brand concepts and store formats.
Evaluate locations based on mall positioning, footfall, customer demographics, tenant mix, accessibility, visibility, unit size and commercial potential.
Recommend suitable locations based on each brand’s target customers, business model and expansion strategy.
2. Shopping Mall & Landlord Relationships
Develop and maintain strong relationships with major shopping mall owners, landlords, developers, leasing teams and property agents.
Leverage existing industry networks and market resources to gain access to suitable retail opportunities and upcoming vacancies.
Maintain regular communication with landlords and leasing representatives to stay informed of new opportunities, rental movements and mall developments.
Establish the Group as a preferred and reliable retail/F&B tenant.
3. Rental & Lease Negotiation
Lead negotiations with landlords on rental rates, lease terms, security deposits, rent-free periods, fitting-out periods, turnover rent, service charges, marketing fees and other tenancy terms.
Analyse and benchmark rental rates across comparable malls and locations.
Negotiate commercially favourable terms while considering the long-term viability of each site.
Review and evaluate Letters of Offer, tenancy agreements and other leasing-related documents together with relevant internal teams and professional advisors.
Identify potential commercial or contractual risks and highlight them to management.
4. Lease Renewal & Existing Store Portfolio
Manage and monitor the Group’s existing retail lease portfolio and upcoming renewal timelines.
Lead lease renewal negotiations with landlords and seek improved or commercially sustainable terms.
Review rental increases, lease conditions, renewal options and other tenancy changes.
Recommend whether to renew, relocate, renegotiate or exit a location based on business performance and market conditions.
Maintain a clear database of lease expiry dates, renewal options, rental rates and key tenancy terms.
5. Market & Rental Intelligence
Maintain strong knowledge of Singapore’s retail property and shopping mall landscape.
Track rental rates, mall performance, footfall trends, tenant mix, new developments, competitor expansion and market movements.
Conduct regular market and location analysis to support the Group’s expansion strategy.
Provide management with insights on suitable malls, locations and commercial opportunities.
Benchmark proposed rental rates and tenancy terms against comparable locations.
6. Site Evaluation & Commercial Analysis
Conduct initial commercial assessments of potential locations.
Work with Finance, Operations and Management to evaluate projected sales, rental costs, occupancy costs and overall store viability.
Prepare site comparison and investment analysis for management review.
Assess the suitability of different locations for different brands based on brand positioning, customer profile and expected sales potential.
7. Cross-Functional Coordination
Work closely with Management, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Design, Procurement and Project/Renovation teams throughout the site acquisition and opening process.
Coordinate site visits, landlord meetings, commercial discussions and handover requirements.
Support the team from initial site selection through to lease execution and store opening.
Ensure key commercial and tenancy information is clearly communicated to relevant stakeholders.
8. New Business & Strategic Partnerships
Identify potential strategic opportunities with shopping malls, landlords, developers and other property partners.
Explore opportunities for new store formats, pop-ups, kiosks, flagship stores and other retail concepts.
Build long-term partnerships that support the Group’s expansion across Singapore and potentially the wider Southeast Asian market.
Requirements:
5–8 years of relevant experience in Business Development, Retail Leasing, Property Leasing, Site Acquisition, Retail Expansion or a related field.
Strong understanding of the Singapore shopping mall and retail property landscape.
Proven network and established relationships with major shopping mall landlords, developers, leasing teams and property agents in Singapore.
Strong knowledge of retail rental rates, mall positioning, tenant mix, footfall and retail market trends.
Demonstrated experience in lease negotiation and commercial tenancy negotiations.
Experience managing lease renewals and existing retail portfolios.
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to evaluate the financial viability of potential locations.
Strong negotiation, communication and stakeholder management skills.
Able to work independently, identify opportunities proactively and drive projects from initial discussion through to completion.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with good attention to commercial and contractual details.

Title: Leisure Travel Advisor

· Build and maintain strong working relationships with internal stakeholders, external clients, and travel partners (e.g. airlines, hotels, tour operators).
· Support visa application processes where required, including documentation checks, coordination with embassies/agents, and ensuring timely submission.
· Assist in sales-related activities, including responding to sales leads, preparing proposals, and identifying opportunities to upsell or cross-sell travel products and services.
· Participate in client visits, travel fairs, and meetings with corporate clients or agents to strengthen relationships and support business development efforts.
· Collaborate with agents and partners to facilitate smooth bookings and ensure alignment on client requirements and service delivery.
· Be prepared to work extended hours during peak travel seasons, major projects, or travel fairs as required.

Title: Manager / Snr Manager (Partnerships & Programmes), Founders' Memorial
Description:
[What the role is]
Do you love Singapore for punching above its weight as a Little Red Dot? Can you identify with the grit exhibited by our founding leaders and generation as they worked hard to build Singapore to what it is today? If the answer is "yes", join us at the Founders' Memorial (FM)!
At the FM, we are creating a brand-new garden-museum experience for Singaporeans, by Singaporeans. A national landmark at the heart of our garden city, uncovering the story of how independent Singapore came to be, and bringing Singaporeans across generations together to reflect and have bold conversations about what our founding values mean today and for our future.
The FM is seeking a suitable candidate to join the Partnerships and Programmes team. You will be part of a passionate team dedicated to expanding and deepening FM’s impact through strategic partnerships and innovative programming. You will implement strategies to reach new audiences and create meaningful opportunities for citizens and stakeholders to participate in and contribute to FM’s vision. Look forward to being a part of creating a living Memorial that unites, challenges and inspires Singaporeans of all generations towards a brighter future.
[What you will be working on]
Programme Development: Build up FM's suite of in-depth and broad-based programmes to engage diverse audiences and create lasting impact across both indoor and outdoor settings. This includes designing and piloting new programme models, evaluating their effectiveness, and working collaboratively with partners across the ecosystem. Curate and execute community programmes, events, and workshops that facilitate meaningful interactions and dialogue — with a focus on fostering intergenerational and intercultural connections and values-based leadership.
Campaign development and implementation: Conceptualise and lead end-to-end campaign planning and execution, including awareness, outreach, and engagement campaigns. Design and oversee community-centric and accessible initiatives that foster meaningful participation for diverse audiences.
Stakeholder Outreach and Management: Reach out to new stakeholders, build networks, and cultivate strong relationships with community partners, local organisations, schools, and other relevant groups — engaging them as key contributors and collaborators in advancing FM's objectives, building affinity, and driving public interest and visitorship.
Evaluation and Reporting: Monitor the effectiveness of community programmes, gather feedback, and prepare reports to assess the impact and success of the initiatives.
Budget Stewardship: Strategically allocate, monitor, and track budget utilisation for assigned programmes, and prepare reports to ensure funds and resources are used effectively and accounted for properly.
[What we are looking for]
Background in a relevant field such as arts, business, communications, public policy or social sciences.
Preferably at least four years of relevant experience, with a track record in partnership management and programme development. Work experience in a museum or attraction setting is an advantage but not mandatory.
[Stakeholder Engagement] Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills. Good command of the English language (written and verbal) – candidates who are proficient in a Mother Tongue language will be considered favourably as selected candidate would be required to engage diverse groups of non-English speaking stakeholders.
[Facilitation] Strong understanding of audience development and community engagement strategies, particularly in the context of facilitating cross-cultural interactions.
Values authenticity and human connection. Have a keen interest to promote intercultural dialogue and understanding.
Proficiency in project management and the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
[Sense & Evaluate Impact] Familiarity with evaluation methods and reporting techniques to measure the impact of programmes.
Some weekend and after-work hours engagements might be required – candidates should be prepared to exercise some flexibility in his/her work schedule.

Title: Manager, Digital Inclusion Programmes
Description:
About Engineering Good
Engineering Good (EG) is a Singapore-based non-profit organisation founded in 2014. We harness technology, engineering and community collaboration to create practical solutions to support the needs of underserved communities and persons with disabilities (PWDs).
Our work focuses on two core areas: Digital Inclusion (DI) and Assistive Technology (AT).
Digital Inclusion
We collect, refurbish and redistribute used laptops to underserved communities, including low-income families and migrant workers, providing them with essential access to the digital world. By extending the useful life of donated devices, our DI work also contributes to environmental sustainability by reducing electronic waste.
To enhance our impact, EG is establishing a new initiative focused on delivering meaningful digital literacy programs. These programs aim to help individuals develop the skills and confidence needed to engage effectively in our increasingly digital society. Skills in digital creation, such as graphic design, video editing, and word processing, not only improve the quality of screen time but also serve as valuable tools for advancing education and economic opportunities.
Assistive Technology

The Manager of Donor Engagement is responsible for growing and managing donor relationships across multiple segments to strengthen long-term support for the Society. Title: Manager, Partnerships, Climate & Food Systems (2-year contract)
Description:
About WWF
WWF-Singapore World Wide Fund for Nature (WWF) is one of the world’s largest and most respected independent conservation organisations. WWF’s mission is to stop the degradation of the earth’s natural environment and to build a future in which humans live in harmony with nature. As one of WWF’s international hubs, WWF-Singapore supports a global network spanning over 100 countries. WWF Singapore works closely with local stakeholders towards a greener and more sustainable Singapore and the region around us. We work to address key conservation areas, such as climate change, sustainable finance, deforestation, illegal wildlife trade, marine conservation, and sustainable production and consumption, through collaboration, education and outreach efforts involving the community, businesses, and governments. For more information, please visit wwf.sg.
Overview
WWF-Singapore is seeking a Partnerships Manager to develop and manage strategic partnerships for its Climate Finance programmes, with a primary focus on its Climate Resilient Rice/Food Coalition.
The role will identify, onboard and steward partners across the private sector, financial institutions, government, philanthropy and other organisations, helping to build a strong coalition that can mobilise finance and collective action for climate-resilient and low-carbon food systems across Southeast Asia.
Key Responsibilities
1. Partnership Development & Onboarding
Identify and engage prospective partners for the Climate Resilient Rice/Food Coalition.
Develop compelling partnership propositions, proposals and engagement materials.
Lead prospective partners from initial engagement through onboarding and formalisation of partnerships.
Identify opportunities for partners to contribute through finance, technical expertise, market access, procurement and other forms of collaboration.
2. Partner Stewardship
Manage relationships with a portfolio of partners and serve as their primary WWF point of contact.
Maintain regular engagement with partners and identify opportunities to deepen collaboration.
Coordinate with WWF programme and technical teams to ensure effective delivery of partnership commitments.
Prepare partnership updates, reports and briefings as required.
3. Coalition Development & Engagement
Support the growth and development of the Climate Resilient Rice/Food Coalition as an effective regional multi-stakeholder platform.
Engage coalition members and facilitate collaboration across businesses, financial institutions, governments, technical organisations and civil society.
Coordinate coalition meetings, roundtables, workshops and other partner engagements.
Identify opportunities for joint initiatives that can mobilise finance and scale climate-resilient and low-carbon agriculture.
4. Programme Development
Support the development of sustainable food programmes and related carbon finance programmes.
Represent WWF-Singapore at relevant external engagements and industry forums.
Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Business, Sustainability, Environmental Studies, International Relations, Finance or a related field.
Minimum 5 years' experience in partnerships, business development, sustainability, programme development or stakeholder engagement.
Demonstrated ability to develop and manage relationships with corporate, financial, government or institutional partners.
Strong communication, relationship-management and project-management skills.
Experience in sustainable agriculture, food systems, climate finance or carbon markets would be advantageous.
Experience working in Southeast Asia would be an advantage.
Why Join Us
Join WWF-Singapore to build partnerships that mobilise finance and collective action for climate, nature and communities. You will work with leading organisations across the region to help scale climate-resilient and sustainable food systems across Southeast Asia.

This role ensures smooth execution of employee lifecycle processes and supports the Business Partners as well as HR Centre of Excellence in system enhancements and policy reviews.
Key responsibilities:
Shared Services Support
Provide end-to-end administrative support to Business Partners for HR transactions, including preparation of employment contracts, letters, onboarding and offboarding documentation
Coordinate logistics for new hires (welcome pack, uniform, digital name card, laptop, staff pass) and departing staff (e.g. return of assets, closure of access)
Maintain accurate data, files, and documentation in HRIS, staff directory and shared drives
Assist with audits and ensure compliance with documentation and record-keeping requirements
Payroll, Leave & Benefits Administration
Prepare monthly payroll preparation, including validation of changes (new hires, resignations, overtime, etc.)
Administer government-paid leave (e.g. maternity, paternity, NS, Childcare) and submit claims
Performance and Learning & Development (L&D) Support
Support training platform administration, claims, logistics for internal and external training courses
Maintain accurate training records and generate reports for compliance, grants and audit purposes
Assist in implementing L&D initiatives (e.g. e-learning, blended learning, learning roadmap & internal workshops)
Maintain and update SOPs and guidelines related to performance management processes
Consolidate performance ratings, promotion nominations, and other related data from departments
Policy, Process & People Transformation Support
Support in process improvement solutioning and digitalisation efforts
Conduct data clean-ups and accuracy checks on SuccessFactors (SF); assist with UAT and issue tracking
Maintain SOPs or user guides for systems and processes
Support in change management communications for policy changes
Assist in P&C policy documentation, version control, and publishing to intranet/SharePoint
Support data collation and P&C reporting for the Centre of Excellence
Manage the posting of announcements and reminders in various communication channels (e.g. Workplace, VivaEngage)
Coordinate staff welfare and wellness activities (e.g. health screening, vaccinations, birthdays, events)
Other HR Operations
Identify applicable government grants and funding schemes (e.g. SMAS, CCSE, CCTG) and administer the application and claims process
Liaise with internal stakeholders and funding agencies to ensure compliance and timely submissions
Any other relevant HR related matters and projects
Job Criteria:
A diploma in Human Resource Management, Business Management or equivalent
At least 3 years' experience in a supportive HR function
Familiarity with payroll processes and HRIS – SuccessFactors is an added advantage
Experience in the social service sector is preferred
Proficient in excel
Good written and verbal communication
Attention to detail and data accuracy
Strong coordination and follow-through
Interpersonal and stakeholder management
Time management and ability to prioritise

Title: Manager, Programme Development & Client Engagement
Description:
ABOUT EQUAL
EQUAL is an IPC-registered charity that delivers equine-assisted and animal-assisted services to support the mental and emotional wellbeing of children, youth, seniors, families, and communities. Our work sits at the intersection of human wellbeing, animal welfare, and experiential learning, and is delivered through a multidisciplinary team of programme professionals, equine specialists, operations staff, and volunteers. Fundraising is mission-critical to EQUAL’s ability to deliver safe, high-quality, and impactful programmes. As the organisation scales, EQUAL is strengthening its fundraising infrastructure, pipeline discipline, and stewardship capability to support sustainable growth.
ROLE SUMMARY
The Manager, Programme Growth & Client Engagement is responsible for growing and sustaining demand for EQUAL's programmes through new institutional engagements, stronger existing client relationships and repeat programme opportunities.
The role proactively develops programme opportunities across schools, social service agencies, healthcare institutions, corporations and community organisations. This includes both fee-paying programme engagements and partnerships that extend programme access and beneficiary reach.
The Manager owns the external client engagement process, from prospecting and enquiries through needs assessment, proposals, quotations, programme confirmation, contracting coordination and renewal.
Working closely with the Programmes & Services team, the Manager ensures that programme opportunities are appropriate, financially sound where applicable, and aligned with EQUAL's programme capabilities and delivery capacity.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Programme Business Growth & New Institutional Engagements
Proactively identify and engage organisations that may benefit from EQUAL's programmes.
Develop new opportunities across schools, social service agencies, healthcare institutions, corporations and community organisations.
Qualify prospective engagements by understanding organisational needs, beneficiary groups, programme objectives, available budgets and potential engagement models.
Convert qualified enquiries and opportunities into confirmed programme engagements.
Respond promptly to assigned programme enquiries, establish clear next steps and follow through until each opportunity is confirmed, declined or closed.
Develop targeted institutional outreach and re-engagement plans.
Identify potential new markets, client segments and programme applications, working with Programme leadership to assess feasibility.
Work with Programme Specialists to assess programme requirements, delivery feasibility and suitable engagement models before making external commitments.
Maintain a clear and actively managed pipeline of programme opportunities.
2. Existing Programme Client Relationships & Retention
Client Relationships & Retention
Manage assigned institutional programme clients and partners.
Maintain regular engagement with existing clients to understand evolving programme needs.
Secure repeat programme engagements and renewals.
Proactively re-engage lapsed programme partners to explore renewed or expanded programme participation.
Identify opportunities to expand programme participation through additional sessions, beneficiary groups or approved programme offerings.
Maintain accurate engagement records, renewal schedules and client follow-up plans.
Collect structured client feedback and coordinate improvements with the Programme team.
3. Programme Proposals, Quotations & Contracting
Lead the preparation of programme proposals, concept notes, quotations and engagement documents, working with Programme Specialists on programme content and delivery requirements
Coordinate programme pricing, budgets and delivery assumptions with the relevant internal teams.
Assess fee-based opportunities using approved pricing, delivery cost and capacity information, escalating exceptions for the appropriate approval.
Manage procurement and tender submissions, including GeBIZ where applicable.
Coordinate service agreements, booking confirmations, contract renewals and amendments.
Ensure programme requirements, commercial terms and delivery commitments receive the necessary internal approvals before confirmation.
Work with Finance to ensure accurate billing information is submitted promptly and help resolve client-related commercial issues.
4. Programme Engagement & Client Coordination
Serve as the primary client-facing contact for assigned programme engagements.
Coordinate client needs and expectations with Programme Specialists and relevant operational colleagues.
Ensure confirmed programme commitments are handed over clearly to the teams responsible for delivery.
Monitor client-facing commitments, programme engagement milestones and renewal opportunities.
Maintain visibility of confirmed programme bookings, client requirements and engagement status, coordinating client-facing issues with the Programme team.
Coordinate the timely submission of agreed programme-client reports and deliverables, using content prepared and approved by the Programme team.
Address client-related issues and escalate operational matters to the relevant functional leads.
5. Programme Pipeline, Performance & Process Improvement
Maintain accurate records of prospective, confirmed and completed programme engagements.
Prepare programme booking forecasts, including expected programme income where applicable.
Track enquiry conversion, programme client retention, repeat engagements and engagement trends.
Monitor commercial engagement performance using approved pricing and cost information.
Identify gaps in enquiry management, proposal turnaround, contracting and client coordination.
Research emerging institutional needs and potential referral channels to inform targeted programme outreach and future growth.
Implement practical improvements to programme business processes.
Provide regular management updates on programme demand, pipeline performance, client retention and growth opportunities.
6. Cross-Functional Opportunity Development
Work with the Fundraising team where programme clients express interest in donations, sponsorships or broader philanthropic partnerships.
Refer volunteering opportunities to the Volunteer Manager and coordinate where volunteering forms part of a programme engagement.
Coordinate external communication with the designated relationship lead where a partner engages multiple EQUAL departments, while owning the programme workstream.
Provide programme scope, costings, delivery assumptions and relevant approved information to support fundraising or grant submissions led by designated colleagues.
Participate in integrated institutional partnership proposals when EQUAL's programmes form part of a broader collaboration.
Maintain coordinated external communication when a partner engages multiple EQUAL departments.
SCOPE & ACCOUNTABILITY BOUNDRIES
This role is
not
responsible for:
Fundraising solicitation, philanthropic funding negotiations or donor stewardship.
Independently managing corporate sponsorships, charitable grants or donation renewals.
Corporate volunteering programme design or volunteer management.
Programme methodology, beneficiary assessments or direct programme delivery.
Producing or approving technical programme outcome reports and research findings.
Issuing invoices, accounting for income or managing formal debt collection.
Making unauthorised commitments concerning programme pricing, expenditure, staffing, capacity or horse welfare.
QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS
Demonstrated experience in institutional business development, service-based partnerships or account management, including converting new opportunities into confirmed engagements and maintaining client relationships.
Experience managing external partnerships, client relationships or institutional accounts.
Strong administrative, organisational and project coordination skills.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Core Competencies
Strong relationship-building and consultative engagement skills.
Proactive business development and follow-through.
Sound commercial judgement and ability to balance growth with operational feasibility.
Excellent written and verbal communication.
Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and CRM/pipeline discipline.
Ability to work across teams while respecting functional expertise and responsibilities.
Key Attributes
Proactive, resourceful and accountable for results.
Comfortable developing new business rather than relying solely on incoming enquiries.
Collaborative, practical and service-oriented. • Able to manage multiple client engagements and deadlines.
Motivated by EQUAL's mission and committed to quality, sustainable programme growth.
WHY JOIN US?
Make a tangible impact in a mission-driven team, grow across operations and systems, and work in a unique, nature-rich environment with meaningful outcomes.
HOW TO APPLY
Please email your updated CV and a short cover letter to
pradeep.thevar@equal.org.sg
with the subject line “Partnership & Development – Your Name”.

Title: Manager/Senior Manager, Outreach Events and Management (WOD)
Description:
Responsibilities
• Lead the planning and delivery of career events, workshops, networking sessions and other outreach initiatives across physical, virtual and hybrid formats, ensuring alignment with Workforce Outreach Division priorities and workforce needs.
• Conceptualise event formats, participant journeys and engagement approaches; pilot new initiatives and improve existing formats to strengthen employer participation, jobseeker engagement and job-matching outcomes.
• Build and maintain effective working relationships with employers, industry partners, associations, Self-Help Groups, community/grassroots organisations and internal stakeholders to mobilise participation, partnerships and resources.
• Shape targeted outreach and engagement strategies to attract suitable jobseekers and employers, advocate jobseeker capabilities and workforce needs, and curate activities that reduce skills and hiring mismatch.
• Oversee end-to-end event operations, including vendor appointment and management, logistics, registration, event-day execution, post-event follow-up, procurement and governance requirements.
• Develop event budget requirements, monitor utilisation, exercise cost discipline, verify billing and ensure effective deployment of resources while delivering value for money.
• Establish and monitor event performance measures, analyse participation, engagement and outcome data, identify trends and translate insights into actionable improvements.
• Lead post-event reviews, consolidate feedback from stakeholders, identify gaps and improvement opportunities, and institutionalise good practices across the event portfolio.
• Coordinate internal teams and external parties to deliver multiple concurrent events, provide direction on priorities and resolve operational issues to ensure timely, quality outcomes.
Requirements
Experience & Qualifications
• At least 5 years of relevant experience in event management, programme delivery, project management, partnerships, outreach or a related field, with demonstrated experience leading end-to-end events or engagement initiatives.
• Experience managing vendors, budgets, stakeholders and concurrent projects in a fast-paced environment.
• Experience in workforce, community, employer engagement or career-related initiatives will be an advantage.
• Candidates without the required qualifications but with strong relevant experience may be considered.
Knowledge
• Events, programme and project management principles, including physical, virtual and hybrid delivery.
• Workforce segment needs, employer hiring challenges and labour market / sectoral manpower trends.
• Job matching, employability and employer engagement considerations.
• HR hiring processes and relevant national employment policies.
• Knowledge of WSG programmes and/or relevant workforce initiatives will be an added advantage.
Skills
• Strategic Planning & Event Management: Translate organisational priorities into practical event strategies, formats and delivery plans.
• Stakeholder & Partnership Management: Build trusted relationships, align diverse interests and mobilise stakeholders towards shared outcomes.
• Budget & Vendor Management: Manage budgets, procurement considerations and vendors with strong governance and value-for-money focus.
• Communication: Strong business writing, presentation and facilitation skills across internal and external audiences.
• Data & Insights: Use participation, engagement and outcome data to evaluate effectiveness and guide improvements.
• Problem Solving & Decision Making: Assess issues, evaluate options and make timely decisions in a changing operating environment.
• Digital & Technology: Proficient in Microsoft Office and able to learn and apply event, collaboration and other digital tools quickly.
Abilities/Aptitudes
• Takes ownership, demonstrates sound judgement and follows through on commitments and outcomes.
• Adaptable and resilient, with the ability to manage last-minute changes and competing priorities.
• Systematic, organised and able to manage concurrent projects without losing attention to detail.
• Collaborative team player who can rally resources, influence stakeholders and resolve issues constructively.
• Comfortable operating in a dynamic environment with a strong service and outcome orientation.
Other Characteristics
• Established network or experience working with industry partners, employers and/or associations.
• Experience working with Self-Help Groups, community or grassroots organisations is an advantage.
