Title: Managing Director, Head of Regional Sales, Global Payments Solutions, Singapore
Description:
Job Description:
At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.
At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
Role Overview
The Managing Director, Head of Regional Treasury Sales, APAC is accountable for defining and executing the firm’s regional treasury sales strategy for multinational clients operating across Asia Pacific, with a primary focus on Regional Treasury Centers (RTCs), In-House Banks, and Shared Service Centers (SSCs).
This role has full responsibility for regional origination, revenue growth, market penetration, and sales leadership across cash management, payments, liquidity, working capital, trade and supply chain finance, corporate and commercial cards, and transactional FX.
This is a player–manager role. The successful candidate will personally lead strategic regional client engagements with senior treasury decision-makers, while building, coaching, and managing a high-performing regional treasury sales organization. The role is central to positioning the firm as a leading treasury partner for multinational clients’ APAC operating and liquidity structures.
Key Responsibilities
Regional Market Leadership & Origination
- Define and execute the APAC regional treasury sales strategy, with a focus on multinational clients’ Regional Treasury Centers and cross-border treasury operating models.
- Personally lead strategic origination and senior-level engagement with APAC-based CFOs, Group Treasurers, Regional Treasurers, and Heads of Finance.
- Drive regional mandate acquisition across cash management, liquidity, payables, receivables, trade and supply chain finance, corporate and commercial cards, and transactional FX.
- Identify regional market opportunities and develop targeted strategies to grow wallet share and franchise relevance across APAC.
Client Coverage, Solutions & Leadership
- Lead complex, multi-product treasury dialogues for multinational clients operating across multiple APAC markets.
- Own and coordinate regional treasury sales coverage for APAC RTC clients, in partnership with country coverage, global relationship managers, and product teams.
- Run and manage complex, multi-product and multi-regional RFPs, coordinating inputs across products, countries, implementation, operations, and global stakeholders to deliver competitive and executable client proposals.
- Deliver tailored regional treasury and working capital solutions reflecting regulatory and operating differences across APAC markets.
- Serves as a bank representative presenting at key industry events, leading consultative discussions at multiple levels of the organization, and providing product line expertise
- Serve as the APAC coordination lead for regional treasury and liquidity mandates, ensuring seamless connectivity between APAC markets, EMEA, and the Americas.
People Leadership
- Lead, coach, and develop the APAC Regional Treasury Sales team.
- Act as a hands-on player–manager supporting senior team members on complex regional originations.
- Manager of Process & Data: Challenges end-to-end process efficiency and effectiveness, championing data driven decision-making and removes obstacles to optimize operations
- Enterprise Talent Leader: Inspects and manages the health of the bench to ensure succession for the organization, while supporting enterprise talent needs.
- Enterprise Advocate & Communicator: Contributes to enterprise strategy and influence messaging to connect team contributions to business purpose, results, and success.
- Set clear performance expectations and accountability aligned with franchise goals.
Risk, Governance & Franchise Stewardship
- Ensure adherence to regional regulatory, compliance, KYC, and internal governance standards across APAC.
- Ongoing collaboration with banking coverage and wholesale credit to ensure deal flow aligns with internal risk appetite
- Uphold the firm’s reputation and risk culture across all regional client engagements.
Required Experience & Capabilities
- Extensive experience in treasury, transaction banking, or working capital solutions covering multinational clients with APAC regional treasury models.
- Proven ability to lead and manage complex, multi-product and multi-country client proposals and RFP processes.
- Strong executive presence with the ability to influence Group Treasurers and Regional CFOs.
- High energy level with a strong work ethic and a continuous desire to learn
- Deal origination and execution
- Risk awareness and credit discipline
- Strategic thinking and commercial acumen
- Fluency in English required; additional Asian languages advantageous.

Title: Marine Navigation Equipment Area Sales Manager
Description:
The Opportunity
Take ownership of HMAP’s marine navigation sales growth across Southeast Asia. Build distributor partnerships, develop business with shipowners and shipyards, and help customers select Radar, ECDIS and VDR solutions for their vessels.
This role combines regional sales strategy, technical solution selling and account development. You will work closely with technical teams and senior management, with direct involvement in market planning, customer opportunities and commercial decisions.
About HMAP
HMAP Pte Ltd is a Singapore-based manufacturer and integrator of marine navigation equipment and automation systems. Our core navigation portfolio includes marine Radar, Electronic Chart Display and Information Systems (ECDIS), and Voyage Data Recorders (VDR).
Why Join HMAP
Regional responsibility:
Shape territory sales plans and develop customer and distributor relationships across Southeast Asia.
Close collaboration with product specialists:
Work directly with technical teams to turn customer requirements into practical proposals and project opportunities.
Visible business impact:
Contribute market insights and commercial recommendations to senior management.
Maritime industry engagement:
Represent HMAP at customer meetings, distributor engagements and maritime exhibitions throughout the region.
What You Will Do
Develop and execute territory sales plans to achieve agreed revenue, profitability and market development targets.
Strengthen and expand distributor networks through clear objectives, regular performance reviews, product training and commercial support.
Identify and pursue opportunities with shipowners, ship managers, shipyards and marine procurement teams.
Manage the sales cycle from prospecting and opportunity qualification through proposals, negotiations and order confirmation.
Work with technical teams on customer requirements, product demonstrations, tender submissions and product specifications for vessel projects.
Monitor competitor activity, customer purchasing priorities and market developments to identify new opportunities.
Maintain an accurate sales pipeline and provide forecasts, performance updates and market feedback to management.
Coordinate with operations and service teams to support effective order handover, delivery and customer satisfaction.
What You Will Bring
A Degree or Diploma in Maritime Studies, Marine Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Business Administration or a related discipline.
At least
five years of B2B sales experience
in marine electronics, navigation systems or bridge equipment.
Strong working knowledge of Radar, ECDIS and VDR applications, technical specifications and relevant maritime regulatory requirements.
An established professional network among distributors, shipowners, ship managers, shipyards and marine procurement professionals, particularly in Singapore and Southeast Asia.
A record of developing business opportunities, managing channel partners, negotiating commercial terms and closing sales.
The ability to communicate confidently with both technical and commercial stakeholders.
A proactive, organised approach and sound commercial judgement, with accountability for results.
Willingness and ability to travel regionally approximately
20–30% of working time
.
Apply
Submit your CV highlighting your marine industry experience, regional market coverage and key sales
HMAP Pte Ltd is a manufacturer of marine navigation equipment and a system integrator for maritime surveillance and traffic management solutions. Its product portfolio includes marine radars, Electronic Chart Display and Information Systems (ECDIS), and Voyage Data Recorders (VDRs).
The company also integrates Coastal Surveillance Systems and Vessel Traffic Management Systems, supporting maritime situational awareness and the safe, efficient movement of vessels. HMAP serves channel partners, shipowners, ship managers, shipyards, and port managers, providing equipment and integrated solutions for shipboard and shore-based operations.

Title: Marine Sales Engineer
Description:
We are seeking a
Marine Sales Executive
to develop new business opportunities and manage customer relationships within the marine and shipyard sectors. The role involves promoting marine products and services, managing sales enquiries and coordinating with internal teams to ensure timely project delivery and customer satisfaction. This is a
full-time role with a 5.5-day work week
.
Responsibilities
• Build and maintain relationships with marine and shipyard customers, and identify new business opportunities.
• Promote marine products and services to grow the customer base and achieve sales targets.
• Handle customer enquiries, requests for quotations (RFQs), quotations and sales follow-ups.
• Coordinate with Operations and Project teams on ship parts and ship repair projects to ensure timely execution and delivery.
• Monitor project progress, address customer concerns and maintain service quality.
• Source materials and liaise with suppliers when required.
• Monitor market trends, business performance and relevant regulatory developments to support sales planning and forecasting.
• Plan and execute sales and marketing activities to increase customer awareness and demand.
• Gather and analyse customer feedback, and recommend improvements to products and services.
• Prepare sales forecasts, sales and marketing reports, and maintain accurate customer records.
Requirements
• Relevant tertiary qualification.
• At least 2 years of sales and marketing experience in the marine and offshore or waste treatment industry, with a proven sales track record.

Title: Market Affairs Associate
Description:
About the role
We are seeking a
detail-oriented, analytical and resourceful Market Affairs Associate
to support ACA’s market information, trade analysis and market access/regulatory reporting work across Southeast Asia.
The Market Affairs Associate supports Agribusiness-Connect Asia’s market access, regulatory affairs and trade data activities across Southeast Asia.
The role provides regional support for monitoring market and policy developments, maintaining market affairs information and resources, conducting targeted research, and preparing materials to support regulatory and market access work.
The position will also support the collection, maintenance and analysis of trade data, helping the team better understand trade flows, market performance and emerging trends.
This is a developing role suited to someone who is organized, analytical and interested in building knowledge of market access, regulatory affairs and trade data analysis.
Reports to:
Senior Manager, Southeast Asia
Functional/Dotted-line reporting:
Regional Director
Market Access & Regulatory Affairs
Monitor relevant regional news, policy and industry developments related to food, agriculture and trade, with particular attention to developments that may affect market access.
Maintain market affairs trackers, stakeholder information, regulatory records, reference materials and other shared resources.
Conduct targeted research and information gathering to support country and regional market access and regulatory matters.
Support cross-market comparisons and compilation of information across Southeast Asian markets.
Support the preparation of market access and regulatory affairs materials, including briefing notes, presentations, background information and meeting materials.
Assist with the preparation and coordination of stakeholder meetings, industry engagements and other market affairs activities, including documenting relevant information and follow-up actions.
Support specific market access and regulatory projects as assigned.
Work with country teams to ensure relevant information and records are captured and maintained consistently.
Trade Data & Analysis
Extract and compile trade data from Trade Data Monitor (TDM) and other agreed data sources.
Maintain recurring trade datasets, reports and other data resources.
Check, organize and prepare trade data for analysis and reporting.
Produce tables, charts and other outputs showing trade flows, market share, product categories, major suppliers and other relevant indicators.
Conduct routine analysis to identify changes, patterns and trends in trade data.
Support ad hoc trade data requests and analysis for the regional team.
Develop the ability to interpret trade developments and explain what the data may indicate for markets, products and U.S. agricultural interests.
Over time, contribute to developing stronger trade insights by connecting data trends with relevant market, policy and industry developments.
Other Responsibilities
Coordinate with country teams and other regional colleagues on assigned projects and information requirements.
Maintain accurate and well-organized working files and documentation.
Support other market affairs activities as required, consistent with the scope and development of the role.
Role Development
The initial focus will be on building strong foundations in market affairs support and trade data management and analysis. As experience and capability develop, the role may take on greater analytical responsibility and contribute more directly to interpreting trade developments and supporting market access and regulatory work across the region.
Qualifications & Experience
Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as economics, international trade, business, agriculture, food science, public policy or international relations.
Preferably 1–3 years of relevant working experience; strong fresh graduates may also be considered.
Interest in international trade, food and agriculture, regulatory affairs, market access or economic and data analysis.
Comfortable working with quantitative information and datasets.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Experience with trade databases, data visualization or analytical tools would be an advantage but is not essential.
Strong written and spoken English.
Skills & Attributes
Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
Able to organize and maintain information systematically.
Comfortable working with both qualitative information and quantitative data.
Able to identify relevant information from multiple sources and summarize it clearly.
Curious and willing to develop an understanding of regulatory, policy and trade issues.
Able to work independently on defined responsibilities while knowing when to seek guidance.
Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with colleagues across Southeast Asia.
Proactive in following through on assigned work and keeping relevant colleagues informed.
Salary: S$3,500–S$4,500 per month, commensurate with qualifications, relevant experience, and demonstrated analytical skills.

Title: Marketing Events Executive

We are seeking an experienced, proactive, and adaptable Marketing EventsSpecialist to join our team. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role for someone who genuinely enjoys the operational side of events—from layout planning to on-site delivery. End-to-End Event Delivery: Plan, coordinate, and execute event operations from setup to teardown, ensuring all venue logistics, booth installations, equipment, and technical requirements are completed efficiently.
On-Site Troubleshooting: Act as the primary point of contact during events, identifying operational issues and implementing timely, practical solutions to ensure smooth event execution.
Manpower Coordination: Recruit, brief, and supervise on-site staff, ensuring all personnel understand their responsibilities, event schedules, and safety and security procedures.

Vendor & Stakeholder Coordination: Liaise with vendors, contractors, venue representatives, and relevant authorities to ensure timely delivery of services and compliance with operational and regulatory requirements.
3. Marketing & Event Support
Marketing Campaign Support: Assist in the execution of integrated marketing campaigns to promote events through both digital and offline channels, driving audience engagement and attendance.
Event Collateral Coordination: Coordinate the development, production, and distribution of event-related marketing materials, including digital content, email campaigns, presentation materials, and event documentation.
Administrative & Project Support: Provide administrative and operational support for marketing initiatives and contribute to ad hoc projects and departmental activities as required.
This version is suitable for an Event Executive, Marketing Executive (Events), or Event & Marketing Executive role and follows a more standard corporate JD format.

Excellent Communication & Coordination Skills: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams, vendors, contractors, and external stakeholders.

Organised, and solutions-focused in fast-paced environments, managing tight deadlines and unexpected situations with professionalism.
A collaborative and hands-on team player who is willing to support the team wherever needed to ensure successful event delivery.
Confident communicator with the ability to coordinate effectively with internal stakeholders, vendors, contractors, venue partners, and senior management.
Capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously, prioritising tasks, and meeting deadlines with strong attention to detail.

Title: Math Curriculum Specialist & Teacher (Primary) [Remote]
Description:
Remote role. Game-based Math lessons. You design the curriculum and teach it yourself.
To apply, please submit an application here: https://airtable.com/appytuR6ewIdKWEFA/pagJkcixPTRFBXrSE/form
Job Highlights
- Fully remote. Every class is taught live online, so you work from home.
- Game-based lessons. We use games, including our own Roblox games, to help children enjoy Math and remember it.
- You design and you teach. You write the P1 to P6 Math lessons, then teach them and see how they land.
- 12 to 16 hours of classes a week, with the rest of your week set aside for curriculum work.
- Modern tools. We use AI to speed up drafting and checking materials, and we will show you how.
About the Role
Ottodot helps children learn Math and Science through live online classes and game-based learning. Our Primary programme is aligned to the Singapore MOE syllabus.
We are hiring a Math Curriculum Specialist & Teacher (Primary) to design our P1 to P6 Math lessons and teach them. The lessons you write are the lessons you teach, so you see every week what works and what needs fixing.
Teaching Responsibilities
- Teach 12 to 16 hours a week of live online Math classes, in groups of up to 4 students.
- Use student work, test results, and feedback to decide what to reteach and who needs extra help.
- Cover a class when another teacher is unavailable. Relief counts toward your monthly hours.
Curriculum Responsibilities
- Write P1 to P6 Math materials: slides, lesson plans, questions, homework, and post-tests.
- Review student results and decide where to focus next.
- Match every lesson to the MOE syllabus and PSLE standards, pitched at the right level.
- Keep the content correct, with full step-by-step working, and fix errors quickly when they are found.
- Work with our game team so the games in class reinforce what each lesson teaches.
Requirements
- Bachelor's degree in any discipline. Mathematics, Science, Engineering, or Education is a plus.
- At least 2 years of experience teaching primary students (school, tuition, or online) or writing primary Math lessons and assessments.
- Well-versed in the Singapore MOE primary Math syllabus and PSLE requirements, including the model method and common PSLE question types.
- Comfortable using AI tools, or willing to learn.
- You remember or understand what it feels like to be a child who is stuck.
- Strong spoken and written English.
Work Schedule
- Employment: full-time, 3-month probation.
- Location: Remote. You need a quiet space and a stable internet connection.
- Core hours: Monday to Friday, 10am to 6pm (GMT+8).
- Curriculum work: at least 3 days a week, agreed together, within core hours.
- Teaching: 12 to 16 hours a week, counted monthly so busy and quiet weeks balance out.
- Class times: weekdays 4pm to 8:30pm and weekend daytime. You pick your slots from our schedule each term.
About Ottodot
Ottodot is a Singapore-based online learning company trusted by over 4,300 parents. We run weekly live online Math and Science classes for P1 to P6, in groups of up to 4 students, aligned to the Singapore MOE syllabus and PSLE question types. Our lessons are built around 200+ concept-aligned games on Roblox, and parents rate us 4.6 out of 5. Our students have reported gains of 20 marks or more, including 2 AL bands at PSLE.
Why Ottodot
- You see your work land. You write a lesson, teach it, and know by the end of the week whether it worked.
- Fun that still builds mastery. We put games at the centre and make sure homework and feedback point the same way.
- Real ownership. You are responsible for the quality and results of our Math curriculum, not just a stack of worksheets.
- Work from home, with clear core hours and a class schedule you can plan around.

Title: Math Tutor (Junior College)
Description:
The Sequoia Vision is looking for a passionate and academically strong
JC Mathematics Tutor / Mathematics Specialist
to join our teaching team.
We are looking for educators who enjoy teaching Mathematics, are confident with the
Singapore A-Level Mathematics syllabus and
are able to break down challenging concepts into clear, structured explanations that students can understand and apply.
Whether you are an experienced JC tutor, former/current MOE educator, or a strong Mathematics graduate looking to build a long-term career in education, we welcome you to explore this opportunity with us.
Team Culture
We believe good educators grow best in an environment where people can learn from one another, exchange ideas and continuously improve their craft.
Real Connections:
We value open and honest communication. Ideas, teaching strategies and constructive feedback are encouraged.
Team Support:
You will work alongside fellow educators who share resources, teaching insights and feedback to help one another improve.
Focus on Teaching:
We want our educators to spend their energy on helping students learn, rather than being weighed down by unnecessary administrative work.
Continuous Improvement:
We believe even experienced teachers can continue developing their teaching methodology, classroom delivery and ability to engage different types of learners.
Impact on Students:
Our goal goes beyond helping students complete questions—we want them to understand Mathematics, become stronger problem-solvers and gain confidence in the subject.
Key Responsibilities
As a
JC Mathematics Tutor / Mathematics Specialist
, you will:
Teach
JC H1 and/or H2 Mathematics
in accordance with the Singapore MOE A-Level syllabus.
Deliver clear, structured and engaging lessons that help students understand complex mathematical concepts.
Guide students in developing strong problem-solving techniques and effective approaches to A-Level examination questions.
Identify students' learning gaps and provide targeted guidance to strengthen weaker areas.
Help students connect mathematical concepts across different topics instead of relying solely on memorised procedures.
Prepare, review and/or improve lesson materials, worksheets, revision resources and assessment questions.
Analyse students' work and common misconceptions to improve teaching effectiveness.
Monitor students' academic progress and provide appropriate feedback and intervention where necessary.
Participate in lesson observations, peer sharing, internal training and professional development.
Collaborate with other Mathematics educators on curriculum development, teaching strategies and educational projects.
Who We're Looking For
We are looking for someone who:
Has a
strong command of JC / A-Level Mathematics
.
Is confident in explaining challenging mathematical concepts in a simple and logical manner.
Enjoys working with teenagers and understands that students learn at different speeds and ability levels.
Is patient, engaging and able to build students' confidence in Mathematics.
Is receptive to coaching, lesson feedback and continuous professional development.
Is reliable, responsible and able to work collaboratively within a teaching team.
Is interested in developing a
long-term career in education and Mathematics teaching
.
Qualifications
Candidates should preferably meet one or more of the following:
Bachelor's Degree in
Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, Physics
, or another highly quantitative discipline from a recognised university.
Strong academic results in
A-Level H2 Mathematics or equivalent
.
Prior experience teaching
JC H1/H2 Mathematics
in an MOE school, tuition centre or private tuition setting is highly advantageous.
Fresh university graduates with excellent Mathematics fundamentals and strong communication skills are also welcome to apply.
Candidates will be required to demonstrate sufficient Mathematics content competency as part of the selection process.
Training & Career Development
For candidates joining our full-time teaching team, we provide structured training and development, which may include:
Observation of experienced educators.
Training in our teaching methodology and lesson delivery approach.
Lesson practice and teaching feedback.
Curriculum and resource familiarisation.
Classroom management and student engagement techniques.
Progressive assignment of classes based on teaching readiness.
Experienced educators may progress more quickly through the training pathway based on demonstrated teaching competency and performance.
Career progression opportunities are available towards roles such as:
Mathematics Specialist → Senior Mathematics Specialist → Master / Lead Mathematics Specialist
Progression is based on teaching competency, contribution, performance and demonstrated ability.
Working Arrangement
Full-Time and Part-Time opportunities are available.
As our students attend lessons primarily outside regular school hours, candidates should be comfortable with a teaching schedule of 4 weekdays and 1 weekend or 3 weekdays and 2 weekends.
Specific working arrangements will be discussed according to the position applied for.

Title: MISSION SECRETARY- PEACE AND DEVELOPMENT
Description:
1. ABOUT THIS ROLE
The “Peacebuilding and Community Development” is one of the six primary areas of the Council for World Mission’s (CWM) Programmatic Structure. This programmatic area aims to help CWM member churches in achieving the vision of creating life-flourishing communities that co-exist in peace and harmony and grow in solidarity with one another. The
“Mission Secretary for Peace and Development”
will assist CWM in developing proposals and strategies for guiding member churches to engage in peace pedagogy and advocacy, conflict resolutions, and achieve life-flourishing growth by transforming community development.
Directly reporting to the Deputy General Secretary-Programmes (DGS-Programmes), the successful incumbent will be expected to relocate to the headquarters of the CWM in Singapore for a contract period of four years which can be renewed to another term. The candidate will work in partnership with member churches, ecumenical partners, and peoples’ movements in promoting peace and community development while also taking the responsibility of a particular region the person represents.
2. KEY ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
2.1. GLOBAL
2.1.1. Having full responsibility on planning, budgeting, coordinating, implementing, and evaluating the programmes or projects on peace and community development programmes across the member churches.
2.1.2. Engaging with member churches and assisting them in developing medium and long-term mission programmes towards building peace and conflict resolution.
2.1.3. Working in collaboration with the member churches in advocating for life-flourishing growth through community development programmes and promoting solidarity.
2.1.4. Engaging and facilitating the member churches and ecumenical partners to discern and identify the contemporary challenges that disrupt peace in various contexts and assist them in finding conflict resolutions and reconciliation.
2.1.5. As part of the management team, assisting the CWM for public witness and diakonia in peace building through effective relations with wider economical communities and people’s movements.
2.1.6. Plan and organise ecumenical consultations, implement strategic responses, draft and release appropriate statements on the issues of peace and community development.
2.1.7. Helping CWM in providing the member churches with necessary Solidarity and Action Grants and missional accompaniment during the challenging times.
2.1.8. Helping the CWM and its member churches and theological institutions to promote Christian education on peace and development to discern and foster communities of that flourish with peace.
2.1.9. Enabling the CWM’s work on peace and development in the context of international affairs and building a network of member churches, ecumenical organizations and local communities to respond to the challenges that hinder peace.
2.2. REGIONAL
2.2.1. Support and facilitate the member churches in the pursuit of their mission and coordinate shared mission activities of the churches in the region.
2.2.2. Implement CWM’s global strategic objectives within the context of the region.
2.2.3. Assist the member churches in transforming themselves as life flourishing communities.
2.3. ORGANISATIONAL
2.3.1. Work in collaboration with the other CWM staff in relevant programmatic areas and maintain clear and open lines of communication.
2.3.2. Work in collaboration with the finance office to prepare, monitor and manage an annual budget for the programme within the agreed guidelines.
2.3.3. Maintain proper documentation, prepare necessary reports and present to the administrative bodies when needed.
2.3.4. Ability to integrate Planning, Monitoring, Evaluation, and Reporting (PMER) system, and work constantly with a result-oriented approach.
2.3.5. Ability to be part of the Management Team to make programmatic decisions and to provide executive level leadership to the CWM office.
3. QUALIFICATIONSAND SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS
3.1. EXPERIENCE
3.1.1. Over five years of experience in working in faith-based organizations and churches in the areas of peace and development with a clear understanding on global and regional issues that hinder peace.
3.2. EDUCATION
3.2.1. Post Graduate(PG) degree (Masters or Equivariant) in the relevant area. A PhD will be an added advantage.
3.3. COMPETENCIES
3.3.1. Proficiency in English language to effectively communicate through verbal, written and digital communication tools.
3.3.2. Ability to work in a team with mutual respect, commitment to diversity and inclusivity, and quality of discretion in handling confidential and sensitive information.
3.3.3. Understanding on CWM’s model of working in partnership with member churches and ecumenical organizations.
3.3.4. Knowledge on CWM’s Strategy Framework for the decade, 2022-2029 and the ability to translate the strategy framework into programmes.
3.3.5. Ability to cope with working schedules, required travels, and maintaining communications.
3.3.6. High level of computer skills to adapt to hybrid workstyle, and maintain digital communications.

Responsibilities
Our Business Integrity team has a strong user focus and a dedication to technical excellence. We aim to meet our users’ needs with reliable and high-performing platforms and services. We are seeking a Model Optimization Specialist to join our dynamic team. You will be responsible for designing and optimizing workflows that improve machine model performance in content moderation — training models to make accurate policy application, rejection, and leakage judgements while maintaining low False Decision Rates (FDR) and improving machine coverage. You will work at the intersection of policy, data, and AI to drive measurable quality outcomes across ad content review systems. Responsibilities - Model Quality & Workflow Design: Design, manage, and optimize end-to-end workflows to improve machine model performance in content policy enforcement — including signal detection, rejection accuracy, and leakage reduction. Develop training data pipelines, QA processes, and performance tracking systems aligned to model improvement goals. - Adversarial Testing & Risk Identification: Conduct structured adversarial testing on AI models, features, and content policies to surface vulnerabilities, edge cases, and emerging risk trends. Explore model behaviour across contexts and user journeys to identify failure modes not captured in standard evaluations. - Root Cause Analysis & Error Optimization: Conduct structured root cause analysis (RCA) on model errors — including overkills, leakages, and misclassification — and translate findings into actionable model improvement recommendations. Partner with Algo and product teams to close root causes through memory insertion, threshold adjustments, rewrite rules, or policy iteration. - Data Analysis & Reporting: Analyze model training and operational performance data to generate actionable insights through reports and presentations. Use data to surface trends, support business decisions, and inform future model training directions or policy adjustments. - Cross-Functional Stakeholder Partnership: Partner with policy, product, business, and operations teams to validate mitigation strategies, align on quality metrics, and ensure root cause closure. Communicate quality insights, risk trends, and model performance updates clearly to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders. - Guidelines & Knowledge Management : Develop and maintain technical guidelines, SOPs, and casebooks to ensure consistent, high-quality decision-making across QA and annotation workflows. Drive alignment between policy intent and operational execution.
Qualifications
Minimum Qualification(s) - Minimum 1 year of experience in Quality Audit, Quality Governance, or Content Moderation Policy & SOP management. - Prior experience with AI/ML model quality assessment, data annotation, or model evaluation (LLM/VLM preferred). - Strong data sensitivity and analytical skills — able to identify patterns, surface trends, and present findings with clear, actionable data evidence to support business decisions. - Ability to design structured workflows and translate qualitative policy requirements into machine-actionable signals that drive measurable model improvement. - Proficiency in data and productivity tools (Excel, Lark Base/Bitable, or equivalent); comfortable working with dashboards, reports, and performance tracking systems. - Excellent written and verbal communication in English. Genuine curiosity in AI, large language models, and human-AI collaboration — willing to learn, explore, and stay ahead of emerging model behaviours and risks. - Comfortable balancing independent judgment with cross-functional collaboration in a fast-paced environment, with a strong ownership mentality and ability to manage multiple projects to closure. Preferred Qualification(s) - Prior exposure to content risk, trust & safety, or ads integrity workflows.

We are looking for an experienced and hands-on operations leader to lead our telemedicine operations and medication fulfilment teams. The role may be appointed at Assistant Manager or Manager level, depending on the candidate's experience, demonstrated scope of leadership and ability to manage complex operational outcomes.
At Assistant Manager level, the role will focus on daily execution, team supervision and implementation of established workforce, quality and performance plans, with broader decisions escalated to the Head of Telemedicine. At Manager level, the role will carry full accountability for the unit's operational performance, workforce, controllable costs, risk management, vendor performance and improvement agenda.

Monitor demand, work queues and service disruptions, deploy resources where they are needed and lead operational recovery when issues arise.

Investigate operational incidents, errors and complaints, identify root causes and complete corrective actions.
Monitor and improve service levels covering staffing, turnaround, fulfilment readiness, accuracy, productivity, escalations and inventory.
Manage controllable costs, inventory and courier or vendor performance within delegated authority, report material variances and recommend corrective action.
Coordinate and resolve non-clinical escalations, ensure timely action and identify recurring causes of service failure to prevent repeat issues.

A relevant diploma or degree, or equivalent experience, with a practical understanding of healthcare operations, patient-data protection and medication-fulfilment processes.

1. Process Review and Optimisation:
a. Analyse existing operational processes to identify bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and areas for improvement.
b. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement streamlined processes that enhance productivity and reduce operational costs.
c. Continuously monitor and measure the effectiveness of implemented process improvements, making necessary adjustments as needed.
2. Automation and Technology Integration:
a. Identify opportunities for automation and technology integration across various operational functions.
b. Work closely with the IT and technology teams to develop and implement automated solutions that enhance efficiency and accuracy.
c. Champion the adoption of new tools and technologies to streamline operations and improve decision-making.
3. Team Management and Leadership
a. Lead and manage a team of operations professionals, providing mentorship, guidance, and performance feedback.
b. Foster a collaborative and positive team environment that encourages innovation and continuous learning.
c. Delegate tasks and responsibilities effectively to ensure optimal team performance and project outcomes.
4. Product Management
a. Collaborate with the product development team to understand product features, functionalities, and user requirements.
b. Contribute insights from an operations perspective to influence product design and development, ensuring seamless implementation and user satisfaction.
c. Assist in defining product roadmaps, release schedules, and feature prioritisation based on operational considerations.

Demonstrate leadership abilities either through academic, extracurricular, or work experiences.
Demonstrate willingness to learn, embrace change, adapt, and thrive in a dynamic environment.
Ability to generate creative solutions proactively, think beyond conventional boundaries, and actively drive positive change.
Ability to contribute to a positive work culture, foster collaboration and build trust among team members.

Opportunities to engage in a mix of formal and informal training, keeping your skills sharp in our ever-evolving technological landscape.
Promotion opportunities based on your capability and on-the-job performance.
A vibrant community of like-minded and friendly colleagues, where collaboration and creativity thrive.
A hybrid work model that offers flexibility for remote work, subject to exigencies of service.

A comprehensive rewards package that includes annual leave, pro-family leave, medical and dental benefits, and access to recreational activities.

Title: Originator (Assets)
Description:
Your Role In Our Story
We are seeking candidate to grow ACT’s renewable energy asset portfolio across APAC. The primary focus of the role is to identify and engage renewable energy asset owners, onboard their facilities for registration with relevant renewable energy certificate (REC) registries through ACT, and propose commercial arrangements for ACT to manage and optimise the RECs generated by these assets.
The role requires a combination of business development, relationship management, commercial negotiation, and project coordination. The successful candidate will actively originate new opportunities through market mapping, cold outreach, industry networks, and direct engagement with renewable energy asset owners and developers.
Key Responsibilities
Renewable Asset Origination & Business Development
Identify, prospect, and engage renewable energy asset owners, project developers, power generation companies, utilities, and other relevant stakeholders across APAC to build a strong pipeline of renewable assets.
Conduct proactive business development activities, including cold calling, direct outreach, industry networking, client meetings, and presentations to renewable energy facility owners.
Educate asset owners on REC registration, issuance, market opportunities, and ACT’s capabilities in managing and monetizing their environmental attributes.
Continuously develop and implement strategies to improve ACT’s access to renewable asset owners and expand the portfolio of renewable assets under management.
Commercial Structuring & Negotiation
Identify opportunities for REC sales and develop commercial solutions that help renewable asset owners maximize the value of their renewable energy portfolios.
Commercial discussions and negotiations with asset owners, including proposing pricing and commercial structures, negotiating terms, and finalizing REC management and/or offtake agreements in accordance with ACT’s internal guidelines.
Develop sourcing strategies that balance competitiveness for asset owners with ACT’s commercial and margin objectives.
Asset Registration & Portfolio Management
Work closely with renewable asset owners and ACT’s Operations team to facilitate timely registration of renewable energy facilities with the relevant registries and support subsequent REC issuance.
Coordinate the collection of required documentation and information from asset owners, ensuring complete and timely submission to Operations and relevant registries.
Maintain visibility over the asset onboarding and registration pipeline, proactively addressing issues that may delay registration or REC issuance.
Monitor the performance and expected REC generation of the renewable asset portfolio and provide relevant updates to commercial and trading teams.
Market & Trading Collaboration
Work closely with ACT’s trading and other front-office teams to understand REC demand, pricing dynamics, buyer requirements, and emerging market opportunities.
Use market intelligence to prioritize origination efforts toward countries, technologies, asset types, and REC products where buyer demand and commercial opportunities are strongest.
Collaborate with trading teams to develop optimal solutions for managing and monetizing sourced RECs and matching renewable asset supply with end-buyer demand.
Provide market feedback from asset owners to support ACT’s broader REC trading and commercial strategy.
Market Intelligence & Strategy
Stay abreast of developments in APAC renewable energy certificate markets, including changes in regulations, registry requirements, green electricity markets, corporate renewable energy procurement, and relevant carbon and environmental markets.
Monitor regulatory and market developments that may create new sourcing opportunities or affect the eligibility and value of renewable energy assets and RECs.
Formulate and execute market-entry and sourcing strategies to expand ACT’s renewable asset portfolio and maximize the commercial value and profitability of REC origination activities.
Your Expertise
To be successful in this role, we are looking for candidates with the following qualifications and attributes
Fluent in English and any SEA language is a plus
Bachelor’s/master's degree, preferably in Energy, Environmental, Electricity, Business and/or other similar fields
2 years experience in the power sector, ESG, particularly in solar project development or EPC sales.
Relevant experience in business development, renewable energy, environmental commodities, power markets, project development, or related sectors.
Existing relationships or experience working with renewable energy asset owners, project developers, utilities, power generation companies, or grid-related organizations in APAC is highly desirable.
Strong business development capabilities, including prospecting, cold outreach, relationship building, client presentations, and pipeline development.
Strong commercial acumen with experience in negotiating agreements and developing commercial or offtake structures.
Ability to understand renewable energy and REC market dynamics and translate market information to support actionable origination strategies.
Strong stakeholder-management skills and the ability to work effectively across commercial, trading, and operational teams.
Self-driven and comfortable developing new markets and relationships from the ground up.
Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
Ability to work across multiple APAC markets and cultures.
If you meet these criteria and are ready to contribute your expertise to a dynamic and challenging environment, we encourage you to appl
The leading global provider of market-based sustainability solutions.
We help organizations achieve their climate action goals, no matter how ambitious. Since our founding in 2009, we have become a reliable partner for high-impact climate projects that generate carbon credits, energy efficiency projects and certificates, and experts in renewable electricity and gas markets, renewable fuels, and emission allowances. Our Amsterdam, New York, Paris, Shanghai, and Singapore teams deliver tailor-made solutions backed by extensive market knowledge. Since the beginning of the energy transition, we have been early adopters, constantly finding new products and participating in new markets. This has given us the knowledge to serve our clients better. In shaping environmental markets, ACT enables organizations to pursue sustainable futures.

Description:
*Job Summary*
We are looking for a reliable, organised and proactive *Part-Time Administrative & Client Servicing Assistant* to support a Financial Consultant with day-to-day client servicing, administrative work, appointment coordination, events, marketing activities and business operations.
This is a varied role suited to someone who enjoys organising information, communicating with clients, following up on outstanding matters and ensuring that tasks are completed properly from start to finish.
You will work closely with the Financial Consultant and assist with both routine administrative duties and ongoing projects. The role requires good attention to detail, initiative and the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines independently.
*Key Responsibilities*
*1. Client Servicing & Appointment Management*
* Contact clients through phone, WhatsApp and email for appointment scheduling, reminders and follow-ups.
* Confirm, reschedule and track client appointments and maintain the consultant's calendar.
* Follow up with clients on outstanding forms, documents, payments and administrative matters.
* Assist with policy review appointment outreach and maintain records of previous and upcoming client meetings.
* Maintain client databases, contact information, birthdays, client categories, review dates and engagement history.
* Track client responses and ensure outstanding matters are followed through to completion.
*2. Insurance, Policy & Claims Administration*
* Provide administrative support for policy servicing, claims and general insurance matters.
* Follow up with relevant departments regarding claim status, policy documents and outstanding requirements.
* Assist clients in gathering required documents for claims and policy servicing.
* Maintain claims trackers and monitor ongoing cases until completion.
* Organise policy certificates, insurance documents, settlement letters and related records.
* Update internal insurance and commission tracking spreadsheets and maintain proper filing in Google Drive.
* Create and maintain reminders for policy renewals and outstanding client matters.
*3. Database, Campaign & Reporting Support*
* Maintain and update client listings, lead databases and internal spreadsheets.
* Perform data entry and update campaign information in internal systems.
* Track leads, appointments, client status, event attendance and other business activity.
* Assist with year-end and periodic reporting, including appointment statistics, client movements, claims status and campaign performance.
* Maintain organised and accurate digital records.

About The Team
Klaviyo’s Partnerships team drives durable growth through an ecosystem of agencies, systems integrators, consultants, MSPs, OSPs, and other strategic services partners. We work closely with partners to create demand, unlock new revenue, improve customer outcomes, and bring the full value of Klaviyo to market.
Our best Partner Managers are commercial, partner-first, and highly collaborative. They turn strong executive relationships into measurable business outcomes through joint go-to-market planning, co-sell execution, partner recruitment, partner enablement, and strategic account development.
About The Role
This is a senior, execution-focused strategic partnerships role supporting Klaviyo’s Mid/Large Enterprise motion across Asia. The role will help build and scale high-impact relationships with global and regional strategic partners, including Accenture, WPP, Hakuhodo, and Dentsu, while developing a broader partner ecosystem across Southeast Asia, Japan, Greater China, and South Korea.
Reporting to the APAC Partnerships Leader, you will identify, recruit, and grow strategic partnerships from the ground up. You will navigate complex, multi-threaded stakeholder environments and translate partner engagement into measurable pipeline, revenue, customer outcomes, and market expansion.
A key part of the role is building Klaviyo’s presence with partners that have strong enterprise reach, delivery capability, and influence across the target markets. Experience working with MSP and OSP models will be beneficial as we creatively explore how these partners can help bring Klaviyo’s next generation of AI-forward product capabilities to market.
You will articulate and differentiate Klaviyo in the market, drive business development and co-sell opportunities, and shape services-led go-to-market plays that help partners grow their Klaviyo practice and profitability. You will also work closely with Partner Marketing, Sales, Product, Customer Success, and regional leadership to bring Klaviyo’s broader platform story to market, including our B2C CRM, AI-powered capabilities, and service offerings.
Strong martech experience is preferred but not required. More important is the ability to understand complex customer and partner environments, build credibility with senior stakeholders, and turn strategic relationships into repeatable commercial outcomes.
Focus markets
- Southeast Asia (SEA)
- Japan
- Greater China (GCR)
- South Korea
How You’ll Make An Impact
- Lead the development and execution of Klaviyo’s strategic partnerships strategy across SEA, Japan, GCR, and South Korea.
- Identify, recruit, and build high-impact partnerships with global and regional GSIs, SIs, agency holding companies, MSPs, OSPs, and other strategic services providers.
- Develop and deepen relationships with priority partners such as Accenture, WPP, Hakuhodo, and Dentsu.
- Build joint business plans that align partner priorities, Klaviyo’s growth objectives, target accounts, routes to market, and measurable revenue outcomes.
- Create repeatable co-sell and partner-led motions across enterprise and upper mid-market accounts.
- Own and grow a focused portfolio of strategic partners, with accountability for partner-sourced pipeline, partner-influenced revenue, activation, and market coverage.
- Establish executive relationships across partner leadership, alliance teams, sales organisations, delivery teams, and relevant country or market leads.
- Develop multi-partner plays that combine Klaviyo with GSIs, SIs, MSPs, OSPs, technology partners, and adjacent ecosystem partners to deliver differentiated customer value.
- Partner closely with Sales to identify whitespace, map strategic accounts, create executive alignment, and accelerate complex opportunities.
- Shape services-led and transformation-driven go-to-market plays that help partners build, scale, and monetise their Klaviyo practices.
- Collaborate with Partner Marketing on regional campaigns, executive programs, events, and partner-led demand generation.
- Work with Product, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Enablement to remove barriers to partner activation and customer adoption.
- Bring Klaviyo’s broader platform story to partners and customers, including martech, AI, data, and service use cases.
- Drive regular business reviews with strategic partners, using data and insight to improve performance, accountability, and long-term impact.
- Travel across Asia, up to 25%, to meet partners, support field engagement, and attend strategic events.
Who You Are
- You have 8+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, alliances, business development, enterprise sales, channel, or a related SaaS go-to-market role.
- You have experience building and scaling high-value relationships with GSIs, SIs, agency holding companies, MSPs, OSPs, or broader services partners.
- You have direct experience with partner recruitment, ideally taking partnerships from zero to one and creating the structure, momentum, and commercial case for growth.
- You understand MSP and OSP operating models and how these partners influence technology decisions, customer relationships, implementation, and ongoing services.
- You have a track record of driving partner-sourced, partner-influenced, or direct revenue outcomes against clear targets.
- You are comfortable engaging senior executives across organisations such as Accenture, WPP, Hakuhodo, Dentsu, and comparable strategic partners.
- You have experience working across multiple Asian markets and can adapt your approach to different business cultures, buying processes, and partner ecosystems.
- You have a strong commercial mindset and know how to turn partner activity into pipeline, revenue, and strategic growth.
- You are comfortable managing complex, multi-threaded relationships across external partners and internal cross-functional teams.
- You have a strong understanding of SaaS sales motions, enterprise deal cycles, co-sell dynamics, and services-led growth.
- You have experience building and executing joint go-to-market plans across co-sell, co-marketing, partner enablement, strategic accounts, and partner-led demand generation.
- You are credible with executive stakeholders and confident leading solution, value, and business discussions with partners and customers.
- You have strong strategic judgement, balanced with the ability to execute hands-on and maintain momentum.
- You have a challenger mindset and are comfortable bringing a clear point of view, asking hard questions, and pushing toward better outcomes.
- You are highly collaborative, operate well independently, set priorities effectively, and drive outcomes in a fast-moving environment.
- Strong martech experience is preferred but not required; experience in adjacent SaaS, CRM, data, commerce, or digital transformation ecosystems is also relevant.
- You are AI fluent and use AI responsibly in your day-to-day work to improve productivity, sharpen thinking, and model new ways of working for partners and internal teams.

Title: Partner Development Manager
Description:
Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
About The Team
What you’ll do
We are hiring a Global Partnerships Lead based in Singapore to own Stripe’s Global Partnerships strategy and execution across SE Asia.
As the regional Global Partnerships Lead, you will own Stripe’s most important in-market relationships across local payment methods, financial partners, card networks, banks, and expansion partners. You will set the partnership strategy for the region; identify, prioritize, and develop new opportunities; lead complex negotiations; and ensure partnerships deliver durable commercial, product, and expansion outcomes for Stripe and our users.
This is a leadership role at the intersection of product strategy, market expansion, and commercial execution. You will serve as Stripe’s senior partnership representative for the region, build trusted executive relationships with ecosystem partners, and lead alignment across Product, Engineering, Go-to-Market, Legal, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Treasury, and Operations.
Responsibilities
- Act as Stripe’s Global Partnerships Lead for SE Asia Expansion, with end-to-end accountability for the regional partnership portfolio.
- Set and execute the regional strategy across local payment methods, financial partners, card networks, banks, and expansion partners.
- Lead Stripe’s senior external relationships in the region, building alignment and representing Stripe’s strategic priorities with partners.
- Own partnership opportunities from market assessment and strategy through negotiation, contracting, onboarding, launch, governance, and performance management.
- Lead regional expansion-partnership strategy and execution, coordinating the partnerships required to establish, operate, and scale Stripe in-market.
- Translate market intelligence, partner priorities, and ecosystem developments into clear recommendations for Stripe’s product and business strategy.
- Drive cross-functional decision-making on commercial, product, operational, regulatory, and technical dependencies related to regional partnerships.
- Establish and manage partner-performance metrics, including commercial outcomes, product adoption, operational health, and strategic progress.
- Anticipate and manage partnership risks, escalations, and trade-offs, ensuring sustained executive alignment internally and externally.
Who you are
We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
Minimum Requirements
- 10+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, corporate development, strategy, financial services, or a related field.
- Significant experience in payments, fintech, e-commerce, banking, card networks, local payment methods, or adjacent financial-services sectors.
- Demonstrated experience leading complex, strategic commercial negotiations with senior external stakeholders.
- Deep knowledge of the payments and financial-partnership landscape in SE Asia, including relevant market dynamics and business models.
- Excellent written, verbal, and English executive communication skills.
- Strong ability to develop a clear point of view amid ambiguity, influence without authority, and drive decisions across complex internal and external stakeholder groups.
- Experience working closely with product and engineering organizations on partnerships with meaningful technical, operational, and regulatory dependencies.
- Ability to operate autonomously while balancing multiple high-priority initiatives and long-term strategic relationships.
Preferred Qualifications
- Experience owning a regional or multi-market portfolio of payments or financial-infrastructure partnerships.
- Experience supporting market-entry, expansion, licensing, or ecosystem-development initiatives.
- Existing senior relationships across banks, networks, payment-method providers, fintechs, or other relevant ecosystem partners in the region.
- Experience working in a fast-paced, global technology company with cross-functional product, commercial, and regulatory stakeholders.
In-office expectations
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
Pay and benefits
The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is SGD 253,800 - SGD 380,800. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.
Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.
We look forward to hearing from you.
At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
Apply now

Leads long-range strategic vision for high-impact, multi-model complex partners across segments. Builds trusted-advisor relationships with C-suite partner leaders, aligns partner priorities with Microsoft strategy, identifies market opportunities, leads business-design briefings, coaches partners on consumption and growth targets, drives GTM/co-selling strategies, supports partner readiness, and resolves complex partner escalations.

Title: Partner Sales Manager
Description:
Your role at Dynatrace
This role is open to candidates based either in Jakarta, Indonesia or Singapore, with the successful candidate supporting their local market. Please note that we are only able to consider citizens and Permanent Residents (PR) of these respective locations, and relocation assistance is not available.
As a Partner Sales Manager, you will be responsible to recruit, develop and manage partner business in a defined geographic region focused on generating incremental, distributed software license and service-related revenue. Within the defined sales region, efforts are focused solely on Dynatrace’s Software Intelligence platform for the Enterprise Cloud.
Responsibilities also include generating interest in the Dynatrace platform by leveraging the partner ecosystem. For both regional and national partners, the objective is to develop strategic relationships through the creation of joint business initiatives and offerings that leverage Dynatrace as a fundamental component of the partner’s business. Partner Managers jointly develop sales strategies with their partners and implement those initiatives by working with local sales teams. Partner Managers are required to travel selectively to meet with partners and sales teams to gain commitment to launch an initiative and ensure successful execution of the established programs.
Responsibilities
- Understand the Partners’ business and align Dynatrace solutions to develop compelling ‘go to market’ propositions
- Qualify new Partners and demonstrate ability to effectively communicate the value of the Dynatrace platform to both C-level’ business leaders and ‘technical’ staff members
- Develop Partners to become self-sufficient in the marketing of the jointly developed solutions
- Develop and build similar sales strategies with all assigned partners in region
- Communicate in region partner activities to other Dynatrace Partner managers so they can leverage that on the jointly developed partner initiatives in their regions
- Manage, Track and Report highest priority action items, results, business plan development, marketing-related successes and accurate partner forecasts, sales
- Perform as an evangelist to drive Dynatrace solutions
- Collaborate with the region sales leadership team and successfully execute the region partner business plan
- Host quarterly business reviews with partners to drive accountability and report on success metrics
- Generate partner-sourced net-new sales pipeline and revenue
What Will Help You Succeed
- A minimum of 10 years experience in software sales, business development, channel/partner management
- A proven track record of overachievement against targets
- A track record of recruiting partners and generating new business revenues
- Solution development experience in a software as a service / cloud services environment
- Willingness to travel 25-50% of the time
- Proven experience in driving sales opportunities from lead generation to closure, effectively negotiating agreements and building long-lasting partnerships
- Managed Services, Digital Agency, and ISV ecosystem experience is a plus

- A track record of building qualified pipeline and progressing complex, multi-stakeholder sales opportunities.
- Strong relationship-building, discovery and communication skills, including the ability to engage business and technical stakeholders.
- An activator mindset: resourceful, proactive and comfortable turning relationships and ideas into concrete next steps.
- The ability to work independently while coordinating effectively across sales, consulting, delivery and partner teams.

What Success Looks Like
- Growth in qualified AWS partner-sourced and co-sell pipeline.
- Stronger AWS relationships that consistently generate customer opportunities.

Deep connections, better outcomes

Title: Partnership Manager, APAC
Description:
The Role
Apryse is scaling its go-to-market across Asia-Pacific, and we're looking for a Partner Manager, APAC to lead and grow our partner ecosystem in the region. We already work with a number of partners across APAC. Your first mandate will be to take stock of this existing partner base, assess where the real value lies, and shape it into a coherent strategy, while recruiting and onboarding new partners with an initial focus on Australia, New Zealand, and India. This is a senior individual contributor role with a rare opportunity to own a function end to end: from defining the partner programs and securing executive sponsorship, to enabling the right partners, to driving measurable pipeline and revenue alongside our sales teams.
You will be the connective tissue between external partners (systems integrators, consultancies, resellers, distributors, and technology/ISV partners) and internal stakeholders across sales, presales, marketing, and executive leadership. Success will require sourcing the right partners, but more importantly, matching each partner's skill set, network, and market presence to the right sales motions and the right parts of the Apryse product portfolio. You'll then work lockstep with our Account Executives in each territory to ensure partner-sourced opportunities convert beyond pipeline creation through to closed revenue.
Responsibilities
- Design and launch Apryse's APAC partner program from creation through execution: define the partner strategy, program structure, tiering, incentives, and operating model, and secure executive sponsorship and cross-functional buy-in.
- Audit and assess the existing partner base across the region: evaluate performance, capability, and fit, and make clear recommendations on where to invest, re-engage, or restructure as part of the overall partner strategy.
- Identify, recruit, and onboard new partners across the region, with initial priority markets of Australia, New Zealand, and India.
- Assess each partner's capabilities, vertical expertise, and customer network, and deliberately map them to the sales motions and product portfolio areas where they can create the most value.
- Build and execute partner enablement plans (training, certification, sales plays, and co-selling frameworks) so partners can confidently position and sell the Apryse portfolio.
- Act as the bridge between partners and Apryse Account Executives in each territory, establishing clear rules of engagement, joint account planning, and deal-level collaboration.
- Work hand in hand with sales reps throughout the deal cycle to ensure partner-sourced opportunities progress from pipeline to close, driving accountability on both sides of the partnership.
- Support and orchestrate partners across multiple sales motions, including new-logo acquisition (land) and account growth (expand).
- Develop joint business plans with strategic partners, including pipeline targets, co-marketing initiatives, and executive alignment cadences.
- Serve as the internal voice of the partner ecosystem: report on partner-sourced pipeline and revenue, surface market intelligence, and continuously refine the program based on results.
How Success Is Measured
- Pipeline generated through partners.
- Revenue closed through partners.
- MBOs tied to onboarding new partners in Australia, New Zealand, and India, and to partner enablement outcomes that support selling of the Apryse portfolio in collaboration with territory sales teams.
Requirements
- 10+ years of experience in B2B software, with at least 5 years in partner/channel management, alliances, or business development roles across APAC.
- Demonstrated success building a partner program from scratch (strategy, executive buy-in, launch, and execution), not just running an established one.
- Experience inheriting and rationalizing an existing partner portfolio: assessing partner performance and potential, and making decisive investment and prioritization calls.
- A proven track record of generating and converting partner-sourced pipeline into closed revenue, with quantifiable results.
- Deep familiarity with the APAC partner landscape across systems integrators, consultancies, resellers, distributors, and technology partners.
- Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills: able to earn trust with partner executives and internal leaders alike, and to align teams without direct authority.
- Strong commercial judgment and the maturity to navigate ambiguity, competing priorities, and direct sales cultures, including the ability to collaborate closely with quota-carrying reps and keep joint deals moving to close.
- Analytical approach to partner selection: able to evaluate a partner's strengths, coverage, and network, and match them to specific sales motions and product lines.
- Excellent communication and presentation skills, comfortable engaging C-level executives at partner organizations and internally.
- Professional working fluency in English.
- Willingness to travel across the region (Australia, New Zealand, India, and Southeast Asia) as needed.
Nice To Haves
- Established relationships with partners in Australia, New Zealand, and India.
- Experience selling or partnering around complex software products; familiarity with SDK/developer-focused or document technology solutions.
- Additional regional languages.
- Experience using CRM and PRM tools to manage partner pipeline and performance.
- A college or university degree, or equivalent experience.
Benefits
- Competitive salary commensurate with experience & qualifications.
- A comprehensive extended benefits package including health and dental for you and your family that starts from day one.
- A great team environment and resources, supporting you to do the best work of your life and providing unlimited career growth potential.
- Highly autonomous and entrepreneurial environment.
- Annual recurring WFH allowance for you to purchase items you need for your home office.
- On going support for learning development so you can master your craft.
- Diverse and inclusive workplace where we all learn from each other.
Company Description
As the industry-leading provider of document software development (SDK) technology powering everything from traditional desktop software to innovative web and mobile applications, at Apryse we are committed to delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that empower our clients to achieve their goals. With a broad international portfolio of combined companies, products, and leading technologies, we are actively changing the way the world works with documents to make work better and life simpler.
Customers like IBM, Autodesk, DocuSign, Boeing, Microsoft (and many more!) come to us to realize their web and mobile strategies for document management, editing, and collaboration as the #1-ranked commercial document SDK of choice for companies worldwide. As a result, you can find our document technology in thousands of solutions, including those of household names, used by millions across virtually every industry. About the Company
🔹We are a high-growth Web3 payment infrastructure company redefining how users and businesses interact with stablecoins and digital assets.
🔹Backed by licensed financial institutions, and trusted by leading Web3 partners, we provide crypto-fiat payment rails, card-issuing infrastructure, and CaaS (Cards-as-a-Service) solutions for exchanges, wallets, protocols, and global fintech innovators.
🔹Our team comes from top global exchanges, tier-one tech companies, and leading fintechs across APAC and Europe — bringing deep expertise, a builder mindset, and a shared passion for shaping the future of compliant, scalable financial infrastructure.
About the Role
Are you a strategic dealmaker who thrives at the intersection of fintech ecosystem plays and commercial lending? We are seeking a high-caliber Senior Partnerships Manager / Director to spearhead the growth of our Cards and Loans businesses in Singapore. This is a balanced, dual-engine growth role across two strategic pillars:
- B2B2C Ecosystems: Accelerating consumer card acquisition share through top-tier brand alliances, loyalty networks, and co-marketing programs and strategic partners.
- B2B Commercial Cards & Funding: Driving corporate cards & loan volumes by establishing strong referral networks and originations within the SME sector.
Positioned at a Senior Manager or Director level depending on your profile, this role offers the autonomy, commercial scope, and platform to scale complex alliances in the Singapore market.
Key Responsibilities
B2B2C Ecosystem & Card Alliances :
- Strategic Alliances: Identify, negotiate, and secure high-value brand and platform partnerships to accelerate new cardholder acquisition.
- Vertical Penetration: Lock in flagship partners across E-commerce, Travel, Lifestyle, Retail, Hospitality, Education, and SME networks.
- Co-Marketing Innovation: Co-design high-impact customer rewards, loyalty programs, and joint acquisition campaigns with corporate partners.
- Commercial Structuring: Formulate win-win business models, revenue-share frameworks, and legally sound partnership agreements.

- Intermediary Networks: Cultivate a robust referral ecosystem of mortgage brokers, accountants, and financial advisors.
- Deal Structuring: Evaluate corporate financial profiles and business needs to recommend optimal, tailored loan structures.
- End-to-End Execution: Lead clients through data collection, application submission, and risk assessment workflows to close deals.
Cross-Functional Leadership & Performance :
- Internal Collaboration: Align with Product, Risk, Compliance, and Tech teams to ensure seamless partner onboarding and regulatory adherence.
- P&L Ownership: Drive accountability for partner-led revenue, active card counts, spending volume, and loan disbursement targets.
- Data-Driven Reviews: Monitor customer acquisition costs (CAC) and deliver performance insights to executive leadership.
