Title: Partnerships Director, Visa Government Solutions, Asia Pacific
Description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
Job Description
Team Summary
Visa Government Solutions (VGS) leads the company efforts to build a business for public sector sales by working with issuer and acquiring banks and other ecosystem partners to solve complex public sector payments challenges that deliver economic, social, and efficiency benefits to individuals and businesses. You will be an integral part of the global VGS team. The role will be based in our Asia Pacific Market Support Centre in Singapore and report directly into the Go-to-Market and Commercialisation lead for VGS Asia Pacific.
What's exciting about joining the Visa Government Solutions team?
- You will partner with government technology providers, system integrators, fintechs, and development organisations to develop and deliver innovative and high impact payments solutions for the public sector.
- We’re a key part of Visa’s focus on new payment flows as a growth driver for our business.
- The nature of this sector reinforces Visa’s purpose-led brand values with social and economic impact.
What a Director of Partnerships for Government Solutions does at Visa:
Visa is seeking an experienced professional to develop and scale strategic commercial relationships for Visa Government Solutions with ecosystem enabler partners, including government technology providers (digital government platforms, system integrators, software solutions, fintechs), providers of specialist capabilities in sector / industry verticals, and humanitarian and development organisations.
Working closely with Visa’s various products and solutions teams, this role will scale enabler partnerships as a key route to market by combining Visa and partner capabilities to deliver innovative public sector solutions and accelerate commercial growth across Asia Pacific.
The Role Encompasses The Following Responsibilities
- Expand and execute our ecosystem partnership sales strategy in collaboration with in-market VGS Sales teams across the region and global VGS colleagues, creating a prioritized pipeline of partners, solutions and commercial opportunities.
- Identify public sector use cases and complementary joint solutions that can be built or scaled to unlock incremental revenue for Visa and ecosystem partners. This may include requirements for Visa solutions teams to incorporate into product and solutions roadmaps.
- Support VGS in-market sales leads to identify, structure and execute mutually beneficial local partnerships with commercial or strategic agreements that can lead to the growth of VGS business, and onboard suppliers accordingly.
- Own and manage partnerships with organisations that are either ready to scale or already operating across multiple Asia Pacific markets. Develop and execute sales strategies / account plans, contracting and onboarding as required with these strategic multi-market ecosystem partners to increase sales volume and market share.
- Support the development of RFP strategies and responses with strategic partners.
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders on partner outreach strategy, targets, and approach to educating influencers on how VGS can support the public sector.
- Develop and articulate compelling value propositions for internal and external audiences, positioning VGS as a leader in the payments industry for Governments and a resource for ecosystem partners.
- Proactively identify and resolve issues affecting partnership sales execution, while monitoring market developments and recommending new approaches to grow the VGS business.
- Stay updated on latest developments in the Govtech space, with a strategic focus on identifying new growth verticals.
Why This Is Important To Visa
This role is critical to building enabler partnerships that scale Visa Government Solutions across Asia Pacific markets. Governments play an important and increasing role in the lives of citizens and businesses. Government payments are a significant part of this, be it government making payments to suppliers or social payments in form of disbursements or accepting tax payments from citizens. In some instances, Governments are also leading the way in payments innovation, such as Government digital transformation, Central Bank Digital Currencies, stablecoins, AI, open data, and in dealing with the big challenges of our times (climate, sustainability). We are looking to partner with Governments around the world as they drive ambitious plans for economic growth, social impact and digitalization, and our ecosystem partners are an important part of how we can elevate payments innovation.
This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.
Qualifications
What you will need:
- 12+ years’ experience working in, or with, organisations that provide technology, infrastructure or other specialist capabilities to governments, ideally with additional payments expertise.
- Track record and proven ability to drive commercial outcomes and grow a business through strategic partnerships.
- Robust understanding of how public sector sales and public agencies operate with expertise in navigating government agencies and procedures, including government procurement.
- Experience structuring partnership deals, with the technical fluency to lead discussions with ecosystem partners and to articulate value propositions across a broad portfolio of solutions.
- Proficiency in onboarding and managing partner relationships, with strong troubleshooting, problem-solving skills, and a bias for action and execution.
- Consultative sales experience and skillful in developing, negotiating, influencing and selling new partnership synergies to ecosystem partners.
- Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills required to influence cross-functional teams in internal solution development and go-to-market strategy.
- Strategic and analytical thinker who is hands-on, and with an entrepreneurial ability that includes comfort with ambiguity and challenges the status quo.
- Experience working in cross-functional and cross-cultural teams in a matrixed environment.
- Comfortable speaking at external events to help build Visa’s presence and reputation through thought leadership.
- Executive communication skills (written, oral & presentation) with an ability to explain complex business and technical concepts to broad audiences in an approachable way
- Fluent in English. Any additional Asian language a plus.
What Will Also Help
- Active network of ecosystem partners and public sector stakeholders across Asia.
- Prior sales and consulting experience servicing government clients and projects.
- Knowledge of payment solutions relevant to the ecosystem mentioned.

Title: Partnerships Executive, Singapore
Description:
About Sleek
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.
We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a high-growth space.
We operate 3 business segments:
- Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations
- Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service
- FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses
Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 15,000 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 450 staff with an intact startup mindset.
We have achieved >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years and as a result have been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia. Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled businesses based out of Singapore.
Requirements
We are looking for a Partnerships Executive to join our Singapore Partnerships team. This is a hunter-focused role. You will be on the ground identifying, approaching and activating new partners — building the top of the funnel that fuels Sleek's growth in Singapore.
You will work closely with and report to the Strategic Partnerships Manager, who will guide deal structuring and partner strategy. Your job is to find the partners, open the doors and generate the leads.
Mission
Build a strong, active pipeline of new partnership leads that drives incremental customer acquisition for Sleek Singapore.
Outcomes
You will be expected to contribute to the following milestones through the partnerships you identify and activate:
- Acquire 10 new partners per month which bring new customers to Sleek
- Drive activity of partners that you own to drive at least 30 New Customers per monthKey Responsibilities
- Proactively identify and approach potential partners across Fintech, eCommerce, professional services, immigration and other relevant industries.
- Execute outreach campaigns to engage prospective partners, set up meetings, and move leads through the pipeline.

Title: Partnerships Lead
Description:
About us
Wavemaker is Southeast Asia’s leading early-stage venture capital firm investing in enterprise and deep tech companies that offer innovative solutions and add significant value. Over the last 13 years, we have invested in over 200 companies and our thesis has remained the same:
We invest in thoughtful founders who have built an internal conviction through experience and reflection and identified a huge opportunity because they see things differently from most other people.
We invest in scalable, capital-efficient, sustainable businesses that aim to create significant value by solving meaningful problems 10x better than existing options.
Today, we’re a team of 40+ incredibly driven and passionate people in the region, and we are looking for a VP, Corporate Partnerships to join our team.
What you'll do
This role sits at the intersection of Wavemaker, our portfolio startups, and ecosystem partners — generating capital for Wavemaker and its portfolio companies, and connecting startups and corporates to accelerate outcomes for both.
Fundraising
- Generate top-of-funnel capital sources for Wavemaker across all fund strategies
- Generate top-of-funnel capital sources for managed portfolio companies, from both financial and strategic investors
- Surface and advance fundraising conversations as a natural extension of the broader relationship-building work
Partnerships & Portfolio Value Creation
- Develop a deep understanding of Wavemaker's portfolio companies, including growth drivers, strategic gaps, and potential exit pathways
- Identify and map corporate ecosystem partners that can accelerate portfolio traction, fundraising, and exit
- Facilitate strategic introductions between portfolio companies and corporates that may become customers, lenders, co-investors, and acquirers
Ecosystem Mapping and Development
- Build and maintain a structured map of corporate ecosystem players relevant to Wavemaker's investment themes and portfolio needs
- Develop and nurture executive-level relationships with key decision-makers across corporate partners
Scaled Exits Support
- Support the scaled-exits effort in older funds
- Apply financial literacy to assess asset value and viable exit routes for these positions
Project Management
- Partner closely with the General Partner to drive execution across active partnership, fundraising, and exit workstreams
- Bring structure and rigor to a fast-moving, relationship-heavy pipeline, ensuring nothing valuable is lost between an introduction and its outcome
Who you are
- You have 8+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, venture capital, investment banking, consulting/corporate strategy, or a related ecosystem-facing role.
- You are a hunter: you have a track record of generating and closing capital relationships — from your own network, from cold outreach, or through structured fundraising processes — not just facilitating warm introductions.
- You have deep financial literacy, including comfort assessing and structuring the liquidation of assets from older fund vintages (scaled exits).
- You have been deeply embedded across founders, operators, and corporates, with a track record as a trusted connector in the ecosystem.
- You have a strong understanding of and curiosity towards business models and commercial drivers, in order to pitch opportunities credibly (both to startups and corporates).
- You are commercially minded, with a strong instinct for identifying and activating opportunities that create tangible outcomes.
- You are highly adaptable and can operate across multiple priorities and evolving scope with ownership and accountability.
- You are a strong communicator with executive presence and the ability to engage senior stakeholders effectively.
- You are relationship-driven and genuinely motivated to help founders and corporate partners succeed.

Title: Partnerships Manager
Description:
On behalf of our clients (A US FinTech Company), we are looking for an experienced Strategic Alliances & Partnerships Manager for APAC.
The Manager, Strategic Alliances & Partnerships is responsible for the design, development, execution and growth of the partner strategy in the APAC marketplace, in close coordination with global counterparts. They will be expected to quickly embrace the business, understand the complex market ecosystem and quickly build and execute an effective GTM and revenue acceleration plan for the various partner channels identifi ed (i.e. OEM/ISV, reseller, system integrators) with the expressed purpose to make an immediate impact to our indirect sales strategy and drive incremental sales with and through our most critical business partners.
The ideal candidate will possess the business acumen to identify business opportunities, build loyal partner relationships with strong negotiation, communication skill sets and a patient disposition.
Responsibilities:
● Understanding the overall partner ecosystem and how to manage channel confl icts with the purpose to aim for an amicable outcome.
● Identify and recruit the right partners to jointly identify and prospect opportunities with the successful management and completion of the deal.
● Maximize closing of deals that can result in the taking of market share from competitors.
● Develop and build partner relationships through calls, emails, meetings and conferences.
● Maintain accurate records of all partner activities for the purposes of identifying, nurturing and closing the Company’s sales pipeline.
● Ensure the direct sales teams and partner sales teams are completely aligned and proactively pursue joint opportunities with a prioritized list of top performing partnerships.
Experience and Qualifications:
● Signifi cant experience and track record of performance within indirect / channel partner / strategic alliances selling roles, ideally in a regional and/or global strategic alliance / partner sales leadership capacity.
● Experience with reseller / independent software vendor / system integration channels in the APAC in fraud & identity verifi cation / cyber security solutions / identity access management solutions is critical.
● Proven strategic leader with a strong track record of driving partner-led revenue growth and GTM success. Recognized for delivering high-impact outcomes through ecosystem alignment, scalable co-sell strategies, and a results-driven mindset. A true rock star in accelerating revenue through partner collaboration and execution excellence.

Title: Partnerships Manager APAC
Description:
Company Description
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
For everyone, everywhere.
Job Description
More about our mission and what we offer.
We are looking for an ambitious and commercially minded Partnerships Manager to join our Strategic Partnerships team in Singapore. You will play a critical role in helping Wise accelerate growth across APAC by building and scaling partnerships that connect us with customers who have international money needs.
APAC is one of Wise's fastest-growing regions and a key growth opportunity. Across international students, travellers, expats and other globally-minded communities, we see significant potential to reach more customers through strategic partnerships.
This is a new role within a global team with high autonomy to own the end to end regional strategy. Working closely with regional growth teams, you will identify, negotiate and launch partnerships across APAC, adapting global opportunities to local markets and turning them into measurable growth.
The goal will be to use your commercial talents to unlock new groups of customers who have a need for Wise, but didn't know enough about us to use us before.
This is not a Wise Platform role - Your main goal is to accelerate personal adoption of Wise in APAC markets.
Responsibilities
- Strategy & Planning
- Define and execute the APAC partnership strategy across consumer partnerships, focused on helping internationally-minded customers discover and use Wise.
- Own, optimise and grow partnership verticals with full autonomy in collaboration with the global team
- Identify and prioritise high-intent customer segments with recurring international money needs, including international students, working holiday travellers, group travel communities, relocation and migration customers
- Build market-level partnership plans that align with regional growth priorities and business objectives
- Forecast partnership impact and prioritise opportunities based on customer acquisition, volume and long-term value
- Sourcing & Negotiation & Execution
- Prospect, qualify and develop relationships with potential partners across Australia, Singapore, Malaysia and broader APAC markets
- Own the full partnership lifecycle from outreach and discovery through to negotiation, contracting, launch and optimisation
- Structure commercial agreements that create value for both Wise and our partners
- Build scalable partnership frameworks that can be replicated across markets and partner categories.
- Go-To-Market & Execution
- Oversee the end-to-end launch of partnership campaigns, working closely with brand, regional growth, legal and product teams to ensure smooth delivery
- Performance & Optimisation
- Define and track key performance indicators for each partnership, including metrics across the funnel that drive measurable growth
- Use data to identify performance trends, opportunities and challenges, turning insights into actions that improve results.
- Maintain and nurture long-term relationships with existing partners, identifying opportunities for expansion, renewal, and increased investment based on proven results
- Regional Collaboration
- Act as the local partnerships expert within APAC
- Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders across regional marketing, growth, product and strategy teams
- Share market insights and partnership learnings that help shape future regional and global initiatives
Qualifications
A Bit About You
- Proven Partnership Success: You have experience sourcing, negotiating and executing successful partnerships that deliver measurable commercial outcomes. Experience working across APAC markets is a strong advantage. You can demonstrate how your work has driven customer acquisition, revenue growth, engagement or other business-critical metrics.
- Commercial Acumen: You are a natural at structuring and closing diverse commercial deals, big or small. You know how to identify opportunities, evaluate potential impact and make sound investment decisions.
- Strategic Yet Hands-On: You enjoy thinking strategically but are equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves and executing. You can take an idea from concept through to launch and optimisation.
- Strong Relationship Builder: You are naturally skilled at building trust with both external partners and internal stakeholders. You understand how to navigate different cultures, communication styles and business environments.
- Strong Analytical Mindset: You love diving into data, spotting trends, and unearthing insights that directly shape winning strategies and forecasts
- Culturally Adaptable: You are comfortable building relationships across different countries, cultures and business environments. You understand how to adapt your approach to local markets while maintaining a consistent commercial strategy.
- Self-Starter: You thrive in ambiguity, enjoy solving problems and are motivated by the opportunity to build and scale something new in a fast-growing region.
- Results-Oriented: You are focused on outcomes and have a track record of delivering against ambitious commercial targets while managing multiple priorities.
- AI-Curious: You actively explore emerging technologies and find innovative ways to integrate AI into your workflows, continuously seeking to improve efficiency and scale your impact.
- Mission-Driven: You are deeply aligned with our core purpose and bring an intrinsic motivation to your work, ensuring that your daily contributions directly advance our long-term vision.
Nice-to-have
- Experience in FinTech, Payments or Financial Services
- Experience in travel, student, migration, relocation or international consumer businesses
- Experience using AI and analytical tools
- Fluency in an Asian language
- Experience working in high-growth technology companies
Additional Information
What’s in it for you?
This will be an opportunity to define and drive how Wise does strategic partnerships. There are no limitations to who we can work with (where the commercial opportunity is robustly justified). You will develop skills in many different verticals all at once and be given resources to do it quickly.
You’ll have the chance to work in a friendly and supportive atmosphere with plenty of opportunities to grow and be part of our revolution. This includes a company funded personal development budget to spend on training, books and events.
Want to find out more about the team? Find out more about what Partnerships means at Wise here and what life is like in the team here.
We’re people without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too.
We want to work with the best people, no matter their background. So if you’re passionate about learning new things and keen to join our mission, you’ll fit right in.
Also, where and what you studied isn’t important to us. If you’ve got great experience, the right skills for the role and you’re great at articulating your thinking, we’d like to hear from you.
If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Title: Partnerships Manager APAC
Description:
We are looking for an ambitious and commercially minded Partnerships Manager to join our Strategic Partnerships team in Singapore. You will play a critical role in helping Wise accelerate growth across APAC by building and scaling partnerships that connect us with customers who have international money needs.
APAC is one of Wise's fastest-growing regions and a key growth opportunity. Across international students, travellers, expats and other globally-minded communities, we see significant potential to reach more customers through strategic partnerships.
This is a new role within a global team with high autonomy to own the end to end regional strategy. Working closely with regional growth teams, you will identify, negotiate and launch partnerships across APAC, adapting global opportunities to local markets and turning them into measurable growth.
The goal will be to use your commercial talents to unlock new groups of customers who have a need for Wise, but didn't know enough about us to use us before.
This is not a Wise Platform role -
Your main goal is to accelerate personal adoption of Wise in APAC markets.
Responsibilities
Strategy & Planning
Define and execute the APAC partnership strategy across consumer partnerships, focused on helping internationally-minded customers discover and use Wise.
Own, optimise and grow partnership verticals with full autonomy in collaboration with the global team
Identify and prioritise high-intent customer segments with recurring international money needs, including international students, working holiday travellers, group travel communities, relocation and migration customers
Build market-level partnership plans that align with regional growth priorities and business objectives
Forecast partnership impact and prioritise opportunities based on customer acquisition, volume and long-term value
Sourcing & Negotiation & Execution
Prospect, qualify and develop relationships with potential partners across Australia, Singapore, Malaysia and broader APAC markets
Own the full partnership lifecycle from outreach and discovery through to negotiation, contracting, launch and optimisation
Structure commercial agreements that create value for both Wise and our partners
Build scalable partnership frameworks that can be replicated across markets and partner categories.
Go-To-Market & Execution
Oversee the end-to-end launch of partnership campaigns, working closely with brand, regional growth, legal and product teams to ensure smooth delivery
Performance & Optimisation
Define and track key performance indicators for each partnership, including metrics across the funnel that drive measurable growth
Use data to identify performance trends, opportunities and challenges, turning insights into actions that improve results.
Maintain and nurture long-term relationships with existing partners, identifying opportunities for expansion, renewal, and increased investment based on proven results
Regional Collaboration
Act as the local partnerships expert within APAC
Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders across regional marketing, growth, product and strategy teams
Share market insights and partnership learnings that help shape future regional and global initiatives
Qualifications
A Bit About You
Proven Partnership Success: You have experience sourcing, negotiating and executing successful partnerships that deliver measurable commercial outcomes. Experience working across APAC markets is a strong advantage. You can demonstrate how your work has driven customer acquisition, revenue growth, engagement or other business-critical metrics.
Commercial Acumen: You are a natural at structuring and closing diverse commercial deals, big or small. You know how to identify opportunities, evaluate potential impact and make sound investment decisions.
Strategic Yet Hands-On: You enjoy thinking strategically but are equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves and executing. You can take an idea from concept through to launch and optimisation.
Strong Relationship Builder: You are naturally skilled at building trust with both external partners and internal stakeholders. You understand how to navigate different cultures, communication styles and business environments.
Strong Analytical Mindset: You love diving into data, spotting trends, and unearthing insights that directly shape winning strategies and forecasts
Culturally Adaptable: You are comfortable building relationships across different countries, cultures and business environments. You understand how to adapt your approach to local markets while maintaining a consistent commercial strategy.
Self-Starter: You thrive in ambiguity, enjoy solving problems and are motivated by the opportunity to build and scale something new in a fast-growing region.
Results-Oriented: You are focused on outcomes and have a track record of delivering against ambitious commercial targets while managing multiple priorities.
AI-Curious: You actively explore emerging technologies and find innovative ways to integrate AI into your workflows, continuously seeking to improve efficiency and scale your impact.
Mission-Driven: You are deeply aligned with our core purpose and bring an intrinsic motivation to your work, ensuring that your daily contributions directly advance our long-term vision.
Nice-to-have
Experience in FinTech, Payments or Financial Services

Who we are
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move money around the world. With the Wise account people and businesses can hold over 40 currencies, move money between countries and spend money abroad. Large companies and banks use Wise technology too; an entirely new cross-border payments network that will one day power money without borders for everyone, everywhere. However you use the platform, Wise is on a mission to make your life easier and save you money.
Co-founded by Kristo Käärmann and Taavet Hinrikus, Wise launched in 2011 under its original name TransferWise. It is one of the world’s fastest growing, profitable technology companies and is listed on the London Stock Exchange under the ticker, WISE.
16 million people and businesses use Wise. In fiscal year 2023, Wise processed approximately £105 billion in cross-border transactions, saving customers around £1.5 billion.
What it’s really like to work here
At Wise, we do things a bit differently. There’s no corporate nonsense, and no old-fashioned hierarchy. Instead, we work in dozens of self-sufficient, autonomous teams. Think of them like start-ups within a start-up that learn from each other.
Each team picks the problems they want to solve. So there’s no micro-management. No hiding behind fancy job titles. And no one telling you what to do. You are your own boss. But you’ll get tons of guidance and plenty of support from talented, super-smart colleagues from all over Wise.
We’re going to be upfront — the way we work doesn’t suit everyone. But if freedom, autonomy, and life-affirming, head-scratching professional challenges rock your world, we could be a match made in heaven.

Title: Partnerships Sales Director - APAC
Description:
Help Us Build The Future of Travel
At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.
Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.
We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone.
Your Next Destination
- Location: Remote.
- Contract: Full-time, permanent.
- Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link - https://airalo-public.notion.site/Benefits-25396a97ffca81fb9bc1f0be479f1be3?pvs=74
- Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async.
As the Director of Partnerships for APAC, you will lead Airalo’s partnership efforts across our four key Partnerships streams - Strategic Partnerships, Channel Sales and Corporate Sales for APAC
What You'll Do
- Work closely with the VP of Partnerships and other team members in the department
- Build, lead, and groom a team of Partnerships Managers, further supported by in-country teams for Channel Sales, and Corporate Sales for key countries within APAC
- Be a core member of the Partnerships Leadership Team that shapes Airalo’s global Partnerships strategy
- Shape the future of Airalo’s Partnerships products by working closely with the Partner Experience Product and Engineering teams
- Find, identify, prospect, and lead negotiations with large strategic partners within APAC
- Maintain relationships with key partners to drive partner profitability and grow the B2B/B2B2C partnerships' contribution to the business
- Refine the Airalo Partnerships roadmap to anticipate and fulfill partner needs, thereby maintaining Airalo’s status as the preferred provider across industry partners in APAC
- Collaborate and work with different internal and external stakeholders to develop and execute joint projects/opportunities
- Define and improve SOPs for the Partnerships department to streamline operations and improve efficiency across workflows
- Represent Airalo at leading industry events and conferences across APAC
- Own the Airalo Partnerships OKRs for APAC
What You'll Bring
- 10+ years of experience in partnerships, sales, account management, or business development in a high-growth B2B and/or B2B2C environment
- 5+ years of prior experience building and managing high-performance teams
- Experience in Traveltech / Consumer tech industries will be an advantage
- Partner-first mentality and a genuine passion for helping your stakeholders succeed while creating win-win relationships
- Ability to develop Airalo’s unique story and the problem we solve for our users, making it a compelling partnership proposition
- Ability to employ, and teach your team, various sales techniques, including effective questioning, objection handling, consultative selling, and solution selling
- Ability to develop thought leadership skills and build trust with key stakeholders - internally and externally
- Ability to multi-task in a complex & matrix environment
- Experience with sales and partnerships tools
- Fluent verbal and written communication skills in Korean is nice to have.
If you are interested in this position, please apply to the ad.
Why People Join Us
We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first.
Our team spans 60+ countries, united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one.
As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact - from anywhere in the world.
Before You Hit Apply
By applying, you acknowledge and agree that, in case of successful application, Airalo may request to run background checks as a condition for entering into an agreement with you. Rest assured that these checks will only occur upon your prior consent and at the end of the selection process, and will be strictly limited to what is allowed under the laws that are applicable to you. We sincerely thank all applicants in advance for submitting their interest in this opportunity. Airalo is an equal-opportunity employer and values diversity, equity & inclusion. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations upon request for individuals with disabilities throughout our job interview process.

These tools support, but do not replace, human judgment; all hiring decisions are made by humans. If you progress to an interview, we may use tools to generate AI-assisted notes - you can opt out of these. For more information on how we handle your data, please see our Privacy Policy: https://www.airalo.com/more-info/privacy-policy.

Description:

Who We Are.
Axi is a leading global provider of margin and deliverable Foreign Exchange, Contracts for Difference (CFDs), and Financial Spread betting. Our business has evolved into a world-class, multifaceted brokerage with offices in six regions. With heavy investment in the latest trading technology, Axi seeks to offer the most comprehensive end-to-end trading experience available, servicing traders of all levels from beginners to institutional-level clients.
Let's talk about the cool stuff you will do at Axi!
Someone who has significant experience and connections within the payments world, primarily on alternative payment methods and higher risk merchants. Wide knowledge of the pricing of payment methods and possible solutions, with a particular focus on APAC and Middle East.
Your EDGE Assignment/You Will
- Build and manage strategic relationships with PSPs, acquiring banks, payment gateways and alternative payment providers globally, with a strong focus on Asia and Middle East.
- Sourcing new payment solutions, new partners and payment methods sourcing, due diligence, contracting, and coordinating Product, Tech, Compliance, Legal and Finance until it's live.
- Manage the commercial terms with payment providers. Own every negotiation on processing rates, settlement terms, reserves and limits, and they're responsible for payments costs for improving.
- Partner performance, working with Product, to track and act on approval rates, reliability, cost, settlement speed and operational risk. Then escalate, renegotiate or replace underperforming partners.
- Develop comprehensive local payment coverage across priority markets, including cards, bank transfers, wallets and alternative payment methods, with appropriate redundancy within the payment ecosystem to reduce over-reliance on individual providers or payment rails.
- Own and drive key initiatives within your area, ensuring alignment with Axi's strategic priorities and business objectives.
- Collaborate across departments to deliver programmes end-to-end with measurable, lasting impact.
- Ensure all activities comply with applicable regulatory requirements and Axi's internal policies.
- Undertake any additional responsibilities as assigned to support Axi's broader business objectives.
Are you the one?
- Demonstrable experience in Contract Negotiation, applied in a commercial environment.
- Demonstrable experience in Detailed Payments Knowledge, applied in a commercial environment.
- Demonstrable experience in External Relationship Management, applied in a commercial environment.
- 8+ years years of relevant experience, ideally within financial services, fintech, or a similarly complex global environment.
- Proven experience in a relevant role within a fast-paced, global organisation.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with experience working across cross-functional teams.
- Proactive, self-driven mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
- Comfortable managing competing priorities and delivering to deadlines in an ambiguous environment.
Nice To Have
- Experience with Compliance And Regulatory Environment or similar is advantageous.
- Experience with Proven Record Of Internal Stakeholder Management or similar is advantageous.
- Experience in FX, CFD, online brokerage, crypto, gaming, Financial Services, FinTech, or Payments Processing Company.
- Experience launching payment solutions across multiple countries.
- Existing senior relationships across major PSPs, acquiring banks and payment companies in Asia and/or Middle Eastern.
- Understanding of payment routing, approval rates, fraud, chargebacks, settlement and payment optimisation.
- Exposure to high-growth, fast-paced global organisations.
Axi's bag of delights
- Competitive and attractive compensation.
- Extensive learning opportunities, such as professional training and certifications and soft skills development.
- 20 annual leave days per year.
- 5 paid study leave days per year.
- 1 paid volunteer day per year.
- Health and Dental Insurance (self + option to include dependents).

- Hiring Manager Interview (75-90 mins)

Title: Payment Technology Risk and Control Director
Description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
Join a role that's central to our technological resilience, offering a unique opportunity to shape the firm's tech risk strategy and enhance industry compliance.
As a Tech Risk & Controls Director in Cybersecurity & Tech Controls supporting Commercial and Investment Bank, Payment Technology, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and implementing the firm's technology risk management strategy. Leveraging your advanced knowledge and expertise in technology-risk disciplines, you will identify, oversee, and mitigate compliance and operational risks in line with the firm's standards. You will collaborate with various stakeholders, including Product Owners, Business Control Managers, and regulators, to develop and maintain a comprehensive view of the technology risk posture and its impact on the business. Your ability to make calculated decisions, manage large teams, and drive strategic projects will be crucial in ensuring the firm's adherence to regulatory obligations and industry best practices. Your work will contribute to the long-term success and resilience of the organization in an ever-evolving technology landscape.
Job responsibilities
Develop and implement technology risk management strategies, policies, and processes to identify, assess, and mitigate risks, and drive strategic projects and initiatives to enhance the firm's technology risk management capabilities, in line with industry best practices and the firm's standards and regulatory requirements
Sets reuse-first expectations for enterprise-authorized AI adoption within the work environment across technology risk and controls operations to accelerate evidence synthesis, issue analysis, and executive reporting, with human-in-the-loop validation and appropriate handling of sensitive data.
Identify and escalate emerging and upstream technology risk through execution of the Firm's management framework tools, including risk event management, reporting, and action plan tracking, and provide expert counsel to stakeholders and constituents regarding their security obligations, facilitating acceptable outcomes
Establish and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including key cross-functional team leads, regulators, and auditors, to ensure compliance with legal, regulatory, and industry standards
Manage reporting and governance of overall controls, policies, issue management, and measurements, etc., providing insight to senior leaders into effectiveness of controls and inform governance work
Establishes governance standards for AI-assisted workflows used in risk reporting and issue/action-plan management, ensuring traceability/auditability and alignment to security, resiliency, and regulatory expectations.
Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Data Science, or related disciplines
7+ years of experience in technology risk management, cybersecurity, or a related field, focusing on APAC regulatory compliance and risk mitigation
Demonstrated experience leading safe adoption of enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment within technology risk and controls workflows, including validation practices and awareness of data sensitivity.
Ability to define review/approval and escalation expectations for AI-assisted recommendations while maintaining security, auditability, and regulatory compliance outcomes.
Demonstrated expertise in risk management frameworks, industry standards, and regulatory requirements relevant to the financial industry
Proven ability to lead large teams, manage cross-functional projects, influence executive-level strategic decision-making, and effectively translate technology insights to business strategy in communications with senior executives
Advanced knowledge and experience leading data security, risk assessment & reporting, and control evaluation, design, and governance, with a track record of implementing effective risk mitigation strategies
#CTC

Description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
Shape how payments client onboarding controls are delivered across Asia Pacific by leading process assurance and change at scale. This is the first role of its kind in the region, created to support growth and align local delivery with global standards. You will work with Global Corporate Banking and Commercial Banking onboarding teams and partners across controls, operations, technology, risk, compliance, and product to remove friction and improve client outcomes.

People & Culture Senior Executive
Singapore

About Us
Adrenalin Group is an integrated communications company. We operate across 3 business units: AdrenalinX (Experiential Events), AVPD Studios (Production and Livestream), and Aether Lab (Innovation and Emerging Technology).
We are looking for a People & Culture Senior Executive to own the full employee lifecycle across all 3 business units. This is a hands-on role covering 9 areas: recruitment, onboarding and offboarding, payroll and compliance, HR policy, employee and industrial relations, training and development, employer branding, internal events and partnerships, and company operations. You will report directly to the Group Managing Director. Candidates with more relevant experience may be considered for a managerial role.
What You'll Own
Recruitment
Run end-to-end hiring for every role across the different units, including full-time, contract and intern hires.
Work with business unit leads to define hiring needs, write job descriptions and set selection criteria
Post roles, screen CVs, conduct first-round interviews and coordinate interview schedules
Manage offers, salary negotiations and candidate communication from first contact to rejection or signed contract
Build talent pipelines for recurring and project-based roles, and manage recruitment agencies and job platforms
Onboarding and Offboarding
Prepare contracts, offer letters and onboarding paperwork
Run orientation, system access and introductions for new joiners
Hold check-ins with new joiners through probation to track how they are settling in and flag issues early
Manage resignations, exit interviews and final settlements
Issue confirmation, promotion and termination letters
Payroll and Compliance
Process monthly payroll for all employees across the group
Submit CPF contributions and SDL monthly
Prepare and submit annual IR8A and employee income records through IRAS AIS
Administer leave, claims, overtime and attendance
Handle work pass applications, renewals and cancellations with MOM
Keep the company compliant with the Employment Act and related legislation
HR Policy
Write and maintain the employee handbook and HR policies
Communicate policy changes and apply them consistently across business units
Keep employee records and HR systems accurate and confidential
Employee and Industrial Relations
Be the first point of contact for employee concerns and grievances
Manage disciplinary matters, investigations and documentation
Advise management on employee relations and handle industrial relation matters
Hold regular one-on-ones with employees on wellbeing, engagement and retention
Training and Development
Coordinate the performance appraisal cycle and support managers through it
Identify training needs, then plan, source and coordinate programmes
Manage training records, vendors and available grants
Administer employee benefits, including medical and group insurance, and manage renewals
Manage Career Conversion Programme (CCP) hires, including applications, training plans, salary support claims and programme reporting
Employer Branding
Run employer branding across LinkedIn, the careers page and other channels
Create content that shows our culture, people and work
Represent the company at external events, including career fiars, school and university events, industry events and networking sessions
Identify, prepare and submit applications for employer and industry awards
Internal Events, CSR and Partnerships
Plan and run internal events such as townhalls, celebrations, team bonding and festive activities, including budgets and vendors
Build and manage partnerships with schools, universities, industry bodies, vendors and community partners
Coordinate internship programmes and talent partnerships
Plan and run CSR initiatives, including community partners, volunteer activities and staff participation
Who Thrives in This Role
You likely:
Have 2 to 3 years of experience in HR generalist work, with hands-on payroll and recruitment
Know Singapore employement law and CPF, IRAS and MOM processes well enough to run them without supervision
Can run many priorities at once with limited support
Handle sensitive matters, from salaries to disciplinary cases, with discretion and judgement
Are comfortable working directly with Group CEO, Group Managing Director and business unit leads
Can adapt to 3 business units with different hiring needs and cultures
Are proficient in Microsoft Office and comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude for drafting and research
Have experience supervising or guiding a junior team member
Have hands-on experience with Info-Tech HRMS and payroll software, or a similar system
Why Join Adrenalin Group
You will own the People & Culture function end to end and shape how a growing, multi-business group hires, develops and looks after its people.
We offer lifestyle benefits, basic health support, team recognition initiatives, and an optional leadership development track.
If this matches how you work, do apply!

Our expertise spans public campaigns, industry conferences, product launches, and stakeholder engagement initiatives, integrating immersive storytelling, cutting-edge production, and strategic events execution. Our people-first, purpose-driven approach ensures that every event and activation is designed to inspire, engage, and create lasting impact. Our inclusive and diverse team brings together talent from different backgrounds, fostering an environment that values creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning.

Our longstanding professional work relationships with government agencies and businesses enable us to contribute meaningfully to Singapore’s events and creative industries.
As we continue to evolve, Adrenalin remains focused on leveraging technology, expanding our capabilities, and setting new benchmarks in experiential communications - ensuring that our work not only engages audiences but also supports long-term economic and environmental sustainability.

Title: Pet Nutritionist
Description:
We are looking for a Nutritionist to join BOM BOM, supporting personalised pet nutrition, nutritional data analysis and new product development. In this role, you will provide tailored dietary recommendations for pets, maintain our nutritional database and SOPs, and contribute to the development and improvement of our pet food products. You will work closely with our Customer Solutions, Operations and Marketing teams to ensure our nutritional recommendations and products are accurate, practical and aligned with established nutritional standards. You will also play a role in improving our Nutrition BOM BOT AI system by reviewing nutritional information, analysing customer insights and enhancing the accuracy of its recommendations. If you have a strong foundation in animal nutrition, enjoy working with data and product development, and are a pet owner who is genuinely passionate about pet health and nutrition, we’d love for you to join us!
Responsibilities
Pet Nutrition & Dietary Recommendations
Provide personalised dietary recommendations based on pets' nutritional requirements, life stages, health conditions and individual needs.
Review pet profiles and nutritional information to recommend suitable products and feeding plans.
Support the Customer Solutions team with nutrition-related enquiries that require specialised knowledge.
Review and update dietary recommendations based on new nutritional findings, product changes and customer feedback.
Escalate complex medical or veterinary-related cases to the appropriate specialists.
Nutritional Database & Analysis
Maintain and update nutritional databases, ingredient information and product specifications.
Analyse nutritional data to support dietary recommendations and product development.
Review nutritional calculations and ensure consistency and accuracy across products and feeding recommendations.
Support the ongoing improvement of Nutrition BOM BOT by reviewing its nutritional knowledge base and identifying gaps or inaccuracies.
SOP Maintenance& Documentation
Maintain and update nutrition-related SOPs, formulation records and technical documentation.
Ensure nutritional information and internal guidelines remain accurate, consistent and up to date.
Work with relevant departments to review and improve existing nutrition-related processes.
Maintain proper records of product formulations, nutritional calculations and supporting documentation.
New Product Development (NPD)
Support the research, formulation and development of new pet food products.
Evaluate ingredients based on nutritional value, suitability and product requirements.
Conduct nutritional calculations and review formulations against established standards, including NRC, AAFCO and FEDIAF.
Coordinate with Operations, Procurement and external laboratories on ingredient testing, product trials and nutritional analysis.
Review existing products and recommend improvements based on nutritional findings, customer feedback and market trends.
Assist with product specifications, nutritional labelling and technical documentation.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Work closely with Customer Solutions to ensure dietary recommendations and nutritional information are communicated accurately.
Collaborate with Operations and Procurement on ingredient suitability, product specifications and formulation requirements.
Provide technical nutritional information to support Marketing's product content and claims.
Work with internal stakeholders to improve nutritional processes and product offerings.
Requirements
Degree in Animal Science, Animal Nutrition, Food Science, Nutrition or a related discipline.
Preferably 2–4 years of relevant experience in pet nutrition, food formulation, product development or a related field.
Good understanding of companion animal nutrition, particularly dogs and cats.
Familiarity with NRC, AAFCO and FEDIAF nutritional guidelines.
Knowledge of nutritional calculations, ingredient functionality and dietary formulation.
Proficient in Microsoft Excel, with the ability to analyse and maintain nutritional data.
Good documentation, organisational and communication skills.
Able to work independently and collaborate with different departments.
Detail-oriented, with an interest in product development and continuous improvement.
Genuine interest in pet health, nutrition and animal welfare.

Description:
DESCRIPTION
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
Amazon Web Service (AWS) is a comprehensive, evolving, and growing business unit within Amazon.com which provides cloud services. Since early 2006, AWS has provided a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform that powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world. If you are interested in a career working in a high growth, fast paced and Customer focused work environment then AWS may be the right fit for you.
The AWS Global Data Center Supply Solutions Team is looking for an experienced professional based in Singapore. In this role, you will be a key member of the Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) team responsible for mitigating financial and contractual risks for our expanding portfolio in Asia Pacific, Japan and China region. Managers work closely with lessors/vendors and internal partner teams to ensure accurate and timely payment of our rent obligations while ensuring contractual compliance.
The ideal candidate is detail oriented and a strong communicator that can work independently in an extremely fast-paced environment with a high demand with a high degree of ambiguity.
Key job responsibilities
- Independently manage a portfolio of complex leases and contracts end-to-end — including abstraction, verification, and integration into lease management systems. Interpret contractual nuances and identify cost optimization opportunities.
- Oversee payment processes, audit invoices against contractual obligations, and monitor compliance of internal and external stakeholders. Support regulatory audit requirements.
- Lead the review of contract abstractions against source documents; establish and refine QC standards for the team.
- Maintain accurate site-level data across contract administration systems to support financial reporting, planning, and leadership decision-making. Produce team performance metrics.
- Maintain effective relationships with vendors, landlords, and internal teams (Accounting, Finance, Business Development, Legal). Proactively identify relationship improvement opportunities.
- Track renewals, escalations, and notices to maintain compliance and operational continuity.
Identify portfolio risks and potential blockers; manage escalations independently and escalate to senior leaders when required.
- Guide and mentor junior team members; share best practices and contribute to team capability development.
- Improve operations and audit processes to bolster team efficacy. Drive scalable solutions that enhance efficiency and stakeholder experience.
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
- 5+ years of property management, asset management, portfolio management and/or real estate financial analysis experience
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, Real Estate, or another related field
- Experience in commercial real estate or lease administration within an industrial, commercial, and/or data center environment
- Experience with Landlord and Tenant codes, commercial law and service charge
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Experience reading and interpreting lease language, managing critical lease dates, and conducting lease negotiations
- Experience utilizing commercial real estate software platforms such as Tango, Yardi, or MRI
- Experience with lease administration processes
- Master's degree or above in enginnering or equivalent, or 3+ years of vendor management experience
- Experience with project management, or experience developing or delivering training programs across multiple sites or regions
- Experience prioritizing and handling multiple assignments at any given time while maintaining commitment to deadlines
- Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present to leadership teams and external stakeholders

This is a senior technical leadership role for a highly experienced specialist who can work across research, engineering, product, and production systems. The right candidate should be able to evaluate new approaches, design model architectures, run experiments, improve model quality, and help engineering teams bring AI / ML capabilities into real production workflows.

The role may also support other internal product groups or AI / ML initiatives where computer vision, image processing, visual search, object detection, segmentation, classification, or model evaluation expertise is needed.

Mobile App / Computer Vision:
Image capture workflows, mobile application integration, computer vision model development, model inference, warehouse / field usability, user feedback loops, production model quality, and UAT support.
AI / ML Product Features:
Applied machine learning features, model evaluation workflows, proof-of-concepts, model-assisted automation, AI-assisted business tools, and integration of AI / ML capabilities into existing business workflows.
Data and Annotation Workflows:
Image datasets, data quality, annotation requirements, labeling guidelines, model training datasets, validation datasets, failure case analysis, and continuous improvement of model performance.
Production ML Systems:
Model deployment, model versioning, inference performance, monitoring, reproducibility, scalability, reliability, and MLOps practices.
Insight on Your Impact
In this role, you will:
Lead research, design, development, and implementation of Computer Vision and AI / ML solutions.
Define model architecture, technical approach, experiment strategy, validation methodology, and production readiness criteria.
Train, fine-tune, evaluate, optimize, and deploy models for object detection, semantic segmentation, image classification, feature matching, OCR, visual search, and image understanding.
Own the full model lifecycle, including data analysis, dataset quality, annotation requirements, model training, experiment tracking, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
Build prototypes, proof-of-concepts, demos, and technical experiments to validate new ideas before full product implementation.
Analyze model performance, identify failure cases, and recommend practical improvements based on data, user behavior, and business needs.
Review and improve existing Computer Vision pipelines, model quality, inference performance, scalability, and production reliability.
Work with software engineers to integrate ML models into production applications and services.
Define standards for model evaluation, model versioning, dataset management, reproducibility, and MLOps practices.
Evaluate research papers, open-source models, AI platforms, and new technologies for potential use in company products.
Provide technical guidance and mentoring to engineers working on AI / ML and computer vision features.
Support planning and estimation for AI / ML work by clarifying technical complexity, risks, dependencies, and realistic delivery assumptions.
Create technical documentation, model evaluation reports, architecture notes, and recommendations for engineering and product teams.
Partner with Product / Delivery Managers to translate business needs into practical AI / ML implementation plans.
Partner with Engineering Managers, Team Leads / Architects, QA, DevOps, Data, and business stakeholders to make sure AI / ML work can be delivered and supported in production.
Your Qualifications, Your Influence
To be successful in this role, you should have:
PhD in Computer Science, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or closely related technical field.
7+ years of hands-on experience in Machine Learning / Deep Learning, with strong focus on Computer Vision.
Strong practical experience with PyTorch and / or TensorFlow.
Strong Python development skills.
Experience with OpenCV, NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn, and modern Python ML ecosystem.
Deep understanding of classical Computer Vision algorithms and modern deep learning approaches.
Strong experience with object detection, semantic segmentation, image classification, feature matching, image retrieval, and model evaluation.
Experience with modern Computer Vision architectures and techniques, including CNNs, Transformers, Vision Transformers, YOLO, Mask R-CNN, CLIP-like models, SAM-like models, or similar.
Experience bringing ML models into production environments.
Experience with model optimization for inference speed, latency, memory usage, scalability, and reliability.
Experience with REST APIs, Docker, CI / CD, model versioning, experiment tracking, and MLOps practices.
Strong understanding of datasets, data quality, annotation processes, labeling requirements, and model error analysis.
Ability to read, understand, and evaluate technical documentation and research papers in English.
Ability to explain complex technical topics to engineering, product, and business stakeholders.
Experience working in Agile software development environment.
Strong ownership mindset, good judgment, and ability to make practical technical decisions under uncertainty.
Comfortable working in distributed teams across multiple locations and time zones.
Preferred Skills and Technical Familiarity
The following experience will be helpful:
Post-PhD research or industry experience in applied Computer Vision.
Publications, patents, or strong applied research record in Computer Vision, Machine Learning, or AI.
Experience leading technical direction for AI / ML projects.
Experience mentoring ML engineers, software engineers, or data annotation teams.
Experience with edge or mobile inference technologies, including ONNX, TensorRT, OpenVINO, TFLite, CoreML, or similar.
Experience with large-scale image processing pipelines.
Experience with synthetic data generation, active learning, weak supervision, or dataset quality improvement.
Experience with multimodal models, vision-language models, prompt engineering, OpenAI, or similar AI platforms.
Experience with cloud ML platforms and production monitoring of ML models.
Familiarity with mobile applications, warehouse workflows, field operations systems, or image capture workflows.
Familiarity with Azure DevOps, Git, CI / CD tooling, documentation systems, and practical software delivery processes.
Experience in electronic components, technology distribution, supply chain, logistics, manufacturing, e-commerce, or similar B2B environments.
Success in the First 90 Days
Within the first 90 days, the Principal Computer Vision Scientist should be able to:
Understand the relevant product areas, users, business workflows, image capture workflows, datasets, model use cases, and current technical risks.
Establish working relationships with Engineering Managers, Team Leads / Architects, Product / Delivery Managers, engineers, QA, DevOps, Data, and business stakeholders.
Review current Computer Vision and AI / ML work, including models, datasets, evaluation methods, annotation process, production integration, and known quality issues.
Identify the most important model quality risks, data quality gaps, technical debt items, production risks, and maintainability concerns.
Define or improve model evaluation criteria, validation process, dataset requirements, and model readiness expectations.
Help improve technical clarity of the active AI / ML backlog by adding design notes, technical breakdown, dependencies, estimates, and risks.
Lead at least one meaningful model improvement, prototype, evaluation effort, or production risk-reduction activity.
Improve documentation around model architecture, data flows, evaluation results, known limitations, and production behavior.
Create an initial technical roadmap or remediation plan for Computer Vision work aligned with product priorities and engineering capacity.
Help onboard or mentor engineers working on Computer Vision, AI / ML, or related product features.
What This Role Does Not Own
This role does not own formal people management for engineers. Engineering Managers remain responsible for hiring, performance management, compensation input, team structure, and capacity planning.
This role does not own business prioritization or user acceptance. Product / Delivery Managers and business stakeholders remain responsible for intake, priority alignment, backlog readiness, UAT coordination, and business acceptance.
This role does not independently commit delivery dates without alignment with Engineering Managers and Product / Delivery Managers.
This role does not own all AI / ML work across the company unless specifically assigned by GEO leadership. The primary responsibility is Computer Vision technical leadership and production-quality AI / ML implementation for assigned product areas.
This role does not replace Software Architects, DevOps, Data, QA, or Infrastructure ownership. The role will work closely with those teams to make sure Computer Vision solutions are technically sound, production-ready, and supportable.

Title: Principal Medical Writer
Description:
Key Accountabilities:
Author Clinical Documents
Gather, review, analyze, and evaluate pertinent resources to prepare, develop, and finalize key clinical documents for submission to regulatory authorities, without the need for any supervision or additional formal on-the-job training. Train self and provide guidance to others to prepare any type of medical writing deliverable.
Revise document drafts based on the review comments from team members to ensure inclusion of all relevant input.
Manage ongoing and/or revised project documentation and correspondence.
Quality Control
Ensure that all work is complete and of high quality prior to team distribution or shipment to client.
Provide technical leadership to ensure clinical data presented in summary documents is in compliance with applicable regulatory guidelines, SOPs, and goals of submission.
Project Management
Operate as the project lead writer/submission coordinator and primary client contact to manage contributions of multiple writers working on related documents. Manage scope of work, timeline and project goals, technical information, and input from clients throughout the project.
Develop, coordinate, and oversee work plans for individual and multiple-document delivery, to enable the team to work efficiently and effectively to meet milestones and achieve team objectives.
Provide leadership and strategic planning/adjustments, delegation of responsibilities, and tasks to team members. Monitor the progress of each individual project task and assess the overall program.
Ensure key information received in project or program meetings is appropriately disseminated, such that project strategy is maintained and data or key message changes are incorporated appropriately across documents.
Continuously monitor overall project performance and, if necessary, identify ways to ensure that the project is completed on-time and within budget.
Keep client and team informed of project status.
Contribute expertise as a document/cross-document specialist and content historian to analyze proposed program, studies, and related documents to deliver information required by the target audiences.
Build and maintain collaborative relationships with teams/clients, leading to increased performance and a sense of inclusion. Cultivate efficient, productive, and professional working relationships to promote client satisfaction and confidence.
Track actual versus planned project budget. Determine the cause of cost overruns and out-of-scope activities and recommend corrective action to medical writing management.
Provide updates for each project to Medical Writing Services management, and assess forecasting and resourcing. Propose creative solutions to medical writing management to shifting timelines and staffing requirements.
Communicate to writer’s line manager any needs or concerns regarding level of training or performance of team members on project work. Provide line manager with input regarding team member’s performance for employees' periodic performance review, and as needed.
Client Liaison/Service
Be aware of client expectations for self and team members. Respond appropriately to incidents of dissatisfaction, and feed back to Medical Writing Services management.
Provide support as appropriate to Business Development/Client Solutions and Medical Writing Services management in their efforts to win new business. Identify and solicit new business leads for Medical Writing Services, attend business development meetings, and prepare and make sales presentations to clients, if called upon.
Provide strategic and project planning intelligence to Medical Writing Services management for medical writing activities in the proposal generation process, including assessment of scope of services to be provided to a client with respect to medical writing tasks. May attend proposal development meetings if requested by Medical Writing Services management.
Input to development of client proposals generated by Medical Writing Services and letters of agreement/intent based on existing templates. May function as the client contact if requested and communicate pricing information in conjunction with Medical Writing Services management.
If requested, suggest appropriate resourcing, based on existing templates and standards, for full-service and stand-alone projects.
Training/Compliance
Keep abreast of new advances in medical writing and regulatory issues.
Develop and train Medical Writing Services staff to enhance writing quality, efficiency, and project management.
Implement and monitor departmental compliance to SOPs. Input to development or revision of departmental SOPs, as appropriate.
Develop and present external training courses.
General
Attend departmental and company meetings as necessary.
Comply with departmental procedures and requirements, such as completion of project assignment and workload trackers on the applicable software platform
Analyze efficiency of work and discuss improvement ideas with Medical Writing
Services management and colleagues, e.g., evaluation of software to increase productivity and document quality.
