Title: Principal, Agency Partnerships
Description:
foodpanda is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.
Job Description
Build the Regional Agency Strategy
- Define and own the regional agency strategy for Retail Media, identifying the agency groups, markets, clients and categories with the highest growth potential.
- Develop a clear framework to increase Retail Media penetration across agency planning, buying and client investment processes.
- Establish regional agency engagement models, commercial priorities and ways of working that can be replicated across APAC and EU markets.
- Identify structural barriers preventing agencies from investing in our Retail Media proposition and develop solutions to unlock incremental spend.
Develop Strategic Agency Partnerships
- Build and strengthen senior relationships across key media agency groups, holding companies and their specialist commerce, programmatic and performance teams.
- Position our Retail Media capabilities with agency leadership, planning teams and client leads, moving the relationship beyond individual campaign briefs toward strategic partnerships.
- Develop joint business plans and strategic initiatives with priority agency partners to grow investment across their client portfolios.
- Create access to new advertisers and budgets through agency relationships, including brands where we currently have limited or no direct commercial relationship.
Drive Market Execution
- Partner with local Retail Media teams to translate the regional agency strategy into market-specific action plans and commercial opportunities.
- Identify priority agencies and advertisers by market and support local teams in developing the right engagement approach.
- Lead or support strategic pitches, agency roadshows, workshops and senior client conversations where regional involvement can accelerate opportunities.
- Build playbooks, best practices and scalable approaches that improve agency engagement capabilities across markets.
- Ensure learnings and successful agency models are shared and replicated across the region.
Grow Retail Media Revenue Through Agencies
- Build a measurable pipeline of agency-led opportunities and establish clear targets for agency-sourced and agency-influenced revenue.
- Increase the share of Retail Media investment coming through agencies and unlock incremental budgets beyond existing trade and shopper marketing relationships.
- Work across onsite, offsite, programmatic and other Retail Media solutions to create propositions relevant to how agencies plan and buy media.
- Identify opportunities to package audiences, inventory, insights and measurement into propositions that can compete effectively for broader media budgets.
Shape Our Agency Proposition
- Bring an agency-insider perspective into the evolution of our Retail Media proposition.
- Provide structured feedback on what agencies and advertisers need across products, measurement, insights, buying models, campaign execution and reporting.
- Partner with Product, Commercial, Marketing, Data and other regional teams to improve agency readiness and remove barriers to investment.
- Represent the agency perspective within the Retail Media organization and help shape our longer-term go-to-market strategy.
Qualifications
- 10+ years experience within a leading media agency, agency holding company, commerce/media practice or closely related environment, ideally with regional APAC exposure.
- Strong understanding of how agencies operate, including media planning, investment decisions, client leadership, trading, programmatic and commercial models.
- Established senior relationships across the media agency ecosystem in APAC.
- Experience developing strategic partnerships and translating them into measurable commercial growth.
- Strong understanding of digital media, programmatic advertising and the evolving Retail Media ecosystem.
- Ability to operate strategically while remaining highly execution-oriented. This is a senior IC role with significant ownership, not a people-management position.
- Experience working across multiple APAC markets and navigating different levels of market maturity.
- Strong executive presence and ability to influence senior agency, advertiser and internal stakeholders.
- Commercial mindset with the ability to identify opportunities, build a pipeline and ultimately convert strategy into revenue.
- Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where the playbook is still being built.
Additional Information
What Success Looks Like
Success in this role means that agencies become a material and scalable growth channel for our Retail Media business in APAC & EU.
You will have built a clear regional agency strategy, established strategic relationships with priority agency groups, created repeatable market playbooks, increased the number of advertisers accessing our Retail Media solutions through agencies, and delivered measurable growth in agency-driven media investment.
Most importantly, you will help shift our relationship with agencies from campaign-by-campaign execution to strategic, recurring media partnerships.

Title: Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement Lead
Description:
Who are we?
Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries.
People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden.
Why Join Howden US?
At Howden, we’re not just building a business- We’re rewriting the rules of what a global insurance broker can be. And now, it’s your turn to be part of something extraordinary. From three people and a dog to over 22,000 employees across 56 countries, we’ve grown into a $4bn revenue powerhouse with bold ambition: to become a $13bn business with 40,000 people by 2030.
We’re launching our US retail platform with the same entrepreneurial spirit that’s driven our success worldwide- and we’re looking for trailblazers to help shape the future.
Why Howden?
You’ll Own It
With 6,000 employee shareholders owning 34% of the company, our unique ownership model means you’re not just joining a team—you’re building a business you truly own.
You’ll Be Empowered
We’re a destination for talent where people are trusted to look after their clients and grow together. You’ll have the freedom to lead, backed by global scale and local expertise.
You’ll Be Part of Something Bigger
Our integrated platform spans broking, reinsurance, and MGA capabilities—giving you access to everything you need to deliver for clients and build something remarkable
We have always been employee-owned and driven by entrepreneurial spirit. Right from the beginning, we've focused on employing talented individuals and empowering them to make a real difference to the company, whilst building successful and fulfilling careers at the same time. Simply put, we hire talented specialists and give them what they need to make a difference for clients. Always have, always will.
What is the role?
We are seeking a Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement Lead to support the design, documentation, and governance of end-to-end operational processes and target operating model elements across the US Retail business. This role will play a critical part in translating strategic change into clear, executable processes while ensuring appropriate controls are embedded.
Reporting to the Head of Continuous Improvement & Change, you will act as a hands-on process and standards leader – driving consistency, enabling scale, and reinforcing operational discipline across teams. This role is an exciting opportunity for a process leader who can translate strategic priorities into clear, governed, and executable ways of working.
What will you be doing?
Process Design and Standardization
Support the design, documentation, and maintenance end-to-end operational processes.
Develop clear SOPs, process maps, RACI models, and handoffs.
Ensure processes are scalable, repeatable, and aligned to business strategy and regulatory requirements.
Partner with business and functional leaders to simplify workflows and eliminate inefficiencies.
Process Governance
Help maintain clear process ownership, documentation, and change control standards.
Maintain process documentation and ensure updates are reflected accurately and consistently.
Define KPIs and partner with Operations on measurement and reporting.
Support audit readiness by ensuring processes are well-documented and consistently executed.
Adoption and Continuous Improvement
Ensure processes, SOPs, and controls are clear, complete and ready for adoption, partnering with Capability & Change on enablement.
Partner with Capability & Change to support enablement where process changes require training or reinforcement.
Identify improvement opportunities using operational data, performance metrics, and stakeholder feedback.
Partner closely with industry practice groups, Operations, Technology, and Learning & Development to align process designs with day-to-day execution.
Provide practical input to leaders and teams on process clarity, consistency, and operational readiness.
Key Skills & Competencies
Strong experience in process design, documentation, and governance within complex environments.
Experience in insurance brokerage, with a strong understanding of core brokerage and client service processes.
Ability to translate complex operations into clear, executable processes.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Highly collaborative, detail-oriented, and execution-focused.
Qualifications
8+ years of experience in process design, process governance, or operational excellence roles within an insurance brokerage or related financial service environment.
Strong understanding of brokerage operations, systems (e.g., Epic or other AMS), and core workflows (e.g., client service, policy administration, certificates, billing).
Proven ability to design, document, and govern end-to-end operational processes that improve efficiency, consistency, and control.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, or related field.
Lean, Six Sigma, or similar continuous improvement training is a plus.
Experience with process mapping and documentation tools is an advantage.
What do we offer in return? A career that you define.
Our business succeeds by allowing our people to make a mark in the areas they care about most: personal development, volunteering, and fundraising for charity, or creating new insurance products that address society’s greatest challenges.
And we know that separate home and work lives don't really exist. If you're happy and healthy at home, you're more likely to be happy and fulfilled at work – and vice versa. That's why we do our best to support our people in every aspect of their lives.
Compensation and Benefits
The expected base salary range for this role is $125,000 - $175,000; actual base salary will be determined based on factors including candidate experience and work location. This role is classified as exempt under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA).
In addition to a competitive base salary, employees are eligible to receive a discretionary bonus. Howden also offers a variety of benefits and programs, subject to eligibility, including:
Medical, dental, and vision insurance, including healthcare savings and reimbursement accounts
401(k) retirement plan
Flexible Paid Time Off and paid parental leave
Life and Disability insurance

Title: Producer
Description:
About Arkchetype
ARKCHETYPE is a Singapore-based creative studio.
We help organisations find the story within an idea, then work out the most compelling way to bring it to life.
For more than a decade, we’ve worked across industries and markets in the region, combining storytelling craft with production expertise across film, animation, design, photography and emerging creative technology.
As the boundaries between filmmaking, design and AI continue to shift, we’re interested in what new tools make possible - not for technology’s sake, but in service of better stories.
We’re looking for a Producer to join our team.
The Role
This is a role for someone who likes taking ownership.
You’ll run projects from brief to delivery - understanding what the client is trying to achieve, keeping people aligned, managing the moving parts and solving problems before they become bigger ones.
The work is varied. One project might be a brand film, another an animation or regional event production, and the next something we’re figuring out for the first time.
You don’t need to know everything from Day One. We can teach processes and parts of production.
What is harder to teach - and what matters to us - is good judgment, curiosity, follow-through and the instinct to take responsibility for getting something across the line.
What You’ll Do
Own and coordinate projects from briefing and pre-production through production, post-production and final delivery.
Manage schedules, budgets, resources, crews, vendors and project logistics.
Be a dependable day-to-day point of contact for clients, communicating clearly and professionally.
Keep projects moving and visible - knowing what’s happening, what’s pending, what comes next and what may be at risk.
Anticipate problems, surface them early and work out what needs to happen next.
Brief and coordinate creative, production and post-production teams, and translate client feedback into clear, actionable direction.
Develop the technical understanding needed to work effectively with editors, animators, filmmakers and other specialists.
Contribute to story and creative discussions where you have the interest and ability.
Explore AI and emerging creative tools and help us identify where they can genuinely improve the way we think, create and produce.
What We’re Looking For
We’re less concerned with having the perfect title, qualification or number of years on your CV than with how you think, work and learn.
You may be a good fit if you:
Have around 2–5 years of relevant experience in production, content, creative agencies, media or a related environment. Strong candidates outside this range are welcome too.
Take ownership and follow through without needing to be constantly chased.
Are organised, resourceful and able to keep multiple moving parts under control.
Communicate early when something is unclear, delayed or at risk.
Write and speak English confidently and professionally.
Can communicate effectively in Mandarin, as the role involves working with Mandarin-speaking clients and production partners in Greater China.
Understand that good client servicing is about clarity, judgment and trust - not simply passing messages between people.
Are curious about AI and emerging creative technology. You don’t need to know every platform, but you should want to experiment, learn quickly and think critically about where these tools add value.
Have enough humility to ask when you don’t know something and enough initiative to work things out.
Are comfortable speaking up when you see a better way, open to having your own thinking challenged in return, and able to move forward once a decision is made.
Experience with video production, post-production workflows, Premiere Pro, After Effects or other creative tools is useful, but you don’t need to be an editor or animator.
Formal qualifications matter less to us than demonstrated ability, judgment and attitude.
Working at Arkchetype
We’re a small team, so you’ll work closely with the founder and creative team and get exposure to much more than one narrow part of the production process.
There isn’t a large hierarchy to disappear into. Your contribution will be visible, and you’ll sometimes need to work beyond neat functional boundaries. In return, good work is noticed quickly too - and as you demonstrate capability and judgment, so will the responsibility you’re trusted with.
We value people who think for themselves. Speak up, question assumptions and bring a point of view - but be equally willing to have your own thinking challenged. Good ideas matter more than hierarchy, and once a decision is made, we move forward together.
Our normal working hours are 9:30am - 6:30pm, Monday to Friday. Production isn’t always predictable, and shoots, events or deadlines will occasionally require flexibility. We try to plan responsibly around normal hours and believe flexibility should work both ways.
This is primarily an in-person role, with a weekly work-from-home day where project requirements allow.
Compensation & Benefits
S4,000–S5,000 per month, depending on experience, capability and the level of responsibility you can independently take on
Annual performance bonus
Health insurance
Exposure to regional projects and clients
Hands-on learning across creative, production, client management and emerging AI workflows
Room to take on greater project, client and team responsibility as you grow
ARKCHETYPE PRODUCTIONS is a Singapore-based storytelling studio that helps organisations translate complex ideas into clear, compelling narratives. Combining craft in video production with photography, animation and advanced AI-driven techniques, the studio brings stories to life and helps brands connect meaningfully with audiences across the region.

Title: Product Life Cycle Manager, ROPU ASKAN
Description:
THE POSITION
The Product Life Cycle Manager, ROPU ASKAN is responsible for managing and coordinating the end-to-end SKU lifecycle across both Human Pharma and Animal Health businesses, from product launch and post-launch changes through to product withdrawal. The role ensures seamless execution of lifecycle activities through established governance processes and systems, including Product Review Meetings, CSC, SLCI, Product Readiness, and other applicable tools.
As the regional subject matter expert, the Product Life Cycle Manager maintains strong knowledge of both global and local product lifecycle management requirements and ensures alignment with relevant launch, change, and discontinuation processes. Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders, the role drives operational excellence, supports supply continuity, facilitates effective change management, and ensures products are introduced, maintained, and retired in a compliant and efficient manner across the ASKAN region.
Tasks & responsibilities
Coordinate product launch activities:
Manage SKU creation requests, business justification and cross-functional coordination for AH & HP within the respective computerized systems.
Maintain oversight through a consolidated database based on inputs from relevant functions, including Regulatory Affairs (RA), Commercial/Marketing, Quality and Supply Chain.
Coordinate SCM-related launch activities, including scenario planning, risk identification and stakeholder alignment to support launch timelines and readiness.
Participate as a member of the Launch Readiness Team and ensure SCM requirements and dependencies are addressed.
Coordinate product changes
Coordinate end-to-end implementation of product changes, including labelling and packaging changes, site transfers and other supply-related changes.
Maintain and manage the master transfer list to provide visibility of implementation status, timelines and key dependencies.
Align change management activities with key stakeholders, including Business Controllers, ROPU RA, ROPU Quality, local CSCM and other relevant functions.
Evaluate and manage opportunities for bundling of changes to optimize implementation and minimize operational complexity.
Coordinate complex changes across multiple countries, considering market-specific requirements, implementation timelines and supply constraints.
Manage Product Phase-Out, Discontinuation and Withdrawal:
Manage and coordinate the end-to-end product discontinuation and withdrawal process across multiple countries and functions.
Coordinate product discontinuation activities, including forecast deletion, SKU withdrawal, license/registration withdrawal and other related supply chain activities.
Coordinate the annual review of local initiatives for SKU portfolio optimization.
Provide visibility of withdrawal/discontinuation status, dependencies, risks and outstanding actions to relevant stakeholders.
Coordinate Multi-Country Redressing & Repacking
Coordinate multi-country redressing and repacking activities involving Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Commercial and other relevant stakeholders.
Manage cross-country requirements, timelines, quantities and dependencies to support effective execution.
Facilitate cross-functional and cross-country alignment to resolve operational issues and ensure timely implementation.
Drive Process Improvement, Automation & Digitalization
Identify and implement opportunities to improve and simplify Product Lifecycle Management processes.
Drive process automation and digitalization initiatives to reduce manual activities, improve efficiency and enhance data accuracy.
Develop and maintain dashboards and report solutions to improve visibility of lifecycle activities, milestones, risks and performance.
Drive continuous improvement based on operational experience, stakeholder feedback and lessons learned.
System, Process & SOP Ownership
Act as System and Process Owner for Product Lifecycle Management, covering the key processes of Product Launch, Product Change and Product Discontinuation/Withdrawal.
Own, maintain and continuously improve relevant SOPs, work instructions, process documentation and training materials.
Ensure process and system changes are appropriately incorporated into SOPs and supporting documentation.
Ensure consistent understanding and application of Product Lifecycle Management processes across users and markets.
Provide functional expertise and guidance related to Product Lifecycle Management systems, processes and governance.
Subject Matter Expert, Training & Capability Building
Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Product Launch, Product Change and Product Discontinuation/Withdrawal processes.
Provide expert process guidance and support to stakeholders and users across countries and functions.
Develop and conduct new-user training and onboarding covering Product Lifecycle Management processes, systems and applicable SOPs.
Provide ongoing user support, process clarification and refresher training as required.
Support users in resolving process and system-related issues and provide guidance for complex cases
Requirements
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Business Administration, Economics, Supply Chain Management or a related discipline.
Minimum 5 years of Supply Chain Management experience, preferably within pharmaceutical, OTC or FMCG industries, with experience in demand/replenishment planning, commercial SCM, packaging/artwork management and/or Product Lifecycle Management.
At least 2 years of people leadership experience and proven project management experience are preferred.
Strong understanding of end-to-end Product Lifecycle Management, covering Product Launch, Product Change, site transfers, phase-out, discontinuation and withdrawal.
Demonstrated experience in multi-country Product Lifecycle Management, with the ability to coordinate different market requirements, timelines and stakeholders.
Experience in multi-country redressing and repacking processes, including cross-functional coordination and execution.
Experience in system, process and SOP ownership, including process governance, documentation, standardization and continuous improvement.
Extensive SAP knowledge, particularly SAP APO.
Good understanding of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).
Strong project management capability and the ability to lead and influence cross-functional stakeholders across multiple countries.
Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills across functions and organizational levels, with the ability to drive alignment and follow-through.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to interpret information and reports and translate them into actionable insights.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in an ambiguous and changing environment.
Proficient in English.
APICS Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP) certification is preferable.

• Improve operational processes and workflows by standardising documentation, streamlining manual activities, and implementing scalable solutions that improve productivity and consistency.
• Support change management and user enablement through training programmes, process documentation, and stakeholder engagement to facilitate implementation and adoption.

Title: Product Owner / Assistant Product Owner
Description:
About discovermarket
discovermarket helps both the insurance industry and consumer-facing brands to digitize insurance distribution and operations end-to-end. We provide the infrastructure that empowers partners to embed insurance offerings into customer journeys. Our modular, API-driven technology and strategic partnerships deliver exceptional customer experiences and open new revenue streams.
About the role
We are looking for a
hands-on Product Owner / Assistant Product Owner who can turn partner needsinto clear, agent-ready specifications, and ship them
with an engineering team that builds with AI agents.
In this role, you will own the definition of platform capabilities, insurance propositions and partner journeys on our embedded insurance platform, from discovery through to production. You will have significant input into new propositions and platform features, working hand in hand with an engineering team that builds with AI agents.
At discovermarket, software is delivered through our Agent Development Lifecycle (ADLC): our approach to the SDLC in which AI agents help plan, build, test and review code, while people stay in control through human review and approval at each key stage. As Product Owner / Assistant Product Owner, you are the author of intent. You will write the requirements and specifications that our in-house Agent Development Kit (ADK) turns into plans and code, and approve the work at each gate.
What you will do
Own the product vision and roadmap for your platform area, working with partners, insurers and business specialists to balance today’s needs with future growth
Lead discovery workshops and interviews with partners and stakeholders to shape product strategy, value propositions, business cases and goals
Analyse and define customer and partner journeys across API, web and mobile touchpoints
Write agent-ready intent and specification artefacts, epics and stories with clear, testable acceptance criteria and non-functional requirements, supported by user flows and wireframes
Facilitate Scrum ceremonies (backlog refinement, sprint planning and estimation, daily stand-ups, showcases and retros)
Own and prioritise the product backlog, including decomposition, estimation and cross-team dependencies
Work hands-on within our ADLC: use ADK agents to author epics and break them down into stories and tasks, review agent-generated plans, and approve work at each human-in-the-loop gate
Partner with engineers on technical design, API contracts and trade-offs, using our platform knowledge base to ground requirements in how the platform actually works
Validate AI-generated output against intent and acceptance criteria before sign-off; you remain accountable for what ships
Plan and run UAT with partner stakeholders and drive launches through to production
Track outcomes after release (adoption, conversion, partner KPIs) and feed what you learn into the next iteration and into our ADK skills
Help define operating models for embedded insurance programmes across markets, in line with local regulatory requirements
Scout trends across embedded insurance, AI and competitors, and turn insights into product opportunities
Follow our security and data-handling rules when working with AI tools, keeping partner and customer data within approved tools
What we are looking for
4+ years as a Product Owner or Product Manager on B2B platform, API or SaaS products
Proven track record of executing product or platform strategy from discovery to launch
Experience working in multi-country, multicultural teams
Solid technical fluency: comfortable reading API specifications (REST/OpenAPI), discussing microservices and event-driven designs, and working with data
Customer-centric mindset, with hands-on experience creating customer personas, value maps and customer and user journey maps
Knowledge and hands-on experience in visual process modelling
Strong analytical skills across products, platform data and competitive intelligence

Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly with internal and external stakeholders

Title: Production Control Supervisor
Description:
MacGregor is a global company that operates in 30 countries with 2000 employees. We provide sustainable cargo and load handling with a strong portfolio of products, services, and solutions to the maritime and offshore industries. Our solutions are found in over half of the world's merchant fleet.
We believe MacGregor is a great place to work and we are looking for innovators with an international mindset to join our team and help us create lifetime value for our customers.
MacGregor – Let's shape the future together
Are you driven by problem-solving and inspired by complex engineering? MacGregor is hiring a Production Control Supervisor to manage the manufacturing and assembly of specialized offshore mechanical and hydraulic equipment. In this role, you will oversee primary fabrication and assembly operations—including welding, painting, machining, piping, and assembly—while ensuring all documentation and quality standards align strictly with project requirements.
Working closely with production teams, you will supervise the assembly of mechanical components and hydraulic circuits, leading rigorous testing and acceptance procedures such as pressure testing, system flushing, and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) according to the Inspection and Test Plan (ITP). Additionally, you will monitor and evaluate risks related to quality, cost, and schedule, delivering technical support and proactive risk mitigation to guarantee seamless installation and commissioning.
More tasks and responsibilities
Ensure suppliers adhere to MacGregor quality standards through active workshop presence, supervising mechanical assembly and hydraulic installations.
Follow up on and document quality issues, focusing on mechanical tolerances and hydraulic system integrity, while driving continuous improvement.
Collaborate closely with engineering to refine mechanical design, documentation and production efficiency
Perform comprehensive inspections of mechanical components (bearings, gears, pins), hydraulic assemblies (cylinders, power units, valve blocks), and final machinery, adhering to MGC holding points.
Verify hydraulic cleanliness levels (e.g., ISO 4406 standards) and ensure proper flushing procedures are followed prior to system activation.
Conduct FAT (Factory Acceptance Testing) inspections alongside Class surveyors and customers, specifically witnessing pressure tests and functional load tests.
Supervise mechanical fitters, hydraulic technicians, and test workers at supplier facilities to ensure best practices in assembly.
Provide technical production support to suppliers regarding complex mechanical alignments and hydraulic troubleshooting
Educate and train shipyards and subcontractors on the installation and piping of MacGregor hydraulic systems, including welding of high-pressure lines and proper hose routing.
Regularly audit supplier documentation, including material certificates (3.1/3.2), pressure test logs, and hydraulic flushing reports.
Review and follow up on final Manufacturing Record Books (MRBs) and FAT reports to ensure all mechanical/hydraulic deviations are resolved and documented
Provide input to progress reporting
Reporting directly to the Interim Global Manager, Quality Control and Installation & Commissioning‎, Offshore Solutions Division. The position will be based in MacGregor’s office in Singapore.
What you’ll need to succeed
The ideal candidate combines hands-on mechanical and hydraulic expertise with strong supervisory skills to oversee the manufacturing and assembly of specialized offshore equipment. You thrive in shop floor and supplier environments, taking a proactive approach to quality control, schedule compliance, and technical risk mitigation.
You are a disciplined contributor who excels at coordinating with engineering teams, suppliers, Class surveyors, and customers to ensure strict adherence to project specifications, FAT standards, and safety-critical quality benchmarks.
Ideally you have
Degree or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field (or equivalent extensive hands-on experience in maritime hydraulics).
Minimum 5 years’ experience in supervising mechanical assembly and hydraulic installations, preferably within the marine, offshore, or heavy machinery industries.
Knowledge of mechanical tolerances, fitments, and alignment techniques for large-scale maritime equipment.
Good understanding of hydraulic systems, including the ability to read and interpret hydraulic schematics
Proficiency in reading technical drawings and Manufacturing Record Books (MRB).
Strong problem-solving skills with a "hands-on" approach to troubleshooting mechanical or hydraulic issues on the shop floor.
Effective communication skills to act as the technical bridge between engineering, the supplier, and the customer. Competency in reading, writing and speaking English is required.
High attention to detail, specifically regarding precision measurements and safety-critical hydraulic connections.
Ability to work independently while spending a significant amount of time on-site at partner and supplier workshops.
Work location is primarily in Singapore however there may be a necessity to travel to China.
Why MacGregor?
Our people are behind every success. People create the technology and product lifecycle solutions that make us great, our people are the ones who innovate, and people drive our business forward. With us you will be part of an international collaborative working culture with challenges and opportunities to further develop yourself professionally.

Customer Success: Our customer's success is our success. We focus on partnership, transparency, and accountability to deliver lifetime value.
Passion to Improve: Always moving forward. We foster a growth mindset, encourage curiosity, and the courage to challenge the status quo.
Winning Together: No one makes the difference alone. We emphasise internal collaboration and mutual trust to ensure we win as "One MacGregor."
MacGregor is an equal opportunity employer. We recognise that diversity is key to our continued success, and strive to maintain a fair and equitable recruitment process for all applicants

Title: Project Officer (Project Coordination/Event Management/Administration)
Description:
Young and research-intensive, Nanyang Technological University (NTU Singapore) is ranked among the world’s top universities. The University combines technological strength with human creativity to address the significant challenges facing society, and draws its faculty and students from across the world.
The College of Humanities, Arts and Social Sciences (CoHASS) aims to be Asia’s leading centre for innovative, interdisciplinary humanities, arts and social science teaching and research. Its research priorities are Digital Culture and Society; Health, Culture and Society; Global Asia; and Art, Science and Ecology.
The Global Asia Research Centre (GARC) is a research centre within the College of Humanities, Arts and Social Sciences (CoHASS), Nanyang Technological University, Singapore. The Centre serves as a platform for interdisciplinary research and scholarly exchange on Asia and its global connections, bringing together academics, researchers, policymakers, and industry partners through research initiatives, conferences, workshops, seminars, and public engagement activities.
Through its research programmes and events, GARC facilitates dialogue on issues of regional and global significance, supports the dissemination of research findings, and fosters collaborations across institutions and disciplines.
For more information, please visit: https://www.ntu.edu.sg/hass/research/global-asia-research-centre
Globally ranked among top research and technology organizations in the environment and water domain, the NTU’s Nanyang Environment and Water Research Institute (NEWRI) ecosystem interacts across a multi- and inter- disciplinary platform of Research – engineering – Development (RED) activities in its approach to developing innovative solutions.
With leading edge technology and robust engineering, NEWRI strives to take its fundamental research from novel lab-scale innovation to industry-level translation and derisking activities - from field applications to piloting and development at full scale in real life settings. Through industrial and community- philanthropic projects for commercial and societal impact, NEWRI continuously strives to make a difference towards developing a circular economy for global sustainability.
For more details, please view https://www.ntu.edu.sg/newri
This is a joint appointment between the Global Asia Research Centre and the Mining Mineral Life project, housed at the Nanyang Environment and Water Research Institute (NEWRI). The Project Officer will contribute to the management and delivery of programs in the Global Asia Research Centre and the Mining Mineral Life: Extracting the Energy Transition in Southeast Asia research project. The role will be divided 60% on the Global Asia Research Centre and 40% on Mining Mineral Life. The role will be essential to the delivery of world class research programs and impact activities including organizing international conferences, seminars, fieldwork logistics.
At GARC, the candidate will join a team of the Director, the Deputy Director, and multiple Early Career Fellows. The centre also hosts Visiting Fellows and Visiting Professors.
On the Mining Mineral Life side, the candidate will join a team including the PI, two Research Fellows, and one PhD student. The team will also collaborate with artists and graphic designers on a program of scholarly and public facing artistic impact projects.
Key Responsibilities
- Coordinate the planning and execution of conferences, workshops, seminars, lectures, and other Centre-related events.
- Liaise with internal and external stakeholders to confirm event requirements, budgets, timelines, and deliverables.
- Manage venue bookings, travel arrangements, accommodation, transportation, catering, and other logistical requirements.
- Administer event registration platforms and maintain participant databases.
- Coordinate the preparation and dissemination of invitations, publicity materials, event websites, and email communications.
- Monitor project and event budgets, process procurement requests, and support financial administration activities.
- Liaise with vendors and service providers, including caterers, transport providers, photographers, and accommodation providers.
- Coordinate event setup, onsite operations, attendee registration, and troubleshoot operational issues during events.
- Manage photography, videography, and event recording arrangements where required.
- Prepare post-event reports, maintain project documentation, and support reimbursement and claims processing.
- Support website content updates and post-event publicity activities.
- Undertake other administrative and project-related duties as assigned.
- Assist in the delivery of international conferences at NTU and elsewhere by liaising with participants, facilitating travel arrangements, booking of rooms and spaces at NTU and beyond. Helping to facilitate during events, manage and arrange catering and other essential bookings.
- Assist with hiring and onboarding of new research staff and PhD students.
- Assist with fieldwork logistics for research team, including flights, accommodation, visa applications, budgeting, monitoring project accounts, facilitate local and overseas payments.

Educational Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Communications, Event Management, Project Management, Public Administration, Social Sciences, Humanities, or a related discipline.
Experience
- Experience in project coordination, event management, programme administration, or a related field is preferred.
- Experience in higher education, research administration, or academic environments would be advantageous.
Skills and Competencies
- Strong organisational and project coordination skills.
- Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Excellent stakeholder management and interpersonal skills.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
- Strong attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
- Experience with event management systems, website content management, or procurement platforms would be advantageous.

Established in 1976, Berkeley Group is a leading UK property developer, renowned for creating high-quality homes and distinctive places across London and the UK.

The Regional Business Development Manager is responsible for driving revenue and gross profit growth across the South Asia region in line with company-defined sales targets. Identify and develop new regional and multinational customers.

Title: Regional Business Development Manager - Asia
Description:
About the role
An established international education organisation is seeking an experienced Regional Business Development Manager to support its continued growth across Southeast Asia and selected Asian markets. Based in Singapore, this is a regional commercial role with responsibility for identifying new market opportunities, developing institutional partnerships and generating sustainable revenue across multiple countries. The successful candidate will work with a diverse portfolio of education, qualifications, training, digital credentials, academic pathways and professional learning solutions.
Key responsibilities
Developing new business across Southeast Asia and selected Asia markets.
Identifying and qualifying new institutional and commercial opportunities.
Building relationships with schools, colleges, universities, training providers, education groups, professional organisations and corporate partners.
Developing new partnership and distribution channels.
Managing opportunities from initial engagement through proposal, negotiation and successful close.
Growing existing institutional relationships and identifying opportunities for cross-selling and expansion.
Developing country and market-specific business development plans.
Maintaining a strong and well-qualified regional pipeline.
Working closely with academic, operations, marketing and leadership teams to develop commercially appropriate solutions.
Providing accurate sales forecasts and maintaining effective CRM records.
Requirement
Approximately 5–8 years or more of successful business development, partnerships or commercial experience.
Experience managing more than one geographical market or territory.
A strong track record in B2B or institutional sales.
Experience developing new business rather than solely managing existing accounts.
Confidence engaging senior decision-makers, including business owners, principals, directors, university representatives and senior executives.
Strong commercial negotiation and relationship-management skills.
Excellent written and spoken English.
Strong organisational skills and disciplined follow-through.
The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across different teams and markets.
Confidence using CRM systems, LinkedIn, digital research tools and AI-enabled business-development platforms.
Experience within any of the following would be advantageous:
International education.
Qualifications or awarding organisations.
Higher education.
Professional education or training.
EdTech.
Student recruitment.
Academic pathways.
Education partnerships.
Corporate learning.
Franchise, channel or distribution development.
Additional Asian-language capability, particularly Mandarin or Malay, would be advantageous but is not essential.
What We Are Looking For
We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate the ability to:
Enter and develop new markets.
Identify commercial opportunities independently.
Build credible relationships with institutional decision-makers.
Develop opportunities from initial contact through to contract.
Manage multiple markets and opportunities simultaneously.
Convert a strong pipeline into sustainable revenue.

commercially minded, proactive, resilient, resourceful and accountable for results
.

Pipeline development.
Qualified opportunities.
Institutional meetings.
Proposals and negotiations.
New partnerships.
Conversion rates.
Revenue generation.
Development of strategic regional accounts.

Work across a broad portfolio of education solutions.
Contribute directly to commercial strategy.
Take meaningful ownership of regional growth.

Title: Regional Business Leader APAC
Description:
If you desire to be part of something special, to be part of a winning team, to be part of a fun team – winning is fun. We are looking for a Regional Business Leader, Exertherm, in Eaton’s Electric business, based in Singapore. In Eaton, making our work exciting, engaging, meaningful; ensuring safety, health, wellness; and being a model of inclusion & diversity are already embedded in who we are - it’s in our values, part of our vision, and our clearly defined aspirational goals.
If you have sales experience in switchgear, transformers, switchboards, circuit breakers, and cable accessories/connectors, who have relationships with a similar pool of consultants and panel builders, please feel free to apply!
What you’ll do:
This role is responsible for driving regional business growth, customer satisfaction, and sales execution across the Asia Pacific region. The position leads market development, customer engagement, partner development, and adoption of Exertherm thermal monitoring solutions within targeted industries and critical infrastructure sectors.
Primary Responsibilities
• Define, plan, and implement the APAC regional sales strategy to meet business objectives.
• Drive business development, sales, training, and support activities to grow thermal monitoring solutions.
• Create, plan, and implement local sales, go-to-market, and strategic business development initiatives aligned with regional priorities.
• Drive achievement of sales targets and implement improvement plans when performance gaps are identified.
• Develop annual market development plans aligned to country market needs and the relevant OEM and partner landscape.
• Conduct market, customer, and competitor analysis to support forecasting and focused plans for segments, solutions, channels, and partners.
• Identify and evaluate opportunities with existing and prospective customers, combining the portfolio offering into value-based solutions.
• Build and maintain partner networks with OEMs, installers, and service partners, including key decision-maker relationships.
• Own strategy development for assigned vertical industries, including segment strategy, growth plan, and sales playbook creation in partnership with the APAC sales team and global marketing.
• Engage end users, consultants, and standards committees to present solutions in a technical context and increase awareness and adoption.
• Drive sales effectiveness through technical and commercial training, knowledge sharing, and cross-collaboration.
• Serve as a trusted advisor and advocate for electrical system health and thermal monitoring solutions.
Qualifications:
Education
• Master degree in electrical engineering, industrial engineering, computer science, business administration, or a related field, or equivalent degree-level experience.
Experience
• At least 10 years of experience in business development, sales, or technical product marketing.
• Experience in technical or commercial marketing and sales into industrial markets, ideally within electrification or power systems.
• Experience in heavy industry and/or critical infrastructure markets such as logistics centers, new energy, battery energy storage systems, airports, or hospitals.
• Strategic sales planning, regional market development, and business development.
• Customer relationship management and value-based solution selling.
• Market analysis, forecasting, and competitive assessment.
• Channel, OEM, installer, and service partner development.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; additional relevant regional language capability preferred.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office and customer relationship management systems, ideally HubSpot.
• Ability to identify improvement opportunities across own and adjacent functional areas.
Leadership Behaviors
• Collaborative team player with the ability to work independently when needed.
• Agile, confident, thoughtful, and open to bringing forward new ideas.
• Well organized, with the ability to plan workload and meet deadlines.
• Able to deliver projects to defined timescales.
• Detail-oriented, proactive, and collaborative.

Description:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences.

Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results.
Role: Regional Digital Project Manager
Location: Singapore
About the role:
Join our dynamic team as a Regional Digital Project Manager, where you'll be integral to delivering website, email and push content across multiple languages for our largest fashion client, based in APAC.
As Regional Digital Project Manager, you'll be accountable & responsible for all the regional client communication for content delivery. You will liaise with the client's team to accurately forecast, produce, and deliver the content across multiple channels (AEM, Push, Email) as per the defined SLA.

Unexpected turns energise you, and you take challenges head-on, inspiring your entire team to find solutions and stay the course. Your positive spirit keeps your sleeves rolled up, always ready to seize every opportunity.
You'll be the kind of person who is driven by managing large volume campaigns curating timelines and motivating your team ensure high quality delivered with maximum efficiency. You'll be confident with clients and can think on your feet. You relish in adding value throughout the end-to-end process, adding your unique touch at every turn.
Ideally, you'll have experience in large-scale accounts in FMCG industries, such as Beauty or Fashion and experience across multiple channels.

Serving as the primary point of contact and digital expert for clients throughout the lifecycle of a digital project is a key responsibility.

Regular communication of project status, both internally and externally, in accordance with agreed-upon account processes.
Produce estimates and timelines and measure progress of projects against those throughout the workflow.
Be able to verify the qualitative and quantitative output of a project against the project objectives.

Support the business to develop technical excellence by suggesting improvements to bring efficiency in the way or working and processes.
Fostering a collaborative and motivational environment to ensure team members remain focused on delivering high-quality work and feel supported is essential.

Ensuring accurate timekeeping and project status updates for both oneself and the team within MPC to facilitate data reporting for the client & Account Lead.

Excellent communication & Attention to detail

Competent user of Microsoft Office software, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint

Passion for and inquisitive about AI and new technologies

Company: Crane Worldwide Logistics S Pte Ltd
Title: Regional Director, Business Development, APAC
Description:
General Description
The Regional Director, Business Development, APAC is a senior individual contributor responsible for identifying, developing and securing new business opportunities across the Asia Pacific region.
Based in Singapore, the role will lead regional and cross-border commercial opportunities, develop relationships with multinational and regional customers, and deliver agreed revenue and gross-profit targets across air freight, ocean freight and related logistics services.
The position will work closely with country management, sales, pricing, product, operations and account-management teams to develop commercially competitive and operationally viable solutions. Although the role does not have direct reports, it is expected to provide commercial leadership and coordinate cross-functional pursuit teams across the region.
Essential Job Functions
Regional Business Development Strategy
Develop and execute business development plans aligned with the company’s APAC growth priorities.
Identify target markets, industry sectors and prospective regional or multinational customers.
Maintain awareness of market developments, competitor activity and regulatory changes that may affect commercial opportunities.
Provide market intelligence and recommendations to regional and country leadership.
Market Expansion and Client Acquisition
Identify, qualify and develop new business opportunities across assigned APAC markets, customer segments or industry verticals.
Build and maintain relationships with senior decision-makers within multinational corporations, regional companies and other prospective customers.
Lead the end-to-end sales process, including prospecting, needs assessment, solution development, proposal preparation, commercial negotiation and closing.
Develop tailored freight-forwarding and logistics solutions that meet customer requirements while delivering sustainable revenue and gross profit.
Maintain an active and credible pipeline sufficient to achieve agreed annual new-business targets.
Regional Opportunity Leadership
Coordinate regional and cross-border opportunities involving multiple Crane offices, products and functional teams.
Lead virtual pursuit teams comprising sales, pricing, operations, product and implementation stakeholders.
Establish clear ownership, timelines and deliverables for regional tenders, requests for proposals and other complex commercial opportunities.
Ensure appropriate handover of newly secured business to implementation, operations and account-management teams.
Support alignment on customer ownership and opportunity management to minimise overlap between regional and country commercial teams.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Work closely with country management, product, pricing, operations, account management and customer-service teams to develop commercially viable solutions.
Influence internal stakeholders without direct reporting authority to ensure timely and effective execution of commercial opportunities.
Share market intelligence, customer feedback and commercial best practices across the APAC region.
Support customer-retention and growth initiatives where regional business development involvement is required.
Commercial Negotiation and Partnerships
Lead commercial negotiations for significant regional and cross-border business opportunities within the appropriate approval authority.
Work with internal product teams to develop competitive and sustainable service solutions.
Identify potential commercial partnerships that may strengthen Crane’s service capabilities or market access.
Ensure that commercial commitments are appropriately reviewed and approved before being presented to customers.
Revenue Management and Reporting
Be accountable for agreed annual new-business revenue and gross-profit targets.
Maintain accurate opportunity, pipeline and forecast information within the company’s CRM and commercial reporting systems.
Monitor conversion rates, revenue performance, gross profit and other relevant commercial indicators.
Provide regular updates to regional leadership regarding pipeline development, business wins, risks and forecast performance.
Analyse market and customer information to support pricing decisions and commercial strategy.
Compliance and Operational Excellence
Maintain current knowledge of international trade regulations, customs requirements and relevant compliance obligations.
Ensure that proposed solutions and commercial commitments comply with company policies, approval requirements and applicable regulations.
Work with operations and product teams to confirm that proposed services are operationally viable and can be delivered consistently.
Promote appropriate service standards and customer-experience expectations throughout the business-development and implementation process.
Physical Requirements
Ability to communicate effectively in person, virtually and through written correspondence with internal and external stakeholders.
Ability to perform computer-based work for extended periods using standard office equipment and systems.
Sufficient visual ability to review detailed documents, commercial reports, presentations and digital information.
Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally for customer meetings, regional collaboration, industry events and other business requirements.
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.
Other Skills / Abilities
Strong knowledge of freight forwarding, including air freight, ocean freight and related supply-chain services.
Demonstrated ability to originate, develop and close complex business opportunities.
Strong commercial judgement, including understanding of revenue, gross profit, pricing and solution viability.
Ability to manage regional and cross-border sales opportunities involving multiple stakeholders and countries.
Strong influencing and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to lead cross-functional teams without direct authority.
Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-management skills.
Strong analytical ability and proficiency in CRM systems, Microsoft Office and relevant logistics or commercial platforms.
Ability to work independently and effectively within a fast-paced, competitive and geographically dispersed environment.
Fluency in English is preferred due to the regional responsibilities of the role.
Education And Experience
Bachelor’s degree in business, logistics, supply-chain management, international trade or a related discipline is preferred.
At least 10 to 12 years of relevant commercial or business-development experience within freight forwarding, logistics, transportation or supply-chain services.
At least five years of experience managing complex, regional or multinational business opportunities.
Demonstrated record of achieving revenue and gross-profit targets and securing significant new customers.
Experience developing business across multiple APAC markets is strongly preferred.
Proven experience negotiating commercial agreements and presenting solutions to senior customer stakeholders.
Previous experience in a senior individual-contributor, regional business-development or external Director-level role would be advantageous.
Certifications And Licenses
Relevant professional qualifications in logistics, supply-chain management, sales or international trade would be advantageous.

Subsea Navigation & Positioning

Naval defence
Maritime technology
Autonomous maritime systems
Subsea technologies

Complex defence or maritime systems

A strong understanding of naval procurement processes, defence programmes and complex sales cycles.
Experience selling sophisticated technical equipment, integrated systems or solutions.
A solid network within the APAC naval and maritime ecosystem.
Experience managing strategic accounts, partners and complex commercial negotiations.
Knowledge of autonomous maritime systems, underwater navigation, positioning or subsea technologies.
A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Marine Technology, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
Fluency in English. Additional APAC languages would be an advantage.

Commercially driven, with a strong ability to turn opportunities into long-term business.
Entrepreneurial and proactive, with a strong business development mindset.
Strategic, with the ability to navigate complex defence programmes and long sales cycles.
Technically curious, able to understand complex naval and subsea solutions.
A strong relationship builder, comfortable engaging with operational, technical, procurement and executive stakeholders.

Internationally minded, comfortable working across different cultures and with global teams.

Title: Regulatory Affairs / Government Affairs Specialist
Description:
We are seeking an experienced and proactive Regulatory Affairs / Government Affairs Specialist to join our Singapore-based regional hub.
The successful candidate will be responsible for regulatory registration and compliance activities across assigned Southeast Asian markets, while also building and maintaining relationships with regulatory authorities and government agencies. Over time, and subject to performance and readiness, the candidate will take on increasing responsibility, including team leadership and strategic government engagement.
We are looking for someone with strong regulatory expertise, a developing network within regulatory authorities across the region, and the capability to eventually lead the RA function and serve as the company's primary interface with government agencies and policymakers.
Key Responsibilities
Regulatory Affairs
Lead end-to-end regulatory registration activities for Class C medical devices across assigned Southeast Asian markets, including regulatory strategy, technical documentation, product testing, clinical evaluations, quality system documentation, and submissions.
Manage regulatory registrations, renewals, amendments, and change notifications for assigned markets.
Prepare and submit regulatory filings in accordance with the requirements of the assigned region(s).
Act as the primary liaison with regulatory authorities, notified bodies, and local registration partners to facilitate timely approvals and address regulatory inquiries.
Monitor submission timelines and proactively manage regulatory milestones to support product launches and lifecycle management.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date regulatory documentation, technical files, product registrations, and regulatory records.
Monitor changes to applicable regulations within assigned markets and assess their impact on existing and future products.
Government Affairs & Authority Engagement
Build and maintain constructive relationships with key regulatory bodies, including HSA (Singapore), MDA (Malaysia), Thai FDA, BPOM (Indonesia), Philippines FDA, and Vietnam MOH, among others.
Represent the company in industry associations, trade groups, and multi-stakeholder forums to advocate for favorable regulatory policies and harmonization initiatives.
Monitor and analyze the political, legislative, and regulatory landscape across assigned markets, providing strategic counsel to senior management on risks and opportunities.
Support advocacy efforts on key policy issues, including regulatory reliance programs, ASEAN harmonization initiatives, and market access reforms.
Prepare and deliver position papers, consultation responses, and policy briefs to government agencies and industry bodies.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategic Support
Collaborate closely with internal teams, including Quality Assurance, Clinical Affairs, Market Access, Commercial, and Legal, to ensure regulatory and quality compliance throughout the product lifecycle.
Provide regulatory guidance on product development, labeling, design changes, and market entry strategies.
Partner with Market Access and Government Affairs colleagues to align regulatory strategy with reimbursement and policy goals.
Support business development activities by providing regulatory due diligence and market entry assessments for new products or markets.
Serve as a subject matter expert on regulatory and government affairs matters for internal stakeholders.
Compliance & Documentation
Ensure all regulatory activities comply with applicable local, regional, and international regulations and standards.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date regulatory documentation, technical files, product registrations, and government engagement records.
Oversee the preparation and submission of regulatory filings, renewals, amendments, and change notifications for assigned markets.
Manage regulatory milestones and submission timelines to support product launches and lifecycle management.

Minimum 5-7 years of Regulatory Affairs experience within the medical device industry, with at least 1-2 years in a team leadership or management role.

Proven experience managing end-to-end product registrations, renewals, change notifications, and regulatory lifecycle activities across multiple Southeast Asian markets.

Excellent organizational, analytical, and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple regulatory submissions and government engagements simultaneously.

Title: Relationship Manager — Private Banker
Description:
About SeedRock
SeedRock Asia Pte. Ltd. is a Monetary Authority of Singapore regulated multi-family office and licensed fund manager (CMS100959), serving ultra-high-net-worth families and institutional clients across two practice pillars: Private Wealth and Family Governance, and Institutional Mandates.
Our positioning is deliberate: Institutional Sovereignty — the corporate office for your family. We exist to give UHNW principals the governance discipline, investment rigour, and institutional infrastructure ordinarily reserved for sovereign wealth funds and the largest endowments, applied at the scale of a single family or a small group of families.
SeedRock is independent. We hold no proprietary product, carry no distribution agenda, and answer only to the families and institutions that retain us. Our Relationship Managers are bankers in the fullest sense — trusted advisers entrusted with the totality of a client relationship — but they operate inside a firm built for permanence rather than a sales floor built for quarterly volume.
The Role
We are looking for an established private banking professional to join SeedRock as a senior Relationship Manager, bringing an existing, portable ultra-high-net-worth client base into a platform built specifically to serve that calibre of client without the conflicts of a balance-sheet bank.
This is a senior, client-facing mandate. You will be the primary point of contact for your principals, responsible for the full relationship: investment advisory, structured solutions, family governance conversations, and coordination with SeedRock's internal investment, risk, and compliance functions on your clients' behalf. You will operate with the autonomy of a private banker and the backing of an institutional platform.
The successful candidate will be someone for whom the move to SeedRock represents a genuine upgrade in client outcomes — not a lateral change of letterhead.
Key Responsibilities
• Manage and grow a portfolio of ultra-high-net-worth client relationships, acting as principal adviser across investment, credit, and family governance matters
• Migrate an existing portable client book (minimum USD 30 million) onto the SeedRock platform within an agreed onboarding period
• Originate and structure investment solutions in partnership with SeedRock's Investment and Strategic Finance and Risk functions, spanning discretionary mandates, structured products, and direct fund allocations
• Lead client conversations on family governance, succession, and institutionalisation — converting personal-relationship-based holdings into structured, multi-generational arrangements where appropriate
• Maintain full ownership of client suitability, KYC, and ongoing due diligence in coordination with Compliance
• Represent SeedRock's institutional positioning consistently — clients should experience continuity of judgement and process, not dependence on a single individual
• Contribute to the firm's broader institutionalisation agenda: converting personal trust into SeedRock-level trust through SMA structures, governance services, and multi-touchpoint client coverage
Candidate Profile
• A minimum of eight years' private banking or wealth management experience at a recognised institution, with a demonstrated track record managing ultra-high-net-worth relationships

Coordinate with product marketing on the development of short-term and long-term sales strategies, product introductions, new products and features, etc.
Plan & execute annual Technology Roadmap Meetings (TRM) at our key accounts to include customer executives as well as Bruker executives.

Establish and manage relationships with cross functional departments within BNSM Div. for product fulfillment, customer service, pricing, etc.

Use SalesForce.com as a sales tracking and forecasting tool
Travel requirements are approximately 30-50% of the work time.

Title: Sales Account Manager (Remote)
Description:
Job Description
About Us
We help interior design and renovation firms in Singapore grow — through lead generation, branding, and marketing programmes that bring them qualified homeowners and stronger market positioning. Our clients don't just buy a service from us once; they grow with us across tiers as their firms scale. That only works when someone closes the right clients — and then owns the relationship after the first close.
That someone is you.
About the Role
This is a fully remote role.
You'll work from wherever you work best — no daily commute, no office face-time. What matters is that your clients feel looked after and your accounts grow. You'll meet clients over video calls (with the occasional in-person session if a key relationship calls for it), and stay connected to the team through our daily rhythms online.
This is a closing role first, a relationship role always.
You'll start by building your own book of business: running sales conversations with interior design firms, diagnosing where their business is stuck, and closing them into the right programme. Every deal you close becomes an account you own — and from there, your job is to make each relationship deeper, longer, and more valuable over time.
The more you close early on, the bigger the portfolio you manage — and the more your recurring income compounds through renewals, tier upgrades, and referrals. You are the person our clients trust from the very first call, the one who checks in before they have to ask, and the reason they sign, renew, upgrade, and refer.
What You'll Do
Run discovery and sales calls with interior design and renovation firms — diagnosing their growth bottlenecks and closing them into the programme that fits
Manage your own sales pipeline end to end: qualification, follow-ups, objection handling, and closing, with clear monthly targets
Own every account you close as their primary point of contact and trusted advisor
Run regular check-ins and performance reviews with clients — walking them through their results, diagnosing bottlenecks, and recommending next steps
Drive renewals by ensuring clients see and understand the value they're getting throughout the programme, not just at renewal time
Identify and develop expansion opportunities — helping clients climb to higher programme tiers when their business is ready for it
Generate referrals naturally by building the kind of relationship people recommend to their peers
Work with our internal teams to resolve client issues quickly and keep promises made during the sales process
Maintain accurate account records, follow-up rhythms, and relationship health tracking in our CRM
Who You Are
2+ years in B2B sales, account management, or client success — with a track record of hitting sales targets and closing deals
A closer who thinks long-term: you know how to drive a deal to a decision, but you close clients you can grow, not just deals you can win
A natural relationship builder — the close is the start of the relationship, not the end of it
Consistent with follow-through: you do what you say, on time, every time
A clear communicator who can explain performance data and business concepts simply, in person and in writing
Commercially sharp — you can spot an upsell or referral opportunity without making the client feel sold to
Organised and self-directed: you manage your own portfolio, pipeline of renewals, and follow-up cadence
Proven ability to work independently in a remote setup — you stay responsive, structured, and visible without anyone looking over your shoulder
Bonus: experience in or exposure to the interior design, renovation, real estate, or home services industry
Why Join Us
100% remote
— you're measured on client outcomes, not hours at a desk
Base salary + commissions on every deal you close, plus recurring incentives on retention, renewals, and account growth — your income compounds as your portfolio grows
Build your own book of business from day one, backed by proven sales scripts, frameworks, and playbooks — you close it, you keep it, you grow it
Clear frameworks, playbooks, and training on how we sell, manage, and grow accounts
A front-row seat to how design and renovation businesses in Singapore scale

Title: Sales and Partnerships Executive
Description:
About King Fire
King Fire is a Singapore fire protection specialist providing solutions from supply and system integration to installation and maintenance. Our purpose is to help protect people, property and the places our communities depend on. We are bringing a range of fire safety products to Singapore’s business and consumer markets, with a focus on solutions to combat battery fires.
The Role
Start your sales career with a mission that matters. Help a business take action on battery fire safety, connect a community with practical product information, or open a conversation with an energy storage operator. Your work will turn awareness into opportunities to improve fire preparedness.
We are looking for a resourceful Sales and Partnerships Executive to help build this launch from the ground up. You will find new B2B customers, develop community partnerships and support B2C sales. Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) will be a specific market for you to explore alongside the technical team. Fresh graduates are welcome; curiosity, initiative and consistent follow-through matter.
Key Responsibilities
Open doors to B2B customers. Research prospects, identify decision-makers and start conversations through calls, emails, networking and visits. Find ways to reach potential buyers and turn first contact into qualified meetings.
Develop the BESS market. Identify energy storage developers, system integrators, operators and asset owners. Understand their needs, arrange introductions and bring in the technical team to assess appropriate fire safety solutions for batteries.
Build community partnerships. Reach out to community organisations, residents’ networks, associations and relevant partners. Propose product showcases, awareness sessions, group purchases and referral opportunities, and coordinate agreed activities.
Turn interest into sales. Understand customer needs, present approved product information, prepare quotations within agreed pricing and follow up through to purchase. Coordinate technical questions and proposals with the appropriate team.
Support the consumer launch. Engage customers at roadshows and community events, follow up on campaign enquiries and coordinate product demonstrations with the team.
Keep opportunities moving. Maintain accurate CRM records, next steps and follow-up dates. Work towards agreed sales and partnershipgoals, and share customer feedback with the sales, technical and marketingteams.
What You Will Bring
Awillingness to start. Fresh graduates are welcome. Previous full-time sales experience is not required; examples from internships, part-time work, student projects or volunteering are welcome.
Resourcefulness. You can research an unfamiliar market, find the right contact and try a different approach when the first one does not work.
Confidence with people. You enjoy starting conversations, listening carefully and explaining ideas clearly to business customers and members of the community.
Ownership and resilience. You follow through on commitments, stay organised and keep going when an enquiry does not immediately become a sale.
Interesting, purposeful work. You want to learn about fire safety, battery technologies and BESS, and understand how the right solution can address a customer’s needs.
A practical working style. You are comfortable with customer visits, outreach and events, as well as keeping records and coordinating with colleagues.
What We Offer
Purpose, you can see. Work on a product launch centred on protecting people and property and improving preparedness for battery fire risks.
Technical support when you need it. No technical background? Do not worry. Our technical team will support you with product questions, suitability assessments and demonstrations, so you can focus on building relationships and developing sales opportunities.
Experience from the start. Build practical skills in prospecting, customer conversations, quotations, sales follow-up and partnership development.
Exposure to different markets. Work with business customers, community partners and consumers, while exploring opportunities in BESS and battery fire safety.
Room to contribute. Bring ideas for reaching new customers and partners, test them with the team and see how your efforts contribute to the launch.
