Title: Sales Consultants (Remote)
Description:
Job Description
About Us
We help interior design and renovation firms in Singapore grow — through lead generation, branding, and marketing programmes that bring them qualified homeowners and stronger market positioning. Our clients don't just buy a service from us once; they grow with us across tiers as their firms scale. That only works when someone closes the right clients — and then owns the relationship after the first close.
That someone is you.
About the Role
This is a fully remote role.
You'll work from wherever you work best — no daily commute, no office face-time. What matters is that your clients feel looked after and your accounts grow. You'll meet clients over video calls (with the occasional in-person session if a key relationship calls for it), and stay connected to the team through our daily rhythms online.
This is a closing role first, a relationship role always.
You'll start by building your own book of business: running sales conversations with interior design firms, diagnosing where their business is stuck, and closing them into the right programme. Every deal you close becomes an account you own — and from there, your job is to make each relationship deeper, longer, and more valuable over time.
The more you close early on, the bigger the portfolio you manage — and the more your recurring income compounds through renewals, tier upgrades, and referrals. You are the person our clients trust from the very first call, the one who checks in before they have to ask, and the reason they sign, renew, upgrade, and refer.
What You'll Do
Run discovery and sales calls with interior design and renovation firms — diagnosing their growth bottlenecks and closing them into the programme that fits
Manage your own sales pipeline end to end: qualification, follow-ups, objection handling, and closing, with clear monthly targets
Own every account you close as their primary point of contact and trusted advisor
Run regular check-ins and performance reviews with clients — walking them through their results, diagnosing bottlenecks, and recommending next steps
Drive renewals by ensuring clients see and understand the value they're getting throughout the programme, not just at renewal time
Identify and develop expansion opportunities — helping clients climb to higher programme tiers when their business is ready for it
Generate referrals naturally by building the kind of relationship people recommend to their peers
Work with our internal teams to resolve client issues quickly and keep promises made during the sales process
Maintain accurate account records, follow-up rhythms, and relationship health tracking in our CRM
Who You Are
2+ years in B2B sales, account management, or client success — with a track record of hitting sales targets and closing deals
A closer who thinks long-term: you know how to drive a deal to a decision, but you close clients you can grow, not just deals you can win
A natural relationship builder — the close is the start of the relationship, not the end of it
Consistent with follow-through: you do what you say, on time, every time
A clear communicator who can explain performance data and business concepts simply, in person and in writing
Commercially sharp — you can spot an upsell or referral opportunity without making the client feel sold to
Organised and self-directed: you manage your own portfolio, pipeline of renewals, and follow-up cadence
Proven ability to work independently in a remote setup — you stay responsive, structured, and visible without anyone looking over your shoulder
Bonus: experience in or exposure to the interior design, renovation, real estate, or home services industry
Why Join Us
100% remote
— you're measured on client outcomes, not hours at a desk
Base salary + commissions on every deal you close, plus recurring incentives on retention, renewals, and account growth — your income compounds as your portfolio grows
Build your own book of business from day one, backed by proven sales scripts, frameworks, and playbooks — you close it, you keep it, you grow it
Clear frameworks, playbooks, and training on how we sell, manage, and grow accounts
A front-row seat to how design and renovation businesses in Singapore scale

Represent the voice of the Asia market by providing customer and market insights that influence business strategy.

12+ years of progressive sales experience within enterprise software, SaaS, IT, security, networking, infrastructure, or related technology markets, including significant sales leadership responsibility.
Demonstrated success leading geographically dispersed sales teams and delivering consistent revenue growth.
Extensive experience with complex two-tier distribution and channel sales models.
Strong executive presence and the ability to influence customers, partners, employees, peers, and senior leadership.
Experience strengthening or transforming sales organizations through coaching, operational discipline, and sales process excellence.
Strong commercial, financial, and strategic business acumen.
Experience developing regional go-to-market strategies and leading cross-functional execution.
Deep understanding of Asian markets and the cultural and commercial differences across Asia, Korea, and Japan.
Passion for developing people and building a high-performance culture rooted in accountability and collaboration.

You are an authentic, visible, and commercially minded leader who combines strategic thinking with operational discipline. Because at Milestone, we grow together!

Description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We're a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.
We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.
To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.
Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.
If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can't wait to meet you.
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
Braze is seeking an experienced Commercial Sales Director to drive our mid-market business across Asia. This is a GTM leadership role responsible for driving the next phase of growth, performance acceleration, and operational excellence across a diverse, multi-market region.
You will lead a team of Commercial Account Executives focused on delivering high-value engagements for Braze's market-leading Customer Engagement platform. This role requires a leader who combines strong commercial instincts with disciplined execution, deal strategy expertise, and a passion for developing high-performing teams.
The ideal candidate brings at least 5 years of deep experience leading Commercial sales teams in high-growth, competitive environments across Asia. You have successfully scaled performance, strengthened operating rigor, and driven measurable acceleration in complex markets. You understand the nuances of selling into Southeast Asia and the Greater China region, and you are comfortable engaging C-level stakeholders across industries.
This role requires urgency, accountability, and a commitment to raising the bar, while building an inclusive, high-performance culture across diverse markets.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Build, lead, and elevate a high-performing team of Commercial Account Executives across Asia
Establish operational rigor and drive execution against ambitious Financial Year revenue objectives, accelerating both net-new acquisition and expansion within strategic accounts
Strengthen enterprise deal strategy, including multi-threading, executive engagement, and value-based selling in complex environments
Coach with intensity and purpose, raising performance standards while developing future leaders within the organization
Collaborate with Go-to-Market teams including SolCon, BDR, Marketing, Partnerships and Executives to ensure the successful execution of the FY plan and represent a clear, single vision to customers and the marketplace
Represent Braze in customer, partner, and industry forums as a trusted enterprise advisor
Plan and manage at both the strategic and operational levels
Be a proactive voice within our APAC and global sales leadership team
WHAT YOU HAVE
5+ years of experience successfully leading quota-carrying Commercial Account Executives in a high-growth SaaS environment
A proven track record of exceeding revenue goals and driving measurable performance improvement across teams
Demonstrated experience leading diverse, multi-cultural team across multiple Asian markets
Expertise in complex sales cycles, including large deal negotiation, executive alignment, and long-term account expansion
A strong track record of recruiting, developing, and retaining high-performing sales people
A proven ability to build connections with Executives, industry subject matter experts and various customer profiles
Experience collaborating cross-functionally across regional and global stakeholders
Strong commercial negotiation skills and executive presence
Prior experience in Marketing Technology or related enterprise SaaS categories is highly preferred
WHAT WE OFFER
Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.
From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:
Competitive compensation that may include equity
Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans
Flexible paid time off
Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave
Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend
A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching
Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze
Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®
ABOUT BRAZE
Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.
The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 "Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product" in 2025.
Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America's Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore.
The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.
BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER
At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.
Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you.
We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we'd love to meet you

Title: Sales Executive (F&B Business Development)
Description:
Sales Executive (F&B Business Development)
Foodmax | Singapore | On-site (with regular field visits) | Full-time
Seniority Level: Associate | Job Function: Sales, Business Development | Industry: Food and Beverage Services
About Foodmax
Foodmax is a technology-driven fresh food supply chain platform in Singapore that offers F&B businesses a one-stop ingredient sourcing solution. Through the Foodmax app, customers can order a full range of food products, including meat, poultry, eggs, vegetables, fruits, packaged goods and dry goods, quickly and reliably.
About the Role
We are looking for a results-driven Sales Executive to grow our F&B customer base in Singapore. Your main focus will be acquiring new F&B customers and getting them to download the Foodmax app and order through it. You will also handle after-sales service, collections and ongoing account management so that customers keep ordering more over time.
Key Responsibilities
New Customer Acquisition
Acquire new F&B customers, including restaurants, cafés, hotels, food court and hawker stalls, central kitchens, and catering companies, and achieve your individual sales and acquisition targets.
Generate leads through field visits, cold calls, referrals and industry events. Learn each customer's menu, purchasing categories, volumes and current suppliers, and recommend suitable products and pricing.
Get customers to download and register on the Foodmax app, support their first order, and train them to order on their own.
Account Management & Growth
Build long-term relationships with existing customers through regular check-ins, and increase their repeat orders and ordering frequency.
Encourage customers to expand from one category to the full range of products, increasing their spend and Foodmax's share of their purchasing.
Spot customers whose orders are dropping or who may leave, follow up early and put plans in place to win them back.
After-Sales Service & Issue Resolution
Act as the customers' main point of contact for issues such as product quality, specifications, stock availability, wrong or missing items, and delivery timing.
Work with the Quality Control, Procurement, Warehouse, Logistics and Customer Service teams to handle returns, replacements and credit notes, make sure each issue is fully resolved, and update the customer.
Gather customer feedback on products, pricing and service, and share it internally to drive improvements.
Collections & Credit Management
Track customer payment terms and statement reconciliation to make sure payments come in on time.
Follow up on overdue payments and work with the Finance team to recover outstanding amounts and reduce bad-debt risk.
Assess the creditworthiness of new customers and flag high-risk accounts early.
Reporting
Keep customer records, visit notes and pipeline updates current in the CRM or sales system.
Track your performance on new customers acquired, active ordering customers, sales revenue, repeat order rate and collection rate.
Report regularly on your progress and on market conditions, including competitor activity and pricing.
Requirements
At least 3 years of sales experience in the HORECA or F&B industry. Experience in food distribution, fresh food supply chain, FMCG or B2B ordering platforms is preferred.
An existing network of F&B customers in Singapore is a strong advantage.
A proven track record in new business development, with the drive to prospect and cold-call, resilience and a results-oriented mindset.
Good understanding of F&B purchasing needs. Familiarity with meat, poultry, eggs, fresh produce and dry goods is a plus.
Experience in after-sales issue handling, account reconciliation and payment collection, with the ability to work across teams to resolve problems.
Familiar with CRM or sales tracking tools. Experience getting customers to adopt an app or online ordering platform is preferred.
Strong communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills, and able to work independently.
Proficiency in Mandarin and/or Malay is an advantage, as the role serves F&B customers from diverse language backgrounds.
Willing to travel frequently for customer visits. A valid driving licence and own vehicle are an advantage.
What We Offer
Competitive base salary plus performance-based commission
Growth opportunities in a fast-growing food-tech company
A full product range and digital ordering tools that make selling easier
A collaborative, results-driven team culture
We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

You will handle bulk and distributor accounts as well as retail customers, support orders from enquiry to delivery and payment, and be a dependable point of contact for our customers.

* Manage wholesale accounts and standing orders, and follow up on repeat purchases and payment collection
* Support product trials and demonstrations to help customers see the results of our fertilizer
*Retail*
* Manage and grow retail channels such as garden centres, nurseries, retail shops, online platforms and events
* Handle retail enquiries and orders, and coordinate stock and fulfilment with the Operations team
* Support retail promotions, events and product demonstrations, and share product information with end-users
*Ownership and Initiative*
* Take full ownership of the assigned accounts, leads and sales targets, from first contact to payment collection
* Proactively source new leads and opportunities through their own research, outreach, referrals and events, without waiting to be assigned, while staying aligned with management directions, target markets and priorities
* Follow up on every enquiry and open deal on your own initiative, and flag problems and risks early, along with proposed solutions
* Propose ideas to improve sales, such as new customer segments, channels, promotions or pricing, and carry them out once agreed with the Manager and/or CEO
* Report progress, challenges and plans to the Sales Manager and/or CEO regularly, and seek guidance on major pricing, contract and strategy decisions
*General*
* Maintain accurate customer records, sales data and pipeline updates in the CRM, and report sales progress to the Sales Manager and/or CEO
* Coordinate with the Operations Executive on stock availability, production schedules and delivery timelines
* Gather customer feedback, market intelligence and competitor pricing, and share it with the team
* Assist in preparing sales collateral, presentations and product information, and support exhibitions and customer visits

* 1–2 years of sales experience (B2B and/or B2C); fresh graduates with strong potential are welcome to apply
* Experience in fertilizers, agri-inputs, gardening, FMCG or distribution is an advantage
*Skills*
* Strong communication and negotiation skills, and comfortable dealing with both trade and retail customers
* Self-starter with a strong sense of ownership: takes initiative, is accountable for results, and does not wait to be told what to do
* Persistent in following up, well organised, and able to manage multiple accounts and orders at once
* Proficient in Microsoft Office; experience with CRM or e-commerce platforms is an added advantage
* Interest in sustainability, agriculture and the circular economy

Title: Sales Manager
Description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION
Who we are
Constellar is a leading venue management group in the Meetings, Incentives, Conventions and Exhibitions (MICE) sector, based in Singapore. With deep expertise in operations, facilities, event delivery and customer experience, Constellar partners international organisers, MICE stakeholders, local businesses and communities to transform spaces into seamless, scalable and memorable experiences. The company manages Singapore EXPO, the nation's largest purpose-built MICE hub and Asia's most sustainable MICE venue, powered by renewable energy.
Our vision is to be a leading and trusted venue management operator, partnering organisations to deliver high-quality event experiences and operate world-class event spaces. We do this by managing best-in-class MICE venues, including Singapore EXPO, and delivering reliable, seamless operations that support events of scale and significance.
Learn more about us at constellar.co.
What it's like to work here
Meetings, Incentives, Conventions and Exhibitions, or MICE, is a vehicle for new businesses, partnerships. We are privileged to have a front seat at the intersection of creativity, communities and collaboration, with a unique opportunity to connect a global eco-system of partners, businesses and consumers in the MICE industry daily. Our ambition is to become a global leader made in Asia, and Asia's top MICE company: A vision shared by our shareholders Temasek and Cuscaden Peak Investments.
We recognise the immense opportunity we have to lead with purpose, demonstrate leadership and commitment to sustainable and responsible business practices, and activate impactful networks for sustainable growth.
You don't need to have MICE experience to work with us. We're looking for ambitious, entrepreneurial self-starters with a strong sense of ownership, passion and curiosity, driven by our values of care, ownership, trust, passion and innovation.
RESPONSIBILITIES
The Sales Manager is responsible for driving revenue growth through the development of new business opportunities and the effective management of existing client accounts. Acting as a trusted advisor to clients, the role focuses on understanding business objectives, identifying event and venue requirements, and delivering tailored solutions that maximise value and customer satisfaction.
Working collaboratively with internal stakeholders including Event Management Services and Operations, the Sales Manager oversees the full sales lifecycle from lead generation and opportunity qualification through contract negotiation, event delivery, and post-event relationship management.
Approximately 70% of the role is dedicated to managing and growing an assigned portfolio of existing accounts, while 30% focuses on business development and securing new revenue opportunities.
Manage and grow a portfolio of existing client accounts to achieve revenue and retention targets.
Identify, develop, and secure new business opportunities to expand market share and drive revenue growth.
Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline through proactive prospecting, networking, referrals, and relationship management.
Develop and deliver customised sales proposals, presentations, and venue solutions that address client needs.
Lead commercial discussions, contract negotiations, and business reviews with clients.
Serve as the primary point of contact throughout the sales and event lifecycle, ensuring a seamless customer experience.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure successful event delivery and client satisfaction.
Maintain accurate sales forecasts, pipeline updates, customer records, and activity reports within the CRM system.
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer insights to identify growth opportunities.
Ensure compliance with company policies, contractual obligations, and sales governance requirements.
Undertake other duties assigned by the Reporting Officer from time to time.
QUALIFICATIONS
Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Business, Marketing, Hospitality, Events Management, or a related discipline.
Minimum 5 years of experience in Sales, Business Development, Account Management, or Venue/Events Sales, with a proven track record of achieving sales targets.
Experience in the MICE, events, exhibitions, or venue management industry will be advantageous.
Experience managing key accounts and developing long-term client relationships.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and CRM systems.
Willingness to travel for client meetings and work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, when required.

Join Us at VIZZIO.AI – Where Extraordinary Happens!
Are you driven by ambition and the desire to achieve greatness? We're seeking passionate individuals who are ready to make an impact.
About Us:
VIZZIO Technologies Pte Ltd is a leading company based in Singapore that specializes in mapping and modeling cities into high fidelity 3D models. Using an AI automated pipeline, VIZZIO generates dimensionally accurate and geo-specific parametric and 3D digital twins from satellite and street images, videos, and point clouds. With 89 3D cities mapped to date, covering over 29.4 million square kilometers of land area, VIZZIO aims to create a digital twin of the entire planet Earth for various applications such as simulation, visualization, urban planning, smart city initiatives, and security& defense.
POLYTRON.AI, a subsidiary of VIZZIO, leads the way in AI-powered LIVE 3D™ camera technology with a patented special-purpose embedded chip that generates "360 3D Video," creating real-time virtual spaces.
Together, we are here to revolutionize real-time 3Dtechnology. Our goal is to push the boundaries of real-time 3D visualization, offering innovative tools that enhance user experience and operational efficiency across various industries.
Role Purpose:
VIZZIO is seeking a commercially driven, entrepreneurial Growth Manager to develop new business, grow strategic customer relationships, and contribute directly to revenue and market expansion. The role sits at the intersection of business, technology and relationships — you do not need to be an engineer, but you must be technology- and AI-savvy enough to understand emerging solutions and articulate their business value with confidence. This is a role for someone who creates opportunities rather than waits for them.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Sales Competencies
Identify, develop and pursue new business across VIZZIO’s target industries and markets, building a qualified pipeline through prospecting, referrals, partners and industry engagement
Lead consultative, solution-based selling — diagnose the customer’s real business problem, build compelling value propositions, proposals and business cases, and manage negotiation through to contract closure
Maintain disciplined pipeline ownership, accurate CRM records and reliable forecasting; meet or exceed agreed sales, pipeline and revenue targets
2. Account Management
Build trusted relationships across customer organisations — from operational and technical stakeholders through to senior management and C-suite
Develop structured account plans for priority customers and strategic prospects, and identify cross-sell, upsell and expansion opportunities within existing accounts
Sustain durable engagement beyond individual deals, coordinating closely with Pre-Sales, Product, Engineering and Delivery so that customer commitments are realistic and are kept, through to a smooth handover into delivery
3. AI & Technology Savvy
Maintain strong working fluency in AI, Generative AI, Computer Vision, Digital Twins, 3D/geospatial and cloud/enterprise technologies relevant to VIZZIO’s business
Translate technical capability into business outcomes customers can act on — credible in both boardroom and technical conversations
Use AI tools productively in day-to-day selling — account research, market analysis, proposal development and meeting preparation — and continuously build personal knowledge of emerging technology relevant to VIZZIO’s markets
Experience & Qualifications:
3–7+ years in B2B/enterprise sales, business development, key account management or solution selling, with a demonstrated record of revenue growth
Experience managing a structured pipeline and CRM discipline across multiple concurrent opportunities; strong executive presence and communication skills
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Technology or a related field preferred (equivalent commercial experience considered in lieu)
Prior exposure to AI, Digital Twins, Computer Vision, SaaS, smart infrastructure or complex B2B technology sales is advantageous; APAC/EMEA market experience is a plus
What Success Looks Like:
A trusted and growing portfolio of customer relationships, a healthy and credible pipeline, and the ability to represent VIZZIO confidently in conversations spanning both business and technology.

The Sales Manager will be responsible for driving revenue growth, account expansion, and managed services adoption across new and existing customers. Revenue Growth & Target Ownership:

Position Hubb IT's managed services, cloud, cybersecurity, infrastructure, circular IT, and workflow solutions to help clients reduce operational risk and improve responsiveness.

Manage the full client relationship—from initial discovery and proposal shaping to contract negotiation, onboarding, and structured periodic account reviews.

Collaborate with System Integrators, MSPs, vendors, and distributors to build joint go-to-market opportunities and execute partner-led sales motions.

Mandatory Background:
Prior experience working in or selling for a System Integrator (SI) environment is mandatory.
Managed Services Sales Experience:
Experience selling managed IT services, cybersecurity services, cloud migration, cloud operations, infrastructure support, endpoint management, backup and recovery, or helpdesk services.
Technical Domain Understanding:
Strong understanding of cloud solutions, infrastructure, systems, cybersecurity, endpoint environments, networks, servers, and service delivery models.
Account Management & Value Selling:
Good account management capability beyond one-time product transactions, with the ability to sell business outcomes rather than only hardware specifications, software features, or price discounts.
End-to-End Sales Acumen:
Strong sales acumen including prospecting, discovery, objection handling, proposal positioning, negotiation, closing, and account expansion.
Stakeholder Engagement:
Comfort engaging both business and technical stakeholders with strong communication, presentation, proposal writing, and follow-up discipline.
Execution & Reporting Hygiene:
Mandatory CRM discipline and weekly reporting discipline.
Behavioural Expectations:
Self-driven, mature, target-oriented, accountable, and comfortable working in a growth-stage environment.
Good to Have (Preferred Experience)
Business Development (Prospecting):
Proven ability to build industry networks, self-generate leads, and uncover new business opportunities across new accounts and ecosystem channels.
Established Executive Network:
Existing network across SMEs, mid-market customers, technology partners, SI/MSP ecosystem, or vendor communities.
Cross-Functional Team Collaboration:
Experience working with proposal, pre-sales, solution architect, project delivery, or service desk teams.
Framework & SLA Knowledge:
Knowledge of ITIL-aligned service delivery, service level agreements, recurring revenue models, and customer success governance.

Open to former L2 Engineers or Systems Specialists looking to transition their technical foundation into commercial sales.
Must possess excellent communication skills: interpersonal skills, active listening, and the communication confidence to engage C-suite and IT decision-makers.

Dedicated company support for paid professional upgrading, relevant technical certifications, and sales performance courses to sharpen your skill set.
Growth Opportunity:
Opportunity to build and scale a managed services business with strong growth ambitions.
Broad Solution Exposure:
Exposure to cloud, cybersecurity, infrastructure, systems, workflow, and partner ecosystem opportunities.
Direct-to-Management:
Direct collaboration with senior leadership and internal teams to shape customer and partner outcomes.
Practical Culture:
A practical, accountable, and forward-looking environment for sales professionals and technical specialists who want to grow beyond standard product selling.
Remuneration Structure
Fixed Salary Base:
Competitive monthly fixed base salary + CPF contributions.
Performance Bonus:
Performance-based sales bonus awarded upon achieving agreed sales KPIs and revenue targets.

Title: Sales Manager Asia
Description:
Location: Singapore, Singapore
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
In Singapore, Thales has been a trusted partner since 1973, originally focused on aerospace activities in the Asia-Pacific region. With 2,000 employees across three local sites, we deliver cutting-edge solutions across aerospace (including air traffic management), defence and security, and digital identity and cybersecurity sectors. Together, we’re shaping the future by enabling customers to make pivotal decisions that safeguard communities and power progress.
Context (challenges, specific issues):
The position is based in Singapore with regional responsibility across Asia.
Responsible for developing business in diverse Asian markets, each with different customer requirements, competitive environments, procurement practices and regulatory considerations.
Requires effective navigation of the Business Line/DGDI matrix organisation, with the ability to influence and align stakeholders across organisations without direct hierarchical authority.
Requires the ability to identify, shape and capture opportunities at an early stage and translate customer needs into viable business opportunities for Thales.
Requires strong commercial judgement, customer relationship skills and the ability to manage complex, long-cycle opportunities involving multiple internal and external stakeholders.
Requires the ability to operate effectively in a multi-cultural environment and to engage confidently with senior customers, government stakeholders, partners and industry leaders.
Missions and responsibilities:
Regional Sales Development
Own and drive sales activities (with Sales Consultants) for opportunities across Asia, in alignment with Business Line strategy.
Take ownership of key opportunities from early identification and qualification through capture, bid, negotiation and contract award.
Develop and maintain clear opportunity/sales strategies & plans, capture plans, win themes, stakeholder maps and customer engagement strategies for strategic pursuits to achieve Order Intake and growth objectives.
Apply left-shift principles to shape opportunities early and influence customer requirements, procurement strategies, solution definition and partner ecosystems.
Build, maintain and continuously develop a strong and clear opportunities pipeline by identifying new customers, markets, opportunities and business models.
Qualify and prioritise opportunities based on strategic value, probability of success, competitive position and required resources.
Lead commercial engagement and negotiations within delegated authority and in accordance with Thales governance requirements.
Contribute directly to the achievement of regional Order Intake, pipeline and business objectives.
Customer & Market Engagement
Establish and maintain strong relationships with senior stakeholders across Air Navigation Service Providers (ANSPs), aviation authorities, airports, airlines, government agencies and other relevant aviation and industry organisations.
Lead customer engagements, meetings and presentations for assigned opportunities and represent the AMS Business Line at an appropriate senior level.
Develop a strong understanding of customer strategies, operational requirements, procurement priorities and decision-making processes, translating customer insight into actionable business opportunities.
Work closely with Country Directors and Key Account Managers to ensure coordinated and effective customer engagement.
Build and maintain a strong network across aviation, government, industry, suppliers, technology partners and academic institutions.
Provide market intelligence and competitive insight to support regional strategy, opportunity positioning and Business Line decision-making.
Opportunity Capture, Bid & Negotiation
Lead or co-lead capture activities for strategically important opportunities, coordinating Business Line, country and functional stakeholders.
Develop and maintain capture plans, opportunity strategies, customer engagement plans and competitive positioning.
Work closely with Bid Management, Engineering, Product Management, Finance, Legal, Contracts, Procurement and other stakeholders to develop compelling, competitive and commercially sound offers.
Ensure appropriate governance, quality, commercial discipline and adherence to critical timelines throughout the opportunity lifecycle.
Identify key risks, dependencies and resource requirements at an early stage and escalate appropriately to the Regional Sales Director and relevant Business Line management.
Develop and manage strategic partnerships and local industrial relationships, in cooperation with DGDI Country organisations, to strengthen Thales' competitive position and probability of success.
Business Line / DGDI Matrix Collaboration
Develop effective working relationships with the DGDI Country organisation to align Business Line opportunities with country strategies and priorities.
Work closely with Country Directors and local teams to coordinate customer engagement, opportunity development, partnerships and market access.
Ensure appropriate alignment of roles, responsibilities and priorities between the Business Line and DGDI Country organisations throughout the sales and capture lifecycle.
Influence and mobilise stakeholders across the matrix to achieve common business objectives without relying on hierarchical authority.
Facilitate effective sharing of customer insight, market intelligence, opportunity strategies and best practices across the relevant organisations.
Identify opportunities for collaboration with other Thales Business Lines where this can strengthen customer value propositions and create additional business opportunities.
Pipeline, Forecasting & Commercial Performance
Own the quality, accuracy and development of the assigned regional sales pipeline.
Ensure opportunities are properly qualified, prioritised and regularly updated in accordance with Thales processes.
Provide regular pipeline reviews, sales forecasts, opportunity assessments and business updates to the Regional Sales Director and relevant Business Line management.
Monitor performance against Order Intake, pipeline and business objectives and proactively develop corrective actions where required.
Ensure sales activities and opportunity development remain aligned with Business Line strategic priorities and relevant country business plans.
Maintain appropriate commercial discipline throughout the sales process, including accurate forecasting, opportunity qualification and reporting.
Compliance, Ethics & Integrity
Conduct all sales, business development, customer engagement and commercial activities in full accordance with Thales compliance policies, procedures, ethical standards, integrity principles and applicable laws and regulations.
Ensure that commercial objectives are pursued within the compliance and ethical boundaries established by Thales, without compromising the company's integrity standards.
Exercise sound judgement in identifying potential compliance, ethical or integrity risks and ensure that such matters are appropriately raised and escalated through the established Thales processes.
Ensure that relationships with customers, partners, suppliers and other external stakeholders are managed in accordance with applicable Thales policies and governance requirements.
Maintain a strong culture of integrity and responsible business conduct throughout all opportunity and customer activities.
Strategic Partnerships & Business Development
Identify, assess and develop strategic partnerships, alliances and local industrial relationships that can strengthen Thales' market position and support business growth.
Work with DGDI Country organisations and Business Line stakeholders to develop sustainable ecosystems around strategic opportunities.
Identify new markets, adjacent opportunities and longer-term growth opportunities for Airspace Mobility Solutions in Asia.
Develop relationships with key industry, government, technology and institutional stakeholders that can support future business development.
Marketing & Market Development
Represent Airspace Mobility Solutions at selected industry, government and customer events across the region.
Support and, where appropriate, lead customer workshops, seminars, demonstrations, presentations and other market-development activities.
Provide market and customer insight to regional marketing and business development activities.
Contribute to positioning Thales as a leading technology and business partner within the regional aviation ecosystem.
Requirement :
Required Education/Certificate:
University Degree in Aeronautics, Electronics Engineering, Business or a related discipline.
Additional qualifications in business, sales, strategy or a relevant technical discipline would be advantageous.
Working Experience:
Typically 10+ years of relevant sales, business development, capture or commercial experience, preferably within the aviation, aerospace, defense or related high-technology sector.
Proven experience in managing complex B2B and/or government opportunities involving long sales cycles and multiple stakeholders.
Experience working with ANSPs, aviation authorities, airports, airlines, government agencies or other major aviation stakeholders is highly desirable.
Strong knowledge of the Air Traffic Management / Airspace Mobility / Surveillance industry is highly preferred.
Demonstrated track record of developing and converting significant business opportunities and delivering measurable commercial results.
Experience working successfully within a matrix organisation and across multiple countries and cultures.
Experience in strategic account development, opportunity capture, complex bid management and commercial negotiation.
Proven ability to establish and maintain relationships with senior customer and government stakeholders.
Personnel Skills:
Strong commercial acumen with a strategic business development mindset.
Demonstrated ability to own opportunities, influence stakeholders and deliver measurable business results.
Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-management skills.
Strong influencing and stakeholder-management capability, particularly within a matrix organisation.
Ability to develop compelling opportunity strategies and competitive positioning.
Strong analytical capability and commercial judgement, with the ability to assess opportunities, risks and priorities.
Able to operate effectively at both strategic and operational levels.
Proactive, entrepreneurial and results-oriented approach to business development.
Strong collaboration skills and ability to mobilise diverse internal and external stakeholders towards common objectives.
Comfortable operating in complex, ambiguous and rapidly changing environments.
Strong cultural awareness and ability to work effectively across diverse Asian markets.
Demonstrates high standards of personal integrity and sound judgement, with the ability to balance commercial objectives with Thales' compliance, ethical and integrity requirements.
Strong commitment to Thales governance, compliance and responsible business practices.
Other:
Willingness to travel extensively across Asia and, where required, internationally.
Able to manage multiple strategic opportunities simultaneously and operate effectively under pressure.
Ability to represent Thales professionally with senior customers, government stakeholders, partners and industry leaders.
At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

Title: SALES SUPERVISOR
Description:
A Sales Supervisor plays a critical role in supporting the success of an organization. They are the leader in coordinating the day-to-day activities of the sales representatives and ensuring that they are meeting their goals. The sales supervisor must work closely with the store manager, general manager, and production manager to communicate changing customer needs. As a liaison between the organization and the customers, the production supervisor must anticipate changing customer needs and design products that meet such needs.
Sales Supervisor Job Responsibilities
• Supervise the activities of the sales team including marketing activities like product activations.
• Assist the line manager to recruit, training, enumerating, and retaining a competent sales team.
• Provide reports to top management like sales reports, lead generation reports, customer complaints reports, and new customers’ on-boarded reports.
• Prepare sales presentations and other sales tools.
• Assist the line managers to ensure adequate client communication, maintain contacts with clients and provide feedback.
• Initiate sales activities, strategies, and sales plans required to build brand visibility.
• Serve as a point of reference to employees in terms of showing great work ethic, habits, personal character, and professional character.
• Develop and maintain accurate records of prospects, leads, pricing, sales activities, and active clients.
• Controlling company marketing expenses to ensure the marketing expenditure is kept within budget.
• Attend trade shows and other marketing events and represent the organization.
• Evaluate the performance of the sales team and seek ways to improve the team’s performance.
• Identify the trends in the market, both current, and future that are likely to affect the performance of the organization.
• Ensure the items are displayed correctly in the malls, supermarkets, and other sales points.
Sales Supervisor Skills/Abilities/Knowledge
• Bachelor’s degree in a business-related course with emphasis on marketing.
• Proven work experience in marketing and achieving set targets.
• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal communication.
• Ability to lead and motivate a sales team, and put in place measures to retain a great team.
• Excellent selling skills, ability to close deals, and deal with post-purchase anxiety.
• Excellent selling skills, people-oriented, and ability to motivate a team.
• Ability to identify potential areas of growth and identify new business partnership opportunities.
• Strong organization skills and multi-tasking skills.
• The ability to work under pressure.
• Availability to work within opening hours (e.g. evenings, holidays, weekends).

Title: Senior Agency Development Manager – Global Brands APAC
Description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
ABOUT THE ROLE:
Agencies decide what gets planned, pitched, and bought. This role exists to make X the default recommendation inside those rooms.
You own the agency system and the commercial architecture for Global Brands across APAC. That means holding-company and regional leadership in Singapore and India — and, as a hiring requirement, the Business Directors, Client Directors, and Account Directors who write the plans and clear the buys. A C-suite network without working-level relationships is not sufficient for this role. You will structure commercial deals, navigate complex agency structures, and create the conditions for the sales tea to win more spend.
This is a senior individual-contributor role. You will operate independently, set your own map, and be accountable for agency-sourced revenue influence and partnership quality. You will work as a peer with the Global Brand sales team — close partnership, distinct ownership. This role reports to the Head of Global Brands, APAC.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Build and run the agency development plan for Global Brands across APAC — covering holding companies, regional hubs in Singapore and India, operating companies, and key independents.
Develop strategic relationships at two levels, both required:
Structure and negotiate commercial deals with agencies: trading agreements, partnership frameworks, incentives, joint business plans, and other constructs that lock in commitment and unlock spend.
Navigate complex agency structures — holdco vs. opco, regional vs. local P&Ls, media vs. creative vs. social specialists, and split decision rights between Singapore regional teams and in-market India / SEA offices. Know who decides, who influences, who executes, and how a regional recommendation dies or ships in-market.
Act as the primary trusted advisor to priority agencies. Educate teams on X products, audiences, creative, brand safety, and measurement. Arm them to recommend X to their brand clients without you in the room.
Partner with Client Partners and market teams to convert agency relationships into live campaigns, larger statements of work, and multi-market commitments.
Identify whitespace: agencies and pods that should be recommending X and currently are not. Open those doors and create a path to revenue.
Represent X at agency town halls, leadership forums, holding-company reviews, industry events, and in-market working sessions.
Track partnership health and commercial performance. Course-correct quickly. Do not wait for a quarterly review to find out a key agency has gone quiet.
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:
A self-starter who runs independently. You do not need a playbook handed to you. You build one, socialize it, and execute.
10–12+ years in media sales, agency development, or senior agency-side commercial / client leadership, with a clear record of driving revenue through agency partnerships in APAC.
An existing network you can use immediately — not a list you hope to build. It must already include:
Proven experience structuring commercial deals and working through layered agency decision-making (holding companies, operating companies, local markets, specialist units).
Strong negotiation, communication, and presentation skills. Credible with a regional CEO and useful to a Business Director running a global brand the same week.
Deep understanding of how media, creative, social, and performance agencies plan and buy in APAC.
Comfortable with ambiguity, competing stakeholders, and a fast-moving product environment.
Willingness to travel regularly across Southeast Asia and India.
PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
Southeast Asian language skills preferred — this will materially increase effectiveness in key markets.
Time spent inside a holding-company network (WPP, Publicis, Omnicom, IPG, Dentsu, Havas) or a major independent, plus platform-side agency development.
Direct experience standing up or resetting an agency partnership in a market where the platform was under-indexed.
Working fluency in how global brands brief regional and local agencies across SEA and India.
Experience with both brand and performance agency models.

Title: Senior Business Development Manager
Description:
*Roles & Responsibilities*
*Job Summary*
We are seeking an experienced Senior Business Development Manager to drive revenue growth across strategic enterprise accounts and expand relationships with merchants. The role combines consultative enterprise sales, account management and commercial execution, with a strong focus on payments and technology solutions. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing new business opportunities, growing existing accounts and managing complex sales cycles across regional markets.

* Collaborate with Product, Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance and Finance teams to develop commercially viable solutions and support successful client implementation and delivery.

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, Finance or a related discipline.
* 6–8 years of enterprise sales or business development experience within payments, fintech, software or a closely related technology environment.
* Proven track record of achieving or exceeding revenue targets and acquiring and managing strategic enterprise accounts.
* Established relationships with enterprise clients or merchants that can be leveraged for business development.
* Strong experience in consultative selling, commercial negotiation and managing complex regional sales cycles.
* Strong understanding of payment flows, acquiring and issuing systems, and risk and fraud frameworks.
* Familiarity with key payment concepts and protocols, including tokenization, 3-D Secure (3DS), settlement and reconciliation.

GoNetZero™ is the carbon management business of Sembcorp Industries, providing market-based decarbonisation solutions including advising on, sourcing, and supplying of energy attribute certificates, carbon credits and renewable energy power purchase agreements to commercial and industrial clients across the world.
About the Role
At GoNetZero™, we empower businesses across diverse industries to achieve their sustainability goals. Because no two decarbonisation journeys are alike, our solutions are designed to be scalable and adaptable to each customer's unique needs.
We are looking for a Commercial Lead to join us in the journey towards net zero. The individual will be accountable for driving growth in revenue; negotiating and closing transactions with both buyers and sellers; and building an active sales pipeline. This role plays the key figure supporting our customers in identifying the right products and solutions to achieve their sustainability goals.
Role and Responsibilities
Responsible for the acquisition of new customers, managing a portfolio of existing customers and building strong, trusted relationships with them.
Drive customer acquisition and revenue growth strategies that are aligned to the company’s target.
Identify new trading/revenue opportunities on the buy side, and appeal to new network of buyers.
Originate, structure and execute proposals and commercial deals on the sell side for various environment attributes, including carbon credits and renewable energy certificates, from various sources.
Deliver high-quality customer service that exceed customers’ expectations and goals. Design and lead customer communication and spearhead marketing activities.
Preferred Skills
Bachelor's or Master's Degree
At least 10 years of relevant experience
Experience in business and partnership development, sales, brokering role or B2B sales in the Commodity/Financial markets; with a strong track record of sales, origination and relationship management
Experience in buy and/or sell-side market for carbon credits
Knowledge of carbon markets, corporate sustainability and with understanding of market dynamics in the carbon market (compliance and/or voluntary)
Strong written and oral communication skills in English.

DESCRIPTION
This position is part of the AWS Specialist and Partner Organization (ASP). Specialists own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for their respective technology domains, providing the business and technical expertise to help our customers succeed. Partner teams own the strategy, recruiting, development, and growth of our key technology and consulting partners. Together they provide our customers with the expertise and scale needed to build innovative solutions for their most complex challenges.
AWS is one of Amazon’s fastest growing businesses, servicing millions of customers in more than 190 countries, reshaping the way global enterprises consume information technology and powering the developers who are building the next generation of global industry leaders. AWS customers include some of the most innovative startups like Netflix, Pinterest, Airbnb, and Instagram as well as some of the largest global enterprises like Shell International, Unilever, Hitachi, Sharp, Bristol-Myers Squibb, and Samsung.
AWS is seeking an experienced Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) Customer Success Specialist for Amazon Connect. Connect was born out of Amazon’s own need for the best CCaaS solution that works at scale, while improving customer experience. Today, Connect is one of AWS's fastest growing services, leveraging native generative AI capabilities to improve customer and employee experiences. As a Connect Customer Success Specialist, you will act as a strategic advisor to customers, helping them innovate and optimize their contact center and customer experience through adoption of the Connect capabilities. You will lead cross-functional field teams in sales, solutions architecture, partner sales, product, and will work at the CxO level with customers to maximize the value of their Connect investment.
The ideal candidate will have enterprise sales and/or consulting experience in Contact Center as a Service or similar SaaS solutions in areas such as telecommunications, VoIP, and/or or CRM/ERP applications. You will be passionate about customer experience and advocacy and bring the voice of the customer into the product development process. You will enjoy solving complex problems; our customers will rely on your guidance to scale Connect across their complex global businesses, overcoming technical and organizational roadblocks on the way.
Key job responsibilities
- Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of strategic customer accounts, managing relationships and being a strategic advisor, driving enterprise-wide adoption of Connect.
- Deliver compelling presentations, product demos, sample solutions and programs, events, and discussions to enable customer success.
- Build customer skills and proficiency with Connect.
- Engage with C-level stakeholders to understand the value proposition of Connect and uncover new areas of business value.
- Develop account plans in conjunction with field teams.
- Meet annual revenue targets through increased adoption of Connect.
- Work with partners and ISVs to extend reach & drive adoption of AWS solutions.
A day in the life
The Amazon Connect Customer Success Specialist (CSS) will create a matrix environment with resources from our partner community, Professional Services, AWS account teams, and Connect service team members to drive customer success. A CSS will run attach service plays, customer engagements to drive adoption of migrating services, work with our partner community to scale and align key members of the services team for optimization and retention efforts. Last, a CSS will uncover cases that align to Connect unique business value to be shared with AWS Marketing.

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Title: Senior Director of Orange Movement
Description:
About the Orange Movement
Launched in 2022, the Orange Movement™ is a global initiative led by IIX Global to integrate gender equality and climate action into financial markets. At its core are Orange Bonds™ — the world's first gender-lens and climate-focused asset class — designed to.
Mobilize US$15 billion in capital markets by 2030
Positively impact 150 million women, girls, and gender minorities
Position women and gender minorities as leaders in climate resilience and adaptation
The Orange Movement advances this vision through capital mobilization, policy reform, global partnerships, training, and advocacy. With US$2 billion already mobilized and a new US$1 billion Orange Climate Fund anchoring a US$10 billion cooperation agreement with the Government of Indonesia, the Movement is entering a pivotal scale-up phase — with an active co-funder base, formalized governance infrastructure, and the Orange Forum as its flagship annual convening. IIX seeks a Senior Director who can build the Movement into an institution with the financial strength, governance maturity, and operating capability to stand on its own for the long term
Role Summary
The Senior Director of the Orange Movement will provide strategic vision, entrepreneurial drive, and organizational leadership to build the Movement into a durable, self-sustaining institution — expanding its reach, resources, and financial independence globally. This is a rare opportunity to take a coalition at the intersection of finance, gender, and climate from an IIX-incubated initiative to a mature institution with genuine systems-change potential.
This senior leadership role will:
Own and manage the Orange Movement program, working closely with IIX teams — including Sustainable Finance and the newly established Impact & ESG Advisory — as they execute Orange transactions and related projects.
Ensure the long-term financial sustainability of the Orange Movement through diversified, multi-year fundraising — spanning co-funders, grants, and catalytic capital.
Mature the coalition's governance infrastructure into a standard-setting model for stakeholder management, built to operate independently over time.
Spearhead co-funder cultivation, partnership pipeline development, and multi-year fundraising.
This position is ideal for a leader who combines deep networks across finance, philanthropy, and development with the entrepreneurial instincts to build lasting institutions — equally comfortable setting strategy and doing the hands-on work of standing up the operating backbone a growing coalition needs.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Partnerships & Global Alliances
Develop and execute a global strategy to expand the Orange Investor Alliance and Partner Coalition
Build and own a structured co-funder pipeline — from identification and cultivation through to close and stewardship
Engage institutional investors, DFIs, corporates, philanthropies, and governments as strategic allies and co-funders of the Orange Movement's mission
Build trust with policymakers, regulators, and multilaterals to embed Orange standards into financial systems
Use CRM systems and research tools to maintain a living, high-quality partnerships database
Engage the newly established Impact & ESG Advisory as a technical thought partner on measurement, standards, and reporting for Orange instruments
Fundraising & Financial Sustainability
Own and drive the Orange Movement's co-funder and fundraising strategy — from identification and cultivation through to closing institutional partnerships with foundations, DFIs, and impact investors
Mobilize grants and catalytic capital to scale the Movement, targeting US$2M+ in co-funder contributions in Year 1 and scaling year over year, securing multi-year funding commitments alongside IIX senior management
Build the Orange Movement's long-term financial sustainability model — including piloting fee-based membership and certification revenue streams — steadily reducing the Movement's reliance on IIX's core platform over time
Maintain best-in-class fundraising collateral, funder value propositions, and a structured partnerships pipeline across the co-funder lifecycle
Training & Market Building
Lead the Orange Capital Verifier Training program and similar certification tracks
Expand training offerings for investors, regulators, and issuers to build global confidence in Orange instruments — including blended/digital learning formats
Partner with universities, think tanks, and global institutions to mainstream Orange finance education
Own the roadmap for establishing the Orange Capital Principles, Orange Seal, and Orange Index as recognized, market-wide reference standards for gender-lens and climate-aligned finance
Coalition Governance & Institutional Development
Serve as Secretariat for the Steering Committee, Advisory Council, and Working Groups — driving formalisation, documentation, and distributed knowledge management
Build and own a structured onboarding process for incoming coalition members
Ensure inclusive, accountable, and transparent governance — supported by clear meeting cadences, action tracking, and member engagement protocols
Diagnose and address engagement gaps across working groups, including reviving or restructuring underperforming groups as needed
Evolve the coalition's governance bodies — Steering Committee, Advisory Council, Working Groups — into a mature structure capable of governing the Movement independently at scale
Advocacy, Convenings & Thought Leadership
Lead the flagship Orange Forum and other global convenings, owning the partnerships and stakeholder coordination layer
Curate high-impact campaigns that place Orange Financing at the center of global finance dialogues
Publish research, thought leadership, and storytelling that amplify Orange's influence

This role will also support regional business planning needs, monitoring of competitive developments across the region / globally, and development of timely response to emerging trends and opportunities across AP. The position will be based in Singapore with some travel expected.
This Senior Director role in the AP Corporate Strategy team supports the AP Regional Head of Strategy in the formulation, analytical review, preparation and communication of the AP strategy and associated Sub Regional and Market Strategy plans. A typical effort may entail working closely with senior stakeholders to understand and logically structure the problem, develop hypothesis, work with cross-functional teams to validate the hypothesis, develop strategy to address the problem, and develop recommendations and execution plan to present to the AP Regional President and the leadership team. Title: Senior Director, Sponsorships Commercialization
Description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
Job Description
Role Overview:
The Senior Director, Sponsorships Commercialisation – Asia Pacific, is a senior leadership role responsible for end-to-end commercialisation of Visa’s global and regional sponsorship assets across Asia Pacific.
This role will lead the strategy, monetisation, and execution of sponsorship-led client marketing programs, transforming sponsorships into a scaled, Marketing Services revenue-generating, Brand building and Core Revenue supporting functon. You will drive commercial outcomes, establish operational rigor, and partner with regional and market teams to embed sponsorships into client growth strategies.
As a member of the AP Marketing Services leadership team, you will act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, shaping how Visa maximizes return on its sponsorship investments while delivering measurable revenue growth and client impact.
What a Senior Director, Sponsorships Commercialisation does at Visa:
Strategic Leadership & Commercial Growth:
Own the commercialisation strategy for Visa’s sponsorship portfolio across Asia Pacific, translating global assets into scalable, revenue-generating client propositions that also strategically drive Visa Brand awareness and core consumer revenue.
Drive incremental revenue, pipeline development, and contribution margin through sponsorship-led solutions
Position sponsorships as a core lever in client growth strategies, aligned to Visa’s business priorities and client needs
Identify and scale new revenue streams (e.g., gaming, emerging platforms, new partnership models)
End-to-End Sponsorship Commercialisation:
Lead the monetisation of sponsorship assets across key properties (e.g., Olympics, FIFA World Cup, NFL, Formula 1), ensuring strong ROI and measurable business outcomes
Establish clear frameworks to price, package, sales assets and sell sponsorship-led marketing solutions to clients.
Partner with Sales, Account Executives, and Client Marketing teams to embed sponsorships into client engagements and go-to-market plans
Drive forecast accuracy, pipeline visibility, and revenue tracking across all sponsorship initiatives
Execution Excellence & Operational Rigor:
Build and lead a commercialisation engine that drives consistent, high-quality execution across markets
Oversee end-to-end delivery including client engagement, activation planning, onsite execution, and performance tracking
Institutionalize processes across contracting, legal, governance, and financial management to support scaled delivery
Drive internalization of capabilities to reduce external agency reliance and improve cost efficiency and control
Client & Stakeholder Leadership:
Serve as the senior sponsorships advisor to regional leadership, country teams, and key clients
Build strong partnerships across Marketing, Sales, Product, and global sponsorship teams to align strategy and execution
Influence senior stakeholders to prioritise sponsorship-led opportunities and investments
Represent AP in global forums, shaping sponsorship strategy and ensuring regional needs are reflected
Team Leadership & Capability Building:
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing Sponsorships Commercialisation team across Asia Pacific
Create a strong culture of commercial accountability, performance, and execution excellence
Coach and mentor team members and broader Marketing Services teams on sponsorship strategy and commercialisation
Drive capability uplift across markets to ensure consistent execution standards and best practice sharing
Why this is important to Visa:
Sponsorship investments are a critical component of Visa’s brand and business growth strategy. As these investments scale, Visa must unlock stronger commercial outcomes, moving from activation-led models to a disciplined, revenue-driven approach.
This role is central to delivering that transformation—ensuring sponsorships become a differentiated, scalable growth engine that drives measurable impact for both Visa and its clients.
Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Proven senior leadership experience in marketing, sponsorships, commercialisation, or revenue-driven marketing services
Strong track record of driving revenue growth, pipeline development, and commercial outcomes

Deep understanding of client marketing, co-marketing models, and partnership-driven growth
Experience working across complex, matrixed, and regional organisations with senior stakeholder influence
Strong commercial acumen with ability to translate marketing investment into measurable business outcomes
Demonstrated experience leading and developing high-performing, geographically dispersed teams

Title: Senior Director, Strategic Alliances
Description:
A Little About Us
EDB provides a data and AI platform that enables organizations to harness the full power of Postgres for transactional, analytical, and AI workloads across any cloud, anywhere. EDB empowers enterprises to control risk, manage costs and scale efficiently for a data and AI led world. Serving more than 1,500 customers globally and as the leading contributor to the vibrant and fast-growing PostgreSQL community, EDB supports major government organizations, financial services, media and information technology companies. EDB’s data-driven solutions enable customers to modernize legacy systems and break data silos while leveraging enterprise-grade open source technologies. EDB delivers the confidence of up to 99.999% high availability with mission critical capabilities built in such as security, compliance controls, and observability. For more information, visit www.enterprisedb.com
Senior Director, APJ Channels & Alliances
Based in Singapore ( Open to Singapore citizens and Permanent Residents (PRs) only )
About EDB
EnterpriseDB (EDB) is the largest provider of Enterprise Postgres software and services and a leader in the open-source database marketplace. EDB delivers the premier open source-based data platform for new applications, cloud re-platforming, application modernization, and legacy database migration. EDB integrates with enterprise technologies and infrastructures for hybrid cloud management, data integration, and data warehousing. Our customers benefit from the highest performing, secure, reliable, flexible, open, and cost-effective data management platform available.
The Role
We are seeking a Senior Director, APJ Channels & Alliances to own and scale our entire partner business across Asia Pacific and Japan. This is a senior regional leadership role responsible for EDB's full partner ecosystem across the region, including distributors, VARs, regional and global SIs, hyperscalers, OEMs, and ISVs.
The role reports to the VP/GM, APJ Sales, and is a core member of the APJ leadership team. You will lead a team of regional Partner Managers across SEA & Hong Kong, India, ANZ, Japan, and North Asia, and own the APJ partner-sourced and partner-fulfilled revenue number.
You will set the long-term partner strategy for APJ, decide where and how EDB invests in the ecosystem, and turn partners into a primary engine of growth for EDB Postgres® AI across the region.
Key Responsibilities
Strategy & Revenue Ownership
- Own the APJ channel and alliances revenue target, with a track record of delivering through partners and distribution
- Define and execute a multi-year APJ partner strategy aligned with regional and global business goals, including market prioritization, partner segmentation, and investment decisions
- Build and maintain pipeline across four rolling quarters to support 2x coverage in the current quarter and 3x in the next rolling quarter, at an APJ level
- Shape routes to market for each country, balancing direct, indirect, and marketplace motions
Team Leadership
- Lead, hire, develop, and mentor a high-performing team of regional Partner Managers across APJ
- Set clear goals, territory plans, and performance metrics for the team, and build a strong bench for future growth
- Create a consistent, scalable operating rhythm for partner management across all APJ markets
Ecosystem & Alliances
- Build and expand strategic relationships with hyperscalers (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud and others), global and regional SIs, distributors, and key VARs
- Develop joint GTM plans, co-selling motions, and marketplace strategies with strategic alliance partners
- Grow EDB's presence in the data and AI ecosystem, positioning EDB Postgres® AI within partner-led modernisation, migration, and AI initiatives
- Own executive-level relationships with partner leadership across the region
Partner Programs & Enablement
- Design and roll out partner programs, incentives, tiering, and certification tailored to APJ markets
- Ensure partners are trained, enabled, and technically capable of selling and delivering EDB solutions
- Drive partner-led demand generation in collaboration with Marketing
Cross-Functional Leadership
- Partner closely with APJ Sales, Pre-Sales, Marketing, Professional Services, and Customer Success leaders to align direct and indirect motions and reduce channel conflict
- Represent APJ in global channel strategy, contributing to programs, policy, and investment priorities
- Provide clear forecasting, reporting, and business reviews to APJ and global leadership using the company's CRM
Qualifications
- 15+ years of experience in enterprise software sales, channels, and business development
- 10+ years in channel and alliances roles, including 7+ years leading multi-country partner teams across APJ
- Proven track record of building a partner ecosystem from the ground up and scaling it into a significant revenue contributor
- Deep experience working with distributors, VARs, SIs, GSIs, OEMs, ISVs, and hyperscaler alliances and marketplaces
- Strong understanding of databases, open-source, or infrastructure software; experience with Postgres or data and AI platforms is a strong advantage
- Experience designing partner programs, incentives, and GTM plans with measurable outcomes
