Title: Senior Partner Sales Manager
Description:
About Temenos
Temenos is a global leader in banking technology. Through our market-leading core banking suite and best-in-class composable solutions, we are modernizing the banking industry. Banks of all sizes utilize our adaptable technology – on-premises, in the cloud, or as SaaS – to deliver next-generation services and AI-enhanced experiences that elevate banking for their customers. Our mission is to create a world where people can live their best financial lives.
VALUES
Care About Transforming The Banking Landscape.
Commit to being part of an exciting culture and product evolving within the financial industry.
Collaborate effectively and proactively with teams within or outside Temenos.
Challenge yourself to be ambitious and achieve your individual as well as the company targets.
THE ROLE
Reporting to the Head of Partner Sales - APAC, the role finds and onboards new Sales Partners (Introducers, Resellers, Distributors); with the objective to drive partner channel sales across Temenos multi product portfolio.
You will be responsible for managing the ongoing relationship with the existing sales partners, ensuring they remain engaged, empowered and educated to promote Temenos to their market. You will also act as the liaison between the partner and the Temenos sales & solutions groups.
OPPORTUNITIES
- You will prospect companies to explore Sales Partnership (Introducers, Resellers, Distributors) opportunities, define and assign targeted accounts, markets, products, explored routes to market.
- You will engage with prospective partners, present them with the Temenos value proposition and evaluate the company based on defined KPIs and criteria's and communicate with them throughout the discovery process.
- You will define mutual business cases/ business plans with estimated ROI.
- You will define market-focused brand awareness strategies as well as go-to-market programs and execute those to generate pipeline.
- You will assume the ownership of opportunities and support the partners throughout the sales cycle until closure.
- You will define procedures to organize the partner’s team to manage / monitor the healthy growth of our mutual business. (setup weekly cadence calls, reviewed pipeline, support the partner to engage with clients, provide the partner with technical and sales trainings).
- You will assist partners throughout forecasting, sales planning, and managing RFP and Pre-Sales processes.
- You will coordinate the involvement of various internal teams such as solution pricing, product teams, professional services, support and legal in relation to the sales opportunities brought by the partner.
- You will be responsible for the organization of sales enablement sessions to partners.
- You will act as the partner channel interface into Temenos with key focus on driving to sales execution and expanding Temenos` reach into identified markets.
- You will perform such other duties, functions and services, consistent with status or vocational ability, as may from time to time be required.
- You will be responsible for the following key activities:
- Identify potential new local Sales partners to on-board.
- Rollout locally Asia partner strategy.
- Train & evangelize partners.
- Manage local Sales partners relationship and identify key sponsors.
- Integrate Partner Strategy dimension in day-to-day local activities.
- Act as a liaison with the Partner Director to support a two ways local partner strategy integration.
- Monitor local pipeline and drive partner sales across Temenos` multi product portfolio.
- Deliver regular management reporting.
- Define local annual business plan.
Skills
- Sales skills:
- You should have a deep knowledge of the financial services industry, the trends, challenges, and innovations in APAC.
- You should have a proven track record of success in selling complex technology solutions to the financial services sector.
- You should be culturally aware and experience of working in a globally matrixed organization.
- You should be ambitious with an entrepreneurial spirit, energy, and a passion for continuous learning and improvement.
- You should have a passion for selling!
- You should have experience of successfully selling in the Asia region
- You should have international experience and a global mindset.
- You should be able to travel extensively.
- Channel Partner management skills:
- You should be able to manage sales/distribution partner’s life cycle and related activities from its start to a sustainable and meaningful relationship position, producing measurable qualitative and quantitative results.
- You should be able to structure partner relationships within relevant go to market, integrating partner potential, market opportunities and dynamics under constraint. Developing consistently and complimentarily the sub-region partner ecosystem avoiding channel conflicts while optimizing Temenos` long term revenue.
- You should be able to think strategically and building long term relationship to reverse traditionally opportunistic sub-region strategic partner behaviors.
- Technical skills:
- You should have a strong knowledge of banking applications and operations, including business processes (retail banking, corporate banking, payment solutions, etc..) as well as core banking and related solutions.
- You should have experience with sales in the specific sub-region in question and proven track record of relations with established market partners and alliances, such as Deloitte, EY, TechMahindra, CapGemini, Accenture, etc.
SOME OF OUR BENEFITS Include
- Maternity leave: Transition back with 3 days per week in the first month and 4 days per week in the second month
- Civil Partnership: 1 week of paid leave if you're getting married. This covers marriages and civil partnerships, including same sex/civil partnership
- Family care: 4 weeks of paid family care leave
- Recharge days: 4 days per year to use when you need to physically or mentally needed to recharge
- Study leaves: 2 weeks of paid leave each year for study or personal development

Description:
Company
Omnichat is a venture-backed, world-class Chat Commerce Platform.
Our vision is simple: Convert all visitors to customers through chat.
Our Omnichannel Chat Commerce SAAS Platform is designed to help businesses implement
marketing automation, achieve higher conversion rates, and increase their sales and customer
service efficiency.
Company / Product:
Omnichat is an Omnichannel Chat Commerce SAAS Platform designed to help businesses
implement marketing automation, achieve higher conversion rates, and increase their sales and
customer service efficiency.
It integrates well-known messaging channels including proprietary Webchat, Facebook
Messenger, LINE, WhatsApp Business API, WeChat, and more.
We deliver actual value to our clients. Achieving 300 percent year-on-year annual recurring
revenue (ARR) growth in the past two consecutive years, but it takes a growing global team of
passionate, eager-to-be successful employees to continue adding to the 5,000+ companies we
support.
Are you ambitious and looking to start a lucrative sales career with an innovative technology
company in one of the fastest-growing sectors? If so, this is the perfect opportunity for you.
Job Description:
【Strategic Advisory & Consulting Alliances】
- Partnership Pipeline Engine: Take the absolute lead in formalizing, structuring, and scaling strategic partnerships with top-tier global consultancies, system integrators, and holding companies to systematically drive enterprise client introductions.
- Executive Co-Selling: Build institutional credibility at the Partner, Managing Director, and Practice Leader levels within these agencies to position Omnichat as their default conversational CRM recommendation for digital transformation projects.
- Co-Innovation & Enablement: Educate agency account teams, solution architects, and digital strategists on Omnichat’s MarTech, Agentic AI and OTO capabilities, enabling them to proactively surface high-value enterprise opportunities.
【Big Tech Alliances (Meta, LINE)】
- Alliance Maximization: Deepen, monetize, and govern our technical alliances with our foundational big tech partners, including Meta and LINE.
- Joint GTM Execution: Maximize partner-led marketing budgets, co-selling programs, and regional field alignments to ensure Omnichat is top-of-mind for Meta and LINE enterprise account managers across SEA.
【MarTech Ecosystem Architecture】
- Technical & Commercial Co-Integration: Map out and drive commercial partnership frameworks with complementary MarTech infrastructure leaders to build a robust, interconnected enterprise software ecosystem.
- Ecosystem Governance: Define, measure, and scale clear KPIs around partner-sourced and partner-influenced ARR, reporting directly to executive leadership on channel health.
Job Requirements:
- 5+ years of enterprise SaaS experience, with a documented track record of successfully managing alliances with Tier-1 consulting firms (Big 4 / major holding agencies) or Big Tech ecosystems.
- An existing, active network within regional enterprise tech consultancies and agencies across Southeast Asia.
- Proven capability to negotiate complex corporate master services agreements (MSAs), co-sell frameworks, and revenue-share models at the C-suite/Partner level.
- Sharp technical and commercial literacy across the enterprise MarTech space, Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), conversational commerce, and the emerging enterprise Generative AI landscape.
- Exceptional organizational stamina; capable of mobilizing internal product, engineering, and enterprise sales teams to align with complex external partner requirements.
- Deep experience running alliances across SEA

- Experience working directly with large global organizations with complex demands and interesting projects

- Working with some of the the most experienced Account Managers and Business Development team at Omnichat
- Exposure to global teams within Omnichat (product, sales enablement, sales, marketing)
- Opportunity to help implement onboarding best practices and processes for Omnichat’s largest and most valued clients.

Title: Senior Partnerships Manager, Lions Asia
Description:
About LIONS Asia
LIONS Asia is the next evolution of Spikes Asia, building on more than three decades of celebrating and advancing creative excellence across Asia Pacific. As a joint venture between Haymarket Asia and Informa plc, LIONS Asia combines deep regional expertise with the global scale and influence of the Lions brand.
Through its awards, festival and industry initiatives, LIONS Asia brings together the region's most influential marketers, agencies, media companies, technology platforms, brands and creative leaders to recognise outstanding work, inspire innovation and shape the future of the industry.
As we enter an exciting new phase of growth, we are seeking an ambitious and commercially driven Senior Partnership Manager to help expand our sponsorship portfolio, develop new revenue streams and build strategic partnerships across the APAC region.
The Role
The Senior Partnership Manager is responsible for driving sponsorship and partnership revenue growth for LIONS Asia.
This is a highly commercial role focused on identifying, developing and securing new business opportunities while building long-term strategic relationships with partners across Asia Pacific. A key focus of this role is identifying and securing new sponsorship partners and revenue streams beyond LIONS Asia's existing client base.
The successful candidate will be an expert in the LIONS Asia sponsorship offering and will play a critical role in shaping go-to-market strategies and ensuring best-in-class partner experiences.
Working closely with the wider Campaign sales team, the Senior Partnership Manager will lead new business acquisition efforts, identify untapped market opportunities and oversee the successful delivery and management of their own sponsorship partnerships.
Key Responsibilities
Sponsorship & Partnership Sales
- Lead sponsorship revenue generation for LIONS Asia.
- Develop and execute a proactive new business strategy to identify and secure new partners across APAC.
- Build and manage a strong pipeline of sponsorship opportunities, from prospecting through to negotiation and contract closure.
- Meet and exceed annual revenue targets through sponsorship sales and strategic partnerships.
- Develop customised partnership proposals that align partner objectives with Lions Asia audiences, platforms and experiences.
- Identify opportunities to create new sponsorship products and revenue streams.
New Business Development
- Hunt for and engage new categories of partners, including technology companies, AI platforms, consulting firms, enterprise software providers, luxury brands, financial services organisations and other businesses seeking access to senior marketing and creative decision-makers.
- Build relationships with senior stakeholders, including CMOs, marketing leaders, brand executives, innovation leaders and business development teams.
- Monitor industry trends and emerging sectors to identify new commercial opportunities.
- Represent LIONS Asia at industry events, conferences and networking opportunities across the region.
Commercial Strategy
- Become the subject matter expert on LIONS Asia sponsorship products, audience insights and commercial opportunities.
- Translate sponsorship offerings into compelling commercial narratives that resonate with prospective partners.
- Collaborate with leadership to evolve and refine partnership packages and sponsorship inventory.
- Work closely with marketing, content and event teams to develop innovative and commercially attractive partnership opportunities.
- Provide market intelligence and commercial insights to support business planning and growth strategies.
Partner Management & Delivery
- Oversee the successful management of sponsorship partners from contract signature through to activation and renewal.
- Act as a senior point of contact for key partners, ensuring a high level of service and stakeholder engagement.
- Work with internal teams to ensure contractual obligations and partnership deliverables are executed successfully.
- Identify opportunities for partnership growth, renewal and long-term strategic engagement.
Skills & Experience
Essential
- 6+ years' experience in sponsorship sales, partnerships, business development or other commercial roles.
- Proven track record of achieving and exceeding revenue targets.
- Demonstrated success in winning new business and developing strategic partnerships.
- Experience selling sponsorship, events, media, marketing, content or B2B solutions.
- Strong consultative sales and negotiation skills.
- Experience building relationships with senior stakeholders and decision-makers.
- Excellent presentation, communication and proposal-writing skills.
- Ability to operate independently while collaborating effectively across teams.
- Strong commercial acumen and a results-driven mindset.
Desirable
- Existing network across APAC marketing, media, technology or creative industries.
- Experience within events, festivals, awards, media brands or professional communities.
- Understanding of the advertising, marketing, media and creative communications landscape.
- Experience working across multiple markets within Asia Pacific.
What Success Looks Like
In this role you will:
- Consistently achieve and exceed partnership revenue targets.
- Expand the LIONS Asia partner ecosystem through the acquisition of new sponsors and commercial partners.
- Build a strong pipeline of high-value opportunities across APAC.
- Establish LIONS Asia as a must-partner platform for organisations seeking access to senior marketing and creative leaders.
- Enable and educate internal sales teams to maximise commercial opportunities.
- Deliver exceptional partner experiences that drive retention and long-term growth.
Personal Attributes
- Entrepreneurial and highly proactive.
- Naturally curious and opportunity-focused.
- Confident engaging and networking with senior executives.
- Strategic thinker with a strong commercial mindset.
- Collaborative and comfortable working across multiple stakeholder groups.
- Passionate about creativity, marketing, media, innovation and business growth.

Senior Product Manager
Date: 19 Oct 2026
Location: Singapore, Singapore
Company: Singtel Group
Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.
We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.
From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.
At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll solve meaningful challenges, shape critical digital infrastructure and help build secure, resilient and AI-enabled solutions that serve businesses, digital ecosystems and communities across the globe.
This is where BIG Possibilities become reality. Whether you're engineering intelligent networks, advancing sovereign AI cloud platforms, strengthening cybersecurity, designing seamless customer experiences or driving sustainable innovation, you'll be part of teams shaping the future of technology.
Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.
Make an impact by:
1. Achieving Revenue and Profitability Targets
Own the commercial performance of the Cybersecurity portfolio, including revenue, orders and profitability.
Develop business plans and financial forecasts, manage product economics and investments, and monitor sales performance and pipeline.
Identify new growth opportunities across SSE, Zero Trust Branch, AI Security, Cellular Security and other emerging Zero Trust capabilities.
Work closely with Sales, Product Specialists, Marketing and technology partners to drive customer adoption, pipeline creation, cross-sell and expansion.
Optimise pricing, commercial models, partner costs and service delivery economics.
Grow sustainable and recurring managed-service revenue.
2. Formulating Product Strategies and Roadmaps
Define and execute the product strategy and multi-year roadmap for the Cybersecurity portfolio.
Align product strategy with Singtel’s business priorities, customer needs, market developments and technology partner capabilities.
Identify and prioritise opportunities across SSE, Zero Trust Branch, AI Security, Cellular Security and emerging security capabilities.
Assess customer needs, competitor developments, technology trends and partner roadmaps.
Determine where Singtel should invest, differentiate, partner or develop new capabilities.
Work with Engineering, Operations, Sales, Marketing and strategic partners to execute the product roadmap.
3. Managing the Entire Product Lifecycle
Own the end-to-end product and service lifecycle from opportunity identification and business case development through launch, growth, optimisation and retirement.
Translate technology capabilities into scalable and commercially viable Singtel solutions and managed services.
Define service scope, operating models, pricing, commercial constructs, Statements of Work, service levels and support models.
Ensure new products are operationally ready and can be effectively sold, delivered and supported at scale.
Monitor revenue, profitability, pipeline, customer adoption, service performance and customer feedback after launch.
Manage technology evolution, product dependencies, partner roadmap changes and end-of-life transitions.
4. Driving Go-To-Market (GTM) and Pipeline Generation
Own and drive the GTM strategy and pipeline development for the Cybersecurity portfolio.
Identify target customer segments, priority use cases and buyer personas.
Develop differentiated value propositions, sales plays, messaging, solution collateral and competitive positioning.

Title: Senior Regional Commercial Manager
Description:
Are you a visionary pharmaceutical marketer ready to shape the APAC healthcare landscape?
Join us as our Senior Regional Commercial Manager and drive the future of our growing pharmaceutical portfolio.
Your Impact
You will be the strategic architect behind our regional brand plans (RBP), launching innovative campaigns and guiding future portfolio strategies—including spotting prime in-licensing opportunities. Working closely with the Regional Commercial Head, you will champion commercial excellence, optimize ROI, and empower country marketing teams across the region in a dynamic, low-bureaucracy environment.
Key Responsibilities:

What You Bring:

- Proven Track Record: Demonstrated success driving product launches and managing brands across all stages of the product lifecycle.
- Therapeutic Expertise: A strong background in oncology, specialty care, and/or cardio-metabolic fields is highly advantageous.
- Modern Marketing Skills: A powerful blend of high-level strategic thinking, hands-on execution, and a solid digital marketing toolkit.
- Collaborative Leadership: Exceptional intercultural communication skills with a passion for empowering teams, building trust, and driving strong financial outcomes.
About Menarini Asia Pacific
We are a global, family-owned healthcare company where our people are our priority. Present across 13 markets in Asia-Pacific, here’s why you should join us:
- Local Market Expertise, Global Footprint: As a global family-owned company, we value local knowledge and expertise to invigorate the lives of patients, people and partners

- Empowered to be Entrepreneurial: We operate in a dynamic, low-bureaucracy environment where swift decision-making allows us to make a real impact

Join us and invigorate lives! For more information about Menarini Asia-Pacific, please visit www.menariniapac.com

Title: Senior Regulatory Affairs Specialist
Description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.
Our nutrition business develops science-based nutrition products for people of all ages, from helping babies and children grow, to keeping adult bodies strong and active. Millions of people around the world count on our leading brands, including Similac®, PediaSure®, Pedialyte®, Ensure® and Glucerna®, to help get the nutrients they need to live their healthiest life.
Working at Abbott
At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You will have access to:
Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists
The Opportunity
As the Senior Regulatory Affairs Specialist, provide support for the regulatory department to ensure efficient and compliant business processes and environment. Execute regulatory tasks and play a consultative role by partnering across business functions. Assist in identifying data needed, obtaining these data and ensuring that they are effectively presented for the registration of products and/or conducting regulatory assessments using worldwide data. Prepare and submit documentation or oversee preparation of documentation needed for registration worldwide. Provide technical leadership to business units.
What You’ll Do
Responsible for compliance with applicable Corporate and Divisional Policies and procedures and Regulatory SOPs.
Work with markets and relevant SMEs to track emerging legislative changes and industry trends to support impact assessments and appropriate handover processes to cross functional teams.
Support and/or lead development of regulatory strategies for new product innovations, line extensions and market entry.
Partner with R&D, commercial, quality assurance, supply chain teams to address technical and regulatory hurdles.
Execute regulatory tasks and manage key projects critical to support AN strategy to futureproof business needs and changes.
Assist in Regulatory SOP development and/or review; identify areas for improvement and optimization in regulatory quality systems and processes.
Depending on specific role, may be involved in various regulatory activities including review of scientific documentation, regulatory submissions and follow-up, evaluation of product and manufacturing changes for regulatory implications, support compliance audits,
Maintaining annual licenses, registrations, listings and patent information, review and approval of label changes, advertising and promotional content, and providing regulatory input to product safety issues and product recalls.
Requirements
Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) is required.
Preferred area of focus in science (biology, chemistry, nutrition, dietetics, microbiology, immunology, medical technology, pharmacy, and pharmacology), math, engineering, or medical fields. M.S. in a technical area or M.B.A. is preferred.
A Ph.D. in a technical area or law is helpful. Certification is a plus (such as RAC from the Regulatory Affairs Professionals Society).
6-7 years of experience in regulatory preferred, but may consider quality assurance, research and development, scientific affairs, operations, or related area.
4-5 years of experience in a regulated industry (e.g., infant and adult specialized nutritionals, medical/pharmaceutical products).
Regulatory knowledge of regulatory requirements, guidelines, policies, standards, practices, history, ethics, agency structure and processes.
Knowledge of GxPs (GMPs, GLPs, GCPs).
Knowledge of principles and requirements of promotion, advertising and labeling.
Specialized nutrition, food and pharmaceutical regulations, especially in Asia is an added advantage.
Strong communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively verbally and in writing, communicate with diverse audiences and personnel, and work with and negotiate with people from various disciplines, organizations, and cultures.
Ability to follow scientific arguments, identify regulatory scientific data needs and, with supervision, solve regulatory issues and define regulatory strategy.
Ability to evaluate various technical alternatives.
Strong attention to detail.
Ability to create and manage multiple project plans and timelines.
Ability to think analytically; organize and track complex information.
Proficient computer skills.

Title: Senior Sales Executive – Retail
Description:
*Company Overview*
We are a dynamic new player entering the Singapore market, focused on establishing our footprint across consumer household electronic appliances and office/educational stationery. We are seeking a hungry, highly driven sales hunter who is eager to break new ground, build robust retail and wholesale channels from scratch, and scale into a key commercial leader as the company grows.
*Key Responsibilities*
* *Appliance Retail Channel Expansion:* Secure shelf space, floor displays, and distribution partnerships across major consumer electrical retail chains, home appliance superstores, and hypermarket electrical aisles.
* *Stationery & Commercial Distribution:* Drive wholesale distribution of office and student stationery across major retail bookstore networks, educational suppliers, and neighborhood commercial outlets.
* *Corporate & Commercial B2B Sales:* Pitch and secure bulk enterprise contracts for household appliances (e.g., corporate welfare gifts, staff pantry fit-outs, property developer furnishing packages) and contracted corporate office supply tenders.
* *Institutional & School Procurement:* Prospect and participate in commercial institutional supply tenders, bulk educational purchasing agreements, and corporate procurement panels.
* *Promotional Campaign Execution:* Partner with retail accounts to implement high-impact in-store visual merchandising, end-cap displays, and seasonal promotional bundles to drive product turnover.
*Qualifications & Requirements*
* Minimum Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Supply Chain/Commerce, or a related field.
* At least 3 to 5 years of solid sales and account management experience within household electronic appliances, small domestic appliances (SDA), consumer hardlines, or stationery/commercial supplies.
* A tenacious hunter profile with proven success in opening new retail doors, pitching to enterprise purchasing managers, and closing high-volume supply agreements.
* Sound working knowledge of Singapore retail channel agreements, trading terms, rebate structures, and local appliance compliance standards (e.g., Safety Mark certifications).
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the confidence to negotiate commercially sound terms with senior buyers.
_*Advantage:While your core focus is Household Electronic Appliances & Stationery, candidates with cross-category familiarity across our wider portfolio (travel bags, luggage, and home living) will hold a strong advantage.*_

Title: Senior Sales Manager
Description:
Summary
The Senior Sales Manager will lead the Company’s sales and business development activities, with responsibility for driving revenue growth, developing strategic partnerships, managing key accounts, and overseeing the performance of the sales team.
The role involves identifying new business opportunities, particularly within the healthcare and high-net-worth individual (HNWI) markets, and building strong relationships with corporate clients, insurers, healthcare professionals, referral partners, and other strategic stakeholders.
The successful candidate will work closely with Management and cross-functional teams to develop and implement sales strategies, manage the sales pipeline and departmental budget, strengthen client retention, and ensure the achievement of individual and departmental sales targets.
Sales Strategy & Business Development
Lead the development and implementation of sales strategies and action plans to achieve the Company’s revenue targets.
Discuss business strategies, growth opportunities, sales performance, and proposed action plans with Management, and implement agreed initiatives.
Proactively source, identify, and secure new business opportunities through networking, referrals, outreach activities, and relationship building.
Oversee the department’s sales pipeline, monitor lead conversion, and ensure timely follow-up on business opportunities.
Conduct sales presentations and lead key business negotiations, including the preparation and review of quotations, proposals, and commercial terms within the Company’s approval framework.
Develop and maintain professional networks to generate referrals and business opportunities, particularly within the healthcare ecosystem and high-net-worth individual (HNWI) market.
Establish strategic partnerships with insurers, corporations, healthcare professionals, and other referral sources.
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and client needs to identify opportunities for business growth.
Team Leadership & Performance Management
Lead, supervise, and guide the sales team to achieve individual and departmental sales targets.
Set and communicate team objectives, sales targets, and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) in consultation with Management.
Monitor individual and team performance against targets, identify performance gaps, and implement corrective action plans.
Provide regular coaching, training, and performance feedback to strengthen the team’s sales capabilities and service standards.
Allocate accounts, leads, duties, and workloads effectively to support departmental priorities.
Identify staffing and development needs and work with Management and Human Resources on recruitment, onboarding, and performance management.
Budget & Resource Management
Prepare and manage the department’s sales forecasts and budget in consultation with Management.
Monitor sales and revenue performance against approved budgets and targets, analyze variances, and recommend corrective actions.
Allocate and manage departmental resources, including manpower and the department budget, to support agreed business plans.
Monitor departmental expenditure and ensure spending remains within approved budgets and complies with the Company’s approval procedures.
Evaluate the effectiveness and returns of sales initiatives and recommend adjustments to improve resource utilization and results.
Corporate Account & Client Relationship Management
Oversee the management of corporate accounts and maintain strong relationships with key clients and business partners.
Act as the primary point of contact for strategic accounts and escalated client matters.
Guide the team in identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling the clinic’s services.
Ensure timely resolution of client concerns and maintain high standards of client satisfaction and retention.
Lead contract renewals and account growth initiatives incoordination with relevant internal stakeholders.
Reporting& Department Administration
Oversee the department’s administrative functions, including sales documentation, account records, quotations, proposals, and reporting.
Ensure accurate and timely recording of sales activities, client interactions, and business opportunities.
Prepare and present regular sales reports, pipeline updates, forecasts, budget performance, and action plans to Management.
Review and improve departmental workflows and ensure adherence to the Company’s policies and approval procedures.
Coordinate with clinical, operations, marketing, finance, and other relevant teams to ensure smooth client onboarding, service delivery, and follow-up.
Perform any other duties related to the role as assigned by Management.
Job Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Healthcare Management, or a related discipline.
At least 5 years of relevant experience in sales, business development, corporate account management, or a related field, including experience leading or supervising a sales team.
Proven track record of achieving sales and revenue targets, developing new business opportunities, and growing key accounts.
Experience in the healthcare, medical services, insurance, hospitality, luxury services, or HNWI market would be an advantage.
Strong professional network and demonstrated ability to generate business through referrals, partnerships, networking, and direct outreach.
Strong leadership and people-management capabilities, with experience setting KPIs, monitoring performance, coaching team members, and implementing performance improvement plans.
Commercially driven, with sound knowledge of sales forecasting, pipeline management, budgeting, contract negotiation, and account development.
Strong presentation, negotiation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
Able to analyze sales performance, market trends, client needs, and budget variances and translate findings into practical action plans.
Client-focused and capable of managing strategic accounts, complex negotiations, and escalated client matters professionally.
Able to work effectively with clinical, operations, marketing, finance, and other internal stakeholders.
Highly organized, proactive, results-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Proficient in Microsoft Office applications and familiar with CRM systems or other sales-tracking tools.

Choose 2 Rent is a global event technology rental company providing registration and check-in solutions for conferences, exhibitions, corporate events, and large-scale events worldwide. We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven
Senior Sales Specialist

Title: Senior Strategic Alliances Manager, GSI (SEA)
Description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.
So, what’s the role all about?
At NiCE, we are passionate about making the customer experience flow. As the global leader in AI-powered customer experience and workforce engagement solutions, we empower organisations to deliver seamless, digital-first interactions that drive real impact.
We are looking for a strategic, relationship-led professional to join us as Senior Partner Acceleration Executive (Senior Strategic Alliances Manager, GSI (SEA)). This high-impact role builds NiCE's GSI alliances across South East Asia, a region of many markets, each with its own partner landscape. You will decide where to invest, build executive relationships with the leading systems integrators, and turn them into a source of joint pipeline and delivery capacity for CXone and Cognigy.
You will collaborate closely with alliance leaders and cross-functional teams across the US, Europe and the rest of APAC to keep our GSI approach consistent and scalable, so that NiCE shows up to partners and customers as one team with one strategy that accelerates adoption, strengthens partner alignment and supports revenue growth.
How will you make an impact?
- Lead and grow NiCE's strategic alliances with the priority GSIs across South East Asia, such as Accenture, NTT DATA, Capgemini, Deloitte and agree where joint investment will return the most
- Build and sustain executive sponsorship at each priority GSI across customer experience, technology and industry leadership, and run a joint business plan for each with clear targets and regular reviews
- Shape and scale a NiCE practice inside the partner: joint solution offerings built on CXone Mpower and Cognigy, certified delivery capacity, and a clear place in the partner's go-to-market
- Drive joint pursuit of named accounts, growing partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline through SI-led bids, RFPs and co-sell alongside NiCE direct sales
- Work with NiCE sales, marketing, product, professional services and customer success to deliver aligned joint campaigns, enablement programmes and delivery quality
- Make sure partner-led deployments land well, so customers see value quickly and references follow
- Act as the voice of South East Asia in NiCE's global GSI programme, giving regional insight to alliance leaders in the US, Europe and the rest of APAC and influencing strategy, programme design and investment
- Serve as NiCE's internal expert on how each GSI sells and delivers, supporting internal training and account team engagement
- Report on performance metrics such as partner-sourced and influenced pipeline, bookings, certified resources and joint wins
Have you got what it takes?
- Minimum 5 years' experience in strategic alliances, systems integrator partnerships or enterprise channel management (CX, contact centre, cloud or enterprise software experience strongly preferred)
- Proven success building joint go-to-market programmes with large systems integrators, including influencing at executive level
- Strong understanding of how GSIs make money: services attach, practice economics, utilisation and certified headcount
- Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and drive alignment across geographies and business units
- Exceptional communication, collaboration and relationship-building skills
- Self-motivated, proactive and able to thrive in a fast-paced, matrixed environment
- Experience working with globally distributed teams across the US, Europe and the rest of APAC
- Willingness and ability to travel regularly across the region
- Fluent English required; additional regional languages are a bonus
This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive, and employees will also perform other reasonable related business duties as assigned by immediate supervisor and other management as required. This organization reserves the right to revise or change job duties as the need arises. This job description does not constitute a written or implied contract of employment.
What’s in it for you?
Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!
Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!
At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

Title: Senior Technical Engineer
Description:
About the Role
Engineering Edge is looking for a
Senior Technical Engineer
to lead our
Technical Department
, which includes the
QC/QA function
.
This is a leadership role responsible for technical support, QC/QA management, supplier quality, customer complaint resolution, engineering change control, product certification and internal workflow improvement.
The role reports directly to the
General Manager
and
Managing Director
.
We are looking for someone who can lead engineers, close process loopholes, prevent costly mistakes, control technical documentation and ensure that every product, supplier and department follows one
Company Department Structure
Engineering Edge’s key departments include:
Business Development, including Marketing
Supply Chain
Finance
HR
Technical, including QC/QA
The Senior Technical Engineer will lead the Technical Department and work closely with all departments to ensure technical, quality, and process requirements are properly controlled.
Key Responsibilities
1. Lead Technical & QC/QA Department
Lead and manage engineers and QC/QA personnel.
Plan, organize, and improve the Technical and QC/QA functions.
Set clear department standards, responsibilities and follow-up procedures.
Ensure timely technical and quality support to internal teams, customers and suppliers.
Build a culture of accuracy, accountability, discipline and continuous improvement.
2. Technical Support & Product Application
Provide product and application-related technical support to internal and external customers.
Support Business Development and Sales teams with technical advice, product comparison, and application guidance.
Analyze technical issues and propose practical solutions.
Develop and maintain technical documents, product guides, and training materials.
Translate technical information into clear explanations for customers and commercial teams.
3. QC/QA Management
Develop, maintain, and improve QC/QA processes, inspection plans and quality standards.
Ensure internal QC/QA procedures are properly followed and documented.
Conduct root cause analysis for technical and quality issues.
Implement corrective and preventive actions.
Ensure the QC/QA team meets internal, external and customer audit requirements.
Maintain control of inspection records, test reports, certificates and quality documentation.
4. Engineering Change & Drawing Control
Manage, track and catalogue engineering changes for every SKU.
Maintain clear visibility of product engineering changes, drawing revisions and technical specification updates.
Ensure each SKU has proper engineering history, including what changed, why it changed, when it changed and who approved it.
Control technical drawing revisions and ensure the latest approved drawings are used internally and by suppliers.
Assess how engineering changes affect product dimensions, performance, application, certification, packaging, inspection requirements and customer approval status.
Define whether a change requires a new SKU, revised drawing, customer approval, supplier requalification or updated inspection plan.
Prevent uncontrolled changes to products, drawings or specifications.
Ensure Business Development, Supply Chain, QC/QA and suppliers are informed of approved engineering changes.
Maintain proper version control for drawings, specifications, technical documents and product records.
5. Internal Workflow & Risk Control
Review internal department workflows and identify loopholes, weak controls and failure points.
Design practical workflows to prevent errors, miscommunication and costly mistakes.
Work with Business Development, Supply Chain, Finance, HR and Technical teams to align responsibilities and checkpoints.
Define approval processes, escalation rules and documentation requirements.
Ensure critical technical and quality decisions are properly recorded and followed through.
6. Supplier Quality Management
Establish and maintain supplier QC/QA requirements.
Conduct supplier audits, surveillance checks and supplier qualification assessments.
Ensure suppliers comply with EESG’s specifications, drawings, inspection standards and quality requirements.
Review supplier inspection reports, test reports and quality documents.
Work with suppliers to resolve quality issues and prevent recurrence.
Align supplier QC/QA plans with EESG’s internal standards.
7. Supplier Control of Change
Put in place a supplier control-of-change process for critical materials, tooling and processes.
Ensure suppliers seek approval before changing coating chemicals, plating chemicals, heat treatment processes, tooling, dies, raw materials, critical dimensions, packaging specifications or other quality-sensitive items.
Assess the technical and quality impact of supplier changes.
Coordinate testing, sample approval or requalification where required.
Ensure approved supplier changes are reflected in the relevant SKU records, drawings, specifications and QC/QA plans.
Prevent unauthorised supplier changes that may lead to product failure, customer complaints or certification issues.
8. Customer Complaint Handling
Establish and manage a structured customer complaint handling process.
Ensure complaints are recorded, investigated and resolved in a timely manner.
Lead technical investigations and root cause analysis.
Coordinate with Business Development, Supply Chain, QC/QA, suppliers and customers until closure.
Prepare investigation findings, corrective actions and customer response reports.
Convert complaint lessons into engineering updates, supplier improvements or internal process changes where required.
9. Product Testing, Certification & Compliance
Obtain and maintain product certifications required by target markets.
Coordinate with testing laboratories, certification bodies and external parties.
·Manage technical submissions, testing schedules and certification documents.
·Ensure certificates, test reports and compliance records are properly maintained.
Ensure engineering changes are reviewed against certification and customer approval requirements.
Requirements
Degree or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering or related discipline.
Minimum 5 years of relevant engineering, QA/QC, supplier quality, manufacturing or technical support experience.
Experience leading engineers, technical staff or QC/QA personnel is preferred.
Strong knowledge of QA/QC systems, inspection methods, supplier quality control and engineering change control.
Able to read and interpret technical drawings, specifications, inspection reports and test reports.

Digital Workflow, Automation & AI: also led by the Technology, Data & Delivery leader, this area will identify and deliver workflow, automation and AI opportunities, establish appropriate controls, and measure whether the expected benefits are realised.
The group works in close partnership with Operations, the Transformation Office, IT, Tactical Operations and Marquee Client teams. Roles may be permanent or approximately 12-month rotational assignments anchored in strategic locations. Rotational colleagues will join from the business, help shape and deliver change, and return to the line with broader project experience.
Your Role
You will lead end-to-end operating model and product redesign for a portfolio of Private Assets services, from problem definition through to adoption.
Lead the redesign of how a service runs end to end — not patching an existing process, but rebuilding it around what the business and clients actually need.
Translate operational pain points into a defined scope, business case and delivery plan.
Define the target operating model for a product or service, including roles, handoffs, controls and location strategy.
Develop and implement best practice standards across regions, driving consistency and efficiency.
Act as the Operations voice in client pitches, POCs and solution design, and hold the line on what is genuinely deliverable.
Lead operational solution design for our marquee clients, working alongside Client Services, Product and Client Integration.
Own the marquee solution reuse assessment — identifying where a client-specific build could be productised for the wider book, and leading that rollout.
Lead complex client transitions and implementations from an Operations standpoint, working alongside the integration team on new client setup.
Set out requirements with the Data, Reporting & Platform Enablement and Digital Workflow, Automation & AI focus areas where a redesign or client solution depends on data, platform or automation capability.
Coordinate across Operations, Tactical Operations, Marquee Client teams, Financial Statements, Tax, Investor Relations and Client Integration.
Lead and mentor focus area resources, including rotational colleagues joining from the business.
Report on progress, risks and benefits realisation to the relevant leader and senior stakeholders.
About You
You have 12–15 years’ experience in private assets, working at a fund administrator, fund manager or comparable environment.
Proven delivery of operating model redesign, process re-engineering or transformation initiatives in financial services.
Strong technical knowledge of private assets accounting and operations, including fund structures and complex calculations.
The ability to see a whole service end to end rather than a single desk, and to design for scale across jurisdictions.
Significant exposure to large or complex client relationships, with credibility in front of clients and the judgement to distinguish between a reasonable request and an unsustainable commitment.
The ability to recognise where a bespoke solution has wider application, and to make the case for productising it.
Comfortable working with data, reporting and platform teams and translating operational need into technical requirements.
Strong leadership skills and supervisory experience of other professionals, including rotational colleagues joining from the business.
Skilled in business planning, budgeting and stakeholder negotiation.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Advanced computer skills (Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint and SharePoint).
Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or a related field; professional accounting designation a plus.
What We Expect of the Strategic Operations Team
Regardless of role or focus area, everyone in Strategic Operations is expected to demonstrate the following:
Deep technical and operational knowledge — genuine depth in how our processes, data and platforms actually work — the detail that only comes from having run the work.
Curiosity — the instinct to ask why a process looks the way it does, to challenge the answer, and to keep asking whether there is a better way.

Title: Senior Vice President, Product Manager - Tech
Description:
We are seeking a Senior Vice President, Applied AI Product Manager – Tech to translate high-value business and client opportunities into viable AI-enabled products, agents and workflow capabilities.
Working alongside the Applied AI Product Manager, you will convert the product vision and intended business outcomes into a clear technical product approach, MVP, delivery backlog and implementation pathway. You will work closely with designers, engineers, AI and data specialists, business teams and control functions to move selected opportunities from discovery through prototype, pilot and production handoff.
You will determine how AI should be applied, how human and AI activities should interact and what data, integrations, controls and evaluation methods are required. You will ensure that proposed products are usable, technically feasible, measurable, governable and appropriate for a highly regulated environment.
You will be expected to operate confidently in technical detail, make informed product trade-offs and provide clear direction to multidisciplinary delivery teams.
In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:
Technical product definition
Partner with the Applied AI Product Manager and Designer to translate business problems, client needs and product concepts into technically viable AI-enabled products and workflows.
Define technical product vision, MVP scope, functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and delivery roadmap.
Own and prioritize the technical product backlog, balancing user value, business outcomes, feasibility, risk and delivery effort.
Identify appropriate applications of generative AI, agentic workflows, intelligent automation and decision-support capabilities.
Determine which activities should be automated, augmented, escalated or remain human-led.
AI product development and prototyping
Shape AI-enabled workflows, agents, prototypes and proofs of concept in partnership with AI, data, engineering and design teams.
Define requirements relating to data, integrations, permissions, model behavior, orchestration, user interaction and performance.
Guide product decisions involving large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, knowledge systems, prompt and context design and agentic workflows.
Use approved AI-enabled development and prototyping tools to accelerate research, requirements definition, experimentation and product delivery.
Design experiments that test the most important product and technical assumptions before significant investment is committed.
Delivery, governance and measurable outcomes
Lead the technical product journey from opportunity definition through prototype, MVP, pilot and production transition or handoff.
Coordinate engineers, AI and data specialists, designers, platform teams and control partners to maintain delivery momentum and resolve dependencies.
Establish evaluation criteria for product quality, reliability, model performance, user experience and business impact.
Incorporate responsible AI, data, privacy, security, compliance and operational-resilience requirements from the outset.
Use testing, user feedback and performance evidence to refine priorities and inform scale, redesign or stop decisions.
Maintain alignment between the product vision, technical execution, user needs and expected value.
Stakeholder leadership and capability building
Communicate technical product concepts, trade-offs and risks clearly to senior business, client and technology stakeholders.
Build trusted relationships across product, design, engineering, AI, data, operations, risk and business teams.
Create alignment between business and technical stakeholders and ensure key decisions are made at the appropriate level.
Provide direction and accountability across small, multidisciplinary delivery teams.
Mentor colleagues and strengthen applied AI and technical product-management capabilities across APAC.
Contribute reusable methods, patterns and practices that improve the quality and speed of future AI product delivery.
What we are looking for
The ideal candidate combines senior product-management experience, practical AI fluency, financial services knowledge and the ability to translate strategic intent into executable technical products.
You will bring:
Significant experience, typically 15 years or more across technical product management, technology-led transformation, innovation, consulting or enterprise delivery.
Recent experience shaping, building or scaling AI-enabled products, platforms, agents, workflow capabilities or intelligent automation.
Strong financial services expertise, ideally across banking, asset servicing, capital markets, payments, operations, risk, compliance or enterprise data.
Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business challenges into MVPs, product backlogs, requirements, roadmaps, prototypes and delivery plans.
Strong understanding of generative AI, large language model applications, intelligent automation, agentic workflows and responsible AI principles.
Practical familiarity with AI methods such as prompt and context design, retrieval-augmented generation, knowledge graphs, model evaluation or agent orchestration.
Working knowledge of enterprise technology concepts, including APIs, data flows, integration patterns, permissions, security and production readiness.
Experience taking enterprise products from discovery and prototype through pilot, adoption and production transition.
Experience using AI-assisted development, coding or prototyping tools would be advantageous.
Experience operating within complex, regulated and highly governed environments.
Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, prioritization and delivery-leadership skills.
A record of delivering measurable business or client outcomes rather than outputs alone.
Relevant product, agile, AI or industry qualifications would be beneficial; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
Behavioral attributes
The strongest candidates will be:
Technically curious and able to evaluate emerging AI capabilities critically.
Comfortable moving between product strategy, technical requirements and delivery detail.
Commercially aware and focused on applying technology to meaningful business and client problems.
Collaborative and low ego, with the ability to work across business, design and technical disciplines.
Able to create clarity and momentum when the product or delivery path is still evolving.
Open to challenge and willing to change direction when evidence invalidates an assumption.
Resilient in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities.
Risk-aware and thoughtful about applying AI within a regulated enterprise.
Committed to developing others and building sustainable team capability.

Description:
Edelman is a voice synonymous with trust, reimagining a future where the currency of communication is action. Our culture thrives on three promises: boldness is possibility, empathy is progress, and curiosity is momentum.
At Edelman, we understand diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging (DEIB) transform our colleagues, our company, our clients, and our communities. We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging.
SVP, Financial Communications (Capital Markets)
Location: Singapore
Edelman Smithfield is a global financial communications firm with the power and scope of Edelman, the world’s largest integrated communications company. We specialize in financial markets and strategic situations, serving clients around the world. Edelman Smithfield offers a deep and talented bench of approximately 225 financial market specialists across more than 25 cities and 15 countries.
Edelman Smithfield advises senior leaders and management teams navigating complex matters that impact reputation and valuation and has deep expertise in serving and communicating to the financial markets.
About The Opportunity
We are seeking a Senior Vice President to lead accounts, teams, and projects for a diverse portfolio of capital markets clients, including private equity and venture capital firms, hedge funds, traditional asset managers, and other institutional investors. The role encompasses executive positioning and reputation management, media relations, crisis and issues management, thought leadership development, regulatory and enforcement matters, transaction and deal communications, and strategic communications support for portfolio companies. Our work is designed to inform investors, navigate complex issues, and bridge divergent stakeholder needs in order to build trust and long-term enterprise value.
Responsibilities
- Provide expert financial communications and capital markets advice to both existing and new clients.
- Act as the primary client relationship manager, advising C-suite executives on financial communications.
- Collaborate with Edelman colleagues across regions and sectors to introduce Edelman Smithfield’s services to broader Edelman clients.
- Lead business development efforts, including pitches and new business opportunities related to financial communications.
- Drive marketing and thought leadership initiatives to elevate Edelman Smithfield’s presence in the U.S. and collaborate with global Edelman Smithfield teams to grow and develop the global practice.
- Ensure proactive, responsive service to clients, maintaining accountability for deliverables and deadlines.
- Oversee multiple complex projects from concept to completion, applying foresight, measurement frameworks, and problem-solving to deliver exceptional results.
- Maintain accountability for quality, performance, timelines, and budgets, ensuring operational efficiency across all account activities.
- Develop and manage staffing plans, budgets, and scopes of work to ensure operational excellence, profitability, and effective resource utilization.
- Mentor, empower, and motivate team members at all levels; provide constructive feedback, foster professional growth, and promote a culture of collaboration and innovation.
- Commit to continuous learning and leadership development while cultivating talent and driving excellence across the team.
Basic Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in political science, business, journalism, public policy, communications, or a related field.
- 10+ years of experience in financial communications
Preferred Qualifications
- Deep understanding of how companies can more effectively communicate to their financial audiences
- Proven experience counseling senior executives of clients operating in the capital markets space on communications matters
- Agency experience strongly preferred
- Proven ability to lead new business development efforts and pitch new services
- Strong media relations experience, including existing top-tier relationships
- Demonstrated experience in mentoring and developing junior talent
- Excellent writing, presentation, and analytical skills
- A proactive, organized leader who anticipates client needs and delivers exceptional service
- Strong interpersonal and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships with clients

As a core member of the Fundraising Team, you will play a pivotal role in directly contributing to the Society’s fundraising success. Your mission: secure philanthropic support, develop long-term corporate partnerships, and deliver fundraising initiatives that meet targets.
This role is highly results-oriented, focusing on pipeline development, donor stewardship, and end-to-end execution of fundraising projects, with clear accountability for KPIs.
We are looking for a proactive, strategic, and results-driven professional who can identify opportunities, engage donors, and convert relationships into sustained philanthropic support. More importantly, we want someone with the heart to serve the vulnerable and a passion to create real impact in the community. Experienced candidates will have the opportunity to lead projects, guide team members, and shape the team, directly contributing to the Society’s overall fundraising target and the long-term sustainability of our programmes that make a difference in the lives of those we serve.

Collaborate closely with internal teams, particularly Operations, Global Engagement, Marketing & Communications and Volunteer Management, to drive awareness and support for fundraising initiatives.

During system development & maintenance engagements: support ongoing model/prompt tuning and monitoring as applications move toward production.

Collaborate with developers on integrating models into the POC workflow, and work closely with PM, devs, and SMEs to refine data and prompts.

3+ years hands-on experience in
AI/ML or Gen AI engineering
.

RAG,

Familiarity with agentic orchestration frameworks (AWS Strands, LangGraph, or equivalent), for designing and testing multi-step agent workflows.
Ability to do rapid experimentation rather than perfect models.
Basic proficiency in Python and Gen AI tools (e.g., model SDKs, vector DBs).
Experience integrating OpenAI APIs into HR helpdesk workflows and combining AI with RPA, business applications and enterprise processes

Gooddata wrangling skills to prepare small datasets quickly

Tax and finance teams in Asia are changing how they handle compliance as e-invoicing mandates spread, Pillar Two moves from analysis to reporting, and pressure grows to use automation and AI. Collaborate with product, marketing, implementation, and sales teams to bring customer feedback and market insight back into the business

5 to 7 years of experience in solution consulting, pre-sales, or tax technology consulting, ideally in tax, e-invoicing, or finance transformation

Collaborative approach with sales, product, marketing, and delivery teams

Title: SPECIALIST TEACHER: ENGLISH LANGUAGE LEARNING (ELL)
Description:
ROLE:
The ELL Teacher will build foundational systems, policies, and inclusive practices for multilingual learners while delivering a comprehensive English language program. The role is distinguished by its dual emphasis on language development and academic integration, working across grades and subjects to ensure students gain English proficiency alongside continued cognitive growth.
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:
Develop and Implement Curriculum
:
Design and implement an age-appropriate English language curriculum aligned with school standards and the science of learning.
Deliver targeted instruction aligned to internationally recognized frameworks.
Differentiate lessons to develop listening, speaking, reading, and writing across proficiency levels.
Apply research-based strategies, including sheltered instruction and language scaffolding.
Use varied, engaging approaches—such as collaborative, hands-on, and inquiry-based learning—to promote engagement and critical thinking.
Create a Positive and Inclusive Classroom Environment
:
Foster a supportive, safe, and inclusive classroom where all students feel valued and respected.
Establish clear expectations for behavior, classroom routines, and academic goals, creating a structured and nurturing environment.
Promote social-emotional learning, helping students build essential skills such as empathy, collaboration, and self-regulation.
Assess Student Progress and Provide Feedback
:
Regularly assess students’ English proficiency through formal and informal assessments, including tests, quizzes, projects, and observations.
Provide constructive, timely, and personalized feedback to students to help them understand their strengths and areas for improvement.
Use assessment data to adjust teaching strategies and support individual learning needs.
Differentiate Instruction to Meet Student Needs
:
Tailor lessons to accommodate diverse learning styles, abilities, and backgrounds, ensuring that each student has the opportunity to succeed.
Modify assignments, assessments, and classroom activities for students with varying levels of understanding and those with special needs.
Provide additional support for students who need extra help and offer enrichment opportunities for advanced learners.
Support Social and Emotional Development
:
Support the development of students' social-emotional skills, including conflict resolution, communication, and self-awareness.
Foster positive relationships among students through team-building exercises, class discussions, and cooperative learning activities.
Help students set personal goals, track their progress, and celebrate achievements to build confidence and motivation.
Collaborate with Other Teachers and Staff
:
Work closely with other teachers and/or subject-specific teachers to support students' individual needs.
Participate in school-wide initiatives and collaborate with other teachers to plan interdisciplinary projects or school events.
Attend meetings with school leadership, counselors, and other staff to discuss students’ academic, social, and emotional progress.
Communicate with Parents and Caregivers
:
Regularly update parents on their child's academic progress, behavior, and overall well-being through newsletters, emails, and parent-teacher conferences.
Maintain open lines of communication with parents to address concerns, provide updates, and collaborate on strategies to support student learning at home.
Provide parents with resources and suggestions to help their children with homework, studying, and personal development.
Manage Classroom Behavior and Foster Positive Relationships
:
Establish clear classroom rules and routines to maintain order and encourage positive behavior.
Use positive reinforcement techniques to motivate students and promote a positive learning environment.
Address behavioral issues in a constructive manner, using conflict resolution strategies and involving students in discussions about appropriate behavior.
Plan and Supervise Field Trips and Extracurricular Activities
:
Organize and supervise field trips, school events, and extracurricular activities that enhance students' learning experiences and provide real-world connections to classroom content.
Ensure that activities are educational, engaging, and safe for students.
Communicate with parents about upcoming trips and volunteer opportunities to ensure participation and support.
Create and Maintain Classroom Materials and Resources
:
Organize and maintain classroom supplies, materials, and resources to ensure a well-prepared learning environment.
Prepare visual aids, bulletin boards, and learning stations that support student engagement and enhance classroom instruction.
Maintain student records, including grades, attendance, and progress reports, in an organized and accessible manner.
Engage in Professional Development
:
Participate in professional development opportunities to stay current with best practices in teaching, curriculum development, and classroom management.
Attend workshops, conferences, and seminars to learn new teaching strategies, educational technologies, and methods for supporting diverse learners.
Collaborate with colleagues to share knowledge, resources, and strategies that improve teaching and student outcomes.
Support School Community and Culture
:
Actively participate in school events, activities, and committees that promote school spirit and community engagement.
Serve as a role model for students by demonstrating respect, responsibility, and commitment to the school community.
Foster positive relationships with colleagues, students, and parents, contributing to a collaborative and welcoming school environment.

A minimum of three years of relevant and successful full-time teaching experience in a K-12 school. Direct experience in an ELL/ELA-focused role is ideal.

Curriculum and program development knowledge preferred.
Strong communication and coaching skill.

Sound EQ, empathy and a strong understanding of self.

Internationally minded and accepting of all people regardless of age, gender, sexual persuasion, culture or language.
Creative and innovative in ideas and outlook.
Sense of humor.

Title: Sponsorship Director – Sustainability Events
Description:
Sponsorship Director – Sustainability Events
Singapore based
up to $86,000 DOE
An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Sponsorship Director – Sustainability Events to join Times Higher Education’s rapidly growing events team to drive sales efforts globally with clients in the sustainability sector. The role will focus on building out the partner offering securing new sponsors for THE’s flagship sustainability event: Global Sustainable Development Congress (GSDC).
The Global Sustainable Development Congress is convened by Times Higher Education and brings together the world's leading thinkers, policymakers and actors from different sectors to drive new alliances and create positive action for a more sustainable future. The GSDC was launched by THE in 2021 and has grown to bring together more than 5,000 delegates across industry, academia, government and third-sector bodies – establishing itself as the leading cross-community sustainability focussed event globally.
Reporting directly to the GSDC Event Director, the candidate will work closely with the events content, marketing, and operations teams to successfully onboard new clients into the event ecosystem. The role will be responsible for driving sales with corporate businesses working within the global sustainability landscape and will have a full global remit to grow our footprint in this new market.
The candidate will benefit from significant support from management and marketing functions across the business but will have a large degree of autonomy in establishing themselves as a sector expert and setting their own strategy to drive best results commercially.
This role will require travel both domestically and internationally to attend events, client meetings and industry conferences. You will be working alongside a dynamic and committed team and will be adept at working effectively both independently and also creatively within a hard-working team.
Key Responsibilities
Build relationships from the ground up; find, engage and nurture your own client base of corporate companies
Drive event sales growth by identifying and winning new business opportunities
Manage the end-to-end sales process, from initial prospecting and high-impact proposals to negotiating complex contracts and closing
Prepare and present regular sales forecasts, performance reports, and market analyses to senior leadership
Partner with the Event Director and Marketing team to develop targeted lead generation campaigns that specifically address the needs of the sustainability market
Create innovative solutions that meet your clients’ needs and that keep GSDC and THE at the forefront in the market
Maintain an overview of competitor landscape
Resolve customer issues by investigating problems; developing solutions; preparing reports; making recommendations to management.
Maintain professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops; reviewing professional publications; establishing personal networks; participating in professional societies.
Attend industry events to maintain relationships with clients and develop new relationships
Experience and Skills Required:
Sales background ideally in live or digital events, with experience in the sustainability sector highly desirable
Quick to grasp new concepts and understand the value proposition for different groups of prospective clients
Confident and independent self-starter who is able to hit the ground running
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work with senior leaders from government, education and industry
Commercially astute and entrepreneurial outlook
Ability to work to agreed deadlines, working well under pressure
Excellent planning and organisational skills in order to manage and prioritise workload
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Passionate about the power of education and importance of sustainability to global development
MS Office essential – Word, Excel and PowerPoint
Flexibility to travel internationally to THE and industry

You do You. With colleagues located around the world, we know that our individuality and diversity of experiences are our greatest strengths. That’s why we want THE to be a place where you are welcome to be who you want to be at work; where you can share whatever part of your life or self-identity you want, without obligation or facing discrimination; and where all abilities and perspectives are recognised and accommodated.
