- Evangelize the AI Data Cloud through speaking engagements, social media, video, and community engagement across customers, partners, media, analysts, and broader industry audiences.
- Develop compelling messaging, content, and sales enablement assets for Snowflake teams and partner teams.
- Partner cross-functionally with demand generation, content marketing, sales, product management, and global stakeholders to align and execute regional go-to-market plans.
- Own and lead end-to-end product launches for ASEAN, including internal and external briefings, spokesperson support, enablement content and sessions, and alignment with marketing and PR on launch campaigns and events.
- Build market and competitive intelligence, and serve as a thought leader on the trends shaping the industry.
- Champion diversity and belonging as part of how we work, lead, and grow as a company.
What Makes You a Stand Out
You’re equal parts strategist, storyteller, and technologist. You can move comfortably from executive conversations to technical narratives, from launch planning to live evangelism, and from market insight to field execution.
Our ideal candidate brings:
- 15-20+ years of experience spanning technology, product, and market-facing roles, with strong exposure to data management and AI/ML.
- Strong cross-functional leadership skills, including the ability to influence without authority and work effectively with senior stakeholders.
- Outstanding communication and presentation skills, with confidence engaging internal leaders, external stakeholders, and public audiences.
- Excellent writing skills, with the ability to distill complex ideas into clear, compelling presentations and plans.
- A track record of working on complex data solutions and demonstrating architectural or technical leadership.
- An analytical mindset, with the ability to interpret information and turn it into actionable insight.
- Strong understanding of both the technical foundations and business value of modern data technologies, across on-premises and cloud environments.
- Experience with database products.
- A BS/BA or equivalent practical experience.
- A proven history of partnering with field GTM teams—across marketing, sales, and solution engineering—to create high-impact content and messaging that connects with diverse personas, from technical practitioners to C-level executives like the CMO, CFO, and CRO.
- Deep insight into the unique technological landscape and market dynamics across the ASEAN region.
- Professional fluency in regional languages including Bahasa, Mandarin, Cantonese or Thai is strongly advantageous, complementing English proficiency.
WHY SNOWFLAKE
Snowflake is growing quickly, and we’re building a team of people who challenge conventional thinking, move with urgency, and create meaningful impact. We care deeply about our people, customers, culture, and values—and we’re looking for people with the growth mindset to solve for today while building for the future.
If you want a role with visibility, influence, and the opportunity to shape one of the most important categories in enterprise technology, this is your moment.
READY TO MAKE YOUR IMPACT
Join Snowflake and help define how the AI Data Cloud wins in ASEAN.
Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

Key Responsibilities
1.Agent Management & Engagement
- Manage day-to-day communications and relationships with local and overseas education agents and recruitment partners.
- Coordinate agent onboarding, documentation, training and ongoing engagement.
- Ensure agents receive accurate and current information on programmes, entry requirements, fees, institutional information and recruitment procedures.
- Conduct briefings and updates for agents on programmes, marketing requirements and relevant regulatory requirements.
- Review agent-generate or distributed promotional content to ensure consistency with approved institutional information and applicable requirements.
- Maintain accurate and audit-ready records of agent communications, training, documentation and marketing materials.

- Maintain appropriate records of advertisements, campaign materials, approvals and revisions for compliance and audit purposes.

- Conduct regular website reviews and coordinate the correction or removal of outdated, inaccurate or potentially non-compliant information.
- Monitor website functionality and coordinate with external developers or vendors for complex technical development or troubleshooting where required.
- Apply basic SEO and web analytics practices to improve website visibility, user experience and recruitment effectiveness.
- Develop, edit, translate and proofread institutional and programme-related marketing content in English and Chinese across websites, digital platforms and other communication channels.
- Design and produce digital and print marketing materials, including brochures, advertisements, social media content, presentations, website graphics, banners and recruitment collateral.

Title: Integrated Marketing Manager
Description:
About Pinterest:
Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we're on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.
Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other's unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It's Possible.
At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we're looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we'll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.
Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.
The Pinterest Business Marketing team is composed of highly skilled marketing generalists, able to flex with equal strength among marketing strategy, copywriting, project management, cross-functional team leadership, event planning and creative oversight. Most importantly, we are business marketers, able to capture hearts and minds with engaging, inspirational work that drives business impact. Expect to roll up your sleeves, grow quickly, pivot often and learn a lot.
As an Integrated Marketing Manager, you will define and deliver our B2B marketing strategy for the Greater China Region. This role requires strong B2B marketing background, project management expertise and a proven ability to influence and manage partners towards a common goal. You will partner closely with Business Marketing leadership, cross-functional partners and our external global sales partners to lead marketing strategy that supports revenue goals.
What you'll do:
Define and deliver the local marketing strategy to support the business in the Greater China Region, leveraging best practices, learnings, industry trends and insights on both Pinterest and competitors
Develop & own key initiatives that are aligned to global business marketing strategies to shift advertiser perceptions and behaviours. This includes strategies across industry marketing, owned events, content marketing, trade media and industry body partnerships, executive engagement, scaled education and success story creation
Develop scalable processes to enable our global sales partners in the region, offering consultation and guidance to ensure their success
Work closely with local and global teams to ensure that global programs resonate locally and meet local sales and marketing needs.
Measure the impact of local marketing initiatives and adjust strategies as needed to achieve business goals
Manage budgets, timelines, and resources to ensure successful execution.
What we're looking for:
Minimal 6-8 years experience in integrated marketing including previous experience working with resellers/agencies
Strong comfort level with B2B marketing
Must have proven integrated marketing experience in the Greater China region including deep understanding of local insights, media landscape, and digital platforms.
Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
Excellent organisational and project management skills to effectively handle multiple projects, stakeholders and deadlines
Fluency in business Mandarin, Simplified Chinese and English is a must.

Title: PUBLIC RELATIONS OFFICER
Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled and motivated Public Relations Officer to join our team. As a Public Relations Officer, you will be responsible for managing and enhancing the public image and reputation of our organization. You will develop and execute effective communication strategies, build relationships with key stakeholders, and handle media relations. The ideal candidate has exceptional communication skills, a strong understanding of public relations principles, and the ability to adapt to a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
Responsibilities
Communication Strategy: Develop and implement comprehensive communication strategies that align with the organization's goals and objectives. Create messaging frameworks, key talking points, and press releases to effectively convey the organization's mission, initiatives, and achievements.
Media Relations: Cultivate and maintain relationships with media representatives, journalists, and influencers. Proactively pitch stories and secure media coverage for the organization and its events, campaigns, and milestones. Serve as the primary point of contact for media inquiries and coordinate interviews and press conferences.
Content Creation: Write, edit, and distribute compelling and engaging content for various channels, including press releases, newsletters, articles, blog posts, and social media. Ensure all content is accurate, consistent, and aligned with the organization's brand and messaging.
Crisis Management: Act as the organization's spokesperson during times of crisis or reputation management issues. Develop crisis communication plans, prepare key messaging, and manage media inquiries effectively. Mitigate potential damage to the organization's reputation and maintain transparency and trust with stakeholders.
Stakeholder Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including clients, partners, government agencies, and community organizations. Develop communication materials tailored to specific audiences and collaborate with internal teams to ensure consistent messaging across all touchpoints.
Event Planning and Management: Coordinate and oversee the planning and execution of press conferences, product launches, corporate events, and other public relations initiatives. Work closely with event organizers, vendors, and internal teams to ensure seamless execution and maximum media exposure.
Monitoring and Reporting: Monitor media coverage and public sentiment related to the organization and its industry. Prepare regular reports on media activity, campaign effectiveness, and key performance indicators. Analyze data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
Requirements
Experience working in the entertainment and nightlife industry
Able to work on weekends and public holidays if required
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building abilities.
Knowledge of public relations principles, strategies, and best practices.
Experience in media relations, including pitching stories and handling media inquiries.
Ability to effectively manage crisis situations and handle sensitive information.
Familiarity with social media platforms and digital marketing trends.
Exceptional organizational and time management skills.
Proficiency in relevant software and tools.
Knowledge of mandarin dialect is essential as our customer base is primarily mandarin speaking
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
Able to work late-night hours up to 3am, including weekends and public holidays
We offer a competitive salary, along with benefits and opportunities for professional growth. If you have a passion for public relations, a knack for storytelling, and a desire to shape and protect our organization's reputation, we invite you to apply for the position of Public Relations Officer.

Title: Senior Associate, Marketing & Media Communications, North APAC, Japanese Speaking
Description:

Business Unit: Fitch Group
Category: Marketing & Communications
Location:
Singapore, SG
Date Posted: Oct 14, 2026
Fitch Group is currently seeking a senior associate, Marketing and Media Communications based out of our Hong Kong or Singapore office. Fluent Japanese language skills are required for this role - near Native-level Japanese proficiency, with strong cultural awareness.
As a leading, global financial information services provider, Fitch Group delivers vital credit and risk insights, robust data, and dynamic tools to champion more efficient, transparent financial markets. With over 100 years of experience and colleagues in over 30 countries, Fitch Group’s culture of credibility, independence, and transparency is embedded throughout its structure, which includes Fitch Ratings, one of the world’s top three credit ratings agencies, and Fitch Solutions, a leading provider of insights, data and analytics. With dual headquarters in London and New York, Fitch Group is owned by Hearst.
Fitch Ratings Marketing and Communications organisation is responsible for developing and executing external communication strategies that drive brand awareness, market visibility, and business growth. It is highly collaborative and draws on expertise from shared service functions such as digital marketing, creative and design, events, and marketing operations to ensure cohesive, commercially focused communications programmes.
As a member of the team, you will be joining Fitch Ratings at a pivotal time of growth and transformation, with the opportunity to help shape how our thought leadership reaches key audiences.
How You’ll Make an Impact:
Support regional media strategies across North APAC, with a focus on Japan, Korea and Greater China, to strengthen the visibility, reputation and commercial relevance of Fitch’s thought leadership.
Identify timely, differentiated media opportunities from Fitch research, rating actions and market developments, and translate complex analysis into clear pitches, briefings, Q&As and spokesperson messaging.
Build targeted journalist engagement by packaging and distributing newsworthy research, coordinating interviews and briefings, and maintaining accurate media contacts and distribution databases.
Track Fitch and competitor coverage using media-monitoring and research tools, producing reports, dashboards and evidence-based insights that demonstrate communications impact and inform stakeholder decisions.
Contribute to integrated campaigns across events, awards, social media, digital channels and local-language content, collaborating with regional marketing, design, video and analytical teams.
You May be a Good Fit if:
Excellent written and spoken English and professional-level Japanese, together with strong writing, editing and storytelling skills for complex financial, economic or analytical topics.
Hands-on experience supporting media relations, journalist outreach, spokesperson preparation, social media content or campaign reporting, with proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint and familiarity with media databases and analytics tools.
Bachelor’s degree in communications, journalism, public relations, marketing, business, finance or a related discipline, with typically 3–5 years of relevant professional experience.
What Would Make You Stand Out:
Excellent written and spoken English and professional-level Japanese, together with strong writing, editing and storytelling skills for complex financial, economic or analytical topics

Title: Social Media & Audience Development Specialist, MAVU
Description:
The Chinese Media Group (CMG) is establishing a new unit, Misinformation Awareness & Verification Unit (MAVU), dedicated to strengthening information integrity in the digital age. Combining journalism, digital verification and public education, the unit aims to produce trusted, evidence-based reporting, practical verification tools and innovative ways of strengthening media literacy in Singapore and beyond.
We are looking for a creative, audience-focused and digitally savvy Social Media Specialist to build and grow the unit's presence and engagement across social media platforms. You will play a pivotal role in translating complex investigations and digital issues into engaging, platform-native content that informs and allows audiences to better navigate today's information environment.
Working closely with the editorial and product teams, you will develop the unit's social media strategy, produce original content and foster meaningful engagement with audiences across Singapore and the region.
Key Responsibilities
- Develop and execute the unit's social media strategy across major platforms, with a strong focus on Chinese-language social media and messaging ecosystems.
- Create and publish platform-native content, including short-form videos, graphics, explainers and interactive posts that translate complex digital investigations and verification findings into engaging content that promotes information literacy and public education.
- Grow and manage the unit's online communities by monitoring conversations, engaging audiences where appropriate, and identifying emerging trends, misinformation narratives and audience concerns.
- Monitor and leverage on audience insights and platform analytics to optimise content performance, evaluate impact and refine content and engagement strategies.
- Collaborate with the editorial, product and technology teams to develop innovative storytelling formats, campaigns and digital initiatives that strengthen information literacy and public trust.
Required Qualifications
- Diploma/bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications, digital media, marketing, multimedia, design or a related discipline.
- At least three years of relevant experience in social media, digital content, audience engagement, journalism or related fields.
- Candidates with experience managing Chinese-language social media accounts or developing digital audience strategies are preferred.
- Excellent command of written and spoken English and Chinese is required, as the role involves managing Chinese-language social media ecosystems and supporting Chinese publications.
- Strong news judgment, curiosity and keen awareness of current affairs, emerging misinformation trends and the evolving digital information landscape.
- Strong understanding of social media platforms, audience behaviour and digital content trends, particularly across Chinese-language platforms such as WeChat, Xiaohongshu, Douyin and Weibo, as well as Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok and Telegram.
- Excellent storytelling skills with the ability to adapt content creatively for different social media platforms, content formats and audiences.
- Proficient in social content creation, including short-form video production, graphic design and AI-assisted creative tools e.g., Canva, CapCut, Premiere Pro, Photoshop or similar platforms.
- Experienced in using audience analytics and social media management tools to measure and optimise content performance and audience engagement and identify trends.
- Proactive, collaborative and possesses a creative mindset and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
To Apply
Please send us your CV together with a brief cover letter (300–500 words) answering the following questions:
- Tell us about a social media account, campaign or content series that you managed or contributed significantly to. What was your strategy, what role did you play, and how did you measure its success?
- Imagine you are launching social media accounts for a new information integrity initiative aimed at helping Singaporeans identify misinformation and AI-generated content. Which platform would you prioritise first, what type of content would you create, and why?
(Note: Please ensure you answer the two questions above and attach your submission when applying. Incomplete applications without these answers will not be considered.)
职位总体目标
人工智能正在改变资讯世界，也让辨识真假变得越来越困难。 新报业媒体华文媒体集团（CMG）正成立全新的数码调查与资讯诚信单位，结合调查报道、数码查证与公众教育，探索人工智能时代的新型新闻实践，并帮助公众提升资讯辨识能力。 我们诚邀具创意、以受众为中心，并熟悉社交媒体生态的人才加入团队，负责建立及拓展单位在各大社交媒体平台上的品牌影响力及受众互动。 你将与记者、编辑及产品团队紧密合作，制定单位的社交媒体策略，策划及制作原创内容，并把复杂的数码调查报道和数码资讯议题，转化为适合不同平台特性、兼具吸引力及教育意义的内容，帮助新加坡及区域的受众更好地理解和应对当今复杂的资讯环境。
工作职责
- 制定及执行单位的社交媒体策略，负责各大社交媒体平台的日常营运，重点拓展华文社交媒体及即时通讯平台的影响力。
- 策划、制作及发布符合不同平台特性的原创内容，包括短视频、图文、资讯图表、互动内容及其他创意形式，将复杂的数码调查和资讯核查成果转化为具吸引力的内容，推动资讯素养和公众教育。
- 建立及经营单位的线上社群，持续关注社群讨论，适时与受众互动，并识别新兴趋势、错误与虚假资讯叙事及受众关注议题。
- 持续监测并运用受众洞察及平台分析数据，优化内容表现、评估成效，并持续完善内容及受众互动策略。
- 与编辑、产品及技术团队紧密合作，探索创新叙事形式及数码传播项目，提升公众资讯素养及对可信资讯的信任。

- 具备至少三年在社交媒体、数码内容、用户发展、新闻或相关领域的工作经验。
- 曾负责华文社交媒体帐号营运，或具备用户增长及数码传播策略经验者将获优先考虑。

Euromonitor International is seeking a commercially minded and data-savvy individual to join our Syndicated Research team as a Analyst/Senior Analyst with a strong focus on client engagement and insight delivery. Final job level will commensurate with experience.
You will leverage Euromonitor's Passport database—a comprehensive source of global market intelligence—to support client queries, deliver insights, and engage in strategic conversations with key stakeholders across consumer goods and services sectors in Southeast Asia. - You will be at the forefront of client engagement, helping organizations unlock value from our data and reports.
- Your work will shape how our insights are applied, focusing on strategic conversations rather than research creation.
- You'll serve as a bridge between our research and commercial teams, helping clients translate data into business actions.

- Act as a first line of support for client queries related to Passport data and reports, ensuring quick, clear, and confident responses.
- Use existing Passport data and content to deliver actionable insights to clients within consumer goods and services space, across Southeast Asia.
- Participate in and lead client engagements, meetings, webinars, and workshops, providing guidance on how to best use Euromonitor's data for strategic decision-making.
- Collaborate with internal teams (research data team, consulting, sales) to align client needs with available data and solutions.
- Monitor usage patterns and common queries to identify training opportunities and collaborate with sales for potential upsell areas.
- Represent Euromonitor at client briefings and industry-facing events as needed.

Title: Communications & Marketing Executive
Description:
About the Role:
The Communications & Marketing Executive plays a vital role in promoting Practice and its programmes, as well as advocating for the value and importance of Singapore theatre by crafting compelling marketing campaigns and fostering strategic partnerships. Reporting to the managers/lead of the department, you'll work closely with internal and external stakeholders to achieve our organisational goals and objectives, ensuring the success of our diverse programmes and initiatives.
What You'll Do:
Assist the team in brainstorming and executing marketing and publicity strategies for sales, ticketing, and promotions.
Develop and execute comprehensive marketing communication plans across various communication channels, including direct marketing, digital marketing, advertising, etc.

Setting realistic deadlines for each phase of the project
Identifying and managing dependencies between tasks
Monitoring progress and making adjustments as needed
Manage social media strategy and content calendar. Work closely with the team to create content, schedule and publish content consistently, track and analyse key metrics to provide feedback, and respond and engage with the online community.
Develop and foster strategic partnerships with like-minded organisations for increased publicity.
Collaborate with various stakeholders to maintain consistent brand messaging.
Attend regular meetings and contribute ideas and insights to achieve marketing and sales targets.
Communicate effectively with partners and audiences, handle inquiries professionally, and gather feedback for improvement.
Provide administrative support to team members as needed.
Who You Are:
You are passionate about theatre and the performing arts.
You possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
You have strong organisational and time management skills.
You are creative, resourceful, and a team player.
Experience in marketing, communications, or a related field is an advantage.
Proficiency in social media platforms and digital marketing tools is preferred.
Comfortable working across English and Chinese communications, including reviewing bilingual marketing materials.
The Theatre Practice (Practice) is Singapore’s longest-standing professional bilingual theatre institution. Artist-driven and deeply progressive, Practice strives to be an arts space in Singapore that consciously nurtures and empowers people who care about humanity. Over the past 61 years, we have developed and presented works that aim to reflect the richness and complexities of Singapore’s diverse cultures.
Today, we carry on the work of our visionary co-founders and cultural medallion recipients, Kuo Pao Kun and Goh Lay Kuan. Under the helm of current Artistic Director Kuo Jian Hong, Practice continues to shape Singapore’s cultural landscape as the definitive voice in Singapore theatre. Jian Hong is deeply influenced by the importance of play in art-making and under her leadership, Practice has become the embodiment of the irrepressible spirit and fearless experimentation of play.
Practice is motivated by a desire to always respectfully entertain. We have collaborated with Singapore and international artists alike to present a critically-acclaimed repertoire of over 330 productions including musicals, classics, original and experimental works. We have toured extensively in the region. Many of our works have entered the canon of Southeast Asian literature and have been adapted and presented by theatre companies worldwide, presenting an authentically Singaporean voice on the world stage.
Since our inception, Practice has served as a cultural bridge between Asia and the world. Our current theatre festival – M1 Patch! A Theatre Festival of Artful Play – comes from a legacy of carefully curated festivals and seminars that gather practitioners of all disciplines and cultures for sharing and exchange, while providing a valuable platform for outstanding international works.
As pioneers in Arts Education in Singapore, Practice has been instrumental both in nurturing leaders in the Singapore arts scene, and inculcating a love for the arts in generations of Singapore youth.
Artistically diverse and constantly relevant, Practice will always engage with the ceaseless exploration of new frontiers.
The Theatre Practice is an Institution of Public Character, a recipient of the National Arts Council’s Major Grant 2017-2020, and a member of the Singapore Chinese Language Theatre Alliance.

Title: E Commerce Digital Marketing Executive
Description:
About the Role
We're looking for a hands-on Ecommerce Digital Marketer whose single most important job is simple: drive sales on our ecommerce platforms. You will own the full revenue funnel — from paid ads that bring traffic in, to the pricing, bundles, and promotions that convert browsers into buyers.
This is not a branding or content-only role. You will be measured on GMV, ROAS, and conversion rate. If you love seeing numbers go up and know how to make it happen with ads and offers, this role is for you.
Key Responsibilities
1. Paid Advertising (Traffic & Sales)
Plan, launch, and optimize paid campaigns across TikTok Ads (GMV Max / Product Shopping Ads), Meta Ads, and platform ads (Shopee Ads, Lazada Sponsored Solutions)
Manage monthly ad budgets with clear ROAS targets; scale winners, kill losers fast
Run A/B tests on creatives, audiences, and landing/product pages
Work with content team on ad creatives (short video, image, live-stream traffic)
2. Pricing, Bundles & Promotions
Own the promo calendar: double-date campaigns (9.9, 10.10, 11.11, 12.12), payday sales, flash deals, platform mega campaigns
Design product bundles, tiered discounts, gift-with-purchase, and vouchers to raise average order value (AOV)
Monitor competitor pricing and adjust our offers to stay attractive without killing margin
Coordinate with operations on stock levels before launching promos
3. Livestream Commerce Support
Design livestream-exclusive offers: flash prices, limited-quantity deals, live-only bundles, and voucher drops timed to peak viewership
Set pricing and promo mechanics before each stream (anchor price vs. live price, countdown deals, tiered unlocks e.g. "hit 500 viewers, price drops")
Coordinate with hosts/streamers on the offer rundown: what to push, in what order, at what price point
Run live traffic ads (e.g. TikTok LIVE Shopping Ads) to boost stream viewership during key selling windows
Review post-stream data (GPM, viewers, conversion, top SKUs) and refine offer mechanics for the next stream
4. Conversion & Store Optimization
Optimize product listings: titles, images, descriptions, reviews, ratings
Improve store conversion rate through better merchandising and offer placement
Set up and manage affiliate/influencer commissions where relevant (TikTok Affiliate)
5. Reporting & Analysis
Track and report weekly on GMV, ROAS, CPA, conversion rate, AOV, and margin impact of promos
Provide clear recommendations: what worked, what didn't, what we do next week
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Monthly GMV / sales target achievement
Blended ROAS across paid channels
Store conversion rate and AOV growth
Promo campaign performance (uplift vs. baseline, margin protected)
Livestream performance: GPM (GMV per 1,000 views), live conversion rate, and stream-over-stream GMV growth
Requirements
2–4 years' hands-on experience in ecommerce performance marketing (TikTok Shop, Shopee, or Lazada strongly preferred)
Proven track record of hitting sales/ROAS targets — be ready to show numbers in the interview
Practical experience managing ad budgets of at least [SGD 10K+/month]
Strong grasp of pricing psychology, bundling, and promo mechanics in SEA marketplaces
Comfortable with data: can pull numbers, build a simple report, and explain what to do about it
Bilingual in English and Mandarin (our market and content are heavily Chinese-speaking)
Experience supporting live-commerce (TikTok LIVE / Shopee Live): offer planning, live pricing mechanics, or live traffic boosting
Willing to work around livestream schedules, including some evenings/weekends during major campaigns
Bonus: experience with affiliate programs or beauty/FMCG products
Who You Are
A doer, not just a planner — you launch fast, learn fast, and iterate
Commercially minded: you think in margin and profit, not just clicks and views
Self-driven; you don't wait to be told what to test next
Thrive in a fast-moving, target-driven environment
What We Offer
Base salary + kpi incentives
Real ownership of a revenue channel with direct visibility to leadership
Fast-growing brand portfolio with room to grow into a lead role
[Other benefits: CPF, medical, flexible arrangements, etc.]

Title: Field Marketing Manager - Asia
Description:
At Jensen Hughes, we help create safe, secure and resilient communities around the world. As a global leader in fire engineering, safety, security and risk-based consulting, our work makes a real difference to the people and places around us.
We're looking for an experienced Field Marketing Manager to join our global marketing team. This is an opportunity to influence how one of the world's leading consulting firms connects with clients, builds its brand and drives business growth across diverse and rapidly evolving markets, including Korea, Greater China, Singapore and Malaysia.
You will work closely with regional leaders, technical experts and the global marketing team to deliver marketing activities that support business objectives and build brand visibility across Asia.
You will join a collaborative global marketing team where ideas are encouraged, innovation is valued and success is shared. If you enjoy balancing strategy with execution, thrive in a fast-paced professional environment and love bringing great stories to life, we would love to hear from you. Working with the global marketing team, you will manage a range of activities including content development, events, digital marketing initiatives such as social media, webinars, and email campaigns.
In this role you will
- Deliver marketing end to end marketing campaigns across Korea, Greater China, Singapore and Malaysia.
- Work closely with regional leaders and technical experts to develop and execute marketing activities that support business growth.
- Be part of a highly collaborative global marketing team that values creativity, initiative and continuous learning.
- Work for a respected international organisation with outstanding career development opportunities.
- This role can be based in Seoul, Singapore, Malaysia, Auckland, Sydney, Brisbane or Melbourne.
If you're looking for a role where your ideas are valued, your work has a visible impact, and your career can continue to grow on an international stage, we would love to welcome you to Jensen Hughes.
Essential functions and duties:
- Collaborate with subject matter experts, regional leaders, and business development specialists to identify and prioritise regional marketing needs and translate them into action plans.
- Support global marketing team colleagues on projects that cross regions and service lines, contributing to a collaborative and team orientated marketing function.
- Plan, coordinate and deliver end to end marketing campaigns and activities that support regional and service line priorities. Tactics may include thought leadership initiatives articles, blogs, webinars, podcasts, case studies, social media, email, speaking opportunities, events/conferences support.
- Adapt marketing plans to regional and cultural differences while fostering open, collaborative communication and diverse perspectives.

- Use marketing data to identify opportunities and provide recommendations to improve campaign performance.

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing or a related field of study is preferred.

- Technical writing, marketing copywriting experience (experience with AP writing style preferred).

- Exceptional attention to detail, quality control review, copywriting, grammatical and proofreading skills.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver projects to deadline.

- Strong understanding of brand elements and guidelines.

Title: General Manager, Regional Marketing
Description:
Nippon Shokubai (Asia) Pte. Ltd. (NSA) is seeking an experienced General Manager to lead regional marketing and business development for Nippon Shokubai Group products in Southeast Asia and India. Paints and coatings will be one of NSA’s core marketing pillars and an important area for future growth. The role requires a rare combination of technical expertise, marketing capability and commercial experience, particularly in paints, coatings, adhesives, emulsion polymers, construction chemicals and related application technologies.
Job Description
Lead the development and execution of NSA’s regional marketing strategy for Nippon Shokubai Group products in Southeast Asia and India, with paints and coatings positioned as one of the principal growth areas.
Identify growth opportunities in paints, coatings and related applications through market research, competitor analysis, customer interviews and engagement with customers’ R&D, technical and procurement functions.
Develop technically differentiated proposals by applying deep knowledge of emulsion products, coating formulations, surrounding raw materials and application technologies to customers’ performance, sustainability and cost requirements.
Work closely with Nippon Shokubai’s R&D, marketing and sales organizations in Japan to translate key regional customers (ASEAN, India and Japan) needs into product development, technical evaluation, sample work and commercialization plans in line with the Group’s strategy.
Lead new application exploration, market development and overseas business development projects, and manage a prioritized pipeline of opportunities across ASEAN and India from initial identification through customer evaluation and commercial readiness.
Coordinate the handover of commercially qualified opportunities to Nippon Shokubai’s responsible sales organization, which will lead commercial negotiations and enter into sales contracts, while NSA continues to support regional customer and market development.
Job Requirements
A minimum of 20 years of hands-on research and development experience in paints, adhesives, emulsion polymers, construction chemicals or related industries, gained at a globally listed chemical manufacturing company or its overseas subsidiaries.
A minimum of 2 years of practical experience in the sales and development of products for paints, adhesives, emulsion polymers, construction chemicals or related applications, including customer proposals, technical discussions, product evaluation and application development. The successful candidate must have gained this experience within the last 2 years.
A minimum of 5 years in a managerial role, leading cross-functional projects and coordinating effectively with R&D, marketing and sales teams in Japan and with customers across the region.
Experience in overseas business expansion, market development or new market entry projects, together with sound knowledge of key customers, market structures, competitors, distribution channels and business practices in ASEAN and India.
Demonstrated hands-on knowledge of resins, additives, related raw materials and formulation technologies used in paints, coatings, adhesives, emulsion polymers, construction chemicals or related applications.
Business-level proficiency in written and spoken English and Japanese language proficiency equivalent to JLPT N1 is required for technical and commercial discussions with key regional customers from ASEAN, India and Japan.
Willingness to travel within ASEAN, India and Japan is required.

PancakeSwap is the largest DEX on BNB Chain and consistently ranks in the global top-three by 30-day volume. Marketing's role is to convert execution on those three pillars into brand equity, user mindshare, and ecosystem reputation — and to proactively open new distribution and growth channels, not simply amplify existing content. We need a lead who can diagnose this situation and drive meaningful change.

Redefine PancakeSwap's brand voice and visual language to build differentiated positioning in a crowded DeFi landscape. Discover and operationalize new distribution channels beyond the standard crypto playbook (Twitter/X, Telegram) — community-led platforms, creator economies, crypto-native media, Web2 surfaces, and whatever emerges next.

Centre for Fathering (CFF) is a Singapore non-profit founded in 2000. We promote active fathering, strengthen families, and address issues arising from fatherlessness.
We champion the national Dads for Life and Mums for Life movements, and lead flagship initiatives including Back to School With Dad, Celebrating Fathers, Eat With Your Family Day, and Great Companies for Dads Awards.
Why This Role Matters
• Shape the national conversation on fatherhood and family life in Singapore.
• Translate programme impact into stories that move policymakers, corporate partners, donors, and families.
• Build the public voice of a25-year-old movement as father-inclusive culture gains ground across workplaces, schools, and communities.

The SeniorManager, Communications and Public Relations leads CFF's strategic positioning and public voice, shaping narratives that advance father-inclusive culture, strengthen brand credibility, and inspire public support.
We are looking for an exceptional writer and storyteller who can turn programme outcomes into human-centred stories, with strong editorial judgement and a visual eye to direct design output from in-house and agency partners.
Familiarity with the evolving role of fathers in Singapore is a strong advantage. The role partners with leadership, programme teams, creative partners, and media to drive integrated communications across earned media, digital, campaigns, and thought leadership.

• Develop and execute CFF'sintegrated communications strategy, aligned to organisational and fundraising priorities.

• Advise the CEO and leadership on public messaging, and draft speeches, op-eds, forewords, and high-level correspondence.
• Translate programme insights into human-centred impact stories and publishable narratives.
• Oversee newsletters, the annual report, and donor communications, ensuring editorial consistency across channels.
• Partner with digital teams to align messaging with CRM segmentation and audience lifecycles.

• Secure meaningful coverage tied to campaign moments and thought leadership opportunities.
• Report media performance to management and the board — reach, sentiment, and message pull-through.
• Identify commentary opportunities in national discussions on family, parenting, and workplace culture.
3. Campaigns, Brand, and Creative Direction

• Direct visual storytelling with designers, videographers, and creative agencies. Graphic design execution is not required, but strong visual judgement and the ability to brief and critique creative output are essential.
• Align message, design, and audience across social, website, EDM, and print.
• Own the master content calendar and set the editorial rhythm across platforms.
4. Stakeholder and Partner Communications
• Develop messaging frameworks for corporate, community, and government stakeholders.

Trade Intelligence Global Pte Ltd is a Singapore-based global trade data and intelligence company founded in 2018. We provide Data-as-a-Service solutions that help businesses access global import-export records, identify potential buyers and suppliers, analyse market trends, and make better international trade decisions. Our platform supports companies across different industries by helping them discover new business opportunities, understand supply chains, and expand into global markets with data-driven insights.
*About the role*
You will own TradeInt's day-to-day digital growth engine: paid search and paid social, SEO and AI-search visibility (GEO/AEO), content distribution, and outbound email. This is a hands-on senior role. You run campaigns, make optimisation calls, and keep daily content production and posting on schedule. You'll work across multiple country websites and languages, partnering with regional sales and marketing teams to improve results in each market.
*What You'll Do*
* Paid ads: Manage and optimise Google Ads end-to-end, and run campaigns on LinkedIn, Meta and other channels as needed.
* Testing: Test new markets, languages and ad formats to lower cost per lead and improve lead quality.
* SEO, GEO and AEO: Improve our search rankings and visibility in AI search and answer engines through on-page, technical and content optimisation.
* Content: Run the weekly content pipeline (articles, social posts and short videos) from preparation to publishing, using AI tools to work efficiently.
* Support cold email campaigns and press releases.
* Reporting: Track channel performance and share regular insights and recommendations.
*Requirements*
* 2+ years in digital marketing, ideally in B2B, SaaS or data products.
* Hands-on Google Ads experience: you have built, managed and optimised search campaigns.
* Working experience with LinkedIn Ads or Meta Ads, including retargeting and lead forms.
* Solid SEO fundamentals (keyword research, on-page, technical basics, schema) and a working understanding of GEO/AEO, i.e., how content gets surfaced by AI search and answer engines.
* Comfortable with WordPress and basic HTML.
* Confident with Google Analytics and Google Search Console; You make decisions from data.
* Daily, practical use of AI tools in marketing workflows.
* Strong organisation: you can run several channels and weekly content deadlines in parallel.
* Proficiency in both English and Chinese is mandatory, as the role requires communication with English-speaking and Mandarin-speaking clients and companies
*Nice-to-have*
* Experience with Yandex Ads or ad platforms on AI products.
* Experience with Apollo or similar prospecting tools and cold email.
* Familiarity with automation tools or light scripting.
* Video content or YouTube channel experience.
* Knowledge of international trade, logistics or supply chain.
*What We Offer*
* A dynamic and collaborative work environment
* Direct exposure to global markets, clients, and business decision-makers
* Hands-on experience with B2B sales, Data-as-a-Service, and market intelligence solutions
* Training and guidance from an experienced team
* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement
* Performance-based career progression
* Monthly base salary of SGD *$4,300-$5,500* depending on experience, capability, and role fit.
*Application Period*
Due to ongoing business expansion and marketing growth, this position is open for long-term recruitment.
*How to Apply*
Simply apply through LI or send your CV to (career@tradeint.com) with the email subject: Singapore\_SENIOR MARKETING EXECUTIVE\_RESUME.
_Note: Applicants who include a portfolio showcasing relevant marketing, content, campaign, or design work will be considered an advantage._

Title: Social Media & Marketing Executive / Intern
Description:
Company / 公司： ShengWang Tech
Location / 工作地点： The Great World, Singapore
Employment Type / 类型： Full-time / Internship 全职 / 实习
Headcount / 招聘人数： 1
About the Role / 岗位介绍
ShengWang Tech is looking for a highly motivated and hands-on Social Media & Marketing Executive / Intern to build and manage our social media presence from 0 to 1 in the Singapore market.
You will independently take ownership of our social media channels, from account setup and content planning to content creation, publishing, community engagement and performance analysis.
This is not a role limited to posting content. We are looking for someone with strong ownership, learning agility and execution ability, who can gradually grow with the business and take on broader marketing responsibilities.
ShengWang Tech 正在招聘一名 社交媒体与市场运营专员 / 实习生，面向新加坡市场，从 0 到 1 搭建并运营公司的社交媒体矩阵。
你将相对独立地负责公司社媒账号的搭建、内容规划、内容制作、发布、用户互动及数据分析，并持续探索适合业务的内容和增长方式。
这并不是一个单纯“发帖”的岗位。我们希望找到一位具有较强 Ownership、学习能力和综合执行能力 的成员，未来随着业务发展，逐步承担更完整的市场营销工作。
Key Responsibilities / 工作职责
1. Social Media 0–1 Setup & Operations
社媒账号 0–1 搭建与运营
· Build and manage ShengWang Tech’s social media presence from the ground up.
· Develop appropriate positioning, content pillars, tone of voice and operating approaches for different platforms.
· Manage day-to-day publishing, account maintenance and community engagement.
主要平台包括：
International Platforms / 国际平台
· Facebook
· Instagram
· TikTok
· X
· Other relevant platforms
Chinese Platforms / 中文平台
· 小红书 Xiaohongshu / RED
· 抖音 Douyin
· 微信视频号 WeChat Channels
· 其他适合业务发展的平台
针对不同平台的用户群体、内容生态和传播机制，制定相应的运营方式，而非简单进行同一内容的跨平台复制。
2. Content Planning & Creation
内容策划与制作
· Develop monthly and weekly content calendars.
· Identify relevant topics, trends and content opportunities.
· Create social-first content including posts, graphics, short-form videos and other formats.
· Write and adapt content in both English and Chinese.
· Localise content for Singapore audiences while considering different cultural and platform contexts.
· Coordinate basic photography, videography and editing where required.
负责日常选题、文案、图片、短视频等内容的策划和制作，并根据国际平台和中文平台特点进行针对性调整。
能够完成基础内容制作，不要求候选人是专业摄影师或设计师，但需要具备良好的内容审美和较强的动手能力。
3. Growth & Community Management
用户增长与社区运营
· Monitor comments, messages and audience feedback.
· Engage with users and help build the company’s online community.
· Experiment with different content formats and growth approaches.
· Explore collaborations, trending topics, creators/KOL/KOC opportunities and relevant communities where appropriate.
持续寻找能够提升品牌曝光、粉丝增长和用户互动的有效方式，而不是机械执行固定内容计划。
4. Performance Analysis & Optimisation
数据分析与持续优化
· Track key social media metrics such as reach, views, engagement, follower growth and traffic.
· Review content performance regularly and identify what works and what does not.
· Turn insights into concrete improvements to future content and campaigns.
· Prepare simple periodic performance reports.
我们希望你不仅关注“发布了多少内容”，也关注 哪些内容有效、为什么有效，以及下一步如何做得更好。
5. Marketing Support & Future Development
市场营销及岗位发展
As the role develops, responsibilities will gradually expand beyond social media into broader marketing activities, including:
· Marketing campaign planning and execution
· Business/product promotion
· Online and offline campaign support
· Promotional materials and marketing content
· Partnership and collaboration initiatives
· Brand communication
· Supporting day-to-day marketing operations for relevant business lines
随着业务和岗位的发展，该职位未来将逐步从 Social Media 扩展至更完整的 Marketing 职能，包括业务线的日常市场运营、品牌宣传、活动策划、营销项目执行以及其他相关工作。
Requirements / 任职要求
What We Care About Most / 我们最看重的
Strong Ownership
You are willing to take responsibility for outcomes, not just complete assigned tasks. When facing something unfamiliar, your first reaction should be to research, learn, experiment and solve the problem.
具备很强的 Ownership。相比“等任务、等指导”，我们更希望你能够主动发现问题、研究问题并推动解决。
Fast & Independent Learner
Social media platforms, algorithms, tools and trends change quickly. We expect you to be able to independently learn new platforms, tools and working methods.
具备较强的独立学习能力，能够快速学习新的平台、工具、业务和工作方式。
Bilingual Communication
· Fluent in both English and Chinese, written and spoken.
· Able to create natural content in both languages rather than relying solely on literal translation.
· Daily internal communication will be primarily in Chinese.
中英文听说读写流利，能够根据不同受众独立完成中英文内容，而不仅仅进行直译。公司内部日常沟通以中文为主。
Social Media Native
You should have a strong understanding of social media and preferably be an active user of platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, Xiaohongshu or similar platforms.
对社交媒体有较强敏感度，理解短视频、图文内容及不同平台的基本内容逻辑和用户习惯。
Preferred / 加分项
The following are advantages, but not mandatory:
· Experience managing social media accounts, personal or commercial
· Experience with TikTok / Instagram Reels / Xiaohongshu / Douyin
· Short-form video shooting and editing skills
· Familiarity with CapCut / 剪映, Canva, Adobe or similar tools
· Basic photography or visual design skills
· Experience in digital marketing, branding, e-commerce or content marketing
· Experience with Meta Ads, TikTok Ads or other paid social platforms
· Personal social media accounts or a content portfolio demonstrating your ability
· Good understanding of Singapore’s local consumer and social media environment
有社媒运营、短视频制作、设计、摄影、Marketing、电商或个人自媒体经验均为加分项，但不是硬性要求。
相比单纯的学历或工作年限，我们更看重 实际能力、学习速度、审美、执行力以及解决问题的能力。
AI-Friendly Workplace / 欢迎使用 AI
We actively encourage the appropriate use of AI tools to improve productivity and creativity.
You are welcome to use AI for:
· Research and brainstorming
· Content ideation
· Copywriting
· Translation and localisation
· Image and video creation
· Data analysis
· Workflow automation
· Learning new skills
We care about the quality of the final output and your judgement, rather than whether every task is completed manually.
我们欢迎并鼓励合理使用 AI。
可以使用 ChatGPT 等 AI 工具辅助信息研究、创意、文案、翻译、图片与视频制作、数据分析、自动化以及学习。
我们关注的是 最终结果、你的判断力以及解决问题的能力，而不是要求所有工作必须手工完成。
Who We Think Will Fit / 我们期待的你
You may be a good fit if you:
· Are proactive rather than waiting for detailed instructions.
· Enjoy figuring things out from scratch.
· Have good judgement and attention to detail.
· Are creative but also execution-oriented.
· Are comfortable working independently.
· Are curious about new tools, technologies and AI.
· Want to grow beyond social media into broader marketing responsibilities.
如果你喜欢从 0 到 1 做事情，遇到问题愿意自己研究，希望自己的工作能够真正影响业务，而不是只执行固定流程，这个岗位会比较适合你。
Fresh graduates and students are welcome to apply. Strong portfolios, personal projects or demonstrated capabilities may be more valuable than years of experience.
欢迎优秀应届毕业生及实习生申请。我们不会单纯以工作年限判断候选人，优秀的作品、个人项目和实际能力同样重要。

Purpose of the role
Network manages social media for interior design firms, architects and furniture suppliers across IG, FB, TikTok and YouTube. Production, design and video editing sit with the delivery team.
This role owns the account and the result. Everything that reaches a client's channel goes through this person: what gets made, what gets written, when it gets shot, and whether it performs.
The delivery team makes the work. The consultant owns the commercial relationship. The Account Manager is accountable for the work being right, landing on time, and growing the account organically. Delivery is the floor, not the measure.
Key responsibilities
Client strategy
Build the content strategy for each account with the consultant assigned to it
Take the commercial context from the consultant (what the client sells, who they want, what they have promised) and turn it into a content direction that delivers it
Set the account's organic objective with the consultant at the start of each cycle, and agree what success looks like
Bring performance data to the consultant so strategy changes are based on what happened, not on what the client asked for last
Flag when a client request will not serve the objective, and give the consultant an alternative to take back
The consultant owns the client relationship and the commercial conversation. The Account Manager owns what gets made and why.
Organic performance
Own the organic result on every assigned account: reach, engagement, page growth and enquiries
Decide what gets made based on what is performing, not on filling a calendar
Track performance weekly and change direction on evidence, not at month end
Identify formats that work on one account and carry them to others
Visual direction and alignment
Hold the visual standard on every account. Network works in a premium category and output must look considered, not templated
Keep each account visually coherent. A feed should read as one brand, not a run of unrelated posts
Reject work that meets the brief but misses the bar, and say why
Client posting and accountability
Own the posting schedule for every assigned account across all platforms
Publish or schedule all content to the agreed calendar
Review every asset before it goes live for typos, brand accuracy and strategic fit
Take responsibility for anything published in error, including retraction and client explanation
Copywriting
Write captions for all assigned accounts in the client's voice, not a house voice
Write hooks, on-creative text and CTAs supplied to the design and video teams
Adapt one concept into platform-appropriate copy across IG, FB, TikTok and YouTube
Maintain a written voice reference for each account so copy stays consistent
Creative deliverables
Plan the content calendar and pipeline for each account against the agreed monthly deliverable
Write briefs for the graphic and video teams that are complete enough to execute without follow-up
Track every deliverable from brief to published, and know its status without being asked
Run revision rounds with the delivery team and close them out
Shoot scheduling and coordination
Schedule production shoots with the client and the production team
Confirm site access, timing, homeowner permissions and scope before the shoot date
Brief the production team on what the shoot must produce
Chase and confirm footage handover after the shoot
Delivery team communication
Act as the single point of contact between clients and the graphic, video and production teams
Give the delivery team enough lead time to work; escalate capacity conflicts early
Keep the delivery team unblocked so they are never waiting on information
Client communication
Own client group chats as the day-to-day point of contact
Respond within working hours, with no dropped threads
Manage expectations on timelines and flag delays before the client notices them
Performance measures
Performance on this role is judged on organic outcomes, not activity.
Primary
Organic creative performance: reach, retention and engagement on published content against account baseline
Page growth: follower growth, saves and shares across assigned accounts
Organic enquiries: DMs, comments and leads generated through organic content
Visual direction: accounts hold a consistent, premium visual standard across the feed
Strategic alignment: what gets made maps to the account's growth objective
Baseline
On-time publishing rate across all assigned accounts
Errors reaching a live client channel (target: zero)
Deliverables completed against monthly contracted volume
Shoot dates held versus rescheduled
Delivery team blocked time attributable to missing briefs or information
Baseline measures are expectations. Missing them is a problem. Meeting them is not performance.

Demonstrated organic growth on an account you owned, with numbers

Title: Social Media Operations Executive
Description:
Established in 1973 with headquarters in Seoul, South Korea, Cheil Worldwide is one of the world’s leading integrated marketing communications networks, with more than 7,200 employees globally in more than 54 offices in 46 countries.
IRIS Singapore, a creative, strategic and innovative company that uses the power of participation to excite progress for businesses has recently become part of the Cheil family. As part of their diverse team, we would like to invite you to participate in their progress – moving yourself and the world forward with every decision you make. Iris’s bustling office is situated in the district of Singapore, proudly embodies the best within the APAC region, home to an eclectic team of 60 with deep specialism, they are proud to be the creative agency for Trust, Samsung, Alcon and other leading brands in the region.
We are inviting candidates for the position of:
Social Media Operations Executive
We are looking for a meticulous Social Media Executive to join Iris Singapore Team in supporting Samsung’s global social media operations. The role will focus on content validation coordination and management, while supporting content management and community management with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) across all key social media channels.
The ideal candidate is highly organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable navigating fast-paced, cross-functional workflows. As the primary liaison with other stakeholders, you will be responsible for coordinating workflows and ensuring operational requirements are accurately communicated. This will provide many learning opportunities for anyone who loves all things social content and wants to build out their expertise in this field into a fledgling social media management career.
Job Description:
Manage end-to-end content requests from local markets and content creators, ensuring all deliverables meet social media best practices, brand and platform requirements.
Coordinate closely with HQ and internal teams to ensure seamless execution of content workflows and minimise operational gaps or errors.
Track and maintain workflow statuses across multiple touchpoints and platforms to ensure timely delivery and accurate reporting.
Review and validate content for brand alignment, platform suitability, compliance, and quality standards before publication.
Identify key KOL content opportunities and proactively engage KOL and their communities through effective community management.
Systematically catalogue and organise approved assets systematically for efficient retrieval, reporting, and future reuse.
Maintain meticulous attention to detail to safeguard against content inaccuracies, permission issues, or asset mismanagement.
Write, edit, and adapt social media copy in line with brand tone of voice and platform best practices.
Publish and schedule content ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and consistency.
Monitor conversations and support crisis management by identifying sensitive issues early and escalating risks appropriately.
Qualifications:
Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Communications, Media, or related fields.
Min. of 2-year experience in social media, community management, or account management roles.
Strong written communication skills and a good sense of tone.
Familiarity with Instagram features and best practices.
Highly organised and comfortable managing manual, detail-heavy processes.
Interest in mobile photography or tech brands is a plus.

Description:
Key Job Accountabilities
As the CRM & Data Analytics Manager, you will be an integral part of the TRAPAC (Travel Retail Asia Pacific) Corporate Marketing team. You will be at the heart of our mission to build deeper traveler relationships by establishing our data infrastructure and turning analytics into actionable CRM strategies. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of personalized consumer engagement for travelers in a dynamic environment.
Responsibilities
- Manage the Data Ecosystem for CRM: You will manage the operational backbone of our 3rd party data partnerships with key retailers in China and travel partners across the region. You will be responsible for implementing data cleanroom/data lake projects by defining data requirements, facilitating the data transfer workflow, and developing performance reports with media and data partners.
- Activate Data-Driven Traveler Engagement: You will translate our audience strategy into tangible campaigns by leveraging our 2P data partnerships. You will partner with brand teams to guide the end-to-end activations through two key methods: deploying campaigns via our partners' CRM channels and building custom audience segments within data clean rooms for precision targeting. This includes the potential to explore and pilot future first-party data and CRM strategies.
- Deliver Full-Funnel Analytics & Performance Insights: You will be the expert on O+O performance. Consolidating data from media, retailers and commercial sources, you will analyze the full traveler journey and translate complex data into clear, actionable insights that will guide future investment and business strategy.
- Champion a Data-First Culture through Upskilling: You will organize regular workshops to elevate the data literacy of our brand marketing teams. This involves coordinating the agenda, briefing internal and external speakers, and presenting your own analyses on O+O campaign effectiveness, competitor best practices, and emerging trends.
- Support Key Media Operations: You will manage the daily maintenance of our OOH media plan, from coordinating campaign launches across 10+ airports to handling contracts and finance logistics.
We Are Looking For
We are seeking a proactive and highly analytical professional with a talent for translating data into strategy and building strong partnerships.
To Succeed In This Role, You Have These Qualities
- An excellent collaborator with strong project and stakeholder management abilities, capable of navigating a complex matrix organization.
- A deeply analytical mindset with proven, hands-on experience turning disparate data sets into clear business insights and strategic recommendations.
- A natural relationship-builder, skilled at creating and nurturing strategic partnerships with external parties.
- A strategic thinker with a strong appreciation for luxury branding and the ability to maintain high brand standards.
- An entrepreneurial and problem-solving mindset, comfortable with ambiguity and skilled at crafting new workflows for first-in-the-industry initiatives.
Your Experience And Requirements
- Bachelor’s degree or above preferably in Business, Marketing, Analytics, or a related discipline
- 5-8 years of solid experience in CRM, customer loyalty programs, or managing data collaboration partnerships. Experience from industries like financial services, travel & hospitality, telecommunications, or luxury retail is highly valuable.
- Proven track record in driving CRM performance with strong experience in loyalty program and partnership expansion (client acquisition, retention, and lifetime value) through data-led strategies and campaigns with significant results and fast growth
- Demonstrate strategy and entrepreneurship building
- Strong knowledge of the mainland China digital and data landscape (e.g., WeChat, RED, local OTAs, loyalty programs, data clean rooms). Experience with other APAC regional platforms is a strong plus.
- A solid background in using data to inform digital marketing or CRM campaign management.
- Knowledge of Travel Retail dynamics and environment is a plus.
- Written and spoken fluency in both English and Mandarin is essential for this role due to the direct communication with our retailers and partners based in China.

Title: Account Executive, Japan & Korea
Description:
We Are Sparta
Sparta is the next-generation commodity trading platform.
We give trading desks the clarity, control, and collaboration they need to move faster and trade smarter.
In February 2025, we secured $42 million in Series B funding. Now we’re scaling up across the business, and it’s an exciting time to join.
Our people are the driving force behind everything we do. At Sparta, you’ll be trusted to take ownership, backed by a team who wants you to succeed. You’ll be challenged, supported, and given room to grow. Because building something this ambitious takes everyone at their best.
At Sparta, your work has reach. From improving our platform, to powering smarter decisions for our customers, to changing how commodity trading is done around the world.
And because we’re growing fast, you won’t just build your career. You’ll accelerate it, with a level of ownership and impact you simply don’t get at bigger, more bureaucratic companies.
The Role
This is a new-logo hunter role with an account development edge. Based in Singapore, you will own Sparta’s Japanese and Korean territory: building pipeline from scratch, getting in front of trading desks in person, and closing complex, multi-product deals. Roughly 70% of your time goes to winning new logos and 30% to growing and supporting the clients you bring in.
Japan is the immediate priority, with Korea following as the territory matures. Many of the desks you sell to sit in Singapore, but sometimes the budget, the mandate and the long-term relationship often sit with headquarters in Tokyo or Seoul. You will work both, building credibility locally and sponsorship at HQ.
You will sell to C-suite and VP-level buyers while winning over the traders, analysts and risk managers who will use the product and know their market cold.
You will have pre-sales and Customer Success behind you, and an Asia Pacific team growing quickly.
You will work from our Singapore office 4 days a week.
What You Will Be Doing
New Business
• Research opportunities, initiate discussions, build prospect relationships, run demos, manage product trials and close deals across Japanese and Korean energy commodity firms.
• Develop a pipeline of high-value opportunities through networking, events and in-person interaction with traders and decision-makers in Singapore and HQ.
• Sell to C-suite, VP-level and trading desks, articulating a clear business case and ROI for our SaaS solutions.
• Build relationships with headquarters stakeholders so that regional wins convert into group-level commitments.
Account Development and Expansion
• Grow the clients you win: expand usage across desks, verticals and products, and build the internal advocacy that turns a first deal into a multi-year relationship.
• Work with Customer Success to protect renewals and spot expansion signals early.
• Act as the commercial point of contact your clients trust, and bring their market feedback back into the business.
Enterprise Sales Execution
• Lead a virtual account team, coordinating with internal resources across pre-sales, customer success and marketing to drive deals forward.
• Use value-selling methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Challenger and SPIN to align solutions with customer pain points and strategic initiatives.
• Structure and negotiate complex, multi-product deals tailored to customer needs.
Forecasting and Pipeline Management
• Maintain accurate sales forecasts, using HubSpot and sales analytics tools to manage deal progression and pipeline health.
• Track sales KPIs and continually refine sales tactics to improve conversion rates and shorten deal cycles.
About You
• 5+ years of enterprise B2B sales experience, preference selling into commodities or energy markets.
• Business-level fluency in Japanese or Korean, in addition to English. This is required because most stakeholders will be Japanese and Koreans and prefer this as their working language
• Proven track record of hunting and closing complex, high-value deals, and hitting six- or seven-figure annual revenue targets.
• Able to build pipeline across a set territory from scratch: identifying the right opportunities, getting access to senior decision-makers, and building the internal advocacy that enterprise deals need.
• Comfortable running product demonstrations and navigating long sales cycles with multiple business and technical stakeholders.
• Strong knowledge of value-based selling frameworks such as MEDDPICC, Challenger and SPIN, and able to run a consultative sales motion.
• Experience orchestrating a cross-functional virtual team across pre-sales, customer success, marketing and executive sponsors.
• Based in Singapore, in the office 4 days a week, and happy to travel frequently for customer meetings and industry events across Asia Pacific. This is a face-to-face, relationship-driven role.
Nice to Have
• Prior exposure to energy and commodity markets, particularly refining, petrochemicals, shipping or trading houses.
• Experience selling financial data platforms, analytics software or SaaS solutions directly to traders, analysts, quants or risk managers.
• An existing network across Japanese or Korean trading houses, refiners, utilities or shipping firms.
• Experience selling for a scale-up or challenger brand, where the name does not open the door for you.
• Familiarity with HubSpot and Claude.
Why Join Sparta?
At Sparta, our culture is built on innovation, collaboration and high performance. We thrive in a fast-paced environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are embraced and impact is rewarded.
• $42M in Series B funding, with strong market traction and investment.
• Early-stage growth, so you build your career as we scale.

We're scaling fast, and it's an exciting time to join. From independents to multinationals, the world's leading commodity teams use Sparta and Leonidas AI to move faster, trade smarter, and stay ahead of the market.
At Sparta, you'll be trusted to take ownership, backed by a team who wants you to succeed. AI is how we build here, not just what we sell. Good ideas move fast, and yours could go from staging to production in a couple of hours, whatever department you're in. You'll be challenged, supported, and given room to grow, building the AI that's changing how commodity trading gets done.
Your work has reach. From shaping Leonidas AI, to powering smarter decisions for traders around the world, to changing how commodity trading is done. And because we're growing fast, you'll accelerate your career with a level of ownership and impact you simply won't get at bigger, slower-moving companies.
The Role
This is a new-logo hunter role with an account development edge. Based in Singapore, you will own Sparta’s Japanese and Korean territory: building pipeline from scratch, getting in front of trading desks in person, and closing complex, multi-product deals. Roughly 70% of your time goes to winning new logos and 30% to growing and supporting the clients you bring in.
Japan is the immediate priority, with Korea following as the territory matures. Many of the desks you sell to sit in Singapore, but sometimes the budget, the mandate and the long-term relationship often sit with headquarters in Tokyo or Seoul. You will work both, building credibility locally and sponsorship at HQ.
You will sell to C-suite and VP-level buyers while winning over the traders, analysts and risk managers who will use the product and know their market cold.
You will have pre-sales and Customer Success behind you, and an Asia Pacific team growing quickly.
You will work from our Singapore office 4 days a week.
What You Will Be Doing
New Business
• Research opportunities, initiate discussions, build prospect relationships, run demos, manage product trials and close deals across Japanese and Korean energy commodity firms.
• Develop a pipeline of high-value opportunities through networking, events and in-person interaction with traders and decision-makers in Singapore and HQ.
• Sell to C-suite, VP-level and trading desks, articulating a clear business case and ROI for our SaaS solutions.
• Build relationships with headquarters stakeholders so that regional wins convert into group-level commitments.
Account Development and Expansion
• Grow the clients you win: expand usage across desks, verticals and products, and build the internal advocacy that turns a first deal into a multi-year relationship.
• Work with Customer Success to protect renewals and spot expansion signals early.
• Act as the commercial point of contact your clients trust, and bring their market feedback back into the business.
Enterprise Sales Execution
• Lead a virtual account team, coordinating with internal resources across pre-sales, customer success and marketing to drive deals forward.
• Use value-selling methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Challenger and SPIN to align solutions with customer pain points and strategic initiatives.
• Structure and negotiate complex, multi-product deals tailored to customer needs.
Forecasting and Pipeline Management
• Maintain accurate sales forecasts, using HubSpot and sales analytics tools to manage deal progression and pipeline health.
• Track sales KPIs and continually refine sales tactics to improve conversion rates and shorten deal cycles.

Understanding is non-negotiable

If it's on you, it's in your control.

Conflict is a gift

Associate/SeniorAssociate, Investor Relations
to support fundraising, investor communications and reporting. This is a hands-on opportunity within a small team, offering exposure to different aspects of investor relations and the firm’s technology investment focus.
The role would suit someone who enjoys working in a lean team, takes ownership of tasks, and is keen to develop their career in private equity investor relations.
The Role
Working closely with the Director of Investor Relations and Managing Partner, you will support the firm’s fundraising and investor relations activities, including preparing investor materials, maintaining relationships with limited partners (LPs), conducting market research, and coordinating investor reporting.
Key Responsibilities
1. Fundraising Support
Prepare fundraising materials, including private placement memoranda (PPMs), teasers, due diligence questionnaires, and LP presentations, ensuring accuracy and professional presentation.
Support initial LP communications, arrange meetings, and document meeting notes and follow-up actions.
Maintain fundraising trackers and support the management of the fundraising pipeline.
2. Investor Relations
Act as a secondary contact for LPs, supporting day-to-day inquiries and information requests.
Assist in preparing quarterly and annual investor reports and material event notices, ensuring accuracy and timely delivery.
Maintain LP databases and CRM systems, keeping investor information and communication records complete and up to date.
3. Market Research
Track global market trends, industry developments, and fundraising activities.
Identify prospective LPs and conduct preliminary research to assess their investment interests and suitability.
Monitor relevant industry conferences and LP events, and support the team’s participation.
4. Internal Coordination
Work with investment, risk, and finance teams to gather and verify information for investor reporting.
Coordinate LP due diligence meetings, annual general meetings, and other investor events.
Maintain the IR team’s filing system and document repository.
Your Profile

2–5 years of relevant experience with a private equity or venture capital firm, family office, private bank, investment bank, or consulting firm.

Basic understanding of private equity and the relationship between limited partners and general partners (LPs and GPs).
Familiarity with private equity performance metrics, including IRR, MOIC, TVPI, and DPI.
Strong proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel, and Word, with the ability to independently prepare polished presentations and data analysis tables.
Basic financial analysis skills and the ability to read and understand financial statements.
Fluent written and spoken English.
Fluent Mandarin to support communication and liaison with Mandarin-speaking LPs in Mainland China and Hong Kong.
Strong follow-through, with the ability to manage tasks independently and meet deadlines.
Detail-oriented, with a focus on accuracy in data and investor-facing materials.
Proactive in learning, responsible, hands-on, and collaborative.
Strong communication skills and a professional approach when working with internal teams and external investors.
