Title: Branding Lead
Description:
About Us
Longbridge is a new-generation, AI-driven online brokerage on a mission to make investing smarter, simpler, and more accessible for everyone. Headquartered in Singapore, we are redefining the investment journey by connecting the stages of “Discovery → Learning → Trading.”With our proprietary AI assistant, Longbridge AI, and a cloud-native infrastructure, we provide retail investors with institutional-grade insights and a seamless global trading network. At Longbridge, you won’t just be working for a brokerage; you’ll be building the future of financial infrastructure.
About the Role
The Branding Lead holds the senior brand seat within the group function. You will fully own the global brand system across all brands and markets — encompassing brand strategy and architecture, identity governance, and performance measurement frameworks. Working in close partnership with business leadership, you will translate commercial priorities into strategic brand initiatives that build deep recognition and trust across retail, institutional, and partner audiences. This is a hands-on senior role in a lean, high-velocity team, perfectly suited for a strategic builder who enjoys both establishing framework standards and actively driving execution.
Location: Hong Kong or Singapore
What You Will Do
- Brand Strategy & Architecture: Own the master-brand architecture across all brands. Define positioning, brand relationships (endorsement vs. separation), and strategic roadmaps for Hong Kong, Singapore, and global expansion.
- Identity & Group-wide Governance: Own the visual and verbal identity system and global brand book. Establish review standards and lead the Brand & Comms Council to drive unified decision-making and cross-market brand enablement.
- Business Unit Partnership: Serve as the strategic brand business partner to BU leaders. Translate commercial goals into actionable brand plans, balance competing market demands, and maintain brand integrity on fast-paced timelines.
- Flagship Campaigns & Summits: Direct regional flagship brand campaigns and our signature in-house regional summit end-to-end — from core value proposition and creative concepting to measured business impact.
- Measurement & Analytics: Manage the brand tracker and Brand Strength Index. Report key metrics (Share of Voice, sentiment, AI-association) to executive leadership on a monthly cadence, focusing on core outcome-driven KPIs.
- Market Entry & Expansion: Develop the brand launch strategy for new markets and segment expansions, crafting localized propositions, entry narratives, and commercial enablement toolkits.
- Team Leadership: Manage and mentor the Branding Manager and creative support team, establishing clear scorecards and scaling the function as the business grows.
What You Bring
- 10+ years of experience in brand strategy, brand marketing, or integrated marketing, with a proven track record of regional scope across APAC (global exposure highly preferred).
- Proven Brand System Capability: Demonstrated experience building scalable brand systems (architecture, guidelines, governance framework) that were successfully adopted by cross-functional teams.
- 0-to-1 Execution Experience: Proven track record of launching a brand, product category, or function from the ground up, with high comfort in navigating ambiguity.
- Trilingual Fluency: Professional written and spoken fluency in English, Mandarin, and Cantonese (including proficiency in both Simplified and Traditional Chinese).
- Domain Expertise: Background in Financial Services, Fintech, or other regulated/high-trust industries. Familiarity with listed-company communication standards is a strong plus.
- Stakeholder Management: Exceptional capability to influence senior leadership and cross-functional teams without direct authority.
- AI-Native Mindset: Daily proficiency in AI tools, with an understanding of AI-era brand visibility (e.g., how AI search engines/answer engines represent the brand) as an essential channel.
- Commercial Acumen: Strong ability to connect branding initiatives directly to commercial pipelines, market expansion goals, and corporate investor narratives.

Title: Communications Executive
Description:
We're Hiring: Communications Executive
Quintessential Education | Full-Time or Part-Time | Orchard Road, Singapore
About QE
Quintessential Education is Singapore's leading provider of pre-tertiary academic programmes (IGCSE & IB) and university admissions advisory for top-tier global universities — Ivy League, Oxbridge, and NUS/NTU/SMU. Since 2012 we have worked with more than 700 students, and most of our new families come to us through referrals. We deliver a fully integrated journey for families: academic mastery, guardianship, and university placement under one roof.
We aim to bring out the best in our students, ignite opportunities and nurture them towards success.
We are looking for committed and talented additions to our team. As an ideal candidate, you should display a proven ability to develop and maintain an environment of trust, diversity, and inclusion within the QE team. You should be able to work with the team to meet deadlines and instill a culture of continuous work improvement.
As part of the position, you will work with the founders, Ivy League and Oxbridge graduates and other high-performing teammates.
The Role
We're looking for a Communications Executive to own the day-to-day relationship between QE and our families. You'll be the first person a parent speaks to when they enquire, and the person who keeps them informed once their child is with us. That means answering enquiries every day, matching students with the right tutors and mentors, and following up with students and parents regularly so nothing slips through.
You'll also help keep our marketing materials and partner relationships in good order. We are open to full-time or part-time candidates, so tell us the arrangement that works for you.
If you're a confident communicator in both English and Mandarin*, stay calm and warm with demanding parents, and like being the person who makes sure things actually get done — we'd love to meet you.
*As a major group of customers are from China and are only able to converse in Mandarin.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Enquiries & Enrolment
Respond to daily parent and student enquiries via phone, WhatsApp, WeChat, and email, ideally within the same working day.
Explain our IGCSE, IB, and admissions programmes clearly and recommend the right fit for each student.
Match students with suitable tutors and mentors, and arrange trial lessons and consultations.
Track every enquiry through to enrolment and follow up with families who have not yet decided.
2. Student Follow-Up & Parent Relations
Check in regularly with enrolled students and parents on progress, attendance, and any concerns.
Collect lesson feedback from students and tutors, and deal with issues early before they become complaints.
Arrange class schedules, replacement lessons, and changes with tutors and families.
Keep parents informed ahead of key moments: exam periods, predicted grades, application deadlines, and results day.
Follow up on renewals and next-stage programmes (e.g. IGCSE to IB, IB to university applications).
3. Business Operations
Prepare and track invoices and payments.
Draft and manage service agreements for clients and tutors.
Keep client records, notes, and follow-up schedules up to date.
Keep a simple monthly record of enquiries, enrolments, and renewals for the founders.
4. Marketing & Partnerships
Keep brochures, website content, and newsletters accurate and up to date.
Work with design and digital marketing agencies on campaigns and collateral.
Support parent seminars and events, including Mandarin-language sessions with our China school partners.
Maintain relationships with partner schools, education consultants, and collaborators.
We're Looking For Someone Who:
Has experience in a client-facing role such as education, admissions, client services, or customer service. Fresh graduates with strong communication skills are welcome to apply.
Has excellent verbal and written communication in English and Chinese. This is required as some Chinese customers can only communicate in Chinese. Japanese and Korean are a bonus as some customers only communicate in these languages.
Is calm, warm, and professional with high-expectation parents, and comfortable handling difficult conversations.
Is highly organised, follows up without being reminded, and keeps clear records.
Can manage many families and a busy inbox at the same time without losing track of details.
Is proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook), Notion or Airtable, and marketing tools (Mailchimp, Canva).
Is comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) and light automation to streamline workflows.
Bonus If You:
Have experience in the education, tuition, or admissions sector.
Know the IB, IGCSE, or university application process (UK, US, or Singapore).
Are familiar with WeChat or Xiaohongshu.
Working Hours
Location: 545 Orchard Road, #14-06/9, Singapore 238882. In Person role.
Start Date: As soon as possible
Commitment: Full-time or part-time. Propose the days and hours that suit you in your application.
Full-time: 5-day work week, Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM, 4 days in office and 1 day remote
Part-time: Days and hours by arrangement, with enough weekday cover to keep up with daily enquiries
Salary & Benefits
Monthly Salary: $4,500 upwards for full-time, depending on experience; pro-rated for part-time
Bonuses: Additional performance and team-based bonuses apply
Benefits Include: $500 Specialist Stipend per annum (e.g. medical or mental health support), $100 Dental Stipend per annum, $500 Personal Development Stipend per annum (for courses, books, conferences, etc.)
How to Apply
Send your CV and a short paragraph on why you're interested in the role to hr@qeducation.sg with the subject line: Application – Communications Executive (Full Time / Part Time)

Company Description
VERSANT (Nasdaq: VSNT) is an industry-changing media and entertainment business and home to trusted brands that shape culture, inform audiences, and build lasting connections. It operates across four core markets: political news and opinion, business news and personal finance, golf, and sports and genre entertainment. These markets are served through a powerful portfolio of iconic and innovative brands, including CNBC, MS NOW, USA Network, Golf Channel, Oxygen, E!, SYFY, and Versant's sports division USA Sports, along with complementary digital assets including Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes, GolfNow and GolfPass.
CNBC INTERNATIONAL
CNBC is the world’s number one business and financial news network. Its mission is to help the influential and aspirational make astute decisions to get ahead by providing live market updates, breaking news, in-depth analysis and exclusive interviews.
CNBC’s vast portfolio includes CNBC.com, the online destination for global business; CNBC PRO, the network’s premium subscription service that provides real-time global market data and market analysis, as well as a growing slate of live and virtual events where consumers can experience CNBC’s award-winning journalism, live.
With headquarters in New Jersey, London, Singapore, and Abu Dhabi, CNBC provides a truly global 24-hour business briefing for senior business leaders, the financial community and those with assets to invest or protect. Today the channel is available in more than 392 million homes worldwide. CNBC also boasts a growing audience across its social media and digital video platforms.
Visit www.cnbc.com for more information.
Job Description
OVERVIEW
CNBC International is looking for an HR Coordinator to provide comprehensive operational support to the International HR team in employee lifecycle processes. This role provides exposure to a range of generalist activities, embedding the HR Coordinator as a key member of the HR team for the business.
In this role, you will be the first point of contact for a range of HR related queries and administrative processes.
You’ll be joining a collaborative and friendly team of corporate functions professionals working alongside digital and TV news experts, creative talents, operations specialists, and sales teams. Reporting to the HR Director, CNBC International, this role offers an exciting opportunity for someone looking to build on their HR Generalist skills within a fast-paced environment.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
HRIS & Payroll
Maintain accurate and timely employee records in Workday, ensuring data quality, compliance, and reliable reporting across the employee lifecycle.
Serve as primary expert for all HR systems and transactions to keep our business running.
Partner with the HR Generalist, payroll teams, and relevant vendors to deliver accurate data and run monthly payroll reports, and maintaining up-to-date trackers for all our processes.
Provide timely employee data to benefits providers for new hires, lifecycle changes, and leavers, while managing vendor escalations and feedback on benefits matters.
Support the ongoing integration and optimization of Workday across CNBC International, including testing system enhancements, documenting processes, and identifying opportunities to streamline HR workflows.
Build employee and manager confidence in Workday by creating clear guidance, troubleshooting self-service issues, and promoting adoption of available tools and functionality.
Partner with HR Operations and relevant stakeholders to ensure Workday processes, data standards/changes, and reporting requirements are consistently implemented across the region.
Employee Experience
Deliver outstanding first-line support for daily HR queries from employees and managers, proactively enhancing the employee experience while escalating complex issues to the HR Director as needed.
Champion and support CNBC employee engagement initiatives, serving as the go-to resource for queries about employee events and experiences across CNBC International.
Assist and support onboarding and offboarding processes, including managing new hire background checks, creating and updating employee records in HRIS, and ensuring all induction and offer materials are accurate and complete.
Administrative Support
Prepare employment contracts, letters, and communications related to employee lifecycle changes and accurately document and track their contents.
Partner with the HR Generalist to prepare job descriptions and work closely with the Talent Acquisition team to support open requisitions.
Track and capture all visa and immigration related documentation.
Assist in any program rollouts (i.e. performance review process, salary planning, benefits open enrollment, early careers programs, etc.)
Ensure prompt processing of employee benefits and perks, such as gift vouchers for long service awards and life event recognition.
Plan and coordinate induction sessions and HR events, while providing administrative support for organizational changes.
Support Global Mobility in managing internal and external relocations, and remote working requests.
Use HR systems to provide accurate reports and data to HR business partners, government surveys, and business leaders.
Organize, conduct and maintain data on leavers and exit interviews.
Support with note taking in a variety of meetings.
Check and process invoices.
Qualifications
ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS
In this role, you’ll exercise sound personal judgment, cultivate relationships, and explore available resources to rapidly build institutional knowledge and effectively support our client groups. The attributes below are essential in successfully accomplishing this.
Demonstrated experience in developing, implementing, and managing new processes and project deliverables.
Excellent digital fluency skills, including the ability to coordinate and administer meetings using communication platforms (e.g., Zoom, and Slack) and strong knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook.
Ability to succinctly record in writing the main points of what is presented in a meeting, highlighting important key topics or themes that are emphasized, and organizing the material in a style that will best capture facts, ideas, and action item.
Demonstrated ability to work effectively with a diverse group of management and staff including executive levels.
Methodical and organized in your approach to work with high attention to detail and a professional, calm manner.
A supportive and collaborative team member with strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Able to maintain a high level of confidentiality and discretion in handling sensitive information
Ability to prioritize tasks and a pro-active, solutions orientated approach to work.
Adaptable to changing priorities and deadlines
Punctual and able to effectively manage time.
Excellent written and oral communication.
Strong attention to detail.
DESIRED ATTRIBUTES
While not essential for this role, candidates with experience or proficiency in the following attributes tend to excel in this position.
Two (2) or more years of experience working in administrative and/or planning capacities.
Fluency in Chinese language in order to edit templates, appropriately file documents, and understand important aspects of employee files and benefits.
Experience working within an HR specialty or environment.

Title: Corporate Affairs Executive
Description:
Position Overview
The Corporate Affairs Executive is responsible for drafting, reviewing, and publishing internal and external news, as well as managing news approvals and quality control for subordinate business units. The role involves building and maintaining strong relationships with government authorities, chambers of commerce, and industry associations. Key duties include managing high-level foreign affairs receptions, tracking government policies, collecting PR intelligence, and drafting executive speeches. Additionally, the role provides administrative support to ensure smooth department operations.
Key Responsibilities
1. News Editing, Review, and Content Drafting
- News Writing & Approval: Draft internal and external news regarding major projects, core businesses, and corporate culture. Ensure all internal and external news strictly follows the company approval process. Review, approve, and assist in refining news submissions from subordinate business units to guarantee content compliance before media release.
- Speechwriting: Draft accurate, precise, and audience-appropriate speeches, remarks, greetings, and presentation reports in both English and Chinese for senior executives and department heads attending conferences, forums, association events, and government-enterprise meetings.
- Comprehensive Materials: Draft PR monthly/annual reports, project summaries, and cooperate with the department head to prepare comprehensive government reporting materials.
2. Government & Association Relations and Event Organization
- External Relationship Management: Serve as the company's liaison window. Establish and maintain stable, long-term relationships with government departments at all levels, major chambers of commerce, industry associations, and organizations.
- Event Coordination: Plan, prepare, design materials for, and execute daily salons, government-enterprise networking events, and association annual meetings.
- Resource Attraction: Assist the company in actively participating in key government and association summits, award selections, and proposals to secure industry influence and corporate awards.
3. Foreign Affairs Reception and Business Visit Coordination
- Pre-approval Support: Prepare and write all necessary documentation, application forms, project proposals, and background briefs required for foreign affairs receptions or overseas business travel approvals.
- Reception Planning: Design tailored reception plans for visiting government officials, key clients, industry experts, and association guests, covering detailed itineraries and core reception logistics.
- Onsite Execution and Coordination: Guide and accompany guests during foreign affairs receptions, ensuring the entire process complies with high-standard international business and government protocol.
- Visit & Reception Reports: Gather feedback after events, draft foreign travel/reception reports, outcome summaries, and minutes, and ensure proper archiving for future reference.
4. Policy Interpretation and PR Intelligence Research
- Policy Interpretation: Closely monitor industrial policies, industry regulations, and macro-economic trends across Singapore, China and key APAC markets. Perform deep analysis on compliance requirements and potential opportunities, and draft concise summary reports.
- PR Intelligence Gathering: Research and monitor main competitors' activities regarding media communication, association partnerships, and large-scale PR events to support the company's PR strategies.
- Core Data Sourcing: Conduct targeted research to gather accurate, authoritative industry data and case studies for executive speeches and government reports.
5. General Administrative Support
- Document Management: Manage PR contracts, archive supplier profiles, and handle the circulation of internal and external official letters and notices.
- Daily Administration: Assist the department head with schedule coordination, cross-departmental meeting organization, meeting minutes preparation, and other ad-hoc administrative tasks (reimbursement handling excluded).
Position Requirements
1. Education:
- Bachelor’s degree or above, preferably in Journalism, Communications, Public Administration, Administrative Management, Law, Business, or related fields.
2. Experience:
- 1–3 years of experience in public relations, government relations (GR) assistance, executive assistant roles, high-standard business/government reception, or large-scale association operations.
3. Language Skills (Core Requirement):
- Native or near-native fluency in Mandarin Chinese and professional proficiency in English (both written and spoken).
- Able to use both languages seamlessly as working languages for business communication, document drafting, and hosting/accompanying international guests.
Core Skills
1. Excellent Writing & Editing Abilities:
- Proficient in drafting news releases, formal government materials, executive speech scripts, and project proposals. Possess strong news sensitivity and editorial skills to guide and proofread articles from business units.
2. Information Retrieval & Analysis:
- Strong policy acumen. Capable of searching public reports and government websites to extract valuable data and insights for PR and external relations.
3. Office Software Proficiency:
- Highly skilled in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, with strong capabilities in document formatting and visual presentation design.
4. Competencies:
- Professional Image: Excellent professional demeanor, well-mannered, and highly familiar with high-standard business, government.
- Meticulous, efficient, organized, and possesses a strong sense of principles and compliance control.
- Exceptional cross-departmental teamwork, external communication, stress management, and confidentiality awareness.

Title: Editor, Publications and Interpretation
Description:
WE TAKE YOU ABOVE BEYOND
Take your passion to the next level and work alongside other masters of their craft to build a fulfilling and rewarding career at Marina Bay Sands.
Job Responsibilities
The ideal candidate will bring editorial judgement, intellectual curiosity, bilingual capability and strong project management skills. Key responsibilities include:
i) Editorial Strategy and Standards
Develop and champion editorial standards for ArtScience Museum and Attractions across various platforms and public programmes.
Ensure consistent tone, style, terminology and institutional voice, adapting language for different audiences and formats.
Advise on structure, hierarchy, accessibility and readability for exhibition texts, labels, scripts, webpages and learning resources.
ii) Publications
Lead editorial development for publications, brochures, essays, guides and partner print materials.
Work with curators, artists, writers, designers, publishers, translators and partners to shape content from concept to final proof.
Commission, edit and proofread all written content across all digital and print materials
Manage schedules, version control, proofreading stages and final sign-off to ensure consistent and timely delivery.
Ensure publications meet standards for accuracy, accessibility, permissions, image crediting and quality.
iii) Museum Interpretation for Exhibitions
Work with curators, exhibition teams, internal and external partners to develop interpretative frameworks from concept to installation.
Translate artistic, scientific, technological and cultural ideas into clear, engaging and accurate language for broad audiences.
Support content hierarchies, visitor journeys and layered interpretation for both general and specialist audiences.
iv) Website and Digital Content
Create and oversee website content acting as the interface between Musuem and MBS marketing and digital teams
Ensure web copy is accurate, timely, audience-focused and aligned with brand, campaign and ticketing needs.
Adapt long-form curatorial, educational and programme content into concise, searchable and accessible digital copy.
Ensure digital content follows editorial standards, accessibility principles, SEO considerations and bilingual requirements.
v) Education and Public Programmes Content
Work with the team to develop and edit learning resources, festival copy, event descriptions, biographies, programme notes, workshop materials and scripts.
Ensure content for schools, families, educators, general visitors and specialist audiences is clear, age-appropriate and inclusive.
Collaborate with producers and educators on language for talks, workshops, tours, screenings, festivals and community engagement.
vi) Bilingual English/Mandarin Content Development
Provide high-quality English writing, editing, proofreading and quality assurance with sensitivity to tone, nuance and register.
Review and quality check Mandarin content, translations and bilingual materials for accuracy, cultural appropriateness and visitor experience.
Work with translators, vendors and stakeholders to manage bilingual workflows, terminology and consistency.
vii) Work within the Marina Bay Sands Operating Environment
Work with senior managers and colleagues across the Museum and wider Attractions portfolio to support effective communication on key content matters.
Work collaboratively across Marina Bay Sands, including Marketing, Communications, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Procurement and other departments.
Work flexibly, including evenings and weekends when necessary.
Job Requirements
Education & Certification
Degree in English, Literature, Art History, Museum Studies, Publishing, Journalism, Communications, Translation, Chinese Studies or a related field.
Postgraduate qualification or equivalent professional experience in editing, publishing, museum interpretation, translation or communications is advantageous.
Experience
At least 4 years’ experience in editing, publishing, museum interpretation, cultural communications, journalism, copywriting, translation or related editorial work.
Track record delivering public-facing content from concept to final delivery across print, digital and/or physical environments.
Experience editing complex material for broad audiences, ideally across art, science, technology, design, culture or interdisciplinary subjects.
Experience managing editorial schedules, proofreading, version control, approvals and content sign-off.
Other Prerequisites
Native-level English writing, editing and proofreading ability, with excellent command of grammar, tone, structure and nuance.
Professional Mandarin proficiency, including the ability to review, edit and quality assure Mandarin translations and bilingual materials.
Excellent editorial judgement and the ability to translate complex ideas into clear, accurate, elegant and engaging public-facing language.
Strong understanding of audiences, accessibility, readability and inclusive communication.
Excellent organisation skills and impeccable attention to detail.
Ability to work diplomatically with senior stakeholders, creative practitioners, external partners and cross-functional teams.
Proven experience in project management and the ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
High level of cultural literacy and an interest in the intersection of art, science, technology and culture.
Ability to work as part of a team and independently, in an often-pressured environment and fast-paced work environment.

Title: Fielding Manager
Description:
COALITION GREENWICH:
Coalition Greenwich is a leading analytics and business intelligence provider to the financial services industry. Our clients include Corporate and Investment Banks, Asset Managers, and Fintechs. We specialize in providing unique, high-value, actionable information to help our clients improve their business performance. Our suite of analytics and insights encompass all key performance metrics and drivers: market share, revenue performance, client relationship share and quality, operational excellence, return on equity, brand perception, behavioural drivers, and industry evolution. We are a division of CRISIL, an S&P Global Company.
THE ROLE:
We are seeking a highly motivated Fielding Manager / Senior Manager to lead and manage complex market research projects from planning through execution and completion.
This is a hands-on role that requires strong project management capabilities, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to coordinate multiple projects and manage teams simultaneously. You will play a critical role in ensuring successful project delivery while maintaining high levels of respondent engagement and data quality.
The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys solving problems, and has experience managing large-scale fieldwork operations within a market research setting.
Project Management& Delivery
Lead end-to-end project planning, execution, and delivery across multiple market research studies.
Monitor project progress and proactively identify risks, issues, and potential roadblocks to ensure projects are delivered on schedule.
Ensure compliance with internal standards and research best practices.
Team Leadership &Resource Management
Manage and develop fieldwork team
Allocate resources effectively to support changing business and project requirements.
Respondent &Stakeholder Management
Build and maintain strong relationships with survey respondents and key stakeholders.
Act as the primary point of contact for fieldwork-related matters and project updates.
YOUR EXPERTISE:
Minimum 5 years of project management experience, preferably within market research, fieldwork operations, or a related industry.
Demonstrated success managing multiple concurrent projects in a fast-paced environment.
Experience leading and developing teams, including contingent or part-time resources.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Exceptional attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
Ability to adapt quickly to changing project requirements and business needs.
Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships across diverse teams.
Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, formulas and functions
Familiarity with the financial services industry is an advantage.
Ability to communicate effectively in Mandarin/Chinese to support collaboration with Chinese-speaking stakeholders would be beneficial.

Title: Global Partner Marketing Lead
Description:
About the company:
Founders today are building global companies from day one — but the systems that manage their money were built for a different era. Aspire exists to change that!
We’re building the financial operating system for global founders, bringing banking, software, and automation into a single platform so businesses can move faster across borders and stay focused on building.
Aspire is built by people who think from first principles, care deeply about solving hard problems, and take real ownership of their work. Our team brings global experience from leading fintech and technology companies, and many of us are former founders and operators who understand what it takes to build thoughtfully, make trade-offs, and deliver at scale in a global environment.
Backed by leading global investors including Y Combinator, Peak XV, and Lightspeed, Aspire has been trusted by more than 50,000 startups and growing businesses worldwide to manage their finances since 2018. Together with partners like J.P. Morgan, Visa, and Wise, we’re building for the next generation of global companies.
About the Role:
You'll own Aspire's global partner marketing strategy and execution. This isn't a coordination role — you're the architect and the operator. You'll design the playbook, set the standards, and drive partner-sourced revenue and customer acquisition across all three business units, all geographies, and all partner categories: banking and fintech, ERPs and accounting platforms, VCs, channel partners, resellers, and ISVs.
Reporting to the VP of Partnerships, you'll set the global strategy and playbook that regional teams execute and localize. You'll work hand-in-hand with Field Marketing Managers in each market and Partnership Managers globally to ensure global consistency and local relevance both hold.
This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role. You're the strategist and the operator — comfortable setting the agenda and shipping campaigns. You'll drive outcomes through influence and partnership, not (initially) through headcount. It's ideal for someone who wants to build a function from blank page and isn't afraid to roll up your sleeves.
What You'll Own:
Global Partner Marketing Strategy & Playbook
- Define and own Aspire's partner marketing roadmap tied directly to partner-sourced revenue and new customer acquisition targets across Aspire BA, Aspire OS, and AspireX.

- Prioritize investment across partner categories and markets based on revenue potential, partner engagement, and strategic fit for each business unit.
Partner-Sourced Pipeline & Revenue
- Identify and activate partner marketing opportunities with Partnership and Channel Managers globally. Turn relationships into active co-marketing pipeline.
- Own the global Marketing Development Fund (MDF) framework — allocation principles, governance, ROI tracking — that regional and in-market teams execute against.
- Track partner-sourced pipeline, revenue contribution, and new-logo acquisition. Use data to reallocate investment toward what works.
Co-Marketing Campaigns at Scale
- Design repeatable co-marketing campaign frameworks (joint content, webinars, events, social) that Field Marketing and partner teams can run in-market.
- Localize global messaging and positioning for partner-facing campaigns, market by market.
- Equip partners with ready-to-use assets, playbooks, and enablement materials so they can market Aspire effectively
Bridge Between Partnerships & Field Marketing
- Work closely with Field Marketing Managers in every market to align partner marketing execution with local go-to-market priorities.
- Be the central coordination point so partner initiatives are globally consistent but locally relevant. No reinventing the wheel. No one-size-fits-all that ignores reality on the ground.
- Represent partner marketing's needs and opportunities in Aspire's broader marketing and partnerships planning.
Measurement & Performance
- Establish shared metrics and reporting cadence for partner marketing performance — pipeline and revenue contribution, campaign output, MDF efficiency, partner activation.
- Share regular performance readouts with VP of Partnerships and BU stakeholders. Translate results into where to double down or pull back.

Must Have

- Experience working globally or across multiple markets/regions, setting central strategy that local teams executed.
- Operate as both strategist and operator. Equally comfortable setting the agenda and shipping a campaign yourself.
- Strong stakeholder management across Partnerships, Sales, Field Marketing, and BU/Product Marketing leadership.

Job Description

OVERVIEW
CoStar Group is a leading global provider of commercial and residential real estate information, analytics, and online marketplaces. Included in the S&P 500 Index, CoStar Group is on a mission to digitize the world’s real estate, empowering all people to discover properties, insights and connections that improve their businesses and lives.
We have been living and breathing the world of real estate information and online marketplaces for over 35 years, giving us the perspective to create truly unique and valuable offerings to our customers. We’ve continually refined, transformed, and perfected our approach to our business, creating a language that has become standard in our industry, for our customers, and even our competitors. We continue that effort today and are always working to improve and drive innovation. This is how we deliver for our customers, our employees, and investors. By equipping the brightest minds with the best resources available, we provide an invaluable edge in real estate.
ABOUT MATTERPORT
Matterport, part of the CoStar Group, is leading the digital transformation of the built world. Our ground-breaking spatial computing platform turns buildings into data making every space more valuable and accessible. Millions of buildings in more than 177 countries have been transformed into immersive Matterport digital twins to improve every part of the building lifecycle from planning, construction, and operations to documentation, appraisal, and marketing.
Learn more about Matterport.
DESCRIPTION
As an Inside Sales Account Executive at Matterport, you will be part of a fast-growing, high-velocity sales organization responsible for helping customers across industries digitize their buildings, streamline operations, and unlock measurable business value through Matterport’s leading 3D digital twin platform.
You will run a full-cycle sales motion—prospecting, discovery, demos, pricing, negotiation, and closing—in a high-activity environment where speed, precision, and strong communication are critical. You’ll speak daily with customers in industries such as Architecture, Engineering & Construction, Facilities Management, Corporate Real Estate, Industrial/Manufacturing, Retail, Hospitality, and Insurance/Restoration.

This role is on-site five days a week in our office on McCallum Street.

Run a full cycle inside sales process, including prospecting, discovery, demos, pricing, negotiation, and closing.
Generate your own pipeline, using outbound calls, emails, sequences, and follow-up to reach decision-makers .

Conduct high-quality discovery calls, uncovering customer pain points, workflows, and use cases that demonstrate the value of Matterport’s platform.
Deliver polished product demonstrations that map customer needs to Matterport’s capabilities and ROI drivers.

Collaborate with your Regional Director and Sales Enablement for coaching, call reviews, skill development, and rapid improvement.

Partner with cross-functional teams (Product, Marketing, Support) to deliver exceptional customer experience and accelerate deals.

Represent Matterport with professionalism, continuously reinforcing our values and delivering customer-first engagement.

Title: JUNIOR COMMODITY TRADER
Description:
Essential Language Requirement — Please Read Before Applying
*Working proficiency in both English and Mandarin is mandatory for this position.*
The successful candidate must be able to:
* Conduct business conversations, meetings and commercial discussions confidently in both English and Mandarin.
* Read and understand business correspondence, quotations, product specifications and commercial documents in both languages.
* Write clear and professional emails and messages in both English and Mandarin.
* Communicate directly with counterparties in China and Taiwan who conduct their business communications primarily in Mandarin.
*Candidates who are unable to conduct business communications in both English and Mandarin will not meet the essential requirements of this position. Language proficiency will be assessed during the interview process.*
About Sherman Mineral Trading
Sherman Mineral Trading is an international commodity trading company focused on supporting the metals, mining and mineral-processing industries.
Our trading activities include sulphur, sulphuric acid, nickel-related products, battery materials and other industrial commodities. We work with producers, suppliers, customers and business partners across Asia, the Middle East and other international markets.
Position Overview
We are seeking a bilingual, commercially astute, resourceful and highly motivated Junior Commodity Trader to join our Singapore team.
The successful candidate will support the full physical commodity trading cycle—from market research, supplier sourcing and business development to commercial negotiation, contract execution, shipping coordination and payment follow-up.
This is a hands-on commercial position requiring strong situational awareness, practical judgement and the confidence to communicate with suppliers, customers, banks, shipping companies and internal stakeholders.
We are looking for someone who is not only academically capable, but also practical, adaptable and commercially alert. The candidate must be able to understand people and situations, identify what is important, ask intelligent questions and respond appropriately without requiring detailed instructions at every stage.
Key ResponsibilitiesTrading and Business Development
* Support the sourcing, purchase and sale of sulphur, sulphuric acid, nickel-related products, battery materials and other industrial commodities.
* Identify and develop potential suppliers, customers, traders and strategic business partners in international markets.
* Communicate directly with counterparties in English and Mandarin to obtain quotations, product specifications, available quantities, shipment schedules and payment terms.
* Prepare commercial comparisons covering price, product quality, logistics, financing costs, payment risks and expected trading margins.
* Support senior management during negotiations, meetings and commercial discussions.
* Follow up actively with counterparties and maintain momentum until each opportunity reaches a clear outcome.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of trading leads, quotations, negotiations and outstanding action items.
* Assist in preparing commercial proposals, presentations and management updates.
Market Intelligence
* Monitor commodity prices, regional supply and demand, freight rates, port conditions and relevant geopolitical and industry developments.
* Prepare concise market updates and highlight developments that may affect pricing, supply availability, logistics or trading strategy.
* Verify market information through multiple credible sources instead of accepting unconfirmed statements at face value.
* Develop a practical understanding of major producers, traders, customers, shipping routes and end-use industries.
* Identify new business opportunities and promptly escalate commercially significant information to management.
* Distinguish actionable market intelligence from rumours, promotional claims and unreliable information.
Trade Execution
* Coordinate with operations, finance, banks, customers, suppliers, brokers, surveyors, shipping agents and other service providers to ensure smooth trade execution.
* Review commercial terms, product specifications, contracts, invoices, letters of credit and shipping documents for accuracy and consistency.

About QE
Quintessential Education is Singapore's leading provider of pre-tertiary academic programmes (IGCSE & IB) and university admissions advisory for top-tier global universities — Ivy League, Oxbridge, and NUS/NTU/SMU. Since 2012 we have worked with more than 1000 students, and most of our new families come to us through referrals. You'll be the first person a parent speaks to when they enquire, and the person who keeps them informed once their child is with us. That means answering enquiries every day, matching students with the right tutors and mentors, and following up with students and parents regularly so nothing slips through.
You'll also help develop our marketing materials and partner relationships.
If you're a confident communicator in both English and Mandarin*, stay calm and warm with demanding parents, and like being the person who makes sure things actually get done — we'd love to meet you.

Arrange class schedules, replacement lessons, and changes with tutors and families.
Keep parents informed ahead of key moments: exam periods, predicted grades, application deadlines, and results day.
Follow up on renewals and next-stage programmes (e.g. IGCSE to IB, IB to university applications).
3. Business Operations
Prepare and track invoices and payments.
Draft and manage service agreements for clients and tutors.
Keep client records, notes, and follow-up schedules up to date.
Keep a simple monthly record of enquiries, enrolments, and renewals for the founders.
4. Marketing & Partnerships
Keep brochures, website content, and newsletters accurate and up to date.
Work with design and digital marketing agencies on campaigns and collateral.
Support parent seminars and events, including Mandarin-language sessions with our China school partners.

Title: Senior Channel Marketing Executive

Together, these underpin our retirement and protection solutions: we are an international player in pension risk transfer, in UK and US life insurance, and in UK workplace pensions and retirement income.
Our global asset management business provides our clients and partners with complex, responsible investment solutions, working internationally across public and private markets.

We are one of Europe’s largest asset managers and a major global investor across public and private markets.
Asset Management is a critical driver of our Group strategy. The business aims to work synergistically with our Institutional Retirement and Retail divisions to benefit our clients and customers, and deliver enhanced shareholder returns.
Our investment philosophy and processes are focused on creating value over the long term. We believe that incorporating financially material sustainability criteria, when relevant to our clients, can create value and drive positive change.

We’re looking for a commercially curious and collaborative marketer to join our growing APAC Asset Management business. This is an opportunity to play a key role in supporting marketing activity across both Institutional and Wholesale client channels, helping deliver campaigns, content, client communications and market engagement initiatives across Asia-Pacific.
Working within a lean regional team, you’ll gain broad exposure across marketing disciplines and partner with stakeholders across Asia and the UK.

-

-
Coordinating campaign delivery across content, digital, email, events and social channels
-

-

-
Managing campaign timelines, approvals and stakeholder inputs
-

-

-
Ensuring marketing activity aligns with brand, regulatory and governance requirements

-
5–8 years’ marketing experience within asset management, financial services or another regulated environment
-
Experience supporting or delivering integrated marketing campaigns across multiple channels
-
Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills
-
Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail
-
Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities independently
-
Strong written and verbal communication skills
-
Fluency in English and Chinese, both written and spoken
-
Knowledge of APAC investment markets and Institutional or Wholesale audiences
Whatever your role, we reward performance and behaviour with a package that looks after all the things that are important to you. Here are some of the benefits we offer:

You will lead complex commercial engagements and work closely with Aurora's market leads, research, advisory, software, and product teams to support investment and financing decisions across the region.

Title: Localization Project Coordinator (Thai)
Description:
Company Overview
As part of Bandai Namco Holdings Inc., a global leader in video games, toys, and amusement parks, Bandai Namco Entertainment Asia (BNE Asia) is a top publisher and distributor of PC and console games across Asia. We bring beloved titles like Elden Ring™, Tekken™, PAC-MAN™, and Little Nightmares™ to fans across the region.
We are united by our purpose: “Fun for all into the Future.” We aim to deliver quality entertainment experiences and connect fans both digitally and physically through unique IPs that only Bandai Namco can offer.
Job Purpose
The Localization Project Coordinator (Thai) is responsible for supporting the planning, coordination, tracking and quality review of Thai localization and LQA projects across assigned titles and content scopes.
The role works closely with the Localization Manager, internal project teams, external translation vendors and LQA vendors to ensure timely delivery, linguistic consistency, clear documentation and continuous improvement of Thai localization quality.
This position will be responsible for seamlessly managing all localization and LQA activities for assigned titles, serving as the primary point of coordination across internal stakeholders, vendors, and QA teams. Responsibilities include project planning and execution, vendor management, linguistic quality oversight, issue tracking, reporting, knowledge-base maintenance, and ensuring timely delivery of localization milestones. Final budget, vendor, project, and commercial approval authority will remain with the Localization Manager and/or designated internal approver.
Why This Role Matters
This role supports BNEAS in building a scalable Thai localization model by strengthening vendor coordination, improving linguistic consistency, maintaining title-specific language assets, and ensuring knowledge continuity across projects and vendors. The role is important in reducing dependency on individual translators and supporting smoother vendor transition, project hand over and business continuity.
Key Responsibilities
1. Localization Coordination
Support localization projects across assigned titles, including planning support, task tracking, delivery follow-up and coordination with internal stakeholders and external vendors.
Track project milestones, dependencies, risks, open issues and pending decisions, and escalate delays or quality concerns to the Localization Manager in a timely manner.
Coordinate project requests and workflows using memoQ and/or other CAT tools, TMS platforms or internal tracking tools, where applicable.
Support delivery alignment across translation, LQA, internal review and final submission stages.
Ensure translated materials and related deliverables are coordinated accurately and delivered according to agreed timelines.
Support continuous improvement initiatives for localization processes, tools, and workflows, including the evaluation and implementation of automation and AI-assisted solutions where appropriate.
2. Vendor Coordination & Communication
Coordinate day-to-day communication with Thai translation and LQA vendors, including project briefing, query handling, delivery follow-up, issue tracking and feedback consolidation.
Brief vendors on project scope, schedule, source materials, style requirements, terminology expectations, delivery format and quality requirements.
Act as the day-to-day contact point for vendor queries and consolidate questions for internal clarification where required.
Maintain vendor communication records, open issue logs and action trackers to ensure clear follow-up and timely resolution.
Provide structured feedback to vendors and escalate quality, schedule, scope or delivery risks to the Localization Manager for decision-making.
3. Thai Linguistic Quality Review
Conduct Thai linguistic spot checks on vendor deliverables to review terminology, tone, consistency, cultural appropriateness, text accuracy and adherence to project guidelines.
Review translated content from vendors, including translation and LQA deliverables, to identify recurring linguistic or quality issues.
Provide practical and structured linguistic feedback to vendors to support quality improvement and calibration.
Recommend Thai linguistic acceptance or rejection for review by the Localization Manager, where required.
Support quality calibration with LQA vendors and internal stakeholders to improve consistency across titles and content types.
4. Localization Knowledge Base & Language Asset Management
Build and maintain Thai localization knowledge assets, including title-specific glossaries, translation memories, style guides, terminology notes, character/IP-specific translation rules and recurring issue logs.
Compile title-specific translation tips, vendor handover notes and project learning points to support continuity across vendors, projects and internal team changes.
Maintain and update Thai terminology references to ensure consistency across different documents, content types and project phases.
Support proper documentation of Thai language decisions, approved terminology and localization guidelines for future reference.
Assist in identifying gaps in existing language assets and recommend improvements to strengthen localization quality and efficiency.
5. Weekly Reporting & Continuous Improvement
Prepare weekly Thai localization progress reports for the Localization Manager / BNEAS localization team, covering project status, vendor progress, key risks, quality issues, pending decisions and next actions.
Prepare post-project summaries, issue trends, quality observations and improvement recommendations to support future localization planning.
Document recurring vendor, process or quality issues and propose practical workflow improvements.
Support the development and maintenance of localization guidelines, best practices, reporting templates and project tracking documents.
6. Schedule and Cost Tracking Support
Track localization and LQA schedules, delivery milestones and vendor submission status, and highlight risks to the Localization Manager and relevant internal stakeholders.
Support cost tracking by maintaining records of vendor quotations, purchase requests, invoices and approved budget references, where applicable.
Coordinate with the Localization Manager and designated internal approvers on cost reporting, project status and required follow-up actions.
Monitor potential schedule or cost risks and provide timely updates; however, budget ownership, vendor commercial negotiation and approval authority remain with the Localization Manager and/or designated internal approver.
7. LQA Coordination Support
Support LQA coordination for all localized content, including issue follow-up, bug and defect clarification, vendor query management, and status tracking across assigned languages, including but not limited to Thai, Bahasa Indonesia, English, and other languages as required.
Assist in checking localized content for language-related issues, inconsistencies or terminology deviations during LQA review stages.
Coordinate with internal QA/LQA stakeholders and vendors on Thai language-related issues within the agreed project scope.
Support LQA reporting and quality feedback documentation for assigned Thai localization projects.
Requirements
Education & Experience
Bachelor's degree preferably in Translation, Linguistics, Communications, Game Studies, Business Administration or a related discipline.
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in the gaming industry, including at least 3 to 5 years in game localization, LQA, localization project coordination, translation project management or vendor coordination.
Experience working with external localization, translation or LQA vendors, including query handling, delivery tracking, feedback consolidation and issue escalation.
Experience supporting launched game titles or live/ongoing game localization projects will be an advantage.
Prior experience in PC, console, mobile game, entertainment, media or digital content localization will be highly relevant.
Language Skills
Professional fluency in Thai, with strong written and spoken proficiency and the ability to review Thai localization for tone, terminology, style, cultural appropriateness, consistency and player-facing language quality.
Strong professional proficiency in English for daily communication, reporting, documentation and coordination with regional stakeholders.
Professional proficiency in Japanese for regular communication and coordination with Japan-based stakeholders, including clarification of localization requirements, source content, terminology, cultural nuances, project queries and linguistic quality issues. JLPT N2 or equivalent proficiency is preferred.
Technical Skills
Familiarity with CAT tools, TMS or localization platforms such as memoQ, XLOC or equivalent systems.
Ability to manage translation memories, glossaries, terminology lists, issue trackers and project documentation accurately.
Familiarity with video game consoles. Able to maneuver and use debug functions.
Proficient in Microsoft Office tools, especially Excel, Copilot, Word and PowerPoint, for reporting, tracking and documentation.
Good understanding of game localization workflows, LQA processes, vendor coordination, issue tracking and delivery management.
Business & Functional Competencies
Strong understanding of Asian and Western gaming markets, player expectations, cultural sensitivities and game localization requirements.
Ability to coordinate multiple projects, schedules, stakeholders and vendors while maintaining quality and documentation discipline.
Ability to translate localization requirements into clear vendor instructions, action trackers and follow-up items.
Strong project tracking capability, including timelines, dependencies, risks, open issues and escalation points.
Ability to identify linguistic quality risks and provide practical feedback for improvement.
Behavioral Attributes
Meticulous, organised and highly attentive to detail.
Strong ownership and follow-through on assigned tasks, open issues and project deliverables.
Clear, respectful and professional communication style with both internal stakeholders and external vendors.
Able to manage multiple deadlines and priorities, especially during peak release or submission periods.
Proactive in documenting knowledge, improving workflows and supporting team continuity.
Able to work independently in an offsite arrangement while maintaining regular communication and reporting discipline.
Team player with a constructive, service-oriented and problem-solving mindset.
Preferred Qualifications & Experience
This role requires relevant experience in game localization, LQA, localization project coordination, vendor communication and Thai linguistic quality review, together with strong attention to detail and project management skills.
Relevant experience includes coordinating with external localization and LQA vendors, reviewing Thai-language content for accuracy, terminology, tone and consistency, maintaining glossaries and translation memories, preparing project status reports, and tracking project issues, risks and deliverables.
Knowledge of game localization workflows, LQA processes, title-specific terminology and language assets, and experience working with cross-functional and regional stakeholders would be advantageous. Familiarity with Asian and Western gaming markets, player expectations and localization quality standards would also be relevant to the role.
What We Offer
Opportunity to work with well-loved Bandai Namco IPs and major PC/console game titles across Asia.
Exposure to regional localization workflows, external vendor coordination, LQA processes, and cross-market project communication.
Opportunity to contribute to the development of Thai localisation standards, glossaries, style guides, and title-specific knowledge assets.
A collaborative regional working environment with stakeholders across BNEAS and external localisation/LQA partners.

B.Sc or Master in Computer Science, Engineering or related subjects.
Experience in network design and topologies, both logical and physical.

Exposure to Kubernetes, container runtimes and cloud native stacks.

Hands-on experience with NVIDIA systems and technologies such as Cumulus Linux, GPU and Network Operator, DCGM, Base Command Manager.
Knowledge of DevOps/MLOps technologies.
Professional fluency in one or more of these languages: Mandarin, Thai, Bahasa Indonesia, Bahasa Malaysia

Title: AI Assisted Sales Manager
Description:
The Sales Manager is responsible for driving revenue across TechStudio's products and professional services. The role combines new business development with account management, engaging both channel partners and enterprise end-clients directly. The primary market is Singapore, with sales support extended into Malaysia and Thailand as opportunities arise.
This is a mid-level, performance-driven sales role suited to a commercially hungry professional who is equally comfortable opening new accounts, nurturing existing relationships, and working alongside channel partners to close enterprise deals. The role carries a fixed base salary complemented by an attractive, uncapped commission structure, allowing strong performers to scale their earnings in direct line with the deals they close.
AI tools form part of the day-to-day workflow. The executive is expected to use them actively for prospecting, account research, and pipeline management, and to contribute ideas that strengthen how the sales team applies AI.
Key Responsibilities
Identify, qualify, and close new business opportunities for TechStudio's products and services across Singapore, Malaysia, and Thailand
Own and consistently deliver against assigned sales quotas and revenue targets
Manage and grow existing accounts, ensuring strong client relationships, renewals, and upsell opportunities
Work closely with channel partners to co-sell into their enterprise customer base
Engage enterprise end-clients directly through discovery meetings, solution presentations, and commercial negotiations
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline, accurately forecast revenue, and report progress to the Sales Director
Collaborate with technical, and service delivery teams to scope proposals and ensure smooth handover to delivery
Stay current on the product roadmap, competitor offerings, and the broader market for AI, WiFi application, IoT, location services, and video AI
Represent TechStudio at industry events, partner briefings, and client engagements
Use AI tools for prospecting, account research, proposal drafting, and CRM hygiene, and contribute prompts and workflows that improve sales productivity
Requirements
Diploma in Business, Marketing, Information Technology, or a related field
Minimum 2 years of B2B sales experience, ideally in enterprise technology, telecommunications, SaaS, or system integration
Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets in a quota-carrying role
Comfortable operating within a performance-driven, commission-centric compensation model with uncapped earning potential, and motivated to grow income through sales achievement
Experience selling through channel partners and directly to enterprise clients
Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to position business outcomes ahead of technical features
Proficient in spoken and written English and Mandarin, to engage with Chinese-speaking clients and partners
Confidence using AI tools in day-to-day sales activities, with a willingness to learn prompt engineering and contribute to sales workflow improvements
Strong presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills
Self-motivated, well-organised, and able to manage multiple opportunities concurrently

A compensation package built around a fixed base salary plus an uncapped commission structure, with no ceiling on earnings for strong performers
A diverse product and services portfolio that addresses real enterprise business outcomes, supported by deployments across major organisations

Direct collaboration with senior leadership and a clear commercial growth path within TechStudio

Location: Bishan

Key Responsibilities
Customer Credit & Risk Management
Conduct credit assessments and approval for new customers, and periodically review credit limits for existing customers.
Develop and maintain a dynamic customer credit rating system.
Monitor customer credit risks and provide timely alerts on over-limit and overdue accounts.
Develop collection and resolution plans to manage credit exposure and minimise risks.

Identify opportunities to improve and automate AR processes.
Provide regular updates to management on collection status, credit risks and overdue accounts.

Title: Channel Development Manager
Description:
Want to build a channel from the ground up in some of Asia's fastest-growing markets?
Our client is a long-established, privately held global software company. It is a recognised leader in Output Management, and large enterprises around the world rely on its platform. Its go-to-market is channel first. It is contuning to invest in Southeast Asia and needs a channel hunter to open the region up.
The opportunity
This is a genuine greenfield role. You'll own the partner recruitment strategy across emerging APAC markets, including Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand and Vietnam. You'll find, sign and activate the partners who will become the company's long-term routes to market in the region.
You'll be recruiting print manufacturers, ISVs, IT outsourcers, system integrators, Managed Print Services providers, and quality local resellers and distributors. You'll then take each one from contract to enablement to first deal and first revenue.
What you'll do
- Build and execute a market-by-market partner recruitment plan
- Assess partners on strategic fit, financial health and market reach
- Lead contracting, onboarding, enablement and certification
- Build executive relationships and joint business plans with partners
- Drive partner-led pipeline across SMB, mid-market and enterprise
- Use AI tools to sharpen market analysis and spot gaps in the ecosystem
- Report to Channel Sales leadership through forecasts and QBRs
What you'll bring
- 6+ years in channel sales, business development or enterprise technology sales
- A proven track record recruiting channel partners in APAC emerging markets
- Strong understanding of enterprise and cloud software
- Fluent English and Mandarin Chinese (a big plus), spoken and written
- Permanent right to work in Singapore or Malaysia
- Comfort with regular regional travel
- Bonus points for experience in print management, output management or document management software. An existing partner network in the region.
The package
- SGD 200,000 to 220,000 OTE plus benefits. The role has the scope and backing to grow as the region grows.
Why this role
You'll be the person who builds the region's partner ecosystem. You'll have the backing of an established global vendor and the autonomy of a hunting role. That means real ownership, real impact, and the chance to put your stamp on a market.

Title: Finance Compliance Officer

Finance Compliance Officer
to join our International team.
You will be responsible for:
Own risk-based due diligence for purchasers, agents, partners and other counterparties, including identity, beneficial ownership and enhanced checks where required.

Fluency in English and Mandarin, with an emphasis on the ability to read and understand Chinese documents and to do simple translations for other region.

Title: Head of Global Partnership
Description:
ABOUT US
PayerMax is a global fintech company rooted in emerging markets, offering seamless global payment solutions, including acquiring, payouts, and collections. Beyond payments, we deliver value-added services such as risk management, foreign exchange, multi-currency accounts, payment marketing, and tax services, designed to simplify and enhance the global payment experience
Driven by a long-term strategic vision, we have steadily expanded our global payment network since our founding in 2018 and now serve over 150 markets worldwide. We’ve built local offices in 18 countries and secured financial licenses and regulatory accreditations in key regions including Singapore, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Hong Kong (China), Thailand, Indonesia, and the Philippines. Rooted in emerging markets, our mission is to help merchants make the most of every minute and every cent, while continuing to drive innovation in digital finance
ABOUT THE ROLE
The Head of Global Partnership will be responsible for leading the company's global partnership strategy across key regions including Europe & Americas, Asia-Pacific, the Middle East, Latin America and other strategic markets. This senior leadership role requires an accomplished executive with deep industry networks, extensive international payments experience, and proven leadership capabilities to drive the company's global payment infrastructure, ecosystem development, and localized market penetration, thereby supporting business growth and global expansion
CORE RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Global Partnership Ecosystem Strategy & Business Development
- Formulate and execute a comprehensive global partner acquisition roadmap aligned with the company's international business strategy and regional client needs, ensuring robust, stable, cost-effective, and fully compliant local payment capabilities across all core markets
- Lead high-level strategic dialogues and negotiations with top-tier global partners, including but not limited to global and regional banks, acquiring institutions, e-wallets, card networks, cross-border payment platforms, fintech firms, and regulatory bodies
- Build and sustain long-term trusted relationships with C-level executives and key decision-makers of partner organizations; drive deep collaboration models such as joint innovation, exclusive partnerships, and equity/strategic investment alliances
2. Team Leadership & Organizational Development
- Lead and manage a globally distributed partnership team of 20+ members across multiple countries and time zones
- Establish efficient global collaboration mechanisms, foster cross-regional and cross-cultural teamwork, define clear performance management systems, and continuously enhance team professionalism and execution capabilities
- Develop a robust talent pipeline and build a versatile, internationally-minded team with strong local market expertise
3. Local Market Implementation
- Based on strategic priorities, spearhead local market entry and scaling in key countries/regions; collaborate closely with Legal, Compliance, Finance, Product, Technology, and Business teams to ensure that localisation solutions are commercially viable, legally sound, and operationally competitive
4. Internal Synergy & Resource Integration
- Serve as the overall owner of global payment capability development, coordinating with internal stakeholders to ensure end-to-end efficient delivery of partnership projects—from contract signing to go-live—while continuously optimising cost and service quality
- Regularly report on project milestones, market opportunities, and risk assessments; evaluate strategic investment opportunities across the payment value chain to accelerate global network coverage and technology capability enhancement
QUALIFICATIONS
- Minimum 15 years of relevant industry experience, with at least 10 years in senior regional or global leadership roles within large financial institutions, international payment companies, or cross-border payment platforms
- Extensive and established network of global payment partners, with deep understanding and first-hand relationships with local payment channels, banking counterparts, and regulatory environments in emerging markets such as Europe & Americas, Asia-Pacific, the Middle East, and Latin America; ability to directly access and influence key decision-makers
- Proven track record in managing large-scale, multicultural, and geographically dispersed teams, with direct supervisory experience over 20+ employees and demonstrated competence in cross-time-zone and cross-language collaboration
- Adept at engaging in C-level dialogue with financial institution executives; strong strategic negotiation and complex deal-structuring skills, supported by a history of successfully leading major partnership initiatives
- Excellent command of both English and Chinese (Mandarin) as working languages, with the ability to conduct high-stakes communications with sophistication
- Highly strategic with strong business acumen, combined with exceptional execution capabilities and resilience; ability to make clear, decisive judgments in highly ambiguous and fast-changing environments
- Unwavering integrity and strong compliance awareness. Bachelor's degree or above required; MBA preferred
关于我们
PayerMax是一家植根于新兴市场的全球金融科技公司，致力于提供无缝衔接的全球支付解决方案，涵盖收单、支付与收款服务。在此基础上，我们还提供风险管理、外汇兑换、多币种账户、支付营销及税务服务等增值服务，旨在全面简化和提升全球支付体验
秉持长期主义的战略愿景，自2018年成立以来，我们稳步拓展全球支付网络，目前已覆盖150多个市场，在18个国家设立了本地办事处，并在新加坡、阿联酋、沙特阿拉伯、中国香港、泰国、印尼和菲律宾等主要地区获得了金融牌照及监管认证。立足新兴市场，我们的使命是帮助商户用好每一分钟、花好每一分钱，同时持续推动数字金融领域的创新 关于职位 作为人力资源团队的一员，你将有机会与各国家/地区的人力资源及业务团队紧密协作，作为人力资源和行政管理方面的专家，为PayerMax中东业务提供坚实支撑，共同推动公司未来发展
关于职位
全球合作伙伴关系负责人（Head of Global Partnership）将全面领导公司的Global Partnership战略，覆盖欧美，亚太、中东、拉美等市场。此岗位需要一位拥有深厚行业资源、丰富国际化支付经验及卓越领导力的资深管理者，推动公司全球支付能力建设、生态合作及本地化深耕，支持公司业务增长与全球化布局。
核心职责
1. 全球合作伙伴生态战略与拓展
- 基于公司全球业务战略及区域客户需求，制定并执行全球支付合作伙伴的拓展蓝图，确保公司在各核心市场具备丰富、稳定、低成本且合规的本地支付能力
- 主导与全球顶级合作伙伴的高层战略对话与谈判，合作伙伴涵盖：全球及区域性银行、收单机构、电子钱包、卡组织、跨境支付平台、金融科技公司及监管机构等
- 建立并维护与合作伙伴C-level及决策层长期信任关系，推动联合创新、独家合作、资本合作等深度绑定模式
2. 团队管理与组织建设
- 领导并管理分布在全球多个国家/地区的Global Partnership团队，团队总规模20人以上
- 建立高效的全球协作机制，推动跨区域、跨文化团队的协同作战能力，制定清晰绩效管理体系，持续提升团队专业度与执行力
- 培养梯队人才，打造具备国际化视野和本地深耕能力的复合型团队
3. 关键市场本地化落地
- 结合公司战略优先级，主导关键国家/地区的本地化进程；与法务、合规、财务、产品、技术及业务团队紧密协同，确保本地化方案在商业、法律及运营层面均具备可行性与竞争力
4. 内部协同与资源整合
- 作为全球支付能力建设的总负责人，协同内部部门，确保合作伙伴项目从签约到上线的全链路高效落地，并持续优化成本与服务质量
- 定期沟通关键项目进展、市场机会与风险，评估支付产业链上下游的战略投资机会，协助加速公司全球网络覆盖与技术能力升级
任职要求
- 15年以上相关行业经验，其中至少10年以上在大型金融机构、国际支付公司、或跨境支付平台负责全球或区域管理
- 拥有深厚的全球支付合作伙伴资源网络，尤其对欧美、亚太、中东、拉美等新兴市场的本地支付渠道、银行及监管环境有深刻理解和一手人脉；有能力直接触达并影响关键决策者
- 具备管理大规模、全球化、多文化团队的成功经验，直接管理过20人以上团队，擅长跨时区、跨语言协作
- 擅长与金融机构C-level高管进行高层对话，具有优秀的战略博弈及复杂条款谈判的能力，过往有大型合作项目的主导落地案例
- 优秀的中英文沟通能力，可作为工作语言进行高复杂度沟通
- 极具战略视野与商业敏锐度，同时具备极强的执行力与韧性；能够在高度不确定和快速变化的环境中做出清晰决策
- 诚信、合规意识强，本科及以上学历，MBA优先

Title: Supply Chain Planning Manager
Description:
The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end supply chain planning for the MX business to ensure optimal inventory levels, forecast accuracy and on-time fulfilment. With a sound understanding of demand and supply planning, order-to-cash processes and the supporting systems from Suwon supply to channel sell-out, he/she will manage the SCM planning role for the business and collaborate with cross-functional teams in Sales, Product Marketing, Logistics, Finance and Suwon and SEAO Regional Office to achieve division KPIs and expectations.
Role Responsibilities:
To deliver on following KPIs:
(a) Forecast Accuracy
(b) Weeks of Stock (WOS) & Aged Inventory
(c) Order Fulfilment & Out-of-Stock
Manage demand forecasting (AP2) by coordinating short, mid and long-term forecasts with Sales and Product Marketing teams, aligned to monthly, quarterly and yearly business targets.
Lead weekly SCM meetings and Channel PSI reviews, providing a clear view of sell-in, sell-out and inventory status against business targets.
Provide accurate Weeks of Stock (WOS) simulation based on sell-in and sell-out, and manage aged inventory with Product and Sales teams on exit strategy.
Manage supply allocation, order fulfilment and new product launch readiness in line with customer requirements and delivery schedules.
Work closely with Suwon, Logistics and 3PL partners on inbound capacity, stock transfers and outbound prioritisation to minimise out-of-stock and delivery delays.
Coordinate and maintain constant communications with all stakeholders (SESP, SEAO Regional Office and Suwon) on supply status, issues and escalations.
Drive SCM process and system improvements (SAP, automated reporting and dashboards) to improve visibility, efficiency and exception-based management.
Contribute towards change management initiatives to achieve operational excellence.
Role Requirements:
Degree in Business, Supply Chain Management or related discipline
5 to 10 years of experience in Supply Chain, Demand/Supply Planning or related operations
MS Office, advance capability particularly in Excel
SAP(SD/MM), ERP and BI tools knowledge is advantageous
Strong communication, stakeholder management and analysis skills
Proficiency in Korean is required due to close collaboration with Global HQ stakeholders in South Korea.
