Title: Account Executive, Media & Telco
Description:
This is us
Kaltura’s (NYSE:KLTR) mission is to power any video experience for any organization – live, on-demand, or real-time. We not only want to make using video simpler, but we also want to better people’s lives through video. Founded in 2006, Kaltura is now a global leader in the video market with millions of people using our products daily to teach, learn, watch, connect, and collaborate. Among our customers, you’ll find more than 1000 global, well-known organizations.
15+ years since starting the company, we continue to foster a diverse and collaborative work environment where everyone gets a say. Our team is currently 700+ people, and we’re still growing. We have offices in New York, London, Singapore, and Tel Aviv, but our technology is all in the cloud.
Kaltura has a fast-paced environment where initiative is always encouraged. Together with our hybrid work model and flexible state of mind, you get the right conditions for creative juices to flow freely. Thanks to our long line of products, cultivation of rich collaborative culture and care for each Kalturian, you’ll never run out of room to grow and evolve.
If you don't meet 100% of the requirements below - that's okay, nobody's perfect! We believe in hiring people, not just a list of skills. We encourage you to apply if you think this is a role that would make you excited about coming to work every day.
Requirements:
About The Role
We're looking for an Account Executive to join our APAC sales team, helping leading Telecom, Media and Entertainment organizations transform how they engage, support and grow their customers.
Based in Southeast Asia, you'll work closely with customers, prospects, partners and colleagues across the region. You'll play an important role in identifying new opportunities, building trusted relationships and helping organisations solve complex business challenges through innovative SaaS solutions.
Whether you're already working in enterprise software sales or have experience selling technology solutions and are ready for your next step, we'd love to hear from you.
You don't need to meet every requirement listed below to apply. If you're excited by the opportunity and believe you could add value, we encourage you to apply.
﻿What You'll Be Doing
- Build and develop relationships with telecom, media and entertainment organisations across Southeast Asia.
- Identify and qualify new business opportunities through prospecting, networking and partner engagement.
- Lead customer conversations, discovery meetings and product demonstrations.
- Work with senior business and technology stakeholders to understand their goals and challenges.
- Manage opportunities through the sales cycle, from initial engagement to contract signature.
- Partner closely with Sales Engineering, Product, Marketing and Customer Success teams.
- Maintain an accurate sales pipeline and forecast within our CRM.
- Represent the company at customer meetings, industry events and conferences across the region.
- Achieve and exceed individual sales and revenue targets.
﻿What You'll Be Selling
You'll represent a portfolio of market-leading SaaS solutions, including:
- A Cloud TV platform helping operators and media companies deliver exceptional video experiences across every screen.
- An AI-powered customer engagement platform that helps organisations acquire, support and retain customers through intelligent conversational experiences.
Together, these solutions help customers improve efficiency, enhance customer experience and accelerate growth.
﻿What We're Looking For
- 2-5 years' experience in B2B SaaS, enterprise software or technology sales.
- Experience generating new business and managing opportunities through a sales cycle.
- Confidence engaging customers and delivering presentations or demonstrations.
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
- A consultative approach with curiosity and a desire to understand customer needs.
- Self-motivated and organised, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Comfortable working independently while collaborating with an international team.
- Willingness to travel across Southeast Asia as needed.
﻿Nice to Have
- Experience in Telecom, Media, Video, AI, Customer Experience or related industries.
- Experience working with customers across Southeast Asia or APAC.
- Additional Southeast Asian language skills such as Bahasa Indonesia, Malay, Thai, Vietnamese or Tagalog.
﻿What We Offer
Our benefits packages depend on type of hire and location. For information please ask us during the interview process
- Competitive salary and uncapped commission plan.
- Comprehensive onboarding and continuous learning opportunities.
- Access to MyndUp for Coaching, Therapy, Psychology or Counselling sessions
- Exposure to innovative AI and media technology solutions.
- Fully flexible working hours
- Remote working set-up (location dep.)
- Occasional Cross-Company wellbeing weekends
- Access to our learning management experience platform (Juno)
- Budget for learning and development
﻿About You
You're curious, relationship-focused and enjoy meeting new people. You listen well, ask thoughtful questions and genuinely enjoy helping customers solve business challenges.
You bring energy, resilience and a growth mindset, and you're excited by the opportunity to learn, develop and make an impact within a growing international business.
If this role sounds interesting but you don't meet every qualification, we still encourage you to apply. We'd love to hear your story.

Google will be prioritizing applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require Google's sponsorship of a visa.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
2 years of experience in digital advertising, consultative sales, digital media sales, business development, online media environment, or digital marketing role.
Preferred qualifications:
Experience in account management, online businesses, advertising, digital marketing, consulting, or the media industry.
Deep understanding of APAC markets, user behaviors, business mechanisms, and the media landscape.
Ability to identify new opportunities and execute ideas in a changing environment alongside stakeholders.
Excellent analytical, organizational, and project management skills.
Ability to communicate in English and Mandarin fluently in order to engage and support customers in the region.
About the job
Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.
As an Account Manager, you will drive excellence by winning with unique value and maximizing the impact of our advertising solutions. You will relentlessly prove value and showcase success to spark future growth for our customers in the evolving AI-era.
As an Account Manager in the Media & Entertainment vertical, you'll craft innovative and effective cross-platform advertising solutions that propel Google's clients to the forefront of the industry. Drive accelerated growth for the world’s best online streaming and theatrical companies, expertly navigating Google's powerful suite of products and services. Build strategic partnerships that transform the advertising landscape and execute bold initiatives that leave your mark. This is your opportunity to join a high impact, agile team and deliver a big impact.
Google's Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.
Responsibilities
Engage and influence key customer stakeholders by leading strategic meetings to uncover marketing goals and key performance indicators, translating them into actionable campaign strategies.
Drive exceptional campaign results, quantify business impact, and demonstrate value to customers, maintaining account hygiene.
Build and pitch data-driven solutions to maximize customer value through Google’s advertising solutions, handle objections, and ultimately achieve sales growth targets.
Analyze campaign data, ensuring performance is accurately tracked, and deliver measurable results aligned with customer objectives.
Monitor performance data to extract key insights, identifying and cultivating qualified upsell opportunities to drive future customer growth and build pipeline.

Title: Alliances Director
Description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.
The Role
AspenTech is seeking a high-performing, strategic Alliances Director (APAC) to lead and optimize our regional partner ecosystem. As the regional strategic lead, you’ll develop and execute partner strategy, overseeing all sales partner activities through structured, programmatic approaches. Leveraging resources from both AspenTech and partners, you’ll drive regional collaboration, portfolio financial performance, business planning, governance, compliance, sales/technical enablement, and joint go-to-market initiatives.
Your core goal is to deliver shared success for AspenTech, Emerson, and customers by expanding our leadership in core markets (energy, chemicals), accelerating growth in high-potential verticals (metals & mining, pulp & paper, power), and tapping into underserved sectors via partners.
Your Impact
Strategic Growth & Partner Execution
- Go-to-Market Strategy: Build and execute structured partner strategies, joint business plans, and co-marketing campaigns aligned with digital transformation initiatives.
- Vertical Expansion: Accelerate market share in core process industries while driving partner penetration into underserved and growth verticals.
- Enablement & Adoption: Deliver sales and technical enablement to upskill partners on AspenTech best practices for standalone and co-selling opportunities.
- Cross-Organizational Interlock: Act as a "partner evangelist," aligning internal field sales, operations, and regional teams to streamline joint deal strategies.
Risk Management, Governance & Operations
- Ecosystem Rationalization: Optimize the APAC partner network by prioritizing high-value, repeatable alliances and minimizing one-off Systems Integrator (SI) engagements.
- Deal Integrity & Compliance: Enforce strict deal registration rules and mitigate operational/compliance risks tied to partner-led and co-sell engagements.
- Commission Framework Management: Establish clear commission structures for sales teams and partners; validate performance evidence to ensure seamless payout operations.
- Performance Tracking: Set joint pipeline goals, track revenue metrics, and lead formal Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with partner executives.
What You'll Need
- 10-15 years of proven success in enterprise tech partner management, alliance building, or channel sales within the Asia Pacific region.
- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Information Technology, or a related field.
- Good understanding of operational technology (OT) software, digital transformation, and industrial software solutions within process and manufacturing industries (energy, chemicals, mining, or power) is preferred.
- Strong track record of balancing high-level strategy with hands-on operational rigor (deal registration, compliance, and commission governance).
- Outstanding capability to build trust, influence without authority, and present effectively to C-suite and General Manager-level executives.
- Self-starter comfortable operating independently
- Full professional proficiency in English and Mandarin (written and spoken) to support regional partner coverage

Title: Analyst, Real Estate and Data Centers
Description:
About General Atlantic
General Atlantic is a leading global investor with more than four and a half decades of experience providing capital and strategic support for over 885 companies throughout its history. Established in 1980, General Atlantic continues to be a dedicated partner to visionary founders and investors seeking to build dynamic businesses and create lasting value. Guided by the conviction that entrepreneurs can be incredible agents of transformational change, the firm combines a collaborative global approach, sector specific expertise, a long-term investment horizon, and a deep understanding of growth drivers to partner with and scale innovative businesses around the world. The firm leverages its patient capital, operational expertise, and global platform to support a diversified investment platform spanning Growth Equity, Infrastructure, and Strategic Solutions. General Atlantic manages approximately $126 billion in assets under management, inclusive of all strategies, as of March 31, 2026, with more than 900 professionals in 20 countries across five regions. For more information on General Atlantic, please visit www.generalatlantic.com.
About Actis
In October 2024, General Atlantic acquired Actis, which now operates as its Sustainable Infrastructure business alongside its existing strategies in Growth Equity, Credit, and Climate. Actis is a leading global investor in sustainable infrastructure, delivering competitive returns for institutional investors and measurable positive impact for the countries, cities and communities in which it operates. Actis invests in structural themes that support long-term, equitable growth in defensive, critical infrastructure across energy transition, digitalization transition, and supply chain transformation. The firm’s decades of global experience, operational know-how and strong culture allows it to create global sustainability leaders at scale. Since inception, Actis has raised $26 billion to invest in a better tomorrow. Actis is a signatory to the United Nations backed Principles for Responsible Investment (UNPRI), an investor initiative developed by the UNEP FI. The firm has consistently been awarded the highest rating score in the UNPRI independent assessment. You can learn more about Actis at www.act.is.
Position Description
General Atlantic is looking to hire an Analyst to support the Actis Southeast Asia Real Estate team, based in Singapore. This is a small, high-ownership team investing in real assets across the region: the Analyst will work on live transactions from first screen through to structuring, financing, asset management and exit, rather than a single slice of the process.
You will build and own the models that underpin pricing and structuring decisions, run defined diligence workstreams with external advisers, and draft the memoranda that go to Investment Committee. The work is quantitative, commercially exposed and visible to senior members of the firm from day one.
Why This Role
Ownership from day one. In a small Singapore team, the Analyst owns models, diligence workstreams and adviser relationships directly
The full lifecycle. Origination, underwriting, structuring, debt financing, asset management and exit
Real assets, real complexity. Development and operating risk, project-level debt, joint venture and platform structures, and multiple Southeast Asian jurisdictions — technical ground that compounds into a durable specialism
Senior access and a defined path. Direct working exposure to Managing Directors and Principals
Responsibilities
Build and own asset- and platform-level financial models — development and operating cash flows, project finance debt sizing, joint venture waterfalls and returns analysis — and run the sensitivities that inform pricing and structuring decisions
Draft investment memoranda and Investment Committee presentations, translating diligence findings into a clear investment case with risks and mitigants set out plainly
Run defined due diligence workstreams end to end — commercial, technical, legal, tax and insurance — coordinating external advisers, tracking issues to resolution and escalating what matters
Support capital structuring and debt raising, including lender materials, base and downside cases, and covenant and debt service coverage analysis
Maintain the team’s market evidence base: supply and demand, rents and yields, land pricing, comparable transactions, buyer appetite and exit routes across the region
Conduct proprietary primary research through calls with operators, developers, occupiers, consultants and other industry contacts
Work alongside Managing Directors, Principals and portfolio company management on value creation — budget review, capital expenditure tracking, performance reporting and asset-level initiatives
Support origination: screening opportunities, preparing early-stage pricing views and keeping the pipeline current
The First Twelve Months
By month three you should be able to build a development cash flow model from a blank sheet and defend the assumptions in it. By month six you should be running a diligence workstream with limited supervision and drafting sections of an Investment Committee paper. By month twelve you should be the person on the team who knows the market data best and be trusted to take an adviser call alone.
Join our team and play a pivotal role in building General Atlantic’s real estate and sustainable infrastructure footprint in Southeast Asia. If you are a results-oriented professional with a passion for real assets and investing, we invite you to apply.

Title: APAC Partner Business Development Manager
Description:
Company Overview
Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.
Company Operating Rhythm
At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.
Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.
Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.
Deepgram is the Voice AI platform powering the next generation of enterprise voice agents, contact centers, and real-time speech applications. As we continue expanding globally, APAC represents one of our highest-growth strategic regions for partner-led expansion.
We are hiring an APAC Partner Business Development Manager to build and scale Deepgram’s partner ecosystem across ANZ, ASEAN, Japan, Korea, India, and Greater China. In this role, you will drive sell-to, sell-through, and sell-with motions alongside strategic partners including hyperscalers, ISVs, CCaaS/CX platforms, GSIs, telcos, and regional system integrators.
This is a highly cross-functional, builder-oriented role focused on growing partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue across diverse APAC markets. You’ll work closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Marketing, and global partner teams to establish Deepgram as a leading Voice AI platform in the region.
If you thrive in fast-moving environments, enjoy building new GTM motions, and are excited about shaping the future of AI partnerships in APAC, we’d love to meet you.
What You’ll DoDrive Regional Partner Growth
- Build and manage strategic partner relationships across APAC
- Develop joint value propositions, GTM plans, and regional co-sell motions tailored to local market dynamics
- Establish Deepgram as a strategic Voice AI partner across key ecosystems in the region
Drive Sell-To, Sell-Through, and Sell-With Motions
- Partner closely with hyperscalers, ISVs, CCaaS/CX platforms, GSIs, telcos, and regional integrators
- Generate and accelerate partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline across APAC markets
- Support co-sell opportunities through customer meetings, presentations, workshops, and negotiations

Title: Associate Director, Private Equity Fund
Description:
Company Overview
CGS International Securities Pte. Ltd. (CGS International) is an award-winning and market leading integrated financial services provider, ranked among the top securities houses in Asia.
CGS International taps on our wealth of global and ASEAN insights to offer equities trading, leveraged products, wealth management, investment banking, equities research, Shariah-compliant financing, fixed income, currency and commodities, structured products and prime brokerage services in over 15 countries and regions.
Along with its parent organisation China Galaxy Securities, a leading securities house in China, CGS International is trusted by more than 15 million customers globally.
Job Simmary
We are seeking a commercially driven
Manager/Associate Director, Private Equity Fund
to join our Asset Management team. The incumbent will play a key role in originating, evaluating, executing, and managing private equity investments across Southeast Asia.
The successful candidate will be responsible for leading investment transactions, conducting comprehensive due diligence, collaborating with portfolio company management teams to drive value creation, and supporting successful exit strategies. Corporate title, grade and the level of deal leadership will be commensurate with the successful candidate’s experience. This role requires strong financial acumen, investment judgment, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to operate effectively in a dynamic investment environment.
Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities
Investment Origination and Execution
Source and evaluate investment opportunities across selected sectors and markets within Southeast Asia.
Build and maintain relationships with investment banks, corporate advisors, entrepreneurs, industry experts, and strategic partners to generate proprietary deal flow.
Lead transaction execution, including valuation analysis, financial modelling, deal structuring, negotiations, documentation, and closing.
Prepare investment papers and recommendations for presentation to the Investment Committee.
Due Diligence and Investment Analysis
Conduct detailed financial, commercial, operational, and strategic due diligence on prospective investments.
Develop financial models and investment valuation analyses to assess potential returns, risks, and value creation opportunities.
Evaluate industry trends, competitive dynamics, regulatory considerations, and key investment risks.
Coordinate and manage external advisors, including legal, financial, tax, and technical consultants.
Portfolio Management and Value Creation
Monitor portfolio company performance against investment objectives and strategic plans.
Partner with management teams to drive operational improvements, business growth initiatives, and value enhancement opportunities.
Review financial performance, budgets, forecasts, and key business metrics.
Support portfolio companies in strategic decision-making, capital allocation, fundraising initiatives, and business expansion plans.
Exit Planning and Investor Reporting
Develop and execute exit strategies to maximise investment returns, including trade sales, secondary transactions, recapitalisations, and IPOs.
Support investor communications and reporting activities by providing timely and accurate updates on portfolio and fund performance.
Prepare presentations and materials for investors, management, and other stakeholders.
Market Intelligence and Stakeholder Management
Maintain a strong understanding of market developments, investment themes, regulatory changes, and emerging trends across the region.
Represent the firm at industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities to strengthen the firm's market presence and relationships.
Job Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related discipline.
MBA, CFA, or other professional investment qualifications will be an advantage.
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in private equity, investment banking, corporate finance, management consulting, venture capital, or asset management. Candidate will be considered for either Manager or Associate Director level, depending on experience, capabilities, and overall fit for the role.
Demonstrated track record in evaluating, executing, and managing investment transactions. For Associate Director level, a track record of leading transactions end-to-end is expected.
Strong financial modelling, valuation, and investment analysis capabilities.
Experience in transaction execution, due diligence, and deal structuring.
Strong commercial acumen and strategic thinking skills.
Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to manage multiple transactions and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Experience in healthcare, technology, or other high-growth sectors (good to have)
CFA, ACCA, CAIA, or MBA qualification. (good to have)
Prior board observer or portfolio management experience. (good to have)
Strong written and spoken English.

Excellent organizational and time-management skills with the ability to handle multiple tasks and deals at any given time and deliver to deadlines.

Title: Ecosystem Partnership Manager / Director
Description:
About the Team & Your Mission
We are building a brand-new Ecosystem Partnership (BD) team in the APAC region, with a strategic focus on the Singapore and Hong Kong markets. We aim to establish deep collaborations with leading SaaS platforms, ERP systems, logistics & warehousing systems, and B2B trade infrastructures. Your ultimate mission is to deeply understand the underlying business models of these ecosystem partners, tailor industry-specific payment solutions for various vertical scenarios and successfully bring these partners and their massive end-customer base into PingPong's global payment closed-loop ecosystem.
Core Responsibilities
- Strategic Partner Acquisition & Breakthrough: Lead and execute partnerships with core ecosystem service providers in SG/HK based on company strategy. Key breakthrough targets include but are not limited to:
- Enterprise TMS & FA&P Giants (New Core Focus): CTSI-Global, nVision Global, GoComet, Blue Yonder, Oracle OTM, etc.
- Order & Fulfillment Systems: Anchanto, Shipsy, Yojee, etc.
- B2B Procurement & Trade Networks: Eezee, Proxtera, GUUD, SGTraDex, etc.
- Leading Regional ERP & Accounting Software: Mekari, Deskera, HashMicro, Bukku, Logi-Sys, Fresa Technologies, etc.
- Scenario-Based Solution Design & Ecosystem Closed-Loop: Based on a profound understanding of clients' business logic and the complex supply chain finance of enterprise clients, deliver highly competitive, niche payment solutions. Examples include:
- Exclusive TMS & FA&P Scenarios: Deliver Mass Payouts via Local Rails to institutions like CTSI-Global to replace expensive and inefficient traditional SWIFT wire transfers, enabling instant, full-amount freight payouts; provide White-label Virtual Accounts for Shippers to help partners instantly open independent fund pools via API to isolate prepaid freight funds for multinational shippers; provide FX Risk Management / Forwards for large-volume shipping routes, helping shippers hedge against FX volatility over 1-3 month ocean freight billing cycles.
- SaaS / ERP / Logistics Scenarios: Enable order synchronization and closed-loop supplier payments within Order Management Systems (e.g., Anchanto); embed cross-border supply chain mass payouts within logistics systems (e.g., Shipsy/Yojee); build APAC Multi-Currency Rails within ERP and accounting systems (e.g., Mekari/Deskera) to bypass USD intermediary routing.
- Data Pipeline Integration: Drive the data closed-loop construction of "Order/Contract + Logistics/Fulfillment/Invoice Reconciliation + Payment/Settlement." Achieve end-to-end integration from transaction trigger and automated audit to automated reconciliation and fund disbursement via APIs, building a strong moat for customer acquisition and business retention.
- Commercial Negotiation & Relationship Management: Lead commercial terms negotiation and partnership agreement signing. Maintain ongoing high-level and cross-functional communications to ensure the long-term vitality and deep mutual trust of partnership projects.
What We Expect From You
- Experience: 5+ years of experience in B2B Business Development, Strategic Partnerships, or Key Account Sales, with strong familiarity with the Hong Kong and/or Singapore markets.
- Ecosystem Network (Crucial): Hands-on BD experience and direct C-level connections with the aforementioned high-priority targets (e.g., Anchanto, Eezee, Mekari, Shipsy, Logi-Sys) or similar Southeast Asian local SaaS, ERP, and logistics systems are highly preferred.
- Industry Insights & Problem-Solving: Deep understanding of cross-border payments, B2B collections/payouts, and FX settlement mechanisms. Strong commercial acumen to quickly deconstruct the business pain points of SaaS/ERP vendors and clearly articulate the incremental value of "PingPong Payments empowering SaaS."
- Competencies: Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills (able to bridge business language and API technical language), along with outstanding ice-breaking and executive-level commercial negotiation skills.
- Language & Location: Fluent in both English and Mandarin (written and spoken). Based in Singapore or Hong Kong.
Bonus Points
- Proven track record of leading the complete integration of a Payment Service Provider (PSP) or financial services into large ERPs, e-commerce middleware, or logistics control tower systems.
- Project experience handling payment/reconciliation integrations for mammoth traditional enterprise software (e.g., Blue Yonder, Oracle OTM) or modern AI-driven multi-modal TMS platforms (e.g., GoComet).
- Familiarity with local clearing networks (e.g., PayNow, FAST, cross-border local payout mechanisms).

Title: Founding Account Executive, Singapore
Description:
About Telnyx
Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network, to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.
We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.
Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.
The Role
We're building a local Enterprise Sales Pod in Singapore — one AE and one Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), working together to build a Telnyx enterprise business in Singapore and the broader ASEAN market. This is not a remote overlay on an existing territory. You will own a named-account list of 30–40 enterprise accounts in Singapore and the surrounding region, and your job is to turn those accounts into production Telnyx customers.
You'll work side-by-side with a dedicated FDE — not a demo resource, but a technical partner who designs architectures, builds POCs, and gets the first workload live. You win together. No throw-over-the-wall.
This is a founding role. You'll help define how Telnyx sells into enterprise accounts in Singapore and ASEAN, set the playbook, and build the references that the next wave of hires will follow.
The Pod Model
Enterprise AE — owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, gets in the room, owns commercial qualification and close, expands the account..
Forward Deployed Engineer — owns technical discovery, designs the architecture, builds the POC when gated, gets the first workload live, removes blockers and finds the next workload.
We sell the workload, not the SKU. Customers buy a production outcome — an AI contact center, a SOC/NOC agent, global communications, connected mobility, or enterprise inference — that runs on Telnyx primitives (voice, messaging, numbers, wireless, Voice AI, inference, agents, connectivity). You lead with the outcome conversation, not a product menu.
What You'll Do
- Own a territory of 30–40 named enterprise accounts in Singapore and ASEAN, narrowing to ~10 Tier 1 accounts worth $1M+ in annual potential
- Build executive relationships — get in the room with CIOs, CTOs, VP Engineering, and line-of-business owners
- Run the full sales cycle: prospect, qualify, design the commercial architecture with your FDE, negotiate, and close
- Sell programmable voice, messaging, Voice AI, wireless, and networking products to both technical and business audiences — from developer teams building on our APIs to c-suite stakeholders evaluating infrastructure partners
- Articulate Telnyx's differentiated value (private network, carrier-grade reliability, AI-native capabilities) and navigate objections against competitors like Twilio and Vonage
- Agree the commercial destination before any custom work begins — no free discovery or free development
- Maintain disciplined POC management: every POC has a named executive sponsor, written success criteria, production pricing discussed, a decision date, and a signed commercial document. POCs end in production or they end
- Expand the account — one workload becomes three, one $500K customer becomes a $2M customer
- Build local references and case studies in the Singapore and ASEAN markets
- Provide accurate pipeline reporting and forecasting — no surprises
What We're Looking For
- 5+ years of enterprise sales experience selling into Singapore and/or ASEAN — CPaaS, UCaaS, CCaaS, telecom, AI/ML, or similarly technical infrastructure
- Proven track record of consistently exceeding quota ($1M+ deals)
- Experience selling to both executive and technical buyers — you can hold your own in the boardroom and in the architecture review
- Hunter mentality — you build your own pipeline and thrive on outbound, in-person selling
- Strong consultative selling skills: can build a clear, compelling ROI story for both technical and business buyers
- Familiarity with sales methodologies (MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, etc.)
- Comfortable with modern sales tools (Salesforce, Outreach, Gong, etc.)
- Excellent written and verbal communication in English. You listen before you pitch.
- Willingness to travel across ASEAN — visiting customers in person is a core part of this role
Bonus Points For
- Fortune 500 or large enterprise new business sales experience in Singapore or ASEAN (DBS, OCBC, UOB, Singtel, Grab, Sea Group, Lazada, Shopee ecosystem)
- Complex sales cycles including RFPs, POCs, and competitive bake-offs
- C-Level selling experience — you can navigate procurement, security, and legal complexity across multiple ASEAN markets
- Understanding of SIP trunking, phone number provisioning, carrier networks, or AI/ML platforms
- Established relationships in the Singapore and ASEAN enterprise ecosystem
- Additional ASEAN language skills (Bahasa Indonesia, Thai, Vietnamese, Mandarin)

Title: Global Corporate Banking - Subsidiary Banking - Intra-Asia Greater China Desk, Managing Director
Description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
The senior Greater China Desk banker will play a key leadership role within the Intra-Asia Subsidiary Banking franchise, with primary responsibility for driving the growth of our Greater China corporate client business across Asia Pacific region.
The role will focus on deepening relationships with leading Greater China corporates as they expand their business, investments and financial activities across ASEAN and the broader Asia Pacific region. The successful candidate will combine strong senior-client connectivity in Greater China with a deep understanding of cross-border corporate banking, capital allocation, risk management and broader institutional banking product suite.
As a senior member of the Intra-Asia team, the individual will also help shape the strategic direction of the franchise, develop the Greater China coverage team and serve as a senior bench leader capable of taking the Intra-Asia Greater China business to the next level.
Key Responsibilities:
Lead the Greater China Intra-Asia growth strategy:
Drive sustainable revenue growth and returns from the Greater China portfolio. Maintain disciplined prioritization of capital and resources, with a strong focus on relationship returns, wallet capture and cross-product penetration.
Own and drive the strategy for Greater China-headquartered corporates operating and investing across Asia, with particularly focus on ASEAN and other priority platforms such as RTC, RHQ, IHQ in Hong Kong and Singapore corridors.
Identify structural growth themes and emerging client opportunities arising from Chinese corporates' regional and global expansion, including manufacturing relocation, supply-chain diversification, energy transition, digital infrastructure, technology, innovation economy and AI infrastructure sectors.
Translate these themes into actionable client strategies, prioritized prospect pipelines and measurable revenue opportunities.
Partner with Greater China and regional leadership to continuously refine the target client universe and resource allocation across the franchise.
Drive senior client coverage and origination:
Develop trusted relationships with CFOs, Treasurers and other senior decision-makers at leading Greater China corporates.
Lead strategic dialogue with clients around their cross-border banking and financing needs, including payments/cash management, liquidity, trade finance, market FX and rates, lending, capital markets and other strategic financing solutions.
Originate complex, multi-product and multi-country opportunities by connecting clients with the bank's capabilities across markets and products.
Act as a senior escalation and relationship point for strategically important Greater China-headquartered clients across Asia Pacific region. Facilitate senior connectivity between Greater China corporate decision-makers and the bank's regional and global leadership.
Build effective coverage models that combine strong headquarters relationships with high-quality subsidiary coverage in destination markets. Coordinate client strategy across countries and products to ensure a consistent, enterprise-wide approach to priority relationships.
Provide franchise leadership:
Serve as a senior member of the Intra-Asia leadership team and contribute to broader strategy and management of the franchise.
Provide leadership, coaching and sponsorship to Greater China Desks bankers and help develop the next generation of senior coverage talents.
Raise standards around client planning, origination, execution and senior stakeholder management.
Required Qualifications and Skillsets:
Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related discipline.
Minimum 13 years of relevant corporate banking experience, including coverage of China-linked clients and/or Greater China corridors.
Significant corporate banking or institutional client coverage experience, ideally including substantial Greater China and cross-border responsibilities. Mandarin proficiency (spoken and written), aligned to client coverage needs.
Strong understanding of transaction banking, markets, credit, trade finance, and the ability to connect these into cohesive client solutions. Proven relationship management and origination capability, including negotiation and long-term client stewardship.
Demonstrated experience coordinating complex, multi-product and multi-country opportunities with multiple stakeholders and tight execution timelines. Strong analytical skills and commercial judgment, with the ability to align opportunities to risk appetite and controls.
Excellent oral and written communication skills; ability to influence and coordinate across internal stakeholders and client teams. Strong organization skills with ability to manage multiple concurrent deliverables while maintaining execution quality and deadlines.
Preferred Qualifications and Skillsets:
Familiarity with multinational subsidiary treasury operating models, including cross-border liquidity structures, cash concentration, and intercompany flows.
Demonstrated leadership capability with a collaborative, team-oriented approach, effectively partnering across coverage and product stakeholders to drive shared objectives and business outcomes.
Track record of effective partnership with Risk, Compliance, and Credit stakeholders in a high-control environment, including issue escalation and remediation support.

Title: Global Partnerships Lead — Greater China, Hong Kong & Singapore
Description:
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet.
About The Team
The Global Partnerships team develops and manages the strategic relationships that enable Stripe’s payments, financial-services, and geographic-expansion ambitions. We work with local payment methods, financial institutions, card networks, banks, and other ecosystem partners to build the infrastructure, commercial models, and market access Stripe needs to serve users globally.
What you’ll do
We are hiring a Global Partnerships Lead based in Singapore to own Stripe’s Global Partnerships strategy and execution across Greater China, Hong Kong, and Singapore.
As the regional Global Partnerships Lead, you will own Stripe’s most important in-market relationships across local payment methods, financial partners, card networks, banks, and expansion partners. You will set the partnership strategy for the region; identify, prioritize, and develop new opportunities; lead complex negotiations; and ensure partnerships deliver durable commercial, product, and expansion outcomes for Stripe and our users.
This is a leadership role at the intersection of product strategy, market expansion, and commercial execution. You will serve as Stripe’s senior partnership representative for the region, build trusted executive relationships with ecosystem partners, and lead alignment across Product, Engineering, Go-to-Market, Legal, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Treasury, and Operations.
Responsibilities
- Act as Stripe’s Global Partnerships Lead for Greater China, Hong Kong, and Singapore, with end-to-end accountability for the regional partnership portfolio.
- Set and execute the regional strategy across local payment methods, financial partners, card networks, banks, and expansion partners.
- Lead Stripe’s senior external relationships in the region, building alignment and representing Stripe’s strategic priorities with partners.
- Own partnership opportunities from market assessment and strategy through negotiation, contracting, onboarding, launch, governance, and performance management.
- Lead regional expansion-partnership strategy and execution, coordinating the partnerships required to establish, operate, and scale Stripe in-market.
- Translate market intelligence, partner priorities, and ecosystem developments into clear recommendations for Stripe’s product and business strategy.
- Drive cross-functional decision-making on commercial, product, operational, regulatory, and technical dependencies related to regional partnerships.
- Establish and manage partner-performance metrics, including commercial outcomes, product adoption, operational health, and strategic progress.
- Anticipate and manage partnership risks, escalations, and trade-offs, ensuring sustained executive alignment internally and externally.
Who you are
We are looking for a commercially rigorous, strategically minded partnerships leader who is deeply familiar with the payments ecosystem in Greater China, Hong Kong, and Singapore. You are comfortable navigating complex stakeholder environments, structuring ambiguous opportunities, and independently driving high-impact outcomes.
Minimum Requirements
- 10+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, corporate development, strategy, financial services, or a related field.
- Significant experience in payments, fintech, ecommerce, banking, card networks, local payment methods, or adjacent financial-services sectors.
- Demonstrated experience leading complex, strategic commercial negotiations with senior external stakeholders.
- Deep knowledge of the payments and financial-partnership landscape in Greater China, Hong Kong, and/or Singapore, including relevant market dynamics and business models.
- Excellent written, verbal, and English executive communication skills and business-level Mandarin proficiency, written and spoken as this role would require working closely with our users and partners in the Greater China region.
- Strong ability to develop a clear point of view amid ambiguity, influence without authority, and drive decisions across complex internal and external stakeholder groups.
- Experience working closely with product and engineering organizations on partnerships with meaningful technical, operational, and regulatory dependencies.
- Ability to operate autonomously while balancing multiple high-priority initiatives and long-term strategic relationships.
Preferred Qualifications
- Experience owning a regional or multi-market portfolio of payments or financial-infrastructure partnerships.
- Experience supporting market-entry, expansion, licensing, or ecosystem-development initiatives.
- Existing senior relationships across banks, networks, payment-method providers, fintechs, or other relevant ecosystem partners in the region.
- Experience working in a fast-paced, global technology company with cross-functional product, commercial, and regulatory stakeholders.
In-office expectations
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
Pay and benefits
The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is SGD 253,800 - SGD 380,800. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.
Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.

Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Title: Graphic Designer
Description:
(Salary SGD2700-3700)
We are seeking a talented and detail-oriented Graphic Designer (Print & Production) to join our fun and dynamic Marketing & Communications team. In this role, you will be the visual guardian of our campus identity, translating academic excellence into compelling physical collateral—from student recruitment brochures and campus posters to event signage and decal across our campus.
You will manage the end-to-end design and print production process, collaborating closely with internal stakeholders, managing external agencies, and liaising with print vendors to deliver flawless, brand-aligned visual assets.
Key Responsibilities
1. Print Design & Campus Collaterals
• Conceptualize and produce high-quality print marketing materials, including course brochures, prospectuses, flyers, campus posters, large-format event backdrops, pull-up banners, and corporate stationery.
• Maintain consistency with the institution’s brand guidelines across all programs (Diploma to MBA level).
• Prepare production-ready files with strict adherence to print standards (CMYK color profiles, bleeds, margins, crops, resolutions, and dielines).
2. Pre-Press & Vendor Management
• Own the entire print production workflow from design output to print timelines.
• Review digital and physical hardcopy proofs, color draw-downs, and material samples to ensure print quality and finishing (e.g., embossing, spot UV, paper weight/texture).
3. Agency & External Partner Coordination
• Formulate clear, concise design briefs for external creative agencies and freelancers when offloading production or campaign-specific workloads.
• Review agency deliverables, provide actionable creative feedback, and ensure final artwork aligns with institutional standards and deadlines.
4. Bilingual Typography & Content Support
• Typeset, lay out, and proofread both English and Chinese marketing copy on printed materials, ensuring linguistic accuracy, cultural nuance, and typographic hierarchy.
• Liaise with Chinese-speaking team or vendors, or regional student recruitment representatives as needed.
5. Ad-Hoc Event & Student Photography (Secondary Task)
• Provide secondary photo coverage when the primary in-house photographer is unavailable.
• Capture high-quality photos for campus events (e.g., orientation, graduation, masterclasses) and student portraits.
• Perform basic post-processing and photo retouching in Adobe Photoshop / Lightroom or any other tools.

• Experience: Minimum 3+ years of professional graphic design experience, with a solid focus on print production and brand collateral. Experience in the education or corporate sector is an advantage.
• Technical Mastery:
o Expert proficiency in Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop.

o Strong technical understanding of prepress processes, dyeline creation, paper stock selection, and print finishes.

o Bilingual fluency in English and Chinese (spoken and written) to typeset, edit, and proofread Chinese collateral and communicate with Chinese-speaking partners.
• Photography Skills:
o Fundamental hands-on experience handling DSLR/Mirrorless camera gear for event and portrait photography.
• Soft Skills:
o Strong interpersonal and communication skills to interface with academic heads, external vendors, and creative agencies.
o Highly organized, proactive, and capable of prioritizing multiple project deadlines simultaneously.
o Attention to detail.

Title: GTM Partnerships Manager (Corp Sec & Accounting Firms), SME & Growth
Description:
About Airwallex
Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.
We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.
We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.
About the team
The GTM Partnerships team at Airwallex is focused on building and scaling partnerships that accelerate customer acquisition, deepen ecosystem reach, and unlock long-term growth. In Singapore, this role will support our SME & Growth segment by owning a curated, high-value portfolio of corporate secretarial and accounting firm partners.
Success in this role comes primarily from deep, hands-on management of your existing book, complemented by growing share of wallet with those partners and hunting new high-priority partners to fill any gaps.
What you'll do
As the GTM Partnerships Manager (Priority), you will own a curated portfolio of roughly 50–60 corporate secretarial and accounting firm partners in Singapore. The majority of your time will go toward managing and growing this existing book — deepening relationships, increasing share of wallet, and preventing churn — with the remainder spent proactively hunting new high-potential partners to fill any gaps in your portfolio.
This role is based in Singapore.

At MEXC, we believe the best platforms are built through constant improvement and open collaboration. Title: Member Services Administrator - Events & Travel
Description:
This position is being created in response to a temporary increase in activity resulting from a change in the regional operating model and the redistribution of responsibilities within the Members Services function.
To support this transition and maintain a high level of service across Events and Member travel activities, FICOFI is recruiting a Members Services Administrative Support – Events & Travel on a fixed-term basis until 30 June 2027.
Although the requirement is temporary, the assignment offers broad exposure to Members Services, events, travel and cross-functional operational coordination within an international environment
The Members Services Administrative Coordinator – Events & Travel is part of the Members Services Managers (MSM) team and provides administrative and coordination support to the Members Services team globally, with a primary focus on Asia-Pacific and France. The position supports the commercial teams – Le Club FICOFI® Advisors (LCFA) – through the Members Services organization and focuses on the administrative management of Member events, travel arrangements, hospitality bookings, participant follow-up and related invoicing activities.
The role acts as an internal concierge-style support for the Members Services team across locations. It requires a hands-on and service-oriented approach, with the confidence to contact hotels, restaurants, partners, Members’ assistants and internal teams directly, including by phone, to clarify information, resolve issues and secure timely solutions.
*KEY RESPONSIBLITIES*
*Administrative support for Member events:*
* Coordinate invitation follow-up and maintain accurate RSVP and attendance information in Salesforce or any successor tool.
* Proactively follow up with MSMs, LCFAs, Members or their assistants to collect guest names, dietary requirements, hotel details and any information required for the event.
* Prepare and update guest lists, attendance trackers (dinners and side activities), table plans and other event administration documents.
* Prepare programmes and communications with practical information to participants and keep clear records of communications and confirmations.
* Manage programme changes and circulate daily or ad hoc updates to relevant stakeholders and participants.
*Travel, hospitality and booking coordination:*
* Manage hotel bookings with partners, including rooming lists follow-up, confirmations, changes, cancellations and special requests.
* Coordinate restaurant bookings and hospitality arrangements linked to Member events, trips and programmes.
* Arrange and follow up on side activities, transfers and other travel-related services with providers and participants.
* Handle last-minute changes calmly and proactively, escalating only when a decision, exception or approval is required.
*Invoicing, payment and administrative control:*
* Prepare, consolidate and check the information required for event and trip invoicing
* Coordinate invoicing follow-up for participation fees, side activities and extra guests, and maintain visibility on pending items.
* Follow up on deposits, payments, supporting documents and discrepancies with MSMs.
* Ensure event references, participant numbers, pricing information and supporting documentation are accurate and traceable.
* Maintain orderly digital files and trackers so that the status of each booking, payment and open point can be understood quickly.
*Internal coordination and service delivery:*
* Work closely with MSMs, LCFAs, Event and Finance Teams to ensure smooth administrative delivery before, during and after events.
* Provide regular and concise status updates, highlighting missing information, deadlines, risks and actions required.
* Take ownership of follow-up: contact the right person, obtain the answer and close the loop rather than simply forwarding a request.
*KEY DELIVERABLES:*
* Accurate and up-to-date RSVP, guest, dietary, hotel and activity trackers.
* Confirmed and documented hotel, restaurant, transfer and side-activity bookings.
* Complete invoicing instructions and reliable payment follow-up.
* Clear programme communications and controlled management of changes.
* Well-maintained event files, checklists and post-event administrative closure.
* Proactive reporting on deadlines, missing inputs, risks and unresolved items.
_It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties or skills required. Responsibilities may evolve according to business needs, regional activity and the development of the function during the fixed-term assignment ending on 30 June 2027._

*Professional Experience*: Approximately 2–5 years in administrative coordination, events, travel, hospitality, executive assistance, customer service or another fast-moving service environment. A varied or non-linear career path may be considered where the candidate demonstrates strong potential.
*Proactivity and Resourcefulness*: Willing to take initiative, make direct contact and find practical solutions to move matters forward.
*Organization and Attention to Detail*: Able to manage multiple events, deadlines, bookings and changing priorities with accuracy.
*Service Orientation and Relationship Skills*: Discreet, thoughtful and reliable when supporting internal teams, Members, assistants and external partners.
*Communication*: Confident and courteous in writing, by phone and in person with a wide range of stakeholders.
*Problem-Solving:* Calm under pressure, solution-oriented and able to follow issues through to resolution.
*Tools: *Good command of Microsoft Office and confidence learning CRM, ERP, event and collaboration tools.
* *Language Proficiency: *Fluent professional English and Mandarin, written and spoken, to communicate with the internal and external stakeholders.

The position supports the commercial teams – Le Club FICOFI® Advisors (LCFA) – through the Members Services organization and focuses on the administrative management of Member events, travel arrangements, hospitality bookings, participant follow-up and related invoicing activities.
The role acts as an internal concierge-style support for the Members Services team across locations. It requires a hands-on and service-oriented approach, with the confidence to contact hotels, restaurants, partners, Members’ assistants and internal teams directly, including by phone, to clarify information, resolve issues and secure timely solutions.
KEY RESPONSIBLITIES
Administrative support for Member events:
- Coordinate invitation follow-up and maintain accurate RSVP and attendance information in Salesforce or any successor tool.
- Proactively follow up with MSMs, LCFAs, Members or their assistants to collect guest names, dietary requirements, hotel details and any information required for the event.
- Prepare and update guest lists, attendance trackers (dinners and side activities), table plans and other event administration documents.
- Prepare programmes and communications with practical information to participants and keep clear records of communications and confirmations.
- Manage programme changes and circulate daily or ad hoc updates to relevant stakeholders and participants.
Travel, hospitality and booking coordination:
- Manage hotel bookings with partners, including rooming lists follow-up, confirmations, changes, cancellations and special requests.
- Coordinate restaurant bookings and hospitality arrangements linked to Member events, trips and programmes.
- Arrange and follow up on side activities, transfers and other travel-related services with providers and participants.
- Handle last-minute changes calmly and proactively, escalating only when a decision, exception or approval is required.
Invoicing, payment and administrative control:
- Prepare, consolidate and check the information required for event and trip invoicing
- Coordinate invoicing follow-up for participation fees, side activities and extra guests, and maintain visibility on pending items.
- Follow up on deposits, payments, supporting documents and discrepancies with MSMs.
- Ensure event references, participant numbers, pricing information and supporting documentation are accurate and traceable.
- Maintain orderly digital files and trackers so that the status of each booking, payment and open point can be understood quickly.
Internal coordination and service delivery:
- Work closely with MSMs, LCFAs, Event and Finance Teams to ensure smooth administrative delivery before, during and after events.
- Provide regular and concise status updates, highlighting missing information, deadlines, risks and actions required.
- Take ownership of follow-up: contact the right person, obtain the answer and close the loop rather than simply forwarding a request.
KEY DELIVERABLES:
- Accurate and up-to-date RSVP, guest, dietary, hotel and activity trackers.
- Confirmed and documented hotel, restaurant, transfer and side-activity bookings.
- Complete invoicing instructions and reliable payment follow-up.
- Clear programme communications and controlled management of changes.
- Well-maintained event files, checklists and post-event administrative closure.
- Proactive reporting on deadlines, missing inputs, risks and unresolved items.

Title: Product Specialist, Localisation (1-year contract), EMTM Product & Tech
Description:
About Us
SPH Media’s mission is to be the trusted source of news and lifestyle content in Singapore and Asia.
One of our core purposes is to produce credible, balanced, and objective news and analysis, always with a view to uphold the public good and fostering an informed, engaged citizenry.
We welcome talented individuals to join us and grow a career in a vibrant and collaborative environment built around a culture of respect and inclusivity.
As an employer, we are committed to rewarding our people fairly and developing them in their careers.
About the Role
The Straits Times is scaling a translation feature that lets readers consume our journalism in Chinese. Improving it takes someone who can read the output like an editor and think about it like a product person.
This is an early-career product role, and an unusually direct way into product work. You bring the language judgement — native-level Chinese and a real feel for how Singapore news reads. You will work closely with the Senior Product Manager, who will work with you week to week, and you will be in the room for the decisions rather than downstream of them.
Expect to spend real time on the daily review queue. That work is not a chore on the side — it is where the signal comes from, and it is what will make you the person on the team who understands this product best.
What You Will Do
- Run the daily quality gate. Review flagged English-to-Chinese articles, resolve critical inaccuracies to ST’s editorial standard, and republish within turnaround targets. This is the product’s last mile and your main source of insight into how and where the system fails.
- Iterate on the AI. Analyse recurring error patterns from the daily queue and translate those insights into actionable prompt improvements. You will directly feed this data back into the AI models to fix translation flaws.
- Build the glossary. Develop and maintain a versioned glossary of Chinese terms, political titles and Singapore-specific idioms. It is not a style document — it feeds into how the system generates output, so accuracy is yours to guard.
- Report on feature performance. Track and report the quality metrics — pass rate, intervention rate, reader feedback, turnaround time — and flag movements that need attention.
- Support experiments and releases. Help the PM design comparisons of prompt variants, model versions and glossary updates against a fixed evaluation set. Run the scoring, write up what you found, and recommend whether it should ship.
What You Will Learn
You will learn to improve AI models by logging and analysing errors from daily translation tasks. You'll work within our sprint cycles to help refine the product, gaining practical experience in AI feedback loops and quality management, with the opportunity to deliver measurable improvements to a live consumer feature that impacts readers.
What We Are Looking For
- Native-level written Chinese and professional fluency in English, with a deep grasp of Singaporean current affairs and localised terminology — enough to make defensible calls on nuance, not just spot errors. This is the non-negotiable part.
- 1–3 years of full-time experience in translation, localisation, copyediting, journalism, content operations, or a product or operations role. Fresh graduates with strong relevant internships are welcome to apply.
- Ability to work at pace in a daily news environment, and comfort with ambiguity in a feature that is still taking shape.
Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a short exercise combining translation judgement with error analysis.

Title: Sales Account Manager — Entry-Level / Hunter Role (AI Infrastructure)
Description:
No prior sales or IT industry experience required. Fresh graduates and career switchers are welcome to apply.
About the Role
We are looking for a motivated, people-oriented
Sales Account Manager
to develop new business opportunities in enterprise IT infrastructure, including servers, storage, networking, GPU computing, AI infrastructure and data centre solutions.
This is a
hunter role
, with a primary focus on proactively identifying potential customers, initiating conversations, securing meetings and converting opportunities into sales. You should be comfortable reaching out to people you have not met, handling rejection professionally and following up consistently—not simply waiting for incoming enquiries.
We value
high emotional intelligence (EQ), strong communication skills, resilience and a willingness to learn
over previous experience. You do not need to be a technical expert when you join, but you must be curious about technology and committed to building your product knowledge. You will work closely with sales colleagues, presales engineers and vendor partners to understand customer needs and develop suitable proposals.
What Success Looks Like
Success in this role is not determined by your previous sales or IT experience. We are looking for someone who is willing to learn, take initiative and consistently put in the effort required to develop new business.
You will be expected to:
Proactively reach out to potential customers rather than wait for incoming enquiries.
Consistently prospect, follow up and work towards securing customer meetings and new opportunities.
Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.
Develop your knowledge of our products, solutions and the enterprise IT industry over time.
Build strong relationships with customers, vendors and internal teams.
Take ownership of your opportunities and follow through on commitments.
Progressively work towards and achieve agreed sales revenue and gross profit targets.
Key Responsibilities
New Business Development & Prospecting
Proactively identify and approach potential customers across enterprise, government, education and other business sectors.
Generate new opportunities through cold calling, email outreach, networking, events and other prospecting activities.
Secure customer meetings, understand purchasing needs and qualify potential opportunities.
Build a healthy sales pipeline through consistent outreach and follow-up, working towards agreed sales activity, revenue and gross profit targets.
Customer Engagement & Relationship Building
Build trust by listening carefully, asking relevant questions and understanding customer priorities.
Adapt your communication style to different personalities and stakeholders, including IT teams, procurement personnel and business decision-makers.
Handle objections, difficult conversations and rejection with empathy, professionalism and persistence.
Develop long-term relationships with customers you acquire and identify opportunities for repeat business.
Sales & Commercial Management
Progress opportunities from initial contact through requirements gathering, quotation, negotiation, order confirmation and post-sales handover, with guidance where needed.
Prepare accurate quotations and proposals in coordination with internal teams.
Follow up on open opportunities, maintain accurate CRM records and provide realistic sales forecasts.
Work within company pricing and approval guidelines to protect margins, and assist with payment follow-up when required.
Solution Selling & Product Learning
Develop an understanding of enterprise servers, storage, networking, AI and GPU computing, and related infrastructure solutions.
Learn to identify customer business needs and explain the value of proposed solutions rather than competing on price alone.
Work with presales engineers and technical consultants to address technical requirements and prepare suitable solutions.
Participate in customer presentations and product discussions, seeking technical support whenever necessary.
Tender & Proposal Coordination
Assist with government, education and enterprise tender submissions, with guidance from experienced colleagues.
Coordinate customer requirements, pricing, supporting documents and submission deadlines with internal teams, vendors and distributors.
Help ensure proposals are complete, accurate and submitted on time.
Learn procurement processes and progressively take greater ownership of tender and proposal activities.
Vendor & Internal Collaboration
Build productive working relationships with vendors, distributors and internal teams.
Coordinate pricing requests, product availability, deal registrations and customer engagements.
Ensure clear communication and a smooth handover to technical and operations teams after a sale.
Requirements
Essential Qualities & Skills
High emotional intelligence (EQ):
Able to listen actively, recognise customer concerns, adapt to different personalities and respond constructively under pressure.
English proficiency is mandatory:
Strong spoken and written English for customer conversations, presentations, emails and proposals.
Hunter mindset:
Willing to initiate contact, make cold calls, ask for meetings and actively pursue new business.
Resilience and persistence:
Able to handle rejection without becoming discouraged and follow up professionally without being overly pushy.
Willingness to learn:

Title: Senior Account Executive, Mid Market, GCR (Singapore)
Description:
About The Role
Fluency in Mandarin and English required.
About The Role
We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented Account Executive to drive DTC commerce growth in GCR. In this role, you will be responsible for building strong relationships with new clients and delivering tailored solutions that meet the unique needs of businesses in the region. You will showcase how high-growth, high-volume DTC merchants can leverage Shopify to accelerate their business growth while consulting on e-commerce technology stacks and business objectives. As a trusted advisor and ambassador for Shopify, you will engage with prospects, merchants, and partners both remotely and on-site, including community events. You will collaborate closely with large Shopify prospects, providing valuable insights and feedback to our Product and Engineering teams, and conduct high-level, solutions-focused discussions with merchants, their business and technical teams. Thriving in a fast-paced team environment, you will play a crucial role in supporting diverse merchants and driving long-term success with the Shopify platform.
Key Responsibilities:
- Engage with prospects and merchants to understand their unique needs and challenges, and provide them with tailored commerce solutions
- Develop and execute a strategic sales plan to achieve revenue targets and grow Shopify usage in GCR markets.
- Collaborate closely with solution engineers as part of a dynamic duo and coordinate with partner teams across multiple channels.
- Manage a comprehensive sales cycle from initial contact through to contract negotiations, maintaining a pipeline of opportunities
- Act as an advocate and trusted advisor for merchants, using your insights and expertise to inform and influence product team decisions.
- Engage with industry stakeholders to gather market insights and strengthen Shopify's ecosystem partnerships.
- Serve as a proactive point of contact for clients, ensuring an exceptional service experience
- Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to enhance client engagements and outcomes
- Keep abreast of the latest product features, industry trends, and market dynamics to provide the best possible advice and service to merchants
- Stay informed about industry trends, competitor activities, and emerging technologies to provide valuable insights to clients.

- Proven experience in sales, preferably in the digital commerce or technology sector
- Strong understanding of the GCR market and its unique business landscape. E-commerce Selling experience to the GCR market is a must.
- Proven track record of overattaining sales quota in consecutive years.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills — capable of building trusting relationships and effectively conveying the value of Shopify’s offerings
- Proven ability to manage detailed sales cycles and succeed in a competitive environment
- Adept at high-volume sales activities and capable of maintaining focus and efficiency in fast-paced settings
- Expertise in cross border commerce, Shopify, and regional-specific e-commerce applications, ecosystems, and integrations
- Analytical mindset with the ability to leverage data to drive decision-making and strategy.
- Experience with CRM tools (for example: Salesforce), and familiarity with sales engagement platforms preferred
- Self-motivated and driven by results, with the tenacity to pursue leads and close deals
- A commitment to experimentation, continuous learning, and educating our enterprise customers, partner agencies, and internal teams
- Ability to multitask, prioritize responsibilities, and thrive on change
- Knowledgeable in targeting and engaging potential clients through strategic questioning and active listening
- A genuine concern for the success of our stakeholders and customers
- Fluency in Mandarin and English is strongly preferred. Cantonese or additional regional language capability is a plus, depending on market coverage.

What We’re Looking For In Salespeople
- Builder mindset: You don’t just follow a playbook—you improve it. You test, iterate, document, and scale what works.

- Execution intensity: You bring pace, resilience, competitiveness, and the ability to take a hit and keep going.
- High agency: You default to action, take ownership, and don’t wait to be told.
- Thrive in ambiguity + change: You stay effective when priorities shift, products evolve, and you’re building while selling.
