Shopify rewards builders with high agency. You’ll have real autonomy, high standards, and a fast pace. We iterate, we challenge each other, and we expect you to take ownership of outcomes—not wait for perfect conditions. If you want comfort and certainty, this won’t fit. If you want responsibility and growth, it will.

Opportunity is not evenly distributed. Shopify puts independence within reach for anyone with a dream to start a business. We propel entrepreneurs and enterprises to scale the heights of their potential. Title: Senior Assistant Director, Chinese Executive Education Partnerships
Description:
Nanyang Business School (NBS), Nanyang Technological University (NTU), is seeking a Senior Assistant Director (Business Development – Joint Executive Education) to support the growth of its executive education portfolio through collaborative programmes with partner universities.
Based within the ASEAN & China Programmes Office, this role focuses on co‑developing and delivering joint executive education programmes with selected partner institutions, primarily in China and selected international markets. The role complements existing open‑enrolment executive education activities by strengthening NBS’ institution‑to‑institution partnerships.
Key Responsibilities Include, But Not Limited To The Following
Joint Executive Education Programme Development (Partner Universities)
- Drive the origination, assessment, and development of joint executive education programme opportunities with partner universities, primarily in China.
- Lead collaboration with academic directors and faculty from NTU and partner institutions to define joint programme themes, target audiences, and delivery formats that align academic excellence with market demand.
- Lead engagement with partner universities on programme structuring, positioning, branding, and delivery arrangements to ensure alignment of academic, commercial, and institutional objectives.
Partner University Relationship Management
- Serve as the primary working‑level contact for designated partner universities on joint EE initiatives.
- Maintain regular engagement to ensure alignment on programme objectives, timelines, and expectations.
- Facilitate resolution of operational or coordination issues during programme development and delivery.
Commercial Structuring and Financial Viability of Joint Programmes
- Lead the commercial structuring of joint executive education programmes, including pricing strategy, cost-sharing models, and revenue frameworks, in alignment with ACP leadership and institutional objectives.
- Drive financial viability assessments for joint programmes, working with finance and operations teams to ensure sustainable and scalable programme delivery models that meet revenue targets.
- Oversee financial and participation performance of joint programmes, identifying optimisation opportunities and recommending strategic adjustments to improve commercial outcomes.
Programme Design Input and Market Relevance
- Shape the design and positioning of joint executive education programmes by translating market intelligence, client needs, and industry trends into strategic curriculum direction.
- Lead engagement with academic directors to ensure joint executive education programmes reflect emerging global themes, including internationalisation, leadership development, and geopolitical dynamics.
- Drive continuous curriculum refinement by synthesising participant and partner feedback into actionable programme enhancements that strengthen market relevance and differentiation.
Internal Collaboration and Team Contribution
- Lead cross-functional coordination across academic directors, marketing, finance, operations, and programme teams to ensure effective development and delivery of joint executive education programmes.
- Provide strategic pipeline analysis and partner intelligence to ACP leadership to inform portfolio planning, prioritisation, and growth strategy.
- Lead capability development by codifying and disseminating best practices in partnership-based executive education programme development across teams.
Key Competencies And Qualification Requirements
- Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree preferred.
- Minimum 10 years of relevant professional experience in business development, executive education, programme development, partnerships, stakeholder engagement, or professional services roles.
- Strong understanding of executive education and senior leadership development, with the ability to translate market and client needs into programme and partnership strategies.
- Proven experience in university-to-university partnerships, including the development and management of joint or co-branded executive education programmes.
- Strong knowledge of China’s business environment and cross-border executive contexts, with demonstrated ability to apply this understanding to partnership development and programme positioning.
- Strong commercial acumen, including experience in pricing strategy, cost structure evaluation, and assessment of financial viability for executive education programmes.
- Demonstrated track record in developing and managing strategic partnerships, engaging senior external stakeholders, and coordinating complex multi-party initiatives.
- Strong analytical, organisational, and programme management capability, with experience managing multiple concurrent strategic initiatives in complex environments.
- Excellent stakeholder management, influencing, and communication skills, with the ability to engage credibly with senior executives and institutional partners.
- Bilingual proficiency in English and Chinese (spoken and written) due to need to liaise frequently with international partners and handle Chinese business documents
- Proficient in business productivity and collaboration tools (e.g. Word, Excel, presentation software, email, and digital collaboration platforms), applied in a complex stakeholder environment.
- Demonstrates strong professional maturity, adaptability, and sound judgement, with the ability to operate independently across diverse institutional and cultural contexts.
- Willingness to undertake domestic and international travel as required.

Title: Senior Associate/Manager, Private Equity Fund
Description:
Company Overview
CGS International Securities Pte. Ltd. (CGS International) is an award-winning and market leading integrated financial services provider, ranked among the top securities houses in Asia.
CGS International taps on our wealth of global and ASEAN insights to offer equities trading, leveraged products, wealth management, investment banking, equities research, Shariah-compliant financing, fixed income, currency and commodities, structured products and prime brokerage services in over 15 countries and regions.
Along with its parent organisation China Galaxy Securities, a leading securities house in China, CGS International is trusted by more than 15 million customers globally.
Job Simmary
We are seeking a commercially driven
Senior Associate to Manager, Private Equity Fund
to join our Asset Management team. The incumbent will play a key role in originating, evaluating, executing, and managing private equity investments across Southeast Asia.
The successful candidate will be responsible for leading investment transactions, conducting comprehensive due diligence, collaborating with portfolio company management teams to drive value creation, and supporting successful exit strategies. Corporate title, grade and the level of deal leadership will be commensurate with the successful candidate’s experience. This role requires strong financial acumen, investment judgment, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to operate effectively in a dynamic investment environment.
Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities
Investment Origination and Execution
Source and evaluate investment opportunities across selected sectors and markets within Southeast Asia.
Build and maintain relationships with investment banks, corporate advisors, entrepreneurs, industry experts, and strategic partners to generate proprietary deal flow.
Lead transaction execution, including valuation analysis, financial modelling, deal structuring, negotiations, documentation, and closing.
Prepare investment papers and recommendations for presentation to the Investment Committee.
Due Diligence and Investment Analysis
Conduct detailed financial, commercial, operational, and strategic due diligence on prospective investments.
Develop financial models and investment valuation analyses to assess potential returns, risks, and value creation opportunities.
Evaluate industry trends, competitive dynamics, regulatory considerations, and key investment risks.
Coordinate and manage external advisors, including legal, financial, tax, and technical consultants.

Location: Singapore
Permanent

Job Purpose:
To lead, coach and manage a team of Health Insurance Specialists responsible for achieving Bupa Global's sales targets through its partnership with Standard Chartered Bank in Singapore.
The role works closely with Standard Chartered Relationship Managers and Insurance Specialists to build referral opportunities, identify eligible customers and support effective sales engagement. The Senior Health Insurance Specialist and the team engage directly with referred customers to understand their needs, explain the proposition, recommend appropriate cover and sell Bupa Global's individual international private medical insurance plans designed exclusively for the bank's priority private and affluent customers.
How you'll help us make health happen:
Own delivery of the Singapore Standard Chartered sales target, translating annual objectives into clear team plans, activity expectations and individual performance goals.
Recruit, onboard, lead, coach and develop a high-performing team of Health Insurance Specialists, setting clear expectations and fostering a customer-focused, compliant and accountable sales culture.
Conduct regular one-to-one meetings, coaching sessions and formal performance reviews, managing performance in line with Bupa's people policies and applicable training and competency requirements.
Manage the team's sales pipeline, referral activity, conversion, productivity and service levels; maintain accurate forecasts and provide timely, insightful sales and performance reporting.
Lead and support direct, needs-based customer sales conversations, particularly for complex or high-value cases, ensuring recommendations are appropriate, clearly explained and accurately documented.
Build strong working relationships with Standard Chartered Relationship Managers and Insurance Specialists to generate qualified referrals, improve customer engagement and increase conversion while maintaining clear roles and responsibilities in the sales process.
Oversee the end-to-end customer journey from referral, initial contact and fact-finding through quotation, application, underwriting, policy issuance and follow-up, working with internal teams to resolve issues promptly.
Ensure the team protects customer personal and medical information and complies with applicable Singapore data-protection requirements, Bupa policies and Standard Chartered information-handling requirements.
Maintain full compliance with applicable Singapore insurance licensing, conduct, disclosure, record-keeping and continuing competency requirements, and ensure consistently fair customer outcomes.
Collaborate closely with Bupa Global Sales Support, Underwriting, Operations, Compliance, Marketing and other relevant teams to progress cases, remove operational barriers and deliver a seamless customer and partner experience.
Assist the Head of Channel Sales on project-related work, including management updates, sales reporting and forecasting, sales initiatives and programmes, and sales engagement plans. Track actions, assess results and support effective implementation across the channel.
Key Skills/Qualifications needed for this role:
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in business, finance, health insurance, or a related field (required).
Hold, or be able to obtain before appointment, all licences, certifications and competency requirements applicable to the sale of the relevant insurance products in Singapore.
Maintain all required continuing professional development, product knowledge and training and competency standards.
Fluency in English is essential; proficiency in Mandarin or another language relevant to Standard Chartered's Singapore customer base is advantageous.
Customer Centricity - Understands the needs of priority private and affluent customers and ensures the team delivers suitable solutions and consistently high-quality outcomes.
Product and Regulatory Knowledge - Good understanding of individual IPMI, underwriting considerations, product benefits, exclusions and the applicable sales and conduct framework.
Leadership and Communication - Sets clear direction, coaches effectively and communicates persuasively with customers, colleagues and partner stakeholders across different cultural contexts.
Sales Leadership and Execution - Translates targets into account plans and team activity, manages pipelines and forecasts, and applies consultative selling techniques to convert quality referrals into sustainable sales.
Partnership and Stakeholder Management - Builds trusted relationships with Standard Chartered and Bupa stakeholders, coordinates shared priorities and resolves issues constructively.
Delivery and Adaptability - Manages competing priorities, delivers projects and sales initiatives at pace, and adapts effectively within a dynamic bank-
Why Bupa?
Bupa Global is the international health insurance division of Bupa. We provide customers who want premium international coverage with products and services to access the healthcare they need anytime, around the world, whether at home or when studying, living, travelling or working abroad.
Bupa Global has offices around the world including London and Brighton (UK), Dublin (Europe), Miami (USA), Dubai (UAE, in partnership with Sukoon), Egypt and Hong Kong (China) as well as regional offices in mainland Singapore, the Dominican Republic, Bolivia, Panama, Guatemala and Ecuador.

At UKi Media & Events, we are dedicated to nurturing professional growth through extensive training, mentoring, and transparent career advancement paths. Our culture is rooted in excellence, innovation, and continuous learning, fostered within an inclusive and collaborative environment that values diversity.

Represent the brand by travelling to meet customers, prospects, and event partners.

Deliver weekly/monthly performance reports, including progress against targets and key actions taken.

Sales
About the role
Fluency in Mandarin required.
About the role
Shopify's Solutions Engineers are trusted technical advisors who help merchants design and adopt the right commerce solutions. You'll blend technical depth, commercial awareness, and clear communication to guide merchants through complex, multi-stakeholder decisions.
As a Senior Solutions Engineer on the ASIA team, you'll support merchants across the Greater China Region and South East Asia. The team operates with a high degree of self-sufficiency. Time zones, market complexity, and regional scale mean you'll need to be hands-on, collaborative, and comfortable using AI as a daily multiplier.
Key Responsibilities
Run deep discovery with merchants and partners, mapping workflows, systems, constraints, risks, and success metrics to find the real problem behind stated requirements.
Design practical solution architectures across Shopify's commerce stack and adjacent systems (ERP, OMS, payments, integrations), including migration paths from legacy platforms.
Make it real through tailored demos, prototypes, diagrams, workshops, and technical narratives that connect Shopify capabilities to merchant-specific outcomes.
Partner cross-functionally with Account Executives, Solution Partners, Product, Launch, and CSM teams to shape opportunity strategy, remove blockers, and translate field insights back into the business.
Use AI to accelerate your work, from merchant research and transcript synthesis to demo planning and technical validation, while building reusable tools, prompts, and workflows that create leverage for the team.
Apply judgment on when to go deep, when to simplify, when to bring in specialists, and when to challenge assumptions.
The role includes merchant-facing activities, including remote and on-site engagements with merchants and supporting community events. Title: Specialist Solutions Architect, Radar (APAC)
Description:
Specialist Solutions Architect, Radar (Fraud)
Who We Are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies-from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups-use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
About The Team
Specialist Solutions Architects (SSA) are domain experts aligned to specific Stripe solutions and customer buying centers. We have in-depth knowledge of specific solution offerings and a deep understanding of customer challenges. We align with specialist product sellers on deals, advise the broader pre-sales team on complex opportunities, support pipeline development and revenue attainment, serve as an advisor on go-to-market sales plays, and provide critical insights to our product and engineering teams.
Stripe Radar is Stripe's fully integrated fraud and risk management platform. The Radar team's mission is to evolve from a best-in-class payment fraud product into a unified risk intelligence platform that protects businesses from all forms of financial loss-from sophisticated payment fraud and account takeovers to first-party misuse and policy abuse. With Radar, businesses can confidently navigate the evolving fraud landscape, accept more good revenue, and focus on growth.
What You'll Do
You will collaborate closely with sales and pre-sales teams to drive pipeline and revenue targets, while also educating the product and engineering teams on market trends and strongly influencing the product roadmap. You will develop deep relationships with senior customer business leaders and grow Stripe's solution offerings with new and existing customers. As a subject matter expert, you will scale the broader organization by creating reusable assets and coaching others on complex, high-value opportunities. You will serve as the domain and product expert to our users and GTM team for Stripe Radar globally.
Responsibilities
Act as a subject matter expert on Stripe's Radar product suite to accelerate opportunities globally
Demonstrate a deep understanding of trends in the fraud and risk management ecosystem, including AI-powered detection, processor-agnostic architectures, and the shift from payment fraud to holistic business risk (policy abuse, account takeover, first-party misuse)
Develop expertise with the functional and architectural patterns for deploying advanced fraud systems, including the lifecycle of rule management, ML model tuning, and manual review optimization
Understand the ecosystem of risk and identity integrations (device fingerprinting, identity verification, bot mitigation, case management) Stripe must support for users to be successful
Define, share, and learn best practices and reusable assets with the broader GTM organization to enhance the quality and efficiency of the team
Create reference architectures to uplevel the team and refine reference solutions based on product enhancements and customer feedback
Partner closely with the Radar product sales team on Stripe's largest and most complex Radar opportunities, leading solution strategy and owning key customer relationships
Partner closely with the Radar product team to get early exposure to new products and features
Serve as a "Voice of the Customer" internally to drive product and feature request prioritization, providing actionable insights on the competitive landscape and emerging fraud vectors
Act as an escalation point to drive complex technical issues to resolution with Stripe's engineering team
Stay current on competitive analysis and market differentiation
Support marketing events including executive briefings, conferences, user groups, and trade shows
Who You Are
We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
Minimum Requirements
7+ years of experience in a pre-sales, technical consulting, product, or risk strategy role focused on e-commerce fraud prevention, risk management, or trust and safety
Deep working knowledge of the fraud and risk ecosystem, including payment fraud (CNP), account takeover (ATO), first-party misuse (friendly fraud), and policy/content abuse
Demonstrated knowledge of risk management architectures, including the role of rules engines, machine learning models, and manual review queues in fraud decisioning
Strong knowledge of the signals and data used in fraud detection: device/IP data, behavioral biometrics, identity verification, and graph-based analysis
Strong knowledge of software engineering and architecture patterns, with the ability to understand how a wide variety of technologies and systems interact
Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, comfortable explaining complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
A proven ability to build strong collaborative working relationships with business partners
Ability to deal effectively with ambiguity and thrive in an unstructured, fast-moving environment
Strong proficiency in English and Mandarin and the position would require you to communicate with customers based in the Greater China region.

Experience with processor-agnostic fraud solutions and multi-processor payment environments
Experience with risk management for platforms/marketplaces, subscription services, and digital goods

Company: INTERNATIONAL FUTURE FUELS WEEK PTE. LTD.
Title: Sponsorship & Exhibition Sales Manager, International Future Fuels Week (IFFW)
Description:
About the organisation
IFFW is an exhibitions and media group serving the future fuels sector across aviation, maritime and land transport. Its flagship event, International Future Fuels Week, is a B2B conference and exhibition. The inaugural edition will take place from 14 to 17 June 2027 at Sands Expo & Convention Centre, Marina Bay Sands, Singapore, and is expected to attract 3,500 delegates from more than 30 countries.
Role purpose
The Sponsorship & Exhibition Sales Manager is responsible for generating sponsorship and exhibition revenue for IFFW 2027. The role covers the full sales cycle, from prospecting and proposal through to contract, payment and client servicing up to and during the event. The role holder will also support the Executive Director on strategic accounts and commercial projects.
As 2027 is the inaugural edition, there is no prior-year client base to renew. The role holder will build the sponsor and exhibitor base from the ground up, and should enjoy new-business selling.
Key responsibilities
Sales and business development
Identify, qualify and approach prospective sponsors and exhibitors across the fuels, energy, aviation, maritime and transport sectors.
Engage senior decision-makers, including heads of commercial, business development and marketing, to understand their objectives and recommend the right mix of sponsorship, exhibition and branding.
Sell sponsorship packages and add-on opportunities in line with the approved rate card.
Sell exhibition space, advising clients on stand options, locations and applicable charges.
Follow up leads generated by marketing campaigns by phone and email, and convert them into qualified opportunities.
Develop and maintain working relationships with exhibition and stand-building agencies.
Represent IFFW at selected industry events to generate new business.
Track competing events and sponsorship trends across the energy and transport sectors, and feed market insight back to the Executive Director.
Client management
Act as the principal point of contact for assigned sponsors and exhibitors from contract through to the close of the event.
Work with the marketing, programme and operations teams to align sales campaigns, floorplan planning and the delivery of sponsor and exhibitor entitlements as contracted.
Sales administration and reporting
Prepare proposals, quotations and contracts, and follow up to ensure timely signature and payment.
Maintain accurate records of the floorplan and sold sponsorship inventory to prevent double allocation.
Maintain the sales pipeline in the CRM and report weekly to the Executive Director on pipeline, bookings, revenue forecast and market feedback.
At the event
Look after sponsors and exhibitors on site and strengthen relationships face to face.
Run the rebooking campaign for the 2028 edition, securing commitments from current sponsors and exhibitors during the show.
Meet prospective sponsors among the delegates and exhibitors to build next year's pipeline.
Supporting the Executive Director
Prepare briefing notes, proposals and follow-ups for the Executive Director's meetings with senior sponsors, partners and government agencies.
Support strategic and high-value accounts that the Executive Director leads directly, from first meeting through to contract.
Follow up commercial leads from the Executive Director's network, speaking engagements and roadshow events.
Take on ad hoc commercial projects as the event develops, such as new sponsorship products or partner programmes.
Qualifications and experience
Essential
At least three years of experience in B2B sales, preferably in sponsorship, exhibition or conference sales.
Experience managing the full sales cycle, from lead generation through to contract and payment.
A record of closing high-value sponsorship deals, with the confidence to negotiate face to face with VP and C-level buyers.
Demonstrated record of achieving or exceeding sales targets.
Strong negotiation, presentation and written communication skills, including the preparation of tailored commercial proposals.
Ability to manage multiple accounts and deadlines with minimal supervision.
Willingness to travel.
Desirable
Established relationships with exhibition or stand-building agencies in Singapore or the wider region.
Familiarity with the energy, aviation, maritime or transport sectors.
Experience selling a launch or first-edition event.
Working knowledge of Salesforce or a comparable CRM.
Experience selling sponsorship for digital or virtual events as well as physical ones.
Proficiency in Mandarin or another foreign language.
What we offer
A competitive base salary and a commission scheme linked to sponsorship and exhibition revenue, commensurate with experience.
A founding role on a new international event planned to run annually, with scope to grow as the event grows.
Direct working access to the Executive Director, and to senior industry and government contacts across the region.

Interested candidates should submit a CV and a brief cover note outlining relevant sales experience. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Title: Sr. Partner Manager
Description:
Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.
Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.
Our vision: A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.
About the Role:
You'll own your outcomes, from the strategies you run to the conversations that shape what we build next. Wrike is looking for an ambitious, strategic Sr. Partner Manager - SEA to lead and scale our channel ecosystem across Southeast Asia. Sitting within the Global Channels & Alliances organization, this is a hands-on, 0-1 builder role designed to expand our partner footprint and accelerate regional ARR growth. You will own the end-to-end partner strategy across the region; identifying, onboarding, and co-selling with top-tier Referral partners, Systems Integrators (SIs), Value-Added Resellers (VARs), and Hyperscalers. You will act as the principal architect of our SEA ecosystem, leveraging AI-driven workflows and modern Go-To-Market strategies to multiply Wrike’s market presence.
Your Impact:
- Architect SEA Channel Strategy: Design and execute a 0-1 partner expansion framework that drives regional ARR across targeted SEA markets.
- Build Ecosystem Alliances: Establish, nurture, and scale high-value relationships with Referral partners, SIs, VARs, and Hyperscalers.
- Drive Co-Selling & Revenue: Collaborate closely with Wrike Sales teams and channel partners to joint-sell, land new accounts, and expand existing enterprise footprints.
- Leverage AI for Growth: Integrate advanced AI tools and automated workflows into channel management, partner enablement, and pipeline forecasting to maximize operational efficiency and scale.
- Enable Partner Capability: Deliver impactful training, sales enablement, and go-to-market resources to partner organizations to build Wrike expertise and quota capacity.
Your Qualifications:
- Experience: 5+ years of experience in channel management, partner ecosystems, or alliance business development in Southeast Asia.
- Channel Expertise: Proven track record of managing multi-channel programs including Referral partners, Systems Integrators (SIs), VARs, and Hyperscalers.
- Track Record: Demonstrated history of exceeding revenue targets and quota achievements in enterprise B2B SaaS.
- Builder Mindset: Strong passion and experience in 0-1 execution, building channel operations and regional ecosystems from the ground up.
- Technical Savvy: High proficiency in leveraging modern AI tools and automated workflows to optimize partner operations, pipeline management, and outreach strategies.
Standout Qualities:
- Direct experience within the Collaborative Work Management (CWM) or Work Management software sector.
- Professional fluency in Mandarin or other regional Southeast Asian languages to effectively build relationships and conduct business with regional partners.
- Existing network of regional C-level partner relationships and enterprise alliance contacts across Southeast Asia.
Team Dynamics:
You will report directly to the Global Director of Partner Ecosystem within the Global Channels & Alliances team. You will work closely with Field Sales, Solution Engineers, Partner Marketing, and Regional Marketing to build cross-functional alignment and drive partner-led revenue.
Benefits & Perks:
- Private health insurance
- 20 days of PTO
- After 3 months’ service, paid leave builds up to 14 outpatient days and 60 hospitalisation days after 6 months. The 60 days include the 14 outpatient days.
- We also offer 500 USD for IT peripherals for newcomers.
Your recruitment buddy will be Tripti Sachan, Senior Recruiter.
Who Is Wrike And Our Culture
We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.
Hybrid work mode
Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.
While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.
Our persona
💡 Smart: We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.
💚 Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too!
🤗 Approachable: We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful.
Our culture and Values
🤩 Customer-Focused
We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.
🤝 Collaborative
We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.
🎨 Creative
We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.
💪 Committed
We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.

Title: Strategic AI, NeoClouds & NVIDIA Business Development Lead
Description:
About The Job
DDN is seeking a highly connected, commercially oriented Director of AI Sales to accelerate growth across APAC through strategic collaboration with NVIDIA, AI infrastructure providers, Neoclouds/NVIDIA Cloud Partners (NCPs), and the broader AI technology ecosystem.
This role will be reporting to worldwide vice president of NCP & AI Native sales and serve as the primary regional connector between DDN's APAC Sales organization, NVIDIA's regional sales and technical teams, key Neocloud/NCP partners, and DDN's NVIDIA headquarters organization. The Director will build relationships, identify opportunities, create alignment across organizations, and help DDN gain earlier and more strategic participation in major AI infrastructure opportunities.
This is primarily a business development and relationship leadership role, with approximately 80% of the focus on ecosystem engagement, relationship development, opportunity creation, and field collaboration, and 20% on technical fluency and solution positioning.
What Will You Do
NVIDIA Regional Engagement
- Build and maintain strong relationships with NVIDIA sales, business development, solution architecture, and ecosystem teams across APAC.
- Establish DDN as a trusted infrastructure partner for NVIDIA field teams pursuing strategic AI opportunities.
- Connect DDN account teams with the appropriate NVIDIA sales and technical resources and identify NVIDIA-influenced opportunities early.
- Work closely with DDN's NVIDIA HQ team to navigate NVIDIA organizational structures, executive relationships, technical influencers, and decision-makers.
- Ensure regional intelligence and field activity are connected back to DDN's broader global NVIDIA strategy.
Neocloud & NCP Development
- Identify and develop relationships with Neoclouds, GPU cloud providers, NVIDIA Cloud Partners, sovereign AI providers, and emerging AI infrastructure companies across APAC.
- Map key decision-makers, technical influencers, investors, customers, and ecosystem relationships surrounding priority AI infrastructure providers.
- Connect DDN field teams to emerging Neocloud/NCP opportunities and help coordinate multi-party pursuit strategies.
- Identify expansion opportunities within established AI infrastructure customers and new opportunities with emerging providers.
- Help DDN understand where GPU capacity is being deployed across APAC and which organizations are likely to become important future AI infrastructure buyers.
Regional AI Business Development
- Serve as a business development overlay to DDN's APAC sales organization for strategic AI opportunities.
- Collaborate with Account Executives, Sales Engineers, Strategic AI sellers, partner teams, and regional leadership on account and opportunity strategies.
- Create connections across customers, NVIDIA, Neoclouds, technology partners, and DDN resources that improve DDN's ability to win.
- Develop account and ecosystem maps for priority AI opportunities and support executive meetings, partner engagements, and strategic pursuits.
- Identify emerging trends, companies, workloads, and investment patterns that should influence DDN's regional strategy.
AI Ecosystem & Technology Partnerships
- Identify ISVs and technology partners that are becoming influential in AI infrastructure buying decisions.
- Work with DDN's ISV and Technical Alliances organization to develop relationships and joint motions with priority software and platform partners.
- Understand where orchestration, data platforms, inference technologies, AI frameworks, and security platforms influence infrastructure decisions.
Technical & Solution Fluency
- Maintain working knowledge of DDN's AI infrastructure portfolio and its role in GPU-intensive environments.
- Understand at a high level how storage, networking, data movement, GPU utilization, training, inference, checkpointing, and AI data pipelines affect infrastructure architecture.
- Understand NVIDIA's major AI infrastructure architectures, platforms, and ecosystem motions sufficiently to identify where DDN adds value.
- Recognize when deeper technical engagement is required and bring the appropriate DDN Solution Engineering, Solution Architecture, Field CTO, Product, or Engineering resources into the opportunity.
- Translate technical differentiation into customer and partner business value.
GEOGRAPHIC SCOPE
The role will cover APAC and requires the ability to operate across highly diverse markets, cultures, business practices, and stages of AI infrastructure adoption. The successful candidate will prioritize markets with significant GPU investment, Neocloud activity, sovereign AI initiatives, hyperscale infrastructure development, and AI-native company formation. Frequent travel throughout the region and close collaboration across time zones will be expected.
What Will You Bring
- 10+ years of experience in enterprise technology sales, business development, alliances, AI infrastructure, cloud, data infrastructure, or related markets.
- Strong track record of developing executive and field relationships across complex technology ecosystems.
- Demonstrated ability to create opportunities through relationships and ecosystem engagement rather than relying solely on traditional direct selling.
- Experience working collaboratively with field sales and technical organizations.
- Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure and the evolving AI technology ecosystem.
- Ability to engage credibly with sales executives, technical leaders, partners, customers, and senior executives.
- Excellent executive communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills; ability to operate independently in an entrepreneurial environment.
Preferred Experience
- Existing relationships within NVIDIA or the NVIDIA partner ecosystem.
- Experience with Neoclouds, GPU cloud providers, NCPs, hyperscalers, AI infrastructure companies, or AI-native organizations.
- Experience with GPU infrastructure, HPC, high-performance storage, networking, cloud infrastructure, or AI data platforms.
- Familiarity with NVIDIA DGX, SuperPOD, reference architectures, accelerated computing, and AI infrastructure concepts.
- Experience working with AI software vendors, data platforms, orchestration technologies, or emerging accelerator providers.
- Experience developing business across multiple APAC markets.
- Native Chinese language proficiency would be a beneficial thought not mandatory.
LEADERSHIP CHARACTERISTICS
- Relationship Builder - creates trusted connections across organizations and turns relationships into productive engagement.
- Ecosystem Thinker - understands how customers, GPU providers, Neoclouds, ISVs, integrators, and infrastructure vendors interact.
- Commercially Oriented - connects ecosystem activity to pipeline, customer access, competitive advantage, and revenue.
- Technically Credible - understands AI infrastructure sufficiently to identify opportunity and engage the right technical resources.
- Highly Collaborative - makes regional sales and technical teams more successful rather than competing with them.
- Entrepreneurial and Externally Focused - seeks emerging opportunities and spends significant time in the market building DDN's presence.
- Culturally Agile - operates effectively across the diverse business environments that make up APAC.
MEASURES OF SUCCESS
- Strength and breadth of DDN's relationships with NVIDIA teams across APAC.
- NVIDIA-influenced and ecosystem-influenced pipeline creation.
- Number and quality of joint DDN/NVIDIA customer engagements.
- Identification and development of priority Neocloud/NCP relationships.
- Earlier DDN engagement in strategic AI infrastructure opportunities.
- Increased connectivity between DDN regional sellers and NVIDIA field teams.
- Expansion of DDN's relationships across the broader AI technology ecosystem.
- Strategic intelligence provided to DDN leadership regarding emerging AI customers, partners, workloads, and market shifts.

Title: Vice President, Regional HR Business Partner – Audit, Risk & Credit (Location Agnostic) (Job ID: 10079694)
Description:
A leading global financial institution is seeking a Vice President, Regional Human Resources Business Partner, to join their dynamic team. This pivotal role offers you the opportunity to shape and deliver high-impact people strategies across multiple regions, working closely with senior leaders and key stakeholders. You will be empowered to drive talent management initiatives, foster inclusion, and support organisational growth through strategic HR advisory. The organisation is committed to putting people first, investing in your development, and providing a flexible work environment that values diverse perspectives and collaboration. If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact on both business outcomes and employee experience, this is your chance to thrive in a supportive and forward-thinking workplace.
You will have the opportunity to influence regional and global HR strategy by partnering directly with senior leadership teams, ensuring alignment with business objectives and talent priorities.
The organisation offers a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and flexibility, enabling you to connect with colleagues across APAC, EMEA, and the Americas while enjoying scheduling flexibility for global connectivity.
Your expertise will be valued as you lead critical change initiatives, drive succession planning, champion diversity and inclusion, and enhance employee wellbeing within a highly respected financial group.
What you'll do:
As Vice President, Regional Human Resources Business Partner, you will play an integral role in shaping the people agenda for the organisation’s regional business functions. Your day-to-day activities will involve building strong partnerships with senior leaders to understand their strategic priorities and translating these into actionable HR solutions. You will act as a connector between global HR teams and local business units, ensuring seamless delivery of talent management initiatives such as succession planning, performance evaluation, recruitment strategy alignment, and employee development. By leveraging your knowledge of best practice HR approaches and market insights, you will proactively identify optimisation opportunities for structural change while fostering an inclusive culture that supports diverse talent. Your success in this role will be measured by your ability to drive collaborative outcomes across multiple regions—balancing stakeholder needs with organisational goals—and your commitment to enhancing employee experience through wellbeing programmes and effective communication.
Build trusted advisor relationships with regional business function heads and their leadership teams to deliver impactful people priorities aligned with the firm’s talent strategy.
Act as a strategic partner to understand business needs, develop tailored HR solutions, and drive talent management initiatives across assigned organisations.
Represent HR at regional business forums, managing relationships between broader HR teams and business units at a regional level.
Collaborate with Centres of Expertise (CoE) to implement operating models based on design principles and business area responsibilities.
Lead regional change initiatives in partnership with global HR leads and relevant stakeholders to embed people priorities into the business function.
Coach leaders on engagement and retention of key talent while supporting talent review processes for high-potential individuals regionally.
Partner with Talent Acquisition teams to anticipate future recruitment needs, ensuring alignment with human capital plans and overseeing senior appointments.
Support performance management processes by guiding annual goal setting, mid-year reviews, moderation of ratings, and compensation calibration exercises.
Drive succession planning by identifying critical roles, developing successor pipelines, creating development plans, and embedding inclusion into culture and decision-making.
Promote employee wellbeing by collaborating on action plans, engaging in employee listening methods, and implementing solutions that protect and enhance wellbeing.
What you bring:
To excel as Vice President, Regional Human Resources Business Partner, you will bring extensive experience from previous roles where you have partnered closely with senior leaders within complex matrixed environments. Your proven ability to develop strategic HR solutions that align with business objectives will be complemented by strong interpersonal skills—enabling you to build trust across cultures while balancing stakeholder needs. You are adept at managing cyclical talent processes such as performance reviews or compensation calibration exercises; your analytical mindset allows you to interpret data effectively for informed decision-making. Discretion is second nature when dealing with sensitive information; your communication style is polished yet empathetic whether coaching managers or presenting recommendations at board level. A deep understanding of current employment regulations ensures compliance throughout all activities while your resourcefulness helps identify alternate paths for achieving results. Your educational background includes at least a bachelor’s degree alongside practical expertise gained from overseeing budgets/resources within large organisations.
Minimum 10 years of experience in an HR business partner or similar role at a global or regional level within a matrixed environment is essential for success in this position.
Proven track record of developing and implementing strategic HR initiatives that contribute meaningfully to achieving business objectives and improving overall performance.
Demonstrated ability to partner with senior leaders and collaborate effectively with key stakeholders to create joint expectations and deliverables.
Strong interpersonal skills including collaboration, influence, empathy, sensitivity to cultural differences, and the ability to manage competing priorities while achieving results.
Deep understanding of generalist HR practices including large-scale cyclical talent management activities such as performance evaluation and compensation processes.
Exceptional discretion when handling confidential information coupled with tactful communication skills suitable for presenting at the highest levels of leadership.
High degree of adaptability combined with resilience; comfortable navigating complex organisational structures while maintaining attention to detail.
Highly numerate with proficiency in analysing data using Microsoft Office applications (PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Outlook, Teams) to support data-driven decisions.
Solid knowledge of HR policies/procedures as well as employment/labour laws relevant to regional operations; experience overseeing budgets/resources is required.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is mandatory; additional qualifications related to human resources or organisational development are advantageous.
What sets this company apart:
This organisation stands out as one of the world’s most respected financial institutions—valuing long-term relationships not only with clients but also among its employees. The company’s vision centres around trustworthiness: putting people first by listening actively to new ideas from diverse backgrounds. Employees are encouraged to own their careers through access to training opportunities supported by knowledgeable colleagues who foster communal growth. Flexible working arrangements are available so you can connect globally without sacrificing work-life balance; generous pension contributions further demonstrate commitment towards your wellbeing. The leadership team is renowned for its supportive approach—championing inclusion objectives that recruit develop retain under-represented talent whilst nurturing an environment where every voice matters. Joining this organisation means becoming part of a network dedicated both professionally personally towards shared sustainable growth—a place where making an impact is genuinely rewarded.

Description:
ABOUT WORLD TABLE TENNIS
World Table Tennis is where the sport’s fiercest battles meet bold ideas and creative minds. WTT is powered by a global crew of innovators, storytellers, and game-changers, who bring energy, expertise, and imagination to everything they do.
We’re not your typical workplace; we’re the global engine behind a sport on the rise. So whether it’s staging iconic global events or redefining fan experiences, this is where bold ideas get built, and where every role has impact. At WTT, the arena simply hits different.
WTT ENGAGEMENT SPECIALIST
The WTT Engagement Specialist will support initiatives that connect fans with WTT, its players, and events. Working closely with internal teams and external partners, the role will help deliver engaging campaigns, content, and experiences that grow audience participation and strengthen fan relationships across digital platforms and live events.
RESPONSIBILITIES
STAKEHOLDER ENGAGEMENT
Deliver the department's engagement plan in key markets to agreed priorities and timelines.
Build and maintain day-to-day relationships with local organising committees, host cities, Member Associations, players, commercial partners, broadcasters and other local organisations.
Place the department's content, campaigns and stories with the partners best positioned to amplify them, adapting materials to each market.
Support the localisation of WTT communications, including language adaptation and coordination with local partners and agencies.
Grow local fan and community engagement to deepen WTT's impact in market.
EVENT PROMOTION SUPPORT
Attend WTT events in market to support engagement activity on the ground.
Work with these stakeholders to meet their PR and marketing requirements around each event.
Coordinate resource allocation, process management and support from WTT's owned platforms and media.
REPORTING
Maintain accurate records of stakeholder contacts, activity and outcomes.
Report on engagement results after each event.

Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Business, or a related field.
2–4 years of experience in stakeholder relations, partnership support, community engagement, event marketing, or a comparable outward-facing role.
Experience managing relationships with external organisations or partners, including day-to-day communication and follow-through.
Experience working to an event or campaign calendar.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and any one of these languages (Mandarin, Japanese, French).
Strong relationship-building skills, with confidence in initiating contact with external organisations.
Cultural awareness and sound judgement in adapting communication and approach to different markets and partners.
A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively across teams.
